discussions.title: Bug: tool calls are dropped against servers that send null in continuation deltas (id/name overwritten, every call becomes UNKNOWN_TOOL)
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

`dsh-llm-deepseek` loses a streamed tool call's `id` and `name` against any server that spells "unchanged" as an explicit `null` instead of omitting the key. Every tool call then reaches the executor unnamed and is rejected as `UNKNOWN_TOOL`, so the harness serves conversation but cannot complete a single tool call. One-line-per-field fix, plus tests, on a branch linked below.

I read `CONTRIBUTING.md` — external PRs are not being accepted right now, so this is a report rather than a pull request. The branch is there purely so the patch and its tests are cherry-pickable; please treat it as attached evidence, not a submission.

## Environment

- `deepseek-harness` at `47f94385` (`0.1.0-rc.5`), built from source, Node 22.22.1
- Profile: `headless`, adapter `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` (`deepseek-official` route)
- Endpoint: a self-hosted SGLang server serving `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731`, reached by setting `baseURL` in a `--patch` overlay. It speaks the DeepSeek dialect natively — `thinking: {"type": "enabled"}` and `reasoning_effort` are accepted, and `reasoning_content` comes back separated — so nothing about the request side is unusual.

Plain chat works. Anything that needs a tool does not.

## Symptom

Every tool call fails identically, whatever the tool:

```json
{"type":"tool/result","data":{"message":{"content":[{"type":"tool-result",
 "content":[{"type":"text","text":"Error: unknown tool \"\""}],"isError":true}]},
 "error":{"name":"ToolNotFoundError","code":"UNKNOWN_TOOL"}}}
```

The corresponding `tool/call` event shows well-formed `arguments` with an empty `name` and an empty `callId`:

```json
{"type":"tool/call","data":{"turn":1,"step":1,"callId":"","name":"",
 "arguments":"{\"file_path\": \"/…/package.json\", \"limit\": 1}"}}
```

The failure mode matters more than the error. `unknown tool ""` names nothing the model can act on, so it retries the same call a few times and then answers from invention. Asked to print the first line of a `package.json`, the run returned a fabricated file plus a footnote that "repeated tool-invocation errors prevented those calls from executing" — a wrong answer delivered with a plausible excuse. From the outside this reads as a model that ignores its tools, not as a decoding defect, which is why it is worth a report even though the fix is small.

## Root cause

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` (in the `delta.tool_calls` loop):

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

A tool call carries its identity once: the first delta for a wire `index` holds `id` and `function.name`, and later deltas for that index carry only an `arguments` fragment. `!== undefined` accepts `null` as a value, so on a server that sends explicit nulls each continuation delta overwrites the identity the first delta captured. By the last fragment both are `null`, and `closeBlock` emits `id: CallId('')` / `name: ''`.

`WireToolCallDelta` in `types.ts` declares `id?: string` and `name?: string`, so the type says the key is simply absent. That is true of the official API and not of every server implementing the same schema — and it is what makes the `undefined` comparison look sufficient. (`WireDelta.reasoning_content` in the same file is already `string | null`, so the nullable spelling is not new to this wire.)

## Wire evidence

Live capture from the endpoint above, one tool call, trimmed to the fields at issue:

```
# first delta — identity present
"tool_calls":[{"id":"call_4b73c2daf341492892dbd6e3","index":0,"type":"function",
               "function":{"name":"read_file","arguments":""}}]

# continuation deltas — identity explicitly nulled
"tool_calls":[{"id":null,"index":0,"type":"function",
               "function":{"name":null,"arguments":"{"}}]
"tool_calls":[{"id":null,"index":0,"type":"function",
               "function":{"name":null,"arguments":"\"path\": \"/etc/hostname\"}"}}]
```

I do not think the server is at fault here. Both fields are optional in the chunk schema, and a server that serializes its response model without excluding unset fields emits every unset optional as `null`. The rest of the same delta shows exactly that: `"role":null,"content":null,"reasoning_content":null` sit beside the nulled tool-call fields. Absence and `null` are two spellings of the same statement, and the adapter currently understands only one of them.

## Reproduce

Point the `deepseek-official` route at any OpenAI-compatible server that serializes unset optionals as `null` (SGLang does by default), then ask for anything requiring a tool:

```sh
dsh --profile headless --patch ./selfhosted.cordis.patch.yml \
  "Run 'git rev-parse --short HEAD' and reply with only that hash."
```

Before the fix: `Error: unknown tool ""` on every step, then an invented answer. After: the hash.

For a unit-level repro with no server at all, feed `translate` a first delta carrying `id`/`name` followed by continuations whose `id` and `function.name` are `null`; the assembled `block-end` comes back with `id: ''` and `name: ''`.

## Fix

Record both spellings in the wire type and assign only on a non-nullish value:

```ts
if (call.id != null) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name != null) block.name = call.function.name
```

Branch: https://github.com/zhoukuncheng/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/tool-call-null-delta-identity (single commit `21564bce5e`, cherry-pick freely — no attribution needed).

It contains the two guards, `WireToolCallDelta` widened to `string | null | undefined` with the JSDoc stating that omission and `null` both mean "unchanged", two unit cases, and a bilingual `bug-fix` Agent Note per `AGENTS.md`.

The two cases cover a single call whose continuations null out both fields, and two parallel calls whose continuations arrive interleaved and out of index order. Both fail against the previous guard and pass after it, so they hold the behavior rather than describe it. The existing cases for the omitted spelling are untouched and still pass, which is what keeps the official-API path covered — behavior there is unchanged, since an omitted key is nullish under either guard.

Checks run on the branch: `pnpm run test packages/llm/llm-deepseek` 153/153 (151 before, +2), `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run lint`, and `pnpm run doc-sync` all clean, plus the `lefthook` pre-commit gates.

## Two smaller things found alongside

Neither is a bug, but both cost me time and might be worth a line in the docs:

1. Running the source entry from another working directory fails at import: `node --import tsx/esm <repo>/apps/cli/src/bin.ts` from outside the repository root gives `SyntaxError: The requested module '@deepseek-ai/cordis' does not provide an export named 'FiberState'`. Since the invoking directory is the workspace root and there is no `--cwd`, using `dsh` against another project from a source checkout means invoking the built `apps/cli/lib/bin.js`. `pnpm dsh` works, but only from the repository root.

2. Launcher flags must precede app flags, which the reference does state — but the failure is confusing in one direction: `dsh web --port 3099 --patch ./x.yml` reports `error: unknown option '--patch'`, because `--port` already started the app's arguments and the web app then rejects `--patch` as its own. `dsh web --patch ./x.yml --port 3099` is fine.

Thanks for open-sourcing this — the plugin tree and the session log made the root cause a five-minute read rather than a guessing game.

discussions.title: [Bug] In-flight settings write can leave a replacement registration indefinitely stale
discussions.body:
## Summary

A settings namespace can remain indefinitely stale when it is re-registered while the previous registration's write is waiting for `persist()`.

Tested on `master` at commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`.

## Reproduction

1. Register a namespace whose current user setting is `{ "theme": "dark" }`.
2. Start an update to `{ "theme": "light" }` with a settings provider whose `persist()` is delayed.
3. Dispose the original registration while the persist is in flight.
4. Register the same namespace again before the persist completes.
5. Let the original persist finish and inspect storage, `describe()`, and the replacement registration.

Observed result:

```text
replacement before persist completes: { theme: "dark" }
persisted document:                 { theme: "light" }
describe() user value:              { theme: "light" }
replacement resolved value:         { theme: "dark" }
```

After the in-flight write completes, the replacement registration does not converge to the value that is already on disk and in the settings document.

## Expected behavior

After the in-flight write reaches storage, the current owner of the namespace should be resolved from that persisted section, so runtime state, `describe()`, and storage agree.

## Root cause

After `await this.persist(ns, section)`, the document cache is updated unconditionally, but the commit is skipped when the namespace owner changed. The replacement registration is not re-resolved:

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts#L634-L643

This can be particularly persistent for a file-backed provider if its watcher suppresses the process's own write event.

## Suggested fix

After persistence, re-resolve and commit the current registration when it differs from the original registration, or serialize namespace replacement behind pending writes. A regression test should delay `persist()`, replace the registration, then assert that the replacement receives the persisted value.

discussions.title: [提案] produced-file 打开动作可拦截 (含补丁分支与测试)
discussions.body:
## 提案：produced-file 打开动作可拦截（含补丁分支）

### 问题
`ui-deliverables` 的 ProducedFiles 行打开动作硬编码调用 Host opener（`openFile`），客户端插件无法把点击路由到自己的视图（例如在侧边栏打开而非系统查看器）。这与 README 的插件化理念（"everything is a plugin"）不符。

### 方案（已实现 + 测试，补丁在分支）
- `routeFileOpen(interceptors, fallback, path)`：零依赖纯函数——第一个返回 `true` 的拦截器接管，否则回退 Host opener
- `ProducedFiles` 经 inject face 接收 `fileOpenInterceptors`；文件 chip 与「在文件夹中显示」都走拦截路由
- `registerFileOpenInterceptor(fn)` 供客户端插件注册（返回注销函数）；fiber 销毁清空注册表（HMR 安全）

**补丁分支**：`https://github.com/Electricitysheep/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/deliverables-file-open-interceptor`（commit `fd4b4d5`，4 文件，+205/-5）

### 测试
- `routeFileOpen` 单元用例 + ProducedFiles 组件用例（接管/回退/链停止/folder 路由）+ 插件注册级用例（注册/注销/fiber 销毁清空），已写入 `tests/produced-files.client.spec.tsx`
- `routeFileOpen` 本机零依赖隔离环境 5/5 通过；组件/插件级用例依赖 dsh web 运行时（ModuleLoader），待仓库 CI

### 后续
已知 CONTRIBUTING 说明当前不接受外部 PR——本贴供评估与后续采纳；如需调整方向（例如改为官方内置的 interceptor 服务而非模块级注册表），欢迎讨论。补丁亦可随时迁移到社区插件实现。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-tool-policy | Declarative allow / ask / deny policies for tool calls
discussions.body: Hi! I'm maintaining **dsh-tool-policy**, an unofficial community plugin that adds a small, declarative policy layer to DeepSeek Harness tool execution. Repository: https://github.com/Drifter-yh/dsh-tool-policy Latest release: https://github.com/Drifter-yh/dsh-tool-policy/releases/tag/v0.2.0 > This is a community-maintained plugin and is not an official DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness component. ## What it does `dsh-tool-policy` hooks into `tools/pre-execute` and evaluates tool calls before execution using ordered `allow`, `ask`, and `deny` rules. **Demo note:** `ask` fails closed here because this minimal Loader demo does not install an approval answerer; only the `allow`ed `read_file` tool body executes. For example: ```yaml defaultDecision: deny rules: - tool: 'read_*' decision: allow - tool: 'bash' decision: ask reason: 'Shell execution requires approval.' - tool: 'delete_*' decision: deny reason: 'Destructive tools are blocked.' ``` The first matching rule wins, and defaultDecision handles unmatched calls, making default-deny policies straightforward to express. An allow decision delegates to the remaining Harness tool pipeline, so later policy listeners or guards may still prevent execution. Conceptually: ```text Tool Call ↓ dsh-tool-policy ↓ Policy Match ↓ allow / ask / deny ↓ DeepSeek Harness ``` New in v0.2.0: policy decision tracing v0.2.0 adds an opt-in, argument-free decision trace: ```yaml trace: true ``` When enabled, the plugin logs: * tool name * the decision produced by this plugin * matched rule number, or the default-policy path * decision reason for ask / deny Parsed tool arguments are never copied into the trace. Tracing is disabled by default and best-effort: logger failures do not change the allow / ask / deny result. The goal is to make a common debugging question easier to answer: Why did this tool call receive this policy decision? This trace is intentionally limited in scope. It does not replace Harness session auditing, sandboxing, or other execution boundaries. What’s next I’m currently exploring: * reusable routing-oriented policy presets * copyable MCP, filesystem, and unattended-agent policy recipes * compatibility validation against the first stable Harness release Real-world policy examples would be especially useful — particularly MCP and unattended-agent setups where deciding what should be allow, ask, or deny gets interesting. Feedback and contributions are welcome!

discussions.title: First-run "npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web" gives zero progress feedback for 8+ minutes on Windows
discussions.body:
### Environment
- OS: Windows 10 (git-bash / MSYS shell)
- Node v22.23.2, npm 11.12.1
- Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (fresh `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, no prior cache)

### Repro
1. Run `npx --yes @deepseek-ai/dsh web` on a machine without the package cached.
2. Observe: for ~8 minutes the only output is npm deprecation warnings (`npm warn deprecated node-domexception@1.0.0: ...`). No install progress, no build stage, no "server starting".
3. Port 3080 is not listening the entire time; the process looks hung.
4. Finally `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080` appears and everything works.

### Impact
- Users (especially on slow networks, common in China) will think the install is stuck and kill the process.
- No way to distinguish "downloading" from "building" from "starting".
- The first-run experience is the first impression of the product.

### Expected
- Phase indicators on first run: `installing dependencies… / building… / starting server…` (or a spinner), or at minimum a printed note "first run downloads dependencies, this can take several minutes".
- Consider documenting npm mirror configuration (`registry.npmmirror.com`) for CN users, and/or making the progress output visible through the npm lifecycle.

discussions.title: Workspace .env bootstrap-only entries abort dsh web startup
discussions.body:
## Problem

`dsh web` discovers the `.env` in its invoking directory. If that file contains a bootstrap-only name such as `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`, app boot throws before the Web UI opens—even when the file belongs to another application in the same workspace.

## Reproduction

```dotenv
# .env in the invoking directory
DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL=https://example.invalid
APP_SETTING=kept
```

```console
dsh web
```

Current behavior: startup aborts while reading `.env`.

Expected behavior: refuse the protected file value, explain how to set it in the launching environment, and continue booting with accepted entries from the same file. The security boundary requires rejecting the value; it does not require rejecting the whole launch.

## Suggested behavior

- Match protected names case-insensitively, as today.
- Warn once for each protected file entry and omit it from both `process.env` and `LaunchEnvironmentSnapshot`.
- Continue applying accepted entries from the project and Harness-home `.env` files.
- Keep inherited launch-environment values allowed.
- Add no flag or escape hatch; the command remains `dsh web`.

## Patch

I prepared a focused patch on my fork:

- Branch: https://github.com/Lancetwang/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/tolerate-protected-dotenv
- Commit: https://github.com/Lancetwang/deepseek-harness/commit/a86eb229ed21166ebf8ce606c76286a70a6f2d23

Verification completed: 52 focused app-boot tests; 124 related tests with 100% coverage for the changed source; lint, build, typecheck, and an unchanged-command built-CLI smoke test. Documentation sync passed 27/28 gates; the remaining Windows symlink-escape fixture could not create its test symlink on this host (`EPERM`).

The repository currently does not accept external PRs per `CONTRIBUTING.md`, so I am reporting the issue here and leaving the commit available for review or cherry-pick.

discussions.title: [Bug] host.describe 返回硬编码版本 0.0.1，与实际版本 0.1.0-rc.5 不一致
discussions.body:
**环境**
- 源码 `master` @ `47f9438`
- 根 `package.json` / `apps/cli/package.json` 版本均为 `0.1.0-rc.5`

**现象**
`host.describe` RPC 返回的 `version` 字段恒为硬编码的 `0.0.1`，与实际包版本 `0.1.0-rc.5` 不一致。`version` 属于 host 域的公开 wire 契约字段（`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/host.ts` 定义 `version: string`，`api/host.schema.ts` 用 `z.string()` 校验）；连接握手成功后（`onConnected` 之前），`hostDescription` 会发布给所有客户端插件（`packages/client/connection`）。因此任何读取 `hostDescription.version` 的客户端/插件（例如「关于」页、按版本做兼容判断）都会拿到错误值。

**根因**
`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 中 `host.describe` 的实现：

```ts
describe(request) {
  // TODO: version should read apps/cli's package.json; placeholder for now.
  const selection = defaults.defaultModelSelection()
  return Promise.resolve(ok(request, {
    version: '0.0.1',
    ...
```

源码已有 `TODO` 自认这是占位符，本应读取 `apps/cli/package.json` 的版本。

**期望**
`version` 反映真实运行时版本（如 `0.1.0-rc.5`），或至少与 CLI 包版本保持一致。

**建议**
- 构建期注入，或运行时从 `apps/cli/package.json` 读取 `version`；
- 过渡期先移除 `0.0.1` 占位、明确该字段为「未发布」语义，避免客户端误判。

discussions.title: [Idea] dsh-memory：跨会话长期记忆插件（补上 memory 能力缺口）
discussions.body:
看到 #14 在求 memory 能力，也确认了 `packages/` 里目前没有独立的 memory 包。想提一个作为**社区插件**落地的方案，严格走「everything is a plugin」的 seam 设计。

## 定位

`dsh-memory`：给 agent 提供**跨会话长期记忆**。当前 agent 的上下文（session log、compaction、spill）都是「单会话内」的，会话结束后知识就没了；memory 补上「跨会话持久」这一环。

## 按 capability seam 三角色拆

**Service Definition** — `ctx.memory`：

```ts
interface MemoryService {
  remember(fact: string, opts?: { tags?: string[]; source?: string }): Promise<MemoryEntry>
  recall(query: string, opts?: { limit?: number }): Promise<MemoryEntry[]>
  forget(id: MemoryId): Promise<void>
}
```

**Service Provider** — 默认本地 JSONL store（存 Harness home 下），检索用轻量关键词 + 时间衰减排序，零重依赖；预留可换成向量库 / 远程的 provider。

**Consumer**（两处）：
- 模型可见工具 `memory_add` / `memory_search`，注册到 `ctx.tools`，schema 自动进入 prompt 组装；
- 自动注入：在 `agent/pre-step` 或 `agent.inject()` 处，按当前输入召回最相关的前 N 条，作为一段紧凑上下文注入。

## 符合仓库不变量

- 「model-visible ⟺ logged」：注入的记忆必须能从 session log 重建——把注入动作写成新的 session event，而不是在 prompt 里拼接不可追溯的文本。
- 纯插件、不动 agent-loop：所有挂点都是已文档化的扩展点（`ctx.tools` / `agent/*` / session event）。

## 为什么值得做

- 社区有直接需求（#14）；
- 官方仓库暂无 memory 包，缺口明确；
- 当前主流 agent harness 都在补 memory 能力，这是生态里能立刻产生差异化的一块。

## 落地方式

作为独立仓库（加 `dsh-plugin` topic）先出 MVP：本地 JSONL provider + 两个工具 + 自动注入；后续按反馈换 provider。

discussions.title: [Bug] Successful tool result is replaced with ABORTED when cancellation arrives after side effects
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a started tool does not immediately stop on its `AbortSignal`, a cancellation that arrives after the tool has committed an external side effect can replace the tool actual successful return value with a generic `ABORTED` result.

The runtime waits for the body promise to settle, constructs a success result from the returned value, and then discards that known result solely because the fused signal is aborted. The durable transcript therefore tells the model that the call was aborted even though the operation may have completed successfully. A later model step or resumed session can retry a non-idempotent operation and duplicate the side effect.

This is distinct from cancellation before dispatch or a process crash where the outcome is genuinely unknown.

## Affected revision

Audited at commit [`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a).

## Relevant code

- [`dispatchToolBody`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts#L1537-L1557) awaits `tool.execute(...)`, constructs `result`, then replaces it when `isAborted(signal)` is true.
- [`toolAbortedResult`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts#L1919-L1930) drops the successful content and metadata and returns only a generic abort error.

## Minimal reproduction sequence

1. Register a side-effecting tool whose body commits an external write and then waits before returning its success value.
2. Start the tool call and wait until the external write has committed.
3. Abort the caller signal before allowing the tool body promise to resolve. The body deliberately responds late to cancellation, as real subprocess/network tools can do.
4. Allow the body to return a successful result.
5. Observe that the external write occurred once, but the recorded tool result is `Error: tool call aborted` with code `ABORTED`.
6. A model seeing only that transcript can reasonably retry the call and perform the write a second time.

Pseudo-test:

```ts
let commits = 0
const gate = Promise.withResolvers<void>()

registerTool({
  name: "side-effect",
  async execute() {
    commits++ // external operation has committed
    await gate.promise
    return { content: [{ type: "text", text: "committed" }] }
  },
})

const controller = new AbortController()
const pending = executeTool({ name: "side-effect", signal: controller.signal })
await waitUntil(() => commits === 1)
controller.abort()
gate.resolve()

const result = await pending
// commits === 1, but result.error.info.code === "ABORTED"
```

## Expected behavior

Once a started tool body has returned successfully, the durable result should not erase that known outcome merely because cancellation arrived before the promise resolution was observed. The transcript must preserve enough truth to prevent blind retry of potentially non-idempotent work. Cancellation can still stop subsequent loop work or affect presentation without rewriting a known successful tool outcome as if it did not complete.

## Impact

This can duplicate writes, sends, purchases, deployments, or other non-idempotent actions after cancellation/resume. The risk is specifically caused by loss of a known successful result, not unavoidable uncertainty after a crash.

## Verification performed

Focused retry, tool-call, repair, and checkpoint-policy suites pass at the audited commit (76 tests total). The existing late-cancellation behavior is covered, but the test does not model a committed external side effect followed by model retry.

discussions.title: dsh 在部分 Windows 10 机器上因 koffi 原生崩溃而不可用（含症状/修复思路/修改过程）
discussions.body:
> 说明：本仓库 Issues 未开放，故发在 Discussion。环境为 Windows 10 Pro **19043 (21H1)** + Intel Core i5-5200U，Node v24.14.0，dsh 0.1.0-rc.6，koffi 2.16.3 / 3.1.4 均复现。

### 一、问题症状

1. **npm 安装失败**
   安装到 `koffi` 时报错：
   ```
   Failed to load prebuilt binary, rebuilding from source
   Error: CMake does not seem to be available
   ```
   首次 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 还会因为首次要装 500+ 包、且 npmmirror 逐条抓取很慢而看起来"卡死"。

2. **原生文件夹选择器崩溃**
   Web UI 里点"添加工作区"，报：
   ```
   directory picker failed: win32 folder dialog worker exited before reporting a result
   ```

3. **服务静默挂掉**
   dsh 能启动，但**页面加载 / 创建会话 / 保存会话**时进程直接崩溃退出（退出码 `3221225477` = `0xC0000005`，原生访问冲突），**无任何日志**（JS 无法捕获原生崩溃），表现为"服务突然没响应"。

4. **整体不可用**
   上述任一项都会中断正常使用流程。

### 二、根因与修复思路

**根因**：dsh 依赖链里的 **koffi**（FFI 库）win32-x64 预编译二进制在这台机器上**任何 FFI 操作（`koffi.load()`）即触发 `0xC0000005`**。koffi 在 dsh 中有 4 条 Windows 专属路径被用到：

| 包 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| koffi 自身 install 脚本 | 预编译可用性检测（子进程 `require(koffi)` 崩溃 → 误判 → 源码编译 → 缺 CMake → 安装失败） |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native` | 原生文件夹对话框（IFileOpenDialog） |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` | 会话持久化（MoveFileExW） |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local` | ACL 保留原子写（GetFileSecurityW / ReplaceFileW） |

**修复思路**：既然 koffi 在这台机器上不可用，就**绕开 dsh 对 koffi 的全部调用**，用纯 Node 实现顶替（这正是非 Windows 平台已有的行为）：
- 跳过 koffi 崩溃的安装检测脚本（预编译二进制照常作为 optional 依赖装入）
- 目录选择器改用 `-browse` 后端（Node stdlib 做目录浏览）
- 会话持久化、ACL 原子写改用 `fs.rename` 等标准 fs 操作

### 三、修改过程（3 处）

**① 安装（绕过 koffi install 脚本崩溃）**
```bash
npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh --ignore-scripts --registry=https://registry.npmjs.org
```
`--ignore-scripts` 跳过 koffi 的 `cnoke.cjs --prebuild` 检测脚本（它因 `require(koffi)` 崩溃而误判预编译不可用）；`@koromix/koffi-win32-x64` 作为 optional 依赖照常装入。dsh 本身没有必须运行的 install 脚本，跳过无副作用。

**② 目录选择器（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）**
禁用 `-auto`（启动时自动选 native 后端），插入 `-browse` 后端：
```yaml
- id: directory-picker
  disabled: true
- insert:
    - id: directory-picker-browse
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse'
    - id: directory-picker-browse-client
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'
```

**③ 两个包的 koffi 调用改为纯 Node（全局 node_modules 内）**

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local/lib/index.js` —— `writeFileAtomic` 的默认实现改为不触发 koffi：
```js
// 原来：
const copyFileDacl = internals.copyFileDacl ?? copyFileDaclWin32;
const replaceFile = internals.replaceFile ?? replaceFileWin32;
// 改为（跳过 Win32 ACL 复制/替换，保留 internals 覆盖能力）：
const copyFileDacl = internals.copyFileDacl ?? (async () => {});
const replaceFile = internals.replaceFile ?? ((replaced, replacement) => rename(replacement, replaced));
```

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js` —— `publishNewFileWin32` 改为 `fs.rename`（并在 fs/promises import 中补上 `rename`）：
```js
// 原来：
async function publishNewFileWin32(existing, replacement) {
	const api = await win32();  // 惰性加载 koffi → 本机崩溃
	if (api.moveFileExW(...) === 0) throw win32Error(...);
}
// 改为：
async function publishNewFileWin32(existing, replacement) {
	await rename(existing, replacement);
}
```

**代价**：丢失 Windows ACL 保留与 MoveFileExW 持久化增强（日常使用无感）。补丁为幂等脚本，`npm update` 后重跑 `patch-dsh.js` 即可（备份为 `*.bak-koffi`）。

### 四、最小复现（不依赖 dsh）

```bash
npm i @koromix/koffi-win32-x64@3.1.4
node -e "require('@koromix/koffi-win32-x64'); require('@koromix/koffi-win32-x64').load('kernel32.dll')"
```
- Node 父进程 `spawnSync` 捕获子进程退出码 `3221225477`（0xC0000005）。
- `require` 成功（能打印版本），崩溃发生在 `koffi.load()` / 进程退出。
- 对照：同环境下 `node-pty@1.1.0` 加载与退出正常（exit 0），排除"机器上所有原生模块都崩"。

### 五、已排查排除的原因

- ❌ Node 版本问题（v22.23.2 / v24.14.0 都崩）
- ❌ koffi 3.x 回归（2.16.3 也崩）
- ❌ 沙箱/工具链环境（cmd /c 与 PowerShell 直跑同样崩）
- ❌ VC++ 运行库缺失（vcruntime140 14.32 已装）
- ✅ 确认为 koffi win32-x64 预编译二进制与部分机器的兼容问题

### 六、给维护者的建议

1. 确认 koffi 是否有针对此类环境的修复版本，或提供"预编译检测失败时跳过而非源码编译"的开关（当前 `cnoke.cjs` 在 `require` 崩溃时误判并尝试源码编译，是第二个失败点）。
2. 建议 dsh 的 win32 路径在调用 koffi 前做可用性探测，失败时**降级到纯 Node 实现**而非让进程原生崩溃、静默挂掉。

discussions.title: Bug: vLLM self-hosted deployments stream thinking as delta.reasoning — adapter drops it (fix available)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Self-hosted DeepSeek deployments on vLLM stream thinking-mode CoT as `delta.reasoning` instead of the official `delta.reasoning_content`. `dsh-llm-deepseek` reads only the official field, so against such gateways every reasoning delta is silently dropped.

## Observed consequences (measured against a vLLM 0.25.2 deployment serving deepseek-v4-flash)

1. **Thinking is invisible** — no reasoning block reaches the session log or the UI.
2. **TTFT is inflated by the entire reasoning phase** — "first token" lands on the first *content* delta. One turn in a real session recorded a 199.9 s "TTFT"; a direct wire measurement of the same endpoint shows the first SSE chunk (a reasoning delta) arriving at **0.51 s**.
3. **Displayed tok/s is inflated** — `outputTokens` comes from `completion_tokens` (which includes reasoning tokens), while the decode window only spans visible text.

## Wire capture

```
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"reasoning":"We"}, ...}]}        <- dropped today
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"reasoning":" need answer"}, ...}]}
```

vs. the official API, which sends `delta.reasoning_content`.

## Root cause

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`: `const reasoning = delta?.reasoning_content` — the alias is never consulted.

## Fix available

Two-line fallback plus the `WireDelta` field declaration:

```ts
const reasoning = delta?.reasoning_content ?? delta?.reasoning
```

Branch with unit tests (alias accepted, official field preferred when both arrive), README note, and an Agent Note per repo policy: https://github.com/DiGuStudent/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/vllm-reasoning-field

Verified end-to-end against the vLLM endpoint after the patch: reasoning blocks are recorded, TTFT reflects the real first token, and the decode window spans the full generation.

I know external PRs are not accepted at the moment — filing this as a bug report per CONTRIBUTING.md; happy to open a PR with this branch whenever that changes, or adjust the approach if you'd rather handle the alias elsewhere.

discussions.title: dsh web fails after global pnpm install: loader cannot resolve ~88 plugin packages
discussions.body:
## Describe the bug

Installing `@deepseek-ai/dsh` as a **global pnpm package** and running `dsh web` fails to boot: the Cordis loader cannot resolve most plugin packages, producing a very long error dump.

## Environment

- `dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 (installed via `pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`)
- pnpm v11.17.0
- Node v24.x
- macOS

## To reproduce

```bash
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6
dsh web
```

**Expected:** boots and prints `dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:<port>`.

**Actual:** a long stack trace ending in

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): loader entries failed to apply
```

with a list of errors like:

```
Error: failed to import loader entry timer (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer): Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer' imported from .../@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js
Error: failed to import loader entry llm (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm): Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm' imported from .../@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js
Error: failed to import loader entry session (@deepseek-ai/dsh-session): Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session' imported from .../@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js
```

…and similar for ~88 packages (126 packages needed by the `web` profile, only 59 resolvable).

## Root cause analysis

Two independent issues combine under pnpm's global (symlinked) install layout:

### 1. `healProfilesModuleFallback` cannot traverse the transitive dependency closure

`healProfilesModuleFallback` in `dsh-app-boot` maintains the flat fallback dir `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` (one symlink per package in the app's dependency closure). It resolves each package with `packageDirFromAnchor`, which uses `createRequire(anchor).resolve.paths(...)` — a **string-path probe that does not follow symlinks**.

Under pnpm's global layout, `dsh`'s direct dependencies resolve fine (they sit next to the app), but the **transitive deps of bundle packages** (e.g. `dsh-web-app`'s deps like `dsh-llm`, `dsh-session`, `dsh-host-webserver`, `dsh-typert-registry`, …) live inside the pnpm content store and are **not reachable from the symlink anchor**, so the BFS silently drops them. Only ~59 direct deps get linked; the ~88 packages required by the `web` profile are missing from the fallback dir.

### 2. Loader requires `--expose-internals` for baseUrl-based plugin resolution

`cordis-plugin-loader`'s `import()` uses the internal Node ESM loader (which imports from `ctx.baseUrl`, i.e. the profile dir) **only when `ModuleLoader.fromInternal()` succeeds**, which requires the `--expose-internals` flag on the node process. Otherwise it falls back to plain ESM `import()` (external mode), which resolves relative to the **loader's own location inside the pnpm store** — where the plugin packages don't exist.

The pnpm-generated bin shim for `dsh` does not pass `--expose-internals`, so even with all symlinks in place, plugin resolution still fails.

## Workaround (local, not a fix)

- Symlink the ~88 missing packages from the pnpm content store into `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/` (plus 2 hidden `include`-referenced deps: `dsh-host-directory-picker-native`, `dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-native`), and
- patch the pnpm bin shim to invoke `node --expose-internals`.

## Suggested fixes

1. In `healProfilesModuleFallback` / `packageDirFromAnchor`: resolve symlinks (`realpath`) before probing, so the transitive closure is found under pnpm's symlinked layouts.
2. Make the `dsh` entrypoint always run with `--expose-internals` (shebang or shim), or make the loader's baseUrl-based (internal) import the default instead of an opt-in.

This makes the tool unusable for the most common install path (`pnpm add -g`), so it would be great to have it fixed before the stable release.

discussions.title: feat(web-fetch): 支持可选 HTTP 代理（proxyUrl 配置 + 环境变量回退）
discussions.body:
## 背景

`web_fetch` 目前只支持直连。在无法直连外网的网络环境里（例如 wikipedia 等站点被封锁），工具不可用；且 `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量对 Node undici 的 `fetch` 默认不生效，环境里配了代理也没用。

## 建议的改动

1. **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-fetch-http` 新增 `proxyUrl` 配置项**（纯 `http://` 代理 URL，如 `http://127.0.0.1:7897`）：
   - 未显式配置时回退到 `HTTPS_PROXY` / `HTTP_PROXY` / `ALL_PROXY` 环境变量；
   - `NO_PROXY` 与 loopback 主机始终绕过代理；
   - 实现只用 Node 内置模块（`http`/`https`/`net`/`tls`），**零新增依赖**：HTTP 目标走绝对形式请求行，HTTPS 目标走 CONNECT 隧道 + TLS（证书校验保持开启）；
   - 完整接入现有超时 / 中止信号、字节上限与重定向策略。
2. **standard / code preset 启用 `tool-web` 的 `fetch` 行**（`fetch: true`），让 `web_fetch` 开箱即用。

## 验证

- 单测 55/55 通过（新增 11 个代理相关用例：绝对形式路由、环境变量回退、NO_PROXY 绕过、CONNECT 拒绝、配置校验等）；
- 全量 host typecheck（`tsc -b tsconfig.host.json`）通过；
- 真实环境：经 `http://127.0.0.1:7897` 代理抓取 `https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Web_scraping` 返回 HTTP 200（直连超时）。

## 参考实现

改动已在 fork 分支 `live-long-and-prosper:feat/web-fetch-proxy`（2 个 commit，共 9 个文件），可 cherry-pick 或直接参考：
1. `feat(web-fetch-http): support an optional HTTP proxy for fetches`
2. `feat(agent-presets): enable the web_fetch tool in code and standard presets`

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Use OpenAI Codex OAuth as a primary LLM provider
discussions.body:
## Summary

Please support `openai-codex` (ChatGPT Plus/Pro OAuth) as a **primary LLM provider** in DeepSeek Harness, so users can select Codex models on the Models page instead of only invoking Codex as a subagent.

Tested against:

- npm: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`
- repository: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- pi-ai: `@earendil-works/pi-ai ^0.82.1`

## Current implementation evidence

Most provider-side building blocks already exist:

1. pi-ai ships the `openai-codex` provider, its model catalog, the `openai-codex-responses` protocol, browser/device-code OAuth, refresh logic, and `CredentialStore` integration.
2. DSH `llm-pi-ai` already materializes pi-ai catalog providers.
3. DSH intentionally withholds OAuth-only catalog routes from the configurable-provider directory because `PiAiAdapter` creates `Models` without a credential store and exposes only `resolveApiKey`.
4. The repository already ships `dsh-subagent-codex`, which delegates to the host `codex app-server` and reuses native Codex authentication, but this does not make Codex available as the parent session model.

The relevant code is in:

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` (`catalogProviderTakesApiKey` and the OAuth-only exclusion rationale)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/adapter.ts` (`createModels()` without `CredentialStore`)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/index.ts` (configurable-provider directory filtering)
- `packages/subagent/subagent-codex/` (working native-Codex delegation path)

## Expected behavior

- The Models page offers **OpenAI Codex**.
- A user can sign in with their own ChatGPT/Codex account through browser or device-code OAuth.
- The OAuth credential is persisted under DSH ownership with owner-only permissions and refreshed under a serialized store lock.
- Codex models can be selected as the default parent-session model.
- Sign-out removes only the DSH-owned credential.

## Security boundary

DSH should use its own OAuth login and credential store. It should **not read, copy, refresh, or overwrite `~/.codex/auth.json`**, because sharing a rotating refresh token between Codex CLI and DSH can invalidate one client and couples DSH to another products private file format.

## Suggested implementation

1. Add a structured OAuth credential store owned by DSH (or a small adapter from a secure DSH credential service to pi-ai `CredentialStore`).
2. Construct each immutable pi-ai `Models` snapshot with that shared store.
3. Add host RPC operations for auth status, login, cancellation, and logout; bridge pi-ai `AuthInteraction` events to the Web UI.
4. Offer OAuth-only providers when the runtime has a persistent store and login surface.
5. Add keyless tests for store serialization, refresh persistence, cancellation, redaction, and provider-directory visibility; keep real OAuth as an opt-in e2e.

Because the contribution guide currently says external pull requests are not accepted, would the maintainers prefer this as a first-party capability, or as an ecosystem `dsh-plugin`? I can prepare a focused implementation after the intended ownership boundary is confirmed.

discussions.title: Web UI crashes on LAN (non-localhost) access: crypto.randomUUID is not a function
discussions.body:
## Environment
  - dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (via npx @deepseek-ai/dsh)
  - Accessing the Web UI from another device on the same LAN (e.g. phone/pc at http://192.168.x.x:3080), not localhost

  ## Problem
  The Web UI only works when accessed via localhost/127.0.0.1. From a LAN IP, the page loads but the app crashes during
  boot:

  - Console: `crypto.randomUUID is not a function` (thrown by the agent-preset / permission / language UI components)
  - `WebSocket connection to 'ws://<lan-ip>:3080/api/events.mux' failed: WebSocket is closed before the connection is
  established`

  ## Root cause
  `crypto.randomUUID` is only available in secure contexts. Browsers treat `http://localhost` / `http://127.0.0.1` as
  secure, but `http://192.168.x.x` is NOT a secure context, so `crypto.randomUUID` is `undefined` and the client JS
  throws before the WebSocket/runtime can boot.

  ## Expected
  The Web UI should be usable from a LAN IP without requiring HTTPS, e.g. by polyfilling `crypto.randomUUID` (or using
  a non-secure-context-safe UUID source) in the frontend bundle.

  ## Additional related note
  Even after working around the above, cross-device use is further limited because `settings.describe` /
  `credentials.describe` (and other PRIVILEGED_METHODS) are gated to loopback only. Would be great to eventually allow
  full LAN use once an auth layer exists.

discussions.title: [Bug 报告] settings 密钥脱敏存在缺口：嵌套在 union/intersect/transform 内的 role('secret') 字段会原样返回（fail-open）
discussions.body:
# [Bug 报告] settings 密钥脱敏存在缺口：嵌套在 union/intersect/transform 内的 `role('secret')` 字段会原样返回（fail-open）

## 概述

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings` 的结构化密钥脱敏（`redactSecrets`，即 `settings.describe({ redactSecrets: true })` 走的那条路径）只递归 `object` / `dict` / `array` 三类 schema 节点。当 `role('secret')` 字段**只能通过 union、intersection 或 transform 节点到达**时，脱敏 walker 会命中 `default` 分支并**原样返回该值**，且不留任何"此密钥未被脱敏"的记录——即 fail-open。该值随后经 `dsh-host-apiproxy` 暴露给浏览器端设置界面，等于密钥可能直接穿过脱敏层发给客户端。

源码中的 `TODO(settings-wire-redaction)` 注释已承认此缺口：

> `lib/types/redact.js:56`
> ```
> // TODO(settings-wire-redaction): Fail closed instead — a secret reachable
> // only through a union, intersection, or transform is returned verbatim
> // here, with nothing recording that it was missed.
> ```

## 影响面

- **泄漏路径**：`redactSecrets` → `settings.describe({ redactSecrets: true })`（`lib/index.js:371-378`）→ `dsh-host-apiproxy` 的 settings 端点（`lib/types/api-proxy.js:1726, 2989`）→ Web 设置页（Models 等配置界面）。
- **触发条件**：某个配置 schema 在 `union` / `intersect` / `transform` 分支内部声明 `role('secret')` 字段，且用户配置中确实填了值。当前内置 schema（如 llm-deepseek 的 `apiKeyEnv` 引用式配置）未命中此路径，因此是**潜在缺口**；第三方插件或未来 schema 一旦这样建模，密钥即会泄漏。
- **严重度**：中-高。当前默认配置未受影响，但这是安全边界上的 fail-open 设计，且走的是对外 wire 面。

## 复现路径（概念验证）

1. 注册一个 settings namespace，其 schema 用 union 包裹含 secret 的 object：

```ts
const schema = z.union([
  z.object({ apiKey: z.string().role('secret') }),
  z.object({ apiKeyRef: z.string() }),
]);
// 用户配置值：{ apiKey: 'sk-live-secret-1234' }
```

2. 调用 `settings.describe({ redactSecrets: true })`。
3. 观察：返回的 descriptor 中 `resolved` / `user` 内 `apiKey` 字段**原样保留**，`secrets` 列表为空——密钥穿过了脱敏层。

对应 walker 行为（`lib/types/redact.js:13-60`）：`union` 节点不匹配 `object` / `dict` / `array` 三个 case，落入 `default` 分支 `return value`。

## 建议修复（供参考）

1. **fail-closed（首选）**：`default` 分支不再返回原值，而是：
   - 对该子树执行"不可达 secret 视为缺失"策略（剥离或置 `undefined`），并
   - 在返回结构里记录"此位置可能含未脱敏 secret"（扩展 `secrets` 侧车或加告警日志），使调用方无法静默放行。
2. **提升 walker 能力**：为 `union` / `intersect` 实现保守递归——`union` 取"任一分支剥离后的结果"（或直接视为含 secret 而整体剥离），`intersect` 对各子节点递归。`transform` 则应在 schema 声明处禁止 `role('secret')` 或强制剥离。
3. **测试**：为上述三种节点类型各加一个"secret 不越界"的单测（仓库门禁要求每文件 100% 行覆盖，需覆盖 `default` 分支）。

## 补充说明

- 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-settings@0.1.0-rc.6`（本次扫描的本地安装版本），schemastery 的 `role()` 将 role 写入 `schema.meta.role`（`schemastery/lib/index.mjs:209-217`），与 walker 读取的 `node.meta?.role` 一致。
- 该 TODO 位于本仓库源码中，符合 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 当前"反馈走 Discussions"的流程，故以此帖提交。

discussions.title: 移动端响应式 UI 与 Tailscale Serve 远程访问适配建议
discussions.body:
## 使用场景

我在 Windows 上从源码运行 DeepSeek Harness，并通过 Tailscale Serve 将本机 Web UI 仅发布到自己的 tailnet，方便在手机上远程使用（未启用 Funnel、未暴露到公网）。

环境：

- Windows 11
- Node.js v24.16.0
- pnpm 11.19.0
- DeepSeek Harness master：`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- 本机入口：`http://127.0.0.1:3080`
- 远程入口：Tailscale Serve 提供的 `https://<machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net/`

## 遇到的问题

### 1. `directory-picker-auto` 在反向代理场景下会选择错误的后端

Harness 绑定在 `127.0.0.1`，Tailscale Serve 也反向代理到这个 loopback 地址。默认的 `directory-picker-auto` 因此选择 native picker，但实际操作端是远程手机。

手机点击“添加工作区”时，会调用 `/api/host.pickDirectory`，返回 HTTP 403；而且即使调用成功，原生目录选择窗口也只可能出现在主机电脑上，手机端无法操作。

### 2. 切换为 browse picker 后，还需要手动配置 trusted host

禁用自动选择器并挂载 browse 版本后，手机端能看到 Web 目录选择界面，但 `/api/host.listDirectory` 仍会因为 Tailscale MagicDNS hostname 不在 `trustedHosts` 中返回 HTTP 403。

需要同时完成以下配置才能正常使用：

```yaml
- id: directory-picker
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: directory-picker-browse
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse'
    - id: ui-directory-picker-browse
      name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'

- id: web-runtime
  config:
    trustedHosts:
      - <machine>.<tailnet>.ts.net
```

然后：

```powershell
tailscale serve --bg http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

完成这些手动 composition/config 调整后，电脑本机和手机远程访问都可以正常使用。

### 3. 移动端 UI 还没有做响应式适配

功能打通后，页面仍明显按桌面宽屏布局渲染：

- 左侧导航栏占用固定宽度，正文区域被压缩；
- 会话正文、输入框、模型选择器和发送按钮在窄屏中拥挤、遮挡或重叠；
- 软键盘弹出后，可用视口进一步缩小，底部输入区域和状态栏布局不稳定；
- 桌面端的触控目标和弹窗尺寸在手机上不够友好。


## 移动端截图

![DeepSeek Harness 移动端 UI 截图（Tailscale 域名已打码）](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wang-xinchun/deepseek-harness/master/mobile-ui.jpg)

## 期望改进

1. 让目录选择器在 Tailscale Serve、SSH tunnel、反向代理到 loopback 等“服务端本地、客户端远程”的场景中支持 browse picker，或提供明确的官方 remote profile / 配置开关。
2. 在文档中补充 Tailscale Serve 的推荐配置，说明 `trustedHosts` / `--trusted-host` 和安全边界。
3. 为移动端增加响应式布局：窄屏抽屉式侧边栏、移动端会话/输入区断点、`100dvh`、软键盘与 safe-area 处理，以及不溢出/重叠的模型选择器、发送按钮、弹窗和触控目标。
4. 保持桌面端现有布局不变，让本机电脑和手机可以同时使用。

想请教：官方是否有计划支持移动端浏览器以及 Tailscale/SSH tunnel 这类远程访问场景？如果方向认可，也希望能提供官方的 remote-browser composition/profile。

> 安全说明：这里使用的是 tailnet-only 的 Tailscale Serve，不是公网 Funnel；截图中的实际域名已经打码。Tailscale 提供网络访问边界，但 Harness 本身目前并没有额外的远程用户认证。

discussions.title: Bug: Web UI multi-turn sessions drop reasoning blocks — 400 "reasoning_text must be passed back" (openai-responses custom provider)
discussions.body:
**Bug: Web UI multi-turn sessions drop reasoning blocks — multi-turn requests fail with 400 "The `reasoning_text` in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API"**

dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm global), Node 22, Windows. Custom provider configured as `openai-responses` against an OpenAI-compatible gateway (OpenCode Go, baseURL `.../v1`). Models are hand-declared (no `reasoningEfforts` field).

## Symptom

- **Web UI multi-turn agent sessions (with tool calls)**: after the first few turns, the next request fails with:
  `OpenAI API error (400): invalid_request_error: Error from provider (Console Go): Upstream request failed: [invalid_request_error] The `reasoning_text` in the thinking mode must be passed back to the API.`
- **Single-turn / headless runs are fine.** `dsh --profile headless` works, including tool-call turns.

## Evidence that the gateway and pi-ai are NOT at fault

1. **Gateway streams reasoning correctly**: captured the live SSE stream — `response.output_item.added` (item type `reasoning`), 35× `response.reasoning_text.delta`, `response.output_item.done`, and `response.completed` usage includes `output_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`. Also returns reasoning in non-streaming mode.
2. **pi-ai 0.82.1 produces thinking blocks in every scenario**: reproduction scripts using the exact pi-ai version shipped with dsh (`streamSimple`, `openai-responses`) yield `thinking_start → thinking_delta… → thinking_end` for: single-turn, multi-turn, with tools, without `reasoningEffort`, and with `reasoning: "max"`. The model (deepseek-v4-pro) even produces thinking with **no** effort param and **no** tools.
3. **Same install, same gateway, same settings — headless sessions record reasoning correctly**: headless `session.jsonl.zstd` contains `reasoning-chunks` storage rows, `assistant/message` content includes `{"type": "reasoning", "text": …}` blocks, and `source.replayState.blocks` includes the `reasoning` signature.
4. **Web UI sessions record zero reasoning**: in the failing session, all 30 `assistant/message` records have `content` with only `text`/`tool-call` blocks, `reasoning-chunks` rows = 0, and `replayState.blocks` has no `reasoning` entry. (Verified in the raw `.zstd` log, not just the export.)

## Mechanism

Because the reasoning block (and its `thinkingSignature`) never reaches the message layer in Web UI sessions, the multi-turn conversion (`replayedAssistant` / pi-ai `convertResponsesMessages`) has nothing to pass back — `reasoning_text` is absent from the next request, and the gateway rejects it.

Direct reproduction of the mechanism with pi-ai: multi-turn request **without** the previous reasoning item passed back → request fails; **with** the reasoning item → succeeds.

## Suggested focus

Web UI session path vs headless path diverge somewhere between the adapter stream and the persisted `assistant/message` — headless persists reasoning blocks, Web UI does not, on the same build.

Related: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/199 (adapter drops thinking for vLLM `delta.reasoning` format — same family, different wire shape).

discussions.title: BUG 报告
discussions.body:
一、agent 在 pre-step 被拒时丢弃已排队唤醒消息并报空闲
pre-step 决策被拒时，落在组装窗口内的 followup/steer 被静默丢弃，agent 报空闲但消息未处理。
复现步骤：
  1. 注册一个会返回 `reject` 的 `agent/pre-step` waterfall 监听器。
  2. agent 运行中，在 pre-step 的 `systemPrompt.assemble`/waterfall await 期间调用 `agent.followup(msg)`。
  3. 令 pre-step 决策被拒。
实际结果：`turn()` 在 `reject` 路径直接返回，不做 `inbox.hasPending` 检查；`wakeDriver()` 对运行中 driver 不置 latch。driver 带着非空 inbox 退休，`whenIdle()` 解析、`agent/status: idle` 触发，消息滞留到下一次交互。
预期结果：被拒后唤醒被重新 latch 或由 driver 重新领取，消息在下一个 turn 被处理。
环境：任意平台；`agent-loop` 运行中。相关代码 `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:267`（及 `:324`、`:172`）。
验收条件：在 pre-step await 窗口内投递且决策被拒的 followup 最终被处理，或显式进入下一个 turn；`whenIdle()` 不得在 inbox 非空时解析。

二、persistent bash 超时/部分输出路径丢失命令早期输出
persistent bash 的 fallback 缓冲被后续空操作的 viewport 覆盖，超时与部分输出路径返回空或误导内容。
- 复现步骤：
  1. 通过 persistent bash 运行一条长命令，使其超过 `timeoutMs`。
  2. 使滚动缓冲在结算前不再包含 start marker（输出量超过保留页）。
- 实际结果：`fallback = incremental.delta.length > 0 ? fallback + delta : result.viewport`，空操作轮询返回空 delta，用空 viewport 替换首轮积累；`partialOutput()` 以 fallback 为最后手段时，模型收到空/误导输出，`fallbackTruncated` 被同步重置。
- 预期结果：fallback 保留命令早期输出，超时/部分输出返回其尾部。
- 环境：任意平台；`tool-bash-persistent`。相关代码 `packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts:303`。
- 验收条件：超时路径下 fallback 含首轮输出；delta 为空时保留已积累缓冲。

三、一次持久化失败使 schedule 定时提醒永久停摆
schedule runtime 在持久化屏障失败后清掉定时器即返回，之后所有定时提醒不再触发。
- 复现步骤：
  1. 配置一条 one-shot 或 fixed-rate 提醒，agent 处于空闲。
  2. 使 `ctx.sessions.flush` 失败一次（例如存储暂时不可写）。
- 实际结果：`driveOnce()` 已 `clearTimer()`，两处 `flushSchedulePersistence` 失败分支只记日志并返回；`requested` 已被置 false，`retire()` 无待办。无定时器、无后续 idle/`schedule/change` 触发，runtime 永久停摆。
- 预期结果：失败后按有界重试重新 arm，提醒稍后触发。
- 环境：任意平台；`schedule` 插件。相关代码 `packages/schedule/schedule/src/runtime.ts:231`、`:315`。
- 验收条件：注入一次 flush 失败后，runtime 仍会 arm 并在随后触发提醒。

四、E2B 子进程被杀后误报为正常完成（exit 137）
E2B 适配器把被杀命令报成 `{ exitCode: 137, signal: null }`，与本地 provider 报 `{ exitCode: null, signal }` 不一致。
- 复现步骤：
  1. 在 E2B 沙箱运行长命令（如 `sleep 60`）。
  2. 从宿主对其实进程组发起 SIGKILL。
- 实际结果：远程包装非 `exec`，SIGKILL 后 wrapper 存活并写入 `$?=137`；`commandOutcome` 的 `publishedExitCode !== undefined` 分支忽略 `terminationSignal`，返回 `{ exitCode: 137, signal: null }`。下游 `bash-local` 消费者把 `proc.status` 判为 `'completed'`，模型看到 `[exit code: 137]` 而非 kill 标记。
- 预期结果：两个 provider 对同一杀法报一致的独立事实（`{ exitCode: null, signal: 'SIGKILL' }`）。
- 环境：E2B sandbox。相关代码 `packages/e2b/subprocess-e2b/src/process.ts:548`（及 `:527`、`:612`）。
- 验收条件：同一 kill 在两个适配器产生相同的 `{ exitCode, signal }`；`terminationSignal` 已设置时优先报告信号。

五、原子写未同步父目录，断电后已报告成功的写入可回退
`writeFileAtomic` rename 后不 fsync 父目录，断电可撤销已确认成功的写入。
- 复现步骤：
  1. POSIX 上通过 `writeFileAtomic` 写入文件并确认成功。
  2. 在 rename 落盘前断电。
- 实际结果：临时文件已 fsync，但目录条目未同步；断电后 rename 可被撤销，文件静默回退旧内容，下一次受保护写入报 `FS_STALE_VERSION`。同仓 `storage-json`/`session-persistence-jsonl` 均同步目录，此处未同步。
- 预期结果：rename 后同步父目录，断电后写入保持。
- 环境：macOS/Linux。相关代码 `packages/fs/fs-local/src/fsio.ts:593`。
- 验收条件：写成功后目录条目持久；或故障注入验证 `fsyncDirectory` 被调用。

六、spill 保存文件未 fsync，崩溃后日志定位符指向缺失文件
`saveTextFile` 返回定位符前不 fsync 文件与目录，崩溃后恢复工件可能缺失。
- 复现步骤：
  1. 触发溢出 spill（如超大 grep 输出），保存完整结果到 spill 文件。
  2. 在工具结果返回后、操作系统落盘前崩溃。
- 实际结果：`saveTextFile` 以 `'wx', 0o600` 打开、写入、关闭即返回 `{ path, bytes }`，无 `handle.sync()` 与目录同步；日志中 "Full formatted result stored at: <locator>" 指向缺失或空文件，恢复路径失效。兄弟包 `attachment-local` 返回前会同步文件与两级目录。
- 预期结果：返回定位符前同步文件与父目录，崩溃后文件存在且完整。
- 环境：任意平台。相关代码 `packages/spill/spill-local/src/store.ts:113`。
- 验收条件：崩溃后定位符对应文件存在；写入在返回前达到持久。

七、SDK 会话 run 等待 idle 无期限，wedged runtime 挂起调用方
`HarnessSession.run` 等待 `session.status: idle` 无客户端期限，runtime 卡死时调用永不返回。
- 复现步骤：
  1. 使 runtime 的轮次永不回到 idle（模型流挂起或 agent 循环无法收敛）。
  2. 调用 `harness.session(id).run(prompt)`。
- 实际结果：`client.prompt` 受 `requestTimeoutMs` 约束，但等待 idle 通知的循环无任何 deadline；调用永不 settle，自动化调用方无法放弃。
- 预期结果：提供调用方可控的 idle 等待期限选项（含文档化默认值），超时以明确错误返回。
- 环境：任意平台。相关代码 `packages/sdk/client/src/api.ts:169`。
- 验收条件：设置期限后 `run` 在期限内 settle 或抛出超时错误；默认行为向后兼容。

八、审计发现 9 项低危缺陷，当前不阻断发布，建议随相关改动修复。
- 复现步骤：
  1. `session-persistence-jsonl`：日志文件被外部删除后，下次 append 静默重建、无会话头，再加载报 corrupt（`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:654`）。
  2. `session-projection-cache`：`markClean` 在持久化屏障/store 写入成功前重置脏计数，写入失败不重试（`packages/session/session-projection-cache/src/index.ts:141`）。
  3. `llm`：`adapterStream` 清理期 `await close()` 无防护，第三方适配器 `.return()` 抛错会替换消费者结果（`packages/llm/llm/src/index.ts:894`）。
  4. `subprocess-local`：spawn 失败不封口 collect 模式 spill 文件，每次失败泄漏一个 fd 与临时文件（`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/spawn.ts:484`）。
  5. `terminal-bash`：异步后端下，超时与在途写竞态令 `active` 槽残留，后续发送全报 `SEND_ACTIVE`（`packages/terminal/terminal-bash/src/session.ts:251`）。
  6. `workflow-worker-thread`：`agentsStarted` 计入启动被拒或失败的孩子（`packages/workflow/workflow-worker-thread/src/host.ts:338`）。
  7. `timeout-policy`：在 abort 时抛错的工具丢失 `TOOL_TIMEOUT` 分类（`packages/guard/timeout-policy/src/index.ts:67`）。
  8. `apiproxy` SSE：读取器只按 `\n\n` 切帧，CRLF 帧会停摆流并无限增长缓冲；当前同仓服务端只发 LF，属潜伏隐患（`packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts:387`）。
  9. `sdk/protocol`：入站缓冲无上限，未终止的超大帧无防护（`packages/sdk/protocol/src/transport.ts:175`）。
- 实际结果：各项影响见上；均不改变正常路径行为。
- 预期结果：随相关改动逐项修复或显式接受为已知限制。
- 环境：任意平台。
- 验收条件：按项逐条关闭。

discussions.title: Windows 下原生目录选择器选中文件夹后 worker 崩溃 (win32 folder dialog worker exited before reporting a result)
discussions.body: ### 环境 - 系统:Windows 11 (build 10.0.26200 x64) - Node.js v24.14.1,npm 11.11.0 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6(全局 npm 安装) - 通过 Web UI(浏览器)以及直接驱动 picker worker 两种方式复现 ### 现象 Web UI 中点击 **Select Workspace Directory**,在弹出的原生对话框里**选中文件夹并确认**时失败,报错: ``` directory picker failed: directory picker failed: win32 folder dialog worker exited before reporting a result ``` 原生对话框能正常弹出,问题发生在选择文件夹、点击 "Select Folder" 确认之后。 ### 复现步骤 按 `dsh-host-directory-picker-native` 的方式拉起 picker worker(`spawn(node, [worker.cjs], { env: { DSH_DIALOG_TITLE }, stdio: ["ignore","inherit","inherit","ipc"] })`),观察 IPC 协议: 1. 先收到 `{"kind":"showing","threadId":}` —— 对话框已弹出,线程 id 有效。 2. 选中文件夹并确认 → worker 进程直接退出,**从未发送** `{"kind":"done"}` 或 `{"kind":"error"}`。driver 的 `worker.on("exit")` 于是抛出错信息。 对照组(完全正常): - 取消对话框(向对话框线程投递 `WM_CLOSE`)→ 返回 `{"kind":"done","path":null}`,worker 退出码 0。 - 说明 spawn、STA 初始化、`Show`、清理全部正常——问题只出在 `Show` 之后的**结果提取路径**上。 ### 原因分析(推测) 崩溃点位于 `resultPath()`(`lib/types/win32-dialog-bindings.js`)的结果提取链: - `IFileDialog::GetResult` → `IShellItem::GetDisplayName(SIGDN_FILESYSPATH)` → `readUtf16` → `CoTaskMemFree` → `Release` 其中 `readUtf16` 对 CoTaskMem 分配的字符串执行 `koffi.view(address, 32768)`:如果实际分配较短,这个 64 KiB 的视图可能越过已映射堆页(guard page / 未映射区域),触发访问冲突把 worker 直接打死——而它来不及发 `{"kind":"error"}`。worker 内部如果只是 JS 异常,是**会**发 `error` 消息的;完全没有消息,强烈指向原生崩溃而非抛错。 补充:driver 的 abort 路径(错误信息为 "native directory picker aborted (dialog unresponsive; worker killed)")没有参与——worker 是在交互过程中立即退出,没有走 WM_CLOSE 重试循环。 ### 临时解决方案 按 seam 文档的换法,在 profile 补丁层(`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`)禁用 auto 选择器、直接组合 `browse` 后端双件套,应用内目录浏览器工作正常: ```yaml - id: directory-picker disabled: true - insert: - id: directory-picker-browse name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse' - id: directory-picker-browse-ui name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse' ``` ### 补充 - `resolveDirectoryPickerBackend` 在 win32 上无条件选择 native 后端(Windows 上没有显示会话探测),所以每次本机启动都会走这条崩溃路径。 - 如果需要,我可以提供崩溃转储,或配合测试修正后的 `readUtf16`/koffi 范围检查构建。

discussions.title: WebUI 缺少移动端响应式布局(手机访问不适配)
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (`dsh web`)

## 现象

手机浏览器访问 WebUI 时页面不适配窄屏：桌面布局被直接压缩渲染，侧边栏/设置面板等无法正常使用。

## 技术分析

- `index.html` 已包含 `<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">`，排除 viewport 缺失导致的按桌面宽度渲染
- index 样式（约 68KB）中媒体查询**仅有**：
  - `@media (pointer: coarse)`
  - `@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce)`
- vendor 样式（约 30KB）中无任何媒体查询
- 全量样式中**不存在任何宽度断点**（`@media (max-width: ...)`），即移动端布局逻辑完全缺失

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 `dsh web`
2. 手机浏览器（或 DevTools 设备模拟）访问 WebUI
3. 侧边栏、设置面板等以桌面宽度布局渲染，窄屏下内容溢出/挤压

## 期望行为

- 窄屏（如 <768px）下侧边栏折叠为抽屉或自动隐藏
- 主内容区自适应宽度
- 次级界面（设置面板等）以全屏模态呈现

## 备注

项目发布当天即有此需求，猜测移动端适配已在规划中；如已在路线图可关闭此 issue，仅作需求同步。

discussions.title: [性能问题] TokenMeter 在每个会话事件后重建完整快照，导致二次方级性能退化
discussions.body:
- Session 每次 append 都会使快照失效：[session/index.ts (line 559)](/E:/githubProjects/deepseek-harness/packages/core/session/src/index.ts:559)
- TokenMeter 在状态建立后监听每个 session/event 并调用 _sync()：[token-meter/index.ts (line 95)](/E:/githubProjects/deepseek-harness/packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts:95)
- _sync() 循环中反复读取 session.events，导致每次重新复制完整日志：[token-meter/index.ts (line 160)](/E:/githubProjects/deepseek-harness/packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts:160)
- 每个模型分片都会追加 assistant/chunk：[agent.ts (line 349)](/E:/githubProjects/deepseek-harness/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:349)

实测结果：
events   inactive meter   active meter
8,000    162 ms           215 ms
16,000   246 ms           404 ms
32,000   476 ms           1,657 ms
32K 时 active/inactive 已达到约 3.5 倍，并呈现二次方增长。

设计建议：
- session/event 已经携带当前 event，监听器应直接 _foldEvent(session, state, event)。
- 仅在 seq 不连续、冷启动或补偿读取时调用完整 _sync()。
- 或给 Session 增加 eventAt() / eventsSince()，避免通过完整防御性快照读取单个事件。

验收标准：
- 事件数量翻倍时，append 总耗时不应超过约 3 倍。
- 保留已有 replay、replacement、source provenance 测试。
- 新增默认 Bundle 下 meter 已激活的性能回归测试。

discussions.title: plan-mode 文案不一致
discussions.body:
# [Bug 报告] plan-mode 指令文案在 base 层与 agent preset 间不一致："keep the request shape stable" vs "keep the tool catalog unchanged"

## 概述

同一段 plan-mode 指令（`plan-mode` 插件的 `section` 配置）在**两个配置层中各自维护了一份拷贝，且其中一句已经漂移**。逐字对比后确认：除下面这一句外，两段指令完全相同。

- `dsh-base` 层（`cordis.patch.yml:272`）：
  > "…those tools remain listed **only to keep the request shape stable**."

- `standard` / `code` / `cordis` 三个 agent preset（`config/agent-presets/*/agent.cordis.yml`）：
  > "…those tools remain listed **to keep the tool catalog unchanged**."

由于 Web 表面实际挂载 `standard` preset（web-app 补丁将 base 层的 `plan-mode` 行 `disabled: true`），而 headless 表面使用 base 层的版本，**同一个模型在不同启动模式下会读到两个措辞不同的 plan-mode 指令**。

## 影响面

- **行为差异**：两句话表达的是同一意图（plan mode 下工具目录保持不变、规则优先于工具描述），但措辞不同——"request shape stable"偏请求形状（更贴缓存），"tool catalog unchanged"偏目录内容。模型对哪个更易遵循可能产生实际差异。
- **维护风险**：这是**同一逻辑两处复制粘贴维护**的典型漂移点。本次是形容词差异，下一次可能是行为性差异；两处没有机制保证同步（没有 TODO/注释互相指向）。
- **实际影响**：低-中。不是功能性 bug，但属于"同一产品不同入口给模型不同指令"的一致性问题，且影响 plan-mode 下所有会话的提示词前缀（与本仓库关注的 request-cache stability 直接相关）。

## 证据

四份文件中包含此句的精确位置（安装版本 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`）：

| 文件 | 行 | 措辞 |
|---|---|---|
| `packages/boot/base/cordis.patch.yml`（base 层） | 272 | …remain listed **only to keep the request shape stable**. |
| `packages/agent-presets/config/agent-presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml` | 117 | …remain listed **to keep the tool catalog unchanged**. |
| `packages/agent-presets/config/agent-presets/code/agent.cordis.yml` | 125 | …remain listed **to keep the tool catalog unchanged**. |
| `packages/agent-presets/config/agent-presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml` | 106 | …remain listed **to keep the tool catalog unchanged**. |

> 注：上表行号为本地安装包内位置，源码仓库中行号可能略有偏移，但文件路径与措辞差异可直接复现。

## 建议修复（供参考）

1. **统一为同一句**（首选）：三处 preset 与 base 层统一措辞。保留哪句由维护者决定；若以"请求缓存稳定性"为设计动机，建议保留 base 层的 "only to keep the request shape stable"（更精确）；若以"工具目录不变"为用户可见语义，则统一为 preset 版。关键是**四个文件必须逐字一致**。
2. **消除复制粘贴**（根治）：把 plan-mode `section` 文案提升为共享常量或从同一来源注入（例如由 `plan-mode` 插件提供默认 section，preset 只在需要覆盖时声明），避免两处手工同步。
3. **测试**：可加一条"所有 agent preset 与 base 层 plan-mode section 文案一致性"的静态检查或单测，防止未来再次漂移。

## 补充说明

- 这是我在扫描 `dsh-base` 与 `config/agent-presets/` 时逐字对比发现的，两处均无 TODO/注释提及此差异，属于"同一逻辑两处维护导致的无声漂移"。
- 与该差异直接相关的本仓库既有设计：plan-mode section 本身强调 "The tool catalog stays the same across modes **for request-cache stability**"——说明文案一致性对缓存前缀稳定性是有意为之的，此漂移与该设计目标相悖。

discussions.title: Security: workflow tool vm escape via injected host-realm functions (user-privilege file/network access, sandbox bypass)
Bug 反馈：Windows 原生目录选择器对含"需求"等汉字（U+9700 类低字节为 0）的路径截断，附修复补丁
discussions.body:
## 问题现象（Bug 反馈）

在 Windows 上使用 Web UI 添加工作区时，**原生文件夹选择对话框**（IFileOpenDialog）对包含特定汉字的路径会返回**父目录**，而不是所选目录。例如：

- 选择 `D:\张三\需求` → 对话框返回 `D:\张三`
- 选择 `D:\张三\日常\需求1\测试需求` → 返回 `D:\张三\日常`
- 而选择 `D:\张三\日常` 等其他目录则完全正常

进一步测试发现，路径中含"需求"（`需` = U+9700）、"一"（U+4E00）、"开"（U+5F00）、"最"（U+6700）、"言"（U+8A00）等**低字节为 0x00 的汉字**时都会触发同样的截断。

## 根因

问题不在 Shell 层，而在 `packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` 的 `readUtf16()`：它以**逐字节**方式扫描 UTF-16 字符串的终止符，但只检查每个编码单元的低字节：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
```

UTF-16 字符串的真正终止符是双字节 `00 00`。`需`（U+9700）的 UTF-16LE 编码为 `00 97`——**低字节恰好是 0x00**，扫描在此处误判为字符串结束，路径被截断在"需"之前。对话框本身始终返回完整路径，路径丢失完全发生在字符串读取环节。

## 修复（已提交）

修改 `readUtf16()` 为**双字节终止符检查**：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2
```

已在 Windows 11 上端到端实测：修复后含"需求"的深层路径均可正确选中，workspace 注册路径正确。

## 补丁位置

- Fork：https://github.com/piaomiaoguying/deepseek-harness
- 分支：`fix/directory-picker-native-utf16-truncation`
- 提交：`b484fdcc8d`（仅 1 个文件、1 行改动 + 根因注释）

仓库当前禁用了 Pull Requests，故先在此反馈。如需要，我可以按贡献流程提交 PR。

discussions.title: Proposal: bound MCP connection and tool discovery with one total timeout
discussions.body:
## Problem

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` currently inherits the MCP SDK's request timeout behavior during startup. That leaves two gaps:

1. The transport start phase is not bounded by the SDK request signal.
2. Each paginated `tools/list` request receives its own timeout, so total discovery time can grow with the number of pages.

An unresponsive server can therefore delay plugin activation and teardown beyond the timeout users reasonably expect.

## Proposed semantics

Add `connectionTimeoutMs` to both stdio and Streamable HTTP configs, with a default of `60_000`.

- The value is one total wall-clock budget for a connection generation: transport start, MCP initialization, and the complete paginated initial `tools/list` sync.
- The initial connection and every reconnect attempt receive a fresh budget.
- A `notifications/tools/list_changed` re-sync receives a fresh budget with the same value. This keeps later discovery from hanging the plugin lifecycle too.
- The same abort signal is passed through all discovery pages. The budget is not reset per page.
- When this deadline expires, the supervisor actively closes the affected MCP client and waits for the generation's close signal before scheduling a replacement. It must not overlap stdio child generations.
- Plugin disposal aborts an in-flight connection or discovery immediately instead of waiting for the configured deadline.
- With `failOnStartupError: true`, an initial timeout rejects plugin activation. With `false`, it follows the existing logged failure and reconnect policy.
- `toolCallTimeoutMs` remains separate and continues to bound individual `tools/call` requests.
- Programmatic config that bypasses Schemastery should still reject non-positive, non-finite, or timer-overflow values at plugin load.

The diagnostic should name the exhausted budget, for example:

```text
mcp-client(github): connection attempt failed: Error: connection and tool discovery timed out after 60000ms
```

## Why one total budget?

A per-request timeout does not bound readiness. For example, initialize plus three `tools/list` pages could each consume almost the full timeout. A single deadline matches the user-visible operation: either this server becomes ready within the configured time, or this generation is closed and handled as a failed attempt.

## Suggested test matrix

| Scenario | Expected result | Level |
|---|---|---|
| Config omitted | Resolves to `60_000` | Unit |
| `0`, negative, non-finite, or above Node's timer ceiling | Fails at plugin load, including programmatic config | Unit |
| Transport/connect never settles | Deadline aborts, client closes, no `tools/list` runs | Unit + real stdio E2E |
| Initialize stalls | Same total deadline closes the generation | Real stdio E2E |
| Page 2 of `tools/list` stalls | Shared signal aborts; page 1 is not partially registered | Unit |
| Initial timeout with `failOnStartupError: true` | Plugin activation rejects with the timeout as cause | Unit |
| Initial timeout with `failOnStartupError: false` | Activation settles and existing reconnect/disabled behavior applies | Unit |
| Reconnect generation stalls | A fresh budget applies to that generation; retry accounting remains unchanged | Unit |
| `list_changed` re-sync stalls | Last good tools remain during fetch; generation closes and reconnects | Unit |
| Dispose during pending connect/discovery | Returns without waiting for `connectionTimeoutMs`; no retry is scheduled | Unit + real stdio E2E |
| Timed-out stdio generation never reports close | Supervisor fails closed after the existing close barrier; no overlapping child is spawned | Unit |
| Streamable HTTP endpoint never responds | Same deadline and startup policy as stdio | E2E |

## Compatibility

The default preserves the current nominal 60-second expectation while making it a strict end-to-end readiness bound instead of a per-request bound. Existing configurations need no changes. The only observable difference is that multi-page or transport-level hangs now terminate predictably.

Would maintainers prefer this single lifecycle-facing setting, or separate connection and discovery timeout fields? I favor one setting because activation exposes one readiness operation and because separate budgets would still need a defined total bound.

discussions.title: Proposal: fall back to rename() when atomic-publish link() fails (EACCES/EPERM) - hard links unavailable on some Android ROMs
discussions.body:
**Proposal: fall back to `rename()` when the atomic-publish `link()` fails — hard links are unavailable on some Android ROMs**

While setting up dsh on Termux (aarch64), session persistence fails at runtime with:

```
EACCES: permission denied, link '.../session.jsonl.zstd.d4846aa9e424.tmp' -> '.../session.jsonl.zstd'
```

**Root cause (device-side, not a dsh bug):** some Android custom ROMs globally block the `link()` syscall for apps via SELinux hardening. Verified on the affected device: `link()` returns `EACCES` for *every* file — own files, own directories (0700), fresh files, 1 MB files, and also on FUSE-backed external storage. `rename()` works fine everywhere. On stock Android and normal Linux this never happens, so this is a defensive-robustness proposal, not a bug report.

Affected device: **Motorola XT2507-5, Android 16 (SDK 36), build W1VVC36H.7-73-6-3** (custom kernel build).

**Affected code paths** (both use the `link(tmp, final)` + `unlink(tmp)` publish pattern):
- `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` → `materializePosix()`: `await link(tmp, finalPath)`
- `dsh-attachment-local` → `saveImageFile()`: `await link(temporary, target)` (content-addressed dedup)

**Proposal:** when `link()` fails with `EACCES`/`EPERM`/`EMLINK`, fall back to `rename(tmp, final)`:

- `rename()` is atomic and same-directory; combined with the existing `fsync(file)` → `fsync(dir)` steps, crash durability is unchanged.
- Session logs already guard against clobbering via `rejectExistingLog()` before publishing; the fallback keeps that check.
- Attachments are content-addressed (`sha256`-keyed), so a rename replacing an existing identical object is semantically a no-op; the existing EEXIST → integrity-verify path can remain as the primary branch.

**Why it matters beyond this device:** restricted filesystems where hard links are unavailable or limited aren't exotic — some FUSE mounts, network filesystems, and security-hardened environments behave this way too. A one-line fallback makes dsh's atomic publish work everywhere `rename()` works.

I have a working local patch (link → rename, plus ENOENT-tolerant cleanup after rename); happy to turn it into a PR if maintainers are interested.

discussions.title: [Windows 数据完整性] 大小写不同的 Session ID 在 JSONL 后端发生路径冲突
discussions.body:
相关源码：
- encodeSegment() 保留 ASCII 大小写：[format.ts (line 121)](/E:/githubProjects/deepseek-harness/packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts:121)

corrupt session log "...\\a\\session.jsonl":
