discussions.title: Composer textarea triggers macOS Safari iCloud Keychain password autofill — add autocomplete="off"?
discussions.body:
## Problem

On macOS, focusing the DSH Web composer input pops up Safari / iCloud Keychain password suggestions (or the system "AutoFill Passwords" overlay) on top of the chat input at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`. The prompt appears on nearly every focus, which is noisy for a coding-agent chat box that has nothing to do with credentials.

## Why

Looking at the source, the composer is a `<textarea>` rendered by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-input-trigger`, and it carries **no `autocomplete` attribute** anywhere in the web shell (`dsh-client-ui-input-trigger`, `dsh-client-web`, `dsh-web-app`). macOS Safari and the system password AutoFill therefore treat the field as a regular form input and offer iCloud Keychain passwords (especially once any value from `127.0.0.1` has been saved to the Keychain, e.g. an API key entered in the settings page).

I searched the repo's issue tracker and discussions and did not find an existing report for this.

## Suggested fix

Add `autocomplete="off"` (and ideally also `data-lpignore="true"` for password managers that ignore `autocomplete`) to the composer textarea in `dsh-client-ui-input-trigger`. This is a one-line change and is the standard way to opt a chat input out of browser/system credential autofill.

## User-side workarounds (macOS)

- Delete the saved `127.0.0.1` entry from the Keychain (Safari → Settings → Passwords, or the macOS Passwords app).
- Or disable Safari → Settings → AutoFill → "User names and passwords".
- Or disable system-wide autofill: System Settings → General → AutoFill & Passwords (macOS 14+).

---

（中文简述:macOS 下 DSH Web 的输入框会反复弹出 iCloud 钥匙串密码提示,原因是 composer 的 textarea 没有声明 `autocomplete="off"`;建议在 `dsh-client-ui-input-trigger` 里加上该属性,并附了用户侧的临时规避方法。检索过 issue 和 discussions,未发现已有同类报告。）

discussions.title: CJK 中文输入法在 Web 对话框无法正常使用（附定位与修法建议）
discussions.body:
## 现象

在 DSH Web GUI（`http://127.0.0.1:3080`）的对话输入框里，中文拼音输入法无法正常使用：打拼音时**看不到组合候选与下划线**，体感像输入法失灵；英文和"粘贴中文"都正常。

## 环境

- DSH 版本：`0.1.0-rc.6`（包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation`）
- 平台：macOS / WebKit 浏览器
- 输入法：讯飞输入法（第三方 CJK IME）

## 根因（静态代码定位，高置信度）

输入框用了"**透明文字 + 背后高亮层**"做 chip 高亮。在 `lib/client.js`：

- textarea 约在 L3791，绑定 `onCompositionStart/End`（L3372–3380）；
- 内联 CSS（`css$17`，约 L3270）：

```css
.uV2eYG_input{ ... color:#0000; ... }  /* 输入文字 = 全透明 */
```

可见文字由 `.uV2eYG_backdrop` 高亮层绘制。浏览器把 IME 的组合下划线/候选直接画在 textarea 上、用它的 `color`；因为全透明，**组合反馈不可见**，所以中文输入法体感失灵。逻辑层其实做了 `isComposing` 守卫，问题只在视觉层。

## 建议修法（供参考）

1. `compositionstart` 时让 textarea 文字临时可见（覆盖 `color:#0000`），同时隐藏 `.uV2eYG_backdrop`；
2. `compositionend` 后恢复透明 + 高亮层；
3. 可选：把 `"DshChipCell"` 字体只作用于 chip 片段，避免 CJK 字形回退/分词异常。

## 影响与临时方案

影响所有 CJK 输入法用户；无数据丢失、无安全风险。临时绕行：别处输入后**粘贴**进输入框。

如果需要，我可以补充复现录屏或进一步定位。感谢 DSH 团队的维护！

discussions.title: [Show and tell] dsh-k12-lesson-builder — synchronized PPTX + DOCX lesson planning for K12 English
discussions.body:
Hi! I built [`dsh-k12-lesson-builder`](https://github.com/shyboy/dsh-k12-lesson-builder), a Windows-first DeepSeek Harness bundle for K12 English teachers.

It turns teacher-provided source material into two synchronized, editable deliverables:

- a PowerPoint lesson deck (`.pptx`);
- a Word lesson plan (`.docx`).

Both files are generated from one structured lesson blueprint, so the teaching objectives, stages, timing, activities, assessment, homework, and PPT page references stay aligned.

## Why I built it

Teachers often ask an agent for a lesson plan and a PPT separately. The two outputs then drift: slide order changes, timing no longer matches, or the Word plan refers to content that is missing from the deck.

This plugin uses a stricter workflow:

1. `prepare_k12_lesson_sources` reads the teacher's textbook, curriculum standard, PPT template, and Word template, then validates the templates.
2. The active DSH agent creates a versioned `lesson-blueprint.json` from the resulting source package.
3. `render_k12_lesson_materials` generates the PPT first, reads back its final page IDs, and then writes the matching page map into the Word plan.
4. Both Office files are reopened and checked, with a machine-readable audit JSON saved beside them.

The plugin does not call a second model or hide lesson generation in a separate service. The current DSH agent remains responsible for the visible teaching blueprint.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shyboy/dsh-k12-lesson-builder#v0.1.1
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Repository: https://github.com/shyboy/dsh-k12-lesson-builder  
Release: https://github.com/shyboy/dsh-k12-lesson-builder/releases/tag/v0.1.1

## Example request

> 请用 `inputs/textbook.pdf`、`inputs/standards.docx`、`inputs/template.pptx` 和 `inputs/template.docx`，为七年级 Unit 1 Reading 第 4—5 页生成 1 课时、45 分钟的 PPT 和 Word 教案，输出到 `outputs/unit-1`。

Typical output:

```text
outputs/unit-1/lesson-日期-时间-短ID/
├── source-package.json
├── template-report.json
├── lesson-blueprint.json
├── Unit-1-Reading.pptx
├── Unit-1-Reading.docx
└── Unit-1-Reading-audit.json
```

## Verified boundary

- Tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` on Windows with desktop Microsoft Word and PowerPoint.
- `npm test`: 23/23 passing, including real Office generation, synchronized slide-to-plan mapping, file reopen checks, and confirmation that source file hashes do not change.
- Public GitHub installation into a fresh isolated profile was verified; the bundle appeared in `dsh --dump-config`.
- Production dependency audit reports no known vulnerabilities.
- Workspace path traversal, sibling-prefix paths, paths outside the active workspace, symbolic links, oversized inputs, invalid blueprints, and ambiguous templates are rejected before generation.
- The plugin itself does not upload teaching files to an independent service.

## Current limits

- Windows 10/11 and desktop Microsoft Word + PowerPoint are required because v0.1.1 uses Office COM automation.
- The first release targets K12 English lessons.
- Scanned-image PDFs need OCR before use; OCR is not bundled.
- The template contract is intentionally strict. Word templates need 11 documented content-control tags, and PPT templates need an unambiguous title-and-content layout.
- Generated teaching content still requires professional review by the teacher.

The repository is MIT-licensed and tagged with `dsh-plugin`. Feedback on the bundle boundary, blueprint contract, and Office-template workflow is welcome.

---

中文简介：这是一个面向 K12 英语教师的一键备课插件。教师提供自己的教材、课程标准、PPT 模板和 Word 教案模板，DSH 先生成统一教学蓝图，再同步输出可编辑的 PPT 与 Word 教案。插件坚持本地文件、可审计过程和教师终审，不内置教材，也不把备课文件上传到独立服务。

discussions.title: 修复提案：移除 host-apiproxy 中重复的 Cordis 依赖键（含补丁分支）Proposal: Remove the Duplicate Cordis Dependency Key from host-apiproxy (Patch Branch Included)
discussions.body:
## 提案：移除 host-apiproxy 中重复的 Cordis 依赖键（含补丁分支）

### 问题

`packages/host/apiproxy/package.json` 的 `devDependencies` 重复声明了两次相同的依赖：

```json
"@deepseek-ai/cordis": "workspace:^"
```

Bun 等会检查对象重复键的工具会因此报告：

```text
warn: Duplicate key "@deepseek-ai/cordis" in object literal
at packages/host/apiproxy/package.json:92:5
```

两个声明的值相同，因此该问题通常不会改变最终依赖解析结果，但重复键会使 manifest 产生歧义，并可能被严格解析器或其他包管理工具拒绝。

该警告与 Bun 的 `InvalidPnpmLockfile` 迁移失败相互独立。本提案不切换包管理器、不修改 `pnpm-lock.yaml`，也不改变仓库固定使用 `pnpm@11.7.0` 的约定。

### 方案（已实现 + 验证，补丁在分支）

- 删除 `devDependencies` 中第二个重复的 `@deepseek-ai/cordis`
- 保留 `peerDependencies` 和 `devDependencies` 中各一处声明
- 不修改依赖版本、运行时代码、锁文件或安装配置

补丁分支：<https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/apiproxy-duplicate-cordis>

提交：[`[b51af4e6c7](https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/commit/b51af4e6c7c51fe0146d58f145cd14e2c07bb2f3)`](https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/commit/b51af4e6c7c51fe0146d58f145cd14e2c07bb2f3)

变更范围：1 个文件，+1/-2。

### 验证

- `package.json` 经 `ConvertFrom-Json` 解析通过
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis` 仅保留两处预期声明：一处 `peerDependencies`，一处 `devDependencies`
- `git diff master...HEAD --check` 通过
- 分支工作区干净，提交已同步到补丁分支

该补丁不改变解析后的依赖值或运行时行为，因此未增加运行时测试。完整 build/hygiene 检查留待仓库 CI 或维护者采纳时执行。

### 后续

已知 `CONTRIBUTING.md` 说明当前不接受外部 PR，本贴用于报告问题并提供可直接评估或采纳的最小补丁。

Bun 的 `InvalidPnpmLockfile` 问题不在本补丁范围内；如需调查，应作为独立问题处理，避免将包管理器迁移兼容性与 manifest 重复键混为同一根因。

--- 

## Proposal: Remove the Duplicate Cordis Dependency Key from host-apiproxy (Patch Branch Included)

### Problem

The `devDependencies` object in `packages/host/apiproxy/package.json` declares the same dependency twice:

```json
"@deepseek-ai/cordis": "workspace:^"
```

Tools that detect duplicate object keys, including Bun, report the following warning:

```text
warn: Duplicate key "@deepseek-ai/cordis" in object literal
at packages/host/apiproxy/package.json:92:5
```

Both entries have the same value, so the duplicate usually does not affect the resolved dependency. However, duplicate keys make the package manifest ambiguous and may be rejected by stricter parsers or package-management tools.

This warning is independent of Bun’s `InvalidPnpmLockfile` migration failure. This proposal does not switch package managers, modify `pnpm-lock.yaml`, or change the repository’s pinned `pnpm@11.7.0` configuration.

### Solution (Implemented and Validated)

- Remove the second `@deepseek-ai/cordis` entry from `devDependencies`
- Retain one declaration in `peerDependencies` and one in `devDependencies`
- Leave dependency versions, runtime code, the lockfile, and installation configuration unchanged

Patch branch: <https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/apiproxy-duplicate-cordis>

Commit: [`[b51af4e6c7](https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/commit/b51af4e6c7c51fe0146d58f145cd14e2c07bb2f3)`](https://github.com/13ob0/deepseek-harness/commit/b51af4e6c7c51fe0146d58f145cd14e2c07bb2f3)

Change scope: one file, +1/-2.

### Validation

- Successfully parsed `package.json` with `ConvertFrom-Json`
- Confirmed that `@deepseek-ai/cordis` now appears only in the two expected locations: once in `peerDependencies` and once in `devDependencies`
- `git diff master...HEAD --check` passes
- The branch has a clean worktree and is synchronized with the patch branch on the fork

The patch does not change the parsed dependency value or runtime behavior, so no runtime test was added. The complete build and hygiene checks can run in repository CI or when maintainers adopt the patch.

### Follow-up

The current `CONTRIBUTING.md` states that external pull requests are not being accepted. This discussion is therefore intended to report the problem and provide a minimal patch that maintainers can evaluate or adopt directly.

Bun’s `InvalidPnpmLockfile` error is outside the scope of this patch. If further investigation is useful, it should be tracked separately so that package-manager migration compatibility is not conflated with the duplicate manifest key.

discussions.title: [Show and tell] dsh-academic-research — Bilingual academic research plugin for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
I’m sharing an independent third-party plugin for DeepSeek Harness: **dsh-academic-research**.

It is designed for teachers, students, and researchers who want a traceable research workflow rather than a generic chat assistant.

It supports:

- bilingual literature discovery;
- evidence matrices and literature reviews;
- academic writing and revision;
- citation and bibliography checking;
- reviewer-response drafting.

The plugin uses read-only public Crossref and OpenAlex connectors. It does not require an additional account or user authorization. It preserves source URLs, retrieval time, identifiers, and evidence availability, and it does not treat a public link as proof that the full paper was read.

Install it into a DSH profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/userInner/dsh-academic-research
```

Repository: https://github.com/userInner/dsh-academic-research

This is an independent community plugin, not an official DeepSeek product. DeepSeek Harness is currently in developer preview, so compatibility may change as the host evolves.

I would especially appreciate feedback from people using it for real literature reviews, manuscript revision, or citation audits. Which research workflow should be supported next?

中文补充：

这是一个面向老师、学生和研究人员的独立第三方插件：**dsh-academic-research**。

它支持中英文文献检索、文献综述、证据矩阵、论文写作与修改、引用核验和审稿回复。插件使用 Crossref 和 OpenAlex 的公开接口，不需要额外账号授权，并且保留来源地址、检索时间、标识符和证据可用性。

欢迎大家用真实科研任务试用，并反馈最希望增加的科研工作流。

discussions.title: Windows 目录选择器截断含特定 CJK 字符的路径时，readUtf16 误判字符串终止
discussions.body:
**Bug 描述**

Windows 下通过"浏览文件夹"选择工作区目录时，路径中如果含有某些 CJK 字符会被截断。例如选择 `D:\音频开发`，确认后工作区路径变成 `D:\音频`，随后报错：

```
workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "D:\音频": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'D:\音频'
```

**复现步骤**

1. 在 Web UI 中新建工作区
2. 点击"浏览文件夹"，选择路径中包含"开"字（U+5F00）的目录，例如 `D:\音频开发`
3. 确认后路径被截断为 `D:\音频`，创建失败

**根因**

`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` 中的 `readUtf16`：

```js
function readUtf16(koffi: Koffi, address: unknown): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768))
  let end = 0
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
  return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
}
```

该循环只检查每个 UTF-16 code unit 的**低字节**是否为 0 来判断字符串结束。"开"（U+5F00）编码为 `00 5F`，低字节恰为 `0x00`，被误判为 NUL 终止符，字符串提前结束。

**建议修复**

```js
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2
```

**环境**

- Windows（win32 / x64）
- DSH 0.1.0-rc.5（源码）/ 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 包均复现）

---

discussions.title: [BUG]遇到个bug，它自己改了，有效果并生成了一个报告
discussions.body:
# [BUG] Adding a workspace whose path contains a U+XX00 char (e.g. 开 U+5F00) fails: Win32 picker truncates the UTF-16 path at a single 0x00 byte

> 可直接粘贴至 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/issues
> 隐私说明：`<ProjectRoot>` 为占位符，代表复现机器上的真实本地根路径（可能含非 ASCII 目录名），已脱敏。

## Summary

On Windows, "Add workspace" opens the native `IFileOpenDialog` (spawned child process + koffi COM).
The selected folder path is read back as a UTF-16LE `LPWSTR`. `readUtf16()` in
`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` treats **any single 0x00 byte at an
even offset** as the string terminator, but a UTF-16 terminator is a full `0x0000` code unit (two zero
bytes). Any path containing a CJK character whose low byte is 0x00 (e.g. 开 = U+5F00, 一 = U+4E00) at an
even code-unit position is silently truncated at that character. The GUI then calls `workspace.create`
with the truncated path, the server's `fs.realpath` throws `ENOENT`, and the user sees:

```
workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "<ProjectRoot>\01": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath '<ProjectRoot>\01'
```

## Environment

- Windows (native directory-picker capability; host serves `native`)
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native` 0.1.0-rc.6 (installed), also current on `master` (checked 2026-08-14)
- DSH web GUI (local deployment)

## Repro

1. Create a folder whose name has an ASCII prefix followed by a character in the U+XX00 block.
   For example, under a Chinese-named parent: `<ProjectRoot>\01开发域`
   (the offending character 开 = U+5F00, low byte 0x00, sits at an even code-unit offset after `01`).
2. Add it as a workspace via the GUI 添加工作区 -> native folder dialog -> select the folder. (Typing the
   path into the dialog produces the same result.)
3. Error: `workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: ... realpath '<ProjectRoot>\01'`
   — the `开发域` suffix vanished because the path was cut right before 开.

Note the Chinese-named parent segment survives because none of its code units has a 0x00 low byte
(which is a fingerprint of this exact bug, not a sign that CJK paths "mostly work").

## Root cause

`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts`:

```ts
function readUtf16(koffi: Koffi, address: unknown): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768))
  let end = 0
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2   // <-- treats any even 0x00 byte as terminator
  return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
}
```

`开` = U+5F00 encodes little-endian as `00 5F`, so the loop stops right at the first byte of 开.

Reproduction of the loop semantics on the path (Node):

```
original: "<ProjectRoot>\01开发域"
buggy   : "<ProjectRoot>\01"      (matches the error exactly)
fixed   : "<ProjectRoot>\01开发域"
```

Secondary issue (same function, lower severity): `koffi.view(address, 32768)` reads up to 32 KiB past the
CoTaskMemAlloc'd string — a latent out-of-bounds read hazard that should be bounded differently.

## Suggested fix (one line)

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2
```

A terminator is only a complete `0x0000` code unit. Optionally also guard the read window with a much
smaller bounded scan and/or use the buffer size the string actually owns.

## Server side is not at fault

Verified by calling `POST /api/workspace.create` with the full path directly — the server registers the
workspace correctly. `fs.realpath`, the RPC transport, and the payload schema all handle Unicode paths
fine. The truncation happens purely in the client-side native picker's `readUtf16`.

discussions.title: [bug] Flaky timeout in scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts under full parallel suite (spawnSync + default 5s vitest timeout)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts` → **"checks preserved TypeGraph syntax without type-aware analysis"** intermittently times out (default 5000ms vitest timeout) when the full test suite runs in parallel. It passes reliably in isolation (~511ms).

## Evidence

Ran `pnpm run test` (full suite, 13512 tests) twice on a fresh clone (master @ 47f9438, Node v22.19.0, pnpm 11.17.0):

- **Run 1**: `Test Files 1 failed | 802 passed`, `Tests 1 failed | 13402 passed` — the failing test is this one: `Error: Test timed out in 5000ms.` at `scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts:199`
- **Run 2**: `Test Files 803 passed | 8 skipped`, `Tests 13403 passed | 109 skipped` — all green

Isolated run: `npx vitest run scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts` → **13/13 passed**, the specific test completes in **511ms**.

## Root cause

The test invokes oxlint via **synchronous** `spawnSync` (see `scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts:30-36`, `runOxlint`) and relies on vitest's default 5000ms per-test timeout. Under the full parallel suite (811 test files), CPU contention pushes the oxlint subprocess past 5s → spurious timeout. It is a classic CI-flaky pattern: a fast test whose wall-clock budget is too tight for parallel load.

## Impact

Flaky CI failures on the coverage-gated pipeline; every occurrence forces a pointless re-run. `pnpm run test` is the primary gate and this intermittently fails with zero product-code changes.

## Suggested fix

Add an explicit generous timeout to the suite or the test, e.g.:

```ts
describe('Oxlint executable contract', () => {
  ...
}, 30_000)
```

or make the test async with a proper timeout argument (`it('...', async () => {...}, 30_000)`). Alternatively (better) replace `spawnSync` with async `spawn` + bounded await so the process is not blocking the worker thread.

---

Verified on master @ `47f9438` (fresh shallow clone, Node v22.19.0, pnpm 11.17.0, macOS).

discussions.title: [bug] Reconnect can silently drop pending approval/question waits (resync() clears pending; mux replay frames race onConnected)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Pending approval/question waits can be **silently dropped on reconnect**, leaving the turn permanently blocked and the UI appearing stuck — because the two authoritative comments about replay-vs-resync ordering contradict each other, and the real ordering is racy.

## Evidence

`packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts:416-438` (`resync()`):

```ts
// Superseded, not settled: the baseline replay re-sends still-pending requested frames verbatim
// (same rpcId), re-minting fresh waits; a stale reference's respond() still reaches the host.
this.pending.clear()          // ← clears all pending waits on reconnect
this.pendingRev++
...
await this.open()
```

`packages/client/connection/src/client/connection.ts:133-137` (handshake):

```ts
// Strict readiness handshake: describe proves unary reachability, onOpen
// proves each physical stream is established before any frame —
// only then may onConnected fire, so the resync it triggers cannot outrun the
// subscribed baseline.
```

**Contradiction**: `session.ts` assumes replay re-sends pending frames **after** `resync()` clears them ("re-minting fresh waits"). `connection.ts` asserts `onConnected` fires before any frame — "resync cannot outrun the subscribed baseline". Both cannot be true for the same race.

The mux stream pump (`connection.ts:178-192`, `pumpStream`) starts consuming frames as soon as the stream opens — **before** `Promise.all([describe, streamsOpen])` settles and `onConnected` fires. The mux stream opens independently; replay frames (including `approval/requested`, `question/requested`) can be delivered and processed by `SessionManager.handleMuxEnvelope` → `Session.mint()` (creating fresh `PendingWait`s) **before** `describe` returns / `streamsOpen` resolves. Then `onConnected` → `session.resync()` clears `this.pending` entirely.

Result: a pending approval/question that existed across the disconnect is dropped mid-session. The host never resends it (it already sent it on this connection generation); the user never sees the interaction; the suspended turn blocks forever until a full page refresh.

## Trigger

Disconnect/reconnect while an approval or question is pending, with mux replay frames arriving before the describe/onConnected handshake completes (frame-light reconnects, i.e. the common case).

## Suggested fix

Before `resync()` clears `pending`, have the manager record the request identities (rpcId/approvalId) of the still-pending waits and re-arm replay expectations for those identities after resync — or, better, do not clear `pending` in `resync()` at all: let the generation invalidation supersede the pending identities and move the cleanup to the `session/subscribed` frame (same moment the queue mirror re-baselines), so ordering is guaranteed. Also consolidate the replay-ordering contract into one authoritative comment.

---

Reviewed at master `47f9438`. Web UI runs locally (http://127.0.0.1:3080) — this is a code-path race, not observed live (requires reconnect with pending interaction).

discussions.title: [bug] JSONL appendLines rollback can be skipped when handle.close() throws → duplicate seqs → session permanently unloadable
[bug] First-connect failure misreported as 'reconnecting'; retry loop has no cap and no terminal error state
discussions.body:
## Summary

Two related connection-state issues in `ConnectionController`:

1. **First-connect failure is reported as `'reconnecting'`** — the user has never been connected, yet the UI shows "reconnecting" semantics (should be "cannot connect / connection failed").
2. **The retry loop has no cap and no terminal error state** — when the backend exits, the page retries forever (500ms → 10s backoff) with only a `console.warn` as the user-visible error surface.

## Evidence

`packages/client/connection/src/client/connection.ts:107-168`:

```ts
private async loop(): Promise<void> {
  while (this.running) {
    ...
    try {
      ...
      this.emitState('connected')          // only on success
      ...
    } catch {
      if (!ac.signal.aborted) ac.abort()
    }

    await failed
    if (!this.isRunning()) return
    this.emitState('reconnecting')         // ← line 163: fires even if never connected
    this.attempt += 1
    console.warn(`[web-runtime] connection lost, retry #${this.attempt}`)
    const idle = new AbortController()
    await sleep(this.backoffDelay(this.attempt), idle.signal)
  }
}
```

`lastState` starts as `null` (line 66) and `emitState` dedupes only against the previous value (line 172-176), so the very first failure — when the host is not yet ready or already gone — emits `'reconnecting'` unconditionally. The UI banner then says "reconnecting" even though a connection never existed.

And nothing stops the loop: no retry ceiling, no `'error'`/`'failed'` state in `ConnectionState` (only `'connected' | 'reconnecting'`, line 40). After the backend process exits, the page spins forever with no visible error guidance — the only trace is a browser `console.warn`.

## Suggested fix

- Gate `emitState('reconnecting')` on `this.lastState === 'connected'`; if never connected, emit a distinct first-connect failure signal (or extend `ConnectionState` with `'failed'`).
- Add a retry ceiling / terminal state so the UI can render an error screen (with a "retry" affordance) instead of an eternal spinner.

## Note

The "no visible error when backend exits" part overlaps with an existing discussion; the unique part here is (a) the false `reconnecting` on first-connect failure and (b) the absence of any terminal failure state in `ConnectionState`.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [idea] One-command environment doctor for fresh installs (dsh doctor)
discussions.body:
## Idea

A **one-command environment doctor** for fresh installs (`dsh doctor` / `dsh diagnose`), run pre-`web` and pre-build.

## Motivation

A quick scan of recent discussions shows the same class of problems recurring — all environment/setup issues that a diagnostics command could catch instantly with actionable output:

- #605: `dsh web` fails on Linux — node-pty native module `pty.node` missing (no prebuild, no build fallback)
- #623: Build fails on fresh clone — tsdown cannot load config because `unrun` is not installed
- #609: Firefox can't open — WebGL errors
- #619: First-run Web UI appears stuck until API key and workspace are configured
- #607: "has anyone packaged this as a standalone desktop app" (setup friction)

## What it could check

- Node version vs `engines` (`^22.19 || >=24`), pnpm version vs `packageManager`, corepack state
- `node_modules` integrity: missing workspace deps / native modules (`pty.node` etc.), postinstall completeness, `pnpm install` freshness (lockfile drift)
- Web UI prerequisites: WebGL availability (headless/GPU-less environments), port 3080 conflicts, localhost bind
- First-run readiness: is an API key configured, is a workspace selected — with a pointer to the right config file instead of a stuck-looking UI
- Output as a checklist with ✅/❌ + exact fix commands per item (mirroring how `scripts/run-gates.ts` gates work but for user environments)

## Why it helps

The project is pre-release with breaking changes weekly; the fastest-growing cost for new adopters is environment diagnosis, and most of these discussions could be closed with a single command's output. It also gives maintainers a standardized "attach your `dsh doctor` output" template for bug reports.

Happy to help spec or prototype it (as a plugin, naturally 😄).

discussions.title: [Bug] 🚨 Cannot install dsh on Linux with GCC < 10 — node-pty fails to build under Node 24 (C++20) and runtime silently requires Node >= 22
discussions.body:
## Environment

- OS: Kylin Linux V10 SP1 (Debian-like), kernel 5.4
- Node.js: v24.14.0 / v20.20.2 / v22.23.2 (tested all three)
- npm: 11.19.0
- GCC: 9.3.0 (distro default)
- Package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`

## Summary

`dsh` cannot be installed/run on a stock Linux box whose GCC predates C++20, and the README's only documented command (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) does not reflect the real Node version requirement. Two distinct problems were hit:

### Problem 1 — `node-pty` fails to compile on Node 24 with GCC < 10

Reproduction:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
# or
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
```

Result (Node v24.14.0, GCC 9.3.0):

```
npm error g++: error: unrecognized command line option '-std=gnu++20'; did you mean '-std=gnu++2a'?
npm error make: *** [pty.target.mk:119: Release/obj.target/pty/src/unix/pty.o] Error 1
npm error gyp ERR! build error
```

Root cause:

1. `node-pty@1.1.0` is a hard dependency of `dsh` (via `@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal`) and its npm tarball ships prebuilt binaries only for `darwin-*` and `win32-*` — **no `linux-x64` prebuild** — so it must be compiled from source on Linux.
2. Node 24 (V8 12.4+) injects `-std=gnu++20` into the build via its bundled `common.gypi` (`cflags_cc` for Linux).
3. `-std=gnu++20` requires **GCC >= 10** (or Clang >= 14). Kylin V10 ships GCC 9.3.0, which only knows `-std=gnu++2a`, so compilation aborts.

### Problem 2 — `dsh` installs on Node 20 but crashes at runtime (silent engine mismatch)

Reproduction:

```sh
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh && dsh web   # on Node v20.20.2
```

`npm install` succeeds (only a non-fatal `EBADENGINE` warning), then `dsh web` crashes immediately:

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: loader entries failed to apply
  [errors]:
    - The requested module 'node:zlib' does not provide an export named 'createZstdDecompress'
    - TypeError: Promise.withResolvers is not a function
    - The requested module 'node:module' does not provide an export named 'stripTypeScriptTypes'
```

Root cause: `dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` uses Node 22+ APIs (`Promise.withResolvers`, `node:zlib.createZstdDecompress` — Node 22.6+, `node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes` — Node 22.18+) but `package.json` declares no `engines` field, so installation on Node 20 only warns instead of failing.

## Workaround (verified)

Use **Node 22.x LTS**:

- Node 22's `common.gypi` uses `-std=gnu++17`, so `node-pty` compiles fine with GCC 9.
- Node 22 also satisfies all runtime APIs `dsh` needs.

```sh
nvm install 22 && nvm use 22
npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
dsh web   # → http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

discussions.title: 通过反代访问提示大部分接口返回403
[bug] HTTPS 访问 127.0.0.1 时 /api 请求返回 403，localhost 正常
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

项目源码启动后，通过 HTTPS 访问 Web UI 时，使用 127.0.0.1 访问会失败，但使用 localhost 访问正常。

## 复现现象

- 访问 https://127.0.0.1 时，页面中的 API 请求返回 HTTP 403。
- 访问 https://localhost 时，功能正常。
- 目前观察到的错误：

```
transport failure for /api/host.pickDirectory: HTTP 403
加载提供方目录失败: transport failure for /api/llm.providers: HTTP 403
```

## 预期行为

127.0.0.1 和 localhost 都是本机回环地址。只要请求的 Host 和 Origin 属于同一个 HTTPS authority，/api 请求应该正常通过信任校验。

## 初步定位

两个失败请求都经过同一个 API trust fence。原实现直接比较 Host 和 Origin 的字符串化 host；在 HTTPS 场景中，Host 可能带有显式默认端口 :443，而浏览器的 Origin 通常省略默认端口。这样同源请求会被误判为不匹配，并在 RPC 分发前返回 403。

## 修复情况

我已经在 fork 中准备了修复：

- 比较 HTTP/HTTPS authority 时按协议计算有效默认端口。
- 保留跨站请求、DNS rebinding 和非 HTTP(S) Origin 的拒绝逻辑。
- 增加 Host: 127.0.0.1:443 与 Origin: https://127.0.0.1 的回归测试。
- 更新中英文文档和 Agent Note。

修复分支和提交：

https://github.com/hatakes/deepseek-harness/tree/agent/fix-api-https-default-port-trust

https://github.com/hatakes/deepseek-harness/commit/5ef2c674aab00bc5d7292038790c518e1005f771

由于当前仓库未开放 Pull Requests，我先在 Discussions 中报告这个问题，方便维护者确认根因并 review 修复方向。

discussions.title: Five community projects for DeepSeek Harness: SpecFlow, GitFlow, Guardian, Code Intel, and VS Code
discussions.body:
I built five community projects for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6. The first four are installable dsh.bundle packages. The fifth is a VS Code client built on the official JSON-RPC SDK runtime. Each project has CI, a public release, and evidence from a real DSH or editor run.

## Projects

- [dsh-specflow](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-specflow) provides specification artifacts, five skills, four commands, goal-backed implementation, and task-progress context.
- [dsh-gitflow](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow) provides approval-gated Git status, diff, log, commit, branch, and optional checkpoint tools.
- [dsh-guardian](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian) provides dangerous-operation policy checks, canonical output redaction, and a security-review workflow.
- [dsh-code-intel](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-code-intel) provides Tree-sitter symbol indexing with lexical or optional embedding-assisted search.
- [dsh-vscode](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-vscode) provides a VS Code sidebar that runs the official JSON-RPC SDK runtime, streams messages and tool cards, and opens durable file diffs in the native diff editor.

The four bundles are at v0.1.2 and install from prebuilt tarballs:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-specflow/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-specflow-0.1.2.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-gitflow/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-gitflow-0.1.2.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-guardian/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-guardian-0.1.2.tgz
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-code-intel/releases/download/v0.1.2/dsh-code-intel-0.1.2.tgz
```

The VS Code extension is at v0.1.1 and currently provides a macOS arm64 VSIX:

```sh
curl -fLO https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-vscode/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-vscode-darwin-arm64-0.1.1.vsix
code --install-extension dsh-vscode-darwin-arm64-0.1.1.vsix
```

![Real model and tool demonstration](https://github.com/lonelymoon87/dsh-vscode/blob/vscode-mvp-assets/dsh-vscode-real-api.gif?raw=true)

## Verification

- CI passes on Node 22.19 and Node 24 for all five repositories.
- Compatibility checks install each bundle against the latest published DSH package.
- All four v0.1.2 tarballs install together into a clean headless profile without profile-local DSH runtime copies.
- A real deepseek-v4-flash turn calls specflow_status, git_status, code_outline, and bash. Guardian redacts the fake token from canonical tool output.
- The v0.1.1 VSIX installs into a fresh official VS Code arm64 profile. Its runtime behavior is unchanged from the real model and bash-tool flow recorded above.

These projects are early community releases and are not maintained or endorsed by DeepSeek. GitHub Release tarballs and the VSIX are available now. npm and VS Marketplace publication can be added after publisher credentials are available. Please open compatibility and behavior reports in the relevant repository.

discussions.title: Bug: dsh plugin add with a github: spec links the dependency but does not append it to dsh.profile.bundles
discussions.body:
Environment: dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, pnpm 11.21, Windows. Reporter is the author of the dsh-exa-mcp third-party bundle (https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp).

Steps to reproduce:

1. `dsh plugin --profile exa-key add github:MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp` (fresh profile; also reproduced after remove + re-add, twice)
2. pnpm reports success: `+ dsh-exa-mcp git+https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-exa-mcp.git` and `Done`
3. `package.json` dependencies gets `dsh-exa-mcp: git+https://...` and pnpm-lock records it
4. But `dsh.profile.bundles` is NOT appended - `--dump-config` shows no `# == dsh-exa-mcp` layer

Same flow with a local directory spec (`add C:/path/dsh-exa-mcp`, a link: dependency) DOES append the bundle correctly.

Root cause trace (from the shipped lib): `runPlugin` calls `reconcilePlugins(before, dir)` on success; `reconcilePlugins` calls `exportsPatch(packageName, profileDir)` which does `resolveBundleDir(...)` + `readProfileManifest(...).dsh?.bundle?.patch !== undefined`. For a git-hosted install that resolve appears to fail (returns false), so the bundle is never pushed and a warning `declares no dsh.bundle` is printed that is easy to miss.

Impact: any plugin installed via github:/git+ spec silently does not activate, while the install itself reports success. Workaround for users: manually append the bundle to `dsh.profile.bundles` in the profile package.json, or use `--patch` overlays / local path installs.

Happy to provide more details or test a fix.

discussions.title: [bug] wakeDriver() synchronous throw during dispose permanently wedges agent in 'running' (whenIdle never settles → teardown deadlock)
discussions.body:
## Summary

If `wakeDriver()` throws synchronously (during agent disposal), the agent is stuck in `'running'` **forever**: `kick()` never executes, its `finally` never restores idle, `whenIdle()` never settles (deadlocking teardown), and subsequent `send()` calls dead-letter their messages. `cancel()` cannot recover it either.

## Evidence

`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:183-192`:

```ts
const driver = Promise.withResolvers<void>()
this.activityDone = driver.promise            // ① replaces activityDone with a never-settling promise
this.setPhase({ kind: 'running', ... })       // ② phase set to running FIRST
this.loopCtx.agents.withInitiator(this, () => this.kick()).then(driver.resolve, driver.reject)
                                              // ③ can throw SYNCHRONOUSLY (initiator scope disposed/closing)
```

`withInitiator`/`runWithInitiator` (`agent/src/index.ts:641`) throws synchronously with `DISPOSED_INITIATOR_MESSAGE` when the initiator scope is not active; accessing the `this.loopCtx.agents` property proxy during dispose also throws "inactive context". The throw happens **after** the phase is set to `'running'` and `activityDone` has been replaced — `kick()` never runs, so the finally block (`agent.ts:217-222`) that restores idle never executes. Same exposure in the `kick()` finally that calls `wakeDriver()` again (line 220).

## Repro (verified)

`ctx.fiber.dispose()` then `agent.followup(...)` → synchronous throw `cannot get required service "agents" in inactive context`; `agent.status` stays `'running'`; `whenIdle()` does not resolve within 300ms; inbox keeps pending messages. Verified with a temporary vitest case (removed afterward; no repo changes).

## Suggested fix

Wrap ③ in try/catch: on synchronous throw, roll the phase back to `{kind:'idle'}` (using the pre-`setPhase` turn value), `driver.reject(error)` so `whenIdle()` settles, and only then decide whether to rethrow per the call contract.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] Failed streaming attempt's assistant/chunk events become orphan log data after retry (phantom replay content, double token counts)
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a streaming request fails mid-stream and the retry succeeds, the failed attempt's `assistant/chunk` events stay in the session log as **orphan data**: the final `assistant/message` only references the second attempt's chunks via `sourceEventSeqs`, yet the first attempt's chunks are never deleted or marked. Replay/UI renders phantom half-generated assistant content; token counting and compaction double-count the failed content.

## Evidence

`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:343-371`:

```ts
for await (const chunk of stream) {
  signal.throwIfAborted()
  chunkSeqs.push(this.session.append('assistant/chunk', { turn, step, chunk }).seq)  // chunk persisted per-event
  assembler.push(chunk)
}
...
if (action?.kind !== 'retry') { throw new LlmError(...) }
continue   // ← retry: the failed attempt's already-appended chunk events are never cleaned up
```

Chunks have no `surfaceOp`, so the surface-replace on success cannot shadow them. The failed attempt's chunks are consumed by replay/token-counting/compaction but are not part of the final message's `sourceEventSeqs`.

## Repro (verified)

Scripted adapter emits `partial ` then an error finish; the retry succeeds. Result: 9 chunk events in the log, the final message references only 6 — seq 7,8,9 are orphans. Existing `request-error.spec.ts` only covers pre-stream failures, not this path. Verified with a temporary vitest case (removed afterward; no repo changes).

## Suggested fix

On retry/terminal failure, delete or mark the failed attempt's chunk events (needs a session delete primitive, or an attempt-group marker consumers skip), or buffer chunks and persist only after the stream succeeds (trade-off: loses mid-crash recovery fidelity).

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] Scheduler failure leaves dangling tool_calls in next-turn request history (tool/call persisted, tool/result never lands)
discussions.body:
## Summary

If the tool-call scheduler itself fails internally (not a tool error — those are wrapped into final results), the next turn's request carries **dangling `tool_calls` with no corresponding `tool/result`**: the `tool/call` event was appended and the `assistant/message` with the tool-call block was already persisted before dispatch, but no result ever lands. Strict OpenAI-compatible providers reject such history; lenient ones let the model fabricate results.

## Evidence

`packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:169-195 + 231-235` (with `agent.ts:381-398`):

`startCall` appends `tool/call` then dispatches. On internal scheduler failure (policy-waterfall plugin throwing, session-append validation failure, etc.), the catch does `Promise.allSettled` and rethrows; the already-recorded `tool/call` events and the persisted `assistant/message` containing the tool-call block have no matching `tool/result`.

Next round, `buildRequest` → `deriveMessages()` (`surface.ts:99-105`) carries that assistant tool_calls message verbatim into the request with no results. The module comment states this is intentional ("preserves already-recorded tool/call events without fabricating results"), but the downstream consequence for derived history is unhandled — a documented consistency gap.

## Trigger

Internal throw in prepare/dispatch/finalize (rare: plugin exception in the policy waterfall, session append failure).

## Suggested fix

Either synthesize an error result for calls that started but never committed (requires revising the documented semantics), or defer persisting the `assistant/message` until the tool group settles, preventing dangling tool_calls from entering derived history in the first place.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: deepseek harness网站打不开了
插件生态缺乏中心化治理
[bug] WebSocket downlink has no backpressure — unbounded memory growth on slow clients
[bug] settings-file: external edits silently overwritten in update race window — reconcile comment promises more than it delivers
discussions.body:
## Summary

`persistSection` reconciles from disk, but the section being rendered was computed by `write()` *before* the reconcile from a stale in-memory snapshot. The `patchNode` ns-level diff then `deleteIn`s the just-folded external keys and writes them away. External edits are silently lost, and the watcher won't correct them (text unchanged check).

## Evidence

`packages/settings/settings-file/src/index.ts:210-230` (`persistSection`) + `packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts:621-644` (`write`):

```ts
// persistSection
await this.reconcileFromDisk()          // ① fold on-disk external edits into this.text + publish
const output = this.spec.format === 'yaml'
  ? this.renderYaml(ns, section)        // ② section is the STALE value computed by write() before ①
  : this.renderJson(ns, section)
await writeFileAtomic(this.spec.filename, output, { mode: 0o600, dirMode: 0o700 })
```

```ts
// write
const current = this.section(ns) ?? {}                    // snapshot at call time (no external edits)
const section = mode === 'merge' ? mergeLayers(current, snapshot) : ...
await this.persist(ns, section)
```

`patchNode` (`settings-file/src/index.ts:81-92`) is a full ns-level diff replace (`deleteIn` removes keys absent from `next`). Timeline: external editor changes `ns.x` to `{a:1,b:2}` (still inside the ~100ms watcher debounce) → in-process `settings.update('ns',{c:3})` computes `section={a:1,c:3}` and enqueues → `persistSection` reconciles and publishes `{a:1,b:2}` → render diff with `next={a:1,c:3}` `deleteIn`s the freshly folded `b:2` and writes it out. External edit silently lost; the watcher reload later sees `text === this.text` and skips.

The reconcile comment promises "fold in any on-disk state this process has not observed yet … so the render below can never resurrect a stale document" — but the render *below* uses the pre-reconcile section. `expectedRevision` only detects this when the caller passes it; plain `update` doesn't.

## Trigger

External file edit + in-process `update` within the same debounce window (~100ms), or any overlap with `watch: false`.

## Suggested fix

Move the merge/replace computation inside `persistSection` and recompute the section from the reconciled `this.text` under the file lock; or diff pre/post reconcile sections and merge before writing.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] JSONL torn-tail repair and concurrent append from two processes can truncate each other's live writes
discussions.body:
## Summary

`materialize` uses `link()+EEXIST` to stop two processes from clobbering each other's session files, but the **append path has no cross-process coordination**. When two dsh processes share a session root: process A appends zstd frames while process B's `loadStored` reads a half-written frame, produces a `tornMarker`, and `commitRepair` → `truncate(path, tornStart)` cuts the tail of a frame A is still writing — A's handle was opened before the truncate and keeps writing from the old offset → holes/interleaved frames → corrupt log.

## Evidence

`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:651-701` (`appendLines`/`repair`), `436-444` (`commitRepair`), `543-556` (`materializePosix` link+EEXIST guard comment: "two processes materializing the same id concurrently cannot clobber each other"), `292-304` (`readStableFile`).

The single-process coordinator serializes per-id (`coordinator.ts:1010-1033`), but cross-process there is no such protection, while other code paths (link guard, `assertStoredIdentity` duplicate-id check) explicitly assume a shared root is a multi-process scenario.

## Trigger

Two processes (or profiles) sharing one session root with concurrent activity on the same session id.

## Suggested fix

Use O_APPEND single atomic write + file-level flock on the append path (aligned with materialize's cross-process guard), or verify the file revision hasn't changed since the read (reuse `readStableFile`'s stat loop) before `commitRepair` truncates.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] .tmp files left behind by a crash between temp write and link are never cleaned up (plaintext session data leak)
discussions.body:
## Summary

`writeSyncedTempFile` creates `<logPath>.<hex>.tmp` with `open(tmp,'wx')` + fsync; `materializePosix` only `rm(tmp)`s after `link(tmp, finalPath)` succeeds (and swallows rm errors). If the process crashes (or power fails) between temp creation and link, the temp file **persists forever** — there is no startup sweep, and `listSessionDirs`/`listArtifacts` don't recognize `.tmp` files. These temps contain the complete session content (plaintext or zstd) — disk accumulation plus a session-content leak.

## Evidence

`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts:543-568` (`materializePosix`), `606-616` (`writeSyncedTempFile`). Both POSIX and Win32 materialize paths share the issue.

## Trigger

Crash between temp write and link (small window, but every new session materialization passes through it once).

## Suggested fix

Sweep `*.tmp` files in session directories at backend startup (validate owner + random-suffix format before deleting), or replace link semantics with rename-based publish and fsync the directory after cleanup.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] SQLite scanRows torn-tail tolerance deletes valid events together with the bad row
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a bad row or seq gap appears **after the last `turn/end`**, `scanRows` marks that row *and every row after it* as torn (`tornFrom = preserved.length`), and `commitRepair` runs `DELETE FROM events WHERE seq >= tornFrom` — deleting valid events of the still-open turn that follow the bad row, then synthesizing only fake closers. One tail corruption discards more than the corrupted row.

## Evidence

`packages/session/session-persistence-sqlite/src/schema.ts:254-269`:

```ts
for (let i = 0; i < rows.length; i++) {
  const p = parsed[i]
  if (!p?.ok || p.event === undefined) {
    if (i <= lastTurnEnd) throw new Error(...)   // bad row in committed region → error
    break                                        // after last turn/end → tolerated as torn
  }
  ...
}
return preserved.length < rows.length ? { preserved, tornFrom: base + preserved.length } : { preserved }
```

`commitRepair` (`session-persistence-sqlite/src/index.ts:313-315`): `DELETE FROM events WHERE seq >= tornFrom` — everything from the first bad row to EOF is deleted, including valid events of the current unclosed turn. JSONL's scanner also errors on committed-region gaps, but SQLite's branch treats everything after `turn/end` as deletable. SQLite transactions normally preclude bad rows (defensive branch), but manual edits / foreign tool writes / cross-version leftovers hit it.

## Suggested fix

Torn tolerance should only cover the unclosed tail: keep consecutive valid rows after a gap (truncate at the gap, not to EOF), or restrict tolerance to strict EOF-truncation cases.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: [bug] Subagent catalog entries are never reclaimed after the menu closes — memory grows linearly with browsing
[bug] PartialAccumulator sparse-block compaction causes mid-stream React remounts of streaming content
discussions.body:
## Summary

`PartialAssistant.blocks` is a sparse array (block-start may arrive out of order, leaving holes) that gets compacted in `toPartial()`. React keys are the *compacted* array index, so filling a hole shifts indexes and React unmounts/remounts `MarkdownText` — rebuilding the incremental markdown parser and syntax highlighting mid-stream. Visually: occasional flicker/re-parse; at high frame rates: sustained jank (memo invalidation).

## Evidence

`packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/partial.ts:95-102`:

```ts
this.snapshot = { turn: this.turn, step: this.step,
  blocks: this.blocks.filter((b): b is AssistantBlock => b !== undefined) }
```

`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/AssistantMarkdown.tsx:53-66`:

```tsx
for (let i = 0; i < blocks.length; i++) {
  ...
  rendered.push(<MarkdownText key={i} text={block.text} ... />)
```

First render: block A (sparse index 1) compacts to index 0. Then `block-start(0)` arrives → compacted array becomes `[A', B]`, A's index moves 0 → 1 → `key={i}` drift → React node replacement → remount.

## Trigger

Streaming output with interleaved tool-call/text blocks where `block-start` arrives out of order (parallel multi-block streams).

## Suggested fix

Give `PartialAssistant.blocks` stable identities (e.g. key by block type + sequence, or maintain a stable `blockId` in the accumulator) and key renders on that instead of the compacted array index.

Verified at master `47f9438`.

discussions.title: 建议支持 Office 全家桶文件类型（Word/Excel/PowerPoint）
discussions.body:
## 建议支持 Office 全家桶文件类型

当前 deepseek-harness 支持的文档上传文件类型较少，希望增加对 Microsoft Office 全家桶（Word / Excel / PowerPoint）常见格式的支持。

### 建议新增的文件类型

- **Word**: `.doc`、`.docx`
- **Excel**: `.xls`、`.xlsx`、`.csv`、`.tsv`
- **PowerPoint**: `.ppt`、`.pptx`

### 理由

1. Office 文档是日常工作和商务场景中最常见的文件格式，用户大量的知识文档、报表、演示材料都是这些格式。
2. 目前主要支持纯文本 / Markdown 等格式，限制了实际使用场景。
3. 这些格式在开源生态中都有成熟的解析库（如 python-docx、openpyxl、python-pptx 等），实现成本可控。

希望能考虑在后续版本中加入支持，谢谢！

discussions.title: [插件分享] dsh-builtin-toggles：DSH Web 内置能力检查器 / Doctor（v0.3.1）
discussions.body:
> **Update · v0.3.1**
>
> 这个项目最开始确实是一个 built-in catalog + 安全开关。
> 0.3.x 之后定位已经收敛为 **Evidence-backed Built-in Capability Inspector / Doctor**：
> 重点是解释当前 DSH Web runtime 实际由什么组成、这些状态从哪里来、是否和 reviewed baseline 发生漂移，以及哪些 mutation 有足够证据可以安全执行。
>
> 9 个 UI controls 仍然保留，但现在只是很窄的附加能力。

## dsh-builtin-toggles

这是一个非官方 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件。

位置：

**设置 → 插件 → 内置插件**

![Capability Inspector 主视图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Starfie1d1272/dsh-builtin-toggles/main/docs/assets/builtin-toggles-inspector.png)

## 为什么后来从“开关”变成了 Inspector

...用很自然的话解释：
Loader / profile / Agent Preset 最终组成实际 runtime；
单看“启用/停用”很容易误解；
所以现在先回答：
- 当前有什么
- 来自哪里
- profile 是继承还是显式 override
- Host / Agent Preset 属于哪个 composition scope
- 与 reviewed baseline 是否发生结构漂移
- mutation 是否真正有资格执行

## 0.3.1 里一个实际遇到的问题

讲 Host `tool-bash` + Agent Preset `tool-bash` 的真实案例。

以前 bare id 判 duplicate → false drift → 9 个 leaf 全部 fail-closed；
现在按 composition scope 区分；
合法跨 scope 重名不报 drift；
真正 collision 仍 fail closed。

这其实是最能解释 Inspector 为什么不只是“开关面板”的案例。

## 现在可以做什么

- broad runtime inspection
- provenance / profile effective state
- Host / Agent Preset scope
- compatibility / drift findings
- anomalies / copied diagnostics
- Inspection API v1
- 9 个 reviewed UI controls

## 安全边界

简洁讲：
- exactly 9 manageable UI leaves
- unknown/core/Agent/external 都 locked
- mutation server-side recheck
- remote trusted host read-only
- mutation loopback-only
- 不管理第三方插件生命周期
- 不编辑 Agent Preset
- 不做 marketplace

## 安装

dsh 和 npx 两套。

## 当前兼容性

reviewed/tested baseline = published rc.6
不是 >= rc.6
runtime identity 缺失时保持 unverified
不猜版本

## 特别想听整合包 / Desktop 作者的反馈

这里才放这次真正新增的宣传目标：

- 如果你固定一个 DSH runtime / profile / patch，是否需要这样的 composition diagnostics？
- 是作为 optional diagnostic plugin 比较合适？
- 还是直接消费 Inspection API v1 接进自己的 Plugin Center？
- 最希望 upstream 稳定暴露哪些 runtime identity / provenance / composition metadata？

GitHub / npm / Release

discussions.title: 后台子代理完整汇报晚于最终答复送达，导致最终答复后出现一串追加确认回合
discussions.body:
### 背景

后台子代理完整汇报（`subagent-report` relay）晚于主 agent 的最终答复送达。主 agent 在收到全部 `subagent-settled` 通知后即交付最终答复，随后每个迟到的完整汇报 relay 触发一个确认回合，最终答复之后出现一连串追加回复，会话阅读混乱。

### 复现

1. 用 `subagent` 工具以 `run_in_background: true` 派多个子代理做深读任务
2. 主 agent 在收到全部 `subagent-settled` 通知后直接写最终答复，不显式调用 `tool-subagent-report` 收齐汇报
3. 等待各子代理汇报正文以 `subagent-report` relay 异步送达

### 实际结果

主 agent 在 turn 1 交付最终汇报后，turn 2–7 各收到一条 `subagent-report` relay（基础设施 / 数据身份 / 能力族 B / 能力族 A / 外部接口 / 文档），每条都唤醒主 agent 生成一条「收到…完整汇报」确认回合，六条追加回复排在交付物之后。会话 `session-4cae51a3-0455-4f16-b503-e32befbb232f` 完整可回放。

### 期望（建议方向，满足其一）

- (a) 主 agent 交付最终答复前能感知「完整汇报仍在途」并须先收齐
- (b) loop 识别「父 agent 已交付最终答复」，将迟到的 relay 合并为单条非交互通知，不再逐条生成确认回合

### 环境

dsh 0.1.0-rc（源码 `pnpm dsh web`），deepseek-v4-flash via deepseek-official，Windows 11。

discussions.title: Bug：run_code 内所有 tools.* 调用都被 missing required property "description" 拒绝
discussions.body:
# Bug：`run_code` 内所有 `tools.*` 调用都被 `missing required property "description"` 拒绝

## 概述

在一次 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）编码代理会话中，从 `run_code` 程序内部发出的**每一个工具调用**都会被拒绝，报错：

```
Error: invalid arguments: missing required property "description"
```

该错误**与被调用工具的 schema 是否有 `description` 字段无关**，也**与实际是否提供了 `description` 无关**。结果是 `run_code` 无法调用任何工具，从而阻塞了全部文件读写、命令执行与子代理委托能力。

## 环境

- 工具入口：`run_code`（唯一通过 `tools.*` 触达 SDK 所有工具的执行面）
- 模型/工具链：DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 会话
- 工作目录：`/home/g/project/OpenAPI-Gateway`

## 复现

不带任何工具调用的裸 `run_code` 程序可以正常工作：

```typescript
// ✅ 正常
return "run_code self works";
```

但只要加入*任意*工具调用就报错——包括那些 schema 里根本**没有** `description` 字段的工具：

```typescript
// ❌ bash（已显式传 description）
return await tools.bash({
  command: "rm -rf -- .zcode",
  description: "Delete the .zcode directory",
});

// ❌ read —— schema 中根本没有 description 字段
return await tools.read({ file_path: "AGENTS.md" });

// ❌ glob —— 没有 description 字段
return await tools.glob({ pattern: "AGENTS.md" });

// ❌ todo_write —— 没有 description 字段
return await tools.todo_write({ todos: [{ content: "x", status: "pending" }] });

// ❌ job_list —— 没有 description 字段
return await tools.job_list({});
```

以上调用全部返回同一条错误。

## 观察 / 复现矩阵

| 工具 | schema 是否有 `description`？ | 是否实际传入？ | 结果 |
|------|-------------------------------|----------------|------|
| `run_code` | 有（必填） | 已传 | ✅ 正常 |
| `bash` | 有（必填） | 已传 | ❌ 被拒 |
| `subagent` | 有（必填） | 已传 | ❌ 被拒 |
| `read` / `glob` / `job_list` / `todo_write` | **无** | 不适用 | ❌ 被拒 |

因此问题**不在于我们漏传参数**：
- 需要 `description` 的工具（`bash`、`subagent`）——我们传了，仍被拒；
- 根本没有 `description` 字段的工具（`read`、`glob`、`job_list`、`todo_write`）——照样被拒。

## 根因推测

`run_code` 的工具分发层似乎在验证每个 `tools.*` 调用时，都**无条件地要求一个 `description` 属性**；而校验层似乎又读不到（或剥离了）实际传入的那个值。由于所有 SDK 工具都只能通过 `run_code` 内部的 `tools.*` 触达，程序内部不存在任何绕过办法——该故障会阻塞会话的全部文件/命令/委托能力。

## 影响

- 无法读取任何文件（`read` / `grep` / `glob`）
- 无法运行任何 shell 命令（`bash`）
- 无法委托子代理（`subagent`），无法管理目标 / 待办（`todo_write`）
- 受影响会话实际上对于任何依赖工具的工作都已失效。

## 给维护者的建议

- 请用上面的最小示例（`read` / `glob` / `job_list`）复现——这些工具 schema 里没有 `description`，可以清楚地暴露这个多余的要求。
- 检查 `run_code` 嵌套 `tools.*` 调度的参数校验路径，修复那个无条件要求 `description` 的逻辑。
- 确认校验读取的是正确的（未被剥离的）args 对象。

discussions.title: NixOS 上 HMR 服务报 --expose-internals is required: node-addon-require-builtin 探测在 Nix 编译的 Node 上失败
discussions.body:
## 问题

NixOS 26.05 (x86_64) 上运行 `dsh web` 或 `dsh --profile cc-tui` 启动即失败:

```
Error: failed to apply loader entry 7e8acce1 (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr): --expose-internals is required for HMR service
```

对 cc-tui profile 还附带 `Cannot find package 'dsh-cc-tui'` / `dsh-session-persistence-sqlite` / `dsh-working-activity` 的 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND(loader.internal 为 null 时 bundle 包解析走错路径)。

加 `--expose-internals` 后一切正常(TUI 已实测可渲染)。

## 根因定位

`cordis-plugin-loader` 获取 Node 内部 ESM loader 有两条路径:
1. `process.execArgv` 含 `--expose-internals` 时直接 require
2. 否则用 `node-addon-require-builtin` (v0.1.4) 原生 addon 运行时探测

路径 2 在 Nix 编译的 Node 上失败:

```
require('node-addon-require-builtin').requireBuiltin('internal/modules/esm/loader')
-> Unsupported/no-getter (x64 sysv getter is not a recognized this->field accessor)
```

## 关键对照实验(排除平台/版本因素)

| 运行环境 | Node 版本 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| Nix 源码编译 node | v24.16.0 | addon 探测失败 |
| 官方预编译 node (nodejs.org) | v24.16.0 (完全相同) | requireBuiltin 返回正常 loader |

同一 addon、同一 Node 版本号、同一架构(x86_64 Linux):差异只来自 **Nix 从源码构建与官方预编译构建的 V8 内部布局不同**,addon 的运行时探测(node-addon-native-custom-loader)认不出 Nix 构建的 getter 布局。Windows(官方 MSVC 预编译 24.15/24.16)不受影响。

## 环境

- OS: NixOS 26.05.20260716 (Yarara), x86_64, glibc
- Node: v24.16.0 (Nix 从源码构建, /nix/store/...-nodejs-24.16.0/bin/node)
- dsh: 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm 全局)
- cordis-plugin-hmr 1.0.16 / cordis-plugin-loader 1.0.2 / node-addon-require-builtin 0.1.4 (linux-x64-gnu)

## 建议

1. 排查 `node-addon-require-builtin` 0.1.4 的探测逻辑对 Nix/源码构建 Node 的兼容性(或更新版本);
2. addon 探测失败时,报错信息应明确指出是 addon 探测失败而非笼统要求 `--expose-internals`(当前信息误导用户以为是启动参数问题);
3. 若短期无法修复,建议在文档中说明 NixOS/源码构建 Node 需 `--expose-internals` 启动。

discussions.title: Show dsh-cost-meter: per-session & daily API cost, budget and official balance in the Web GUI
discussions.body:
## dsh-cost-meter — session & daily API cost, budget and official balance in the Web GUI

DeepSeek Harness shows token usage but not **money**, and the official platform balance lives on a separate website. I kept a spreadsheet open just to know what a session costs. So I built a small plugin.

**What it does**

- **Per-session cost** badge in the composer dock or session header, with input / cache-read / cache-write / output token breakdown
- **Daily cost** and **official account balance** (total / granted / topped-up) in the sidebar
- **Budget box** with usage %, progress bar, over-budget warning (today / month / total / custom range)
- **Settings → 费用** dashboard: summary cards, per-session breakdown, day-level history (retention configurable)
- **Peak/off-peak pricing** with effective-time gating (matches the official peak-hours plan), current tier indicator
- **One-click official price sync** — parses the official pricing page and applies it; manual price editing as fallback

Billing is taken from the usage block of every model call (including subagents, compaction, title generation), matching the official bill.

**Try it**

 + "`sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter
`" + @"

(then restart dsh web)

Repo: https://github.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter · MIT · dsh-plugin topic

![promo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Han-1413141/dsh-cost-meter/master/docs/promo.png)

Known limitations: the official-page parser can break when the pricing page layout changes (manual editing is the fallback), and the session badge estimates at the current tier while the ledger records exact per-call billing.

Feedback very welcome.

RTL mixed-text rendering is broken when a sentence starts with an English word
discussions.body:
## Problem

Mixed-script messages (Arabic + English) render unreadably whenever a sentence
opens with an English word followed by Arabic — e.g. `Hello كيف حالك اليوم` is
treated as LTR and the Arabic word order gets scrambled.

Below is a self-contained prompt describing the root cause, the fix, and the
files to touch, so it can be picked up directly.

---

Fix RTL rendering of mixed Arabic/English text in the DeepSeek Harness web UI.

## Root cause
No element in the web client sets the `dir` attribute, so the browser applies
the Unicode bidi algorithm's first-strong-character rule (UAX #9, P2/P3): each
paragraph's base direction is decided by its FIRST strong directional character.
A sentence that starts with an English word (e.g. `Hello`, `Open`, `PDF`)
followed by Arabic is therefore treated as LTR, scrambling the Arabic word
order and making the sentence unreadable.

## Fix approach
Replace the first-strong heuristic with a dominant-direction detector:
1. Add a helper that counts strong RTL characters (right-to-left scripts,
   e.g. Arabic) vs. strong LTR characters (all other alphabetic characters
   via \p{Alphabetic}) across the WHOLE string, and returns 'rtl' only when
   RTL strong characters outnumber LTR ones. Digits, punctuation, and
   whitespace are neutral and never decide.
2. Apply the result as a `dir` attribute on:
   - user/steering message text (MessageText),
   - the MarkdownText document root (inherits into every block),
   - each block individually (p, h1-h6, li, blockquote, table cells,
     footnote items) using a `documentDirection` field on the render context,
     emitting an explicit `dir` only when a block's own dominant direction
     DISAGREES with the inherited one (so English paragraphs inside an
     Arabic-dominant document get dir="ltr" and vice versa),
   - the chat composer textarea stack (backdrop + textarea + mirror must share
     one direction or heights/wrapping diverge — set dir on their common
     container based on the draft),
   - the custom answer input/textarea in QuestionComposer.
3. Never emit `dir` for LTR-dominant or empty text: the browser default
   already reads those correctly, and the pinned DOM-parity fixtures
   (packages/client/ui-primitives/tests/fixtures/markdown-dom/*) must stay
   byte-identical — they contain no RTL text.

## Files to touch
- packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/text-direction.ts (new helper)
- packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/MessageText.tsx
- packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/MarkdownText.tsx
- packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/render.tsx
- packages/client/ui-primitives/src/index.ts (export the helper)
- packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx
- packages/client/ui-user-questions/src/client/QuestionComposer.tsx
- Tests: markdown.client.spec.tsx, markdown-render-units.client.spec.tsx,
  input-bar.client.spec.tsx, user-questions-composer.client.spec.tsx

## Acceptance
- 'Hello كيف حالك اليوم' renders/typing with dir="rtl"; 'plain english'
  has no dir attribute.
- Mixed documents: Arabic paragraphs get dir="rtl" in LTR docs, English
  paragraphs get dir="ltr" in Arabic docs.
- DOM-parity fixtures unchanged; vitest suites pass; tsc -b tsconfig.client.json clean.

discussions.title: [Plugin] Workspace rules bridge for Cursor, Gemini CLI, and GitHub Copilot
discussions.body:
## dsh-plugin-workspace-rules

I built a small out-of-tree plugin that reuses existing workspace instructions from other coding agents in DeepSeek Harness:

- `.cursorrules`
- `GEMINI.md`
- `.github/copilot-instructions.md`

Repository: https://github.com/youjiaqi421/dsh-plugin-workspace-rules

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:youjiaqi421/dsh-plugin-workspace-rules
```

The package is a Harness bundle and adds one configurable `workspace-rules` row. pnpm 10+ may require explicitly allowing the Git dependency's `prepare` build, as described in the README.

### Behavior

- Reads files in configured order and ignores missing or empty files.
- Re-reads files before each model request, so edits do not require a Harness restart.
- Preserves literal `{{...}}` text instead of treating it as a Harness prompt variable.
- Requires relative paths inside the workspace root and rejects symlink targets outside it.
- Uses strict UTF-8 decoding with configurable per-file and total byte limits.
- Fails loudly for unreadable, duplicate, invalid, or oversized inputs.

### Validation

- TypeScript strict typecheck
- 9 unit/integration tests, including a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` assembly
- Production ESM build and declaration generation
- Package-content dry run

Feedback on the default file set and prompt placement is welcome.

---

这是一个树外 Harness 插件，用于直接复用 Cursor、Gemini CLI 和 GitHub Copilot 的工作区指令。它会在每次模型请求前重新读取规则文件，同时限制路径、符号链接、UTF-8 和内容大小，避免静默加载不完整或越界的指令。欢迎反馈默认支持的文件类型和系统提示位置。

discussions.title: Rewrite shipped preset picker copy for product users
discussions.body:
The Web mode picker currently names tools and SDKs (`str_replace_editor`, Code Mode SDK, TypeScript, PTC) instead of saying what each mode is for. A few of the names also point people at the wrong job.

Upstream has pull requests disabled, so here is a fork branch plus a compare link:

- Fork: https://github.com/Victor-Xiaoyu-Ye/deepseek-harness
- Branch: https://github.com/Victor-Xiaoyu-Ye/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/user-facing-preset-picker-copy
- Compare: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Victor-Xiaoyu-Ye:deepseek-harness:feat/user-facing-preset-picker-copy

## What looks wrong today

1. Chinese **PTC 模式** vs English **Code mode**. PTC is unexplained, and it does not match the preset id `code` or the public site.
2. Translating Code mode as **代码模式** would sit next to **标准模式** and read as "the mode for writing code" — but Standard mode is already the coding assistant.
3. **极简模式** reads as a beginner or easier choice. It is a two-tool runtime for measuring the model.
4. **创造模式** reads as a more imaginative chat. It is the path for authoring a custom assistant.
5. Descriptions list internal machinery instead of when to pick the mode.

## Proposed picker copy

| Mode | Copy |
| --- | --- |
| **标准模式** / Standard mode | 日常写代码、改文件、查资料的完整助手。不确定选哪个时，用这个。 / Everyday coding assistant for files, commands, web search, planning, and splitting work. Start here if you are unsure. |
| **高效模式** / Code mode | 能力和标准模式相同，一次能连续做完多步。步骤多或能并行时通常更快、更省用量。 / Same abilities as Standard mode, but finishes several steps in one go. Better when the work has many steps or can run in parallel. |
| **极简模式** / Minimal mode | 只保留终端和改文件，用来评测模型。没有搜索、计划或分工，日常请选标准模式。 / Only a terminal and file editor, for measuring the model. Everyday work belongs in Standard mode. |
| **创造模式** / Creator mode | 用来自制一套助手。能力和标准模式相同，还能查看运行环境、试插件，并按指引写出新配置。 / For building your own assistant. Same abilities as Standard mode, plus inspecting the live runtime, trying plugins, and a walkthrough for writing a new configuration. |

Preset ids, compositions, and English display names are unchanged. Chinese Code-mode display text is **高效模式** on purpose, so it is not read as "write code". The settings intro and specialist CLI docs that name `bash` / `str_replace_editor` as a composition contract are left alone.

Happy to adjust wording if maintainers want a different Chinese name for Code mode, or if Minimal / Creator should be renamed rather than only re-described.

discussions.title: [Bug][macOS][v0.1.0-rc.6] “添加工作区”缺少即时反馈，目录选择器启动延迟且可能未置前
discussions.body:
## 问题摘要

在 macOS 上点击侧栏“添加工作区”按钮后，界面没有即时反馈。系统目录选择器出现前存在明显可感知的等待，容易让用户误以为点击没有生效并再次点击。

该现象已在以下两种环境中复现：

- 普通桌面浏览器打开 DSH Web UI；
- 基于 WKWebView 的 macOS 桌面包装应用。

两种环境的表现一致，因此问题位于 DSH Web UI 与 host native directory picker 的公共调用链路，并非 WKWebView 包装器特有问题。

本报告只讨论侧栏标题栏中的“添加工作区”按钮，不讨论 Hero 页面中的工作区选择菜单。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness：`0.1.0-rc.6`
- 操作系统：macOS
- 服务地址：`127.0.0.1:3080`
- 目录选择能力：native directory picker
- 当前 macOS native picker 实现：`osascript` + AppleScript `choose folder`
- 已复现客户端：
  - 普通桌面浏览器
  - DeepSeekHarnessMac（WKWebView）

## 已确认现象

1. 点击侧栏“添加工作区”按钮后，按钮本身没有 loading、pressed 或 disabled 状态。
2. 从点击到系统目录选择器出现之间存在明显可感知延迟。
3. 等待期间按钮仍然可以再次点击，没有防重复触发机制。
4. 在普通浏览器和 WKWebView 包装应用中，目录选择器都可能没有立即出现在最前方。
5. 宽侧栏模式下按钮命中区域约为 `28 × 28px`，点击边缘时体验不够稳定。

## 复现步骤

1. 在 macOS 上运行：

   ```bash
   npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
   ```

2. 使用普通桌面浏览器打开：

   ```text
   http://127.0.0.1:3080
   ```

3. 确保左侧栏处于展开状态。
4. 点击“工作区”标题右侧的“添加工作区”按钮。
5. 观察系统目录选择器出现前的按钮状态。
6. 在选择器出现前尝试快速再次点击按钮。
7. 取消目录选择器，观察按钮和选择流程是否正确复位。
8. 在 WKWebView 包装应用中重复上述操作，可以观察到相同的延迟和反馈缺失。

## 当前行为

- 点击后按钮外观没有变化。
- 用户无法判断点击是否已被接受。
- 等待过程中按钮仍可重复点击。
- 系统目录选择器出现存在可感知延迟。
- 目录选择器可能没有立即成为最前方窗口。
- 较小的按钮命中区域进一步放大了“不跟手”的感受。

## 期望行为

- 点击后按钮立即显示 busy/loading 状态。
- busy 期间按钮不可重复点击。
- 目录选择器取消、报错或工作区创建完成后，busy 状态统一清理。
- 系统目录选择器应可靠地出现在最前方。
- 按钮应具有更舒适、稳定的点击区域。

## 源码观察

### 1. 按钮使用 toggle 状态

侧栏按钮当前执行：

```tsx
setWsPickerOpen(v => !v)
```

相关文件：

[`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx)

对于侧栏“只添加工作区”的入口，toggle 并不是必需的。使用幂等的 `setWsPickerOpen(true)` 更符合该操作的语义，也可以避免重复点击反转外层状态。

### 2. 目录流程在后续 Effect 中启动

`WorkspacePickFlow` 在 `addOnly=true` 时，通过 Effect 检测：

```tsx
open && addIsTheOnlyEntry && !flowBusy
```

条件满足后才调用 `openDirectoryFlow()`。

相关文件：

[`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/WorkspacePicker.tsx`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/WorkspacePicker.tsx)

这一轮 React 状态往返本身不是系统选择器延迟的主要来源，但按钮没有即时反馈，所以等待过程会被用户感知为“点击没有生效”。

### 3. 已有 `flowBusy` 没有反馈给侧栏按钮

`WorkspacePickFlow` 已经计算：

```tsx
const flowBusy = flowOpen || pickingFolder
```

这个状态能够覆盖：

- 正在打开或等待目录选择器；
- 用户已经选择目录，正在执行 `createWorkspace`；
- 用户取消选择器；
- 目录选择器报错；
- 工作区创建成功或失败。

但目前该 busy 状态没有反馈给侧栏“添加工作区”按钮，主要只用于禁用菜单项。

### 4. macOS picker 每次启动 `osascript`

macOS 分支通过外部 `osascript` 进程执行 AppleScript `choose folder`：

[`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/index.ts`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/index.ts)

外部进程启动以及 macOS 的应用激活、窗口焦点行为，会增加实际等待，并可能影响目录选择器的置前表现。

由于普通浏览器和 WKWebView 中均能复现相同行为，这一现象与 host 侧 native picker 的公共实现一致。

### 5. 按钮命中区域较小

宽侧栏模式下，按钮约为：

```css
width: 28px;
height: 28px;
```

标题操作区域还设置了固定 `max-width` 和 `overflow: hidden`。如果扩大按钮，需要同步调整父容器宽度，否则新增的命中区域可能被裁剪。

## 建议的最小修复

### 1. 幂等打开并立即进入 busy

侧栏按钮可以改为：

```tsx
onClick={() => {
  if (workspacePickerBusy) return
  setWorkspacePickerBusy(true)
  setWsPickerOpen(true)
}}
disabled={workspacePickerBusy}
aria-busy={workspacePickerBusy}
```

busy 时显示固定尺寸的 spinner，避免按钮内容切换造成布局跳动。

### 2. 将 `flowBusy` 变化反馈给调用方

为 `WorkspacePickFlow` 增加一个可选回调：

```tsx
onFlowBusyChange?: (busy: boolean) => void
```

仅在 `flowBusy` 真正翻转时通知调用方。侧栏入口使用该回调维持并最终清理按钮 busy 状态；Hero 等其他入口不传该属性，继续保持现有行为。

这样可以统一覆盖：

- 取消目录选择；
- 目录选择器报错；
- `createWorkspace` 成功；
- `createWorkspace` 失败。

不需要在父组件分别维护 `openingPicker` 和 `adoptingWorkspace`。

### 3. 扩大命中区域

建议仅将侧栏“添加工作区”按钮扩大到约 `36 × 36px`，并同步调整标题操作容器宽度。

如果宽态下同时存在一个 `28px` 按钮、一个 `36px` 按钮和 `4px` 间距，父容器至少需要约：

```text
28 + 4 + 36 = 68px
```

放大时还应检查 section header 的高度，避免按钮纵向裁剪。

### 4. macOS 原生选择器作为独立增强

在通用 DSH host 中，可以继续改进 `osascript` 的应用激活和焦点行为。

对于原生 macOS 宿主，也可以考虑允许宿主提供目录选择能力，例如：

```text
DSH client directory picker
  → native host bridge
  → NSOpenPanel
  → selected path
  → createWorkspace
```

这一部分属于独立的平台增强，不需要与按钮反馈修复绑定。

## 影响

该问题不会造成工作区数据损坏，但会明显影响第一次使用和频繁切换项目时的体验：

- 用户难以确认点击是否成功；
- 容易产生重复点击；
- 目录选择器未置前时，看起来像功能失效；
- 较小的命中区域会进一步放大“点击没有生效”的感受。

由于普通浏览器中也能复现，该问题属于 DSH Web UI 与 host native picker 的公共链路，而不是某个桌面包装器的兼容性问题。

## 补充观察：尚待稳定复现

以下行为目前只作为观察记录，不作为本报告的确定结论：

1. 在目录选择器出现前快速再次点击，取消选择器后可能再次触发目录选择流程。
2. Hero 工作区菜单打开时，再次点击菜单触发按钮，可能存在 document-level `pointerdown` 关闭后，按钮 `click` 又重新打开的竞态。

这两个现象涉及不同入口，建议在获得稳定复现步骤后分别讨论。

## 补充复现环境

我还在一个非官方 SwiftUI macOS 包装项目中复现了相同行为：

[Carleo10032/deepseek-harness-mac](https://github.com/Carleo10032/deepseek-harness-mac)

该项目启动官方 `dsh web` 本地服务，并在 `WKWebView` 中加载官方 Web UI。它没有替换工作区选择流程或 host native directory picker。

由于普通浏览器中也能独立复现，因此该仓库只作为补充复现环境和 macOS 宿主参考，不是本问题成立的前提。

## 可补充材料

如有需要，我可以进一步提供：

- 点击到目录选择器出现的屏幕录制；
- 快速重复点击的录屏；
- 普通浏览器中的复现录屏；
- WKWebView 中的复现录屏；
- 基于上述最小修复方案的本地验证结果。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness 交流群
[Bug] Literal {{...}} in a third-party tool description breaks code-mode prompt assembly
discussions.body:
## Problem

In code mode, the `tools:sdk` prompt section embeds each tool's `description` into the generated TypeScript/Python SDK as a JSDoc/docstring comment. If a third-party tool description contains a literal `{{...}}`, the system-prompt interpolator misreads it as a prompt variable reference and the whole turn fails before the model is called:

```
malformed prompt variable reference "{{...}}" in section "tools:sdk" (variable names match /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/)
```

Triggered in practice by the `officecli` MCP server, whose single tool description contains `... scan for leftover placeholders (xxxx, lorem/ipsum, <TODO>, {{...}}, $VAR$, empty ()/[]) ...`.

## Fix

Escape `{{` when emitting a description into the SDK text ??splitting the brace pair so the interpolator (which has no literal-escape syntax) never sees a `{{...}}` group:

- `packages/core/tools/src/ts-types.ts` `docLines`: add `.replaceAll('{{', '{ {')`.
- `packages/core/tools/src/py-types.ts`: do it once in `describe()` so the docstring, field `#` comment, and subscript comment all share the behavior.

Regression tests added for both renderers. Verification: `pnpm vitest run packages/core/tools/tests/ts-types.spec.ts packages/core/tools/tests/py-types.spec.ts` ??64 passed; `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` and `tsdown --env.DSH_BUILD_FACE host` both exit 0.

(I attempted to open a PR with this fix first, but the repository's `pulls` endpoint returns 404 even anonymously, so reporting here instead.)

discussions.title: Python SDK: resuming a persisted session in a new process fails with id collision; session/load and session/resume are not exposed
discussions.body:
## Summary

`deepseek-harness-sdk` 0.1.0rc6 cannot resume a persisted session from a **fresh runtime process**. The first `run()` on a session works, but any later `run()` with the same `session_id` in a new process (e.g., after the host process restarts, or when a server runs multiple workers and the next turn lands on a different worker) ends immediately with an empty response:

```
turn/end reason.kind = "error"
error.message = 'session "<id>" already has a persisted log on disk that does not match this live session (id collision)'
```

## Expected behavior

A persisted session should be resumable from a new process. The runtime already implements `session/load` / `session/resume` (ACP methods), so a subsequent prompt should continue the conversation with the restored context instead of failing.

## Actual behavior

- First turn on a fresh session: works; `assistant/chunk` deltas and a final `assistant/message` are produced.
- Second turn with the **same** `session_id` from a **new runtime process**: immediately `turn/end` with `reason.kind == "error"` and the "id collision" message above. No `assistant/chunk` events; `final_response` is empty; `finish_reason == "error"`.
- Two sequential `run()` calls with the same `session_id` in the **same** runtime process: both succeed (the in-memory session object is reused).
- Calling `session/load` (or `session/resume`) directly via `harness.client.request(...)` fails with `JsonRpcError: unknown DeepSeek Harness SDK runtime method: session/load` — the SDK JSON-RPC server only accepts `initialize`, `session/prompt`, and `shutdown`.

## Reproduction

Environment: `deepseek-harness-sdk==0.1.0rc6` + bundled runtime (`deepseek-harness-runtime-bin==0.1.0rc6`), model `deepseek-v4-flash` via the official provider, Python 3.12.

```python
from deepseek_harness import DeepSeekHarness

cfg = dict(provider="deepseek-official", model="deepseek-v4-flash",
           cwd="/tmp", session_root="/tmp/dsh-sess")

# 进程 A：第一轮（新会话）
h1 = DeepSeekHarness(**cfg)
r1 = h1.run("只回复：一", session_id="dsh-resume-test")
print(r1.finish_reason, r1.final_response)  # completed, "一"
h1.close()

# 进程 B：新运行时恢复同一会话 → id collision，空回复
h2 = DeepSeekHarness(**cfg)
r2 = h2.run("只回复：二", session_id="dsh-resume-test")
print(r2.finish_reason, repr(r2.final_response))  # error, ''
```

## Impact

- Multi-turn conversations cannot survive a host process restart, which is common in server deployments (deploys, restarts, or multiple uvicorn workers behind a load balancer).
- Current workaround: start a fresh session for every turn and feed the previous messages back through the prompt. This loses tool/Bash state between turns and duplicates context.

## Suggested fix

- Expose `session/load` (or `session/resume`) through the SDK JSON-RPC server — the runtime already implements these ACP methods; or
- Make `session/prompt` adopt an existing persisted log when the requested session is not already live (treat "load/resume it instead of creating" as the default for existing sessions).

## Environment

- deepseek-harness-sdk 0.1.0rc6 (latest on PyPI)
- deepseek-harness-runtime-bin 0.1.0rc6
- Python 3.12; reproduced on macOS arm64 and Linux x64 bundled runtimes
