discussions.title: # [Feedback] 一个会话的提示词缓存命中率从 ~97% 掉到 ~11% —— 疑因会话中途工具集变化导致前缀缓存失效
discussions.body:
# [Feedback] 一个会话的提示词缓存命中率从 ~97% 掉到 ~11% —— 疑因会话中途工具集变化导致前缀缓存失效

> 注：仓库关闭了 GitHub Issues，所以把反馈发到这里（Discussion）。这是一个效率/成本优化的反馈，不是崩溃型 bug。

## TL;DR

在一次会话（"Magic Roguelike 3D Game Design"）里，**缓存命中率只有 ~11%**，而同机的其他会话都在 86–98%。排查后发现,大概率是**会话中途工具（function）列表发生了变化**，导致 DeepSeek 的前缀缓存从这一步起大面积失效,整条会话的命中率被拉垮。

## 背景 / 目的

dsh 每个 step 都会把完整消息历史重新序列化发给模型。DeepSeek 的提示词缓存是**自动前缀缓存**——只有两次请求的**前部逐字节一致**才能命中。请求前部 = `system prompt + 工具定义 + 历史消息`，而**工具定义紧跟在 system prompt 后面、位于前缀最前面**。一旦工具被增删，前缀就从那里断开,后面一大堆历史全部无法命中。

我想请官方/社区确认：**会话执行中途不应增删工具集（至少不应破坏一个 turn 内的前缀稳定）**，并希望据此优化。

## 实测数据（session session-e3ec5725）

来自 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache.json`：

- `uncachedInputTokens = 56,659`
- `cacheReadTokens = 6,656`
- 命中率 = `6656 / (6656 + 56659)` ≈ **11%**

（GUI 显示口径即 `dsh-client-ui-conversation` 的 `cacheHitPercent`：`round(cacheReadTokens / (uncachedInput + cacheRead + cacheWrite) * 100)`）

## 现场时间线（来自 session JSONL）

1. **Step 1** —— 请求头带 **26 个工具**，含一个自定义/运行时工具 `win_terminal_probe`（`request/header` `reason: initial`）。这一步冷启动（该步 usage `cacheReadTokens: 0`）；且模型为 `deepseek-v4-pro` + `reasoningEffort: max`，输出巨大——step 1 usage 里 `reasoningTokens: 45148`。
2. **Step 1 → Step 2 之间** —— 出现新的 `request/header` 且 `reason: change`：工具从 **26 → 25**，`win_terminal_probe` 被移除。
3. **Step 2** —— 由于工具定义在前缀区，删掉一个工具后，前面已经累积的大量历史（含那 4.5 万推理 token）无法命中缓存 → `uncachedInput = 47,728`，仅命中 `6,656`。

合计 63,315 个输入 token 计费、只有 6,656 命中 ⇒ 11%。

## 为什么重要

- harness 每个 step 都重发完整历史，但"前缀稳定"的前提被**会话中途的工具集变化**打破。
- 叠加 reasoning-max 模型把 prompt 撑得很大，一次前缀断裂就要重复计费几万 token，在 3 步的 turn 里就是一笔不小的、本可避免的开销尖峰。

## 复现模式（猜测，欢迎补充）

1. 起一个会话，让 step 1 注册了一个条件/运行时工具（例如插件加了 `*_probe` 工具）。
2. 到 step 2 时该工具消失（热重载、插件启用/禁用、后端状态变化等）。
3. 观察缓存命中骤降、`uncachedInputTokens` 涨到接近完整历史大小。

## 建议改进（开放式，欢迎讨论）

- **让一个 turn 内的工具集（前缀区）保持稳定**。若某插件工具是临时的：
  - 把工具增删推迟到 turn 边界（`turn/start`），而不是 turn 中间的 step 之间；或
  - 将易变/条件工具从缓存前缀区挪走/单独下发，让"常驻工具"在一个 turn 内固定不变。
- 在 token/trajectory 视图里给出"**工具列表变化导致前缀失效**"的单步提示，方便用户/开发者一眼看出某步为何脱缓。
- 若工具集**必须**变化，尽量放在新 turn 开头（首个请求本来就要重写缓存），而不要在打开中的 turn 内中途变。

## 环境

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh`）
- provider `deepseek-official`，模型 `deepseek-v4-pro`（reasoningEffort max）/ `deepseek-v4-flash`
- Windows + Web GUI（:3080）

## 参考 artifacts

- 会话 id：`session-e3ec5725-40bc-435d-b08f-9ce85e5ce4dd`（"Magic Roguelike 3D Game Design"）
- 证据：`request/header` seq 18（26 工具，initial）与 seq 45337（25 工具，change，移除 `win_terminal_probe`）；step-1 usage `{inputTokens:8931, outputTokens:45423, cacheReadTokens:0, reasoningTokens:45148}`；step-2 bucket `{uncachedInputTokens:47728, cacheReadTokens:6656}`。

discussions.title: Skills with an invalid frontmatter name are dropped silently — the user never finds out
discussions.body:
A skill whose frontmatter fails validation is removed from discovery and the only trace is a `logger.warn`. Nothing reaches the model catalog, and the package's own docs confirm the user cannot tell an invalid skill from an absent one. For anyone migrating a skill library from another harness, this fails in the worst possible way: the agent keeps answering confidently, just without the instructions you thought you had loaded.

### What happens

`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:20`

```ts
const SKILL_NAME = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/
```

`packages/skill/skill-filesystem/src/index.ts:816-819`

```ts
if (!isSkillName(name)) {
  ctx.logger.warn(`skill file ${path} ignored: invalid skill name "${name}"`)
  return undefined
}
```

There is no fallback to the directory name, and the same shape applies to missing frontmatter, a missing `name`/`description`, and an invalid invocation policy — ten `logger.warn` sites in that file, none of them aggregated anywhere.

`packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md` already states the consequence:

> **Malformed entries disappear with a warning** — the model catalog receives no per-skill diagnostic and cannot distinguish an absent skill from an invalid one.

### Reproduce

```sh
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills/my-skill
cat > ~/.dsh/skills/my-skill/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: My Skill
description: A skill that will never load.
---

Body.
EOF

dsh web
```

Ask the agent what skills are available. `my-skill` is not among them. Change `name` to `my-skill` and it appears. The only difference is a space and a capital letter in a field most people never think of as an identifier.

### Measured

Mounting `dsh-skill` + `dsh-skill-filesystem` over one custom root with five fixtures (`includeDefaultRoots: false`, `watch: false`), on `47f943859`:

| fixture | frontmatter defect | in `skills.list()` |
|---|---|---|
| `good-skill` | — (control) | ✅ |
| `bad-name-skill` | `name: Bad Name Skill` | ❌ |
| `missing-description` | no `description` | ❌ |
| `camel-invocation` | `userInvocable` instead of `user-invocable` | ❌ |
| `no-frontmatter` | no frontmatter block | ❌ |

Four of five silently removed, `errorsThrown: 0`, and `ctx.skills.snapshot()` returned **`complete: true`**.

### The part that makes it undiagnosable

`complete` is not the missing signal — it means something else, and correctly so (`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:235`):

```ts
/** Whether every registered provider completed without a concurrent catalog revision. */
readonly complete: boolean
```

So a consumer that wanted to warn the user has nothing to read: `SkillCatalogSnapshot` carries `skills` and `complete`, and neither can express "I saw five skill files and rejected four." The information exists at the moment of rejection and is discarded one line later. That is the gap — not the validation, and not `complete`.

### Why this is worth fixing rather than documenting

The validation itself is right — a kebab-case identifier is the correct constraint, and `/skill-name` invocation depends on it. The problem is only *how the rejection is delivered*.

Two things in this repo already argue for surfacing it:

1. **The codebase is loud everywhere else.** An invalid name from a plugin author throws:

   - `packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:743` — `validateRuntimeSkill`: `throw new Error(\`invalid skill name "${skill.name}"\`)`
   - `packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:712` — `validateCandidate`: `throw new Error(\`skill provider "${providerName}" returned invalid skill name ...\`)`

   Every programmer-facing mistake throws. The one user-facing mistake only warns. That asymmetry looks unintended: the user is the party least equipped to notice.

2. **The same class of problem is already solved one package over.** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` has `failOnStartupError` for exactly this — a source that would otherwise activate contributing nothing can be made to fail loudly instead. `dsh-skill-filesystem` has no equivalent.

The migration cohort makes it urgent rather than merely untidy. `~/.agents/skills` is scanned by default, which is an invitation to point an existing library at DSH; a library written for a harness with looser frontmatter rules will lose an arbitrary subset of its skills on arrival, and the loss is invisible from inside the session.

### Suggested change, cheapest first

1. **A `rejected` count (or list) on `SkillProviderObservation` / `SkillCatalogSnapshot`**, so a consumer can render "3 skill files were ignored — run with `--verbose` for paths". Additive, no change to `skills` or `complete`, and nothing new reaches the model.
2. **A `failOnInvalidSkill` config flag** mirroring `mcp-client`'s `failOnStartupError`, default `false`. Opt-in strictness for people who would rather not boot than boot half-loaded.
3. **A one-line startup summary** when the count is non-zero. This is the version a non-developer user actually benefits from.

Any one of the three would have made this self-diagnosing. (1) alone seems like the best ratio.

Happy to supply more detail on any of it.

---

<!-- 中文版 -->

## 中文

frontmatter 校验失败的 skill 会被从发现结果中移除，唯一的痕迹是一条 `logger.warn`。模型 catalog 里什么都不会出现，而该包自己的文档也确认：用户无法区分「skill 不存在」和「skill 非法」。对正在从别的 harness 迁移 skill 库的人来说，这是最坏的一种失败方式——agent 依然自信作答，只是少了你以为已经加载的那份指令。

### 现象

`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:20`

```ts
const SKILL_NAME = /^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$/
```

`packages/skill/skill-filesystem/src/index.ts:816-819`

```ts
if (!isSkillName(name)) {
  ctx.logger.warn(`skill file ${path} ignored: invalid skill name "${name}"`)
  return undefined
}
```

没有回退到目录名。缺 frontmatter、缺 `name`/`description`、invocation 策略非法，都是同样的形状——该文件里共 10 处 `logger.warn`，没有任何一处被汇总。

`packages/skill/skill-filesystem/README.md` 已经写明了后果：

> **Malformed entries disappear with a warning** — the model catalog receives no per-skill diagnostic and cannot distinguish an absent skill from an invalid one.

### 复现

同上英文代码块。把 `name` 改成 `my-skill` 就会出现。差别只是一个空格和一个大写字母，而多数人根本不会把这个字段当成标识符。

### 实测

在 `47f943859` 上挂载 `dsh-skill` + `dsh-skill-filesystem`，单个自定义根、5 个 fixture（`includeDefaultRoots: false`、`watch: false`）：

| fixture | frontmatter 缺陷 | 出现在 `skills.list()` |
|---|---|---|
| `good-skill` | —（对照） | ✅ |
| `bad-name-skill` | `name: Bad Name Skill` | ❌ |
| `missing-description` | 无 `description` | ❌ |
| `camel-invocation` | 写成 `userInvocable` 而非 `user-invocable` | ❌ |
| `no-frontmatter` | 无 frontmatter | ❌ |

5 个里静默移除 4 个，`errorsThrown: 0`，且 `ctx.skills.snapshot()` 返回 **`complete: true`**。

### 真正让它无法自诊的地方

`complete` 不是那个缺失的信号——它表达的是另一件事，而且表达得没错（`packages/skill/skill/src/index.ts:235`）：

```ts
/** Whether every registered provider completed without a concurrent catalog revision. */
readonly complete: boolean
```

所以一个想提醒用户的消费方无处可读：`SkillCatalogSnapshot` 只有 `skills` 和 `complete`，两者都无法表达「我看到 5 个 skill 文件，拒绝了 4 个」。这个信息在拒绝的那一刻是存在的，下一行就被丢掉了。缺口在这里——不在校验规则，也不在 `complete`。

### 为什么值得修，而不是写进文档

校验本身是对的——kebab-case 作为标识符的约束是合理的，`/skill-name` 调用也依赖它。问题只在**拒绝的方式如何传达**。

仓库里已有两点支持把它暴露出来：

1. **这套代码在别处都是「响」的。** 插件作者写错名字会抛异常（`skill/src/index.ts:743` 的 `validateRuntimeSkill`、`:712` 的 `validateCandidate`）。**每一个面向程序员的错误都抛异常，唯独唯一一个面向用户的错误只写一条 warn。** 这个不对称看起来不是有意为之——用户恰恰是最没有能力察觉它的一方。
2. **同类问题在隔壁包里已经解决过。** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 的 `failOnStartupError` 正是为此而设：一个本来会「激活但什么都不贡献」的来源，可以选择改为直接失败。`dsh-skill-filesystem` 没有对应物。

迁移人群让这件事从「不整洁」变成「紧急」：`~/.agents/skills` 默认就在扫描范围内，这等于邀请大家把已有的 skill 库指向 DSH；而一个按更宽松规则写成的库，迁过来会丢掉任意一个子集，且在会话内部完全不可见。

### 建议的修改（按成本从低到高）

1. **在 `SkillProviderObservation` / `SkillCatalogSnapshot` 上加一个 `rejected` 计数（或列表）**，让消费方能渲染「3 个 skill 文件被忽略」。纯增量，不动 `skills` 和 `complete`，也没有任何新东西进入模型上下文。
2. **加一个 `failOnInvalidSkill` 配置项**，对齐 `mcp-client` 的 `failOnStartupError`，默认 `false`。
3. **计数非零时打一行启动摘要。** 这是真正让非开发者用户受益的版本。

三者任一都能让这个问题自我暴露。单做 (1) 性价比最高。

discussions.title: Modal focus can escape to the page, and one Escape closes nested dialog layers
discussions.body:
# Modal focus can escape to the page, and one Escape closes nested dialog layers

## Summary

The shared Web UI `Modal` exposes two related modal-stack problems:

1. keyboard focus is not contained by the active dialog, so `Shift+Tab` can move focus to controls behind it;
2. every mounted modal-like layer installs its own document-level `keydown` listener, so the same `Escape` event can close more than the topmost layer.

I reproduced both behaviors in the current Web UI at commit [`47f9438`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a).

## Real reproduction

Environment: Windows 10, Chromium, local Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, source checkout at `47f9438`.

1. Open **Settings**.
2. Select **Agent presets**.
3. Click **Copy Standard** to open the copy-preset modal above Settings.
4. The identifier input receives focus.
5. Press `Shift+Tab` once: focus moves to the copy modal's Close button.
6. Press `Shift+Tab` again: focus moves behind the modal to the Settings “close details” control.
7. Press `Escape` once.

Observed:

- focus reaches an interactive control behind the `aria-modal="true"` dialog;
- one `Escape` closes both the copy-preset modal and the Settings panel.

Expected:

- `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` stay within the topmost modal;
- `Escape` dismisses only the topmost modal;
- closing the modal restores focus to its opener.

## Call chain

The copy-preset flow mounts the shared `Modal` inside the already-open Settings panel:

```text
SettingsRoot
  -> SettingsPanel
     -> Agent presets section
        -> Copy Standard
           -> shared Modal (copy-preset dialog)
```

Two independent document listeners then receive the same bubbling `keydown` event:

- [`Modal.tsx#L44-L51`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Modal.tsx#L44-L51) calls the child modal's `onClose()` for `Escape`;
- [`SettingsRoot.tsx#L49-L55`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-settings-general/src/client/SettingsRoot.tsx#L49-L55) calls the Settings panel's `onClose()` for that same event.

The shared dialog declares `aria-modal="true"`, but has no focus trap or focus restoration: [`Modal.tsx#L55-L85`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Modal.tsx#L55-L85).

There is already an in-tree workaround documenting both assumptions in the directory picker: it manually makes the parent inert because “Modal has no focus trap” and guards the parent close because Escape reaches every mounted Modal listener: [`DirectoryBrowser.tsx#L743-L760`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse/src/client/DirectoryBrowser.tsx#L743-L760).

## Impact surface

This is a shared primitive rather than a copy-preset-only defect. The current tree has 14 production `<Modal>` call sites, including workspace creation/browsing, agent presets, model/settings flows, and other nested UI paths. Any modal whose parent remains mounted can expose background controls to keyboard or assistive-technology users. Any nested layer with its own global Escape handler can also consume the same key event.

The directory picker already carries local state and comments to compensate for this behavior, which is evidence that callers currently have to understand and defend against the primitive's modal-stack semantics.

## Root cause

`Modal` visually renders a modal overlay, but interaction ownership is global and unscoped:

- Escape is observed on `document`, once per mounted instance;
- keyboard focus is not cycled inside the active dialog;
- the opener is not captured/restored;
- underlying UI is not made inert by the primitive.

As a result, visual stacking and keyboard/event ownership diverge.

## Minimum fix boundary

The smallest root-cause boundary is the shared `Modal`, not each feature caller:

1. handle `Escape` on the dialog/overlay event path and stop propagation after the topmost modal claims it;
2. contain `Tab` / `Shift+Tab` within that dialog while open;
3. capture the active opener and restore it on close;
4. make the underlying application subtree inert while the portal is active, preserving prior inert state for nested dialogs.

The Settings shell is a separate hand-built `role="dialog"`; after the shared primitive is corrected, it should either adopt the same primitive or receive the same interaction semantics. The minimal patch should not add caller-specific guards to all 14 call sites—the directory picker workaround shows why that does not scale.

I am preparing a runnable patch in a personal fork as technical evidence, since this repository currently routes external contributions through Discussions rather than pull requests.

discussions.title: [Bug] ModelSelect skips the first menu item on the initial ArrowDown
discussions.body:
## Summary

The composer's `ModelSelect` root menu skips its first item when the menu opens with focus still on the trigger and the user presses `ArrowDown` once. Focus lands on the second row (`Reasoning effort`) instead of the first row (`Model`). This makes the menu's initial keyboard navigation inconsistent with the expected menu-button behavior.

Tested against upstream `master` at `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`.

## Minimal reproduction

1. Focus the model selector trigger in the web composer.
2. Open the selector with Enter/Space (or click the focused trigger).
3. Press `ArrowDown` once while focus is still on the trigger.

Actual result: focus moves to the second root menu item, `Reasoning effort`.

Expected result: focus moves to the first root menu item, `Model`. An initial `ArrowUp` should continue to move to the last item.

## Root cause

`packages/client/ui-model-selection/src/client/ModelSelect.tsx` computes the next index as:

```ts
const active = items.findIndex(item => item === document.activeElement)
const next = (Math.max(active, 0) + offset + items.length) % items.length
```

When focus is on the trigger, no menu item is active, so `active` is `-1`. `Math.max(active, 0)` changes that to `0`; adding the `ArrowDown` offset (`+1`) then selects index `1`, skipping index `0`.

## Reproduction test

I added a focused component regression locally before changing the implementation:

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run packages/client/ui-model-selection/tests/model-select.client.spec.tsx -t "moves focus to the first menu item"
```

On the unmodified implementation it fails deterministically:

```text
Expected: Model
Received: Reasoning effort
Test Files  1 failed (1)
Tests       1 failed | 5 skipped (6)
```

Environment: Windows NT 10.0.26200.0, Node v24.14.0, pnpm 11.7.0.

## Suggested fix

Treat “focus is outside the menu items” as its own starting state: initial `ArrowDown` selects index `0`, initial `ArrowUp` selects the final item, and navigation from an already active item keeps the existing wraparound behavior.

The fix should be local to `ModelSelect.tsx` with a component regression test; it does not require changes to the shared menu primitive or model-selection state.

## Duplicate check

I searched the repository's Discussions (including comments) for `ArrowDown`, `ModelSelect focus`, `model menu keyboard focus`, `模型 下箭头`, and related first/second-item wording. I found no matching report. Discussions #843 and #312 mention `ModelSelect`, but cover custom-provider effort metadata and transport-failure recovery respectively, not keyboard focus navigation.

I will attach a small, tested fork commit in a follow-up comment so maintainers can cherry-pick or rewrite it through the repository's internal workflow.

discussions.title: [RFC] Workspace-scoped configuration and runtime state for MCP, environment overlays, and project services
discussions.body:
## Summary

DeepSeek Harness currently has a process/profile-wide Cordis composition and per-agent scoped registrations, but it does not have a workspace-scoped configuration and runtime plane.

This becomes visible with MCP:

- an `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` row added through a profile patch creates one long-lived MCP client/server instance;
- its `cwd` and `env` are fixed when the plugin instance is loaded;
- its tools are normally registered in the root `ctx.tools` layer;
- every session in the same DSH Host can therefore see and call those tools, regardless of `session.header.cwd`.

As a result, a project cannot safely declare an MCP server that is automatically available only to sessions in that project.

The same missing scope also affects other project-bound services such as environment overlays, language servers, code indexes, persistent terminals, and local development services.

A concrete motivating case is a potential `dsh-envrc` plugin. Safely applying `.envrc` in DSH Web requires an environment owned by a workspace rather than mutation of the Host's `process.env`. The resulting environment should be reusable by Bash, persistent terminals, workspace MCP servers, LSP processes, and other subprocess consumers without leaking into unrelated sessions.

## Expected behavior

A project-local configuration should be able to express something like:

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "project_database": {
      "transport": "stdio",
      "command": "project-database-mcp",
      "cwd": "."
    }
  }
}
```

with the following semantics:

```text
Session in /work/project-a
  -> sees global tools + project-a tools
  -> uses an MCP process rooted at /work/project-a

Session in /work/project-b
  -> sees global tools + project-b tools
  -> cannot see or call project-a's MCP tools

Two sessions in /work/project-a
  -> may share the same project-a MCP process

A subagent inherited from a project-a agent
  -> remains attached to project-a unless explicitly moved
```

Project-local configuration should merge over Host-global defaults, and a project should be able to override or disable an inherited global MCP entry.

## Current behavior

DSH profiles are composed at Host startup from:

1. bundle patches;
2. the profile's `cordis.patch.yml`;
3. `$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`;
4. command-line `--patch` overlays.

These layers configure the Host Cordis tree, not a tree selected from each session's workspace.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` reflects that model:

- one plugin instance connects to one MCP server;
- stdio `cwd` and `env` are static plugin configuration;
- the connection lives until the plugin fiber is disposed or reloaded;
- discovered tools are registered through the plugin context;
- `serverName` reservations are currently unique across the application root.

A root/profile MCP row therefore represents a Host-level MCP server.

DSH does have scoped tool registrations and Agent Presets. Those are useful foundations, but they do not provide workspace-local configuration:

- a preset is selected as an agent capability composition, not discovered from `session.header.cwd`;
- selecting a workspace does not automatically select or compose a corresponding preset;
- a preset is not a canonical workspace runtime shared by all sessions in that workspace;
- MCP `cwd` and `env` remain static configuration rather than values derived from the owning workspace;
- project instruction discovery (`AGENTS.md`, `AGENTS.local.md`, `CLAUDE.md`, and `CLAUDE.local.md`) affects model instructions only, not Cordis services or MCP configuration.

In other words, DSH has an authoritative session cwd and scoped registries, but it lacks the layer that turns a workspace identity into scoped service instances and configuration.

## Why this is more than an MCP convenience issue

### 1. Tool visibility

If project A adds an MCP row through the profile, sessions in project B receive the same root tool registrations.

Tool naming or prompting cannot provide strong isolation. The project-B agent should not receive project-A tool schemas in the first place.

### 2. Process working directory

A stdio MCP server receives the plugin's configured `cwd`, not the cwd of the session making the tool call.

A project-sensitive server may therefore read or modify the wrong repository when used from another session.

### 3. Environment and secrets

A project MCP may need a virtual environment, Nix/direnv environment, database URL, or project-specific credential.

Injecting that environment into a root MCP instance makes it shared by every session that can call the instance. Mutating the Host's `process.env` would be worse: DSH Web can host concurrent sessions from unrelated workspaces.

### 4. Stateful servers

Many MCP servers keep indexes, caches, database handles, or in-memory state. One process cannot simultaneously have two different project roots and OS environments unless the server protocol explicitly models them.

### 5. Other workspace services

The same scope mismatch appears when implementing:

- per-project environment overlays;
- project-specific LSP processes;
- local code indexes;
- project terminals or persistent shells;
- file watchers and development servers.

Adding independent ad hoc fixes for each consumer would duplicate workspace identity, lifetime, reload, and disposal logic.

### 6. A concrete blocked consumer: safe `.envrc` integration

This issue became clear while investigating a possible `dsh-envrc` plugin.

A simple implementation could run:

```text
direnv export json
```

and assign the result to the Host's `process.env`. Some OpenCode plugins take this approach, but it is unsafe for DSH Web:

```text
Session A in /repo/a
  -> loads PATH, VIRTUAL_ENV, and secrets from /repo/a/.envrc

Session B in /repo/b
  -> shares the same Host process
```

The last session to mutate `process.env` would affect unrelated sessions and any subsequently spawned Host service. Removed variables would also require explicit unset semantics, and project secrets would be exposed to more subprocesses than intended.

Injecting the environment only into one-shot Bash is safer, but incomplete. Persistent Bash/PTY, workspace MCP servers, LSP processes, and other subprocess consumers use separate creation paths. Each consumer could grow an independent direnv adapter, but that would duplicate:

- workspace-root resolution;
- `.envrc` trust state;
- environment loading and caching;
- set/unset semantics;
- change detection;
- failure policy;
- reload and disposal behavior;
- session and workspace isolation.

A workspace runtime would provide a natural owner for this behavior:

```text
Workspace A runtime
├── trusted direnv snapshot A
├── Bash processes using A
├── persistent terminal processes using A
├── MCP processes using A
└── LSP processes using A

Workspace B runtime
├── trusted direnv snapshot B
└── unrelated processes using B
```

The environment would be copied into each workspace-owned child process at spawn time. The DSH Host itself would remain environment-neutral, and global services would not accidentally inherit project variables.

This does not imply automatically trusting `.envrc`. An `.envrc` is executable project code. A safe implementation should never run `direnv allow` automatically, should bind trust to a canonical file/path and content revision, should avoid logging exported values, and should make fail-open versus fail-closed behavior explicit.

The important architectural requirement is therefore not built-in direnv support. It is a reusable workspace-owned environment capability that a `dsh-envrc` plugin can provide and Bash, PTY, MCP, LSP, and other workspace process providers can consume.

## Prior art: OpenCode server mode

OpenCode solves this even when one app server serves multiple GUI workspaces.

The GUI creates a directory-bound SDK client and sends the directory with each request. The server resolves the request to an `InstanceContext` and caches instance state by normalized directory:

```text
request(directory=/repo/a)
  -> Instance A
  -> merged Config A
  -> MCP State A
  -> tools A

request(directory=/repo/b)
  -> Instance B
  -> merged Config B
  -> MCP State B
  -> tools B
```

Global and project `opencode.json`/`opencode.jsonc` files are merged per instance. MCP clients, LSP state, plugins, and tool assembly read the current instance state.

This does not require one server process per GUI project. One server multiplexes multiple directory instances while keeping their service state separate.

The important idea is not OpenCode's exact config format. It is the existence of a directory/workspace runtime between the global server and individual sessions.

## Suggested design direction

This section is intentionally brief; the primary request is for a supported workspace scope, not a specific implementation.

### 1. Introduce a canonical workspace runtime

A Host service could resolve and retain a runtime by canonical workspace identity:

```ts
interface WorkspaceRuntimeRegistry {
  acquire(input: {
    cwd: string
    session: Session
  }): Promise<WorkspaceRuntimeLease>
}

interface WorkspaceRuntime {
  root: string
  config: WorkspaceConfig
  context: Context
}
```

The runtime could be keyed by a canonical project/worktree root rather than by raw path spelling.

Sessions in the same workspace could share it. The final lease release would dispose workspace-owned plugin fibers and processes.

### 2. Allow workspace runtimes to contribute environment overlays

A workspace runtime should be able to expose an environment snapshot independently of Host `process.env`:

```ts
interface WorkspaceEnvironmentSnapshot {
  readonly set: Readonly<Record<string, string>>
  readonly unset: ReadonlySet<string>
  readonly revision: string
}

interface WorkspaceRuntime {
  readonly root: string
  readonly config: WorkspaceConfig
  readonly context: Context
  readonly environment?: WorkspaceEnvironmentSnapshot
}
```

The exact API is only illustrative. The important properties are:

- values are owned by one canonical workspace;
- deletion is representable rather than approximated by omission;
- consumers receive an immutable snapshot;
- environment values are not added to logs, model context, or Host-global state;
- a revision change can invalidate or restart workspace-owned processes;
- global processes do not receive the overlay unless explicitly configured.

A `dsh-envrc` plugin could implement this capability by evaluating an already trusted `.envrc` through `direnv export json`, caching the result per workspace, and publishing a new snapshot when direnv's watched inputs change.

Process providers could consume the same snapshot at their actual spawn boundaries:

```text
one-shot Bash       -> ShellExecRequest.env
persistent Bash/PTY -> terminal spawn environment
workspace MCP       -> stdio transport environment
workspace LSP       -> language-server spawn environment
```

This keeps environment policy separate from each consumer while preserving consumer-specific lifecycle behavior. Long-lived MCP, LSP, and terminal processes would normally need restart or explicit refresh after an environment revision changes; changing a cached map cannot modify an already running process's OS environment.

### 3. Add workspace scope to the existing scope chain

A useful lookup order could be:

```text
Host/global
  -> workspace
  -> preset
  -> agent/session
```

Registrations made through the workspace context would be visible only to agents attached to that workspace.

This would let the existing layered `ctx.tools` design provide correct visibility without checking cwd inside every tool execution.

The exact order of workspace and preset scopes should be decided explicitly, especially for shadowing and restrictions.

### 4. Start with a declarative project configuration

Automatically loading arbitrary Cordis modules from a repository is equivalent to executing project code and needs a trust decision.

A safer first version could support a restricted declarative file, for example:

```text
<workspace>/.dsh/config.jsonc
```

with a narrow initial schema such as:

```json
{
  "mcp": {
    "project_database": {
      "transport": "stdio",
      "command": "project-database-mcp",
      "args": [],
      "cwd": ".",
      "enabled": true
    }
  }
}
```

Possible precedence:

```text
Host defaults
  -> workspace-root config
  -> nearer directory config, if nested overrides are supported
  -> explicit session override
```

A workspace should be able to disable an inherited global entry with `enabled: false`.

Full workspace Cordis composition could be considered separately, with explicit trust and approval semantics.

### 5. Make MCP instances workspace-owned

For a local MCP entry:

- resolve relative `cwd` against the canonical workspace root;
- construct its environment without mutating Host `process.env`;
- register its tools in the workspace scope;
- allow the same `serverName` in unrelated workspace scopes;
- share one instance among sessions in the same workspace when configured to do so;
- close the client and process when the workspace runtime is disposed;
- reload only that workspace when its configuration changes.

A global MCP entry should remain possible and retain its existing Host-wide semantics.

### 6. Bind sessions and subagents explicitly

A session should record or deterministically derive the workspace runtime it joined.

Resume should reattach to the same workspace identity. Subagents should inherit the parent's workspace by default, while an explicit cross-workspace delegation would require a separate operation and permission decision.

### 7. Treat workspace config as a trust boundary

Project configuration can start executable programs and supply environment references. It should not become trusted merely because a user opened a directory.

At minimum, the design should define:

- whether first use requires approval;
- whether trust is tied to canonical path and content hash;
- what changes invalidate trust;
- which environment variables or credential references may be supplied;
- whether untrusted config is ignored, reported, or blocks workspace activation;
- how symlinks and worktrees affect workspace identity.

## Acceptance examples

### Project-only MCP

```text
Global config: no "database" MCP
Project A config: defines "database"
Project B config: no "database"
```

Expected:

- an Agent in A sees the database tools;
- an Agent in B does not receive their schemas;
- a direct attempt to execute the A-only tool from B fails lookup before transport;
- B does not inherit A's MCP environment.

### Same MCP name in two projects

```text
Project A: "project" -> command A, cwd A
Project B: "project" -> command B, cwd B
```

Expected:

- both workspace runtimes can use the local name `project`;
- each Agent sees only its workspace's definition;
- the two stdio processes have different cwd/environment values;
- disposing A does not disconnect B.

### Global default overridden by a project

```text
Global: "search" enabled
Project A: "search" disabled
Project B: no override
```

Expected:

- A does not see the search tools;
- B continues to use the global server;
- the override does not mutate the Host-global configuration.

### Concurrent Web sessions

Run sessions in A and B concurrently and call their MCP tools.

Expected:

- no tool-schema leakage;
- no cwd/environment crossover;
- no shared mutable client state unless the two sessions intentionally share one workspace runtime.

### Workspace environment isolation

```text
Project A:
  .envrc exports VIRTUAL_ENV=/repo/a/.venv
  .envrc prepends /repo/a/bin to PATH

Project B:
  .envrc exports VIRTUAL_ENV=/repo/b/.venv
  .envrc prepends /repo/b/bin to PATH
```

Expected:

- Bash, PTY, workspace MCP, and LSP processes created for A receive only environment A;
- corresponding processes for B receive only environment B;
- the DSH Host's `process.env` is not mutated;
- a global MCP server receives neither project environment by default;
- environment values never appear in logs, tool schemas, or model-visible status output;
- removing a variable from A is represented as an unset for future A processes;
- changing A's environment does not restart or invalidate B's services;
- blocked or untrusted `.envrc` files are not automatically allowed.

## Questions for maintainers

1. Is a workspace/runtime scope already planned between Host and Agent Preset scopes?
2. Should workspace-local configuration initially be restricted to declarative capabilities such as MCP, rather than arbitrary Cordis rows?
3. Should the canonical lifetime be per directory, Git worktree, DSH workspace record, or another identity?
4. Should global MCP entries be inherited into every workspace by default, with project-level override/disable support?
5. Could `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` be adapted to a workspace context, or should a manager/provider own workspace MCP instances above it?
6. How should workspace scope compose with Agent Presets and subagent inheritance?
7. Should a workspace runtime expose a generic environment-overlay capability so external plugins such as `dsh-envrc` can supply one snapshot to Bash, PTY, MCP, LSP, and other workspace process providers?

discussions.title: Bug: crypto.randomUUID is not a function when accessing Web GUI over plain HTTP (LAN/phone)
discussions.body:
### Bug: `crypto.randomUUID is not a function` when accessing the Web GUI over plain HTTP on another device

**Environment**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, accessed from a phone on the same LAN at `http://<lan-ip>:<port>` (plain HTTP, non-`localhost`).

**Symptom**: The page loads but shows no conversation/model data, with `crypto.randomUUID is not a function` in the console.

**Root cause**: `crypto.randomUUID` is only exposed in a *secure context* (HTTPS or `localhost`). On a plain-HTTP LAN origin the API is absent. The production RPC client mints its request ids here:

- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts` → `mintRpcId()` → `RpcId(crypto.randomUUID())`

**Note**: the browser-safe replacement already exists in the repo — `packages/client/connection/src/client/random-uuid.ts` → `randomUuid()`, which uses `crypto.getRandomValues()` (available on insecure origins) and is already used by the connection client's other paths (`rpc.ts`, `fixture.ts`). It just isn't wired into `mintRpcId()`.

**Suggested fix**: use `randomUuid()` in `mintRpcId()` (and, for consistency, the browser draft-attachment id in the conversation UI) instead of `crypto.randomUUID()`.

Happy to submit a PR if it helps — this blocks LAN/mobile access to the Web GUI.

discussions.title: [Bug Report] Web UI 弹层：焦点可逃逸出 `aria-modal` 对话框，一次 Escape 同时关闭多层弹层（各弹层独立监听、无 stack 协调）
discussions.body:
## 摘要

**Web UI 的弹层没有统一的焦点与 Escape 协调**：`primitives Modal` 与 Settings 面板（`SettingsPanel`）是两套独立实现，**各自向 document 注册自己的 keydown 监听器**（一个 Escape 事件会触发所有弹层的 `onClose`），且两者都**没有任何焦点圈禁**（无 Tab 循环、无背景 inert）——`Shift+Tab` 可以把焦点移出 `aria-modal="true"` 对话框到背后控件，关闭后焦点也不会恢复到触发元素。

## 复现步骤

1. 打开 Web UI（127.0.0.1:3080），打开 **Settings**（Agent presets 面板）。
2. 点击 **Copy Standard** 打开 copy-preset 弹窗（叠加在 Settings 之上）。
3. 焦点在标识输入框时按 `Shift+Tab` 两次：焦点依次移到 copy 弹窗的 Close、再移到 Settings 面板背后的"关闭详情"控件 —— **焦点逃逸出对话框**。
4. 按一次 `Escape`：copy-preset 弹窗 **和** Settings 面板**同时关闭** —— 一个 Escape 事件关闭了两层。

> 社区已复现（Windows 10, Chromium, commit 47f9438）。预期：Tab 循环圈禁在顶层弹窗内；Escape 只关闭最顶层；关闭后焦点回到触发元素。

## 根因（源码定位，rc.6）

1. **primitives `Modal`：独立 document 监听 + 无焦点管理** — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives/lib/index.js`：
   - L1983-1992：`useEffect` 中 `document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)`，`if (e.key === "Escape") onClose()` —— 每个 Modal 实例挂载期间都占用 document 级监听；
   - L1994-2034：渲染树只有 `role="dialog"` / `aria-modal="true"`（L2003-2004），**没有焦点圈禁逻辑、没有对背景层的 inert/aria-hidden 处理、没有关闭后的焦点恢复**。

2. **Settings 面板（`SettingsPanel`）：另一套同样的独立实现** — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-settings-general/lib/client.js`：
   - L100-108：同样在 useEffect 中 `document.addEventListener("keydown", onKeyDown)`、Escape → `onClose`（L94-95 注释明示 "document-level Escape (mounted only while open)"）；
   - L113-124：自定义 `role="dialog"` + `aria-modal="true"` 面板，同样无 Tab 循环（仅在打开时聚焦一次 close 按钮，L110-112）。

3. **两个监听器同时收到同一个 Escape 事件**：Settings 面板与 copy-preset Modal 各自持有 document keydown 监听，事件冒泡到 document 后两处 `onClose` 都被调用 → 一层 Escape 关闭两层（与复现完全吻合）；两个弹层都没有 Tab 焦点圈禁 → 焦点自由移出对话框（与复现完全吻合）。

## 建议修复

**方案 A（推荐）· 引入全局弹层栈协调**：一个共享的 modal stack 服务/context —— 每个弹层注册进栈；`Escape` 只派发到**栈顶**弹层；焦点圈禁（Tab/Shift+Tab 在栈顶 dialog 内循环）、打开时聚焦首个可聚焦元素、关闭后把焦点还给触发元素。`SettingsPanel` 与 `primitives Modal` 都接入该栈，消除两套各自为政的监听。

**方案 B · 分别补齐两处实现**：primitives Modal 增加焦点陷阱 + 打开聚焦/关闭恢复；SettingsPanel 同步改造。改动局部但两处仍需保持一致（协调层缺失问题依旧，后续新弹层还会重蹈覆辙）。

**方案 C · 背景 inert + 顶层 Escape 拦截**：弹层打开时给背景层设 `inert`（阻止焦点进入，缓解逃逸）；Escape 监听改为"仅当自己是栈顶时响应"。可作为最小补丁，但焦点恢复与栈管理仍需 A 的方案才能完整。

## 影响

- 键盘可达性：`aria-modal="true"` 语义被破坏——屏幕阅读器/键盘用户焦点可进入背后控件，与无障碍契约不符；
- 误操作：一次 Escape 关闭多层弹窗（用户以为只关了最上层），未保存的编辑内容可能随层一起丢失；
- 架构风险：两套独立弹层实现继续分化（本报告即证据），后续 UI 弹层仍会重复出现同类问题。

## 环境

- 源码定位：0.1.0-rc.6（npx 缓存安装包，Node v24.16.0，Windows 11）
- 原报告：#938（Windows 10, Chromium, commit 47f9438 实测复现）

## 验证材料

- 社区复现步骤（Shift+Tab 两次逃逸 + 一次 Escape 关两层）与预期行为；
- rc.6 源码逐行核对：`dsh-client-ui-primitives/lib/index.js` L1983-2034 与 `dsh-client-ui-settings-general/lib/client.js` L97-124；
- 机制推演：两个独立 document keydown 监听 → 同一 Escape 事件触发两次 onClose；两处均无 Tab 循环 → 焦点可逃逸。

---

*First analysis of discussion #938. Happy to open a PR with fix option A.*

discussions.title: Windows 文件夹对话框会把含「开」「一」等汉字的路径截断，导致已存在的目录无法添加为工作区
discussions.body:
一句话说明错误结果：在 Windows 上通过原生文件夹对话框选择工作区目录时，若路径中含低字节为 0x00 的汉字（如「开」U+5F00、「一」U+4E00），路径末尾会被静默截断，导致 workspace.create 报 workspace-invalid-path，明明存在的目录无法添加为工作区。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
    1. 在 Windows 上启动 dsh web（绑定 127.0.0.1，directory-picker-auto 自动挂载 native 文件夹对话框）。
    2. 打开「添加工作区」→ 弹出原生 Windows 文件夹对话框。
    3. 选择一个路径末尾含「开」（U+5F00）之类字符的目录，例如 E:\我的世界Java版模组开发。
    4. 点击「选择文件夹」，界面随即报错。

- 实际结果：
    报错：workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "E:\我的世界Java版模组": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'E:\我的世界Java版模组'
    注意：选择的完整路径 E:\我的世界Java版模组开发 在报错里变成了 E:\我的世界Java版模组，末尾的「开发」丢失；该目录真实存在，fs.realpath('E:\我的世界Java版模组开发') 可以成功解析。改为选择纯 ASCII 路径（如 E:\）则一切正常。

- 预期结果：对话框返回完整路径，目录存在时工作区创建成功。

- 环境：Windows 11（build 26200），dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（本机安装版；npm 最新 0.0.1-rc.1 与 GitHub master 分支当前代码同样存在该问题）。

- 验收条件：选择任意含 U+XX00 汉字的目录（如 E:\我的世界Java版模组开发、D:\一）都能完整返回路径并成功创建工作区。

</details>

根因分析：问题在 packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts 的 readUtf16。它用 while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2 逐 2 字节扫描，但只检查 UTF-16 码元的低字节是否为 0。而「开」U+5F00 的 UTF-16LE 编码是 00 5F，低字节恰为 0x00，被误判为字符串结尾（NUL），其后所有字符（如「开发」）被丢弃。任何码点形如 U+XX00 的汉字（开、一、上、下、万、丁……）都会触发。

验证数据：Buffer.from('开','utf16le').toString('hex') === '005f'；用现有 readUtf16 读取 E:\我的世界Java版模组开发 的 UTF-16LE 字节流，得到 E:\我的世界Java版模组，截断可稳定复现。

修复建议（最小 diff）：

    function readUtf16(koffi: Koffi, address: unknown): string {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768))
      let end = 0
    - while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
    + while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2
      return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
    }

discussions.title: Alpine Linux (musl) 上 dsh web 因缺少 musl 预编译二进制而启动失败
discussions.body:
dsh web 在 musl libc 环境下因 node-addon-require-builtin 平台包不兼容而崩溃。

 <details>
 <summary>复现与预期</summary>

 复现步骤：

 ```bash
   # 在 Alpine Linux 3.24 (musl libc) 上
   npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
   dsh web
 ```

 实际结果：

 ```
   Error: failed to apply loader entry 5f1fd5b4 (@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr): --expose-internals is required for HMR service
 ```

 根因分析：

 HMR 服务需要访问 Node.js 内部模块，有两条路径（cordis-plugin-loader 的 requireInternal）：

 1. --expose-internals flag
 2. node-addon-require-builtin 原生插件

 node-addon-require-builtin 的 optionalDependencies 只发布了 glibc 版本的 Linux 包（-linux-x64-gnu、-linux-arm64-gnu），声明了 "libc": ["glibc"]。在 musl
 环境下 npm 报 EBADPLATFORM 静默跳过，两条路径都失败后 HMR 构造函数抛出错误。

 ```
   npm error code EBADPLATFORM
   npm error notsup Unsupported platform for node-addon-require-builtin-linux-x64-gnu@0.1.4:
     wanted {"os":"linux","cpu":"x64","libc":"glibc"}
     (current: {"os":"linux","cpu":"x64","libc":"musl"})
 ```

 预期结果：

 dsh web 在 musl 环境下正常启动。

 环境：

 - OS: Alpine Linux 3.24.1 (musl libc)
 - Node: v24.17.0
 - npm: 11.12.1
 - dsh: 0.1.0-rc.6

discussions.title: bug: Win32 目录弹窗将含零低字节汉字的路径截断，workspace 创建失败（附修复补丁）
discussions.body:
## 描述

Windows 上通过目录弹窗选择工作区目录时，若路径包含「码点低字节为 0x00」的汉字（如「开」U+5F00，UTF-16LE 内存为 00 5F），返回的路径会被截断，随后 workspace create 的 fs.realpath 校验报 workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "...": ENOENT，工作区创建失败。

复现：目录弹窗选择 F:\联昌开发（含「开」）→ 实际返回 F:\联昌 → 报错；选择 F:\联昌U9资料（不含此类字符）则正常。

## 根因

packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts 的 readUtf16 以「单个 0 字节」判断 UTF-16 字符串结尾：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
```

UTF-16 编码单元为两字节，单个 0 字节可以是合法码元的低字节（「开」= 00 5F），扫描提前终止导致截断。

## 影响

任何包含此类字符的目录路径都无法通过弹窗创建工作区（如 F:\联昌开发、F:\联昌开发-docs）。

## 修复补丁

已修复并提交 PR（见关联 PR）：改为扫描 0x0000 双字节终止符，并新增回归测试。仓库禁用了 Issues，故以此帖作为跟踪。

discussions.title: [Bug 报告] Windows 沙箱的 read-only 边界比宣传的更弱：受限令牌限制列表常驻 Everyone/登录 SID，read-only 仍可写世界可写目录
discussions.body:
> 建议分类：Bug report（若仓库 Discussions 有该分类）；如无则选 General / Ideas
> 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6，Windows（仅影响 Windows 的 `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 后端）
> 严重级别：我认为是 **critical（Windows 专属）**——权限标签与真实边界不符

## 摘要

Windows 上的沙箱后端（`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`）用 WRITE_RESTRICTED 受限令牌做文件写入限制，但受限令牌 pass-2 访问检查的语义是"**任一**限制 SID 命中即放行"，而两个模式（read-only / workspace-write）的限制列表都**常驻 `Everyone`（S-1-1-0）与登录会话 SID**。因此：

- **read-only 模式仍可写**任何 DACL 授予 Everyone 或登录 SID 写权限的目录（如公共/共享目录、世界可写位置）；
- 受限进程**新建的对象**（文件/目录）默认 DACL 会被授予 Everyone `FILE_ALL_ACCESS`（read-only 下落到 worldSid）；
- 这与同一部署中 `fs-sandbox` 文件围栏的语义（read-only = 拒绝**一切**写，`dsh-fs-sandbox/lib/index.js:161`）直接矛盾——同一个"read-only"标签，两套边界。

## 证据（代码与行号）

代码根：`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`（0.1.0-rc.6 构建产物）

1. **限制列表构成** — `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-CNjZgO4h.js:1196-1202`
   ```js
   const restrictingSids = buildRestrictingSids(mode === "read-only" ? [logonSid, known.world] : ... [logonSid, known.world, ...writeSids]);
   ```
   read-only 与 workspace-write 都包含 `logonSid` 与 `known.world`（Everyone）。

2. **作者自认该语义** — 同文件 `:1354-1359` 注释原文：
   > "the check ALSO inherits the ambient write ACEs of the other restricting SIDs — the keep-alive group logon SID + Everyone; Authenticated Users, INTERACTIVE, and LOCAL are absent from both lists …"

   即受限检查会继承"其他限制 SID"（Everyone、登录 SID）的环境写 ACE。作者为关闭 Public 树逃逸而专门从列表剔除 INTERACTIVE/LOCAL 的行为，也只有在"任一命中"语义下才有意义。

3. **默认 DACL 授予 Everyone 全权** — 同文件 `:1493` + `:1140`
   `setTokenDefaultDaclGrant(api, restrictedToken, this.tempWriteSidPtr ?? this.writeSidPtr ?? worldSid)` —— read-only 下两者均 undefined，落到 `worldSid`；`setEntriesInAclW(..., buildExplicitAccess(sidPtr, 1, FILE_ALL_ACCESS), ...)` 把 Everyone `FILE_ALL_ACCESS` 合并进令牌默认 DACL。受限进程新建对象默认 DACL = Everyone 全权（`:1122` 注释亦承认）。

4. **fs 围栏语义相反** — `dsh-fs-sandbox/lib/index.js:161`：read-only 对一切写抛 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`。

## 复现步骤

> 说明：pass-2"任一命中"语义源自 Windows 文档与上述代码注释，属高置信；建议维护者在本机用 `icacls` 复核目标目录的 Everyone 写 ACE 后判定修复优先级。

1. 在 Windows 上用 read-only 权限模式运行 dsh（`DSH_PERMISSION_MODE=read-only`），或任意模式；
2. 找一个**授予 Everyone 写权限**的目录（例如某些公共目录、`C:\Windows\Temp` 类世界可写位置，或用户自建的共享目录）；
3. 通过 pwsh 工具在该目录执行写入（如 `Set-Content` / `New-Item`）：
   - 预期（按"read-only"标签）：被拒绝；
   - 实际：**写入成功**（受限检查被 Everyone 通道放行）；
4. 对比：同一模式下用 fs 工具写工作区外文件 → 被 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` 拒绝。两个工具对同一权限标签给出不同边界。

## 影响

- 权限模式标签（read-only / workspace-write）在 Windows 上**不能按字面理解**：它只挡住"DACL 对 Everyone/登录 SID 拒绝写"的对象；
- 新增文件默认 Everyone 可读写，若进程在共享位置创建文件（如 `%TEMP%` 派生目录之外的意外位置），其他本地用户可读取/篡改；
- 权限策略 UI（permission-presets）展示的模式与 shell 实际边界不一致，模型与用户都会误判。

## 建议修复（供讨论）

1. read-only：限制列表去掉 Everyone 通道——仅保留最小 keep-alive 集，并对目录写入采用**逐目录 deny ACE** 或改用非"任一命中"的机制；
2. read-only 不调用 `setTokenDefaultDaclGrant`（或改为最小权限默认 DACL）；
3. 让 `fs-sandbox` 围栏与 shell runner 对同一模式给出同一边界（或明确文档化差异）；
4. 在 README 的 Modes 一节如实描述该边界。

## 附注

- 已确认不是问题的部分：子进程**永不**在未受限令牌下启动（`FAILS CLOSED`）；workspace-write 的能力 SID 设计本身合理。
- 若该边界是刻意设计（"Windows 上 read-only 只防正常用户目录"），也请更新文档与 UI 文案，避免策略承诺与实际行为不一致。

discussions.title: [Bug 报告] LAN 部署下审批可被旁路：`/api/respond` 不在 loopback 钉扎名单，局域网设备可批准工具调用/回答问题
discussions.body:
> 建议分类：Bug report（安全）
> 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6，仅在**显式配置 LAN 访问**时受影响（`--trusted-host` 或自定义 `host: 0.0.0.0` 配置）；默认 127.0.0.1 部署不受影响
> 严重级别：**major**——审批是"用户同意"这一安全控制，LAN 上可被完全绕过

## 摘要

Web 部署的 `/api` 面有一份"钉扎到 loopback"的特权方法名单 `PRIVILEGED_METHODS`（`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:504-520`，含 settings/credentials 等敏感方法）。但**审批应答方法 `respond` 不在名单里**。一旦用户通过 `--trusted-host <LAN-IP>` 让 LAN 设备可以访问 Web（这是官方支持的用法），任何局域网设备都可以：

1. 订阅服务端→浏览器的 mux 事件流（`/api/events.mux`），被动拿到 `approval/requested` 帧（内含 `rpcId` / `approvalId` / `sessionId`）；
2. 向 `/api/respond` POST 一个伪造的应答包，把 `outcome` 置为 `"allowed-once"`；
3. 结果：**替用户批准任意待审批的工具调用**（如提升权限的 shell 命令）、或**代替用户回答 `ask_user_question`**。

配套问题：Typert 网关以 `authority: "trusted-host"` 注册拦截器（`dsh-api-gateway/lib/index.js:62`），绕开 `PRIVILEGED_METHODS` 的 loopback 复检（`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:232-240` 只在 loopback 时用空信任列表）——两套调度平面的安全策略不一致；`0.0.0.0` 绑定还会把全部 LAN IPv4 自动加入信任列表（`dsh-web-app/lib/index.js:47-53`）。代码注释自己也声明 trustedHosts "explicitly not authentication"。

## 证据（代码与行号）

- 钉扎名单不含 respond：`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:504-520`（`PRIVILEGED_METHODS` 集合成员列表）；
- respond 只校验 rpcId/approvalId/sessionId 匹配，无来源校验：`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:3816-3865`（`respond(message)` → `pendingApprovals.get(message.rpcId)` → 校验 `parsed.data.approvalId !== approval.approvalId || parsed.data.sessionId !== approval.sessionId` → `approval.resolve(parsed.data.outcome)`；问题同理 `:3831-3864`）；
- 审批请求帧经 mux 流广播给浏览器：`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1350-1361`（`requestedFrame` 携带 rpcId/sessionId/approvalId）；
- mux 升级路径的栅栏对 trustedHosts 放行：`dsh-client-connection/lib/index.js:569-573`（`isTrustedApiRequest`，Host=LAN IP 字面量命中 trustedHosts 即通过）；
- 应答包 schema：`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/types/api/approvals.schema.js:11-15`（`{sessionId, approvalId, outcome: "allowed-once" | "rejected"}`）；问题应答 `dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/types/api/questions.schema.js:17+`。

## 复现步骤（概念验证）

前置：`dsh --profile web --trusted-host 192.168.1.100`（或自定义 cordis.yml 配 `host: 0.0.0.0`），使 LAN 上其他设备能访问 `http://192.168.1.100:3080/`。

1. **触发一个待审批操作**：在任一 Web 会话里让 agent 发起一个触发审批的工具调用（或 `ask_user_question`）；
2. **从另一台 LAN 机器**打开 WebSocket 连 `ws://192.168.1.100:3080/api/events.mux`（浏览器形态请求，Host 头为 LAN IP 字面量 → 通过栅栏），等待并记录 `approval/requested` 帧中的 `rpcId`、`approvalId`、`sessionId`；
3. **POST 伪造应答**到 `/api/respond`（`respond` 的 wire 形态为 client-response 信封）：
   ```json
   {
     "type": "client-response",
     "rpcId": "<步骤2捕获的 rpcId>",
     "result": {
       "ok": true,
       "value": {
         "sessionId": "<步骤2捕获>",
         "approvalId": "<步骤2捕获>",
         "outcome": "allowed-once"
       }
     }
   }
   ```
4. 观察：agent 的待审批工具调用被执行；用户本人从未点过"允许"。

## 影响

- 审批这一安全控制在 LAN 部署下**完全失效**：设备无需任何凭据即可批准任意工具调用（含可能提升为完整 shell 权限的 escalation 请求）、或替用户回答提问；
- `ask_user_question` 的答案也可被伪造，模型会把它当作真人输入执行后续动作；
- 即便不配 `--trusted-host`，若自定义配置把 webserver 绑到 `0.0.0.0`，`resolveLanTrust` 会把所有非内网 IPv4 自动加入信任列表，问题面进一步扩大。

## 建议修复（供讨论）

1. **最小修复**：把 `respond`（以及 `session.export` 等无认证副作用端点）纳入 `PRIVILEGED_METHODS`，钉扎到 loopback；
2. 让 Typert 网关拦截器与 fetch 网桥共用同一套 `PRIVILEGED_METHODS` 门禁（或在 gateway 层单独复检）；
3. webserver Config schema 与 CLI 保持一致拒绝 `0.0.0.0`，或在 0.0.0.0 时强制要求显式 `--trusted-host` 并输出警告；
4. 长期：在真正认证层出现前，所有跨 loopback 的"影响宿主/批准操作"都应默认拒绝。

## 附注

- 已确认非问题：默认（127.0.0.1）部署下该链不可达；DNS rebinding 栅栏主链路（`isTrustedApiRequest`）本身逻辑正确；
- 本报告的定位是"trustedHosts 被明确标记为非认证，但 respond 这类高影响方法却没有像 settings/credentials 一样钉扎 loopback"——两处设计意图不一致。

discussions.title: [Bug 报告 / 设计问题] glob/grep 工具完全绕过沙箱：`path` 无任何策略约束，可读取工作区外任意文件（含隐藏文件）并注入模型上下文
discussions.body:
> 建议分类：Bug report 或 Ideas（安全模型）
> 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6，全平台
> 严重级别：**major（取决于安全模型定位）**——若沙箱是部署的安全边界，这是可绕过的后门；若"读开放、写受控"是刻意设计，则需文档化并收窄

## 摘要

`glob` / `grep` 两个搜索工具（`dsh-tool-fs-search`）通过 `ctx.subprocess.spawn` 直接运行 ripgrep，**没有任何 `sandboxPolicy` 或路径约束**（代码注释自称 "unconfined (a plain `ctx.subprocess` call)"）。工具的 `path` 参数被原样拼进 rg argv，且 rg 以 `--no-ignore --hidden` 运行（刻意枚举隐藏文件）。因此：

- 模型（或被提示注入的代理）可以传 `path: "C:\Users\<someone>\.ssh"`、`path: "$DSH_HOME"` 等任意路径，**读取工作区之外的 `.env`、密钥、其它用户文件的内容**并注入模型上下文；
- 这与同一部署中 bash/pwsh 的沙箱 + 审批升级体系、以及 fs 工具 write/edit 的 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` 机制**完全不一致**。

## 证据（代码与行号）

- 无围栏的 spawn：`dsh-tool-fs-search/lib/index.js:159-178`（`runRipgrep` → `ctx.subprocess.spawn({ argv: [rg, "--no-config", ...argv], cwd: workdir, ... })`，全程无 sandboxPolicy）；
- `path` 原样进 argv：同文件 `:561`（glob `{ path: args.path }`）与 `:911`（grep `{ path: args.path }`）；
- 枚举隐藏文件：`--no-ignore --hidden`（见工具描述/实现，刻意如此）；
- 对比：fs 工具 write/edit 有完整围栏（`dsh-fs-sandbox/lib/index.js:157-170` 的 `checkedTarget` → `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`）；bash/pwsh 有沙箱 + escalation（`dsh-sandbox` / `dsh-pwsh-sandbox`）；
- 读取本身在所有模式下放行（`dsh-fs-sandbox/lib/index.js:74-75`："Reads pass through untouched: every mode permits reading"）——若读取开放是设计，则与"bash 的读也被沙箱约束"形成面差。

## 复现步骤

在任意会话中调用 grep（普通工具调用，无需特殊权限）：
```
grep  pattern: "DEEPSEEK_API_KEY"  path: "C:\Users\<你的用户名>\.dsh"   # 或任意工作区外目录
```
- 预期（按"沙箱存在"的心智模型）：拒绝或至少提示越界；
- 实际：返回匹配行内容（含 `.credentials.yaml`、`.env` 等文件内容）到模型上下文。

同样，`glob` 传 `path: "C:\Users\..."` 可枚举任意目录下的文件名（含隐藏文件），作为后续读取的侦察手段。

## 影响

- 权限模式（read-only / workspace-write）**对搜索工具完全不生效**——搜索是"读"，而读不受限；
- 若用户的机器上存在其他敏感文件（浏览器凭据、SSH key、其他项目），一次提示注入即可把它们拖进模型上下文并（通过其它工具）外发；
- 安全心智模型不一致：模型被告知有沙箱，但搜索工具是例外面。

## 建议修复（供讨论）

1. **收窄**：对 `path` 施加与 fs 工具一致的策略根/工作区约束（越界报 `FS_SANDBOX_DENIED` 类错误），或将 rg 的 spawn 纳入与 bash 相同的沙箱执行路径；
2. **或明确设计**：若"读开放、写受控"是刻意设计（合理），请在工具描述与权限文档中明确说明"glob/grep/read 不受沙箱约束，可读任意路径"，并考虑默认禁止读取隐藏/敏感文件（`.env`、`.credentials*`、`.ssh` 等）或至少对工作区外读取追加审批；
3. 至少去掉对工作区外路径的 `--hidden` 静默支持，改为显式 opt-in。

## 附注

- 已确认非问题：argv 直传无 shell 注入面；工具输出截断/窗口正确；
- 本报告不主张"必须禁止所有越界读"，而是指出**机制面不一致**：要么统一收窄，要么统一文档化，避免部署方把沙箱当作边界后出现意外开口。

discussions.title: [Bug 报告 / 隐私] 匿名用户 ID 无条件随每次 LLM 请求外发：关闭遥测不豁免，且自定义第三方 baseURL 也会收到稳定身份
discussions.body:
> 建议分类：Bug report 或 Ideas（隐私/透明性）
> 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6，全平台
> 严重级别：**major（隐私）**——默认配置下即发生，且与"关闭遥测"的用户预期相悖

## 摘要

DeepSeek 官方 LLM 适配器（`dsh-llm-deepseek`）在**每次** chat/completions 请求上都会附加：

- `x-deepseek-harness-user-id`：一个**持久的 per-harness-home 匿名 UUID**（首次请求时创建并落盘 `$DSH_HOME/.anonymous-user-id`）；
- 可选 `x-deepseek-harness-session-id`、`x-deepseek-harness-compact`。

关键问题：

1. **与遥测开关无关**：`DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE=DISABLED`（默认）/ `DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED` 只关闭 OTLP 上传，**不阻止**该匿名 ID 的创建与外发——实测默认配置下首次请求即生成 `.anonymous-user-id` 文件；
2. **自定义 baseURL 也发**：用户在 Models 页把 baseURL 指向任意第三方 OpenAI 兼容端点（`DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` env / settings 均支持）时，该稳定身份与会话 ID **同样发往第三方端点**；
3. **UI 无披露**：Web 界面没有任何地方告知用户"每个请求都携带一个持久匿名身份"。README 有提及，但对终端用户不可见。

## 证据（代码与行号）

- 无条件解析并外发：`dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js:536`（`const userId = this.config.resolveUserId()`）→ `:753`（`resolveUserId = () => userId ??= getOrCreateAnonymousUserId()`，无任何 telemetry 开关判断）→ `:578`（`"x-deepseek-harness-user-id": String(userId)`）；
- 发往解析后的 baseURL：`:584`（`fetch(`${connection.baseURL}/chat/completions`, ...)`），baseURL 可由 env/settings 指向任意端点（`:707` 附近）；
- ID 创建：`dsh-anonymous-user-id/lib/index.js:50-76`（`getOrCreateAnonymousUserId`，首次调用即 mkdir+writeFile）；
- 调用方不止 LLM：`dsh-command-feedback/lib/index.js:69` 的 `/feedback` 也会创建/回显该 ID，与遥测开关无关；
- 对比：`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 适配器**不发送**该头（不一致）。

## 复现步骤

1. 确认 `DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE` / `DSH_TELEMETRY_DISABLED` 均未设置（默认关闭）；
2. 启动 `dsh --profile web`，发一条消息触发 LLM 请求；
3. 检查 `$DSH_HOME/.anonymous-user-id`：**已被创建**（尽管遥测默认关闭）；
4. （可选）在 Models 页把 baseURL 改为自建/第三方网关，抓包可见 `x-deepseek-harness-user-id` 与 `x-deepseek-harness-session-id` 头发往该端点。

## 影响

- 隐私预期落差：用户关掉"遥测"以为停止上报，但身份仍随每次模型请求外发；
- 第三方端点（非 DeepSeek 官方）可凭该稳定 UUID 关联该 harness home 的全部请求与会话——对自建网关/企业代理用户尤其敏感；
- 该 ID 还同时用作 OTLP 遥测的 `user.id`（开启时），构成跨通道关联。

## 建议修复（供讨论）

1. 将该头与 telemetry 模式绑定：`DISABLED` 时不创建、不发送；
2. 或至少：当 baseURL 不是 DeepSeek 官方端点时省略该头（及 session-id/compact 头）；
3. 在 Web UI（设置页/隐私说明）中披露"每次模型请求携带的匿名身份"及其用途；
4. 让 `/feedback` 与 LLM 适配器共用同一开关语义。

## 附注

- 已确认：该头可能用于官方侧的滥用防护/配额关联，存在合理动机；本报告主张的是**透明性与一致性**（默认关闭遥测时仍外发、第三方端点也收到、UI 不披露），是否保留由团队决策；
- README 已文档化该行为，故非"隐藏"缺陷；但终端用户与自定义 baseURL 场景未被覆盖。

discussions.title: [Bug Report] Windows 原生文件夹对话框把含 U+XX00 汉字（开/一/上/下…）的路径静默截断（UTF-16 终止判定只看低字节）
discussions.body:
## 摘要

**Windows 原生文件夹对话框返回的路径被静默截断**：`readUtf16` 用 `bytes[end] !== 0` 逐 2 字节扫描 UTF-16LE 字符串，但只检查每个码元的**低字节**；「开」U+5F00 的 UTF-16LE 编码是 `00 5F`（低字节恰为 0x00），被误判为 NUL 字符串结尾，其后所有字符被丢弃 —— 选择 `E:\我的世界Java版模组开发` 返回 `E:\我的世界Java版模组`，目录明明存在却报 `workspace-invalid-path`。**已在 rc.6 编译产物中实证复现，修复判定（检查整个码元）实证通过。**

## 复现步骤

1. Windows 上启动 `dsh web`（绑定 127.0.0.1，directory-picker-auto 自动挂载原生文件夹对话框）。
2. 打开「添加工作区」→ 弹出原生 Windows 文件夹对话框。
3. 选择路径末尾含「开」（U+5F00）之类低字节为 0x00 的汉字目录，如 `E:\我的世界Java版模组开发`。
4. 点击「选择文件夹」→ 报错 `workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "E:\我的世界Java版模组": ENOENT` —— **末尾「开发」被静默丢弃**；目录真实存在（`fs.realpath` 可解析）。
5. 纯 ASCII 路径（如 `E:\`）正常。

> 社区已实测复现（Windows 11 build 26200，rc.6；npm 0.0.1-rc.1 与 master 同样存在）。家族相关：#107/#151/#210/#244/#396 同主题报告，#151 评论中 FenjuFu 复核确认该逻辑在 `master@47f9438` 上依旧。

## 根因（源码定位，rc.6）

1. **`readUtf16` 的终止判定只检查码元低字节** — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native/lib/worker.cjs`：
   ```js
   function readUtf16(koffi, address) {           // L21
   	const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
   	let end = 0;
   	while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2;   // L24
   	return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);                    // L25
   }
   ```
   - UTF-16LE 的 NUL 终止符是 `00 00`（高低字节都为 0），但 L24 只检查 `bytes[end]`（每个码元的**低字节**）；
   - 「开」U+5F00 → UTF-16LE `00 5F`，低字节 0x00 → 扫描在此停止，**其后所有字符丢失**；
   - 任何码点形如 U+XX00 的汉字（开、一、上、下、万、丁…）都会触发；纯 ASCII 路径不受影响。
2. **截断在对话框返回点发生**（worker.cjs L132 `const path = readUtf16(koffi, nameOut[0])`），对话框本身无感知，直到 `workspace.create` 的 realpath 才报 ENOENT —— 错误被延迟暴露，排查成本高。

## 建议修复

**方案 A（推荐）· 终止判定改为整个 UTF-16 码元**（一行级修改，已实证）：
```js
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2;
```
本地实证：`E:\我的世界Java版模组开发`（utf16le Buffer + NUL 结尾）在旧逻辑下解码为 `E:\我的世界Java版模组`，新逻辑完整返回 ✅。`bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0` 才是真正的 NUL。

**方案 B · 用 `bytes.indexOf(Buffer.from([0, 0]))` 定位真终止符**：语义等价于 A，写法更直白，但多一次整段扫描（32768 字节上限内可忽略）。

**方案 C · `koffi.decode(addr, "str16")`**：若 koffi 的 str16 解码对 out-param 地址语义可用则最简；但该文件注释（L16-19）说明直接解引用会崩溃，需实测验证后采用。

## 影响

- Windows 中文用户路径含 U+XX00 汉字（开/一/上/下/万/丁…）即无法添加工作区，真实存在的目录被误报 invalid-path；
- 家族已有至少 6 帖（#107/#151/#210/#244/#396/#945），官方 rc.6 仍未修复 —— 影响面明确且持续；
- 截断是**静默**的：对话框正常返回、无任何提示，只有后续 create 才暴露，用户难以自行归因。

## 环境

- 源码定位：0.1.0-rc.6（npx 缓存安装包，Node v24.16.0，Windows 11）
- 原报告：#945（Windows 11 build 26200，rc.6 实测）

## 验证材料

- 本地实证（Node 复刻 worker.cjs 逻辑）：`E:\我的世界Java版模组开发` → rc.6 逻辑解码 `E:\我的世界Java版模组`（截断，与报错一致）；修复判定 → 完整路径 ✅；
- 「开」UTF-16LE bytes = `00 5f`（低字节 0x00，触发条件成立）；
- rc.6 编译产物 `worker.cjs` L21-26/L132 逐行核对；
- 社区复现（#945 原帖 + #151 FenjuFu 复核）。

---

*First analysis of discussion #945. Happy to open a PR with fix option A.*

discussions.title: Menu exposes menu roles without keyboard navigation
discussions.body:
# Menu exposes menu roles without keyboard navigation

## Summary

The shared Web UI `Menu` renders `role="menu"` / `role="menuitem"`, but it does not implement the keyboard interaction those roles promise. Opening a menu leaves focus on the trigger, and `ArrowDown`, `ArrowUp`, `Home`, `End`, `Enter`/`Space`, and submenu arrow keys are not handled.

I reproduced the primary failure in the current Web UI at commit [`47f9438`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a).

## Real reproduction

Environment: Windows 10, Chromium, local Web UI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, source checkout at `47f9438`.

1. Focus the current workspace selector.
2. Activate it to open the workspace menu.
3. Press `ArrowDown`.

Observed:

- focus remains on the trigger;
- no menu item becomes active;
- repeated arrow keys do not navigate the list.

Expected:

- opening from the keyboard places focus on an enabled menu item (or the selected item);
- `ArrowDown` / `ArrowUp` move through enabled items and wrap;
- `Home` / `End` move to the first / last enabled item;
- `Enter` / `Space` activate the focused item;
- `ArrowRight` opens and enters a submenu, while `ArrowLeft` returns to its parent;
- `Escape` closes and restores focus to the trigger.

## Call chain and source evidence

The workspace selector is one caller of the shared primitive:

```text
WorkspacePicker
  -> Menu
     -> role="menu"
        -> button role="menuitem"
```

The open-state key listener only handles Escape: [`Menu.tsx#L167-L188`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Menu.tsx#L167-L188).

Items and submenu items are rendered as ordinary buttons with `role="menuitem"`, but without roving `tabIndex`, item refs, or list-level key handling: [`Menu.tsx#L202-L259`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Menu.tsx#L202-L259). The menu container itself only stops click propagation: [`Menu.tsx#L265-L278`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/client/ui-primitives/src/Menu.tsx#L265-L278).

Submenus currently open on hover/focus, but keyboard focus never enters them; the parent only toggles `openSubmenuId` on focus/click.

## Impact surface

The current tree has 11 production `<Menu>` call sites across 10 files. They cover workspace selection/actions, language, permission presets, agent presets, input behavior, and JSON-tree actions. This makes the defect a shared keyboard-accessibility and ergonomics issue rather than one workspace-picker edge case.

Because native `<button>` elements remain individually tabbable, users can sometimes reach rows by repeatedly pressing Tab. That is not equivalent to menu navigation, and the declared ARIA roles cause assistive technology to announce a menu interaction model that the component does not provide.

## Root cause

`Menu` implements pointer ownership (outside click, hover grace, hover/focus submenu opening) but has no active-item model. Consequently there is nowhere for arrow-key movement, disabled-item skipping, focus restoration, or parent/submenu transitions to be expressed.

## Minimum fix boundary

The smallest reusable fix belongs in the shared `Menu`:

1. keep refs for enabled top-level and submenu items;
2. on keyboard open, focus the selected item or first enabled item;
3. implement `ArrowUp` / `ArrowDown` / `Home` / `End` on the active menu;
4. implement `ArrowRight` / `ArrowLeft` for submenu entry/return;
5. close on `Escape` and restore focus to the trigger;
6. use roving `tabIndex` so only the active menu item participates in the tab order.

This should remain one primitive-level change. Adding key handlers to the 11 callers would duplicate state and produce inconsistent behavior between ordinary, portaled, footer, and submenu variants.

📚 I wrote a beginner-friendly dsh tutorial (12 chapters + original diagrams) — feedback welcome!
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! I've been learning dsh over the past few weeks and wanted
to give something back to this amazing project: I wrote a
**plain-language tutorial** for DeepSeek Harness, built on the Feynman
learning method (explain it in simple words → recite it back → fill the
gaps).

What's inside:

- **12 chapters across 4 acts**: what dsh is → core mechanics (turns,
  session log as the single source of truth) → pluggable power (seams,
  tools & execution pipeline, scopes, delegation) → hands-on (run it
  yourself + write your first bundle)
- **12 original SVG diagrams** (all local assets, zero external deps)
- A **Feynman-style self-quiz** at the end of every chapter — answer it
  out loud before expanding the reference
- A **side-by-side comparison with Claude Code / Codex** for people who
  already know those tools
- Verified against the latest source & docs (**0.1.0-rc.5**)

It's 100% static and works offline (download the zip from Releases).
Content is in Chinese with an English README; an English site
translation is in progress.

🔗 Repo: https://github.com/Hubert-hwk/dsh-for-humans
🌐 Read online: https://Hubert-hwk.github.io/dsh-for-humans/

Since dsh is still in developer preview and the API moves fast, please
open an Issue if you spot anything inaccurate or outdated — I'll fix it
promptly. Hope this helps newcomers get started faster than I did 🙂
