现状：目前无论 `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` 还是源码安装，用户都要自己打开终端输入命令，再手动访问 http://127.0.0.1:3080，对不熟悉命令行的用户不够友好。

具体建议：
1. 安装后自动创建桌面快捷方式（Windows `.lnk` / macOS `.app` / Linux `.desktop`）；
2. 快捷方式启动 `dsh web`，等服务就绪后自动打开浏览器；
3. 提供可选项（如 `dsh setup --desktop-shortcut` 或安装器勾选），不想要的用户可跳过；
4. 图标直接用仓库 favicon 生成。

附 Windows 参考实现（启动脚本 + 创建快捷方式，可放进安装/postinstall 流程）：

```bat
@echo off
setlocal
title DeepSeek Harness
cd /d "%~dp0"
set "NODE_BIN=node"
where node >nul 2>nul || set "NODE_BIN=C:\Program Files\nodejs\node.exe"
start "" powershell -NoProfile -WindowStyle Hidden -Command "$port=3080; $ok=$false; for($i=0;$i -lt 90;$i++){ try { $c=New-Object Net.Sockets.TcpClient; $c.Connect('127.0.0.1',$port); $c.Close(); $ok=$true; break } catch { Start-Sleep -Seconds 1 } }; if($ok){ Start-Process 'http://127.0.0.1:3080' }"
"%NODE_BIN%" "%~dp0apps\cli\lib\bin.js" web
endlocal
```

$ws = New-Object -ComObject WScript.Shell
$lnk = $ws.CreateShortcut("$env:USERPROFILE\Desktop\DeepSeek Harness.lnk")
$lnk.TargetPath = "$env:COMSPEC"
$lnk.Arguments = '/c ""C:\path\to\DeepSeek-Harness.cmd""'

discussions.title: [feat request] 主进程launch时自注入NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY,使得llm-pi-ai可以走代理端口
discussions.body:
## 1. 问题

在子代理/工作流中以 `gpt-5.6-luna`（Luna 5.6）运行任务时失败：

```
OpenAI API error (403): {"message":"Upstream request failed: [403] This model is not available in your region."}
```

curl 直连同一 endpoint + 同一 key 却返回 200。

## 2. 根因

LLM 调用链（全部在 DSH 主进程内）：

```
llm-pi-ai (config.ts → provider.ts)
  → pi-ai@0.84.1 createProvider / openai-responses API
    → openai-node SDK v6 (new OpenAI({apiKey, baseURL, ...}))
      → Node 全局 fetch (undici) —— 直连，不读代理 env
```

- **Node/undici 默认忽略 `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量**；只有
  `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`（Node ≥ 22.15 / 24）或 `--use-env-proxy` 才启用
  `EnvHttpProxyAgent`。
- 主进程 env 虽已导出 `http_proxy/https_proxy=http://127.0.0.1:7897`（Clash），
  但未启用 env-proxy 时全部 LLM 请求直连。
- undici 直连的出口对 opencode.ai 上游被地区拒绝（403）；经 7897 代理出口
  则放行（200）。curl 直连成功是因为 curl 与 undici 的 TLS 请求特征不同，
  被网关区别对待——不影响结论。
- 主模型 `deepseek-v4-flash` 不受地区限制，所以此前一直正常；luna 一用即暴露。

## 3. 实测矩阵（同 key、同 endpoint、同模型 gpt-5.6-luna）

| 路径                                         | 结果             |
| -------------------------------------------- | ---------------- |
| undici 直连（修复前 harness 行为）           | **403** 地区错误 |
| curl 直连 / `-x http://127.0.0.1:7897`       | 200              |
| undici `ProxyAgent('http://127.0.0.1:7897')` | 200              |
| Node `--use-env-proxy`                       | 200              |
| `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` 环境变量              | 200              |

## 4. 解决方案

1. 临时方案 : launch DSH 时加 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`：
`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 $DSH_SOURCE/apps/cli/lib/bin.js web`
2. bin.ts自注入`NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`：
```ts
#apps/cli/src/bin.ts
if (process.env.NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY === undefined
  && (process.env.HTTP_PROXY !== undefined || process.env.HTTPS_PROXY !== undefined)) {
  process.env.NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY = '1'
}
```
- `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY` 在 Node **首次 fetch 时惰性
读取**，进程内设置与 launch 设置同样生效（均 200），故此处注入时机安全；

discussions.title: Proposal: where should community translations live? (starting with Japanese)
discussions.body:
I've translated the root `README.md` and `CONTRIBUTING.md` into Japanese. The files are on a branch in my fork: https://github.com/eltociear/deepseek-harness/tree/add-ja-doc

I'm not opening a pull request — `CONTRIBUTING.md` says external PRs can't be accepted right now, so I'm raising it here instead, as that document suggests.

I don't think "merge two files" is the real question, though. Reading `docs/i18n/README.md`, the documentation system looks bilingual by construction rather than multilingual with two languages configured:

- a pair is three sibling files (`foo.md`, `foo.zh.md`, `foo.i18n.yaml`), and the consistency record holds exactly two blob hashes
- `verify-translation-pairing`, the `dsh-translation-pairing` merge driver, and `translation-prompt.ts`'s two render directions all assume two sides
- the website projects two locales
- the docs are explicit that the gate cannot judge whether two sides actually say the same thing — that half of the contract belongs to a reviewer who reads both languages

So a third language isn't a file addition; it's a change to the contract, and it needs someone on the review side who reads it. That's a real cost, and it's yours to weigh rather than mine. Three ways it could go, cheapest first:

1. **A community-translations carve-out.** Japanese files live outside the pairing gate entirely — explicitly community-maintained and unverified, excluded through the existing manifest mechanism, reachable by a single link. The pairing contract is untouched and nothing in CI learns a third language. The cost is a manifest entry and the honesty of the "unverified" label.

2. **Generalize pair → set.** `.i18n.yaml` records N hashes, switchers list N languages, the structural signature is checked per language, the website gains a locale. Correct, and much larger — and probably not worth doing for one language without a maintainer per language.

3. **Not now.** The Japanese docs stay in a separate community repo with no official link. This is my default if there's no appetite, and it's a fine answer.

Either way, I'm offering to maintain the Japanese side and keep it in sync with the English source, following `terminology.md` and `translation-rules.md`.

If the answer is (3), no reply is needed — I'll read the absence of interest as the answer and won't push it further. Mainly I'd like to avoid doing work that has nowhere to go.

discussions.title: dsh-git-credentials — multi-forge token management: tokens never enter the model context
discussions.body: 大家好 👋 分享一个我在维护的 out-of-tree 插件：[dsh-git-credentials](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials) —— DeepSeek Harness 的 Git 凭据管理插件，统一管理 GitLab、GitHub、Gitee、Gitea、Bitbucket 五个平台的 API token，token 值永不进入大模型上下文。 ### 功能 + 模型工具只携带 token 引用名（如 GITHUB_TOKEN），调用时才从插件自己的 AES-256-GCM 加密存储中解密一次，token 只出现在发出的 HTTP 请求头里 + 20 个 forge 工具：每个 provider 提供 仓库、文件读取、issue、pull request 四类（gitlab_*、github_*、gitee_*、gitea_*、bitbucket_*），按 provider 限定——gitlab_* 工具只会看到 GitLab 站点 + 未配置的 site/token 响亮失败，错误里列出合法值 + 设置页 → Git 凭据 分区：添加/编辑/删除站点、写入或清除 token 值——任何接口响应都不携带 token 值 + 改动即时生效；配置修改热加载，无需重启 ### 安装 ```sh # 从 release 页面下载 dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz，然后： dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz # 重启 GUI（bundle 层在启动时组合），之后在 设置 → Git 凭据 管理站点 ``` 下载：[dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz) · Release：[v0.1.0](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials/releases/tag/v0.1.0) ### 安全模型 + ~/.dsh/git-credentials.json 整体 AES-256-GCM 加密，密钥独立文件（0600）——单独拷走数据文件只有密文 + 威胁模型与 harness 自身密钥处理同级：防磁盘静态泄露（人），不防同 UID 进程，不防用户主动泄密 ### 诚实的定位 如果只需要 GitHub，官方 GitHub MCP server 是更主流的选择。本插件的价值在于多 forge 场景（尤其是 Gitee、自托管 Gitea），以及"加密存储 + 产品内管理页面"的需求。完整对比见[「为什么不用 MCP server？」](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md#%E4%B8%BA%E4%BB%80%E4%B9%88%E4%B8%8D%E7%94%A8-mcp-server) MIT 协议，欢迎反馈和 PR！ Hi everyone 👋 I'd like to share an out-of-tree plugin I've been maintaining: [dsh-git-credentials](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials) — a DeepSeek Harness plugin that manages GitLab, GitHub, Gitee, Gitea, and Bitbucket API tokens so token values never enter the model context. ### What it does + The model's tools carry only a token reference name (e.g. GITHUB_TOKEN); the value is decrypted from the plugin's own AES-256-GCM encrypted store at call time and appears only in the outgoing HTTP header + 20 forge tools: repos, file read, issues, and pull requests per provider (gitlab_*, github_*, gitee_*, gitea_*, bitbucket_*), scoped per provider — a gitlab_* tool only ever sees GitLab sites + Unconfigured sites/tokens fail load with the valid values listed in the error + Web settings panel under Settings → Git Credentials: add/edit/delete sites, store or clear token values — no API response ever carries a token value + Changes take effect on the next call; config edits hot-reload without restart ### Install ```sh # download dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz from the release page, then: dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz # restart the GUI (bundle layers compose at boot), then manage sites under Settings → Git Credentials ``` Download: [dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-git-credentials-0.1.0.tgz) · Release: [v0.1.0](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials/releases/tag/v0.1.0) ### Security model + ~/.dsh/git-credentials.json is fully encrypted (AES-256-GCM), with the key in a separate 0600 file — a copied data file alone is ciphertext + Threat model is the same level as the harness's own key handling: protects at-rest disclosure from humans, not same-UID processes, not deliberate user disclosure ### Honest positioning If you only need GitHub, the official GitHub MCP server is the mainstream choice. This plugin targets multi-forge setups (especially Gitee or self-hosted Gitea) and use cases that want encrypted storage plus an in-product management page. Full comparison: [Why not just an MCP server?](https://github.com/revive/dsh-git-credentials#why-not-just-an-mcp-server) MIT licensed. Feedback and PRs welcome!

discussions.title: dsh-hindsight-memory：给 DeepSeek Harness 加跨会话语义记忆（向量检索 + 自动召回）
discussions.body:
大家好，我做了一个 DeepSeek Harness 插件：**dsh-hindsight-memory**。

它为 Harness 增加**跨会话的语义长期记忆**：通过本地 Hindsight daemon（PostgreSQL + pgvector + DeepSeek embeddings），把用户偏好、踩坑经验、业务背景等嵌入向量库，按**语义相似度**召回——不需要关键词匹配。

### 主要功能

- **`hindsight_retain`**：写入一条记忆；Hindsight 自动抽取事实、解析实体、生成 embedding、去重相似事实、建立时间/语义/实体链接
- **`hindsight_recall`**：语义检索（embedding 相似度 + 知识图谱扩散激活），换个说法也能命中
- **`hindsight_reflect`**：让后端 LLM 综合多条相关记忆给出精炼回答
- **自动召回（autoRecall）**：监听 `agent/pre-step`，每步前自动把相关记忆以 `<system-reminder>` 注入对话，任务开始不再"冷启动"
- **完全隔离**：插件使用独立 Hindsight profile（独立 daemon 端口 + 独立 PostgreSQL 实例 + 独立 bank），不会读写其他 profile（如 Hermes 的）数据

### 为什么需要它

Harness 原生记忆是**会话级**的（per-session 事件日志 + AGENTS.md 指令）。这个插件补上的是**跨会话语义记忆**：这个用户偏好什么、上次踩过什么坑、某个项目的历史决策——下次任务自动想起来。

### 安装

```sh
# 方式一：从 GitHub 安装（现在可用）
dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/WeilaiSun/dsh-hindsight-memory.git

# 方式二：从 npm 安装（即将发布）
# dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-hindsight-memory
```

然后在 agent preset 的 `agent.cordis.yml` 加一行：

```yaml
- id: hindsight-memory
  name: 'dsh-hindsight-memory'
  config:
    autoRecall: true
```

仓库：https://github.com/WeilaiSun/dsh-hindsight-memory

### 前置条件

- 本地有 `hindsight_embed` Python 包（venv），默认路径按 Hermes 布局（`F:\Hermes\HERMES_HOME\...`），可用配置覆盖
- DeepSeek API key（或任意 OpenAI 兼容端点）做 embedding，key 从本地 config.json 读取，不硬编码

### 当前状态

早期社区插件，非 DeepSeek 官方。已在本地实际会话中验证：retain → recall 闭环可用，auto-recall 注入正常，与 Hermes 的 Hindsight 数据完全隔离共存。源码与冒烟测试在仓库中。

欢迎大家反馈：

- autoRecall 的注入频率/预算是否需要可调项？
- 是否希望支持直接检索现有 Hermes bank（只读）？
- 记忆自动写入的触发策略有什么建议？

discussions.title: [Review] DeepSeek Harness 初步评测：插件化 AI 工作台的潜力与门槛
discussions.body:
这是一篇基于实际接入和发布独立 dsh-plugin 的初步体验，不代表 DeepSeek 官方立场。

## 总体结论

DeepSeek Harness 最有价值的地方，不只是调用某一个模型，而是把工具、技能、系统提示和工作流统一成可安装、可组合的插件。

对于希望打造垂直行业 AI 的开发者，它提供了一个很有吸引力的基础：可以把“通用模型”包装成面向科研、教育、内容生产或其他行业的专门工作台。不过，目前项目仍处于 developer preview 阶段，开发者体验、插件分发和普通用户的上手流程还需要继续打磨。

## 做得好的地方

### 1. 插件化方向正确

插件可以承载工具、技能、提示词和工作流，不需要每个行业都从头开发一套 Agent 应用。这种边界设计适合长期构建插件生态。

### 2. 适合打造垂直行业 AI

同一个 Harness，可以通过不同插件变成科研助手、课程设计助手、代码审查助手或企业知识助手。插件负责行业能力，宿主负责对话、任务和工作区，这个分层很有潜力。

### 3. 插件可以独立分发

我实际制作并发布了一个独立插件 **dsh-academic-research**，面向老师、学生和研究人员，提供中英文文献检索、文献综述、证据矩阵、论文写作与引用核验等能力。

仓库地址：

https://github.com/userInner/dsh-academic-research

安装方式：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/userInner/dsh-academic-research
```

## 当前的主要门槛

### 1. 插件开发者需要更清晰的最小示例

新开发者需要同时理解插件清单、工具注册、技能目录、运行时依赖和宿主版本。建议提供一个从零开始、几分钟内可以运行的最小插件模板，并明确哪些能力适合放在 tool、skill 或 system prompt 中。

### 2. 版本兼容契约需要稳定

插件生态能否持续发展，很大程度取决于宿主升级后，已有插件是否仍然可用。建议尽早明确插件 API 的兼容策略、版本范围、弃用周期和自动诊断方式。

### 3. 安装和发现机制还可以更友好

目前通过命令安装对开发者来说已经可用，但普通用户还需要知道插件是什么、从哪里找、是否可信、需要哪些权限。未来如果有官方插件索引、权限说明、兼容性标记和一键安装入口，使用门槛会明显降低。

### 4. 错误信息需要更面向用户

插件加载失败、工具 schema 不正确、依赖缺失或外部服务不可用时，最好直接告诉用户：

- 哪个插件出了问题；
- 是否影响当前任务；
- 用户可以怎样修复；
- 是否可以安全地继续使用其他能力。

这比展示底层错误名称更容易定位问题。

## 我的建议

我认为项目下一阶段可以优先做好四件事：

1. 发布稳定的插件开发规范和最小模板；
2. 增加插件检查器，安装时提前检查 manifest、依赖、权限和版本兼容性；
3. 建立官方或社区插件目录，并显示权限、数据来源和维护状态；
4. 继续优化首次启动、任务队列、失败恢复和普通用户的反馈状态。

## 最终评价

DeepSeek Harness 的方向是对的：它把“做一个 AI 应用”进一步抽象成“组合一个可安装的 AI 能力系统”。

如果插件 API、分发机制和文档继续成熟，它有机会成为构建垂直行业 AI 的基础设施。现阶段更适合开发者和早期用户试用，普通用户还需要更简单的安装、发现和故障处理体验。

欢迎大家分享自己的接入体验：你认为 DeepSeek Harness 最应该优先完善哪一部分？

discussions.title: Allow third-party plugins to expose their own settings namespaces to the Web plugin-configuration section
discussions.body:
## Summary

The Web plugin-configuration section (`设置 → 插件配置`, served by `dsh-host-apiproxy`) only exposes settings namespaces listed in the hardcoded `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` allowlist. A third-party plugin can register a namespace via `ctx.settings.register(...)` (it persists fine), but the browser half gets `settings-not-exposed` from `settings.describe`, so its settings card renders nothing and users cannot configure the plugin from the GUI.

The code comment in `dsh-host-apiproxy` already acknowledges this:

> a namespace absent here answers `settings-not-exposed` even when its owner registered it, so adding a section to that page is a decision made here rather than by the registering plugin. Moving that declaration to `settings.register()`, so a plugin can expose its own configuration without a change in this package, is deferred work.

## Proposal

Move the exposure decision into `settings.register()` so a plugin can opt in:

```ts
ctx.settings.register(settingsNamespace('my-plugin'), schema, {
  applies: 'live',
  expose: true, // opt-in: serve this namespace to configuration clients
});
```

Keep the allowlist as the default for existing namespaces (backwards compatible), and let `exposedNamespaces()` include every namespace registered with `expose: true` (probably gated on the owner being an enabled entry, like the current explicit list). A `restart`-applies namespace could be excluded from the exposed set if that is safer.

## Context

I maintain a third-party plugin ([dsh-auto-continue](https://github.com/HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue)) that registers an `auto-continue` settings namespace. Without this change, every installation needs a one-time vendor patch that appends the namespace to `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` in the installed bundle (see [scripts/patch-expose.mjs](https://github.com/HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue/blob/main/scripts/patch-expose.mjs)) — it works but is fragile across reinstalls (npx cache, global installs) and is exactly the kind of per-plugin core modification the seam was meant to avoid.

Happy to adapt the proposal or submit a PR if that helps.

discussions.title: Persistent Bash timeout message should not diagnose OOM
discussions.body:
## Summary

At upstream `master` commit [`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a), the persistent Bash timeout-handling path renders a timeout-or-OOM diagnosis even though that code path has only deadline evidence. It does not observe a process exit status, kernel event, cgroup event, or memory evidence that could establish an OOM.

## Minimal reproduction

- The focused package test uses the timeout stub (`wait-for-abort`) and verifies the rendered timeout result.
- The assembled JSON-RPC scenario asks Bash to run exactly:

  ```sh
  printf 'BEFORE_TIMEOUT\n'; sleep 60
  ```

  It captures `BEFORE_TIMEOUT` before the 15-second snapshot deadline.

## Root cause

The timeout-handling code path establishes only that its deadline fired; it does not observe process exit status, kernel events, cgroup events, or memory evidence that could establish an OOM. The OOM alternative therefore overstates the available evidence.

## Proposed correction

Replace only the first diagnostic line:

```text
Old: Your command timed out after N seconds or experienced an OOM error. Below is partial output:
New: Your command timed out after N seconds. Below is partial output:
```

Deliberately unchanged: bounded partial-output handling, timeout rounding, reset behavior and guidance, shell lifecycle handling, configuration defaults, and terminal backend contracts.

## Behavior preserved

Persistent Bash state before timeout is preserved. The assembled coverage also preserves bounded partial output; reset guidance; a fresh workspace current directory and environment; `DSH_EXAMPLE_COUNT` unset after reset; explicit `exit 9`; editor create, view, and replace behavior; and the final `PERSISTENT_TOOLS_OK` response.

## Keyless assembled coverage

The `persistent-tools` snapshot runs the real JSON-RPC runtime, persistent Bash tool, terminal service, and terminal Bash backend. It replays only recorded model output, so it needs no model key. The ordinary interactive default remains 300 seconds; snapshots use 15 seconds.

## Validation

Full verification at `c3c17837a8d82e783a5047807dd8eb91580bd08e` recorded the following results:

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/tests/tools.spec.ts` — passed, 17/17 tests.
- `pnpm run test:snapshot examples/jsonrpc-agent/tests/sdk.snapshot.ts -t persistent-tools` — passed, 1 test passed and 3 skipped.
- `pnpm run test:snapshot` — passed, 12 files passed; 115 tests passed and 1 skipped.
- `pnpm run typecheck` — passed.
- `pnpm run doc-sync` — passed, 28/28 gates.
- `pnpm run lint` — passed.
- `git diff --check` — passed with no output.

The final documentation-only commit, `8cdd11d423359409323d1cd072a461669a6d0981`, then passed its scoped documentation checks, `pnpm run doc-sync` (28/28 gates), `git diff --check`, and the pre-push typecheck.

The same commands were retried on a host-backed runner only for sandbox restrictions on real `/bin/ps`, local IPC, listeners, temporary workspaces, and file watchers; those restrictions were not treated as product failures.

## Optional reference implementation

If useful for evaluation, the fork branch and its seven separated commits are available below; this is reference material, not a request or expectation that the project accept a pull request or cherry-pick.

Branch: <https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/persistent-bash-timeout-diagnostic>

Core proposal, fix, coverage, and decision:

1. [`cf49b3d5f41842034a6b9eae81c6d6c40565a94e`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/cf49b3d5f41842034a6b9eae81c6d6c40565a94e) — `docs(shell): propose timeout-only persistent bash diagnostic`
2. [`786f68b0c09062aa1832702a9449cffa277e1c4d`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/786f68b0c09062aa1832702a9449cffa277e1c4d) — `fix(shell): report persistent bash timeouts accurately`
3. [`d04e3fe6317f7ed30ee1c5d6fb7a7f3a0f065467`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/d04e3fe6317f7ed30ee1c5d6fb7a7f3a0f065467) — `test(shell): snapshot persistent bash timeout reset`
4. [`fac441f1fc68fc19e0dd249f96eb6b849b9bc6e3`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/fac441f1fc68fc19e0dd249f96eb6b849b9bc6e3) — `docs(shell): record timeout-only diagnostic decision`

Generated and review-documentation follow-ups:

discussions.title: Export resolved DSH_HOME at boot so plugin apply() sees it
discussions.body:
## Summary
dsh web resolves the harness home via resolveDshHome() (with ~/.dsh fallback), but never writes the result back to process.env.DSH_HOME. Third-party plugins that read  in apply() crash the whole profile (fail-loud) on default installs where the env var is unset — the Windows default.

## Evidence
- dsh-memento fails with StoreError: MISSING_DSH_HOME (its own error text says "run under dsh or set dbPath explicitly") — plugin-side report: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-memento/issues/1
- dsh --profile web --dump-config passes (tree only); real boot fails at apply().

## Related inconsistency
dsh-shell-env injects DSH_HOME for child processes, while the host Node process itself never has it.

## Suggestion
After home resolution in boot:
`
process.env.DSH_HOME ??= resolveDshHome()
`
Low-risk, matches the documented  contract, and prevents one misbehaving plugin from bricking the entire profile.

discussions.title: [BUG] /api trust fence rejects Chromium port-less Origin: 403 blocks workspace directory picker (host.pickDirectory)
discussions.body: 发现BUG后，deepseek v4 Flash 帮我修复了该 bug，并提交了如下讨论，正文内容为 AI 书写，它已将我本地代码修复了。报错截图如下： 大家好，我在当前 master（`0.1.0-rc.5`，commit `47f943859b`）的 Web UI 上遇到了一个可稳定复现的 403。按贡献指引发到这里（目前仓库暂不接受外部 PR）。 **环境** - 机型：Apple Silicon MacBook Pro（Mac16,5），macOS 26.6.1（Build 25G76） - 浏览器：Chrome 151.0.7922.137（Chromium），默认设置 - 运行时：Node v26.7.0、pnpm 11.7.0 - dsh：源码构建（`pnpm run build`）后以 `pnpm dsh web` 启动 **复现步骤** 1. 设置 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 后运行 `pnpm dsh web` 2. 在 Chrome 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 3. 点击「添加工作区」→ 系统文件夹选择流程失败，弹出「无法打开文件夹」并显示 `transport failure for /api/host.pickDirectory: HTTP 403`；点「重新选择」每次都复现 因此 Chrome 下完全无法创建工作区。同源 `curl`（带 `Origin: http://127.0.0.1:3080`）请求正常，掩盖了非浏览器客户端不会遇到该问题的事实。 **诊断** `/api` 浏览器信任栅栏 `isTrustedApiRequest`（`packages/client/connection/src/api-request-trust.ts`）要求附加的 `Origin` 与 `Host` 权威完全一致（`new URL(origin).host === hostUrl.host`）。 通过临时在服务端加日志，实测 Chrome 请求头为： - `Host: 127.0.0.1:3080` - `Origin: http://127.0.0.1` —— **Chromium 剥掉了端口** - `Sec-Fetch-Site: same-origin`、`Sec-Fetch-Mode: cors`、`Referer: http://127.0.0.1:3080/` 于是 `new URL('http://127.0.0.1').host` = `127.0.0.1` ≠ `127.0.0.1:3080` → 在任何 RPC 分发之前返回 403。根因：**Chromium 对回环/IP 来源的 `Origin` 头序列化时不带端口**（Chrome 151 实测）；因此按完整权威比较会拒绝所有发往 Web UI 的合法 Chromium 请求。 **解决思路（已本地实现并测试）** `Origin` 的**主机名**与 `Host` 主机名精确比较；仅当 `Origin` 携带**显式非默认端口**时才比较端口： - 无端口的 `Origin`（Chromium 的序列化方式）接受——浏览器根本没有发送端口可供比较。 - 带端口的 `Origin` 必须与 `Host` 端口一致，从而为序列化完整来源的浏览器（如 Safari/Firefox）保留同主机跨端口 CSRF 防御。 - 两侧默认端口（`:80`/`:443`）归一化为无端口。 - 不变的部分：跨主机（攻击者主机名）仍拒绝、`sec-fetch-site: cross-site` 仍拒绝、`Host` 栅栏与 `trustedHosts` 语义不变；栅栏仍只是可达性策略，不是认证。 需要说明的一个边界：在 Chromium 上，同一回环主机上不同端口的请求与同源请求无法区分，因为 Chromium 会完全省略 `Origin` 里的端口——这是浏览器序列化的限制，不是栅栏能补的。 测试覆盖：无端口接受、带端口匹配、跨端口拒绝、`https:` 默认端口归一化。如有需要可提供完整 diff。

discussions.title: [Bug] headless 模式下 subagent 子代理结果丢失（backgroundMode: continuable 是 base bundle 的默认配置）
discussions.body:
# [Bug] headless 模式下 subagent 子代理结果丢失（`backgroundMode: continuable` 是 base bundle 的默认配置）

## Summary（概述）

headless profile（`dsh --profile headless "<任务>"`）在父 agent 最后一轮 turn 结束后立即拆除运行时。任何以 `backgroundMode: continuable` 委派出去的子代理（这是 base bundle 的默认配置）此刻可能仍在运行，其结果永远无法送达父 agent。**最终答案会静默丢失子代理结果**，本应消费结果的续轮（continuation turn）也永远不会执行。

## Repro（复现步骤）

```bash
dsh --profile headless "用子代理查北京天气和上海天气，汇总"
```

实际输出：

```
两个子代理已启动，正在分别查询北京和上海的天气。等待它们返回结果后我会进行汇总。
```

Session 日志（`~/.dsh/sessions/.../session.jsonl.zstd`）显示：

```
[turn/start]
[TOOL_CALL] todo_write
[TOOL_CALL] subagent
[TOOL_CALL] subagent
[TOOL_RESULT] ok=          ← 立即返回，不含子代理结果
[TOOL_RESULT] ok=
[ASSISTANT] "两个子代理已启动，等待汇总"
[turn/end] reason=completed ← headless 在此退出
```

同样的提示词在交互式 profile（web）下正常，因为循环会一直存活到后台任务结算。

## Root cause（根因分析）

以下均在源码中实际验证（commit `47f94385`）：

1. **`packages/bundle/headless/src/index.ts`（run()，96-134 行）** — 提交任务后唯一的等待是 `await agent.whenIdle()`（126 行）。`summarize()`（61-82 行）只折叠 `assistant/message` 的文本块；子代理结果是通过 notice 以 `user/message`（source `subagent-settled`）进入父会话的，`summarize()` 根本不会读取它。headless runner 中**没有任何等待 pending 子代理的机制**。

2. **`packages/subagent/tool-subagent/src/index.ts`（387-398 行）** — 在 `backgroundMode: continuable` 下，工具调用 `ctx.subagents.startContinuable(...)`，其注释（390-391 行）写明 "Resolves at inbox acceptance… neither waits for nor collects a result"，**立即返回** `{ kind: 'continuable', subagentId }`。结果通过后续 notice 驱动的续轮交付。

3. **`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts`（whenIdle()，195-200 行）** — `whenIdle()` 只在 `this.activityDone` 上循环，而该字段只跟踪 agent 自身的 driver/维护任务。**后台子代理的结算对它完全不可见**。生产代码中的 `agent/turn-stopping` 监听者也不会等待子代理。

4. **`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml`（313-318 行）** — `tool-subagent` 行的配置是 `backgroundMode: continuable`，所以 headless profile 未经选择就继承了后台优先行为。

官方快照 `examples/headless-agent/tests/snapshots/subagent-settlement/stream-json.expected.jsonl` 展示了唯一的"赢路径"：notice 必须在父 agent 最后一轮 turn 结束**之前**到达并被认领。真实 LLM 子代理几乎不可能在父代理最后一轮生成结束前完成结算，所以"输路径"实际上是常态。

## Impact（影响评估）

- headless 运行中委派子代理的任务会产生**无任何报错的残缺答案**——结果被静默丢弃。
- 失败是**时序相关、非确定性的**：极快的子代理偶尔能赶上，导致 bug 间歇性出现、难以在 CI 中复现。
- 任何构建在 headless 之上的自动化（CI 检查、批量评测、一次性 ACP 运行）都无法信任委派结果。

## Suggested fix（建议修复方向）

- 在 headless 中，finalize session 之前**等待所有未结算的 continuable 任务**（排空 pending 子代理结算，然后给父 agent 一次最终的续轮来消费结果），**或者**让 headless 组合默认 `backgroundMode` 为阻塞（blocking）模式。
- 增加一个 e2e/snapshot 用例：在 headless 模式下委派子代理，并断言最终答案包含其结果，防止回归。

discussions.body:
dsh-messager

  

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）任务状态通知插件。 当会话需要交互、任务完成或任务出错时，通过系统通知（OS toast）、浏览器通知与**飞书机器人（webhook）**推送提醒——不再依赖盯着会话列表的圆点。

English readme

English version: README.en.md

简介

dsh-messager 是 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的一个通知插件，属于**单包双运行端（dual-runtime）**结构：

  • host 端（Node，服务端）——负责系统通知与飞书 webhook；
  • client 端（浏览器）——负责 Web Notification。

两端配置同源（settings 命名空间 messager），Web 设置页可编辑、即时生效。

能力一览

需求 | 实现 -- | -- 触发时机 | 需要交互（审批 approval/asked、提问/计划待审 ask_user_question、客户端 pendingInteraction）、任务完成（agent/status running→idle 且仅根会话 + turn/end 原因）、任务出错（agent/error） 推送路径 | 系统通知（node-notifier toast）、浏览器通知（Notification API）、飞书机器人（webhook：interactive 卡片 + HMAC-SHA256 签名）；NotifyChannel 接口可扩展 可配置 | 触发开关、各通道启停/verbosity/icon、去重冷却、标题前缀等，见配置

触发语义与 Web UI 状态圆点完全对齐：橙点 = 需要交互（pendingInteraction），绿点 = 任务完成（running→idle 且非当前会话），蓝点 = 运行中（不通知）。

特性

  • 🟢 三种触发：需要交互 / 任务完成 / 任务出错，可独立开关；
  • 🔔 三条通道：系统通知、浏览器通知、飞书机器人，可独立启停、久内容繁复度（minimal / normal / detailed）；
  • ⚙️ 热更新配置：改设置即生效，无需重启 DSH；
  • 🔌 可扩展通道：实现 NotifyChannel 接口即可接入钉钉 / 企业微信 / Telegram 等；
  • 🧪 单元测试覆盖信号提取 / 模板渲染 / 调度去重 / 飞书签名 / 配置解析 / client diff。

discussions.title: [Bug] Cordis effects retain completed caller closures through lazy outer stacks (HMR keeps one obsolete module generation alive)
discussions.body:
**Runnable HMR reproduction:** https://github.com/jtwangbimsa-dragon/cordis-hmr-effect-stack-repro

## Summary

A live `ctx.effect()` keeps its per-effect `EffectRunner.getOuterStack` supplier after effect setup has completed. Because `buildOuterStack()` stores an unformatted `Error`, V8 can retain a closure frame captured by that stack together with values reachable from the closure's lexical environment.

The self-contained reproduction below isolates this path: the effect callback is defined at module scope, so `runner.execute` cannot capture the probe, and an otherwise identical no-effect arm retains nothing.

This matters in DeepSeek Harness HMR because replacement effects are registered while `partialReload()` still has its backup maps in scope. A replacement effect can therefore keep one obsolete module generation reachable through setup-time stack state after the reload has completed.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness commit: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis`: `4.0.1`, current vendored source at that commit
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr`: current vendored source at that commit
- Core reproduction: 20/20 independent process runs produced the asserted current result on each of Node `v22.19.0`, `v24.14.0`, `v24.19.0`, and `v26.7.0` on macOS arm64
- Locally patched reproduction: 20/20 independent process runs produced the asserted zero-retention result on each of the same four Node versions
- HMR reproduction: Node `v24.14.0` on macOS arm64; current and patched `N = 3` arms each repeated in 10 independent processes

The repository supports `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`. The reproduction uses `node:v8`'s `queryObjects()` API with no command-line flags. It is [Stability 1.1 (active development) in Node 22.19.0](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v22.19.0/docs/api/v8.html#v8queryobjectsctor-options); [Node 24.13.1 documentation removed the previous Stability 1.1 designation](https://nodejs.org/download/release/v24.14.0/docs/api/v8.html#v8queryobjectsctor-options). The tested Node 26.7.0 binary still emits an `ExperimentalWarning`, so this report does not rely on the API's stability label. No command-line flag is required, and the same documentation specifies that it searches the heap after a full garbage collection, so the result is not explained by a collection that simply has not run yet.

## Expected behavior

After an effect's setup has completed, a caller closure that is otherwise unreachable should be collectible while the effect remains live.

At the application level, after a plugin reload completes and no application reference remains, the previous module generation and its exported data should become unreachable.

## Actual behavior

The completed caller closure remains reachable for the full lifetime of the effect through the per-effect runner's lazy outer-stack supplier. It becomes collectible only when the effect is disposed.

## Minimal reproduction

Create an empty directory and install the published vendored Cordis package:

```sh
npm init -y
npm install @deepseek-ai/cordis@4.0.1
```

Save the following as `effect-stack-query.mjs`:

```js
import assert from 'node:assert/strict'
import v8 from 'node:v8'
import { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'

class Probe {}

const root = new Context()
const emptyEffect = () => {}
const count = () => v8.queryObjects(Probe)

function completedFrame(registerEffect) {
  const probe = new Probe()

  function closureCaller() {
    // Ensure this caller has a lexical environment containing `probe`.
    void probe
    return registerEffect ? root.effect(emptyEffect) : undefined
  }

  return closureCaller()
}

const baseline = count()
completedFrame(false)
const controlRetained = count() - baseline

let dispose = completedFrame(true)
const retained = count() - baseline
dispose()
dispose = undefined
const retainedAfterDispose = count() - baseline

const result = { controlRetained, retained, retainedAfterDispose }
console.log(JSON.stringify(result))
assert.deepEqual(result, {
  controlRetained: 0,
  retained: 1,
  retainedAfterDispose: 0,
})
```

Run it with any of the validated Node versions:

```sh
node effect-stack-query.mjs
```

Current output on Node 22.19.0, 24.14.0, 24.19.0, and 26.7.0:

```json
{"controlRetained":0,"retained":1,"retainedAfterDispose":0}
```

With the locally tested lifecycle change described below:

```json
{"controlRetained":0,"retained":0,"retainedAfterDispose":0}
```

The closure in this reproduction is deliberate, but it is not an artificial permanent anchor: the no-effect arm executes the same closure and retains zero probes. The module-scope `emptyEffect` also rules out the effect callback as the retaining closure. In the HMR path, no synthetic closure is required: the real `partialReload()` invocation has `esmBackup` in its execution context while replacement effects are registered.

I also ran the install and script above from a fresh empty directory. No `--expose-gc` or other Node flag is required.

## HMR impact and boundedness

I rebuilt the end-to-end HMR reproduction from the published packages listed above. It rewrites one plugin at the same file URL, allocates a 4 MiB `ArrayBuffer` per module generation, and observes generations only through `WeakRef`. On Node 24.14.0/macOS arm64, three reloads (generations 0–3) currently produce:

```json
{"reloadCount":3,"payloadBytes":4194304,"arrayBufferNet":4194304,"obsoleteReachable":1,"aliveGenerations":[2,3]}
```

With the same per-effect lifecycle change:

```json
{"reloadCount":3,"payloadBytes":4194304,"arrayBufferNet":0,"obsoleteReachable":0,"aliveGenerations":[3]}
```

Both `N = 3` results were deterministic in 10/10 independent process runs. A fresh-process reload-count scan produced:

| Reloads/imports (`N`) | Current HMR net | Current obsolete | Patched HMR net | Patched obsolete | Bare Node `?v=N` net | Bare obsolete |
|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| 1 | 4 MiB | 1 | 0 | 0 | 4 MiB | 1 |
| 3 | 4 MiB | 1 | 0 | 0 | 12 MiB | 3 |
| 5 | 4 MiB | 1 | 0 | 0 | 20 MiB | 5 |
| 10 | 4 MiB | 1 | 0 | 0 | 40 MiB | 10 |
| 20 | 4 MiB | 1 | 0 | 0 | 80 MiB | 20 |

The Harness retention is therefore bounded with respect to reload count in this scan: it keeps the current generation plus exactly the immediately previous generation. The bare-Node control deliberately imports a fresh query-string URL and retains 4 MiB per imported generation. The Harness result is lower severity than an unbounded per-reload leak, but it still pins obsolete plugin state after each reload.

That boundedness applies only to reload count in the tested HMR scenario. The generic Cordis retention scales on a separate axis: every live effect can retain its own completed caller closure and the object graph reachable from it, so aggregate cost grows with the number and captured state of live effects.

## Retainer chain

The heap contains both Node/V8's ordinary ESM ownership and this application path:

```text
live Context / EventsService
  -> current plugin effect wrapper
  -> per-effect EffectRunner.getOuterStack
  -> lazy Error / CallSiteInfo
  -> HMR partialReload() execution context
  -> esmBackup
  -> old ModuleJob
  -> ModuleWrap / SourceTextModule
  -> export Cell
  -> 4 MiB ArrayBuffer
```

Bare Node imports with a fresh `?v=N` URL retain every ESM generation, but that is a separate baseline. In the Harness HMR case the module URL is reused; releasing the per-effect outer-stack path releases the obsolete generation. The result is therefore not explained by Node's module map alone.

## Root cause

`buildOuterStack()` deliberately defers stack formatting:

```ts
export function buildOuterStack(offset = 0) {
  const outerError = new Error()
  return () => outerError.stack!.split('\n').slice(3 + offset)
}
```

`Fiber.effect()` stores that supplier on a local one-shot runner:

```ts
const runner: EffectRunner<boolean> = {
  execute,
  epoch: true,
  collect: /* ... */,
  getOuterStack: buildOuterStack(),
}
```

A full `git grep` of this DeepSeek Harness commit finds 39 `getOuterStack` references. The matches outside `vendor/cordis/` pass stack suppliers through loader/import or plugin-registration diagnostics; none accesses the local per-effect runner. Within Cordis, `_execute()` is the only reader of `getOuterStack` on that local runner:

- `vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts:455` assigns it on the runner local to `Fiber.effect()`.
- `vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts:399` reads `runner.getOuterStack` in `_execute()`.
- `vendor/cordis/src/fiber.ts:682` is a different object: the persistent plugin lifecycle runner `this._runner`, used to compose unload errors.

That distinction matters because `_execute()` is shared by both one-shot effect runners and reusable plugin runners. Clearing a field in `_execute()` itself would also clear the plugin runner, weakening unload diagnostics. The cleanup belongs at the call site in `Fiber.effect()`, where the runner is known to be the local one-shot runner.

## Proposed boundary

After `Fiber.effect()` has invoked `_execute(runner)`, replace only that local runner's `getOuterStack` with a shared empty supplier:

```ts
const emptyOuterStack = () => []

// In Fiber.effect(), around the existing call and error rollback:
try {
  task = this._execute(runner)
} catch (reason) {
  // existing rollback path
  throw reason
} finally {
  runner.getOuterStack = emptyOuterStack
}
```

This fixes the generic effect lifetime instead of adding an HMR-specific cleanup rule, while leaving the persistent plugin runner unchanged.

## Diagnostic behavior checked

This proposal intentionally discards the per-effect runner's lazy registration stack after setup invocation. That would be a diagnostic capability reduction if any current post-setup path read that field, so I checked the relevant paths rather than assuming it was harmless:

- Synchronous setup failures are composed before `_execute()` exits.
- For a pending asynchronous setup failure, `composeError()` closes over its local `getOuterStack` parameter in the Promise rejection handler; it does not read `runner.getOuterStack` later. A regression test using `Promise.reject(new Error(...))` retains the effect registration site before and after the change.
- The per-effect disposal path does not read the local runner's `getOuterStack`.
- Plugin unload error composition reads the separate persistent `this._runner.getOuterStack`, which this boundary does not clear. In a local regression test, a plugin still applied twice across `fiber.restart()`, and a cleanup failure still included the plugin registration site before and after the change.
- A failure thrown after an additional `await` currently lacks the registration site both before and after the change because it does not match `composeError()`'s stack-splice point; the proposal does not worsen that existing behavior.

If preserving a latent future post-setup read is preferred, a conservative alternative is to eagerly materialize the stack into strings and replace the lazy supplier with a supplier over those strings. That preserves frames without retaining the lazy `Error`/`CallSiteInfo`, at the cost of formatting every successful effect stack. The empty shared supplier avoids that cost and matches all current consumers found in the repository.

I have a minimal patch and regression tests ready. Would you prefer this fix in the vendored Cordis copy here, or upstream Cordis first?

discussions.title: Chunked responses break any hand-written /api client — plus two things I built on top (ArrowUp prompt recall, a Tauri desktop shell)
discussions.body:
CONTRIBUTING.md says external pull requests are not being accepted right now, so this is a Discussion rather than a PR. Everything below lives on a fork; take, adapt, or ignore any part of it.

Fork: https://github.com/Octo-o-o-o/deepseek-harness

## 1. A bug in the harness itself, worth reporting regardless of the rest

The Web server sets no `Content-Length` and answers every index and `/api` request with `Transfer-Encoding: chunked`. Any non-browser client that reads the socket and treats everything after the header terminator as the body therefore gets chunk framing in its "body":

```
e7\r\n{"type":"server-response","rpcId":"...","result":{...}}\r\n0\r\n\r\n
```

`curl` and `fetch` decode that transparently, so nothing in the repository's own checks notices. That is the part I think is generally interesting: a hand-written client is the only kind that can see this, and there is currently no hand-written client in-tree pointed at a real server. If one is ever added — a supervisor, a health probe, an embedded shell — it will hit this on day one, and the failure looks like a business error (`result.ok` false) rather than a transport bug, which sends you looking in the wrong place.

## 2. `feat(web)`: recall a session's own prompts with ArrowUp

Branch: https://github.com/Octo-o-o-o/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/input-prompt-history

![composer prompt recall](https://github.com/Octo-o-o-o/deepseek-harness/blob/input-prompt-history-assets/prompt-recall.gif?raw=true)

ArrowUp from a collapsed caret at the very start of the draft walks back through this session's own prompts; ArrowDown walks forward and, past the newest, restores the draft that was being composed when the walk began. Re-running a prompt with one word changed otherwise means scrolling the transcript, selecting, and copying back.

Two design points that took the most thought:

- **The trigger menu keeps first claim on both keys.** Recall is what they mean only after `arbitrate` passes them back.
- **Once a walk has begun, the caret stops deciding.** Re-testing offset 0 on every key stalls on the recalled text itself: recall places the caret at the end so the text is immediately editable, and a multi-line prompt then absorbs the next ArrowUp as an ordinary line move. The walk ends on an explicit act instead — editing, sending, or switching session.

`prompt-history.ts` is pure (a derivation from conversation nodes plus a cursor transition); the composer holds the cursor in a ref and writes through the ordinary `setDraft` + `track` path, the same way the space-claim gesture does. **The frozen input contract is untouched.** History is bounded by the loaded window, and a durable cross-session history is deliberately deferred — prompts are the most sensitive text in the product.

This one is small and self-contained, and it is the piece I would most like to see land in some form, whether or not it is this implementation.

## 3. `dshd`: a Tauri 2 desktop shell

Branch: https://github.com/Octo-o-o-o/deepseek-harness/tree/desktop-app · Notarized arm64 DMG: https://github.com/Octo-o-o-o/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dshd-v0.1.1

I expect this one is out of scope for the repository, and that is a reasonable call — it adds a Rust toolchain, a platform matrix, a signing pipeline, and a 175MB payload to a project that currently ships an npm package. I am posting it anyway because the interesting content is not the shell, it is what a supervisor has to get right against `dsh web`, and that is useful to you even if you never take the code:

- **Readiness is four gates, not one.** The `dsh web:` URL line, `__DSH_BOOT__` in the index, `host.describe` returning `result.ok`, and the browser client's own signal that both downlinks are up. Stopping at the URL line gives you a window that loads before the API answers.
- **Data directory.** The shell injects `DSH_HOME=~/.dsh`, the CLI's own home, so a desktop window and `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` share sessions live and can run at the same time. An earlier revision gave the desktop its own platform app-data directory to avoid two writers; that produced two trees that never converged, which was worse. Both running at once is verified, not assumed.
- **A pid file is not a licence to kill.** Once the home is shared, a stale `sidecar.pid` plus pid reuse authorizes killing a `dsh web` the user started themselves. The record has to name the entry script too.
- **Loopback is enforced on the argv**, not by convention: the shell refuses a sidecar argv that would bind non-loopback or pass `--trusted-host`. The per-launch token never appears in argv, the URL, or logs — the index carries a one-time nonce that is exchanged for an HttpOnly cookie.

What it is not: a browser wrapper. There is no remote origin — the whole agent runtime runs on the user's machine, and the shell owns process lifecycle, teardown, and the loopback trust posture that a browser tab cannot have.

## What I am actually asking

Nothing, beyond a sanity check on (1) — that one is a real bug in the harness whether or not anyone builds a desktop shell. (2) is small enough to be reimplemented in an afternoon by whoever owns the composer, if the gesture seems worth having. (3) is there to be read, not merged.

Thanks for the work — it is a genuinely nice codebase to move around in.

discussions.title: [Bug][Web GUI] User input panel does not appear until the browser is refreshed in a new session ，每次新建会话后，如果 Agent 需要用户确认、选择选项或补充信息，回答面板不会自动显示。
discussions.body: ### Description In the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, when starting a new conversation, the user input/answer panel sometimes does not appear when the agent asks the user a question. The panel only becomes visible after manually refreshing the browser. ### Steps to reproduce 1. Open the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI. 2. Start a new conversation. 3. Send a request that requires the agent to ask the user for confirmation, missing information, or a choice. 4. Wait for the agent to request user input. 5. Observe that the answer/input panel does not appear. 6. Refresh the browser. 7. The answer/input panel appears after the refresh. ### Expected behavior When the agent requests user input, the answer panel should appear immediately without requiring a browser refresh. ### Actual behavior In a newly created conversation, the answer panel does not appear automatically. The user must refresh the browser before the panel becomes visible. ### Impact This makes the conversation appear stuck because the user cannot see that the agent is waiting for an answer. It also makes every new session that requires user interaction inconvenient. ### Possible cause This may be related to the Web GUI not reacting to, or not rehydrating, the pending user-question state after a new session is created. The state appears to exist on the server because refreshing the page makes the panel appear. ### Environment - Product: DeepSeek Harness Web GUI - URL: `http://127.0.0.1:3080` - Occurrence: New conversations - Workaround: Refresh the browser Please let me know if browser console logs, network traces, screenshots, or additional reproduction details would help. --- ### 中文说明 在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中，每次新建会话后，如果 Agent 需要用户确认、选择选项或补充信息，回答面板有时不会自动显示。 用户必须手动刷新浏览器，回答面板才会出现。 **期望行为：** Agent 请求用户输入时，回答面板应立即出现，不需要刷新页面。 **实际行为：** 新会话中的回答面板不会自动出现。刷新浏览器后，面板才正常显示。 **影响：** 用户会误以为会话卡住了，无法判断 Agent 正在等待回答。 **临时解决方法：** 手动刷新浏览器页面。

discussions.title: Third-party plugins cannot expose settings namespaces to the web settings page (WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES whitelist is upgrade-fragile)
discussions.body:
### Summary

A plugin installed from **outside this repo** cannot make its settings namespace editable in the web settings page. Even after the plugin registers its namespace (via `installSettingsSection` / `settings.register`) and contributes a `settings.section` cell on the client, web reads/writes are refused with `settings-not-exposed` unless the namespace is manually appended to `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` in `packages/host/apiproxy`. That list is a hardcoded const in the shipped package, so the patch is **overwritten on every dsh upgrade** (npx reinstall / `@deepseek-ai/dsh` update) — a silent regression for the plugin's users.

### Reproduction

1. Install a third-party plugin, e.g. `dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/my-plugin`, whose host half calls `installSettingsSection(ctx, 'my-ns', schema, entry, hooks)` and whose client half registers a `settings.section` cell (`id: 'my-ns'`).
2. Open Settings → the plugin's page, change a field, hit Save.
3. **Expected**: the write persists (schema validation + revision fencing apply).
4. **Actual**: the write is refused before the settings seam is touched:

   `settings-not-exposed: settings namespace "my-ns" is not exposed to configuration clients`

   Editing `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` directly works fine.

**Workaround**: append `'my-ns'` to `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` in both `lib/index.js` and `lib/types/api-proxy.js` of the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy`, then restart. Fragile: any dsh update wipes it, and the source `src/` tree ships without the entry, so the divergence is easy to miss.

### Background

The design note `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-10-web-plugin-configuration.zh.md` already records this as a deliberate cost:

> 「暴露仍是 Host 的白名单。仅有注册依然不会跨越传输边界……加入第四个插件仍需要在 apiproxy 白名单里添一条，因此本页的覆盖面是 Host 的决定而非插件的决定。」

and documents the preferred alternative — a **registration-time exposure declaration**:

> 「用注册期的暴露声明取代白名单。这才是诚实的形状——命名空间的拥有方声明自己的暴露，在本仓库之外分发的插件也无需改动 packages/host/apiproxy 就能呈现自己的配置。」

deferred because it would change the seam contract, every existing registration point, anti-enumeration semantics, and needs a fail-closed redaction path before plugins may expose arbitrary schemas.

### Proposal

Implement the registration-time exposure declaration, e.g. an `expose` option on `settings.register(ns, schema, { expose })` (or a dedicated registration call), addressing the deferred concerns:

- **Anti-enumeration**: only namespaces the owning plugin explicitly marks exposed are served to configuration clients; `describe`/`get` for others keep answering `settings-not-exposed` exactly as today.
- **Redaction**: reuse the existing `settings.describe({ redactSecrets: true })` path so an exposed arbitrary schema still never leaks secrets over the wire (the current seam already redacts before views are built).
- **Migration**: default `expose: false` keeps today's semantics for existing callers; in-repo namespaces flip to `expose: true` as they're migrated off `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`, which can then be removed.

Until then, at minimum it would help to document the whitelist requirement for third-party plugin authors — the runtime error message already points to the workaround, but the docs don't, and the upgrade-overwrite failure mode is hard to diagnose.

(Encountered with a local third-party plugin `dsh-llm-proxy`; happy to provide more detail or a minimal repro repo.)

---

discussions.title: dsh web fails to boot: unresolvable plugin reference in profile patch (cordis.patch.yml)
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

`dsh web` fails to boot when the profile patch layer references a package that does not exist on npm. The loader applies the reference without validation, and a single dangling entry kills the entire plugin tree — no skip-and-warn, no graceful degradation. This may be related to reports of "plugins missing after restart".

## Environment

- dsh: `0.1.0-rc.6` (installed via npm)
- OS: Ubuntu 26.04, Node v24.18.0
- Profile: default `web` profile

## Reproduction

Run `dsh web`. Observed output:

```
[plugin-session-export] registered "export_session" — listed=true
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include
(cordis:include): failed to import loader entry dev-workbench
(@dsh-user/dev-workbench): Cannot find package '@dsh-user/dev-workbench'
imported from /home/boyin/.dsh/profiles/web/
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: ...
```

## Root cause

`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` contains:

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dev-workbench
      name: '@dsh-user/dev-workbench'
```

- `@dsh-user/dev-workbench` does not exist on npm (`npm view` → 404).
- It is not declared in the profile's `package.json` `dependencies`, and not present in `node_modules`.
- Nothing validates the reference before the loader tries to import it at boot → hard crash.

## Impact

- One dangling reference blocks the entire profile; all other valid plugins fail to load.
- No graceful degradation — unresolvable entries are not skipped with a warning.
- Recovery requires manual YAML editing.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Validate references before they become boot blockers**: resolve `name:` at write time in the plugin manager / UI (reject 404s immediately), or at minimum validate at boot and surface the exact file/line/entry id.
2. **Fail soft**: skip unresolvable loader entries with a warning instead of aborting the whole plugin tree.
3. **Add a diagnostic command** (e.g. `dsh doctor` / `dsh check`) that scans profiles for dangling plugin references and undeclared dependencies — this case would have been caught in seconds.

## Workaround (applied)

Backed up `cordis.patch.yml`, removed the dangling `insert` block. `dsh web` boots normally afterwards.

discussions.title: 【Bug】工具调用循环中思考内容直接混入正文显示（deepseek-v4-flash 经 pi-ai 路由时多数 step 不产生 thinking 事件）
discussions.body:
## 环境

- DSH: `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6`（npm 安装，当前最新版）
- 路由：`dsh-llm-pi-ai`（pi-ai），provider `opencode-modlens`，model `deepseek-v4-flash`，`reasoningEffort: max`
- macOS + Chrome 151 + `dsh web`（127.0.0.1:3080）

## 症状

Agent 在**工具调用密集的长回合**中，思考内容（内心推理）大量直接以**正文**形式显示在对话流里，而不是折叠在「Think」行中。用户观察：回合开头思考正常显示在 Think 折叠行（reasoning 块），进入工具循环后"思考跑出来了"——大段推理文本直接作为正文渲染（用户截图确认）。

## 证据（会话原始 chunk 流统计）

对 `session.jsonl` 的 `assistant/chunk` 事件按 turn/step 统计块类型：

| turn | 总 step 数 | 含 reasoning 块的 step | 占比 |
|---|---|---|---|
| turn 1（对话开头） | 4 | 3 | 75% |
| turn 2（工具密集：跑日报） | 52 | 15 | 29% |
| turn 5（本次长调研） | 41 | **2** | **5%** |

- 具体实例：turn 5 step 26 的**单个 text 块**（1321 字符）内混有完整推理段落（"嗯，用户看的是我上一轮…这很可能就是 trajectory 显示…"）与正文，全部以正文渲染。
- 回合首步（step 1）和个别步（step 34）有正常 reasoning 块（2177/5958 字符），所以"刚开始在 Think 后面"是真实的——thinking 通道是**间歇性**工作的。

## 根因分析（三层链路均已验证）

1. **GUI**（`dsh-client-ui-conversation`）：`reasoning` 块 → Think 折叠行；`text` 块 → 正文。渲染逻辑正确。
2. **适配器**（`dsh-llm-pi-ai` `toStreamChunks`）：上游 `thinking_delta` → `reasoning-delta`；`text_delta` → `text-delta`。映射忠实，无丢失。
3. **模型侧**（deepseek-v4-flash 经 pi-ai 路由）：**工具调用循环中大部分 step 的推理直接输出到 `content`（text 通道），未产生 `thinking` 事件**。仅回合首步/特定步走 thinking 通道。

**结论**：问题根源在模型经 pi-ai 路由时 thinking 通道不稳定——工具循环中多数 step 的思考直接以 text 输出，工具调用越密集、上下文越长越严重。DSH 的适配器与 GUI 渲染均忠实处理了收到的数据。

## 建议

- 排查 pi-ai 路由对 deepseek-v4-flash 的 thinking 事件生成逻辑（是否与工具轮次的 thinking-mode passback / reasoning_effort 有关）。
- 或 GUI 侧：对长文本块中疑似推理的内容做降级展示（如折叠长段自问自答文本）。

## 相关讨论

- #1146 pi-ai DeepSeek 路由在回传跨 provider 历史消息时丢失 reasoning_content
- #1158 长工具调用期间 UI 无反馈、内容一次性涌入

discussions.title: 【ai4math】ai数学需要你
discussions.body:
jacobian在给AI做 可组合的数学工具 让他能解决数学猜想

discussions.title: dsh-browser-playwright：给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Playwright 浏览器插件（快照 + ref 定位）
discussions.body:
给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个真正的浏览器能力：**快照式交互 + 稳定元素引用（ref）**，模型不再靠猜 CSS 选择器。

## 一句话

Playwright 驱动的 `browser_*` 工具族：每次操作返回当前页面的可访问性快照（带 `ref=e1` 标识），后续 click/fill/press 直接用 ref 定位，确定性强、token 省。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-browser-playwright
```

无需下载浏览器：自动探测 chromium → chrome → msedge → edge 通道，本机有 Chrome 就零下载（受限网络给了 npmmirror 镜像指引）。

## 特性

- **17 个工具**：navigate / snapshot / click / fill / press / scroll / back / forward / wait / tabs 四件套 / screenshot / extract / evaluate / close
- **会话隔离**：每个 harness 会话一个独立浏览器上下文，登录态/Cookie 跨调用保留，空闲自动回收
- **截图即附件**：`browser_screenshot` 存为持久图片附件，视觉模型直接看
- **结构化提取**：`browser_extract` 用自然语言指令从页面提取 JSON（配一个辅助模型即可）
- **安全默认**：仅 http(s)、域名白名单、evaluate 默认关闭、快照 token 上限
- **能力接缝**：`ctx.browser` 三段式（Service Definition / Provider / 工具），将来换云端浏览器（Browserbase/Steel）不动工具 schema

## 与现有 dsh-browser 的差异

dsh-browser 是 CSS selector 猜测 + get_text/get_html；本插件是 **a11y 快照 + ref 定位 + tabs + extract + 附件截图**，二者可共存，按偏好选用。

## 链接

- GitHub：https://github.com/ChenyuHeee/dsh-browser-playwright （24 个测试 + CI 全绿）
- npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-browser-playwright

基于 @deepseek-ai/dsh-* 0.1.0-rc.2 ~ rc.6 开发，已实测兼容 rc.5 运行时。欢迎试用、提 issue。

discussions.title: BUG: 会话已是 danger-full-access 时，模型仍反复触发 `sandbox escalation to "..." is not strictly wider` 错误
discussions.body:
**环境**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / `dsh-sandbox` 0.1.0-rc.6, Windows, Web GUI (`dsh web`), provider `gptcodex` (model `gpt-5.6-luna`)
**类型**: 工具 schema 广告与模型行为叠加导致的重复报错（无安全问题，调用被 fail-closed 拒绝，未执行任何操作）

## 现象

会话文件策略为 `danger-full-access`（最高权限），且会话快照明确告知模型：

> Approval prompts are disabled in this session: actions that require approval are rejected automatically — do not request sandbox escalation (do not set `sandbox_permissions`).

但模型仍然在**普通的工作区内写文件调用**（write/edit/pwsh，目标都在 workspace 内）上主动附加 `sandbox_permissions` + `justification`，每一次都被拒绝：

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
```

实测统计（4 个 session.jsonl，全部来自同一次任务）：

会话 | 带 sandbox_permissions 的调用 | "not strictly wider" 错误 | 前置沙箱拒绝
-- | -- | -- | --
主会话 | 7（5× danger-full-access + 2× workspace-write） | 7 | 0
子代理 A | 4 | 3（另 1 次是 invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence） | 0
子代理 B | 3 | 3 | 0

关键事实：

1. **全程 0 次沙箱拒绝** —— 模型是投机性升级，没有任何合法触发条件。
2. 收到错误后模型**换枚举值重试**（danger-full-access → workspace-write → danger-full-access …），同一个文件反复产生相同错误，浪费大量 token，任务被卡住。
3. 子代理日志里模型的推理原文："写入工具将权限参数误判为升级请求"、"把已有的最高权限错误地当作'待升级权限'" —— 说明模型把 `sandbox_permissions` 理解成了"声明本次操作需要的权限模式"，而不是"请求升级"。

## 根因分析

1. **升级字段无条件广告**：只要组合挂载了沙箱后端，`dsh-tool-fs` / `dsh-tool-bash` / `dsh-tool-pwsh` 就永远在 schema 里公开 `sandbox_permissions`（enum 为全局常量 `ESCALATION_TARGETS = ["workspace-write", "danger-full-access"]`），与当前会话生效模式无关。会话已是 `danger-full-access`（梯子顶端、不存在更宽模式）时字段依然存在，模型无从得知"升级已无意义"。
2. **字段描述措辞诱导误用**：`"The wider sandbox mode this file operation needs. Only valid as a one-shot retry of an operation the sandbox just denied; requires justification and user approval."` 前半句 "the mode this operation needs" 读起来像权限声明，模型（至少 gpt-5.6-luna）会把它当成必填/常规字段在每次调用中附带。
3. **拒绝信息不含可用目标**：`approveEscalation` 的严格更宽检查（`WIDER_MODES`）在审批之前抛错，错误文本只说明"不是严格更宽"，没有列出当前模式**实际可升级到**哪些模式；升级提示 `escalationHintMarker` 也不带当前模式。模型只能盲试 enum 里的另一个值，形成重试循环。

discussions.title: [Bug][Web GUI] Failed subagents stay visible in the UI as if still running — non-terminal ready state, no way to clear them from the UI
discussions.body:
"## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 0.1.0-rc.6, Linux

## Symptom

A parent agent started background subagents that all failed. After they failed:

1. The Web UI kept showing those subagents **as if they were still running / active**. The user could not tell they had already failed ("为什么不清掉?……至少从 ui 上就不应该让我再看见了").
2. `list_agents` reported them as `[ready]` — defined as *exists only in storage, resumable, not terminal, not a result waiting to be collected*.
3. There is **no way to remove these failed subagent entries from the UI**. The only way they disappeared was manually deleting their session directories on disk (`~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/<session-id>/`).

This is the opposite side of the state-model problem already reported in #476 / #478 (ready sessions rendered as green "done"); here the same non-terminal entries are presented as if still running, with no clear action to dismiss them.

## Sanitized trajectory (from session event log)

```
2026-08-14T08:54:16Z  tool result : "started subagent A"            (background)
2026-08-14T08:54:23Z  notice     : "Background subagent A failed before it finished."
                                   "It left no closing message."
2026-08-14T08:55:54Z  tool result : "started subagent B"            (background)
2026-08-14T08:56:01Z  notice     : "Background subagent B failed before it finished."
                                   "It left no closing message."
2026-08-14T08:56:28Z  tool result : "Error: subagent run failed"    (sync probe, isError)
2026-08-14T08:58:58Z  tool result : "Error: subagent run failed"    (sync probe #2, isError)
-- list_agents afterwards: "subagent A [ready]", "subagent B [ready]"
-- UI: both still displayed as active; no dismiss/remove action available
-- only after deleting the on-disk session dirs did the UI entries disappear
```

## Expected

1. Failed/terminated subagents should show a clear **terminal/failed** state in the UI instead of looking active.
2. Provide a UI action to dismiss/remove terminated subagent records (analogous to clearing finished background jobs).

## Related

- #476 / #478 — same `ready` state model, rendered as green "completed"
- #1136 — the silent-fail root cause that produced these entries
"

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 下 taskkill 被拒绝时，工具超时/取消无法真正杀掉子进程——工具调用会一直挂起到命令自然结束
[Bug][Web GUI] Terminal background-job records cannot be deleted — job_list entries persist until process restart, no remove API
discussions.body:
"## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` 0.1.0-rc.6, Linux

## Symptom

1. Started two background bash jobs (`sleep 90` and `sleep 180`).
2. One finished naturally (`completed`), the other was cancelled (`killed`).
3. After that, **both records stay in the task list forever**:
   - `job_list` keeps returning both entries on every query.
   - The Web UI shows them with no delete/clear button.
   - The jobs service exposes only `start/list/get/read/kill/wait`; `job_kill` on a terminal job returns `already-finished` and does nothing. There is **no remove/delete API**.
4. The records exist **only in process memory** — a full search of `~/.dsh/` found no on-disk persistence for them. The only way to clear them is restarting the DSH process.

## Sanitized trajectory (from session event log)

```
2026-08-14T08:57:21Z  tool result : "started background job bash-1"   (sleep 90)
2026-08-14T08:59:05Z  tool result : "started background job bash-2"   (sleep 180)
2026-08-14T08:59:42Z  job_list    : "bash-1 [bash] completed — sleep 90; ..."
                                    "bash-2 [bash] running — sleep ..."
2026-08-14T08:59:46Z  tool result : "requested cancellation of job bash-2"
2026-08-14T08:59:52Z  job_list    : "bash-1 [bash] completed — ..."
                                    "bash-2 [bash] killed — ..."
-- subsequent job_list queries: both entries still present, unchanged
-- job_kill on bash-1/bash-2: "already-finished" (no-op)
-- no delete API exists; only a process restart clears the list
```

## Expected

1. Allow manually **clearing terminal job records** (completed / killed / failed) from the UI, or
2. Provide an automatic expiry/cleanup policy for terminal jobs, or
3. At minimum expose a delete API for terminal jobs.

## Related

- #757 — asks for quick-stop of *running* jobs (opposite direction: that request wants to end active jobs; this one wants to clear finished records)
- #511 — stuck tasks cannot be stopped/cleared
"

discussions.title: DSH-TMCRA：跨软件、跨会话继续项目，无需重新介绍
discussions.body: # DSH-TMCRA：跨软件、跨会话继续同一个项目 我们发布了 `dsh-tmcra-memory` 技术预览插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 TMCRA 长期记忆。 同一个项目可以在 DeepSeek Harness、Codex 等已经接入 TMCRA 的工具之间继续推进。换软件或打开新会话后，Agent 能先取得此前的项目要求、重要决定、实施进度、测试结论、遗留问题和下一步，用户无需重新介绍整个项目。 ## 它能做什么 - 自动召回同一项目在过去会话中积累的相关记忆； - 将用户长期背景与当前项目记忆分开管理，并行召回； - 在 Harness 与 Codex 等工具之间延续已经写入 TMCRA 的项目进度； - 将用户原始陈述与 Agent 回答分开写入，避免混淆是谁说过什么； - 保留软件、项目、会话、Agent、父会话和委派深度等来源信息； - 支持主 Agent 与子 Agent 共享项目记忆，同时保留各自身份； - 持续整理项目现状、决策过程、实施记录、测试结果、失败经验和后续行动； - 在 TMCRA 网页端查看、搜索和删除记忆，检查知识库与知识图谱，并查看服务端确认的用量。 ## 记忆如何延续 每一轮用户提问进入模型前，插件会并行召回两类信息： 1. 用户在不同项目中都适用的长期背景； 2. 当前项目已经积累的目标、要求、决定、进度与经验。 召回结果会在模型回答前写入可审计的 Harness 会话记录。回答成功完成后，用户提问与 Agent 结果会作为两条独立记录更新到 TMCRA。 Harness 接入与 TMCRA Codex 接入共用 `.tmcra/project.json` 和基于 Git 的项目识别规则。同一 TMCRA 账号、同一项目标识会使用同一份项目记忆；不相关的项目继续隔离。`session_id` 用于记录项目内部的会话来源，不会把同一项目切成互不相通的第三层记忆。 跨软件延续只覆盖已经写入 TMCRA 的记忆。两个接入端还需要登录同一 TMCRA 账号，并识别为同一个项目。 ## 账号连接 首次使用需要注册或登录 TMCRA 账号。插件通过带 PKCE 保护的设备授权流程完成连接，用户无需手工复制 API Key。插件取得的凭据只包含 `memory:read` 和 `memory:write` 权限，并由 Harness 的凭据存储管理。 发布初期，TMCRA 账号免费使用，暂不设置记忆写入与召回额度上限。政策如有调整会提前公告。 ## 安装 ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/reshuibuduo/dsh-tmcra-memory/releases/download/v0.1.1/dsh-tmcra-memory-0.1.1.tgz dsh plugin --profile web exec dsh-tmcra-memory login dsh --profile web --dump-config dsh web ``` 项目仓库：https://github.com/reshuibuduo/dsh-tmcra-memory 技术预览版：https://github.com/reshuibuduo/dsh-tmcra-memory/releases/tag/v0.1.1 TMCRA 官网：https://tmcra.com ## 已完成的生产验收 本轮使用 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` 与 TMCRA API `0.2.2` 完成验证： - 两个完整回合写成四条用户与 Agent 分角色记忆； - 第二个独立 Harness 会话成功召回用户保存的检查点与 Agent 已完成的进度； - 服务端账本记录两次写入事件，共 53 个估算写入 Token，并记录两次召回请求；第一次面向全新项目范围，按设计容错放行，第二次完成有效召回； - TMCRA 记忆处理链路记录 7,894 个模型 Token，已知模型 API 成本为 ¥0.00；回答端使用记录型测试适配器，没有消耗外部回答模型的 Token 或费用； - 验收结束后，两个一次性会话以及相关记忆、服务消息、索引指针和测试凭据均已清理。 ## 安全与故障处理 - 内容发送到 TMCRA 前会清理常见 API Key、Bearer Token、密码、私钥、验证码和带凭据的 URL； - 召回临时失败时默认容错放行，不阻断 Harness 回答； - 写入失败会保存在本地持久化待写队列，并在后续回合继续处理； - 用户可以在网页控制台撤销连接、检查或删除记忆，并查看项目与会话边界和用量归属。 ## 当前限制 - 当前只验证了 DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`，Harness 仍处于开发者预览阶段； - 暂时不会自动导入接入前的 Harness 历史对话； - Harness 暂未提供原生 TMCRA 设置面板，账号连接通过 CLI 引导和浏览器确认完成； - 当前安装产物为经过检查的 GitHub `.tgz`，尚未发布到 npm； - 大量长期会话在持续召回和上下文压缩条件下的表现仍需继续测试。 ## 技术交流与接入支持 安装、账号连接、版本兼容、自动召回、自动写入和跨软件延续方面的问题，可以加入 **TMCRA 接入技术支持群**。群内有 TMCRA 技术人员参与交流和问题排查。 当前二维码有效期至 **2026 年 8 月 21 日**。失效后会在同一位置更新新的入群二维码。 欢迎反馈安装过程、跨软件项目识别、自动召回与写入效果、多 Agent 来源追踪，以及长期项目中的实际使用体验。如果插件对你有帮助，也欢迎给仓库点一个 Star，方便关注后续兼容更新。

discussions.title: dsh-delayed-task：页面关闭后，Agent 仍会在约定时间回来
discussions.body:
我做了一个 DSH 持久化延时任务插件：让 Agent 在稍后真正回来，而不只是提醒你。

仓库：https://github.com/m-guo-2/dsh-delayed-task

它解决的是这类场景：Agent 现在无法得到最终结果，于是记录“为什么决定稍后再判断”；即使页面已经关闭、原会话已经变冷，到期后仍由 DSH 后台恢复原 session，注入一条客观的历史决策事件，让 Agent 根据最新证据重新决定是执行、结束，还是安排下一次检查。

### 一次真实 E2E

- 14:34：创建任务，要求 120 秒后检查 `README.md` 是否存在
- 随后关闭页面，原会话不再活跃
- 14:36：插件后台恢复原 session
- DeepSeek V4 Flash 在 `reassess-only` 模式下成功调用 `read` 和 `glob`
- Agent 确认文件存在并结束任务，结果写回原会话

另外也验证了 DSH 进程中断后的恢复：服务重新启动后，插件会扫描并补触发逾期任务。

### 授权设计

插件提供两种明确模式：

- `reassess-only`：只能使用 DSH 标记为 `read` 或 `search` 的观察型工具，不能执行副作用操作
- bounded grant：用户明确选择授权失效时间、精确工具 allowlist、最大调用次数，以及是否允许 Agent 继承授权再次排程

没有可交互 UI 时，授权请求会自动降级为 `reassess-only`，不会静默获得后台执行权限。插件也不会扩大或替代 DSH 原有 sandbox。

### 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:m-guo-2/dsh-delayed-task
```

当前状态：16 个自动化测试通过，GitHub CI 通过，并完成真实 DeepSeek E2E、冷会话恢复、服务重启补触发和官方 GitHub 安装验证。项目是社区插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方组件。

欢迎反馈两类问题：你最希望 Agent 延后重新判断什么场景？对于后台授权边界，还有哪些约束是你认为必须显式展示的？

---

**English:** `dsh-delayed-task` adds durable delayed decisions to DeepSeek Harness. It can resume a cold original session after the page is closed, inject an objective historical event, reassess current evidence, and either stop, act within an explicit bounded grant, or schedule another check.

discussions.title: [Feedback] Windows Codex CLI integration: fork patch and remaining upstream seams
discussions.body:
我在 Windows 的 DSH Web 场景中接入本机官方 Codex CLI / 模型，整理了一个可审查的 fork 提交，以及随后实际遇到的几个集成问题。这里不包含 API key、网关地址或会话内容。

## 可审查的 fork 提交

- 上游基线：`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`（当前 `master`）
- fork 分支：[`codex/fix-delegation-and-sandbox`](https://github.com/lyd123qw2008/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/fix-delegation-and-sandbox)
- 已推送提交：[`36f2d61fcb0daa15d094a837a581424ff4f5e1c1`](https://github.com/lyd123qw2008/deepseek-harness/commit/36f2d61fcb0daa15d094a837a581424ff4f5e1c1)（64 files，当前比上游多 1 commit）

该提交包含三组相关改动：

1. **子代理继承当前模型与 reasoning effort**：Web 会话明确选中了 `max` 时，in-process child 不应只复制 provider/model 而遗漏 effort；否则适配器可能回退并发送不被当前 Codex 模型接受的值。
2. **已被当前策略覆盖的沙箱字段应是 no-op**：当 session 已是 `workspace-write` 或 `danger-full-access`，模型附带相同或更窄的 `sandbox_permissions` 时，不应把它当作新的 escalation，也不应要求 `justification` 或触发 approval。
3. **Codex rollout 导入命令**：以显式 source-checkout command 将可表示的 Codex JSONL 历史转换为 DSH session；保留用户/助手文本、可识别工具调用与输出，跳过加密 reasoning、provider 请求状态和未知事件，而不是把外部日志直接复制进 DSH persistence。

## 实际遇到的问题与建议

### 1. 同一路由的辅助调用也必须继承选中的 reasoning effort

实际报错：

```text
OpenAI API error (400): {"code":"unsupported_value","message":"Unsupported value \"none\" for reasoning.effort on model \"gpt-5.6-luna\". Supported values are: low, medium, high, xhigh, max.","type":"invalid_request_error"}
```

除子代理外，direct compaction summarizer 也可能只带 provider/model 而遗漏当前 `max`。建议：只有汇总目标仍是同一 provider+model 时，继承持久化请求头中的显式 effort；目标不同则让目标路由自行选择默认值，不能把 `none` 或另一个模型的 effort 强行复制过去。

### 2. Codex 会在无需升级时仍携带 sandbox 字段

这与 [#1201](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1201) 的报告相同。实际出现过：

```text
sandbox escalation to danger-full-access is not strictly wider
invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence
```

在 `approval never` 且当前 mode 已覆盖目标的情况下，这些是继承/模型生成的冗余元数据，不是新的权限请求。建议在 shell/fs consumer 已解析 standing policy 后先判定“已覆盖的已知目标”，直接按原策略执行；未知模式或真正变宽的请求仍保留现有 fail-closed、justification 与 approval 路径。

### 3. 重试必须基于下游结构化 code/status，而不是英文文案

一次 Codex Gateway 流式失败只在 DSH UI 中落为：

```text
Our servers are currently overloaded. Please try again later.
PI_AI_ERROR
```

这会跳过 provider 配置的有界重试。pi-ai 0.82.1 的 Responses 路径实际可从 HTTP error 取到 status，也可从 SSE `error` / `response.failed` 取到如 `server_error` 的 code，但在生成 `AssistantMessage` 前把这些字段扁平为 `errorMessage`。因此下游语义在 DSH 重试层不可用。

建议在 pi-ai / DSH seam 中保留可选的 `errorCode` 与 `errorStatus`：先按 machine code（例如 `server_error` -> `SERVER`、`rate_limit_exceeded` -> `RATE_LIMIT`），再按 HTTP status 分类；仅对没有结构化字段的旧协议保留受限的文字兜底。这样不会因供应商调整英文提示而改变重试语义，也能补充 [#530](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/530) 所述的 `PI_AI_ERROR` 漏重试问题。

### 4. 官方 Codex CLI 的 native web search 与会话导入

当前 Web `web_search` 默认走 DeepSeek provider。为了明确使用本机已认证的 Codex CLI 内置搜索，我在一个 `codex` preset 中只暴露 `subagent_codex`，移除竞争性的 `web_search`，并在 persona 中要求研究任务走 native Codex search。这样不是把不同语义的 subagent 工具伪装成通用 search。

会话导入方面，已有社区插件（例如 [#1087](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1087)）覆盖更广场景；这里的实现刻意保持为 source-checkout 命令和严格的 DSH event 转换，不扩张 DSH persistence 格式。希望确认维护者更倾向于核心提供最小导入器、还是只保留插件扩展点。

## 希望的上游方向

如果这些方向可接受，我可以按可独立评审的范围拆成 PR：

1. 子代理与同路由 compaction 的 reasoning-effort 继承；
2. 已覆盖 sandbox escalation metadata 的 no-op 处理；
3. provider error code/status 透传与重试分类；
4. Codex preset 与最小会话导入器（若核心愿意接收）。

欢迎指出更合适的拆分、目标 package 或已有进行中的实现。

discussions.title: [Bug] 复制消息时出现多余换行符（视觉折行被误复制为 \n）
discussions.body:
## 环境
- 平台：DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
- 时间：2026-08-14

## 现象
界面里某段长文字显示为「一句话」（视觉上连续），但复制出来却在中间多出了换行符。

例如界面显示：
> 把浏览器标签页的本地分类规则从 ai.py 提取到 monitor.py，采样时立即分类

复制出来却变成：
```
把浏览器标签页的本地分类规则从 ai.py
 提取到 monitor.py
，采样时立即分类
```

## 根因分析
复制的换行位置，正好是长文本在消息容器内被 CSS 自动折行（word-wrap）的位置。

推测复制逻辑使用了 `innerText` 而非 `textContent`：
- `innerText` 会把 CSS 视觉折行的位置渲染成 `\n` 换行符
- `textContent` 保留原始文本，不含视觉折行

## 建议
复制消息时改用 `textContent`（或渲染前的原始纯文本），避免把视觉折行误复制为换行符。

discussions.title: NanoBananaPro + Seedance2 image and video plugins for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
We released two open-source DeepSeek Harness plugins for API-powered image and video generation:

- **dsh-nanobananapro** — image generation, video generation, task polling, balance checks, and account/setup help. [GitHub](https://github.com/synmindai/dsh-nanobananapro) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-nanobananapro)
- **dsh-seedance2** — image generation, Seedance video generation, task polling, and account/setup help. [GitHub](https://github.com/synmindai/dsh-seedance2) · [npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-seedance2)

Install either plugin into the Harness web profile:

```bash
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-nanobananapro
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-seedance2
```

Both v0.1.0 releases have CI coverage and were verified by installing from npm into clean Harness profiles. English and Chinese setup guides cover API keys, credits/recharge, supported tools, and safe task polling. Paid generation tools request explicit approval by default.

Feedback and compatibility reports are welcome.

discussions.title: [建议] 任务栏 todo 进度指示滞后于 agent 实际进度
discussions.body:
## 环境
- 平台：DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
- 时间：2026-08-14

## 现象
agent 连续执行多个子任务时，任务栏（todo 面板）的「进行中」指示停留在早期任务，而实际工作已推进到后面的任务。

具体某次 4 项任务的修复中：
- 17:15:02 面板显示「第 2 项 in_progress」
- 此后 agent 连续完成了第 2、3、4 项任务
- 直到 17:22:18 才一次性把 4 项全部标记 completed
- 中间约 7 分钟，面板的 in_progress 一直停留在「第 2 项」

## 日志证据（session.jsonl.zstd 中的 todo/write 事件）
```
17:15:02 (seq 104641): [completed, in_progress, pending, pending]
17:22:18 (seq 124469): [completed, completed, completed, completed]
```
中间没有任何 todo/write 事件。

## 根因分析
agent 在连续工作时，倾向跳过中间状态更新，攒到最后批量写入 todo。todo 面板被动显示 agent 最后一次 todo_write 的状态，导致进度指示与实际工作脱节。

## 建议
1. 在 system prompt 中约束 agent 在每个子任务边界更频繁地更新 todo 状态；
2. 或由 harness 在检测到 agent 连续执行多个工具调用时，自动推进 todo 的 in_progress 指针。

discussions.title: npm 全局安装后 dsh web 启动失败：node-pty 原生模块 pty.node 缺失
discussions.body:
Linux 上 npm 全局安装 dsh 后，dsh web 直接报错退出，原因是 node-pty 的原生模块 pty.node 不存在。

复现步骤：

1. Ubuntu 24.04，npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh（0.1.0-rc.5，npm 11.17.0），安装显示成功、无报错
2. 运行 dsh web
3. 启动即崩溃，报 Failed to load native module: pty.node
    实际结果：
    Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include):
    failed to import loader entry subprocess (@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local):
    Failed to load native module: pty.node, checked: build/Release, build/Debug, prebuilds/linux-x64:
    Error: Cannot find module './prebuilds/linux-x64//pty.node'
  
根因分析：

- dsh 依赖树中的 node-pty 为 1.1.0（2021 年发布）。其 npm 包内只打包了 darwin/win32 的预编译二进制，linux-x64 的预编译需安装时下载，而 Node 24（ABI 137）没有对应预编译产物，prebuilds/linux-x64/ 目录最终不存在。
- node-pty 的 install script 是 node scripts/prebuild.js || node-gyp rebuild，理论上会回退到源码编译，但编译在安装期间静默失败（机器上 g++ 13.3.0 / make / node-gyp 13.0.1 齐全，头文件缓存就绪后手动 npx node-gyp rebuild 一次成功，说明工具链本身可用，失败点在安装链路）。
- npm 对依赖的 install script 失败只警告不中断，导致安装"成功"但产物缺失，直到运行期才暴露。
    
预期结果：

- 干净环境下 npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh && dsh web 直接可用；或安装时显式失败/警告，提示需要编译工具链或 pty.node 构建失败，而不是静默产出不可运行的安装。

- dsh：0.1.0-rc.5

- 在无预编译依赖、工具链齐全的 Linux 干净环境执行全局安装，dsh web 能启动；或安装阶段即明确报错，不再静默成功。

discussions.title: [Security] Cross-session approval hijack in the dsh web gateway allows unauthenticated local code execution
discussions.body:
**Security disclosure — verified end-to-end against the default configuration on rc.5@47f943859b.**

This repo has no SECURITY.md, private vulnerability reporting is not enabled, and Issues are disabled, so per the README this report is posted as a discussion.

---

SUMMARY
The dsh Web gateway broadcasts every session's pending tool-approval and user-question
prompts over a global, unauthenticated WebSocket stream (`/api/events.mux`) and settles
them via `/api/respond` keyed only by `rpcId`, with no binding between the answerer and
the session owner. Any local process or page — or any LAN peer when the server is
exposed — can silently approve or reject another session's human-in-the-loop decisions.
Verified on the default configuration: an attacker answered a victim session's
`danger-full-access` sandbox escalation and the command executed on the host without the
victim human ever clicking.

VULNERABILITY DETAILS
The gateway (default `http://127.0.0.1:3080`) holds one process-wide pending-approval
table (`pendingApprovals`) and one global set of mux subscriber queues (`muxQueues`).

1) Global broadcast: every `approval/request` is pushed as an `approval/requested`
   server-request to ALL connected mux queues, and a new mux subscriber receives a
   replay of every session's still-pending approvals/questions.
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:3432-3447 (mux baseline + replay)
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1467-1484 (approval push loop)
   The stream is WebSocket-only (`/api/events.mux`; plain GET -> 426) and carries no
   parameters, token, or session-owner binding.
   - packages/client/connection/src/index.ts:146-152

2) Unbound answering: `/api/respond` routes by the echoed `rpcId` through
   `pendingApprovals` and validates only that the payload's `approvalId`/`sessionId`
   match the pending entry. The answer payload schema is exactly three fields
   (`sessionId`, `approvalId`, `outcome`), and the client-response envelope has no
   identity field. `respond` is not in `PRIVILEGED_METHODS`.
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:3696-3720
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/approvals.schema.ts:26-33
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc.schema.ts (clientResponseSchema)
   - packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/handler.ts:277-282
   - packages/client/connection/src/index.ts:89-126 (privileged-method list)

   The same `rpcId`-only routing also lets an attacker answer another session's
   `ask_user_question` prompts (api-proxy.ts:3717-3745).

REPRODUCTION (verified end-to-end on rc.5@47f943859b, real provider, default
`workspace-write` + `approval: ask`)
1. Victim session asks bash to write a file outside the workspace; the sandbox denies
   it and the model retries the same command with
   `sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access"` + `justification` (its sanctioned
   escalation path). An approval is suspended for the victim session.
2. Attacker (plain WebSocket + curl, no session/UI) receives the victim's frame:
   {"rpcId":"304d7b36-c552-42c0-b5b5-445d1e16e1cd","method":"approval/requested",
    "payload":{"type":"approval/requested",
               "sessionId":"session-f0ec9c08-1248-45c8-9252-be8dafaae877",
               "approvalId":"53469106-6520-4a13-9860-605fe3093793",
               "toolName":"bash","callId":"call_00_ubOxPeXMj9gwFQiQ10J82254",...}}
3. Attacker answers:
   curl -s -X POST http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/respond -H 'content-type: application/json' \
     -d '{"type":"client-response","rpcId":"304d7b36-...",
          "result":{"ok":true,"value":{"sessionId":"session-f0ec9c08-...",
            "approvalId":"53469106-...","outcome":"allowed-once"}}}'
   -> {"accepted":true}
4. Observed: mux broadcasts `approval/resolved`; victim audit shows
   `approval/asked` (seq 2635) -> `approval/decided` (seq 2636, allowed-once) with no
   human interaction; the bash call executes under `danger-full-access`
   (tool/result: PROBE, exit 0) and writes a workspace-external file
   (/Users/lihao/Documents/dsh-outside-workspace-probe.txt, cleaned up after test).
   A one-line variant with "outcome":"rejected" silently vetoes the victim's legitimate
   approvals; the first responder to settle an rpcId wins.

IMPACT
Unauthenticated local process (other user, malware, compromised same-origin page, or
LAN peer when the server is exposed with --host 0.0.0.0 and a matching Host) can grant
itself danger-full-access command execution on the dsh host through another user's
session, or veto that user's approvals, without consent and leaving only a forged audit
record. The same primitive hijacks ask_user_question prompts. This breaks the product's
stated human-in-the-loop approval contract across sessions.

AFFECTED VERSIONS
- Verified: 0.1.0-rc.5 (commit 47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a).
- Assumed: any version carrying the global mux broadcast and rpcId-only respond routing
  (rc.6 not available for verification).
- No SECURITY.md / published disclosure policy exists in the repo.

PATCHED VERSIONS
- None at the time of writing.

SEVERITY
- CVSS 3.1: AV:L/AC:L/PR:N/UI:N/S:U/C:H/I:H/A:H = 8.8 (High); AV:N (9.8) when exposed
  beyond loopback.
- CWE-862 (Missing Authorization). The trust fence is explicitly documented as "not an
  auth layer".

RELATIONSHIP TO PRIOR REPORTS
- #250 (agent self-answering its own approvals): cross-session path does not depend on
  the model and survives that fix.
- Fz0x00 G-5 (passive mux eavesdropping): shared root; new capability here is ACTIVE
  cross-session answering of approvals and questions.
- P16 (session.search lacks per-cwd authorization): related gap, different endpoint.

SUGGESTED FIX
1. Bind the answerer to the session owner (per-session downlink token issued at
   create/resume; /api/respond must prove it).
2. Scope approval/question frames to the owning session's own subscriptions only.
3. One-time nonce in approval/requested, echoed in respond.
4. Record the answering channel/identity in the audit trail.

REFERENCES
- packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:3432-3447, 1467-1484, 3696-3720, 3717-3745
- packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/approvals.schema.ts:26-33
- packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc.schema.ts (clientResponseSchema)
- packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/handler.ts:277-282
- packages/client/connection/src/index.ts:89-152
- packages/interaction/user-approval/src/index.ts:261-274

CREDITS
- Reporter: lihao (https://github.com/qinaigonghe)
- Discovery & verification: 2026-08-14, end-to-end on rc.5@47f943859b (macOS, real
  DeepSeek provider, default workspace-write + approval: ask).

TIMELINE
