discussions.body: ## 中文 我在 [NEXTINDIE/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code](https://github.com/NEXTINDIE/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code) 的基础上深度定制了一款 DeepSeek Harness 的 VS Code 客户端插件(fork 个人版),作为我的日常工具持续迭代中,部分改动也已作为 Pull Request 回馈上游。 **主要特性** - **对话标签页**:每个会话在编辑器区以独立标签页打开,可与代码文件随意切换;侧边栏变成带搜索框、按工作区分组(可展开/收起)的会话列表 - **实时任务面板**:输入框上方常驻任务摘要条(如「任务 1 进行中 · 2 待处理」),展开可见完整清单,已完成带对勾,与 Web 端一致 - **插话打断**:Ctrl+Enter(macOS 为 Cmd+Enter)立即打断当前回合插入新指令;排队消息带「插话发送」按钮 - **实时会话统计**:轮数/步骤/LLM 与工具耗时/首 token 延迟/tok·s/缓存命中/输入输出 token 常驻显示,每几秒刷新 - **与 Web 端完全双向同步**:对话历史、权限预设、模型与推理等级、工作区及其中的会话,两边改动即时互相同步 - **更流畅的流式输出**:渲染节流、流式光标、按帧滚动、消息动画(尊重系统减少动态效果设置) - **纯净线条图标 UI**:全仓库无 emoji,纯黑白线条 SVG,自动适配明暗主题 - **SCM 提交信息生成**:源代码管理面板一键让 DSH 根据 diff 生成提交信息 **安装**:从 [Releases 页面](https://github.com/foorgange/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code/releases) 下载最新 `.vsix`,在 VS Code 扩展面板右上角菜单选择「从 VSIX 安装」。 --- ## English I built a heavily customized VS Code extension for DeepSeek Harness on top of the [NEXTINDIE/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code](https://github.com/NEXTINDIE/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code) client. It is my daily driver and keeps evolving; some parts are contributed back as pull requests to the upstream repo. **Highlights** - **Conversations as editor tabs**: each session opens as its own tab in the editor area, switchable with code files; the sidebar becomes a searchable session list grouped by workspace (expand/collapse) - **Live task panel**: a persistent summary bar above the input (Tasks - 1 in progress - 2 pending) with an expandable checklist; completed items show a check mark, matching the web UI - **Steer / interrupt**: Ctrl+Enter (Cmd+Enter on macOS) interrupts the running turn immediately; queued messages get a dedicated Send-as-steer button - **Real-time session stats**: turns / steps / LLM & tool time / first-token latency / tok-per-sec / cache hit / token usage, refreshed every few seconds - **Full two-way sync with the web app**: history, permission presets, model & reasoning-effort switches, workspaces and their sessions stay in sync in both directions - **Smoother streaming**: throttled markdown rendering, blinking caret, per-frame scroll, subtle animations (all disabled under prefers-reduced-motion) - **Clean line-icon UI**: no emoji, pure monochrome SVG icons adapting to light/dark themes - **SCM commit-message generation**: a button in source control that lets DSH write your commit message from the diff **Install**: grab the latest `.vsix` from the [Releases page](https://github.com/foorgange/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code/releases), then Extensions -> ... -> Install from VSIX. **Links** - Fork repo: https://github.com/foorgange/DeepSeek-Harness-for-VS-Code - Upstream contributions: PR #3 (workspace sync), #4 (whale icon), #5 (editor tabs + session list), #6 (emoji-free UI) Feedback and ideas are welcome - the fork is my daily driver, so I keep iterating on it. ![Uploading 屏幕截图 2026-08-14 175802.png…]()

discussions.title: [BUG] 多个 dsh 实例并发写 workspace.json 导致非 ASCII 路径乱码、工作区会话列表消失
discussions.body:
「我让 dsh 在中文路径目录开两个实例，其中一个的 workspace.json 路径被写坏成乱码，重启后会话列表全空了——数据文件还在磁盘。」两个 dsh 实例同时运行时，含非 ASCII 路径的工作区在 $DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json 中被写坏成无效字节，重启后该工作区所有历史会话从 UI 消失。

<details> <summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>
复现步骤：

在含中文/非 ASCII 路径的目录（如 C:\用户\项目）启动 dsh web
保持该实例运行，再开第二个 dsh web 实例（同一 $DSH_HOME）
第二个实例写入 $DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json，工作区 path/title 变乱码
重启 dsh，该工作区的历史会话从会话列表消失（UI 像被清空）
实际结果： workspace.json 中工作区路径为无效 UTF-8 字节；UI 会话列表为空；数据文件（sessions/<workspace>/*.jsonl.zstd）仍在磁盘但无法通过 UI 访问。

预期结果：
a. 多实例对存储文件应有并发保护（锁/合并/最后写入者验证），不破坏现有条目
b. 非 ASCII 路径应始终以有效 UTF-8 读写
c. 路径损坏时应优雅降级（提示工作区无效/可修复），而非静默清空会话列表

环境： Windows 10 · Node v24.15.0 · dsh 0.1.0-rc.6

验收条件： 并发启动多个实例后，既有工作区的 path/title 保持有效；即使损坏也应给出可操作提示而非空列表。

</details>

discussions.title: 【建议】子代理没有继承当前对话模型配置，错误调用其它模型产生意外扣费
discussions.body:
## 问题现象
我配置了两组 API Key：
1. DeepSeek 官方 Key
2. OpenCode‑Go 的 Key
两个后端对应的模型都选择 deepseek‑v4‑flash。

在对话会话里，我手动选定使用 OpenCode‑Go 渠道的 deepseek‑v4‑flash，调用子代理进行代码审查。
实际运行子代理的时候，没有沿用当前会话选择的 OpenCode‑Go 配置，错误使用了 DeepSeek 官方的 Key，造成非预期扣费。

## 使用场景
同一个模型，对接多个不同服务商/中转渠道，希望子代理完全继承当前对话所使用的后端、密钥、模型参数，而不是回退到默认的官方配置。

## 期望行为
子代理启动时，完整继承父对话的：
- API Key / 后端渠道
- 当前选用模型
- 温度、上下文等参数

而不是回退使用全局默认或者第一个配置的密钥。

discussions.title: [Idea] Import sessions & agents from pi / opencode / codex / claude-code into dsh — worth making this official?
discussions.body:
Hi maintainers & community,

I've been using dsh alongside pi (pi-coding-agent), opencode, codex and claude-code, and built a plugin that imports their sessions, chat history, and agents into dsh. It works well for my workflow, and I'd like to ask whether this is a feature the project wants to own — as a first-party plugin or built-in — or whether it's better left as a community extension.

**What it does**

- **Session import** — parses pi JSONL session files, the opencode SQLite store, codex rollout JSONL, and claude-code JSONL into real dsh sessions, written in the exact on-disk format the dsh JSONL persistence backend uses (checksummed zstd frames, project-dir encoding). Round-trip verified with the backend's own `list` / `load` / `prepare`.
- **Resumable** — imported sessions appear in the dsh session list and can be resumed: the model continues with the complete history (text, reasoning, tool calls) as context. Tool calls become `tool-call` content blocks paired with `tool/call` + placeholder `tool/result` events so OpenAI-compatible APIs accept resumed requests (no orphaned `tool_calls`).
- **Agents → skills** — pi agents / mode prompts and opencode agents become discoverable dsh skills under `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills`, with `metadata.source` / `metadata.kind` in the frontmatter.
- **Workspace placement** — imported sessions attach to a workspace matching their original `cwd` (created on demand) instead of piling up ungrouped.
- **Plugin UX** — slash commands (`/import-pi`, `/import-opencode`, `/import-agents`, `/import-all`, `/attach-workspaces`), a session-start migration prompt (asks once per project, remembered in `$DSH_HOME` state), and a one-click **Sync** button in the composer tool row.
- **Idempotent, zero runtime deps** — stable ids (`pi-<uuid>`, `oc-<id>`, `codex-<id>`, `claude-<id>`); re-imports skip what already exists. Only Node built-ins (`node:zlib` zstd, `node:sqlite`) + dsh platform modules.

**Where it lives**

- Repo: https://github.com/Chang-Tong/dsh-import-agents (MIT)
- npm: `pnpm add dsh-import-agents` (v0.2.1)
- Enable: append one row to `cordis.patch.yml`, restart `dsh web`.

**The question**

Is cross-tool migration in scope for dsh? Specifically:

1. Would you like this as a **first-party plugin / built-in**, or is community extension the right home?
2. What would it take to be acceptable upstream — storage-contract stability, tests against the real backend (already have `verify.mts` + `plugin-test.mts`), docs, naming?
3. Which sources matter most to you (pi / opencode / codex / claude-code)?

I'm happy to contribute the code directly if there's interest. 🙏

discussions.title: 做了一个可验证的 DeepSeek / DSH Skills 目录
discussions.body:
最近 Agent Skills 仓库涨得很快，`awesome-*` 也很多。纯链接目录很容易变成“能找到，但不知道还能不能装”。我先做了一个很小的 DSH 版本：

https://github.com/Whning0513/awesome-deepseek-skills

现在只有 8 条，没有先爬几千个仓库。每条记录都固定到具体 commit，并保存：

- `SKILL.md` 的实际路径和许可证位置；
- Agent Skills 参考解析器、`skill-validator v1.6.0` 和 DSH profile 的静态报告；
- 是否联网、执行命令、写 workspace / 外部状态的提示；
- 检查时留下的 warning。warning 不会被目录包装成“全绿”。

可以直接装固定版本，默认放到 DSH 能发现的共享目录：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/Whning0513/awesome-deepseek-skills.git
cd awesome-deepseek-skills
uv sync --locked
uv run python scripts/catalog.py install \
  obra/superpowers/verification-before-completion \
  --target /path/to/project/.agents/skills
```

安装器遇到同名目录会拒绝覆盖，也会拒绝带符号链接的 Skill；来源会写进 `.deepseek-skills.lock.json`。它不会执行第三方脚本。

另外拆了一个很小的专项检查器：https://github.com/Whning0513/deepseek-skill-doctor 。通用格式、链接、token 这些还是交给现有工具，它只补 DSH 的单层发现、description 路由、`allowed-tools` 不被 filesystem provider 执行，以及 DeepSeek `reasoning_content` / thinking 相关的几条坑。

这不是安全审计，也不会声称静态通过就代表效果好。更希望有人提交“在 DSH 里实际加载过”的小 Skill；新项目可以收，但会如实标成 `new`。

discussions.title: ⚒️ 铸剑炉 Forge 插件：12 个工具开箱即用（真计算 gate + 中医诊断）
discussions.body:
大家好，我为 DeepSeek Harness 开发了一组插件 **forge-plugins**，12 个工具一条命令开箱即用：

```
dsh plugin add https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/releases/download/v0.1.0/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins-0.1.0.tgz
```

包含 3 个插件、12 个工具：

**1️⃣ forge-gates（6 工具）— 真计算不幻觉的 gate 门**
- `forge_math`：符号数学化简/求值（真计算，不是 LLM 猜的）
- `forge_logic`：一阶逻辑可满足性判定（Z3 风格）
- `forge_regex`：正则 fullmatch 语义验证
- `forge_eprover`：TPTP 一阶逻辑定理证明
- `forge_system`：状态机建模/不变量验证
- `forge_repair`：代码修复建议（静态分析）

**2️⃣ forge-memory（4 工具）— BM25 经验召回 + 折叠索引**
- `memory_recall` / `memory_fold_list` / `memory_fold_preview` / `memory_fold_deep`

**3️⃣ forge-tcm（2 工具）— 唯一的中医插件 🀄**
- `tcm_diagnose`：八极八势辨证诊断（向量化）
- `tcm_herb_pair`：古籍药对检索（附子+干姜 → 916 首方剂）

**示例**：
- 数学：`3*(x+1)-3*x` → 化简 → `3` ✅ 真计算
- 逻辑：`prove: x>0 ∧ x<10 ⊢ x>0` → `proved` ✅
- 正则：`[A-Z]\d{3}` 对 `B456` 匹配、对 `order B456 ok` 不匹配（fullmatch 语义）

**仓库**：https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins
- MIT 协议 / 零 npm 依赖 / Windows 预编译 exe（Release 里 8 个）+ 跨平台 go build 一行编译
- 数据说明：中医古籍方剂库为家传私有数据，不随仓库分发（官方数据红线），插件支持自带数据

感谢 DeepSeek Harness 开源！"Everything is a Plugin" 的理念太棒了，期待正式版！

discussions.title: dsh-import-agents: bring pi / opencode / codex / claude-code history & agents into dsh
discussions.body:
Sharing a plugin I built: **dsh-import-agents** — import sessions, chat history, and agents from **pi (pi-coding-agent)**, **opencode**, **codex**, and **claude-code** into DeepSeek Harness (dsh).

## Why

I work across several coding agents. dsh is where I want my history to live, but past conversations were scattered across pi / opencode / codex / claude-code JSONL files and an opencode SQLite DB. This plugin pulls them all in:

- Imported sessions become **real dsh sessions** (written in the exact on-disk format the dsh JSONL persistence backend uses, checksummed zstd frames) — they appear in the session list, are fully browsable, and can be **resumed**: the model continues with the complete history (text, reasoning, tool calls) as context.
- pi agents / mode prompts and opencode agents become **discoverable dsh skills** under `$DSH_AGENTS_HOME/skills`, with `metadata.source` / `metadata.kind` in the frontmatter.
- Imported sessions attach to a workspace matching their original `cwd` instead of piling up ungrouped.

## In the GUI

- **Sync button** — a one-click button in the composer tool row runs the full import (`/import-all`) and shows the result inline.
- **Migration prompt** — when a new top-level session starts, it asks once (per project) whether to migrate pending sessions/agents; decisions are remembered, so it never nags twice.
- **Slash commands** — `/import-pi`, `/import-opencode`, `/import-agents`, `/import-all`, `/attach-workspaces`, with options like `--limit N`, `--project <substr>`, `--since`, `--no-tools`.

## Install

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-import-agents
# append to cordis.patch.yml:
#   - insert:
#       - id: import-pi-opencode
#         name: dsh-import-agents
```

Restart `dsh web`, refresh the page — the Sync button appears in the composer tool row. That's it.

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/Chang-Tong/dsh-import-agents (MIT, zero runtime deps — only Node built-ins + dsh platform modules)
- npm: `dsh-import-agents` v0.2.1
- 中文文档: https://github.com/Chang-Tong/dsh-import-agents/blob/main/README.zh.md

Verified against the real dsh backend (`list` / `load` / `prepare` round-trip), idempotent re-imports with stable ids (`pi-<uuid>`, `oc-<id>`, `codex-<id>`, `claude-<id>`).

Feedback welcome — especially if you also hop between multiple coding agents 😄

discussions.title: DSH Trust Layer: four privacy-minimal observability plugins
discussions.body:
我做了四个可以独立安装的社区插件，尝试回答一个问题：**怎样让 DeepSeek Harness 的运行过程更容易检查，同时避免把提示词、工具参数和结果正文复制进另一个日志系统？**

> 这是社区项目，不是 DeepSeek 官方插件或安全认证。

![DSH Trust Layer preview](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/030611/dsh-verification-receipt/main/docs/social-preview.jpg)

### 四个独立插件

- [`dsh-telemetry-redactor`](https://github.com/030611/dsh-telemetry-redactor)：在已配置遥测后端收到导出副本前，对受支持的凭证模式脱敏；不改写规范会话日志，也不承诺识别任意未知秘密格式。
- [`dsh-verification-receipt`](https://github.com/030611/dsh-verification-receipt)：每轮写入工具计数和词法层面的形似验证信号；不保存 prompt、工具参数或结果正文，也不证明测试真的运行或代码正确。
- [`qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit`](https://github.com/030611/qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit)：写入本地哈希链 evidence receipts，用于发现部分编辑、删除和重排；它不是数字签名、可信时间戳或密码学认证。
- [`dsh-context-provenance`](https://github.com/030611/dsh-context-provenance)：把公开运行时接口能够支持的结论明确标成 `Observed`、`Estimated` 或 `Unavailable`；不返回提示词正文、消息内容、工具 schema 或原始路径。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-telemetry-redactor
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-verification-receipt
dsh plugin --profile web add qiushi-dsh-evidence-audit
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-context-provenance
```

四个包都已发布 npm `v0.1.0`，各仓库提供边界说明、测试与可复现的发布检查。它们可以单独使用，不要求一次安装整套。

我特别希望得到三类反馈：

1. 在不同 DSH profile / rc 版本上的实际安装结果；
2. verification heuristic 的误报或漏报样例；
3. telemetry / evidence 字段边界是否符合真实部署需求。

---

**English summary:** Four independently installable, community-maintained DSH plugins for privacy-minimal runtime observability: outbound telemetry-copy redaction, heuristic per-turn verification summaries, local hash-chained evidence receipts, and strictly labeled context provenance. They do not prove semantic correctness, provide signatures, or expose hidden prompts. Real compatibility reports and boundary-focused feedback are welcome.

Development and documentation were assisted by OpenAI Codex. The repositories disclose concrete test coverage and limitations; claims above were checked against their public manifests, source, and released `v0.1.0` packages.

discussions.title: Subagent header should display the effective delegated role instead of the inherited capability preset
discussions.body: ## Summary A native subagent can correctly inherit its parent's composition, tools, guards, sandbox, and approval boundary while running with a different delegated persona. The Web header currently renders only the session's inherited `agentPreset`. This makes a delegated Orchestrator or Project Research child appear to still be an Architect. Example: ```text capability preset: agent-architect effective role: agent-orchestrator nested role: agent-project-research ``` The breadcrumb correctly shows: ```text orchestrator / project-research ``` But the header badge shows: ```text 🏗️ Architect ``` ## Environment - DeepSeek Harness: `0.1.0-rc.6` - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset`: `0.1.0-rc.6` - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`: `0.1.0-rc.6` - `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`: `0.1.0-rc.6` - Web UI: `http://127.0.0.1:3080` - OS: Windows - User presets: `%USERPROFILE%\.dsh\.agent-presets` ## Reproduction 1. Start a root session using `agent-architect`. 2. Start a native child that inherits the parent's composition but applies the `agent-orchestrator` persona. 3. Give the child the durable label `orchestrator`. 4. Open the child session. 5. Optionally delegate again with the Project Research persona and label `project-research`. Observed session data: ```text agentPreset = agent-architect projectionValues.subagent.label = orchestrator ``` Nested child: ```text agentPreset = agent-architect projectionValues.subagent.label = project-research ``` ## Actual behavior ```text orchestrator [🏗️ Architect] orchestrator / project-research [🏗️ Architect] ``` The breadcrumb and header communicate different identities. ## Expected behavior The header should show one badge containing the effective delegated role and the same native preset icon used by the new-session preset selector: ```text [IconAgentPresetOutline16] 🧭 Orchestrator [IconAgentPresetOutline16] 🔎 Project Research ``` Simplified Chinese: ```text [IconAgentPresetOutline16] 🧭 协调器 [IconAgentPresetOutline16] 🔎 项目研究 ``` The header should not display a second visible capability badge such as: ```text Capabilities: Architect 能力：架构师 ``` The inherited capability preset may remain available in a tooltip or accessibility description. Root sessions and same-role children should continue to show their normal single preset badge. ## Why this matters The inherited `agentPreset` and the effective delegated role describe different facts: - `agentPreset`: composition and capability boundary - delegated role/persona: behavioral identity for the current child Capability inheritance is desirable and must remain unchanged. Mounting the target preset into the child would risk widening its capabilities and is not an acceptable UI fix. The problem is that the header currently uses `agentPreset` as both the capability identity and the visible role identity. ## Current implementation evidence `AgentPresetLabel` in: ```text @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-agent-preset/lib/client.js ``` reads only: ```js state.byId[sessionId]?.agentPreset ``` The current subagent projection exposes: ```ts type SubagentIdentityProjection = { mode: 'one-shot' | 'continuable' label?: string seq: number } ``` A free-form `label` is not guaranteed to be a role ID, so the UI should not universally infer a preset from every label. ## Suggested upstream design Add optional, explicit, immutable delegated-role metadata to the native subagent descriptor. For example: ```ts interface SubagentDescriptor { mode: 'one-shot' | 'continuable' label?: string /** * Persona identity used for display only. * It must not mount or grant the referenced preset. */ personaPresetId?: string } ``` Flow the field through: ```text SubagentStartRequest → subagent/descriptor event → SubagentIdentityProjection → session list/history API → client SessionSummary → AgentPresetLabel ``` The existing `agentPreset` should retain its current meaning as the composition supplying tools, guards, services, and restrictions. `personaPresetId` should be presentation metadata only. ## Rendering rules | Condition | Visible header | |---|---| | Root session | Native preset icon + `agentPreset` display name | | No explicit role metadata | Native preset icon + `agentPreset` display name | | Role equals capability preset | Native preset icon + one role name | | Role differs from capability preset | Native preset icon + effective role name | | Arbitrary free-form label only | Preserve current preset display; do not guess | The inherited capability preset may be included in the badge tooltip: ```text Effective role: Orchestrator · capability preset: Architect ``` ## Security requirements The delegated-role metadata must not: - mount the referenced role preset; - expand the child's tool catalog; - replace inherited guards; - change sandbox or approval policy; - alter composition ancestry; - change session authorization. The child must continue to inherit the exact parent composition. ## Acceptance criteria - [ ] Root sessions render one native preset icon and one preset name. - [ ] Cross-role children render one native preset icon and the effective role name. - [ ] Nested children render their current effective role. - [ ] No second visible “Capabilities” badge is added. - [ ] The inherited capability source is available in a tooltip or accessibility description. - [ ] Arbitrary free-form labels are not interpreted as preset IDs. - [ ] The role identity survives persistence, reload, and cold history reads. - [ ] Existing descriptors remain backward compatible. - [ ] Adding role metadata cannot widen child capabilities. - [ ] English and Simplified Chinese behavior is covered. - [ ] Tests cover root, same-role, cross-role, nested, missing-role, and arbitrary-label cases. ## Temporary local workaround A local UI patch can map a label only when the corresponding preset exists: ```js const roleLabel = summary.projectionValues?.subagent?.label const roleOption = roleLabel ? presetOptions.find((entry) => entry.id === `agent-${roleLabel}`) : undefined ``` When a matching role exists, render one badge: ```jsx {roleName} ``` This confirms the desired presentation but is not a robust upstream contract because labels can be arbitrary. Explicit descriptor metadata is preferable. ## Screenshots Attach screenshots showing: 1. the breadcrumb displaying `orchestrator` while the header displays Architect; 2. a nested `project-research` child still displaying Architect; 3. the desired native icon and single effective-role label from the new-session preset selector. Suggested caption: > The breadcrumb identifies the delegated role, while the header incorrectly identifies only the inherited capability preset. The expected header is one native preset icon followed by the effective delegated role.

discussions.title: Forge Plugins for dsh: 12 gates (real computation, no hallucination) + the first TCM plugin
discussions.body:
## ⚒️ Forge Plugins — 铸剑炉插件集

A plugin bundle that brings the **Forge** (铸剑炉) tool gates into DeepSeek Harness. 12 tools, zero npm dependencies, all local execution.

### What's inside (3 plugins / 12 tools)

| Plugin | Tools | What it does |
|---|---|---|
| **dsh-forge-gates** | 6 | **Real computation, no hallucination**: `forge_math` (symbolic simplification, e.g. `3*(x+1)-3*x → 3`), `forge_logic` (formal proof / equivalence check via z3), `forge_regex` (fullmatch validation), `forge_eprover` (first-order logic theorem proving), `forge_system` (state-machine invariant checking), `forge_repair` (code fix suggestions) |
| **dsh-forge-memory** | 4 | Experience recall via BM25 + folded-index browsing (list/preview/deep) |
| **dsh-forge-tcm** | 2 | **The first Traditional Chinese Medicine plugin**: 八极八势 (eight-pole eight-potential) diagnosis + 古籍药对检索 (herb-pair search across 11,289 classical formulas) |

### Install (one command)

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/releases/download/v0.1.0/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins-0.1.0.tgz
```

Windows prebuilt exe included — works out of the box. Cross-platform build from Go source also documented in the repo.

### Why gates?

LLMs are great at language but can hallucinate math/logic. These gates shell out to real engines (Go, z3, Eprover) and return *verified* results — so your agent can **prove** things instead of guessing.

### Repo
https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins · MIT · `dsh-plugin` topic

Feedback welcome! 🙏

discussions.title: Proposal: headless driver protocol (--session-id / --model / --mode / --jsonl)
discussions.body:
## Proposal: headless driver protocol (`--session-id` / `--model` / `--mode` / `--jsonl`)

### Summary

Proposing a small extension to the `headless` bundle so external tools can drive dsh as a real agent backend: an explicit session id (create-or-resume), per-run model / permission-mode overrides, and a JSONL event stream with an interactive approval channel.

Motivation: I integrated dsh into [cc-connect](https://github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect) (a bridge that exposes AI coding agents over Feishu/Telegram/etc.) — see [chenhg5/cc-connect#1682](https://github.com/chenhg5/cc-connect/pull/1682). The headless profile is the natural entry point, but the one-shot runner currently:

- creates a fresh random session every run (no way to keep a conversation across runs),
- prints only the final text (no streaming text/thinking/tool events),
- has no interactive approval channel (approvals fail closed),
- and cannot override the default model or permission mode per run.

The patch below adds exactly those four flags to `packages/bundle/headless` (runner + startup + bundle config + tests):

- **`--session-id <id>`** — resume the persisted session when it exists, otherwise create it with that exact id (create-once, resume-always), so an external driver can keep one conversation across runs.
- **`--model <model>`** — override the default model selection for this run.
- **`--mode <mode>`** — pin the session's sandbox/approval knobs (`read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access` / `confirm`).
- **`--jsonl`** — stream machine-readable events on stdout (`text` / `thinking` deltas, `tool/call`, `tool/result`, `approval/request`, `result`, `done`) and read approval responses (`{"type":"approval/response","id":...,"outcome":"allowed-once"|"rejected"}`) from stdin. In `confirm` mode it also intercepts write/execute tools (`write`, `edit`, `str_replace_editor`, `bash`, `pwsh`, `terminal_send`) and asks the human first — the headless counterpart of a client-side confirm-writes plugin.

The runner registers one terminal answerer on the scoped `approval/request` waterfall and relays each request to the driver, blocking until the driver answers on stdin. Without `--jsonl` the behavior is unchanged (final text on stdout, exit code mapping).

### Full patch

[gist: headless-cc-connect.patch](https://gist.github.com/baizhu945/57c649c14fda591b8b8f23345e33eb4c) — modifies:

- `packages/bundle/headless/src/startup.ts` — parse the four flags
- `packages/bundle/headless/src/index.ts` — create-or-resume, model/mode overrides, JSONL streaming, approval answerer + stdin reader, confirm-mode ask interception
- `packages/bundle/headless/cordis.patch.yml` — wire the new runner config fields
- `packages/bundle/headless/tests/headless.spec.ts` — regression + new tests (13 headless tests pass; full host `tsc -b` clean)

### Verification

- `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` clean; `vitest run packages/bundle/headless/tests/` 17/17 pass
- End-to-end against the built CLI: approval → tool executes; rejection → `Error: the user rejected tool "write"` and the file is **not** created
- Multi-turn resume + `--jsonl` + `--mode confirm` verified

### Questions for the team

1. Is a headless "driver protocol" direction you'd be interested in? If so I'm happy to iterate on naming/schema (e.g. JSONL event shapes, session-id semantics) and prepare a proper PR-compatible change set.
2. Any preference on the wire protocol (e.g. JSONL vs NDJSON envelope with a version field)?
3. Should the confirm-mode ask list be configurable through the bundle config instead of hard-coded in the runner?

discussions.title: 无法按照“提供商/模型”作为subagent去调用
discussions.body:
# 希望 subagent 支持按调用动态选择 provider 和 model

## 事情经过

我在 DSH 的 `settings.yaml` 中配置了多个 LLM provider 和模型，例如：

- Herbivore API / `gpt-5.6-luna`
- 小鸡毛（`xjm`）/ `deepseek-v4-flash`
- 未来还会继续增加其他 provider 和模型

最开始我希望在对话中直接说明：

> 使用小鸡毛的 deepseek-v4-flash 模型完成这个任务。

然后让当前 Agent 通过 subagent 调用对应的模型。

排查后发现，当前 `dsh-tool-subagent` 的模型配置主要通过 preset 中的 `agentOptions` 固定：

```yaml
agentOptions:
  provider: xjm
  model: deepseek-v4-flash
```

如果不配置 agentOptions，spawn 类型的子 Agent 通常会继承父 Agent 当前使用的模型。因此，同一个普通 subagent 工具无法在不同调用之间动态切换 provider 和 model。

DSH 的底层 subagent runtime 实际上已经支持传入不同的 provider 和 model。另外，workflow 工具中的 agent() 也支持按调用指定模型，但它需要生成 JavaScript 工作流脚本，主要面向大型多 Agent 编排，不适合普通的一次性 subagent 委派。

## 当前问题

目前需要为不同 provider/model 配置不同的 subagent 工具，或者修改 preset 配置，无法只通过自然语言在每次调用时选择模型。

## 期望效果

希望普通 subagent 支持按调用动态指定 provider 和 model。
例如用户只需要在提示词中说明：使用小鸡毛的 deepseek-v4-flash 分析当前代码。
当前 Agent 就能够将这次 subagent 调用路由到：
```text
provider: xjm
model: deepseek-v4-flash
```

如果没有指定 provider/model，则保持现有行为，继续继承父 Agent 的模型。

discussions.body:
Hi everyone! 👋

We built **Forge plugins** for DeepSeek Harness — a bundle of 12 tools that turn the agent into a *real computation* machine (not just text). Install with one command from GitHub Release:

```bash
dsh plugin add https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins/releases/download/v0.1.0/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins-0.1.0.tgz
```

## What's inside (3 plugins, 12 tools)

**⚙️ forge-gates** — 6 Go-compiled gates (zero npm deps):
- `forge_math` — symbolic math: `3*(x+1)-3*x` → `3` (no hallucinations)
- `forge_logic` — prove / equivalence checks: `x>0 ∧ x<10 ⊢ x>0` → proved
- `forge_regex` — fullmatch regex validation with positive/negative cases
- `forge_eprover` — first-order logic theorem proving (TPTP)
- `forge_system` — state-machine invariant checking (deadlock detection)
- `forge_repair` — bug pattern diagnosis → concrete code fixes

**🧠 forge-memory** — BM25 experience recall + fold/unfold index (read-only, list/preview/deep)

**🏥 forge-tcm** — Traditional Chinese Medicine (the only TCM plugin in the ecosystem):
- `tcm_diagnose` — eight-axes / eight-tendencies dialectical diagnosis
- `tcm_herb_pair` — herb-pair lookup across 916 formulas with source/composition/efficacy

## Why it matters

- **Real compute, not tokens**: gates are Go binaries with prebuilt Windows exe (sources included for cross-platform build)
- **Zero npm dependencies** — no supply-chain surface
- Verified end-to-end: config tree + all 12 tools registered via `dsh plugin add`

Repo: https://github.com/jinguanghai/deepseek-harness-forge-plugins
Docs in README (EN/中文). PR to awesome-dsh-plugin: https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/162

Thanks for building dsh — *everything is a plugin*! ⚒️

discussions.title: dsh-agent-memory:给 DSH 装上跨会话长期记忆
discussions.body:
## 这是什么

dsh-agent-memory 是 DeepSeek Harness(DSH)的跨会话长期记忆插件:会话之间沉淀的知识(用户偏好、已定决策、踩坑教训)自动保存,新会话开局就能用上。零依赖、无 MCP、无向量库、无 embedding API。

- **npm**:https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-agent-memory(`npm i dsh-agent-memory`)
- **源码**:https://github.com/Culeot/dsh-agent-memory(MIT)

## 核心特性

- **跨会话持久**:A 会话写入,B 会话开局即可检索;数据存 `$DSH_HOME/storages/memory.json`,纯 JSON 可查看、可进 git。
- **按需注入**:每轮模型执行前,通过 DSH 的 `agent/pre-step` 钩子按当前消息检索最相关记忆,注入最多 3 条短摘要;检索结果不变时跳过注入,不重复刷屏。
- **自我纠错闭环**:同一错误重复出现 2 次,提示固化为 importance=3 的教训,自动注入防止再犯;用户纠正当场固化。
- **中文友好检索**:中文 bigram + 单字兜底,英文按词,整串匹配,无需分词库。
- **原生接入**:复用 `ctx.storageDomain`(schema 校验、原子写、事件)、`ctx.tools.register`、`agent.inject()`,与官方插件同构。
- **治理四件套**:容量淘汰(默认 400 条)、近重复合并(Jaccard 0.7)、TTL 过期、importance=3 删除需确认。
- **外部修改防护**:写入前校验文件指纹,外部改动不会静默覆盖;`memory_import` 走写链批量导入,`memory_reload` 从磁盘重开合并。

## 工具

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `memory_remember` | 写入记忆(含 TTL) |
| `memory_recall` | 检索,按相关性×重要性×新鲜度排序 |
| `memory_index` | 浏览清单,kind/tag/scope 过滤 |
| `memory_forget` | 按 id/tags 删除 |
| `memory_import` | JSONL/JSON 批量导入 |
| `memory_reload` | 外部修改后重开合并 |

## 安装

```bash
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/<名字>
pnpm add dsh-agent-memory
```

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<preset>/agent.cordis.yml
- id: memory
  name: 'dsh-agent-memory'
```

重启 DSH,新会话出现 6 个 `memory_*` 工具。前置条件:profile 已挂存储三件套(`dsh-storage`、`dsh-storage-json`、`dsh-storage-domain`——web profile 自带)。

## 质量

45 个单元测试全绿;真机(headless)冒烟通过;检索 top-1 命中 100%(9/9);400 条写入 45ms、召回 3ms。

## 提案

DSH 目前记忆能力是"文件型"(storage domain、session-query-sqlite、agent-instructions),动态记忆无处安放。本插件把这块补齐,建议官方纳入 packages/memory/*,欢迎以任何形式并入官方仓库。

discussions.title: [Bug] plugin install reports success but silently disables an unresolved profile bundle
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a profile dependency is declared in `package.json` but missing from `node_modules` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`, `dsh plugin --profile web install` can report success without restoring it. DSH then silently removes the unresolved package from `dsh.profile.bundles`, leaving the profile in a misleading and inconsistent state.

## Environment

- Windows 11
- Node.js v24.13.0
- pnpm v11.0.8
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- Profile: `web`

## Reproduction

1. The profile manifest contains the package in both dependencies and bundles:

```json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all": "0.1.12"
  },
  "dsh": {
    "profile": {
      "bundles": ["@linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all"]
    }
  }
}
```

2. The package is absent from `node_modules` and `pnpm-lock.yaml`.
3. Run `dsh web`. It fails with `dsh: cannot resolve profile bundle "@linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all"`.
4. Run `dsh plugin --profile web install`.
5. The command prints `Already up to date` and exits successfully, but the package is still missing. DSH also removes it from `dsh.profile.bundles` while leaving it in `dependencies`.
6. Explicitly running `dsh plugin --profile web add @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all@0.1.12` repairs the profile.

## Expected behavior

After the package-manager command succeeds, DSH should verify that every declared profile dependency and enabled bundle is actually resolvable.

If validation fails, the command should:

- exit with a non-zero status;
- report which bundle is unresolved;
- preserve the original bundle list instead of silently disabling it;
- ideally roll back partial manifest/lockfile changes.

A regression test for a manifest/lockfile/node_modules mismatch would help prevent this from recurring.

## Additional note

This appears distinct from discussion #1032, which concerns a missing runtime dependency in a published DSH package. This report concerns profile reconciliation reporting success and mutating the enabled bundle list when the declared dependency is unresolved.

discussions.title: [Idea] 图片上传被模型目录能力硬性拦截：主模型无视觉模态时也应允许附件（以链接/路径交给工具处理，类似 opencode 做法）
discussions.body:
## 背景

我是 [dsh-koboldcpp-hands](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-koboldcpp-hands) 插件的作者。该插件为 dsh 提供 koboldcpp_run / koboldcpp_vision 两个工具，把 OCR、图片分析、多图对比等视觉任务交给本地 KoboldCpp 多模态模型处理。其中 koboldcpp_vision 的一个重要输入来源就是"当前会话附带的图片"（通过 attachment 服务读取）。

## 问题

当用户在主对话中上传图片时，如果当前主模型在 pi-ai 模型目录中声明的 input 模态不包含 "image"（例如 opencode-go 下的 deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro，目录声明 "input": ["text"]），服务端会在消息进入会话之前直接拒绝整条消息：

1. dsh-host-apiproxy 的 prompt 接口发现消息含 image 部分后，调用 resolveModelInfo(provider, model) 查询当前模型的输入模态；
2. dsh-llm-pi-ai 从 pi-ai 内置目录（@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/<provider>.json）返回 inputModalities；
3. inputModalities 不含 "image" → 返回 attachment-error / MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES；
4. 前端 dsh-client-ui-conversation 渲染为"当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型"。

## 对工具型视觉工作流不友好

1. 图片从未进入会话：拒绝发生在附件入会话之前，视觉工具（包括 koboldcpp_vision 的"读取会话最近附带图片"路径）永远拿不到图——即使主模型有视觉工具也派不上用场。
2. 混淆了"主模型原生视觉"与"工具视觉"：主模型不需要原生多模态能力；只要它拥有视觉类工具或文件读取工具，就完全可以把图片交给工具处理。opencode 等 agent 产品的做法是：无论模型是否声明视觉模态，都把图片以链接/路径形式随消息给到模型，由模型自行决定如何处理。
3. 误伤纯文本模型用户：用户明明配好了本地视觉模型（例如通过插件），主模型只是恰好选了纯文本的 deepseek-v4-flash，结果连图都传不上去，只能绕过 UI 手动给路径，体验很差。

## 建议

- 放宽限制：当 inputModalities 不含 image 时不再硬性拒绝；允许图片作为附件进入会话，并以"链接/路径"形式（而非像素数据）呈现给主模型，由模型决定是否调用工具读取（opencode 风格）。
- 或提供配置开关：例如设置项 allowImageAttachmentsForTextOnlyModels，把硬拒绝降级为提示/警告。
- 实现成本不高：附件已由 dsh-attachment / dsh-attachment-local 持久化，dsh-llm-pi-ai 已有 resolveAttachments 管线，路径是现成的。

## 复现

- dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（web profile）
- provider: opencode-go，model: deepseek-v4-flash（目录 input: ["text"]）
- 步骤：上传任意图片 → 发送 → 立即被拒（"当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型"）
- 同目录声明 input: ["text","image"] 的模型（minimax-m3、qwen3.7-plus、kimi-k2.6、kimi-k3、mimo-v2.5、grok-4.5 等）不受影响

## 相关社区反馈

社区里已有类似声音（"聊天框的输入检测比插件的时机更早，不换模型无法 hook"、"多模态模型放进 dsh 壳子无法视图"），说明这不是个例。希望官方考虑放宽这个限制，给视觉工具类插件留出空间。谢谢！

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-mcp-lens — progressive-disclosure MCP for large Harness tool estates
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! I built `dsh-mcp-lens`, a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness that keeps the model-facing MCP surface fixed at **two tools**, even when a profile aggregates a very large remote MCP estate.

## What it does

- `mcp_search`: searches remote capabilities and reveals only the selected exact input schemas
- `mcp_call`: invokes one exact `server/tool`
- lazy stdio / Streamable HTTP connections
- last-good catalog with TTL, invalidation, and bounded persistence
- exact allow/deny policy over the hidden `server/tool` identity

## Why

The stock MCP client is the right default for a small stable tool set. It gets expensive and noisy when one profile carries dozens or thousands of remote tools.

This plugin keeps the standing model surface constant:

- 12 remote tools: `4,862 -> 1,114 bytes`
- 100 remote tools: `62,062 -> 1,114 bytes`
- 1,000 remote tools: `647,962 -> 1,114 bytes`

Metric: exact UTF-8 JSON bytes of `ctx.tools.schemas()`. This is component evidence only, not task-quality evidence.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens#v0.1.0-rc.1
```

Or install the reviewed release tarball:

- GitHub repo: https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens
- Release: https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/releases/tag/v0.1.0-rc.1

Verified on DSH `0.1.0-rc.6`, Node `22.19+` and `24+`.

This is an independent community plugin, not affiliated with the official project. Feedback and issues are welcome.

discussions.title: DSH Plugin Doctor: compatibility and security checks for plugin bundles
discussions.body:
I built a small tool for validating DSH plugin bundles before they are installed into a real Profile:

https://github.com/Xrainsmile/DSH-Plugin-Doctor

DSH Plugin Doctor checks plugin compatibility, scans risky behavior, installs the plugin in an isolated temporary `DSH_HOME`, starts a test Web/Profile, and generates Markdown/JSON reports plus a compatibility badge.

Main features:

- Validate `package.json` and `dsh.bundle.patch`
- Check Node, DSH, Cordis, and peer dependency compatibility
- Scan high-risk behavior such as lifecycle scripts, shell execution, filesystem access, network access, credential access, hooks, dynamic eval, and native modules
- Install into a temporary `DSH_HOME` and test Profile
- Start Web/Profile to detect plugin-caused startup failures
- Generate Markdown, JSON, and SVG badge reports
- Provide a `dsh-plugin-doctor install` flow with automatic Profile rollback on failure
- Include GitHub Actions support for Linux, macOS, Windows, and multiple DSH versions

I made this because official plugins are npm Bundles installed through:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <profile> add <package>
```

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-remote-ssh — 把 SSH 远程主机作为透明工作区使用（支持 Web 目录浏览与远端工具路由）
discussions.body:
之前看到社区里不少朋友（也包括我自己）遇到远程开发的痛点：在 Linux 服务器、虚拟机或 WSL 里跑代码，或者通过 SSH 端口转发访问 dsh web 时，选择工作区会触发服务端本机的 OS 弹窗，或者必须在本地改完代码再 rsync 推送到远端编译

为了解决这些问题，我开发了这个插件：**[dsh-remote-ssh](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh)**

### 核心特性

- **透明路由**：在 Web 界面选择 <服务器> > <项目目录> 后，读写文件、搜索代码（远端 
g）、执行终端命令（bash）全都在目标 SSH 主机上运行。不用增加 
emote_* 衍生工具，远端连接中断或失败时遵循 Fail-Closed，绝不意外回退到本机
- **持久 Bash PTY**：每个 Agent 会复用持久的远端 Bash PTY，跨工具调用能自然保留当前工作目录（cwd）、环境变量、自定义函数以及后台 Shell 状态
- **纯 Web 端目录选择器**：替换了原生的 OS 文件夹弹窗，直接在浏览器里浏览远端和本机的目录结构，彻底解决端口转发与远程访问下的选目录 Bug
- **连接复用 & OpenSSH 集成**：自动读取 ~/.ssh/config（包含 Include 递归解析）。同一服务器上的多个工作区共享 host 级连接，内部基于 VS Code Agent Host Protocol (AHP) 通信，避免频繁 SSH 握手开销

### 快速开始

可以通过 dsh plugin 命令直接安装：

`sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-ssh
`

如果你是从源码 checkout 运行，也可以关联本地插件路径：

`sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add link:/path/to/dsh-remote-ssh
`

更详细的远端依赖要求和安装指南请参考项目仓库：
👉 GitHub：https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-remote-ssh

欢迎大家试用、反馈 Issue 或提 PR

discussions.title: Proposal: Reintroduce terminal frontend (TUI) as a plugin — following the four re-entry conditions
discussions.body:
## Proposal: Reintroduce a terminal frontend (TUI) as a plugin — meeting the four re-entry conditions

Hi maintainers — I'd like to propose reintroducing a TUI frontend, **as a new plugin package, not a revival of the removed implementation**. This directly follows the re-entry conditions documented in the 2026-08-04 removal decision (`2026-08-04-remove-tui-package.md`).

### How each condition is met

| Condition | Our approach |
|---|---|
| named product / deployment | `dsh --profile tui` — a shipped profile template composing `dsh-base` + a new `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tui` plugin |
| explicit package boundary | New package `packages/ui/tui`, Cordis plugin, "owns terminal input and presentation only" — no agent-loop/persistence/tool logic; consumes only public seams (`agent.send/steer/followup/cancel`, `ctx.commands`, `ctx.userQuestions`, `ctx.approval`, `session-projections`) |
| concrete interaction provider | All seams verified against current HEAD (S0 audit memo, 12 assumptions checked with file:line evidence) |
| assembled lifecycle & transcript acceptance | ConPTY real-machine smoke matrix (14 scenarios: boot/TTY-fail-loud/streaming/tool-cards/Ctrl+C/IME/resume/terminal-restore) + semantic terminal snapshots via the existing vitest snapshot gate |

### Key design decisions

- **Fresh implementation, old TUI as design reference only** — no `git revert`; `/resume` uses the current profile-launcher semantics (`--resume <id>`), not the removed execve handoff
- **Windows-first**: native console path (raw mode + VT input), node-pty strictly test-only (eslint-enforced), real-machine gate on the existing `windows-native` CI lane
- **pi-tui**: try unpatched 0.84.2 first (upstream is very active; grapheme-width fixes already landed); the old 346-line patch is fallback only
- **Rendering from projection events + projection-cache only** — no full-transcript replay (addresses the long-session render cost the old TUI never solved)

### Ask

1. Any objection to the plugin-package approach on the grounds not covered above?
2. Preference on PR granularity — we're planning three PRs (skeleton → core interaction → integration+gates), happy to adjust.

If there's no objection in the next two weeks we'll proceed with the skeleton PR; if the direction needs correction we'll stop at whatever batch is current and archive the prototype. Thanks!

discussions.body:
开源了一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 Cordis 插件，让 Agent 直接在飞书里收发消息，中国大陆网络可用、不需要公网 IP / 域名 / 内网穿透。

仓库：https://github.com/AtinyFurina/dsh-adapter-feishu

功能：
- 飞书长连接(WebSocket)事件接收 im.message.receive_v1，回复自动分片、群聊 @发送者
- 两级菜单：/menu 列出工作区 → 进入后 0=新建对话、数字=接管该工作区历史对话
- 每个飞书会话绑定一个 DSH Agent，挂载标准 agent 预设（工具可用）
- Agent 的提问（ask_user_question）直接弹到飞书里作答；权限确认在飞书回复「允许/拒绝」
- /model 查看与切换本对话模型
- 执行进度消息按大节点编辑（适配飞书 20 次编辑上限），任务完成发通知
- 回复文本自动过滤 <invoke> 标记泄漏

安装：dsh plugin 或把插件放进 profiles/web/plugins，再在 cordis.patch.yml 里 insert 一行即可，README 有完整步骤。

踩过的坑（README 与代码注释里都有）：
- Cordis 插件必须用命名导出 apply（default 导出会丢 inject/Config）
- Config 必须用 schemastery Schema
- ctx.setInterval 需要 inject "timer"
- 接管活跃会话要直接复用 live agent（resume 会报 while it is live）
- 飞书消息编辑上限 20 次

欢迎试用与反馈。

discussions.title: 多插件架构会放大 LLM 幻觉吗？——拆解三条放大路径与对策
discussions.body:
dsh 开源三天就 8.5 万星，插件生态也在飞速生长。这让我忍不住想聊一个生态层面的问题：**插件越多，LLM 幻觉是不是越严重？** 我的初步判断：方向是，但归因要拆开。

**一、三条放大路径（我观察到的机制）**

1. **决策空间爆炸**：工具从 1 个变 20 个，LLM 每次要"20 选 1"。而工具选择恰恰是 LLM 最弱的环节——读 description、区分相似能力、决定用哪个，这个环节的错误率随选项数非线性上升。选错工具 = 用错工具得出貌似合理的结果，这是一种"功能性幻觉"。

2. **信息源污染**：社区插件质量参差，劣质插件可能返回过时数据、错误计算甚至编造的输出。而 agent 机制是把工具输出当事实吸收进上下文——垃圾进料口越多，模型越"自信地胡说"。

3. **注意力稀释**：每个插件的定义/schema/说明都占上下文，插件多了，干活 token 占比下降，幻觉率随噪声上升。

**二、但要澄清：多插件是放大镜，不是火源**

幻觉的根因在模型层的统计拟合，没有工具、纯对话也会幻觉。而工具恰恰是**抑制**幻觉的手段——真计算走工具（编译执行/形式验证）就是确定性输出，零幻觉空间。所以正确归因是：**多插件不增加幻觉，它增加的是幻觉的暴露面和传播路径**——环节变多（选择/吸收/仲裁），出错概率面变大，但根子还是那个模型。

**三、dsh 的三重特定风险**

- 生态无审核机制，劣质插件 = 污染源直通上下文
- "一切皆插件" = 把编排决策权全交给 LLM，正撞在最弱环节
- 0.1.0 预览版无稳定契约，插件 API 破坏性变更 → 老插件悄悄坏掉 → 输出垃圾 → 用户还以为是模型问题

**四、我的对策方向（抛砖引玉）**

1. **确定性优先**：数学/逻辑/代码/检索走确定性执行（编译/验证/查表），LLM 只翻译意图不算数
2. **schema 强校验**：减少 LLM 乱填参数的空间
3. **description 写死边界**：工具说明里给反例，降低选错率
4. **关键流程编排固化**：少让 LLM 每次重新编排
5. **插件质量门禁**：输出格式契约 + 测试，劣质插件别让 LLM 吃到它的输出

一句话：**不是"少用插件"，是"让插件变确定"。** 大家怎么看？有没有踩过类似坑，或者更好的实践？

幻觉的根因在模型层的统计拟合，没有工具、纯对话也会幻觉。而工具恰恰是**抑制**幻觉的手段——真计算走工具（编译执行/形式验证）就是确定性输出，零幻觉空间。所以正确归因是：**多插件不增加幻觉，它增加的是幻觉的暴露面和传播路径**——环节变多（选择/吸收/仲裁），出错概率面变大，但根子还是那个模型。

**三、dsh 的三重特定风险**

- 生态无审核机制，劣质插件 = 污染源直通上下文
- "一切皆插件" = 把编排决策权全交给 LLM，正撞在最弱环节
- 0.1.0 预览版无稳定契约，插件 API 破坏性变更 → 老插件悄悄坏掉 → 输出垃圾 → 用户还以为是模型问题

**四、我的对策方向（抛砖引玉）**

1. **确定性优先**：数学/逻辑/代码/检索走确定性执行（编译/验证/查表），LLM 只翻译意图不算数
2. **schema 强校验**：减少 LLM 乱填参数的空间
3. **description 写死边界**：工具说明里给反例，降低选错率
4. **关键流程编排固化**：少让 LLM 每次重新编排
5. **插件质量门禁**：输出格式契约 + 测试，劣质插件别让 LLM 吃到它的输出

一句话：**不是"少用插件"，是"让插件变确定"。** 大家怎么看？有没有踩过类似坑，或者更好的实践？

discussions.title: [Bug] host 与 preset 双挂 tool-skill 时，skill 目录（<available_skills>）在每个会话中被静默剥掉
discussions.body:
## 版本

`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`（web profile）

## 出问题的配置

profile patch（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）里 re-enable 了 web bundle 默认禁用的两个 host 行：

```yaml
- id: skill-filesystem
  disabled: false
- id: tool-skill
  disabled: false
```

而 agent preset（standard / code / cordis …）本来就各自挂载 `skill-filesystem` + `tool-skill`，于是进程里出现 **host 层与 preset 层两个 `tool-skill` 实例**。

## 现象

会话始终收不到 `<available_skills>` 目录 system-reminder，但其余 skill 能力正常：

- `skill` 工具已注册、可正常调用加载
- `/name` 用户手势注入正常
- `ctx.skills.snapshot({ cwd, scope: agent })` 返回完整目录且 `complete: true`
- 会话 events 中 `skill-catalog` 消息计数为 **0**——目录从未进入会话历史

即：模型没有任何途径发现可用 skill 名单，除非名字恰好在别处（如 AGENTS.md）被提到。

## 原因（读 rc.6 源码定位）

两个实例都在各自层注册名为 `skill` 的工具，并都在 `agent/pre-step` 挂了目录监听器。preset 层注册对 agent 可见性获胜；host 实例的监听器里 `ctx.tools.get('skill', agent) === 本实例 skillTool` 判定为 false，走"工具不可见→按空目录处理"分支。host 实例在瀑布中先注册（外层）、preset 实例后执行（内层先注入目录），于是每个 pre-step：

1. preset 实例注入完整目录
2. host 实例以空目录视界运行，把同一步里刚注入的目录消息当陈旧列表剥掉

每步"注入→剥除"循环，目录永远进不了模型请求。

## 最小复现

上面两行 patch + 任一 preset 会话发一条消息即可：无目录；`skill` 工具与 `/name` 手势不受影响。

## 当前 workaround

preset 已自带这两个插件，host 行保持默认 disabled 即可——从 profile patch 删掉这两个 override，HMR 立即生效，无需重启；既有会话下一步就会收到目录。

discussions.title: [Bug] 自定义提供方(openai-completions)下内置工具 get_goal schema 非法:null is not of type "array"
discussions.body:
## 现象

使用自定义提供方(第三方 OpenAI 兼容网关,协议选 openai-completions)时,
在对话框发送消息,请求被上游直接以 400 拒绝,模型没有产生任何输出。

报错:

```
失败原因:Stream ended without finish_reason

本轮运行失败 400: {"message":"Invalid schema for function 'get_goal': null is not of type \"array\"","type":"invalid_request_error","param":"","code":"invalid_request_error"}
```

界面上标记为 `INVALID_REQUEST`。

## 分析

`get_goal` 是 Harness 内置工具,不是我自己注册的自定义工具。
报错来自上游 API 对 `tools` 字段的 schema 校验,提示某个应为 `array` 的位置收到了 `null`。

推测是 Harness 在把 `get_goal` 的工具定义序列化成 openai-completions 协议的
`tools[].function.parameters` 时,某个可选的数组属性(如 `required` / `enum` / `items`)
在无值的情况下被写成了 `null`,而没有被省略或置为 `[]`。

由于校验发生在生成之前,这一路请求 100% 失败,与用户输入内容无关。
同时导致流未正常结束,前端额外显示 "Stream ended without finish_reason"。

## 环境

- Harness 版本:0.1.0-rc.6(通过 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动)
- 操作系统:macOS
- 提供方类型:自定义提供方(Custom provider)
- API 协议:openai-completions
- 网关:New API(第三方 OpenAI 兼容聚合网关)
- baseURL:https://your-gateway.example/v1

## 复现步骤

1. 设置 → 模型 → 添加自定义提供方
2. API 协议选 `openai-completions`,填入网关 baseURL(需带 `/v1`)与 API 密钥
3. 手动添加一个模型 ID 并保存
4. 在对话框发送任意一句话
5. 立即出现上述 400 报错,无任何模型输出

## 补充

不确定该问题是 openai-completions 协议路径特有,还是所有自定义提供方都会触发。
如果需要,我可以从网关侧抓取 Harness 实际发出的请求体中 `get_goal` 那一段 JSON 以便定位。

discussions.title: [Show and tell] dsh-mnemosyne：给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体装上跨会话长期记忆
discussions.body:
## 一句话讲完项目

`@ztm-njau/dsh-mnemosyne` 是一个给 DeepSeek Harness 智能体用的**长期记忆能力 seam**：在会话 A 里记住的事实，在另一个会话 B 里能被 `memory_recall` 召回。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile headless add @ztm-njau/dsh-mnemosyne
```

一行命令装好（走 pnpm，因为包声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch`，会自动写进 `dsh.profile.bundles`，无需手改 YAML）。

## 它是什么

DSH 的能力是「三件套」——服务定义 + Provider + 消费者。这个插件把三样都补齐了：

| 角色 | 实现 | 平面 |
|---|---|---|
| 服务定义 | `memory` — `remember` / `recall` / `forget` / `list` | host |
| Provider | `$DSH_HOME/mnemosyne/memory.jsonl`（追加式 JSON-lines 落盘） | host |
| 消费者 | 工具 `memory_remember` / `memory_recall` / `memory_forget` | host `tools` 注册表 |

智能体拿到三个面向模型的工具；在会话 A 里记住的事实，在**另一个**会话 B 里能被召回（实测：三个独立 headless 进程）。同一 profile 上的任何其它插件也能 `ctx.get('memory')` 直接消费服务——这才是 seam 在发力的地方，而不只是工具本身。

## 我们真正学会的一条规则（以及被它教训的那个 phase）

整个项目存在的意义，是把一条规则吃透：

> **发布服务的行不能裸放在 agent preset 里。** 不给它 isolate realm 就会落到进程级 realm，第二个挂载这个 preset 的会话就会和第一个撞车。

我一开始不信，直到亲手复现了它。写了一个 `ctx.provide('noteboard', …)` 的动态插件，又写了第二个做同样的事，运行时直接拒绝挂载，报错原文：

```
service "noteboard" has been registered at <noteboard-service>
```

这条报错，就是「平面规则」以崩溃的形式现身。所以这个 bundle 里的 `memory` 服务 + Provider 放在 **host 平面**（profile bundle 的一行），绝不裸放在 preset 里——因为记忆必须跨会话、且是同一个共享存储；工具那部分是消费者。这就是「用 DSH」和「共同作者 DSH」的分界线。


## 一些局限

- 存储是**追加式 JSON-lines + 读时折叠**（同 id 最后一次写胜出；`forget` 写 tombstone）。**不是 ACID**——是 last-write-wins。损坏行被跳过并记日志。
- 召回是**关键词子串 + 标签打分**——确定性、纯本地、无网络、无 embedding。（语义召回显然是下一步：在同一 `memory` 接口后面换一个 Provider，消费者不动——这正是 seam 的意义。）
- 目标是 `rc.6`（开发者预览）。API 会变，所以我们每次改动前都先 inspect。

## 为什么发这个

记忆功能只是载体。真正的成果是：一个原本只是「用过」DSH 的人，现在能**从零写一个 DSH 能力**——inspect、build、mount、publish、share——并且有一个真实可装的 artifact 和一份书面记录来证明。如果你也想学同样的事，最短路径就是这个 README + 上面那条撞车报错：看懂那一次崩溃，就看懂了 host/preset 平面。

npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@ztm-njau/dsh-mnemosyne

discussions.title: 多插件架构会放大 LLM 幻觉吗？——拆解三条放大路径与对策
discussions.body:
dsh 开源三天就 8.5 万星，插件生态也在飞速生长。这让我忍不住想聊一个生态层面的问题：**插件越多，LLM 幻觉是不是越严重？** 我的初步判断：方向是，但归因要拆开。

**一、三条放大路径（我观察到的机制）**

1. **决策空间爆炸**：工具从 1 个变 20 个，LLM 每次要"20 选 1"。而工具选择恰恰是 LLM 最弱的环节——读 description、区分相似能力、决定用哪个，这个环节的错误率随选项数非线性上升。选错工具 = 用错工具得出貌似合理的结果，这是一种"功能性幻觉"。

2. **信息源污染**：社区插件质量参差，劣质插件可能返回过时数据、错误计算甚至编造的输出。而 agent 机制是把工具输出当事实吸收进上下文——垃圾进料口越多，模型越"自信地胡说"。

3. **注意力稀释**：每个插件的定义/schema/说明都占上下文，插件多了，干活 token 占比下降，幻觉率随噪声上升。

**二、但要澄清：多插件是放大镜，不是火源**

幻觉的根因在模型层的统计拟合——没有工具、纯对话也会幻觉。而工具恰恰是**抑制**幻觉的手段：真计算走工具（编译执行/形式验证）就是确定性输出，零幻觉空间。所以正确归因是：**多插件不增加幻觉，它增加的是幻觉的暴露面和传播路径**——环节变多（选择/吸收/仲裁），出错概率面变大，但根子还是那个模型。

**三、dsh 的三重特定风险**

- 生态无审核机制，劣质插件 = 污染源直通上下文
- "一切皆插件" = 把编排决策权全交给 LLM，正撞在最弱环节
- 0.1.0 预览版无稳定契约，插件 API 破坏性变更 → 老插件悄悄坏掉 → 输出垃圾 → 用户还以为是模型问题

**四、我的对策方向（抛砖引玉）**

1. **确定性优先**：数学/逻辑/代码/检索走确定性执行（编译/验证/查表），LLM 只翻译意图不算数
2. **schema 强校验**：减少 LLM 乱填参数的空间
3. **description 写死边界**：工具说明里给反例，降低选错率
4. **关键流程编排固化**：少让 LLM 每次重新编排
5. **插件质量门禁**：输出格式契约 + 测试，劣质插件别让 LLM 吃到它的输出

一句话：**不是"少用插件"，是"让插件变确定"。** 大家怎么看？有没有踩过类似坑，或者更好的实践？

discussions.title: [Bug] skill frontmatter 含「冒号+空格」的 description 未加引号时被静默忽略，catalog 完全无感知 / Skills with colon-containing unquoted description are silently dropped from the catalog
discussions.body:
[Bug] skill frontmatter 含「冒号+空格」的 description 未加引号时被静默忽略，catalog 完全无感知 / Skills with colon-containing unquoted description are silently dropped from the catalog

## 现象 / Symptom

`~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` 的 frontmatter 中，`description` 值如果包含「冒号+空格」（如 `Priority order: check the curated list first`）且未用引号包裹，YAML 解析会在 `parseFrontmatter` 抛 `Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings`，skill 被静默移除：

- 会话 skill catalog（`<available_skills>`）中完全不出现该 skill；
- 用户与模型侧无任何提示，仅后端 `logger.warn`（`skill file ... ignored: invalid YAML frontmatter`）；
- 排查只能靠逐文件比对 catalog 差异，极难发现（今日实测，三个新 skill 全部中招后才发现）。

This is a concrete trigger of the same defect class described in #936 (malformed frontmatter entries are dropped with only a logger.warn, and the catalog cannot distinguish an absent skill from an invalid one). Here the trigger is a YAML parse error rather than a name/description validation failure — same silent removal, same undiagnosable shape.

## 复现 / Reproduce

```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills/foo
cat > ~/.dsh/skills/foo/SKILL.md <<'EOF'
---
name: foo
description: Use when the user asks to find plugins. Priority order: check the curated list first.
---
EOF
# 启动 dsh web 后，foo 不会出现在 skill 工具的 <available_skills> 目录中
```

修复方式：`description: "Use when ... Priority order: check ..."`（双引号包裹）后立即生效。

## 环境 / Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（CLI），deepseek-harness-desktop 0.3.4
- Windows 11 / PowerShell 5.1
- 相关包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`（`parseSkillFile` → `parseFrontmatter` 抛错路径，仅 `ctx.logger.warn` 后 return）

## 建议 / Suggestion

与 #936 的修复建议一致（rejected 计数 / failOnInvalidSkill / 启动摘要均适用），此处补充一个真实触发形态供确认修复优先级。

/cc #936

discussions.title: @akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger：DSH 原生、证据约束的持久负面记忆门禁（v0.1.0）
discussions.body:
# @akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger — DSH 原生负面记忆门禁插件（v0.1.0）

DSH 原生、证据约束的持久负面记忆门禁：失败结论随环境证据自动生效和吊销，并在并发代理之间保持事务一致。

## 解决什么问题

官方 `repeat-tool-reminder` 只做「相同调用提醒」，不持久化、不看证据。本插件把失败路径（`command_failed` / `file_missing`）连同结果与前置条件证据、指纹、重试条件记入 SQLite 账本（WAL，多进程/多代理安全）：

- **warn 模式**：重复尝试前经 inbox 注入提醒；诚实计数 `duplicateFailuresObserved` / `warningsEmitted` / `callsDenied`，无 token 估算；
- **block 模式**：派发前 deny，账本不可用时 fail-closed；
- **证据变化自动吊销**：文件写入（`fs/observed`）使 `file_missing` 失效；命令失败按 `after` TTL 放行；
- **跨代理一致**：父代理的失败结论对子代理同样生效（warn 注入 / block deny）；
- **事务**：原子决策（BEGIN IMMEDIATE + OCC revision）、重试租约（互斥 + 接管）、操作回执（幂等重放）、崩溃恢复。

## 对照基准（formal，54 轮，deepseek-v4-flash，单一 harness commit）

| 门槛 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| Block 重复失败较官方 reminder 降低 ≥ 70% | **降低 100%**（9 → 0） |
| Block 错误阻止 = 0 | **0** |
| 合法重试放行率 = 100% | **6/6**（s3 文件证据 3/3、s4 TTL 3/3） |
| Block 完成率 ≥ Baseline | **100% ≥ 100%** |
| 跨代理重复降低 ≥ 80% | **降低 100%**（3 → 0） |
| Warn 重复压力轮注入提醒 | **全部注入** |
| 账本计数与会话日志一致 | **一致** |

协议：[benchmark/PROTOCOL.md](https://github.com/akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger/blob/main/benchmark/PROTOCOL.md)；审计摘要：[benchmark/FORMAL-RESULTS.md](https://github.com/akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger/blob/main/benchmark/FORMAL-RESULTS.md)。数字均来自 formal 阶段（每格 3 轮、54 轮完整），模型与 harness commit 一致。

## 安装

```sh
npm i @akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger
```

挂载（cordis.yml / patch overlay）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: negative-ledger
      name: @akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger
      config:
        backend: sqlite   # 默认；jsonl 为遗留后端
        mode: warn        # warn | block | off
        dir: .negative-ledger
```

仓库：https://github.com/akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger · npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/@akslcw/dsh-negative-ledger

discussions.title: dsh plugin add promotes pre-existing bundle-declaring deps into the bundle stack and breaks the next boot with "duplicate loader entry id"
discussions.body:
# `dsh plugin add` promotes pre-existing bundle-declaring deps into the bundle stack and breaks the next boot with "duplicate loader entry id"

## TL;DR (中文摘要)

`dsh plugin --profile web add <pkg>` 安装成功后，会把**所有**声明了 `dsh.bundle` 的依赖（包括本次命令之前就存在、一直靠 `cordis.patch.yml` insert 加载的插件）追加进 `dsh.profile.bundles`。如果用户 patch 里仍保留这些插件的 insert，下一次启动 `dsh web` 时 cordis loader 会因重复 entry id 直接崩溃：

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): duplicate loader entry id: better-sidebar
TypeError: duplicate loader entry id: better-sidebar
    at EntryGroup.update (cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js:81:28)
```

`dsh --profile web --dump-config` 检测不到这个问题（它不挂载 loader），只有真实启动才报错。

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 (launched via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`)
- macOS arm64, Node 22.22.1, pnpm 9.15.9
- Profile: `web`

## Steps to reproduce

1. Profile has out-of-tree plugins installed as `file:` dependencies and loaded **only** through the user patch layer (`profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml` inserts) — e.g. `dsh-better-sidebar` and `@liustack/modlens`, whose packages **do** declare `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` but are **not** in `dsh.profile.bundles`.
2. Run `dsh plugin --profile web add dshmarket` (any package triggers it).
3. Restart `dsh web` → crash: `duplicate loader entry id: better-sidebar` (and `modlens`).

## Root cause

`dsh plugin` (the `reconcilePlugins` step in `lib/plugin-*.js`) reconciles `dsh.profile.bundles` against the installed state on **every** invocation: every dependency that resolves to a package declaring `dsh.bundle.patch` is appended to the bundle layer list. This is intentional (an `update` should activate a package that gained the declaration in a newer version), but it also promotes *pre-existing* dependencies that were never bundle layers and were being loaded via user-patch inserts.

The user's own patch layer (`cordis.patch.yml`) is **not** reconciled: its now-redundant `insert` entries remain, so the same entry id is inserted twice. `cordis-plugin-loader`'s `EntryGroup.update` throws on duplicate ids at mount time. `--dump-config` never mounts the loader, so the duplicate is invisible there (verified: dump-config exits 0 with both duplicate rows present in the composed tree) — the failure only appears on a real boot.

## Workaround (what fixed it)

Back up and edit `profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`: remove the `insert` entries whose ids are now provided by bundle layers (in my case `better-sidebar` and `modlens`); keep only the non-bundle inserts (`@local/dsh-emoji-picker`, `@local/dsh-ui-customizer`). Boot then succeeds.

## Suggested fixes (any would help)

1. After reconciling bundles, diff the insert ids of the newly-active bundle patches against the user patch; either auto-remove the now-redundant user-patch inserts (keeping a `.bak` backup) or fail with an actionable message naming the exact file and entries to remove.
2. Add a validation path that mounts the loader (e.g. `dsh --profile web --check`, or make `--dump-config` do a mount-only dry run) so duplicate ids surface before the user restarts.
3. Minor UX: when `pnpm` is missing, `dsh plugin` prints "pnpm not found on PATH — install pnpm to manage profile plugins" but could suggest concrete commands (`corepack enable pnpm` / `npm i -g pnpm`); the dshmarket plugin already provisions pnpm this way.

## Note

dshmarket's one-click install also shells out to `dsh plugin --profile <name> add`, so it inherits this behavior — a user installing anything from the market can hit the same crash if their user patch contains inserts for bundle-declaring packages.

discussions.title: unknown tool "" / 会话历史加载失败:流式 tool_calls 空 delta 覆盖了首块 id/name
discussions.body:
DeepSeek 流式返回工具调用时,首块带正常 id/name,后续 delta 里 id/name 若为空字符串,会把首块的值覆盖成空,导致 `unknown tool ""` 且 callId 为空;该会话下次加载时历史直接读不出来。

## 最小复现
两个 SSE data 帧,第二帧把 id/name 清成空串:

```text
data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_1","type":"function","function":{"name":"get_weather","arguments":""}}]}}]}

data: {"choices":[{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"","type":"function","function":{"name":"","arguments":"{\"city\":\"Paris\"}"}}]}}]}

data: [DONE]
```

装配出来的 tool call:`id=""`、`name=""` → `ToolNotFoundError("unknown tool \"\"")`,且 tool/result 的 `source.callId` 为空字符串。

## 根因
`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`:

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

`!== undefined` 对空串为真,后续 delta 的空串 id/name 覆盖首块。`closeBlock` 里 `id: CallId(block.callId ?? '')` 在流里没有 id 时直接落空串,没有兜底(通用装配器 `packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts` 有 `?? CallId('call-${index}')`)。

空 callId 写进 `tool/result` 后,会话校验 `assertMessageEventShape`(`packages/core/session/src/index.ts`,空 `source.callId` 被拒)在重新加载时抛 `must have tool source` → `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` → `history unavailable`,整条会话历史加载失败。模型发一次空 id 工具调用就卡死该会话。

## 修复(已本地验证)
```ts
// 只在非空串时赋值,避免空串 delta 覆盖首块
if (typeof call.id === 'string' && call.id !== '') block.callId = call.id
if (typeof call.function?.name === 'string' && call.function.name !== '') block.name = call.function.name
```
`closeBlock` 加兜底:
```ts
id: CallId(block.callId && block.callId !== '' ? block.callId : `call-${block.index}`),
```
加了两个测试(空串 delta 覆盖、流里无 id),并更新了原断言“无 id 输出空 id”的用例;`pnpm vitest run packages/llm/llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` 32/32 通过。

和 #879 #885 #161 #615 #725 #887 #890 同一根因,这条补上具体复现和补丁。

修复已在 fork 上:`WilShi/deepseek-harness` 分支 `fix/llm-deepseek-empty-toolcall-delta`(commit 82f3634aae),含两个回归测试。

discussions.title: [Bug Report] Windows: sandbox permanently fails after Storage Sense deletes the session's private temp directory
discussions.body:
[Bug Report] Windows: sandbox permanently fails after Storage Sense deletes the session's private temp directory

TL;DR

On Windows, a low-disk-space Storage Sense cleanup can delete the sandbox provider's private %TEMP%\dsh-* directory while the dsh server is still running. After that, every confined command fails with windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory until the server is restarted — because the provider caches the temp path per session and never re-validates it on cache hits.

Environment

  • Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh v0.1.0-rc.6 (running via npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web)

  • OS: Windows 10 Pro (22H2, build 19045); the mechanism should be OS-version independent

  • Sandbox mode: workspace-write (session default)

  • C: drive free space at diagnosis time: ~6.7 GB (low-space condition)

Symptoms

Every pwsh execution fails with:

Error: sandbox mode "workspace-write" is requested but no sandbox backend is
usable on this host; refusing to run the command unconfined. ...
Runner failure: windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory:
C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-au2XNB

The reported path is the session's private temp directory that the provider itself created earlier in the same server lifetime — it no longer exists on disk. Read/write/edit file tools keep working; only confined command execution breaks.

Root cause

In dsh-sandbox-local (packages/sandbox/sandbox-local), materializeAclGrant(sessionId, workspaceRoot) caches the private temp capability per [sessionId, workspaceRoot] key:

const key = JSON.stringify([String(sessionId), workspaceRoot]);
const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0) return existing;   // ← returns stale path, no existence check
const tempDir = mkdtempSync(join(tmpdir(), "dsh-"));

The cache-hit path performs no existence check, so once anything external deletes the directory, the provider keeps handing the stale path to the ACL runner, which fail-closes on startup (requireDirectory("--temp", …) → exit 127). The README documents OS temp hygiene reclaiming crash residue, but the same hygiene can also reclaim the live directory of a running provider — a case the design doesn't cover.

How I traced the trigger (evidence from the affected machine)

The session was only ~20 hours old, so the "files older than N days" rule could not apply (session artifacts are timestamped 00:31–00:56 the same day). The actual trigger was the low-disk-space immediate cleanup by Windows Storage Sense:

So: low disk space → Storage Sense immediate cleanup → private temp dir deleted → cached path goes stale → permanent fail-closed sandbox for the session.

Impact / why this matters

This is likely a fairly common Windows scenario:

  1. dsh web server keeps running (normal usage), and

  2. Storage Sense fires — routinely triggered by low disk space, which is very common on Windows laptops.

The session is then permanently broken for confined commands until restart. Fail-closed is the correct runner behavior; the bug is the provider trusting a cached path forever.

Suggested fix

Re-validate on cache hit and re-materialize transparently:

const existing = this.tempCapabilities.get(key);
if (existing !== void 0) {
  if (existsSync(existing.dir) && statSync(existing.dir).isDirectory()) {
    return existing;
  }
  // External cleanup (Storage Sense / disk hygiene) deleted our private temp
  // dir. Best-effort revoke the stale grant, drop the entry, and fall through
  // to materialize a fresh directory + SID below.
  try { existing.grant.dispose(); } catch { /* log */ }
  this.tempCapabilities.delete(key);
}

This extends the documented design philosophy ("a fresh provider always chooses a new path; residue is inert") to mid-lifetime invalidation.

Workaround for affected users

  • Restart the dsh server (new provider creates a fresh temp dir).

  • Stop Storage Sense from deleting Temp: Settings → System → Storage → Storage Sense → disable automatic temp-file cleanup, or free up space.

  • Stop-gap: run affected commands with danger-full-access (unconfined).

Thanks for the great work on the harness — happy to provide more logs or test a patch if you have a preferred fix direction.

discussions.title: MCP server launched via npx crashes repeatedly in dsh on Windows (no TTY): node.exe error popup + "fetch failed"
discussions.body:
## Environment
- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`, Windows 11
- MCP server: `@modelcontextprotocol/server-github@2025.4.8` (stdio transport)

## Config
```yaml
- id: mcp-github
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: github
    transport: stdio
    command: cmd
    args: ['/c', 'npx', '-y', '@modelcontextprotocol/server-github@2025.4.8']
    env:
      GITHUB_TOKEN: !!js process.env.GITHUB_TOKEN
```

## Symptoms
1. Windows **"node.exe - Application Error"** popups appear repeatedly while working.
2. Every call to `mcp__github__*` tools fails with `MCP error -32603: fetch failed`.
3. The spawned MCP server node process keeps dying and being restarted (observed PID churn: a process disappears, a new one appears ~2 minutes later), so the popups recur.

## What works fine on the same machine
- Running the same server manually responds to MCP `initialize` correctly:
  `npx -y @modelcontextprotocol/server-github@2025.4.8` → `serverInfo: github-mcp-server 0.6.2`.
- Same result via `cmd /c npx ...` (mimicking the dsh spawn path).
- `GITHUB_TOKEN` is valid: `GET https://api.github.com/user` with the token returns the authenticated user.
- Network to api.github.com is fine.

## Hypothesis
The failure only happens when the server is spawned by dsh (no TTY, stdio pipes owned by the host). This looks like the known class of issues where **npx-based MCP servers fail silently in no-TTY environments** (e.g. anthropics/claude-code#25044, modelcontextprotocol/servers#1082). npx does its own version resolution and child-process indirection, which can misbehave when stdin/stdout are pipes rather than a TTY.

## Suggested improvements
1. On Windows, allow / document launching MCP servers via the direct Node entry path instead of going through `npx` (avoid the `.cmd`/ps1 wrapper + npx indirection).
2. Add a Windows-specific section to the mcp-client README with a known-good config template.
3. Log the spawned server's exit code / stderr when it dies, so "crash loop" cases like this are diagnosable from logs alone.

Happy to provide more logs or test another configuration if useful. Thanks for the great project!

discussions.body:
官方统计行把缓存命中率四舍五入成整数——不太精确且99.5%+会显示100%

https://github.com/noone89A/dsh-gauge

- 分桶明细：命中 / 未命中输入 + 输出 token

- 配置卡片（设置 → 插件 → 可配置插件），保存后立即生效（需一次性把 gauge 加入宿主白名单：dsh-host-apiproxy 的WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES，详见 README 故障排查；不加不影响核心功能）

**截图**
