discussions.title: 🚀 dsh-web-search-tavily & dsh-web-search-brave — web_search providers (keyless Tavily + Brave)
discussions.body:
## 🚀 dsh-web-search-tavily & dsh-web-search-brave — third-party web_search providers

Two community search providers for the DeepSeek Harness web capability seam (`ctx.web`): make the built-in `web_search` tool run on third-party search APIs instead of the shipped DeepSeek route.

English | 中文

---

### 🔎 dsh-web-search-tavily

- **Keyless mode** — works with **no API key at all** (official `X-Tavily-Access-Mode: keyless` header; responses identical to keyed ones)
- **Keyed upgrade** — set `TAVILY_API_KEY` (1,000 free credits/month at app.tavily.com); key resolved fresh per search
- **Official defaults** — `search_depth: basic`, `include_answer: false`, `max_results: 5`, `chunks_per_source: 3`
- 📦 npm: [dsh-web-search-tavily](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-search-tavily) · 🐙 [github.com/cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-tavily](https://github.com/cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-tavily)

### 🦁 dsh-web-search-brave

- Brave Search Web API (`X-Subscription-Token` auth)
- Clean snippets — `text_decorations: false` (no `<b>` markers)
- `page_age` (ISO 8601) → `publishedAt`; 2,000 free queries/month
- 📦 npm: [dsh-web-search-brave](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-search-brave) · 🐙 [github.com/cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-brave](https://github.com/cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-brave)

---

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-search-tavily   # keyless, zero config
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-search-brave    # needs BRAVE_API_KEY
```

Keys go in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (Tavily optional — keyless works without):

```yaml
TAVILY_API_KEY: tvly-...
BRAVE_API_KEY: BSA...
```

Select the provider in your profile's `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: tavily   # or: brave
```

---

### ✅ Compatibility report (for the dsh.so matrix)

```
Plugin: cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-tavily + cnChenKai/dsh-web-search-brave
dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.6
Install method: bundle (profile cordis.patch.yml insert)
Result: pass
Notes: verified end-to-end on Debian 13 (aarch64). Both providers returned real results via the built-in web_search tool; provider switching (tavily ↔ brave) hot-applies without restart; vitest suites (7 + 6 tests) green.
```

Both repos carry the `dsh-plugin` topic — they are already picked up by community market tools (dsh-plugin-market, dsh-plugin-workshop, plugin-finders). MIT licensed.

discussions.title: [Feature request] A general per-workspace child slot for the workspace overflow menu (`sidebar.workspaces.entry`)
discussions.body:
## Background

I'm writing a ["skills manager" plugin](https://github.com/royenheart/MaintainAll/tree/main/apps/dsh-plugin-skills-manager) for dsh: enable/disable skills across **session > workspace > global** scopes (the host side uses a rank-50 skill provider to block disabled entries, the client side reuses the `skill.list` RPC + a settings scope). The global settings page and the session `conversation.view` tab both already have existing slots.

Only the **workspace scope** has no suitable entry point. My approach is: add a "Manage skills" option to each workspace's three-dot overflow menu, and clicking it opens that workspace's skills panel. But after going through the client source I found there is **no way for a plugin to do this**.

## Current state (why plugins can't do it)

1. `sidebar.workspaces` is a `single` slot (`packages/client/ui-sidebar/src/client/contract/slots.ts`):
   ```ts
   'sidebar.workspaces': { kind: 'single'; scope: 'root'; owner: SidebarSectionOwnerProps }
   ```
   The entire browse area is rendered exclusively by `ui-workspace`'s `WorkspaceBrowser`.

2. `WorkspaceBrowser` declares only **one** child slot (`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/contract/slots.ts`):
   ```ts
   'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow': { kind: 'single'; scope: 'root'; owner: DirectoryFlowOwnerProps }
   ```
   It's only the "directory selection" hole, not a per-workspace row/menu extension point.

3. The workspace three-dot menu is **hardcoded** (`ProjectRowItem` in `packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/rows/Rows.tsx`):
   ```tsx
   const workspaceMenuItems = [
     { id: 'rename', label: t('rename'), icon: <IconEditOutline16 /> },
     { id: 'delete', label: t('delete.workspace'), icon: <IconTrashOutline16 />, danger: true },
   ]
   ```
   `Menu` takes a descriptor array (`MenuItem[]`), not React nodes, and there is no registration point to "append external menu items".

Conclusion: to make the workspace overflow menu extensible, currently **you can only change the `ui-workspace` source**.

## Proposal: a general `sidebar.workspaces.entry` (list slot)

Follow dsh's existing mature `conversation.view` (tabs) and `settings.section` (settings nav) pattern, and add a **`list` slot** for workspaces:

- **Plugin-side registration** (label comes entirely from the plugin's own locale, zero hardcoding on the dsh side):
  ```ts
  ctx.slots.register({
    name: 'sidebar.workspaces.entry',
    id: 'skills-manager',
    label: t('workspace-entry'),   // the plugin's own i18n
    order: 100,
  }, (props) => <SkillsPanel workspacePath={props.workspacePath} />)
  ```
- **WorkspaceBrowser side**: use `slots.entries()` to project into menu-item descriptors, render them into the workspace three-dot menu, and on selection `renderSlot(key, { workspacePath }, { only: id })` opens a modal rendering only that entry.

This way any plugin can contribute workspace menu items, with `id/label/order` semantics exactly matching `conversation.view` / `settings.section`.

## Appendix: full implementation patch

> Verified in the local `deepseek-harness` worktree: `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` and `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` both 0 errors, and all 121 `ui-workspace` tests pass.

### 1. ui-workspace — slot declaration + overflow-menu rendering

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/contract/slots.ts`:

```diff
+/**
+ * Owner share of a per-workspace entry slot: the workspace directory path the
+ * entry's component receives when rendered from the workspace overflow menu.
+ */
+export interface WorkspaceEntryOwnerProps {
+  readonly workspacePath: string
+}
+
 declare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots' {
   interface SlotMap {
     'conversation.hero.workspace.directoryFlow': { kind: 'single'; scope: 'root'; owner: DirectoryFlowOwnerProps }
     'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow': { kind: 'single'; scope: 'root'; owner: DirectoryFlowOwnerProps }
+    /** Per-workspace menu entries rendered from the workspace overflow menu (declared by the WorkspaceBrowser entry). */
+    'sidebar.workspaces.entry': { kind: 'list'; scope: 'root'; owner: WorkspaceEntryOwnerProps }
   }
 }
 
 export type WorkspaceBrowserInjected = DirectoryPickingInjected & {
   ...
   createWorkspace: (input: { path: string }) => Promise<WorkspaceView>
+  /** Projected per-workspace menu entries (resolved label + id) for the overflow menu. */
+  workspaceEntryItems: () => readonly { id: string; label: string }[]
 }
 
 export type WorkspaceBrowserProps =
   PropsRuntime<'sidebar.workspaces'>
-  & PropsRenderSlots<'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow'>
+  & PropsRenderSlots<'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow' | 'sidebar.workspaces.entry'>
   ...
```

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/index.ts`:

```diff
-import type { HostObservable } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'
+import { resolveSlotLabel, type HostObservable } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots'
 ...
     createWorkspace: input => ctx.workspaces.create(input),
+    workspaceEntryItems: () => {
+      const items: { id: string; label: string }[] = []
+      for (const entry of ctx.slots.entries('sidebar.workspaces.entry')) {
+        if (entry.options.id === undefined) continue
+        items.push({ id: entry.options.id, label: resolveSlotLabel(entry.options.label) ?? entry.options.id })
+      }
+      return items
+    },
     hooks: { directoryFlow: browserFlowSource },
   })
 ...
       name: 'sidebar.workspaces',
-      children: { 'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow': { kind: 'single', scope: 'root' } },
+      children: {
+        'sidebar.workspaces.directoryFlow': { kind: 'single', scope: 'root' },
+        'sidebar.workspaces.entry': { kind: 'list', scope: 'root' },
+      },
```

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/rows/Rows.tsx` (`ProjectRowItem`):

```diff
-export function ProjectRowItem({ group, onToggle, onCreate, actions, drag, t }: {
+export function ProjectRowItem({ group, onToggle, onCreate, actions, drag, extraMenuItems, onEntrySelect, t }: {
   group: GroupNode
   onToggle: () => void
   onCreate: () => void
   actions?: { rename: () => void; delete: () => void } | undefined
   drag?: WorkspaceRowDragProps | undefined
+  /** Additional per-workspace menu entries contributed by feature plugins. */
+  extraMenuItems?: readonly { id: string; label: string }[] | undefined
+  /** Select an additional entry (id from extraMenuItems). */
+  onEntrySelect?: (id: string) => void | undefined
   t: RowTranslate
 }) {
   ...
   const workspaceMenuItems = [
     { id: 'rename', label: t('rename'), icon: <IconEditOutline16 /> },
     { id: 'delete', label: t('delete.workspace'), icon: <IconTrashOutline16 />, danger: true },
+    ...(extraMenuItems ?? []).map(item => ({ id: item.id, label: item.label })),
   ]
   ...
             onSelect={(id) => {
               setMenuOpen(false)
-              if (id !== 'rename' && id !== 'delete') return
-              if (id === 'rename') actions.rename()
-              else actions.delete()
+              if (id === 'rename') {
+                actions.rename()
+                return
+              }
+              if (id === 'delete') {
+                actions.delete()
+                return
+              }
+              onEntrySelect?.(id)
             }}
```

`packages/client/ui-workspace/src/client/WorkspaceBrowser.tsx` (key spots):

```diff
 type SessionTreeProps = Pick<...> & {
   ...
   orderBy: SessionOrderBy
+  /** Projected per-workspace menu entries (resolved label + id). */
+  entryItems: readonly { id: string; label: string }[]
+  /** Open a per-workspace entry (id from entryItems) for a workspace path. */
+  openWorkspaceEntry: (workspacePath: string, id: string) => void
 }
 ...
 function SessionTree({ ..., t, entryItems, openWorkspaceEntry }: SessionTreeProps) {
   ...
               <ProjectRowItem
                 ...
+                extraMenuItems={entryItems}
+                onEntrySelect={(id) => {
+                  if (group.cwd !== undefined) openWorkspaceEntry(group.cwd, id)
+                }}
               />
 ...
 export function WorkspaceBrowser({ ..., renderSlot, workspaceEntryItems, t }: WorkspaceBrowserProps) {
   const workspaces = useWorkspaces(state => state.items)
+  const entryItems = workspaceEntryItems()
   ...
+  const [entryTarget, setEntryTarget] = useState<{ workspacePath: string; entryId: string; title: string } | null>(null)
+  const openWorkspaceEntry = (workspacePath: string, id: string) => {
+    const item = entryItems.find(entry => entry.id === id)
+    if (item === undefined) return
+    setEntryTarget({ workspacePath, entryId: id, title: item.label })
+  }
 ...
               <SessionTree
                 ...
+                entryItems={entryItems}
+                openWorkspaceEntry={openWorkspaceEntry}
 ...
       <Modal
         open={entryTarget !== null}
         onClose={() => { setEntryTarget(null) }}
         closeLabel={t('close')}
         title={entryTarget?.title ?? ''}
       >
         {entryTarget !== null && renderSlot('sidebar.workspaces.entry', { workspacePath: entryTarget.workspacePath }, { only: entryTarget.entryId })}
       </Modal>
```

### 2. apiproxy — `skill.list` exposes `source` (for scope filtering)

The skills-manager plugin needs to distinguish "global (user-level) skills" from "workspace (project-level) skills", but the existing `skill.list` wire projection deliberately doesn't expose `source` (see the original comment "provider/source vocabulary stays host-side"). This is a minimal relaxation, avoiding adding a listing RPC per scope:

```diff
--- a/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.ts
+++ b/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.ts
-/** Skill catalog row (wire projection of the host SkillSummary; provider/source vocabulary stays host-side). */
+/** Skill catalog row (wire projection of the host SkillSummary). */
 export interface SkillEntry {
   ...
   /** False marks a user-only skill ... */
   readonly modelInvocable: boolean
+  /**
+   * Host discovery source vocabulary (e.g. project-dsh, project-agents,
+   * user-dsh, user-agents, bundled, custom, runtime). Exposed so a feature
+   * plugin can distinguish globally-available skills from workspace-scoped
+   * ones without a second listing RPC.
+   */
+  readonly source: string
 }

--- a/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.schema.ts
+++ b/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.schema.ts
   modelInvocable: z.boolean(),
+  source: z.string().min(1),
 }) satisfies z.ZodType<Wire<SkillEntry>>

--- a/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts
+++ b/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts
             skills: skills.map(skill => ({
               name: skill.name,
               description: skill.description,
               ...skill.whenToUse === undefined ? {} : { whenToUse: skill.whenToUse },
               modelInvocable: skill.invocation.modelInvocable,
+              source: skill.source,
             })),
```

## Implementation progress (verified locally)

- `sidebar.workspaces.entry` list slot + `slots.entries()` projection + modal rendering: landed per the patch above; `tsc` + 121 tests pass.
- The workspace skills panel modal has been widened (`.skillsModal { width: min(760px, 92vw) }`) so the toolbar's "Disable selected" etc. no longer wrap/overflow at the default 380px width.
- Skill discovery now uses `skill.list`'s `cwd` branch (a workspace lists directly by path, no longer depending on an attached session); see the skill-list-source draft.
- Enforcement (disabled skills no longer appear in the model catalog) is fixed via the harness's "hard block wins across layers"; see section B of the skill-list-source draft.

## Questions to confirm

1. Does this `list` slot + `slots.entries()` projection + modal rendering direction match your plan for "workspace UI extensibility"? Or is there a more suitable seam I've missed?
2. If the direction works, I'd be glad to submit an implementation PR per repo conventions (including the `ui-workspace` declaration/rendering + a minimal demo plugin + tests).

## Related

- Existing discussion #1184 "Dynamic Cordis plugins registering into list slots always sort before shipped entries" — list slots + third-party plugin contributions are already an active topic, and this proposal is of the same origin.
- #1183 "Allow third-party plugins to expose their own settings namespaces…" — same theme of "give third-party plugins a UI extension surface".

discussions.title: Bug ? harness.run({ sessionId }) 在 per-request close() 之后无法从磁盘 JSONL 续会话 — 第二轮 finalResponse 为空，尽管已有 session.jsonl.zstd（npm 0.1.0-rc.6）
discussions.body:
标题

harness.run({ sessionId }) 在 per-request close() 之后无法从磁盘 JSONL 续会话 — 第二轮 finalResponse 为空，尽管已有 session.jsonl.zstd（npm 0.1.0-rc.6）

摘要

同一 sessionId，两轮各用一个新的 DeepSeekHarness，中间完整 close()（每请求起停子进程）。第一轮成功，并在 DSH_SESSION_ROOT 下写出 session.jsonl.zstd；第二轮 finalResponse 为空，模型也回忆不起第一轮内容。磁盘有文件 ≠ resume 成功。

这会挡住我们想要的产品用法：进程每请求关闭；多轮靠磁盘 session + 稳定 sessionId 续（不必整段 transcript 再灌进 prompt）。

环境

  • 依赖线：@deepseek-ai/dsh-* 0.1.0-rc.6
  • 运行时：Node（对官方 dsh-jsonrpc-agent / @deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-demo 的薄包装）
  • Cordis：静态配置，含 dsh-session-persistence-jsonl（root: process.env.DSH_SESSION_ROOT ?? './.sessions'）
  • Provider / model：deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash
  • API：已设置 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
  • 系统：macOS，临时目录作 cwd

复现步骤（最小）

  1. 建临时 cwd，设置：
    • DSH_CWD=<cwd>
    • DSH_SESSION_ROOT=<cwd>/.sessions
  2. 固定一个 UUID 作为 sessionId。
  3. 第一轮：新建 DeepSeekHarness → start() →
    run("请记住暗号 BANANA-42。只回复：OK", { sessionId }) →
    断言 finalResponse 含 OK → close()。
  4. 确认磁盘已有 .../<sessionId>/session.jsonl.zstd。
  5. 第二轮：再新建一个 DeepSeekHarness（新子进程），相同 env + 同一 sessionId，prompt 不要带任何历史前缀：
    run("我让你记住的暗号是什么？只回复暗号。", { sessionId }) → close()。

期望行为

  • 第二轮 finalResponse 非空，且包含 BANANA-42（或能证明记得上一轮）。
  • 同一 sessionId 能在进程边界外复用已落盘的 JSONL 会话。

实际行为

2026-08-14 复现两次：

  | 第一轮 | 第二轮 -- | -- | -- finalResponse | "OK" | ""（空） 磁盘 | 已有 session.jsonl.zstd | 仍在 记忆 | 暗号已写入会话文件 | 模型输出未体现

示例 session id：b765746c-9d6a-46fd-a929-183a7b9eac03
磁盘路径形态（DSH_SESSION_ROOT 下带 cwd 编码段 + session id）：
.../.sessions/<encoded-cwd>/<sessionId>/session.jsonl.zstd

测试边界说明

  • 不是「保活子进程」。每轮都是新 harness + 显式 close()。
  • 第二轮故意不注入 transcript 前缀；被测的唯一连续性路径是 sessionId + persistence 插件。
  • 开源 ai-sdk-provider-dsh 文档里每轮传 sessionId；在 resume 未 live 验证前，我们不能在产品侧接线。

影响

集成方无法安全地做 conversationId → sessionId。今天硬接，风险是第二轮空回复（比只用 history 前缀更差）。我们目前只保留 history 前缀，磁盘 resume 不接线。

希望确认

  1. 在 0.1.0-rc.6 上，run({ sessionId }) 在 close 后再开新进程 是否是受支持契约？
  2. 若是：正确的 env / session root / id / close 顺序是什么，才能让第二轮在 prompt 前加载 JSONL？
  3. 若否 / 有 bug：计划修哪个版本，或文档里标明「仅同进程有效」？

discussions.title: Session resume fails: Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is already registered (process-singleton registry collides between preset mounts)
[Bug 报告] Windows 下文件链接/产物点击无反应：路径含非 ASCII（中文）字符时 host.openPath 静默失败
discussions.body:
# [Bug 报告] Windows 下文件链接/产物点击无反应：路径含非 ASCII（中文）字符时 host.openPath 静默失败

> 目标仓库：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness（官方 Discussions）
> 提交日期：2026-08-14

## 环境

- Windows 11（10.0.22621），系统区域为简体中文
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局 + 桌面壳 deepseek-harness-desktop 0.3.4，二者同一份上游代码）
- 复现不依赖桌面壳：Web 端（浏览器打开 `dsh web`）同样复现

## 现象

1. 会话工作目录含中文（例如 `D:\项目\xxx`），agent 产生或引用了中文路径的文件；
2. 点击消息中的「产物」文件 chip 或文件提及；
3. 期望：系统默认应用打开该文件；实际：**完全无反应，无任何错误提示**。

ASCII 路径（例如 `C:\Users\...\Temp\a.txt`）点击**可以正常打开**。

## 最小复现（绕过 UI，直接调 host API）

对运行中的 `dsh web` host 发请求：

```http
POST /api/host.openPath
Content-Type: application/json

{"type":"client-request","rpcId":"repro","method":"host.openPath","payload":{"path":"C:\\Users\\<user>\\AppData\\Local\\Temp\\中文测试\\open_cn.txt"}}
```

响应（成功，但文件并未打开）：

```json
{"type":"server-response","rpcId":"repro","result":{"ok":true,"value":{"opened":true}}}
```

同一请求换成 ASCII 路径（`...\\Temp\\dshdiag\\open_ascii.txt`）→ 文件正常打开。

即：**host 返回 `opened: true`，但文件实际上没有打开**——错误被静默吞掉。

## 根因分析

`host.openPath` 的实现链路（`dsh-host-apiproxy`）：

```
host.openPath → openNativePath → openWindowsPath
  → runNativeCommand('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', "Invoke-Item -LiteralPath '<path>'"])
  → child_process.execFile(..., { encoding: 'utf8', windowsHide: true })
```

（见 `packages/api/.../native-path-opener.js` 的 `openWindowsPath` / `powershellLiteral`。）

当 `path` 含中文等非 ASCII 字符时，该 `powershell.exe -Command` 命令在 host 进程中**静默空转**：powershell 退出码 0（`execFile` 因此不报错、`openPath` 返回成功），但 `Invoke-Item` 没有任何实际效果（文件/目录/快捷方式均未打开，已用 .cmd 写标记文件、.lnk 快捷方式等验证过「彻底无副作用」）。ASCII 路径则完全正常。

- 前端侧 `openFile` 使用 `.catch(() => {})` 吞掉异常，所以用户看到的是「点了没反应」；
- host 侧 `openTarget` 只在命令失败（非零退出）时才返回 `ok: false`，而本场景是「退出 0 但无效果」，无法被发现。

同一机制下，Web 端（浏览器 + 普通 node host）与桌面端（Electron 壳）均复现，说明是**上游通用问题**，与桌面壳无关。

## 建议修复

在 `native-path-opener.js` 的 `openWindowsPath` 中，避免把含非 ASCII 字符的路径拼进 `-Command` 字符串：

1. 推荐：改用 PowerShell `-EncodedCommand`（base64 / UTF-16LE 编码整条命令，彻底规避命令行编码问题）：

   ```js
   const command = `Invoke-Item -LiteralPath ${powershellLiteral(path)}`;
   const encoded = Buffer.from(command, 'utf16le').toString('base64');
   await run('powershell.exe', ['-NoProfile', '-Command', '-EncodedCommand', encoded], signal);
   ```

2. 或改用不经过 PowerShell 字符串解析的方式，如 `cmd.exe /d /c start "" "<path>"`、`explorer.exe /select,"<path>"`，或 Windows 上的直接 ShellExecute 绑定。

## 影响面

- Windows 用户中，中文用户名/中文项目目录非常常见（本机 `C:\Users\Julliane` 恰好是 ASCII，但项目目录 `D:\项目\...` 为中文即触发）；
- 所有依赖 `host.openPath` 的入口（产物 chip、文件提及、目录「在文件夹中显示」）均受影响；
- Web 与桌面端通用。

## 备注

- 该仓库未开启 Issues，故以 Discussion 形式提交；
- 另已在桌面壳 steven-kid/deepseek-harness-desktop 同步提交 issue 跟踪（上游修复后的打包跟进）。

discussions.title: Web 输入框无法正常使用中文输入法预编辑文字
discussions.body:
# Web 输入框无法正常使用中文输入法预编辑文字

## 问题

在 DSH Web composer 中使用微信输入法拼音模式时，无法正常输入中文；同一输入法在其他网页、应用和终端中工作正常。

## 复现环境

- DSH：`0.1.0-rc.6`
- 官方仓库提交：`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- macOS：`26.5.1 (25F80)`
- Chrome：`151.0.7922.138`
- 输入法：微信输入法 `com.tencent.inputmethod.wetype.pinyin`
- 启动方式：`dsh web`

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 `dsh web`，打开任意会话。
2. 聚焦底部消息输入框。
3. 切换到微信输入法拼音模式。
4. 输入拼音并选择中文候选词。

实际结果：中文预编辑文字无法正常显示或输入。

预期结果：拼音预编辑文字和候选词选择过程正常可见，选词后中文完整保留在草稿中。

## 初步定位

`InputBar.module.css` 中真实 `textarea` 使用 `color: transparent`，可见文字由其下方的 `[data-input-backdrop]` 镜像层绘制：

- [`InputBar.module.css#L202-L218`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.module.css#L202-L218)
- [`InputBar.tsx#L689-L729`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx#L689-L729)

现有 `compositionstart` / `compositionend` 只维护按键保护用的 `composingRef`，没有处理原生预编辑文字的可见性：

- [`InputBar.tsx#L104-L119`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx#L104-L119)

CJK IME 的 preedit 文字由浏览器在原生输入控件中绘制；不同输入法/浏览器组合不保证在 composition 期间持续用普通 `input` 更新 React 镜像。因此真实 textarea 透明时，预编辑文字可能完全不可见。

## 已验证的本地 workaround

我用一个独立 Web client 插件验证了以下最小处理：

1. `compositionstart` 时给 composer textarea 添加临时属性；
2. composition 期间将真实 textarea 恢复为主题正文色；
3. 同期隐藏 `[data-input-backdrop]`，避免重复文字；
4. `compositionend` 后在下一个 task 恢复原有透明 textarea + backdrop；
5. `blur` 和插件卸载时清理临时状态。

核心 CSS：

```css
textarea[data-dsh-ime-composing] {
  color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary) !important;
  -webkit-text-fill-color: var(--dsw-alias-label-primary) !important;
}

[data-input-backdrop]:has(+ textarea[data-dsh-ime-composing]) {
  visibility: hidden !important;
}
```

浏览器组合事件验证结果：

- composition 期间：中文 value 保留，原生 textarea 为主题正文色，backdrop 隐藏；
- composition 结束后：临时属性清除，textarea 恢复透明，backdrop 恢复显示且中文草稿完整；
- 未改写 draft、提交、空格、回车或候选词按键逻辑。

## 建议验收

1. macOS + Chrome + 微信输入法输入 `zhongwen` 并选择“中文”，草稿正确显示“中文”；
2. composition 期间的空格、回车、方向键不触发提交或 DSH 快捷命令；
3. 中文、日本语、韩语至少各覆盖一个 IME smoke test；
4. 在 `input-bar.client.spec.tsx` 增加 composition 可见状态的回归测试，并保留现有 Safari 延迟清除按键保护。

discussions.title: Bug: 每次工具调用崩溃 reading 'prepare' — profile 内独立 dsh-tools 副本分裂 Symbol
discussions.body:
## Bug: 每次工具调用崩溃 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` — 根因是 profile 内独立 dsh-tools 副本分裂 Symbol

（Reading CONTRIBUTING.md 知悉外部 PR 暂不被接受，故以此 Discussion 形式报告 bug + 附上根因与已验证的修复方案，供团队采纳。）

### 现象

当 web profile 的 `package.json` 声明了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 依赖时，**每次** agent 工具调用（pwsh / read / glob / web_search …）都崩溃：

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
    at startCall (dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:194)
    at fillPool (dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:236)
    at runGroup (dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:245)
    at executeToolCalls (dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:135)
    at ReactLoopAgent.step (dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:666)
```

崩溃表达式是 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare()`，其中 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 为 `undefined`。turn 以 `code: UNKNOWN` 结束。

### 根因

同一进程里加载了**两份物理上不同的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`**：

| 副本 | 位置 | 来源 |
|---|---|---|
| 运行时（agent-loop 等） | `.../node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | harness 内嵌依赖 |
| profile 层 | `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` | `dsh plugin`（pnpm）装进 profile 的独立副本 |

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 导出了模块级 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` `Symbol`。每份副本持有各自**互不相等**的 Symbol：

- `dsh-agent-loop` 从宿主闭包解析 dsh-tools，用它那份 Symbol 做查找；
- `ctx.tools`（ToolRuntime 服务）由 profile 副本构造，其实例字段 `[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 用**自己那份** Symbol 写入。

两份 Symbol 不等 → agent-loop 的查找读不到 → `undefined` → 每次工具调用必崩。我用模块加载探针确认了两份都在启动时被加载；把 profile 副本指向宿主实例后，该查找恢复可解析。

### 为什么现有防护没拦住

`healProfilesModuleFallback`（`packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`）已确立"单一模块实例"契约：把应用依赖闭包里的每个包 symlink 进 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules`，注释也写明 "every plugin shares the installation's single cordis instance instead of a duplicate"。但这只覆盖**经由 fallback 目录的解析**。一旦 profile 自己 `package.json` 声明了 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（`dsh plugin add`、pnpm peer 提升、或手改），pnpm 会在 profile 的 `node_modules` 下落一份**真实副本**，Node 从 profile 目录向上查找时**先命中这份副本**，fallback 根本轮不到 → 重复实例存活。

### 复现

1. `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`
2. 让 `~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json` 含 `"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "0.1.0-rc.6"`，并在 profile 目录跑 `pnpm install`（独立 dsh-tools 落进 `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/`）。
3. `dsh web` → 新建/恢复会话 → 让 agent 调任意工具。
4. 工具调用崩，重试仍崩，turn 以 `reading 'prepare'` 结束。

### 影响

任何让 profile 积累了**带共享模块级 Symbol 的 harness 包**（dsh-tools 是最明确的；其它共享 Symbol 的包同理）的 profile，工具调用即不可用。`dsh plugin` 是裸 pnpm 转发器、对无 bundle 依赖只打 warning，很容易无意间把 harness 包装进 profile。

### 建议修复（已在本地验证）

在 `apps/cli/src/plugin.ts` 的 `runPlugin` 成功路径（`reconcilePlugins` 之后）新增一步 `relinkHostPackages`：审计 profile 依赖，凡是**从宿主安装解析**（`resolveBundleDir` 已按 installAnchor 优先）但 profile 侧又持有**独立真实副本**的包，把 profile 侧替换成指向宿主安装的 junction/symlink，恢复单一模块实例（单一 Symbol）。宿主闭包外的第三方插件从 profile 侧解析、不受影响；幂等（realpath 相等即跳过）。

```ts
function relinkHostPackages(profileDir: string): void {
  const manifest = readProfileManifest(NAME, profileDir)
  for (const packageName of Object.keys(manifest.dependencies ?? {})) {
    let hostDir: string
    try {
      hostDir = resolveBundleDir(NAME, packageName, INSTALL_ANCHOR, profileDir)
    } catch { continue }
    const profileCopy = join(profileDir, 'node_modules', ...packageName.split('/'))
    if (!existsSync(join(profileCopy, 'package.json'))) continue
    const hostReal = realpathSync(join(hostDir, 'package.json'))
    const copyReal = realpathSync(join(profileCopy, 'package.json'))
    if (hostReal === copyReal) continue
    rmSync(profileCopy, { recursive: true, force: true })
    mkdirSync(dirname(profileCopy), { recursive: true })
    symlinkSync(hostDir, profileCopy, process.platform === 'win32' ? 'junction' : 'dir')
  }
}
```

配套在 `runPlugin` 成功后调用 `reconcilePlugins(before, dir); relinkHostPackages(dir)`。这样每次 `dsh plugin add/update/install/remove` 既修复既有 profile，也自愈转发器可能引入的重复。

我已把该改动落在 `apps/cli/src/plugin.ts`（分支 `fix/plugin-relink-host-packages`，位于我的 fork `yinsang0910-star/deepseek-harness`），因官方暂不收外部 PR 而未发起 PR。若团队愿意采纳，可直接取用或联系我调整。

### 附带验证

- 模块加载探针：确认 host 与 profile 两份 dsh-tools 同时加载。
- relink 后 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]`（用 agent-loop 同款 Symbol 查）恢复可解析。
- 模拟 relink 逻辑：独立副本 → junction 指向宿主 ✓；第三方依赖不动 ✓；幂等重跑 no-op ✓；junction 的 `lstatSync().isSymbolicLink()` 为 true ✓。

discussions.title: [Bug Report]：Windows 上 dsh plugin 的含空格路径参数会被拆断
discussions.body:
# [Bug Report]：Windows 上 `dsh plugin` 的含空格路径参数会被拆断

我在用 Open Design 桌面版（把 DeepSeek Harness 作为设计引擎）时报错：它自动安装连接组件 `@open-design/dsh-runtime` 失败，报
`DeepSeek Harness could not install the Open Design connection component.`。查下来根因在 dsh ，所以提交这个 bug。

## 1. 环境

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh | 0.1.0-rc.6 |
| 系统 | Windows 11，PowerShell 5.1 |
| Node.js | v22.21.1 |
| pnpm | 任意近期版本，与版本无关 |

复现不需要 Open Design，本地任意一个含空格的包路径就能触发。

## 2. 复现步骤

```powershell
# 把任意一个有效 .tgz 放到含空格的目录里
$dir = "$env:USERPROFILE\my plugins"
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $dir -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item .\some-package-0.0.0.tgz "$dir\some-package-0.0.0.tgz" -Force

dsh plugin --profile test add "$dir\some-package-0.0.0.tgz"
```

Open Design 的场景等价于这条命令，它的连接组件默认路径带空格：

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile open-design add "C:\Users\Pii\AppData\Local\Programs\Open Design\resources\open-design\agent-runtimes\deepseek-harness\open-design-dsh-runtime-0.1.0.tgz"
```

## 3. 实际行为 vs 期望行为

安装失败，每次必现。路径在空格处被拆成两段传给 pnpm。前半段（`...\Programs\Open`）被 pnpm 当成一个不存在的路径规格，报 ENOENT；后半段（`Design\resources\...\x.tgz`）变成多余参数，按相对路径从 profile 目录解析。实际报错：

```text
ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\Pii\.dsh\profiles\open-design\Design\resources\open-design\agent-runtimes\deepseek-harness\open-design-dsh-runtime-0.1.0.tgz'
```

Open Design 安装器对用户显示的是：

```text
DeepSeek Harness could not install the Open Design connection component.
No agent selection was changed.
```

期望 pnpm 把完整路径当一个参数收下，安装成功。

## 4. 根因

`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts` 的 `runPlugin`（[源码](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/cli/src/plugin.ts#L129-L133)）在 Windows 上用 `shell: true` 转发 pnpm，参数不转义：

```ts
const result = spawnSync('pnpm', args.map(argument => anchorPathSpec(argument, process.cwd())), {
  cwd: dir,
  stdio: 'inherit',
  shell: process.platform === 'win32',
})
```

拆开看有三个细节：

- `anchorPathSpec` 只重写相对路径（`.`、`..`、`file:`、`link:`），绝对路径原样透传，它自己的注释就写着 "Absolute specs ... pass through untouched"。
- Node 的 `shell: true` 把命令和参数用空格拼成一行交给 cmd.exe，不做转义。Node 22 起对这个用法打 DEP0190 弃用警告。
- 仓库里其实已经记录过这个坑。`scripts/verify-node-next-types.ts` 的注释写 "shell:true, which space-joins args UNESCAPED (DEP0190) — a hazard"，那里改用 `execFileSync(process.execPath, [...])` 绕开了，`runPlugin` 没跟上。

我在本机验证过：`spawnSync(node, ['-e', …, 'C:/…/Open Design/…/x.tgz'], { shell: true })`，cmd 在空格处就把参数拆了，报 `'C:\Program' is not recognized`。

## 5. 影响范围

触发条件是 Windows、本地路径规格（tarball、目录或 `file:`）、路径带空格，三个凑齐必现。从 registry 装包（`dsh plugin add @scope/pkg`）不受影响，包名没空格；macOS 和 Linux 上 `shell` 是 false，也不受影响。

受害的集成有 Open Design 桌面版，它自动装连接组件时路径在 `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Programs\Open Design\...`，必然撞上。

严重性算中等：报错清晰、不损坏数据，但确定性强，报错内容也不会让人联想到空格问题，还挡住了一个真实的三方集成。建议 P2。

## 6. 临时规避

先把 tarball 复制到无空格路径再 add：

```powershell
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\od-runtime" -Force | Out-Null
Copy-Item "C:\Users\Pii\AppData\Local\Programs\Open Design\resources\open-design\agent-runtimes\deepseek-harness\open-design-dsh-runtime-0.1.0.tgz" `
          "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\od-runtime\open-design-dsh-runtime-0.1.0.tgz" -Force
dsh plugin --profile open-design add "$env:USERPROFILE\.dsh\od-runtime\open-design-dsh-runtime-0.1.0.tgz"
```

## 7. 修复方向

两个办法：

1. 找到 pnpm 的 JS 入口（`.cmd` 背后的 `pnpm.cjs`），用 `spawnSync(process.execPath, [pnpmJs, ...args], { shell: false })` 启动。参数数组语义由 Node 保证，不经 shell 拼接，这也是 `verify-node-next-types.ts` 已经在用的办法。推荐这个。
2. 保留 `shell: true`，但对每个参数做 cmd 引号转义。能修，顺带消掉 DEP0190 警告。

## 8. 备注

行号和源码链接基于 master 当前代码（`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts`、`scripts/verify-node-next-types.ts`）。Open Design 只是发现场景，最小复现见 §2，不依赖它。

discussions.title: [Idea] goal 等待子代理时 idle 轮次过密，容易误判卡住并中断正常子代理
discussions.body:
现象(工作区 2026-08-14 会话日志实测)
1、idle 轮短间隔触发：等待子代理期间 8 分钟内跑了 27 轮，间隔 7.4-73.6 秒，其中 8-14 秒的密集段大量存在。
2、模型把"轮次数"当成"已等待时长"：一个判官类子代理 12:08:40 派出，12:10:16 被 interrupt（96 秒），12:10:43（123 秒）模型判定"它已经跑了 9 轮……放弃这个判官"并再次 interrupt。该子代理实际 12:22:12 完成，全程 13.5 分钟——正是该类任务的正常速度（P50=14 分钟）。2 分钟内攒出的 9 个空转轮被当成"等了很久"，对还需要约 12 分钟的健康子代理发出了中断并放弃。

根因：goal idle-round driver 数轮不读秒，模型无墙钟感知，轮次数被误当等待时长——轮越密，误判来得越快。

建议：存在运行中子代理时，抑制或节流 goal 的 idle 轮；仅当按任务类别的墙钟预算（普通 ~10 分钟 / 判官类 ~30 分钟，⚠ 建议值）耗尽且无产出时，才触发 idle/blocked 提示，并附证据（agent createdAt / 最后文件 mtime / 产出文件）。

参考先例：esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix PR #6960（reset idleTurns to prevent premature idle intercept，已合并）：https://github.com/esengine/DeepSeek-Reasonix/pull/6960

discussions.title: [Bug] --llm agent 在 DeepSeek Harness 中遇 408 即整批退出，pending calls 无法被后续会话认领，前端进度冻结
discussions.body:
# [Bug] `auto --llm agent` 在 translate 阶段静默退出并留下未认领 pending calls，手动 claim 后前端进度仍不更新

## 现象 / Symptom

使用 `baocut auto <project> --llm agent --lang zh-Hans` 进行韩语到中文的翻译任务时，pipeline 在 translate 阶段多次以 `HTTP 408: no agent answered call <id> within 1800s` 退出。退出后：

- `task status` 中仍存在大量 `pendingCalls`，但 `workerPlans` 为空；
- 手动 `task claim` + `task submit` 能继续推进翻译，但 `studio/progress.json` 不再更新；
- 网页版 Subtitle Studio 的进度条和 `callsDone` 完全冻结，用户无法确认任务是否仍在执行；
- 整个项目处于“实际在跑，视觉上卡死”的状态，只能靠外部 monitor 脚本轮询文件系统确认。

## 复现 / Reproduce

```bash
# 1. 创建项目并启动 auto pipeline
BAOCUT_SKILL_ROOT=<skill-dir> \
  ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.stepfun.com/step_plan \
  ANTHROPIC_MODEL=step-3.7-flash \
  ANTHROPIC_AUTH_TOKEN=<token> \
  BCUT_LLM_MAX_WORKERS=1 \
  <skill-dir>/bin/baocut auto "<project>" --llm agent --lang zh-Hans --jsonl

# 2. 等待 translate 阶段出现以下日志后 pipeline 退出：
# {"event":"error","kind":"io","message":"HTTP 408: no agent answered call c0113 within 1800s — run `bcut task claim` in another session"}

# 3. 在另一个会话中手动 claim：
bcut task claim "<project>" --worker w1 --timeout 60 --kinds translate --json
# 返回一个 pending call，此时 task status 中 completedCount 增加，但 pendingCount 不变

# 4. 提交答案后，再次检查：
bcut task status "<project>" --json
# completedCount 继续增加，pendingCount 持续为 0，但：
cat "<project>/studio/progress.json"
# 仍显示旧的 callsDone / linesDone / pct，网页前端无任何变化
```

## 环境 / Environment

- BaoCut skill：`~/.agents/skills/baocut`（macOS）
- CLI：`bcut` 1.0.4-build.39（cached）
- LLM：StepFun `step-3.7-flash` via DeepSeek Harness `--llm agent`
- `BCUT_LLM_MAX_WORKERS=1`
- 项目：`测试视频.bcut`（941 行韩语音频，MOSS + WeSpeaker ASR）

## 建议 / Suggestion

1. **408 后自动恢复**：当 producer 因 `no agent answered call` 退出时，应在 task 元数据中标记“可恢复”，并允许新的 `auto` 或 `task claim` 会话无缝接续，而不是留下一个已死 task。
2. **手动 loop 同步进度**：`task submit` 成功后，应由 CLI 或 hook 更新 `studio/progress.json` 的 `callsDone` / `linesDone` / `pct`，使前端与真实完成度一致。
3. **worker pool 预热**：`auto` 的 agent worker pool 应在 `task` 事件阶段提前预热，而不是在 `batch-dispatch` 后才启动，避免 1800s 超时。
4. **RPM 限流自动退避**：遇到 `request limited RPM reached` 时，内置指数退避重试，不要将错误抛给用户或中断 pipeline。

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] 关掉终端 dsh 就没了？我做了一个 macOS 常驻服务管理器
discussions.body:
这两天折腾 dsh 挺开心的。Everything is a plugin 这个理念在 agent harness 上落地得比我预期的要干净，Cordis 那套组合方式也值得慢慢来看，感谢官方把它开源出来。

我这两天试 DSH 时碰到一个很实际的问题：npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 会一直占着终端，关掉终端或者重启电脑之后都得手动再跑一次。于是花一天写了个小东西——DSH Service。

它不是桌面套壳，也没有改官方的 Web UI，只是单纯把 DSH 安装成一个 macOS 用户服务：登录自启、异常退出自动拉起。顺带因为它接管了安装这一步，版本也就固定下来了，更新失败会自动回滚到上一个健康版本。

目前只有 macOS 版。Linux 版正在做；Windows 我手头没有设备，实在没法测，如果有用 Windows 的朋友愿意一起来搞就太好了。

也先讲清楚定位：这是个临时方案，不是要跟官方抢什么。哪天官方出了自己的服务化方案或者桌面端，这个项目就该退场，我会很高兴地在 README 上写 deprecated。在那之前，如果它能帮到同样被绊住的人，那就够了。

仓库：https://github.com/TristanXS/dsh-service （MIT，中英双语 README）

```bash
git clone https://github.com/TristanXS/dsh-service.git
cd dsh-service && ./install.sh
dsh-service status
dsh-service open
```

**它和 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 有什么不同**

前台 npx | dsh-service
-- | --
跑在当前终端里，关了就没 | 一个 per-user LaunchAgent，登录即起
进程退出就停 | 异常退出后自动重启
没有状态可查，也没有恢复机制 | 生命周期命令和更新都走健康检查
每次都要手动敲命令启动 | 安装版本化 release，激活失败自动回滚

**几个我觉得值得说的设计**

- 不跑 npx。 安装和更新会把 @deepseek-ai/dsh 解析到一棵私有的、版本化的 release 目录树里，并记录 Node 可执行文件的绝对路径，由 launchd 直接调用入口。好处是"当前跑的是哪一版"一直是明确可查的，换版本只发生在你显式执行 update 的时候。

- 更新是事务式的，中断也能恢复。 先 stage 并校验候选版本，写一份 activation journal，切换 current / previous 链接，再启动服务并验证端口归属和 Web 健康——全部通过才清 journal、剪枝旧版本；候选不健康就恢复并验证上一个版本。就算回滚本身被打断，manager 也不会删掉未验证的 release，status 会报 interrupted，跑一次 restart 把记录的激活过程走完。

- 卸载不动你的数据。 ~/.dsh 是 DSH 自己的用户状态，manager 不碰它；uninstall 清掉所有 manager 拥有的路径，但完整保留 ~/.dsh——这条在 smoke test 里是显式验证的。

installer 自身的事务性、完整路径清单和各状态的恢复语义都写在 README 里了。

**关于安全，有件事得说在前面**

这不是我的发现，也不是 DSH Service 引入的问题：@mxym 在 #250 里指出，DSH 的 Web 控制面目前只靠 loopback 可达性判断调用者身份，并不区分"用户的浏览器"和"本机其他进程"——sandbox 内的模型进程可以连上同一个控制面替用户回答 approval，他也给出了实机复现。建议直接读原帖，比我转述准确。

常驻会放大这个问题的暴露时间：以前只有我开着终端时它才在，现在是我一登录它就在，崩了还自动拉起。所以：

服务只绑 127.0.0.1，本版本没有端口设置，也不会提供 --host 0.0.0.0 这样的开关
在上游修复之前，不建议把它跑在存有敏感凭据的机器上
只绑 loopback 只是减少了网络层面的暴露，它不会把 DSH 关进沙箱，也不会验证本机调用者的身份

常驻确实方便，但这份方便是有代价的，我觉得应该先讲清楚。

**现状**

Public alpha。验证环境 macOS 26.5.2 / arm64 / DSH 0.1.0-rc.6，live smoke 覆盖 install、status、restart、同版本 update、stop、start、uninstall。跨版本激活目前只有隔离测试覆盖——公开发布至今只有一个版本，还没出现过真实的版本跳变，下一版发布时我会把实测补上。换个环境不一定能跑，v1.0 之前命令和路径也可能还会变。

DSH Service 的 bug 请提到它自己的仓库（https://github.com/TristanXS/dsh-service/issues ），别开到官方这边来。附上 macOS 版本、架构、Node 版本和 dsh-service status 输出（不要贴 API key 或 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 的内容）。平台需求去 https://github.com/TristanXS/dsh-service/discussions 说一声，我按呼声排优先级。

discussions.title: 长任务链很需要一个折叠功能，但是插件实现不了
discussions.body:
我自己尝试制作折叠功能 但是失败了 只能做一个抛弃某些功能的版本
常见的功能完全可以复刻
cordis 专属卡片（状态 / 业务视图 / 审批按钮）这种就不行
而且自己做的插件只能完全覆盖 做不到只折叠基础卡片 完全不动这些

下面是ai给的长篇回复

## 落点：`ChatView.tsx` 的 `order.map`

`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx`（当前 master 约 L382）里：

```tsx
{order.map(nodeKey => <ChatNodeSeat key={nodeKey} ... />)}
```

每个节点被渲染成**一个独立的 `div.flowItem`**（`ChatNodeSeat.tsx` L41-48），内部再 `renderSlot('conversation.chat.node', ...)`。所以"把连续 N 个工具包进一个折叠容器"这个动作，只可能发生在 `order.map` 这一层——这里对 `order` 做一次 `groupConsecutive`（连续的 `tool-call` / `context` 各成一组），组内节点继续原样走 `ChatNodeSeat → renderSlot('conversation.chat.node')`，容器用 `dsh-client-ui-primitives` 现成的 `DisclosureRow`。

关键收益：**所有原生卡片原封不动**——`ToolCallTree` → `tool.call.toolview` → cordis 专属卡片（状态 / 业务视图 / 审批按钮）整条链路不断。

## 为什么"动态插件做"走不通（这是多数人会先试的直觉）

Harness 是 everything-is-a-plugin，直觉上"写个插件 shadow 掉 tool-call 渲染器就行"。但实测源码发现三道硬墙：

1. **`renderSlot` 是按 entry 授权的**。`packages/client/web-react/src/scoped-slots.tsx` L47-50：renderSlot 只能调当前 entry 自己 `children` 表里声明的 key，否则抛 `SlotOwnershipError`。
2. **子槽声明全局唯一**。`packages/client/ui-slots/src/index.ts` L825-832：`tool.call.toolview` 是 `tool-call` entry 在 register 时用 `children` 声明的（`ui-tool/src/client/apply.ts` L27-29），重声明直接 `already declared`。
3. **shadow ≠ dispose**。用更低 `priority` shadow 掉的只是渲染优先级，原 entry 仍在注册表、其声明仍占用；只有 `dispose` 才会 collapse 声明（`releaseEntry`，L1129-1149），而那个 disposer 捏在宿主包手里，动态插件拿不到。

于是死锁成立：shadow 后想调 `renderSlot('tool.call.toolview')` → 没声明 → `SlotOwnershipError`；想补声明 → 原声明还在 → `already declared`。cordis 卡片依赖的正是 `tool.call.toolview`（`ui-cordis/src/client/index.ts` L115-134）+ 内部 inject 注入链，所以插件只能手写简化版，做不成"完全一致"。

还有一个独立于 cordis 的结构墙：tool-call 组件是**单节点作用域**，只活在 `ChatNodeSeat` 的 `flowItem` 内部，跨不出这个 div 去包邻居——所以"连续 N 个折成一行"物理上只能回到 `order.map` 层。

## 建议的实现方案（供 maintainer 取舍）

- **方案 A（最小改动）**：在 `ChatView` 里做分组预处理，无需新扩展点。
- **方案 B（更插件化）**：给 `ChatView` 暴露一个"节点列表分组/包裹"扩展点（新 slot 或 wrap 回调），折叠逻辑独立成一个包，社区可自行开关。

无论哪种，都有几条实测过的约束必须保留：

1. **运行中 / 待审批 turn 永不折叠**（否则 `cordis_run` 阻塞在审批上会把模型卡死）；
2. 分组只作用于**顶层**连续 `tool-call` 节点，**不拍平子调用树**（`ToolCallTree` 的 `subCalls` 递归保留）；
3. 不破坏每个节点的稳定锚点（`data-chat-anchor-key` / `data-chat-flow-key`，被 `chatScroll`/paging 依赖）；
4. 正在流式解码的尾步保持展开。

如果方向认可，我可以基于 `ChatView.tsx` 出一个最小可用的 draft patch（`groupConsecutive` + `DisclosureRow`），供 PR 参考。

---

说明：文中行号是当前 master 的相对定位，粘贴前可让 maintainer 按组件名（`ChatView` / `ChatNodeSeat` / `ToolCallTree` / `SlotCore.register`）锚定，避免因版本漂移对不上。

discussions.title: [Feature request] Expose `source` on `skill.list` + allow listing by `cwd` (workspace scope)
discussions.body:
## Background

I'm writing a ["skills manager" plugin](https://github.com/royenheart/MaintainAll/tree/main/apps/dsh-plugin-skills-manager) for dsh that enables/disables skills across three scopes — **session > workspace > global**. On the host side the plugin enforces "disabled" via a rank-50 skill provider; on the client side it reuses the existing `skill.list` RPC rather than adding a custom listing.

While building the scope filtering I hit a wall. To render the right set per panel —

| Panel | Should list | Distinction needed |
|---|---|---|
| Global settings | Only **global** skills (`user-dsh` / `user-agents`) | global vs workspace |
| Workspace | Global + workspace skills (`project-dsh` / `project-agents`) | same |
| Session | Global + workspace skills | same |

— the client must be able to tell a user-level skill from a project-level skill / global-level skill. Today it cannot: `skill.list` is session-addressed (it returns the session's project + user skills merged) and its wire rows carry no `source`.

## Current state (why `source` is not on the wire)

This omission is deliberate, not accidental. `SkillEntry`'s comment currently reads:

```ts
/** Skill catalog row (wire projection of the host SkillSummary; provider/source vocabulary stays host-side). */
```

and the skill subsystem docs (`docs/subsystems/skills.md`) state the same principle for the model-facing catalog:

> The catalog contains sorted skill `name` and normalized, XML-escaped `description` only; it **omits bodies, paths, sources, providers, and routing hints**.

That decision is reasonable for its original purpose:

1. **Minimize the exposure surface** — the model's `<available_skills>` reminder and the `/`-trigger picker only need `name` + `description` to decide whether to load a skill; they don't need its origin.
2. **Don't leak host-side implementation details** — `path` / `provider` could expose local directories or provider identity (a privacy/trust boundary), and the `source` vocabulary is **open** (see below), so pinning it as a stable wire contract would couple consumers to every new source.

The existing client simply never needed the distinction; a scope-aware manager plugin does.

## Proposal

Expose `source` on `SkillEntry` — a coarse, open string label (not a path, not a provider identity) — so feature plugins can distinguish globally-available skills from workspace-scoped ones without a second listing RPC. A companion change lets `skill.list` be addressed by `cwd` (instead of only an attached session), so a workspace-scoped panel can list that workspace's skills.

Why relaxing `source` is safe:

- `SkillSource` is itself an **open string label**, not a path, not a provider identity, and carries no sensitive information:
  ```ts
  export type SkillSource = 'project-dsh' | 'project-agents' | 'runtime' | 'user-dsh' | 'user-agents' | 'custom' | 'bundled' | (string & {})
  ```
- The trailing `(string & {})` keeps it **forward-compatible**: a new source never breaks the wire contract; a client just sees a literal it doesn't recognize.
- It does not leak disk paths (`project-agents` is a category name, not the concrete `<project>/.agents/skills` path).

## Appendix: full implementation patch

> Verified in the local worktree: `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` and `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` both 0 errors.

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.ts`:

```diff
-/** Skill catalog row (wire projection of the host SkillSummary; provider/source vocabulary stays host-side). */
+/** Skill catalog row (wire projection of the host SkillSummary). */
 export interface SkillEntry {
   /** Kebab-case identifier the user references as /name in the composer. */
   readonly name: string
   /** Short routing description. */
   readonly description: string
   /** Optional extra routing guidance. */
   readonly whenToUse?: string
   /** False marks a user-only skill (disable-model-invocation): invocable here, absent from the model catalog. */
   readonly modelInvocable: boolean
+  /**
+   * Host discovery source vocabulary (e.g. project-dsh, project-agents,
+   * user-dsh, user-agents, bundled, custom, runtime). Exposed so a feature
+   * plugin can distinguish globally-available skills from workspace-scoped
+   * ones without a second listing RPC.
+   */
+  readonly source: string
 }
```

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.schema.ts`:

```diff
 export const skillEntrySchema = z.object({
   name: z.string().min(1),
   description: z.string(),
   whenToUse: z.string().optional(),
   modelInvocable: z.boolean(),
+  source: z.string().min(1),
 }) satisfies z.ZodType<Wire<SkillEntry>>
```

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`:

```diff
             skills: skills.map(skill => ({
               name: skill.name,
               description: skill.description,
               ...skill.whenToUse === undefined ? {} : { whenToUse: skill.whenToUse },
               modelInvocable: skill.invocation.modelInvocable,
+              source: skill.source,
             })),
```

(Since `source` becomes required, the two test fixtures that hand-construct this wire type must add the field too: `packages/client/connection/src/client/fixture.ts` and `packages/host/apiproxy/tests/fetch-carrier.spec.ts`.)

## Appendix: full implementation patch (II) — `skill.list` supports listing by `cwd`

The workspace scope has no usable "attached" session: `skill.list`'s session-addressed path requires `ctx.sessions.get()` to hit a session already loaded in memory, while `WorkspaceView.sessionIds` is a persisted account that may contain sessions left over from a previous run and not currently attached. More importantly, the web profile sets the base host `skill-filesystem` row `disabled: true` (`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`, whose comment says "presets own local discovery"), so skill discovery moved to each preset's own scope layer — thus simply calling `skillRegistry.list()` with `cwd` and `scope: undefined` cannot reach the filesystem provider and yields an empty catalog.

Minimal and general solution: relax the request from `{ sessionId }` to `{ sessionId?; cwd? }`, and in the `cwd` branch resolve the **default preset's standing key** as the scope:

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.ts`:

```diff
 export interface SkillsApi {
-  /** Lists the user-invocable skill catalog for the session's project. */
-  list(request: RpcRequest<{ sessionId: SessionId }>): Promise<RpcResponse<{ skills: readonly SkillEntry[] }>>
+  /** Lists the user-invocable skill catalog by sessionId (resolves its cwd) or by cwd. */
+  list(request: RpcRequest<{ sessionId?: SessionId; cwd?: string }>): Promise<RpcResponse<{ skills: readonly SkillEntry[] }>>
 }
```

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/skills.schema.ts`:

```diff
 export const skillListRequestSchema = z.object({
-  sessionId: sessionIdSchema,
+  sessionId: sessionIdSchema.optional(),
+  cwd: z.string().min(1).optional(),
 }) satisfies z.ZodType<Wire<RequestPayload<'skill.list'>>>
```

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` (key handler branch):

```diff
       async list(request) {
-        const { sessionId } = request.payload
-        const session = ctx.sessions.get(sessionId)
-        if (session === undefined) return err(request, { code: 'session-not-found', ... })
-        ...
-        const cwd = session.header.cwd
+        const { sessionId, cwd: directCwd } = request.payload
+        const presets = ctx.get('agentPresets')
+        let cwd: string
+        let scope: ScopeKey | undefined
+        if (directCwd !== undefined) {
+          cwd = directCwd
+          scope = undefined
+          if (presets !== undefined) {
+            try {
+              // Workspace listing has no session; use the default preset's
+              // standing key so its per-scope skill providers (filesystem) resolve.
+              scope = await presets.standingKeyFor()
+            } catch { scope = undefined }
+          }
+        } else if (sessionId !== undefined) {
+          // ... existing session resolution + presenterScopeFor ...
+        } else {
+          return err(request, { code: 'bad-request', message: 'skill.list requires sessionId or cwd', ... })
+        }
+        ...
       }
```

(`presets.standingKeyFor()` without an id returns the standing scope of `defaultId`; see `packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts`.)

> Verified locally: `POST /api/skill.list { "payload": { "cwd": "<workspace>" } }` returns that project's + user skills (with `source`); previously it was an empty array.

## Appendix: two robustness and enforcement notes

### A. A provider with an empty `description` drags down the whole session (suggestion: default to disable + warn, instead of throw)

`ctx.skills.registerProvider`'s `list` candidates enforce `description.length > 0` in `validateCandidate`, otherwise it throws (`skill provider "…" returned skill "…" without a description`), and that throw bubbles up to the agent request, breaking the whole conversation.

An enforcement provider for "disabled skills" (like this plugin) naturally returns a placeholder candidate for blocked skills — if the placeholder description is empty it triggers the crash above. A plugin can work around it by filling a non-empty description (I do), but it's more robust for the registry to **degrade to "disabled" and warn** for a candidate with no description rather than throw, so a typo in any third-party provider can't drag down the session.

### B. A global enforcement provider is shadowed by the per-preset filesystem (web profile)

The web profile sets the base host `skill-filesystem` row `disabled: true` (`packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml`), with discovery moved to each preset's own scope layer. And the `ctx.skills` registry merges "global layer + scope chain", where **a nearer layer's same-name entry overrides a farther layer's** (in `collectFresh`, `merged.set(name, entry)` runs per layer in order, and rank only decides within a single layer).

So an enforcement provider registered in the **global layer** (rank 50) is entirely shadowed by `skill-filesystem` (rank 100–600) in the preset layer — a disabled skill still appears in the catalog with `modelInvocable: true`. For cross-scope disabling plugins this is fatal: to enforce via a provider you'd have to register on the same layer as the filesystem (the preset layer) or a nearer layer.

**General fix already adopted** (make a "hard block" win across layers in `collectFresh`, deny wins):

```diff
   for (const layer of layers) {
     const collected = await this.collectLayer(layer, options)
     if (!collected.cacheable) cacheable = false
-    for (const entry of collected.entries) merged.set(entry.candidate.name, entry)
+    for (const entry of collected.entries) {
+      const existing = merged.get(entry.candidate.name)
+      // A fully-disabled candidate is a hard block: a nearer layer must not revive it.
+      if (existing !== undefined
+        && existing.candidate.invocation.modelInvocable === false
+        && existing.candidate.invocation.userInvocable === false) continue
+      merged.set(entry.candidate.name, entry)
+    }
   }
```

That is: treat "fully disabled (`modelInvocable:false && userInvocable:false`)" as a deny that a nearer layer must not revive; ordinary same-name replacement (shadow) still follows nearest-layer-wins. This is a first-class registry semantic, independent of any profile or specific plugin (a no-op in base/headless, restoring deny absoluteness in web). Verified locally: after disabling, `skill.list` no longer returns that skill, and `tool-skill`'s `snapshot().filter(isModelInvocable)` also filters it out of the model catalog.

**Not implemented, discussion-only alternative**: make "fully disabled" an explicit `SkillCandidate.blocked?: true` (rather than inferring from the invocation combination `modelInvocable:false && userInvocable:false`). An explicit field is clearer and can't be misread as "user-only invocable (`modelInvocable:false, userInvocable:true`)", but it adds API surface; for now I use the combination check, keeping the minimal zero-new-API change.

## Questions to confirm

1. Is resolving the default preset's standing key in the `cwd` branch (already merged into `skill.list`) appropriate? Is there a more canonical "get a scope without a session" entry point worth splitting into a separate `skill.listByCwd`?
2. Should `source` be tightened to an explicit enum (dropping the open `(string & {})` tail) before going on the wire? I lean toward keeping the open string, to avoid breaking the contract with new sources.
3. If the direction works, I'd be glad to submit an implementation PR per repo conventions.

## Related

- `docs/subsystems/skills.md` — the original design description "catalog omits bodies, paths, sources, providers, and routing hints".
- Discussion #1183 "Allow third-party plugins to expose their own settings namespaces…" — same theme of "give third-party plugins a minimal UI/interface extension surface".

discussions.title: Show & Tell: ACN plugin for DeepSeek Harness — agent-to-agent collaboration
discussions.body:
# Show & Tell: ACN plugin for DeepSeek Harness — agent-to-agent collaboration

We built a plugin that lets DeepSeek Harness agents join the ACN (Agent Collaboration Network) — so your agents can **discover each other, send messages, and collaborate across agent instances**.

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:acnlabs/dsh-plugin-acn
```

Restart `dsh --profile web` and tell the agent to join ACN. That's it.

## What agents get

- `acn_join` — register on the network
- `acn_agents_search` — find other agents by capability
- `acn_message_send` — message them directly
- `acn_inbox_list` — check incoming messages

## Why we built it

Most agent tooling today assumes one developer orchestrating agents they wrote themselves. We keep running into the case where agents from different teams or instances need to work together — and that coordination layer (registry, discovery, messaging) shouldn't have to be rebuilt every time.

The plugin is fully open source (MIT): **github.com/acnlabs/dsh-plugin-acn**

Happy to answer questions or take feedback — genuinely curious if anyone else is hitting the same cross-instance collaboration wall.

discussions.title: 关于「多 agent 会话迁移」的讨论：换了 AI 编程工具，历史会话怎么办？
discussions.body:
## 大家的会话历史是怎么跨 agent 迁移的？dsh 要不要官方支持「多 agent 会话导入」？

现在 AI 编程 agent 百花齐放：pi、opencode、codex、claude-code、Cursor……每个工具都有自己**私有的会话存储格式**。我自己的真实场景：

- 在 pi 里攒了几百个会话（推理过程、工具调用、关键决策记录）
- 换到 opencode 后又攒了一批
- 想统一回看、甚至接着上次继续对话时发现：**历史会话带不走，也没法跨工具继续聊**

这让我开始想几个问题，想听听社区的看法：

1. **大家有同样的痛点吗？** 会话历史（尤其是长对话里的推理过程和决策记录）对你们来说有多重要？换工具时会不会舍不得，或者专门想办法迁移？
2. **有没有跨 agent 迁移会话的经验或方案？** 格式转换、脚本、手动导出……都踩过什么坑？
3. **dsh 作为统一的 harness，是不是应该官方支持「多 agent 会话导入」？** 让 pi / opencode / codex / claude-code 的会话都能进 dsh，统一浏览、统一继续对话——这会不会是 dsh 的一个关键差异化能力？

> 补充：我自己先做了个实验性实现 [dsh-import-agents](https://github.com/Chang-Tong/dsh-import-agents)，支持把 pi / opencode / codex / claude-code 的会话与 agents 导入 dsh，目前做到：真实 dsh 会话（**可继续对话**）、工具调用**轨迹复原**（tool-call 块 + 配对 tool/call + tool/result 事件）、幂等重复导入、agents 自动转 dsh skills（带来源溯源）。贴出来主要是抛砖引玉，想听听大家对这个方向的想法，也欢迎试用反馈——如果这个需求呼声高，希望 dsh 官方也能把它纳入路线图。

大家怎么看？你希望 dsh 支持导入哪些 agent 的会话？

discussions.title: dsh-launchpad — one-window launcher for dsh on macOS & Linux (balance tracking + custom background)
discussions.body:
I've been using DeepSeek Harness daily since release and put together a small companion tool for three things I kept bumping into. Sharing in case it's useful to anyone else.

**👉 [dsh-launchpad](https://github.com/jovequli/dsh-launchpad)** — one window that starts `dsh web`, waits until it's actually ready, opens the browser, and shows your API balance.

| One window controls everything | Optional custom chat background |
|---|---|
| ![console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jovequli/dsh-launchpad/main/docs/terminal.png) | ![web ui](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/jovequli/dsh-launchpad/main/docs/web.png) |

### What it solves

- **Nothing to remember.** Double-click on macOS, or launch from the app menu on Linux — it starts the service and jumps straight to the Web UI. No command, no port, no opening a tab by hand.
- **Spending visibility.** The API exposes current balance only, so it keeps local snapshots and tells you *how long* each chunk of credit lasted. It notifies you every time you spend a set amount, and again when the balance runs low.
- **Clean shutdown.** Closing the window stops the service — no orphan process left holding the port. (Getting this right needed a background log tail plus a polling loop; a foreground `tail -f` swallows the signal and the trap never fires.)
- **Optional custom chat background.** Drop in an image.

### Notes

- It's a **standalone companion tool — not a plugin and not a fork.** It only calls the public CLI. It never asks for your API key: the balance check reuses the one `dsh` already stores in `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`, and nothing else in `~/.dsh` is modified.
- The background feature copies a CSS file and an image into the served frontend and adds one `<link>` to `index.html`. It deliberately targets only `body` and the official `--dsw-alias-*` tokens, never the content-hashed class names, and re-applies itself on every start since `npx` swaps the package folder whenever dsh updates. If the frontend is restructured upstream, that's the one part that would need attention.
- Only external dependency is Node.js; everything else is OS built-ins (no `jq`, no Python, no Homebrew packages).
- **macOS is tested end to end. Linux is written to spec but not yet verified on real hardware** — feedback especially welcome there.

README is bilingual (English / 中文). Issues and suggestions welcome.

Thanks for open-sourcing this — the "everything is a plugin" architecture and the documented `--dsw-alias-*` token layer made it unusually pleasant to build around.

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] DeepSeek Harness Handbook — architecture maps, operator guides, and recipes
discussions.body:
I have been reading the DeepSeek Harness source and official docs from an Agent-builder perspective. The runtime becomes easier to reason about once the model, profile composition, Agent Loop, tool policy, and durable session events are treated as separate layers.

I turned those notes into an independent, open-source handbook:

https://github.com/sandbaseai/deepseek-harness-handbook

It is not an official DeepSeek AI project. The handbook complements the upstream reference with task-oriented explanations, diagrams, and failure checklists while linking version-sensitive claims to primary sources.

## Live operator tools

- [Field Status](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/field-status.html) — current rc.6 boundaries, first evidence, and safer next actions.
- [Interactive Failure Router](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/diagnose.html) — choose the first broken surface and collect the right evidence.
- [Version Evidence](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/version-evidence.html) — distinguish moving npm tags, the installed artifact, and the inspected source revision.
- [Subagent Scale and OOM](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/subagent-scale-oom.html) — separate concurrency from total-agent limits and batch large fan-out workloads.
- [Plugin Recovery Runbook](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/plugin-recovery.html) — preserve a known-good profile, inspect reconciliation, and route the first boot error.
- [Session Log Durability](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/session-log-durability.html) — stop a live writer safely and separate crash tails from committed corruption.
- [Non-FHS PTY Shell Paths](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/pty-shell-path.html) — point persistent Bash at the executable available on NixOS and other non-FHS hosts.
- [Visual site](https://sandbaseai.github.io/deepseek-harness-handbook/) — quickstart, runtime map, incident notes, and downloadable field guide.

## What is available now

- a five-minute Web UI quickstart with explicit success evidence;
- headless Agent, CI, and Python SDK guidance;
- model-provider and custom endpoint configuration;
- visual maps of the plugin-composed runtime, Agent lifecycle, and tool execution pipeline;
- guides for Skills, subagents, MCP, bounded subagent capacity, and plugin recovery;
- a reproducible repository-research Agent recipe;
- symptom-driven troubleshooting for provider, session, MCP, sandbox, permission, composition, and host compatibility failures;
- a compact operator cheat sheet and offline PDF.

## The mental model used throughout

```text
Profile
  → Bundles + patches
    → Cordis plugin graph
      → Agent Loop
        ↔ Model provider
        ↔ Tools + approval + sandbox
        ↔ Durable session events
          → Web, headless, SDK, and other clients
```

The practical distinction that saved me the most debugging time is this:

- a prompt describes intent;
- approval decides whether a requested effect may proceed;
- the sandbox limits what the process can actually reach;
- session events provide evidence of what happened.

Those are related, but they are not interchangeable security boundaries.

## Example bounded first task

```text
Inspect this repository without changing files.

Deliver:
1. its purpose;
2. its main packages and entry points;
3. the commands used to test it;
4. unresolved risks or unknowns.

Cite file paths for every conclusion. Stop before any write,
network request, credential use, or external publication.
```

## Feedback wanted

The most useful contributions are source corrections, reproducible platform failures, real Agent recipes with explicit effect boundaries, and fluent reviews of the translated navigation pages.

The project is Apache-2.0 and technical pages record verification context. If a page becomes stale against upstream, please open an issue with the relevant source path, package version, or commit.

discussions.title: Bug: 同一会话被两个 dsh 进程并发写入导致会话日志损坏（seq 撞号）
discussions.body:
# Bug 报告：同一会话被两个 dsh 进程并发写入导致会话日志损坏（seq 撞号）

两个 dsh 实例（npm 版与源码版）共用同一 `$DSH_HOME` 并发写入同一会话，导致 `session.jsonl.zstd` 中两个事件撞上同一个 seq，resume 时报 `corrupt session log: seq gap`。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 启动第一个实例：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`（端口 3080）
  2. 启动第二个实例：`pnpm dsh web --port 3081`（共享同一 `$DSH_HOME`，默认 `~/.dsh`）
  3. 两个实例都操作/写同一个会话
  4. resume 该会话 → 报错
- 实际结果：会话日志损坏，resume 失败。`session/end-seed` 与 `agent/inbox/spliced` 被分配了同一个 seq（47245），持久化层将其判定为 "seq gap"（expected 47246, got 47245），拒绝恢复。手动删除撞号事件后进一步报 `invalid persisted inbox splice`（insert/claim 是成对事件，删 insert 导致 claim 在空 inbox 上校验失败）。
- 预期结果：第二个实例无法写入同一会话（单写者保护），或至少大声告警；损坏时提供可用的修复工具。
- 环境：Windows 11，Node v24.13.1，pnpm 11.7.0；npx `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 与源码版 0.1.0-rc.5（commit 47f9438）同时运行。
- 验收条件：
  1. 双实例并发写同一会话时，第二个写者被拒绝或告警，而不是静默写坏日志；
  2. 报错信息区分 `seq 重复（撞号）`与 `seq 缺失（真 gap）`两种情况；
  3. （建议）提供持久化层的 renumber/repair 工具，中段损坏可自动恢复。

</details>

## 根因分析

两个写者各自的 seq 计数器都走到了 47245，各写入一条不同事件。持久化层没有单写者保护：README 声明 "One live writer per session"，但没有任何机制阻止第二个进程写同一会话。这是并发写入，不是事件丢失——现有报错 `corrupt session log: seq gap` 把两种情况（`event.seq < expected` 撞号 / `event.seq > expected` 真 gap）混为一谈，误导排查方向。

## 修复过程（用户侧手动完成）

1. 用 harness 自带的 `scanZstdFrames` + `decompressZstdFrame` 逐 frame 解压（Node 内置 `zstdDecompressSync` 只解第一个 frame，多 frame 拼接流需自行逐帧解）；
2. 按文件顺序重新分配事件 seq（保留第一次出现的 47245，其后的 splice-insert 顺延为 47246，后续所有事件 +1）；
3. 未受影响的 frame 原字节保留，只重编码受影响的 frame（`compressZstdFrame`）；
4. 结果：48251 个事件全部保留，seq 连续，28 个 inbox splice 重放全部通过。

## 给团队的改进建议

1. **单写者保护**：对会话文件加文件锁/租约/原子认领，第二个写者直接拒绝或大声告警，而不是静默写坏。
2. **报错信息误导**：`format.ts:364-373` 两条分支共用一个 message，建议区分 `seq 重复`与 `seq 缺失`，便于定位是双写者还是丢事件。
3. **缺少修复工具**：中段损坏属于硬损坏（README："A defect at or before the last committed turn/end is corruption and rejects"），无自动修复。建议提供持久化层的 renumber/repair CLI。
4. **双写者检测**：append 时检测到 seq 与已有冲突并报警。

discussions.title: 给纯文本模型开发自定义识图工具时，发现图片准入设计有点别扭
discussions.body:
我们在给 DSH 开发一个自定义识图工具（vision-agy：图片经外部视觉引擎 agy/Gemini 读成结构化文字证据，再喂给 DeepSeek 这种纯文本模型）的时候，发现一个绕不开的设计问题，想反馈一下。

## 问题现象

纯文本模型（DeepSeek/GLM）的会话里，用户贴一张图片，发送时直接被拒绝，提示 Model does not support image input.。

我们理解这是防御性设计：防止把模型处理不了的内容发过去。但对自定义工具来说，这个限制有点别扭——我们的工具根本不依赖模型本身看图：图片由外部引擎读取，转成文字后模型再读。所以"模型能不能看图"和"这个会话能不能处理图片"其实是两回事，但当前准入只看前者。

## 具体表现

发消息时（dsh-host-apiproxy）检查当前模型的 inputModalities，不含 image 直接拒绝（MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES）；即使放行，请求发出前（dsh-llm-pi-ai stream 层）还有一道 UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT 检查再拦一次。

结果就是：图片根本进不了会话，自定义识图工具没有用武之地。

## 可能的解法（仅供参考）

1. 准入条件从"模型模态支持图片"放宽为"模型模态支持图片 或 会话具备可消费图片的工具"
2. 或者参考 modlens 插件里 paste-to-path 的思路：粘贴图片自动落盘成临时文件，把文件路径（纯文本）注入会话——模型不会触发图片准入，工具按路径读图。这条路目前要靠插件自己实现，如果平台直接支持会更顺

想听听维护者的看法，也欢迎讨论有没有更合适的做法。谢谢！

discussions.title: [BUG] auto-translate breaks the web app
discussions.body:
It keeps auto translating from chinese to english, the app & browser language are english.

**Demo**
https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/3e6e2fc5-0a49-4805-b98f-de76c72e4744

As explained with DeepSeek V4 Flash :point_down: 

## Title

`<html lang="zh-CN">` hardcoded in `index.html` triggers Chrome auto-translate and breaks text rendering

## Body

**Describe the bug**

The web GUI hardcodes `<html lang="zh-CN">` in `apps/web/index.html` line 2. This causes two bugs in Google Chrome:

1. **Unwanted auto-translate** — Chrome sees the page declared as Chinese and automatically offers (or auto-applies) translation to English, even when both the browser language and the in-app locale are already English. The UI copy ends up overlaid or double-translated.

2. **Invisible / white characters** — Chrome Translate injects its own `<font>` and `<span>` overlay elements with inline CSS to render translations on top of the original text. These injected styles can override the app's own text colors, making some characters appear white/transparent against a white background — they exist in the DOM but are visually invisible.

**Steps to reproduce**

1. Launch DeepSeek Harness Web GUI in Google Chrome with an English-language browser profile
2. Chrome shows the translate icon in the address bar (or auto-translates immediately if that setting is on)
3. The page content appears overlaid / machine-translated
4. Some UI text characters appear missing, faint, or white-on-white

**Expected behavior**

- Chrome should not offer to translate an English-language app that already shows English UI
- All text should render at full opacity with the correct color

**Root cause**

`apps/web/index.html` line 2:

```html
<html lang="zh-CN">
```

This tag is static — it never changes. The app has a complete runtime locale system (zh ↔ en switching via `ctx.locale.setLocale()`), but **no code anywhere updates `document.documentElement.lang`** when the user picks a different locale. So `lang="zh-CN"` stays set forever, and Chrome always treats the page as a Chinese document that needs translating.

**Suggested fix**

When the locale is `en`, update the root `lang` attribute to match:

```js
document.documentElement.lang = locale === 'en' ? 'en-US' : 'zh-CN'
```

This would stop Chrome from offering translation and prevent the broken text rendering caused by the translation overlay CSS.

**Environment**

- Browser: Google Chrome (any recent version)
- OS: any
- DeepSeek Harness: latest

discussions.title: dsh-plugin: Native OpenViking memory for DeepSeek Harness (automatic session capture + memory tools + profile injection)
discussions.body:
## What

A community `dsh-plugin` that turns OpenViking (volcengine/OpenViking, self-evolving context database) into **native long-term memory for DeepSeek Harness** - no separate plugin framework, no second persistence layer. Two packages, two rows in the host composition, works for **every agent preset**:

- **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-memory-openviking`** (host plane): publishes the `memory` service and automatically captures sessions - buffers `session/event` (user/assistant surface messages) and drains at the awaited `session/flush` durability checkpoint into OpenViking (`batchAddMessages` ? async `commitSession`, server-side LLM distillation into preferences/entities/events). Failure-isolated: a dead server never blocks the session loop.
- **`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-memory`** (global registration): five thin tools (`memory_write/recall/search/profile/forget`) plus an automatic `<memory_profile>` prompt section (session working-memory overview + cross-session recalled preferences/entities/events; 1200-char budget, 5-min cache, synchronous provider with async refresh - prompt assembly never blocks on network).

Repo: https://github.com/zouyuanqing/dsh-memory-openviking (topic `dsh-plugin`, tag v0.1.0, MIT).

## Design notes (what we verified against the live runtime)

- **Plane decision**: capture hooks and tool/section registration live in the **host composition** (`$DSH_HOME/cordis.patch.yml`) so memory is infrastructure, not a per-preset option - global `tools.register`/`systemPrompt.section` are visible to every scope unless a preset explicitly restricts global tools (none shipped does).
- **Recall must use context mode**: `@openviking/sdk` 0.1.0 `find/search` (list mode) cannot return extracted memory leaves; `POST /api/v1/search/search {mode:"context"}` is the modern equivalent of the deprecated `/api/v1/search/recall` and returns the flat `<memory>` block suitable for injection (see docs/sdk-0.1.0-live-notes.md).
- **Commit throttling**: message-count threshold (16) or time interval (60s) - otherwise chatty sessions flood the server extraction queue.
- **Session ? peer isolation**: per-session `actorPeerId` (`X-OpenViking-Actor-Peer`) + `peerScope` are wired, but OpenViking 0.4.13 dev mode has **no peers** (verified: `viking://user/default/peers` is empty), so it is a production-multi-tenant switch.

## Measured

LoCoMo-style synthetic eval (scripts in the repo): **91.7% fact-level recall** (short sessions), **77.8%** (40-turn sessions), cross-session & temporal 100%; **58.9% token compression** per long session (memory representation vs full transcript, same heuristic as the harness token meter).

## Questions for the community

1. Is host-plane registration the right pattern for cross-preset capabilities, or should the roster/preset layer expose an explicit "capability mixin" mechanism?
2. Would the harness team consider a first-class `memory` service contract (write/recall/search/profile) so backends other than OpenViking can plug in?
3. Any appetite for an official integration package once OpenViking 0.4.x stabilizes the peer model?

discussions.title: [Bug] Settings can lose valid JSON property names such as __proto__
discussions.body:
## Summary

The settings service can confuse valid JSON property names such as `__proto__` and `constructor` with properties inherited from `Object.prototype`. This can lose stored data, change object prototypes, or produce incorrect equality and redaction results.

I found this while reviewing the settings write path and prepared a tested fix in a public fork. Since the repository currently disables external pull requests, I am sharing the findings and patch here as requested by `CONTRIBUTING.md`.

## Root cause

Settings documents are JSON-shaped records, so every string is a valid property name. Several reconstruction paths used ordinary bracket assignment, while membership checks used inherited-property semantics:

- cloning and layered merging could invoke the legacy `Object.prototype.__proto__` setter instead of storing an own data property;
- `deepEqualJson` could treat an inherited property as if it existed in the compared record;
- schema-aware redaction could omit or absorb special JSON keys while rebuilding objects;
- an absent namespace named `constructor` could be read from `Object.prototype`;
- nested `unset` operations could traverse inherited-looking paths that were not present in the document.

For example, the old equality implementation could report these unrelated values as equal:

```ts
deepEqualJson(JSON.parse('{"__proto__":{}}'), { unrelated: 1 })
```

## Impact

Configurations containing these valid JSON property names may not round-trip faithfully through snapshots, layer composition, path mutation, change detection, or wire redaction. The behavior is also observable for valid kebab-case namespaces that happen to match inherited names, such as `constructor`.

The proposed fix defines enumerable own data properties explicitly and uses own-property membership checks. It preserves ordinary `Object.prototype` objects, so existing consumers do not receive a new null-prototype object shape.

## Proposed fix

- Commit: [`f73a7f8e18`](https://github.com/Lzb-gzist/deepseek-harness/commit/f73a7f8e1816e0f1af0e9193dcff286e9450fbae)
- Full comparison against official `master`: [deepseek-ai:master...Lzb-gzist:agent/preserve-special-json-property-names](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Lzb-gzist:agent/preserve-special-json-property-names?expand=1)
- Fork branch: [`agent/preserve-special-json-property-names`](https://github.com/Lzb-gzist/deepseek-harness/tree/agent/preserve-special-json-property-names)

The patch adds regression coverage for clone/merge behavior, own-property equality, inherited-looking namespaces, nested path unsets, and schema-aware redaction. It also updates the English/Chinese settings documentation and the owning architecture note.

## Validation

- `pnpm exec vitest run packages/settings/settings/tests packages/settings/settings-file/tests` — **159 tests passed**.
- `pnpm exec tsc -b packages/settings/settings/tsconfig.json --pretty false` — passed.
- `pnpm run lint` — passed.
- `pnpm run doc-sync` — **28/28 gates passed**.
- Repository pre-commit checks — passed.
- Repository pre-push full typecheck — passed.

I would be happy to adjust the patch or provide additional reproduction details if useful.

discussions.title: 【安全评审】动态插件的 vm "沙箱"存在宿主进程逃逸，PoC 已验证：一次批准 = 完整 RCE
discussions.body:
### 概述

`cordis_define` / `cordis_run` 让模型编写并运行"动态插件"。插件宿主半在一个 `node:vm` 沙箱里求值，但该沙箱**不是安全边界**（仓库注释自认），且沙箱内放置了宿主函数（`TextEncoder` / `btoa` / `atob`），通过标准构造器逃逸即可拿到宿主进程的 `process` —— 获得完整用户权限：任意命令执行、任意文件读写、密钥窃取（如 `.env` 中的 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`）、持久化后门。

我已用 PoC 实测验证，并非理论推测。

### 攻击链

```
提示注入（网页/任务文本/文档）
  → 模型按指示 cordis_define 写动态插件（宿主半代码，3 行逃逸载荷）
  → 用户批准一次 cordis_run（批准摘要由模型自述，可被注入粉饰）
  → 插件 apply 同步执行逃逸代码
  → TextEncoder.constructor("return process")() 拿到宿主 process
  → 任意命令执行 + 任意文件读写 + 持久后门（无任何后续审批）
```

### 证据

**1. 仓库自认的非 containment 注释**（`packages/extensions/cordis-host-runner/src/sandbox.ts`）：

```ts
// L6-7: This keeps cooperative packages inspectable and disposable but is
// not containment: host-realm helper functions remain an escape route.
// L217-219: vmTimeoutMs only bounds the SYNCHRONOUS portion; an async body
// escapes it — acceptable under the module's trust stance.
```

**2. 逃逸源进入沙箱**（`sandbox.ts` L137-140）：

```ts
btoa: (s: string) => Buffer.from(s, 'utf-8').toString('base64'),
atob: (s: string) => Buffer.from(s, 'base64').toString('utf-8'),
TextEncoder,
TextDecoder,
```

宿主函数对象的 `.constructor` 指向宿主 `Function` —— 这是 Node 官方文档明示的 vm 边界（"The vm module is not a security mechanism"）。

**3. PoC（Node 22.19 实测，无副作用）：**

```js
const vm = require('node:vm');
const sandbox = { TextEncoder, TextDecoder, btoa: (x) => Buffer.from(x, 'utf-8').toString('base64'), atob: (x) => Buffer.from(x, 'base64').toString('utf-8') };
vm.createContext(sandbox);
console.log(vm.runInContext('TextEncoder.constructor === Function', sandbox));          // false —— 是宿主构造器
console.log(vm.runInContext('TextEncoder.constructor("return process")().cwd()', sandbox)); // 真实 cwd
console.log(vm.runInContext('TextEncoder.constructor("return process")().getBuiltinModule("child_process").spawnSync', sandbox)); // 可执行任意命令
```

实测输出：`false` / `N:\...真实路径...` / `function` —— **逃逸成立，spawnSync 与 readFileSync 均可达**。

**4. 执行点**（`lifecycle.ts` L28）：动态插件在宿主进程内以 `ctx.plugin(guardedPlugin(plugin, ...))` 启动，apply 的函数体位于 vm realm，逃逸代码同步执行于第一次 apply，`cordis_run` 的批准是唯一闸门。

### 为什么现有防线挡不住

- **approval / sandbox / workspace-write / fs-policy 全部作用于工具执行层**（bash、fs、web 工具调用）；
- 而动态插件代码执行在**进程层**（vm 求值 + 宿主 `ctx.plugin`），逃逸后直接获得进程权限，工具层防线对其不可见；
- 批准信息由模型自述，提示注入可将其粉饰为无害；
- 批准记录是进程内内存状态（重启后重新要求），但逃逸在第一次 apply 即完成，与持久性无关。

### 关于定位

我理解这是**设计内**的信任立场（"API 塑形而非安全边界"、信任等级与 bash 相当），注释写得坦诚。本帖的诉求不是"这是 bug 快修"，而是：

**产品的用户侧叙事（"沙箱" + "批准"）与实际信任模型之间存在落差。** 用户以为代码被隔离、操作被审批，实际上一次批准即授予进程级权限。这个落差需要被决策、被文档化、或者被消除。

### 三个可选方向（恳请维护者决策）

1. **进程级隔离（治本）**：宿主半移出宿主进程，走 OS 级沙箱（landlock / Windows ACL，与 e2b 子进程方案同构）+ 剔除 `.env` 等敏感环境 + IPC 通信；
2. **文档化与叙事修正（最低成本）**：明确声明动态插件为"进程级信任"，产品界面与提示词中同步呈现，取消"沙箱"表述；
3. **官方扫描/守卫钩子（中间态）**：在宿主半求值前提供静态检查扩展点，拦截常见逃逸模式。

### 贡献意向

我计划提交一个守卫插件（严格拒绝模式）：挂载于工具执行管线，扫描 `cordis_define` 的代码参数，拦截构造器链 / `eval` / `new Function` / 逃逸源函数引用等模式（初始规则集含全部 PoC 模式），附测试与文档。若维护者倾向方向 1 或 2，该插件仍可作为过渡防线。

如有表述或事实错误，欢迎指正；PoC 已在本地实测，随时可提供复现步骤。
