discussions.title: Bug report: dsh 0.1.0-rc.6: shipped "standard" preset fails to mount — every registration (persona, tool:pwsh, tool:read, plan:policy, ...) collides with the deployment layer
discussions.body: ## Summary After a fresh reinstall of dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, resuming any session fails: the SHIPPED default preset `standard` (and `code`) fails to mount because every registration inside the preset collides with the deployment layer. This is not caused by custom presets — the presets shipped with the package are affected. ## Environment - dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (installed via `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`) - OS: Windows 11 (amd64) - Node: v22.19.0 - Profile: `dsh web` (default `web` profile, bundles: @deepseek-ai/dsh-base + @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app) - Default preset: `standard` (the shipped default) ## Reproduction steps 1. `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` 2. Run `dsh web` and open the UI 3. Resume an existing session (or send a message) ## Actual behavior Resume fails with (screenshot attached): resume failed for session "session-...": Error: agent-presets: preset "standard" failed to mount: loader entries failed to apply failed to apply loader entry persona (@deepseek-ai/dsh-persona): prompt section "deployment:persona" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-pwsh (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh): prompt section "tool:pwsh" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-fs (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs): prompt section "tool:read" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-fs-search (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-fs-search): prompt section "tool:glob" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-jobs (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-jobs): prompt section "tool:jobs" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-skill (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill): tool "skill" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-goal (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-goal): prompt section "tool:goal" is already registered failed to apply loader entry planning (cordis:group): plan-mode: prompt section "plan:policy" is already registered failed to apply loader entry delegation (cordis:group): tool-ask-user: tool "ask_user_question" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-todo (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-todo): tool "todo_write" is already registered failed to apply loader entry tool-web (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-web): prompt section "tool:web_search" is already registered Every `... is already registered` is followed by "(for a per-agent override, register through that agent's agent.ctx instead)". The same failure occurs with the shipped `code` preset. A custom preset copied from `code` fails identically. ## Root cause analysis The preset mount path used by the web profile (patch-application via `applyEntryPatches`) registers preset rows into the GLOBAL prompt/tool layer, where the deployment layer has already registered the same section/tool names — so every row collides. Key observation: loading the SAME composed configuration as a rendered YAML file (equivalent content, including the injected shipped-preset root) mounts the same preset successfully — registrations land in the preset's own scoped layer and shadow correctly. So the configuration and preset files are fine; the bug is in how the patch-application startup path mounts presets versus the YAML path. ## Expected behavior The shipped default preset (`standard`) should mount without errors on a fresh install of 0.1.0-rc.6. ## Suggested fix Investigate why preset registrations during the patch-application boot path resolve to the global layer instead of the agent/preset scope (the `agent.ctx` path hinted by the error), and make `mountPreset`/`ensureStanding` produce the same scoped behavior as the rendered-YAML path.

discussions.title: [SDK server protocol] session/prompt is accepted before initialize
discussions.body:
## Summary

The SDK JSON-RPC server currently accepts `session/prompt` before any successful `initialize` handshake. It creates a durable session using constructor defaults (the host process cwd, `deepseek-official` provider/model, and no SDK token cap), then returns a normal `messageId`.

This lets a direct, faulty, or version-skewed client bypass the process-wide handshake that is supposed to establish the workspace and model route for every SDK-owned session.

## Deterministic reproduction

On a fresh `HarnessSdkJsonRpcServer`, send this as the first request:

```json
{"jsonrpc":"2.0","id":1,"method":"session/prompt","params":{"sessionId":"early","contentBlocks":[{"type":"text","text":"must not run"}]}}
```

Before the fix, both direct request dispatch and the real stdio transport resolve it with a `messageId`; the agent factory is called even though no handshake occurred.

## Root cause

The server documented `initialize` as a process-wide handshake but carried no completed-handshake state. Request dispatch routed `session/prompt` directly to session creation, where constructor defaults looked like a valid route.

## Proposed fix

The contribution records successful completion of `initialize` and makes that state a wire-level prerequisite for `session/prompt`:

- an early prompt rejects with `initialize must complete before session/prompt`;
- session lookup and the agent factory are not reached;
- failed or still-running initialization does not open the gate;
- `shutdown` remains available before initialization so an uninitialized runtime can always exit cleanly.

The bilingual server documentation now states the ordering contract explicitly.

## Verification

- The old regression resolves with a `messageId`; the fixed direct-dispatch test rejects and proves zero agent creations.
- A plugin-level stdio test verifies the `-32603` JSON-RPC response and absence of session events.
- The complete SDK server suite passes: 33 tests.
- Package lint and TypeScript compilation pass.
- Repository lint, full pre-push typecheck, documentation sync (28 gates), translation pairing, duplication, pre-commit, and whitespace checks pass.

I searched the latest 100 Discussions before posting and found no existing report for this pre-initialization prompt path.

## Contribution

- Compare: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Lzb-gzist:agent/sdk-server-require-initialize
- Branch: `agent/sdk-server-require-initialize`
- Commit: `5f65e500b31898122fc98fffc165aaa6770b8e34`
- Base: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`

The official repository currently has Pull Requests disabled, so I am sharing the reproducible case, verified fix, and compare link here for maintainer review.

discussions.title: 8/16 涨价实测：缓存命中率越高，账单涨得越狠（650 次请求，已与 DeepSeek 官方账单对账）
discussions.body:
## 先说结论

我把自己 `~/.dsh/sessions` 里的日志全部算了一遍：650 次请求、16 个会话，其中 613 次是 v4-pro，提示词 1.559 亿 tokens，缓存命中率 **98.09%**。

把这批 token 按 8/16 的新价重算，**账单变成原来的 2.7 倍**。
同样的 token，要是缓存命中率是 0，**反而只变成原来的 1.5 倍**（当然没有缓存整体金额是涨了）。

也就是说：**缓存命中率越高，这次涨价越不实惠**

## 凭什么信这些数字

谁都能把日志里的数字加一遍，问题是这些数字是不是真的就是账单上收你的那笔。所以我把同一个计费日的账单从 DeepSeek 控制台拉出来，对了一遍：


|        | 本地日志   | DeepSeek 控制台 | 差距  |
| ------ | ------ | ------------ | --- |
| 花费     | ¥17.45 | ¥17.73       | −2% |
| Tokens | 157.7M | 160.2M       | −2% |
| 请求数    | 650    | 684          | −5% |


**花费的差距和 token 的差距是同一个数**，说明单 token 的账算得跟官方一致；（差的那部分是本地日志少了 34 次请求，没走DeepSeek Harness）。所以下面每个数都不是估值。

用的是官方人民币价目表，没拿美元价折算——国内账户本来就按人民币结算，而两套价目表又不是同一个汇率换出来的，硬换算只会引入跟 token 无关的误差。

## 为什么会这样：三档价不是一起涨的


| v4-pro     | 旧价（全天一个价） | 新空闲价     | 涨幅       |
| ---------- | --------- | -------- | -------- |
| 输入 · 缓存命中  | ¥0.025/M  | ¥0.15/M  | **6.0×** |
| 输入 · 缓存未命中 | ¥3.00/M   | ¥4.50/M  | 1.5×     |
| 输出         | ¥6.00/M   | ¥13.50/M | 2.3×     |


大家都在说输出涨了 2.3 倍，但**涨得最狠的其实是最便宜的那一档**。旧价目表对缓存命中率高的人最友好，所以这次他们也最吃亏。

这不是说别缓存了——绝对金额上，缓存比以前更值钱：还是这份负载，缓存把一张本该 ¥711.73 的账单压到了 ¥46.53，省下 ¥665.21。它还是最大的那根杠杆，只是没从前那么陡了。

## 第二根杠杆：时段，而且对国内特别不友好

新价按 UTC 分高峰/空闲，空闲价是高峰价的一半。高峰窗口北京时间是 **09:00–12:00 和 14:00–18:00——正好卡在标准工作日的两个时段上。**

空闲时段只剩午休和下班以后。（而美东/美西的 9am–5pm 反而几乎全落在空闲段里。）

我把这 650 次请求的时间戳套到新的高峰窗口上算了一下：**41.1% 的 token 落在 8/16 之后要按高峰计费的时段**——纯粹因为我们是在北京时间白天干的活。

能等的批量任务，挪到午休或晚上，不改一行代码就能拿到五折。

## 可以用你自己的实测

每次 API 响应的 `usage` 里都有两个互不重叠的计数器，加起来正好是提示词长度：

```
hit_rate = prompt_cache_hit_tokens / (prompt_cache_hit_tokens + prompt_cache_miss_tokens)
```

用 dsh 的话什么都不用埋，它已经把每次请求的 token 明细写进 `~/.dsh/sessions` 了。上面这些数字都是同一个脚本产出的，我把它公开了，单文件、零依赖、不联网、从不碰凭证文件：

```
curl -O https://deepseekprice.com/dsh-cache-audit.py
python3 dsh-cache-audit.py
```

跑完直接打印你自己的命中率、三张价目表下各自的账单、完全不吃缓存的对照值，还有你的预热曲线。

完整数据、方法和对账过程：[https://deepseekprice.com/zh/deepseek-cache-pricing](https://deepseekprice.com/zh/deepseek-cache-pricing)
换算到你所在时区的时间窗口：[https://deepseekprice.com/zh/off-peak-hours](https://deepseekprice.com/zh/off-peak-hours)
价格计算器: [https://deepseekprice.com/zh/api-cost-calculator](https://deepseekprice.com/zh/api-cost-calculator)
（页面是我做的，脚本随便用。）

discussions.title: Extension point for third-party LLM provider editors in Models settings
discussions.body:
## Context

I am building an independently distributed Ollama Cloud adapter that registers a native `/api/chat` provider, a configurable-provider directory entry, a settings namespace, credential reference, model discovery, and model metadata. The provider loads correctly and appears on **Settings → Models**.

The Models editor currently recognizes only the built-in `llm-deepseek` and `llm-pi-ai` namespaces in `ProviderEditor.layoutOf()`. An external namespace therefore falls back to “edit settings.yaml directly”, even when its schema contains the same API-key, base-URL, and model-catalog fields.

A third-party package can ship a `dsh.client` entry in the same npm package and register a card under `settings.plugin.item`, as Codex Connect demonstrates. That provides a valid workaround in **Plugin configuration**, but it separates provider setup from the Models page and requires each provider to recreate model-management UI.

## Proposal

Please expose a generic Models-page extension for independently installed LLM plugins. Any of these would solve the problem:

1. A slot/chain contribution for a provider editor, selected by configurable-provider identity or settings namespace.
2. Metadata on `registerConfigurableProviders()` describing a supported editor family or client contribution.
3. A schema-driven fallback editor for common provider fields such as credential reference, base URL, model discovery, and model catalog.

The mechanism should let the Host remain authoritative for settings validation and credentials while allowing a client plugin to own presentation. It should also preserve unknown model-catalog fields so provider-specific metadata such as vision, tools, context limits, output limits, and reasoning levels survives edits.

## Why a generic extension

Adding another hardcoded namespace to `layoutOf()` would fix one adapter but leave every future third-party provider with the same problem. A public extension point would keep external providers independently installable and align the Models page with Harness's existing client-plugin and slot composition model.

## Current workaround

The Ollama Cloud package will carry both Host and Web client entries in one npm artifact and register its configuration card under `settings.plugin.item`. That requires no Harness core modification, but a Models-page extension would provide the expected provider setup experience and avoid duplicated catalog UI.

discussions.title: [SDK server lifecycle] repeated initialize rewrites future session routes
discussions.body:
## Summary

`HarnessSdkJsonRpcServer` documents reinitialization as unsupported, but accepts every `initialize` request. Each success rewrites cwd, provider, model, and maxTokens for *future* sessions; already-created agents retain their original configuration. One runtime can therefore silently contain sessions governed by different process-wide routes.

Concurrent handshakes are also unreserved. A second request can enter while the first awaits fallback adapter mounting, making the eventual route depend on asynchronous completion order and permitting multiple mount attempts.

## Deterministic reproduction

1. Initialize with route A: `/workspace-a`, `route-a`, `model-a`, maxTokens 111.
2. Create session `first`.
3. Initialize again with route B: `/workspace-b`, `route-b`, `model-b`, maxTokens 222.
4. Create session `second`.

Before the fix, step 3 succeeds. The two agent-factory calls carry different routes even though the server exposes one process-wide identity.

## Root cause

The server stored handshake parameters directly in mutable instance fields and had no initialization lifecycle state. It neither reserved the asynchronous setup path nor rejected a handshake after one had succeeded.

## Proposed fix

The contribution introduces explicit `new` → `initializing` → `ready` states:

- the first request reserves initialization before validation or asynchronous work;
- a concurrent request rejects while adapter mounting is pending;
- after success, every later `initialize` rejects and the route stays immutable;
- parameters and an owned fallback fiber are committed together only after setup succeeds;
- a failed handshake returns to `new` for a clean retry;
- if shutdown wins the pending mount, the newly mounted fiber is disposed and initialization cannot publish success.

The bilingual server documentation now makes the single-handshake contract explicit.

## Verification

- The old regression accepts route B; the fixed regression rejects it and proves both session factories retain route A.
- A controlled pending mount proves concurrent initialization is rejected without a second mount attempt.
- A shutdown race proves a late mounted fiber is disposed and no success is published.
- A plugin-level stdio test verifies repeated initialization becomes a `-32603` JSON-RPC error.
- The complete SDK server suite passes: 35 tests.
- Package lint and TypeScript compilation pass.
- Repository lint, full pre-push typecheck, documentation sync (28 gates), translation pairing, duplication, pre-commit, and whitespace checks pass.

This complements #1570: that report requires a handshake **before** prompts; this one freezes the route **after** the one successful handshake. Each is independently based on official `master`.

I searched the latest 100 Discussions before posting and found no existing report for repeated or concurrent server initialization.

## Contribution

- Compare: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Lzb-gzist:agent/sdk-server-single-handshake
- Branch: `agent/sdk-server-single-handshake`
- Commit: `2a2ed62cf1a26f0c1ca6ea27225452d45e0bb240`
- Base: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`

The official repository currently has Pull Requests disabled, so I am sharing the reproducible case, verified fix, and compare link here for maintainer review.

discussions.title: [建议] 为 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN 补充结构化的工具副作用信息
discussions.body:
最近在看 Harness 的工具调用和 Session 恢复实现，有一个关于 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 的想法，想听听维护团队的意见。

当前 `session-checkpoint-policy` 会在顶层工具执行前刷新 Session，确保 `tool/call` 已经持久化：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/session/session-checkpoint-policy/src/index.ts#L52-L75

如果进程在工具开始执行之后、`tool/result` 写入之前退出，恢复逻辑会补充 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`。其中的提示也很谨慎：只读或幂等操作可以考虑重试；可能有副作用的操作应该先核对外部状态，不能盲目执行。

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/repair.ts#L91-L123

我觉得这个处理方向是对的，不过目前还有一个信息缺口：Harness 知道调用已经开始、结果没有记录，却不知道这个工具本身是只读、幂等，还是可能产生不可重复的外部副作用。

例如发送邮件、退款或删除文件。外部操作可能已经成功，只是 Harness 没来得及写入结果。这时恢复提示只能让模型根据“工具语义”自行判断，但这部分语义目前没有结构化地出现在 `ToolDefinition` 或持久化的 `tool/call` 中。

是否可以考虑给工具增加一个可选的副作用描述？例如：

```ts
interface ToolEffect {
  sideEffect: "none" | "read" | "write" | "external"
  idempotency: "guaranteed" | "keyed" | "non-idempotent" | "unknown"
}

interface ToolDefinition {
  effects?: ToolEffect | ((args: unknown) => ToolEffect)
}
```

之所以考虑支持函数形式，是因为同一个工具的性质可能取决于参数。例如文件工具的 `read` 和 `delete` 虽然属于同一个 Tool，但恢复策略显然不应该相同。这个形式也有点类似现有的 `isConcurrencySafe(args)`。

如果这个方向成立，我觉得还需要在调用发生时，把当时计算出的结果和 `tool/call` 一起持久化。否则插件更新以后，恢复旧 Session 时可能会用新版本的 Tool Definition 重新解释旧调用。

第一阶段也许不需要直接实现自动重试或完整的 Reconcile 机制，只需让恢复逻辑获得结构化信息：

- 明确为只读、幂等的调用，可以提示允许安全重试；
- 写入或外部操作，提示先核对状态；
- 未声明或无法判断的工具继续保持当前的保守行为。

这样可以保留现有 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 的文本提示，但提示内容来自持久化的工具事实，而不是让模型重新猜测工具性质。

这个建议并不能让任意外部操作获得 exactly-once。支付、邮件等外部系统仍然需要自己的 Idempotency Key 或状态查询接口。它主要想解决的是：Harness 已经检测到结果未知以后，能否更确定地判断下一步属于“可以重试”还是“必须核对”。

想请教几个问题：

1. `ToolDefinition` 是否适合承载这类信息？
2. 这类信息更适合放进 `tool/call`，还是作为单独的 Session Event？
3. 先只增加副作用分类、继续保留现有恢复行为，是否是一个比较合适的增量？

discussions.title: [Bug] Single tilde ~ renders as strikethrough — Chinese price ranges get struck through
discussions.body:
**Environment**: Windows 11 · dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`) · Chrome

**Screenshot** (pricing digits masked for privacy; the strikethrough effect is visible):

![dsh strikethrough bug](https://gist.githubusercontent.com/eeehaule/d051bcfa51df26c663e32dfcb7e85c2a/raw/dsh_bug_screenshot_masked.png)

**Summary**

In Chinese, a single tilde `~` is the standard range notation (prices, dates, weekdays). When a message contains **two** ranges like `开通费 6800~12800 元 + 800~1500 元/月`, the Web UI treats the two `~` as a strikethrough delimiter pair and strikes out everything in between. See the screenshot below — the middle segment (`+2800 开通费 + 800`) is crossed out. The original text was:

```
（收 6800~12800 开通费 + 800~1500 月维护费，对齐商业审核报告定价）
```

**Reproduce**

1. Open any chat in `dsh web`
2. Send (or have the model output) a message containing: `（收 6800~12800 开通费 + 800~1500 月维护费）`
3. `12800 开通费 + 800` renders with a line through, as if it were `~~12800 开通费 + 800~~`

Minimal parser repro (same libraries used by `packages/client/ui-primitives/src/markdown/parse.ts`):

```js
import { fromMarkdown } from 'mdast-util-from-markdown'
import { gfmFromMarkdown } from 'mdast-util-gfm'
import { gfm } from 'micromark-extension-gfm'

const tree = fromMarkdown('（收 6800~12800 开通费 + 800~1500 月维护费）', {
  extensions: [gfm()],
  mdastExtensions: [gfmFromMarkdown()],
})
// → 1 delete node with value "12800 开通费 + 800"
// `a~b~c` also produces 1 delete node ("b")
```

**Root cause**

`micromark-extension-gfm` strikethrough accepts a **single** `~` as a delimiter (per GFM spec). In English this rarely collides with real content, but in Chinese `~` is the everyday range separator, and LLM agents writing Chinese output produce this pattern constantly (e.g. pricing summaries with two ranges on one line). Every Chinese user will eventually hit this.

**Suggested fix** (any one would work):

1. Accept only double tilde `~~` as strikethrough delimiters, or
2. Add a CJK-aware extension alongside the existing `cjkFriendlyStrong` that refuses `~` as a delimiter when adjacent to digits or CJK characters, or
3. At minimum, do not treat `~` as a delimiter when both sides are digit sequences (range notation).

---

中文备注：`~` 在中文里是区间符号（如 6800~12800、周一~周五），此段内容被误判为删除线。希望官方能对 CJK 场景收紧删除线语法（仅 `~~` 触发，或参考 `cjkFriendlyStrong` 的做法），这个坑在中文文案里出现频率非常高。

discussions.title: DSH | Plan Lattice | Execution-time drift control for long-running agents
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial community project, independently developed and maintained. It has not been reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek.**

**Project URL:** https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice  
**Latest stable release:** [v0.3.0](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/releases/tag/v0.3.0)  
**Current public runtime candidate:** [v0.4.0-rc.6](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/releases/tag/v0.4.0-rc.6)

## Scope

Plan Lattice controls one long-task failure boundary: a later mutation whose accepted intent or factual basis has become incomplete, stale, or no longer authoritative.

It persists an accepted contract and recursive plan, and requires a current one-use action basis before protected mutations. Clear, bounded tasks can enter `bypass`, which adds no Lattice prompt, tools, state, question, guard, or controller model call.

## Screenshots

[![First-drift mechanism stress-test results](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/v0.4.0-rc.6/demo/results/first-drift-summary.svg)](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/blob/v0.4.0-rc.6/BENCHMARK.md)

*RC.6 mechanism result on the named stress-test hazards; this is not a general coding-quality benchmark.*

## DSH integration

Plan Lattice installs as a DSH bundle; its Cordis patch inserts one Host plugin into the selected profile without modifying Harness source. The plugin joins Harness agent inbox/session events, system-prompt assembly, live ownership, and ToolRuntime guard/execute/result events. It registers 16 `lattice_*` tools and uses the optional native user-question service for outcome-critical clarification. Clear bounded tasks take the true bypass path and receive none of that model-visible surface.

## RC.6 behavior

RC.6 adds or strengthens:

- true bypass for explicit, bounded one-file tasks;
- per-dimension critical clarification for missing outcome, scope, truth-source, authority, side-effect, and acceptance information;
- canonical persistence of human answers rather than model-rewritten authority;
- durable root fencing when material human input reaches a delegated child;
- process-restart preservation of unresolved checkpoint obligations.

## Published evidence

The deterministic mechanism tests use real Harness runtime services.

- Stale-basis hazards: native Harness entered 12/12 unsafe mutations; Plan Lattice entered 0/12.
- Matched legitimate controls: both arms completed 7/7.
- Real `SIGKILL` hazards: native continued unsafely in 2/2; Plan Lattice in 0/2.
- Matched restart controls: both arms completed 2/2.

Two exploratory `deepseek-v4-flash` repeats on one fixed bypass task scored 10/10 in both arms, with zero RC.6 clarification questions. Per-run overhead non-inferiority and general quality uplift were not established.

Exact artifacts:

- [Candidate commit `591cf737bf7b46bb977a6cd642a29945ff31eb3e`](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/commit/591cf737bf7b46bb977a6cd642a29945ff31eb3e)
- [RC.6 release](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/releases/tag/v0.4.0-rc.6)
- [Green CI](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/actions/runs/32007734310)
- [Mechanism benchmark](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/blob/v0.4.0-rc.6/BENCHMARK.md)
- [Two-run pilot summary](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/blob/v0.4.0-rc.6/eval/pilots/results/rc6-simple-bypass-summary.json)

Released tarball SHA-256:

`9e522d43877debcccbcad1e1ebb15916fbb35d50a9a98032bdc6149802c30082`

## Official Harness rc.7 compatibility

The exact published RC.6 tarball is now checked against official [`dsh-v0.1.0-rc.7`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dsh-v0.1.0-rc.7), commit `99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`.

[CI run 32100142825](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/actions/runs/32100142825) downloaded the release asset, verified the SHA-256 above, installed it into a fresh profile, confirmed rendered bundle membership, booted the real Web host to HTTP 200 with the expected title, and observed all 16 `lattice_*` tool schemas. A separate matrix arm passed the same checks for the current main candidate. Both arms uploaded machine-readable `dsh-plugin-compatibility/v1` records.

This establishes installation, startup, profile composition, and tool-registration compatibility with that exact Harness release. It does not establish full behavioral equivalence or model-quality uplift.

## Install

```sh
gh release download v0.4.0-rc.6 --repo 1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice --pattern "*.tgz"
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-plan-lattice-0.4.0-rc.6.tgz
```

## Evidence boundary

A separate, unreleased RC.7 development attempt reached guarded execution and a durable checkpoint, then ended with provider HTTP 502 / `STREAM_CLOSED` without a deliverable or grader result. The [exact result](https://github.com/1052326311/dsh-plan-lattice/blob/d14f43fc62732ec06f8db44c35f17d872d7577fe/eval/pilots/results/rc7-icae-js-ts-01-agent-stream-closed.json) is retained as a terminal task failure and is not eligible for a discretionary rerun under the frozen policy. It establishes no uplift.

These are hand-designed mechanism tests and two exploratory repeats on one task. They do not establish general coding-quality uplift, production success rate, ranking, or an official DeepSeek review.

discussions.title: 反向桥接第一例：DSH 作为 codewhale 的子 agent（codewhale-dsh）
discussions.body:
DSH 生态已有的桥接都是 X → DSH（把别的工具接进来）。我们做了另一侧：DSH → 其他 harness。

- 已实现：流式吐字（chunk）、权限求助（request_permission → blocked → dsh_respond）、优雅取消（session/cancel）、token 记账（读会话日志 usage）
- 20 测试全绿，TDD，MIT

"Everything is a plugin" 的另一种注解：DSH 自己也可以是插件。

仓库：https://github.com/zhiyuchen1101/codewhale-dsh
Roadmap 待认领：求助分级 L2/L3、任务队列、npm 包

欢迎讨论反向桥接这个新分类，也欢迎来认领 Roadmap。

discussions.title: Show and tell: MCP Lens — 1,000 MCP tools behind 2 interfaces (live V4 Flash A/B)
discussions.body:
我做了一个 DeepSeek Harness 社区插件 **MCP Lens**：把大型 MCP 目录从“每轮都把全部 schema 交给模型”，改成两个固定入口——`mcp_search` 和 `mcp_call`。

> English summary: MCP Lens keeps large MCP catalogs behind two model-facing interfaces, returns the selected tool's exact schema, and connects only when the tool is called.

![MCP Lens comparison](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/main/assets/mcp-lens-comparison.svg)

## 为什么做

直接 MCP 路径会为每个远程工具注册一个模型可见 schema。工具数量到数百或数千时，这些定义会反复进入请求，并扩大上下文、费用和工具选择面。

MCP Lens 的运行路径是：

1. `mcp_search` 检索经过安全投影的目录元数据，并返回候选工具的**精确 `inputSchema`**；
2. 模型按该 schema 生成参数；
3. `mcp_call` 精确调用一个 `server/tool`；
4. MCP 连接仅在实际需要时建立。

它不需要 embedding、向量数据库或外部搜索服务。当前支持 stdio 与 Streamable HTTP，并带默认拒绝策略、allow/deny、缓存失效、超时和工具/目录/cursor/HTTP 响应上限。

## 同一 DeepSeek V4 Flash 的小规模实测

环境：Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`，同一个 1,000-tool MCP fixture，同样三项任务。

| 指标 | 直接 MCP 路径 | MCP Lens |
|---|---:|---:|
| 完整 Harness 模型可见工具数 | 1,025 | 27 |
| 其中 MCP 工具 | 1,000 | 2 |
| 完整 `request/header.tools` JSON | 674,249 B | 27,401 B |
| 任务完成 | 3/3 | 3/3 |
| 三任务估算费用 | $0.0307204 | $0.0034707 |

费用按 2026-08-14 获取的 DeepSeek V4 Flash 价格快照重算。这里的边界很重要：它只是三任务功能性 pilot，不是普遍质量或速度结论。Lens 多一次搜索；本次输出 token 也更高（491 → 794）。它更适合大型、多服务器、长尾目录，而不是五个始终高频的工具。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc.7/dsh-mcp-lens-0.1.0-rc.7.tgz
```

- 仓库与五分钟配置：https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens
- 中文 README：https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md
- 本地目录测量与 schema-free 分享：https://labmimors.github.io/dsh-mcp-lens/
- 完整 pilot 方法与逐任务数据：https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/blob/main/docs/LIVE_DEEPSEEK_PILOT.md

## 想征集的反例

我最想要的不是泛泛的点赞，而是两类真实反馈：

1. 你的 MCP 目录大约有多少工具、多少服务器，常用工具与长尾工具比例如何；
2. 一条脱敏后的检索失败：query、工具名/描述/schema、预期匹配与实际排名。

请勿提交凭据、客户数据或私有工具输出。有效失败样本会被转成公开回归测试。

如果你在真实目录中复现后觉得它值得保留，欢迎给仓库一个 Star，并在下面写下目录规模；我会把有效失败样本和规模数据继续纳入公开回归基准。

披露：我是该插件作者。MCP Lens 是 MIT 许可的独立社区插件，不是 DeepSeek 官方组件。

discussions.title: 主题：[Bug 反馈] DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 通过 pi-ai 适配器强制发送 thinking:disabled，导致 deepseek-v4 单回合输出被静默截断在 8192 tokens
discussions.body:
您好，

我在使用 DeepSeek Harness（命令行 dsh，版本 0.1.0-rc.6）时，发现一个会导致大文件/长文本生成被静默截断的 bug，已定位到根因在适配层，特此反馈。

一、环境

- DSH：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6
- pi-ai 适配器：@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai 0.1.0-rc.6
- pi-ai 引擎：@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1
- 模型：deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro
- 配置：settings.yaml 中两 provider、两 deepseek 模型均设置 maxTokens: 384000（已确认该值确实进入请求体）

二、现象  
通过 dsh 让模型在一个回合内输出超过 8192 token 的内容（例如一次性写入一个较大的 app.js），该应用稳定出现：  
outputTokens = 8192  
stopReason  = "length"（被截断）  
且因为截断发生在工具调用中途，续传时会抛出 invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content，导致整轮失败、会话被污染。小输出回合不受影响（这也是此前"偶尔没事"的原因）。

三、根因（已在本地安装包逐行核实）  
dsh-llm-pi-ai 最终调用 @earendil-works/pi-ai 发送请求。pi-ai 在拼请求体时，对 deepseek 模型（未显式要求 reasoning 时）无条件发送 thinking:{type:"disabled"}：

文件 @earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js 第 586–592 行：  
else if (compat.thinkingFormat === "deepseek" && model.reasoning) {  
if (options?.reasoningEffort) {  
params.thinking = { type: "enabled" };  
}  
else if (model.thinkingLevelMap?.off !== null) {  
params.thinking = { type: "disabled" };  
}  
}

而 deepseek 模型定义在 @earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/providers/data/deepseek.json：  
"deepseek-v4-flash": { "reasoning": true, "thinkingLevelMap": {"minimal":null,"low":null,"medium":null,"high":"high","max":"max"} }  
该 thinkingLevelMap 没有 off 键 → model.thinkingLevelMap.off === undefined → undefined !== null 恒为 true → 永远走 disabled 分支。  
（compat.thinkingFormat 对这些模型在第 1156 行被设为 "deepseek"，model.reasoning 为 true，两个条件均满足。）

用 onPayload 抓到的 pi-ai 真实请求体印证了这一点：  
{"model":"deepseek-v4-flash","max_completion_tokens":384000,"stream":true,  
"thinking":{"type":"disabled"},"stream_options":{"include_usage":true}}  
→ 384000 已正确发送，唯一异常的字段是 thinking:{type:"disabled"}。

四、决定性实验（同一模型 / 同一 key / 同一 384000，唯一变量 = thinking）

- 裸 API 非流式，max_completion_tokens=384000，不传 thinking → completion_tokens=65536，完整输出（约 10134 行）
- pi-ai streamSimple，max_completion_tokens=384000，thinking:{type:"disabled"} → 8192、length、截断
- 裸 API 流式，max_completion_tokens=384000，不传 thinking → stop，完整输出 5000 行
- 裸 API 流式，max_completion_tokens=384000，thinking:{type:"disabled"} → 8192、length、截断

结论：DeepSeek 服务端当前对「thinking:disabled + max_completion_tokens」组合，把单次可见输出按 8192 处理。这不是 settings.yaml 的问题，也不是服务端全局限制 8192（裸请求不带 thinking 可到 65536+）。

五、影响  
任何单回合输出 > 8192 token 的任务（大文件整体写入、长文档一次性生成等）都会被静默截断，并因截断停在工具调用中途引发 invalid pi-ai replay state，导致整轮失败、会话被污染。

六、建议修复（按优先级）

1. pi-ai：deepseek 模型 thinkingLevelMap 无 off 且调用方未显式要求 reasoning 时，省略 thinking 字段（不发送 {type:"disabled"}），使 max_completion_tokens 正常生效。
2. dsh-llm-pi-ai：不启用 reasoning 时对 deepseek 改用 max_tokens（已实测 max_tokens=384000 不带 thinking 可完整输出）。
3. 若该行为是服务端固有语义，则应在适配层文档/配置层明确「deepseek + 显式 thinking:disabled ⇒ 有效输出 ≤ 8192」，避免用户误以为 384000 已生效。

七、修复前本地规避  
让模型分多次小步写入大文件，单轮输出控制在低千 token 以内，避免触发 8192 上限。

以上代码证据（文件路径、行号、模型定义）均已在本地实际安装的 0.1.0-rc.6 / 0.82.1 包中逐行核实。盼复，谢谢！

discussions.title: Bug: Subagents inherit the parent session's creation-time model snapshot instead of the model the session actually uses
discussions.body:
# Bug Report: Subagents inherit the parent session's *creation-time* model snapshot instead of the model the session actually uses > **Status**: Needs maintainer confirmation (behavior contradicts documented intent) > **Severity**: Medium — functional inconsistency, no crash > **Affected packages**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` (0.1.0-rc.6), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy` (0.1.0-rc.6), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` (0.1.0-rc.6), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` (0.1.0-rc.6) > **Environment**: dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, hybrid deployment — DeepSeek official API + local llama.cpp models (reproduced via the dsh web `session.*` API) > **Date**: 2026-08-15 > **Labels**: `bug` / `subagent` / `model-selection` / `inheritance` ## Summary After switching the model of a session via the web UI, subagents spawned from that session **still run on the model that was the global default when the session was created**, instead of the model the parent session is actually using. Switching a model updates both the in-session selection and the global default (`settings.yaml`), but the subagent inheritance logic reads a **one-time creation snapshot** (`parent.options`) that is never updated, so the two diverge. ## Steps to reproduce 1. **Prerequisite**: global default model is `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash` (`agent-default-model` in `settings.yaml`). 2. Create a new session `S` (its creation snapshot is therefore `deepseek-v4-flash`). 3. In the browser UI, switch session `S` to a local model `local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5` (invokes `session.selectModel`). 4. Confirm `S` is now actually talking to the local model (works as expected). 5. Spawn a subagent from `S` via the `subagent` tool. 6. **Observed**: the subagent session's `request/header` event carries `config.provider = "deepseek-official"`, `config.model = "deepseek-v4-flash"`, `maxTokens = 256000` (DeepSeek official provider defaults), not the local model's `local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5 / 65536`. ## Expected behavior The subagent should inherit the model the parent session is **currently using** (`local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5`), because: - `resolveChildAgentOptions`'s own doc comment states the child *"inherits the parent's provider/model route"*; - DSH's model-selection machinery treats the session **request header** as the authoritative source of the session's current model. ## Actual behavior The subagent uses the model snapshot taken **when the parent session was created**, even though the parent switched models afterwards and has been running on the new model. ### Observed evidence | Scenario | Global default at parent creation | Parent actually uses (after switch) | Subagent request header | |---|---|---|---| | Old session (created while default = deepseek) | deepseek-v4-flash | local-aeonb (switched manually) | **deepseek-v4-flash** ❌ | | New session (created while default = local-aeonb) | local-aeonb | local-aeonb | **local-aeonb** ✅ | #### Two-way reproduction via the dsh web `session.*` API (2026-08-15) **Reproduction A (creation = local → switch to flash → subagent still local)** | Step | Action | Result | |---|---|---| | 1 | Create a new session (global default = local-aeonb) | Session `session-020f3838`, default model = local-aeonb | | 2 | `session.selectModel` to deepseek-v4-flash | Parent request header = `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash / 256000` (switch took effect) | | 3 | Spawn a subagent from the parent (`session.prompt`) | Subagent request header = **`local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5 / 65536`** ❌ does not follow the switch | **Reproduction B (creation = flash → switch to local → subagent still flash; the original user scenario)** | Step | Action | Result | |---|---|---| | 1 | Set global default to flash, create a new session | Session `session-f4284b40`, default model = deepseek-v4-flash | | 2 | `session.selectModel` to local-aeonb | Parent request header = `local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5 / 65536` (switch took effect) | | 3 | Spawn a subagent from the parent (`session.prompt`) | Subagent request header = **`deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash / 256000`** ❌ does not follow the switch | **Side-effect observed**: every `session.selectModel` call also writes the selected model into `agent-default-model` in `settings.yaml` (switching a model changes the global default); `settings.yaml` changed in real time during reproduction and was restored to `local-aeonb` afterwards. ## Root cause ### 1. Subagent inheritance source: a static creation snapshot `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:501-512` ```js function resolveChildAgentOptions(parent, requested, childDepth) { const parentProvider = parent.options.provider; // set once at creation, never updated const parentModel = parent.options.model; const parentMaxTokens = parent.options.maxTokens; return { ...parentProvider !== void 0 ? { provider: parentProvider } : {}, ...parentModel !== void 0 ? { model: parentModel } : {}, ...parentMaxTokens !== void 0 ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {}, ...requested, subagentDepth: childDepth }; } ``` `parent.options` is assigned once in the Agent constructor (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:354`: `this.options = options`) and **no code updates it afterwards**. ### 2. What the creation snapshot contains: the global default at that moment `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1708-1714` ```js const agentOptions = () => { const { provider, model } = defaults.defaultModelSelection(); // reads agent-default-model from settings.yaml return { provider, model }; }; ``` (invoked on session create/resume, lines `2164` and `2152`). ### 3. Switching a model updates two things, but never `parent.options` `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:2694-2706` (`session.selectModel`) ```js selectionFor(found.agent).current = selected; // ① in-memory selection for this session await defaults.saveDefaultModelSelection?.(selected); // ② global default (writes settings.yaml) // parent.options is NOT updated ``` ### 4. Documented intent contradicts the implementation `selectionFor` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1741-1750` documents the intended precedence: > "Precedence, **resolved on EVERY read rather than seeded once**: a selection made in this process, else the session's own **latest logged request/header**, else the live Agent default." i.e. the design philosophy is **dynamic-first**: the authoritative source of a session's current model is its latest request header (`parent.session.requestHeader()?.config`). But `resolveChildAgentOptions` reads the static `parent.options` instead, so the same codebase maintains **two inconsistent notions of "current model"**: - parent session request header: `local-aeonb / 27B-AEON-Q5` (the model actually in use) - subagent inheritance source: `parent.options` = creation snapshot = `deepseek-v4-flash` ## Impact - Subagents spawned after a model switch do not follow the new model; behavior diverges from what the UI shows. - Especially visible in multi-model / multi-provider setups (session A on a local model, session B on the official API — subagents may all fall back to the creation-time default). - Users must create a *new* session to get subagents on the desired model, which is confusing (this report comes from real user feedback). - The fact that `selectModel` also overwrites the global default amplifies the confusion: after a switch, *new* sessions follow the switched model while *subagents* still follow the old snapshot. ### Real-world consequences in hybrid deployments (official API + local models) This report comes from a hybrid deployment (DeepSeek official API coexisting with local llama.cpp models). In this scenario the bug causes: 1. **Hidden API billing**: local models are free; the official API is metered. When a subagent wrongly inherits the creation-time official default, users believe the subagent runs locally while every subagent request actually hits the official API (measured subagent request header: `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash / maxTokens 256000`), incurring unexpected cost. In the reported usage, large batches of subagent tasks (e.g. multi-chapter novel generation) all consumed official quota. 2. **Content-behavior divergence (moderation differences)**: local models (e.g. uncensored fine-tunes) and the official API apply different moderation/filtering policies. Content the parent (local, permissive) can produce may be refused, rewritten, or endlessly retried by the subagent (official, moderated), splitting output style and usability within one task. Real user feedback: "the subagent is a moderated model; the same model in OpenCode can generate it" — caused by this bug. 3. **Subagent connection failures**: if the local model is not running (e.g. the user stopped the service to free VRAM) while a subagent wrongly inherits the local snapshot, every subagent request fails to connect; conversely if the subagent inherits the official default while the user is offline it also fails. In hybrid deployments the "is the model online" state and the "model the subagent actually picked" are misaligned, making failures hard to diagnose. 4. **Default-model drift amplifies cost**: because `selectModel` writes the global default on every switch, combined with the subagent snapshot mismatch, new sessions and subagents can end up on different lines (local vs official) as the user switches between sessions; cost and behavior become unpredictable and cannot be corrected intuitively from the UI (a new session is required). ## Suggested fix ### Option A (recommended): prefer the parent's *actually-used* model, fall back to the creation snapshot Modify `resolveChildAgentOptions` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js:501-512`).
⚠️ Important: an earlier draft used parent.options.provider ?? logged?.provider, which does NOT fix this bug `??` only falls back when `parent.options` is empty, but the bug scenario is precisely when `parent.options` holds a stale value (e.g. flash), so `??` always resolves to the stale value. The request header (actually-used model) must take **precedence**, with the snapshot as fallback — not the other way around: ```js function resolveChildAgentOptions(parent, requested, childDepth) { // The model the parent session actually uses (authoritative): latest request header const logged = parent.session.requestHeader()?.config; // Follow the actual usage; only fall back to the creation snapshot when the // session has never issued a request (no request header yet) const parentProvider = logged?.provider ?? parent.options.provider; const parentModel = logged?.model ?? parent.options.model; const parentMaxTokens = logged?.maxTokens ?? parent.options.maxTokens; return { ...parentProvider !== void 0 ? { provider: parentProvider } : {}, ...parentModel !== void 0 ? { model: parentModel } : {}, ...parentMaxTokens !== void 0 ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {}, ...requested, subagentDepth: childDepth }; } ``` Key points: - **`logged` (request header) takes precedence**: after the parent switches models and actually uses the new one, subagents follow the switched model; - `parent.options` (creation snapshot) only serves as a fallback when the session has never issued a request; - `maxTokens` follows the request header too, avoiding mismatches (e.g. flash 256000 vs local 65536); - `parent.session.requestHeader()` is a public API of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` (`Session.requestHeader()`); `parent` is an Agent (with `.session`), so it is directly usable; - `...requested` is still spread last, so explicit provider/model overrides from the caller keep their precedence.
### Option B (alternative): update `parent.options` inside `selectModel` In `session.selectModel` (`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:2701`), besides updating `selectionFor(...).current` and the global default, also update `found.agent.options.provider/model/maxTokens`. Note: `options.provider/model` is also read by system-prompt variables (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:1001-1002`: `ctx.systemPrompt.variable("provider"/"model")`); updating it will also change the model name in the system prompt (likely desired), but making `options` mutable conflicts with the "creation snapshot" semantics and other paths reading `parent.options` need evaluation. ## Verification after the fix Re-run both API reproductions above (Reproduction A / B); after the fix the expected results are reversed: - Reproduction A (created local → switched flash → spawn subagent): subagent = **flash** ✅ (was local ❌ before) - Reproduction B (created flash → switched local → spawn subagent): subagent = **local** ✅ (was flash ❌ before) ## Notes - Findings based on source reading plus real-environment testing (subagent `request/header` events as direct evidence). - Measured subagent request headers: `{"provider": "deepseek-official", "model": "deepseek-v4-flash", "maxTokens": 256000}` (old-session spawn) vs `{"provider": "local-aeonb", "model": "27B-AEON-Q5", "maxTokens": 65536}` (new-session spawn). - If maintainers consider this behavior intentional (e.g. deliberately pinning subagents to the parent's birth identity), please close with a rationale; otherwise Option A is suggested. - **We kindly ask maintainers to reproduce and fix this precisely**: this report provides complete reproduction steps, two-way API reproduction data, and a precise fix suggestion. Because provider/model setups differ across deployments (this report is based on DeepSeek official API + local llama.cpp hybrid deployment), we suggest maintainers run the two-way reproduction in their official test environment following the "Steps to reproduce" and "Verification after the fix" sections, confirm the root cause, and land Option A or a more appropriate implementation. If the reproduction differs from this report, feedback with additional information is welcome.

discussions.title: "到底是卡死了，还是仍然在运行？"——给 DSH 后台任务增加 Shell 实时进度窗口
discussions.body: **一句话：** 模型在后台跑长命令时，我终于能实时看到它在干什么了 —— 而且这个窗口**不会偷走模型自己的 job_output 数据**。 **痛点（相信很多人都遇到过）** 训练模型、跑批处理、长构建……模型发起一个后台任务后，界面顶部只有一句"N 个后台任务运行中"： - ❌ 看不到正在执行什么命令 - ❌ 运行中没有任何入口打开这个 Shell - ❌ 要等任务结束，对话流里才冒出 `Tool call · job_output`，点开才能看到输出 - ❌ 等久了心里直打鼓："它是不是卡住了？" **我做了什么** 给 DSH 加了一套"后台任务实时输出"能力： 1. **运行中任务小框** —— 输入框上方出现胶囊小框：`● pwsh-1 命令内容 已运行 42秒`，多任务各自独立、并行不打架 2. **实时 Shell 窗口** —— 点击小框打开终端风格窗口：状态圆点 + 耗时 + 完整命令 + **每秒自动刷新的输出流**，自动滚动跟随；向上翻历史时暂停跟随，回到底部自动恢复；任务结束后窗口保留**完整最终输出** 3. **顶部任务列表联动** —— "N 个后台任务运行中"下拉列表的每一行都可点击，直接打开同一个实时窗口 **最有意思的技术点：非消耗式 peek** 人类看进度 ≠ 模型读输出。原来的 `readOutput` 是"消费式"的 —— 谁读谁拿走，界面如果直接轮询，**模型自己的 `job_output` 工具就会少读到数据**。所以我在注册表里新增了 `JobRegistry.peek()` / `JobHooks.peekOutput()`： - 界面轮询走 `peek`：**不推进读游标、不标记完成通知**，观众随便看，模型一个字都不会少读； - 复用 Shell 进程的保留缓冲（偏移 0 读取），**进程退出后窗口依然能拿到完整输出**； - 新增全链路 RPC `jobs.output`，授权与会话级 `session/jobs` 镜像一致，**查看输出不会冷启动会话**。 - [替换文件.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31085421/default.zip) [changes.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31085432/changes.patch) [反馈说明与修改优势.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31085434/default.md) **实测效果** - 5 分钟进度条任务：小框出现 → 点开窗口每秒滚动 → 结束保留完整输出 ✅ - 中途手动取消：状态正确翻转为"已取消"，窗口显示取消前最后输出 ✅ - **质量** - 三层构建（host / client / web）全部通过 - 101 个相关单元测试全绿（含新增的 peek 语义测试：断言读取游标计数为 0） - lint 0 警告 0 错误 **代码**：完整实现已整理好（46 个文件，按仓库路径镜像，可直接覆盖替换），见 `替换文件/`、`changes.patch`，构建与复现步骤见 `反馈说明与修改优势.md`。 --- 欢迎官方和社区同学试跑、拍砖！特别想听大家意见的点： 1. 实时窗口的**刷新频率**（当前 1s）和**输出截断策略**够不够用？ 2. 是否需要在窗口里加**停止任务**按钮？ 3. 以后要不要把实时窗口**嵌入对话流**（像 Tool call 卡片一样），而不是 Dock 小框？ （如果官方采纳，非常乐意按 DSH 的代码规范进一步打磨并提 PR 🙌） ---

discussions.title: Plugin-written session events have no registration surface — a third-party plugin event makes whole session logs unloadable on rc.6
discussions.body:
# Plugin-written session events have no registration surface — a third-party plugin event makes whole session logs unloadable on rc.6

## TL;DR

`dsh-session` validates persisted logs against a **static** list of known event types, and there is **no way for a plugin to register its own event types** — nor to mark an event as *ignorable*. A third-party plugin that appends a custom session event therefore makes the **entire session log unloadable**: no history, no resume. This is a real API gap, not a version mismatch.

---

## Problem

The source itself acknowledges the gap:

> `Downstream (out-of-repo) plugin events are outside this list by construction; a registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists.`
> — `dsh-session` `lib/index.js`

That consumer now exists: plugins like [`LoserFox/distill`](https://github.com/LoserFox/distill) (a skill-distillation plugin) append custom session events via `session.append(type, data)`. On rc.6 two facts combine into a hard failure:

1. **Write side:** `session.append(type, data, opts)` accepts only `sourceEventSeqs` / `surfaceOp` — a plugin **cannot** set `ignorable: true` on the envelope, even though the load side (`assertSessionEventEnvelope`) already understands that key.
2. **Read side:** `assertEventsSupported` refuses the **whole log** if it contains a type outside `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` that is not marked ignorable → `SessionFormatUnsupportedError`.

The error message ("it was likely written by a newer harness") is misleading here: the log is perfectly valid, the harness just doesn't know the plugin's event type.

## Impact

- Every session touched by such a plugin becomes **permanently unloadable** (no history view, no resume) until manually repaired.
- With the plugin's default `minUserMessages: 3`, essentially **every active session** is affected.
- The offending event here is a log-only diagnostic (used to reconstruct model-visible input) — dropping it changes nothing about the conversation. It is exactly the kind of event the `ignorable` contract was designed for, yet the API makes it impossible to mark as such.

## Suggested fixes (in priority order)

1. **Add a plugin-side registration surface** for session event types — e.g. `registerSessionEventType(type)` on the session service/store.
2. **Allow `session.append(type, data, opts)` to carry `ignorable: true`** on the envelope, so log-only/diagnostic plugin events that are safe to skip can opt in.
3. **At minimum, fix the refusal message**: name the offending event type and point at the `ignorable` contract, instead of blaming a newer harness.

## Repro

```bash
# dsh 0.1.0-rc.6; any plugin that appends a custom event type
# (e.g. session/distill-review-request from LoserFox/distill)
dsh web
# use a session until the plugin appends its custom event, then restart
# open the session → SessionFormatUnsupportedError, whole log refused
```

## Workaround (local, non-durable — lost on `npm update`)

- **Option A:** manually add the type to `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` in the installed `dsh-session`:
  `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/lib/index.js`
- **Option B:** for already-broken logs, decompress the log (`unzstd`), add `"ignorable": true` to that event's envelope, recompress (`zstd`).

Both restore full loading; Option B is safe here because the event is log-only and sits outside any turn.

discussions.title: 会话内热切换agent预设：Live agent-preset switching at turn boundaries — a community fork of DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**Project** — Live agent-preset switching at turn boundaries (community soft fork of `dsh`)

**GitHub repository** — https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/deepseek-harness-live-preset-switch
(branch `live-agent-preset-switch`; the feature lands as a single commit, 80 files / +1604 / -148)

**What it does**

An agent preset is currently a session's *creation* fact: once a conversation starts, its mode
(Standard / PTC / Minimal / Creator) is locked, and switching requires abandoning the
conversation. In practice I often wanted to start in Standard, drop to Minimal for quick
follow-ups, and switch back — without losing context.

This fork adds a **preset chip in the composer (input bar)** of running sessions:

- Shows the session's current preset (e.g. `Agent preset, current: Standard mode`).
- Switches to any preset for the *same, already-started* conversation.
- Takes effect at the **next turn boundary** — the chip is disabled while a turn runs, so every
  turn runs under one tool catalog. (API callers get the existing `agent-busy` / `turn-running`
  and retry at idle.)
- The new-session screen keeps its original chip, which still stages the preset of the *next*
  session.

**How it works**

1. **History projection** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`): when the new preset omits a tool an
   earlier turn used, the logged tool call/result is *degraded to deterministic, truncated text*
   rather than dropped, keeping the conversation legible. Adapter-private replay state is
   discarded on rewritten messages so replay-aware providers never fail per-block validation
   (this is what avoids `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`).
2. **Model-visible ⟺ logged**: the session log stays the single source of truth. A switch is
   recorded as an `agent-preset/selected` event, and every request projection is a pure function
   of the log, so cold replays and exports reproduce exactly.
3. **Turn-boundary guard** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy`): `agentPreset.select` keeps the
   blank-session fast path and now also allows a started session while the agent is idle.
   `agent-preset-locked` is no longer produced (kept only for wire compatibility).

Full design rationale lives in the fork's Agent Note
(`.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-14-live-agent-preset-switch.md`).

**Why a fork instead of a PR**

CONTRIBUTING.md says external PRs aren't accepted right now, so this follows the ecosystem path
you describe: ship it as a community fork. If PRs open up later, the branch is prepared —
`PR-PRESET-SWITCH.md` is a complete delivery list for review, including the remaining
Linux-CI checklist items.


---

### 中文版

**项目** — 会话内热切换 agent preset（DeepSeek Harness 社区软分叉）

**仓库** — https://github.com/HaoyanZhang123/deepseek-harness-live-preset-switch
（分支 `live-agent-preset-switch`；功能为单个 commit，80 个文件 / +1604 / -148）

**做了什么**

上游目前把 agent preset 锁定为会话创建时的事实：会话一旦开始，模式（标准 / PTC / 极简 / 创造）
就不能再换，想切换只能放弃对话。而实际使用中经常想"标准模式起步 → 切极简快速追问 → 再切回标准"，
且不丢上下文。

这个 fork 在**输入框（composer）里加了一个 preset chip**：

- 显示当前会话的模式（如 `Agent preset, current: Standard mode`）；
- 在**同一个已开始的会话**里直接切换任意模式；
- 在**回合边界生效**——回合运行中 chip 禁用，保证每个回合只跑在一个工具目录下
  （API 调用方会收到既有的 `agent-busy` / `turn-running`，空闲后重试即可）；
- 新会话页原有的 chip 保持不变，仍然用于预选"下一个"会话的模式。

**原理**

1. **历史投影**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session`）：新模式没有的旧工具调用，被降级为确定性的截断文本
   （工具名 + 截断参数/结果）而不是丢弃，对话保持可读；重写消息会丢弃适配器私有重放状态，
   避免重放类 provider 的逐块校验失败（即 `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`）。
2. **模型可见 ⟺ 已入日志**：会话日志仍是唯一事实来源。切换记录为 `agent-preset/selected` 事件，
   每次请求投影都是日志的纯函数，冷重放和导出结果完全可复现。
3. **回合边界守卫**（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy`）：`agentPreset.select` 保留空会话快速路径，
   并在 agent 空闲时放行已开始的会话；`agent-preset-locked` 不再产生（仅为兼容保留）。

完整设计依据见 fork 内的 Agent Note
（`.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-14-live-agent-preset-switch.md`）。

**为什么是 fork 而不是 PR**

官方 CONTRIBUTING 说明目前不接受外部 PR，因此按社区生态路线以软分叉形式发布。若将来开放 PR，
`PR-PRESET-SWITCH.md` 已备好完整交付清单（含 Linux CI 复核项）。

discussions.title: [bug] 会话历史加载失败：崩溃恢复与残留执行流并发写同一日志，seq 重叠（corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region）
discussions.body:
## 崩溃恢复写入的合成闭包事件，与仍存活的旧执行流写入的真实事件，共用 seq 200476–200479，导致会话历史加载失败。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 0.1.0-rc.6（npm `next`，2026-08-13）
- Windows；存储格式 zstd JSONL，`packChunks` 开启

## 症状

打开会话时提示：

> history unavailable for session "session-da9edcf9-…": Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 10170 (expected 200480, got 200476)（internal）

## 复现路径（据日志证据还原，未做最小确定性复现）

1. `run_code → pwsh` 工具调用执行中被强制结束/重启；日志已持久化到 `tool/code-dispatch-start`（seq 200475）。
2. 重启后的恢复流程合成 4 条闭包事件并写入日志：
   - `tool/result`（`interrupted-tool-result-call_…-200476`，`TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`）
   - `step/end`
   - `turn/end`（`interrupted`）
   - `session/end-seed`
   - 对应 seq 200476–200479。
3. 约 119 秒后，残留的旧执行流把**同一 `rootCallId`/`subCallId` 的真实执行结果**再次追加到同一文件，但 seq 仍从 200476 开始（`tool/code-dispatch` → 真实 `tool/result` → `step/end` → `step/start`…）。
4. 解码器要求 `events[i].seq === i`，在 end-seed 之后发现回退，整段历史拒绝加载。

## 关键日志节选

```text
L10165 seq=200474 tool/call              callId=call_00_wvO…
L10166 seq=200475 tool/code-dispatch-start
L10167 seq=200476 tool/result            interrupted-tool-result-…-200476 / TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
L10168 seq=200477 step/end
L10169 seq=200478 turn/end               reason=interrupted
L10170 seq=200479 session/end-seed
L10171 seq=200476 tool/code-dispatch     ← 与 L10166 同一 subCallId，seq 回退
L10172 seq=200477 tool/result            ← 真实执行结果
L10173 seq=200478 step/end
L10174 seq=200479 step/start
L10175 seq=200480 assistant/chunk
```

物理层面对应：合成闭包位于 zstd 第 7791/7792 帧，真实续写从第 7793 帧开始。

## 影响

- 会话窗口永久显示“历史加载失败”，无法续写。
- 与 README 中“One live writer per session”限制直接冲突：恢复写者与旧执行流写者没有跨实例互斥。

## 临时修复（本地已验证）

删除 4 条过时合成闭包（物理上移除 2 个 zstd 帧）后，剩余 244,016 个逻辑事件用官方 `decodeStorageRecord` + `Session.fromRestore` 全量校验通过，历史完整恢复。

## 期望修复

1. 应用/进程级对同一会话强制单写者，恢复写者在写入闭包前确认旧写者已退出；
2. 或恢复流程以当前已持久化日志长度重新计算游标，而不是让旧执行流按过期游标续写；
3. 可选：解码器遇到“合成 interrupted-tool-result 被同一 callId 的真实 result 取代”模式时，自动丢弃过时闭包而不是整体拒绝加载。

## 关联

- 相关但不相同：#483（force-kill 后 write-behind 尾部丢失）

discussions.title: dsh runs on Termux (Android) — with 5 small patches
discussions.body:
## dsh runs on Termux (Android) — with 5 small patches

Hi team! First of all, thank you for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` — I'm literally running this session on **Termux** (Android) right now, powered by dsh.

The catch: `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` installs but does not *run* on Termux. Five independent incompatibilities have to be fixed. I've packaged everything into a one-command installer: **[lilyco-42/dsh-termux](https://github.com/lilyco-42/dsh-termux)**.

### The 5 problems and their fixes

| # | Package / feature | Problem | Fix |
|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | `node-pty` | node-gyp copies `process.config.variables.OS = "android"` into `config.gypi`, making gyp reference the undefined `android_ndk_path`. | Patch node-gyp to drop the `OS` variable so gyp infers `linux`. |
| 2 | `koffi` | `base.cc` calls `statx()`, hidden by bionic below API 30; clang targets `android24`. | Compile with `--target=aarch64-unknown-linux-android30`. |
| 3 | `sharp` | No prebuilt binding for `android-arm64`. | Install system `libvips` and build sharp against it (`SHARP_FORCE_GLOBAL_LIBVIPS=1`). |
| 4 | HMR service | `cordis-plugin-hmr` needs Node `--expose-internals`; `node-addon-require-builtin` has no android prebuild. | Rewrite the `dsh` shebang to `node --expose-internals`. |
| 5 | `session-persistence-jsonl` | Publishes logs with a hard `link()`, forbidden on Android (`EACCES`). | Switch the atomic publish to `rename()` (equally atomic). |

### Install (Android 11+/API 30+)

```bash
bash <(curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/lilyco-42/dsh-termux/main/install.sh)
```

### Verify

```bash
dsh --version
dsh web            # serves the browser UI
dsh --profile headless "hello"   # one task, prints result, exits
```

### For the maintainers

- Are there plans for official **Android/Termux support** in the harness? Happy to help port these patches into the repo (I know CONTRIBUTING.md currently says external PRs aren't accepted yet — just wanted to document the work in the recommended channel).
- Items **4 and 5** are genuinely portable to the upstream source (`bin.js` re-exec with `--expose-internals`, and `rename()` over `link()` in the JSONL session persistence), and would benefit non-Termux users too (e.g. `link()` also fails on some filesystems).
- Items **1–3** are install-time concerns (node-gyp `OS` detection, clang target, sharp prebuilds) that could be handled by a small install helper shipped with the CLI.

Thanks again for building this — the plugin architecture is a joy to work with on mobile. 🙂

discussions.title: 三键分工 + 插话（steer）快捷键：建议作为默认键位
discussions.body:
## 三键分工 + 插话（steer）快捷键：建议作为默认键位

### 反馈背景

我们在 Hermes Agent + DeepSeek Harness 协作流中遇到一个高频痛点：Agent 跑长任务时（文档蒸馏 / 全量代码 review / 多轮工具调用），用户不能停下来干等——他们要纠正方向、追加要求、或者紧急换话题。普通 Enter 只能排队等当前任务跑完，体感上 Agent 整个时段都"不在线"。

### 现状的不足

- 默认只有 **Enter 发送** + **Shift+Enter 换行** 这一套。
- 没有任何"打断"通道。用户要么干等，要么 `Cmd+R` 刷新页面（丢失上下文）。
- 其实 DSH 后端已经支持 `steer`（插话），只是**前端没有暴露快捷键**，普通用户根本接触不到。

### 建议：把三键作为默认

| 按键 | 行为 | 用途 |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` | 换行 | 多行输入 |
| `Ctrl+Enter` | 普通发送（排队） | 日常消息 |
| `Cmd+Enter` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` (Win/Linux) | **加速/插话（steer）** | Agent 忙时直接打断，立刻转向 |

> 加速模式（steer）代码里的定义：Agent 忙的时候，普通发送会排队等当前任务跑完；Cmd+Enter 是"插话"，让 Agent 放下手里的事先回你。用户忙的时候按 Cmd+Enter，Agent 立刻转向处理新消息。

### 为什么这个改动值得默认化

1. **零学习成本**：键盘上的三个修饰键 Enter / Ctrl+Enter / Cmd+Enter 是绝大多数 IM/编辑器的肌肉记忆（Slack/Discord/VSCode/JetBrains 全家桶都是这套）。
2. **后端能力不要浪费**：DSH 已经支持 steer（插话模式），只是没有快捷键入口，等于把一个高价值功能埋在了高级设置里。
3. **input box 忙时 prompt 自动切换文案**：输入框被禁用时提示文案直接变成 "Cmd/Ctrl+Enter 插话发送全部排队消息"，用户立刻知道加速键能用了。
4. **可逆不影响老用户**：保留 `Shift+Enter` 换行 + `Enter` 发送作为 fallback，老用户无感；新键位只是给了"有需要的人"一条逃生通道。

### 实现要点（供参考）

- 监听 `keydown`：裸 Enter 不发送，Ctrl+Enter 走 `queue()`，Cmd+Enter 走 `steer()`。
- 按钮 hover tooltip 写明 "Cmd+Enter 插话发送"。
- 输入框 disabled 时 placeholder / 边框颜色变一下，让"现在按哪个键"看得见。

### 收益

- Agent 跑长任务时，**用户不再被锁死**——紧急情况可即时打断。
- 这条键位本质是给"用户想说话"和"Agent 在工作"两个状态一个**显式区分通道**。
- 默认化之后，所有 DSH 用户都能用上这个能力，不用再读高级文档。

感谢团队做出这么好的开源项目！如果需要我可以提 PR 帮忙改前端。

discussions.title: Three-key split + Steer shortcut: suggest as the default keybinding
discussions.body:
## Three-key split + Steer shortcut: suggest as the default keybinding

### Context

We're running Hermes Agent on top of DeepSeek Harness for long-horizon workflows — document distillation, full-codebase review, multi-round tool use. One pain point keeps coming up: **when the agent is busy, the user is effectively locked out**. They want to correct direction, append a requirement, or pivot to something urgent, but normal Enter just queues the message and waits for the current task to finish. From the user's perspective, the agent feels "offline" for the whole duration.

### The gap in the current UX

- Default is `Enter` to send, `Shift+Enter` for newline. That's it.
- There is no "interrupt" channel. The only escape hatch today is `Cmd+R` reload, which **drops session context**.
- The backend already supports `steer` (interrupting the current run and re-orienting the agent). It's just not exposed via any keyboard shortcut, so normal users never touch it.

### Proposal: make three keys the default

| Key | Action | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `Enter` | Newline | Multi-line input |
| `Ctrl+Enter` | Normal send (queue) | Day-to-day messages |
| `Cmd+Enter` (macOS) / `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` (Win/Linux) | **Steer / interrupt** | Cut into a busy agent immediately |

> Steer, in code: when the agent is busy, a normal send joins the queue and waits for the current run to finish. `Cmd+Enter` is the interrupt — the agent drops what it's doing and re-orients to your new message first. If you press it while the agent is busy, the agent pivots immediately.

### Why this is worth defaulting

1. **Zero learning cost.** `Enter` / `Ctrl+Enter` / `Cmd+Enter` is the muscle memory almost every IM and editor already uses — Slack, Discord, VS Code, the entire JetBrains family. Users won't have to learn anything new; they'll just discover the existing pattern is there.
2. **Stop wasting backend capability.** Steer already works. Shipping only a queue-mode default means a high-leverage feature is buried in advanced settings that nobody opens.
3. **The input box can advertise it when it matters.** When the input is disabled (agent is busy), the placeholder / hint text can flip to "Cmd/Ctrl+Enter to steer past queued messages" — so the affordance only appears at the moment it's useful, instead of cluttering the UI the rest of the time.
4. **Fully reversible.** Keep `Shift+Enter` for newline and `Enter` for send as a fallback for existing users who never want to think about it. The new keys are purely additive — a second escape hatch for the people who need it.

### Implementation sketch (for reference)

- Listen on `keydown` for the textarea / contenteditable:
  - bare `Enter` → no send (let it pass for newline)
  - `Ctrl+Enter` → call the existing `queue()` send path
  - `Cmd+Enter` (Mac) / `Ctrl+Shift+Enter` (Win/Linux) → call `steer()`
- Update the send button's hover tooltip: "Cmd+Enter to steer"
- When the input is disabled, swap the placeholder and the border accent color so it's visually obvious which key will work right now.

### What you get

- Long-running agents stop locking the user out — they can be interrupted the moment something more important comes up.
- It's a clean separation between two states: *"I want to talk to the agent"* vs *"the agent is working for me"*. One key per state, no ambiguity.
- Default-on means every Harness user benefits, not just the ones who read the advanced docs.

Thanks for the open-source work — happy to open a PR against the frontend if the team is open to it.

discussions.title: Session resume fails with "invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq N" after an approval-policy switch
discussions.body:
# Session resume fails with `invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq N` after an approval-policy switch

## Summary

Opening an existing conversation and resuming it fails permanently with:

```
internal: resume failed for session "session-…": Error: invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq 488
```

The persisted log is structurally perfect (contiguous seqs, valid checksums), but one durable `agent/inbox/spliced` event references a message that was never durably inserted: a `claim()` recorded deleting 1 message from the `next-step` inbox while replaying the log yields an empty `next-step`. The strict replay-once validation in `dsh-agent`'s `Inbox` then hard-fails resume with no built-in recovery path.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` / all `@deepseek-ai/*` packages at `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Windows, Web GUI, JSONL persistence backend with zstd compression (`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`)

## Evidence

Session log: 90,043 events, 4,030 zstd frames, seqs contiguous `0..90042` (no gaps, no duplicates), all frames decode and validate. The only inconsistency is logical.

Relevant event window (seq 484–493):

```
484  step/end    turn 3 step 2
485  step/start  turn 3 step 3          ← 48 s gap with no events (turn pending)
486  agent/inbox/spliced  next-turn start=0 insert [user "继续"]   ← user message queued
487  turn/start  turn 4
488  agent/inbox/spliced  next-step  start=0 removedCount=1       ← INVALID on replay
489  agent/inbox/spliced  next-turn  start=0 removedCount=1
490  step/start  turn 4 step 1
491  user/message  "The approval policy changed from \"ask\" to \"never\" (changed by the user)."  (source: plugin "user-approval")
492  user/message  "继续"
493  user/message  (runtime-context snapshot)
```

Key findings:

1. During the 48 s gap the user switched the approval policy `ask → never`. `dsh-user-approval`'s `setPolicy()` appends an `approval/policy` event and then calls `agent.inject(createUserMessage(...))`, which routes through `send(message, "next-step", false)` → `inbox.splice("next-step", …)` — a **durable** `agent/inbox/spliced` insert.
2. Both of those events (`approval/policy`, and the `next-step` insert of the policy-change message) are **absent from the durable log**, yet the live inbox clearly held the message: the claim at seq 488 recorded `removedCount: 1` computed from the live `next-step` length.
3. The immediately following events (486–489) *were* persisted. So a durable append batch containing the two events was lost while later appends survived — the live inbox projection and the durable log diverged.
4. Turn 3 has no `step/end`/`turn/end` before turn 4's `turn/start`: the running turn was abandoned mid-step, consistent with a writer-lifecycle interruption (plugin reload / dispose / process boundary) rather than an in-log corruption.

## Root cause hypothesis

The `Inbox` `mutate()` path commits the durable event before mutating the live projection, and the JSONL backend rolls back a failed batch and retains it for retry, so a plain write failure alone should not drop exactly two events while later ones persist. The observed pattern (middle events lost, later events persisted, turn abandoned mid-step) points to a **write-path lifecycle race**: a batch still buffered in a `SessionWriteBehind` when its owning `PersistenceCoordinator` is reloaded/disposed (e.g. HMR reload of the persistence plugin, or a session lifecycle boundary) is dropped, while the new coordinator, having re-seeded its cursor from the disk prefix (which lacks those events), persists all subsequent events normally. The in-memory agent/Inbox keeps the phantom message, and the next `claim()` durably records a deletion that the replayed log cannot satisfy.

## Impact

- The affected session can never be resumed again (`resume failed … invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq N`).
- The validation is deliberate defense-in-depth, but there is no recovery path: a single dropped event bricks the whole conversation, and no repair surface exists in the product.

## Suggested fixes (upstream)

1. **Root cause**: audit the persistence write-path lifecycle — `SessionWriteBehind` + `PersistenceCoordinator` (dsh-session-persistence) across plugin reload/dispose/adoption boundaries — for a path that can discard a retained buffered batch while later batches persist. In particular, verify that a re-seeded coordinator cannot diverge from the live session's event list, and that HMR reload of the persistence plugin drains the old controller's buffer before the new one takes over.
2. **Defensive recovery**: when `Inbox` replay validation fails on resume (`invalid persisted inbox splice`), instead of hard-failing, treat out-of-range splice coordinates as recoverable — clamp `removedCount` to the replayed list length (the claim was clearing the queue; the end state is identical) and drop duplicate-inserted message ids — log a warning, and continue. This preserves all events and message content and keeps the session resumable.
3. **Invariant check**: detect divergence early — e.g., a `claim()` whose deletion count exceeds the durable projection is already the signal; surface it as a logged warning at write time.

## Reproduction

Timing-dependent (a lost-write race), but the triggering interaction is:

1. Start a turn whose step is pending (e.g. waiting on approval under policy `ask`).
2. While it is pending, switch the approval policy `ask → never` (this calls `setPolicy` → `agent.inject` → `next-step` insert).
3. Send a follow-up message.
4. Restart the harness, then open the session and resume → `invalid persisted inbox splice at session seq N`.

## Workaround (local data repair, no product changes)

Until fixed upstream, the affected log can be repaired by clamping the out-of-range `removedCount` on the offending splice (no events removed, seqs untouched, message content intact). The repaired log replays cleanly through the real `Session` + `Inbox` classes and resumes normally.

discussions.title: [BUG] 会话日志中一条 tool/result 引用了不存在的 call id，导致该会话所有请求被供应商 400 拒绝，永久不可用
discussions.body:
[BUG] 会话日志中一条 tool/result 引用了不存在的 call id，导致该会话所有后续请求被供应商以 400 拒绝，永久不可用、无自愈路径

## English Summary (TL;DR)

A single corrupted `tool/result` event in a session log cites a **call id that never existed** in any assistant message. From then on, *every* LLM request in that session is rejected by the provider with `400 INVALID_REQUEST` — *"An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id', The following tool_call_ids did not have response messages: …"* — and the session is permanently deadlocked. The harness has **no validation of tool-call ↔ tool-result pairing** when deriving/serializing the transcript, and the crash-repair path (`interruptedTurnClosers`) only covers *open tail turns* at load, so a mismatched call id inside a closed turn is never detected or repaired. Surface replacement for `tool/result` is additionally restricted to changing only `content` (`assertToolResultRewrite`: *"may change only content"*), so even manual recovery through supported APIs is impossible; we had to patch the JSONL file directly.

Environment: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` **0.1.0-rc.6**, web profile, Windows, JSONL+zstd session persistence.

---

## 1. 现象

- GUI 显示：`本轮运行失败` + `An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id', The following tool_call_ids did not have response messages: call_efaab339117449e8b1e79c44`（HTTP 400, INVALID_REQUEST）。
- 同一会话连续重试 3 次（第 12、13、14 轮），每次都在**第一步请求**即失败，会话完全无法继续。

## 2. 根因（有完整证据链）

会话 `session-28edf83f-…`，第 7 轮 step 1：

| seq | 事件  | 内容  |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 10438 | `assistant/message` | 工具调用：`todo_write(call_f8b23eafdd7a4237b572fcec)` + `pwsh(call_97d60fa2b6314cd383925ab6)`（流式 chunk 10293–10435 中的 id 与此一致） |
| 10439 / 10441 | `tool/call` / `tool/result` | todo_write，引用 `f8b23eaf…` ✓ |
| 10442 | `tool/call` | pwsh，引用 `97d60fa2…` ✓ |
| **10443** | `tool/result` | **引用 `call_efaab339117449e8b1e79c44` —— 该 id 在整份日志中从未出现在任何 assistant 消息或 tool/call 里**；且 step=2（调用在 step 1）、**无 `sourceEventSeqs`**、`isError=false` |

用与 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 完全相同的 wire 序列化逻辑复现，发给供应商的历史为：

```
assistant tool_calls = [call_f8b23eaf…, call_97d60fa2…]
tool messages       = [call_f8b23eaf…, call_efaab339…]   ← 97d60fa2 无应答 → 供应商 400
```

该坏事件不符合 Harness 任何正常写入路径的特征：

- `appendToolResult`（dsh-agent-loop）总是带 `sourceEventSeqs` 且使用 assistant block 的 id；
- 崩溃修复 `interruptedTurnClosers` 合成的结果总是 `isError=true` 且带 error code；
- tool-result pruner 只做 `surfaceOp: replace` 且保留 callId。

→ 结论：该事件来自写入竞争（torn/interleaved write），而非正常逻辑。

## 3. 触发场景（重要）

第 7 轮代理执行的 pwsh 命令本身在**重命名 sessions 目录**：

```
Rename-Item C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\sessions → sessions.old
New-Item -ItemType Junction C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\sessions → D:\...\dsh-sessions
```

即：**Harness 正在向会话日志追加写入时，其持久化目录被改名 + 换成 junction**（Windows 下 O_APPEND 句柄与目录 rename/junction 并发）。同一会话更早还有另一处损坏（seq 488 `agent/inbox/spliced` 的 `removedCount` 异常，只能手工修补），进一步佐证写入流被破坏。

## 4. Harness 缺口（希望修复的点）

1. **无配对校验**：`Session.deriveMessages()` / 各 adapter 的 wire 序列化不做 "assistant tool-call ↔ tool 消息" 配对校验。日志一旦出现错配记录，wire 历史必然非法，供应商 400，Harness 无检测、无恢复。
2. **崩溃修复覆盖不足**：`interruptedTurnClosers` 只处理加载时「尾轮未闭合」的情况；「已闭合轮次内的错配 call id」完全覆盖不到（本例轮次已正常闭合，只是轮内结果引用错误）。
3. **修复途径被锁死**：`tool/result` 的 surface replacement 被 `assertToolResultRewrite` 限制为只能改 `content`（`message.source.callId` 在比对范围内），因此即使想通过受支持的 API 修正 call id 也不被允许，只能手工改文件。
4. **UX 无提示**：GUI 只透传供应商原文错误，用户无法判断是"会话日志已损坏"，只能反复重试。
5. **持久化目录无保护**：sessions 目录被 rename/junction 时没有保护或检测；加载时只有帧结构校验，没有事件级语义校验（seq 连续、call id 配对）。

## 5. 建议修复方向

1. 在 deriveMessages 或序列化前做配对校验：对每条 assistant tool-call，确认其后存在同 id 的 tool 消息；错配时自动修复（如把结果 id 修正为最近的未应答调用）、丢弃孤儿记录，或至少记录 `session/corruption` 事件并在 UI 提示。
2. 扩展 `interruptedTurnClosers`（或新增 transcript-repair pass）覆盖已闭合轮次：扫描全日志，修正/清除引用了未知 call id 的 `tool/result`。
3. 为修复工具结果提供受支持途径（允许通过 surface replacement 修正 call id，或提供专门的 repair API）。
4. GUI 遇到此类"历史无效"错误时提示"会话日志可能损坏，可新建会话/联系支持"，并给出会话 ID。
5. Windows 下对持久化目录改名/move 增加防护，或写入时校验路径身份；并对日志做事件级校验。

## 6. 证据材料（可按需提供）

- 修复后的会话日志：`C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\sessions\…\session-28edf83f-….jsonl.zstd`（修复前备份在 `D:\ds harness默认工作区\session-28edf83f.jsonl.zstd.bak`）
- 修复脚本：`D:\ds harness默认工作区\repair-broken-session.mjs`（逐帧重编码，仅改 seq 10443 的 callId + step）
- wire 复现脚本：`D:\ds harness默认工作区\wire-repro.mjs`
- 会话扫描脚本：`D:\ds harness默认工作区\scan-all-sessions.mjs`（可复现"全日志仅此一处错配"）

修复方式说明：由于 surface replacement 不允许改 callId，只能直接重写 zstd-jsonl 中 seq 10443 这一条记录（`callId`/`toolCallId` 改为 `call_97d60fa2…`，step 2→1），其余 1693 个 zstd 帧字节原样保留；修复后全日志 0 悬挂调用、0 孤儿结果，wire 校验通过。

discussions.title: Abyss 深海曜石：一套完整的 dsh web 界面重制 — a full UI restyle built on the token layer
discussions.body:
Thanks for open-sourcing this — the plugin architecture made a full visual overhaul far cleaner than I expected, so I wanted to share the result and two gotchas I hit along the way.

**Abyss (深海曜石)** is a complete restyle of the `dsh web` client on top of `v0.1.0-rc.5` (`47f9438`). Light mode reads as ink on porcelain (mist-blue canvas, white surfaces); dark mode is an actual abyss (blue-black elevation layers). A sapphire accent runs through focus rings, selection indicators and the send button.

Repo: https://github.com/douyamv/deepseek-harness-abyss

![light](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/douyamv/deepseek-harness-abyss/main/assets/abyss/conversation-light.png)

![dark](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/douyamv/deepseek-harness-abyss/main/assets/abyss/conversation-dark.png)

**What it changes**

- **Token layer** — recast the `--dsw-*` palette (cool neutral ramp + sapphire), added `accent-primary` / `accent-soft` / `ring` semantics plus a radius scale, reworked the shadow tiers, redrew the shiki dual-theme code palette.
- **Surfaces** — sidebar panel and session rows (accent indicator, status-dot halo), tool-call rows rebuilt as compact monospace cards with a 20px accent icon tray (my favourite part — it changed how the whole transcript reads), the composer as a floating card with a focus-ring choreography, and the shared primitives: buttons, menus, dialogs, tooltips, toasts, code blocks, settings.

**What it deliberately does not change:** agent behavior, slot composition, session protocol, locale keys, public exports. CSS Modules + tokens only, per `docs/web-styling.md`; `pnpm run test:gui` stays green (272 files / 3757 tests).

**Two things that might deserve a line in the docs**

1. `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` can resolve `@types/react` from *outside* the repo. The client aggregate includes specs from packages that don't declare `react` (e.g. `client/connection`, `client/modules`, `api/gateway`), so under `jsx: react-jsx` their `react/jsx-runtime` lookup walks up past the repo root — on my machine it landed on a stray `$HOME/node_modules/@types/react@19`, putting two `ReactNode` declarations in one program (`Type 'bigint' is not assignable to type 'ReactNode'`). Pinning `@types/react` in the root `devDependencies` fixes it. Per-package `src` programs are unaffected, which is why CI is green.
2. The `auto` directory picker opens a **native host dialog**. That is right for a local desktop session, but surprising when `dsh web` is driven headlessly or over a remote host — the request just hangs on a dialog nobody can see. `browse` may be the friendlier default in those setups.

Happy to split the token layer out as a standalone bundle if there is interest in a theming seam — it is four CSS sheets plus per-component modules, and nothing else depends on it.

---

**中文简介**

在 `47f9438` 基础上做了一套完整的 Web 界面重制，代号「深海曜石」：浅色是墨与瓷（雾蓝画布 + 纯白浮面），深色是深渊（蓝黑分层），蓝宝石点缀色贯穿聚焦环、选中指示与发送按钮。工具调用行改成了等宽小卡片，观感变化最大。

全部改动走设计令牌层与 CSS Modules，没有触碰 agent 行为、槽位组合、会话协议与 locale 键，客户端测试保持全绿。上面两条 issue 供参考：一是 client 聚合工程可能解析到仓库外的 `@types/react`，二是 `auto` 目录选择器会在宿主机弹原生对话框，远程/无头场景下会静默卡住。

令牌层如果对官方有价值，我可以拆成独立 bundle 提 PR。

discussions.title: hooks-claude-code bridge: add SessionEnd event support
discussions.body:
## Summary

The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code` bridge currently supports 7 of 30 Claude Code hook events: `SessionStart`, `UserPromptSubmit`, `PreToolUse`, `PostToolUse`, `Stop`, `SubagentStart`, `SubagentStop`. `SessionEnd` is missing.

## Motivation

`SessionEnd` is the hook point Claude Code clients (including tools like Serena `serena-hooks`) use for per-session cleanup: removing temporary session persistence directories, flushing caches, etc. Without it, cleanup hooks simply never fire, and per-session garbage accumulates on disk.

Concrete real-world impact: Serena `serena-hooks cleanup --client claude-code` is wired to `SessionEnd` in Claude Code, but DSH users have to map it to `Stop` instead — the closest available event, but semantically not the same (`Stop` fires every turn, not just once at session end). This is a workaround, not a proper fix.

## Proposal

Add `SessionEnd` to the `CLAUDE_EVENTS` array in `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/config.ts` so it is parsed and dispatched like the existing 7 events.

## Expected behavior

- `SessionEnd` hooks defined in a `hooks.json` would be executed when the DSH session ends.
- Cleanup hooks (e.g. `serena-hooks cleanup`) would fire exactly once at session termination, not every turn.

## Additional context

- Config definition: `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/config.ts:11-19` (the `CLAUDE_EVENTS` array)
- Bridge README: `packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/README.zh.md:20-27` (lists 7 supported events and explicitly notes 23 unsupported ones including `SessionEnd`)
- Serena issue tracking the `--client dsh` gap: https://github.com/oraios/serena/issues/1869
