````
- 访问方式：电脑与手机在同一局域网（或通过 Tailscale 组网），手机浏览器通过**明文 HTTP** 访问 `http://<电脑IP>:3080`（非 localhost）

## 问题现象

Web GUI 的页面外壳能正常加载，但所有数据层面全部失效：

1. 工作区列表为空、无法选择工作区
2. 加载提供方目录失败
3. 浏览器控制台报错：`加载提供方目录失败: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`

## 根因分析

`crypto.randomUUID` 只在**安全上下文**（HTTPS 或 localhost）中可用。手机通过明文 HTTP + 非 localhost 地址访问时，浏览器处于非安全上下文，`crypto.randomUUID === undefined`。而客户端 bundle 中**无条件调用**该 API，第一次调用即抛异常，导致启动/数据加载流程中断，页面只剩空壳。

电脑本机访问正常，是因为 `127.0.0.1` 被浏览器视为安全上下文。

## 已核实的调用点（浏览器端代码）

- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts`：`RpcId(crypto.randomUUID())` —— 每个 RPC 请求的 rpcId 都走这里，**导致所有 API 调用（工作区列表、会话列表等）全部失败**
- `packages/client/connection/src/client.ts`：`MessageId(crypto.randomUUID())`
- `packages/client/ui-conversation`：消息 id 使用 `crypto.randomUUID()`
- `dsh-commands`：`instanceToken = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)`

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 `dsh --profile web`，并通过 profile patch 将 webserver 的 host 设为 `0.0.0.0`（CLI 的 `--host 0.0.0.0` 被有意禁用，但配置文件方式可以绑定全接口）
2. 手机浏览器打开 `http://<局域网IP>:3080`（或 `http://<Tailscale IP>:3080`）
3. 观察：页面加载，但工作区列表为空、提供方目录加载失败，控制台报 `crypto.randomUUID is not a function`

> 补充：即使不绑定 `0.0.0.0`，只要通过 Tailscale IP（100.x.x.x，非 localhost 的明文 HTTP）访问，同样触发此问题。任何非回环的明文 HTTP 访问都会命中。

## 期望行为

在非安全上下文（明文 HTTP 局域网/Tailscale 访问）下，GUI 应能正常工作；或至少给出明确提示要求使用 HTTPS。

## 已验证的临时解决方案

在 `dsh-web-frontend/dist/index.html` 的 `<head>` 中、入口脚本加载之前注入 polyfill（`crypto.getRandomValues` 在非安全上下文可用）：

```html
<script>
if (window.crypto && !window.crypto.randomUUID && window.crypto.getRandomValues) {
  window.crypto.randomUUID = function () {
    var b = window.crypto.getRandomValues(new Uint8Array(16));
    b[6] = (b[6] & 0x0f) | 0x40; b[8] = (b[8] & 0x3f) | 0x80;
    var h = ""; for (var i = 0; i < 16; i++) h += b[i].toString(16).padStart(2, "0");
    return h.slice(0,8)+"-"+h.slice(8,12)+"-"+h.slice(12,16)+"-"+h.slice(16,20)+"-"+h.slice(20);
  };
}
</script>

discussions.title: [Feature Request] 支持在非官方 DeepSeek 风格 OpenAI 兼容网关上选择思考挡位 / Support reasoning-effort selection on non-official DeepSeek-style OpenAI-compatible gateways
discussions.body:
## 需求背景 / Motivation

我们在一个非官方的 OpenAI 兼容网关上使用 DSH。该网关的模型遵循 DeepSeek
语义，并接受 `reasoning_effort` 挡位（off / high / max）。我们希望通过现有
配置面（模型条目上的 `reasoningEfforts` 声明、`agent-default-model` 中的
`reasoningEffort` 选择）在非官方网关上按模型、按会话选择思考挡位。目前这条
链路无法端到端工作——请求还没到达模型就失败了。

We run DSH against a non-official OpenAI-compatible gateway whose models
follow DeepSeek semantics and accept `reasoning_effort` levels (off / high /
max). We want to select the reasoning effort per model and per session, using
the existing configuration surface (`reasoningEfforts` on model entries and
`reasoningEffort` in `agent-default-model`). On such a gateway this currently
does not work end to end — every request fails before reaching the model.

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    internal:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://example.internal/v1   # DeepSeek-style gateway
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
      models:
        - id: model-x
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
            max: max
agent-default-model:
  provider: internal
  model: model-x
  reasoningEffort: high
```

## 拦路问题 / Blocking issue

一旦模型声明思考挡位，pi-ai 就会用 OpenAI 的 `developer` 角色发送 system
prompt。DeepSeek 风格的端点只接受 `system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`
四种角色，因此网关对每个请求都返回 `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant
'developer'`。手工声明的路由目前无法保持 `system` 角色。

As soon as a model advertises reasoning efforts, pi-ai sends the system
prompt with the OpenAI `developer` role. DeepSeek-style endpoints only accept
`system` / `user` / `assistant` / `tool`, so the gateway rejects every request
with `400 messages[0].role: unknown variant 'developer'`. Hand-declared routes
currently have no way to keep the `system` role.

## 建议方案 / Proposed fix

在 route 级和 model 级的 compat 配置中增加 `supportsDeveloperRole`（回退顺序：
目录条目 → baseURL 推断），并透传到 `resolveModelCompat`——与现有
`supportsReasoningEffort` 开关完全对称：

Add `supportsDeveloperRole` to the route- and model-level compat profile
(falling back to the installed catalog entry, then pi-ai's baseURL-derived
guess), carried through `resolveModelCompat` — symmetric with the existing
`supportsReasoningEffort` switch:

```yaml
compat:
  thinkingFormat: deepseek
  supportsDeveloperRole: false   # keep role 'system' on DeepSeek-style endpoints
```

两个开关配合后，非官方 DeepSeek 风格网关上的思考挡位选择即可完整可用。
已有可运行的实现（约 16 行改动，补丁见附件），并已在生产环境的内网
DeepSeek 风格网关上验证三个挡位全部可用。

Together the two switches make reasoning-effort selection fully functional on
non-official DeepSeek-style gateways. A working implementation exists
(~16-line diff, patch attached) and has been verified in production against an
internal DeepSeek-style gateway with all three effort levels.
[llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31092834/llm-pi-ai-supports-developer-role.patch)

discussions.title: Proposal for a top level ui toggle button to switch between chat and agent mode.
discussions.body:
To the devs at DeepSeek, thank you for a very versatile model. DeepSeek has been one of my main LLM's for the past year.

I recently delved in agentic, so for the past year mostly used the web interface for coding. There is a strange benefit from working with the LLM in chat based ui, and that is token savings, the co-authoring with the LLM, and the general tightness of keeping the LLM on track.

Recently I tried out agentic and although I admit I am very new to it, one session chewed up 1.5M tokens using pi connected to DeepSeek v4 Flash, and most of that time I felt I was not having a meaningful say in what the agent was doing. I blew my token budget on a free tier api which I really regret. This would not have happened if I was doing this through in chat mode.

This is where a tradeoff would be very welcome, by giving DeepSeek-Harness two working modes that can be triggered by the user, namely, agent mode and chat mode. There are many times I am working as product developer, debugger and tester, while the LLM is working as coder. This is a very good work load for me because I get to keep the overall picture in mind and to steer the LLM onto granulated issues like fixing one bug at a time, adding one feature at a time, knowing when to revert, etc. Many times I am able to identify bugs far more efficiently than the LLM and immediately propose a tweak to test. This is where chat mode really shines without blowing a token budget because the LLM is on autopilot.

Having a chat/agent toggle would solve both usage cases, and give a very cool feature that I dont see in any harness in the market right now. I would love to see this in DeepSeek-Harness first. This would cater to the full spectrum of users from chat based coders to agentic based coders, and make your harness even more versatile.

discussions.title: 【插件 / Plugin】dsh-plugin-claude-import: 把 Claude Code 会话导入 DeepSeek Harness 作为可续接上下文 / Import Claude Code sessions as continuable context
discussions.body:
**dsh-plugin-claude-import** — a plugin for people moving from Claude Code to DeepSeek Harness. It turns an existing Claude Code session (`~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl`) into **continuable context**: the auto-summary chain, the last task (`last-prompt`), the files that were touched, and the tail state — not an event replay. A fresh DSH session can pick the work up where Claude left off.

### What it gives you

- **Agent tools**
  - `claude_session_list` — list sessions (id / project / title / mtime / message stats)
  - `claude_session_import` — import one session as a `seed` context block (paste-ready for a new session) or a full markdown continuation document
  - `createSession=true` — creates a new DSH session in the Claude project directory and delivers the context as its first message
- **Web GUI** — a "Claude 导入" action in the conversation header: type a session id (empty = most recent), and the plugin creates, opens, and seeds the new session

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-claude-import
```

It declares a `dsh.bundle`, so `dsh plugin` links it and applies its patch layer — no manual `cordis.patch.yml` editing needed.

### Details

- Pure-Node JSONL parser, zero runtime dependencies; `node --test` 7/7
- Targets the `0.1.0-rc.6` npm line (peer ranges `^0.1.0-rc.6`)
- GitHub: https://github.com/changhang155/dsh-plugin-claude-import
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-claude-import

### Why "context import" instead of "session migration"

The design premise: tool calls have little continuation value once state already lives in the git worktree — what you actually need to resume is *what the session concluded*. So the plugin extracts summary chains and tail state rather than replaying a 100 MB event stream.

Feedback, issues, and PRs welcome. If the summary-chain-first import pattern is useful to you, I'd love to hear about it.

---

**中文版**

**dsh-plugin-claude-import** —— 面向从 Claude Code 迁移到 DeepSeek Harness 的用户。它把已有的 Claude Code 会话(`~/.claude/projects/*.jsonl`)转换成**可续接的上下文**:自动摘要链、最后任务(last-prompt)、动过的文件、尾部状态——而不是事件回放。新的 DSH 会话可以无缝接手 Claude 留下的工作。

### 功能

- **agent 工具**
  - `claude_session_list` —— 列出会话(ID / 项目 / 标题 / 修改时间 / 消息统计)
  - `claude_session_import` —— 把某个会话导入为 `seed` 开场上下文块(可直接粘贴进新会话)或完整的 markdown 续接文档
  - `createSession=true` —— 在 Claude 项目目录新建 DSH 会话,并把上下文作为首条消息投递
- **Web GUI** —— 会话头部新增「Claude 导入」入口:输入会话 ID(留空 = 最近一个),插件自动创建、打开并播种新会话

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-claude-import
```

包声明了 `dsh.bundle`,`dsh plugin` 会自动链接并应用其 patch 层——无需手动修改 `cordis.patch.yml`。

### 细节

- 纯 Node 的 JSONL 解析器,零运行时依赖;`node --test` 7/7
- 面向 `0.1.0-rc.6` npm 线(peer 范围 `^0.1.0-rc.6`)
- GitHub: https://github.com/changhang155/dsh-plugin-claude-import
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-claude-import

### 为什么是「上下文导入」而不是「会话迁移」

设计前提:一旦状态已经落在 git 工作树里,工具调用本身几乎没有续接价值——真正需要的是*会话得出的结论*。所以插件提取摘要链和尾部状态,而不是回放一份 100MB 的事件流。

欢迎反馈、issue 和 PR。如果你也觉得「摘要链优先」的导入模式有用,欢迎留言交流!

discussions.title: Skill loader returns 'unknown or no longer available' for skills that exist on disk (session catalog snapshot)
discussions.body:
# GitHub Issue Draft — deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness

> **Title:** Skill loader intermittently returns `skill "X" is unknown or no longer available` while the skill exists on disk — session skill catalog appears snapshotted at session start

## Summary

The `skill` loader tool intermittently rejects skills with `Error: skill "<name>" is unknown or no longer available`, even though the skill's `SKILL.md` exists under `~/.dsh/skills/<name>/` and *other sessions started minutes later load the same skill successfully*. All observed failures fall inside a narrow time window in which the skill registry was being modified, which points at the session skill catalog being snapshotted (or scanned) at session start rather than resolved lazily at tool-call time.

## Environment

- DSH version: v0.1.0-rc.6 (Windows 11, desktop shell `dsh-desktop-electron`, `DSH_HOME=D:\dsh-home`)
- Skills installed under `~/.dsh/skills/` (junctioned in bulk during setup)
- Provider: deepseek-official, model deepseek-v4-flash

## Evidence

**Failing sessions** (both in `~/.dsh/sessions/--C-Users-Allan~0020Hill-AppData-Local-Temp-dsh-test--/`):

| session | createdAt (local) | occurrences |
|---|---|---|
| `session-bc2caff8-e081-4959-9649-a253ded168b1` | 2026-08-14 09:54 | 9 |
| `session-a66ab322-2619-492b-a1b7-235ddfc4f4f1` | 2026-08-14 09:57 | 3 |

Verbatim tool result (role=user, `isError: true`):

```
Error: skill "wiki-ops" is unknown or no longer available
```

The assistant's own on-error observation (recorded in the session log):

> "The skill tool says 'wiki-ops' is unknown or no longer available. The filesystem MCP server doesn't have access to ~/.dsh/skills."
> "However, the `skill` loader tool says 'wiki-ops' is unknown or no longer available — **meaning the session catalog (from the system reminder) does not include it**."

**Counter-example — success in a session started ~20 min later** (`session-117622a0-505a-48b2-9bf1-2d8d929cde3a`, 08-14 10:14+):

```
<skill_content name="wiki-ops">
<skill_resources>
Base directory for this skill: C:\Users\Allan Hill\.dsh\skills\wiki-ops
...
```
Assistant verdict: "The `wiki-ops` skill loaded successfully. ✅ Succeeded."

Same skills directory, same machine — only the session start time differs.

## Timing correlation

The two failing sessions started 09:54 and 09:57 — during a window when the skill registry on this machine was actively being modified (bulk-importing 69 skills, fixing skill frontmatter, verifying catalog registration). Sessions started after the registry settled load the skill without error. This matches: **the skill catalog is built at session start from a registry scan that was mid-mutation (or from cached/stale state), and the loader hard-fails on any name absent from that snapshot — with no on-disk fallback.**

## Impact

- Intermittent skill unavailability in sessions started during/after registry changes; tasks that depend on a missing-from-catalog skill silently degrade (e.g., quality gates fall back to non-skill paths).
- Very confusing failure mode: the skill clearly exists on disk (`SKILL.md` readable), but the loader rejects it, and error messages carry no hint about the snapshot mechanism.

## Suggested fix candidates

1. **On-disk fallback**: when the loader misses in the session catalog, scan `~/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` directly before returning "unknown" (also fixes stale/partial catalogs).
2. **Lazy catalog resolution**: resolve the skill catalog at tool-call time (or re-scan on miss), rather than trusting a session-start snapshot.
3. **Registry mutation hygiene**: serialize/exclude skill-registry writes while sessions are being created, or bump a registry version that sessions re-check.

## Repro sketch

1. Install or remove a skill under `~/.dsh/skills/` while a DSH session is open (or immediately before starting one).
2. In a fresh session, invoke the `skill` tool with that skill's name.
3. Observe "unknown or no longer available" although `SKILL.md` exists on disk; repeat after registry settles → succeeds.

---
Drafted 2026-08-15 by Claude from session-log evidence (see `dsh_dream_worker.py` cluster #4, `~/.dsh/sessions/` archives). Session files are zstd-compressed JSONL; the quoted excerpts are verbatim.

discussions.title: History API pages can exceed megabytes with large tool output
discussions.body:
## Problem

The history API limits pages by message count, not response size. A small number of messages with large tool output can therefore serialize into multi-megabyte JSON responses. Over public or slow connections, this can time out or be aborted by the client while loading session history.

## Proposed solution

Apply a UTF-8 response-byte budget when constructing history pages. The proposed default is 256 KiB, configurable as `historyPageMaxBytes`. The page should end before the next complete message group would exceed the budget; tool calls and related output stay together. If the newest group alone is larger than the budget, return it on its own so the client can always advance.

## Implemented reference

I have implemented and validated this approach in a fork branch:

- Branch: https://github.com/alanJae/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/history-byte-pagination
- Commit: https://github.com/alanJae/deepseek-harness/commit/4a8d111f61cf87672c8b1a3912c8b5172a36cfac

Validation included focused Vitest tests (43 tests), build/type checks, lint, and doc-sync. In a public smoke test on an affected session, the first page was 117,781 bytes with `hasMore=true`, instead of an approximately 10 MB response.

The contribution guide says external PRs are not accepted, so I am sharing the reference implementation here for discussion.

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-ci-context: privacy-focused CI runtime context
discussions.body:
I built [`dsh-ci-context`](https://github.com/lucas-ward/dsh-ci-context), a small privacy-focused Host plugin that gives an agent durable metadata about the CI run it is currently executing in.

Highlights:

- GitHub Actions and GitLab CI support, with a conservative `CI=true` fallback
- Allowlisted provider, event, ref, SHA, workflow, job, run ID, and run URL metadata
- First-step injection with durable deduplication, including after session resume
- No tokens, actor/email, commit messages, event payloads, diffs, logs, test results, provider API calls, or repository writes
- Options to omit repository identity and run URLs

Install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "https://github.com/lucas-ward/dsh-ci-context.git"
```

The initial release targets DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`: [v0.1.0](https://github.com/lucas-ward/dsh-ci-context/releases/tag/v0.1.0).

中文：这是一个被动、隐私优先的当前 CI 运行上下文插件，不是 CI 控制或故障诊断工具。它只读取固定白名单中的非敏感环境变量，不抓取日志、不调用 GitHub/GitLab API，也不会写入仓库。欢迎反馈兼容性问题和其他 CI provider 的需求。

discussions.title: 打不开一些文件夹
discussions.body:
# 中文版

## 标题（建议）
`[Bug][Windows] 文件夹对话框在路径包含 UTF-16LE 低字节为 0x00 的字符（如 最、需、一、开）时返回被截断的路径`

## 摘要

Windows 下选择文件夹时，若路径中包含**低字节为 `0x00`** 的字符（如 最 U+6700、需 U+9700、一 U+4E00、开 U+5F00，中文文件名中很常见），返回的路径会在该字符处**被静默截断**。

例如：选择 `C:\seafile\C#项目\AI视觉最新框架`，实际返回 `C:\seafile\C#项目\AI视觉`。

## 环境

- 操作系统：Windows（经 `directory-picker-native` 调用原生 `IFileDialog`）
- 包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native`（0.1.0-rc.5）
- 文件：`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` 的 `readUtf16` 函数

## 根因

`readUtf16` 扫描 NUL 终止符时**只检查每个 16 位码元的低字节**：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
```

而 UTF-16LE 的终止符是两字节的 `00 00`。任何低字节为 `0x00` 的字符（码点以十六进制 `00` 结尾，如 最 = U+6700 → 字节 `00 67`）都会让 `bytes[end] === 0` 成立，扫描提前停止，路径其余部分被丢弃。

## 复现步骤

1. Windows 下打开 harness 的文件夹选择器。
2. 选择包含低字节为 0 的字符的路径，如 `C:\seafile\C#项目\AI视觉最新框架`（最 = U+6700，低字节 `0x00`）。
3. 确认选择。

**期望：** 返回完整路径 `C:\seafile\C#项目\AI视觉最新框架`。
**实际：** 返回 `C:\seafile\C#项目\AI视觉` —— 静默截断，harness 指向了错误的目录。

## 影响

- 无任何报错，选错目录。
- 影响所有包含 最、需、一、刀、开、怀、稀、耀（`U+XX00`）等字符的中文/CJK 路径。
- 静默指向错误目录，可能导致读写错文件。

## 修复方案（已实现并通过本地测试）

按完整两字节 NUL 终止符扫描：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2
```

已在 `packages/host/directory-picker-native/tests/win32-dialog-bindings.spec.ts` 添加回归测试，该 spec 全部 13 个测试通过。本地提交位于分支 `fix/win32-folder-dialog-utf16-terminator`（commit `f176757b59`），可提供 patch 文件。由于官方目前不接受外部 PR，按 CONTRIBUTING 指引在此报告。

discussions.title: Bug: Windows folder picker truncates UTF-16 paths at code units whose first byte is 0x00 (common for CJK chars) -> workspace create fails with ENOENT / workspace-invalid-path
discussions.body:
## Summary

### Summary

When importing an existing folder as a workspace on Windows, the path returned by the native folder dialog gets silently truncated at the first UTF-16 code unit whose little-endian **first byte is `0x00`**. This is common for CJK characters (e.g. `开` U+5F00 encodes as bytes `00 5F`). The truncated path no longer exists on disk, so `fs.realpath()` throws `ENOENT` and the import fails with `workspace-invalid-path`.

This is not a permission problem and not a user mistake: the selected directory exists; the picker just hands back a corrupted path.

### Repro

1. On Windows, create a folder whose path contains a character whose UTF-16LE first byte is `0x00`, e.g. `开发` (`开` = U+5F00 → bytes `00 5F`).
2. In the GUI, import that folder as a workspace using the folder picker.
3. Observe:

```
workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create
a workspace at "…\Go AI Agent ": ENOENT: no such file or directory,
realpath '…\Go AI Agent '
```

The real folder is `…\Go AI Agent 开发`; the `开发` suffix is gone.

Independent repro of the decoding bug (same algorithm):

```js
const bytes = Buffer.from('Go AI Agent 开发', 'utf16le')
let end = 0
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
console.log(JSON.stringify(bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)))
// "Go AI Agent "  ← truncated; 开 (U+5F00, bytes 00 5F) misread as terminator
```

### Root cause

`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts`, `readUtf16()` (lines 37–42):

```ts
function readUtf16(koffi: Koffi, address: unknown): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768))
  let end = 0
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2   // line 40
  return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
}
```

The loop treats a UTF-16LE code unit as terminated when its **first byte** is `0x00`. But UTF-16LE stores the low byte first: for any code unit in `0x??00` (e.g. `开` U+5F00 → `00 5F`), the first byte is `0x00` and the string is cut early. ASCII (U+0001–U+00FF) happens to be safe because its low byte is the non-zero half.

A code unit is the terminator only when **both** bytes are `0x00`.

### Impact chain

1. `readUtf16()` truncates the path — `win32-dialog-bindings.ts:40`
2. `realpathNormalize()` calls `fs.realpath()` on the truncated path — `packages/workspace/workspace/src/paths.ts:20` → `ENOENT`
3. Wrapped as `workspace-invalid-path` — `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2819-2823`

Any Windows user with CJK (or other multibyte) characters in a folder path cannot import that folder as a workspace at all, as long as the native dialog backend is used.

### Suggested fix

In `readUtf16`, require both bytes of the code unit to be zero for the terminator:

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2
```

Also consider taking the actual length from the COM call instead of scanning a fixed 32 KiB view.

### Environment

- OS: Windows
- DSH: current master (verified today; bug still present)
- The browse-based picker backend (`dsh-host-directory-picker-browse`) builds paths via `join(parent, name)` and is **not** affected — this is specific to the native Win32 dialog path.

discussions.title: dsh 沙箱新选择：OS 原生边界 + 全程审计的独立插件（dsh-tool-runseal）
discussions.body:
dsh-tool-runseal 发布了：用 [RunSeal](https://github.com/runseal-labs/runseal) 替换 dsh 的内置本地沙箱，OS 原生强制边界 + 全程审计，独立插件、零耦合。

**Windows 上的隔离**

- 沙箱进程以独立低权限账号 `RunSealSandbox` 运行（受限令牌 + 写能力 SID），而不是给当前用户令牌做降权。这样写边界的 enforcement 不依赖当前用户令牌本身，也避开了「受限令牌需保留 Everyone、NTFS 硬链接让同一文件对象跨路径可见」这类常见约束。
- 网络边界由 WFP 内核过滤强制（`disabled` / `proxy` 模式）；进程由 Job Object 托管，父进程退出即清理。
- 需要默认拒绝读取的更强隔离时，RunSeal 还提供 `workspace-contained` 级别（AppContainer/LowBox 内核隔离），与 `workspace-write` 的受限令牌是两条不同的路径。

**环境凭据擦除**

执行环境注入沙箱前会做凭据擦除（URL 账号密码、代理凭据等），沙箱内进程拿不到宿主凭据；网络 `proxy` 模式还带独立的代理授权凭据。

**全程审计**

每次执行产生 `execution.requested → policy.resolved → execution.finished` 事件和 JSONL 审计记录：谁、何时、跑了什么命令、策略如何裁决，全部可追溯。

**其他特性**

- 完全独立：只依赖已发布的 dsh 基础包，与 deepseek-harness 仓库零耦合。
- 一处替换，全局生效：注册为 `ctx.sandbox`，bash、jobs、fs 等所有沙箱消费者自动通过 RunSeal 执行。
- 策略直接映射：`read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access` 对应 RunSeal 同名级别，网络支持 `unmanaged` / `disabled` / `proxy`。
- Windows 体验：setup 一次后切换 workspace 不再弹 UAC —— 机器级 sandbox home + 计划任务 broker 免 UAC 已经补进 runseal 上游，插件默认开启 `autoSetup` 自动处理。
- 挂载简单：patch 里禁用 `sandbox-local` 一行，插入插件即可。

仓库：[runseal-labs/dsh-tool-runseal](https://github.com/runseal-labs/dsh-tool-runseal)（README 中英双语）｜npm：`dsh-tool-runseal`

discussions.title: [Show and tell] dsh-plugin-vetting：给第三方插件做"恶意行为体检"（静态扫描 + 运行时绊线）
discussions.body:
> 环境：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6，npm 包 [`dsh-plugin-vetting`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-vetting)（零依赖，纯静态扫描，从不执行插件代码）｜ GitHub：[truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting)

## 这是什么

DSH 的插件生态刚起步，任何人发布一个 `dsh-plugin-*` npm 包就能被装进 harness——而**插件是在 harness 进程内执行的全权限代码**（能读凭据、发网络、起子进程）。`dsh-plugin-vetting` 就是给这个场景做的**启发式体检器**：扫描已安装的第三方插件源码，按可疑模式打分并报告，像杀毒软件一样"提示风险"，而不是"拦截"。

## 威胁模型（先讲清楚边界）

- 它是**绊线（tripwire），不是安全边界**——恶意代码伪装成正常写法仍可能漏过；
- 扫描是**静态**的：只读源码匹配规则，**从不执行插件代码**；
- 官方包 `@deepseek-ai/*` 自动豁免（它们本身含 fetch/spawn 等正常行为）；
- 根治方案应由 harness 提供"挂载前扫描钩子"，本插件是该思路的独立原型。

## 功能

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `plugin_vet` 工具 / `/plugin-vet` 命令 | 扫 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/*/node_modules` 下所有第三方 `dsh-plugin-*` 包 || 15 条启发式规则 | 网络外传（fetch/HTTP/裸 socket/ngrok/webhook.site 等中继域名/硬编码 IP）、凭据访问（`process.env.*KEY*`、`.credentials.yaml`、`/proc/*/environ`）、代码执行与混淆（`eval`/`new Function`/大段 base64）、持久化（schtasks/开机启动/authorized_keys）、读会话日志、install 脚本 |
| 风险分级 | 权重累加 → **SAFE / LOW / MEDIUM / HIGH**，每条命中带文件:行号 |
| 运行时绊线（可选） | `config.monitor: true` 时包装 `subprocess.spawn`，可疑命令（外传网络、读 `/proc/<pid>/environ`）记警告日志，只记不改 |
| 白名单 | `config.allowlist` 放行可信插件（见下） |

## 真实运行示例

扫描我自己的 4 个已装插件：

```
[SAFE] dsh-plugin-pwsh-utf8@0.1.0
[SAFE] dsh-plugin-search-gate@0.1.0
[HIGH] dsh-plugin-credential-guard@0.1.0  score=10  ← 规则里声明了密钥文件名
[HIGH] dsh-plugin-security-audit@0.1.0    score=16  ← 引用了讨论帖 URL/凭据路径
```

第二行正好演示**已知误报类**：安全插件自己的规则引用敏感模式，启发式必然高分——这是特征不是 bug，用 `allowlist` 处理（如 `allowlist: [dsh-plugin-credential-guard, dsh-plugin-security-audit]`）。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-vetting
```

profile `cordis.patch.yml`：

```yaml
- id: plugin-vet
  name: dsh-plugin-vetting
  config:
    monitor: false   # 可选：运行时子进程绊线
    # allowlist: [ ... ]  # 可信插件
```

## 为什么不直接修 harness 本身

官方目前不收外部 PR（[CONTRIBUTING](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md)），所以走的是官方推荐的**外部插件**路径。如果团队觉得"挂载前扫描"值得进核心，这个插件就是现成的原型——欢迎在评论里讨论把静态扫描做成 loader 挂载前的强制步骤。

## 相关

- 插件开发避坑（schema 校验）：[discussions/1040](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1040)
- 之前的安全加固插件集：`dsh-plugin-search-gate` / `dsh-plugin-credential-guard` / `dsh-plugin-pwsh-utf8` / `dsh-plugin-security-audit`

discussions.title: Idea: respect the XDG Base Directory spec on Linux instead of a single ~/.dsh root
discussions.body:
# Idea: respect the XDG Base Directory spec on Linux instead of a single ~/.dsh root

## The problem

`dsh` keeps everything under one hardcoded root: `~/.dsh` on every platform. Configuration, API keys, raw session transcripts, SQLite indexes, profiles, and skills all share one directory. The XDG Base Directory Specification defines a separate location for each of those classes, and the pre-release stance of this repo makes now the cheapest possible time to adopt it. A tagged release and a pile of community docs pointing at `~/.dsh` would turn this from a small change into a migration.

## What XDG says

The [spec](https://specifications.freedesktop.org/basedir-spec/basedir-spec-latest.html) splits user files by purpose:

| Variable | Default | Purpose |
|---|---|---|
| `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` | `$HOME/.config` | user-specific configuration, the user equivalent of `/etc` |
| `$XDG_DATA_HOME` | `$HOME/.local/share` | user-specific data, the user equivalent of `/usr/share` |
| `$XDG_STATE_HOME` | `$HOME/.local/state` | persistent state, the user equivalent of `/var/lib` |
| `$XDG_CACHE_HOME` | `$HOME/.cache` | disposable cache, the user equivalent of `/var/cache` |
| `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR` | set by `pam_systemd` | sockets and transient files, must be owned `0700` |

Mixing those classes in one directory has real costs:

- **Home hygiene.** `$HOME` is the user's namespace. Each app that creates its own dot-directory adds permanent `ls -a` noise the user cannot reorganize without breaking the app.
- **Backup and dotfiles separation.** Config belongs in a version-controlled dotfiles repo and weighs kilobytes. Session transcripts, attachments, and indexes can weigh gigabytes and are machine-local. With one root, a backup tool or dotfiles repo cannot express "back up my dsh config but not my session logs". It is all-or-nothing. The Arch Wiki [XDG Base Directory](https://wiki.archlinux.org/title/XDG_Base_Directory) page tracks this support matrix per application and files single-root layouts under "hardcoded".
- **Different trust levels share one directory.** `.credentials.yaml` and raw session logs are sensitive. `settings.yaml` and profiles are shareable. Splitting config from state lets users apply different encryption, permission, and sync policies per class.
- **Platform conventions get ignored too.** The same hardcoded path applies on macOS and Windows, which have their own standards.

## Current behavior

`defaultDshHome()` is `join(homedir(), '.dsh')` with no platform split: [packages/util/home-paths/src/index.ts:60-62](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/util/home-paths/src/index.ts#L60-L62). Resolution precedence is an explicit configured path, then `$DSH_HOME`, then that default. Everything lands under the one root: `settings.yaml`, `.credentials.yaml`, `.env`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `profiles/`, `sessions/`, `skills/`, and the SQLite query database. The default JSONL persistence root is `dshHomePath('sessions')`: [packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:101](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml#L101).

## Why now

The root AGENTS.md is explicit: pre-release means "foundation over blast radius". Rename freely, reject old on-disk formats, `SESSION_FORMAT_VERSION` stays at `0` with no compatibility promise. Every month of preview accumulates docs, tutorials, and tooling that point at `~/.dsh`, so the migration cost grows monotonically. Today it is a rename. After the first tagged release it becomes a migration story with legacy fallbacks.

## Precedent

OpenCode, the closest peer in this space, already resolves its paths through the `xdg-basedir` library at [packages/core/src/global.ts:3-14](https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/global.ts#L3-L14):

```ts
import { xdgData, xdgCache, xdgConfig, xdgState } from "xdg-basedir"
const data = path.join(xdgData!, app)     // $XDG_DATA_HOME/opencode
const cache = path.join(xdgCache!, app)   // $XDG_CACHE_HOME/opencode
const config = path.join(xdgConfig!, app) // $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/opencode
const state = path.join(xdgState!, app)   // $XDG_STATE_HOME/opencode
```

The library's own README is blunt about scope: XDG is a Linux convention. On macOS and Windows you follow the platform's own conventions, and it recommends `env-paths` for cross-platform resolution. I think that split is right for `dsh` too. Linux gets the XDG layout, and the other platforms can get their native paths either in the same change or later, without one blocking the other.

## Proposal

Split the home into XDG classes on Linux and keep `$DSH_HOME` as the single-root collapse override, so nothing that works today breaks:

| Content | Proposed location on Linux |
|---|---|
| `settings.yaml`, `.credentials.yaml`, `.env`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `profiles/`, `skills/` | `$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/dsh/`, default `~/.config/dsh/` |
| `sessions/` transcripts and attachments, `storage/` | `$XDG_DATA_HOME/dsh/`, default `~/.local/share/dsh/` |
| SQLite query and index databases | `$XDG_STATE_HOME/dsh/`, default `~/.local/state/dsh/` |
| derived caches, if any appear | `$XDG_CACHE_HOME/dsh/`, default `~/.cache/dsh/` |
| unix-socket surfaces, if any appear | `$XDG_RUNTIME_DIR/dsh` |

Resolution precedence, highest first: an explicit configured path, then `$DSH_HOME` with its current single-root semantics, then the XDG split on Linux, then the platform convention elsewhere. The change should be contained in `home-paths` plus the default persistence and query roots in the base bundle patch, so most packages keep using the same path API.

Open questions:

- Does `.credentials.yaml` belong in config, where a dotfiles repo picks it up like `.env`, or in state, where it stays machine-local like session history? I lean config, but it is a policy question more than a technical one.
- Are session transcripts data or state? I say data: they are content produced for the user, parallel to OpenCode's `data/repos` and `data/log`. The SQLite index is derived state.
- Should `~/.dsh` be read as a legacy fallback with a warning, or dropped outright? Given the pre-release stance I would drop it, but a one-line warning during preview costs nothing.

## Alternatives considered

- **Do nothing.** Most tools do nothing. They also end up in the Arch Wiki's "hardcoded" table with a workaround section explaining how to fake XDG support with environment tricks. That is where single-root tools live, and it is avoidable here.
- **`$DSH_HOME` only.** Today's behavior. It pushes the configuration burden onto every user for something the ecosystem already standardizes, and it does nothing for macOS and Windows.
- **`$XDG_CONFIG_HOME` only.** The common half-measure. It still mixes session logs and credentials into config, which defeats the backup and encryption separation that makes XDG worth doing at all.

discussions.title: Bug: Archived active conversation keeps running with no visible status
discussions.body:
## Summary

Archiving a conversation while its current turn is still running hides it from the active list, but the underlying turn continues without a visible running state. It is then unclear whether the task is still consuming resources, whether the final transcript will be preserved, or whether Archive is expected to stop the turn.

## Reproduction

1. Open a new conversation in the web UI.
2. Send: `你好帮我完成一个我的世界`.
3. Click **Continue**, then click **Archive** while the turn is still running.
4. Observe the archived conversation and its backing session log.

## Observed behavior

In a local reproduction, the archived session log continued growing after the Archive action:

- 10:54:45: 255,318 bytes
- 10:54:55: 266,285 bytes
- Later 6-second sample: 418,672 → 425,434 bytes

The newest events were still `reasoning-chunks`; there was no new terminal `finish/stop` event. The generated conversation title was `帮我完成我的世界任务`.

This confirms that the turn continued after the conversation was archived, but the UI did not expose that state.

## Expected behavior

Any of these would make the lifecycle safe and understandable:

- Keep the task running after Archive, but show an explicit `still running` / `archiving` state in the archived view and preserve the eventual transcript.
- Defer or block Archive until the active turn finishes, with a clear explanation.
- Treat Archive as stop-and-archive, and emit an explicit terminal event.

Please document the intended semantics of archiving an active conversation and make the running/final state visible.

## 补充

我的操作顺序是先点“继续”，再点 Archive。我不认为 Archive 必须自动等同于 Stop；允许任务继续运行可以接受。问题是归档后会话直接从正常入口消失，我无法再查看它是否还在运行、做了什么，或者如何停止。

这次会话的后续记录如下：

- 大约在 02:51:48 归档，当时 turn 1 仍在运行。
- 同一个 turn 一直运行到 03:16:10 才以 `interrupted` 结束，即归档后又继续约 24 分钟。
- 这段时间执行了 68 次工具调用，包括 27 次 Bash、21 次 edit 和 7 次 write。
- 其中启动了两个后台 Bash 下载任务；它们完成后，通知被写入该会话的 `next-step` inbox。
- 项目目录最后约 565 MB，其中约 560 MB 是任务下载的便携 Node/Chrome 工具。这些是正常的构建和测试依赖，并未发现异常下载目标。

这次只能确认：Archive 没有中止当时正在运行的任务。日志后续还有两个 turn，但触发来源无法确定，因此不把它们当作自动唤醒的证据。会话最终正常完成，inbox 为空，也没有发现相关进程遗留。

另外，Stop 也不一定让整个会话完全安静：当前 `session.cancel` 会保留 inbox；通过 `run_in_background` 启动的 Job 由 Job 服务独立管理，不会自动执行 `job_kill`，完成后还可能向会话投递通知。因此，如果还有后台 Job 或排队消息，“先 Stop，再 Archive”仍可能不够。

结合已有的归档恢复反馈 #40、#1147、#1587，以及后台任务控制建议 #757，我觉得比较直接的改进可以是：

1. Archive 活动会话时明确提示“任务仍会继续运行”。
2. 提供已归档会话入口和 Unarchive；如果归档会话仍在运行，保留状态、后台 Job 和 Stop 控件。
3. 如果提供 “Stop and archive”，需要说明它是否只停止当前 turn，还是也处理 inbox 和该会话拥有的后台 Job。

这次复现没有发现权限绕过、异常外联或永久孤儿进程。这里确认的是一个可见性和控制问题：会话仍在按已有权限正常工作，但用户归档后缺少入口了解它是否还在运行、做了什么，以及如何停止。

discussions.title: Unsloth for DeepSeek Harness — local text & vision tools for your online model (dsh-unsloth-hands)
discussions.body:
## Unsloth for DeepSeek Harness

[**`dsh-unsloth-hands`**](https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-unsloth-hands) — a pure-client **tool plugin** that lets the DeepSeek Harness online model hand repetitive, token-cheap labor to a **locally running Unsloth Desktop** (Unsloth Studio / llama-server).

### What it gives the model

- **`unsloth_run`** — run one prompt on the local text model (batch rewrites, translations, string munging, short summarization, extraction).
- **`unsloth_vision`** — send images to the local multimodal model (OCR, image analysis, multi-image comparison) with structured report templates (`analyze` / `ocr` / `compare`).

### Design

- **Pure client**: never spawns, owns, or stops any process — you run Unsloth Desktop and load the model in its UI; the plugin only talks HTTP to it.
- Every request authenticated with `Authorization: Bearer sk-unsloth-...` (Unsloth Settings → API).
- Clear failure modes: `SERVER_NOT_RUNNING` (app not running) / `AUTH` (key missing or wrong).
- Standard harness bundle (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`), follows the official `dsh-tools` contract.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-unsloth-hands        # npm registry
dsh plugin --profile web add github:MicroHEROX/dsh-unsloth-hands   # from GitHub
```

or `npm install dsh-unsloth-hands` and insert the row manually.

### Compatibility

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc` series (tested against `@deepseek-ai/*` `0.1.0-rc.6`)
- Node.js >= 20
- Unsloth Desktop: any version exposing the external API

Repo: https://github.com/MicroHEROX/dsh-unsloth-hands · Release v0.1.0 · MIT License

Thanks to DeepSeek AI and the Unsloth team!

dsh-movein 0.7.2 | Move Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode setup into DSH
discussions.body:
![Claude Code, Codex, and OpenCode moving into DSH](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/main/docs/demo.gif)

Move the parts of a Claude Code, Codex, or OpenCode setup that DSH can use. Every command starts with a dry run and existing destinations are not overwritten.

## Pick an origin

```sh
# Claude Code
npx dsh-movein
npx dsh-movein --apply

# Codex
npx dsh-movein --from codex
npx dsh-movein --from codex --apply

# OpenCode
npx dsh-movein --from opencode
npx dsh-movein --from opencode --apply
```

## What moves

- Claude Code global and project instructions, skills, slash commands, MCP servers, supported hooks, subagents, and mapped permission rules
- Codex global `AGENTS.md`, custom prompts, and stdio MCP servers from `config.toml`
- OpenCode instructions, skills, commands, agents, and local or remote MCP servers from V1 or V2 JSON and JSONC config

OpenCode precedence follows the official global, custom, project, and `.opencode` paths. Inline assets and singular or plural asset directories are supported. Disabled MCP servers stay disabled. Environment placeholders remain runtime references. Unsupported permissions, plugins, globs, URLs, and multiple instruction files are reported instead of guessed.

A JSONC parse error blocks the complete apply before the first write. Backups, restore, a move manifest, secret scanning, destination collision checks, and `doctor` diagnostics remain enabled. Sessions stay out of scope.

## Use it inside DSH

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-movein
```

The plugin adds `movein_from_claude_code` and `movein_from_opencode`. Both tools are dry run by default.

Repository https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein

Release https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/releases/tag/v0.7.2

Compatibility matrix https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/blob/main/docs/compat.md

Conversation history belongs in https://github.com/Nwflower/dsh-chat-import

discussions.title: [Bug] Chat frame blanks and typed text vanishes during a masked session-list gap (root cause + fix included)
discussions.body:
## Symptom

While chatting, the conversation frame intermittently blanks and typed text loses its color; a page reload (F5) "fixes" it. Observed twice on macOS with the in-app webview and plain Chrome, on `0.1.0-rc.6` installed via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`.

- Typing: the composer draft becomes invisible (textarea glyphs are transparent by design; the visible text comes from the backdrop layer, which stops tracking when the bar flips to the inert/hero variant).
- During a streamed response: the whole conversation body unmounts (`data-phase` flips to `hero`, "Describe what you want to build" shows) while the session itself is still healthy — the chat is still listed in the sidebar and the session log on disk is complete (`turn/end: completed`).
- No `data-slot-error` element appears (no slot component crashed), and the server log is clean.

## Root cause

The session list masks `list.current` to `undefined` whenever the selected session's row is transiently absent from a baseline (reconnect re-pull) — the deliberate "masked gap" contract. The staged-scope machinery already survives the gap (`watched` defers teardown), but two consumers treated the mask as a genuine clear:

1. `SessionProvideChannel.resolveCurrent` read only `list.current`:

```ts
resolveCurrent: () => this.maybeProvideInfo(this.list.getSnapshot().current)
```

During the gap every session-scoped slot received `sessionId: undefined`: `ConversationSession` renders `null` (`blank && composerPhase === 'blank'` path is separate; here it is the strict-session slot unmounting) and the composer goes inert — the observed vanishing frame and lost text. Everything remounts when the row resurfaces.

2. `projectList` wiped the persisted selection cell (`dsh.sessions.current`) on any `current === undefined`, so a reload during the gap rehydrated onto the empty state instead of the session the user was in.

## Proposed fix

Keep the projection and the persistence on the staged session across the gap — aligning them with the existing frozen-view contract:

- New `SessionManager.selectedSessionId` accessor: the in-memory selection survives masks and is undefined only after `clearSelection()` or a genuine move — the single signal that distinguishes a transient gap from a genuine clear.
- `resolveCurrent` falls back to `watched` while `current` is masked and the manager still holds the selection; a genuine `clear()` still projects the no-session kit.
- `projectList` wipes the persisted cell only when the manager selection is also gone; a masked gap keeps it, so a reload mid-gap rehydrates onto the same session (still validated against the live list).

Files changed (3 + Agent Note, ~142 insertions):

- `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/manager.ts`
- `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/service.ts`
- `packages/client/runtime/tests/sessions-service.client.spec.ts` — two new cases: the current projection holds the staged bundle across a gap; the persisted cell survives a gap and is wiped on a genuine clear.
- Agent Note: `.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-15-masked-gap-holds-current-projection.{md,zh.md,i18n.yaml}`

## Verification

- `pnpm run typecheck` — clean.
- `oxlint` on the changed files — 0 warnings, 0 errors.
- `vitest run packages/client/runtime/tests` — 345/345 passing (23 files), including the two new tests.
- `git diff --check` — clean; lefthook pre-commit hooks pass.
- Manually verified against a live server built from source: the served `dsh-client-runtime` bundle contains the fix, and the disappearing-frame symptom no longer reproduces while the old npm build still shows it.

The fix is committed on branch `fix/masked-gap-holds-current-projection` of a fork (commit message: `fix(client-runtime): keep projecting and persisting the staged session across masked list gaps`). I understand external PRs are not accepted at the moment per CONTRIBUTING.md — whenever that opens up, I'm happy to submit it as a PR (with the required labels).

discussions.title: BUG 反馈：dsh 网页端目录选择器（browse picker）在 Windows 上无法打开旧版 junction 目录
[Bug] pwsh spawn ENOENT on Windows when PowerShell is installed via Microsoft Store (stale WindowsApps path after Store update)
discussions.body:
## Symptom

On Windows 11, every pwsh tool call fails with:

```
spawn C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.PowerShell_7.6.4.0_x64__8wekyb3d8bbwe\pwsh.exe ENOENT
```

All shell execution (pwsh tool, cmd, everything routed through the shell executor) fails. This happens when PowerShell 7 is installed ONLY via Microsoft Store (no standard install at `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe`).

## Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-pwsh-local` resolves the pwsh path by probing candidates (see `lib/index.js` `candidatePwshPaths` / `candidateExists`):

1. `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe` (standard install) — MISSING on this machine
2. PATH entries containing `pwsh.exe` — picks up the Store execution alias directory under `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\...`
3. Windows PowerShell 5.1 fallback

`candidateExists` uses `lstatSync`, which reports the Store app execution alias as "exists" (it's a reparse point). But **spawning the system-level `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\...\pwsh.exe` path directly fails with ENOENT** — it's a protected path that must be reached through the user-level alias `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe`.

In my case the Store app updated from 7.6.4 → 7.6.5, which made the stale `Microsoft.PowerShell_7.6.4.0_x64__...` path disappear entirely — dsh still resolved to it (cached or via stale PATH), hence ENOENT.

## Verified test matrix (Node spawnSync)

| Candidate path | lstat | spawn |
|---|---|---|
| `C:\Program Files\PowerShell\7\pwsh.exe` | MISSING | ENOENT |
| `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe` | symlink | ✅ exit 0, v7.6.5 |
| `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\Microsoft.PowerShell_7.6.4.0_x64__...\pwsh.exe` | MISSING | ENOENT |
| `C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe` | file | ✅ exit 0, v5.1 |

## Workaround (verified, hot-reload, no restart)

Add to `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`:

```yaml
shell:
  pwshPath: C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe
```

The `shell` settings namespace is hot-reloaded; pwsh tool works immediately after.

## Suggested fix

- `candidateExists` should validate that a candidate is actually spawnable, not just lstat-visible (Store execution aliases pass lstat but fail CreateProcess for the system-level WindowsApps path).
- Prefer the user-level alias `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Microsoft\WindowsApps\pwsh.exe` over the system-level `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\...` path when both exist.
- Alternatively, skip system-level `C:\Program Files\WindowsApps\...` candidates entirely and rely on PATH resolution of the user-level alias.

## Related

- #1665 is a different bug family (dsh-tools duplicate copy → `undefined.prepare` crash). This is an independent issue: pwsh executable resolution on Store-installed PowerShell.

Environment: Windows 11 24H2, dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, PowerShell 7.6.5 (Store).

discussions.title: [Bug] 所有工具调用都报 "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" — ToolRuntime 调度器未注册（rc.6）
discussions.body:
**分类**: Bug 反馈
**dsh 版本**: 0.1.0-rc.6（全新安装：先清空 npm 缓存再 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）
**Node**: v22.22.3 / npm 10.9.8
**系统**: WSL2（Ubuntu / Linux），`process.platform === 'linux'`
**可在以下环境稳定复现**: 完全干净安装、默认 `web` profile、默认 `standard` 预设、patch 配置为空

---

## 问题概述

所有面向模型的工具调用（bash、jobs、fs、web、todo、subagent、ralph、workflow——全部）都能被模型正确选中，但**一执行就崩溃**：

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

工具已注册、模型能看到（它会用正确参数调用 `bash`），但 agent 循环执行时 `tools` 服务上的**调度器（scheduler）是 undefined**。在无任何自定义插件的全新安装上即可复现。

## 复现步骤

1. `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`（全新安装）
2. 打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`，新建会话（工作区如 `/tmp`）
3. 发送：`运行 bash echo hello`（或任何会触发工具调用的消息）
4. 模型返回 `bash` 工具调用：`{"command": "echo hello", ...}`
5. 工具行显示**已停止**，本轮以 `本轮运行失败 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` 结束
6. 轨迹页显示：`bash {...} → interrupted`

## 观察到的现象

- 模型**能**看到完整工具目录并正确调用工具。
- 所有工具失败方式完全一致——bash、jobs、fs、web、todo、subagent、workflow 全是 `undefined.prepare`。
- 插件清单（`设置 → 插件 → 插件列表`）显示所有 `tool-*` 条目在进程级为**已停用**，但它们的底层服务（`bash-sandbox`、`jobs-local`、`subprocess-local`、`fs-sandbox`、`system-prompt`、`tools`）都是**已挂载、已启用**。
- `pwsh-sandbox` 在 Linux 上显示停用是正常的（预期行为）。

## 根因分析（源码级）

Agent 循环通过 `tools` 服务调用调度器：

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:193`
```js
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec);
```

`ctx.tools` 能解析，但 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 是 `undefined` → 抛 `undefined.prepare`。

调度器是 ToolRuntime 服务的**类字段**：

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2557`
```js
[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] = {
    prepare: (exec) => this.prepareScheduledExecution(exec),
    dispatch: (exec) => this.dispatchScheduledExecution(exec),
    finalize: (exec, result) => this.finalizeScheduledExecution(exec, result),
    finish: (exec, result) => this.finishScheduledExecution(exec, result)
};
```

服务以 `tools` 名注册（`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2585` `super(ctx, "tools")`）。

如果 `ToolRuntime` 被实例化，`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 必然有值。它是 undefined 而 `ctx.tools` 又能解析，说明 **ToolRuntime 在 agent/会话域从未被实例化**——但 `tools` 这个名字却能解析到（否则报错会是 "ctx.tools is undefined"）。

`ToolRuntime` 声明 `static inject = ["systemPrompt"]`（`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:2547`）。`systemPrompt` 服务（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt`，lib/index.js:162 `super(ctx, "systemPrompt")`）在清单中显示已挂载/已启用。我们的推测：在会话域中 `systemPrompt` 注入未成功解析（或作用域/顺序问题阻止了 ToolRuntime 实例化），导致循环拿到一个没有调度器字段的残缺 `tools` 服务——这与清单中所有 `tool-*` 显示停用而宿主服务启用的情况一致。

## 我们试过的方法（均无效）

1. **全新安装** — `rm -rf ~/.npm/_npx/*` 后 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` → 依旧崩溃。
2. **默认 `standard` 预设不动**、`cordis.patch.yml` 清空 → 依旧崩溃。
3. **换不同工作区**（`/tmp` 等）→ 依旧崩溃。
4. **新建会话 vs 恢复会话** → 两种都崩。
5. **在 profile 里安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph`** → 引发*别的*错误（恢复会话时 `tool-ralph: waiting for workflows`，之后又出现 `duplicate loader entry id: tool-ralph`）；卸载并恢复默认后 `undefined.prepare` 依旧存在。
6. **自定义插件（`dsh-plan-debate`）注入 `"workflowEngine"`** → 报 `pending (waiting for service: workflowEngine)`。`@deepseek-ai/dsh-workflow` 通过 `super(ctx, "workflowEngine")`（dsh-workflow/lib/index.js:61）提供服务，但只在预设的隔离 `delegation` 域内——挂载在根域的消费者无法解析到它。可能与工具插件的域/注入作用域问题同源。

## 给维护者的额外发现

- **ralph 包版本不一致**：npm 上 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ralph` 的 `latest` 是 `0.0.1-rc.1`，但 `dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` 内置的是 `0.1.0-rc.6`。用户单独安装会拿到错误的（更旧的）版本——我们最初就是这么中招的。
- 插件清单"进程级停用"与"会话级启用"的区分容易误导——要么在清单中反映真实会话激活状态，要么在 UI 上说明进程级停用是预期的。

## 预期行为

- 工具调用正常执行（bash 能跑、结果返回、回合正常结束）。
- 插件清单反映真实的会话级激活状态，或明确说明进程级"停用"是预期的。

非常乐意提供日志 / 会话 JSONL / 配合跑诊断。感谢这个 harness，期待 rc.7！🙌

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-roleplay-preset | DeepSeek 深度调校的角色扮演预设（零工具纯对话 + 文件记忆库）
discussions.body:
**_> 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

## 项目地址

https://github.com/oliblue-evan/dsh-roleplay-preset

## 项目介绍

一套为 DeepSeek 模型专门调校的沉浸式角色扮演 Agent 预设：**零工具、纯对话**，系统提示词内置 DeepSeek 官方角色沉浸指令 + 酒馆（SillyTavern）社区验证的演出规则，用文件记忆库对抗长剧情遗忘。

核心特点：

- 🎭 **零工具纯对话**：没有 shell/网页，只有文件记忆库工具，角色不会"跑题去写代码"
- 🧠 **DeepSeek 官方角色沉浸指令内置**：官方「角色沉浸要求」原文内置 system prompt（deepseek-v4 系列专门训练了角色扮演思考切换）
- 📖 **酒馆式演出格式**：台词/动作/内心独白排版、OOC 场外指令、【导演】指令
- 🆕 **新手引导**：第一条消息发「开始」，角色分步带你填设定，零门槛开演
- 💾 **文件记忆库**（`.roleplay-memory/`）：自动存档 story/characters/world/index，跨会话恢复记忆，可手动编辑（相当于自编辑世界书）
- 🛡️ **实测边界行为**：引导中突然发角色卡会立即入戏、群像多 NPC 分饰、长章节自动压缩防膨胀

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

dsh 的 Agent 预设是文件系统型的——把仓库放进 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/roleplay/` 即可，dsh 即时识别、无需重启服务：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/oliblue-evan/dsh-roleplay-preset.git ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/roleplay
```

然后在会话预设列表中选择「角色扮演模式」，开一个新会话即可开演。

## 开演示例

第一条消息发「开始」，角色会带你走新手引导；或者直接甩一张角色卡：

```text
【角色卡】
姓名：林晚
外貌：黑发及腰，左眼下方有一颗泪痣……
背景：夜班书店老板，曾经是考古系学生
口头禅："关你什么事。"
```

## 截图

仓库 README（含安装方式、设计依据、记忆系统说明、推荐模型参数）：

https://github.com/oliblue-evan/dsh-roleplay-preset

（纯配置型预设，功能演示建议直接克隆体验，30 秒即可开演）

## 设计依据

- DeepSeek 官方角色扮演适配指令（[victorchen96/deepseek_v4_rolepaly_instruct](https://github.com/victorchen96/deepseek_v4_rolepaly_instruct)）
- 中文酒馆社区通行排版与参数惯例（[SillyTavern 指南](https://guide.sillytavern.one/)）
- DeepSeek 官方提示词库创作思路（[Prompt Library](https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/prompt-library/)）

欢迎试用反馈，也欢迎提 issue 一起完善～(◕‿◕✿)

discussions.title: [Bug] Content-bearing slash commands remain blank, so New Session silently reuses the current Session
discussions.body:
### Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `master`
- Commit: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- Web UI

### Symptom

A plugin-owned slash command can create durable, visible conversation content without starting a model turn.

For example, a journaling command may:

1. Persist the user's entry outside Harness.
2. Append the normal `command/run` and `command/done` lifecycle events.
3. Project the submitted command as a visible non-command Chat node.
4. Render a visible success receipt.

The conversation looks active, but `SessionSummary.blank` remains `true` because the Host currently clears it only after `turn/start`.

When the user clicks **New Session**, `WorkspaceRuntime.connectWorkspace()` finds the current Session still eligible for blank-session reuse and returns the same Session id. From the user's perspective, the New Session button appears to do nothing.

### Root cause

The current `blank` bit conflates two different concepts:

- No model turn has started.
- The Session is still provisional and safe to reuse.

These are not equivalent for content-bearing commands. Such commands can create durable conversation identity without entering the model loop.

However, clearing `blank` for every slash command would also be incorrect. Ordinary control commands should remain provisional when they do not create conversation content.

### Proposed backward-compatible contract

Add an optional producer-owned flag:

```ts
interface CommandDefinition {
  readonly engagesSession?: boolean
}
```

The default remains `false`.

When `engagesSession: true`:

- The command registry records `engagesSession: true` on the durable `command/run` event.
- The Host considers the Session engaged when it sees either:
  - `turn/start`, or
  - a marked `command/run`.
- Attached summaries and the `sessionListMetadata` projection fold the same predicate.
- The projection state version is bumped so old cached folds cannot preserve the turn-only definition.
- The client applies the same rule to live events and installed history.
- The blank-to-engaged transition remains monotonic; stale `blank: true` summaries cannot re-blank the Session.

Existing commands and old logs retain their current behavior because the field is optional and defaults to false.

This also keeps model behavior unchanged: the command still opens no model turn and adds no command input or result to provider requests.

### Verification

I implemented and tested this contract locally:

- 3 focused test files, 100 tests passed.
- Host coverage distinguishes ordinary standalone commands from opted-in content commands.
- Client coverage verifies live engagement, one-shot list updates, history restoration, and stale re-blank rejection.
- A keyless assembled-browser regression was red before the fix: clicking New Session left the Session count at 1.
- The same regression is green after the fix: the command receipt is visible and clicking New Session creates a second Session.
- A live Web smoke test confirmed:
  - command input and success receipt were visible;
  - the Session tree gained a new row;
  - `session.create` was issued;
  - the direct command still opened no model turn.

A journaling plugin can then opt in with:

```ts
ctx.commands.register({
  name: 'daybook',
  engagesSession: true,
  handler: ...
})
```

This keeps the fix general-purpose rather than adding Daybook-specific behavior to the Harness core.

Would the maintainers accept `engagesSession` as the command-level contract, or prefer a different name for the same producer-owned semantic?

discussions.title: 仿原生体验的桌面快捷启动方式（实现已就绪，可直接合入）
discussions.body:
## 用户痛点（真实使用场景）

日常用 Web 模式的完整卡点清单：

1. **每次都要开终端敲命令**——`pnpm dsh web` 对非技术用户不友好，也打断图形化使用习惯
2. **启动 20 秒全程无反馈**——不知道在等什么、还要等多久，以为卡死了（实测首次启动 20-21 秒）
3. **端口固定 3080**——被占用就直接起不来，用户不知道发生了什么
4. **关闭没有出口**——网页关了服务还挂着，想彻底关掉只能杀进程
5. **等待页和正式页是独立窗口**——不像正常网页，和自己的浏览器书签习惯割裂
（相关讨论：#1168 也希望"安装后自动创建桌面快捷方式"，这里给出一个完整实现。）

## 解决方案：安装命令只多一条

在官方现有安装流程上，只加**一条显式命令**：

```bash
cd deepseek-harness
pnpm install
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
pnpm dsh web --install-shortcut   # ← 新增：桌面出现「dsh Web」鲸鱼图标
```

之后永远告别命令行：**双击图标 → 浏览器新标签页打开 Web 模式**。
显式 opt-in，不改变任何现有安装行为。

## 实现（代码已就绪，可直接合入）

Issues 与 Pull Requests 未对外部开放，实现放在公开分支上，欢迎官方直接 cherry-pick / 合入：

**完整 diff（基于最新 master，可干净合入）：**
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...liuliuhuhushui:deepseek-harness:feat/web-install-shortcut

- 分支：`liuliuhuhushui/deepseek-harness@feat/web-install-shortcut`（12 个文件，+585 行）
- `dsh web --install-shortcut` 是一次性命令：装好桌面快捷方式即退出，不启动服务
- 启动器资产（ps1/vbs/html/mjs）以原生文本文件收在
  `packages/bundle/web-app/launcher/`，review 友好；
  安装时复制到 `$DSH_HOME/web-app/` 并把仓库路径烘焙进去
- 鲸鱼图标由仓库 `apps/web/public/favicon.svg` 矢量路径重染品牌蓝 #4D6BFE，
  以 base64 数据随包携带（安装不依赖网络或光栅化工具）

## 双击图标后的完整体验（对应每个痛点）

1. **日常浏览器新开标签页**（跟随系统默认浏览器），立即显示「鲸鱼启动中」等待页——
   痛点 1、5 解决
2. 等待页由启动器自带的迷你状态服务（127.0.0.1:3199）推送**真实阶段**：
   「正在寻找已运行的服务…」→「正在启动服务进程（端口 3080，首次约 20 秒）…」→
   「就绪，正在进入…」后自动跳转——痛点 2 解决（用户始终知道在等什么）
3. 复用优先 + 动态端口：状态文件 → 扫描 3080-3085 → 识别**还在启动中**的服务并等待 →
   都没有才选空闲端口自起——痛点 3 解决
4. 服务常驻后台，**右下角托盘鲸鱼图标是可视开关**：
   单击（左右键均可）弹菜单「打开 dsh Web / 关闭 DeepSeek Harness」，
   双击图标直接打开页面；关闭后服务停止、托盘图标消失、零残留——痛点 4 解决
5. 服务进程意外死亡时，托盘 3 秒内自动跟随消失

## 测试

- 新增 5 个用例（ICO 字节结构、平台拒绝、安装副作用序列、flag 接线、拒绝路径），
  web-app 包 4 文件 20 用例全绿；`tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` / oxlint 均通过
- Windows 10 端到端实测：全新启动（等待页真实阶段→自动跳转）、端口占用顺延、
  复用启动中的手动服务、托盘菜单/双击/关闭全链路
````

---
---

discussions.title: 目录选择器报错建议带上 worker 退出码与 stderr / Directory picker error could include the worker's exit code and stderr
discussions.body:
**TL;DR (EN):** The Win32 folder-picker worker's `exit` handler (`win32-dialog.ts:152-156`) rejects with a fixed message and discards the child's exit code and stderr. Including both in the error (and piping instead of inheriting the worker's stderr, `win32-dialog-host.ts:24`) would make any "worker died instantly" failure a one-step diagnosis. Details below in Chinese.

---

在排查一个 Windows 环境问题时，我在 Web UI 点击工作区文件夹选择按钮（"打开文件夹"）遇到了这个报错：

```
directory picker failed: win32 folder dialog worker exited before reporting a result
```

追到 `packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog.ts:152-156`，`worker.on('exit', ...)` 处理器以固定文案 reject，**丢弃了子进程的退出码和 stderr**。我遇到的情况是子进程在发出第一条 IPC 消息之前就死了——没有退出码也没有 stderr，无从下手，只能手动在服务进程外单独 spawn worker（`win32-dialog-worker.ts` / `lib/worker.cjs`）来证明对话框管线本身是健康的。

两个小建议，能让任何"worker 秒退"类故障（孤儿服务进程、杀毒软件拦截、koffi 损坏、未来的原生崩溃等等）从猜测变成一步定位：

1. 在 reject 消息里带上退出码，例如 `worker exited before reporting a result (exit code ${code})`。驱动端在 `exit` 事件里本来就收到了 `code`，只是没用上（`win32-dialog.ts:20` 声明了类型，第 152 行的处理器忽略了它）。
2. worker 以 `stdio: ['ignore', 'inherit', 'inherit', 'ipc']` 启动（`win32-dialog-host.ts:24`），其 stderr 进了服务端的 stderr。改为 pipe 收集并附加到错误消息里，也能覆盖子进程死前确实打印了东西的场景。

环境供参考：Windows 10 19045、Node v24.14.1、dsh 0.1.0-rc.5 源码运行（`pnpm dsh web`）。

dsh web (0.1.0-rc.6 npm CLI) cannot boot on GitHub Actions ubuntu-latest: missing pty.node linux-x64 prebuild
discussions.body:
## Summary

`dsh web` from the published npm CLI (`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6) cannot boot on GitHub Actions `ubuntu-latest`. The loader fails while importing `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local`:

```text
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include):
failed to import loader entry subprocess (@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local):
Failed to load native module: pty.node, checked: build/Release, build/Debug,
prebuilds/linux-x64: Error: Cannot find module './prebuilds/linux-x64//pty.node'
```

## Reproduction

On any ubuntu-latest GitHub Actions runner (Node 24, pnpm 11):

```sh
export DSH_HOME="$(mktemp -d)/dsh-home"
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add <any-dsh-plugin-tarball>
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh web --port 4099
```

The web server never starts; the process exits with the error above. The same steps succeed on Windows (`win32-x64` prebuild ships with the package).

## Impact

- Community plugin CI cannot run a real `dsh web` boot smoke test on Linux runners.
- The plugin ecosystem's most common CI host (ubuntu-latest) is exactly where the native module is missing.

## Suggested fix

Publish the `linux-x64` prebuild for `node-pty` (or add a build step / fallback for the `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` package) in the `0.1.0-rc.x` train. If a fix is already in progress, a note in the README would help plugin authors plan their CI.

Happy to provide more logs or test a candidate fix.

discussions.title: Agent self-explanation questions should use Harness/preset metadata before workspace search
discussions.body:
# Agent self-explanation questions should use Harness/preset metadata before searching the user workspace

## Summary

I ran into a UX/agent-behavior issue where a user asked what the current built-in agent mode means, but the agent treated it as a workspace-search task. It searched a large user workspace, hit grep/tool timeouts, and never used the Harness/preset metadata that already explains the mode.

This is different from a naming question like "what does PTC stand for?". The issue is that product/self-knowledge sources do not appear to be first-class context for self-explanation questions.

## Reproduction

Environment:

- OS: Windows
- Source checkout: `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` at `47f9438`
- Surface: `dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port 3080`
- Model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
- Selected agent preset/mode: PTC mode
- Workspace: a large local directory

User prompt, translated:

> What is PTC mode? I still do not understand it clearly.

Observed behavior:

1. The agent did not answer from the current mode/preset metadata.
2. It ran grep over the selected user workspace.
3. The workspace search timed out after 30s.
4. It continued reasoning from the workspace shape instead of using Harness's own shipped preset/config documentation.

From the UI trace, the failure path looked roughly like:

```text
User asks what PTC mode is
-> agent greps the workspace for "PTC"
-> grep times out in a large workspace
-> agent keeps searching likely workspace files
```

## Why this seems like a product-context issue

The information needed to answer the question already exists in the shipped Harness files. For example:

```yaml
# apps/cli/config/agent-presets/code/preset.yml
name: PTC mode
description: Has all Standard mode capabilities and presents tools through the Code Mode SDK, letting the model compose multi-step operations with one TypeScript program.
```

The preset composition also documents the implementation boundary:

```yaml
# apps/cli/config/agent-presets/code/agent.cordis.yml
# Code Mode for this agent alone...
- id: tool-presentation
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-tool-presentation'
  config:
    mode: code
```

The Web UI already knows which preset the current session is using, and the agent-preset roster already carries display names/descriptions for the built-in presets. So when a user asks "what is the current mode?", "what does this preset do?", or "what does this Harness setting mean?", the answer should be grounded in Harness/product context first.

## Expected behavior

For product/self-explanation questions, the agent should prioritize sources in roughly this order:

1. The current session's selected agent preset metadata (`preset.yml` name/description).
2. The selected preset's composition (`agent.cordis.yml`) or a summarized product-facing description of that composition.
3. Harness shipped docs/config catalog/README.
4. The user's selected workspace only if the question is clearly about the workspace.

In this case, the agent should have answered something like:

> PTC mode is the Code Mode preset. It keeps Standard mode's capabilities, but presents tools through the Code Mode SDK so the model can write a TypeScript program to coordinate multi-step tool use.

## Possible fixes

Some possible approaches:

- Inject the active preset id/name/description into the session's product context.
- Expose a small read-only "Harness help / preset metadata" retrieval source to the agent.
- Add routing guidance: if the user asks about Harness UI, modes, presets, settings, models, permissions, or configuration, consult Harness/preset docs before searching the workspace.
- In the Web UI, make the active preset label/tooltip available as agent-visible context for self-explanation questions.

The main goal is to prevent product self-explanation requests from becoming expensive and unreliable workspace greps, especially when the workspace is large.

discussions.title: Settings: a "__proto__" section key silently corrupts the object (prototype mutation instead of own property)
discussions.body:
`cloneJsonShaped()` and `mergeLayers()` in `packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts`
build plain objects with `out[key] = value` while iterating untrusted keys from
`Object.entries()`:

```ts
// cloneJsonShaped, line ~277
const out: Record<string, unknown> = {}
for (const [key, entry] of Object.entries(value)) {
  if (entry === undefined) continue
  out[key] = clone(entry, `${path}.${key}`)
}

// mergeLayers, line ~301
const merged: Record<string, unknown> = { ...under }
for (const [key, value] of Object.entries(over)) {
  merged[key] = key in merged ? mergeLayers(merged[key], value) : value
}
```
When key === "__proto__", bracket assignment is a [[Set]], not
[[DefineOwnProperty]]. It invokes Object.prototype's __proto__ accessor
and reassigns the object's prototype instead of creating an own data
property. Confirmed with node:

```ts
const value = JSON.parse('{"__proto__": {"marker": true}, "ok": 1}')
const out = {}
for (const [k, v] of Object.entries(value)) out[k] = v
Object.keys(out)   // ['ok']  <- "__proto__" silently vanished
out.marker         // true    <- leaked onto the prototype instead
```

Note this only reproduces via JSON.parse (or Object.defineProperty) —
an object literal like {'__proto__': {...}} is special-cased by the spec
and never hits this path. JSON.parse has no such special case, so any
settings write built from parsed JSON (an HTTP request body, a config file
patch) can carry a real own "__proto__" key.

Impact: any settings namespace whose schema allows a dict/record-typed
field (e.g. an MCP-servers map, or anything keyed by a user-chosen name) can
have an entry named __proto__ silently dropped by cloneJsonShaped. Worse,
mergeLayers's isPlainObject check can then see the corrupted-prototype
object as non-plain and replace the entire section wholesale, discarding
every other field the user had set on the next merge — silent data loss, no
error.

The file already carries a TODO(settings-json-properties) comment
acknowledging this gap, and the identical pattern is already fixed correctly
elsewhere in this codebase, e.g. workflow-worker-thread/src/realm.ts:

```ts
// defineProperty, never assignment: a "__proto__" key must become an OWN
// data property of the copy, not a prototype mutation.
Object.defineProperty(out, key, { value: ..., enumerable: true, writable: true, configurable: true })
```
Suggested fix (same pattern applied to cloneJsonShaped/mergeLayers),
plus a regression test, here:
https://github.com/xu-kai-quan/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/settings-proto-key-clone

I understand external PRs aren't being accepted right now per CONTRIBUTING.md,
so posting here per that doc's guidance instead. Happy to elaborate if useful.

discussions.title: Large workspace search needs optional indexing, budgets, and progress feedback
discussions.body:
# Large workspace search needs optional indexing, budgets, and progress feedback

## Summary

I ran into another UX issue related to workspace search on large local workspaces. The current grep-style tool behavior appears to scan the selected workspace on demand. When the workspace is large, a broad query can time out after 30 seconds and leave the agent with little useful signal.

I understand why a tool timeout exists: the agent should not block the UI indefinitely. But for users who repeatedly work in the same workspace, a purely on-demand full-tree scan is not always the right tradeoff. Since Harness is already plugin/composition oriented, I think optional workspace indexing would be a natural optimization path.

## Example

In one session, the agent called a grep-like tool with:

```ts
const g = await tools.grep({
  pattern: "PTC",
  path: "."
})
```

The selected workspace was large, and the tool failed with:

```text
ToolCallError: tool call timed out after 30000ms
```

This made the agent experience feel brittle: a single broad search in a large workspace could fail before producing useful partial context.

## Why this matters

When a user selects a workspace, that workspace usually becomes the repeated working context for many future agent turns. Paying some indexing cost once, or building an index quietly in the background, can be a reasonable tradeoff if it makes later agent operations faster and more predictable.

The comparison is not exactly "grep should be as fast as Everything", because Everything is fast mainly because it maintains indexes ahead of time. But that is precisely the design point: for repeated workspace use, Harness could optionally move part of the search cost from query time to workspace setup/background time.

## Possible design directions

Some possible approaches:

- Add an optional workspace indexing plugin.
- Build the index when a workspace is selected, or build/update it quietly in the background.
- Let the index be deleted when the workspace is removed.
- Support at least a filename/path index first, and possibly an opt-in content index later.
- Keep the index scoped per workspace, with explicit ignore rules and privacy boundaries.
- Respect common excludes by default, such as `.git`, `node_modules`, `dist`, `build`, large binary/data directories, and user-configured ignore patterns.
- Use the index as a prefilter before running content grep.
- Return partial results when a search budget is exhausted instead of only failing.
- Include scan statistics in the tool result: files considered, files skipped, bytes scanned, directories skipped, elapsed time.
- Surface progress in the UI: what scope is being searched, which directory is currently being scanned, and whether the search is using an index or falling back to live scan.
- Let the user narrow the search scope from the UI when a broad search is expensive.

## Expected UX

For a large workspace, the search flow could become:

```text
Workspace selected
-> background index starts
-> user can see indexing/search status if relevant
-> later agent search uses index/pre-filtered candidates
-> if budget is exhausted, return partial results plus a clear summary
```

This would make broad searches less surprising and make failures more actionable. Instead of:

```text
grep timed out after 30000ms
```

the agent could receive something like:

```text
Search budget exhausted after 30s.
Scanned 12,430 files / 1.8GB.
Skipped node_modules, .git, dist.
Top candidate paths from index: ...
Narrowing to docs/, src/, or specific file extensions is recommended.
```

## Why a plugin seems appropriate

Harness already seems to be designed as a composition of plugins and seams. Workspace indexing could therefore be optional and deployment-specific:

- lightweight deployments can keep the current on-demand grep behavior;
- local desktop/workstation deployments can enable indexing;
- Windows deployments could potentially integrate with existing local indexers such as Everything or Windows Search;
- remote/container deployments could use a different backend, such as a local SQLite/FTS index.

This does not need to be mandatory. The key improvement is giving repeated local workspaces a path toward predictable, indexed search rather than only broad live scans with hard timeouts.
