discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-plugin-doctor — the dsh plugin check from RFC #1629, now real
discussions.body:
The `dsh plugin check` idea from RFC #1629 is now a real tool: **dsh-plugin-doctor** 🩺

It runs repeatable health checks on any DeepSeek Harness plugin bundle:

- `manifest` — `package.json` + `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.bundle.patch` + `prepare` + `main`
- `patch` — `cordis.patch.yml` parses and contains at least one `insert` row with an `id`
- `entry` — the `main` target exists (warns when not built yet)
- `files` — a `files` allowlist is declared
- `build` — `pnpm run build` succeeds (`--build`)
- `pack` + `install` — `pnpm pack`, install into a brand-new `DSH_HOME` profile, and confirm the plugin id in `--dump-config` (`--full`)

Exit code 0/1 and `--json` output make it CI-friendly:

```sh
dsh-plugin-doctor .                 # quick checks
dsh-plugin-doctor --build ./my-plugin
dsh-plugin-doctor --full ./my-plugin   # pack + fresh profile install + config check
```

Verified against the [dsh-plugin-template](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-template): `--full` reports all checks PASS, including the packed tarball loading into a fresh profile with `template-hello` present in the composed config.

Why it matters: "loads fine" is not "works". pnpm can silently link an older RC into a plugin's peer slot, and manifest mistakes only surface on other people's machines. A local doctor turns both into immediate, actionable failures.

Repo: [zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor) · Release: [v1.0.0](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor/releases/tag/v1.0.0) · RFC: [#1629](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1629)

Feedback and feature requests welcome — PRs too.

discussions.title: loongport — one-command multi-site provider setup for dsh (signed directory + Settings page)
discussions.body:
Hi! I'm the maintainer of **loongport**, a Cordis plugin that makes it easy to point dsh at OpenAI-compatible relay providers — signed provider directory instead of hand-copied base URLs, and a Settings page instead of config-file editing. ## Quick start ```sh dsh plugin --profile add loongport ``` 1. Install the bundle (npm package [`loongport`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/loongport), current release 0.2.0). 2. Open the dsh Web UI → **Settings → LoongPort**. 3. Pick a verified provider, open its registration/login link if you don't have an account yet, create an API key on the provider's site, paste it into the page, pick a model, save. Done. The default provider is DeepSeek’s official API (`https://api.deepseek.com/v1`) with `deepseek-v4-flash` (default) and `deepseek-v4-pro`; BestAPI (`https://api.bestapi.store/v1`) is the verified relay option for cheaper multi-site access. The API key lives in DSH credentials only. ## What it does - **Signed provider directory** (Ed25519): provider identity, URLs, models, and registration links come from a signed directory — the Settings page can't silently show a different provider than what was published. No unsigned fallback if the signature fails. - **Settings → LoongPort page**: provider selection plus manual API key entry, with each provider's own registration/login links. - **OpenAI-compatible routes** use dsh's built-in transport; the plugin implements none of its own. Verified loading against dsh 0.1.0-rc.6: after `dsh plugin add`, `dsh --profile

--dump-config` shows the `loongport` and `loongport/host` rows. ## What it deliberately doesn't do (0.2.0) No automated browser authorization, no cookie/localStorage/session collection, no device-auth flows. Keys are pasted by the human who owns them, and the plugin reads keys only from the `LOONGPORT_API_KEY` environment variable when you use the CLI form (`npx loongport dsh setup`). ## Links - Setup guide (English / 中文 / 日本語): https://loongport.dev/en/dsh - Source: https://github.com/SailingLoong/loongport-dsh - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/loongport Feedback welcome — especially on whether the signed-directory approach is useful for other provider bundles.

discussions.title: [BUG] 工具执行中途崩溃后会话永久卡死：DeepSeek 400 "insufficient tool messages"（rc.6）
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

1. 某轮对话中，助手刚输出一个工具调用（`todo_write`），工具执行阶段随即崩溃，该轮报错：

   ```
   Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
   ```

2. 崩溃之后这个会话彻底废了：之后无论发什么消息，每一轮都在第一步直接失败，报：

   ```
   An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages
   responding to each 'tool_call_id'.
   (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)
   HTTP 400 INVALID_REQUEST
   ```

   一次中途崩溃 = 会话永久卡死，只能放弃该会话。

## 复现步骤

1. `dsh web` 开启会话，正常跑任务（环境：Windows 11 / Node v24.15.0 / 模型 deepseek-v4-pro）
2. 会话运行期间，在同一个 dsh 实例上安装社区插件（热加载，未重启 dsh）
3. 安装活动之后的下一个工具调用即崩溃（`undefined.prepare`），该轮以 UNKNOWN 错误结束
4. 在同一会话继续发任意消息 → 每轮都报上面的 400 错误，100% 复现（连续 3 轮验证）

## 实际行为

崩溃后会话历史里残留一条**没有工具结果的 assistant tool_calls**，dsh 不做任何修复（不补合成结果、不裁剪悬空消息），把残缺历史原样发给 API，DeepSeek 严格校验直接 400，会话永久无法继续。

## 期望行为

崩溃后会话应当可恢复：为未应答的工具调用补一条合成错误结果（类似已有的 "tool call aborted before dispatch" 处理），或裁剪悬空的 assistant 消息。至少后续消息不应再触发 API 400。

## 环境信息

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh 版本 | 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装） |
| 操作系统 | Windows 11 |
| Node 版本 | v24.15.0 |
| 使用方式 | `dsh web` |
| 模型 | deepseek-v4-pro（reasoningEffort: max） |
| 社区插件 | continual-evolve、fail-logger、at-file、better-sidebar、distill、automation、genui、modlens |

## 日志与证据

崩溃那一轮（step 1）的会话事件序列：

| seq | 事件 | 说明 |
|-----|------|------|
| 128939 | `assistant/message` | 助手消息含 reasoning + tool_calls |
| 128940 | `tool/call` | `callId: call_00_BNK32bokg9LKRgMdRwlY8298`，`name: todo_write` |
| 128941 | `step/end` | — |
| 128942 | `turn/end` | `reason: {"kind":"error","error":{"message":"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')","code":"UNKNOWN"}}` |

注意：该 `todo_write` 调用**自始至终没有对应的 `tool/result` 事件**。

之后连续三轮（25、26、27）每轮都是同一模式：

| seq | 事件 | 说明 |
|-----|------|------|
| 128944 | `turn/start` | 第 25 轮 |
| 128947 | `user/message` | 新消息追加在悬空的 tool_calls 之后 |
| 128948 | `assistant/chunk` | finish 即错误：`INVALID_REQUEST`、`status: 400` |
| 128950 | `turn/end` | 同样的 400 错误 |

## 根因分析（AI 分析）

> 以下分析由 AI 辅助完成，不保证准确，仅作为排查线索提供：

1. **触发缺陷**：`undefined.prepare` 对应 `dsh-agent-loop` 中 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(...)`。同一时刻 `ctx.tools.executionMode()` 正常，说明 tools 服务还在，但 Symbol 键的调度器属性变成 undefined。崩溃发生在运行中热加载插件之后，怀疑 HMR 模块重载后 `dsh-agent-loop` 与 `ToolRuntime` 之间的 Symbol 引用对不上。
2. **致命缺陷**：崩溃后会话表面不做修复（`appendSkippedToolCall` 的合成结果逻辑只覆盖中止场景，不覆盖调度器抛异常场景），悬空的 tool_calls 被 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 原样序列化发给 API。

discussions.title: Show and tell: offline-first desktop shell for dsh (+ 3 reliability findings we'd love to fix upstream)
discussions.body:
## DeepSeek Harness Desktop

We built an unofficial desktop shell for dsh: https://github.com/Myoontyee/deepseek-harness-desktop

- Tauri 2 + WebView2 (Windows / macOS Apple Silicon / Linux), single-instance, system tray
- **Offline-first**: the installer bundles the official source snapshot — first run initializes with zero network
- Auto-syncs the official `master` branch; system-proxy aware for git (Clash etc.); multi-level fallback (snapshot → git clone → ZIP) with hard timeouts so boot never hangs
- Bundled portable Node + pnpm; magazine-style boot page with real progress percentages

## 3 reliability findings we hit while building it

1. **Concurrent dsh servers corrupt the shared session log** — two `dsh web` instances appending to the same `~/.dsh` session interleave frames, seq numbers go backward, and history fails to load (`corrupt Zstandard session log`). We recovered by frame-level truncation. Suggest a per-user single-instance lock on the session store.
2. **`pnpm install --production` permanently breaks the dev environment** — the workspace state records production mode, every subsequent `pnpm <script>` re-runs the failing production install, and the root postinstall (`scripts/install-lefthook.mjs`) statically imports the devDependency `lefthook`, aborting with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`. We have a minimal fix ready (dynamic import, exit quietly when absent) — happy to open a PR.
3. **Web boot cold-start race** — a fresh server answers `/` before `/plugins` routes are live; the immediately-tier plugin modules can fail to load and the whole plugin graph stays pending with "Failed to load plugins" and no retry. We mitigate by probing the plugin endpoint before navigating and auto-reloading (max 3x).

Happy to turn any of these into a PR with a minimal reproduction. Thanks for the great project!

discussions.title: Bug: installing any plugin that depends on @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools breaks every tool call (Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare'))
discussions.body:
"### Summary

Installing any third-party plugin that depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (e.g. `@anweat/dsh-browser`, `@linxin666/dsh-ssh`) breaks **every** agent tool call with:

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

The turn ends immediately after the first `tool/call` (`turn/end` reason `error`). This is a platform-level module-instance shadowing bug, not a plugin bug: the crash site is `dsh-agent-loop`'s scheduler, and the plugin whose install triggered it is never even loaded into the config tree.

### Environment

- dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm global install)
- Profile: `web` (generated by dsh; `pnpm-workspace.yaml` uses `nodeLinker: hoisted`, `autoInstallPeers: false`)
- pnpm 11, Windows 10, Node 24

### Repro

1. `dsh plugin --profile web add @anweat/dsh-browser` (any plugin whose dependencies include `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` works, e.g. `@linxin666/dsh-ssh`)
2. Boot the web profile, start a session, and issue any prompt that triggers a tool call.
3. The turn fails right after the first tool call with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`. Repeats on every turn.

### Root cause (verified)

1. The profile's `pnpm-workspace.yaml` (dsh-generated) uses `nodeLinker: hoisted`, so the plugin's transitive `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (the **same version**, 0.1.0-rc.6) is hoisted into the profile's top-level `node_modules`.
2. The config tree anchors `baseUrl` at the profile directory, and bare specifiers resolve profile-first with the host as fallback (`HostResolvedRootInclude.import` in `packages/boot/app-boot` → `internal.import(specifier, bareModuleBaseUrl, {})`). The `tools` entry (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) therefore loads the **hoisted copy** instead of the host's copy.
3. `dsh-agent-loop` is loaded from the host copy and reads `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)` using the **host copy's** `Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')` (a module-level `unique symbol`). The registered `ToolRuntime` instance was created by the hoisted copy, whose prototype carries a **different** symbol value (`Symbol` identity is per-module-instance). The lookup yields `undefined` → `undefined.prepare(...)` → the exact TypeError above.

Verified empirically: loading both copies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6` in one process yields `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` symbols that are not `===` equal.

### Impact

- Any third-party plugin that imports `defineTool` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (the platform's own plugin-authoring API) and gets installed with a hoisted profile layout triggers this.
- Two independent plugins are affected today: `@anweat/dsh-browser` and `@linxin666/dsh-ssh` (ships in `dsh-web-ui-all`).
- The failure is also completely non-diagnosable: nothing points at duplicate module instances.

### Suggested fix directions

- In `HostResolvedRootInclude.import` (or the native `internal.import` fallback), resolve the harness's own scope (`@deepseek-ai/*` present in the host's `node_modules`) **from the host first**, so a profile-installed duplicate can never shadow the host instance; or
- Detect and warn/error when a profile-installed package shadows a host package of the same name+version, with an actionable message.

### Workaround (verified on the affected setup)

Declare the SDK as a `link:` dependency in the profile so the profile resolves the **host's** copy (same realpath → same module instance → symbols match):

```jsonc
// ~/.dsh/profiles/web/package.json
{
  "dependencies": {
    "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": "link:C:/Users/<user>/AppData/Roaming/npm/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools",
    // ...other plugins
  }
}
```

then `pnpm install` in the profile. After that, tool calls complete normally (verified end-to-end with a Pwsh tool call: `1 轮 · 2 步`, no errors). Note the absolute path must be adjusted if the npm global prefix changes.
"

discussions.title: DSH Desktop：开箱即用的 DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端
discussions.body:
大家好，我基于 DeepSeek 官方开源的 **DeepSeek Harness** 做了一个社区桌面封装项目：**DSH Desktop**。

项目地址：<https://github.com/libi/dsh-desktop>

DeepSeek Harness 是 DeepSeek AI 推出的开源 Agent Harness。它采用插件化架构，可以让 AI Agent 在授权范围内读取和编辑文件、执行命令、维护任务计划，并将部分工作委派给子 Agent。官方提供的 Web UI 可以通过以下命令启动：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

这种方式对开发者很方便，但对不熟悉 Node.js、npm 和命令行的用户来说，安装依赖、配置环境以及长期运行服务仍有一定门槛。因此，我做了 DSH Desktop，希望把这些步骤封装成更接近普通桌面软件的使用体验。

## 目前实现的功能

- 将 DeepSeek Harness 和 Web UI 打包为桌面应用
- 启动应用时自动拉起本地 DSH 服务
- 自动打开操作界面，不需要手动执行命令
- 支持系统托盘运行及快速打开主界面
- 关闭应用时自动清理对应的后台服务
- 提供 Windows 安装包，并通过 GitHub Actions 自动构建发布
- 保留 DeepSeek Harness 原有的模型配置、工作区和插件能力

## 为什么做这个项目

DSH Desktop 并没有修改 DeepSeek Harness 的核心工作方式，而是在它外面增加了一层轻量桌面外壳，主要负责：

1. 管理本地服务的启动与退出；
2. 定位并校验打包后的运行资源；
3. 将 Web UI 嵌入桌面窗口；
4. 降低安装、启动和日常使用门槛。

我的目标不是重新实现一个 Agent 框架，而是让更多人能够更方便地体验和使用 DeepSeek Harness。

## 适合哪些用户

- 想体验 DeepSeek Harness，但不想配置 Node.js 环境的用户
- 希望以桌面应用方式管理本地 AI Agent 的开发者
- 想研究 Agent 工具调用、插件系统和多 Agent 协作的学习者
- 希望在本地工作区中使用 AI 辅助编程和自动化操作的用户

## 项目说明

DSH Desktop 是社区项目，并非 DeepSeek 官方桌面客户端。核心 Agent 能力来自官方的 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，本项目主要负责桌面化封装、安装包构建和进程管理。

DeepSeek Harness 当前仍处于开发者预览阶段，后续版本可能存在破坏性变更。DSH Desktop 也会持续跟进上游版本，并完善打包兼容性和启动稳定性。

Agent 可能读取或修改工作区文件、执行本地命令。使用时请只选择可信目录，认真确认授权提示，并避免在包含敏感信息的环境中直接运行未经验证的任务。

## 想听听大家的意见

项目还在持续完善，欢迎体验、提交 Issue 或参与开发。尤其希望了解：

1. 你更希望优先支持哪些桌面平台？
2. 安装和首次配置过程中是否遇到问题？
3. 哪些 DeepSeek Harness 功能最值得做成桌面端快捷入口？
4. 你更关注自动更新、日志查看，还是多工作区管理？

如果这个项目对你有帮助，欢迎给仓库一个 Star，也欢迎分享你的使用体验和改进建议。

相关链接：

- DSH Desktop：<https://github.com/libi/dsh-desktop>
- DeepSeek Harness：<https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness>
- DeepSeek API 文档：<https://api-docs.deepseek.com/zh-cn/>

discussions.title: [Released] LoongSuite OpenTelemetry GenAI Observability Plugin for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
> **Release status (2026-08-17):** Stable version `0.1.1` is available. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add @loongsuite/dsh-plugin`. Source and documentation: [`loongsuite/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/loongsuite/dsh-plugin).

## 背景

DeepSeek Harness（DSH）采用“一切皆插件”的架构，并提供完整的 session、turn、step、LLM 和 tool 生命周期数据。仓库目前已经包含 [`dsh-session-telemetry-otel`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/session/session-telemetry-otel)，可以通过 OTLP 导出结构化日志；但如果想在可观测后端中直接查看一次 Agent 执行里的模型调用、推理步骤、工具调用、Token 和耗时关系，还缺少一棵标准化的 GenAI Trace 树。

我们计划为 DeepSeek Harness 开发一个独立、开源的 LoongSuite 可观测插件，想先向维护者和社区征求对方案及集成方式的意见。

## LoongSuite 是什么

LoongSuite 是基于 OpenTelemetry 的开源可观测数据采集体系，并增强了生成式 AI 与 Agent 场景的语义表达。这个项目希望把 LoongSuite 的 OpenTelemetry GenAI 可观测能力带到 DeepSeek Harness，同时保持采集协议、部署方式和后端选择的开放性。

插件代码与文档将托管在独立仓库：[`loongsuite/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/loongsuite/dsh-plugin)。

## 方案定位

我们希望提供一个真正的 DSH 原生插件，而不是修改 Harness 核心代码、解析终端输出，或依赖额外的本地采集进程：

- 通过 DSH 原生插件机制、生命周期事件和公开扩展点采集数据；
- 在插件进程内构建 OpenTelemetry GenAI spans 和 metrics；
- 按 OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions 组织 `ENTRY → AGENT → STEP → LLM / TOOL` Trace；
- 采集模型、Token、TTFT、耗时、结束原因、错误和工具调用等指标与属性；
- 插件自身通过标准 OTLP 将数据直接发送到配置的后端；
- 不绑定特定厂商、SaaS 或云服务，也不要求部署额外的本地采集组件；
- 可观测配置、网络或后端故障不会影响 Agent 的正常执行。

目标 Trace 结构示例：

```text
enter_ai_application_system  (ENTRY)
  └── invoke_agent           (AGENT)
       ├── react             (STEP)
       │    ├── chat         (LLM)
       │    └── execute_tool (TOOL)
       └── react             (STEP)
            └── chat         (LLM)
```

数据通过标准 OTLP 输出，可发送到任何兼容 OTLP 的开源或商业后端，例如 OpenTelemetry Collector、Jaeger、Grafana Tempo、SigNoz 和 Langfuse。不同后端对 GenAI 专用字段和 UI 的展示能力可能不同，但底层数据与传输协议保持开放、标准化。

## 如何使用（计划接口）

项目目前处于方案与实现准备阶段。首个版本发布后，用户可以从 DSH 插件市场或命令行独立安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @loongsuite/dsh-plugin
```

然后在 DSH profile 中配置 OTLP endpoint：

```yaml
- id: loongsuite-observability
  name: '@loongsuite/dsh-plugin'
  config:
    endpoint: http://localhost:4318/v1/traces
    serviceName: my-dsh-agent
    headers: {}
    captureContent: false
```

启动或重启 DSH 后，插件会自动采集 Agent 运行数据并上报。用户可以在 Jaeger、Grafana Tempo、SigNoz、Langfuse 等兼容后端中查看会话、模型调用和工具调用链路。OpenTelemetry Collector 可以作为可选的转发与处理层，但不是使用插件的必要条件。

我们也计划支持标准 OpenTelemetry 环境变量，例如 `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`、`OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS` 和 `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME`，便于容器与自动化部署。

## 与现有能力的关系

这不是对现有 `dsh-session-telemetry-otel` 的简单重复：

- 现有官方插件主要输出 OTLP Logs，适合保留权威 session 事件和运维记录；
- 本提案重点补齐 Agent / Step / LLM / Tool 的父子 Span、Trace Context 传播和 GenAI Metrics；
- 社区已有的 [`dsh-plugin-langfuse`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1007) 证明了从 DSH session 数据构建 Trace 的可行性；LoongSuite 方案的差异是使用标准 OTLP、后端无关，并作为可独立安装的 DSH 插件发布。

实现计划通过 DSH 的公开事件和插件生命周期进行旁观式采集，不占用或替换官方 `sessionTelemetry` backend，因此目标是能够与现有 OTLP Logs 后端同时运行。

## 隐私与可靠性原则

- 默认只在 Trace 中采集调用元数据；Prompt、Completion、工具参数和工具结果等内容默认关闭；
- 内容采集必须显式开启，并支持可配置的脱敏与敏感信息过滤；
- OTLP endpoint、鉴权 headers 和资源属性均由用户配置；
- 批处理、队列、刷新和关闭流程遵循 OpenTelemetry SDK 生命周期；
- 采集或导出异常会被隔离，不阻塞或改变 Agent 的正常行为；
- 插件不依赖任何特定云服务、商业产品或私有协议。

如果方向得到认可，我们会在 [`loongsuite/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/loongsuite/dsh-plugin) 公开设计、实现、测试和使用文档，并首先提供一个能够直接连接本地 OpenTelemetry Collector 或 Jaeger 的最小可运行版本。

---

## Background

DeepSeek Harness (DSH) follows an “everything is a plugin” architecture and exposes complete session, turn, step, LLM, and tool lifecycle data. The repository already includes [`dsh-session-telemetry-otel`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/session/session-telemetry-otel), which exports structured logs through OTLP. What is still missing is a standardized GenAI trace tree that lets an observability backend directly show the relationships among model calls, reasoning steps, tool executions, token usage, and latency within an agent run.

We propose an independent, open-source LoongSuite observability plugin for DeepSeek Harness and would like feedback from the maintainers and community on the design and integration approach.

## What is LoongSuite?

LoongSuite is an open-source observability data collection suite built on OpenTelemetry, with enhanced semantic representation for generative AI and agent workloads. This project aims to bring LoongSuite's OpenTelemetry GenAI observability capabilities to DeepSeek Harness while keeping the collection protocol, deployment model, and backend choice open.

The plugin source code and documentation will live in the standalone repository [`loongsuite/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/loongsuite/dsh-plugin).

## Proposed scope

The goal is a native DSH plugin, without modifying Harness core, parsing terminal output, or requiring an additional local collection process:

- Collect data through DSH's native plugin mechanism, lifecycle events, and public extension points.
- Build OpenTelemetry GenAI spans and metrics inside the plugin process.
- Represent traces according to the OpenTelemetry GenAI Semantic Conventions as `ENTRY → AGENT → STEP → LLM / TOOL`.
- Capture model identity, token usage, TTFT, duration, finish reasons, errors, and tool execution attributes.
- Export directly from the plugin to a configured backend through standard OTLP.
- Avoid dependencies on a specific vendor, SaaS product, cloud service, or additional local collection component.
- Ensure that configuration, network, or backend failures in observability never affect normal agent execution.

Target trace structure:

```text
enter_ai_application_system  (ENTRY)
  └── invoke_agent           (AGENT)
       ├── react             (STEP)
       │    ├── chat         (LLM)
       │    └── execute_tool (TOOL)
       └── react             (STEP)
            └── chat         (LLM)
```

The plugin will emit standard OTLP data to any compatible open-source or commercial backend, including OpenTelemetry Collector, Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, SigNoz, and Langfuse. GenAI-specific visualization capabilities may differ between backends, but the underlying data and transport remain open and standardized.

## How to use it (planned interface)

The project is currently in the design and implementation preparation stage. After the first release, users will be able to install it independently from the DSH plugin market or the command line:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @loongsuite/dsh-plugin
```

Users will then configure an OTLP endpoint in their DSH profile:

```yaml
- id: loongsuite-observability
  name: '@loongsuite/dsh-plugin'
  config:
    endpoint: http://localhost:4318/v1/traces
    serviceName: my-dsh-agent
    headers: {}
    captureContent: false
```

After DSH starts or restarts, the plugin will automatically collect and export agent telemetry. Sessions, model calls, and tool execution traces can then be inspected in compatible backends such as Jaeger, Grafana Tempo, SigNoz, or Langfuse. An OpenTelemetry Collector may be used as an optional processing and forwarding layer, but it is not required to use the plugin.

We also plan to support standard OpenTelemetry environment variables such as `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_ENDPOINT`, `OTEL_EXPORTER_OTLP_HEADERS`, and `OTEL_SERVICE_NAME` for containerized and automated deployments.

## Relationship to existing capabilities

This is not a duplicate of the existing `dsh-session-telemetry-otel` package:

- The official plugin primarily exports OTLP Logs, which preserve authoritative session events and operational records.
- This proposal focuses on Agent / Step / LLM / Tool parent-child spans, Trace Context propagation, and GenAI metrics.
- The community [`dsh-plugin-langfuse`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1007) has demonstrated the feasibility of building traces from DSH session data. The LoongSuite proposal differs by using standard OTLP, remaining backend-neutral, and being distributed as an independently installable DSH plugin.

The implementation is intended to observe DSH public events and plugin lifecycles without claiming or replacing the official `sessionTelemetry` backend, so it should be able to run alongside the existing OTLP Logs backend.

## Privacy and reliability principles

- By default, traces contain invocation metadata only. Prompts, completions, tool arguments, and tool results are disabled by default.
- Content capture must be explicitly enabled and will support configurable redaction and sensitive-data filtering.
- The OTLP endpoint, authentication headers, and resource attributes are controlled by the user.
- Batching, queueing, flushing, and shutdown follow the OpenTelemetry SDK lifecycle.
- Collection and export failures are isolated and never block or alter normal agent behavior.
- The plugin does not depend on any specific cloud service, commercial product, or proprietary protocol.

If the direction is accepted, we will publish the design, implementation, tests, and usage documentation in [`loongsuite/dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/loongsuite/dsh-plugin), starting with a minimal runnable version that can connect directly to a local OpenTelemetry Collector or Jaeger instance.

discussions.title: 报告：根 package.json 的 scripts 使用 npm run 与 pnpm-only 声明冲突，且 devDependencies 缺少 unrun 依赖
discussions.body:
## 标题（Title）

报告：根 package.json 的 scripts 使用 npm run 与 pnpm-only 声明冲突，且 devDependencies 缺少 unrun 依赖

## 正文（Body）

根 package.json 的 scripts 使用 npm run，与 packageManager 声明的 pnpm-only 冲突，且 devDependencies 缺少 tsdown 所需的 unrun 依赖。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

### 问题一：scripts 使用 `npm run`，与 `packageManager` 声明的 pnpm-only 冲突

- 复现步骤：
  1. 读取仓库根目录 `package.json` 的 `packageManager` 字段（当前为 `pnpm@11.7.0`，见第 7 行）；
  2. 检查 `scripts` 中各命令的前缀；
  3. 统计：`build`、`build:lib`、`typecheck`、`lint`、`lint:fix`、`test:web`、`test:web:refresh`、`test:web:perf`、`test:web:stress`、`doc-typecheck` 共 10 个脚本以 `npm run` 开头。
- 实际结果：同一文件既声明 `"packageManager": "pnpm@11.7.0"`（配套 `pnpm-lock.yaml`），又在 `scripts` 中直接调用 `npm run`，混合使用两种包管理器。`npm run` 不识别 pnpm 的 workspace 协议与 `--filter` 语义；仓库其余部分（`lefthook.yml`、`CONTRIBUTING.md`、各子包 `package.json`）全部以 `pnpm` 或 `node_modules/.bin` 调用，唯独根 `scripts` 例外，约定不一致。
- 预期结果：所有 `scripts` 统一使用 `pnpm run`（`pnpm run` 完全兼容 `npm run` 的写法），与 `packageManager` 字段一致。

### 问题二：devDependencies 缺少 `unrun`

- 复现步骤：
  1. `grep '"unrun"' package.json` → 无结果；
  2. 检查 `pnpm-lock.yaml`：`unrun@0.3.1` 已作为 `tsdown@0.22.2` 的 peerDependency（tsdown 的 `peerDependencies` 声明 `"unrun": "*"`）出现在 lockfile 中，但根 `package.json` 的 `devDependencies` 未显式声明；
  3. 运行依赖 tsdown 的流程，例如 `pnpm run dev:web`（`scripts/dev-web.ts` 通过 tsdown watch 模式构建）。
- 实际结果：`unrun` 处于"隐式可用"状态——仅当 tsdown 的 peer 解析恰好带上它时才可用，依赖解析的偶然性；缺失显式声明会让 `knip`、`publint` 等卫生门禁无法正确校验；`THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 相应缺少 unrun 条目。
- 预期结果：`devDependencies` 显式声明 `"unrun": "^0.3.1"`，并同步重新生成 `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md`。

### 环境

- 分支 / 提交：`master` @ `47f943859b`（release 0.1.0-rc.5）
- Node：^22.19.0 或 >=24.0.0；pnpm 11.7.0

### 修复与验收

- 交付物：
  1. `package.json`：10 处 `npm run` 改为 `pnpm run`；`devDependencies` 增加 `"unrun": "^0.3.1"`；
  2. `pnpm-lock.yaml` 同步更新（lockfileVersion 不变，仅新增 unrun 解析条目）；
  3. `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` 重新生成（含 unrun 条目）。
- 测试证据（在修复后工作树实测）：
  - `grep -oE '(^|[^a-zA-Z])npm run' package.json | wc -l` → 0；
  - `grep -oE 'pnpm run' package.json | wc -l` → 34；
  - `pnpm-lock.yaml` lockfileVersion 保持 9.0 不变，diff 仅新增 unrun 解析条目（+20/-2）；
  - `tsx scripts/gen-third-party-notices.ts --check` → "THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md is up to date"。
- 验收条件：
  - `package.json` 中不再出现真实的 `npm run` 调用；
  - `unrun` 出现在 `devDependencies`；
  - `pnpm run hygiene`（或至少 `verify-third-party-notices`）通过。
- 修复状态：本地已完成修复提交（分支 `fix/root-package-pnpm-unrun`，提交 `4cedb4eca3`），如维护者认可，可继续跟进提 PR。

</details>

discussions.title: invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content after truncated output + continue
discussions.body:
## Description

When a pi-ai-backed model response is truncated by `max_tokens` (stopReason `length`), the UI shows “已达到输出 token 上限回答被截断”. If the user then sends “继续” to continue the truncated assistant message, the next request fails with:

```
invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
```

## Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6
- OS: Windows + WSL2 (Debian)
- Provider: opencode-go / deepseek-v4-flash (pi-ai)
- Preset: custom code-wsl (PTC/Code Mode) with tool-bootstrap `bootstrapMaxTokens: 1024` (later raised to 16384)

## Steps to reproduce

1. Use a PTC/Code Mode preset whose first request has a small `maxTokens` cap (e.g. 1024).
2. Send a prompt that causes a long first response (e.g. a large `run_code` program).
3. The response hits the output token limit and is truncated.
4. Click “继续” / send “继续”.
5. The next turn fails with `invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content`.

## Expected behavior

After a truncated assistant message, “继续” should resume cleanly, or the replay state should be discarded/rebuilt so the conversation can continue.

## Actual behavior

The turn fails with an `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE` error and the conversation cannot continue from that truncated message.

## Possible cause

`toPiReplayState` stores `blocks` from the pi-ai `done` message even when `stopReason` is `length`. When the harness later continues/edits the truncated assistant content, the durable assistant content block count no longer matches the saved replay state blocks, so `replayedAssistant` rejects with `block count does not match assistant content`.

## Workaround

- Avoid using “继续” after truncation; send a new message instead.
- Increase the output token cap so truncation is less likely.

## Related

- The replay state validation is in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`: `replayedAssistant` checks `state.blocks.length !== message.content.length`.

discussions.title: DSH Ops Skill: evidence-first checks for blank-instance upgrades
discussions.body:
I built **[DSH Ops Skill](https://github.com/dragon43pp/dsh-ops-skill)** for a specific runtime failure pattern: after an upgrade, DSH can return HTTP 200 yet look like a fresh instance—empty session sidebar, missing routes, or fresh Settings.

In many cases this is not immediately proven data loss. The candidate runtime can be resolving a different state root because `HOME`, `DSH_HOME`, a mount destination, entrypoint, or workdir changed. The safest first move is evidence collection, not copying files or enabling more privileges.

## What v0.1.0 provides

- A read-only `dsh-doctor` with **versioned redacted state contracts** (key/value or JSON).
- Private snapshots that refuse overwrite, plus **review-oriented contract diffs**: `UNCHANGED` exits 0; `REVIEW` exits 2.
- A one-way state-root fingerprint and root-selection origin without emitting the raw path.
- An isolated POSIX-shell regression suite and a no-secrets GitHub Actions check.
- Recovery playbooks, a synthetic redacted demonstration, and a least-privilege Compose overlay.

## Deliberate boundaries

This is a community, folder-based Skill—not an official DeepSeek plugin or DSH profile bundle. It does not read conversations or config values, invoke Docker, modify state, copy sessions, or enable privileged mode, Docker Socket access, or `SYS_ADMIN` by default.

- Repository: https://github.com/dragon43pp/dsh-ops-skill
- v0.1.0 pre-release: https://github.com/dragon43pp/dsh-ops-skill/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- Synthetic workflow: https://github.com/dragon43pp/dsh-ops-skill/blob/main/docs/demo.md

I would value **fully redacted compatibility reports**: DSH version, deployment form, non-sensitive `dsh-doctor contract` output, expected behavior, and observed symptom. The goal is to learn which upgrade contracts drift in the real world—without turning a diagnostic tool into a privileged recovery wrapper.

discussions.title: [Bug] Web GUI cannot open very large sessions — session.history pages are unbounded by event count
discussions.body:
## Summary

`session.history` pages are bounded by message count only (`maxMessages`), so a
session with streamed, chunk-heavy turns produces a single page large enough to
make the Web client abort the request and fail to open the session.

## Reproduction

- Session: 51 turns, 247,267 persisted events, ~10.6 MB JSONL (zstd-compressed 5.2 MB).
- Opening it in the Web GUI fails with:
  `历史加载失败：The user aborted a request.（internal）`
- The default page (`maxMessages: 50`, `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts`
  `PAGE_MESSAGES = 50`) resolves to **65,878 events / ~12.9 MB of JSON**.
- The host serves it fine (~0.2 s), but the browser client's bounded unary timeout
  (`DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000` in `packages/client/connection/...`) aborts the fetch
  (or the tab freezes parsing/rendering tens of thousands of events), and the session
  cannot be opened.

## Proposed fix (server-side, transparent to clients)

Cap each history page by event count in addition to message count, in
`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` `paginate()`. The cut must stay on a
message boundary (the existing `groupStart` rule), so pages remain contiguous
ranges and the client's existing paging (`loadOlder`, `hasMore`) works unchanged.

```ts
/** Page size when history is called without maxMessages. */
const DEFAULT_MAX_MESSAGES = 50

/**
 * Hard cap on events per history page. Streamed turns append one event per
 * chunk, so a handful of messages can span tens of thousands of events — a
 * real 51-turn session produced a 65,878-event / ~13 MB tail page at the
 * default 50 messages, which the Web client aborts. The cut still lands on a
 * message boundary (groupStart), so pages stay contiguous and client paging
 * is unaffected.
 */
const MAX_PAGE_EVENTS = 20_000
```

In `paginate()`:

```ts
    if (count >= maxMessages) {
      cut = groupStart
      break
    }
    if (count >= 1 && window.length - i > MAX_PAGE_EVENTS) {
      cut = groupStart
      break
    }
```

## Notes

- `hasMore` / `beforeSeq` semantics are unchanged; only the page size shrinks for
  pathological sessions. Normal sessions still page by 50 messages.
- The client timeout does not need changing once pages are small; the abort is a
  symptom, not the cause.
- Suggested test (extend `packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-cold.spec.ts` or a new
  paginate spec): a session whose last few messages span > MAX_PAGE_EVENTS chunk events
  must return `hasMore: true` and a page ≤ cap + one message, with cuts on message groups.
- Workaround used in the meantime (user-side): patch the Web client bundle constants
  `maxMessages: 50 → 8` and the unary timeout `30s → 120s`.

---

中文摘要：历史分页只按"消息数"截断，流式会话一条消息可能含上万条 chunk 事件，
默认 50 条消息的一页实测达 65,878 个事件 / 约 13MB，浏览器客户端请求被超时中止
（报 `The user aborted a request`），会话打不开。建议在服务端 `paginate()` 增加
单页事件数上限（如 20,000），截断点仍落在消息边界，客户端分页逻辑无需改动。

discussions.title: Experiment: Cordis dynamic host halves under Hardened JavaScript (SES)
discussions.body:
Hi, I'm here after reading [A Programming Paradigm for Spatiotemporal Composability](https://github.com/cordiverse/paper/blob/main/paper.pdf). The core position resonates strongly: fine-grained, dynamic composability is necessary for self-evolving harnesses, and is worth its costs. It was also interesting to see how much object-capability discipline falls out of the coeffect lens, as the paper acknowledges.

I have some feedback on the sandboxing discussion that might be of interest, backed by a small experiment in the harness. I'm curious if you think it's a useful direction to explore further.

## Hardened JavaScript

The paper defers untrusted-component security to an external sandbox in §6.3:

> When a component's code cannot be trusted, language-level access control is insufficient, since a malicious component with access to the host runtime can reach the underlying objects directly, rendering such checks moot.

Section 6.7 sketches what it wants instead, assigning it to a co-designed operating system:

> Such an operating system can supply the sandbox that Section 6.3 defers to a mechanism outside the language. It does so by bounding a component to the dependencies it declares, supplying them when the component is loaded and leaving nothing else reachable from within it, as a WebAssembly module receives its imports from its embedder at instantiation.

That second description is pretty close to what a SES Compartment does, and it exists in the language the harness already uses: [Hardened JavaScript](https://hardenedjs.org/) (the [SES](https://github.com/endojs/endo/blob/master/packages/ses/README.md) shim: `lockdown()` plus `Compartment`).

§6.3's argument assumes untrusted code can reach the Host runtime's underlying objects; lockdown removes exactly that ambient reach for code evaluated in a Compartment. It might be best to think of it less as a sandbox and more as two guarantees: evaluated code can touch only what the Host makes reachable to it, and the shared intrinsics are frozen, so cross-component prototype pollution through those intrinsics is impossible.

## The experiment

I had an agent put together a quick POC that adds `ses` as an opt-in evaluator for the host halves of dynamic packages, alongside the default `vm` evaluator:

https://github.com/0xpatrickbot/deepseek-harness/tree/poc/cordis-host-ses

The POC demonstrates:

- Realm separation is not confinement: under the default VM evaluator, a direct write to a package's own `Array.prototype` stays local, but a constructor escape through an endowed host function reaches the host realm.
- A package can then mutate the Host `Array.prototype`, stop and undefine cleanly, and leave the mutation behind, observable through ordinary host arrays passed to later packages.
- SES rejects both the constructor escape and the shared-intrinsic mutation.
- The SES evaluator enters the existing guard and fiber lifecycle without changes to Cordis core, the Guard, or `cordis-dynamic`.

## Boundaries

- **Compatibility with the existing 4k+ plugin ecosystem.** Lockdown is process-global, so every co-loaded plugin must tolerate frozen intrinsics. _Most breakage in practice is the JavaScript override mistake (assignment to inherited properties on frozen prototypes), and the fixes are mechanical: `Object.defineProperty`/`Object.defineProperties` instead of assignment, the `overrideTaming` lockdown option, and vetted shims for legitimate global modification._ My read is that this cost is worth paying in the current agentic era.
- **Resource exhaustion.** The SES path shares the Host thread and heap. A spin loop or allocation burst can still take the process, so availability isolation needs a Worker or subprocess boundary either way.
- **Capability leakage.** The boundary is only as good as the capabilities the host supplies: endowments and later-passed references still need to be attenuated so they do not leak more powerful objects. The current context facade permits optional undeclared service lookup through `ctx.get()`, live services can convey authority beyond the top-level reference the guard sees, and Host-provided handler arguments remain mutable under both evaluators.


## Agent Report

> ### The experiment
> https://github.com/0xpatrickbot/deepseek-harness/tree/poc/cordis-host-ses
> 
> 
> The branch adds an experimental `experimentalHostEvaluator: "ses"` setting to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner`, alongside the default `"vm"`.
>
> Each dynamic package evaluates in a fresh named `Compartment`. Its Host endowments are the tagged console, `harness.defineTool`, `harness.registerTool`, `harness.handle`, `btoa`, `atob`, `TextEncoder`, and `TextDecoder`. The endowment graph is hardened before evaluation, and the validated Plugin surface is hardened afterward.
>
> Cordis core, the dynamic package format, the Guard, and the `cordis-dynamic` fiber lifecycle are unchanged.
>
> ### What was measured
>
> The final focused Host-runner suite passes 98 tests. Seven isolated subprocess cases cover five SES scenarios and two VM comparison scenarios. A separate built-artifact smoke runs an assembled `dsh --profile headless` process that defines, activates, calls, and stops an SES package.
>
> The SES scenarios exercise non-endowed Host globals, constructor escapes, frozen shared intrinsics and endowments, distinct package globals, Compartment-local `Function` and indirect `eval`, dependency parking and reactivation, Tool and handler ownership, timers, effects, activation rollback, stop, and failure cleanup.
>
> The VM/SES comparison found:
>
> | Channel | Default `vm` | `ses` |
> | --- | --- | --- |
> | package-realm `Array.prototype` mutation | Accepted, but package-scoped | Rejected |
> | Host-realm mutation through constructor escape | Accepted and survives unload | Rejected |
> | Mutation of Host-provided handler arguments | Accepted | Accepted |
>
> ### Why this bears on recovery
>
> The paper's recovery results are correctly scoped to the system boundary of §6.1: transformations represented in Γ can be tracked and recovered, while operations outside it are neither. Host-realm prototype mutation is therefore not a counterexample to the theorems.
>
> It is still a problem for their implementation. A Host half can mutate a Host intrinsic outside the inverse accumulator, then stop and undefine cleanly while the realm stays poisoned. The accumulated inverses, disposal closures, and lifecycle transitions continue to execute against intrinsics the departed component may have corrupted. Lockdown prevents that class of untracked mutation at the point where no inverse could repair it; in that sense it protects the substrate on which the recovery implementation relies.
>
> ### Compatibility differences
>
> Under the SES evaluator:
>
> - `Date.now()`, zero-argument `new Date()`, and `Math.random()` are disabled.
> - Non-endowed `require`, `fetch`, and timer globals are absent.
> - SES 2.3.0 rejects apparent `import(...)` and HTML-comment tokens anywhere in source, including strings and comments.
> - `Compartment.evaluate` has no synchronous timeout equivalent, so `vmTimeoutMs` is not applied.
>
> Lockdown is process-global and irreversible. Hardening the endowment graph also freezes the Host `TextEncoder` and `TextDecoder` constructors and prototypes process-wide.
>
> Static Plugins, Client code, and production containment are outside the experiment.
>
> ### Where it could go
>
> - **Make declarations determine reachability.** Today `inject` is obtained from the Plugin returned after evaluation, while Services arrive later through the guarded Context façade. The nearest step is to require every Service reached through that façade to be named in `inject`, removing undeclared optional `ctx.get()` access and auditing the reachable graphs of supplied Services. If `inject` moved into package metadata known before evaluation, the loader could use the same declaration for pre-evaluation policy.
> - **Add a Worker or subprocess boundary.** Eventual Send and CapTP provide relevant machinery for promise pipelining, pass-by-presence identity, and remote-reference management, but carrying the Cordis Context lifecycle across that boundary remains design work.
> - **Treat tamed clocks as a prerequisite for determinism.** Removing built-in time and randomness is not sufficient for deterministic replay; external Services, inputs, and scheduling must also be deterministic or logged. With those pieces, replay-based reconstitution after crash or upgrade could complement inverse-based removal.

discussions.title: 官方纯文本模型也能贴图（dsh-plugin-multimodal）
discussions.body:
官方线路是纯文本，Web 贴图会被拒：`当前模型不支持图片`。这个插件补的是**贴图准入**，不是视觉工具箱。

Official DeepSeek routes reject pasted images (`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`). This plugin lets the GUI accept the paste. It is not a `vision_*` toolbox.

对应需求：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/588

## 做什么

1. 主模型本身收图（Claude / GPT / 自建视觉网关）→ 原样把图交给模型
2. 主模型是纯文本（官方 DeepSeek）→ sidecar 转成文字再发给主模型
3. 磁盘截图用 `see_image`

Anionex/`dsh-vision-toolkit` 是另一条路：给 agent 一堆工具，要模型自己去调。本插件让**粘贴不被拒**。

## 安装

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
```

然后**重启** `dsh web`。旧会话的工具表不会更新。

## 配置

`DSH_VISION_MODEL` 必须是**真能看图**的模型，不要填 `deepseek-v4-flash` / `GLM-5.2-FP8`。

```
DSH_VISION_BASE_URL=https://api.example.com/v1
DSH_VISION_API_KEY=...
DSH_VISION_MODEL=glm-4.5v
```

## 30 秒验收

主模型仍用官方纯文本，配好 sidecar，在 Web 里贴一张报错截图，问「红字说了什么」。过关：不再弹「当前模型不支持图片」。

## 仓库 / WeChat

- Repo: https://github.com/shinjiyu/dsh-plugin-multimodal
- 微信群：deepseek harness 交流群（码大约到 2026-08-22）

discussions.title: dsh-movein-permissions · per tool deny/ask rules for DSH · 给 DSH 补上细粒度权限规则
discussions.body:
DSH ships three coarse permission presets, and the permission-presets README itself names the missing piece, there is no per tool allowlist. This plugin adds one.

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: cc-permissions
      name: 'dsh-movein-permissions'
      config:
        deny:
          - 'Bash(rm -rf:*)'
          - 'Read(*secrets*)'
          - 'mcp__github__delete_repo'
        ask:
          - 'Bash(git push:*)'
          - 'Write'
```

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-movein-permissions
```

It hooks the `tools/pre-execute` gate, deny returns a typed refusal to the model, ask forces a confirmation. Rule syntax is Claude Code's (prefix `:*`, `*` globs, exact `mcp__server__tool` names, which are identical in DSH anyway). `*` matches as a superset, over-denying is the safe direction for a gate. Deny beats ask.

Born inside [dsh-movein](https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein) (the Claude Code migration kit), but it works standalone, you write the rules by hand and never touch the migrator. If you DO come from Claude Code, `npx dsh-movein --apply` compiles your existing settings.json rules into this row automatically, with a diff report for anything that cannot map.

MIT, ~60 lines, zero dependencies. Rule shapes you wish it supported, tell me here.

---

DSH 只有三档粗粒度权限预设，官方 README 自己也承认没有按工具的 allowlist。这个插件补上：在 `tools/pre-execute` 强制执行 deny/ask 清单，规则语法与 Claude Code 相同，deny 优先于 ask，`*` 按超集匹配（宁可多拦）。不迁移也能单独用，从 Claude Code 过来的话 `npx dsh-movein --apply` 会自动把现有规则编译成配置行。想要什么规则形状，评论区说。

discussions.title: Docs suggestion: a "Migrating from Claude Code" guide (most of it is already free)
discussions.body:
A large share of the people trying DSH this week come from Claude Code, and the single most common question shape in discussions is some form of "how do I bring my setup over". The pleasant surprise is that DSH already did most of the work, CLAUDE.md is a default instruction candidate, SKILL.md loads as is, mcp__server__tool names are identical, and dsh-hooks-claude-code runs existing hooks configs unchanged. But none of that is discoverable in one place in the docs, people find it out by reading source or by accident.

Suggestion, a short "Migrating from Claude Code" page under docs/user/guide covering, per asset type, what is native, what needs one manual step, and what has no equivalent (sessions, slash commands, permission allowlists). Since external PRs are not accepted right now, offering research instead of a patch. We measured every asset type against the rc.6 source and published it as a compatibility matrix, feel free to lift any of it into official docs, no attribution needed:

https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/blob/main/docs/compat.md

Community tooling already covers the automatable parts (dsh-chat-import for conversation history, dsh-movein for config/skills/MCP/hooks), the docs gap is the map itself.

中文：建议在官方文档加一页「从 Claude Code 迁移」。DSH 其实已经原生消化了大半（CLAUDE.md 默认读取、SKILL.md 原样兼容、MCP 工具名一致、hooks 有官方桥），但这些散落在源码里，没有一处能看全。我们按 rc.6 源码逐项实测整理了对照表（上面链接，含中文摘要），官方文档随意取用，无需署名。

discussions.title: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「侧边任务」面板:主对话右侧开临时任务,用完即删、零残留
discussions.body:
# 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「侧边任务」面板：主对话右侧开临时任务，用完即删、零残留

用过 Codex 的朋友应该熟悉它的「侧边任务」交互：主任务跑着跑着，突然想查个东西、问个问题，又不想打断主对话——在右侧开一个临时任务，带着当前上下文问完就关，干净利落。

我们觉得这个交互对 DSH 很有价值，就用 DSH 自己的插件机制做了一个社区插件 **`ui-side-tasks`**。先说清楚：这是**受 Codex 交互启发的一个社区实现**（与 Codex 的原生侧边任务是不同的代码实现），但核心体验一致——**不打断主对话，临时任务用完即删**。

## 它长什么样

- 会话头部一个「侧边任务」按钮，点开右侧浮出任务面板（和主对话同屏）
- **新建任务 = 从当前会话 fork**，自动带上主会话的全部上下文——临时问个问题，不需要重新交代背景
- 面板里直接对话：发消息、看回复、停止，都不用切走主对话
- **用完即删、零残留**：删除任务 = 停掉它的 agent + 删掉它的日志 + 从工作区移除，磁盘上不留一点痕迹（这也是我们最看重的一点：临时任务就该是临时的）

## 顺手解决了什么

| 场景 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 主任务进行中，想查个资料 | 开新会话重新交代上下文，或打断主任务 | 侧边开个任务，带着上下文问完就删 |
| 想让模型同时做两件事 | 来回切换，思路被打断 | 主对话 + 侧边任务并行 |
| 验证完的临时会话 | 留在侧边栏占位置 | 一键删除，磁盘零残留 |

## 一些设计细节

- **不打扰主界面**：侧边任务 fork 后自动收纳，不会在你左侧的会话列表里堆积——它只活在面板里，用完即删
- **消息近实时跟随**：面板对话自动刷新，任务运行中的回复会自己出现，不用手动点
- **自动清理**：超过 1 小时没有活动的任务会被自动清理（打开面板时执行），临时任务不会变成陈年垃圾
- **实现基础**：完全基于 DSH 官方能力——fork 子会话、`prompt`/`cancel`、会话删除链路，插件本身不魔改内核

## 在哪里可以了解

- 这个插件来自 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev)（一个**非官方**社区，爱好者维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系）。我们日常用 DSH 干活，遇到痛点就做成插件，也收录在插件大全里。
- 想找更多 DSH 插件，可以逛逛我们的插件大全：它收录的是整个社区的 DSH 插件——社区作者发布的、我们自己做的、日常从生态里挖掘发现的，全部带 AI 中文总结 + AI 智能搜索（[https://mydsh.dev/plugins](https://mydsh.dev/plugins)）

评论区聊聊：你希望侧边任务还能做什么？或者去 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev) 反馈页告诉我们。

插件已开源：**[github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks](https://github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks)**（已加入官方 [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，可在生态里直接搜到）。安装很简单：`git clone` 后执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add <仓库路径>` 即可。

discussions.title: Streamed tool calls lose name/id against OpenAI-compatible servers that send explicit nulls (SGLang) — every call fails as UNKNOWN_TOOL
discussions.body:
### Summary

When the runtime streams from an OpenAI-compatible server that sends **explicit `null`s** in tool-call continuation chunks (SGLang does), the delta accumulator in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` wipes the already-captured tool name and call id on every argument fragment. Every tool call then reaches the tool layer with an empty name and fails as `ToolNotFoundError: unknown tool ""` — with fully intact arguments. This effectively breaks agentic tool use for anyone self-hosting DeepSeek-V4-Flash behind `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL`.

### Environment

- `deepseek-harness-sdk==0.1.0rc6` / `deepseek-harness-runtime-bin==0.1.0rc6` (Linux x64)
- `examples/jsonrpc-agent/minimal.cordis.yml` composition, per the Python SDK guide
- `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` → SGLang OpenAI-compatible endpoint (`0.0.0.dev1+g4ef1660cd`) serving `DeepSeek-V4-Flash`
- Repro prompt: any tool-using task ("read greeting.txt, create reply.txt …")

### Observed

Session JSONL, every tool call:

```json
{"turn": 1, "step": 1, "callId": "", "name": "", "arguments": "{\"command\": \"pwd && ls -la && cat greeting.txt ...\"}"}
{"error": {"name": "ToolNotFoundError", "code": "UNKNOWN_TOOL"}}
```

The model retries until the step budget runs out; the task never completes.

### Root cause

Captured wire chunks from SGLang for one bash call — first delta carries `id` + `function.name`, continuation deltas repeat the fields as **explicit `null`** (where the official DeepSeek API omits them):

```json
{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"id":"call_585b9e17c76f4bd591e549c5","index":0,"type":"function","function":{"name":"bash","arguments":""}}]}}
{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"id":null,"index":0,"type":"function","function":{"name":null,"arguments":"{"}}]}}
{"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"id":null,"index":0,"type":"function","function":{"name":null,"arguments":"\"command\": \"pwd\"}"}}]}}
```

`translate.ts` (master @ `47f9438`, lines 159–160) merges deltas with strict-undefined checks, so the explicit nulls overwrite the captured values:

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

After the last fragment, `callId` and `name` are `null`, and the tool dispatch sees `""`.

### Suggested fix

Treat null and undefined alike when merging continuation fields, per the OpenAI streaming convention that an absent-or-null field means "no change":

```ts
if (call.id != null) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name != null) block.name = call.function.name
```

(`block.name !== undefined` at line 167 has the same hazard once `name` has been assigned `null`.)

### Workaround

A proxy in front of the model server that drops null `id`/`type`/`function.name`/`function.arguments` keys from streamed `tool_calls` deltas restores correct behavior with no other changes — confirmed end-to-end with the same composition and model.

dsh plugin --profile web add github:shinjiyu/deepseek-harness-evolver

discussions.title: Composer: no way to configure Enter=newline / Cmd+Ctrl+Enter=send keymap (Enter always submits)
discussions.body:
## Problem

In the web composer, pressing **Enter always submits** the message, and there is **no way to configure the keymap**. The only way to insert a newline is `Shift+Enter`, and there is no setting to switch to the common ChatGPT-style keymap where:

- `Enter` inserts a newline, and
- `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` sends.

This is a usability gap for multi-line prompts (multi-paragraph context, structured instructions, code snippets), and it is especially painful for Chinese IME users where `Shift+Enter` is sometimes swallowed by the input method itself.

## Expected behavior

A configurable keymap, e.g. a General Settings row (like the existing "Enter behavior while busy" preference) or a `settings.yaml` field, with at least two options:

- `enter`: Enter sends, Shift+Enter inserts newline (current behavior)
- `cmd-enter`: Enter inserts newline, Cmd/Ctrl+Enter sends

## Where it lives

- Composer key handling: `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx` → `onKeyDown` (Enter block, ~lines 313–338). Plain Enter goes through `keyboard.arbitrate('enter', composing)`, then `preventDefault()` + `keyboard.submit(...)`; `Cmd/Ctrl+Enter` is already handled as the accelerated gesture.
- Submission policy: `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/submission-policy.ts` → `ComposerSubmissionPolicy.resolve()`.

## Implementation notes (for maintainers)

- Preserve command-menu arbitration: when a `/` or `@` trigger menu is open, Enter must still pick the highlighted item (`arbitrate` returns `consumed`/`pick-highlighted`); only a `pass` result should fall through to newline-vs-submit.
- Preserve the IME composition guard (`composingRef` / `isComposing` / keyCode 229).

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` (latest npm release), web GUI (`dsh web`).

discussions.title: New Session flow always requires a workspace — cannot start a plain conversation without one
discussions.body:
## Problem

There is no way to start a conversation **without a workspace**. Every entry point of the New Session flow first resolves a workspace target:

- The sidebar "New Session" button and the workspace browser's new-session actions all require a workspace.
- With no workspaces at all, `WorkspaceRuntime.startSession()` (`packages/client/runtime/src/client/workspaces/service.ts`, ~lines 177–192) just calls `this.sessions.clear()`, and the composer drops into the "Choose workspace" hero state (`workspaceTrigger` in `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx`) with no option to start a plain conversation.

## Current behavior vs. backend capability

The backend already supports workspace-less sessions:

- `session.create` accepts neither `workspaceId` nor `cwd` (both optional in the schema) and falls back to the host default cwd; the session is simply not attached to any workspace.
- The sidebar already renders sessions outside every workspace under an "Ungrouped" group (`groupByWorkspace` in `packages/client/ui-workspace`).

So only the client New Session flow blocks this use case.

## Expected behavior

Allow starting a conversation without choosing a workspace, e.g.:

- A "Start a conversation without a workspace" action in the "Choose workspace" hero, and/or
- `startSession()` falls back to creating an unattached session (`sessions.create({})` + `sessions.open(...)`) when no workspace target exists, which would land in the existing Ungrouped group.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` (latest npm release), web GUI (`dsh web`).

discussions.title: Agent shell execution ran `rm -rf` after a failed `&&` chain (`;` semantics) - no dry-run or guard, caused real data loss
discussions.body:
## What happened

While running a move command through the agent's Bash tool, the model issued:

```bash
mv cpp/build/model_a cpp/build/model_b . && ls && echo ... && for x in cpp/*; do mv "$x" .; done; rm -rf cpp/build cpp && ls
```

The first `mv` failed (one source path was wrong — the file lived elsewhere), so the whole `&&` chain was skipped. But the `;`-separated `rm -rf cpp/build cpp` still executed **unconditionally**, deleting the entire project source tree plus ~1.8 GB of training data in a single command. The attached screenshot shows the exact command and the aftermath.

The harness executes agent shell commands verbatim via `bash -c` with no simulation/parsing and no guard on destructive operations. One `;` vs `&&` mistake — by the model or by the human reviewing the command — turns a routine directory migration into permanent data loss.

## Suggested safeguards

1. **Dry-run / simulation before execution**: parse the command and report what it would touch (files and directories), especially for `rm -rf`, `mv` overwrites, `>` redirects, `dd`, `mkfs`.
2. **Destructive-command guard**: refuse or require explicit confirmation for commands containing `rm -rf` / `rm -fr` / overwriting `mv` — at minimum when they target the session workspace.
3. **Recycle instead of permanent delete**: intercept `rm` (or snapshot the workspace before each run) so deletions stay recoverable.
4. **Shell-semantics awareness**: flag `;` following a failing `&&` chain, or surface exit codes so a partially failed chain is obvious before the destructive tail runs.
5. **Workspace snapshots**: a cheap git-style snapshot before any Bash run would have made this incident recoverable in seconds.

## Impact in our case

- 19 source files, tests, tools, UI and a 1.8 GB dataset deleted irrecoverably from the disk (ext4 with `orphan_file` — no inode-based recovery was possible).
- Only the files moved out *before* the failing command survived.
- The source tree was eventually restored because an independent copy existed elsewhere.

Happy to provide more detail. Thanks for considering!

discussions.title: 双机实战：Windows 上跑 dsh headless + 跨机器编排（飞书集成 / 远程 GPU 任务）
discussions.body:
## 背景

我们是双机环境：Mac mini（M4，控制端）+ Windows 笔记本（RTX 5070，算力端）。在 Windows 上部署了 dsh v0.1.0-rc.6，把它当作跨机器 Agent 编排的中枢使用。分享实战结果，附一点对官方有价值的反馈。

## 我们做了什么

### 1. Windows 上的 headless 部署
- `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`（Node 22），`setx DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 持久化，`dsh --profile headless "任务"` 可正常跑。
- 已知限制：Windows 持久 PTY 受限，Python SDK 官方文档明确只支持 Linux x64 / arm64、macOS 14+ arm64（不支持 Windows）。

### 2. 跨机器编排（控制端 → 算力端）
- 两条通道：LAN SSH（192.168.1.x）+ 阿里云反向隧道（`ssh -R`，schtasks 保活，公网 relay）。
- 踩坑：算力端大负载时（GPU 推理 + Windows Defender 扫描），SSH 会话频繁超时；只能改用隧道 + 计划任务（schtasks）脱离会话后台跑。

### 3. 飞书（Lark）集成
- 事件流 `event consume` → daemon → 自动回复 + 定时调度器：定时触发 dsh headless 任务并把结果回传聊天。实现了"在哪边问就在哪边回"的机器人。

### 4. 远程 GPU 任务编排
- 从 Mac 侧编排 Windows 上的 IndexTTS-2.5（零样本 TTS）配音任务（短剧项目），dsh 作为统一任务入口。

## 做得好的地方

- **headless profile** 适合脚本化调用，退出行为可预期，适合 CI/任务队列。
- **模型无关**：接 DeepSeek 官方 API，也支持 OpenAI/Anthropic 兼容端点。
- **Web UI 默认 127.0.0.1:3080**，回环安全，可隧道访问。
- **"一切皆插件"** 的扩展点干净——我们自己按这个思路搭了飞书管道，官方生态里已有 `dsh-notify` 等同类插件。

## 附：调研报告结论摘要

我们整理了一份 dsh 深度调研（架构、四种运行模式、插件生态、V4 Pro 0813、定价、社区热度），核心结论：

- dsh 的"运行时级可组合"（Cordis 时空可组合 + 事件溯源 + append-only 日志）在 Agent 框架里是少见的路线，可观测性做到极致；
- 但工程成熟度尚早：v0.1 破坏性变更频繁、TypeScript 运行时性能不如 Rust 单体方案、无独立第三方基准（官方用未发布的极简模式跑自家模型，第一方口径）。

需要的话可以在评论区展开细节。

## 环境

- dsh v0.1.0-rc.6，Node 22，Windows 11（RTX 5070）+ macOS（M4）
- DeepSeek 官方 API + 本地 IndexTTS-2.5（GPU）

discussions.title: 功能建议：Windows 支持（Python SDK）+ 官方远程沙箱 provider + headless 异步化 + 官方飞书/钉钉插件
discussions.body:
## 背景

我们是双机环境（Mac mini 控制端 + Windows RTX 5070 算力端），用 dsh v0.1.0-rc.6 做跨机器 Agent 编排。实际使用中遇到几个痛点，按优先级列出建议：

## 建议 1：Windows 支持（Python SDK / 持久 PTY）

**痛点**：大量用户的"算力机"就是 Windows + NVIDIA（RTX 4070/5070 等），但 Python SDK 明确只支持 Linux x64 / arm64 与 macOS 14+ arm64（持久 PTY 需 POSIX 终端）。我们只能靠 headless CLI 兜底，无法在 Python 应用里嵌入 Agent 运行时来编排本地 GPU 任务（TTS / ComfyUI 等）。

**建议**：
- 支持 Windows：持久 PTY 可用 Windows 服务 / 命名管道 / WinRM 后端替代 POSIX PTY；
- 至少在 README 显著位置标注平台限制，避免用户装完才发现。

## 建议 2：官方远程沙箱 provider（控制端-执行端分离）

**痛点**：文档里的 Seam 概念（fs/process provider 可指向远程沙箱）正是我们想要的——控制端 dsh 驱动远程 Windows/Linux 盒子执行。目前只能靠 SSH 转发 + 计划任务拼凑，大负载下 SSH 会话还频繁超时。

**建议**：优先做一个官方 SSH 远程沙箱 provider，让 Bash / PTY / LSP 一起迁移到远程主机，避免每个用户自己实现一遍。

## 建议 3：headless 异步化（detach + 轮询）

**痛点**：长任务（GPU 推理动辄几分钟到几十分钟）需要脱离会话后台跑 + 轮询结果，而不是占着 SSH 会话。

**建议**：官方 job-queue / `--detach` 插件或 headless 的异步模式，任务完成回调（webhook / IM 通知）。

## 建议 4：官方飞书（Lark）/ 钉钉插件

**痛点**：我们自己 hack 了一套飞书事件管道（事件流 + daemon + 调度器）实现"IM 里发任务、Agent 回结果"。

**建议**：官方若出 Lark/Feishu、钉钉插件，能标准化"Agent 进 IM"的玩法（现有 `dsh-notify` 只覆盖单向通知，缺事件入口）。

## 环境

- dsh v0.1.0-rc.6，Node 22，Windows 11（RTX 5070）+ macOS（M4）

discussions.title: [Bug] 通过局域网 IP 访问 dsh web 时，/api/host.listDirectory 返回 HTTP 403
discussions.body:
**描述**

**环境信息**
- DSH 版本：`0.1.0-rc.6`（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）
- 服务端操作系统：Linux（服务器）
- 客户端浏览器：Windows（Edge/Chrome），通过局域网访问

**问题现象**

我在服务器上运行 `dsh web`，并尝试从同一局域网内的 Windows 设备通过浏览器访问 `http://<服务器IP>:3080`。页面可以正常加载，但在选择工作区时，`/api/host.listDirectory` 请求返回 `HTTP 403 Forbidden`。控制台报错：

```
transport failure for /api/host.listDirectory: HTTP 403
```

**预期行为**

在可信内网环境中，用户应能够通过服务器 IP 地址访问 DSH Web GUI 并正常使用所有功能（包括选择工作区、列出目录等）

**实际行为**

页面静态资源可正常加载，但所有涉及文件系统操作的 API 请求（如 `host.listDirectory`）均被拒绝，返回 403

---

**复现步骤**

1. 在 Linux 服务器上启动 DSH Web 服务：
   ```bash
   dsh web
   ```
   或
   ```bash
   dsh web --host 0.0.0.0
   ```
2. 在同一个局域网内的 Windows 设备上，通过浏览器访问 `http://<服务器IP>:3080`
3. 页面加载成功后，点击选择工作区
4. 观察浏览器开发者工具 Network 面板，可以看到 `/api/host.listDirectory` 请求返回 `HTTP 403 Forbidden`

---

**根因分析**

DSH 后端 API 有内置的安全中间件，会对请求的来源 IP 进行校验。只有来自 `127.0.0.1` 或 `localhost` 的请求才能通过，来自非本机 IP（包括局域网 IP）的请求会被直接拦截。

这与 `--host 0.0.0.0` 的限制是同一安全设计的不同表现——即使绕过了启动时的绑定限制，API 层的 IP 校验依然会阻止非本机访问。

---

**临时解决方案**

目前有两种可行的解决办法：

**方案一：SSH 端口转发（推荐，最安全）**

在 Windows 本地执行 SSH 隧道命令，将服务器的 3080 端口映射到本地：

```bash
ssh -L 3080:127.0.0.1:3080 用户名@服务器IP
```

然后在浏览器中访问 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 即可。此方式无需修改任何配置，全程加密，且不会触发 API 的 IP 校验。

**方案二：安装社区插件 `dsh-lan-access`**

在服务器上安装社区插件以解除 API 限制：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lan-access
```

安装后重启服务即可通过 `http://<服务器IP>:3080` 正常访问。

> 注意：该插件同时会注入 `crypto.randomUUID` polyfill，解决局域网 HTTP 环境下该 API 不可用导致的问题。

---

**建议的官方修复方向**

1. **提供官方的内网访问配置选项**：增加一个类似 `--allow-network` 或 `--trusted-hosts` 的启动参数，让用户在明确知晓安全风险的前提下，允许来自可信内网的访问。
2. **改进错误提示**：当前 403 错误没有任何诊断信息，用户难以定位问题根源。建议在返回 403 时附带更明确的提示，如 `"Access from non-loopback IP is blocked for security reasons"`。
3. **考虑将 `dsh-lan-access` 插件的功能纳入官方支持**：该插件已在社区得到验证，可考虑将其部分功能整合进官方版本。

---

**补充说明**

这个问题与 [#900](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/900) 中讨论的 `127.0.0.1` vs `localhost` 的 403 问题有相似的安全校验机制，但触发场景不同——#900 是本地访问时的 Host/Origin 比较问题，而本问题是明确的非本机 IP 访问被拦截

discussions.title: [Bug: Windows] postinstall emits DEP0190 when launching Lefthook through shell:true
discussions.body:
## Environment

- OS: Microsoft Windows 11 Pro 10.0.26200 (build 26200), x64
- Node.js: v24.18.0
- pnpm: 11.19.0
- Git: 2.53.0.windows.2
- Repository commit: `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`

## Reproduction

On an unmodified checkout at the commit above:

```powershell
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
node --throw-deprecation scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
```

The normal `postinstall` completes but prints `DEP0190`. The strict command exits with status 1.

## Actual behavior

On Windows, `runLefthook()` launches the `node_modules/.bin/lefthook.cmd` shim with `spawnSync(..., { shell: true })` while also passing `['install', '--force']`. Node.js 24 reports that combination as `DEP0190`; with `--throw-deprecation`, the installer terminates at `scripts/install-lefthook.mjs:560` before Lefthook runs.

## Expected behavior

The installer should run `lefthook install --force` without a command shell, emit no `DEP0190` warning, and preserve the existing worktree-local hook installation and rollback behavior.

## Root cause

The Windows-specific `.cmd` launch requires `shell: true`. Node then concatenates the separately supplied arguments into a shell command without escaping them, which is the deprecated and potentially unsafe pattern identified by `DEP0190`.

The installed `lefthook` package already declares a JavaScript bin entry (`bin/index.js`) that selects and launches its platform-native executable, so the package-manager shim is unnecessary here.

## Proposed patch

- Resolve `lefthookPackage.bin.lefthook` under `node_modules/lefthook`.
- Execute that JavaScript entry with `process.execPath` and the arguments `install --force`.
- Keep the filtered Git environment, working directory, inherited stdio, error aggregation, hook-path migration, locking, and rollback behavior unchanged.
- Update the integration fixture to expose only the package bin entry and add a regression that runs the installer with `NODE_OPTIONS=--throw-deprecation`.

The local patch changes only:

- `scripts/install-lefthook.mjs`
- `scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts`

## Verification

The regression was first run against the unmodified launcher and failed with status 1 and `DEP0190` at line 560. After the patch, these commands pass locally:

```powershell
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts -t 'runs Lefthook without shell argument interpolation' --reporter=verbose
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts --reporter=dot
node --throw-deprecation scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
pnpm exec tsx scripts/run-oxlint.ts scripts/install-lefthook.mjs scripts/install-lefthook.spec.ts
git diff --check
```

The complete focused suite reports 33 passed and 6 skipped tests on Windows. The strict real-installer run exits 0, synchronizes the hooks, and emits no `DEP0190` output.

discussions.title: 不会 npx 也能打开 DeepSeek Harness（easy-dsh）
discussions.body:
官方入口是：装 Node → `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` → 自己填密钥 → 自己选文件夹。10 万星里很多人卡在第一扇门。Windows 上还没有官方一键启动。

easy-dsh 只做**进门**。不是 Electron 桌面壳，也不是 dsh 插件。

The official path still assumes Node, `npx`, a key, and a workspace click. This tool only gets you into the first chat. It is not an Electron desktop, and not a `dsh plugin`.

对着：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/358 · https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/576 · https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/998

## 做什么

1. 没有 dsh 就装
2. 密钥贴一次，写进本机 `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`
3. 选文件夹后走官方 API：`workspace.create` + `session.create`（也绕开 #998 后台进程里「添加工作区」没反应）
4. 浏览器打开时，输入框已经能用

现有 [dsh-launcher](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-launcher) 假定你已经会用 `dsh plugin`，而且不支持 Windows。这个包反过来。

discussions.title: [Show and tell] dsh-diagnose: a symptom-diagnosis skill for DSH runtime internals
discussions.body:
**What it is**

`dsh-diagnose` is a skill for diagnosing DSH runtime issues by symptom. It maps 16 symptom families (llm retry storms, compaction thresholds, token metering, sandbox denials, approval policy, credentials resolution, tool registry gaps, agent-loop lifecycle, subagent depth, workflow script failures, jobs/web/approval/credentials internals, and more) to: mechanism chain → knowledge doc → check command → remediation advice.

**Why**

While operating DSH (and evolving a self-evolver preset on top of it), I read the source of the rc.6 packages (dsh-llm-retry, dsh-compaction-basic, dsh-token-meter, dsh-agent-loop, dsh-session, dsh-tools, dsh-fs, dsh-sandbox, dsh-user-approval, dsh-credentials-local, dsh-skill-filesystem, dsh-subagent, dsh-scope, etc.) and distilled the understanding into ~24 knowledge docs plus the skill. The skill is self-contained: the symptom table embeds mechanism chain, check command, and remediation, so any session can use it without extra tooling.

**Version anchoring (methodology worth sharing)**

Knowledge docs are anchored to a specific release (0.1.0-rc.6). A checker script (check-knowledge-anchors) verifies each anchor (package dir / symbol / constant) against the installed deployment on every session start, so knowledge fails loudly instead of going stale silently after an upgrade. Pure-symbol anchors get a "semantic drift" reminder for manual review.

**Try it / feedback**

Install: copy the `dsh-diagnose` skill directory into your skills root (`~/.agents/skills/`), then any DSH session can diagnose issues. Corrections welcome — the knowledge is written from source reading and is anchored to rc.6; after an upgrade, run the anchor check first.

Note: this is a local, community-side artifact, not an official DSH feature. If the maintainers find it useful, consider folding the diagnosis tables into official docs or a bundled skill.

discussions.title: [Bug] /api/commands/list 返回 404，命令菜单完全打不开
discussions.body:
**环境**：DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` · macOS · web profile（`dsh web` 默认部署）

**现象**：Web UI 的命令菜单无法使用——前端调用 `/api/commands/list` 得到 404，命令列表加载为空，菜单点不开。同时 `/api/dynamicCordisRunner/*`（syncInspectManifest / inventory）也全部 404，设置页插件相关 UI 报 `[cordis-client-runner] syncing inspect providers failed`。

**复现步骤**：
1. 正常启动 `dsh web`（常驻或手动均可）
2. 浏览器打开 Web UI，点命令菜单入口
3. 命令菜单无内容 / 点不开
4. 直接请求：`curl http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/commands/list` → `404`

**关键：全新实例同样复现**——用同一份配置另起一个实例（`dsh web --port 3180`），`/api/commands/list` 依然 404。排除插件/本地配置因素，属官方包行为。

**已排查（配置侧一切正常）**：
- `dsh-base`（0.1.0-rc.6）的 patch 中 `commands` entry 正常注册（`id: commands, name: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands`，无 disabled）
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-commands` 包 `exports["./typert"]` 声明正常（`./lib/typert.host.js`），manifest 含 `package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-commands, face: host`，schema 含 `commands/list`、`commands/execute`
- api-gateway 的 HTTP 映射规则（`endpointOf(namespace, method)` → `/api/<ns>/<method>`）路径正确
- 第三方插件注册的 RPC 端点工作正常 → api-gateway 本身在跑

**推测**：`dsh-commands` 的 TYPERT manifest 未被 typert-loader 注册进运行时（或注册了但 api-gateway 未挂载该 namespace），链路断在加载/注册阶段，非配置问题。需要官方排查 typert-loader 对 `dsh-commands` 的加载时序或激活条件。

**影响**：命令菜单（/ 命令、ui-commands）整体不可用；对 agent 开发者是核心交互入口缺失。同批 404 的 `dynamicCordisRunner` 影响设置页动态插件管理。

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-telegram-duty — your pocket duty office on Telegram
discussions.body:
I built **dsh-telegram-duty** — a Telegram gateway plugin that turns DeepSeek Harness into an always-on pocket duty office, with zero token cost while idle.

- 📱 **Task loop**: message a Telegram bot from your phone → a dedicated duty session (standard tool set) does the work → the final reply comes back to your phone.
- ✅ **Global approval forwarding**: in duty mode, approval requests from **all** sessions arrive on your phone as inline **[Approve] / [Reject]** buttons (typed replies also work); unanswered approvals time out to *rejected* (fail-closed).
- ❓ **telegram_ask tool**: agents push choice / confirmation questions to the phone with one button per option.
- 🔀 **Duty/local toggle**: any phone message or /away enters duty; any web message or /back returns to local — with a web duty banner showing the current state.
- 🗂 **Durable**: long-polling cursor persists across restarts; the first run fast-forwards the backlog.
- 🌐 **English & Chinese** messages; **direct connection by default** (proxy configurable for blocked networks).

Install: dsh plugin --profile web add @luzhengyangtx/dsh-telegram-duty

- Repo: https://github.com/luzhengyangtx/dsh-telegram-duty
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@luzhengyangtx/dsh-telegram-duty

Feedback and feature ideas are very welcome (there is also a Telegram user group linked in the README).

中文简介：把 DSH 变成手机上的值班室——Telegram 发消息即干活、审批转发到手机按钮应答、值守/本地一键切换、空闲零 token。

discussions.title: subagent-codex: expose Codex thread/start execution policy as deployment config
discussions.body:
## Problem

The stock Codex subagent provider hard-codes `thread/start` to
`{ cwd, ephemeral: true }` and exposes only `env` and `disposeGraceMs`.

Codex app-server's `ThreadStartParams` already accepts native execution-policy
fields — `approvalPolicy` (`AskForApproval`) and `sandbox` (`SandboxMode`) —
but the provider does not expose or forward them.

In unattended deployments where the host Codex configuration defaults to
`approval_policy = "on-request"`, Codex emits command/file approval requests for
workspace-allowed commands. The provider's unattended handling is fail-closed,
so those requests are declined and the run errors out. Today there is no
deployment-owned way to select `approvalPolicy = "never"` together with
`sandbox = "workspace-write"` without environment hacks or editing the
user-global Codex configuration.

## Proposal

Add an optional, deployment-owned config key to `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex`:

```ts
threadPolicy?: {
  approvalPolicy?: 'untrusted' | 'on-request' | 'never'
  sandbox?: 'read-only' | 'workspace-write' | 'danger-full-access'
}
```

- Closed enums mirror the Codex protocol vocabulary exactly.
- Conditionally merged into `thread/start` only when members are set; an
  unconfigured deployment keeps the current wire payload byte-identical.
- Invalid values fail plugin load (no silent fallback).
- The model and the task text cannot influence policy; it is provider config.

Explicitly out of scope: human approval forwarding, `approvalsReviewer`,
the `granular` approval object form, generic `config` passthrough, provider
forks, and any change to Codex itself.

## Maturity

A local proof-of-concept patch exists and is validated by provider unit and
contract tests, schema validation, backward-compatibility tests, typecheck,
and lint. No PR was pushed, respecting the current contribution policy; the
tested patch can be shared or adapted if the capability is useful.

## Questions

1. Would the project be open to exposing Codex `ThreadStartParams`
   `approvalPolicy` and `sandbox` as deployment-owned provider configuration?
2. If yes, what contribution path would maintainers prefer, given the
   repository currently does not accept external PRs?

discussions.title: 下游插件会话事件类型的注册面：append() 无法标 ignorable，未知类型连环炸
discussions.body:
## 场景

下游插件（如工作状态指示插件 dsh-working-activity）需要往会话日志里写 UI 状态帧：`session.append('activity/status', …)`。这类事件是纯 UI 临时帧——不进 surface、不进模型历史，回放时应当被跳过。

## 问题链

目前 `append()` 没有暴露 `ignorable` 标志，而 `activity/status` 不在 `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` 里。于是一个快照事件就让整个会话在严格读路径上全灭：

1. **resume 种子校验**：`assertEventsSupported` 抛 `unknown to this harness and not marked ignorable`，整个会话无法恢复；
2. **`persistence.load()`**：同样整个抛异常——调用方（如 TUI 的会话选择器）会退化到空列表/目录名兜底；
3. 任何第三方 UI/工具消费同一份日志都会踩到同一个坑。

## 源码里其实预留了口子

`known-event-types.ts` 的注释写着："a registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists"。消费者出现了——我们就是。:)

## 建议（二选一即可）

1. `registerSessionEventType(name)` 之类的显式注册 API；
2. 或者 `append(type, data, …)` 支持写时标记 `ignorable: true`。

另外提醒一个实现细节：运行时可能加载**多份** dsh-session 物理副本（CLI 树与 profile 插件树在版本错位的窗口期各有一份），严格校验器只查自己那份 Set——注册 API 如果只在模块级 Set 上操作，文档里值得提醒这一点。

## 我们的临时方案（供参考）

在插件加载时把类型注册进所有可达的 `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` 副本（多锚点 createRequire），读取侧另有一层 resume 前补 `ignorable` 标记的迁移逻辑。都已验证可行，但官方 API 才是正解。

- 写入侧注册：https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-working-activity/blob/main/packages/activity/working-activity/src/registration.ts
- 读取侧修复层：https://github.com/ccch1mneyyy/dsh-TUI/blob/main/src/compat/sessionLog.ts

discussions.title: 【社区反馈】Discussions 加群广告泛滥，请求官方处理
discussions.body:
## 现状

最近 Discussions 里**加群广告泛滥**，已经影响到正常使用了：

1. **群引流帖刷屏**：搜"交流群"能搜到 15+ 条帖子（#1718 / #1728 / #1431 / #1248 / #1282 / #1319 / #749 / #1205 / #710 / #1155 等），大量是低活跃度账号发的"扫码即进""官方企业微信群"类引流帖。
2. **评论区被广告跟评**：正常群帖发布后 20 分钟内就会被广告号评论（例如"加入产品迭代群，官方增强版本"+微信二维码），同一个广告还会**换号重复投放**（leenkcool、buptrolex-netizen 等账号在多个帖子重复发）。
3. **冒充官方的风险**："官方增强版本""官方企业微信群"这类话术容易误导新用户，把广告当成官方渠道。

## 影响

- 正常提问和分享被广告淹没，讨论区可读性严重下降；
- 广告混在真实内容里，新用户难以分辨真假官方；
- 群类帖子的评论区基本被广告污染，失去了交流价值。

## 建议

1. **清理**：删除现有广告帖和广告评论，对重复投放的账号采取封禁；
2. **门槛**：对新账号/低活跃账号的发布和评论设置限制（人工审核或冷却期），这是 GitHub 讨论区防广告的常见做法；
3. **官方渠道置顶**：如果有官方群/官方渠道，建议置顶说明，减少仿冒空间。

希望官方能处理一下，还讨论区一个干净的环境。@deepseek-ai

discussions.title: rc.6 Session.append 丢弃 ignorable 标记，插件审计事件导致会话恢复失败
discussions.body:
rc.6 的 `Session.append` 会丢弃调用方传入的 `ignorable: true` 标记，导致 out-of-repo 插件事件以无标记形式写入会话日志，恢复会话时抛出 `SessionFormatUnsupportedError`。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 插件调用 `session.append('myPlugin/audit', data, { ignorable: true })`；
  2. 检查 `session.jsonl[.zstd]` 中该事件 envelope 只有 `type`/`seq`/`time`/`data`，无 `ignorable`；
  3. 重启并恢复该会话 → `SessionFormatUnsupportedError: ... unknown to this harness and not marked ignorable`。
- 实际结果：任何自定义事件类型均无标记写入会话日志，恢复会话失败，只能删除会话日志。
- 预期结果：`options.ignorable === true` 时事件 envelope 带 `ignorable: true`（读侧 `assertEventsSupported` / `assertSessionEventEnvelope` 已支持该字段，仅写侧缺失）。
- 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence` `0.1.0-rc.6`；dsh-permission-rules 0.1.1。
- 验收条件：`Session.append(type, data, { ignorable: true })` 后事件持久化含 `ignorable: true`；恢复含此类事件的会话不再报错。

</details>

discussions.title: DSH Marketplace - an open-source plugin registry + storefront
discussions.body:
## 馃洅 DSH Marketplace 鈥?a self-hostable plugin registry + storefront

[![GitHub](https://img.shields.io/github/stars/ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace)](https://github.com/ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace)
[**Live demo**](https://ydhrdh.github.io/dsh-marketplace/) 路 [**Source**](https://github.com/ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace)

Since *everything in DSH is a plugin*, I built a small open-source **marketplace** so the community can browse, search, and install DSH plugins with one copy-paste command.

### What it does

- **Static, auditable registry** 鈥?each plugin is one tiny JSON file under `registry/plugins/<id>/plugin.json`, reviewed through a normal GitHub PR. No database, no server, Git history is the audit log.
- **Real `dsh` install commands** 鈥?every plugin card generates the exact command with your profile choice (`web`, `headless`, custom):
  ```bash
  dsh plugin --profile web add <spec>
  ```
  Supports all DSH install sources: **npm packages**, **Git-hosted plugins** (`github:owner/repo`), and local paths.
- **Search & 8 categories** 鈥?instant client-side search over names, descriptions, tags, and maintainers; filters for Skills, Tools, Web, Infrastructure, Integration, Workflow, Experimental, etc.
- **Trust badges** 鈥?`verified` (maintainer-reviewed) and `deprecated` flags, so users can tell curated entries from early ones.
- **Web UI quirks covered** 鈥?the git install hint surfaces DSH's `allowBuilds`/pin-sha guidance, mirroring the official publish docs.

### Stack

Pure static **Vite + React** frontend (no backend framework), JSON Schema validation + index builder in `scripts/`, GitHub Actions for **PR validation, build, and GitHub Pages deploy**. Zero-cost self-hosting: `npm run build && host web/dist`.

### Try it

- **Online**: https://ydhrdh.github.io/dsh-marketplace/
- **Repo**: https://github.com/ydhrdh/dsh-marketplace
