discussions.body:
# AI 编写的 DSH 插件为什么容易出问题？—— 风险综述与防御实践

> **适用版本**：DeepSeek Harness `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6`（2026-08-15）
> **作者**：@XJungit
> **类型**：经验分享 / 讨论（非官方文档）
> **说明**：DSH 仍处于 developer preview，核心插件与 API 会快速演进，文中的约定以当前 rc.6 为准，失效时欢迎指正。本文为@XJungit 的个人经验分享，非 DeepSeek 官方内容；文中引用的讨论、文章均为第三方观点，仅供参考。

---

## 摘要

DeepSeek Harness 的定位是"一切皆插件"，并且插件**主要不是给社区 review 的成品，而是给 AI 现场生成、自用的**。这带来了一个结构性风险：**Cordis 插件跑在同一个进程里、共享 context 与工具注册表、没有运行时隔离——一个 AI 写的插件只要犯一个小错，轻则插件不生效，重则拖垮整个 DSH。**

本文第一部分汇总社区里的真实证据（GitHub Discussions / Hacker News / Reddit / 中文社区），说明"AI 写的 DSH 插件质量差、容易导致崩溃"不是个别现象，而是有架构根因的普遍问题；第二部分给出作者在 omdp 仓库（dsh-connector / dsh-vision-bridge 两个插件的实际落地）验证过的防御实践，希望能帮大家少踩坑。

---

## 一、问题：插件为什么"跑着跑着就出问题"

如果你用 AI 写过 DSH（Cordis）插件，大概经历过这些：

- 插件装上后**一直 pending，不生效**，日志里是 `waiting for services: ...`
- 运行时报 `cannot get property "xxx" without inject`
- 启动时 `Cannot find package ...` 直接 **`dsh web` 起不来**
- 插件之间**互相覆盖 / 撞名**，行为变得不可预测

这些不是个例。它们的共同根源，是 DSH 的插件架构本身。

---

## 二、架构根因：单进程、共享注册表、无隔离

来自官方仓库的讨论 [Discussion #326 — Thoughts on "Everything is a Plugin" — the user-side cost](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/326)，作者 @phinn 分析了 DSH 的 49 个包依赖图后指出：

> **"Cordis plugins share one process, one context object, one tool registry."**
> （Cordis 插件共享一个进程、一个 context 对象、一个工具注册表。）

他还对比了 Webpack loaders："那些平台花了多年时间建立**运行时隔离**，Cordis 没有。"

**这意味着什么：**

| 风险 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| 一个插件抛未捕获异常 | 可能波及整个进程，影响所有会话 |
| 两个插件注册同名服务 / 工具 / section | 互相覆盖或 `fail loud`，行为不可预测 |
| 插件声明了错误的 `inject` | 自己 pending 不生效，甚至阻塞启动 |
| 插件依赖的原生二进制装错平台 | loader 同步导入失败，**整个 `dsh web` 启动即崩** |

而 Hacker News 上关于 DSH 的讨论（[DeepSeek Harness developer preview](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49285244)）更是点破了设计定位：

> "This is not for community plugins, **it's for AI generated plugins**. If everything is a plugin it means plugins can do everything. AI can write custom plugins for you."

翻译过来就是：**DSH 的插件是给 AI 生成、给自己用的，没有社区 review 这道质量闸门。** 所以"AI 写的插件质量差"是设计使然，不是偶然现象。

---

## 三、社区证据：这不是个别现象

### 3.1 官方 GitHub Discussions

**① [Discussion #380 — 写第一个 dsh 插件踩的六个坑（0.1.0-rc.6 本机复核）](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/380)**

作者（做 dsh-superpowers，把 Superpowers 方法论搬进 DSH）用 AI 辅助开发，踩了 6 个坑，几乎全是"AI 写插件"高频翻车点：

- **坑 1：import 路径解析失败**。dev 链接下 Node 走软链接的真实路径，`createRequire` 找不到 `@deepseek-ai/*` → `MODULE_NOT_FOUND`。
- **坑 2：`inject` 写成对象**。`{ required: [...], optional: [...] }` 会被 Cordis 当成"我要 required 和 optional 这两个服务"，插件永远 pending，启动卡住。
- **坑 3：`inject` 数组 vs 对象的语义混淆**。数组每一项是服务名；对象走 `Object.keys()`，是拦截配置，别混用。
- **坑 4-6**：section 命名冲突、host/preset 分层、npm 发布（国内镜像只读、OTP 2FA）。

作者的最终结论非常关键：

> "我最后让插件不 import 任何 `@deepseek-ai/`，只留 node 内置模块，要什么都从 `ctx` 上拿。"

**② [Discussion #535 — npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 报错](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/535)**

插件依赖导致**整个 DSH 启动即崩**的实证：
- `attachment` 插件：`sharp` 原生二进制加载失败（win32-x64 不匹配）
- `subprocess` 插件：`node-pty` 找不到（`Cannot find package ...`）

因为 **DSH 的 loader 在启动时同步导入所有 bundle 的 loader entry**，任何一个含原生依赖的插件装错平台，整个 `dsh web` 直接抛错起不来，而不是降级跳过。

**③ [Discussion #758 — Windows sandbox (workspace-write) 崩溃 + 4 related issues](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/758)**

虽然不是插件问题，但同属"早期框架隐蔽坑"：沙箱临时目录清理后不自愈、ConstrainedLanguage 噪音、WMI 查询被拒、UAC 静默失败。作者本人在 Windows 上也踩过 BUG-1（`windows-acl-run: --temp is not an existing directory`），说明这类运行时脆弱性是真实普遍的。

**④ 其他运行时隐藏问题**
- [Discussion #483 — force-kill 后 write-behind 丢失未刷新尾部](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/483)
- [Discussion #712 — Python SDK 会话恢复 id 冲突](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/712)

### 3.2 英文社区

- **Hacker News**（同上）：确认"插件给 AI 生成"的定位；也有人指出插件生态的普遍宿命——"插件通常因唯一维护者失去兴趣而死"。
- **Reddit**（[r/DeepSeek — Harness and tools for deepseek](https://www.reddit.com/r/DeepSeek/comments/1ug8ecg/harness_and_tools_for_deepseek)）："it was breaking very often where it got stuck, **so much badly written code**"——直接吐槽经常卡死、大量写得烂的代码。

### 3.3 中文社区 / 第三方评测

- **[5toy — DeepSeek Harness 测试反馈两极分化](https://5toy.com/s/13814)**：
  - liustack（modlens 视觉插件作者）：多模态支持**硬编码、没给第三方完整接口**，只能"注册特殊模型变体绕过"，评价"太早期，很不完善"。
  - Bohu：eval 发现策略 bug——dsh 要求调查每个非零 exit code，但 `grep` 无匹配也返回 1 → 误判失败 → **自我强化验证循环**（同任务请求数 61 vs 32、成本 $0.17 vs $0.05、token 290万 vs 54.8万）。
  - 结论："更适合开发者测试、拆解和做插件，**不适合直接交给生产环境跑关键业务**。"
- **[掘金 — 给 DSH 加一双"眼睛"：图片识别插件踩坑实录](https://juejin.cn/post/7673655608423235634)**：与视觉插件同类的实现与踩坑过程。
- **[博客园 — 插件开发实战：从设计理念到 npm 发布](https://www.cnblogs.com/pc2005/p/22477987)**：含 npm 发布流程（印证 #380 的发布坑）。

---

## 四、AI 写插件的高频雷点清单（含真实报错）

以下是社区证据 + 作者实测汇总的、AI 写 DSH 插件最容易犯的错：

| # | 雷点 | 典型表现 / 报错 |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | `inject` 写成对象（`{required, optional}`） | `1 entry did not activate my-plugin: pending (waiting for services: required, optional)` |
| 2 | 访问未注入的服务 | `cannot get property "credentials" without inject`（Cordis 的 Proxy 在 get 时直接抛，`?.` 救不了） |
| 3 | import `@deepseek-ai/*` 在 dev 链接下解析失败 | `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` |
| 4 | 依赖原生二进制（sharp / node-pty 等） | `dsh web` 启动即崩：`Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime` / `Cannot find package ... node-pty` |
| 5 | 注册同名服务 / 工具 / section | fail loud 或互相覆盖，行为不可预测 |
| 6 | 未捕获异常 | 单进程无隔离，可能波及整个 harness |
| 7 | 工具 `parameters` 用 DSH per-property map | OpenAI 兼容 provider 报 `schema must be a JSON Schema of 'type: "object"', got 'type: null'`（HTTP 400） |
| 8 | 依赖 rc 期的接口细节 | API 快速演进，AI 学的旧写法很快失效 |

> 其中第 7 条是作者在 dsh-vision-bridge 上**实测踩过**的：`ctx.tools.register`（已安装 bundle 路径）会把 `parameters` 原样转发给 provider，per-property map（顶层无 `type`）到了 provider 手里变成 `type: null` 被拒。必须写完整的 JSON Schema（`{ type: 'object', properties: {...} }`）。

---

## 五、防御实践：如何写出"不崩"的 DSH 插件

### 5.1 三条核心原则

1. **纯 JavaScript / 零构建**：避免 TS 编译产物缺失、避免原生二进制（sharp / node-pty 类），从根上避开 #535 那类启动崩溃。
2. **零运行时依赖**：插件只 import Node 内置模块，要任何能力都从 `ctx` 上拿（社区共识，见 #380）。
3. **`inject` 显式声明 + 一维字符串数组**：需要什么服务就明确声明什么，别靠 `?.` 兜底。

### 5.2 `inject` 正确写法

```js
// ✅ 正确：一维字符串数组
export const inject = ['tools', 'agents', 'attachments', 'llm', 'credentials']

// ❌ 错误：对象写法会被当成两个"服务名"
export const inject = { required: ['systemPrompt'], optional: ['skills'] }
```

### 5.3 服务访问的正确姿势

Cordis 对未注入服务的访问会在 `get` 时**直接抛错**（Proxy 实现），所以：

```js
// ❌ 这样写没用：错误在访问 ctx.credentials 时就抛了
const cred = await ctx.credentials?.resolve?.(ref)

// ✅ 先在 inject 里声明 'credentials'，再访问
export const inject = ['credentials']
// apply(ctx) 里：
const cred = await ctx.credentials.resolve(ref)
```

### 5.4 工具注册的正确姿势（JSON Schema）

`ctx.tools.register`（已安装 bundle 路径）会把 `parameters` **原样转发**给 OpenAI 兼容 provider，所以必须是完整的 JSON Schema：

```js
ctx.tools.register({
  name: 'my_tool',
  description: '...',
  parameters: {
    type: 'object',
    properties: {
      path: { type: 'string', description: '...' },
      verbose: { type: 'boolean', description: '...' },
    },
    additionalProperties: false,
  },
  // ...
})
```

> 动态插件 `defineTool` 才用 per-property 的 `ParameterSchemaSpec` 写法；`ctx.tools.register` 这条路不适用。

### 5.5 错误处理与边界

- 关键调用包 `try/catch`，失败降级为可读的文本/错误信息，而不是抛到顶层。
- 注册前查重：工具名、服务名、section 名尽量带插件自己的前缀，避免撞名。
- 对"同名已存在"做 fallback（例如工具名被占用时换一个备用名注册），而不是让注册直接失败。

### 5.6 本地开发与验证流程

1. **本地 `link:` 安装**（`"@omdp/xxx": "link:D:/path"` + `pnpm install`），改完重启 DSH 即生效，避免每次远程拉取。
2. **小步验证**：先 `dsh --profile xxx --dump-config` 看 patch 层是否正确加载，再起一个最小会话测工具。
3. 用 `node --check` 做语法校验，`import` 后做 smoke test（确认模块能加载、导出函数存在）。

### 5.7 发布注意

- GitHub 远程安装会遇到 **pnpm ≥10 的构建脚本拦截**：首次 `dsh plugin add github:...` 会失败，需在 profile 的 `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 加：
  ```yaml
  allowBuilds:
    '@omdp/xxx': true
  ```
- 纯 JS 插件无需 `prepare` 脚本，`allowBuilds` 是唯一门槛。
- 若发 npm，注意国内镜像只读、`npm publish` 只认 `--otp`（见 #380）。

---

## 六、作者实践：omdp 仓库怎么做的

作者维护的 [omdp](https://github.com/XJungit/omdp) monorepo 里有两个插件，完全按上面的原则落地：

- **`@omdp/dsh-connector`**：MCP + Skills 管理插件。纯 JS、仅依赖 `yaml`；写 `cordis.patch.yml` 前做完整校验（transport/serverName/url/command），并原子写入，保证"坏配置到不了下次启动"。
- **`@omdp/dsh-vision-bridge`**：视觉桥插件（给文本模型加"眼睛"）。**零依赖**、只 import Node 内置模块；工具 `parameters` 用完整 JSON Schema（修掉了 `type: null` 400）；`inject` 显式声明（修掉了 `cannot get property "credentials" without inject`）；工具重名做 fallback；粘贴路由做 magic-byte 校验 + 25MB 上限 + TTL 清理。

这些修复过程本身就是"AI 写插件踩坑"的活案例——建议直接参考仓库里的实现。

---

## 七、开放讨论（欢迎社区参与）

1. **DSH 是否需要为第三方插件提供某种隔离/沙箱？** 现在单进程共享 context，一个插件崩可能拖垮整个 harness。未来会不会有进程级隔离或插件级错误域？
2. **"插件主要给 AI 生成"这个定位，是否意味着官方应该提供更好的插件校验/调试工具？** 比如 `--dump-config` 之外，能不能有"插件体检"工具，提前暴露 inject 错误、服务缺失、schema 问题？
3. **社区需要一份"AI 写 DSH 插件安全清单"吗？** 如果大家觉得有用，可以一起维护一份，减少重复踩坑。

---

## 附录：来源链接

**GitHub Discussions（官方仓库）**
- [#380 写第一个 dsh 插件踩的六个坑](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/380)
- [#326 "Everything is a Plugin" — the user-side cost](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/326)
- [#535 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 报错](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/535)
- [#758 Windows sandbox 崩溃 + 4 related issues](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/758)
- [#483 force-kill 后输入丢失](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/483)
- [#712 Python SDK 会话恢复 id 冲突](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/712)

**英文社区**
- [Hacker News — DeepSeek Harness developer preview](https://news.ycombinator.com/item?id=49285244)
- [Reddit — Harness and tools for deepseek](https://www.reddit.com/r/DeepSeek/comments/1ug8ecg/harness_and_tools_for_deepseek)

**中文社区 / 第三方**
- [5toy — DeepSeek Harness 测试反馈两极分化](https://5toy.com/s/13814)
- [掘金 — 给 DSH 加一双"眼睛"：图片识别插件踩坑实录](https://juejin.cn/post/7673655608423235634)
- [博客园 — 插件开发实战：从设计理念到 npm 发布](https://www.cnblogs.com/pc2005/p/22477987)

---

*本文为社区公开讨论的整理与作者实测的归纳，观点归属原作者；DSH 仍处 developer preview，接口与行为会变，请以最新官方文档为准。*

discussions.title: dsh-vision — give your DeepSeek Harness agents eyes (analyze_image + send-image button)
discussions.body:
# 📸 dsh-vision — Give your DeepSeek Harness agents eyes

> **dsh-vision** gives your DeepSeek Harness agents the ability to "see" images — even when your default model doesn't accept image inputs. It registers an `analyze_image` tool that sends local images (or image URLs) to **any OpenAI-compatible vision model you configure** (OpenAI, Qwen-VL, GLM-4V, SiliconFlow, local vLLM/Ollama, etc.) and returns the model's text description back into the conversation.

**Repo:** [yyking12/dsh-vision](https://github.com/yyking12/dsh-vision) · **Plugin package:** `dsh-tool-vision`

## What it does

DeepSeek Harness' default models usually **don't accept image inputs** — the host rejects messages with `image` blocks. This plugin solves that through three paths:

1. **`analyze_image` tool** — tells the agent to call it whenever the user mentions an image; the plugin sends the image to *your* configured vision model (OpenAI-compatible API) and brings the text description back into the conversation.
2. **📤 Send-image button + paste/drag** — pick an image in the composer / Ctrl+V paste / drag & drop, automatically uploaded as a conversation attachment with a plain-text marker (`🖼️ 图片附件: <id>`) inserted into the input box — no `image` block in the message, so non-multimodal models can still "see" images.
3. **Three image sources** — local file paths, http(s) URLs, or conversation image attachments (attachment_id).

## Features (v0.6.0)

- 🔌 **Provider-agnostic**: only relies on `baseURL` + `model` + `apiKey` — presets for OpenAI, Alibaba DashScope, SiliconFlow, Zhipu AI, local Ollama, plus arbitrary custom endpoints (vLLM / Xinference / Moonshot / MiniMax...)
- 🖥️ **GUI settings page** (Settings → Image Understanding): visual provider/endpoint/model/key config, one-click connection test
- 🔁 **Result caching**: same image + prompt + model + endpoint only calls the API once (LRU, default 64 entries)
- ⚡ **Auto-retry** with exponential backoff for 429/5xx, honoring `Retry-After`
- 🎚️ **detail control**: `auto` / `low` / `high` (high for OCR/small text)
- 🛡️ **Safe by design**: API key only in the `Authorization` header, images go base64 straight to *your* endpoint, tool results return only text descriptions

## Quick start

```bash
# 1. Add to the web profile
DSH_HOME=~/.dsh dsh plugin --profile web add <path-to-this-package>

# 2. Make sure cordis.patch.yml has the enable entry
#    - insert:
#        - id: vision
#          name: dsh-tool-vision

# 3. Restart dsh web
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

**Configure your vision provider** (any one of):

```bash
# Env vars (simplest)
export VISION_API_KEY="sk-xxx"
export VISION_BASE_URL="https://api.openai.com/v1"
export VISION_MODEL="gpt-4o-mini"
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Or use the GUI settings page, or add to `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml` (`VISION_API_KEY: sk-xxx`), or patch config in `cordis.patch.yml`.

**Use it:**

> 看一下 `C:\Users\me\Pictures\截图.png`，里面写了什么？

The agent will automatically call `analyze_image` and bring the description back into the conversation. Works with local paths and URLs:

> 分析 `screenshots/bug.png`，重点看报错信息。

## Debugging

```bash
VISION_API_KEY=sk-xxx VISION_MODEL=qwen-vl-max node plugins/dsh-tool-vision/scripts/vision.mjs 图片.png "图片里有什么？"
```

Supported formats: png / jpg / jpeg / gif / webp / bmp (single image up to 20 MiB by default).

If this plugin helps you, a ☕ coffee is welcome — details in the repo. Happy building! 🚀

discussions.title: `tokenUsage` projection never folds `compaction/summary.usage`, and replaces rather than adds across a retried step
discussions.body:
Two gaps in `token-meter`'s `tokenUsage` projection, found while measuring session logs from a probe corpus. Both are in the projection itself, so plugins that do the recommended thing (read `ctx.sessionProjections.tokenUsage` instead of folding the log themselves) inherit them.

Measured on 4 sessions, 8,650 events, 78 usage samples, two providers (MiniMax-M3 over `minimax-cn`, and `qwen2.5:14b` over a local OpenAI-completions endpoint).

## 1. Compaction cost is never counted

`compaction/summary.usage` carries the provider-reported cost of the summarize call. It is typed in `packages/compaction/compaction/src/types.ts` ("Provider-reported token usage for the summarization request, when emitted") and written at `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts:447`.

`usageOf()` in `packages/llm/token-meter/src/usage-projection.ts` matches only `assistant/chunk` (usage) and `assistant/message`. The summarize call is not a loop step, so it produces neither. The event is never folded.

**Measured:** 3 compaction events, **48,895 tokens**, none counted. The largest was a single MiniMax-M3 summarize call reporting 536 input / 2,436 output / 41,472 cache-read = 44,444 tokens, against a `shadowedTokenCount` of 19,962 for the range it replaced.

Whether that trade is worth it depends on cache pricing, and I have no opinion on it. The issue is that a user reading any usage surface built on this projection cannot see that the call happened at all — and compaction fires more often precisely on the long sessions where budgets matter.

**Suggested fix:** extend `usageOf()` to match `compaction/summary` and return `event.data.usage`. The `(turn, step)` replacement logic does not apply (a summary is not a loop step), so it wants a plain add. `usage?` is optional, so an absent value stays absent rather than becoming zero.

## 2. A retried step's earlier attempt is replaced, not added

`apply()` replaces on a repeated `(turn, step)` via `addReplacing` (lines 126-136). That is correct for the two-sample case D-1 documents: a usage chunk followed by the assembled message reporting the same numbers.

It is not correct across a retry. Observed sequence in one session:

```
seq 3203  assistant/chunk   usage  {"inputTokens":0,"outputTokens":0}
seq 3204  assistant/chunk   finish {kind:'error', failure:{code:'TRANSPORT'}}
seq 3205  llm/retry                retryId=afabacf1 provider=minimax-cn
seq 3206  llm/retry-started        retry=1
…                                  the response streams again from block-start
seq 3279  assistant/chunk   usage  {"inputTokens":32,"outputTokens":1042,"cacheReadTokens":10368}
seq 3281  assistant/message usage  {"inputTokens":32,"outputTokens":1042,"cacheReadTokens":10368}
```

Three usage samples under one `(turn, step)`, and one more retry would make four. The two attempts are separate costs, not duplicate reports of one cost, but they share a key and `apply()` has no way to tell them apart — `llm/retry` is not in its match list.

The failed attempt reported zeros here, so nothing was actually lost in this corpus and **I am claiming no number for the undercount**. The mechanism is what I am reporting. A provider that reports real usage before a transport failure would have that cost silently dropped.

The token-meter README says "Usage chunks are counted even when a request later fails", which holds when the failed step produces no message. It stops holding when a retry succeeds under the same key.

**Two things this also affects:** the group-size assumption (a `(turn, step)` can carry k>2 samples) and keep-first implementations, which report such a step as costing zero — 10,368 cache reads in the case above.

`llm/retry` / `llm/retry-started` carry a `retryId` and sit between attempts, so the discriminator already exists in the log.

## What is already right

Worth stating, because it is why these two stood out. Append-only with dense contiguous `seq` removes the whole class of drift that comes from in-place transcript rewriting. Terminal-only usage (`types.ts:291`: "Adapters emit usage before the terminal finish and nothing afterward") removes partial-snapshot summing. Sibling child sessions with `parentSession` + `seedLength`, and telemetry that says to stitch on that pair, is the right shape. `addReplacing` for the ordinary two-sample case is correct, and its existence is what told me the double-write hazard was real rather than theoretical.

## Reproducing

Stdlib-only Python, no dependencies, no vendor account:

```bash
python3 dsh_usage_probe.py --self-test        # folds vs a hand-computed fixture
python3 dsh_usage_probe.py --root <sessions>  # four folds over a real corpus
```

It folds a corpus four ways (naive, a line-for-line transcription of `tokenUsageProjectionDefinition`, seed-aware, and corrected) and prints the deltas plus the `(turn, step)` group-size distribution. `--self-test` asserts every fold against constructed ground truth before it touches real data.

Corpus written with `compression: 'none'` and `packChunks: false` so the log is line-readable.

Probe, protocol, and the full invariant catalog: https://github.com/lizhuojunx86/traceguard/blob/main/usage-tracker-audit/dsh-probe/README.md

I understand external PRs aren't being accepted right now. Happy to supply a regression fixture in whatever form is useful, or just leave the measurements here.

---

**中文摘要**

两处都在 `token-meter` 的 `tokenUsage` 投影里，所以按推荐做法读 `sessionProjections.tokenUsage` 的插件全都会继承。

一、`compaction/summary.usage` 从不被折叠。`usageOf()` 只匹配 `assistant/chunk` 和 `assistant/message`，而摘要调用不是 loop step。实测 3 次 compaction、48,895 token 全部未计入，其中一次 MiniMax-M3 摘要调用报了 44,444 token（含 41,472 cacheRead），换掉的历史 `shadowedTokenCount` 是 19,962。建议 `usageOf()` 增加 `compaction/summary` 分支，按相加而非 `(turn, step)` 替换处理。

二、同一 `(turn, step)` 下的重试尝试被替换而非相加。流传输失败后 harness 在同一 key 下重试，两次尝试是两笔独立成本，但 `apply()` 看不到 `llm/retry`，无从区分。本语料中失败尝试报的是全零，**所以我没有漏计的数字**，报告的是机制本身。附带两个影响：一个 step 的样本数可以大于 2；keep-first 实现会把这一步报成零成本（上例中丢掉 10,368 个 cacheRead）。

复现脚本纯标准库、无依赖、无需任何厂商账号，`--self-test` 会先用手算真值校验四种折叠再碰真实数据。

discussions.title: 白嫖苹果 Vision！让 DeepSeek 在 Mac 本地看懂图片，免费 安全 极速
discussions.body:
## 插件介绍：@niyongsheng/free-vision-skill

DeepSeek Harness 公开发布没几天，插件生态还是空白一片 —— 正好，我补了一块拼图：**让 Agent 直接在本地"看"图**。四个关键词总结这个插件：

- **本地**：macOS Vision Framework 推理，不走任何云端模型
- **免费**：不烧 token、不付 API 费，纯白嫖苹果的能力
- **安全**：图片永不离开你的 Mac，发票、截图敏感内容放心喂
- **极速**：首次编译 5–10 秒，之后秒级返回，无网络延迟

### 能力一览

| 工具 | 功能 |
| --- | --- |
| `ocr_image` | 提取文字；`layout=true` 时输出表格结构 + 坐标 |
| `view_image` | 描述图片内容：场景、人物、二维码、构图 |

- 输入支持：**本地路径 / http(s) URL / base64**
- 全本地推理，图片永不离开你的 Mac

### 使用方式：会复制粘贴就会用

**Web 模式（推荐）：多张图片直接粘贴到输入框**

1. 打开 DSH web 界面，在输入框里直接 **⌘V** 粘贴图片（一次可以粘多张）
2. 插件自动把图片保存到本机 `~/Pictures/free-vision`，输入框里出现每张图的**本地绝对路径**（换行分隔，顺序不变）
3. 补一句"识别这些图片"，回车发送 —— agent 会逐张调用 `ocr_image` / `view_image` 处理

**Headless / CLI**：传路径、URL 或 base64 直接调用

```bash
dsh --profile headless "调用 ocr_image 识别 ~/Desktop/发票.png，提取表格"
```

### 安装（1 步）

```bash
dsh plugin add @niyongsheng/free-vision-skill
```

插件自带 bundle 配置（`dsh.bundle`），装完即用，无需手动编辑 `cordis.patch.yml`。

### 安全细节

粘贴的图片只经过本机 `127.0.0.1` 上传（非本机来源直接拒绝）、单张上限 20MB、格式按内容魔数校验 —— 图片从头到尾不出你的 Mac。

### 一个真实例子

让 headless 模式识别一张测试图，完整走完 模型 → 调用工具 → 本地识别 → 返回结果：

> 输入：`调用 ocr_image 识别 test.png，输出识别内容`
> 输出：`Hello Vision 123` ✓

### 写给想了解实现的人

插件完全基于 macOS Vision Framework（Swift），代码量很小，仓库就是最好的教程：`@niyongsheng/free-vision-skill`，MIT 协议。想给 DSH 写本地工具插件的同学可以直接抄作业。

欢迎体验、提 issue、给反馈 —— 尤其是**表格结构提取**的用例，我很想知道在真实发票/截图上的效果如何。

---

**TL;DR**: fully-local OCR & image understanding for DeepSeek Harness, powered by macOS Vision Framework. Free, fast, private — images never leave your Mac. Paste multiple images into the web input box (⌘V) and the agent reads them locally. Supports `ocr_image` (text + table layout) and `view_image` (scene description). Install: `dsh plugin add @niyongsheng/free-vision-skill` (MIT).

discussions.title: Idea: Session-scoped plugin assembly — auto-install plugins for the task, clean up when the session ends
discussions.body:
**Background**

DeepSeek Harness is built on an "Everything is a Plugin" philosophy with Cordis at its core. Today, however, the plugin lifecycle is largely decoupled from the agent lifecycle: plugins are installed up front (via `dsh plugin add`), and a session either uses what's already there or the user manually adds something mid-flight. The *task* itself never drives the plugin lifecycle.

**Proposal**

Make plugin provisioning part of the session lifecycle:

1. **Identify** — During a session, the harness detects what capabilities the current task actually needs (e.g., web search, memory, file parsing) and resolves which plugin(s) can provide them — for example, via a registry lookup such as `dsh-plugin-search`.
2. **Assemble** — The harness installs the required plugins *on demand* (with user approval and sandbox/permission checks as appropriate), so the agent effectively "self-assembles" its toolchain for the task at hand.
3. **Decide on cleanup** — When the task completes, the user can choose to:
   - **Keep** the plugin (promote it to a permanent, session-independent install), or
   - **Discard** it, letting it live and die with the session — automatically removed when the session ends, leaving no residue.

**Why this fits DeepSeek Harness**

- It extends the modular philosophy to the *runtime*: a session becomes a disposable composition of exactly the plugins it needed, nothing more.
- It lowers the barrier for newcomers — no need to curate a plugin set in advance.
- It reduces clutter and risk: no stale, unused, or forgotten plugins piling up between sessions.
- It pairs naturally with existing community work on plugin registries, search (`dsh-plugin-search`), and install-path guardrails.

**Open questions**

- Should auto-install be gated by a permission prompt (like tool approval) or a per-session toggle?
- What is the right security boundary for a session-scoped install? (Workspace-local? Profile-local? Sandboxed?)
- How should cleanup interact with plugin state that survives the session (cached data, credentials, local files)?
- Could this be implemented as a plugin itself (a "plugin orchestrator"), staying true to the architecture?

I'd love to hear the community's thoughts — especially on the security model and how this might compose with existing marketplace efforts.

discussions.title: 建议：给 subprocess-local 补上 win32 ProcessInspector（附 MIT 参考实现，实测数据齐全）
discussions.body:
CONTRIBUTING 说暂不接受外部 PR，所以按建议把这个提到 Ideas，附一份可用的参考实现。

**缺口。** `subprocess-local` 的 `spawnTerminal` 在 node-pty 之前解析平台进程探测器，而 `createProcessInspector` 只有 linux/darwin 分支，win32 直接抛 `terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`。于是 Windows 上持久 shell（以及依赖它的极简模式）整体不可用。架构笔记里也标了这是待补项（"The minimal preset's missing win32 PTY stack is a preset-metadata follow-up"）。

**参考实现。** 我们在插件层用官方注入座（`terminalInspector` 字段）补了一个 win32 ProcessInspector，思路如下。

- 进程树与身份。一次 CIM 快照（`Get-CimInstance Win32_Process`，pid/ppid/CreationDate FILETIME 作身份），children-first 排序，容 PID 复用成环
- 信号。taskkill（/F 对应 SIGKILL），已退出目标视为成功
- POSIX 独有概念（前台进程组、会话、stdin 等待探测）如实返回"不可得"，上层优雅降级
- 取消命令的 SIGINT 走 ConPTY 惯例，把 \x03 作为 PTY 输入写进去，MSYS/ash 会转发给前台任务

windows-latest CI 上实测。持久 shell 状态跨调用保留、中断 `sleep 60` 得 exit 130。配合 busybox-w32 ash 时在 WRITE_RESTRICTED 令牌（workspace-write 沙箱）内也能完整往返（MSYS bash 因 cygheap 的 TokenDefaultDacl 0xC0000022 起不来，这个也一并实测记录了）。

代码在 https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-win32 （MIT，`src/inspector.ts` + `src/terminal-wrap.ts`，含单测与 CI）。如果官方愿意收编进 core，随便拿，需要我配合调整也可以。Windows 用户等这个等得比较苦（讨论区 Windows 相关帖子已经 400+ 了）。

discussions.title: [Bug] 会话日志被外部删除后，下一回合 dsh 进程直接 fatal 退出
discussions.body:
## 现象

正在运行的会话，其持久化日志（或整个会话目录）被外部删除后（例如清理脚本误删
`$DSH_HOME/sessions/**`、其他工具/进程删除，或手动 `rm -rf`），下一个回合结束时
dsh 崩溃退出：

```
dsh: fatal load failure: Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open
'/home/.../.dsh/sessions/--home-...--/session-19fd6b44-.../session.jsonl.zstd'
    at async open (node:internal/fs/promises:637:25)
    at async JsonlSessionPersistence.appendLines (.../dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1203:18)
    at async JsonlSessionPersistence.appendBatch (.../dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1023:23)
    at async PersistenceCoordinator.appendCore (.../dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:836:3)
    at async PersistenceCoordinator.appendLiveBatch (.../dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:1332:3)
```

会话本身一直在运行（对话在内存里继续），一次持久化失败就让整个进程退出。
`compression: 'none'`（session.jsonl）与 `zstd`（session.jsonl.zstd）都观察到同样表现。

## 复现办法

1. 启动任一 surface（TUI / web），创建会话，发一条消息，等第一个回合完成
   （日志已落盘）。
2. 在另一个终端执行：
   `rm -rf $DSH_HOME/sessions/<workspace 目录>/<session-id>`
   （或直接 `rm -rf ~/.dsh/sessions/*`）。
3. 回到 dsh 再发一条消息，等回合结束。
4. 进程以 `fatal load failure ... ENOENT` 崩溃退出。

环境：dsh 0.1.0-rc.6，Linux（x64），TUI surface（dsh-pi-tui）与 web 同属一类路径。

## 相关讨论

- #647（JSONL appendLines 的另一类故障：rollback 被跳过 → 重复 seq）
- #673（torn-tail 修复与并发 append 互相截断）
- #496（中断重写遗留重复记录的恢复）
- #1473（单个损坏日志让整个 workspace 无法启动）
- #260（I/O 失败直接终止整个 harness 进程的同类现象）
- #1348（会话删除/清理入口的功能请求）

discussions.title: dsh使用体验，兄弟们我客观么？
dsh-cyber-pet 给DeepSeek Harness的一只赛博鲸鱼宠物：悬浮在 Web UI 里游动，实时播报你的 token 消耗，可以投喂、换色、陪它聊天。
discussions.body:
## 解决什么问题

跑 Agent 时，token 消耗是"看不见"的——你不知道这轮花了多少、额度还剩多少、上下文占了多满，往往等到额度告警或上下文爆掉才反应过来。

这只鲸鱼把仪表盘变成了一只宠物：

- **消耗可视化**：每轮对话结束，鲸鱼用气泡播报本轮花费与剩余额度；额度条、上下文占用、消耗速度实时可见。额度不足 10% 时它会焦虑，烧得快时它游得快。
- **零打扰**：不需要打开任何监控页，它就游在你的工作界面角落，瞥一眼即可。
- **有粘性**：鲸鱼会成长（幼鲸 → 金冠鲸）、有情绪、每 1 万 tokens 庆祝一次——把枯燥的成本管理变成一件愿意持续看的事。

## 主要能力

| 能力 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 📊 实时播报 | tokens / 额度 / 上下文占用 / 轮次 / 对话数，每轮气泡播报消耗 |
| 🎨 外观 | 像素风 / 拟物风两套皮肤，7 个预设色 + 自由取色器 |
| 💬 聊天 | 本地规则大脑（零请求）、任意 OpenAI 兼容接口、宿主侧 Remote（凭据不出宿主）三选一 |
| 🌱 成长 | 4 级成长系统、情绪引擎、里程碑庆祝、首次加载昨日摘要 |
| 🍱 互动 | 拖拽投喂、右键切换行为模式、自动巡游、轻柔音效 |
| 📸 报告卡 | 一键导出带鲸鱼和你的数据的 PNG |

## 技术形态

一个 dsh-plugin bundle（`@borisshaw6/dsh-cyber-pet`），同时携带宿主侧 `petChat` Remote 与浏览器表面，通过 `dsh.bundle` + `dsh.client` 挂载——不改 harness 源码、无需重新构建。所有计数与偏好持久化在浏览器 `localStorage`，升级不丢。

- 仓库：https://github.com/BorisShaw6/dsh-cyber-pet
- 在线演示（不装也能玩）：https://borisshaw6.github.io/dsh-cyber-pet/demo/
- 协议：MIT（与 DeepSeek Harness 一致）

discussions.title: 🧠 dsh-mneme — 离线语义记忆引擎
discussions.body:
# 🧠 dsh-mneme — 离线语义记忆引擎

> **你的记忆，只属于你。** 完全离线的长期记忆 + 语义搜索 + 后台自我整理，零 API 依赖，零网络泄露风险。

---

## 一句话定位

**dsh-mneme** 是 DeepSeek Harness 的本地语义记忆插件。它让 Agent 跨会话记住你的偏好、项目和决策，并且能自己定期整理、去重、修正记忆——全部在本地完成，记忆文本永不出境。

---

## ✨ 现在就能用的核心能力

### 🔒 完全离线
Embedding、Rerank、记忆整理，全部本地运行。无需 API Key，记忆永不上云，隐私零妥协。

### 🧠 语义搜索
向量召回 + Cross-Encoder 精排 + FTS5 关键词混合搜索。找得到，也找得准。

### 🛌 autoDream 自我整理
后台自动运行：合并重复记忆、裁决矛盾信息、生成摘要、重建向量索引。记忆库越用越干净。

### 🪞 反思更新
模型能主动识别过时或错误的单条记忆，直接修正内容——不是简单归档，而是真正的"改对"。

### 📝 记忆主权
所有记忆同步到人类可读的 Markdown 镜像。你可以直接编辑文件，插件自动同步回数据库。

### 📊 完整审计
每次整理生成可验证的 receipt，记录全部决策和结果。出了错，能定位、能重放、能审计。

---

## 🆚 与其他记忆插件的区别

| 维度 | 典型记忆插件 | **dsh-mneme** |
|---|---|---|
| 搜索方式 | 关键词匹配 | **语义向量 + 精排 + 关键词混合** |
| 记忆整理 | 无 / 人工 | **autoDream 自动整理（合并/裁决/修正）** |
| 网络依赖 | 部分需联网 | **完全离线，embedding 也本地** |
| 人类可读 | 数据库二进制 | **Markdown 镜像直接编辑** |
| 审计能力 | 基础日志 | **决策级 receipt + 可重放验证** |
| 内容修正 | 归档后重建 | **原地反思更新（update）** |

---

## 🚀 快速开始

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @modusensus/dsh-mneme
dsh web
```

推荐配置（完全离线模式）：
```yaml
- patch:
    dsh-mneme:
      embedProvider: local
      localEmbedModel: Xenova/bge-small-zh-v1.5
      rerankEnabled: true
      autoDream: true
```

---

## 🔮 正在探索的方向

> 以下能力已在架构中预留扩展点，正在逐步落地。

### 🧬 结构化记忆（记忆基因）
从文本片段升级为"实体-属性-时间"三维模型。自动抽取"用户/项目/技术栈"等实体，追踪属性随时间的变化，建立可追溯的变更历史。

### 🛌 系统级睡眠（深度整理）
将 autoDream 从"写入触发"升级为"定时深度维护"：夜间自动归档降级、压缩冷记忆、从大量记忆中提取高阶规律（模式发现）。

### 🔄 反思性成长（纠错进化）
当用户纠正记忆时，不仅修正内容，还记录"为什么错了"。系统从失败轨迹中自动提取规律，反向优化搜索策略和整理参数——让记忆系统从自己的错误中学习。

---

## 🤝 反馈与贡献

- 🐛 [Issue 反馈](https://github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme/issues)
- 💡 [功能建议](https://github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme/discussions)
- ⭐ 如果对你有用，欢迎 star 支持

---

**仓库**：https://github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme

discussions.title: Concrete downstream use case for a pre-commit tool-input rewrite consistency seam
discussions.body:
## Summary

We have a concrete downstream product consumer for the repository's proposed [pre-tool input rewrite consistency transaction](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/.agents/notes/proposed/feature/2026-06-30-pre-tool-input-rewrite.md).

We are building **MyAgents-dsh**, a batteries-included DSH distribution used by the MyAgents desktop product through a native bidirectional RPC boundary. The same Runtime is also intended to support an Agent SDK-compatible facade. Host-provided Hooks, canonical built-in tools, Host tools, and MCP tools all execute through the one DSH `ctx.tools` pipeline.

For that design, `PreToolUse.updatedInput` cannot be an execution-only convenience. It must be the authoritative input observed by durable model history, the tool audit record, UI presentation, permission checks, and the executor.

DSH already parses this field in `hooks-claude-code`, but currently logs a warning and ignores it. This post is intended as downstream application evidence and a concrete set of invariants for promoting the existing proposed design into a public extension seam.

Audited against `master` at `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a` / `0.1.0-rc.5`.

## Our application scenario

The MyAgents Host owns product policy and Hook configuration. A typical tool call crosses these layers:

```text
model tool call
  -> Host PreToolUse Hook
  -> product hard policy and permission
  -> DSH ToolRuntime
  -> canonical / Host / MCP executor
  -> PostToolUse
  -> durable result and Host event projection
```

A Hook may normalize or rewrite a call before approval and execution. For example, an organization policy may replace a shorthand test command with its governed form, or normalize a tool argument into an approved workspace-relative representation. Product hard guards still run after the rewrite and may only reduce, never widen, authority.

For SDK compatibility, a Hook returning `updatedInput` must have one unambiguous meaning: **this is the call that was approved and executed**. If history or UI still shows the original arguments, users can approve one operation while another runs, and a resumed model sees a false transcript.

## Why a normal plugin cannot implement this today

The current ordering is internally consistent but closes the extension seam too early:

1. AgentLoop assembles the provider output and appends [`assistant/message`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts) before scheduling tool calls.
2. The scheduler appends [`tool/call`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts) before `ToolRuntime.prepare()`.
3. [`tools/pre-execute`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/core/tools/src/index.ts) can only return `allow`, `deny`, or `ask`; its `ToolExecution.arguments` are already detached and frozen.

Consequently, adding `updatedArguments` only to the current `PreToolDecision` would be too late. It could alter execution but not the already committed assistant history and call audit.

An outer proxy tool is also not equivalent: it creates separate outer/inner call identities and results, and splits policy, audit, presentation, and cancellation.

## Suggested generic capability

The exact API shape can remain an upstream design choice. The important capability is a **tool-call-specific pre-identity / pre-commit transaction**, not a general mutable assistant-message hook.

One possible shape is an agent-scoped waterfall after provider stream assembly and before the canonical assistant/tool-call commit:

```ts
interface PendingToolCall {
  readonly callId: CallId
  readonly name: string
  readonly rawArguments: string
  readonly parsedArguments: unknown
}

interface ToolCallInputRewrite {
  readonly callId: CallId
  readonly updatedInput: JsonValue
}

'agent/tool-calls-pre-commit'(
  calls: readonly PendingToolCall[],
  next: () => Promise<readonly ToolCallInputRewrite[]>,
): Promise<readonly ToolCallInputRewrite[]>
```

The API name and return type are illustrative. We would expect the framework to enforce these invariants:

- only arguments may change; call ID, tool name, call count/order, and non-tool assistant content remain immutable;
- transforms run deterministically and observe the step `AbortSignal`;
- transformed JSON is validated again before identity is committed;
- the same effective value is written to `assistant/message`, `tool/call`, presentation, permission/policy, and `ToolExecution.arguments`;
- original and effective arguments retain an explicit audit relationship, as proposed by the existing Agent Note;
- after commit, the ordinary immutable `ToolExecution` and existing allow/deny/ask, guards, dispatch, post-processing, and result path remain unchanged;
- with no listener, behavior and persisted bytes remain equivalent to the current implementation.

Because one assistant message may contain multiple parallel tool calls, the design should explicitly define batching: making the assistant message authoritative appears to require resolving all input rewrites before any call from that message executes. We can support that ordering in our Host Hook bridge, but it should be part of the public contract rather than an accidental consequence.

## Why this is useful beyond our distribution

- The shipped Claude Code Hook bridge already accepts and parses `updatedInput`.
- Governance plugins can normalize a call before approval without creating a second executor.
- Compatibility layers can preserve one truthful call identity across replay and UI.
- Tool migrations can normalize legacy arguments before a definition changes, while keeping the effective call explicit.
- Security/audit products can ensure that the value inspected is exactly the value executed.

## Suggested acceptance coverage

- one call and multiple parallel/exclusive calls;
- chained transforms and deterministic ordering;
- invalid JSON/schema, throw, timeout, and cancellation;
- permission/approval sees only the effective input;
- original/effective audit relationship is replayable;
- `deriveMessages()`, `tool/call`, presentation, and executor agree after close/resume;
- crash after provider chunks but before/while rewrite produces a repairable Session;
- HMR and no-listener behavior remain compatible;
- existing `hooks-claude-code` tests change from "warn and ignore" to honoring `updatedInput` through this seam.

Would the maintainers be open to promoting the existing proposed Agent Note into a public tool-call pre-commit extension point? We would be happy to validate the eventual contract against the downstream RPC/Hook use case, even though the contribution guide currently asks the community not to submit external PRs.

discussions.title: Required downstream Session events need an instance-scoped persistence recognition seam
discussions.body:
## Summary

This is a focused follow-up to [#802](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/discussions/802), [#1584](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/discussions/1584), and [#1748](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-Harness/discussions/1748).

Those discussions correctly identify that downstream plugins cannot safely persist custom Session events and propose an `ignorable` append option and/or event registration. Our downstream distribution has a second, stricter use case: **required, non-surface domain events that must not be skipped during recovery**.

We are building **MyAgents-dsh**, a product distribution in which DSH remains the only AgentLoop and the DSH Session remains the only durable conversation authority. We intentionally do not want a parallel product transcript or recovery database. To reconstruct a safe Runtime after restart, our DSH plugins need required events for operation admission/terminal state, TaskGraph transitions, component generation receipts, and managed checkpoint/mutation correlation.

Marking these events `ignorable` would make an old or incomplete Runtime silently reconstruct the wrong state. We therefore need a public persistence recognition seam for required downstream event types.

Audited against `master` at `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a` / `0.1.0-rc.5`.

## Concrete product events

Representative non-surface facts are:

```text
myagents/operation/accepted
myagents/operation/claimed
myagents/operation/terminal
myagents/task/created
myagents/task/updated
myagents/component/committed
myagents/checkpoint/prepared
myagents/mutation/committed
```

These do not produce model messages, but they are not informational:

- skipping `operation/accepted` or `operation/terminal` can duplicate an RPC operation or produce two terminals after restart;
- skipping TaskGraph events changes dependency/cycle/state reconstruction;
- skipping checkpoint or mutation receipts can restore the wrong file/Session generation;
- skipping component receipts can bind resumed work to the wrong effective catalog.

The desired failure mode when the owning product plugin/profile is absent is exactly the current one: refuse to resume. The desired success mode is that an installed, version-compatible profile can declare these required types before persistence prepares the Session.

## Current extensibility gap

At compile time, `SessionEventMap` supports declaration merging, and at runtime `Session.append()` accepts the resulting log-only event. On cold read, however, `PersistenceCoordinator.assertEventsSupported()` checks only the repository-generated `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` plus `event.ignorable === true`.

This creates an incomplete extension contract:

```text
downstream event is type-safe and appendable
  -> flush succeeds
  -> next process refuses load/inspect/prepare/resume
```

For required events, an `ignorable: true` writer option is intentionally not a solution.

## Suggested minimal seam

The smallest implementation we currently need is an optional known-event predicate supplied directly to the public `PersistenceCoordinator`:

```ts
interface PersistenceCoordinatorOptions {
  readonly preparedSessionCacheSize: number
  readonly writeBatchMaxDelayMs: number
  readonly isKnownEventType?: (type: string) => boolean
}
```

Semantics:

```ts
const known = options.isKnownEventType
  ?? ((type: string) => KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES.has(type))

if (known(event.type) || event.ignorable === true) continue
throw unsupportedUnknownRequiredEvent(...)
```

A product persistence Provider can pass a frozen predicate over the union of built-in and product event names. The default remains byte-for-byte equivalent for every existing backend/profile.

We prefer passing the predicate into each coordinator over mutating a process-global exported `Set` because:

- it avoids the multiple-physical-package-copy problem described in #1748;
- the exact persistence instance owns the recognition policy used for its read path;
- a distribution can freeze the event vocabulary before any Session `load`, `inspect`, or `prepare`;
- tests can prove that removing the product profile restores fail-closed behavior.

A richer future API could register `{ type, schemaVersion, validate }` through an effect-scoped service. The predicate is only the minimum seam required to close the current type-recognition mismatch; product folds still validate payload shapes and state transitions before Agent publication.

## Relationship to ignorable plugin events

We support the separate `session.append(..., { ignorable: true })` proposal for genuinely informational downstream records. The two capabilities serve different compatibility contracts:

| Event kind | Writer intent | Reader without plugin |
| --- | --- | --- |
| informational | explicitly `ignorable: true` | skip safely |
| required domain event | registered/recognized by active profile | refuse safely |

Automatically treating every declaration-merged event as known would be unsafe. TypeScript declaration merging is not a runtime trust decision, and a removed or incompatible plugin must not cause silent partial recovery.

## Required lifecycle

For a required-event registry/predicate to be sound:

1. the complete event vocabulary is installed before persistence reads or prepares a Session;
2. it is frozen for the persistence/profile generation and cannot disappear while a Session is live;
3. HMR/adoption uses the same recognition set;
4. event payloads and cross-event invariants are validated before Agent publication;
5. a missing/incompatible owner fails closed with the exact event type and sequence;
6. registration does not imply that an unknown surface event is safe to derive.

This fits a batteries-included distribution well: the official composition knows its product event vocabulary at startup, while DSH still owns append ordering, Session surface/history, crash repair, and persistence orchestration.

## Suggested acceptance coverage

- registered required event passes `load`, `inspect`, `prepare`, resume, `readFrom`, live adoption, and HMR;
- the same stored event refuses when the product predicate/registry is absent;
- unknown required events still refuse;
- unknown `ignorable: true` events still skip under the existing contract;
- registration is isolated to the intended coordinator/profile instance;
- built-in default behavior is unchanged with no option;
- generated/product event-set changes are reflected in persistence/profile digests;
- malformed product payload/state transitions remain a product recovery error, not silently accepted state.

Would the maintainers consider an instance-scoped recognition hook on `PersistenceCoordinator` (or an equivalent pre-load registry) for required downstream events? This would let product distributions keep one DSH Session authority without weakening the current forward-compatibility refusal rule.

discussions.title: dsh-mobile-access — use the Web GUI from your phone
discussions.body:
# 📱 dsh-mobile-access — use the Web GUI from your phone

Hi everyone! Following the CONTRIBUTING guidance to share community plugins, I'd like to introduce **`dsh-mobile-access`**: a bundle that serves the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI to a phone through your **own domain and public server**.

Repo: https://github.com/kk99668/dsh-mobile-access (topic: `dsh-plugin`)

## What it does

```text
phone ── https://dsh.example.com ──> Caddy (HTTPS, on your server)
                                        └──> 127.0.0.1:<relay-port>  (sshd reverse tunnel)
                                                  └──> local token gate (dsh process)
                                                        └──> http://127.0.0.1:<web-port>
```

- **Token gate** — every request and WebSocket upgrade must present a shared secret (login form cookie, Basic, or Bearer) before being forwarded to the webserver. This is the auth layer the /api trust fence deliberately is not.
- **Supervised SSH reverse tunnel** — `ssh -N -R` child with exponential restart backoff, stable-uptime reset, keepalive probes, and SIGTERM-then-SIGKILL teardown.
- **Fence integration** — the bundle patch injects a `mobileAccess` service into the `connection` row, so the /api browser-trust fence accepts the public authority (and keeps privileged methods pinned to loopback).
- **Nice touches** — prints the public URL with a terminal QR code once the tunnel is up, registers the `app:mobile-surface` prompt section and `DSH_WEB_PUBLIC_URL` bash variable, and is tuned for weak mobile networks (permessage-deflate, browser reconnect backoff, tunnel keepalive).

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:kk99668/dsh-mobile-access
```

Set 4 env vars (`DSH_MOBILE_PUBLIC_HOST`, `DSH_MOBILE_RELAY_HOST`, `DSH_MOBILE_RELAY_USER`, `DSH_MOBILE_TOKEN`), run the one-shot server setup script (installs Caddy + a restricted relay user), and scan the QR code with your phone. A full bilingual deployment runbook (`DEPLOYMENT.md`) ships in the repo.

## Why

I wanted to reach the GUI from my phone on the subway — a constrained link where the standard setup (LAN URL) doesn't work. The plugin works over your own domain + VPS with automatic HTTPS, and the weak-network section of the README documents the tuning knobs.

Feedback, issues, and PRs are welcome in the repo! 🚀

discussions.title: dsh-beautify美化插件
discussions.body:
dsh-beautify —— 让你的 DeepSeek Harness 界面变成自己的风格
一句话：输入一个关键词，整个界面换一套主题；配一张壁纸，每个区域单独调透明度 —— 不用写代码，全在设置页里点出来。

🔗 获取
https://github.com/lieve-c/dsh-beautify

✨ 它能做什么
1. 关键词生成整套主题
在设置页输入「我的世界」「高达」「EVA」「赛博朋克」「星空」「樱花」…，自动生成全套配色（品牌色 / 背景 / 内容面板 / 边框 / 侧边栏 / 文字，浅色深色都适配）。

内置 14 套主题：我的世界 / 高达 / EVA / 赛博朋克 / 暗黑 / 星空 / 樱花 / 森林 / 海洋 / 落日 / 薄荷 / 蒸汽波 / 霓虹 / 午夜
其他任意关键词 → 按哈希生成专属配色，每个词都有独一无二的主题
2. Bing 壁纸搜索
关键词自动从 Bing 图片搜索抓取关联壁纸，点缩略图一键应用 —— 不用自己找图。

3. 分区壁纸工作室
全局背景 / 侧边栏 / 对话区 / 详情区 4 个区域各自独立设壁纸：

每区单独：图片、透明度、大小（铺满/完整/拉伸/缩放）、位置
该区面板透明度：只让当前区域的内容面板变透明，露出壁纸（其他区域不受影响）
背景模式 / 前景模式切换
上传本地图片 或 粘贴图片 URL
4. 色相滑块自定义配色
拖动色相滑块，整套主题色实时联动，浅色/深色模式自动适配；可保存为自己的预设。

5. AI 头像 + 发送键图标
上传一张图标：

显示为 AI 回复头像 + 会话标题栏 Logo
发送键也可以换成它（圆形裁切、透明背景，独立于头像不受影响）
6. 效果持久化
所有设置自动保存到浏览器，刷新页面不丢失；一键重置。

📦 两种安装方式（二选一）
方式 A · 部署级插件（开机自启，推荐长期使用）

把仓库 dsh-beautify 文件夹拷贝到 <DSH_HOME>/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/@local/dsh-beautify/
在 cordis.patch.yml 顶层列表追加：
yaml
复制
- insert:
    - id: beautify
      name: '@local/dsh-beautify'
重启 DSH → 侧边栏底部出现「✨ 美化」入口
方式 B · 动态插件（快速体验 / 二开，无需改配置） 在当前会话里 cordis_define + cordis_run 直接运行，把 dynamic/host.js 和 dynamic/client.js 分别粘贴到 code.host / code.client 即可。

🔗 获取
https://github.com/lieve-c/dsh-beautify

仓库含完整源码、部署版 + 动态版双版本、中文/英文 README、安装示例。

discussions.title: 插件启动/重启与生态的几个问题与建议（附复现步骤）
discussions.body:
## 背景

在 Windows + 自建 profile 上深度使用 DSH web 时，遇到并定位了几个值得官方关注的问题。每条都附了可复现步骤与根因，欢迎指正。

## 1. `dsh plugin add` 会静默丢失 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中的已有条目（Bug）

- **现象**：执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add link:D:/xxx` 安装新 bundle 后，`profiles/web/package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 数组中原有条目被移除（实测丢失了 `@dsh-polyglot/bundle` 和 `dsh-web-control`），这些插件的路由/UI 静默失效（HTTP 404），无任何告警。
- **复现**：备份 `package.json` → 执行 `dsh plugin add <任一 bundle>` → 对比 bundles 数组。
- **建议**：`plugin add` 应合并而非整体替换 bundles 列表；写入前先 `--dump-config` 校验，并把实际变更记录到日志。

## 2. 适配器路由冲突导致启动即崩，错误信息难以定位

- **现象**：第三方路由插件用 `ctx.llm.registerAdapter(['deepseek-official'], …)` 抢注已由 `llm-deepseek` 注册的 provider，进程在 boot 阶段直接抛 `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` 崩溃，整棵组合起不来。堆栈里能看到 provider 名，但没有指出「谁先注册、谁冲突」。
- **复现**：把注册同一 provider 的两个 adapter 插件放入同一组合启动。
- **建议**：
  - `DUPLICATE_ADAPTER` 崩溃信息点名冲突双方（已注册者 + 请求者）；
  - 引导第三方路由插件用 `registerConfigurableProviders` 或仅注册新路由，而不是抢注既有 provider；
  - 启动预检（`--dump-config` 或 loader 层）能提前拦截这类冲突，给出可操作提示（如「请移除 X 或改用 Y」）。

## 3. 「由后端派生的重启脚本杀后端」会连带杀掉自己，重启必然失败

- **现象**：把 `restart-web.ps1`（由 dsh web 进程派生运行）直接 `Stop-Process` 3080 监听进程，脚本自身也随宿主进程树被终止，永远走不到后面的重新拉起步骤，后端只能靠外部（手动运行启动器）恢复。
- **根因**：重启脚本运行在被杀进程的进程树内。
- **修复（已在本机验证）**：
  - 重启动作交给「脱离被杀进程树」的执行者：Windows 上用一次性计划任务；Node 侧用 `spawn(detached: true) + unref`（`dsh-service-control` 已用该模式，工作正常）。
  - 建议官方在 web 内置健壮的 stop/restart 入口（appExit + detached 重启），避免每个部署自己造轮子踩坑。

## 4. 启动器「预检 + 恢复菜单 + known-good 快照」设计，值得官方参考

自建启动器（`启动 DeepSeek Harness.ps1`）目前包含：
- 启动前预检：`--dump-config` 组合校验 + 每个 bundle 入口语法检查 + 冒烟测试；
- 启动失败时恢复菜单：自动识别出错插件并禁用重试 / 还原 known-good 补丁 / 回滚 / 会话损坏隔离与恢复；
- 每次成功启动后把 `cordis.patch.yml` 快照为 known-good；
- 错误摘要中文化，完整堆栈只写日志。

这套机制把「组合被改坏」从「死页面 + 只能手动折腾」变成「一键定位/恢复」。若官方 launcher 或 `dsh web` 能内置类似能力（或提供官方 preflight/recovery 钩子），能显著改善插件生态可用性。

## 5. 插件开发坑：用 `ctx.settings` 必须声明 `inject: ['settings']`

- **现象**：插件在 `apply()` 里 `ctx.get('settings')` 注册命名空间，但未声明 `inject: ['settings']`。插件会先于 settings 服务就绪而激活，`ctx.get('settings')` 返回 undefined，注册被跳过；客户端写该命名空间时报 `settings namespace not registered`。
- **修复**：`export const inject = ['settings']`（或对可选服务做 undefined 处理）。
- **建议**：插件开发文档明确这一点——settings/connection 等 Host 服务作为硬依赖时务必声明 `inject`。

---

以上均为本人在 Windows + 自建 profile 下的实测。感谢 DSH 团队与社区！

discussions.title: DSH全网首发浏览器录屏：对话框右上角一键录制屏幕/窗口/标签页，MP4 输出（WebM 回退+ffmpeg 转码）、麦克风混音、光标跟随放大聚焦、光标高亮/点击波纹、摄像头气泡、倒计时、暂停/继续、快捷键。核心同时可作为独立 JS 库嵌入任何网页。
discussions.body:
# open-dsh-plugins
##https://github.com/zrt-ai-lab/open-dsh-plugins.git

[DeepSeek Harness (DSH)](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@deepseek-ai/dsh) 的开源动态 Cordis 插件合集。每个子目录是一个独立插件，内含源码、构建脚本和安装说明。

Open-source dynamic Cordis plugins for the DSH Web GUI. Each subdirectory is a self-contained plugin with source, build script, and install instructions.

## 插件列表 / Plugins

| 插件 | 说明 |
| --- | --- |
| [`reelspot`](./reelspot) | 浏览器录屏：对话框右上角一键录制屏幕/窗口/标签页，MP4 输出（WebM 回退+ffmpeg 转码）、麦克风混音、光标跟随放大聚焦、光标高亮/点击波纹、摄像头气泡、倒计时、暂停/继续、快捷键。核心同时可作为独立 JS 库嵌入任何网页。 |

## 一键安装 / One-line Install

### npx 持久安装（推荐，永久生效）

```bash
npx dsh-reelspot install   # 然后重启 DSH，硬刷新页面
```

基于 DSH 官方组合插件机制（profile `node_modules` + `cordis.patch.yml` 用户层），装好后永久生效、无需批准。卸载：`npx dsh-reelspot uninstall`。

### 一句话试用（动态插件，进程级）

**不需要 clone、不需要构建、不需要碰任何文件。** 在 DSH 对话框里发送一句话即可（以 reelspot 为例）：

```
安装 ReelSpot 录屏插件：读取 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zrt-ai-lab/open-dsh-plugins/main/reelspot/dist/reelspot-dsh.client.js 和 https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zrt-ai-lab/open-dsh-plugins/main/reelspot/dist/reelspot-dsh.host.js ，分别作为 code.client 和 code.host 调用 cordis_define（idPrefix 用 reelsp），然后 cordis_run 运行
```

DSH 代理会自动拉取插件文件并完成安装，你只需在弹出的批准卡片上点一下 ✓（点 ✓✓ 可授权该插件的未来版本，以后更新免确认）。

> 说明：DSH 动态插件是**进程级**的——DSH 重启后插件会消失，重新发送上面这句话即可重装（10 秒）。这是 DSH 当前的设计，不是插件的缺陷。

## 手动安装 / Manual Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/zrt-ai-lab/open-dsh-plugins.git
cd open-dsh-plugins
```

每个插件的 `dist/` 目录已包含构建产物，**无需运行任何构建命令**：在 DSH 会话中让 Cordis 代理读取插件 `dist/` 下的 `*.client.js` / `*.host.js`，分别作为 `cordis_define` 的 `code.client` / `code.host` 并运行即可。各插件子目录的 README 有详细说明。

## License

各插件目录内含自己的 LICENSE（如无特殊说明均为 MIT）。

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-rule-evolve ? verification-driven self-evolution loop (rules are only as good as their checks)
discussions.body:
**dsh-evolve ? a verification-driven self-evolution loop for dsh plugin maintenance.**

Repo: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-evolve ? Zero-dependency CLI

## The loop

```text
experience (markdown)  ?  learn  ?  rules (AGENTS.md)  ?  verify (real checks)
```

Every rule carries its source and its last verification result. Evolution is auditable; nothing is "learned" without being checked.

## Proof it actually evolves (dogfood run, today)

1. `learn` extracted 5 real lessons from our doctor experience doc (#1697/#1842/#1856/#1859/#1863)
2. `rules` rendered them into an AGENTS.md block
3. `verify` ran the real dsh-plugin-doctor check against its own repo ? **and it failed**: the `pre-execute-side-effects` lint false-positived on doctor's own source (comments + its own regex matched)
4. We fixed the lint (only quoted event names / method calls count; tests dirs skipped; regex no longer self-matches), released v1.10.1, re-ran verify ? **5/5 entries verified ?, doctor passes its own check (exit 0)**

That is the loop working: a tool checking itself, finding its own bug, and the fix being captured as a verified rule.

## Why this slot is empty

The ecosystem has 12+ memory plugins and #1881 proposes triple-layer persistent memory. Its Layer 1 is Git-tracked Markdown rules. dsh-evolve is the **production + validation half of that layer**: where rules come from and how they stay honest. Complementary to #1881, not a duplicate.

## Try it

```sh
node scripts/dsh-evolve.mjs loop --from docs/troubleshooting.md --out experience.jsonl --dir ./my-plugin
```

Feedback welcome ? especially on the rule-extraction heuristics and the verify contract.

discussions.title: [Plugin] DSH Mini TUI — less process, more answer
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek Harness community!

I built **DSH Mini TUI**, a minimalist terminal interface plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

> **The interface is Mini; the capability is not.**

DSH Mini TUI keeps the complete DSH agent and tool workflow, but moves routine execution activity out of the conversation by default. The terminal stays focused on user input and the model's final response instead of filling the screen with successful tool calls.

![DSH Mini TUI startup screen](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/boxeryao/deepseek-harness-tui/main/assets/tui-startup-dashboard.png)

### Highlights

- **Answer-first output** — successful tool calls stay quiet by default.
- **Failure visibility** — failed tools still produce one compact line instead of disappearing silently.
- **Details on demand** — use `/verbose` for subsequent tool output or `/tool N` for retained call details.
- **Private thinking state** — shows a compact thinking indicator without printing internal reasoning content.
- **Deep-sea visual language** — a true-color gradient wordmark, restrained status colors, and deterministic path coloring.
- **Native DSH integration** — uses DSH tools, approvals, agent lifecycle, and durable Session logs directly.
- **Lightweight** — a focused terminal presentation layer with no web application runtime.

### Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile tui add deepseek-harness-tui@latest
dsh --profile tui
```

Repository: https://github.com/boxeryao/deepseek-harness-tui  
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/deepseek-harness-tui

The project is currently tested against the DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 package line. Since DSH is still evolving quickly, compatibility feedback and suggestions are very welcome.

I would especially love feedback from terminal-first users: which execution details should remain quiet, and which signals do you always want visible?

discussions.title: Sidebar Settings entry is misaligned with sibling footer actions
discussions.body:
## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness web UI (this repo), running locally in WSL2, Chrome 1136x1222 dpr 1, zh-CN locale.
- Sidebar footer (all stock): `Cordis Plugin` badge (cordis preset) → `设置` (Settings). User-installed third-party plugins in the same footer follow the same 49px rhythm and are not part of this repo.

## Problem

The native **Settings** trigger row does not share the geometry of the stock `Cordis Plugin` badge right above it, so the bottom row of the sidebar footer looks inconsistent:

| element | class prefix | margin | padding | height | width | left edge |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Settings trigger | `VOzbGW_trigger` | `4px -4px` | `6px 2px 6px 10px` | 34px | 264px | x=8 |
| Cordis Plugin badge | `Nqubda_badge` | `0` | `0 8px 0 6px` | 49px | 256px | x=12 |

Measured with `getBoundingClientRect()` on the live page. Two visible consequences:

1. The Settings row is 15px shorter and 8px wider, breaking the shared 49px/256px/12px row rhythm of the sidebar footer.
2. The trigger label renders at x=42 while the badge label renders at x=40 (the trigger icon is a 16px svg vs 14px in the badge), so the text column is off by 2px as well.

## Suggested fix

Make the Settings trigger use the same box metrics as the Cordis Plugin badge: `margin: 0`, `padding: 0 8px 0 6px`, `height: 49px`, `width: 256px` (border-box), `border-radius: 12px`, and a 14px icon so the label lands at the same x=40 column.

A smaller secondary observation: the Cordis dynamic-plugins panel is `position: fixed` with `inset: 410px 702px 128px 12px`; its bottom gap feels slightly larger than the spacing rhythm used elsewhere (I currently anchor it at `bottom: 112px` via a local override). If there is an intended value for that gap, sharing it would be helpful.

discussions.title: [Showcase] Session pin-to-top (pin conversations above the list)
discussions.body:
I built a "pin conversation to top" feature on top of DeepSeek Harness. Pinned sessions float above the selected order in the workspace browser, with a Pin/Unpin menu action and a pin badge, persisted durably on the host (survives restarts, like the archive set).

What it changes:
- workspace domain: registry-global pinnedSessionIds set + setSessionPinned
- apiproxy: workspace.setSessionPinned RPC + host/pinned-sessions-changed frame
- client runtime: workspaces service/manager expose pinnedSessionIds + setSessionPinned
- ui-workspace: Pin/Unpin menu action + pin badge

Since this touches core (persistence schema, RPC protocol, and the workspace browser), it cannot ship as a dsh-plugin. I'd love to see it (or an extension point for session-row actions/ordering) land upstream. Full diff is in my fork:

https://github.com/hanhan10098-ship-it/deepseek-harness/tree/feature/pin-conversations

discussions.title: Web 端 bash 工具在无 /bin/bash 系统上全部失败：PTY shell exited during startup
discussions.body:
Web 端 bash 工具在无 /bin/bash 的系统（NixOS）上全部失败：`Error: PTY shell exited during startup`。

<details>
<summary>复现、根因与建议</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. NixOS（纯 NixOS 没有 /bin 目录）上 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动 Web UI
  2. 新建会话，向 agent 发送 `can you \`ls\``
  3. agent 每次调用 bash 工具都得到 `Error: PTY shell exited during startup`，被迫改用 str_replace_editor 兜底
- 实际结果：bash 工具 100% 失败（会话日志里连续 4 次调用全部返回该错误）。
- 根因：dsh-terminal-bash 的 schema 默认 `shellPath: "/bin/bash"`（lib/index.js 第 10 行 `shellPath: z.string().default("/bin/bash")`）。NixOS 不存在 /bin/bash，node-pty spawn 直接失败，shell 启动即退出。
- 验证（本机实测）：
  - `node-pty.spawn("/bin/bash")` → 立即 exit code 1
  - `node-pty.spawn("/run/current-system/sw/bin/bash")` → 正常出提示符
- 影响面：任何没有 /bin/bash 的环境（NixOS、精简容器、部分 Termux 类环境）都会命中。
- 建议修复：
  - 默认值改为 `process.env.SHELL` 兜底、或解析 PATH 中的 `bash`（execvp 语义），或
  - 在文档/默认配置中把 shellPath 改为可发现路径，并让 tool-bash 行透传该配置。
- 临时 workaround（已在本机应用并重启）：profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 里
  ```yaml
  - id: tool-bash
    config:
      shellPath: /run/current-system/sw/bin/bash
  ```
- 验收条件：无 /bin/bash 的系统上 bash 工具可用；或默认值不依赖 /bin/bash。

</details>

discussions.title: [Bug] Empty tool-call id ("") from adapters persists into the session log and refuses the whole session on load
discussions.body:
## Summary

A degenerate model/adapter can emit a tool call with an **empty id/name** (`tool-call-delta id:""` or a `block-end` payload carrying `id:""`). The harness persists it verbatim:

- `BlockAssembler.assemble()` falls back only via `partial.toolCallId ?? CallId(...)` — `??` does not catch `""` (only `undefined`), and the `block-end` path (`if (partial.block) return partial.block`) bypasses the fallback entirely;
- `AgentLoop.step` / `executeToolCalls` write `block.id` straight into `tool/call callId:""` and `tool/result message.source.callId:""`;
- on load, `assertMessageEventShape` requires a non-empty `tool/result` `source.callId` → **the whole session log is refused** (`session event at seq N message must have tool source`). A single bad event makes every previously recorded message unreachable.

## Repro context

A polyglot provider streamed `tool_call` with empty `id` and `name`; the executor answered `unknown tool ""`; that empty `callId` was durably recorded; every subsequent load of the session failed with `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError`. The same corruption hit several sessions on our deployment.

## Suggested fix (3 layers)

1. `BlockAssembler.assemble()` (`packages/llm/llm/lib/types/assembler.js`): fall back on empty string too:
   `id: partial.toolCallId && partial.toolCallId.length > 0 ? partial.toolCallId : CallId(\`call-${index}\`)`
   and `name: partial.toolCallName && partial.toolCallName.length > 0 ? partial.toolCallName : 'unknown-tool'`.
2. `BlockAssembler.blocks()`: sanitize at the exit so direct `block-end` payloads are normalized as well (they currently skip the `assemble()` fallback).
3. `AgentLoop.step` (`packages/core/agent-loop/lib/index.js`): normalize `tool-call` blocks before writing `assistant/message`, so the assistant message, `tool/call` and `tool/result` all share one non-empty call id.

This prevents new bad data. Existing corrupted logs still need a one-off repair pass that assigns deterministic ids (`call-<index>` or similar) to the empty ids.

Happy to open a PR with the exact diff if useful.

discussions.title: [Showcase / 展示] SandBase Harness — 在 DSH 中管理持久化 Agent 会话
discussions.body:
## 中文

SandBase Harness v0.3.7 可以通过 stdio MCP 作为真正的 DeepSeek Harness 插件运行。它为 DSH 会话提供六个原生工具，用于列出 Agent、创建和运行持久化会话、读取结果与产物，以及停止任务。

本版本同时支持 Agent Skills 标准 `compatibility` 元数据：Runtime 会校验 1–500 字符边界、持久化并通过 API 返回，在 Console 搜索和详情中以不可信文本安全展示。

### 无需本地安装先体验 Console

[在 GitHub Codespaces 中打开 SandBase Harness](https://codespaces.new/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness?quickstart=1)，等待开发容器构建完成后运行：

```bash
node dist/index.js start --host 0.0.0.0
```

打开自动转发的 Console 端口，在 **Settings > Models** 中配置模型。Codespaces 可能产生 GitHub 用量费用；固定版本的本地安装仍见下方。

### 可复现的源码安装

npm 上未加 scope 的 `managed-agents` **不是**本项目。请固定使用 GitHub v0.3.7 源码：

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.7 --depth 1 https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness.git
cd sandbase-harness
npm ci
npm run build:runtime
mkdir ../my-agents && cd ../my-agents
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js init
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js start
```

另开终端：

```bash
export MANAGED_AGENTS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
# 仅在 Runtime 开启认证时设置 MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY
dsh plugin --profile web add -w ../sandbase-harness
dsh web
```

DSH 会获得：

- `mcp__sandbase__list_agents`
- `mcp__sandbase__create_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__run_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__get_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__list_artifacts`
- `mcp__sandbase__stop_session`

### 镜像与安装前预检

v0.3.7 MCP bridge 已验证包含 Linux `amd64` 与 `arm64` 两种架构，OCI index digest 为 `sha256:5f7dcac499e95294be540035bd4892456ffbb7bedf2bb2d8a96d65e4203f11dc`，并带 GitHub build provenance。

集成指南提供零依赖预检：先检查公开 Health Endpoint，再检查带认证的 Agents Endpoint，从而在 MCP 子进程启动前区分 URL 不可达与 API Key 被拒绝。命令不会打印 Key。

- [固定版本集成指南](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/tree/v0.3.7/examples/deepseek-harness)
- [v0.3.7 Release](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/releases/tag/v0.3.7)
- [官方 MCP Registry 条目](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.sandbaseai%2Fsandbase-harness)
- [中文 DSH Runtime 教程](https://blog.sandbase.ai/zh-CN/deepseek-harness-developer-preview-2026/#接入一个真实的第三方-runtime-插件)

Bridge 只连接 `MANAGED_AGENTS_URL`，有效权限由 `MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY` 限制，且不持久化凭证。默认 Local Sandbox 适合可信开发；需要更强隔离时请选择 Docker 或 Kubernetes Backend。

卸载：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove managed-agents
```

关联披露：我是 SandBase 仓库维护者，并参与了此集成。

---

## English

SandBase Harness v0.3.7 runs as a real DeepSeek Harness plugin over stdio MCP. It gives DSH six native tools for durable agent work:

- `mcp__sandbase__list_agents`
- `mcp__sandbase__create_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__run_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__get_session`
- `mcp__sandbase__list_artifacts`
- `mcp__sandbase__stop_session`

The release also supports the standard Agent Skills `compatibility` metadata end to end: 1–500 character validation, persistence, API responses, Console search, and safe untrusted-text rendering.

### Try the Console without a local install

[Open SandBase Harness in GitHub Codespaces](https://codespaces.new/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness?quickstart=1), wait for the development container build, then run:

```bash
node dist/index.js start --host 0.0.0.0
```

Open the forwarded Console port and configure a model under **Settings > Models**. GitHub may bill Codespaces usage; the pinned local install remains below.

### Reproducible source install

The unscoped `managed-agents` npm package is **not** this project. Build the immutable v0.3.7 GitHub source:

```bash
git clone --branch v0.3.7 --depth 1 https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness.git
cd sandbase-harness
npm ci
npm run build:runtime
mkdir ../my-agents && cd ../my-agents
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js init
node ../sandbase-harness/dist/index.js start
```

In another terminal:

```bash
export MANAGED_AGENTS_URL=http://127.0.0.1:3000
# Set MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY only when runtime authentication is enabled.
dsh plugin --profile web add -w ../sandbase-harness
dsh web
```

### Image, preflight, and verification

The v0.3.7 MCP bridge was verified as a Linux `amd64` + `arm64` OCI index at `sha256:5f7dcac499e95294be540035bd4892456ffbb7bedf2bb2d8a96d65e4203f11dc`, with GitHub build provenance.

The integration guide includes a zero-dependency preflight that checks the public health endpoint and then the authenticated agents endpoint before the MCP child starts. It distinguishes an unreachable URL from a rejected API key without printing the key.

- [Pinned integration guide](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/tree/v0.3.7/examples/deepseek-harness)
- [v0.3.7 release](https://github.com/sandbaseai/sandbase-harness/releases/tag/v0.3.7)
- [Official MCP Registry entry](https://registry.modelcontextprotocol.io/v0.1/servers?search=io.github.sandbaseai%2Fsandbase-harness)
- [DSH runtime-plugin walkthrough](https://blog.sandbase.ai/deepseek-harness-developer-preview-2026/#add-a-real-third-party-runtime-plugin)

The bridge connects only to `MANAGED_AGENTS_URL`; effective access is limited by `MANAGED_AGENTS_API_KEY`, and the bridge does not persist credentials. Use Docker or Kubernetes rather than the default local-process sandbox when you need a stronger execution boundary.

Uninstall with:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove managed-agents
```

Disclosure: I maintain the SandBase repositories and prepared this integration. Feedback on the MCP tool shape, profile lifecycle, and authentication boundary is welcome.

### v0.3.7 clean-profile verification / 干净 Profile 验证

The v0.3.7 bundle was re-tested with an isolated DSH home against commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`: Runtime health and Agents preflight passed, the Web profile installed `managed-agents 0.3.7` from the pinned source directory, DSH logged `sandbase-harness MCP server connected over stdio`, and the Web endpoint returned HTTP 200. No global npm link or custom PATH is required.

v0.3.7 已使用隔离的 DSH Home 完整复验：Runtime 预检通过、Web Profile 从固定源码安装、MCP stdio 握手成功、DSH Web 返回 HTTP 200；无需全局 npm link，也不会解析 npm 上的同名包。

discussions.title: dsh web 内网访问时 crypto.randomUUID is not a function，提供方目录无法加载
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

dsh web 绑定 `0.0.0.0` 后，内网设备通过明文 HTTP（如 `http://192.168.3.122:3080`）访问时，**设置 → 模型** 页加载提供方目录失败，报错：

```
加载提供方目录失败: crypto.randomUUID is not a function
```

前端代码无条件调用全局 `crypto.randomUUID()`，而该 API **仅在安全上下文（HTTPS 或 localhost）中可用**。局域网 IP + 明文 HTTP 属于非安全上下文，`crypto.randomUUID` 为 `undefined`，RPC ID 生成时抛出异常。

## 环境信息

| 项目 | 值 |
| --- | --- |
| 版本 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` |
| 运行时 | Node v24.18.0 / npm 11.16.0（Windows） |
| 浏览器 | Chromium 系（Chrome/Edge） |
| 访问方式 | `http://<内网IP>:3080` |

## 复现步骤

1. 启动 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`，并通过 profile patch 让 webserver 绑定 `0.0.0.0`：

   ```yaml
   - id: webserver
     config:
       host: 0.0.0.0
       port: !!js ctx.webStartup.port ?? 3080
   ```

2. 同一内网的其他设备打开 `http://<内网IP>:3080`
3. 进入 **设置 → 模型**（提供方目录）
4. 页面报错：`加载提供方目录失败: crypto.randomUUID is not a function`

> **补充验证：** 用 `http://127.0.0.1:3080` 访问则一切正常，可确认是安全上下文问题，而非后端故障。

## 根因分析

客户端代码直接使用全局 Web Crypto 的 `crypto.randomUUID()`：

- `dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js` — `mintRpcId() { return RpcId(crypto.randomUUID()); }`（约 6184 行）
- `dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js` — `MessageId(crypto.randomUUID())`（约 242 行）
- `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js` — `id: crypto.randomUUID()`（约 63 行）
- `dsh-commands/lib/index.js` — `instanceToken = crypto.randomUUID().slice(0, 8)`（约 233 行）

按 [Web Crypto 规范](https://developer.mozilla.org/en-US/docs/Web/API/Crypto/randomUUID)，`Crypto.randomUUID()` 仅在安全上下文中暴露；`http://<内网IP>` 下该值为 `undefined`。

## 预期行为

- 内网 HTTP 下提供方目录应能正常加载，**或**
- 无法支持时，应给出明确的"非安全上下文"提示，而非 `TypeError`

## 修复建议

- [ ] 提供 UUID 兜底实现（如基于 `crypto.getRandomValues` 的 RFC 4122 v4 生成器），并改为 `crypto.randomUUID?.() ?? fallback`
- [ ] 或检测 `!globalThis.isSecureContext` 时自动走兜底路径
- [ ] 或在文档中明确：内网访问需配置 HTTPS

## 补充说明

该问题会直接阻碍 dsh web 的纯内网部署场景：

- `--host 0.0.0.0` 已被 CLI 出于安全考虑拒绝（需通过 config patch 绕过）
- 而内网 IP 上提供 HTTPS 又依赖自签证书，对普通用户门槛较高

discussions.title: Proposal: first-class file snapshot + /rewind and batch-write confirmation guardrails for core (community plugins exist, e.g. dsh-turn-rewind)
discussions.body:
# Proposal: file snapshot + `/rewind` and batch-write confirmation must be native core capabilities, not third-party plugins

## 1. Background / Problem Statement

While using DSH, an agent executed a Bash script that batch-modified workspace files, truncating and blanking the content of **multiple files at once** (a scripting bug wrote only the front-matter block back to each file). The damage was fully recoverable only because:

- the project happened to be under Git, and
- an *external* tool (Claude Code) had kept session transcripts on disk containing the previous file contents.

Neither of those belongs to the harness. If the user had no Git and no external tooling, **the files would have been permanently lost** — the harness itself provided no way to see what changed, no confirmation, and no recovery path.

This exposed two gaps at the harness level:

- Safety depends entirely on the agent's "self-discipline." There is no structural backstop.
- `workspace-write` mode silently permits **any** in-workspace write — including bulk, destructive, multi-file overwrites — with no confirmation point and no rollback.

## 2. Why this is core, not plugin territory

DSH's plugin philosophy ("everything is a plugin") is a strength — for *extensibility*. But **safety nets are a trust boundary, not a feature**. A plugin is, by definition, optional: a user with a minimal plugin list gets zero protection, and protection must not depend on the user knowing that a third-party plugin exists. That is exactly what happened here.

Additional signals that this belongs in core:

- Claude Code ships native checkpoints and `/rewind`; the comparable primitive should be native here too.
- The community plugin [dsh-turn-rewind](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind) had to build an entire **Change Ledger engine** (restore points, drift preview, human gate, rescue points, hash verification, rollback) with its own security model. A plugin reimplementing a safety contract from scratch is evidence the core is missing a primitive, not that the feature is a plugin.
- Recovery being dependent on *external* VCS is a correctness property of the runtime, not an optional extra.

## 3. Comparison with industry standards

| Safety net | Claude Code | DeepSeek Harness (current) |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **Confirmation on high-impact changes** | Even with Write/Edit allowed, large-impact modifications still ask the user | `workspace-write` silently allows everything; no bulk-modification confirmation point |
| **Change visibility** | Live diff preview in the conversation for every edit | An agent-authored script running via Bash produces **zero** visible diff — the user cannot see what was changed |
| **File snapshot & recovery** | Built-in snapshots + `/rewind`, independent of external Git | ❌ No native snapshot/rollback; session log only, and it does not retain prior file contents |
| **Recovery path** | Native CLI restore command | Entirely dependent on the user manually cleaning up Git state (or external tools) |

## 4. Verifiable evidence (checked against the current DSH codebase)

- Core ships exactly three slash commands: `/compact`, `/goal`, `/feedback`. There is **no undo / rewind / restore** command.
- The only `rewind` string in the codebase is an internal type label — `ConversationContextOriginKind = 'compaction' | 'rewind' | 'rewrite'` (client/runtime) — which marks *why* a model-context generation exists. It is not a user-facing feature and has no file-state semantics.
- There is no file snapshot/restore layer: the only `checkpoint` in core is **compaction durability**; `fs-observation-policy` only enforces read-before-edit; the session log records events but **not prior file contents**.
- Sandbox modes (`read-only` / `workspace-write` / `danger-full-access`) and an approval policy exist, but `workspace-write` grants every in-workspace write without a blast-radius check.
- A Bash script that rewrites N files is invisible in the UI: no diff preview, no per-file summary, no confirmation.

## 5. Existing community work (demand already proven)

- [Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind](https://github.com/Anionex/dsh-turn-rewind) — message-anchored workspace recovery with a Change Ledger engine: content-addressed restore points → path-level drift preview → human-gated restore dialog → automatic rescue point before restore → post-restore hash verification → rollback on failed restore. It deliberately never mutates the Git index/branches.
- [dsh-checkpoint-rewind](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-checkpoint-rewind) (npm)
- [Moeblack/dsh-message-edit](https://github.com/Moeblack/dsh-message-edit) — branch-based message editing / reroll / retry with a version timeline.

**Request:** adopt this capability **into core as a first-class feature**, or at minimum provide an official, stable snapshot/restore API so plugins do not have to reimplement the safety contract.

## 6. Proposed solutions

### 6.1 Blast-radius-scoped confirmation (not confirmation fatigue)

Confirmation must be scoped by **blast radius**, not by operation type:

- Routine single-file edits stay silent (that is what allowlists are for).
- Confirmation triggers on: bulk writes (≥ N files), large deletions, overwrites of tracked files, or irreversible operations.
- The threshold must be configurable (`off` / `ask` / `always`), and the confirmation dialog must show a **per-path preview**.

### 6.2 Auto-snapshot + `/rewind`

- Content-addressed snapshots stored in the harness home (not in Git, so it works without a repo).
- Auto-create before agent-initiated writes — at minimum before bulk/destructive operations.
- `/rewind` restores file state and optionally rewinds the conversation to the message that caused the change.
- Never touches Git index/branches/stash. Borrow the Change Ledger contract: rescue point before restore, post-restore hash verification, rollback on failed restore.

### 6.3 Bash operation visibility

- **Cheap tier:** diff the workspace state before/after each Bash call and surface a summary (covers most cases, no infrastructure).
- **Robust tier:** filesystem-level tracking (overlay) during Bash execution; heavier, can be phased later.
- **Session-log guarantee:** any file mutation must persist enough information in the session log to reconstruct the pre-write state — see acceptance criteria.

## 7. Acceptance criteria

1. **Recovery must never depend on external VCS.** A user with no Git and no external tooling must still be able to restore pre-write file states from harness-owned data.
2. Confirmation triggers on blast radius only — routine edits remain frictionless.
3. Snapshot/`/rewind` works in a workspace with **no Git repository**.

## 8. Open questions (for discussion)

- Snapshot storage: per-session TTL? content-addressed dedup? retention policy?
- Interaction with compaction — snapshots vs compacted history (origin kinds already exist in core: `compaction | rewind | rewrite`).
- Should `/rewind` ship as a core command, or as a core API + command? (Both, ideally.)
- Cross-platform (Windows sandbox) implications for the Bash-diff tier.

discussions.title: Show and tell: DSH 1024Store — 开源社区插件目录、自动校验与设置页内市场
discussions.body:
# DSH 1024Store

大家好，我们做了一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 生态的开源社区插件目录和设置页内市场：**DSH 1024Store**。

- 在线目录：https://deepseek1024.com/
- 开源仓库：https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins
- DSH 内市场 npm 包：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-1024store

这是一个**非官方社区项目**。我们的目标不是替代 DSH 的插件机制，而是在官方 `dsh plugin`、profile bundle 和 `dsh.bundle.patch` 契约之上，补齐发现、校验、提交和安装体验。

## 它目前做了什么

- 定期发现带有 `dsh-plugin` GitHub Topic 的仓库，也接受结构化 PR 提交；
- 检查插件仓库的 `package.json`、`dsh.bundle` 声明和 patch 路径等基础安装契约；
- 提供搜索、分类、插件详情和 GitHub 活跃度信息；
- 提供可安装到 DSH 设置页的市场插件，支持搜索、已安装状态检测、确认安装、卸载和操作进度；
- 提供 Agent Skill，帮助插件作者检查仓库并生成最小范围的目录提交 PR；
- 安装时仍调用官方 DSH 插件流程，不维护第二套 package/profile 机制。

安装设置页内市场：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-1024store
```

重启 DSH 后，可在 Settings 中打开 **1024 Store**。

也可以使用开源包装 CLI 安装目录中的插件：

```sh
npx @dsh-1024store/cli add <owner>/<repository> --profile web
```

包装器会委托官方 DSH CLI 执行安装，并检查 profile 的实际安装结果。设置页内安装器不会执行目录返回的任意命令，而是从已校验的 GitHub 仓库地址构造安装 spec。

## 安全与隐私边界

插件会作为受信任的本地代码运行，因此：

- 被目录收录只表示通过基础格式校验，**不等于安全审查、质量背书或官方认可**；
- 安装第三方插件前仍应检查源码、依赖和 package lifecycle scripts；
- 敏感环境建议固定到审查过的版本或 commit；
- 项目的安装统计只记录文档中列出的匿名安装结果字段，不上传命令输出、文件路径、用户名、环境变量、源码、会话或 prompt；当前首次使用会明确提示，可通过 `DO_NOT_TRACK=1`、`DSH_1024STORE_TELEMETRY=0` 或 `npx @dsh-1024store/cli telemetry disable` 完全关闭。

完整统计字段与边界：https://github.com/imsai-sh/awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins/blob/main/docs/install-analytics.md

## 希望获得的反馈

我们尤其希望听到维护者和插件作者对这些问题的意见：

1. 第三方插件目录最应该展示哪些兼容性字段？
2. 除 `dsh.bundle.patch` 外，是否有建议稳定检测的安装契约？
3. 社区市场应如何表达“自动发现 / 格式校验 / 人工整理 / 安全审查”之间的边界？
4. 是否值得共同制定一份机器可读的兼容性与安全元数据规范？

目录元数据采用 CC0，应用与自动化代码采用 MIT。如果社区未来形成更统一的 registry/schema，我们愿意对齐并共享数据。

---

**English summary:** DSH 1024Store is an unofficial, open-source community plugin directory and in-app marketplace built on the official `dsh plugin` and profile-bundle model. It discovers and validates basic plugin manifests, accepts structured submissions, and provides catalog search plus confirmed install/uninstall flows. Catalog inclusion is not a security endorsement. Feedback on compatibility and security metadata is very welcome.
