discussions.title: Turn silently ends right before a tool call is emitted (workspace-write, v0.1.0-rc.6) - intermittent
discussions.body:
**Version:** DeepSeek Harness v0.1.0-rc.6 (developer preview), `dsh web` profile

### Summary
Occasionally, when a session has decided to call a tool and is about to execute it, the turn silently ends: the tool call is never actually emitted (no tool invocation happens), and the turn stops with no supplementary output and no error surfaced. It is intermittent - "sometimes it suddenly triggers".

### Observed behavior
- The session appears to have decided to call a tool; it stalls at the moment right before the call would be executed.
- The tool call is not actually emitted.
- The turn then silently ends: no additional assistant output, no error message, nothing to click/recover.
- Intermittent; no deterministic reproduction yet.
- Happened under the **workspace-write** permission mode (the sandbox mode that restricts command execution and file modifications to the workspace).
- The same behavior was observed under both **Standard Mode** and **Creation Mode** (the prebuilt agent presets), so I am not sure it is specific to either preset.

### Environment
- DeepSeek Harness v0.1.0-rc.6, installed via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh` (`dsh web` profile)
- OS: Windows 10 22H2 (build 19045); Node v24.16.0; npm 11.19.0
- Model: `deepseek-v4-flash` via an OpenAI-compatible provider
- Browser: Chrome-class

### Questions
- Is this a known issue, a bug, or a configuration/usage matter? (I would rather let the maintainers classify it than assert a label myself.)
- What logs/session data would help triage? I can attach them next time it reproduces (durable session logs are stored locally).

### Possibly related
- #1554 - ask_user_question card never appears in the browser; turn hangs indefinitely (pending tool call, no timeout)
- #646 - Reconnect can silently drop pending approval/question waits
- #291 - Undefined behaviour when headless hits an approval-required tool
- #1476 - ask_user_question inside run_code: answer silently dropped from the conversation

(Note on terminology: "workspace-write" is the sandbox permission mode; "Standard Mode"/"Creation Mode" are prebuilt agent presets. I am reporting the same symptom under both presets, not contrasting two "modes".)

discussions.title: dsh-web-shell — collapsible right-docked web terminal for the Web UI
discussions.body:
## What it is

A right-docked web terminal for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI: xterm.js in the browser, bridged over a WebSocket at /api/shell to a host-side PTY (bash/zsh).

## Highlights

- Right dock: the main conversation column makes way instead of being covered (needs dsh-client-ui-layout with the right-dock API).
- Drag the left edge to resize (360–960 px).
- Fold vs close are separated: folding hides the panel but keeps the WebSocket/PTY session alive; closing terminates it.
- bash/zsh switching starts a fresh PTY.
- Configurable font stack through the bundle patch.

## Install

npm (prebuilt, no build approval):

    dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-shell

From GitHub (prebuilt lib/ committed, no allowBuilds step):

    dsh plugin --profile web add github:JesmonX/dsh-web-shell

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/JesmonX/dsh-web-shell
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-shell
- awesome-dsh-plugin entry PR: https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/557

The /api/shell upgrade route uses the same loopback / trusted-host / origin fencing as the /api gateway.

discussions.title: 关于模型切换的建议
discussions.body: ##问题 当前会话只要包含历史图片就无法切换非视觉模型，这会导致用户在视觉模型额度不足或暂时不可用时，无法切换非视觉模型继续利用已有的文字对话。 ##建议修改： ###1. 允许切换到非视觉模型： 含有历史图片的会话应允许切换到不支持视觉输入的模型。 非视觉模型发起请求时： - 历史图片块不发送给模型； - 历史文字和视觉模型此前对图片的分析结果继续保留； - 图片在持久会话记录中保持不变； - 切换回视觉模型后，原始图片可以重新进入请求。 ###2. 不在模型上下文中声明视觉能力 经过测试，省略历史图片时，不能写入类似“当前模型无法查看图片“的内容，以免上下文污染，导致切换回视觉模型后仍然不查看图片。 如果确实需要保留图片位置，只使用中性引用，例如： - `[Historical image file: "example.png"]` - `[Historical image]` 这些文字不会污染上下文。 ###3. 给用户显示明确警告 切换到非视觉模型成功后，在界面中提示： > 当前模型视觉不可用，历史图片不会进入上下文 这个提示只属于 UI，不能进入模型上下文。 新上传或新发送的图片仍应被阻止，因为非视觉模型没有可复用的既有分析结果。 ###4. 在下一轮对话中显示模型变更 模型切换后，不立即把选择动作写入对话记录。 只有用户继续发送消息，并且下一次模型请求真正使用了新模型时，在对话区显示： > 模型已从 A 更改为 B 建议使用居中的时间线分隔样式。 以下情况不显示： - 会话中的第一次模型请求； - 模型实际没有变化； - 用户切换模型后没有继续对话； - 用户在下一轮开始前又切换到了其他模型。 该提示只能是浏览器 UI 投影，不能成为持久消息或模型输入。 ##修改验收标准： 1. 视觉模型 → 非视觉模型可以成功来回切换。 2. 非视觉请求不包含历史图片块。 3. 非视觉请求仍包含已有文字和视觉模型的图片分析结果。 4. 模型上下文不包含“当前模型不支持视觉”等能力判断。 5. 非视觉模型 → 视觉模型后，原始历史图片重新可用。 6. 切换非视觉模型时显示视觉不可用警告。 7. 下一轮真正使用新模型时显示模型变更时间线提示。 8. UI 警告和模型变更提示均不进入模型上下文。 9. 新图片在非视觉模型下仍被拒绝。 目前我克隆了仓库，进行了修改，并且正在测试修改后的功能是否正常

discussions.title: Plugin compatibility report: dsh-mneme flagged high-risk due to static-scan false positive
discussions.body:
dsh-mneme (https://github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme) was flagged as high-risk on dsh.so's automated scan, but all 11 Critical findings are false positives.

## The issue
All 11 Criticals are db.exec(...) calls flagged as shell command execution. These are node:sqlite's DatabaseSync.exec() - executing SQL statements (SCHEMA, PRAGMA, ALTER TABLE), NOT child_process.exec(). There is no shell execution anywhere in the codebase.

## Verification
- Two independent models (Kimi K2.7, DeepSeek V4 Flash) reviewed the findings: no shell injection surface, no child_process/execSync/spawn, all SQL uses parameterized binds.
- The Info findings (fetch, localStorage, process.env) are normal functionality: the Web panel calls its own API; embedding endpoints come from user config, not hardcoded.

## Request
The scan is heuristic and doesn't recognize node:sqlite's db.exec() as a SQL method rather than a shell command. Requesting awareness so other node:sqlite plugins aren't falsely flagged as high-risk. Repo: github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme

discussions.title: Plugin compatibility report: dsh-mneme flagged high-risk due to static-scan false positive
discussions.body:
## Summary

The dsh.so plugin community site (DeepSeek Harness plugin registry) automatically scanned the [dsh-mneme](https://github.com/modusensus/dsh-mneme) plugin and flagged it as **"high-risk"**, reporting **11 Critical issues**. After verification, **all 11 Critical findings are false positives**.

## Root cause of the false positive

The static scanner misidentifies `DatabaseSync.exec()` from Node.js built-in **`node:sqlite`** module as `child_process.exec()` (shell command execution). The scanner's pattern matching cannot distinguish SQL execution on a local database from arbitrary OS shell execution.

## Facts

- **No shell execution exists in the codebase.** Every SQL statement goes through parameterized/bound queries (`db.prepare(...).run(...)` / `.get(...)` / `.all(...)`), never string-interpolated into an exec.
- `db.exec()` is the standard `node:sqlite` API for running SQL scripts (DDL/migrations) against a local SQLite file — it is not a child process call.
- The finding was **independently verified by two models**: Kimi K2.7 and DeepSeek V4 Flash, both confirming the 11 Critical items are misclassifications with no actual shell-execution risk.

## Code locations

- `DatabaseSync.exec()` usages in the embedding/indexing pipeline (SQL DDL + batch inserts) — e.g. `src/db/` module of the plugin.
- All user/query inputs are passed as bound parameters; no input ever reaches an exec string.

## Request

Please ask the scanner to special-case the Node built-in `node:sqlite` `exec` API, or at least suppress `exec()`-family matches when the receiver is a `DatabaseSync` instance. A static scanner that flags every `node:sqlite` plugin as "high-risk" hurts the ecosystem and buries real vulnerabilities under noise.

Happy to provide the full scan report or a minimal repro snippet on request.

discussions.title: Show and tell: orchestration-skill — 长任务不该贵到必须用前沿模型 / Long tasks shouldn't cost like they need a frontier model
discussions.body:
# Show and tell: orchestration-skill — 长任务不该贵到必须用前沿模型 / Long tasks shouldn't cost like they need a frontier model

**orchestration-skill** 是一个给 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent Skill：让**廉价模型**跑出**前沿模型**的长任务可靠性——把可靠性从模型身上搬进结构里。

> 仓库：https://github.com/pridesong/orchestration-skill
> 发布：v0.3.0 · https://github.com/pridesong/orchestration-skill/releases/tag/v0.3.0
> 类型：Agent Skill（`SKILL.md` + 纯 Python 标准库脚本，零依赖）

## 核心逻辑

长任务失败不是因为模型在某一步弱，而是不可靠在长链上复利。与其花钱买更强的模型把整条链装进它的上下文，不如**把长链拆成廉价模型轻松胜任的小步**，让链的可靠性由机械结构承担：

- **状态在磁盘不在上下文** — 每步写 `artifacts/<field>.json`；断点续跑、零上下文损耗、只重跑失败的那一步
- **每个边界有机械门禁** — `validate`/`check`/`compare` 机械拦截幻觉与格式错误，不信任模型自检
- **多次廉价调用 > 一次昂贵调用** — 编排者 + 独立审计 + 动态审计，多脑子补足单次推理弱
- **零引导语派发（T3）** — subagent prompt 是 regex 锁定的文件引用（`T3FILE:v1 读取 <file> 并按内容执行`）；散文无法包裹协议，模型没有漂移空间

## 实测证据（廉价模型全链路）

一个完整医药供应链任务（PVG→EZE 温控空运，1000kg，$11,500 硬预算）在廉价模型上全链路跑通：11 个字段（报价/海关/天气/航线/成本NPV/仪表板/审计/结论）。

降本回退对照实验展示了结构带来的差距：

| | mind-reason（方案内推导） | mind-crusher（翻墙） |
|---|---|---|
| 总成本 | $15,730 | **$12,676** |
| 预算缺口 | $4,230 | **$1,176**（收窄 72%） |
| 预算内可行运量 | 500kg（50%） | ≈888kg（89%） |

且当回修经由运行时 **mind-decider**（读审计证据——固定成本墙 vs 单价墙——再选思维）路由时，精确复现 $12,676：选择是机械可复算的判别决策，不是散文运气。

## 关键机制

- **模块装配**：编排者是装配师不是协议设计师，从模块库挑模块、连线、设路由，模块自带协议
- **op-table 由声明展开**：executor 零推导，`next`/`parallel`/`routing` 展开为排它条件路由表；并行组写同一行 state.csv（多条件 AND）
- **T3 零引导语派发**：六件套协议（fill/rules/schema/data/write/forbidden），派发 prompt 被 regex 锁死
- **mind-decider**：复杂回退不静态绑死思维，策略师判别式运行时读审计证据选重试思维
- **两层审计 + 失败回流**：静态（独立审计装配表）+ 动态（3 次同类失败 → 重新编排）
- **零依赖**：纯 Python 标准库，Python 3.7+ 即可运行

## 文档

- `SKILL.md` — 协议（给 LLM，schema 驱动契约，派发 prompt pattern 锁死）
- `Description.md` — 人类阅读版（理念/架构/工作流）
- `README.md` — 卖点定位 + 实测证据
- 5 个示例：demo-task（线性）/ bad-example（负例）/ eco-analysis（研究）/ quant-adaptive（并行组）/ dsh-client（判别路由）

---

**English summary:** orchestration-skill is an Agent Skill for DeepSeek Harness that makes **cheap models** deliver frontier-model reliability on long tasks by moving reliability out of the model and into mechanical structure (disk-resident state, mechanical gates at every boundary, multi-brain audit, regex-locked zero-prose T3 dispatch). Evidence: a full pharma supply-chain task (11 fields) ran end-to-end on a cheap model; a cost-reduction rework experiment cut the budget gap by 72% ($12,676 vs $15,730), and the runtime mind-decider reproduced the result exactly. Pure Python stdlib, zero dependencies. Feedback welcome!

discussions.title: 有一些问题要怎么解决
Harness 上下文占用指示器：余量显示与实际请求限制存在系统性偏差
discussions.body:
## 受影响版本 / 平台 / 影响类别

- 版本：dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（web profile）
- 平台：Windows 11 / Node 24.x / DeepSeek 官方 API（含 reasoning 的模型）
- 影响类别：上下文占用指示器（UI gauge）分项统计与 API 真实请求计费不一致；推理密集的长会话可能在 UI 显示仍有明显余量时，下一轮请求即触发上下文长度上限错误
- 严重程度：中（可用性/体验；不涉及数据泄露，但会造成长任务意外中断、误导用户判断余量）

## 现象（一句话）

长会话中，UI 显示的上下文占用分项加总明显小于总量（推理 token 未计入分项），且指示器不预留输出 token 预算；当输入占用已偏高（约 3/4）时，任何新请求都会因「输入 + 固定输出预算」超过模型上限而失败，尽管界面看起来还有约 1/5 余量。

discussions.title: aflare: deterministic workflow tools for DSH agents
discussions.body:
One line to install:

```
dsh plugin --profile web add @alib8b8/dsh-plugin-aflare
```

**aflare** is a local-first automation agent and deterministic workflow engine, and this plugin hands its core to DSH agents as 6 native tools:

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `aflare_version` | Installed aflare version |
| `aflare_generate` | Create workflow YAML from a description (optional LLM generation) |
| `aflare_validate` | Validate a workflow YAML |
| `aflare_run` | Execute a workflow and return the output |
| `aflare_template_list` | List built-in templates (300+ skills, 16 domains) |
| `aflare_template_run` | Run a template by ID |

**Why this exists:** chat agents improvise; aflare workflows are deterministic — a YAML DAG with WAL crash recovery, Saga transactional compensation, idempotency, retry/circuit-breaker, and full audit replay. Now a DSH agent can generate, validate, and execute them without leaving your machine: every tool spawns the local `aflare` binary via `execFile` (no shell), and data never leaves localhost.

**Prerequisite:** the `aflare` binary (one-line install):

```bash
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/alib8b8/aflare/main/install.sh | bash
```

**Links:**
- npm: [@alib8b8/dsh-plugin-aflare](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@alib8b8/dsh-plugin-aflare)
- Plugin source: [alib8b8/dsh-plugin-aflare](https://github.com/alib8b8/dsh-plugin-aflare) (dist repo) / [aflare monorepo](https://github.com/alib8b8/aflare/tree/main/integrations/dsh-plugin)
- aflare itself: [alib8b8/aflare](https://github.com/alib8b8/aflare) (AGPL-3.0, Go)
- Also submitted to dsh-index: [Sunrisepeak/dsh-index#35](https://github.com/Sunrisepeak/dsh-index/pull/35)

Happy to hear what workflows you'd want an agent to run deterministically.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] 撤回某条 AI 消息时，该消息所产生的项目文件修改也应一并撤销
discussions.body:
## 描述

当前 DSH 不支持**撤回（unsend / 删除）某一条已经发出的 AI 消息**这个操作。
即使能将消息移除，该消息在对话期间通过工具调用（write / edit / 文件操作等）对项目文件所做的修改也会留在磁盘上，无法随消息一起回滚。

## 现状

- DSH 目前没有撤回某条 AI 消息的能力；
- 对话中 AI 产生的文件副作用没有消息级 undo / 回滚机制。

## 期望行为

希望能够支持撤回某条 AI 消息，并且在该消息被撤回时，将其所触发的所有项目文件修改也一并撤销（回滚），让工作区恢复到该消息执行之前的状态。

## 建议方案

- 希望**不依赖 git，也不要代替用户执行 git 操作**；
- 建议由 DSH 在消息的 tool-call 层面对文件变更自行做快照 / diff，撤回时按逆序回滚对应的文件写入，把回滚的完整逻辑交给 DSH 自己管理。

## 环境

- DSH 版本：v0.1.0-rc.6
- 运行方式：`dsh web`（Web UI）

## 其他

类似能力可参考其他 agent harness 的“消息级 undo + 文件副作用回滚”机制。

discussions.title: New plugin: dsh-mcp-mgr — workspace-level MCP manager for dsh
discussions.body: Hi everyone 👋 I'd like to introduce [**dsh-mcp-mgr**](https://github.com/yangfch3/dsh-mcp-mgr), a plugin that brings Claude/Codex-style MCP management to DeepSeek Harness. **_> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.** ## What it does Declare MCP servers in a workspace's `.dsh/dshmm/mcp.json` — the familiar `mcpServers` format — and they are auto-discovered, hot-synced, and dynamically registered as dsh plugin instances: ```json { "mcpServers": { "unity-mcp": { "type": "http", "url": "http://localhost:8090/" } } } ``` Highlights: - **Workspace MCP**: auto-discovery across registered workspaces, hot-sync on file changes, auto-unload on workspace removal - **Profile MCP display**: unified view of mcp-client registrations from the config tree (profile patch / bundle / `--patch`), with real status and conflict hints - **Settings tab**: manage servers right in the dsh web UI — source, status, remove, and open the source config file - Tools register under dsh's standard `mcp____` naming, so multiple servers and sources are naturally isolated ## Install ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-mgr npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web ``` That's it — the MCP tab appears in Settings. ## Try it, give feedback, contribute This is an early release (v0.1.x), and I'd love to hear from you: - **Feedback & bug reports** → open an [issue](https://github.com/yangfch3/dsh-mcp-mgr/issues) - **Feature ideas** → start a discussion or open an issue - **Code contributions** → PRs are very welcome; the repo is a small, self-contained codebase (host plugin + web UI plugin) The design notes live in `Doc/requirements.md` in the repo if you're curious about the internals. Thanks for reading, and happy MCP-ing! 🚀

discussions.title: [Bug] Compaction request misses provider prefix cache entirely — summarizer doesn't inherit reasoningEffort / adds maxTokens
discussions.body:
# [Bug Report] Compaction request misses the provider prefix cache entirely — summarizer doesn't inherit reasoningEffort / adds maxTokens

Category: **Ideas** (bug report)

## Summary

When `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` triggers a compaction (auto `compactIfNeeded` or manual `/compact`), the summarizer LLM call is sent with **different request parameters** than normal agent turns. Under providers with prefix caching (e.g. the `opencode-go` gateway for `deepseek-v4-flash`), that cache-key divergence makes the **compaction request itself miss the cache completely**, re-billing the entire context (~100k+ tokens) at full price.

## Evidence (real session data, `opencode-go` / `deepseek-v4-flash` / `reasoningEffort: high`)

Before fix — compaction request usage:

```
usage: {"inputTokens":122558,"outputTokens":1584}   // no cacheReadTokens → 100% miss
```

After locally patching `summarizeWithLlm` to inherit `reasoningEffort` and drop the extra `maxTokens` — next compaction:

```
usage: {"inputTokens":402,"outputTokens":3548,"cacheReadTokens":220928}  // 99.7% of prefix reused
```

The shadowed range was ~158k tokens; a full miss means ~122k tokens re-priced on every compaction. In a long-running session with frequent auto-compaction this is a substantial recurring cost.

## Root cause

`dsh-compaction-basic/lib/index.js`, `summarizeWithLlm` (~lines 267-316) builds the summarizer options as:

```ts
{ provider, model, messages, system, tools, maxTokens: config.maxTokens(8192), sessionId, purpose: "compaction", signal }
```

It picks `provider`/`model` from the last routed request header, but **does not inherit the rest of the header config** — notably `reasoningEffort` (we use `"high"`) — and it adds `maxTokens: 8192` that normal turns don't send (normal requests in `dsh-agent-loop` inherit `header.config` wholesale, no explicit `maxTokens`).

The compaction call is intentionally a genuine prefix of the last routed request (per the design comments, so the provider KV cache is reused) — but the differing `reasoning_effort` / `max_tokens` params split the provider-side cache key, defeating that intent.

## Proposed fix

In `summarizeWithLlm`, inherit request parameters the same way `dsh-agent-loop`'s `buildRequest` does: take `agent.session.requestHeader()` → `header.config` (provider/model/reasoningEffort/…), skip fields where `header.adapterDefaults.reasoningEffort === true`, and drop the explicit `maxTokens` override (let the adapter default apply, same as normal turns).

i.e. re-use the header config wholesale instead of cherry-picking `provider`/`model` only.

## Impact / context

- Claude Code's compaction reuses identical cache-safe parameters for exactly this reason ("the only new tokens are the compaction prompt itself").
- With the fix applied, the compaction request hit 220,928 cached tokens and only billed 402 new input tokens in our test.
- This affects any provider/gateway whose cache key includes `reasoning_effort`/`max_tokens` (DeepSeek official KV cache, OpenAI-style gateways, etc.).

Happy to open a PR once contributions are enabled, or provide the patch diff.

discussions.title: Show and tell: 轨迹解读 (Trajectory Reader) — a DSH web plugin that interprets each round of the trajectory
discussions.body:
I built a DSH Web client plugin: **轨迹解读 · Trajectory Reader**.

It adds a new **「轨迹解读」** tab beside 对话/轨迹 in the conversation view ring. For each user round it summarizes what was wanted and how the assistant fulfilled it — 用户需求 / 助手思路 / 执行过程 / 结果 — via a zero-dependency rules engine, plus an optional **✨ AI 过程解读** (per-round LLM narrative through the host `llm` service, cached by material hash). Files touched, commands run, tool usage and errors at a glance; **user messages stay verbatim**.

Install (declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, auto-activates):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @clarkchan/trajectory-reader
# or from source: dsh plugin --profile web add "github:flyingtimes/dsh-trajectory-reader#v0.2.0"
```

- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@clarkchan/trajectory-reader
- GitHub: https://github.com/flyingtimes/dsh-trajectory-reader
- Featured in [awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness) (already merged)

Demo: open any session → click the 轨迹解读 tab → a rules-based interpretation appears instantly; click ✨ AI 解读本轮 for an LLM narrative of that round.

discussions.title: [plugin] dsh-minimal-msys2: A plugin for using git bash or msys2 bash on Windows
discussions.body:
链接：https://github.com/AythyaCrispus/dsh-minimal-msys2

Link：https://github.com/AythyaCrispus/dsh-minimal-msys2

# dsh-minimal-msys2

> [English](README.en.md) | 中文

Windows 极简模式 dsh 插件：在 Windows 上提供与官方极简模式工具定义完全一致的持久 `bash` 工具（`command` 参数、持久 shell 语义），外加 `str_replace_editor`。

## 背景

官方 `minimal`（极简模式）preset 的持久 bash 在 Windows 上无法工作，有两层独立的平台限制：

1. `dsh-subprocess-local` 的终端分配依赖 POSIX 进程检查（Linux /proc、macOS ps），win32 直接抛 `terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`；
2. 即使绕过第一层，默认 `workspace-write` 沙箱会把 bash 包进 Windows ACL 受限令牌 runner，而 MSYS2/Cygwin 运行时在受限令牌下无法创建信号管道（`bash: *** fatal error - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5`），bash 启动即崩溃。

本插件提供 win32 原生 PTY spawn（node-pty/ConPTY，无 POSIX 进程检查），并复用官方 `BashTerminalBackend` 的会话逻辑，因此模型看到的 `bash` 工具定义与官方极简模式完全一致。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AythyaCrispus/dsh-minimal-msys2
```

然后**重启 dsh**。插件启动时会自动把 agent preset 复制到 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/minimal-msys2`（已存在则不覆盖，保留你的修改）。

## 使用

1. 以 **danger-full-access** 模式启动/切换会话（MSYS2 bash 与 Windows 受限令牌不兼容，这是硬限制）：
   ```powershell
   $env:DSH_PERMISSION_MODE = 'danger-full-access'
   dsh web
   ```
   或在 Web UI 的会话设置中把沙箱模式切到 danger-full-access。
2. 新建会话，Agent 选择 **Windows Minimal Mode**（选择器里显示英文名）。
3. 工具列表应为 `bash` + `str_replace_editor`。

## 配置 bash 路径（GUI）

MSYS2 与 Git Bash 的安装路径不同，无需改配置文件：

1. 打开 Web GUI **设置 → 插件配置 →「Windows 极简模式」**（卡片标题跟随界面语言，中文界面显示「Windows 极简模式」，英文界面显示 "Windows Minimal Mode"）；
2. 在 **bash 路径** 输入框填写你的 `bash.exe` 绝对路径（如 `C:/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe` 或 `C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe`），点击 **保存**；
3. 该值写入 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` 的 `DSH_MSYS2_BASH` 条目（经凭据域持久化，绕开 rc.6 的 settings 白名单）；后端启动 bash 时优先读取；点「清除」并保存可恢复默认值。

也可以直接设置环境变量 `DSH_MSYS2_BASH`（优先级高于凭据文件），或编辑 `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/minimal-msys2/agent.cordis.yml` 里 `terminal-bash` 行的 `shellPath`（优先级最低，作兜底默认）。

## 卸载

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-minimal-msys2
Remove-Item "$HOME\.dsh\.agent-presets\minimal-msys2" -Recurse -Force   # 手动删除已复制的 preset
```

## 已知限制

- 必须在 `danger-full-access` 模式下使用（MSYS2/Cygwin 与 Windows 受限令牌的根本不兼容，无法绕过）。
- 非持久：与官方极简模式一致，为持久 PTY shell。
- 依赖 host 已有的 `node-pty`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash`、`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess`（peerDependencies，安装时复用，不重复构建原生模块）。

# dsh-minimal-msys2

Windows Minimal Mode dsh plugin: provides a persistent `bash` tool on Windows whose model-facing definition is identical to the official `minimal` preset (`command` parameter, persistent-shell semantics), plus `str_replace_editor`.

## Background

The official `minimal` preset's persistent bash cannot work on Windows, for two independent platform limitations:

1. `dsh-subprocess-local`'s terminal allocation depends on POSIX process inspection (Linux /proc, macOS ps) and throws `terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`;
2. Even past that, the default `workspace-write` sandbox wraps bash in the Windows ACL restricted-token runner, under which the MSYS2/Cygwin runtime cannot create its signal pipe (`bash: *** fatal error - couldn't create signal pipe, Win32 error 5`) and bash dies at startup.

This plugin provides a win32-native PTY spawn (node-pty/ConPTY, no POSIX process inspection) and reuses the official `BashTerminalBackend` session logic, so the model-visible `bash` tool definition stays identical to the official minimal preset.

## Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:AythyaCrispus/dsh-minimal-msys2
```

Then **restart dsh**. On startup the plugin copies the agent preset to `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/minimal-msys2` (existing files are never overwritten, so your edits survive upgrades).

## Usage

1. Run sessions in **danger-full-access** mode (MSYS2 bash is incompatible with the Windows restricted token — a hard limit):
   ```powershell
   $env:DSH_PERMISSION_MODE = 'danger-full-access'
   dsh web
   ```
   Or switch the session sandbox mode to danger-full-access in the Web UI.
2. Create a session and pick **Windows Minimal Mode**.
3. The tool list should be `bash` + `str_replace_editor`.

## Configuring the bash path (GUI)

MSYS2 and Git Bash install paths differ, so no config-file editing is required:

1. Open Web GUI **Settings → Plugin settings → "Windows 极简模式"** (the card is bilingual; it follows the GUI locale: "Windows 极简模式" in Chinese, "Windows Minimal Mode" in English);
2. Type your `bash.exe` absolute path (e.g. `C:/msys64/usr/bin/bash.exe` or `C:/Program Files/Git/bin/bash.exe`) and click **Save**;
3. The value is stored as the `DSH_MSYS2_BASH` entry in `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` (persisted via the credentials domain, which bypasses the rc.6 settings-namespace allowlist); the backend reads it on every session start; click **Clear** and save to restore the default.

You can also set the environment variable `DSH_MSYS2_BASH` (higher priority than the credentials file), or edit the `shellPath` of the `terminal-bash` row in `$DSH_HOME/.agent-presets/minimal-msys2/agent.cordis.yml` (lowest priority; the fallback default).

## Uninstall

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-minimal-msys2
Remove-Item "$HOME\.dsh\.agent-presets\minimal-msys2" -Recurse -Force   # remove the copied preset by hand
```

## Known limitations

- Requires `danger-full-access` mode (fundamental MSYS2/Cygwin incompatibility with the Windows restricted token; cannot be worked around).
- Persistent PTY shell, matching the official minimal preset.
- Reuses the host's `node-pty`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash`, and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess` (peerDependencies; no native rebuild on install).

discussions.title: [Idea] Add secret-safe environment provenance diagnostics (`dsh env explain <KEY>`)
discussions.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek Harness resolves environment variables from multiple layers and applies additional rules such as bootstrap-only filtering. When configuration fails, users currently have no safe way to determine which layer won or why a value was ignored.

Several discussions expose different sides of the same observability gap:

- #71: a non-file `.env` path is surfaced as a loader warning.
- #190: bootstrap-only entries in a workspace `.env` abort startup.
- #981: an empty project value can mask a valid user credential.

The `dsh doctor` proposal in #1719 focuses on broad runtime and dependency health. This proposal is narrower: explain the resolution of one environment key without exposing its value.

## Proposal

Add a read-only CLI command (name illustrative):

```console
dsh env explain DEEPSEEK_API_KEY --profile web
```

Example output:

```text
key: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
resolved: yes
source: launch environment
layers:
  project .env: skipped (empty)
  user .env: present, lower precedence
  launch environment: selected
value: [redacted]
```

The command could report states such as:

- `selected`
- `absent`
- `empty`
- `rejected-protected`
- `non-regular-path`
- `unreadable`
- `lower-precedence`

A `--json` mode would make the result usable by diagnostic tools and support workflows.

## Security requirements

The command should never print or derive secret material. In particular, it should not expose:

- the raw value;
- prefixes or suffixes;
- hashes;
- value length.

Only the key name, source layer, resolution state, and non-sensitive reason should be returned.

## Open questions

1. Should an explicitly empty value be authoritative, or should resolution continue to lower layers?
2. Should this be a dedicated `dsh env explain` command, part of `dsh doctor`, or an internal API consumed by both?
3. Which layer names and states should be treated as a stable public contract?

Would this kind of secret-safe provenance view fit the intended configuration model?

discussions.title: Proposal: make WorkspaceRegistry.create path-only
discussions.body:
## Summary

At upstream `master` commit [`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a), `WorkspaceRegistry.create(path, title?)` still exposes an optional creation-time title even though the shipped Host route calls it with `{ path }` only. Workspace naming already has the explicit `Workspace.setTitle()` / `workspace.rename` operation.

I prepared a focused reference implementation that narrows the registry contract to:

```ts
create(path: string): Promise<Workspace>
```

## Proposed behavior

- A new record derives its title from `basename(canonicalPath)`.
- Reusing the original path or a symlink returns the existing entity without changing an explicitly renamed title.
- Different canonical paths with the same basename remain distinct records.
- A newly created record is prepended to the durable registry order, as today.

## Compatibility boundaries

Unchanged:

- RPC request remains `{ path }`.
- Host schema and Client contract.
- Workspace persistence/storage schema and existing records.
- Bootstrap behavior and mutable `Workspace.setTitle()`.
- Canonical-path identity and same-basename behavior.

Intentional compatibility effect:

- TypeScript embedders passing a second argument no longer compile.
- Dynamic JavaScript extra arguments continue to be ignored by the runtime.
- The unowned atomic create-and-name shortcut is removed; callers can explicitly rename after creation.
- No compatibility shim or replacement atomic create-and-name operation is added.

## Validation

The reference branch records:

- Focused Workspace + Host/API proxy coverage: 66 tests passed.
- Exact keyless assembled Cordis inspection snapshot + fixture guards: 8 tests passed.
- Typecheck, build, lint, translation pairing, and documentation synchronization passed.
- Final whole-branch review found no Critical, Important, or Minor findings.

One repository-baseline note: `rescope-vendor:check` reports the same 26 pre-existing residues at the official base and on this branch; this contribution changes none of those residue lines. The remaining hygiene sub-checks passed.

## Optional reference implementation

This is reference material for maintainer evaluation, not a request or expectation to accept a pull request or cherry-pick.

- Branch: https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/tree/refactor/workspace-create-path-only
- Design commit: [`65ab8427552b4a7cacb0e249db1928b019a0aa1d`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/65ab8427552b4a7cacb0e249db1928b019a0aa1d)
- Implementation commit: [`3f9660565de3e3ee05e43936e4a830a04863ac0b`](https://github.com/alexzhu0/deepseek-harness/commit/3f9660565de3e3ee05e43936e4a830a04863ac0b)

I did not open a PR because `CONTRIBUTING.md` says the project cannot accept external pull requests at the moment and directs contributions to GitHub Discussions.

Would this path-only contract match the maintainers’ intended Workspace creation boundary?

discussions.title: Bug: service crashes with ENOENT when the %TEMP% spill directory is removed (Windows)
discussions.body:
### Environment

- OS: Windows 11 Pro 23H2 (10.0.22621), x64
- Node.js: v24.16.0
- pnpm: 11.21.0
- deepseek-harness: latest main (0.1.0-rc.5), run from source (`pnpm install && pnpm run build && pnpm dsh web`)

### Description

On Windows, the whole service process crashes with an uncaught `ENOENT` when
`OutputCollector.spillAll()` tries to open a spill log file whose parent
directory no longer exists:

```
node:fs:561
  return binding.open(
                 ^

Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open '%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-<random>\dsh-subprocess-<pid>-1-<random>-stderr.log'
    at openSync (node:fs:561:18)
    at OutputCollector.spillAll (<repo>\packages\subprocess\subprocess-local\src\spawn.ts:169:22)
    at OutputCollector.push (<repo>\packages\subprocess\subprocess-local\src\spawn.ts:134:80)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (<repo>\packages\subprocess\subprocess-local\src\spawn.ts:366:54)
    at Socket.emit (node:events:509:28)
    ...
Node.js v24.16.0
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
```

The crash happened while a task in the Web UI was running a subprocess whose
stderr output exceeded the in-memory cap, triggering the spill path.

### Root cause analysis

1. `privateSpillDir()` (`spawn.ts:90`) creates a `dsh-subprocess-*` directory
   under `os.tmpdir()` via `mkdtempSync`. It is a module-level singleton and
   there is **no code path that ever deletes it**.
2. On Windows, that directory lives in `%TEMP%`, which system cleanup
   (Storage Sense / disk cleanup / third-party cleaners) periodically purges of
   "unowned" directories. The directory vanished while the service was running.
3. `OutputCollector.spillAll()` (`spawn.ts:169`) assumes the directory exists:
   it calls `openSync(this.spillFile, 'wx', 0o600)` directly, with no existence
   check and no retry.
4. The failure occurs inside the `stream.on('data')` handler (`spawn.ts:366`),
   so the exception is uncaught and takes down the entire service process.

Note: this is not just a theoretical race. We observed the crash in practice
~20-30 minutes after starting the service; after the crash, `%TEMP%` contained
no `dsh-subprocess-*` directory at all.

### Steps to reproduce

1. On Windows, `git clone`, `pnpm install`, `pnpm run build`, `pnpm dsh web`.
2. Trigger at least one subprocess spawn so `mkdtempSync` creates
   `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*` (any Web UI task that runs a command will do).
3. Manually delete the `dsh-subprocess-*` directory under `%TEMP%` (or wait
   for system cleanup to remove it).
4. Run a task whose subprocess emits more than the in-memory cap of stderr
   output. The service crashes with the ENOENT above.

### Suggested fix

- In `OutputCollector.spillAll()` (`spawn.ts:169`), ensure the spill directory
  exists before opening the file — e.g. `mkdirSync(this.spillDir, { recursive: true })`
  (or catch `ENOENT` and recreate + retry).
- More robustly, host the spill directory outside the shared system tmpdir
  (application data dir) so external cleanup cannot remove it mid-run.
- Consider wrapping the `data` handler (`spawn.ts:366`) so an output-collection
  failure degrades gracefully (drop output) instead of killing the process.

### Workaround (used to unblock)

Start the service with a dedicated temp directory:

```powershell
$env:TEMP = '<repo>\.dsh-tmp'   # any app-owned dir
$env:TMP  = '<repo>\.dsh-tmp'
$env:TMPDIR = '<repo>\.dsh-tmp'
pnpm dsh web
```

discussions.title: GitHub integration pattern: deepseek-harness-action for PR/Issue/CI workflows
discussions.body:
I want to share a Community GitHub Action project I built: `deepseek-harness-action`.

It is a GitHub integration layer that lets GitHub events flow into DeepSeek Harness worker flows:

`PR / Issue / CI event -> GitHub Action controller -> isolated DeepSeek Harness worker -> review / diagnose / fix -> PR`

DeepSeek Harness already provides a headless runtime for coding-agent style execution, and PR/Issue/CI are naturally strong entry points in GitHub workflows, so this action focuses on that integration surface rather than implementing a new runtime.

Project: https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action
Current release: https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action/releases/tag/v0.2.0

What the source actually implements (checked across action/workflow/source files):
- GitHub PR/Issue/CI trigger handling and command routing in the action input/command layer
- Controller/worker split with policy gates (`trusted-read`, `trusted-write`, `untrusted`) before any mutation
- Docker isolation for trusted flows and dedicated workspace snapshots
- `DeepSeek API Key` / GitHub token never directly exposed to worker process
- Inline review comments + `result-json` output + structured output validation
- sticky progress/result comment lifecycle
- fail-closed behavior for validation, policy, timeout, and controller-phase errors
- issue → PR path with guarded update/creation flow

Representative public E2E links:
- PR review example: https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action/pull/3
- Issue → PR flow: https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action/issues/4 and https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action/pull/5
- CI diagnosis run: https://github.com/Lixiaoyiao/deepseek-harness-action/actions/runs/31874235899

This is **not** an official DeepSeek product; it is a community project.

Please feel free to try it and share feedback in issues/PRs.

discussions.title: [Feature] Composer cannot steer subagent sessions (queue-only) — please expose a steer channel for subagents
discussions.body:
## Problem

Opening a subagent session in the Web GUI, the composer can only QUEUE input — there is no way to steer (interrupt the running turn with fresh input). For a long-running child, a human must wait for the current turn to finish before their message is even seen.

## Root cause (source-verified)

1. `dsh-client-ui-conversation` `lib/client.js` (line ~3503): `keyboard.submit(resolveSubmitMode(running, gesture, subagent === null))` — `steeringAvailable` is hard-coded to `subagent === null`, so every subagent session resolves to queue-only.
2. The ordinary API prompt path does NOT reject subagent sessions: `prompt` -> `turnAgentFor` -> `agentFor` carries no subagent-ownership check (that check lives in `ensureSession`, which other endpoints use). So `agent.steer` on a live child is reachable through the API — only the UI entry is closed.

## Evidence that the agent loop itself supports it

A host-side plugin CAN steer a live subagent: calling `agent.steer(message)` on a running child works (we use it from a cross-session messaging plugin today, and the child observes it mid-turn). The blocking point is purely the composer UI gate.

## Suggestion

Drop the `subagent === null` gate (or expose an explicit steer option) so the composer can steer when the target child is live, falling back to queue when it is not running. This matters for interactive supervision: humans opening a child session mid-run should be able to redirect it immediately, the same way they can for top-level sessions.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] 支持上传通用文件（非图片）/ Support uploading generic (non-image) files in the web UI
discussions.body:
## 需求摘要 / Summary
Web 界面目前只能把图片（PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF）作为附件上传；PDF、Word、Excel、压缩包、源代码等通用文件无法直接上传到会话。要处理文档只能手动把文件放进工作区目录，对普通用户不友好。

The web UI currently only accepts images (PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF) as attachments. There is no way to upload generic files (PDF, Word, Excel, zip, source code, etc.) to the session, which makes it hard to work with documents without manually dropping them into the workspace folder first.

## 期望行为 / Expected behavior
在输入框支持任意类型文件的上传/附加，类似 DeepSeek Chat 的文件卡片 + 上传进度体验。非图片文件可以选择：(a) 作为工作区文件交给 agent，用现有工具读取；或 (b) 通过文件引用机制暴露给模型。

Support attaching/uploading arbitrary file types in the composer, similar to DeepSeek Chat file-card + upload-progress UX. Non-image files could either be (a) placed in the session workspace for the agent to read with its tools, or (b) exposed to the model through a file-reference mechanism.

## 当前绕过方式 / Current workaround
把文件放进会话工作区，再用 @ 路径引用（可用，但需要本地文件访问，且不够直观）。

Putting the file into the session workspace and using @ path references works, but requires local file access and is not discoverable.

## 背景 / Context
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` 的 README 已将此列为已知限制：第一版仅接受 PNG、JPEG、WebP 和 GIF；通用文件、音频、视频需要单独的生命周期与提供方契约。本 issue 请求补齐这一缺口。

The `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment` README already lists this as a known limitation: "v1 accepts only PNG, JPEG, WebP and GIF... generic files, audio, video need separate lifecycle and provider contracts." This issue is a request to close that gap.

discussions.title: [Bug] 任务完成后 Harness 未正确检测产物，界面卡在“运行中”
discussions.body:
产品反馈：任务执行状态检测逻辑缺陷

现象：

AI 执行打包任务后，实际文件已生成在桌面

但 CMD 窗口未正确返回完成信号

AI 持续等待，界面显示“运行中”，用户误以为卡死

建议改进：

任务执行时，除了等待进程返回，应同时检测目标文件是否生成

如果文件已生成（如 ZIP 包），直接判定任务完成

设置超时机制：30 秒内未收到进程返回，但文件已存在 → 自动跳过

这样可以避免因进程通信问题导致的永久卡死

影响：

用户容易误以为程序崩溃，刷新页面导致进度丢失

浪费大量等待时间

降低产品体验和信任度

discussions.title: 【插件分享】dsh-quota-float：悬浮用量卡片，跟着每个对话的模型自动切换
discussions.body:
大家好，分享一个我给 DeepSeek Harness 写的小插件：**dsh-quota-float** 🐳

在网页右下角放一个可拖拽的悬浮卡片，实时显示当前对话所用模型的额度和余额——
**每个对话选了什么模型，卡片就智能显示对应厂商的用量**，多对话共享一个位置，不用来回切页面查了。

![Kimi 额度](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liuliuhuhushui/dsh-quota-float/main/docs/kimi.png)
![DeepSeek 余额](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liuliuhuhushui/dsh-quota-float/main/docs/deepseek.png)

**目前支持：**
- 🌙 Kimi（kimi-for-coding）：5 小时 / 每周限额进度条 + 重置倒计时
- 🐳 DeepSeek 官方：余额 + 赠送金
- 🌋 火山引擎 Ark：API 额度
- ☁️ 阿里云百炼 DashScope / BSS 账户账单

**特性：**
- 随对话模型自动切换数据源，零手动配置
- 从 DSH 自己的凭据链读 API Key，不用单独配置
- 可拖拽、可折叠、60 秒自动刷新
- 3 次重试 + 5 分钟缓存 + 过期兜底显示，网络抖动不白屏
- 零依赖、跨平台（Windows / macOS / Linux），Node ≥ 22.13

**一条命令安装：**

```bash
dsh plugin add @liuliuhuhushui/dsh-quota-float

源码 & 详细文档：👉 https://github.com/liuliuhuhushui/dsh-quota-float npm：👉 https://www.npmjs.com/package/@liuliuhuhushui/dsh-quota-float

觉得好用的话求个 Star ⭐，有 bug 或想支持的厂商欢迎来 Issues 聊！🐳

discussions.title: [Idea] Cordis 插件面板的版本下拉：悬停显示每个版本的用途说明
discussions.body:
在用 Cordis 面板切换插件版本时，下拉框里只有 `包名 · pkg-8` 这样的标识，选之前看不到这个版本是干嘛的，只能盲选或者一个个点。

我本地做了一个小改进：把版本下拉换成自定义组件，鼠标悬停（或键盘聚焦）在某个版本选项上时，会弹出一个气泡显示这个包当时填写的 purpose（用途/更新说明），当前选中的版本尾部带个勾。这样翻版本历史就像看更新日志，不用点一下看一行。

改动只涉及 `packages/extensions/ui-cordis` 的面板 UI，不动插件运行逻辑——选版本依然只是"预览"，实际切换运行还是要按行尾的运行按钮。

已经在我的 fork 里实现并跑了一段时间：https://github.com/GammaChineYov/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/cordis-version-purpose-tooltip

如果官方觉得这个交互值得收编，可以直接参考；如果暂时不做，也希望能看到这个需求方向（插件面板的版本管理对多版本插件的日常维护挺重要的）。

discussions.title: Tool dispatch fails with cryptic "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')" when tool runtime becomes unavailable - turn dies until restart
discussions.body:
_Note: This report was prepared and posted on behalf of a community user by an AI assistant, at the user's request. It is based on the user's real local DSH portable installation (v0.1.0-rc.6, Windows) — the diagnosis comes from actual session logs and source inspection._

## Summary

When the agent tool runtime becomes unavailable, every tool call in a turn fails with the cryptic TypeError `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`, the turn dies with `reason: { kind: "error" }`, and nothing recovers until the DSH service is restarted. Session-level recovery (fork / rewind / new conversation) does not help.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 (portable install), Node v22.20.0, Windows
- Third-party plugins (`dsh-find-plugin`, `dsh-web-plugin-manager`) were installed at the time and removed later

## Symptom (from the session log)

A failing turn looks like (no `tool/result` is ever recorded):

```
tool/call  run_code
step/end
turn/end  reason: { kind: "error", error: { message: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')", code: "UNKNOWN" } }
```

Every subsequent turn that calls any tool fails the same way until the server process is restarted.

## Root-cause analysis

The failure happens at `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:169`:

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

Importantly, `ctx.tools.executionMode(...)` (line 88) succeeded earlier in the same dispatch — so `ctx.tools` itself existed, but `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` was `undefined`. `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a module-local `Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")`. Two plausible causes:

1. **Duplicate module instance.** If a second copy of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` is loaded (e.g., pulled in by a profile plugin's dependency tree), the symbol constant differs between the two module instances, so `ctx.tools[<runtime copy's symbol>]` is `undefined` while string-keyed methods like `executionMode` still resolve. (In our environment the profile indeed had its own `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` copy.)
2. **Runtime plugin-tree change.** cordis supports in-process plugin updates (`cordis-plugin-loader`'s `internal/update`); installing / uninstalling / toggling plugins at runtime disposes and rebuilds plugin fibers, and already-running agents can resolve a torn-down or mid-rebuild tools service.

## Proposed fix (minimal, purely diagnostic)

Add an availability guard at the start of `executeToolCalls` in `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` (right after `const { session } = agent`):

```ts
// Guard: surface a clear diagnostic instead of the cryptic
// "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
const toolsMissing = ctx.tools === undefined
const schedulerMissing = !toolsMissing && ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] === undefined
if (toolsMissing || schedulerMissing) {
  throw new Error(
    '[dsh-agent-loop] tool runtime unavailable: ' +
    (toolsMissing
      ? 'the tools service is not mounted on ctx'
      : 'TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER is missing on ctx.tools (likely a duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools module instance or an in-flight plugin-tree change)') +
    '. Restart the service to rebuild the plugin tree.',
  )
}
```

Benefits:
- Turns fail with a clear, actionable message instead of a TypeError that looks like an unrelated bug.
- The guard fires before `appendToolCall`, so a failed dispatch no longer leaves a dangling `tool/call` event in the session log.

Related observation: the turn/end error code is hard-coded to `"UNKNOWN"` in the agent-loop's turn-error normalization (near the `turn/end` append in `packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts`). Making this class of failure carry a stable code (e.g. `TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE`) would let clients detect and explain it programmatically.

## Impact / suggestion

- The guard is diagnostic only; the underlying remedies are: avoid mutating the plugin tree while agents are running, and avoid duplicate `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` instances in profile dependency trees.
- Happy to provide a full patch / tests if the team wants it (noting CONTRIBUTING.md says external PRs are not accepted at the moment — this is posted as a bug report + proposal).

---

# 中文版 (Chinese version)

> 说明:本报告由 AI 助手应社区用户要求代为撰写与发布,基于用户在本地 DSH 便携安装(0.1.0-rc.6, Windows)中遇到的真实情况,诊断来自实际会话日志与源码检查。

## 概述

当 agent 的工具运行时失效时,回合中的每一次工具调用都会报晦涩的 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`,回合以 `reason: { kind: "error" }` 结束,且只能通过重启 DSH 服务恢复。会话级手段(派生/回退/新建对话)均无效。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6(便携安装)、Node v22.20.0、Windows
- 当时装有第三方插件 `dsh-find-plugin`、`dsh-web-plugin-manager`(后来已移除)

## 现象(来自会话日志)

失败回合形如(始终没有 `tool/result`):

```
tool/call  run_code
step/end
turn/end  reason: { kind: "error", error: { message: "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')", code: "UNKNOWN" } }
```

此后该服务实例中每个调用工具的回合都以同样方式失败,直到重启进程。

## 根因分析

报错发生在 `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts:169`:

```ts
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec)
```

关键在于:同一派发流程里前面的 `ctx.tools.executionMode(...)`(第 88 行)是成功的——说明 `ctx.tools` 本身存在,但 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 是 `undefined`。`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是模块级 `Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler")`。两个合理成因:

1. **模块重复加载**:如果进程里加载了第二份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`(例如被某个 profile 插件的依赖树带进来),两份模块实例的 Symbol 常量不同,`ctx.tools[运行时副本的Symbol]` 就是 `undefined`,而字符串键方法(如 `executionMode`)仍可解析。(我们的环境里 profile 确实存在第二份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`。)
2. **运行中插件树变更**:cordis 支持进程内插件更新(`cordis-plugin-loader` 的 `internal/update`);运行中安装/卸载/开关插件会 dispose 并重建插件 fiber,正在运行的 agent 可能解析到被拆除或重建中的 tools 服务。

## 建议修复(最小、纯诊断)

在 `packages/core/agent-loop/src/tool-calls.ts` 的 `executeToolCalls` 开头(`const { session } = agent` 之后)加可用性守卫:

```ts
// Guard: surface a clear diagnostic instead of the cryptic
// "Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')".
const toolsMissing = ctx.tools === undefined
const schedulerMissing = !toolsMissing && ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] === undefined
if (toolsMissing || schedulerMissing) {
  throw new Error(
    '[dsh-agent-loop] tool runtime unavailable: ' +
    (toolsMissing
      ? 'the tools service is not mounted on ctx'
      : 'TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER is missing on ctx.tools (likely a duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools module instance or an in-flight plugin-tree change)') +
    '. Restart the service to rebuild the plugin tree.',
  )
}
```

收益:

- 失败回合给出清晰、可操作的信息,而不是看似无关的 TypeError。
- 守卫在 `appendToolCall` 之前触发,失败派发不再在会话日志里留下悬空的 `tool/call` 事件。

顺带发现:回合错误码被硬编码为 `"UNKNOWN"`(agent-loop 的 turn/end 错误归一化处,位于 `packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts`)。若此类失败能携带稳定错误码(如 `TOOLS_UNAVAILABLE`),客户端就能程序化识别并解释它。

## 影响 / 建议

- 守卫只是诊断性的;根本性对策是:不要在 agent 运行时改动插件树,并避免 profile 依赖树里出现重复的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`。
- 如需完整补丁/测试可提供(注:CONTRIBUTING.md 说明目前暂不接受外部 PR,本帖以 bug 报告+方案形式提交)。


---

## Reference implementation (open-sourced)

A community reference implementation of the session-recovery workflow is now open-sourced:

**https://github.com/LiuJunheng/DeepSeekHarnessGreen → [`plugins/dsh-session-rewind`](https://github.com/LiuJunheng/DeepSeekHarnessGreen/tree/master/plugins/dsh-session-rewind)**

It includes:

- A **WebUI plugin** that lists sessions, analyzes them turn-by-turn (user prompt / step count / tool-call errors / completion status), and recovers poisoned conversations by **forking at any completed turn** (based on the official `session.fork` + `sessions.open`). Since the orphan `tool_calls` only lives inside the crashed turn, forking from the previous completed-turn boundary cleanly drops the poisoned tail while keeping all earlier history — a more convenient alternative to "start a new session" when you want to keep the conversation.
- `tools/rewind-session.mjs` — an offline rewind script (truncates a session log back to the last completed turn, with automatic backup) for maintenance windows.
- `tools/apply-agentloop-guard.mjs` — the diagnostic guard patch described above, as an idempotent re-appliable script.

Built for DSH 0.1.0-rc.6; depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session@0.1.0-rc.6` (auto-installed into the profile). MIT licensed.

discussions.title: 可能的工具 Schema 不匹配导致 danger-full-access 会话产生多余沙箱升级
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh`：`0.1.0-rc.6`
- 复现时文件策略：`danger-full-access`
- 复现时审批策略：`never`
- 平台：macOS
- Provider：`ciiicodex`
- 模型：`gpt-5.6-sol`
- API：`openai-responses`

## 现场现象

在受影响的会话中，执行普通命令：

```bash
pwd
```

生成的工具调用却携带：

```json
{
  "sandbox_permissions": "danger-full-access",
  "justification": "..."
}
```

此时有效权限已经是 `danger-full-access`，命令在实际执行前被拒绝：

```text
sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call current "danger-full-access" mode
```

文件写入也出现相同行为。重启 DSH 后，在该环境中仍可复现。

将策略暂时切换为 `workspace-write + ask` 后，相同的自动升级请求可以在人工审批后执行，因为此时 `danger-full-access` 确实是更高权限。但这只是绕过现场症状，并未修复 optional 参数被填充的问题。

## 期望行为

普通命令在 `danger-full-access` 会话中不应携带可选的权限升级参数，也不应请求同级权限升级。

## 已确认的事实

- `approveEscalation()` 拒绝 `danger-full-access -> danger-full-access` 是正确的安全行为。
- DSH 持久化的 bash 工具 Schema 中，required 只有 `command` 和 `description`。
- `sandbox_permissions` 和 `justification` 在 DSH 原始 Schema 中是 optional。
- 这些 optional 字段已经出现在 provider 返回的 `tool-call-chunks` 原始流中，不是 DSH 执行器后补的。
- 相同现象跨 bash、read、grep、glob、write 和 update_goal 系统性出现，并非 sandbox 特例。

## 当前根因判断

当前证据指向自定义 `openai-responses` 兼容链路：`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 目前无法为自定义 Responses route 配置 `supportsStrictMode`，因此 `pi-ai` 完全省略工具定义中的 `strict` 字段，而不是显式发送：

```json
"strict": false
```

在该 provider 链路中，省略 `strict` 后，模型工具调用会系统性填入 optional 参数。这与 Vercel AI #11869 报告的 Responses API/Gateway 行为高度相似：

https://github.com/vercel/ai/issues/11869

## 尚未确认的边界

客户端证据尚不能进一步区分 optional 字段究竟由 `codex.ciii.club` 网关填充，还是其后端模型生成。但可以确认：DSH 持久化的 required Schema 正确，异常字段来自 provider 响应。

## 建议修复方向

在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 中开放：

```ts
supportsStrictMode?: boolean
```

允许自定义 `openai-responses` route 配置：

```yaml
compat:
  supportsStrictMode: true
```

并将该配置传入最终的 pi-ai model compat。对于普通 DSH 工具，这应使 wire payload 显式包含：

```json
"strict": false
```

该能力建议保持显式启用，不要对所有第三方 Gateway 默认开启，因为部分非标准端点可能不接受 `strict` 字段。

更完整的轨迹统计、源码链路和测试建议见下方根因分析评论。欢迎维护者帮助确认最终发送给 provider 的工具定义，以及该兼容开关最合适的配置位置。

discussions.title: 在 DeepSeek Harness 上写插件:从 0 到 85KB 持久插件的 10 个坑(实测)
discussions.body:
DeepSeek Harness(dsh)发布 5 天,10.8 万 star,插件生态刚开始。我们做了第一个"吃透 DSH 原生机制"的深度插件——给 agent 一份项目记忆(仓库:https://github.com/scd13150/dsh-cognition)。以下是全过程踩坑实录,每条都标了现象、根因、正确做法,基于 rc.6 实测;官方已声明 developer preview 会有破坏性变更,以下内容以 rc.6 为准。

### 1. 动态插件(cordis_define/run)的三个边界

**坑 1:cordis_run 报 `policyFor(...) is not a function`,还残留 "running" 僵尸。**
根因:插件代码(工具执行链可达处)引用了未声明全局,比如 `setTimeout`——运行版策略预检拒绝,错误被包装成看似无关的 policyFor。正确做法:一律 `inject: ['timer']` + `ctx.timeout/ctx.interval`,不要用裸 setTimeout。

**坑 2:动态包是实验形态,不是部署形态。** 它只存在于进程内存,重启即失、以会话为界,官方明说"不能自动转为正式插件"。要做长期能力,直接上 agent preset + 常规 ESM 插件文件(见第 4 节)。

**坑 3:spawn 子代理里 define 的插件,主进程看不到。** spawn provider 是独立进程,子代理的 define 随其进程退出消失。要在主进程生效,只能在主会话 define 或走持久形态。

### 2. fs 服务的五参契约与 FsTarget

`fs.resolve(path)` 返回 **FsTarget 对象**,不是字符串——**禁止字符串拼接路径**,把 resolve 结果直传 readText/writeText/editText。

写入必须显式五参:`fs.writeText(t, content, undefined, undefined, policy)`——不传 policy 时隐式解析可能退化为只读,工作区写入被拒。**无会话调用**(事件回调、persist(null))必须以插件工作区为根自构 policy:`{ mode: 'workspace-write', workspaceRoot: <宿主工作区> }`,不能用 `sandboxPolicy.resolve({})` 的部署默认根(可能是服务器 cwd,踩过 FS_SANDBOX_DENIED)。

编辑失败是**抛异常**(FS_EDIT_NOT_FOUND/FS_AMBIGUOUS_EDIT/FS_STALE_VERSION),不是返回错误对象——catch 后按 `e.code` 细分错误码,别只按 message 正则猜。

### 3. 工具管线:哪些事件值得监听

按价值排序,我们实测:

| 事件 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `tools/pre-execute`(waterfall) | deny 硬闸:未定向拒写、scope 锁、shell 写命令拦截(扫描 pwsh/bash 的 arguments.command) |
| `tools/result`(emit,冻结) | **审计真源**:最终结果不可篡改,对账"声明 vs 真相" |
| `fs/edit-intent`(waterfall) | 内核级版本守卫:每一次写都过版本检查,外部改动即刻暴露 |
| `tools/post-execute`(waterfall) | read 结果追加提示、edit 后记录 patch 观测 |
| `agent/turn-stopping`(serial) | 任务自动闭合、状态落盘的安全时机 |
| `systemPrompt.context` | **每步上下文注入**——观测信号每步主动可见,这是 Cursor 系给不了的 |

注意:pre-execute 是 waterfall 且有顺序,多插件监听时硬闸插件要保证注册序在前。

### 4. agent preset:持久插件挂载的正确姿势(最容易绕晕的一节)

- preset = 目录 + `agent.cordis.yml`(插件行列表)+ 可选 `preset.yml`
- **插件行支持相对路径**:`name: ./my-plugin.mjs` 从 preset 目录解析——插件文件放进 preset 目录,预设可整体迁移
- **代际语义(必懂)**:preset 以组装文件 mtime/size 为 stamp。**已运行会话保持旧代际,只有新会话挂新代际**——改 agent.cordis.yml 不影响任何在跑会话;挂载失败会回滚会话创建,备份 agent.cordis.yml 是标准操作
- 子代理走 `composeFrom()` 认父——**加入的是父方正在运行的组装,不是新代际**;spawn 子代理永远看不到父会话之后改的 preset
- 服务行必须放 `cordis:group` + `isolate` realm(否则发布进根 realm 被挂载审计拒绝);只注册工具/监听事件的行不需要
- 常规 ESM 插件导出形状:命名导出 `name`/`inject`/`apply`,**无默认导出**(默认导出会丢 inject)

### 5. sessionQuery:全文搜索可能被部署禁用

`searchSessions/searchEvents`(FTS)在 `openAt: "never"` 的部署下抛 `SESSION_QUERY_SEARCH_DISABLED`——**部署差异是常态,客户端必须做降级**。

禁用时的替代路径(filterSessions + filterEvents 字面扫描)实测够用:
- 会话记录形状:`{ header: { id, cwd, createdAt, agentPreset }, live, persisted }`——**cwd 在 header 里**
- SessionResultFilter 是判别联合:`{kind:'cwd', values:[...]}`、`{kind:'created-at', from, to}`——字段名不是直觉的 `{cwd: x}`
- `tool/call` 的语义文本 = 工具名 + `\n` + JSON 参数——**file_path 可以直接从文本正则提取**,这是"历史会话先例检索"的合法路径

### 6. skills 知识层的两个形态

- runtime provider(`ctx.skills.registerProvider`):目录每次 assemble 可见,零常驻 token;`control.invalidate` 是主动失效钩子
- 文件形态(skill-filesystem):发现根 rank 100 = `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills`;**正文每次加载重读文件,改文件即更新,无 hash/修订协议**——"知识随仓库走"的官方路径
- frontmatter 必填 `name`(kebab-case)与 `description`;格式错误会被静默排除(无诊断,排查时注意)

### 7. 通用工程纪律(血泪)

1. **路径键空间统一是第一优先**:同一数据(文件路径)在多处做键,必须同空间(root 前缀/反斜杠/`./` 前缀)。我们踩过三次:git 矩阵键、先例支持度键、focus/mutate 双轨解析。修复是把规范化函数下沉为唯一入口并配断言。
2. **生成代码的 TDZ**:跨文件引用后置 const 定义,只有异步回调才调用时安全——fixture 若不覆盖该路径,TDZ 会漏到生产。给每个"通道 on/off/异常"配集成断言。
3. **镜像修复纪律**:同一逻辑在多个产物(动态版/持久版/碎片)重复时,修一处必须 grep 全部镜像点——我们有"修复没镜像,持久形态复现老 bug"的事故。
4. **观测字段别硬编码**:趋势/埋点字段若写死默认值,该字段就是"看似有实则空"。

### 8. 结尾

完整版(含沙盒事实、更多细节)在仓库 `docs/DSH_DEV_EXPERIENCE.md`。我们用它建成的插件是 **DSNLE(dsh-cognition)**:给 DSH agent 一份项目记忆——历史先例检索、scope 锁、跨会话认知积累,全部 DSH 原生机制实现,47 次真实修复上游验收、去 gold 化 20/20,边界全公开。

仓库:https://github.com/scd13150/dsh-cognition
安装:clone 后 `node install-dsnle.mjs --set-default`,新会话即生效。

欢迎 star、issue、以及指出文中任何与你的 rc.6 体验不符的地方(开发者预览,一切以实测为准)。

discussions.title: 建议：命令面板（输入框"+"菜单）中的命令名称/描述未本地化
discussions.body:
# 建议：命令面板（输入框"+"菜单）中的命令名称/描述未本地化

## 环境

- DSH 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`（Web GUI）
- 界面语言：中文（zh）

## 问题描述

界面语言为中文时，输入框左侧"+"按钮（或输入 `/`）打开的命令面板中：

- **分组标题已本地化**（如"命令"、"技能"、"子智能体"）✅
- 但**命令项显示英文命令名 + 英文描述** ❌

复现示例（zh 语言下）：
- `/export` → 描述显示 `Download this Session log as a ZIP archive`
- `/compact` → 描述显示 `Compact older conversation history`

## 根因分析（已排查源码）

命令面板（slash 菜单）中每个命令项渲染的是**宿主命令注册表的 `name` + `description` 原文**，这两个字段**不经过 locale 翻译系统**：

1. 客户端 `ui-input-trigger` 的 `MenuView` 直接渲染 `item.name` / `item.description`（`packages/client/ui-input-trigger/src/client/MenuView.tsx`）——只有分组标题 `t(group.source)` 走 locale；
2. 命令候选来自 `ui-commands` 的 `commandUi.menuCandidates()`，直接把宿主目录的 `c.name` / `c.description` 映射为菜单项（`packages/client/ui-commands/src/...`）；
3. 宿主命令注册要求 `description` 为**纯字符串**（`packages/interaction/commands/src/index.ts` 中校验 `typeof definition.description !== "string"` 抛错），各功能包注册的是硬编码英文：
   - `dsh-session-log-export`：`name: "export", description: "Download this Session log as a ZIP archive"`
   - `dsh-command-compact`：`name: "compact", description: "Compact older conversation history"`

因此这些英文无法通过现有的 locale 字典补全（它们不是 t() 键）。

## 建议方案

1. **命令描述支持本地化**：允许命令注册的 `description` 为 i18n key（或在 `CommandDescriptor` 上携带 `localeKey`），客户端菜单/命令列表按当前 locale 渲染描述；
2. **命令名保留英文标识符**（用户需要输入 `/compact`，名称不宜翻译），仅**描述**本地化；
3. 至少为内置命令（`export`、`compact`、`model`、`plan` 等）补充 zh 描述。

## 影响

zh 语言用户看到的"+"命令面板中命令项为英文，界面汉化不完整。该问题同样影响所有非英文语言的本地化工作。

discussions.title: 希望常规会话能直接调用原生工具,而非所有操作都经 run_code
discussions.body:
当前某些预设下,agent 的所有工具操作都通过 `run_code`(Code Mode)间接执行——先写一段 TypeScript/Python 代码,再在其中调用 read/write/bash 等工具。这带来几个体验问题:

1. 操作不直观:用户看到的是一条 `run_code` 调用,而不是"读了哪个文件、执行了哪条命令"。
2. 审批粒度粗:难以逐条确认每个具体操作。
3. 学习成本高:非编程用户看到大段代码会困惑。

建议:常规(默认)会话直接调用原生工具(read/write/bash 等),或提供清晰的开关让用户在"原生直调 vs Code Mode"之间切换,并默认原生直调。

补充:从源码看 `standard` 预设未显式设置 `mode`(应回落 `native`),只有 `code` 预设是 `mode: code`;如果默认 standard 也出现 `run_code` 独占,烦请一并确认是否另有配置原因。

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-pet-evolve — the pet that grows with your agent (5 stages, real signals, share cards)
discussions.body:
## 中文

**dsh-pet-evolve — 会随 agent 一起成长的宠物。** 不是静态贴图，宠物的每个形态都是真实信号挣来的。

### 特性

- **5 阶段进化**：蛋 → 幼崽 → 少年 → 成年 → 传说（300 / 800 / 1600 / 3000 XP）
- **真实成长来源**：已验证规则（兼容 dsh-rule-evolve 规则库）、完成会话、工具调用、压缩摘要
- **agent 状态镜像**：working / done / failed / idle 实时反映会话日志
- **一键成长分享卡**：1200×630 PNG（"My agent pet reached Legend"）
- **喂食/玩耍交互** + 本地持久化
- **零依赖、100% 本地、零遥测**

### 使用

```sh
npx dsh-pet-evolve                          # 独立运行
npx dsh-pet-evolve --profile ~/.dsh/profiles/web   # 绑定真实 DSH 信号
npx dsh-pet-evolve --report                 # 无头成长报告
```

DSH 插件模式（`lib/` 已提交，安装无需构建）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zoahdev/dsh-pet-evolve
```

### 验证

- 引擎 + 适配器 10/10 测试（node:test）
- CLI 报告 + 本地服务冒烟（页面 + /api/state）
- CI：测试 + 产物完整性 + 报告冒烟

仓库：https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-pet-evolve 路 Release v0.1.0

### 设计动机

宠物图鉴给你看贴图；这里相反——宠物形态是 **agent 成长的证据**。把 dsh-rule-evolve 的"验证驱动学习"变成看得见、可分享的生命体。

---

## English

**dsh-pet-evolve — the pet that grows with your agent.** Not a static sprite: every form is earned from real agent signals.

### Features

- **5 evolution stages**: Egg → Baby → Teen → Adult → Legend (300 / 800 / 1600 / 3000 XP)
- **Real growth sources**: verified rules (dsh-rule-evolve compatible), completed sessions, tool calls, compaction summaries
- **Agent-state mirroring**: working / done / failed / idle from session logs
- **One-click growth share card**: 1200×630 PNG
- **Feed/play interactions** + local persistence
- **Zero dependencies, 100% local, zero telemetry**

### Usage

```sh
npx dsh-pet-evolve
npx dsh-pet-evolve --profile ~/.dsh/profiles/web
npx dsh-pet-evolve --report
```

DSH plugin mode (committed `lib/`, no build at install):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:zoahdev/dsh-pet-evolve
```

### Verification

- 10/10 engine + adapter tests (node:test)
- CLI report + live server smoke (page + /api/state)
- CI: tests + artifact integrity + report smoke

Repo: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-pet-evolve · Release v0.1.0

### Why

Pet galleries show you sprites. Here the pet's body is the **evidence of your agent's growth** - verification-driven learning (dsh-rule-evolve) turned into a living, shareable companion.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] 历史消息含图片时，允许切换到纯文本模型 / Allow switching image-containing sessions to text-only models
discussions.body: Hi DeepSeek Harness 团队，使用过程中发现一个与模型切换有关的问题，想在这里反馈一下。 ## 问题描述 在历史消息中包含图片的会话里，尝试切换到不支持图片输入的模型时，操作会被直接拒绝，无法完成切换。 ## 复现步骤 1. 在会话中发送一张图片。 2. 图片相关问题处理完毕后，尝试切换到 DeepSeek V4 Flash 等不支持图片输入的模型。 3. 切换被拒绝，报错： `Model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model.` ## 推测的原因 检查相关代码后发现，切换模型时，`selectModel` 会检查当前会话中是否还有图片，以及目标模型是否支持图片输入。如果会话中有图片，而目标模型明确不支持，就会直接报错并拒绝切换。 DSH 使用的底层依赖中已有图片降级函数 `downgradeUnsupportedImages`。当模型不支持图片时，它可以把历史消息中的图片替换成文字占位符。这个机制本来可以用来处理上述场景，但目前没有被用于模型切换：模型选择阶段的检查更早生效，直接阻止了切换。 ## 期望的效果与建议 有些任务必须借助图片才能说明清楚，这时可以先使用视觉模型；图片相关的问题处理完以后，如果后续不再需要图片，用户可能希望切换到性价比更高的纯文本模型，例如 DeepSeek V4 Flash。 建议允许用户切换到纯文本模型，可以复用现有的 downgradeUnsupportedImages 机制，也可以采用其他合适的处理方式。 至于是否需要用户确认，可以在交互上增加提示或确认框，明确告知用户：目标模型不支持图片，历史图片会被替换成文字占位符；确认后再完成切换。 ## 运行环境 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` - Web UI - Windows ## 截图 见附图。 感谢阅读，希望这个建议能对后续体验改进有所帮助。 --- ## English Version ### Allow switching image-containing sessions to text-only models via the existing image downgrade capability Hi DeepSeek Harness team, I noticed an issue while switching models and would like to share it here. #### Description When a session contains images in its message history, switching to a model that does not support image input is rejected. #### Steps to reproduce 1. Send an image in a session. 2. After the image-related task is complete, try to switch to a model that does not support image input, such as DeepSeek V4 Flash. 3. The switch is rejected with the following error: `Model "deepseek-v4-flash" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model.` #### Possible cause After checking the relevant code, I found that `selectModel` checks whether the current session still contains images and whether the target model supports image input. If the session contains images and the target model explicitly does not support them, the switch is rejected immediately. The underlying dependency used by DSH already has an image downgrade function named `downgradeUnsupportedImages`. When a model does not support images, this function can replace images in the message history with text placeholders. This existing mechanism could be used for the scenario above, but it is currently not applied during model switching: the earlier model-selection check blocks the switch first. #### Expected behavior and suggestion Some tasks require a vision model because images are necessary to explain the problem. After the image-related part is complete, if images are no longer needed, users may want to switch to a more cost-effective text-only model, such as DeepSeek V4 Flash. It would be helpful to allow users to switch to a text-only model, either by reusing the existing downgradeUnsupportedImages mechanism or through another suitable approach. If confirmation is considered necessary, the UI could show a warning or confirmation dialog explaining that the target model does not support images and that historical images will be replaced with text placeholders before completing the switch. #### Environment - `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` - Web UI - Windows #### Screenshot See the screenshot above. Thank you for taking the time to review this feedback.

discussions.title: 插件分享：dsh-wildmon —— 你的真实工作就是草丛（宝可梦式捕捉收集，零 token）
discussions.body:
**仓库**：https://github.com/swaylq/dsh-wildmon · MIT · 纯 JS 零依赖 · `dsh plugin --profile web add github:swaylq/dsh-wildmon`

## 你的真实工作就是草丛

回合、消息、工具调用、报错 —— 每件真实发生的事都有几率惊动草丛，冒出一只野生小灵：

```
野生的 碎屏蛙 Shardtoad 出现了！◇ 常见 · 故障岭

  ▚ ▞▚ ▞
 ( ⊙ ﹏⊙ )
  ⟋⟍  ⟋⟍

图鉴里还没有它的记录。
它大约还会停留 10 分钟
球 ×7 —— /mon throw 投球 · /mon run 撤退
```

`/mon throw` 投球（摇三下，咔哒），集 28 格图鉴，带 6 只队伍。工作方式决定你遇见谁：写文件跑命令惊动锻造窟，读代码查资料惊动墨书林，报错震醒故障岭，深夜 00:00–05:59 有夜行种。三只传说各守着自己的出现条件（其中一只每 250 个回合浮出水面 —— 向黑鲸致个敬）。异色 1/64。

## 和 dsh-digipet 是姊妹作

上周发的 [dsh-digipet](https://github.com/swaylq/dsh-digipet) 是**一只**宠物的深度养成（孵蛋 → 进化）；wildmon 是**一群**小灵的广度收集（遭遇 → 捕捉 → 图鉴 → 队伍）。两个同装共存，互不干扰。查重口径：`dsh-plugin` 话题 2800+ 仓库与四个精选列表里，捕捉/收集玩法此前零命中。

## 信任立场（与 digipet 相同）

不注册模型工具、不注入上下文、不写会话事件 —— **模型从头到尾不知道它存在，零 token 开销**。监听的全是通知型事件且全部 try/catch 包裹；只读写自己的存档（`$DSH_HOME/wildmon/state.json`，原子写入）；无网络。所有概率常数都写在 `core.js` 顶部。

在 dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` 真机验证：无 API key 靠失败回合的真实事件刷出遭遇并完成捕捉，存档与事件逐项对账；61 个单元/集成测试。全部 28 只小灵的命名与 ASCII 立绘均为原创，不含任何官方名称或素材（README 有「致敬与边界」声明）。

---

**English summary**: dsh-wildmon is a collect-em-all safari where your real work is the tall grass — turns, tool calls and errors spawn wild encounters; throw balls, fill a 28-slot dex, walk a team of six. Sibling of dsh-digipet (raising vs collecting), installs side by side. Zero tokens, zero tools, no model-facing surface; listeners are notification-only and try/catch-wrapped; writes only its own save. Verified live on 0.1.0-rc.6 with 61 tests. All 28 species are original work.

discussions.title: dsh-compass 已发布,右侧文件夹面板和只读 git tree
discussions.body:
这个面板写了两天,今天刚发布到 GitHub。仓库在 [Happy2Git/dsh-compass](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass),先给这里的社区看一眼。

dsh-compass 是一个单包插件,装进 web profile 以后,对话区右侧多出一块固定面板,和左侧边栏对称。面板里有三个标签。

文件夹标签是一棵惰性目录树。列目录时目录排前面,文件排后面,两组各自按名字排序,指向目录的符号链接算目录。点击文件行直接在中部弹出预览,支持 Markdown 渲染和普通文本,256 KiB 以上的文件截断显示。每行都能复制路径,也能用系统默认应用打开。

![dsh-compass 文件夹标签](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass/raw/main/screenshots/01-files-tab.png)

Git 标签画只读提交图,参照了 vibe-ide 的 GitGraph。泳道按分支排,合并回到主干,HEAD 和标签都有徽章。点击提交懒加载改动文件,新增、修改、删除三种状态,行数变化也一起显示。

![dsh-compass Git 标签](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass/raw/0856888/screenshots/02-git-tab.png)

上下文标签列出本次会话注入的上下文文档,指令文件和运行时注入分开标记,支持往前翻更早的页面。面板头部还有会话日志下载,导出一个 ZIP。

安装走官方插件通道,一条命令。git 安装会触发包的 prepare 构建,首次需要按提示放行一次。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Happy2Git/dsh-compass#v0.1.0
```

有一点要说清楚。面板依赖槽位系统,这套系统已经在当前 master 里,但最后一次 npm 发布早于它。所以在下一个版本发布以前,只能装到从 master 构建的 dsh 上,或者装到我们维护的 fork 上。fork 的默认 web profile 已经内置了这套面板,想用插件版本的话,把内置四行在 profile 补丁里禁用即可,README 里有完整说明。

我们把面板和它依赖的能力面一起开源了,git 能力、目录路由、面板本体都写在包内,不碰核心网关。欢迎试用,有什么想法直接在仓库提 issue。

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Web UI: no way to delete a conversation/session
discussions.body:
## Problem

In the DSH Web GUI, there is NO way to delete a conversation (session). The session row's "..." context menu only offers Rename, Fork, and Archive. There is no Delete option - unlike workspace rows, which do have a Delete action.

## Expected behavior

A way to delete a conversation from the sidebar, for example:
- A "Delete" item in the session context menu (with a confirmation dialog), that removes the session data permanently, and/or
- A trash / recycle-bin mechanism with restore, consistent with the existing Archive feature.

## Current workaround

Session data lives under ~/.dsh/sessions/<workspace>/session-<uuid>/session.jsonl.zstd . Deleting that folder manually removes the conversation, but this is not discoverable and is unsafe while DSH is running.

## Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (web UI, http://127.0.0.1:3080)
- OS: Windows 11

## Related code

- dsh-client-ui-workspace - SessionNodeItem context menu only defines rename / fork / archive items (menu.archiveSession), no delete item.
- Workspace rows (ProjectRowItem) do have a delete item, so the pattern already exists.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Web UI: archived sessions cannot be viewed or restored
discussions.body:
## Problem

The session context menu has an "Archive session" action, which hides the session from every sidebar view (workspace groups, flat list, and search results). However, there is NO UI entry point to view archived sessions or restore (unarchive) them. Once archived, a session disappears and cannot be recovered through the UI.

## Expected behavior

- A "Show archived" toggle or an "Archived" section in the sidebar that lists archived sessions, and
- A "Restore" (unarchive) action on archived sessions so they reappear at their previous position.

## Notes

The backend already supports the data model for this:
- archivedSessionIds is persisted durably in the workspace state (~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json), returned by the workspace.archiveSession API.
- Archived sessions keep their slot in the workspace sessionIds; comments in @deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace state: "an archived session keeps its sessionIds slot so unarchiving restores its position".
- But no unarchive API endpoint and no archived-list UI exist yet, so archiving is effectively one-way hide.

## Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (web UI, http://127.0.0.1:3080)
- OS: Windows 11

## Related code

- dsh-client-ui-workspace - sessionVisible() filters out archived.has(session.id) from all views; WorkspaceBrowser reads archivedSessionIds but renders no archived view.
- dsh-workspace - WorkspaceRegistry.archiveSession() appends to archivedSessionIds; no unarchive method.

discussions.title: Custom pi-ai routes lose catalog-known modalities — inheritance is keyed by provider route, not model id
discussions.body:
> **中文 TL;DR**：自定义 OpenAI 兼容路由（如 sub2api 反代 OpenAI 官方模型 id）下，即使已安装的 pi-ai catalog 明确记录了该 model id 支持 image 输入，模态继承也只按 provider 路由键查找；查不到就静默回退 `['text']`，导致带图会话无法切换到该模型。建议为手写路由增加一层按 model id 的 catalog 继承。

## Setup

A custom OpenAI-compatible route fronted by a translation proxy (sub2api) that serves genuine upstream model ids. The route key is a private one, so every model entry is hand-declared with just an id:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-gateway:
      apiKeyEnv: MY_GATEWAY_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://sub2api.example.com/v1
      models:
        - id: gpt-5.2
        - id: gpt-5.6-sol
        # ...
```

## Symptom

- A session that already contains images cannot switch its model to any model on this route — `selectModel` refuses with *"Model ... does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model."*
- Sending a new image is refused by `prompt` with `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` → "当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型".

Both gates live in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` and call `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model)`.

## Root cause

`resolveRouteModels` in `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` resolves input modalities as:

```
input: declaredInput(entry.input) ?? base?.input ?? [...request.defaultInput]
```

where `base = catalogModels(provider).get(entry.id)` and `catalogModels(provider)` indexes the installed catalog **by the provider route key**. A hand-declared route key that pi-ai does not ship yields an empty `defaults` map, so even model ids the installed catalog fully describe inherit nothing and fall through to `DEFAULT_INPUT = ['text']` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/config.ts`).

The part that stings: with pi-ai 0.82.1, the generated catalog already knows these ids — `MODELS['openai']['gpt-5.6-sol']` (and every other gpt-5.x) records `input: [text, image]` with `contextWindow: 272000`. The information is present in the very package the adapter imports; only the route-key indirection loses it. Nothing interrogates the gateway, which is a deliberate posture — but here the answer is already local.

For contrast: routes whose key happens to match an installed catalog provider inherit modalities per model id, which is why one settings file can work for those routes and break only for the hand-declared key.

## Workaround (works today, hot-reloads)

- route-level `defaultInput: [text, image]` covering every undeclared model on the route, or
- per-model `input: [text, image]`, or
- naming the route key `openai` so it becomes a catalog route (keeps the custom `baseURL`) — at the cost of the custom display name, and non-catalog entries (e.g. `gpt-image-*`) still fall back.

## Suggestion

For hand-declared routes (route key not shipped by the installed catalog), add one model-id-keyed inheritance layer between `base?.input` and `route.defaultInput`:

- if the entry's id exactly matches a single model in the installed catalog across all providers (or models all from one provider), inherit its `input` — and possibly `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` / reasoning capability — as the next resolution layer;
- ambiguous ids (the same id under multiple providers) keep today's behavior.

This keeps the conservative `['text']` floor for genuinely unknown models — under-claiming refuses an image up front and names the model, while over-claiming gets rejected mid-turn after the message is durable — while proxies serving genuine upstream model ids keep the correct modalities for free.

Related: #356 covers the same admission gate for hand-declared models in general; this discussion is the narrower case where the installed catalog already knows the exact model id and the route-key indirection is the only thing dropping it.

discussions.title: Source launch duplicates dsh-typert-protocol for out-of-tree plugins, silently disabling their Remote layer
discussions.body:
## Follow-up: source launch silently breaks the Remote layer of every out-of-tree plugin

Reporting a concrete instance of the extensibility gap discussed above, with a reproduction and a root cause.

### Symptom

A third-party plugin installed under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<profile>/node_modules/` registers a `TypertRemoteService` subclass with `@Remote` methods. The host half loads correctly and its model-facing tools work. Every one of its `/api/<namespace>/<method>` endpoints returns a bare `404 not found`.

A 404 from `RpcHost` means `TypertGatewayService.claimsEndpoint()` returned false — the request never reached argument validation, so there is no error, no log line, and nothing that points at the real layer. The plugin author reasonably concludes their namespace is unsupported.

### Root cause

`remoteMethods()` reads decorator markers from a module-private `WeakMap` (`packages/typert/protocol/src/index.ts:126`).

Under the documented source launch (`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`), tsx applies the repository `tsconfig.base.json` `paths` at runtime:

```jsonc
"@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol": ["./packages/typert/protocol/src/index.ts"]
```

The host therefore loads the protocol from `src/`. A plugin installed under `$DSH_HOME` is outside the tsconfig scope, so its identical bare import resolves the ordinary Node way to `lib/index.js`.

Two module instances, two private `WeakMap`s:

- the plugin's decorator initializers register markers into the **lib** copy
- `collectSrcClaims()` / `resolveSrcDescriptor()` read the **src** copy and find nothing

The SRC fallback is doing exactly what it should; it simply cannot see markers written into a different module instance.

### Evidence

Measured under the source launcher, comparing the copy the plugin's compiled class extends against the copy the host uses:

```
plugin base class === src copy of TypertRemoteService : false
plugin base class === lib copy of TypertRemoteService : true
Remote / remoteMethods identical across copies        : false
```

Single-variable intervention — same profile, same plugin commit, only the launcher changed:

| Launcher | `POST /api/pluginMarket/status` |
| --- | --- |
| `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web` | `404 not found` |
| `node apps/cli/lib/bin.js web` | `{"ok":true,"value":{"totalPlugins":1164,...}}` |

Switching my own host to the built launcher fixed the plugin's Settings UI with no change to the plugin.

### Why this is worth addressing rather than documenting

The failure is silent on both sides and the observable symptom points at the wrong layer. It affects the exact population the plugin system is meant to serve: developers running DSH from a checkout while installing community plugins into `$DSH_HOME`. It also generalizes beyond Typert — any cross-package registry keyed by module-private state (decorator metadata, `instanceof` checks, Symbol registries, memoized singletons) has the same exposure.

### Possible directions

1. **Make duplication detectable.** Have the protocol module register its instance identity on a `globalThis` symbol at load and warn when a second instance appears. One log line would have replaced this entire investigation.
2. **Make the Gateway's miss diagnosable.** When `claimsEndpoint()` rejects an endpoint whose namespace matches a live Cordis service that carries a `typertRemote` binding but exposes no markers, that specific combination is almost certainly module duplication and could say so instead of 404.
3. **Resolve framework packages for out-of-tree plugins through the host's own module registry**, so a plugin loaded by the Loader shares the host's protocol instance regardless of launcher.
4. At minimum, state in the plugin-authoring documentation that the source launcher is not a supported host for plugins installed outside the repository.

Directions 1 and 2 look cheap and independent of whichever way 3 is resolved.

### Environment

DSH `0.1.0-rc.5`, Windows, plugin installed with `dsh plugin --profile web add <github spec>`.

discussions.title: [Bug] Tool calls fail with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading prepare)' — unclear error, hard to debug
discussions.body:
## Bug: Tool calls fail with 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading prepare)' — unclear error, hard to debug

### Environment
- DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm)
- Windows 11
- Node v24.14.0 / v24.19.0 (both tested)
- deepseek-v4-flash

### Symptom
When the agent invokes any tool (e.g. `pwsh`), the turn fails with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` / `UNKNOWN`. No stack trace in UI or server logs. Session history shows `turn/end` with `reason: {kind: "error", error: {message: "...reading 'prepare'...", code: "UNKNOWN"}}`.

### Investigation
Narrowed to `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`: `prepare()` calls `this.coordinator.prepare(id, signal)` (lib/index.js ~816), and `this.coordinator` is `undefined` when `PersistenceCoordinator` was not constructed — but no error is logged at plugin load, so it fails silently until the first tool call.

Ruled out: custom preset vs standard (both fail), cordis.patch.yml plugins, Node version (both fail), full npm reinstall (still failed).

**Fully wiping `~/.dsh` (profiles/sessions/storages) and re-initializing fixed it.** So corrupted/legacy state in `~/.dsh` can leave the persistence coordinator partially initialized, surfacing only at tool-call time with an opaque message.

### Suggestions
1. Fail fast at boot if session-persistence fails to initialize its coordinator.
2. Surface full stack trace / error context in `turn/end` error events and the UI (not just message + UNKNOWN).
3. Make the JSONL backend resilient to corrupted storage files (validate/migrate `storages/workspace.json` and session logs on boot).

discussions.title: Windows 下点「停止」后回合被中止了, 但 turn/end 序列化失败, 变成了 host/agent-error
discussions.body:
Windows + DSH 0.1.0-rc.6

点击 Web GUI 的「停止」按钮中断正在运行的回合

回合确实被中止了, 但客户端收不到 turn/end aborted
取而代之的是 host 广播的 agent-error

## 日志

浏览器 console 里第三方插件收到:

```
session event "turn/end" carries non-JSON-serializable data
```

## 根因链

1. 点击停止 → agent loop 追加 turn/end { kind: "aborted", reason: signal.reason }
2. Windows 下 AbortSignal 的默认 reason 是 DOMException, 不可 JSON 序列化
3. Session.append 的序列化校验抛错(dsh-session 的 snapshotJsonValue 校验)
4. loop 的 finally 捕获后 throwError → 宿主广播 host/agent-error
5. 于是「用户主动停止」这个事件丢失了 aborted 语义, 变成了一个看起来像故障的 agent-error, 第三方插件无法区分这是用户取消还是真的故障, 容易误触发自动恢复(我们插件就踩了, 见参考链接)

## 一些建议

turn/end aborted 的 reason 在 append 前做 JSON 安全处理

signal.reason 是 DOMException / Error 时, 序列化为 { kind: "user" } 或 message 字符串

这样取消语义能正常到达客户端, 序列化失败不会吞掉 aborted

## 参考

我们插件因此误发过「继续」, 完整复现链与修复见
https://github.com/HsiangNianian/dsh-auto-continue/issues/2
