discussions.title: [Unofficial] dsh-cross-session-agent: safe coordination across Harness sessions
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial third-party plugin.** This project is not affiliated with, reviewed by, endorsed by, or supported by DeepSeek or DeepSeek Harness.

## What it is

[`dsh-cross-session-agent`](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent) helps independent Harness sessions coordinate when multiple agents are working in the same repository. It is designed for file-ownership coordination, blocker/handoff reports, avoiding duplicate work, and checking limited progress evidence before sending a deliberate peer message.

It contributes four tools:

- `list_peer_agents`: discover eligible peer sessions and runtime metadata
- `send_agent_message`: send one explicit coordination message
- `check_delivery`: inspect native transport receipts without claiming read/reply/completion
- `get_peer_context`: read a bounded, same-`cwd` context/activity projection

## Privacy and trust boundary

`get_peer_context` does **not** expose an arbitrary transcript or search API. It allows only a different, unarchived, non-subagent Session with the exact same non-empty `cwd`.

Conversation output contains only the folded current surface: direct user text, canonical compaction checkpoints, and completed assistant text. Activity contains structural turn/step state plus tool name/status/time, a one-way call-id fingerprint, and sanitized error code. Hidden reasoning, raw tool inputs/results/meta, system prompts, plugin/relay/scheduled messages, approvals, inbox data, attachments, todos, credentials, unknown events, and shadowed history are excluded.

Peer text is always untrusted background data. It cannot grant permissions, replace user approval, change configuration, or prove that work completed. The plugin has no network calls, telemetry, independent database, or parallel transcript store; Harness remains the data owner.

This boundary follows the same isolation principle used by official cross-session/subagent designs: explicit messages and bounded final/current projections, not implicit sharing of private histories or tool traces.

## Install and compatibility

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent
```

Current release: [`v0.1.0`](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent/releases/tag/v0.1.0), tested against DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6` on Node 24.

Validation performed:

- source tests: 46/46
- package allowlist and `pnpm pack --dry-run`
- packed-plugin live rc.6 profile E2E
- same-workspace conversation + structural activity read
- cross-workspace authorization fail-closed
- native relay persistence with the new source/tag
- manual static scan: no runtime network, telemetry, environment-secret reads, or independent file persistence

Security/privacy details: [SECURITY.md](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent/blob/main/SECURITY.md), [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent/blob/main/PRIVACY.md), [architecture](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent/blob/main/docs/architecture-v2.md).

The project is MIT and independently maintained. It derives from `GengDaPeng/dsh-agent-message` v1.5.1 under MIT; attribution is retained in [NOTICE.md](https://github.com/dd2673/dsh-cross-session-agent/blob/main/NOTICE.md).

discussions.title: DSH｜DSH Testkit｜真实宿主插件生命周期测试 / Real-host plugin lifecycle testing
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**
>
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.**

**项目地址 / Project URL:** https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit  
**v0.3.1:** https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/releases/tag/v0.3.1  
**npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-testkit/v/0.3.1

![DSH Testkit real-host lifecycle evidence](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/main/docs/assets/dsh-testkit-showcase.png)

## 中文

AI 可以很快写出一个 DSH 插件，但“代码能生成”“包能安装”并不能证明发布产物能在真实 DSH 中完成启动、注册、调用、卸载和重启。

**DSH Testkit** 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 插件的确定性真实宿主生命周期测试工具。它会把插件打包，在一次性 Docker 环境中安装精确版本的 DSH，启动真实宿主，验证配置与运行时注册，执行不依赖模型的最小能力调用，然后卸载插件并重启同一个 profile，最终保留 JSON、JUnit、Markdown、脱敏日志和阶段证据。

```text
resolve → install-dsh → package → install-plugin → assemble → boot
        → register → exercise → update? → uninstall → reboot → recover? → cleanup
```

### v0.3.1 一键接入

```bash
pnpm add -D dsh-testkit
pnpm dsh-test init
pnpm dsh-test
```

`init` 离线读取插件声明的 bundle patch，只生成三个可审核文件：

- `dsh-testkit.yaml`：精确 DSH 版本和自动识别的 row 预期
- `.github/workflows/dsh-lifecycle.yml`：最小权限的真实生命周期 CI
- `.agents/skills/dsh-testkit/SKILL.md`：让兼容的 coding agent 在开发、review 和发布时主动使用同一套门禁

命令幂等，不修改 `package.json`、lockfile 或 `AGENTS.md`；冲突或 symlink 路径会在任何目标写入前失败，除非显式使用 `--force`。

GitHub Actions 仍可直接使用：

```yaml
- uses: iiwish/dsh-testkit/.github/actions/dsh-test@v0
  with:
    plugin: .
    dsh-version: 0.1.0-rc.6
```

它也提供可选的 DSH 原生 `dsh_test` tool 和 `dsh-testkit` Skill。外部 CLI/CI 仍是独立发布闸门：如果插件让宿主在 tool 注册前就启动失败，宿主内工具无法自救。

### 已验证的发布证据

- 111 个 unit、integration 和 contract tests
- 8 个真实 DSH 生命周期 fixture
- 真实 profile 中的原生 bundle、`dsh_test` 调用和 Skill discovery
- 干净公共 npm consumer、tarball scaffold 和完整卸载
- 受保护分支 CI、CodeQL、publint、actionlint、依赖审计和 npm SLSA provenance

它不做安全认证，也不评测模型输出质量。静态 manifest/preflight、plugin doctor、组合检查和插件单元测试仍然各有必要；Testkit 专注真实宿主中的单插件生命周期。

### 首批维护者招募

我们想邀请 **5 个 DSH 插件维护者**作为首批设计伙伴：

1. 以精确插件版本和精确 DSH 版本运行 Docker quick lifecycle。
2. 共同确认插件所需的 row/service/tool 与 prerequisite profile。
3. Testkit 维护者可以提交一个可审核的 CI 接入 PR。
4. 失败先私下或在插件仓库中提供可复现证据；未经复现和维护者知情，不做点名排名。
5. 反馈会优先影响 prerequisite profile、跨平台 runner 和下一批 Agent 工作流设计。

愿意参与可以直接在本帖留言，或在仓库创建 issue：
https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/issues

当前支持：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`。DSH 仍处预览期，支持范围会以真实 canary 证据逐版本更新。

---

## English

AI can generate a DSH plugin quickly, but generated code and a successful package install do not prove that the release artifact can boot, register, execute, uninstall, and reboot inside a real DeepSeek Harness host.

**DSH Testkit** packs the plugin, installs it beside an exact DSH version in a disposable Docker environment, boots the real host, verifies configuration and runtime registration, performs deterministic model-free exercise, uninstalls the plugin, reboots the same profile, and retains reviewable JSON, JUnit, Markdown, sanitized logs, and stage evidence.

v0.3.1 provides the three-command adoption flow above. `dsh-test init` works offline and creates only a scenario, least-privilege workflow, and project-local Agent Skill. It is idempotent, refuses implicit replacement and symlink paths, and does not edit package manifests, lockfiles, or repository instructions.

The same canonical `dsh-testkit` Skill ships in npm and registers in the native bundle when DSH exposes its optional Skills service. It helps compatible coding agents choose and interpret the lifecycle gate; it does not authorize untrusted execution or replace review.

A pass is environment- and scenario-bound lifecycle evidence. It is **not** a security certification, a model-quality evaluation, or a replacement for unit tests, static preflight, plugin doctors, or composition checks.

We are recruiting **five DSH plugin maintainers** as initial design partners. We will help define the smallest deterministic scenario, run the exact release in Docker, and prepare an opt-in CI integration PR. Findings are shared with reproducible evidence; named public failure claims are not made before reproduction and maintainer awareness.

Reply here or open an issue: https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/issues

Current host support: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`.

discussions.title: Proposal: Zero-loss pruning (spill-copy-on-prune)
discussions.body:
# Proposal: Zero-loss pruning (spill-copy-on-prune)

## Context

DeepSeek Harness's `compaction-tool-result-pruner` (threshold 8192, head 4096, tail 1024) and `spill-policy` (maxInlineBytes 50000) are independent mechanisms:

- **Prune tier** (8K–50K): permanently drops the middle with a fixed marker `[... tool result middle pruned ...]` — no recovery path.
- **Spill tier** (>50K): writes full output to disk, inline preview with locator.

The prune tier's permanent loss is by design but unnecessary — the spill infrastructure already exists.

## Proposal

**Merge the tiers**: when the prune tier fires, also write the full output to a spill file (same `ctx.spillStore`), and include the file path + exact elided span `[start, end)` in the marker. The middle is dropped from context (same context savings) but recoverable from disk (zero information loss).

### Marker upgrade

Current: `[... tool result middle pruned ...]`

Proposed (with spill copy):
```
[pruned — full output at <spill-path>; grep to recover]

<head 4096>

[... middle pruned: 4390 code points omitted [4096, 8486); full output at <spill-path>; grep or slice to recover ...]

<tail 1024>
```

The short prefix at position 0 survives compaction serialization (which truncates tool results to 2000 chars). The full marker in the middle gives exact offsets for precise recovery. The model uses these to `grep` or `sed -n 'START,ENDp'` the spill file.

### Recovery-loop prevention

`read` results targeting a file inside the spill directory should pass through untouched — otherwise reading a spill file to recover the pruned middle would re-prune it (infinite loop).

## Evidence

Benchmarked with 19 live sessions (glm-5.3 + deepseek-v4-flash) using a pi extension implementing this design:

| Scenario | Standard | With zero-loss pruning | Δ |
|---|---|---|---|
| Uncached prefill | 10-16K tok | 1.5-3K tok | **−72% to −88%** |
| Transcript chars | 51-55K | 3-10K | **−81% to −93%** |
| Correctness | ✓ | ✓ (same answers) | parity |
| Hallucinations | 0 | 0 | — |
| Recovery via spill file | N/A | confirmed (grep + sed) | — |

Key finding: a deepseek-v4-flash model, given a 30K fake test log with an AssertionError at position 12K (in the pruned middle), recovered the correct root cause by `grep`-ing the spill file for `FAIL|AssertionError` then `sed`-ing the exact lines. Zero hallucination — the marker's omission count made the loss legible.

## Implementation notes

This is a plugin-level change in dsh's architecture — the pruner plugin would call `ctx.spillStore` before dropping the middle. No core changes needed (everything is a plugin). The `dsh-plugin` topic exists for this kind of contribution.

Config: `pruneSpillCopy: boolean` (default true; false reverts to current permanently-lossy behaviour for disk-constrained environments).

## Files

- Working extension code (pi): `~/.pi/agent/extensions/tool-result-pruner/` — 32 tests, tsc clean
- Benchmark harness: `/tmp/pi-bench/` — prompts, driver, analyzer, 19 session transcripts

discussions.title: 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛：Pi 生态两种识图能力，两条命令安装
discussions.body:
给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛，同时把 Pi 插件生态直接接进来——这是 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) 最近完整跑通的能力。

Pi 有一套很丰富的 Agent 插件生态。pi2dsh 做的是一层通用 **Pi Host ABI → DeepSeek Harness** 兼容引擎：兼容的 Pi 插件保持 npm 上发布的原样，不 fork、不改源码，也不需要为每个包写一套转换代码。

## 安装只有两步

```sh
# 引擎只装一次
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh@0.11.0

# 之后直接安装兼容的 Pi 插件原包
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

装完重启 DeepSeek Harness。pi2dsh 会从 profile 的显式依赖中发现并挂载 Pi 插件；引擎和插件可以分别升级，互不绑定。

## 给 DeepSeek Harness 装上看图的眼睛

DeepSeek 官方文本模型本身不接收图片，但很多 Agent 工作流又必须看截图、读图或检查页面。pi2dsh 会自动为每条 text-only 模型路由注册一个独立的 **Vision Bridge** 伴生路由，不需要手工修改模型能力声明。

模型选择器里会同时保留原始 DeepSeek 分组和独立的 **DeepSeek + Vision Bridge** 分组：

![DeepSeek + Vision Bridge model picker](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/01-vision-companion-model-picker.png)

选择伴生分组后，Web 可以像使用原生多模态模型一样直接粘贴图片：

![image accepted by a text-only DeepSeek session](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/02-image-accepted-by-text-only-model.png)

然后有两种工作方式可以选择。

### 方式一：自动识图

安装 [@kassing/pi-vision](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kassing/pi-vision)：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @kassing/pi-vision
```

它会在 DeepSeek 推理前调用你配置的视觉模型，把图片分析结果作为 Harness 原生的 context injection 注入。主模型不需要主动调用工具，直接基于分析后的文字回答。

```sh
export OPENROUTER_API_KEY='<your-openrouter-key>'
export VISION_BRIDGE_BASE_URL=https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
export VISION_BRIDGE_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
export VISION_BRIDGE_API_KEY=$OPENROUTER_API_KEY
```

OpenRouter is only a public example. DashScope/Qwen-VL, a self-hosted vLLM, or any OpenAI-compatible vision endpoint works the same way. The key comes from the environment and is never stored in pi2dsh source.

真实 Web 验证结果：

![vision result injected into text-only DeepSeek](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/main/docs/posting-kit/assets/03-vision-bridge-answer.png)

图中可以看到 `pi2dsh:@kassing/pi-vision` 的上下文注入，纯文本 DeepSeek 在一轮一步内正确回答了图片颜色。

### 方式二：Agent 按需识图

如果希望 Agent 自己决定什么时候看图，可以安装 [pi-vision-tool](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi-vision-tool)：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi-vision-tool
```

这种方式先把视觉模型按 DSH 官方 `llm-pi-ai` 配进 `$DSH_HOME/settings.yaml`，然后选择该路由：

```sh
export PI_VISION_PROVIDER=my-vision
export PI_VISION_MODEL=qwen/qwen2.5-vl-72b-instruct
```

完整的 DSH gateway 配置示例：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/custom-gateways

它提供 `describe_image` 工具。Agent 可以按任务需要控制识图提示词、图片压缩和视觉推理深度，适合 OCR、UI 检查、错误截图分析、坐标定位和图片对比。

已有 MCP / skill / script 只要能读取文件路径也可以直接复用：Vision Bridge 会把 Web 附件物化为临时文件，并把路径交给 Agent。

## 整条链路

```text
Web 粘贴图片
  → Vision Bridge 接受并物化附件
  → 自动视觉插件分析，或 Agent 调用 describe_image
  → 视觉结果以文本进入上下文
  → 原始 DeepSeek 文本模型继续推理
```

在发往 DeepSeek 官方文本 adapter 前，图片块会被递归移除，因此文本模型接口始终只接收文字。

CLI 和 Web 两端都已完整跑通，仓库里提供了测试图片和从安装到复现的完整示例：

- GitHub：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh
- 视觉示例：https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/vision-bridge
- npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi2dsh

如果你也想把兼容的 Pi 生态插件直接用在 DeepSeek Harness 上，欢迎试用、提场景，也欢迎给项目一个 Star。

discussions.title: 【Bug】test-invariants 代理使 ctx.plugin 首挂载崩溃，Loader/服务测试无法隔离运行（附复现与受影响包）
discussions.body:
### 一句话

`scripts/test-invariants.ts` 的 `ctx.plugin` 代理使任意插件在全新 Context 上的首次挂载崩溃（`fiber.ctx.fiber` 为 undefined），导致 Service 测试与 Loader 组合测试无法隔离运行（`vitest run <包路径>` 即可触发）。

### 复现步骤

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run packages/llm/llm/tests/service.spec.ts
# 或
pnpm exec vitest run packages/web/web/tests/web.spec.ts
# 或
pnpm exec vitest run packages/todo/tool-todo/tests/loader-composition.spec.ts
```

### 实际结果

任一上述命令都会让该文件的几乎全部用例失败，报错在 `scripts/test-invariants.ts:95`：

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'PENDING')
  const initiallyPending = fiber.ctx.fiber.state === FiberState.PENDING
```

并伴随未处理拒绝：`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'ACTIVE')`（`requireActive` 处，`scripts/test-invariants.ts:229`）。

实测受影响（全部在隔离运行下复现）：`packages/llm/llm/tests/service.spec.ts`（71 failed）、`packages/web/web/tests/web.spec.ts`（19 failed）、`packages/todo/tool-todo/tests/loader-composition.spec.ts`（4 failed）。新建的 `packages/vision/tool-vision/tests/loader-composition.spec.ts` 同样触发。

### 根因分析

`scripts/test-invariants.ts` 代理了 `RegistryService.prototype.plugin`（约 line 69）。对全新根 Context 的首个 `ctx.plugin()` 调用：

1. `startInvariantHost(root)` 挂载 InvariantRegistry 与包伴生 companion，`ready` 链异步提供 `TEST_INVARIANT_READY_SERVICE`。
2. 代理随后用 `withInvariantReadiness(plugin, callback)` 把用户插件包装成 `{ apply, inject: { testInvariantReady: null } }` 对象形态并挂载。
3. 挂载后同步读 `fiber.ctx.fiber.state`（line 95）——但被包装插件的 fiber 在就绪服务提供前 `ctx.fiber` 为 undefined，于是抛 TypeError。

即：代理对被 `withInvariantReadiness` 包装的插件（尤其 Service 类，或就绪前挂载的函数插件）读到了不完整的 fiber 形状。`usesManualInvariantTree` 只豁免 invariant 命名 spec 与 2 个例外路径，service.spec / loader-composition 均不豁免。

### 影响面

- 任何需要 `ctx.plugin()` 挂载 Service 类或走 Loader 组合的服务/集成测试，在隔离运行下都会红。
- 新包无法满足 `packages/AGENTS.md` 要求的"真实 Loader 组合测试"（产品可见插件必须有），因为组合测试同样触发该代理。
- 若 CI 以全量 `pnpm run test` 运行可能被顺序掩盖，但按文件过滤开发时必现，是显著的本地开发阻塞。

### 建议修复方向（供参考，未验证）

- 在 `startInvariantHost` 的 `ready` 就绪后再挂载被包装的用户插件（把挂载放进 `ready` 链），或
- 让 `withInvariantReadiness` 对 Service 类插件保留原插件形态（不降级为对象 `apply`），或
- 对 `fiber.ctx.fiber === undefined` 的情形优雅降级（跳过 `initiallyPending` 检查）。

环境：Windows 11 · Node v24.14.1 · pnpm 11.7.0 · deepseek-harness 0.1.0-rc.5（master）。

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-plugins｜思考折叠、Skill 提及、会话协作、插件管理和 Git worktree 5个使用插件的分享
discussions.body:
项目地址：https://github.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins

发布版本：https://github.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/releases/tag/v0.1.0

# dsh-plugins

> 非官方社区项目，由个人开发和维护。

这是给 DeepSeek Harness 做的一组第三方插件。目前一共五个，分别用于整理对话里的思考与工具调用、在输入框中选择 Skill、跨会话协作、接入 Agent Plugins，以及管理 Git worktree。

五个插件放在同一个仓库，但彼此独立，不需要整套安装。

## dsh-thinking-collapse

把每个模型步骤里的思考过程和普通工具调用收成一条活动记录。

进行中会显示当前内容和耗时；步骤结束后自动折叠。回答正文仍然显示在外面，需要查看过程时再点开。

![思考和工具调用折叠](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/v0.1.0/packages/dsh-thinking-collapse/screenshots/collapsed.png)

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-thinking-collapse@0.1.0
```

## dsh-composer-skill-mention

在 Web 输入框里输入 `$` 或全角 `￥`，可以搜索当前会话可用的 Skill。

选中后会写入 `$skill-name`，DSH 在处理这条消息前加载对应的 Skill。

![在输入框里选择 Skill](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/v0.1.0/packages/dsh-composer-skill-mention/screenshots/mention.png)

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-composer-skill-mention@0.1.0
```

## dsh-session-tools

增加六个会话工具，支持列出、读取、创建、重命名、Fork 会话，以及向另一会话发送消息。

Web 输入框里还可以使用 `@` 选择另一段会话，把它作为带来源的上下文放进当前消息。

![选择其他会话作为上下文](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/v0.1.0/packages/dsh-session-tools/screenshots/mention.png)

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-tools@0.1.0
```

## dsh-agent-plugins

让 DSH 可以读取 Agent Plugins 格式的插件包，包括 `plugin.json`、`skills/` 和 `mcp.json`。

这个包带有 `agent-plugins` 命令行工具，也在 Web 侧栏增加了一个插件管理面板。可以启停整个插件，也可以单独控制其中的 Skill 和 MCP server。

![Agent Plugins 管理面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/v0.1.0/packages/dsh-agent-plugins/screenshots/panel.png)

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-agent-plugins@0.1.0
```

## dsh-worktree-workspaces

在 DSH 里创建和归档 Git linked worktree。

它提供 `/worktree` 命令、模型工具、`dsh-worktree` CLI，以及 Web 里的工作树选择器。创建工作树后，可以直接切换到对应的 DSH Workspace。

![Git worktree 选择器](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/v0.1.0/packages/dsh-worktree-workspaces/screenshots/picker.png)

安装：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-worktree-workspaces@0.1.0
```

## 版本要求

- Node.js 22 或更高版本
- `pnpm` 已加入 `PATH`
- 当前版本按 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` 制作

五个包都已经发布到 npm，可以按需安装。

各插件的完整说明和卸载命令见中文 README：

https://github.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/blob/main/README.zh.md

遇到问题可以在仓库提交 Issue：

https://github.com/SisyphusSQ/dsh-plugins/issues

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-tokenscope｜在设置面板中查看 Token 用量与估算花费的仪表盘插件
discussions.body: > **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。** 项目地址： https://github.com/HduSy/dsh-tokenscope 项目介绍： dsh-tokenscope 是 DeepSeek Harness 的用量仪表盘插件，在 Web GUI 的设置弹窗中新增「用量」小节，以 TokenScope 风格的仪表盘展示你的 DSH 使用情况： - 今日 / 本周 / 本月三个维度（自然周、自然月口径），总 Token 计数动画、环比涨跌 - 缓存命中拆分条、按小时/按天的堆叠趋势图（TokenScope 同款稀疏刻度） - 按模型分布（用量越多颜色越深）、按模型估算花费环图 - 请求/会话统计、工具调用排行、约 26 周每日活跃热力图 - 面板顶部内置一键截图（PNG 下载，含 header、自动过滤截图按钮） - 中/英文随 Harness 语言设置实时切换，浅/深主题自适应 与 DSH 的集成方式： - 数据源是 DSH 自身的会话轨迹：Host 侧订阅 `session/event` 事件流（`assistant/message` 的 usage、`request/header` 的模型归属、`tool/call`），按天/小时聚合，持久化到 `$DSH_HOME/usage-dashboard.json`，并注册 `GET /api/usage-dashboard` 路由。 - 花费估算与 TokenScope 同算法：精确 Token × models.dev 动态价格（24h 刷新、本地缓存，官方供应商优先），面板标注 est.。 - 浏览器侧是标准的 dual-half 客户端插件（`dsh.client` 清单 + `__ModuleLoader__` 闭包产物），通过 `settings.section` 插槽注册，接入 Harness 的 locale 与主题体系。 安装方式： 把仓库地址发给你的 DSH Agent，一句话即可： > 帮我安装这个 DSH 插件：https://github.com/HduSy/dsh-tokenscope Agent 会完成克隆、依赖处理与挂载配置（仓库内置构建产物，通常无需编译）；装完刷新浏览器页面，进入「设置 → 用量」查看。配置热生效，无需重启服务。 已知边界：统计自插件挂载起累计（挂载前的种子历史不计入）；花费为公开价格估算值，非账单。 截图：

discussions.title: [Fix] Add Support for Minimal Mode on Windows
discussions.body:
# fix(subprocess-local) — add Windows terminal process inspection

**Title:** `fix(subprocess-local): add win32 terminal process inspection`

**Labels:** `kind/bug-fix`, `area/subprocess`

**Patch file:** `dsh-win32-terminal-inspector.patch` (38 KB, applies cleanly to `master` @ `47f94385` with `git apply`)

---

## Problem

`createProcessInspector()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` only implemented
`linux` (`/proc` probes) and `darwin` (`ps` snapshots) and threw
`subprocess-local: terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32` for every
other platform. `LocalSubprocessRuntime.spawnTerminal()` constructs the inspector
before allocating the `node-pty` terminal, so persistent PTY shells
(`dsh-terminal-bash` — the `minimal` preset's persistent bash) could never spawn on
Windows, even though `node-pty` ships ConPTY support and the package's ordinary
`spawn` path already handles win32 tree teardown via `taskkill`.

Fixes the root cause behind community discussion
[#1832](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1832)
(the community workaround plugin `clearkurt/dsh-win-terminal-inspector` served as
the reference mapping; this PR makes the capability native to the provider).

## Change

`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/process-inspector.ts`

- Add `WindowsProcessInspector` mapping POSIX concepts onto the Windows console model:
  - Process table: one `powershell.exe -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command` query
    over `Get-CimInstance Win32_Process` (pid/ppid/UTC ISO creation time), parsed by
    the new `parseWindowsProcessTable()`, cached with a 300 ms TTL; a failed query
    degrades to an empty table (proves no liveness, signals nothing).
  - `foregroundPgid(shellPid)` returns the shell pid while alive (whole ConPTY tree =
    one process group); `isStdinWaiting` is always false (readiness stays prompt-driven,
    same as macOS); `processSession` returns `[]`.
  - `signalGroup`: SIGINT is delivered as a `0x03` write into the ConPTY input of the
    attached terminal (authentic CTRL_C_EVENT); without an attachment it degrades to
    killing the running members except the shell root; every other signal
    force-terminates the tree children-first. `signalProcess` keeps the
    pid + creation-time identity fence.
- Add optional `attach?(terminal: IPty)` to `ProcessInspector`.
- Add the `win32` branch to `createProcessInspector()`.
- `DEFAULT_INTERNALS.exec` gains `windowsHide: true` + a 20 s timeout.

`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/index.ts`

- `spawnTerminal` calls `inspector.attach?.(terminal)` on the freshly allocated
  `node-pty` process (no-op for the Linux/macOS inspectors and the `terminalInspector`
  test hook).

Tests / docs / notes

- `tests/process-inspector.spec.ts`: Windows inspector suite — JSON parsing, TTL cache
  (hit/expiry/rewind/query-failure), console-model mapping, children-first trees + cycle
  containment, all signal paths with injected internals; the old
  `win32 → throw` assertion moves to `freebsd`.
- `tests/local.spec.ts`: spawnTerminal attach-hook coverage.
- `README.md` / `README.zh.md`: Known Limitations rewritten (Windows inspection now
  supported; graceful TERM/TSTP/HUP still absent on Windows).
- New Agent Note: `.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-15-win32-terminal-inspector.md`
  (+ `.zh.md`).

[repo.](https://github.com/Piggy343288/deepseek-harness)

## Verification performed (Windows host)

- `tsc -b packages/subprocess/subprocess-local` — clean.
- `vitest` (win32-local config): `process-inspector.spec.ts` 14/14 pass;
  attach test + terminal-input tests pass in `local.spec.ts`.
- `oxlint` on the four changed TS files: 0 warnings / 0 errors.
- tsdown rebuild of `lib/index.js` + `lib/invariant.js`; deployed bundle loads under
  Node and contains the win32 branch.
- Real end-to-end smoke against the live `powershell.exe` process table:
  `createProcessInspector('win32')` → `WindowsProcessInspector`, `processTree`,
  pid+creation-time liveness, foreground pgid, and degraded signal paths all verified.
- `git apply --check` clean against pristine `master`; applied tree matches the
  working tree for all 8 files (modulo git's autocrlf on disk).

## Known limitations (documented in README)

- Windows console processes have no graceful TERM/TSTP/HUP: teardown force-terminates
  while the TERM→grace→KILL ladder timing is preserved.
- `isStdinWaiting` is always false on Windows; readiness depends on the prompt-driven
  PTY backend, exactly as on macOS.
- A failed `powershell.exe` table query degrades terminal inspection to the empty-table
  state (same degradation class as an unreadable `/proc` on Linux).


If you find it useful, please fork and star.

discussions.title: Bug 报告：Agent 陷入无限重复工具调用循环，防循环机制（repeat-tool-reminder）未能阻止
discussions.body:
# Agent 陷入无限重复工具调用循环，防循环机制（repeat-tool-reminder）未能阻止

## 概述

一个会话（`session-5d7b1dd3-d3a8-4e8e-813e-662ab9d8d9a3`，agentPreset: `cordis`）在完成主要开发任务后陷入严重的"确认循环"：**在约 6 分钟的循环固化期内连续 45 步只调用 `cordis_inspect_query` 这一个工具，其中 51 次（含后续 turn）以完全相同的参数调用 `Service.listService + {"service":"subprocess"}`**，期间 11 次收到系统防循环插件的警告提醒、2 次被用户直接质问，均无法跳出循环。最终会话在模型一边宣称"彻底停止重复调用、直接调用 vivado_start_session 工具"、一边继续生成同一个 `cordis_inspect_query` 调用的自相矛盾状态下结束。

这暴露了两个问题：

1. **模型行为缺陷**：进入"惯性循环"（循环期间几乎无推理输出），且声明与实际行动脱节；
2. **防循环机制（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder`）设计缺陷**：纯 advisory（仅文本提醒、不否决、不清算），且提醒注入后计数链被清零，无法对顽固循环形成有效压制。

## 复现环境

| 项         | 值                                                           |
| ---------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 会话 ID    | `session-5d7b1dd3-d3a8-4e8e-813e-662ab9d8d9a3`               |
| Agent 预设 | `cordis`                                                     |
| 模型       | `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash`                      |
| 日志文件   | `session.jsonl`（6506 行，4 个 turn，168 个 step）           |
| 防循环插件 | `@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder` v0.1.0-rc.6（阈值默认 `[3, 5, 8]`） |
| 会话时长   | 2026-08-15 22:59:05 → 23:34:27（35 分 22 秒）                |

## 任务背景

用户（FPGA 工程师）要求开发一个 Vivado 插件（参考 [vivado-mcp](https://github.com/mapleleavessssssss-wq/vivado-mcp)），需要读取 Tcl 参考手册 PDF、创建插件目录等。

会话进度正常，模型完成了绝大部分工作：

- **turn 1**（22:59–23:10）：加载 skill、web 调研 vivado-mcp。
- **turn 2**（23:13 起，"刚才任务中断了，继续任务"）：
  - step 2–18：阅读 vivado-mcp 源码、提取 PDF 文档、确认 Vivado 2018.3 路径；
  - step 19–61：研究 DSH 内部实现（npm-cache 中的 harness 源码）、编写 `tcp_bridge.js` 并通过 probe 测试；
  - step 66：`cordis_define` 创建插件 `vvd-2`；
  - step 68：`cordis_run vvd-2/pkg-2` **失败**：`Error: harness.defineTool parameters.session_id.required must be true when present`（模型代码 schema 错误，随后修复）；
  - step 70：`cordis_run vvd-3/pkg-3` **成功**：`vvd-3/pkg-3 is running (run-2)`。

**插件运行成功之后，模型没有去调用已注册的 vivado 工具，而是滑入循环。**

## 循环现象（关键数据）

### 工具调用统计

| 工具                                                         | 调用次数                              |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------- |
| `cordis_inspect_query`                                       | **85**（占全部 185 次工具调用的 46%） |
| `pwsh`                                                       | 30                                    |
| `read`                                                       | 26                                    |
| `grep`                                                       | 18                                    |
| `web_search`                                                 | 9                                     |
| 其他（job_output / inspect_self / run / define / write / skill / glob / inspect_list） | 17                                    |

`cordis_inspect_query` 的 85 次调用中：

| 查询                                                         | 次数                     |
| ------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------ |
| `Service.listService` + `{"service":"subprocess"}`           | **51（完全相同的参数）** |
| `Service.listService` + 其他服务（harness/settings/timeout/shell/fs/web/approval 等逐个枚举） | ~25                      |
| `Tool.listTools`（含 `{}` 空参连续 5 次）                    | 7                        |
| `Event.listEvents` / `Builtin.listBuiltins`                  | 各 1                     |

### 时间线

| 时间              | 事件                                                         |
| ----------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------ |
| 23:15:28          | 探索期首次 `subprocess` 查询（turn 2 step 23，正常枚举阶段） |
| 23:26:57–23:28:09 | **turn 2 step 75–96：系统性枚举 Host 服务**（shell/subprocess/sandbox/web/fs/approval/jobs/userQuestions/workspaceRegistry/timer/sessions/commands/systemPrompt/agentPresets/terminal/terminals/tools/sandboxPolicy，每个查一次，已明显偏离任务） |
| 23:28:13–23:31:09 | **循环固化期：turn 2 step 97–141，连续 45 步全部是 `cordis_inspect_query`**（subprocess 为主，穿插 harness/settings/timeout/events 各 1 次、listTools 空参连续 5 次） |
| 23:28:34 起       | `repeat-tool-reminder` 插件开始注入警告，共 **11 次**（见下） |
| 23:31:41          | 用户："你好像进入了某种循环，一直在重复，怎么打破"           |
| 23:31:47–23:32:05 | **turn 3 step 1–5：5 步又全部是 subprocess 查询**（对用户打断的第一反应仍是重复查询） |
| 23:33:40          | 用户："告诉我怎样才能打破循环，目前依靠你自己好像出不来这个循环，要不你先跳出当前任务检查一下自己的bug" |
| 23:33:46–23:34:26 | **turn 4 step 1–9：9 步又全部是 subprocess 查询**            |
| 23:34:26          | 最后一条 `assistant/message`（seq=100026）后会话结束，仍以 subprocess 查询收尾 |

### 防循环插件注入的 11 次警告（全部被无视）

```
23:28:34  repeat-tool-reminder × 3  "You are repeating the exact same tool call..."
23:28:48  repeat-tool-reminder × 3  ...
23:28:56  repeat-tool-reminder × 5  "Repeated tool call detected: consecutive_calls: 5 ..."
23:29:07  repeat-tool-reminder × 3  ...
23:29:17  repeat-tool-reminder × 5  ...
23:29:31  repeat-tool-reminder × 8  ...
23:31:56  repeat-tool-reminder × 3  ...
23:32:05  repeat-tool-reminder × 5  ...
23:33:57  repeat-tool-reminder × 3  ...
23:34:06  repeat-tool-reminder × 5  ...
23:34:21  repeat-tool-reminder × 8  ...
```

### 循环中的模型状态（"惯性循环"证据）

- 循环期间模型**几乎没有任何推理输出**：`reasoning-delta` 仅剩零星碎片（如单字"工具"、"我又"），说明模型不是"在思考后决定重复"，而是**机械地重复生成同一个 tool-call**。
- 每次查询 `subprocess` 都返回**相同的大段 JSON**（约 2KB 的"Abstract subprocess service"服务描述，明确写着该服务需子类实现、不能直接调用），但模型既不读取、也不换方案。
- 每条 subprocess 查询返回约 2KB，51 次累计约 100KB+ 进入上下文，上下文持续膨胀进一步削弱模型跳出循环的能力。

### 最直接的现场证据（声明与行动脱节）

循环末尾（seq=100026，23:34:26），模型在推理中明确说：

> "我确实陷入了严重的重复调用循环。用户指出后我还是在重复。我需要真正停下来…… **现在彻底停止 cordis_inspect_query，直接调用已注册的 vivado_start_session 工具**"

—— 但该消息中**紧接着生成的 tool-call 依然是 `cordis_inspect_query`（`{"service":"subprocess"}`）**。模型"说一套做一套"，它认为自己可以调用 `vivado_start_session`（推理中称"5 个 vivado 工具已注册到当前 Agent"），实际生成的却是 `cordis_inspect_query`。模型对"工具已注册"与"工具可被当前步骤调用"两个状态的认知是错乱的。

## 根因分析

### 1. 直接诱因：插件运行成功后模型进入"确认循环"

vvd-3 插件运行成功并注册了 vivado 工具后，模型想确认这些动态工具"是否轮到当前 Agent 调用"，于是：

- step 75–96：先系统性枚举 Host 服务（shell、subprocess、sandbox、web、fs、approval、jobs、userQuestions、workspaceRegistry、timer、sessions、commands、systemPrompt、agentPresets、terminal、terminals、tools……每个查一次，尚属"探索"但已明显偏离任务）；
- step 97 起：退化为**重复查询同一个服务**，循环固化。

模型的推理（乱码还原后）显示其认知误区：*"作为当前 Agent，我无法直接调用这些工具——它们是注册给我的，在下一步模型步骤中才会出现在我的工具列表里……我一直在这个'确认'循环里打转，从不向前推进。"* 它认为"还需要再确认一步"，于是无限"确认"。

### 2. 防循环机制 `repeat-tool-reminder` 的缺陷（需要修复的核心）

阅读插件源码（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-repeat-tool-reminder` lib/index.js）后确认：

- **纯 advisory 设计**：`README` 明确写 *"advisory loop-breaker … it never appears in the tool list, never vetoes or rewrites a call"* —— 插件只注入文本提醒，**从不否决、阻断或改写调用**，是否停止完全取决于模型自觉。
- **提醒注入后计数链被清零**（源码第 317–320 行）：

```js
ctx.on("agent/pre-step", ({ agent, messages }, next) => {
    if (messages.some((message) => message.source.kind === "user")) chains.delete(agent);
    return next();
});
```

  提醒本身以 `user/message` 形式注入，而 `agent/pre-step` 一旦发现 user 消息就**清空计数链**。于是实际效果是：模型重复 3 次 → 收到提醒（链清零）→ 再重复 3 次 → 再收到提醒（链清零）……警告永远停留在"3–5–8"的节奏上，**无法累积成更强、更持续的干预**。这与日志中 `×3 → ×5 → ×8 → ×3 → ×5 → ×8` 反复出现的模式完全吻合。

- **对"惯性循环"无效**：当模型处于无推理的机械重复状态时，注入文本提醒根本不会被"读进去"（循环期间模型几乎没有 reasoning，也不换工具）。需要的是**硬性熔断**（阻止调用 / 强制换工具 / 终止 turn），而非建议性文本。

### 3. 没有 step 级硬上限保护

单个 turn 内模型连续执行了 45 步（turn 2 step 97–141）全部是同一类查询工具，系统没有任何 step 数上限或"同类只读查询累计 N 次强制干预"的机制。

## 次要发现（建议一并修复）

1. **session.jsonl 中文乱码（编码 bug）**：日志文件中所有中文均为 GBK 误读乱码（如"我是一名"被写成 `鎴戞槸涓€鍚`）。验证：文件中"鎴戞"两字的 UTF-8 字节为 `E9 8E B4 E6 88 9E`，而正确"我是"应为 `E6 88 91 E6 98 AF` —— 说明写入端把 UTF-8 文本按 GBK 解码后写入了 JSONL，日志永久损坏、不可读（本报告所有中文引用均需先做编码还原）。
2. **部分行 JSON 解析失败**：6506 行中 3259 行 `ConvertFrom-Json` 失败（如 `\^@` 等控制字符未转义/非法字符直接进入字符串），日志完整性存疑。
3. **工具结果记录缺失**：turn 2 step 71 的 `Tool.listTools` 有 `tool/call`（seq=84469）但无对应 `tool/result`，可能影响审计。
4. **插件错误信息可读性**：`harness.defineTool parameters.session_id.required must be true when present`（vvd-2 失败）——报错指向性弱，模型需要多次试错才理解 schema 要求（此条为次要，非本次循环根因）。

## 复现步骤

1. 新建会话（agentPreset: `cordis`）。
2. 让模型开发一个 Cordis 插件，插件通过 `harness.defineTool` 注册若干动态工具（参考 vivado 插件的做法，工具带 `session_id` 参数）。
3. 插件 `cordis_run` 运行成功后，模型会尝试用 `cordis_inspect_query` 反复"确认"动态工具是否可用（本会话中表现为查询 `Service.listService` 的 `subprocess` 服务）。
4. 观察到模型连续 20+ 步以相同参数调用 `cordis_inspect_query`，期间 `repeat-tool-reminder` 注入多次警告但模型无视，直至用户手动干预或会话超时。

## 修复建议

1. **为 repeat-tool-reminder 增加硬性熔断选项**（核心）：达到最高阈值（如 `[3,5,8]`）后，除注入提醒外，可配置为：
   - 阻止下一次相同调用（返回错误，强制模型换工具或结束）；
   - 或强制结束当前 turn 并向用户报告"模型陷入重复循环"。
     当前 advisory-only 设计对惯性循环无效。
2. **修复计数链清零逻辑**：注入提醒后不应立即清零计数（或至少保留 escalated 状态，使后续重复立刻触发更高级别干预），避免"提醒→清零→再重复→再提醒"的空转。
3. **增加 step/turn 硬上限**：单个 turn 内 step 数超过阈值（如 100）或同一工具累计调用超过阈值（如 20）时强制介入。
4. **工具注册状态语义**：`Tool.listTools` 的结果应明确标注动态工具"已对当前模型可见可用"，或插件运行成功后向模型注入一条明确的"工具已就绪，可直接调用，无需确认"上下文，消除模型的"确认"动机。
5. **修复 session.jsonl 编码 bug**：日志写入端统一按 UTF-8 写入，禁止 GBK 解码路径。

## 相关日志证据（文件内位置）

- 会话文件：`loop_check/dsh-session-session-5d7b1dd3-d3a8-4e8e-813e-662ab9d8d9a3/session.jsonl`
- 循环起点：seq=17411（探索期首次 subprocess 查询，turn 2 step 23）；seq=89015 起为循环固化期（turn 2 step 97–141）
- 循环终点：seq=100027（最后一条 subprocess 查询，turn 4 step 9）
- 模型"声明停止却又重复"的铁证：seq=100026（assistant/message）
- 防循环提醒：seq=89698 / 90239 / 90481 / 90957 / 91595 / 92411 / 96893 / 97257 / 98258 / 98708 / 99699
- 插件 vvd-2 失败：step 68 result（`session_id.required must be true`）
- 插件 vvd-3 成功：step 70 result（`vvd-3/pkg-3 is running (run-2)`）

discussions.title: RFC: Kernel X-Ray as a foundation for automatic AMDGPU kernel optimization
discussions.body:
Hi! I am exploring a small external DSH plugin around AMD GPU kernel development, and I would like to check whether the idea and its Plugin/Skill boundary match how the Harness team expects external plugins to be designed.

Repository: https://github.com/yujiaoliang/dsh-plugin-amdgpu-inspect

## The idea: give an agent "X-ray vision" into a GPU kernel

When an agent works on a HIP kernel today, it can read and edit the source, invoke the build, and run a benchmark. What it does not have is a compact and reliable view of what the compiler actually produced between the source edit and the runtime result.

A source change may remove a branch while increasing VGPR pressure, introduce scratch traffic, change LDS usage, or move waits and memory operations. The information exists in the AMDGPU code object and LLVM disassembly, but raw `llvm-readelf`/`llvm-objdump` output is large, version-sensitive, and awkward to carry through model context.

## Longer-term vision: closed-loop kernel optimization

The larger goal is to let a DSH agent optimize a kernel automatically rather than merely explain its assembly. I would like an agent to be able to run a bounded optimization loop such as:

```text
Capture the baseline source, build, correctness, and performance
  -> inspect the generated AMDGPU code object
  -> identify one testable bottleneck hypothesis
  -> edit the HIP kernel
  -> rebuild for the same target and compare compiler artifacts
  -> run the same correctness gate
  -> benchmark the same workload
  -> keep or revert the candidate from evidence
  -> repeat until the budget or stopping criterion is reached
```

Examples of iterations the agent could attempt include reducing an observed scratch spill, changing a load or reduction strategy, testing a different workgroup mapping, or evaluating whether a source-level simplification actually changes the generated ISA. Static inspection would guide the next experiment, while correctness and measured workload performance would decide whether the change survives.

This is not intended to encode a table of AMD-specific tuning rules or claim that ISA inspection alone predicts performance. The interesting part is an evidence-driven agent loop in which compiler artifacts provide an additional observation surface between source and benchmark. Failed ideas should be reverted, every accepted candidate should pass correctness, and a speedup claim should always come from measurement.

The low-level plugin in this repository is only the observation primitive for that larger loop. It should expose stable facts without embedding optimization policy; a Skill or workflow can compose those facts with source editing, compilation, correctness, benchmarking, iteration budgets, and stopping rules.

The experience I would like to enable is:

```text
Agent edits a HIP kernel
  -> builds baseline and candidate HSACO files
  -> inspects kernel descriptors and resource fields
  -> queries only the relevant ISA, such as scratch_* or s_waitcnt
  -> forms and tests a concrete hypothesis about the generated code
  -> runs correctness and the real workload
  -> accepts, rejects, or revises the candidate automatically
```

## What I hope the low-level plugin will provide

The proposed plugin treats an existing AMDGPU HSACO/ELF file as structured, queryable data:

- Discover the target architecture, code-object version, and contained kernels.
- Report public kernel descriptor fields such as SGPR/VGPR counts, fixed LDS, private-segment/scratch size, kernarg size, and wavefront size.
- Normalize disassembly into address/opcode/operands/category records.
- Query ISA by exact kernel, opcode glob, start address, and cursor.
- Keep responses bounded so a large kernel does not consume the model context.
- Remain read-only: never load or execute the code object.

An optional `kernel-xray` Skill then owns the first higher-level workflow: how to build comparable artifacts, which facts to inspect for a given question, how to distinguish facts from hypotheses, and why a real correctness/performance measurement is required. A later optimization workflow could add candidate generation, budgets, acceptance criteria, rollback, and iteration on top of the same primitive.

The intended separation is:

```text
Plugin: stable low-level mechanism and structured facts
Skill/workflow: optimization loop, experiment policy, and validation discipline
Agent: hypotheses, source edits, and evidence-based decisions
```

## What exists in the prototype today

The current repository is a small proof of concept with two DSH tools:

- `amdgpu_object_inspect`: returns architecture, code-object version, kernels, selected resource descriptor fields, and neutral instruction-category counts.
- `amdgpu_isa_query`: returns a bounded page of normalized instructions filtered by opcode glob and/or start address.

The implementation currently:

- invokes ROCm LLVM's `llvm-readelf --notes` and `llvm-objdump --disassemble --demangle`;
- normalizes their text output into JSON;
- limits artifacts to regular files up to 256 MiB;
- caps ISA queries at 200 records and provides a deterministic cursor;
- launches tools without a shell and honors cancellation;
- caches one inspected artifact by absolute path, size, and modification time;
- includes synthetic metadata/disassembly parser tests and a fake-LLVM end-to-end pipeline test;
- includes a concise `kernel-xray` Skill that requires before/after build provenance, correctness, and workload measurement.

The current plugin deliberately does **not** compile HIP, run kernels, benchmark, calculate occupancy, or make optimization recommendations. Those are expected to be composed around it rather than hidden inside the inspection primitive. It has also **not yet been tested against a real ROCm installation or real HSACO**. I want to validate the architectural direction before investing in output compatibility and the complete automatic optimization loop.

## Questions for the Harness maintainers

1. Is this low-level observation primitive a good plugin foundation for a future automatic kernel-optimization workflow, or would Harness expect the entire loop to be shaped differently?
2. Does keeping structured compiler facts in a Plugin while a Skill/workflow owns candidate generation, correctness, benchmarking, rollback, and stopping criteria match the intended Plugin/Skill separation?
3. The prototype currently reads the artifact and launches LLVM on the DSH host with Node APIs. Should an external plugin instead consume Harness filesystem/subprocess services so deployment policy, cancellation, and alternate providers remain effective?
4. Is shipping a low-level plugin with an optional companion Skill an expected distribution shape, or should they be separate packages?
5. Are two model-facing tools (`object_inspect` and paginated `isa_query`) the right granularity, or would a service plus a thinner consumer tool be more idiomatic?
6. For the eventual bounded optimization loop, would the existing workflow/goal/job capabilities be the expected composition points, rather than adding lifecycle and iteration state to this plugin?

Any feedback on whether this is a useful plugin-shaped foundation for automatic kernel optimization, and on how to align it with Harness composition, would be very helpful before I take the implementation further.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-mmx-bridge：让 DeepSeek Harness 开口说话、睁眼看图、随手画画
discussions.body:
> 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。
>
> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.

**项目地址 / Project URL:** https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge
**npm:** https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mmx-bridge (`dsh-mmx-bridge@1.0.0`, MIT, 零依赖)

![banner](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/banner.png)

## 中文

大家好！我给 DeepSeek Harness 写了一个 MiniMax 多模态桥接插件。装好之后，Agent 就多了一双眼睛、一张嘴和一支画笔：能看图、能说话、能生成图片，甚至还能生成视频和音乐。

**为什么做它：** DSH 内置的工具基本活在文本世界里（搜索、读文件、执行命令），模型"看不见也说不出来"。MiniMax 有一整套多模态 API，我用一个插件把它们全部桥接成 DSH 的一个原生工具 `mmx_bridge`，Agent 无需学习任何新工具。

### 亮点

- **一个工具，八种能力**：`mmx_bridge` 单个工具覆盖图片生成、图片理解、视频生成、语音合成、音乐生成、音频翻唱、联网搜索、用量查询
- **对话流内嵌播放器**：生成的图片、音频、视频直接以卡片形式嵌进会话内播放，不用离开对话
- **可接管内置工具**：可选地用 MiniMax 视觉模型接管内置 `read_image`、用 MiniMax 搜索接管内置 `web_search`，Agent 侧零改动
- **图片直出可预览**：生成文件名带时间戳前缀，永不互相覆盖，客户端即时预览
- **零核心改动**：纯插件实现，不碰 DSH 内核；零 npm 依赖，MIT 协议
- **一键安装**：已发布到 npm，`dsh plugin` 直接安装

### 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mmx-bridge
```

装好后在插件管理页打开开关，并把 MiniMax API Key 填进 `MMX_API_KEY` 环境变量（或控制文件配置）即可。完整的安装、配置、排查指南在 [AGENT.md](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/blob/main/AGENT.md)，也可以直接让 Agent 照着装：

> "安装 dsh-mmx-bridge 插件，并按它的 AGENT.md 配置 MiniMax API Key。"

### 效果一览

![features](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/features.png)

| 文生图 | 语音合成 | 图片理解 |
|---|---|---|
| ![image-generation](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/image-generation.png) | ![speech-tts](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/speech-tts.png) | ![vision-demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/vision-demo.png) |

| 插件管理页开关 |
|---|
| ![plugin-settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/main/docs/plugin-settings.png) |

仓库：https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge · npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mmx-bridge

欢迎试用、提 issue、提需求，也欢迎交流多模态 Agent 的玩法～

---

## English

Hi! I built a multimodal bridge plugin that connects MiniMax's API suite to DeepSeek Harness. Once installed, the agent gains eyes, a voice, and a paintbrush: image generation, image understanding, video generation, TTS, music, audio cover, web search and quota check — all through a single native tool `mmx_bridge`.

**Highlights**

- Single tool, eight capabilities — no new tooling to learn
- Inline players: generated images/audio/video render as playable cards right in the conversation
- Optional shadow takeover of the built-in `read_image` and `web_search` (MiniMax vision / search backends), zero agent-side changes
- Timestamped unique filenames, instant client-side preview
- Zero core modification, zero npm dependencies, MIT
- Published on npm, one-line install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mmx-bridge
```

Set your MiniMax API key via `MMX_API_KEY`, flip the switches in the plugin settings page, and you are ready. Full install/config/troubleshooting guide: [AGENT.md](https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge/blob/main/AGENT.md).

Repo: https://github.com/welsione/dsh-mmx-bridge · npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-mmx-bridge

Feedback, issues and ideas are very welcome!

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-plugin-doctor GitHub Action — pre-publish checks for every plugin
discussions.body:
## English

**dsh-plugin-doctor is now a GitHub Action** - the pre-publish health check for DeepSeek Harness plugins, one line in any plugin's CI.

```yaml
- uses: zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action@v1
  with:
    path: .
    # full: 'true'   # add build + pack + fresh-profile install smoke
```

- Runs manifest structure, patch validity, entry points, and files allowlist checks on every push/PR.
- `full: true` adds build + pack + fresh-profile install smoke.
- Failures/warnings become GitHub annotations and run-summary lines; `ok` output is CI-friendly.
- Installs from a pinned GitHub Release tarball (no npm publish dependency), Node 22.

This is the "loads is not callable" answer in tool form (#1965, #1697, #2002): every plugin author can now run the same checks a maintainer would, before a user ever installs it.

Repos:
- Action: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action
- Doctor: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor

---

## 中文

**dsh-plugin-doctor 现在是一个 GitHub Action** —— DeepSeek Harness 插件发布前体检，一行接入任何插件的 CI。

```yaml
- uses: zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action@v1
  with:
    path: .
    # full: 'true'   # 追加 build + pack + 全新 profile 安装冒烟
```

- 每次 push/PR 自动跑 manifest 结构、patch 有效性、入口点、files 白名单检查；
- `full: true` 追加构建 + 打包 + 全新 profile 安装冒烟；
- 失败/警告变成 GitHub annotations 和 run-summary，`ok` 输出可直接做 CI 门禁；
- 从固定 GitHub Release tarball 安装（不依赖 npm 发布），Node 22。

这是"能加载 ≠ 能调用"的工具化答案（#1965/#1697/#2002）：每个插件作者现在都能在用户安装之前，跑一遍维护者会跑的检查。

仓库：
- Action：https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor-action
- Doctor：https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-plugin-doctor

discussions.title: UI improvement: hover-open model and reasoning effort submenus
discussions.body:
## Summary

The composer model selector currently requires repeated clicks when choosing both a model and its reasoning effort. I implemented a UI/UX improvement that keeps the two choices available as one continuous interaction:

- Hover, keyboard focus, or click on the Model row opens its side submenu.
- Hover, keyboard focus, or click on the Reasoning Effort row opens its side submenu.
- A successful model selection keeps the root menu open, so the reasoning effort can be selected next without reopening the trigger.
- Selecting a reasoning effort closes the menu.
- A 400 ms close grace period and a 10 px pointer bridge keep the submenu available while the pointer crosses the gap at a deliberate speed.
- Escape closes the active submenu before closing the root menu.

## Motivation

Opening the submenu immediately on hover removes unnecessary clicks. The first hover implementation was too easy to lose while moving from the root row into the side card, especially with slower pointer movement. The grace period and pointer bridge address that failure without keeping abandoned submenus open indefinitely.

## Implementation

- Fork branch: https://github.com/franksong2702/deepseek-harness/tree/franksong2702/model-effort-hover-menus
- Commit: https://github.com/franksong2702/deepseek-harness/commit/f52d36f7dcf1a0907779ffc4fa703f7c76185134

The change is limited to the browser model-selection UI, its component and browser tests, the keyless snapshot, and the corresponding bilingual documentation and Agent Note. It does not change the Host model-selection API or session format.

## Validation

- ModelSelect component tests: 8 passed.
- GUI suite: 3,760 passed, 1 skipped.
- Keyless Web snapshot suite: 253 passed, 15 skipped.
- Documentation gates: 28 passed.
- Package bundle, lint, diff check, and the pre-push host build plus client contracts typecheck all completed successfully.
- Manual browser verification confirmed slow pointer travel into both the model and reasoning effort submenus at http://127.0.0.1:3081/.

The repository currently does not accept external pull requests, so I am sharing the working fork here for maintainer and community feedback.

discussions.title: 插件分享｜Task Board：可持久化、可审核、可重试的原生任务看板
discussions.body:
# Task Board：把一次性对话任务变成可持久化、可审核、可重试的任务卡

我为 DeepSeek Harness 做了一个原生 Task Board 插件能力族。它直接接入 Cordis、Session、Remote、ApiProxy 和 Web profile，不是外挂页面，也不是只保存一份前端状态。

一句话概括：**把 Agent 任务放进“初始化 → 执行中 → 待审核 → 已完成 / 失败”的工作流，并保留每轮 Session、执行日志和人工反馈。**

## 项目地址

- 功能分支：https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/task-board-plugin
- 图文 PR：https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/pull/1
- 验证提交：`d7b07cbb9c0c457ee7b8eb3b0cb4a2e4395d9af3`
- 标记：`#dsh-plugin`

官方仓库目前关闭了 Pull Requests 和 Issues，因此先在 fork 内保留完整 Draft PR 与可审阅提交。

## 它能做什么

- 创建 Agent 任务或手动任务，指定 Workspace/目录、Agent Preset、任务要求、验收标准和参考图片。
- 支持创建并启动、停止、人工审核、驳回后沿用同一 Session 继续修订、失败后人工重试、重新打开和删除。
- 提供五状态看板、列表、任务详情、活动记录和逐事件执行日志。
- 支持搜索，以及按状态、位置和 Agent 筛选。
- 支持同列拖拽排序、CAS 并发修改、revision-gap 修复和冷启动对账。
- 页面刷新或 Harness 进程冷重启后，任务状态、活动记录和各轮 Session 均可恢复。
- 适配浅色、深色和 900px 窄屏布局。

## 效果截图

### 创建任务

![创建 Task Board 任务](https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/blob/task-board-pr-assets/task-board-create.png?raw=true)

### 五状态任务看板

## 当前如何体验

npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:scwlkq/dsh-task-board

```

![设置页中的唯一 task-board Loader](https://github.com/scwlkq/dsh-task-board/blob/task-board-assets/task-board-v0.1.0-settings.png?raw=true)

以上演示来自全新 `DSH_HOME` 和公开 GitHub 安装，使用真实 DSH Web、Host、RPC 与持久化链路。演示选择“手动任务”和“仅创建”，因此不需要 API Key，也没有调用真实 DeepSeek 模型。真实 Agent 执行仍需按 DSH 现有方式配置模型凭据。

如果希望审阅随 DSH 一起发布的官方内置实现，仍可查看 [Fork PR #1](https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/pull/1)；该方案继续等待上游接收。

## 验证结果

- Host：5 个文件、78 项测试通过。
- Client：10 个文件、69 项测试通过；纳入源文件的 lines、statements、functions、branches 均为 100%。
- `pnpm run build`、built package invariants 和 NodeNext types 检查通过。
- Task Board Web 快照 4 项通过。
- 文档同步 28/28 gates 通过。
- 浏览器闭环覆盖：创建、刷新恢复、启动、日志、驳回修订、失败、人工重试、审核完成、深色主题、900px 窄屏和冷重启恢复。

## 验收边界

截图来自上述提交的真实 Harness Web、Remote、ApiProxy、Session 编排和持久化流程。验收环境没有 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`，模型输出由确定性 `LlmAdapter` 驱动，因此这些证据证明插件组装和完整产品流程可用，但不冒充真实 DeepSeek API 网络调用验证。

欢迎试用、提建议，也欢迎讨论：这个能力更适合进入官方 Web profile，还是继续拆成独立可安装的社区 bundle。

discussions.title: Authoritative effective model selection for subagents and plugin runtimes
discussions.body:
## Summary

Third-party DSH plugins that route models (agent distributions, team runtimes, workflow plugins) need an **authoritative seam** to determine the *effective* provider / model / reasoningEffort of a request. This is a question about the ecosystem contract, not a bug report.

## Background

DSH already provides rich seams: `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` for exact-model capability, `installModelSelection` for composing provider/model/reasoningEffort into an agent's request config, `prepareCall` for validating a call config, and the session log's `request/header` event as the durable record of what was actually sent.

We are building [DSHelm](https://github.com/Altairpaca/dshelm), an independent DSH-native agent distribution, and we wrote a keyless contract test that asserts the full chain:

```
DSHelm resolved policy (provider/model/reasoning)
  → real agent loop + installModelSelection composition
  → session request/header event
  → adapter GenerateOptions (the actual provider I/O)
```

For our own path these four agree (test: `packages/dsh/tests/dsh-request-contract.test.ts`). The question is about **plugin-authored** model routing — e.g. a team runtime that wants per-member models.

## Observations on the ecosystem

- `dsh-agent-teams` (0.1.5) passes per-member `agentOptions: { provider, model }` into `subagents.startContinuable` and uses a `withPending` bridge to make the selection visible while the child materializes. That is a reasonable composition strategy.
- The durable, replayable record of what actually happened is the child session's `request/header` event (and the adapter's `GenerateOptions`).
- There is no documented "effective model resolution" service: `resolveModelInfo` answers capability questions, `prepareCall` validates, but neither is an authority on *which* route a particular child ended up with.

## Questions

1. Is the session `request/header` event the **authoritative evidence** plugin authors should assert against for effective provider/model/reasoningEffort? (That is what we do; we'd like this confirmed as the intended contract.)
2. Is there (or is there a plan for) a public seam that answers "what effective route did this agent/child resolve to" — e.g. a `request/header` read helper, a model-selection snapshot, or a documented invariant?
3. For plugin-authored routing (per-member models, fallback chains), what is the recommended composition point: `agentOptions` on `SubagentStartRequest`, `installModelSelection` in the child setup scope, or both with an explicit precedence?

## Environment

- `dsh --version`: 0.1.0-rc.6
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*`: 0.1.0-rc.6, Cordis 4.0.1
- Test evidence: keyless composition (scripted rc.6 adapter), no credentials needed

We encountered this while building DSHelm, an independent open-source agent distribution for DSH (not affiliated with DeepSeek). Happy to turn any of the above into a concrete proposal or test fixture if that helps.

discussions.title: DSHelm — an OmO-inspired batteries-included agent distribution for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
## DSHelm — an OmO-inspired batteries-included agent distribution for DeepSeek Harness

Repo: https://github.com/Altairpaca/dshelm (Apache-2.0, independent project — not affiliated with DeepSeek)

### Problem

Bare DSH is a powerful plugin substrate, but a multi-agent coding environment still needs an opinionated layer: roles, model profiles with fallback chains, task categories, reasoning policy, tool/persona/depth policy, verification, and an answer to "why did my agent use this exact configuration?".

### What DSHelm owns

- **DSHelm Core** (`@dshelm/core`): a policy/routing/capability/provenance kernel — runtime-validated policy documents (nested schema, prototype-pollution guards on config and resolver inputs, key/id consistency, reference validation, plain-JSON round-trip), deterministic resolver with per-candidate structured evaluation, opaque reasoning identifiers, canonical **Resolution Trace**.
- **DSHelm DSH adapter** (`@dshelm/dsh`): a real `dshelm.policy` Cordis host service provided by the bundle itself, exact-model validation via `ctx.llm.resolveModelInfo` (`listModels` is advisory only), `dshelm/control-plane` session events folded into a session projection, subagent provider mapping onto official `SubagentStartRequest` seams, model-selection composition onto official `installModelSelection`, config precedence (`.dshelm/config.jsonc`, defaults → user → project → request).
- **dshelm doctor**: environment + distribution diagnostics (DSH/Cordis/DSHelm versions, ecosystem capabilities, a keyless runtime probe: resolution, exact-model validation, projection transport).
- **dshelm migrate omo**: read-only OmO config migration prototype (models/agents/categories + fallback chains → DSHelm policy; SUPPORTED/MAPPED/LOSSY/UNSUPPORTED report; dry-run by default).
- **ExecutionBackend contract**: native backend (verified) + AgentTeams adapter direction — core never depends on execution plugins.

### What DSHelm deliberately does not rebuild

Session runtime, agent loop, subagent runtime, provider transport, team mailbox/task DAG (dsh-agent-teams), workflow persistence, Cordis, terminal infrastructure. DSH is the execution foundation; DSHelm composes it.

### Verified seams (keyless tests, no credentials)

- ResolutionTrace == session `request/header` == adapter `GenerateOptions` (provider/model/reasoningEffort) — `packages/dsh/tests/dsh-request-contract.test.ts`.
- Real bundle host service: inject-declared, fiber lifecycle, duplicate registration fails loud; real profile boot (`qa:dsh-host`).
- Vertical slice: goal → planner PlanArtifact → bounded parallel workers → WorkerResults → structured reviewer verdict with bounded revision.
- Host→client projection transport (real SessionStore + SessionProjectionRegistry fold).
- A real browser client bundle now builds (projection-fed control-plane panel, `__ModuleLoader__` closure) — the round's npm blocker was resolved: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime@0.1.0-rc.6` is published and has no `dsh-compact` dependency (the 0.0.1-rc.1 latest tag is a stale line).

### Ecosystem stance

- OmO is a **behavioral/product reference** (SUL-1.0 — never copied; `dshelm migrate omo` is a read-only behavioral port).
- AgentTeams is a **reusable durable-team backend** (MIT), not a competitor — DSHelm policy maps onto it.
- Sisyphus presets (SUL-1.0) are a compatible preset backend, not something to clone.
- The feature matrix (`docs/ecosystem/omo-feature-matrix.md`) records what is NATIVE / MATURE_PLUGIN / MISSING — DSHelm only implements real gaps.

### Known blockers

- Credentialed E2E (no key in dev environment) — keyless acceptance unaffected.
- Live browser rendering of the client panel needs a real Web shell session.
- npm publish of `@dshelm/*` pending registry credentials.

### Status

v0.1 baseline merged to `main` (CI green: core-unit, core-property, typecheck, build, dsh-contract, pack-install). v0.2 distribution work in progress on `feat/v0.2-distribution`. Feedback welcome — especially on the [effective-model-selection contract question](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2053).

discussions.title: dsh web server crashes with ENOENT when subprocess temp dir is cleaned mid-task (no self-healing)
discussions.body:
## Summary

The `dsh web` server crashes the entire process when a running task's subprocess output directory under the session temp dir is removed/cleaned while the subprocess is still alive. The crash is **not contained** to the task — it takes down the whole gateway, and there is no retry/self-healing.

## Reproduced (twice, same stack)

Both crashes are identical, from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` `OutputCollector.spillAll`:

```
node:fs:697
  return binding.open(
                 ^

Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\Administrator\AppData\Local\Temp\reasonix-session-tmp-2783212258\dsh-subprocess-nX1pQh\dsh-subprocess-12560-2-fa38ca524bec-stderr.log'
    at openSync (node:fs:697:18)
    at OutputCollector.spillAll (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:417:19)
    at OutputCollector.push (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:393:75)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (file:///.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:562:14)
    at Socket.emit (node:events:514:20)
    ...
```

Occurred on two different long-running sessions:
- `reasonix-session-tmp-217339424` (stdout log, `-stdout.log`)
- `reasonix-session-tmp-2783212258` (stderr log, `-stderr.log`)

Environment: Node.js v26.7.0, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, Windows 10/11.

## Root cause hypothesis

The parent session temp dir (`reasonix-session-tmp-<n>`) still exists at crash time, but the per-subprocess child dir (`dsh-subprocess-<id>/`) has already been removed. When the subprocess later writes output, `OutputCollector.push` → `spillAll` calls `openSync` on the now-missing file and throws an uncaught `ENOENT`, which kills the Node process. So something (temp cleanup / session GC) deletes a subprocess output dir that is still in active use, and the error is not handled — the whole web gateway dies instead of just failing that one subprocess.

## Impact

- A long-running agent task running in the DSH web UI silently kills the entire `dsh web` gateway.
- All open sessions are disrupted; the task in progress is interrupted (session data survives, but the run stops).
- No automatic recovery: the service stays down until manually restarted.

## Expected behavior

- Deleting a subprocess output dir that is still owned by a live subprocess should be prevented (lifecycle-aware cleanup), or
- `OutputCollector` should tolerate the missing dir (recreate it / reopen / buffer in memory) so a single subprocess I/O error cannot crash the whole process.

## Reproduce

1. Start `dsh web`.
2. Launch a long-running agent task that spawns subprocesses writing to the temp session dir.
3. While the task is running, delete/clean `dsh-subprocess-<id>` under the session temp dir (or wait for whatever cleanup path does it).
4. The next subprocess output write crashes the entire gateway with the ENOENT stack above.

discussions.title: Profile-local host package copies shadow the installation and crash PTC run_code ('prepare'); the failed turn then poisons session history
discussions.body:
## Summary

Two related bugs in `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, reproduced on two Windows x64 machines:

1. If an installed plugin pulls a host package (e.g. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) into the profile's own `node_modules`, the cordis include loader instantiates the `tools` service (`ToolRuntime`) from that profile-local copy, while the rest of the harness uses the copy from the dsh installation. `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a module-level `Symbol`, so `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(...)` reads `undefined` and every PTC `run_code` dispatch crashes with `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` (surfaced as code `UNKNOWN`).

2. That crash aborts the turn after the assistant `tool_calls` message was persisted but before any tool result was appended. Every later turn then fails with HTTP 400 `INVALID_REQUEST`: *"An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'"*. The session never recovers; starting a new session is the only way out.

## Reproduction

1. In a fresh profile, install any plugin whose `package.json` lists `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` under `dependencies` (we hit this with our own `dsh-doc@0.1.0`): `dsh plugin --profile web add <that-plugin>`. pnpm then places a real copy at `<profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`.
2. Restart `dsh web`, open a session in PTC (code) mode, and send any prompt that makes the model use tools.
3. The first `run_code` call crashes with the `prepare` error; every following turn fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`.

Verified by tracing ESM resolution during boot: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` imported with the profile dir as the parent URL resolves to `<profile>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js`, while `dsh-agent-loop` and friends resolve it to the global installation. Every other host package falls through to the `profiles/node_modules` fallback symlinks and stays single-instance; only packages physically present in the profile's `node_modules` split.

## Root cause

- `dsh-base`'s bundle patch declares the tool registry as `- id: tools / name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'`. The include loader imports plugin packages by bare name with the profile directory as the resolution base, so a profile-local copy wins over the installation copy.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` keys the runtime scheduler on a module-identity `Symbol` (`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER`). Two module instances → two distinct symbols → `registry[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` → `.prepare` throws. (Relevant spots: `dsh-agent-loop` tool-call dispatch and the `dsh-tools` code-mode transport.)

## Suggested fixes

- Resolve service/bundle packages with installation-anchor precedence (as `resolveBundleDir` already does for bundles), or fail loudly at boot when a profile-local copy of an in-box package shadows the installation copy.
- Consider `Symbol.for(...)` or a plain string key for cross-module contracts like the scheduler, so accidental package duplication degrades gracefully instead of crashing tool dispatch.
- On turn abort after `tool_calls` were emitted, roll back the orphaned assistant message or append synthetic error tool results before the next request, so one failed turn doesn't permanently corrupt the session history.

## Workaround for plugin authors

Declare every `@deepseek-ai/*` host package as a peer dependency (never a runtime dependency), so installing a plugin never places host packages into the profile's `node_modules`. We shipped this as `dsh-doc@0.1.1` and verified single-instance resolution with a boot-time module trace afterwards.

Environment: Windows 11 x64, Node 24, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, profile managed by `dsh plugin add` (pnpm 10, `nodeLinker: hoisted`).

discussions.title: dsh-persist：让 DSH 的 agent 不再"换对话就失忆"（记忆分层 + 语义检索 + 自动召回）
discussions.body:
大家好，自荐一个刚发布的 DSH 记忆插件 [dsh-persist](https://github.com/tluoluo/dsh-persist)（npm：[dsh-persist@0.2.0](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-persist)）。

默认情况下 DSH 的 agent **换对话就失忆**——上下文一关，什么都不记得。dsh-persist 把记忆做成文件系统上的分层结构，每个对话**按需注入**：

- **对话独有记忆**：每个对话一本"不会丢的笔记本"，其他对话看不到、不注入
- **选择性注入**：勾选什么才注入什么；新对话默认零注入，不占上下文
- **项目记忆**：同一工作目录共享项目经验；命名项目可把同目录的多项目分开
- **Vault 语义记忆**：bge-m3 按意思检索（硅基流动免费 key 即可），不配 key 自动降级关键词搜索
- **自动召回**：每轮按你的消息自动从 Vault 检索相关记忆注入（可关）
- **记忆 tab**：对话顶部可视化编辑 + 注入配置 + 实时预览
- **全部纯文本存储**（`~/.dsh-memory/`），可读可改、随时备份迁移

安装三步：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-persist
# 重启 DSH 后，对话顶部「记忆」tab 即可用
```

设计上对标 LTM / PARA Project / Zettelkasten 分层（README 有对照表），内置自动写入/清理/归档维护标准，agent 会自己维护记忆。欢迎试用反馈。

discussions.title: Web UI 发送消息偶发报错 "signal timed out (internal)"：unary RPC 固定 30s 超时且不可配置
discussions.body:
# Bug Report：DSH web UI 发送消息偶发超时 `signal timed out (internal)`

- **仓库**：`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`
- **提交地址**：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/issues/new
- **严重程度**：中（可用性问题，偶发、重试可恢复）

## 环境

- Windows 11 10.0.26200 (x64)
- Node.js v24.19.0
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- web profile 以 Windows 服务方式运行（nssm，LocalSystem，session 0，端口 3080）

## 现象

- Web UI 发送消息偶尔失败，聊天中插入错误气泡：`signal timed out (internal)`
- 偶发，重试通常能成功；与 host 负载相关（安装多个插件 / 后台有任务运行时更易触发）

## 证据

- 客户端连接层 `dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js`：
  - `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 3e4`（**30 秒固定值，非配置项**）
  - `postJson()` 对 unary RPC 无条件附加 `AbortSignal.timeout(30s)`：
    ```js
    const requestSignal = timeoutPolicy === "default"
      ? signal === void 0 ? AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs)
      : AbortSignal.any([AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs), signal])
      : signal;
    ```
    超时即中止，抛出的 DOMException 文案正是 `signal timed out (internal)`。
  - 聊天发送走 unary RPC（如 `session.prompt`，返回 receipt），receipt 超过 30s 未返回即失败。
- host 为单进程，同时承载 agent loop + 12 个常开 MCP stdio server + 插件；事件循环繁忙时 unary RPC 容易越过 30s 被误杀。
- 该超时值在 profile 配置中无透出项，无法调整。

## 期望 vs 实际

- **期望**：host 繁忙时应排队/延后处理，而非用固定 30s 误杀用户发送；错误信息应可定位（哪个 RPC、哪个环节、超时时长）。
- **实际**：固定 30s 超时 + 含糊文案，用户无法区分是客户端连接问题、host 繁忙还是 provider 慢。

## 建议

1. 超时值可配置（profile patch / 设置项），默认值可调大（如 60s）。
2. 错误文案带上上下文：RPC 方法名、超时时长、host 状态。
3. 对发送类 RPC 采用更宽松的超时策略（代码中已有 user-paced / stream 免超时策略，可扩展）。

---

> **AI 标识**：本报告由 AI 辅助生成（ZCode · DeepSeek-V4），技术事实、代码行号与版本号经人工核实；提交前建议再自查一遍关键行号与版本号。

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-agent-memory — self-evolving memory with a "dream" pass, user profile, and provenance from the replayable session log（自进化记忆插件）
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

**`@dsh-kit/agent-memory`** — a self-evolving memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness. It brings the industry's **"dream" memory-consolidation pattern** (Claude Code Dream / ChatGPT Dreaming / Letta sleep-time) to DSH for the first time, and it builds on the one asset Claude Code and Codex structurally lack: **the replayable, typed session log**.

Repo: https://github.com/findshan/dsh-agent-memory · npm: `@dsh-kit/agent-memory` · MIT · `dsh-plugin` topic

## Why memory, why now

We surveyed the DSH memory ecosystem (120+ plugins) and the industry (Claude Code, Codex, ChatGPT Dreaming, Letta, MEM0, Zep) and found two things:

1. **The "dream" is now an industry-standard mechanism** — background memory consolidation while the user is away (merge, dedupe, correct, prune). Anthropic's `/dream` is shipped, OpenAI's Dreaming V3 is live, Letta has sleep-time agents. But **zero DSH plugins implement it**.
2. **DSH has a structural advantage nobody is using**: every session is a **fully typed, replayable event log** — `user/message` with source, `tool/call`/`tool/result` with exact args and results, `assistant/message` with token usage, `request/header` snapshots, fork/resume lineage. Claude Code's memory system has to `grep` JSONL transcripts; DSH memory can be **derived from ground truth with provenance back to exact `(sessionId, seq)` events**.

## What it does

**Capture → Dream (consolidate) → Retrieve/inject → Evolve**

- **Layered belief store**: `user` (profile) / `project` / `session` / `global` scopes, each a plaintext belief with confidence, importance, and **provenance**.
- **Correction learning**: you correct the agent → it learns automatically → the new belief **supersedes** the old one (history kept, auditable). The #1 trust builder, built into the write path.
- **The Dream pass**: a gated background job (interval + session count + lock file) that reads new session events, merges duplicates, supersedes contradictions, archives stale beliefs, and refreshes a "last time we were doing X" resume digest — injected at session start so the agent opens by continuing, not by asking.
- **Frozen profile snapshot**: top user + project beliefs injected at ≤2k tokens (PersonaMem-v2 shows 2k-token agentic memory beats full-context personalization while using 16× fewer tokens).
- **7 compact tools** for the model: `memory_save / memory_search / memory_list / memory_confirm / memory_forget / memory_profile / memory_dream`.
- **Governance**: writes land as `suggested` and only become active on human confirmation; everything is plaintext, local-first, zero native dependencies.

## The 30-second demo

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-kit/agent-memory
```

```ts
// any plugin: inject: ['memory']
await ctx.memory.remember({ content: '用户偏好 pnpm 而非 npm', scope: 'user', kind: 'preference' })
const hits = await ctx.memory.search('pnpm')   // BM25, ranked by relevance × confidence × importance
await ctx.memory.confirm(id)                   // human confirms → active
await ctx.memory.dream(true)                   // force a consolidation pass
```

## Where the research went

We wrote the full landscape survey while designing this — competitor mechanisms, memory architectures (MEM0/Letta/Zep), the DSH ecosystem gap analysis, and the mechanism verification against DSH source. It's in the repo: `research/` + `PRD.md`.

## Why this position is open

| Position | Who holds it today |
|---|---|
| Three-in-one (self-evolving + profile + project) | `dsh-memory-evolve` — but fully self-built storage, no official infra |
| Official-infra reuse (approval, systemPrompt, sessionQuery) | `dsh-memento` / `Max-Null` — but no evolution/dream |
| Log-citation extraction | `Jesse-njx/dsh-memory` — but no profile, no dream |
| **All of it + dream consolidation + provenance from the replayable log** | **nobody — this is the open seam we're claiming** |

**Feedback wanted**: is the 7-tool surface right? Should the dream's LLM-assisted consolidation (v0.2) use a forked subagent like AutoDream, or inline cheap-model calls? What would make this the memory seam you'd actually adopt?

---

## 中文版

**`@dsh-kit/agent-memory`** —— 为 DeepSeek Harness 打造的自进化记忆插件。首次把行业前沿的 **「梦境式记忆整合」**（Claude Code Dream / ChatGPT Dreaming / Letta sleep-time）带到 DSH，并且建立在 Claude Code 和 Codex 结构上做不到的资产上：**可回放、类型化的会话日志**。

**为什么现在做**：调研了 DSH 生态 120+ 记忆插件与全行业后确认——①「梦境」已是行业标准机制，但 DSH 生态零实现；② DSH 的全量类型化事件日志（`tool/call` 精确参数、`assistant/message` 带 token 计费、fork 谱系）是别人没有的 ground truth，却没人用它做记忆。

**它做什么**：捕获 → 梦境整合 → 检索注入 → 进化。
- 分层信念库（用户画像 / 项目 / 会话 / 全局），每条带置信度、重要性、**溯源**
- **纠错即学**：纠正 → 自动学习 → 覆盖旧信念（历史可审计）
- **梦境 pass**：门控后台任务，合并去重、淘汰过时、刷新"上次进展"叙事
- 冻结画像注入 ≤2k token；7 个精简工具；suggested→active 人机共治；明文本地、零原生依赖

仓库：https://github.com/findshan/dsh-agent-memory · 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add @dsh-kit/agent-memory`

期待大家的反馈：工具面是否合适？v0.2 的 LLM 整合该用 fork 子代理（AutoDream 式）还是内联轻量模型？怎样才是你愿意真正采用的记忆缝？

discussions.title: [性能] 多插件环境下刷新页面全量重下全部 bundle（no-cache），主线程拥塞致插件延迟 10-20s；建议按 rev immutable 缓存
discussions.body:
## 一句话
刷新页面后所有插件 bundle 无缓存全量重下、重新执行，多插件环境（50 个 bundle / 4.9MB）下浏览器主线程拥塞，尾部落地的插件（如 whale-girl 宠物）延迟 **10-20s** 才显示。

## 复现
- 环境：DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 / web profile / Windows 11，安装 @linxin666/dsh-web-ui-all（14 个插件）+ whale-girl
- 步骤：刷新页面（Ctrl+Shift+R），观察右下角宠物出现时间
- 实际：10-20s（禁用全家桶后立刻出现）
- 预期：刷新后秒级加载

## 根因
`dsh-client-modules.serveBundle` 对所有插件 bundle 返回 `cache-control: no-cache`，而 bundle URL 本身带**内容哈希 rev**（`/plugins/<id>/client.js?rev=<hash>`）——rev 不变内容必不变，完全具备 immutable 长缓存的语义条件。当前每次刷新都全量重下 50 个 bundle（实测 4.9MB）并重新解析执行，主线程被占满；请求数量多、初始化重的插件（whale-girl 16 个素材请求 + 15 次逐像素扫描）排最后，被拖到 10-20s。

## 建议
- **bundle 响应按 rev 提供 `public, max-age=31536000, immutable`**（rev 变则 URL 变，天然失效）；开发期热重载场景可仅对无 rev / 调试请求保留 no-cache
- 参考：whale-girl 素材路由同样 no-cache，本机改为 immutable 后问题立刻消失（相关 issue：vlln/whale-girl#6）

## 验收条件
- 多插件环境下刷新页面，插件（含第三方宠物等）秒级出现
- 开发期改源码后 HMR/刷新仍能看到新内容（rev 变化机制不受影响）

## 用户侧临时缓解（已本机验证）
- 第三方插件素材路由加 immutable 缓存头 + 首屏优先加载（详见 vlln/whale-girl#6）；平台层 bundle 缓存仍需官方修复。

discussions.title: The price change hits cache-heavy users hardest: a 650-request audit, reconciled against billing
discussions.body:
I pulled every request out of my local `~/.dsh/sessions` logs: 650 requests,
16 sessions, 155.9M prompt tokens, and a 98.09% cache hit rate on v4-pro
(normal for agent workloads — the same context gets resent constantly).

Repricing those exact tokens under the new table (effective Aug 16, 16:00 UTC):
my bill lands at **2.7x**. The same tokens with zero cache hits would be only
1.5x. The better caching works for you today, the bigger your increase —
because the three meters didn't move together (v4-pro, old flat card vs new
off-peak card, USD per 1M tokens):

| tier | old flat | new off-peak | change |
|---|---|---|---|
| input, cache hit | $0.003625 | $0.022 | **6.1x** |
| input, cache miss | $0.435 | $0.66 | 1.5x |
| output | $0.87 | $1.98 | 2.3x |

Most coverage quotes the output increase. The tier that actually moved most is
the cheapest one — the old card was extremely generous to cache-heavy
workloads, so those workloads eat the biggest correction. To be clear, caching
is still absolutely worth it: on this workload it still cuts the bill ~15x
versus no cache. It's just a much less steep discount than before.

The second lever is the new peak/off-peak windows: peak is 01:00–04:00 and
06:00–10:00 UTC, and off-peak is half price. If you work US hours, your entire
9-to-5 falls in off-peak on both coasts. If you work Chinese hours, peak sits
almost exactly on the workday — batch jobs shifted to evenings get 50% off
without touching a line of code.

On whether these numbers are real: I reconciled the same billing period
against the DeepSeek console — 2% delta on both spend and tokens, explained by
34 requests missing from local logs (a session deleted before the audit, plus
failed or retried requests that never wrote a completed message). So every
figure above is a floor, not an estimate.

Don't trust my numbers — run your own. dsh already writes per-request token
accounting to `~/.dsh/sessions`, hit/miss split included. This script parses
them offline (single file, stdlib only, no network, never touches
credentials) and prints your hit rate, your bill under the old/new/no-cache
tables, and your warmup curve:

```
curl -O https://deepseekprice.com/dsh-cache-audit.py
python3 dsh-cache-audit.py
```

Full methodology and the reconciliation: https://deepseekprice.com/deepseek-cache-pricing
Peak/off-peak windows rendered in your timezone: https://deepseekprice.com/off-peak-hours
(The pages are mine; the script is free to use.)
