discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 的极简模式运行 Shell 工具时报错，str_replace_editor 工具在 Read Only 的情况下可读写工作区外文件
discussions.body:
代码分析部分完全使用 DeepSeek Harness 完成，本人没有动过一点大脑（）我对 Node 的了解比较少，这个 Discussion 也是大晚上写的，估计比较烂，凑合看看，轻喷（

---

我听到 Linux + Minimal 能发挥几乎全部实力，我就吭哧吭哧跑来了，虽然我是 Windows，搭配的是 PowerShell，但我觉得也可以试一下，结果 `subprocess-local` 盖了我一巴掌（bushi

**测试环境**：Windows 11 23H2 (22631.6199)

**DSH 启动参数**：`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`（默认，设置我也没调）

Windows 的极简模式下运行命令出错的问题很简单，我觉得大伙也知道：

极简模式没有根据平台区分 Shell 工具，而 `subprocess-local` 因为平台不对直接打回去了，喜提 `Error: subprocess-local: terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`。当然用户侧已经有一个解决方案了，比如 #1832 和对应的[插件仓库](https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-win32)。

标准模式倒是有按平台区分，DSH 核心也是这么做的：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml#L210-L216

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/apps/cli/config/agent-presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml#L35-L50

---

接下来是另一个问题：

我在尝试 Minimal 的过程中发现 `str_replace_editor` 可以任意读取工作区外的文件，我个人十分担忧，但大肥鱼跟我说这是工程取舍。我没怎么经常使用 AI 编程，不知道大伙怎么想的（）让别人能够读你工作区的密钥和私人文件，就算对面是只大肥鱼心里也会担忧吧（

但我让大肥鱼分析源码之后发现这个工具没有读限制，也没有写限制。没错，你在权限为 **Read Only** 的情况下也能读写，`str_replace_editor` 使用的文件系统 shadow 了宿主的文件系统沙箱，甚至源码里都写了相应的注释：

https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/apps/cli/config/agent-presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml#L46-L62

测试我也简单的测了一下：


那么什么所谓的根因链我就引用大肥鱼的报告：

> ### 根因链（代码路径）
> 
> 1. **极简 preset 给编辑器接了一个"裸"文件系统后端** — `apps/cli/config/agent-presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml:46-62`：
>    ```yaml
>    - id: filesystem
>      group: true
>      isolate: { fs: true }
>      config:
>        - id: fs-local          # @deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local（无沙箱）
>          config: { cwd: !!js process.env.DSH_CWD ?? process.cwd() }
>        - id: str-replace-editor # @deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-str-replace-editor
>    ```
>    注释自认："The bare local filesystem shadows the host's sandboxed provider only for this preset."
> 
> 2. **隔离 realm 的遮蔽机制** — `isolate: { fs: true }` 在组内开辟独立 `fs` 作用域（Cordis `ctx.isolate` 语义，见 `docs/cordis-api/context.md`）；组内 `fs-local` 在该 realm 提供 `fs`，遮蔽了根 realm 的宿主 `fs-sandbox`（`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:443-444`）。编辑器 `inject = ['tools', 'fs']`（`packages/fs/tool-str-replace-editor/src/index.ts:494`）按名字解析，最近提供者获胜。
>
>    https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml#L441-L444
> 
>    https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/fs/tool-str-replace-editor/src/index.ts#L494
>
> 3. **工具以 `sandboxMode` 判断是否有沙箱，裸后端报告"无"** — `packages/fs/fs/src/index.ts:91-105` 契约：`FileSystem.sandboxMode` 对裸后端返回 `undefined`（"does not confine at all"），仅 `fs-sandbox` 返回部署默认模式。于是 `MutationPolicy`（`tool-str-replace-editor/src/index.ts:65-73`）：
>
>    ```ts
>    this.policy = ctx.fs.sandboxMode === undefined ? undefined : ctx.get('sandboxPolicy')
>    ```
>
>    拿到裸后端时 `policy = undefined` → 三个写命令的 `sandboxPolicy` 恒为空。
> 
> 4. **裸后端的写本来就无条件** — `packages/fs/fs-local/src/index.ts:166-171` 的 `writeText` 签名没有 `sandboxPolicy` 参数；沙箱 containment（`checkedTarget`）只存在于 `packages/fs/fs-sandbox/src/index.ts:84-145`（read-only 拒绝一切写；workspace-write 校验 containment；`FS_SANDBOX_DENIED`）。
>
>    https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/fs/fs-local/src/index.ts#L166-L171
>
>    https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/fs/fs-sandbox/src/index.ts#L73-L148

从该报告可以看出，`str_replace_editor` 寻找 `fs`，发现了 `fs-local` 它就用了这个文件系统后端，直接绕开了宿主的文件系统沙盒。

---

另外一个我感觉不算太紧要的事情：

我去测试了一下 `str_replace_editor` 的写，让 AI 写入 `E:\test.txt`（工作区外），我发现如果在根目录创建文件夹会遇到目录创建不出来的问题，我觉得这好像是把盘符当作了目录处理来 `mkdir` 但是失败了：

> Payload:
>
> ```json
> {
>   "command": "create",
>   "path": "E:\\test.txt",
>   "file_text": "test"
> }
> ```
> 
> Result:
> 
> ```
> Error: EPERM: operation not permitted, mkdir 'E:\'
> ```

discussions.title: Bug 报告：未分组的对话（Ungrouped Sessions）无法删除
discussions.body:
环境：DeepSeek Harness Web UI

问题描述：
在 deepseek-harness 的 Web 界面中，位于 "Ungrouped"（未分组）列表下的对话会话（Session）缺少删除功能。这属于产品设计上的缺陷。

预期行为：
用户应该能够删除任何对话，无论它是否被归类到某个 Workspace 分组下。

实际行为：
在 Workspace 分组内的对话，可以通过行内的 Delete 操作进行删除（删除分组后，其下的会话会保留并移至 Ungrouped 下）。然而，对于原生就处于或移入 "Ungrouped" 列表的会话，界面上没有提供删除入口。这导致这些会话会永久驻留在侧边栏，无法被清理。

背景说明：
根据项目架构，Workspace 列表和 "Ungrouped" 列表在数据持久化策略上存在差异：Workspace 的顺序和元数据会与服务端同步，而 "Ungrouped" 的状态仅保存在浏览器本地。但无论如何，用户对于数据删除的基本操作需求是合理的。目前的设计限制了用户对本地数据的控制权。

建议修复方向：
为 "Ungrouped" 列表中的每个会话项添加删除按钮（或右键菜单选项），并实现对应的前端删除逻辑与本地存储清理，确保用户体验的一致性。

discussions.title: Bug: two different session events share the same seq — "corrupt session log: seq gap" on load
discussions.body:
## Bug: two different session events share the same seq — "corrupt session log: seq gap" on load

### Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 (web profile, Windows 11)
- Node 22.23.1
- Session persistence: `session.jsonl.zstd` (zstd, packed chunk rows)

### Symptom

Loading a session fails with:

```
history unavailable for session "session-ad228b75-13e8-4979-bfbd-33d84a9ddb27":
Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 30976
(expected 461421, got 461420)（internal）
```

### Evidence (from the damaged artifact)

Decompressing the log and inspecting around the reported line shows **two different events that were both allocated seq 461420**:

```json
{"type":"session/end-seed","seq":461420,...}
{"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","seq":461420,"time":1786716691871,
 "data":{"target":"next-turn","start":0,"inserted":[{...user message...}]}}
{"type":"turn/start","seq":461421,...}
```

The loader (`SessionLogScanner.consumeEventLine`) requires `event.seq === events.length` (0-based expanded-event index). Because `agent/inbox/spliced` carries the same seq as the preceding `session/end-seed`, the check fails and the whole log is refused.

All 471,075 expanded events before and after this point are strictly contiguous (verified by replaying the same `decodeStorageRecord` expansion the loader uses), so this is the **single** corruption in the file.

### Root-cause hypothesis

The two events come from **different write paths**:

- `session/end-seed` — appended by the `Session` constructor (seed boundary on reopen/resume),
- `agent/inbox/spliced` — appended by the agent loop when a user message arrives.

Both received seq 461420, and the counter continued correctly at 461421 afterwards. This looks like a **race in seq allocation across concurrent appends** (e.g., the next-seq value was derived from a stale log-length snapshot, or the append path is not serialized across these two writers). Since the two lines carry different event types, this is not a torn-write duplicate of one event — the allocator handed out the same sequence number twice.

### Impact

A session with one duplicated seq becomes **entirely unloadable** (the loader refuses the whole log, not just the bad event). The user loses access to the whole conversation history until manual repair.

### Suggested direction

- Serialize seq allocation per session (single monotonic counter updated atomically with the append), or
- Have the loader tolerate/skip a single duplicate-seq row (log a warning and continue) instead of failing the whole log, or
- Investigate the `session/end-seed` vs `agent/inbox/spliced` interleaving around session reopen while a message is queued.

### Notes

- We repaired the affected file locally by removing the duplicate `agent/inbox/spliced` row and rebuilding the zstd frames (frame 1 = header line, frame 2 = events); the session loads fine afterwards. The paired inbox-removal row and the `user/message` for the same input were both intact, so no model-visible history was lost.
- I could not reproduce this deterministically — it happened once under normal use (message sent while the session was being reopened/restored).

discussions.title: 显式说明 web_search 搜索模型使用：搜索结果卡片显示实际计费模型，设置卡片可配置搜索模型
discussions.body:
## 内容

**现状不足**：用户把会话模型设为 "DeepSeek V4 Pro · max"，官网用量页却出现 flash 计费。主循环请求全程 pro max，但 `web_search` 每次以固定默认模型 `deepseek-v4-flash` 发独立辅助请求，界面无任何提示——对话中的搜索结果卡片不显示计费模型，设置 → 插件「联网搜索」卡片也无模型字段。

**升级带来的改进**：两层透明化，不改默认模型——

- 对话中的搜索结果卡片动态显示实际计费模型（当场看清 flash 账单来源）；
- 设置 → 插件「联网搜索」卡片补上 `model` 字段（Host schema 已有该字段，仅 UI 未暴露），改后下一次搜索即生效、无需重启。

检索在服务端完成，flash 只做工具触发与结果转述，属合理分层；本升级保持默认模型不变，只让用户看得见、改得动。

## 升级方案

**方案要点**：

- B 配置可见可改：设置「联网搜索」卡片补 `model` 字段（留空=默认 flash，语义不变）。
- A 现场可见：搜索结果卡片显示实际计费模型（动态取实际请求事实，不写死）。

**涉及位置**：阶段一 1 个包（`ui-settings-plugins`）；阶段二 7 个包（`web`、`web-search-deepseek`、`core/tools`、`tool-cordis` 生成物、`tool-web`、`ui-primitives`、`ui-tool`）。

**实施要点（已实施并自测）**：数据线为 `dsh-web` 结果类型 → `web-search-deepseek` provider 把实际请求的 `options.model` 写入结果 → `tool-web` meta/视图透传 → `ui-tool` 卡片渲染；model 走 presentation meta 落入会话日志可重建，旧日志无 model 时卡片不显示该行（天然回退）。

**自测证据**：

- `pnpm run typecheck` 通过（exit 0）。
- `pnpm run verify-cordis-catalog` 通过（93 个生成文件/区域 up to date）。
- `pnpm run test:gui` 通过（272 文件、3760 测试、1 跳过）。
- `DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm run test:web`：built-boot 快照（1）与 web-search-round e2e（6/6）通过。
- `pnpm run lint` 通过（0 warnings 0 errors）。

**偏离声明**：无偏离；红线全守——不换默认模型、不碰 provider 选择/认证/重定向、卡片模型取实际请求事实（不硬编码）。

**遗留问题（诚实声明）**：`packages/web`、`packages/core` 组级单测在本机受 vitest 运行器问题阻塞（环境/前置问题，与本次改动无关）；验收 B2/B3 的 pro 覆盖路径由 `settings.spec.ts` 断言但本机同受该阻塞，默认 flash 路径的 `body.model` 已由 web-search-round e2e（6/6）实证。

discussions.title: Measured: your skill catalog costs ~28 tokens per skill on every request · 实测技能目录的 token 账单
discussions.body:
Every request that can see skills carries the `<available_skills>` system-reminder, one line per skill. I reconstructed the block byte for byte from the rc.6 source (`packages/skill/tool-skill/src/index.ts`, `renderCatalog`) and tokenized it:

| skills in catalog | tokens per request | marginal per skill |
|---|---|---|
| 0 | 143 | |
| 20 | 703 | ~28 |
| 40 | 1,263 | ~28 |
| 129 | 3,755 | ~28 |

- Fixed framing 143 tokens, each skill ~28 (median 96-char description, your bill scales with description length).
- 129 is the orange-book boot count, a setup that size pays ~3.8k tokens of catalog per request. Prompt caching softens the money, not the context window.
- Workspace instructions add 50 tokens of framing plus your whole AGENTS.md/CLAUDE.md (64KB cap).
- This is also the exact block the anchored-standard style bootstraps suppress on request #1, now you can price that suppression for your own setup.

Reproduce: `node scripts/token-bill.mjs` in https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein (tokenizer o200k as approximation, DeepSeek tokenizer has no JS build). Full writeup, https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-movein/blob/main/docs/token-bill.md

Practical take for migrators, curate before you migrate, move the skills you use, not the skills you have. Descriptions are the per-request bill, keep them tight.

---

实测：每个技能在每个请求里花 ~28 token（96 字符描述计），目录固定包装 143 token，129 个技能 ≈ 每请求 3.8k token。缓存省钱不省上下文窗口。结论：搬家前先精简，描述写短点。格式逐字取自 rc.6 源码，仓库里一条命令可复现。

discussions.title: Question: smooth upgrade path for a long-running dsh web service
discussions.body:
---

## Title

Feature request / question: smooth upgrade path for a long-running `dsh web` service

## Body

**Context**

We run `dsh web` as a long-lived local service (default `127.0.0.1:3080`), supervised by launchd with `KeepAlive`. We want to upgrade it automatically whenever a new version of `@deepseek-ai/dsh` is published, with minimal service interruption.

**What we found so far**

- The CLI has no `update` / `upgrade` / `self-update` command (`dsh --help`, `dsh web --help`).
- Neither the repo README, `apps/cli/reference/README.md`, nor `docs/` describe an upgrade procedure for npm-installed `dsh`; there is no changelog/release notes file in `apps/cli`.
- From `apps/cli/reference/README.md` we derived:
  - In-box bundles (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`, …) always resolve from the same installation as the running `dsh`; the profile fallback links under `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` are "healed on every launch" (confirmed in source: `healProfilesModuleFallback(INSTALL_ANCHOR)` walks the current install's dependency tree and re-links).
  - A first `SIGINT`/`SIGTERM` starts a graceful drain with up to 5 s for the plugin tree to dispose; `SIGTERM` exits 0.
- Our current approach therefore is: install the new version into the same fixed directory (`npm install --prefix … @deepseek-ai/dsh@<new>`), verify `dsh --version`, then SIGTERM the running process and let the supervisor (launchd `KeepAlive`) restart it against the new install. Health-check afterwards; roll back on failure. This gives ~5 s of interruption worst case.

**Questions for the maintainers**

1. Is there an officially recommended (or upcoming) upgrade flow for `@deepseek-ai/dsh`? E.g. a `dsh update` command, or a documented procedure?
2. Is the install-directory swap + graceful restart approach considered safe for session/data persistence under `$DSH_HOME` (sessions, `storages/`, `workspace.json`)? Are in-flight sessions expected to survive a version upgrade?
3. Is true zero-downtime upgrade possible (e.g. starting a new instance on the same port before killing the old one, or hot-reload of bundles)? If not, is the 5 s graceful-drain window the intended ceiling for downtime?
4. Would you accept a docs PR that adds an "Upgrading" section to `apps/cli/reference/README.md` (or a new doc) covering: check version, install new version, graceful restart, verify, rollback?

**Environment**

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, macOS, npm-installed, `dsh web` profile.

discussions.title: 线上部署了deepseek-harness容器，可以不同用户之间隔离使用。但是用起来总感觉容易中断，不能做复杂的任务
Agent 在用户连续拒绝权限审批后陷入无限思考循环
discussions.body:
问题简述

在使用 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 时，Agent 在用户多次拒绝其权限审批请求后，陷入了“思考 → 申请审批 → 被拒绝 → 再思考”的无限循环，无法正常终止或接受用户的新指令。

复现步骤

    在 Web UI 中启动一个 DeepSeek Harness 会话（默认 workspace-write + ask 权限模式）。

    向 Agent 提出一个需要权限审批的任务（例如需要写入文件或执行命令）。

    Agent 思考后发起一个权限审批请求（ctx.approval.request）。

    用户在 UI 中点击 拒绝（Reject）。

    用户开始在输入框中打字，准备向 Agent 说明拒绝原因和调整方向。

    在用户尚未发送新消息的情况下，Agent 自动重新开始思考，分析“用户为什么拒绝”，然后自行提出一个“调整后的方案”，并再次发起新的审批请求。

    用户再次点击拒绝，Agent 又再次自动进入思考循环。

    即使 Agent 在思考中输出类似“你可能有别的想法，你说，我听”的语句，表示愿意倾听用户输入，但实际上它并未等待用户发送消息，而是继续自行思考并发起新一轮审批。

    此循环持续不断，用户无法打断，也无法发送新的指令来纠正 Agent 的行为。

预期行为

    当用户拒绝审批后，Agent 应停止当前动作，等待用户的下一条输入，而非自动重新思考并再次申请审批。

    用户应能够在拒绝后立即发送新的指令，Agent 应优先响应用户的新输入，而不是继续自行循环。

    或者在连续多次拒绝后，Agent 应主动暂停并请求用户明确指示，而不是无限重试。

实际行为

Agent 将用户的每次拒绝都视为一个需要“解决”的“任务结果”，触发新一轮的 Agent Loop，而不是将拒绝理解为“暂停并等待用户指令”。即使 Agent 在输出中表示愿意倾听，其底层循环机制仍未真正等待用户输入，导致用户无法介入对话。

环境信息

    版本：v0.1 开发者预览版（当前 master）

    运行方式：Web UI（默认 workspace-write + ask 权限模式）

    权限策略：ask（默认）

补充说明

这个问题在交互式使用场景中严重影响用户体验。当 Agent 的理解出现偏差时，用户希望通过拒绝审批 + 文字说明来纠正 Agent，但当前的循环机制使得用户无法完成这个“纠正”动作，因为 Agent 不会等待用户输入就自行进入了下一轮循环。

官方文档中提到，ctx.approval 的 rejected 结果会导致工具体被跳过，调用方对 rejected 执行拒绝。但目前的实现中，rejected 似乎被 Agent 视为一个需要“重新尝试”的触发条件，而不是“停止并等待”的信号。

感谢开发团队的辛勤工作，这个预览版整体体验很棒，希望这个反馈能帮助改进产品！

discussions.title: [Plugin] Archive management panel for DSH WebUI: reopen, unarchive, or permanently delete sessions — with search and native-feel UI
discussions.body:
Hey folks 👋 I built a plugin that fills a gap some of you may have hit: DSH can **archive** a session, but once it's archived there's no way to see it again — no list, no unarchive, no delete. It just disappears. **dsh-archive-manager** adds an "Archived" entry at the sidebar footer. Click it and you get a panel that looks and feels native: - 📂 **Browse** archived sessions grouped by workspace, exactly like the normal sidebar - 💬 **Reopen** — click a session to continue chatting, archive state untouched - ♻️ **Unarchive** — put it back in its workspace, original position preserved - 🗑️ **Delete for good** — safely stops a running session first, then removes its complete on-disk record (with a confirmation dialog) - 🔍 **Search** — filter by title/workspace instantly, plus message search over your prompts and the assistant's replies - 🔄 **Two-way view sync** — grouping, ordering, and drag-to-reorder stay in sync with the native sidebar in real time - 🌐 English / Chinese UI following your system language **Screenshot**

**Install (one command):** ```sh npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archive-manager ``` Restart `dsh web` — done. Sessions archived *before* installing are fully manageable too. **Links:** - GitHub: https://github.com/jasonrale/dsh-archive-manager Built against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`; it relies on some internal shapes, so after a dsh upgrade check the repo for a compatible release first. Happy to hear feedback — especially on anything that feels off visually or behaviorally. Bug reports and PRs welcome!

discussions.title: Fix: `reading 'prepare'` crash from duplicate `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` copies (Symbol-key mismatch) — a one-line `Symbol.for` fix
discussions.body:
`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` resolves to `undefined` at tool dispatch because `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a module-local `Symbol`; when multiple physical copies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` exist in one process, the agent-loop's key and the ToolRuntime field's key are unequal Symbols. A one-line `Symbol.for` fix restores the lookup while preserving the author's intent.

<details>
<summary>Repro / root cause / fix / verification</summary>

- **Repro**: install any plugin that declares `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` as a dependency (or a peerDependency while `autoInstallPeers` is on), then `dsh web` and ask the agent to call any tool.
- **Observed**: `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')` at `dsh-agent-loop` `startCall`; the turn ends with `code: UNKNOWN`, leaving a dangling `tool_call` so later turns fail with `INVALID_REQUEST`.
- **Root cause**: `packages/core/tools/src/index.ts:466` exports `Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')`; `dsh-agent-loop` imports the same key from a different physical copy, so the two Symbols are not `===`.
  This is the **dual package hazard** — the Node.js-documented case where the same package loaded twice yields two module instances whose identity checks (`Symbol`, `instanceof`, `WeakMap`) no longer match. Here the second instance comes from a duplicate physical copy rather than the usual ESM/CJS dual entry, and `Symbol.for` is the standard remedy.
- **Fix**:
  ```diff
  - export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
  + export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER: unique symbol = Symbol.for('@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler')
  ```
  `Symbol.for` uses the global registry, so the key is identical across all module instances. It stays a Symbol, preserving the `@internal` "omitted from the generated named service API" intent.
- **Verified**: with duplicate copies present, a second `dsh web` instance now completes tool calls (`turn/end completed`, `tool/result` present) on 0.1.0-rc.6.
- **Fix available at**: [`leether/deepseek-harness` → `fix/tool-runtime-scheduler-symbol`](https://github.com/leether/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/tool-runtime-scheduler-symbol) — a clean single-commit fork branch (the fork's `master` tracks upstream).
- **Related**: lands the "registry-based key" suggestion in #572 (point 2); same root cause as #1418, #1337, #1849.

</details>

discussions.title: [BUG] 思维链持续重复mmm-WAIT-
Feature request: per-project (workspace) default agent preset and model
discussions.body:
## Problem

DSH already discovers **project-level skills** via `<projectRoot>/.dsh/skills/` (cwd-sensitive, resolved by `dsh-skill-filesystem`'s `findProjectRoot`), but **agent preset** and **default model** are global-only:

- `agent-presets.default` and `agent-default-model` live in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` and apply machine-wide.
- The preset is chosen manually per-session at the composer seat; the default model has no per-project override at all.

For users who work across multiple workspaces (e.g. a `writing/`, a `development/`, an `exploration/` workspace), each workspace wants a different preset (different tool composition) and often a different default model. Today the user must remember to switch the preset manually every time they open a session in a different directory, and there is no way to pin a per-workspace model.

## Proposal

Add project-level (cwd-sensitive) overrides for agent preset and default model, mirroring the existing project-level skill discovery:

1. Allow a project config under `<projectRoot>/.dsh/` to declare defaults, e.g.:
   ```yaml
   # <projectRoot>/.dsh/agent.yml  (or extend the settings section)
   agent-preset: writing
   agent-default-model:
     provider: minimax-txt
     model: MiniMax-Text-01
   ```
2. When a new session's `cwd` resolves to that project root, these become the session's default preset/model (still overridable manually at the seat).

`findProjectRoot` (the `.git`-walking resolver already used for skills) can be reused, so the "project root" concept already exists and just needs to feed preset/model resolution too.

## Why this matters

- **Saves tokens**: each workspace only loads its relevant preset/tools, and the right model is picked without a manual step.
- **Reduces friction**: no manual preset switching when moving between workspaces.
- **Consistent**: closes the gap between project-level *skills* (already cwd-sensitive) and project-level *preset/model* (currently global-only).

## Workaround today

Manually select the preset at the composer seat; the model stays global (`deepseek-v4-pro`), with per-task model choice delegated to subagents.

discussions.title: [Bug] profiles/node_modules 直接 npm install 会清空依赖树；多实例 EADDRINUSE；npm 11 allow-scripts 文档缺失
discussions.body:
环境：Windows 11, Node.js v24.19.0（便携版，npmmirror 源）, dsh @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（开发者预览版） 日期：2026-08-15 ~ 08-16

1. 在 $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules 执行 npm install 会清空整个运行时依赖树，且服务不自愈
一句话说明：在无 package.json/lockfile 的 profiles 依赖树里执行 npm install <pkg>，npm 会把全部运行时依赖视为 extraneous 并删除（实测 510+ 包），服务重启报 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND 且不自愈。

<details> <summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>
复现步骤：

正常部署 dsh（npm 全局安装 + dsh web 启动一次，使 $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules 具备完整运行时依赖：express、koffi、node-pty 等）；
在 $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules 目录直接执行 npm install @some/plugin（该目录无 package.json / package-lock.json）；
观察 npm 输出：把整棵依赖树视为 extraneous 并 prune；
重新执行 dsh web。
实际结果：

profiles/node_modules 下 510+ 个运行时包被删除（express、koffi、node-pty、dsh-update-checker 等）；
启动失败：Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'dsh-update-checker' imported from C:\Users\Administrator\.dsh\profiles\web\；
服务不会自动从部署侧重新同步缺失包，只能手动 robocopy 恢复。
预期结果：

提供官方安全安装入口（如 dsh plugin add <pkg>），内部以安全方式安装，不触碰既有依赖；
或启动时检测 profile 依赖树不完整，自动从部署侧（<deploy>/node_modules）恢复；
或至少在文档中明确警告：禁止在 $DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules 直接执行 npm install。
验收条件：在无 package.json 的 profiles 目录执行安装命令不会删除既有包；或服务能自动恢复。

</details>
2. 多实例无保护：已有实例时再次 dsh web 抛裸 Node 堆栈
一句话说明：服务已运行时再次执行 dsh web，直接抛 EADDRINUSE Node 堆栈，而非友好提示。

<details> <summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>
复现步骤：

启动 dsh web（HTTP 200，监听 127.0.0.1:3080）；
不退出，再次执行 dsh web。
实际结果：进程崩溃，输出裸 Node 堆栈：

复制
Error: ... listen EADDRINUSE: address already in use 127.0.0.1:3080
预期结果：检测到端口被本程序占用时输出友好提示（如 "dsh 已在运行，访问 http://127.0.0.1:3080"）并正常退出；或支持单实例锁（pid/lock 文件），第二次启动自动打开已有实例界面。

验收条件：重复启动不抛裸堆栈，给出可读提示；或自动复用已有实例。

</details>
3. npm 11 的 allow-scripts 默认拦截原生依赖安装脚本
一句话说明：npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh 在 npm 11.x 下默认禁止安装脚本，koffi/node-pty 等原生组件未构建导致运行异常，文档未说明。

<details> <summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>
复现步骤：

使用 npm 11.x；
执行官方安装命令 npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh；
启动 dsh web。
实际结果：koffi / node-pty / dsh-subprocess-local 的原生组件未构建（npm 11 默认 allow-scripts=false），运行异常；必须显式补装：

sh
复制
npm install -g --allow-scripts=@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local,koffi,node-pty,@google/genai,protobufjs @deepseek-ai/dsh
预期结果：官方 README/安装文档补充 npm 11 的 allow-scripts 说明；或发布包配置 trustedDependencies 减少手工步骤。

验收条件：按官方命令安装后可直接运行；或文档明确给出 npm 11 的完整安装命令。

</details>
4.（附带）bun 无法运行 dsh：需 Node ≥ 22.6 但无版本检测提示
一句话说明：用 bun 执行 bun x @deepseek-ai/dsh web 报 node:module 无 stripTypeScriptTypes 导出，启动无 Node 版本检测提示。

<details> <summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>
复现步骤：在仅有 bun（1.3.x）的环境执行 bun x @deepseek-ai/dsh web。

实际结果：Export named 'stripTypeScriptTypes' not found in module 'node:module'——dsh 依赖 Node.js ≥ 22.6 的 node:module.stripTypeScriptTypes，bun 不兼容。

预期结果：启动时检测 Node 版本，明确提示需要 Node ≥ 22.6（而不是裸的模块导出报错）。

验收条件：不支持的运行时下给出可读版本提示。

discussions.title: DSH｜DshCockpit｜dsh web 桌面驾驶舱：成本/用量监控 · 自动更新 · 定时任务
discussions.body: > **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。** **项目地址：** https://github.com/Lxiayu/DshCockpit **项目介绍：** DshCockpit 是一个开源（MIT）的 Electron 桌面壳，把 `dsh web` 从"必须开着浏览器标签页"变成"双击即用、托盘常驻、会算账的桌面控制台"——关掉窗口会话和后台任务照常运行，跑完/需要审批时系统通知你。 在壳这一层做了几件 dsh web 本身没有的事： - **Token 用量胶囊**：右上角常驻当前会话输入/输出 tokens，上下文压力 60%/85% 黄/红预警，提醒"该开新会话了" - **成本中心**：按天/周/月/工作区统计 token 与估算费用，月度预算 80%/100% 报警——月底不再收到吓人的账单 - **运行时自动更新管道**：检查 → 安装 → `--dump-config` 冒烟守卫（坏版本绝不激活）→ 一键回滚 - **Quick Ask**：全局热键 `Ctrl+Alt+Space` 随手提问，后台无头会话执行 + 完成通知 - **定时任务**：每天/每间隔跑固定提示词（日报、清理），到点执行 + 通知 - **`Ctrl+K` 会话全文检索**：跨全部历史会话关键词搜索 - **插件市场**：直接浏览 GitHub `dsh-plugin` 话题（2000+ 插件），一键安装/卸载 **与 DSH 的集成方式：** 不 fork、不修改上游 UI——通过 spawn 启动标准 `dsh web` 作为后台服务，壳与运行时彻底解耦（版本化共存于 `userData/runtime/`）。数据层只读解析 DSH 的会话日志（zstd）做用量/成本统计与检索；事件层订阅运行时 WebSocket 感知任务完成/审批/提问；插件安装走官方 pnpm bundle 流程。上游怎么改，壳的接口面（spawn 参数、URL 行、HTTP/WS）都保持最小。 **截图：** **安装：** - **Windows**：[Release](https://github.com/Lxiayu/DshCockpit/releases) 下载 zip → 7-Zip 解压 → 双击 `DshCockpit.exe`（内置运行时，无需 Node） - **macOS**：下载 `.dmg`（arm64/x64 都有）→ 拖入应用程序；未签名包首次放行：`xattr -dr com.apple.quarantine /Applications/DshCockpit.app` - 或从源码：`git clone && npm install && npm start` 完全本地运行，不收集不上传任何数据；备份刻意不含 API 凭据。v0.2.0 预览版，Windows 端刚做了一轮主线程阻塞专项优化。欢迎试用提 issue，特别想听成本统计和定时任务的使用场景反馈 🙏

discussions.title: Client module loader crashes the whole UI when one plugin bundle fails to register
discussions.body:
## Summary

A failure in any single browser-side plugin bundle currently aborts the whole client module loading phase and leaves the application on a full-page **"Failed to load plugins"** screen. One bad bundle therefore makes the main UI and every otherwise healthy plugin unavailable.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Windows 11 build 26200
- Node.js `24.14.1`
- pnpm `11.21.0`

## Observed behavior

We reproduced the failure with client bundles that were:

- prefixed with a UTF-8 BOM; or
- temporarily empty (0 bytes) while `pnpm` was rebuilding the profile's `node_modules`.

Representative errors:

```text
failed to import loader entry ... (dsh-inline-images):
client-modules: bundle /plugins/dsh-inline-images/client.js?rev=...
loaded without registering "dsh-inline-images" via __ModuleLoader__.load
```

The same failure class was observed with `@anionex/dsh-vision-toolkit`. In both cases, the entire page failed instead of isolating the affected plugin.

## Reproduction

1. Install or enable a plugin that provides a browser `client.js` bundle.
2. Either:
   - prefix the bundle with a UTF-8 BOM; or
   - truncate it to 0 bytes.
3. Refresh the web UI.
4. Observe the full-page **"Failed to load plugins"** error.

## Expected behavior

Only the affected plugin should be disabled for that load, with:

- a clear console error containing the plugin ID and revision;
- a visible failed/disabled status in Settings; and
- all other plugins and the main UI continuing to work.

## Suggested direction

In the `client-modules` loading loop:

1. isolate each bundle with a per-bundle `try/catch`;
2. validate that the response body is non-empty;
3. verify that evaluation completes registration through `window.__ModuleLoader__.load`;
4. commit/cache a revision only after successful registration;
5. fall back to the last-known-good revision when available; and
6. expose the failed plugin ID, revision, and reason in diagnostics.

This is related in spirit to #880, but distinct: #880 is a server-side profile/import failure that prevents boot, while this report concerns a browser-side bundle registration failure after the server has started successfully.

discussions.title: Plugin installs are not atomic: browsers can fetch half-written bundles (0-byte) during pnpm rebuild
discussions.body:
## Summary

Plugin installation/rebuild currently mutates the live profile `node_modules` tree in place. During `dsh plugin add` / `pnpm install`, a running browser can fetch a client bundle while it is temporarily empty or only partially written.

This creates a real failure window in which refreshing the UI can cache or execute a damaged bundle and trigger a persistent **"Failed to load plugins"** page.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Windows 11 build 26200
- Node.js `24.14.1`
- pnpm `11.21.0`

## Observed behavior

During a profile rebuild:

1. a live plugin `client.js` temporarily became 0 bytes;
2. the running DSH server was still able to serve that path;
3. a browser refresh fetched the damaged response;
4. the client module loader reported that the bundle did not register through `__ModuleLoader__.load`; and
5. the UI remained broken across refreshes until the install completed and the service/browser state was repaired.

The timing window is short but reproducible when refreshing during a rebuild.

## Reproduction

1. Run `dsh web` with one or more client-side plugins enabled.
2. Keep the browser open and refresh repeatedly.
3. In parallel, run a plugin add/update or a `pnpm install` that rebuilds the active profile's `node_modules`.
4. Observe occasional empty/partial `client.js` responses and a client registration failure.

## Expected behavior

The active plugin set should remain immutable and fully readable until the replacement set has been completely installed and validated.

## Suggested direction

- Install into a staging directory, validate it, then atomically switch the active plugin tree.
- Alternatively, write bundles to temporary paths and atomically rename them only after completion.
- Do not publish a new manifest/revision until every referenced client bundle exists, is non-empty, and passes basic registration validation.
- If the server observes an empty/invalid live bundle, retain the last-known-good version rather than serving the damaged file.
- As a minimum fallback, document that users should not refresh during installation and make the loader validate the response body/hash.

This is related to #2063. That discussion documents that bundle revisions are content hashes computed at activation. An in-place rebuild can temporarily change the served file while the active revision still describes the previous content, violating the revision/cache invariant.

discussions.title: Docs: Windows launcher gotchas (CRLF endings, call npx, no parens in echo inside if blocks)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Please document three easy-to-miss Windows `.bat` launcher rules, and apply them to any official launcher/template examples. We hit all three independently while maintaining a local DeepSeek Harness launcher; each one can make startup stop before the server begins listening.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Windows 11 build 26200
- `cmd.exe`
- Node.js `24.14.1`
- npm `11.19.0`

## Gotcha 1: use CRLF line endings

A launcher saved with LF-only line endings was parsed incorrectly by `cmd.exe` in this environment. Command fragments were treated as separate invalid commands and startup failed before port binding.

Recommendation: generate and document `.bat` files with Windows CRLF line endings.

## Gotcha 2: use `call` for `npx.cmd` / `npm.cmd`

From inside a parent batch file, this preflight silently ended the parent script after `npx` returned:

```bat
npx dsh --profile web --dump-config
echo This line was never reached
```

The working form is:

```bat
call npx dsh --profile web --dump-config
if errorlevel 1 exit /b 1
```

The same rule applies to `npm.cmd` whenever control must return to the parent batch file.

## Gotcha 3: escape or avoid parentheses inside parenthesized blocks

This is unsafe:

```bat
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Recovery: run (restore DSH.bat).
)
```

It can fail with:

```text
. was unexpected at this time.
```

Use `^(` / `^)`, or avoid parentheses in the message:

```bat
if errorlevel 1 (
  echo Recovery: run the restore launcher.
)
```

## Suggested documentation change

Add a short "Windows launcher" note to the development/plugin documentation and ensure any generated `.bat` examples:

- use CRLF;
- use `call npx ...` / `call npm ...` when more commands follow; and
- escape or avoid parentheses inside `if (...)` blocks.

A small smoke test that verifies the launcher reaches its final command and opens the expected port would catch all three classes of failure.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-pi-kit | Auto-review for every tool call, chimes for approvals and task completion
discussions.body:
# DSH | dsh-pi-kit | Auto-review for every tool call, chimes for approvals and task completion

> Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community member.

**Project links:**
GitHub: https://github.com/Pidreamleaves/dsh-pi-kit
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-pi-kit

**About:**

A minimal plugin kit for DSH with an i18n-ready UI (zh/en bilingual). One package, three small plugins:

- **Auto Review** (dsh-auto-reviewer): every tool call passes three layers before it runs — built-in rules plus your YAML policy files block dangerous commands first; sandbox escalations and outbound network calls are always reviewed; finally a lightweight review model decides (default deepseek-v4-flash, reusing the provider credentials already configured in your DSH — no API key needed). Uncertain or failed reviews fall back to a human prompt. Same-parameter results are cached for 30s, consecutive blocks trip a breaker, and verdicts are summarized in a colored badge at the end of each turn (green = allowed / red = blocked / blue = escalation approval, expand for per-decision details).

- **Approval Chime** (dsh-approval-chime): three distinct sounds for approvals, questions, and background-task completion; system notifications when the page is in the background, plus a global pending badge on the input row.

**How it integrates with DSH:**

Pure Cordis bundle plugins — no DSH source changes. Each package declares `dsh.bundle.patch`, so one command installs and mounts everything:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pi-kit
```

discussions.title: Proposal: add real-host release lifecycle validation to the plugin-development Skill / 建议增加真实宿主发布门禁
discussions.body:
## Proposal

Add a short, vendor-neutral **release lifecycle gate** to the official [`cordis-plugin-development` Agent Skill](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/apps/cli/config/agent-presets/cordis/skills/cordis-plugin-development/SKILL.md).

The current Skill is strong at inspecting live capabilities, defining immutable Cordis Packages, running/updating them, and handling approval or repair. A distributable DSH Profile Bundle has one additional boundary: the packed release artifact should prove that it can install, boot, register, execute, uninstall, and reboot in an exact real host. Generated source and a successful `cordis_run` alone cannot prove that boundary.

## Suggested Skill text

The following could be inserted after the standard development workflow without requiring any particular test product:

```markdown
## Validate a distributable Plugin

Before releasing a Plugin as a DSH Profile Bundle:

1. Test the packed artifact, not only the repository source.
2. Install it beside an exact supported DSH version in a disposable environment.
3. Boot the real host and assert the declared rows, Services, Tools, and other public capabilities.
4. Exercise the smallest deterministic capability path without relying on model selection.
5. Uninstall the Plugin, reboot the same profile, and check for owned capability, process, port, and filesystem residue.
6. Retain the exact artifact identity, DSH version, scenario, result, reproduction command, and machine-readable evidence.

Use an external runner when host boot or Tool registration is part of the behavior under test. An in-host Tool cannot diagnose a host that fails before that Tool registers. Do not weaken declared expectations merely to obtain a pass, and do not describe a lifecycle pass as a security certification or model-quality evaluation.
```

This complements unit tests, manifest/preflight checks, plugin doctors, and multi-bundle composition checks rather than replacing them.

## Reference implementation and evidence

[DSH Testkit v0.3.0](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/releases/tag/v0.3.0) is one unofficial community implementation of this workflow. It is not proposed as a mandatory dependency or an official endorsement.

- One-command setup: `pnpm dsh-test init`
- Real-host lifecycle: pack → install → boot → register → deterministic exercise → uninstall → reboot → residue check
- Agent Skill: project-local `.agents/skills/dsh-testkit/SKILL.md` plus optional DSH runtime registration
- Reviewed implementation: [PR #12](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/pull/12)
- Public release workflow: [GitHub Actions run](https://github.com/iiwish/dsh-testkit/actions/runs/31897201179)
- npm SLSA provenance: [attestation](https://registry.npmjs.org/-/npm/v1/attestations/dsh-testkit@0.3.0)
- Community context and maintainer recruitment: [Show & Tell #2038](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2038)

Because the repository's current contribution policy does not accept external pull requests, I am proposing the wording here rather than opening a PR.

Would maintainers prefer this release boundary in the built-in Agent Skill, in the plugin tutorial, or in both with the Skill linking to the longer guide?

---

## 中文摘要

建议在官方 `cordis-plugin-development` Skill 中增加一段与具体工具无关的发布前真实宿主生命周期验证：测试实际打包产物，在精确 DSH 版本中完成安装、启动、能力注册、确定性调用、卸载、同 profile 重启和残留检查，并保留机器可读证据。

这不是要求官方依赖 DSH Testkit。Testkit v0.3.0 只是已经通过公共 npm、真实 DSH profile 和 provenance 验证的社区参考实现。核心目标是让 Agent 在“写完插件”和“发布 bundle”之间主动想起这条独立边界。

discussions.title: Bug + one-line fix: streaming tool calls lose function.name when continuation chunks send name: null (dsh-llm-deepseek, rc.6)
discussions.body:
# Streaming tool calls lose `function.name` when continuation chunks send `name: null`

**Package:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` (also affects `@deepseek-ai/dsh`) · **Version:** 0.1.0-rc.6
**Repo path:** `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/.../index.js`

## Summary

Every tool call made by the model is rejected at dispatch with `unknown tool ""` when the
LLM is reached over an OpenAI-compatible **streaming** chat-completions endpoint whose
continuation chunks include `function.name: null` (a valid, common variant of the OpenAI
streaming tool-call protocol — the name is sent once in the first chunk, then `null` while
the arguments stream).

## Root cause

In the SSE tool-call accumulator:

```js
for (const call of delta?.tool_calls ?? []) {
    let block = toolBlocks.get(call.index);
    if (!block) { /* open block */ }
    if (call.id !== void 0) block.callId = call.id;
    if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;   // <-- bug
    const fragment = call.function?.arguments ?? "";
    block.text += fragment;
    ...
}
```

The guard `call.function?.name !== void 0` only skips `undefined`. When the provider streams
`function.name: null` in continuation chunks (after the first chunk carried the real name),
`null !== undefined` is `true`, so `block.name` is **overwritten with `null`**. At
finalization `name: block.name ?? ""` collapses to `""`, and the runtime then rejects the
call as `unknown tool ""`.

Observed stream (first chunk has the name, rest send `name: null`):

```
delta.tool_calls[0].function = { "name": "write_file", "arguments": "" }
delta.tool_calls[0].function = { "name": null, "arguments": "{" }
delta.tool_calls[0].function = { "name": null, "arguments": "\"path" }
...
```

Non-streaming responses from the same endpoint return the complete `function.name`, so the
defect is specific to the streaming accumulator.

## Fix (one line)

Guard against `null` as well as `undefined`:

```diff
- if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;
+ if (call.function?.name != null) block.name = call.function.name;
```

(`!= null` matches both `null` and `undefined`.) The same care should be applied to the
`tool-call-delta` emit that follows, so a later `null` never blanks a previously known name.

## Impact

Tool use is completely broken for any OpenAI-compatible provider that emits `name: null` on
continuation chunks — the agent can never call `write`/`bash`/`fs`/etc. Confirmed fix
restores tool use (verified end-to-end: model created a file via its file tool).

discussions.title: Source launch loads workspace packages twice, splitting the Typert @Remote registry - the gateway then skips the service silently
discussions.body:
## Summary

Under the source launcher (`pnpm dsh`, i.e. `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts`), a workspace package is loaded **twice** — once from `src` for harness code, once from `lib` for anything resolved outside the tsconfig scope, which includes every plugin installed under `$DSH_HOME`. Any registry kept in module-private state is therefore split.

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol` keeps exactly such a registry, so a plugin's `@Remote` marks land in one copy while the gateway reads the other. The gateway then **silently skips** the service and answers with a message that blames the plugin author.

This is reproducible with a controlled probe; the exact skip is one line.

## Reproduction

Identity comparison rather than a behavioural probe — a behavioural one can fail for unrelated reasons (decorator emit, wrong receiver) and its empty result then looks like a positive. Each run carries a control: the same specifier imported twice must be identical.

```js
const SPEC = '@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol'
const LIB  = 'file:///<checkout>/packages/typert/protocol/lib/index.js'

const viaSpecifier = await import(SPEC)
const viaAgain     = await import(SPEC)   // control
const viaLib       = await import(LIB)

for (const n of ['Remote', 'remoteMethods', 'TypertRemoteService', 'bindTypertRemote']) {
  console.log(n, viaSpecifier[n] === viaAgain[n], viaSpecifier[n] === viaLib[n])
}
```

| Resolution context | control | specifier vs `lib` | resolves to |
|---|---|---|---|
| checkout, `node --import tsx/esm` (harness) | 4/4 identical | **0/4 identical** | `src` |
| `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web`, plain `node` (plugin) | 4/4 identical | 4/4 identical | `lib` |

Same probe, same control, only the resolution context changes. Harness gets `src`, plugins get `lib` — two instances.

The plugin side resolves through `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol`, a junction into the checkout whose `exports["."].default` is `./lib/index.js`. The harness side is remapped by `tsconfig.base.json`:

```json
"@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-protocol": ["./packages/typert/protocol/src/index.ts"]
```

Running the same file under plain `node` instead of tsx removes the remapping, and the split with it.

## Where it fails

`packages/typert/protocol/src/index.ts:126`

```ts
const markers = new WeakMap<object, Map<string, StoredRemoteMethodMarker>>()
```

Module-private, so one table per module instance. `packages/api/gateway/src/index.ts:244-253`:

```ts
const value = Reflect.get(original, 'typertRemote')       // 244  succeeds
if (value === undefined) continue
const binding = readBinding(value, original, serviceKey, endpoint)
if (binding.namespace !== namespace) continue             // 247  matches
const marker = remoteMethods(original).find(...)          // 248  reads the split table
if (marker === undefined) continue                        // 249  silently skipped
...
throw new TypertGatewayError('invocation-unavailable', endpoint,
  'no active Remote method exports this endpoint')        // 253
```

The first half **succeeds** under the split, which is what makes this hard to diagnose. `bindTypertRemote()` returns a plain frozen object carried on the instance, not module-private state — so the service is found and the namespace matches. Only line 248 touches the WeakMap, reads the wrong copy, and line 249 drops the candidate without a word.

The resulting message, *"no active Remote method exports this endpoint"*, reads as "the plugin never declared this method". The truth is "the declaration is in another copy of this module". A plugin author following that message will look in the wrong place indefinitely.

## Why I think this is a defect rather than an unsupported combination

Two rules from the repository's own `AGENTS.md`:

> **Misconfiguration fails loud** at load when self-contained, otherwise at the earliest resolvable point; **never silently skip a missing referent**.

> **Source plane vs artifact plane, never mixed.**

Line 249 is a silent skip of a referent that was found. And the mixing is not user error: `pnpm dsh` is the documented source entry point, plugins under `$DSH_HOME` are a supported feature, and [separate-source-launch-from-build](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/simplification/2026-08-12-separate-source-launch-from-build.md) states that source launches still require `pnpm run build` to produce Typert host artifacts. The two planes are therefore *expected* to coexist; nothing detects when they diverge.

## Suggested fixes, least invasive first

**1. Make the skip speak.** No design change, no effect on any succeeding path. At line 248-249 the gateway already holds everything needed to distinguish the two cases: the binding matched the namespace, yet `remoteMethods()` returned nothing. "Namespace claimed, zero marks" is the signature of a duplicate protocol instance and cannot be produced by a plugin that simply forgot a decorator on *that* method — such a plugin still exposes its other marks. Naming the likely cause here would have turned this from a multi-hour trace into a log line.

**2. Detect the duplication directly.** A module-scoped identity token compared once at gateway boot, or a version/identity field on the binding, reports "two instances of dsh-typert-protocol are loaded" before any request arrives.

**3. Make duplication harmless.** Move `markers` to a realm-scoped registry (`globalThis` + `Symbol.for('…')`), which is the usual remedy for a cross-package registry that cannot guarantee single instantiation. Module-private state is the right default when one-instance-per-realm holds; here the product's own launcher breaks that invariant.

## Scope of what I verified

Verified on this machine: the two resolution contexts and their identity results above; the tsconfig mapping; the junction and its `exports`; the WeakMap at protocol `index.ts:126`; the gateway path at `index.ts:244-253` including the error text.

**Not** verified: that a plugin is hitting this in the current release. `dshmarket` is immune — it declares no Typert dependency and mounts raw HTTP routes under `/dsh-market/*`. I did not audit other published plugins. So this is a demonstrated mechanism, not an observed live outage, and the impact depends on how many plugins use Typert `@Remote`.

Also unverified: whether the team considers source launch plus third-party plugins a supported combination. If it is not, fix 1 still applies — the diagnostic would say so instead of misattributing the failure.

## Disclosure

I misdiagnosed this same subsystem in an earlier report, claiming the gateway route table was a build-time artifact that third-party plugins could not extend. That was wrong: `resolveSrcDescriptor` scans live services at runtime, and it is the very function quoted above. I am flagging it so the claims here get the scrutiny that history earns — everything above is either a quoted line or a probe result, and the probe carries a control precisely because my previous error came from trusting an unvalidated measurement.

discussions.title: 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机 4G 远程控制电脑上的 Agent（DeepSeek Phone Harness）
discussions.body:
> 一个社区开源项目（非官方）。仓库：[2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness)

---

# 把 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋：手机 4G 远程控制电脑上的 Agent

> 开源项目 **DeepSeek Phone Harness** —— 在手机上完整复刻 DeepSeek Harness 的工作体验：对话、模型切换、工具调用审批、终端、文件浏览，随时随地。

---

## 先讲个场景

凌晨一点，你躺在床上，电脑在书房跑着一个 DeepSeek Harness 任务。突然你想：让它顺手把那个重构也做了吧。于是你爬起来、走到书房、打开电脑、输入指令、等它跑完、看一眼输出、再回床上——**就为了发一句话，你花了两分钟走了一趟**。

如果这时候你只需要掏出手机，打开一个页面，发消息、看流式输出、批准工具调用、甚至回答 Agent 的反问，然后继续躺着呢？

这就是我做 **DeepSeek Phone Harness** 的动机：**把 DeepSeek Harness 装进口袋**。

## 这是什么

DeepSeek Phone Harness 是一个开源的手机端远程控制系统。它让手机在任何网络下（4G/5G / WiFi / 公网）远程操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：

- 给电脑上的 Agent 派发任务，**流式**看它干活
- 查看每一步**工具调用**：做了什么、操作了哪个文件、结果如何
- 危险操作**审批**：允许 / 拒绝
- Agent 反问时**回答提问**，任务不会被卡死
- 切换**模型**、发**图片附件**、看**思考过程**
- 跑**终端命令**、翻**文件代码**、查**任务记录**
- 完全对标 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 的工作体验

界面参考了开源项目 codex-relay 的设计语言（深色、卡片化、金色鲸鱼标识），对话体验对齐 DSH 原生界面。

## 上手体验：就像在用 DSH 本身

### 对话，和电脑上一样

手机端打开就是对话界面，支持多轮会话、Markdown 渲染、流式打字机输出。顶部可以**切换模型**（deepseek-v4-flash / v4-pro 等多个 Provider），输入框旁有 **+ 添加图片**，发图给 Agent 分析。

### 每一步操作都看得见

这是我觉得最值的地方——**工具调用卡片**：

```
[📄 read]                        ● 完成
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json   ← 路径一目了然
▾ 点击展开：
  参数  {"file_path": "...", "limit": 1}
  结果  <path>... 1: {
```

图标区分工具类型（write/read/终端/web/子代理…），状态实时切换（执行中转圈 → 完成绿点 / 失败红点），**操作的文件路径直接显示**，点卡片还能看完整参数和结果。Agent 的**思考过程**也折叠展示，流式时自动展开——你看着它一步步想、一步步做。

### 审批与提问，一个都不卡

DSH 的 Agent 会请求授权、也会反问用户。手机端对应两张卡：

- **需要授权**：允许一次 / 拒绝
- **需要你回答**：选项选择 / 自定义输入 / 跳过本题

不回就等，回完继续跑——**任务永远不会因为没人回答问题而卡死**。

### 终端、文件、任务，全套远程

- **终端**：手机执行电脑命令，流式输出，中文正常，可停止
- **文件/代码**：浏览电脑目录、查看文件内容
- **任务列表**：历史任务回看、展开输出、一键重跑
- **会话管理**：多工作区切换、新建 / 重命名 / 删除 / 搜索

## 技术上有意思的地方

- **纯 Node.js 零依赖**：Agent 端没有装任何 npm 包，HTTP 传输 + DSH Web API RPC 封装 + events.mux WebSocket 中继，全是 Node 原生能力
- **单文件前端**：`relay.html` 一个文件搞定全部界面，无框架，手机浏览器直接打开
- **事件流复用**：一条 WebSocket 连接同时收审批、提问、会话事件，前端增量轮询做打字机效果
- **云端可选**：Cloudflare Worker 托管前端 + 可选 E2EE 任务通道，4G/5G 直连电脑走 Tailscale 即可

## 三分钟跑起来

```bash
# 电脑端（需已运行 dsh web，监听 127.0.0.1:3080）
cp config.example.json config.json   # 填访问令牌
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

手机打开 `http://<电脑Tailscale IP>:8788/`，输入地址和令牌，选工作区，开工。

## 开源 & 欢迎参与

项目完全开源（MIT License）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

- 支持 Star / Fork / PR
- Roadmap：PWA 离线壳、推送通知、更多模型快捷切换、多设备支持
- 有任何想法欢迎提 Issue

---

**在手机上和你的 Agent 对话，比想象中舒服得多。** 试试看，然后告诉我你用它干了什么。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Phone Harness: Remote-Control Your Desktop Agent from Your Phone — now on the App Store of your pocket
discussions.body:
> A community open-source project (not official). Repo: [2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness)

---

# DeepSeek Phone Harness: Remote-Control Your Desktop Agent from Your Phone

> Open-source project **DeepSeek Phone Harness** — the full DeepSeek Harness experience on mobile: chat, model switching, tool-call approvals, terminal, file browsing — anywhere, over 4G/5G.

---

## A familiar scene

It's 1 a.m. You're in bed. Your computer in the study is running a DeepSeek Harness task. Suddenly you want it to also do that refactor. So you get up, walk to the study, open the computer, type the instruction, watch it run, check the output, and walk back to bed — **two minutes of walking just to send one sentence**.

What if you could just pick up your phone, open a page, send the message, watch the streaming output, approve tool calls, even answer the agent's questions — and stay in bed?

That's exactly why I built **DeepSeek Phone Harness**: **DeepSeek Harness in your pocket**.

## What it is

DeepSeek Phone Harness is an open-source mobile remote-control system. It lets your phone operate DeepSeek Harness on your computer from any network (4G/5G / WiFi / public internet):

- Send tasks to your desktop agent and watch it work in **real-time streaming**
- See every **tool call**: what it did, which file it touched, and the result
- **Approve** risky operations: allow / reject
- **Answer agent questions** so tasks never hang
- **Switch models**, attach **images**, read the agent's **thinking**
- Run **terminal commands**, browse **files & code**, review **task history**
- The experience mirrors the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI

The UI follows the codex-relay design language (dark, card-based, gold whale branding), with the conversation experience aligned to DSH's native interface.

## What it feels like

### Chat, just like on your computer

Open the page and you're in a conversation: multi-turn sessions, Markdown rendering, streaming typewriter output. **Switch models** from the top (deepseek-v4-flash / v4-pro and more providers), attach **images** with the `+` button and send them to the agent.

### Every step is visible

This is the part I'm most proud of — **tool call cards**:

```
[📄 read]                        ● done
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json   ← path at a glance
▾ tap to expand:
  arguments  {"file_path": "...", "limit": 1}
  result     <path>... 1: {
```

Icons distinguish tool types (write / read / terminal / web / subagent…), status switches live (spinner while running → green done / red failed), **the file path is shown directly**, and tapping the card reveals the full arguments and result. The agent's **thinking** is also folded up for inspection, auto-expanding while streaming.

### Approvals & questions — nothing hangs

DSH agents request authorization and ask questions. Both become cards on your phone:

- **Authorization needed**: Allow once / Reject
- **Your answer needed**: choose an option / type a custom answer / skip

Don't answer, it waits; answer, it continues — **tasks never deadlock waiting for a human**.

### Terminal, files, tasks — the whole remote kit

- **Terminal**: run commands on your computer from the phone, streaming output, full UTF-8, stoppable
- **Files / code**: browse desktop directories, view file contents
- **Task history**: review past tasks, expand output, re-run with one tap
- **Sessions**: switch workspaces, create / rename / delete / search

## What's interesting technically

- **Pure Node.js, zero dependencies**: no npm packages at all — HTTP transport + DSH Web API RPC wrapper + events.mux WebSocket relay, all Node built-ins
- **Single-file frontend**: `relay.html`, no framework, opens directly in the mobile browser
- **One WebSocket to rule them all**: approvals, questions, and session events flow through a single `events.mux` connection; the frontend polls increments for the typewriter effect
- **Optional cloud**: a Cloudflare Worker hosts the frontend + optional E2EE task channel; direct 4G/5G via Tailscale works too

## Run it in three minutes

```bash
# On the computer (requires dsh web listening on 127.0.0.1:3080)
cp config.example.json config.json   # fill in your access token
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

On your phone open `http://<computer Tailscale IP>:8788/`, enter the address and token, pick a workspace, and go.

## Open source & welcome

MIT licensed:

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

- Star / Fork / PR are all welcome
- Roadmap: PWA offline shell, push notifications, more model shortcuts, multi-device
- Ideas? Open an issue

---

**Talking to your agent from your phone is more comfortable than you'd think.** Try it — and tell me what you did with it.

# 一个 4000 行的 Node 脚本，让我的手机变成了 DeepSeek Harness 的遥控器

> 没有云服务器，没有公网 IP，没有数据库。只有一个 Node 进程 + 一个 HTML 文件。以及，4G 网络。

---

先问一句：**你有没有在离开电脑后，突然想给电脑上的 Agent 派个活？**

我有。而且是深夜。

凌晨一点，我躺在床上，想到一个可以让任务早点跑完的操作。当时的选项是：

1. 爬起来，走去书房，操作电脑，再走回来
2. 假装没想起来，明天再说
3. **掏出手机**

选项 3 以前是不存在的——DeepSeek Harness 跑在电脑上，手机够不着。直到我花了一个周末，写了一个 4000 行代码的开源项目，把这个问题彻底解决了。

## 它做了什么

简单说：**你的手机浏览器，变成了 DeepSeek Harness 的遥控器。**

- 发任务，**实时流式**看 Agent 干活
- 每一步工具调用都看得见：**读了哪个文件、改了哪行代码、跑了什么命令**，点开还能看完整参数和结果
- Agent 要权限？手机上弹「需要授权」，允许/拒绝一键决定
- Agent 反问？手机上弹「需要你回答」，选选项或直接打字
- 想换模型？顶部点一下，deepseek-v4-flash / v4-pro 随便切
- 想发截图给 Agent 分析？输入框旁边 `+` 添加图片
- 终端、文件浏览、任务重跑……全都有

## 为什么是 4000 行

因为它**零依赖**——没有 `npm install`，没有框架，没有数据库。一个 Node 进程用内置模块完成了全部：HTTP 服务、DSH RPC 封装、WebSocket 事件中继。克隆下来直接 `node agent.mjs` 就能跑。

前端也是单文件 `relay.html`，手机浏览器打开即用。

## 最打动我的一个细节

Agent 在工作时，手机上会实时出现一张张**工具卡片**：

```
[📄 read]                          ● 完成
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json
▾ 点击展开：完整参数 + 完整结果
```

它不是"正在执行…"这种敷衍提示，而是**每一步具体在做什么、动哪个文件、结果如何**。躺在床上看 Agent 干活，和坐在电脑前看，体验几乎一致。

## 怎么用

```bash
# 电脑上（已装 DeepSeek Harness）
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

手机装个 Tailscale（免费），4G/5G 下直接访问 `http://<电脑IP>:8788/`，填令牌，开工。

全程不需要公网 IP、不需要路由器配置、不需要云服务器。**三分钟，搞定。**

## 最后

项目已开源（MIT）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**评论区聊聊：你希望手机远程控制电脑上的 Agent 帮你做什么？** 呼声最高的功能我下一版优先做。

Star 是对开源最大的支持，先谢过 🫡

discussions.body:
# DeepSeek Harness 出门就废？我做了个开源项目，让它在 4G 网络下也能随叫随到

> 电脑上的 Agent 再强，你不在电脑前它就等于不存在。直到手机也能指挥它。

---

先说结论：**这个帖子是来"打脸"的——打我自己之前的脸。**

我一直觉得 DeepSeek Harness 很好用，直到有一天我在外面，突然想让电脑上的 Agent 帮我整理一份资料。然后我意识到一个残酷的事实：

> 我人不在电脑前，Agent 就是摆设。

你在公司、在通勤、在吃饭、在躺平——**任何离开电脑的瞬间，你都用不上它**。这合理吗？不合理。所以我动手了。

## 我做了什么

做了一个开源的手机端远程控制项目，让手机在任何网络下操作电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness：

- **4G/5G 直连**（走 Tailscale，免费），不用公网 IP
- **实时流式输出**——Agent 说的话，手机上一个个字蹦出来
- **工具调用全程可视**——读了什么文件、执行了什么命令、结果如何，一张卡片全看清
- **审批 + 问答**——要授权弹卡，要提问弹卡，任务永不卡死
- **模型随便切**、**图片随便发**、**终端随便敲**、**文件随便翻**

## 它有多轻

整个 Agent **零 npm 依赖**，4000 行左右。前端一个 HTML 文件。

没有云服务器、没有数据库、没有框架、没有 `npm install`。**克隆 → 填个令牌 → 跑起来**，就这么简单。

## 实测场景（都是真事）

**场景一**：地铁上，手机打开页面，给电脑 Agent 发了个任务。到站时，结果已经在手机上了。

**场景二**：Agent 干活到一半要授权——以前这种情况我只能干等。现在手机上弹卡，点「允许一次」，它继续。

**场景三**：Agent 突然反问我一件事。手机卡片上选个选项，任务接着跑。**以前遇到反问，任务基本等于卡死；现在 10 秒解决。**

## 三分钟跑起来

```bash
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

手机 Tailscale 连上电脑，打开 `http://<电脑IP>:8788/`，输入令牌，开干。

## 说点实话

它当然还有不足：目前是网页版（不是原生 App），命令执行是逐个跑（没有完整 PTY 交互），云端通道还需要自己部署 Worker。**但"手机上能完整控制电脑 Agent"这件事，已经做到了，而且是开源免费的。**

项目地址（求 Star 求 PR 求 Issue）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**评论区想听听：你最想在手机上用 Agent 干什么？** 或者你对远程控制有什么顾虑？都来聊聊，我每条都看。

*（补充：纯社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无关，纯粹觉得好用所以做了。）*

# I turned my phone into a remote for DeepSeek Harness — and it changed how I use agents

> No cloud server. No public IP. No database. One Node process, one HTML file, and a 4G connection.

---

Let me ask you something: **how many times have you wanted to send a task to your desktop agent after you left the room?**

I had that moment at 1 a.m., in bed, with my computer in the study. My options were:

## What it does

- Send tasks, watch the agent work in **real-time streaming**
- Every tool call is visible: **which file it read, what command it ran, the result** — tap to expand full arguments and output
- Agent needs permission? An **approval card** pops up on your phone — allow once / reject
- Agent asks a question? A **question card** pops up — pick an option or type an answer

Because it has **zero npm dependencies**. No framework, no database, no `npm install`. One Node process using built-ins only: HTTP server, DSH RPC wrapper, WebSocket event relay. Clone and `node agent.mjs` — done.

The frontend is a single `relay.html` file that opens directly in your mobile browser.

While the agent works, the phone shows **tool cards**, live:

Not a vague "running…" — but **exactly what step is happening, which file it touches, and what came back**. Watching the agent work from bed feels almost identical to sitting at the desk.

## Try it in three minutes

```bash
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both

Install Tailscale (free) on both devices, open `http://<computer IP>:8788/` on your phone over 4G/5G, enter the token, go.

No public IP, no router config, no cloud server. **Three minutes.**

discussions.title: The dsh-plugin topic is polluted by non-DSH repos — worth adding a guideline?
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek Harness team 👋

We run **dshbase**, a community plugin directory for DeepSeek Harness. While auditing our own catalog, we discovered that the `dsh-plugin` GitHub topic is significantly polluted: many repos tag themselves `dsh-plugin` for visibility but are **not actually DSH plugins**.

**A few concrete examples (all currently in the topic, all high-star):**

- `openhanako` (~6k★) — a personal AI agent with memory/personality, no bundle manifest, no relationship to DSH.
- `EchoBird` (~3k★) — a "model switch across 20+ coding agents" tool.
- `exo` (~650★) — a *different* harness entirely.
- `synergy` (~540★) — a general-purpose agent.

A real DSH plugin ships a bundle manifest (`cordis.patch.yml` / `cordis.yml`) and installs via `dsh plugin add`. These don't.

**Why this matters:** the topic is the de-facto registry. Directories that trust it unverified (e.g. the `awesome-dsh-plugin` list and the `dsh-suite` catalog) end up listing these as "plugins", which misleads users and erodes trust in the whole ecosystem. We removed 19 such projects from our own directory after this audit.

**Our suggestion:** it would help enormously if the official project published a short guideline for what qualifies as a `dsh-plugin` (bundle manifest + installable via `dsh plugin add`), and ideally a curated/verified list. We'd be glad to contribute our verification tooling (bundle-manifest check + LLM README review) if useful.

Happy to share the full list of tag-squatters we found if that helps.

— the dshbase team (dshbase.com)

---

中文简述：我们发现 `dsh-plugin` topic 被大量非 DSH 仓库蹭标签（如 openhanako 6047★ 是独立 AI agent、EchoBird 3016★ 是跨工具切换器、exo 是另一个 harness）。真正 DSH 插件应带 bundle 清单（cordis.patch.yml）且能 `dsh plugin add` 安装。建议官方出个「什么算 dsh-plugin」的规范，最好维护一份官方精选列表，避免生态被污染。
