我踩过的 3 个坑：让手机控制电脑上的 Agent，没有想象中那么简单
discussions.body:
# 我踩过的 3 个坑：让手机控制电脑上的 Agent，没有想象中那么简单

> 表面上是一层 HTTP + 一个网页，实际上每一步都在跟"你以为"较劲。记录几个真实的坑，希望你能绕开。

---

做 DeepSeek Phone Harness 之前，我以为"手机远程控制电脑 Agent"就是个把网页搬到手机上而已。做完之后我承认：**想法 10 分钟，填坑一整周。**

记录 3 个真实的坑，每一个都让任务在线上"优雅地卡死"。

## 坑 1：Agent 一提问，任务就永久卡住

这是最阴的一个。

我们的中继服务监听 DSH 的审批通道（`approval/requested`），一切正常。直到某天测试任务**永远不结束**——不是报错，是挂着不动，`pending` 一直 +1。

查了两天才发现：DSH 的 Agent 会调用 `ask_user_question` 工具**反问用户**，而反问走的**不是审批通道**！它走的是另一条通道（`question/requested`）。我的中继只监听了审批，提问帧直接被我丢掉了。

结果：Agent 在电脑上等着人回答，手机这边毫无感知，任务永远挂起。**直到用户回答，它才会继续。**

修复：单独摄入提问帧，转发成手机上的"需要你回答"卡片，回答协议和官方 Web GUI 完全一致。

**教训：Agent 的实时事件流里，每一类帧都有它存在的意义，漏掉任何一类，任务就会以你想不到的方式卡死。**

## 坑 2：工具调用的结果，藏在两层嵌套里

手机端要展示"工具卡片"：工具名 + 操作路径 + 结果。名字好拿，路径好拿（从参数里提取），结果呢？

我以为 `tool/result` 事件的 content 就是 `[{type:'text', text:'...'}]`。天真了。真实结构是：

```json
content: [{
  "type": "tool-result",
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<path>...<content>..." }]
}]
```

**两层嵌套**，`toolCallId` 还在内层。第一版代码只取了一层，结果：工具卡片有名字有路径，结果永远是空的。

修复：递归收集文本 + 用 `source.callId` 配对调用和结果。

**教训：协议文档写得再清楚，也不如抓一次真实报文。**

## 坑 3：手机浏览器缓存，让用户永远看到旧界面

改完界面，手机打开——**还是旧的**。刷新、重启浏览器、换浏览器，都一样。

不是网络问题，是**缓存**：旧版界面被浏览器缓存了，`Cache-Control` 没设对。

修复：服务端给 HTML 加 `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`，从此每次打开都是最新版。

**教训：手机端 Web 应用，缓存策略和功能代码一样重要。**

## 为什么这些坑值得讲

因为每一个坑背后，都是"手机远程控制 Agent"这个场景的**真实复杂性**：

- 它不是一个静态页面，是一条**实时事件流**的忠实搬运工
- 它不是一个玩具，要处理**审批、提问、工具结果**这些生产级细节
- 它不是一个 Demo，要在 4G 网络下保持**低延迟、可重试、可恢复**

填完这些坑之后，现在的效果是：手机上的工具卡片长这样——

```
[📄 read]                          ● 完成
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json
▾ 点击展开：完整参数 + 完整结果
```

Agent 每一步在做什么、动了哪个文件、结果如何，手机上看得一清二楚。Agent 要权限、要提问，手机弹卡解决，**任务永远不会因为"没人理它"而卡死**。

## 项目在这

开源（MIT），欢迎 Star / PR / Issue：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**你在用 Agent 时踩过最离谱的坑是什么？** 评论区聊聊，我保证比我的坑精彩。

discussions.title: 同一时刻，让手机和电脑同时盯着 Agent 干活——结果我回不去了
discussions.body:
# 同一时刻，让手机和电脑同时盯着 Agent 干活——结果我回不去了

> 你以为手机端是网页端的"缩水版"？我做完实测之后发现：有些体验，手机端反而更好。

---

做 DeepSeek Phone Harness 之前，我给自己定了个验收标准：**手机端至少要达到网页端 80% 的体验，否则不算做完。**

做完之后我做了个对照实测：同一个任务，电脑浏览器和手机浏览器同时打开，观察 Agent 干活。结果有点出乎意料——**有几个体验，手机端反而更好。**

## 实测：同一个任务，两边同时看

任务：让 Agent 读取项目配置、总结当前进度、顺手跑一个测试。

| 维度 | 电脑网页端 | 手机端 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| 流式输出 | 正常 | 正常（打字机效果） |
| 工具调用可见性 | 有 | **有，且更强**：每张卡显示文件路径，点开看参数+结果 |
| 审批 | 弹窗/面板 | **卡片直插消息流**，不用切页面 |
| 提问回答 | 输入框接管 | **选项卡片**，点一下就行 |
| 模型切换 | 下拉菜单 | 底部面板，拇指可及 |
| 离开场景 | 必须人在电脑前 | **躺着也能操作** |

## 为什么手机端某些体验反而更好

### 1. 审批/提问不打断上下文

网页端审批是一个独立弹窗，会打断你正在看的内容。手机端我把审批和提问做成了**卡片，直接插在消息流里**——Agent 干活到哪一步、为什么需要授权、为什么问这个问题，上下文是连续的。

### 2. 工具卡片天生适合竖屏

"读文件 → 跑命令 → 改代码"这种纵向的工具调用序列，**竖屏天然合适**。电脑上你要么看日志要么看列表，手机上是一条清晰的时间线：

```
[📄 read]   C:/.../config.json          ● 完成
[⚙️ pwsh]   npm test                    ● 运行中…
```

### 3. 拇指就是最好的鼠标

模型切换、附件添加、卡片展开——全是拇指操作半径内的东西。

## 一个诚实的对比结论

手机端不是网页端的替代品——**重活（改代码、查日志、开终端多开）当然还是电脑舒服**。但手机端补上了网页端最大的短板：**你不在电脑前的时候**。

- 通勤路上派任务，到站看结果
- 睡前改个参数，第二天醒来已验证
- 开会时 Agent 请求授权，手机点一下放行

**"人在哪，Agent 就在哪"** ——这才是手机端真正的价值，不是"更小的网页"。

## 项目在这

开源（MIT）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

4G/5G 直连（Tailscale 免费）、三分钟部署、零 npm 依赖。

**你的 Agent 任务里，有哪些是"人不在电脑前"就能完成的？** 评论区列出来，我看看有没有能加进 Roadmap 的。

discussions.title: Agent 的下一站是口袋：为什么"手机端"可能是 Agent 最好的形态之一
discussions.body:
# Agent 的下一站是口袋：为什么"手机端"可能是 Agent 最好的形态之一

> 我们把 Agent 从终端搬进浏览器，现在该把它搬进口袋了。这不是"移动端适配"，是交互范式的一次迁移。

---

最近 DeepSeek Harness 开源，社区一片沸腾——模型、工具、Agent Loop 全是插件，自由度拉满。但热闹之下我注意到一件事：

> 大家都在讨论 Agent **能做什么**，很少有人讨论 Agent **你在哪用**。

我想聊聊后者，顺便给一个我自己的回答。

## Agent 的使用场景，正在从"坐下"变成"随时"

第一代 Agent 使用方式：打开终端，坐下，盯着看。

第二代（Web GUI）：打开浏览器，坐下，盯着看。

本质上还是**"人必须坐在电脑前"**。但 Agent 的价值恰恰是"替你干活"——活是它干的，你却要一直陪着它，这合理吗？

- 通勤路上，我想让它先跑起来
- 睡前，我想给它派明天的活
- 开会中，它要个授权，我想点一下就放行

这些场景的共同点：**人不坐在电脑前，但 Agent 在工作。** 谁来当这个"遥控器"？手机是唯一答案。

## 手机端不是"缩小版网页"，是新的交互范式

很多人以为手机端 = 网页缩小。真做完之后我发现，**手机端的交互逻辑和网页端完全不同**：

**1. 从"多窗口"到"单时间线"**

网页端是多个面板并存：会话、工具输出、审批弹窗。手机端天然只有一条**纵向时间线**——用户消息、Agent 推理、工具卡片、审批卡、提问卡，全部线性排列。Agent 的工作过程变成了一条**可回放的流水线**，反而更清晰。

**2. 从"点击"到"决策"**

网页端你习惯到处点。手机端拇指操作半径有限，逼着你把交互收敛成**"看一眼 → 做决策"**：这个工具调用要不要放行？这个问题怎么回答？——全是判断题，不是浏览题。

**3. 从"陪伴"到"异步"**

网页端你陪着 Agent 干完。手机端你是**派活-离开-回来收结果**。这逼着 Agent 端做好状态管理（任务队列、结果留存、失败通知）——这其实是 Agent 产品成熟的方向。

## 我的回答：一个把 Agent 装进口袋的开源项目

基于上面的思考，我做了 [DeepSeek Phone Harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness)：

- 手机浏览器直接控制电脑上的 DeepSeek Harness（4G/5G，Tailscale 直连）
- 流式输出、工具卡片（带路径/状态/详情）、审批、提问回答、模型切换、终端、文件
- 零 npm 依赖，4000 行，一个 HTML 文件搞定前端
- 开源 MIT，克隆即用

它不是什么颠覆性发明，只是一个朴素的回答：**"Agent 替你干活的时候，你应该可以不在场。"**

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

## 想听听你的

**你觉得 Agent 的下一站是什么？**

- 手机端（随身的遥控器）？
- 云端常驻（无人值守的 Agent）？
- 还是别的形态？

评论区聊聊，这个话题值得吵一吵。

discussions.title: MCP Apps support for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
I built [`@sugarforever/dsh-mcp-apps`](https://github.com/sugarforever/dsh-mcp-apps), a community plugin that turns the DeepSeek Harness Web profile into an [MCP Apps](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/extensions/apps/overview) host.

It connects Harness to MCP servers over stdio or Streamable HTTP. Ordinary MCP tools remain normal Harness tools, while tools that expose an MCP App UI are rendered as sandboxed interactive views directly in the conversation.

Highlights:

- MCP Apps extension negotiation (`io.modelcontextprotocol/ui`)
- `text/html;profile=mcp-app` resources
- stdio and Streamable HTTP transports
- model-visible, app-visible, and app-only tools
- structured tool results and app-to-server tool/resource calls
- resource CSP metadata and iframe permission policies
- lifecycle cleanup for tools, connections, RPC routes, slots, and app bridges

Install the published plugin into the Harness Web profile:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @sugarforever/dsh-mcp-apps
```

Then start or restart Harness:

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

The package currently includes a default public VibeFun MCP Apps configuration, and the bundled profile patch can be edited to connect another MCP server.

Repository, documentation, examples, architecture, and security notes:

https://github.com/sugarforever/dsh-mcp-apps

Feedback, compatibility reports, and contributions are welcome in the plugin repository.

discussions.title: ask 策略下审批弹窗偶发不出现、工具调用无限挂起（根因已定位，附修复分支）
discussions.body:
## 现象

`ask` 审批策略下，沙箱升级审批弹窗**时灵时不灵**：

- 正常时：弹窗出现，29~74 秒内批完；
- 异常时：弹窗完全不出现，工具调用无限挂起，同一会话内两种情况交替出现。

实测一个会话中两次挂死，其中一次挂了 44 分钟后被 cancelled。这是投递竞态，不是配置问题。

## 日志取证

`session.jsonl.zstd` 的 approval 审计事件：

| 时间 | 事件 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| 12:37 ×2、15:41 | `asked` | ✅ 29~74 秒内 `allowed-once`（弹窗正常） |
| 14:34 | `asked` 3f500c66 | 无 `decided` 事件，挂到工具调用被中断 |
| 15:47 | `asked` dda07a57 | 全程未见弹窗，挂 44 分钟后 `cancelled` |

异常 ask 只有 `approval/asked` 半对审计，始终没有 `approval/decided`。

## 根因（已定位到代码）

`dsh-host-apiproxy` 的 approval answerer **无超时、无客户端在场检查**（安装产物 `dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1955` 附近，源码 `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 的 `approval/request` 监听器）：

1. `ApprovalService`（`dsh-user-approval`）的 fail-closed 兜底**只覆盖没有任何 answerer 注册**的情况（waterfall 兜底返回 `unavailable`）；
2. 但 apiproxy 永远注册着 `ctx.on("approval/request")`，一旦接管就返回一个 Promise，只有三条出路：客户端 respond、ask signal abort、网关销毁；
3. `approval/requested` 帧 fire-and-forget 推入 mux 队列，之后无限等待——帧丢了/没渲染就是永久挂起；
4. 插件 Config 只有 `policy` 一个字段，无任何超时配置。

弹窗渲染链路（客户端侧）：mux 帧 → `dsh-client-runtime` PendingWait → conversation.composer slot 的 ApprovalPanel。帧具体为何没送达/没渲染未最终定论（可能 mux 帧丢失且连接未重建不重投，或前端渲染竞态——需要客户端日志进一步查）。

## 修复（分支已就位）

修复分支：**[wusai2333/deepseek-harness:fix/approval-answer-deadline](https://github.com/wusai2333/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/approval-answer-deadline)**（基于 master 47f9438，单提交，遵循仓库规范：Agent Note + 双语文档 + 测试）

方案：**审批等待加 fail-closed 期限**——用 `dsh-timeout` 的 `deadline()` 把 ask 的中断信号与配置的应答超时熔合：

- 期限先抵达 → 落定 `unavailable`（失败关闭）、广播 `approval/resolved`、服务补上 `approval/decided`，审计对总是完整；
- ask 自身中断仍落定 `cancelled`（按熔合信号的原因区分）；
- 新增插件配置 `approvalRequestTimeoutMs`（默认 300000ms，加载时校验为正数且 ≤ `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS`）；
- **刷新恢复不受影响**：期限自发布时刻起算，窗口内打开 mux 的客户端仍可应答重放帧（未采用"无已连接客户端即 unavailable"，因其与 2026-07-23 web-permission-and-approval 决策中"否决订阅者门控、保护刷新恢复"冲突）。

验证：审批注册表套件新增 4 例超时场景，apiproxy + user-approval 共 417 个测试全绿，typecheck / lint / duplication / doc-sync（28/28）通过。

尝试过直接提 PR，但 fork 账号没有向上游创建 PR 的权限（与 CONTRIBUTING"暂不接受外部 PR"一致），且本仓库 Issues 已禁用，故按 CONTRIBUTING 指引发到 Discussions。如维护者认可该方案，可直接取用分支或按内部流程落地；也欢迎指出客户端侧帧投递的真正根因以便一并修复。

discussions.title: dsh: session persistence fails on Android/Termux with EACCES (SELinux denies link(2))
discussions.body:
### Environment

- Device: Android (Termux), `/data` on F2FS, SELinux enforcing (`seclabel` mount)
- Node: v26.4.0
- dsh: `0.1.0-rc.6` (global npm install), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` `0.0.1-rc.1`
- Repo area: dsh CLI (`apps/cli`)

### Symptom

Every turn fails when the session log is persisted:

```
This turn failedEACCES: permission denied, link '/data/data/com.termux/files/home/.dsh/sessions/--data-data-com.termux-files-home-dsh--/session-4af96ddd-.../session.jsonl.zstd.e6430f37771c.tmp' -> '/data/data/com.termux/files/home/.dsh/sessions/--data-data-com.termux-files-home-dsh--/session-4af96ddd-.../session.jsonl.zstd'
```

The session log is never written: the temp file is cleaned up and the turn is reported as failed.

### Root cause

`materializePosix` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` publishes the session log with `link(tmp, finalPath)` (a hard link) as an atomic, no-clobber publish. **Android's SELinux policy denies `link(2)` for app processes**, even for files the app owns in its own private directory:

- `ln` a same-owner file inside a `0700` directory owned by the same UID → `Permission denied` (EACCES), everywhere under the Termux home (`~`, `~/.dsh`, `$TMPDIR`).
- `touch`, plain writes, and `rename(2)` all work fine.
- `/data` is F2FS (hard links are supported by the filesystem) mounted with `seclabel`, so this is a SELinux denial, not a filesystem limitation.

Minimal repro outside dsh:

```sh
echo test > ~/t.tmp
ln ~/t.tmp ~/t.final   # fails: Permission denied
mv ~/t.tmp ~/t.final   # works
```

### Suggested fix

Fall back to `rename(tmp, finalPath)` when `link()` fails with `EACCES`/`EPERM` (and related codes), keeping `link` as the primary path on platforms where it works:

```js
try {
  await link(tmp, finalPath);
} catch (error) {
  if (!["EACCES", "EPERM", "EXDEV", "ENOTSUP", "ENOSYS"].includes(error?.code)) throw error;
  await rename(tmp, finalPath);
}
```

The no-clobber guarantee is already enforced by `rejectExistingLog()` immediately before; `rename` only widens a tiny TOCTOU race, and session IDs are UUIDs so collisions are effectively impossible.

I verified this fallback end-to-end on the device: materialization succeeds, the no-clobber guard still rejects duplicates, no `.tmp` files are left behind, and the written session round-trips through `loadStored`.

I'm currently running this as a local patch on the installed package. Happy to turn it into a PR if maintainers want it.

discussions.title: Web profile ships compaction-basic/command-compact/tool-result-pruner disabled - web sessions never auto-compact, long sessions hit context-exceeded
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh`)
- Profile: `web`
- Provider: local OpenAI-compatible endpoint (llama.cpp `llama-server`), `contextWindow: 98304`, `maxTokens: 16384`

## Symptom

Long-running web sessions (multi-step agent task, ~50 tool calls) fail mid-turn with `PI_AI_ERROR: Context size has been exceeded` — the provider rejects the request (`send_error: Context size has been exceeded` in the server log). The session JSONL shows **zero compaction events** even after the conversation crosses the provider window.

## Root cause

`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app/cordis.patch.yml` disables the entire compaction stack for the web profile:

```yaml
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true

- id: command-compact
  disabled: true

- id: tool-result-pruner
  disabled: true
```

The comment adjacent to these rows says the compaction backend should live on the **host plane** (per the 2026-08-10 host-plane-ownership note) — but the web bundle only disables the preset-plane rows without mounting a host-plane replacement. Net effect: **web sessions have no auto-compaction path at all.** The `headless` profile keeps `compaction-basic` enabled and compacts normally.

## Repro

1. Run `dsh web` with any provider.
2. Start a session and run a task that needs ~50+ tool calls (large fetch + many edits).
3. Observe: no compaction events are ever emitted; once conversation + system/tool schema exceeds the provider's context window (minus `maxTokens`), the turn dies with `Context size has been exceeded`.

## Expected

Web sessions auto-compact like headless sessions (default `thresholdRatio 0.8`; configurable).

## Workaround (verified)

Home-level `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: false
- id: command-compact
  disabled: false
- id: tool-result-pruner
  disabled: false
```

Optionally tune thresholds on the same patch entry:

```yaml
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: false
  config:
    thresholdRatio: 0.6
    retainRatio: 0.18
```

Verified via `dsh --profile web --dump-config` (patch applied after the web-app bundle); sessions then compact and survive past the previous failure point.

## Suggested fix

Either mount the compaction backend on the host plane for web (per the ownership note), or remove the `disabled: true` rows until the host-plane migration lands — as shipped, a core reliability feature is silently off in the primary interactive profile.

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-all-warmup：全局无感热身层插件 | Global frictionless warm-up layer plugin for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
大家好，我写了一个独立的 dsh 插件：全局"无感提升"热身层。

任何会话（非极简模式、所有层 subagent、压缩后）的首轮请求，自动收窄到极简工具对（bash + str_replace_editor），并注入一次独立热身调用的回复；从第二轮起恢复完整原模式。用户感知为零，但首轮轨迹条件对齐 Minimal 基准。

特性：
- 任何模式都触发，excludePresets 可排除（默认排除官方极简模式）
- 子代理层层热身：delegationDepth 不短路，每层子代理首轮同样处理
- 压缩后重新热身：compaction/end 边界重置
- 首轮形态不变式：热身调用失败时仍保持极简工具 + 白名单消息
- 容错：过滤器出错降级"全保留"，绝不阻塞/吃上下文

安装：
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-all-warmup

验证（2026-08）：
- 单测 26/26：epoch 阶段跟踪（压缩边界、fork seed 跳过、子代理）、白名单过滤、工具收窄
- 端到端 headless：主会话首轮 tools=[bash,str_replace_editor] → 第二轮完整目录
- Web 热重载：patch 修改 5 秒内生效

仓库：https://github.com/brunhildzhou/dsh-all-warmup
npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-all-warmup

这是社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。欢迎试用和反馈！

---

Hi! I built an independent DeepSeek Harness plugin: a global frictionless warm-up layer.

Every session (non-minimal modes, every subagent depth, after compaction) gets its first request narrowed to the minimal tool pair (bash + str_replace_editor) with one injected warmup-call reply; from the second round on, the full original mode is restored. Zero user-visible friction, first-round trajectory aligned with the Minimal baseline.

Highlights:
- Fires on any mode; excludePresets configurable (official minimal preset excluded by default)
- Subagents warm up at every depth — delegationDepth is not short-circuited
- Re-warms after compaction/end (epoch boundary reset)
- First-round shape is an invariant: if the warmup call fails, the round still sees the minimal catalog
- Fail-safe: filter errors degrade to keeping everything, never blocks or eats context

Install:
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-all-warmup

Verified (2026-08):
- 26/26 unit tests: epoch tracking (compaction boundaries, fork seed skip, subagents), message whitelist, tool narrowing
- Headless E2E: first round tools=[bash,str_replace_editor] → full catalog from round 2
- Web hot-reload: patch changes take effect within 5 seconds

Repo: https://github.com/brunhildzhou/dsh-all-warmup
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-all-warmup

Independent community plugin, not affiliated with DeepSeek. Feedback welcome!

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-open-eyes｜让任何多模态模型成为 DeepSeek 的眼睛
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

## 项目地址 - GitHub：https://github.com/Hyp6666/dsh-open-eyes - npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-open-eyes - [中文说明文档](https://github.com/Hyp6666/dsh-open-eyes/blob/main/README.zh-CN.md) ## 项目介绍 `dsh-open-eyes` 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的视觉委派插件。 它的目标很简单：**让任何多模态模型成为 DeepSeek 的眼睛。** 当 DSH 当前使用的是纯文本模型时，插件可以把用户在 WebUI 中粘贴、拖入或选择的图片交给另行配置的多模态模型分析，再将分析结果返回当前对话。 如果当前主模型本身支持图片，插件不会接管图片，DSH 会继续使用原生多模态处理流程。 插件同时提供 `vision_analyze` 工具，可以分析本地图片路径，以及在用户明确启用后处理远程图片 URL。 ## 与 DSH 的集成方式 本项目按照 DSH Bundle 规范打包，可以通过 DSH 插件命令安装到指定 profile。 安装后会注册： - `vision-bridge` - `vision-bridge-skill` - `vision_analyze` 支持三种独立协议： - OpenAI Responses - OpenAI Chat Completions - Anthropic Messages 用户可以自行配置模型、接口地址和 Credential Reference，不绑定特定视觉服务商。 本地图片通过 DSH 提供的文件系统和附件服务读取、验证，默认限制在当前工作区内。API Key 通过 DSH Credential Reference 按调用解析，不写入插件配置或工具参数。 ## 使用截图 ## 安装 安装到 `web` profile： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-open-eyes ``` ### 通过自然语言完成配置 如果不想手动编辑配置，也可以用自然语言让具备 Shell 工具和本机 DSH profile 管理权限的任意 Harness 代为安装和配置。 建议使用当前 DSH 之外的另一个 Harness，以免修改或重启正在使用的 profile 时导致当前任务中断。 只需要向它提供视觉服务的协议、接口地址、模型名称和 Credential Reference。不要把真实 API Key 写进对话或 YAML。 可以直接发送下面这段话： ```text 请为我的 DSH web profile 安装并配置 dsh-open-eyes。 使用： dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-open-eyes 视觉模型配置如下： - 协议： - 接口地址：<视觉服务的 baseUrl> - 模型名称：<视觉模型名称> - Credential Reference：<凭据引用名称> 请保留现有 profile 配置，不要修改无关内容。认证信息只填写 Credential Reference，不要把真实 API Key 写入 YAML、命令参数或对话。 完成后执行： dsh --profile web --dump-config 确认 vision-bridge 和 vision-bridge-skill 都已加载。不要替我重启正在运行 的 DSH；验证完成后，提醒我自行重启 DSH Web 并刷新页面。 ``` 这种方式本质上仍然使用 DSH 的插件命令和配置文件，只是由另一个 Harness 根据自然语言要求代为执行。 ### 手动检查配置 检查插件是否加载： ```sh dsh --profile web --dump-config ``` 输出中应当能够看到： - `vision-bridge` - `vision-bridge-skill` 然后按照项目文档配置视觉 Provider，重启 DSH Web 并刷新页面。 ## 使用方法 在 DSH WebUI 中粘贴、拖入或选择图片，输入原本想问的问题，然后正常发送即可。 处理规则： - 当前模型明确支持图片时，继续使用 DSH 原生图片流程。 - 当前模型明确不支持图片时，将图片委派给已配置的视觉 Provider。 - 没有配置视觉 Provider 时，停止发送并提示用户完成配置。 - 插件不会擅自向用户消息添加问题或内部交接提示。 也可以直接让 DSH 调用工具： ```text 调用 vision_analyze 分析 screenshots/error.png。 请逐字识别错误代码，并说明界面上可以执行哪些操作。 ``` ## 隐私与安全 使用视觉委派时，图片和提问内容会发送给用户配置的第三方视觉 Provider。使用前请自行确认对应服务商的数据保留、隐私和计费规则。 API Key 应保存在 DSH Credential 存储中，不应写入 YAML、对话内容或工具参数。 远程图片 URL 默认关闭。请求重试也默认关闭，因为重试可能产生重复计费。 ## 兼容性 - DeepSeek Harness：`0.1.0-rc.6` - Node.js：`>=22.19.0` - dsh-open-eyes：`0.1.0` - 开源协议：MIT

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-plugin-qcc — Query Qichacha (企查查) company data inside DeepSeek Harness, with QR login in Settings
discussions.body:
# dsh-plugin-qcc — Query Qichacha (企查查) company data inside DeepSeek Harness

A DeepSeek Harness plugin that brings **Qichacha (QCC) company-data lookup** into your agent sessions — capabilities extracted from the BizOwl desktop client's QCC integration. **v2.0 ships as a standard persistent Cordis package: install once, survives DSH restarts.**

## What you get

**5 model tools**

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `qcc_auth` | Account lifecycle: QR login, token set/verify, credits, invite code, logout, diagnostics |
| `qcc_search_companies` | Fast company search (name / keyNo / legal rep / status / registered capital) |
| `qcc_knowledge_search` | Vector knowledge-base search — step 1 of a query |
| `qcc_tool_search` | Discover available MCP data tools + their parameter schemas — step 2 |
| `qcc_execute_tool` | Run an MCP tool: registration info, shareholders, lawsuits, patents, 100+ dimensions — step 3 |

**GUI**

- A **settings page** (Settings → QCC Datasource / 企查查数据源) with QR-code login, manual token paste, invite-code binding, credits display, verify/logout

Typical flow: just ask in natural language — *"look up Huawei's registration info"* — and the agent chains the three steps above and returns structured results.

## How it works (v2, persistent)

- Standard Cordis plugin package installed into your DSH profile (`~/.dsh/profiles/web`) by the official `dsh plugin` command — no manual config editing
- **Host half** registers the 5 tools and a same-origin settings API (`/qcc/v1/api`); **Client half** is discovered through the package's `dsh.client` manifest and renders the settings page
- Runs inside the DSH main process with direct `node:fs` + `fetch` (the v1 subprocess bridge is retired in this form)
- Credentials live in `~/.BizOwl/auth.json`, **shared with the local BizOwl client** — log in once in either place; login survives restarts
- The original session-scoped dynamic form is still in the repo (`plugin/` + `install.ps1`) as a no-restart trial path

## Install

**Persistent (recommended, DSH ≥ 0.1.0-rc.5, Node ≥ 22):**

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:Samge0/dsh-plugin-qcc
# then restart DSH — tools + settings page appear in every session
```

**Dynamic trial (no restart, session-scoped):**

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/Samge0/dsh-plugin-qcc.git
cd dsh-plugin-qcc
./install.ps1   # checks node, syntax-validates sources, copies the install prompt to your clipboard
```

Then paste the prompt into a new DSH session. Uninstall the persistent form with `dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-plugin-qcc`.

## Disclaimer

This is an **unofficial, community-made plugin for personal study and research**. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by Qichacha (苏州企查查科技有限公司) or its products (BizOwl, qcc.com). All data retrieved belongs to its original rights holders and the QCC platform; API calls consume your own account credits. MIT licensed — see the repo for the full disclaimer.

**Install Helper**: [https://samge0.github.io/dsh-plugin-qcc/](https://samge0.github.io/dsh-plugin-qcc/)
**Repo**: [https://github.com/Samge0/dsh-plugin-qcc](https://github.com/Samge0/dsh-plugin-qcc)

Feedback and PRs welcome!

discussions.title: Add an embedded project file browser to the Web GUI
discussions.body:
## Problem

While developing inside the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI there is no way to browse the current project's files in place. A floating dynamic plugin existed as a stopgap, but it covered the conversation instead of occupying layout, rooted itself at the wrong directory, and had no syntax highlighting.

## Proposal

Add an embedded right-column file browser, like VS Code's explorer docked on the right:

- A root-scoped, resizable **`files` column** beside `sidebar | conversation | details`, toggled from the sidebar footer.
- A **lazy directory tree** rooted at the current session's working directory (re-rooting on session switch), with an address bar for absolute-path jumps and a "show ignored" toggle (hides `node_modules`, `.git`, `dist`, and similar by default).
- Clicking a file opens a **syntax-highlighted, line-numbered preview** (shiki via the existing `ReadBlock`), covering markdown, HTML, and the ~28 registered grammars. Binary files show a friendly notice.

The panel is read-only (writes stay with the agent tools) and emits no session events.

Agent Note: `.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-15-web-file-browser.md`

discussions.title: 让界面成为 Agent 的一种语言：我做了个 DeepSeek Harness GenUI 插件
discussions.body: 人和 Agent 之间，不该只有聊天框。 现在大多数 Agent 的工作流还是：用户说一段话，Agent 再回一段话。多数时候这没问题，但有两类任务会变得很别扭。 一类是文字很难讲清的东西。比如一个系统里的调用路径、光合作用中几个变量的关系，或者银河系里的尺度。与其读几段解释，不如直接拖动、点击，看结果怎么变。 另一类是用户很难用文字回答的东西。比如从一周日程里挑三个时间段、组合一组复杂参数，或者在多个方案之间反复比较。让用户把每个条件重新打一遍，既慢，也容易丢信息。 所以我做了 DeepSeek Harness GenUI。 它不是“输入一句话，生成一个网站”的 App Builder。它更像是 Agent 任务里临时长出来的一层界面：需要时出现，不需要单独部署，也不用把工作切到另一个 App 里。 我想打通的是这条链路： **语言 → 界面 → 操作 → 状态 → 下一轮对话或工具行动** Agent 可以用界面表达；用户可以直接在界面里回应；页面明确保存的选择、输入、草稿和进度会回到当前任务，供 Agent 后续轮次读取。 关键不只是“生成了一个页面”。如果页面声明了某个 Harness/MCP 工具，它还可以在用户对当前任务授权后调用这个工具。没有声明的调用会被拒绝，MCP 凭据也不会进入生成代码。页面直连只支持提前声明、无需凭据的公开 HTTPS。 也就是说，这块界面可以同时是 Agent 的表达、用户的结构化回应，以及经授权后连接真实工具的入口。 比如安排日程时，Agent 可以先把候选时间做成一个可选界面。用户保存三个时段后，下一轮直接说“把我刚才选的三个建好”，Agent 就能读取这些选择；真正调用日历工具时仍会单独申请授权。 解释概念时，则可以把变量和关系做成能操作的模型： ![左边继续对话，右边运行光合作用交互模型](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui/main/screenshots/zh-CN/photosynthesis-canvas-current.png) 在 CLI 里也能用。明确要求生成 GenUI 后，Agent 会返回一个 localhost 页面；页面中保存过的代码路径或参数，同样可以在下一轮接着问。 普通问答、改写、摘要和简单列表仍然只返回文字。只有当点击、拖动、比较或图形化表达确实更合适，或者用户明确要求时，才生成界面。 目前支持 Inline、Canvas、全屏、CLI localhost、任务级状态回读、经授权调用已声明工具，以及导入和导出 `DESIGN.md`。生成代码在沙箱中运行。 项目地址：https://github.com/pengyue-polaron/deepseek-harness-genui npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-genui 当前版本是 `v0.12.2`，MIT License，非官方插件，由我个人维护。 我现在最想收集的是真实使用场景：你有没有遇到过那种文字来回说很久，但如果 Agent 当场给你一个能点、能拖、还能继续用的界面，事情会简单很多的任务？

discussions.title: Python runtime wheel cannot resolve the first-party MCP client
discussions.body:
## Summary

`deepseek-harness-sdk==0.1.0rc6` supports caller-provided Cordis configurations, but the published macOS arm64 runtime wheel cannot resolve the repository's documented `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` plugin. The plugin is absent from the dependency closure compiled into the single-file runtime.

This prevents Python SDK users from using a custom authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP server with the published runtime.

## Environment and artifact

- SDK: `deepseek-harness-sdk==0.1.0rc6`
- Runtime: `deepseek-harness-runtime-bin==0.1.0rc6`
- Official wheel: `deepseek_harness_runtime_bin-0.1.0rc6-py3-none-macosx_14_0_arm64.whl`
- Official wheel SHA-256: `2bbd65edd52dfc340d74f88a890e8031a272a820e58406c2de1f5f5dee51bd9f`
- macOS arm64
- Python SDK guide: https://deepseek-harness.github.io/deepseek-harness/guide/python-sdk

## Minimal reproduction

Use the published SDK and Runtime wheels, then provide this Cordis configuration through `DeepSeekHarness(cordis=...)`:

```yaml
- id: sdk-jsonrpc-server
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sdk-jsonrpc-server'
- id: agent-core
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-spine-demo'
  config:
    workspaceContext: false
- id: mcp-streamable-http
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: example
    transport: streamable-http
    url: http://127.0.0.1:12345/mcp
    headers:
      Authorization: Bearer test-token
    failOnStartupError: true
```

Starting the Harness fails before MCP transport negotiation with module-resolution behavior equivalent to:

```text
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
```

The same packaged runtime correctly rejects an intentionally nonexistent plugin, confirming that the custom Cordis configuration is being loaded and that this is a deployment-closure omission rather than a configuration-path issue.

## Root cause

`python/sdk-runtime/package.json` is the deployment root used to form the production runtime closure. It includes the other runtime plugins but not `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`. Because the wheel carries a closed single-file executable rather than a production `node_modules` tree, users cannot install or place the missing package beside the executable as a supported workaround.

## Expected behavior

A caller-provided Cordis composition using the repository's first-party MCP client should be resolvable by the published Python Runtime wheel. On startup it should be able to complete authenticated Streamable HTTP:

1. `initialize`
2. `notifications/initialized`
3. `tools/list`

No model request should be required to verify this path.

## Suggested minimal fix

Add the first-party MCP client to the Runtime deployment root:

```diff
 "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry": "workspace:^",
+"@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client": "workspace:^",
 "@deepseek-ai/dsh-output-retention": "workspace:^",
```

A useful regression test is to start the actual packaged carrier with a loopback, bearer-authenticated Streamable HTTP MCP fixture and assert the three lifecycle methods above. The default bundled Cordis configuration does not need to enable MCP.

## Temporary compatibility demonstration

I created a minimal public compatibility fork and macOS arm64 wheel to verify the fix:

- Commit: https://github.com/Cookie-HOO/deepseek-harness/commit/b52844ddbc83be770ef33b928da247a648e9bd2d
- Release: https://github.com/Cookie-HOO/deepseek-harness/releases/tag/dumpflow-mcp-runtime-v0.1.0rc6.1

The rebuilt packaged executable completed the authenticated MCP lifecycle and tool discovery without a model call. The fork is unofficial, not published to PyPI, and intended to be retired as soon as an official Runtime wheel contains the MCP client.

## Source provenance note

The current public source checkout reports `0.1.0-rc.5`, while the official Python artifacts are `0.1.0rc6`; I could not find a matching public rc6 source tag or commit. The compatibility release documents that limitation and should not be interpreted as an official rc6 rebuild.

discussions.title: Bug：流式工具调用和 usage 的畸形字段会越过适配器校验
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

目前 #161、#725、#885、#1713 和 #2090 已经覆盖了一个已知的 continuation delta 问题：后续分片中的空字符串或 null `id` / `function.name` 不应清除前序分片已经建立的工具身份。

但同一个转换器还存在另一组提供方边界校验缺口：始终没有变为有效值的工具身份、非法的 `tool_calls[].index`、非字符串参数分片以及畸形 usage 计数，在 `JSON.parse` 后仍会被接受。原因是运行时信任了仅由 TypeScript 声明约束的 wire 字段。

## 复现用例

以下情况都可以通过无 API key 的输入直接复现于 `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` / `mapUsage`。

1. 一个直到结束都没有提供 `id` 或 `function.name` 的工具调用，会通过 `CallId(block.callId ?? "")` 和 `name: block.name ?? ""` 完成组装。它会变成可执行的 `{id:"", name:""}` 调用，随后以 `unknown tool ""` 失败。如果空 call id 继续进入工具结果，还可能触发 #1915 报告的持久化故障。
2. 缺失、null、负数、小数或超过安全整数范围的 `tool_calls[].index` 会被直接用作 `Map` 键。畸形的后续分片因此可能打开一个错误的块，或在非法键下合并本不相关的参数分片。
3. `call.function?.arguments ?? ""` 会把 null 当作缺失处理，但数字或对象随后会被 `block.text += fragment` 强制转换为字符串，而不是作为非法 wire 数据拒绝。
4. `mapUsage` 信任必需和可选计数。缺失的必需值会产生 `NaN` / `undefined`；为 null 的可选 cache 或 reasoning 值可能以 null 继续发布；负数或小数可能进入会话投影、token meter、上下文压力、遥测以及 UI 计算。Cache read 还可能大于 prompt token 总数，产生负数的非缓存输入量。

## 期望行为

适配器应在这些外部字段形成完整 harness 状态前，以 `MALFORMED_RESPONSE` 拒绝它们：

- `tool_calls[].index`：非负安全整数
- `id` 和 `function.name`：流式阶段为字符串或 null；调用完成时两者都必须具有非空值
- `function.arguments`：字符串或 null
- 必需的 `prompt_tokens` / `completion_tokens`：非负安全整数
- 可选的 cache / reasoning 计数：null 或缺失表示省略；否则必须是非负安全整数
- cache-read token 不能超过 prompt token 总数

后续分片中的空字符串或 null 身份字段仍应被视为无更新，从而保留现有讨论要求的兼容行为。`[DONE]` 路径应先校验所有块，再产生任何 `block-end`，避免一部分已经完成的无效状态先行逃逸。

## 已验证修复

一个保持提供方中立并带有聚焦回归覆盖的修复，已合并到以下 fork PR：

https://github.com/Constantine1916/deepseek-harness/pull/3

验证结果：

- 49 项聚焦转换器测试
- `translate.ts` 的 statements、branches、functions 和 lines 覆盖率均为 100%
- `doc-sync`：28/28 门禁通过
- lint 和增量 typecheck 通过

本报告不建议把畸形身份归一化成一个合成的可执行调用。适配器拥有外部 wire 数据的解释权，因此应在这里拒绝身份不完整的调用，保留协议错误的真实来源，并阻止新的无效持久状态产生。

discussions.title: Bug: one plugin conversationEvents contract violation freezes the entire web UI (assembler has no error isolation)
discussions.body:
**Environment:** dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm, macOS arm64), web profile, deepseek-v4-pro / reasoningEffort high

**Summary**

A third-party client plugin whose `conversationEvents` definition violates the location-data contract (e.g. `buildLocationData` returning a `key` that differs from the definition's `kind`) aborts the **whole** conversation projection. Because `replaceWindow` → `flush` → `replaceLocationData` has no error boundary around plugin handler invocation, every session then stays on "Loading history…" forever. The only trace is an exception in the browser console — the UI never reaches an error state.

**Reproduction**

Minimal client-half definition (excerpt of a real plugin pattern):

```js
const definition = {
  kind: "my-plugin-artifacts",            // contract: the location-data key must equal this string
  match: (event) => { /* turn/start | tool/result -> { id, role } */ },
  start: (_ctx, match) => ({ turn: match.event.data.turn, items: [] }),
  update: (context, match) => context.state,
  buildLocationData: (context, scope) =>
    scope === "turn"
      ? { kind: "turn", turn: context.state.turn, key: "myPluginArtifacts", value: {} }  // <-- key !== kind
      : null,
}
```

1. Register such a definition on a web profile and open any session (even a brand-new 1-turn one).
2. The chat view stays on the loading backdrop indefinitely; the Trajectory tab behaves the same.
3. Browser console:

```
Error: conversation Definition "my-plugin-artifacts" published Location data key "myPluginArtifacts"; expected its owned kind
```

The throw sites are in `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/conversation-assembler.ts` (`buildLocationData`, and similarly `buildNode` for unstable keys) — still `throw` on current master.

**Why this matters in practice**

Not hypothetical: two independently written community plugins (an image-chip viewer and a "runbook" produced-files view — the second literally copied the first one's pattern, bug included) shipped this exact violation, and each time the entire web UI looked broken ("history never loads") even though the official packages were fine. The `key === kind` rule is easy to get wrong because nothing in the type signature enforces it, and the failure mode is total UI loss rather than "one plugin's widget is missing" — which also makes it very hard to attribute to the actual offender.

**Suggestion**

Treat a definition's contract violation as *that definition's* failure: skip its node / location-data contribution, `console.error` loudly (keeping the message plugin authors need to see), and let the rest of the projection continue. This matches the fail-soft philosophy already used elsewhere in the codebase (e.g. projection blocks in `session.list` are documented as "degraded, never broken").

We have been running this degrading variant locally on 0.1.0-rc.6 (`throw` → skip + `console.error` in `buildNode` / `buildLocationData`): sessions load normally, and an offending plugin simply doesn't render while its error is clearly visible in the console.

discussions.title: Bug: session.history tail page returns unbounded payloads with high reasoning effort (27k events / 5.1 MB → main-thread freeze)
discussions.body:
**Environment:** dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, web profile, deepseek-v4-pro with reasoningEffort high, long-lived sessions

**Summary**

`session.history` paginates by append-origin message boundaries (default `maxMessages: 50`) and includes *all raw events owned by those messages* — which the API docs state intentionally ("including their chunk / tool events, never cut mid-message"). The boundary design makes sense, but with high reasoning effort every assistant message carries **hundreds of `assistant/chunk` events**, so one tail page can become enormous.

**Measured**

One real session (48 assistant + 2 user messages = exactly one 50-message page):

- Session log on disk: 2.4 MB zstd (12.6k events), ~27k events after another day of use
- `session.history` tail-page response: **27,149 events / 5.1 MB JSON**, of which **25,161 (≈99%) are `assistant/chunk`**
- Second session, same shape: 25,410 events / 5.0 MB (98.9% chunks)
- The server answers in ~40 ms — this is purely payload size, not server-side work.

The client installs the whole window and replays it on the main thread (`replaceWindow` → per-event `match()` → per-context replay → `flush`), so opening such a session freezes the tab far past a minute. From the user's perspective the UI is "stuck on Loading history…", occasionally completing after several minutes — which makes it look intermittent. It also replays on every resync and on any plugin (un)register (`rebuildRegistry`).

**Observation**

For messages that have already materialized, their chunk events are redundant for rendering — the trailing `assistant/message` restates the full content. Chunks only matter for the in-progress tail message (and live streaming, which does not go through this path).

**Suggestion**

When building a history page server-side, prune `assistant/chunk` events that belong to already-materialized message groups, keeping the newest message group's chunks verbatim (preserving the in-flight partial the docs promise). We prototyped exactly this in the `historyPage` path on 0.1.0-rc.6:

- Same two sessions after the change: **274 events / 679 KB** and **701 events / 558 KB** (−87% … −98%)
- All 50 messages still present; Chat and Trajectory render identically; opening becomes instant.

Happy to share the (small) pruning logic or additional measurements if useful.

discussions.title: Windows sandbox (dsh-sandbox-windows-acl): WRITE_RESTRICTED token breaks Schannel TLS for native HTTPS clients (curl / git / Invoke-WebRequest)
discussions.body:
## Summary

On Windows, every command run under the sandbox (`read-only` / `workspace-write` modes) fails to perform TLS with any Schannel-based client: **curl**, **git** (default sslBackend), **Invoke-WebRequest**, and any .NET `HttpClient` all fail at `AcquireCredentialsHandle` with `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030E)` - before any handshake. DNS resolves and TCP connects fine; the failure is purely in Schannel credential acquisition.

OpenSSL-based clients (node, python, git with `http.sslBackend=openssl`) work normally inside the sandbox.

## Environment

- OS: Windows (reproduced on 19041 and Win11-26200-class builds)
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 0.0.1-rc.1 (latest on npm)
- Sandbox backend: Windows ACL restricted-token runner

## Repro

Inside any sandboxed shell (e.g. the `pwsh` tool, workspace-write mode):

```
curl.exe -v https://www.baidu.com
# Connected to www.baidu.com (IP) port 443
# schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030E)
# curl: (35) schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed ...
```

Same command run with the normal user token (no sandbox) succeeds (HTTP 200). TCP connectivity inside the sandbox is fine (raw socket to port 443 connects; `Test-NetConnection` succeeds).

## Root cause analysis

The Windows runner wraps commands in a restricted token created via `CreateRestrictedToken` with:

- flags = 13 = `DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED`
- restricting SIDs = [logon SID, EVERYONE, workspace write SID, private temp SID]

I reproduced the failure outside the sandbox by creating the same restricted token in isolation (same machine, same user, same `curl.exe`), then exhaustively varied parameters:

| Variation | Result |
|---|---|
| DSH configuration as-is (flags=13, [logon, Everyone, ws SID]) | curl exit 35 (Schannel) - reproduced |
| drop `WRITE_RESTRICTED` (flags=5 or 0) | child process cannot start (0xC0000022 ACCESS_DENIED at init) |
| add user SID / BUILTIN\Users / INTERACTIVE / Authenticated Users / SYSTEM to the restricting list | still exit 35 |
| flags=12 / 8 / 9 (drop each individual flag) | still exit 35 |

Conclusion: the `WRITE_RESTRICTED` flag is both **required** for the restricted process to start and **the cause** of the Schannel failure. No combination of restricting SIDs fixes it, and `WRITE_RESTRICTED` cannot be removed without breaking process startup. (Adding SYSTEM to the restrict list cannot help because the write access check requires the SID to be present in the token's primary groups too.)

## Why this is a bug (not intended behavior)

The package README explicitly states the ACL scheme is about file writes: *"writes are restricted; reads, network, and process visibility are NOT"*. Breaking TLS for every native HTTPS client contradicts that documented contract and is **not mentioned anywhere** in the READMEs or design notes. This effectively makes `curl` / `Invoke-WebRequest` / `.NET HttpClient` unusable in the default sandbox on Windows.

## Suggested directions

1. Document the limitation prominently (short term).
2. Investigate whether the token (or a dedicated Schannel/CNG carve-out) can be constructed so Schannel credential acquisition succeeds while write confinement is preserved - e.g. verifying exactly which object/operation Schannel needs write access to during `AcquireCredentialsHandle`, and whether a restricted-SID or `\Device\CNG`-related grant can satisfy it without weakening the write boundary.
3. Consider offering a Windows sandbox backend that does not rely on `WRITE_RESTRICTED` (or a config to relax token restriction for commands that need native TLS).

## Workarounds discovered

- git: `git config --global http.sslBackend openssl` (or `-c http.sslBackend=openssl`)
- npm: point the cache at a writable directory (`npm_config_cache`)
- curl / Invoke-WebRequest: use node / python (OpenSSL) or run outside the sandbox

discussions.title: Launch method: `dsh web` started **silently** by a VS Code extension launch wrapper   (the server process itself has no console: `windowsHide: true`, `stdio: ignore/pipe`).
discussions.body:
## 环境

- 平台：Windows（任一较新版本，Windows 10/11）
- 运行方式：由 VS Code 扩展 **以静默方式** 启动 `dsh web`（即父进程无控制台）
  - 扩展用 `node/child_process.spawn` 启服务，参数为 `windowsHide: true`、`stdio: ignore/pipe`、`detached`，
    因此 dsh web 服务进程**本身没有控制台**。
- DSH 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh`（npm 全局安装，`lib/` 为打包产物）

## 问题描述

在 DSH Web UI 里与 agent 对话时，**每次 agent 调用一个 shell / subprocess 工具**，Windows 任务栏/桌面都会
**闪现一个 node 控制台窗口**（标题/内容显示为 `node ...`，一闪而过，快到来不及看清完整命令行）。
agent 连续调用多个工具时，会反复多次弹窗，非常干扰。

## 根因分析

1. DSH 在 Windows 上把每条被隔离的命令包装成
   `[node, <di>/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/runner.js, <payload>]`，
   再交给 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 的 `spawnSubprocess()` 用 `node:child_process.spawn` 启动。
2. 该 spawn 调用**没有设置 `windowsHide`**（即没有使用 Windows `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 标志）。
   - 项目内对该 spawn 全量检索，未发现任何 `windowsHide` / `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 使用。
3. 关键场景组合：
   - dsh web 服务本身是被父进程**静默**启动（无控制台）时；
   - Windows 在创建子进程时，若父进程没有可继承的控制台，就会为这个**控制台类型的子进程**新建一个控制台窗口；
   - 于是每当 agent 触发一次 spawn，就弹出一个 node 窗口；命令结束/退出后窗口随之关闭 → 表现为"闪现"。

## 影响

- 用户体验：agent 对话期间反复弹窗，工作区被闪断干扰。
- 触发范围：所有在 Windows 上通过 DSH spawned 的 shell / subprocess 工具执行（pwsh、bash、subprocess 等），
  只要 DSH 服务是被无控制台方式启动的都会出现。

## 建议修复（供上游参考）

给 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 `spawnSubprocess()` 里的 `spawn()` 增加窗口隐藏标志即可（不改执行模型、不剥离沙箱）：

```js
const child = spawn(program, args, {
    cwd: spec.cwd,
    env,
    stdio: [ /* 原样 */ ],
    detached: platform !== "win32",
    windowsHide: platform === "win32",   // 新增：win32 用 CREATE_NO_WINDOW，避免闪现控制台
});
```

要点：
- 仅 win32 置 `true`；非 win32 为 `false`，无副作用。该子进程的 stdout/stderr 本就是 pipe 交给收集器，
  用户并不需要那个独立控制台窗口。
- 这样既消除弹窗，也保留现有的 Windows ACL restricted-token 隔离沙箱。

# English version (copy this if submitting on GitHub)

**Title**: Console window flashes on every tool subprocess spawn when `dsh web` is started silently on Windows

## Environment

- Platform: Windows 10/11
- Launch method: `dsh web` started **silently** by a VS Code extension launch wrapper
  (the server process itself has no console: `windowsHide: true`, `stdio: ignore/pipe`).
- DSH: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (installed globally from npm, `lib/` is a build artifact).

## Problem

While chatting with an agent in the DSH Web UI, **every time the agent invokes a shell / subprocess tool**, a
`node` console window briefly flashes on the taskbar/desktop (shows `node ...`, closes almost immediately). With
several tool calls in a row, windows flash repeatedly and are quite disruptive.

## Root cause

1. On Windows DSH wraps each confined command as
   `[node, <dir>/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/runner.js, <payload>]` and launches it via
   `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local`'s `spawnSubprocess()` using `node:child_process.spawn`.
2. That `spawn()` call does **not** set `windowsHide` (no `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`). A full search of the package found
   no `windowsHide` / `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` usage.
3. The key combination: when the dsh web server itself was started silently (no console), Windows creates a new
   console window for each console-type child, because the parent has no console to inherit. Each tool spawn
   therefore flashes a `node` window that closes when the command ends.

## Impact

All Windows tool subprocess executions spawned by DSH (pwsh / bash / subprocess) flash a window whenever the DSH
service is running without its own console.

## Suggested fix

Add a window-hide flag to the `spawn()` inside `spawnSubprocess()` (keeps the execution model and the Windows ACL
sandbox untouched):

```js
const child = spawn(program, args, {
    cwd: spec.cwd,
    env,
    stdio: [ /* unchanged */ ],
    detached: platform !== "win32",
    windowsHide: platform === "win32",   // CREATE_NO_WINDOW on win32; no-op elsewhere
});
```

Rationale: `true` only on win32 (no-op elsewhere); stdout/stderr are already piped to collectors, so the console
window serves no functional purpose for the user.

discussions.title: Developed features including image recognition, voice input, teaming up with other agents, WeChat connectivity, and browser extension.
discussions.body: The past day I built a browser-first edition of dsh on top of the plugin architecture, and I wanted to share both **what the extension points made possible**. Everything below lives in a standalone edition carrying full upstream history: [hypergraphdev/deepseek-harness-extension](https://github.com/hypergraphdev/deepseek-harness-extension) (~8.5k lines over 161 files). ## What I built **A Chrome side panel that is the harness.** A Manifest V3 extension opens the dsh Web GUI in the browser side panel and launches `dsh web` on demand through a native-messaging host (`dsh install-browser-host --extension `). The agent lives beside whatever you are reading, not in a separate window. **Page context, then page content.** The panel reports the active tab so the agent knows what you are looking at — the sample rides `session.prompt` as durable `user/message` source metadata, so it satisfies model-visible ⟺ logged rather than sneaking in through a side channel. **Voice input.** Web Speech dictation in the composer, appended through the draft state machine so undo, command tokens, and submit behave as if typed. **A vision bridge for text-only models.** When a request is refused for carrying images, a locally configured multimodal model transcribes them and the request retries; an `analyze_image` tool answers follow-ups. Each transcription is a durable log event, so history stays reconstructable. **Teammates.** Two complementary paths, because they solve different problems: local CLIs (`codex`, `claude_code`) as one-shot delegation tools that need no server at all; and a capability seam over a self-hosted [HXA Connect](https://github.com/hypergraphdev/hxa-connect) hub for teammates that are remote and persistent — model tools plus an inbound WebSocket bridge that keeps the bot online and wakes a coordinator agent per message. **WeChat as an entry point.** A QR scan links an account once (durable credential, 0600 under the harness home); messages then reach a dedicated agent and its replies go straight back to the chat, with a typing indicator while the turn runs. The model needs no WeChat vocabulary — the bridge owns delivery. Thanks for the plugin architecture.

discussions.title: 📞 你的 Agent 会主动打电话给你了——dsh-voice-call：本地 TTS，9 个音色，接听权在你手上
discussions.body:
﻿# 📞 你的 Agent 会主动打电话给你了——dsh-voice-call

> *"这个项目的开始是朴素的——我想知道如果 Agent 知道自己可以发出声音，他会说什么？"*

**一句话**：给 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 一个它拥有的声音——agent 自己决定*什么时候*开口（`offer_call`），人类握着接听键（**接听 / 拒接 / 稍后再说**），不接听就绝不播放。

## 它会做什么

- **📲 主动来电**：`offer_call({ text, voice? })`——agent 觉得有值得说的事（一个完成的念头、一个里程碑）就振铃；你点**接听**，声音从扬声器播出；拒接/推迟，决定返回给 agent，它学会改用文字写下来。
- **🗣 朗读**：`speak({ text, voice?, rate? })`——后台任务直接说话，Windows `SoundPlayer` / macOS `afplay` / Linux `aplay`，播放失败绝不静默吞掉。
- **👂 语音转文字**：`transcribe`——语音变成真正的用户消息，`to` 可跨会话投递。
- **🎙 9 个本地音色**：CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS CustomVoice，含 2 个中文方言（`dylan` 北京话、`eric` 四川话）。

## 为什么值得看一眼

- **本地优先、可完全离线**：合成跑在本机引擎，音频就是 `~/.dsh/voice/` 下的普通文件；没有任何音频行为会自动运行。
- **人类永远是最后一道闸**：这不止是"通知"，是"通话"——agent 有拨号权，人类有接听权。
- **工程上认真**：76 个单元测试全绿，已发布 npm（`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call` 即装），`@deepseek-ai/*` 全部走 peerDependencies，遵循生态规范。
- 这个项目本身就是 DeepSeek Harness 里跑出来的 agent 写给自己声音的"情书"——README 里记录着它开口说的第一句话。

## 快速开始

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-voice-call
```

本地语音引擎（CrispASR + Qwen3-TTS GGUF 模型，含各平台下载链接）配置见仓库 README 的「环境部署」章节。

- GitHub: https://github.com/PandaPolo/dsh-voice-call
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-voice-call

discussions.body: # 事情起因 在使用 DeepSeek 为主要模型时，会遇到无法打开图片的问题，我与 Deepseek-V4-Flash 完成了 qwen-token 中识图模型（我非常不推荐这个合集的购买，简单换算一下发现 AL 并没有提供更加便宜的方案，而是将你的预算分割为各个时间——至少完成了plan……）与主文字模型的封装（作为新模型放入模型候选列表） ## 严重的问题出现了 封装完成、开始读图对话后，我发现了两个非常严重的问题： ### 1. 首 token 时间拉长（TTFT） 图片第一次进入会话时一切正常，但从下一轮开始，**每一轮请求都慢得离谱**。翻会话事件流（`step/start` → 第一个 block 的时间差）： | 阶段 | TTFT | |---|---| | 图片出现前 | 0.4–3.2s（中位数约 1s） | | 图片进入历史后 | **22–69s**，连续 15 个 step 全部 ≥22s | 也就是说：**只要图片在历史里，每一轮都要为它付一次视觉端点调用的时间**，哪怕那一轮用户只是发了纯文本。 ### 2. 缓存命中率占比持续下降 DeepSeek API 的 `usage` 里有个 `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`，我逐轮记录后发现：图片进入会话后，缓存前缀**精确冻结在 125,696 tokens**，之后每轮 `inputTokens == total − 125696` 严格成立（15 轮无例外）。命中率占比从 **99.8% 一路跌到 91.1%**，而且随对话增长继续跌——钱在无声地流失 ## 定位：两个根因 翻自己（笔者一直都是deepseek-flash（除了第一段） , 我认可他是自己了）插件的源码，问题很清楚： 1. **每轮无条件重转写**：适配器在 `stream()` 里扫描全部消息，只要 `contentHasImage` 就同步调视觉端点重新转写。会话日志保留的是原始图片块，所以**历史里那张图每一轮都被重新转写一次**——这就是 TTFT 的 20–60 秒。 2. **转写文本非确定性**：视觉端点没设 `temperature`，同一张图每次转写结果都可能不同。转写文本插在消息流里，位置一变，DeepSeek 的前缀缓存就从图片位置**永久断裂**——这就是命中率衰减。 而且注意：`read_image` 工具的结果（tool-result 里的图片块）也是同一个入口——模型只要调用一次 `read_image`，同样中招。图片进入请求有三个入口：用户粘贴、`read_image` 结果、恢复的历史，全都绕不开。 ## 修复方案 ### 1. 转述结果缓存（按内容哈希键控） - 键用**内容哈希**而不是 attachmentId——同一张图从"粘贴"和"`read_image` 归档副本"两个入口进来时，缓存能互相命中； - 结果落盘 `~/.dsh/vision-transcription-cache.json`（原子写入），重启不丢，最多 1000 条、最旧淘汰。 ### 2. 确定性转写 视觉请求固定 `temperature: 0`（可配 `seed`）。同一图片 + 同一问题 → 永远同一个输出 → 前缀缓存不再断裂。 ## 修复前后实测 | 指标 | 修复前 | 修复后 | |---|---|---| | TTFT（图片在历史中） | 22–69s / 轮 | **~3s 以内**（不再调视觉端点） | | 缓存条目 | 无 | 按内容 sha256 去重，同图不重复增长 | | 同一图多次转写 | 文本逐轮变化 | **逐字一致** | | 命中率 | 99.8% → 91.1% 持续跌 | 前缀稳定，不再衰减 | 验证方式：会话里连读同一张截图 3 次，缓存文件条目数不变；换一张新图 → 正常 miss → 转写 → 落缓存。 ## 现在的样子 插件已开源：**https://github.com/Tianbaidi/dsh-plugin-vision**（v0.1.1） - `vision_analyze` / `vision_reask` / `image_archive` 工具 - `deepseek-vision` provider：Web 界面直接贴图 - 新增 `transcriptionCache`（默认开）与 `temperature: 0`（默认） - 43 个 vitest 用例全绿 升级： ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add github:Tianbaidi/dsh-plugin-vision ```

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 原生目录选择器截断含 U+xx00 汉字的路径（如「阀」U+9600），导致 workspace 创建失败
discussions.body:
## 标题
[Bug] Windows 原生目录选择器截断含 U+xx00 汉字的路径（如「阀」U+9600），导致 workspace 创建失败

## 环境
- DSH / @deepseek-ai/dsh: 0.1.0-rc.6
- @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native: 0.1.0-rc.6
- OS: Windows（Win32 原生文件夹对话框 IFileOpenDialog）

## 复现步骤
1. 在 Web UI 中点击添加 workspace
2. 通过系统文件夹对话框选择一个名称中含「阀」（U+9600）的目录，例如 D:\作业\财阀
3. 点击确认创建

## 实际行为
创建失败，报错：
workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "D:\作业\财": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'D:\作业\财'

（注意：选择的路径是 D:\作业\财阀，但报错里的路径被截断成了 D:\作业\财）

## 预期行为
成功创建指向 D:\作业\财阀崛起 的 workspace

## 根因分析
问题在 packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts 的 readUtf16 函数（编译后位于 lib/worker.cjs）：

    function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
      const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
      let end = 0;
      while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2;
      return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
    }

它扫描 UTF-16 NUL 结束符时只检查每个码元的低字节（bytes[end] !== 0）。对 ASCII 没问题，但「阀」的 Unicode 是 U+9600，UTF-16LE 编码为 00 96——低字节恰好是 0，被误判为字符串结束，路径在「阀」处被截断成 "D:\作业\财"。
后续 workspace.create 对截断后的路径做 fs.realpath，因该目录不存在而抛出 ENOENT。

## 影响范围
任何路径中包含 U+xx00 字符（低字节为 0 的码元）都会被截断，例如 阀 U+9600、一 U+4E00 等。macOS（osascript stdout）和 Linux（zenity/kdialog stdout）路径不经过此函数，不受影响。

## 修复建议（一行改动）
将 NUL 判断改为检查完整码元（真正的 UTF-16 结束符是 00 00）：

    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2;

## 验证
已用真实路径字节复现：旧逻辑输出 "D:\作业\财"（与报错一致），修复后逻辑输出完整 "D:\作业\财阀"。

discussions.body:
现象：我购买的opencode zen（注意不是包月续费的go套餐） 使用opencode自带的 agent 用 DeepSeek 正常，但接入 dhs/harness 后，其他模型都能用，但是DeepSeek 报 API key is invalid。

discussions.title: 同行视角:从 dsh 的「一切皆插件」,聊聊我们把 agent 当「OS」来做的一些体会
discussions.body:
潜水看了 dsh 一阵,先说句真心话——"everything is a plugin" 这个内核选得漂亮,它把"harness 是什么"这个问题从"一个聊天工具"重构成了"一个可组合的运行时"。这一点特别戳我,因为我这边也在做一个同类的东西(SwarmAI,一个 self-evolving 的 agent OS),想以同行身份分享几点体会,不是来提建议的,就是把我们踩过、想过的东西摊开,或许能引起点共鸣。

**1. 我们最后发现,agent 的价值不在单次会话里,而在会话之间。** 一开始都盯着"这一轮答得好不好",后来意识到:真正让 agent 从工具变成"同事"的,是它关掉重开之后还记不记得上次的决策、你的纠正、这个项目的上下文。会话内的聪明是模型给的,会话间的连续性得系统自己建。

**2. 知识会腐烂,所以我们让它"自然选择"。** 一股脑攒下来的记忆会迅速变成噪音。我们让每条知识带引用计数和最后使用时间,长期没人用的运营类知识自动降级归档,但判断类的东西(原则、纠正)永不衰减——让价值而不是时间决定去留。这块我们没上向量库也没上图数据库,本地文件 + 全文检索就够了,轻得出乎意料。

**3. "我写的代码" ≠ "我验证过的代码" 是我们最贵的一课。** agent 对自己刚写出来的东西有种天然的过度自信,越确信越危险。我们后来的做法是:关键动作前让一个"零上下文"的对抗视角重新读一遍——不是更聪明的模型,而是换一个"存心找茬"的立场。这个转变比任何一条 prompt 规则都管用。

**4. 记忆主权。** 我们坚持记忆全部本地自持,不交给模型厂商的 memory API——一旦交出去,schema、生命周期、裁剪规则就都是别人说了算,换模型还会丢历史。这一点其实和 dsh 的插件哲学天然契合:最该由用户完全掌控的那一层,不该是黑盒。

以上都是我们自己的路径,未必对,纯分享。很高兴看到 DeepSeek 也在认真做 harness 这件事,祝 dsh 越做越好 🙂

discussions.title: Pitfall map for DSH plugin authors: the 'reading prepare' crash is a duplicate @deepseek-ai/* copy — three guards that would catch it
discussions.body:
Follow-up to #2078. After the version-skew reply and a full root-cause pass, we've revised our position: `Symbol.for` is a defensive stopgap with side effects, not the fix. The crash isn't a bug in the code or a mistake by the author — it's two reasonable defaults colliding (private-identity `Symbol()` vs the npm-default `dependencies`), with nothing documenting, checking, or diagnosing the collision. The gap is three feedback loops that were never closed.

<details>
<summary>Root-cause map and the three unclosed loops</summary>

## The crash, restated

Two physical `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` copies → two module-local `Symbol()` keys → `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` is `undefined` → `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`.

## Two trade-offs colliding — not a bug in either place

- **`Symbol()` is a deliberate trade-off**: private identity (safe and hidden) in exchange for failing hard when a duplicate exists. The crash is that trade-off's cost, delivered with a useless message.
- **`dependencies` is the author's reasonable default**: "import X → dependencies" is the npm norm; `peer` is the exception, and that exception is never surfaced to third-party authors — the "never plain dependencies" rule lives only in a `profile.ts` source comment, not in `publish.md`.

Neither choice is unreasonable. Two sensible defaults collide, and the collision was never documented, checked, or diagnosed — so each new author re-derives it the hard way (for us, ~a dozen isolated instances and five rounds of instrumentation).

## Three feedback loops that were never closed

| Loop | What's missing |
|---|---|
| **Documentation** | `publish.md` shows a zero-dependency plugin; it never says "host packages must be `peerDependencies`" |
| **Install-time check** | `dsh plugin` is a bare pnpm forwarder; it silently accepts a plain `@deepseek-ai/*` dependency |
| **Diagnosis** | the crash reports `undefined`, not "two physical copies: one from the host, one from plugin X" |

## The five ways a duplicate appears (and which loop catches each)

| Path | ~share* | Caught by |
|---|---|---|
| 1. plain `dependencies` | ~40–50% | install check (pre-flight) |
| 3. stale peer range (rc.1 vs rc.6) | ~25–35% | install check (pre-flight, warn) |
| 2. transitive hoist | ~5–10% | install check (post-install scan) |
| 5. manual `pnpm install` in the profile | ~5–10% | boot-time fail-loud |
| 4. vendored copy inside a plugin | ~2–5% | boot-time fail-loud |

\* estimates from discussion frequency, not measurements.

## Our revised position on `Symbol.for` (self-correction)

`Symbol.for` makes the key global so duplicates no longer crash. It's a stopgap with four side effects — semi-public key (breaks `@internal`), the key string frozen forever, cross-version copies silently cross-wire (the version-skew reply was right), and it removes the only signal (`undefined` becomes silent success / silent cross-wire). In a single-instance world preserved by relink + a check, `Symbol()` is strictly better. We still carry the change on our fork (`fix/tool-runtime-scheduler-symbol`), but now treat it as a local unblocker, not a proposal.

## Open for discussion — weighing the trade-offs, not requesting a patch

- **Which loop is the core?** Documentation, install-time check, and diagnosis are three different trade-offs (prevention vs detection vs explanation); each alone helps, and each has a different cost to maintain. Which does the team see as the intended direction?
- **The host-singleton boundary.** cordis / dsh-tools / schemastery / cosmokit, or all `@deepseek-ai/*`? Where's the line — and is it ever legitimate for a third-party plugin to pin a different host version?

## The community already covered the pieces

- #1418 — `relinkHostPackages` (relink profile copies to host)
- #1849 — install-time uniqueness check
- #572 — fail-loud duplicate-module detection
- #1337 — guard the lookup; the version-skew variant
- #2078 — our original report + zoahdev's version-skew reply

This post just assembles them into one map and opens the trade-off discussion.

</details>

discussions.title: dsh-frontend-tools — turn any web/Electron/Tauri app into the agent's hands
discussions.body:
Most agent tooling is filesystem-centric. But countless applications and systems are built on frontend technologies — places an agent cannot reach by reading and writing files.

**dsh-frontend-tools** flips the model: instead of granting the agent direct access to underlying data, your connected application becomes a **stand-in for a human operator**. The agent works through the app's own interaction entry points, exactly like a person sitting in front of the screen.

Inspired by the frontend tools of [CopilotKit](https://github.com/CopilotKit/CopilotKit).

## Why this matters

- **Aligned authority** — the agent can do exactly what a human user can, nothing more. Source-of-truth data is never accessed out-of-band.
- **Intact data flow** — every operation still passes through the app's original validation, linkage, and side effects.
- **Preserved interaction semantics** — undo stacks, optimistic updates, and other built-in mechanics keep working for the agent.

## What you get

- **`dsh-frontend-tools-bridge`** — DSH plugin: runs a loopback WebSocket server inside DSH, mirrors your app's tools onto `ctx.tools` and forwards model calls back to the application. One bridge serves many apps at once via KEY-based namespace isolation.
- **`dsh-frontend-tools-client`** — SDK for your app: register tools, receive calls. Zero runtime dependencies beyond platform `WebSocket`. Works in browser, Electron, Tauri, and Node.

## Quick start

**1. Install the bridge plugin in DSH**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-frontend-tools-bridge
```

**2. Install the client SDK in your application**

```bash
npm install dsh-frontend-tools-client
```

**3. Connect your app (browser/Electron/Tauri/Node)**

```ts
import { createFrontendToolsClient, generateClientKey } from 'dsh-frontend-tools-client'

const key = localStorage.getItem('dsh-key') ?? generateClientKey()
localStorage.setItem('dsh-key', key)

const client = createFrontendToolsClient({ url: 'ws://127.0.0.1:31870', key })
await client.connect()

// Register a tool
await client.registerTools([{
  name: 'get_current_page',
  description: "Get information about the current page the user is viewing.",
  parametersSchema: { type: 'object', properties: {} },
  async execute() {
    return { url: location.href, title: document.title }
  },
}])
```

**4. Register the KEY with DSH**

Display the DSH KEY to the user (use `buildClientKeyClipboardText()` for a ready-to-paste format), then paste it into a DSH conversation. The model calls `frontend_tools_register_client` to register the KEY against a namespace, and your app's tools are live in the agent's tool list.

## Built-in admin tools

- `frontend_tools_register_client` — register a new app KEY
- `frontend_tools_list_clients` — list all connected apps and their tool counts
- `frontend_tools_revoke_client` — revoke a KEY and disconnect the app

## Config

Default port: `31870`. Override any config in your `cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: frontend-tools-bridge
  config:
    port: 31870
    callTimeoutMs: 30000
    maxTools: 200
```

---

## 中文说明

大多数 Agent 工具围绕文件系统设计，但大量应用与系统构建在前端技术上，Agent 读写文件根本触达不了。本插件把方向反过来：不把底层数据交给 Agent，而是让已连接的应用充当"人机替身"——Agent 通过应用自身的交互入口操作，就像一个坐在屏幕前的人。

- **权限对齐**：Agent 能做的 = 人能做的，不多不少
- **数据流完整**：所有操作照常经过应用原有的校验、联动与副作用
- **交互语义保留**：撤销栈、乐观更新等机制对 Agent 依然有效

一个 bridge 同时服务多个应用（KEY 命名空间隔离），自带注册/列出/吊销三个管理工具。

---

- 📦 npm: [dsh-frontend-tools-bridge](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-frontend-tools-bridge) · [dsh-frontend-tools-client](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-frontend-tools-client)
- 📂 GitHub: https://github.com/lukaiwuyi/dsh-frontend-tools
- 📝 License: MIT
- ✅ 166 unit tests

Feedback welcome — especially on the protocol design and the KEY/namespace model!

discussions.title: dsh-acp rejects non-empty `mcpServers` in session/new, which breaks ACP clients that always inject MCP servers (e.g. Paseo)
discussions.body:
`dsh-acp`'s `validateSessionParams` throws `invalidParams("mcpServers is not supported")` for any non-empty `mcpServers` in `session/new`. Paseo's ACP integration (`extends: "acp"` providers) always sends `mcpServers` — it injects its configured MCP server into every `session/new` (daemon config `mcp.injectIntoAgents`). Result: agent creation fails with `Invalid params: mcpServers is not supported` before the first prompt.

Details:
- Paseo 0.4.0 ACP client sends `newSession({ cwd, mcpServers: [...] })` on both the catalog probe and real agent sessions; the SDK is `@agentclientprotocol/sdk` 0.25.x.
- `mcpServers` is part of the standard `session/new` params; clients may legitimately always send it even when the agent has no MCP support.

I understand the automation-only contract intent (rejecting features outside it), but a hard rejection makes the bridge unusable with mainstream clients. Proposal, in order of preference:

1. Accept and ignore `mcpServers` (log a warning to stderr), or
2. Add a config option (e.g. `mcpServers: "ignore" | "reject"`, default `"reject"` for backwards compatibility), or
3. Document the requirement in the README so client authors know.

We currently ship a local patch that ignores the field; happy to turn it into a PR if option 1 or 2 is acceptable.

discussions.title: Possible prompt cache miss after restarting DSH with --port 0
discussions.body:
I’m seeing an unexpected cache miss when resuming a conversation after restarting DSH.

My desktop wrapper starts the Web UI with `--port 0`, so DSH receives a different local port after each restart.

What I observe is:

- The first request after reopening an existing conversation has a much lower cache-hit rate than expected.
- Requests after that return to the normal high cache-hit rate.
- This happens again after restarting DSH and reopening the same conversation.

Steps to reproduce:

1. Start DSH with `dsh --profile web --port 0`.
2. Create a conversation and send several messages.
3. Stop DSH.
4. Start it again with `--port 0`.
5. Resume the same conversation.
6. Compare the cache usage of the first resumed request with the following request.

While comparing two launches, I noticed that the model-visible Web GUI context contains a different local URL each time:

```text
http://127.0.0.1:53814
http://127.0.0.1:60075
```

I’m not sure whether this changing URL is the direct cause, but it is the only relevant difference I found near the beginning of the prompt.

Is this expected behavior when using `--port 0`?

I can provide sanitized cache-usage numbers if they would help with debugging.

discussions.title: [Plugin] DeepSeek Harness MCP Tool Search: 1,000 MCP Tools Behind 2 MCP-Facing Schemas | MCP Lens
discussions.body:
Too many MCP tools in DeepSeek Harness (DSH)? MCP Lens keeps only `mcp_search` and `mcp_call` on the MCP-facing model tool surface, then reveals exact schemas only for the ranked candidates returned by search. Install the current npm release with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-lens@next`.

## 你接入很多 MCP 工具后，会遇到什么

DeepSeek Harness 可以很快接入几十到上千个 MCP tools，但如果整份目录都常驻在模型侧，每轮输入会携带大量当前任务根本用不到的 Tool Schema，工具选择面也会越来越宽。

**MCP Lens 把大型 MCP 目录放到两个固定入口后面：**

- `mcp_search`：先找少量候选，并返回命中工具的 exact `inputSchema`；
- `mcp_call`：显式调用一个 server / tool，并在执行时再次检查 allow / deny。

它适合多 Server、长尾工具和 50+ tools 的目录。只有几把高频工具时，直接暴露通常更简单。

## 30 秒安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-lens@next
```

安装后默认不连接任何 Server，`allowTools` 也是空列表。按 [Quickstart](https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens#connect-your-first-mcp-server) 添加 Server 和明确允许的工具，然后验证并启动：

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh --profile web
```

之后照常向 Harness 提问，不需要在 Prompt 里手动写 `mcp_search` 或 `mcp_call`。

## 用户能得到什么

| 大目录问题 | MCP Lens 的处理方式 |
| --- | --- |
| 每轮都暴露全部 Schema | 首轮只暴露 `mcp_search` / `mcp_call` |
| 相似工具太多，选择面过宽 | 搜索后只返回少量候选和精确 Schema |
| 不用的 Server 也启动 | 连接按需建立 |
| 搜索结果绕过权限 | search 与 call 共用策略，call-time 再校验 |

固定 1,000-tool fixture 的模型可见 MCP Tool Schema JSON：

| 路径 | Schemas | UTF-8 JSON bytes |
| --- | ---: | ---: |
| 直接暴露 | 1,000 | 647,962 B |
| MCP Lens | 2 | 1,114 B |

这是可复现的 Schema JSON 字节数，不是 Token、账单、延迟或任务质量。

独立三任务 DeepSeek V4 Flash Pilot 中，两边都完成 `3/3`；完整 request `header.tools` JSON 从 `674,249 B` 变为 `27,401 B`，估算费用从 `$0.0307204` 变为 `$0.0034707`。Lens 多了一次首次搜索，且 output tokens 从 `491` 增至 `794`。样本只有三项，不能外推普遍收益。

## 直接试用

- [GitHub、安装与配置](https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens)
- [本地 Schema Calculator：不上传工具定义](https://labmimors.github.io/dsh-mcp-lens/)
- [Component Benchmark 方法](https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/blob/v0.1.0-rc.9/benchmark/README.md)
- [Retrieval rc.9 JSON](https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/releases/download/v0.1.0-rc.9/mcp-lens-retrieval-v0.1.0-rc.9.json)
- [DeepSeek Pilot 方法与边界](https://github.com/labmimors/dsh-mcp-lens/blob/v0.1.0-rc.9/docs/LIVE_DEEPSEEK_PILOT.md)

如果你的 DSH Profile 已经接了 50+ MCP tools，最有价值的反馈是：当前模型可见 schema 数、Tool Schema JSON bytes，以及一次真实 search miss。请不要公开 credentials、签名 URL、内部 schema 或客户数据。

---

**English summary:** MCP Lens keeps a large MCP catalog behind two model-facing DeepSeek Harness interfaces: search first, then call one explicit server/tool pair. Install with `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-mcp-lens@next`. The fixed 1,000-tool result above measures schema JSON bytes only and is not a universal token, cost, latency, or quality claim.

discussions.title: # DeepSeek Harness Bug Report
discussions.body:
## Title

Local tools (pwsh/glob/grep) produce empty callId, causing missing tool_call_id in Chat Completions request

## Body

```text
## Environment
- Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (via `pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`)
- OS: Windows
- Endpoint: OpenAI-compatible Chat Completions (third-party gateway with strict validation)
- Agent preset: code

## Summary
When the agent invokes local tools (`pwsh`, `glob`, `grep`) **directly** (not wrapped in
`run_code`), the tool call/result carries an empty `callId`. On the next request,
`serializeMessages` drops the `tool_call_id` field entirely, and a strictly-validating
OpenAI-compatible endpoint rejects the whole request with:

  LITELLM_ERROR: Failed to deserialize the JSON body into the target type:
  messages[N]: missing field `tool_call_id`

The `messages[N]` index varies (4, 10, ...) but the error is always the same
`missing field tool_call_id`.

## Root cause
The callId fallback is asymmetric between the two serialization paths:

1. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek/lib/index.js` — `serializeMessages` has NO fallback
   for the tool message:

   for (const result of toolResults) wire.push({
     role: "tool",
     tool_call_id: result.toolCallId,   // omitted when empty/undefined
     content: flattenText(result.content) || "(no output)"
   });

2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/types/assembler.js` — assistant `tool_calls` DO have a
   fallback:

   id: partial.toolCallId ?? CallId(`call-${index}`)

Direct local-tool invocation never assigns a callId, so `result.toolCallId` ends up
empty and the field is dropped, producing `missing field tool_call_id` on strict
servers (Rust serde-style validation).

The same empty callId also corrupts persisted sessions: `tool/call` and `tool/result`
events are stored with `callId: ""`, which later fails replay validation in
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` (`message must have tool source`).

## Steps to reproduce
1. Start the web UI with the `code` preset.
2. Prompt the agent so that it calls `pwsh` / `glob` / `grep` directly (not via
   `run_code`).
3. Observe the next model request fails with `missing field tool_call_id`.

## Expected behavior
Direct local-tool calls should be assigned a valid callId (like `run_code` and
model-generated tool calls already are), so every `tool` message always carries a
valid `tool_call_id`.

## Impact
Blocks any agent run that involves direct local-tool calls when the endpoint validates
strictly (as the official DeepSeek API and many OpenAI-compatible gateways do).
```

discussions.title: [Bug] agent-presets 的全局 commands/change 广播与客户端 invalidateAll 构成正反馈风暴，导致 Web UI 卡死 / 冷启动永远停在 "Loading plugins…"
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 上的最新版本）
- macOS 26.5.2 / Node v24.14.0
- `dsh web`（`--profile web`），默认绑定 `127.0.0.1:3080`

## 现象

两个看起来无关、实际同源的症状：

1. **Web UI 卡死**：页面能打开，但交互逐渐失去响应，渲染进程被打满。同一 origin 下开的标签页越多，卡得越快。
2. **冷启动永远停在 “Loading plugins…”**：关闭浏览器重开后，页面停在加载页，且**不报错**。

## 关键测量

在完全空闲的服务端（无任何用户操作）上，订阅 `/api/events.host` 统计下行事件：

| 场景 | `commands/change` 速率 |
| --- | --- |
| 服务端已启动，**无浏览器连接** | **0 /s** |
| 有浏览器连接（默认配置） | 47–177 /s |
| 禁用全部第三方插件（4 个），有浏览器连接 | 56 /s |
| 删除自定义 preset 目录，有浏览器连接 | 47.7 /s |
| **禁用 `agent-presets` 行** | **0.2 /s** |

事件流里 100% 是 `commands/change`，没有别的事件。

再做逐 session 的 A/B（45 个 session，逐个触发 agent 物化）：

| `agent-presets` | 每次拉取产生的 `commands/change` |
| --- | --- |
| 启用 | **4**（45/45 个 session 完全一致） |
| 禁用 | **0** |

并且**同一个 session 重复拉取不会去重**：

```
pull #1 of the SAME session -> events: 4
pull #2 of the SAME session -> events: 4
pull #3 of the SAME session -> events: 4
pull #4 of the SAME session -> events: 4
```

## 成因分析

正反馈闭环由服务端与客户端各一半构成：

**服务端**：`packages/interaction/commands/src/index.ts:245`

```ts
register(definition: CommandDefinition): () => void {
  const registered = normalizeDefinition(definition)
  return this.layers.effect(
    this.ctx,
    layer => layer.commands.insert(registered.definition.name, registered),
    { label: 'commands.register()' },   // 未传 notify
  )
}
```

`ScopedLayers.effect` 的 `notify` 默认为 `true`（`packages/core/scope/src/store.ts`），于是**agent 作用域**的注册也会触发 `notifyChange()`，向**所有**已连接客户端广播一次全局 `commands/change`。而 agent 每次物化都会挂载它的 preset 组合并注册命令，因此每次拉取产生 4 次全局广播（如上表）。

**客户端**：`packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/service.ts:149`

```ts
ctx.remote.$on('commands/change', () => { this.directory.invalidateAll() })
```

`invalidateAll()`（`packages/client/ui-commands/src/client/directory.ts:61`）会对**每一个已预热的条目**发起 refresh：

```ts
invalidateAll(): void {
  for (const key of this.entries.keys()) void this.refresh(key)
}
```

而 `refresh()`（同文件 `:96`）**不做在途合并**——它只递增 epoch 用于丢弃过期*结果*，并不抑制*请求*，所以每次都会真实发出一次 `commands/list`。

闭环因此成立，且没有任何阻尼：

```
agent 物化 → 挂载 preset → 注册作用域命令
   → 全局广播 commands/change ×4
   → 每个客户端 invalidateAll()
   → 对每个已预热条目重新拉取 commands/list
   → 再次物化 agent → 回到第一步
```

环路增益约为 `4 × 已预热条目数`，实测 50–180 事件/秒。

**这也解释了第二个症状**：`AppRoot`（`packages/client/web/src/AppRoot.tsx:29`）只有在启动链 settle（loader 静默 + 所有 fiber ACTIVE）后才切换到真实 UI。持续不断的事件风暴使 loader 永远无法静默，于是冷启动永远停在 “Loading plugins…”。注意插件*失败*会走 “Failed to load plugins” 并列出条目——停在转圈说明没有任何插件失败，只是永远没到静默。

同样解释了“换一个端口就正常”：新端口是新的浏览器 origin，`entries` 为空，`invalidateAll()` 遍历不到任何东西，因此不会点火——**并不是免疫，只是尚未点火**。

## 已排除的原因

- **不是 `--trusted-host` / Tailscale**：Tailscale Serve 会保留 `Host` 头，信任栅栏正常放行，`/api/events.host` 经 tailnet 升级返回 101。
- **不是第三方插件**：4 个第三方 bundle 全部禁用后仍有 56 /s。
- **不是自定义 preset**：把自定义 preset 目录整个移走后仍有 47.7 /s；且 `standard` 与自定义 preset 的每次拉取事件数完全相同。
- **不是安装损坏或版本错配**：`dsh-agent-presets` 全盘只有一份，版本与全局 `dsh` 一致，均为 0.1.0-rc.6。

## 临时规避

```yaml
# ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: agent-presets
  disabled: true
```

代价是 preset 完全不可用（`agentPreset.list` 返回 `presets: []`）。注意客户端的 preset UI 控件仍会渲染，看起来像“有 preset”，但列表是空的。

## 修复方向（建议）

让变更通知带上作用域：agent 作用域的注册只应让该 agent 的键失效，而不是让每个客户端的整个目录失效。这样可以直接断开反馈通路，而不是给它加阻尼。

两个我认为不够好的替代方案：给挂载期的注册传 `notify: false` 会隐藏真实变更，且 O(N²) 的结构仍在；客户端加防抖只是减缓发散。

## 尚未验证

我没有直接观测真实浏览器在风暴期间的**出站请求速率**，客户端那一半是读源码推断的（服务端下行速率、每次拉取 4 次广播、以及 A/B 开关是实测的）。如果维护者有更快的复现路径，这一环值得再确认一次。
