discussions.title: dsh-skill-pack-security: eight audit skills + the plugin_vet supply-chain gate for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
Security audits are methodology-heavy: which scanners to run, how to tier false positives, what to redact, in what order to remediate. **dsh-skill-pack-security** turns that methodology into eight on-demand agent skills — so the model follows a fixed, checkable audit flow instead of improvising — and, since 2.0.0, a **plugin_vet** gate that automates the same checks before you install anything.

**The eight skills (Chinese + English editions, identical metadata):**
- `secret-scan` — gitleaks/trivy credential audit, false-positive tiers, redacted reports, remediation order
- `dependency-audit` — pnpm/npm audit reading, licenses, typosquat risk, lockfile drift
- `supply-chain-review` — quick PR/new-dependency review: install scripts, typosquat, reproducible builds
- `prompt-injection-review` — injection-surface review for agent projects (AGENTS.md, skills, tools, MCP, web)
- `security-audit` — five-phase whole-repo audit: scope → inventory → risk tiering → verification → report
- `threat-model` — design-stage modeling: trust boundaries, STRIDE table, attack trees, mitigations
- `vuln-intel` — NVD/CISA-KEV/GHSA/OSV lookups with verdict criteria
- `incident-response` — agent-environment IR: contain → evidence → recover → postmortem

Every skill is **executable by a model**: each step is a real command with an expected-output sample, an exit-code criterion, and false-positive criteria.

**plugin_vet (new in 2.0.0):** an automated pre-install scanner registered on `ctx.tools` — license scan (LICENSE + SPDX), SBOM from the lockfile, commit-lock verification (install refs and workflow actions must be immutable 40-hex SHAs), malicious-pattern static checks (lifecycle scripts, exfiltration domains, obfuscated payloads), and a five-dimension risk card. The gate is `warn` by default and can be switched to `deny`; every finding cites the matching skill for the manual deep-dive. Zero-dependency scan engine, timeouts + AbortSignal respected, reports redact secret-shaped text.

**Install (npm bundle):**
```
dsh plugin --profile web add @perrylink/dsh-skill-pack-security-provider
# config.language: zh (default) | en
```
The pack passes a 25-check CI suite against the official skill parser and the real tools runtime on Ubuntu and Windows, pinned to harness commit `47f9438`.

**Links:**
- Repo: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-skill-pack-security
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@perrylink/dsh-skill-pack-security-provider
- List PRs: [awesome-dsh-plugin#1135](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/1135) · [awesome-dsh-plugins#204](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/pull/204) · [awesome-deepseek-harness#305](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness/pull/305) · [bruc3van showcase#60](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/60)

Feedback and contributions welcome — 中英文都欢迎。

discussions.title: cordis preset: skill catalog empty — skill-filesystem !!js baseUrl customSkillDirs fails to mount/discover on Windows
discussions.body:
**Environment:** DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 · Windows 11 (10.0.26200) · web profile

## Bug

Under the official cordis (Creator) preset, `~/.dsh/skills` and `~/.agents/skills` skills are never discovered — the catalog contains only plugin-registered skills (vision-tools, visualize). The `standard`/`liangshen` presets (no `customSkillDirs`) work fine on the same machine.

## Cause

cordis's skill-filesystem config uses a `!!js` expression with `baseUrl`:

```yaml
customSkillDirs:
  - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('skills/', baseUrl))"
```

This fails in this deployment; the provider contributes zero skills.

## Workaround (confirmed)

Copy the preset, replace with explicit paths:

```yaml
config:
  includeDefaultRoots: true
  dshHome: 'C:/Users/<user>/.dsh'
  agentsHome: 'C:/Users/<user>/.agents'
  customSkillDirs:
    - 'C:/Users/<user>/.dsh/.agent-presets/<copy>/skills'
```

→ skills load correctly.

## Additional finding

Copying the cordis preset also requires disabling its `tool-cordis` row while a session on the stock cordis preset is live, otherwise mount fails with `Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is already registered`.

discussions.title: DSH-Encrypt DeepSeek Harness 凭证加密插件，通过设置密码使用AES-256-GCM+SHA3-256实现的全流程加密+校验，运行时临时解密，内存安全。
discussions.body:
# dsh-encrypt

https://github.com/yauntyour/DSH-Encrypt

> **DSH 凭证加密插件**（bundle 形态）：一个文件（`$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`）双形态存储——未设密码时是与官方 `dsh-credentials-local` 完全一致的明文 YAML；在「设置 → 加密安全」设置密码后，同一文件原地替换为 AES-256-GCM 密文文档（scrypt 派生密钥 + SHA3-256 完整性指纹）。浏览器只提交密码的 SHA3-256 摘要（前后端分离校验），模型请求按需临时解密，明文从不缓存；另提供「N 天免密登录」滑块（仅 localhost 生效）。

| 项目 | 值 |
| :-- | :-- |
| 形态 | **bundle**（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`，随 profile 启动，`dsh plugin add` 原生安装） |
| 版本 | `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| 依赖线 | npm rc.1（`@deepseek-ai/cordis@^4.0.1` 等 scoped 包） |
| 环境 | Node.js ≥ 18（官方教程建议 22+）；DSH `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.0.1-rc.1`+ |
| License | [MIT](./LICENSE) |

## 解决的问题

DSH 默认的凭证存储把密钥以**明文 YAML** 写在 `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml`。dsh-encrypt 用**同一个文件**提供可选的加密形态：设置密码前零改动、完全兼容；设置密码后文件内容被替换为密文文档，凭证只在模型调用发生时临时解密。

## 特性

- **单文件双形态**：明文 YAML ↔ `dsh-encrypt-credentials` 密文 JSON 原地互转，不产生第二个文件、不迁移路径
- **WebUI 全生命周期**：设置密码 / 解锁 / 修改密码 / 移除密码，全部在「设置 → 加密安全」完成
- **AES-256-GCM**：每条凭证独立随机 nonce，凭证引用名绑定为 GCM AAD（换位即认证失败）
- **SHA3-256 双重完整性**：条目级指纹 + 覆盖文档头部的文档级指纹，损坏文件在启动时即被拒绝（绝不当作“空库”）
- **scrypt 密码派生**（N=131072, r=8, p=1，约 128 MiB）：密码不落盘，仅存盐与 AEAD 验证器
- **摘要校验（前后端分离）**：WebUI 用纯 JS Keccak-f[1600] 计算密码的 SHA3-256，只 POST `{ digest }` 到后端；后端用 scrypt 拉伸摘要并与 AEAD 验证器匹配，原始密码不离开浏览器
- **免密登录滑块**：设置「多少天免密」（0 = 每次都输密码 / 1–30 天 / 永远），解锁成功后签发 256 位票据（HttpOnly Cookie），磁盘只存被 AEAD 包裹的密钥副本；到期或票据不匹配即失效
- **仅 localhost 免密与改密**：非本机访问强制每次都输密码，且不能设置/修改/移除密码（后端强制，返回 `LOCAL_ONLY`）
- **按请求解密**：明文只存活于单次操作，不缓存、不进日志；密钥在锁定/卸载时清零
- **热重载**：外部编辑明文即时生效；外部加密即时转锁定；损坏的中间状态保留最后一个好快照
- **原子写 + 文件锁**：写入经 `dsh-atomic-write`，POSIX 上强制 `0600` 权限（启动即校验）
- **自动化解锁**：`DSH_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD` 环境变量在启动时解锁（适合 headless）

## 形态与架构

本插件是 **bundle** 形态（`package.json` + `dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`），由三个组合行构成：

| 组合行 | 入口 | 注入 | 职责 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `dsh-encrypt` | `dsh-encrypt`（`lib/index.js`） | —（`CredentialProvider` 服务） | `EncryptedCredentialProvider`：替换被禁用的基础 `credentials` 行，在同一 `ctx.credentials` 接缝上提供双形态存储 |
| `dsh-encrypt-web` | `dsh-encrypt/web`（`lib/web.js`） | `webServer`、`credentials` | 浏览器密码路由（5 条 `/api/credentials.*`），headless 组合不需要 |
| `dsh-encrypt/client` | `package.json` 的 `dsh.client` 声明 | `slots` | 「设置 → 加密安全」面板（web 组合自动挂载） |

替换方式遵循 bundle 生态边界：**不修改任何核心 row**（`tools`/`session`/`llm`/`web`/`permission` 均不动）。bundle patch 只做两件事——禁用基础 bundle 插入的明文 `credentials` 行，插入 `dsh-encrypt` 行。它提供同一个 `ctx.credentials` 接缝，因此 LLM 适配器、Models 页、web-search 等所有既有消费者**无需任何改动**。

## 安装

### 1. Profile Bundle（推荐）

先打包，再装进 profile（`dsh plugin add` 会把声明了 `dsh.bundle.patch` 的依赖自动 reconcile 进 bundles 列表）：

```sh
# 打包（files 字段仅含 lib 与 cordis.patch.yml，test/ 不入包）
npm pack
# → dsh-encrypt-0.1.0-rc.6.tgz

# web profile（设置页「加密安全」）
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-encrypt-0.1.0-rc.6.tgz

# headless profile（一次性任务 / 自动化解锁；web 与 headless 是不同 profile，需分别安装）
dsh plugin --profile headless add ./dsh-encrypt-0.1.0-rc.6.tgz
```

本地源码目录同样可以直接安装（路径用 Windows 正斜杠形式）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:/path/to/DSH-Encrypt"
```

### 2. 挂载 Web 密码路由（设置面板需要，仅 web profile）

bundle patch 只插入 provider 行；浏览器密码路由是独立组合行，需在 profile 用户层挂载。编辑 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`，追加：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: dsh-encrypt-web
      name: 'dsh-encrypt/web'
```

### 3. 验证安装

```sh
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep dsh-encrypt
# 期望：出现 dsh-encrypt 与 dsh-encrypt-web 两个行，且基础 credentials 行被禁用
```

### 4. 运行验证

```sh
# web：启动后打开「设置 → 加密安全」，应能看到加密面板
dsh web
```

```sh
# headless：环境变量自动解锁后，任何任务都应正常启动、凭证解析无 VAULT_LOCKED
DSH_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD='<密码>' dsh run "运行一次最小任务验证凭证可用"
```

仓库另附两阶段真实重启 e2e（见[开发与测试](#开发与测试)），覆盖 明文→设密→损坏/恢复→重启锁定→解锁→改密→移除密码 全生命周期。

### 5. 手动安装与旧版本兼容（仅调试场景）

手动 patch 只作为旧快照兼容或调试方案，不是默认安装流程。完整手动层：

```yaml
# $DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml
- id: credentials
  disabled: true

- insert:
    - id: dsh-encrypt
      name: 'dsh-encrypt'
      config:
        allowEnvFallback: true

    - id: dsh-encrypt-web
      name: 'dsh-encrypt/web'
```

## 使用

全部操作在「设置 → 加密安全」完成（面板 id `encryption`）：

| 操作 | 前置状态 | 效果 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 设置加密密码（输入两次，至少 8 个字符） | 明文 | 同一文件原地替换为密文文档，进程保持解锁 |
| 解锁 | 加密+锁定（重启后） | 校验密码摘要并派生密钥，立即恢复模型调用 |
| 修改密码 | 加密+解锁 | 全部条目在新密钥下重加密 |
| 移除密码 | 加密+解锁 | 解密全部条目，文件恢复为明文 YAML |
| 免密登录时长（滑块） | 任意 | 0 = 每次都输密码；1–30 = N 天内免密；31 = 永远免密（均仅本机） |

滑块即改即存（松开即提交到 `/api/credentials.config`，只接受 localhost）。解锁成功后按当前滑块时长签发免密票据；改动滑块会作废旧票据，若当前已解锁则立即按新时长重新签发。免密期间重开页面自动解锁；到期后回到密码解锁。**非 localhost 访问始终需要输入密码，且不显示改密/移除密码入口**（后端同样强制）。

状态机：

```text
             set-password                    (restart)            unlock
  plain ──────────────────► encrypted+unlocked ──────► encrypted+locked ──► unlocked
    ▲                            │  ▲                                        │
    └────── clear-password ──────┘  └──────────── change-password ───────────┘
```

- **锁定期间**：web 服务照常运行；继承环境中的凭证仍可解析，文件内凭证解析抛 `VAULT_LOCKED`，`describe` 报告 `source: "locked"`——设置页即是解锁入口
- **免密窗口**：票据在签发时写入 `issuedAt` 与 `days`；`days: -1` 永不失效。滑块改动会立即作废旧票据
- **忘记密码**：设计上不可恢复（密码不落盘）；恢复手段 = 删除 `.credentials.yaml` 重新配置

## 凭证解析顺序

| 优先级 | 来源 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| 1 | 继承环境（launching environment） | 只读、高于受管文件；对被其遮蔽的引用写入会被拒绝 |
| 2 | 受管文件 `.credentials.yaml` | 明文或密文形态，可写 |
| 3 | `.env` 回退（project-env / user-env） | 低于受管文件，仅在文件无此引用时兜底 |

`allowEnvFallback: false` 可关闭第 1、3 层（严格仅文件策略）。

## 磁盘格式

**明文形态**（未设密码，与 `dsh-credentials-local` 完全一致）：

```yaml
OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY: sk-…
```

**密文形态**（设密码后，同一文件的内容被替换）：

```json
{
  "format": "dsh-encrypt-credentials",
  "version": 2,
  "algorithm": "aes-256-gcm+sha3-256",
  "kdf": "scrypt",
  "kdfInput": "sha3-256-password",
  "n": 131072, "r": 8, "p": 1,
  "salt": "<base64url>",
  "verifier": { "data": "<base64url>", "sha3": "<hex>" },
  "remember": {
    "salt": "<base64url>", "issuedAt": 1755000000000, "days": 7,
    "cipher": { "data": "<base64url>", "sha3": "<hex>" }
  },
  "entries": {
    "OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY": { "data": "<base64url>", "sha3": "<hex>" }
  },
  "sha3": "<document fingerprint>"
}
```

- `kdfInput: "sha3-256-password"`：scrypt 的输入是密码的 SHA3-256 摘要（浏览器计算），原始密码不进后端
- `verifier` 是固定明文的 AEAD 密文，用于在不接触任何真实凭证的前提下校验摘要
- `remember` 仅在签发过免密票据时存在：`cipher` 是在票据密钥（SHA3-256(域名‖salt‖票据)）下 AEAD 包裹的主密钥；票据本身只存在于浏览器 HttpOnly Cookie，永不落盘；`days: -1` 表示永远
- 文档级指纹覆盖 `sha3` 以外的全部字段（含 salt、成本参数与 remember 块）；条目级指纹覆盖各自的密文 blob
- 密码与票据从不落盘

## HTTP 路由（web 行）

仅 `POST application/json`（与官方 /api 相同的跨站写护栏）；响应 `{ ok: true, value }` 或 `{ ok: false, code, message }`，错误消息不含密码或任何密钥材料：

| 路径 | 请求体 | 作用 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `/api/credentials.status` | `{}` | 返回 `{ format, unlocked, local, remember: { days, active, issuedAt, expiresAt } }`；localhost 且携带免密 Cookie 时先尝试票据解锁 |
| `/api/credentials.unlock` | `{ digest }` | 密码摘要解锁（64 位小写 hex SHA3-256）；localhost 成功后再按滑块签发免密 Cookie |
| `/api/credentials.set-password` | `{ digest }` | 明文 → 密文（**仅 localhost**） |
| `/api/credentials.change-password` | `{ digest }` | 重加密（需已解锁，**仅 localhost**，作废旧票据） |
| `/api/credentials.clear-password` | `{}` | 密文 → 明文（需已解锁，**仅 localhost**，作废旧票据） |
| `/api/credentials.config` | `{ action: "get" }` / `{ action: "set", rememberDays }` | 读取状态或设置免密天数（-1 = 永远，0 = 每次，1–30；**set 仅 localhost**） |

所有路由只接受 `POST application/json`。密码本身永不出现在任何请求体里——浏览器只提交 `digest`（可用 `node -p "require('crypto').createHash('sha3-256').update('密码').digest('hex')"` 计算）。

headless 组合不挂载 web 行，因此没有 HTTP 面。

## 配置项

```yaml
config:
  path: ''            # 凭证文件绝对路径；未设置时取 $DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml
  dshHome: ''         # Harness home（通常由运行时注入，无需手动设置）
  allowEnvFallback: true          # 允许继承环境与 .env 回退层
  passwordEnv: DSH_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD  # 启动自动解锁的环境变量名
  watch: true         # 监听文件变化热重载
  debounceMs: 100     # 热重载防抖（毫秒）
```

| 字段 | 类型 | 默认值 | 说明 |
| :-- | :-- | :-- | :-- |
| `path` | string | `$DSH_HOME/.credentials.yaml` | 凭证文件绝对路径（运行时注入 `dshHome` 计算默认值） |
| `dshHome` | string | 运行时注入 | Harness home |
| `allowEnvFallback` | boolean | `true` | 是否启用继承环境与 `.env` 回退层 |
| `passwordEnv` | string | `DSH_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD` | 启动自动解锁密码的环境变量名 |
| `watch` | boolean | `true` | 是否监听文件热重载 |
| `debounceMs` | number | `100` | 热重载防抖毫秒数（≥ 0） |
| `rememberDays` | number | `0` | 免密登录天数：`0` = 每次都输密码，`1..30` 天，`-1` = 永远（补丁配置的初始值；滑块运行时值写入 `$DSH_HOME/.dsh-encrypt.json` 并优先生效） |

## 安全模型

**保证**：

- 静态存储只含密文；内存快照在密文形态下只保存密文记录
- 每条目随机 12 字节 nonce；引用名作为 GCM AAD，记录换位会认证失败
- 双层 SHA3-256 指纹 + GCM 认证标签：篡改且重算指纹的攻击仍会以 `VAULT_KEY_MISMATCH` 失败（与错误主密钥不可区分——这是 AEAD 的诚实答案）
- 密码经 scrypt（N=131072, r=8, p=1）派生，只存盐与 AEAD 验证器
- POSIX 上凭证文件必须是 owner-only（`0600`），否则启动直接拒绝（`chmod 600` 修复）；Windows 无 mode 可查，保护由创建 API 与 OS ACL 表达
- 密钥（KEK）在锁定/卸载时清零（`zeroizeBuffer`）

**诚实边界**：

- JavaScript 字符串不可变：解密出的明文无法在内存中清零。给出的保证是**不持久化、不缓存、不进日志**，以及操作结束即丢弃引用
- 解锁期间主密钥必须驻留内存（否则无法解密任何条目），请以操作系统账户与 `0600` 文件保护
- 忘记密码无法找回（设计如此）；唯一恢复手段是清除凭证文件后重新配置

## 错误码

`VaultError` 携带稳定的机器可读 `code`，消息永不含明文/密文/密钥材料：

| code | 含义 |
| :-- | :-- |
| `PASSWORD_WRONG` | 摘要与验证器不匹配（错误密码在触碰任何条目之前即被拒绝） |
| `PASSWORD_INVALID` | 摘要不是 64 位小写 hex 的 SHA3-256 |
| `LOCAL_ONLY` | 该操作（改密/移除密码/免密设置）仅允许 localhost |
| `REMEMBER_EXPIRED` | 免密票据已超过其窗口，需重新输入密码 |
| `REMEMBER_INVALID` | 免密票据与本凭证库不匹配（或库中无票据） |
| `VAULT_LOCKED` | 凭证库已锁定；在「设置 → 加密安全」解锁（或导出 `DSH_CREDENTIAL_PASSWORD`） |
| `VAULT_NOT_ENCRYPTED` | 尚未设置密码，无锁可解/无密可改/可除 |
| `VAULT_ALREADY_ENCRYPTED` | 已设密码；修改密码请用 `change-password` |
| `VAULT_CORRUPTED` | SHA3-256 完整性校验失败，错误中指名出问题的引用 |
| `VAULT_INVALID` | 文档结构非法（版本、算法、字段形状） |
| `VAULT_KEY_MISMATCH` | GCM 认证失败：主密钥不匹配，或密文被替换 |
| `PASSWORD_INVALID` / `MASTER_KEY_INVALID` | 参数或密钥材料非法 |

## 兼容性与升级

- **v0.1.0-rc.6 → rc.7（本次更新）**：文档版本升级为 v2（KDF 输入从密码改为密码的 SHA3-256 摘要）。v1 密文文档无法被 rc.7 读取——升级前请先在旧版「移除密码」恢复明文，或删除 `.credentials.yaml` 重新配置；明文形态不受影响
- 与官方 `credentials` 接缝 **drop-in**：LLM 适配器、Models 页、web-search 等消费者零改动
- 官方凭证 RPC（如 `credentials.set`）在两种形态下照常工作；锁定状态下写入会以 `VAULT_LOCKED` 拒绝
- 明文形态文件可被 `dsh-credentials-local` 直接读取——移除本插件前先「移除密码」即可无缝回退
- 对外导出：`dsh-encrypt`（provider）、`dsh-encrypt/vault`（零依赖密码学核心）、`dsh-encrypt/web`（路由）、`dsh-encrypt/client`（浏览器包）

## 卸载与回滚

1. **先移除密码**：设置页「移除密码」把文件恢复为明文（否则基础 `credentials` 行无法理解密文文档）
2. 移除 web 行：删除 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml` 中的 `dsh-encrypt-web` insert
3. 移除 bundle：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-encrypt
dsh plugin --profile headless remove dsh-encrypt
```

基础 `credentials` 行随 bundle 移除自动恢复启用，明文文件继续可用。

## 开发与测试

```sh
npm install        # devDependencies 自包含（scoped rc.1 依赖线）
npm test           # node --test：42 个单元测试（vault 30 + provider 12）
```

额外验证脚本：

```sh
node test/client-smoke.mjs     # 浏览器包 ModuleLoader/SSR 冒烟
# 两阶段真实重启 e2e（目标实例与 home 均显式传入，不硬编码回环地址）：
node test/e2e-webui.mjs --base http://localhost:3199 --home <dsh-home> --phase 1
node test/e2e-webui.mjs --base http://localhost:3199 --home <dsh-home> --phase 2
```

测试套件仅本地回归用，不随 npm 包分发（`files` 仅含 `lib` 与 `cordis.patch.yml`）。

## 许可证

discussions.title: Windows: sharp ESM load fails with ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED (dev build + packaged desktop host) - workaround included
discussions.body:
**Summary / 问题概述**

On Windows, loading `sharp` via the ESM entry fails with `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`, which breaks `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` during host boot. This happens both in a dev checkout (`dsh web`) and in the packaged **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** app (`resources/host`). A two-line workaround fixes it; details below.

在 Windows 上，通过 ESM 入口加载 sharp 会报 `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`，导致 host 启动时 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local` 加载失败。开发版（`dsh web`）和打包的桌面版（`resources/host`）都会复现。两行 workaround 可解决，详见下文。

**Environment / 环境**
- OS: Windows 11
- Node: 22.22.2 (dev) / 24.18.1 (desktop host)
- dsh: 0.1.0-rc.5
- sharp: 0.35.3

**Error / 错误**

```
Could not load the "sharp" module using the win32-x64 runtime
ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED: The specified procedure could not be found.
...\node_modules\@img\sharp-win32-x64-0.35.3\lib\sharp-win32-x64-0.35.3.node
```

Trigger: host boot loads `@deepseek-ai/dsh-attachment-local`, which imports `sharp` (ESM). Both the dev build (`node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web`) and the packaged desktop host (`resources/host`) hit this.

**Root cause / 根因分析**

- sharp 0.35.3 的 `package.json` 中 `exports["."].import.default` 指向 `./dist/index.mjs`。
- 在 Windows 上通过 ESM loader 加载 `sharp.mjs` 时，其依赖的 DLL（`libvips-42.dll` / `libvips-cpp-8.18.3.dll`）查找失败，报 `ERR_DLOPEN_FAILED`（`The specified procedure could not be found`）。
- 但 **CJS 路径完全正常**：`main` 本来就是 `./dist/index.cjs`，`require('sharp')` 秒过。
- 关键证据：把 `exports.import.default` 改为 `./dist/index.cjs` 后，ESM `import('sharp')` 立即正常（实测返回 `0.35.3`）。

**Workaround / 临时解决方案**

```jsonc
// node_modules/sharp/package.json
"exports": {
  ".": {
    "import": { "types": "./dist/index.d.mts", "default": "./dist/index.cjs" }, // was ./dist/index.mjs
    "require": { "types": "./dist/index.d.cts", "default": "./dist/index.cjs" }
  }
}
```

Apply to both:
- dev checkout: `<dsh>/node_modules/.pnpm/sharp@*/node_modules/sharp/package.json`
- desktop host: `DeepSeek Harness/resources/host/node_modules/sharp/package.json`

**Suggestion / 建议**

- In packaging/host, pin `sharp`'s ESM entry to the CJS build (or adjust the host DLL search path) so Windows users don't hit this on a fresh install.
- 打包时统一把 sharp 的 ESM 入口指向 CJS 构建，或修正 host 的 DLL 搜索路径，避免 Windows 新装用户直接撞上此问题。

discussions.title: I made a portable build of DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
I wanted a copy of DSH I could keep on an external drive and move between machines without rebuilding the setup every time, so I made DSH-Portable.

![DSH-Portable running DeepSeek Harness](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/main/assets/dsh-interface-en.png)

It runs the official DSH web app in a native window. The important part for me was making the data portable too: sessions, settings, plugins, the default workspace, and the app profile stay with the folder.

Windows has a small online bootstrapper and a full offline zip. There is also a normal installer, plus zip and dmg builds for macOS. The bundled `dsh` command can manage plugins without relying on a system Node or pnpm install. Updates preserve the data directory, verify the new component before switching over, and roll back if it does not start cleanly. Update prompts can also be turned off while keeping the manual check available.

The Windows packages have been tested end to end. The macOS packages are built and smoke-tested on both Intel and Apple Silicon runners. DSH is still moving quickly, so I would appreciate a few people trying the boring parts—moving the folder, installing a plugin, and updating—and telling me what breaks.

This is an unofficial community build on top of the DSH preview.

https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable

discussions.title: dsh-tool-diagnose: runtime diagnostics as an actual Cordis plugin
discussions.body:
## What it is

`dsh-tool-diagnose` is a DSH Cordis plugin exposing a model-facing `diagnose` tool backed by an extensible `ctx.diagnostics` check registry. It targets the same problem #1739's `dsh-diagnose` Skill does (runtime symptom diagnosis), but takes a different technical approach: a Skill is static knowledge (a symptom table plus instructions on which shell commands to run); this plugin reads real Cordis runtime state directly, in-process, and returns structured results.

Six checks currently, all grounded in real, already-shipped dsh service APIs:

- `plugin-fiber-state` — reads `ctx.loader.entries()` (the same primitive `dsh-host-plugin-inventory` uses for the web UI's plugin panel): is a plugin mounted, enabled, and in which fiber phase
- `tool-visibility` — `ctx.tools.get(name)`: is a tool registered and visible
- `credential-resolution` — `ctx.credentials.describe()`: is a credential configured (never returns the value)
- `approval-policy` — the currently effective approval policy
- `token-pressure` — `ctx.tokenMeter.measure()`: current token pressure for a session
- `subagent-tree` — flattens a session's descendant subagent tree

## Why a plugin instead of a Skill

A Skill can only tell the model to run a shell command and read the output; a plugin can query state directly, in-process. The registry is also extensible — any other plugin can add its own check with `inject: ['diagnostics']`, without touching this package's code.

## Two bugs I hit building this (might be useful if you're writing something similar)

1. **`defineTool`'s `output.schema` has its own compact DSL** — a property's required-ness goes on the property itself (`required: true`, same as `parameters`), not a sibling plain-JSON-Schema `required: [...]` array on the object node. Getting this wrong type-checks fine under `tsc` but throws at `defineTool()` call time, which happens at plugin-load — so the tool silently failed to register, with no crash and no log line, in every profile.
2. **A Cordis ctx reference doesn't survive being stored and handed back through another service's `this.ctx`.** A scope's injected-service access is granted per exact context reference — even a statically `inject`-declared one — and does not propagate once that reference is stored as a plain value inside another `Service` instance and read back later. Fix: every check is a factory that closes over its own already-scoped `ctx` at construction time; the registry never passes `ctx` around.

Both bugs passed a full, green unit-test suite — they only surfaced once I actually booted the plugin inside a real `dsh --profile headless` process and had the agent call the tool for real. Details are in the repo's README under "Audit notes."

## Try it / feedback

Install: `dsh plugin add dsh-tool-diagnose` (or `dsh plugin add github:xu-kai-quan/dsh-tool-diagnose`)
Repo: https://github.com/xu-kai-quan/dsh-tool-diagnose

Inspired by #1739's `dsh-diagnose` — if you want the "no code, just knowledge" shape, that's the one to use; this is for when you want the agent to query live runtime state directly. They compose well together.

Note: this is a community plugin, not an official DSH feature.

discussions.title: dsh-archived-chats — manage archived chats in Settings, with true in-place deletion (no restart)
discussions.body: Once a chat is archived in DSH it vanishes from the sidebar with no way to browse it again. This plugin adds an **Archived Chats** page under Settings: - Full archived-session list, grouped by workspace — collapsible, searchable, filterable - **Unarchive** single chats or whole groups; restored chats reappear in the sidebar immediately - **Delete** one / group / all — and deletion takes effect **immediately, no restart**: even sessions still resident in the background are torn down along the official lifecycle (cancel → quiesce → flush → fiber teardown → registry detach) and wiped from disk in the same request. Every internal seam is feature-detected, falling back to park-and-defer if a future DSH build changes internals. Install: dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-archived-chats Repo (EN/中文 README): https://github.com/Ultronen/dsh-archived-chats Next up: cascade-deleting a workspace together with its sessions — right now deleting a workspace only removes the grouping and orphans its chats into "Ungrouped", which trips a lot of people up. --- 中文：DSH 里聊天一旦归档就从侧边栏消失且无法找回。这个插件在设置里补上「已归档的聊天」页：按工作区分组浏览/搜索/筛选，一键取消归档，删除即生效、无需重启（后台驻留的会话也能当场彻底删除）。欢迎反馈，觉得有用点个 star 🙏

discussions.title: 人机边界不可伪造：DSH 审批的 FIDO2 带外门 + 策略格立法 / Unforgeable human approval for DSH: FIDO2 out-of-band gate + policy lattice
discussions.body:
# 人机边界不可伪造：DSH 审批的 FIDO2 带外门 + 策略格立法 / Unforgeable human approval for DSH: FIDO2 out-of-band gate + policy lattice

在 #250（sandbox 内模型可通过 Web approval 回环通道自批准 danger-full-access）、#451/#817/#853（沙箱逃逸 ×2 + 本地 /api RPC 无鉴权）、#454（第三方安全审计）之后，我们对 DSH 的『人类审批』机制做了结构性分析，得出两条结论：**当前架构下 agent 伪装成人类批准自己的成功率是数学上恒等于 100% 的**；以及**唯一能打破它的路径**——带外签名 + 策略格。两份完整技术规格在此分享，欢迎攻击、欢迎证伪。

## 一、问题：伪造率为什么是结构常数 1.0

五路独立碰撞收敛到同一事实：

- **来源区分信息量 = 0 bit**（Dolev-Yao 模型）：agent 的 web-fetch 请求与人类浏览器请求共享同一 TCP 四元组（127.0.0.1:临时端口 → 127.0.0.1:审批端口），HTTP 头/载荷/TLS 字节全部由 agent 可控。`web-fetch-http` README 明言 SSRF 防护 deferred（不拦 private/loopback）；`sandbox` README 明言 network/process 在沙箱词汇外。
- **SID 全等率 = 100%**：agent spawn 的 pwsh 与审批载体共享同一 Windows 用户会话（CreateProcess 继承父 access token）。Windows DAC 只按 token SID 判权——同 SID 进程可 OpenProcess/CreateRemoteThread 直接改写审批进程内存/UI。
- **授权路径上 0 个已校验主体属性**：identity 包是 anonymous UUID，无主体模型（RFC 4949：身份 = 区分实体的属性集合，属性数 0 ⇒ 连接主体不可区分）。
- 结果：5/5 已知伪造链（#250 自批准、#451/#817/#853 RCE、#454 审计路径）全穿透；loopback-pinned 只是可达性策略（connection README 明言 reachability ≠ authentication）。

**消除路线全部被杀**：更严审批 UI、缩短审批链、收紧 loopback 绑定、进程级防火墙、本机独立审批守护进程、loopback mTLS、TPM、OTP……共 11–14 条——它们在 0 bit 信息上做策略分派，提升量恒为 0。

## 二、方案 A：FIDO2 带外签名门（伪造率 1.0 → 2^-128）

人类持有、**私钥永不落本机**的硬件安全密钥（YubiKey 5 / 手机 Secure Enclave），对『一次性 128-bit 随机挑战 ‖ SHA-256 操作指纹 ‖ 时间戳』做 Ed25519/ES256 签名，执行器授权前必须验签（fail-closed，无旁路）。

- user presence 物理触摸不可程序化触发、私钥不可读 ⇒ 伪造率 2^-128（≈2.9e-39/次）
- 信息量 0 → 128 bit；5/5 已知链 0/5 穿透
- 不改 pinned 上游（独立 verifier 进程）
- 已验证边界：触摸钓鱼属人类因素攻击，不在 2^-128 自主伪造声明内；执行器须无旁路强制验证门

## 三、方案 B：策略格立法（Policy Lattice）——解决『全部 touch 不可用』

方案 A 的直接形态（每步 touch）在产品上不可用：FIDO2 触摸串行下限 ≈10s/次，人手持续上限 360 次/h，而廉价模型长任务 burst ≥1 次/s、30s 挑战 TTL 下覆盖率 ≤27% ⇒ 任务必断（10× 吞吐缺口）。

策略格立法把批准对象从**每次调用**升格为**策略边界**：

- 人类**签名一次策略根** `policy_root = {推导规则集 R, seq, verifier_id}`（R = fs/net/exec/env/budget 模板规则语言）
- verifier 冻结编译器（agent 零写权）把任务计划 P 机械映射进策略格推导闭包 `closure(P,R)`：
  - **P ⊆ closure** → 边界自动实例化，**0 触碰/任务**（机器速运行，界外内核 fail-closed）
  - **P ⊄ closure** → 生成最小 delta 触碰人类 1 次，Knaster–Tarski 单调扩格（旧包络保持）
- 健全性 = BMC 穷举证明（1e-13 逐调用假接受预算迁移为编译期确定性 0）；seq 单调链防回滚
- 边界安装 = AppContainer/受限令牌进程 + 句柄相对锚定（无 TOCTOU）+ WFP L4 网络过滤器默认拒绝 + exec SHA-256 白名单 + env 净化 + 预算

**量化**：门控事件 O(调用) → O(1/任务)；门控速率 6/min → 0/min（300×↓）；触摸负载 360/h → ~0.006/h（>60,000×↓）；1500 调用长任务墙钟零中断。

## 四、与手机远程执行的合成

这套方案与『手机远程执行 DSH』天然咬合：手机既是远程终端（云端 Harness），又是带外批准通道——云端长任务跑在策略格内零打扰，越界才推送挑战到手机，用户在 Secure Enclave 上按一下签名。私钥在手机安全芯片里，云端 agent 永远碰不到。

---

**English summary:** We analyzed DSH's human-approval mechanism after #250/#451/#817/#853/#454 and derived two structural results. **(1) The forgery rate is mathematically pinned at 1.0** under the current architecture: source-discrimination information = 0 bits (Dolev-Yao: agent and human browser share the same TCP 4-tuple on loopback), SID equality = 100% (spawned pwsh shares the user token), and 0 verified subject attributes (anonymous UUID identity). 5/5 known forgery chains penetrate; loopback-pinned is reachability, not authentication. **(2) Two papers with full specs** — (A) an out-of-band FIDO2 signing gate (human-held key never on the machine, touch-presence signature over challenge ‖ SHA-256 fingerprint ‖ timestamp, verifier-gated, fail-closed) pushing forgery rate from 1.0 to 2^-128; and (B) **Policy Lattice**, which moves approval from per-call to per-boundary: one human signature over a policy root (template rule language R), a frozen compiler mechanically derives the closure of each task plan, in-boundary calls run ungated at machine speed (0 touches/task), out-of-boundary deltas trigger exactly 1 touch with monotone lattice expansion, soundness via BMC exhaustive proof, kernel-enforced boundary (AppContainer/WFP/exec-hash allowlist). Gated events drop from O(calls) to O(1/task); gate rate 6/min → 0/min (300×); touch load 360/h → ~0.006/h (>60,000×). Pairs naturally with mobile remote execution: the phone is both remote terminal and the out-of-band approval channel. Full specs live in our cataclysm sandboxes; happy to share details or iterate. Attacks and falsifications welcome — the honest boundary is touch-phishing (human-factor) and kernel-enforcement semantics.

discussions.title: [Bug/修复建议] 会话中途切换 Full access 必定失败：持久 bash 存活时护栏无差别拦截，preset 半提交变 Custom
discussions.body:
## 环境

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`（涉及包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-terminal-bash`、`dsh-permission-presets`、`dsh-client-ui-permission-presets`、`dsh-tool-bash-persistent`），macOS
- 触发条件：部署组合包含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash-persistent`（持久 `bash` 工具）；与客户端形态无关，官方 web 组合该包后同样复现

## 复现步骤

1. 新建会话，保持默认 `workspace-write` + `ask`
2. 对话中让 agent 执行任意 `bash` 命令——此后该 agent 一直持有存活的持久 shell（PTY）
3. 在 composer 的 `/permission` 弹窗切换到 Full access
4. 完成风险双确认（勾选 + 启用）
5. 切换失败；无论重试多少次都同样失败，且权限选择器显示变为 `Custom`

错误信息：

```
cannot change sandbox mode from "workspace-write" to "danger-full-access" while persistent terminal sessions are open or being created; wait for creation to settle and close them first
```

## 根因（源码 + 会话日志定位）

1. `dsh-terminal-bash` 的 `ensureSandboxModeFence()`：只要 owner 有存活 PTY，**任何** `sandbox/mode` 变化都会在 `internal/dispatch` 中抛错——护栏不区分「放宽」与「收紧」方向。但放宽方向其实无需拦截：旧 shell 只是不能继续用，杀掉后下次调用会按新模式重建（与现有超时重置同一路径）。
2. `dsh-permission-presets` 的 `apply()` 先 append `permission/preset` 事件、再 `setSandboxMode()` / `setApprovalPolicy()`。`setSandboxMode` 被护栏抛错后，preset 事件已写入日志、两个 knob 却没变——选择器于是推导出 `custom`，留下一个既不是旧预设也不是新预设的悬挂状态。
3. 会话日志中的证据链（多次尝试完全一致）：`command/run (permission danger-full-access)` → `permission/preset: danger-full-access` → `command/done kind:"error"`。
4. UX：风险确认门在选项阶段不检测存活 PTY，用户走完双确认后才收到面向开发者、不可操作的报错。

用户视角的体感：**会话中途想从「边确认边写」切到 Full access，怎么点都改不了**。

## 修复建议

1. **放宽方向**（如 `workspace-write` → `danger-full-access`）：重置该 owner 的持久 shell 后放行；下次 `bash` 调用按新模式的 argv 重建（可复用现有超时重置路径）
2. **收紧方向**保留护栏（安全上必须拦截），但报错文案改为可操作（提示关闭终端或新开会话）
3. **原子化**：`sandbox/mode` 写入失败时回滚 `permission/preset`，避免 `custom` 悬挂态
4. **UI 预检**：`/permission` 弹窗在选项阶段检测存活 PTY，直接置灰并说明原因，而不是双确认后才失败

## 已验证的本地补丁（rc.6）

```diff
--- a/packages/terminal-bash (ensureSandboxModeFence)
+++ b
+const SANDBOX_MODE_PERMISSIVENESS = { "read-only": 0, "workspace-write": 1, "danger-full-access": 2 };
 ...
 if (event.data.mode === currentMode || !state.pty.hasOwnerActivity(owner)) return;
-throw new Error(`cannot change sandbox mode from "${currentMode}" to "${event.data.mode}" while persistent terminal sessions are open or being created; wait for creation to settle and close them first`);
+const rank = (mode) => SANDBOX_MODE_PERMISSIVENESS[mode] ?? -1;
+if (rank(event.data.mode) > rank(currentMode)) {
+    for (const snapshot of state.pty.list(owner)) {
+        state.pty.kill(owner, snapshot.sessionId, `sandbox mode widened from "${currentMode}" to "${event.data.mode}"; the persistent shell will respawn under the new mode on next use`).catch(() => {});
+    }
+    return;
+}
+throw new Error(`cannot tighten sandbox mode from "${currentMode}" to "${event.data.mode}" while this conversation still has a live persistent shell spawned under the wider mode; close the terminal or start a new session first`);
```

打补丁后原场景一次切换即成功，下次 `bash` 自动以新沙箱参数重建 shell；收紧方向仍被正确拦截。

如果方向上认可，我可以按这个思路提 PR（会按仓库源码结构移植，而非直接改构建产物）。

discussions.title: Session logs become unreadable after a plugin that wrote session events is uninstalled
discussions.body:
## Summary
After uninstalling a plugin that writes custom session events, old sessions become **completely unreadable** — a single unknown event poisons the whole log and there is no recovery path in the UI.

## Repro
1. Install a plugin that appends session events (e.g. `@loserfox/distill` writes `session/distill-review-request`).
2. Uninstall the plugin.
3. Restart and try to open any session that contains such an event.

Result:
```
history unavailable for session "...": SessionFormatUnsupportedError: session contains
event type "session/distill-review-request" (seq 76818) unknown to this harness and not
marked ignorable; refusing to interpret the log
```
Resume fails with the same error.

## Workaround (manual, fragile)
Hand-edit the zstd session log: add `"ignorable": true` to the unknown event and re-compress with frames aligned to **complete JSONL records** (line-aligned, not byte-chunked). Deleting the event is invalid — the committed region requires contiguous seqs (`seq gap ... expected 76818, got 76819`).

## Suggestions
1. Plugin-authored session events should be **`ignorable` by default** (or namespaced/versioned so the harness can safely skip unknown ones).
2. Offer a built-in recovery action in the UI (e.g. "skip unknown events and open" / quarantine view) instead of a hard refusal.
3. In the error, identify **which plugin** wrote the unknown event and hint "reinstall the plugin to read this history".

discussions.title: "Failed to load plugins" fatal screen offers no recovery action
discussions.body:
## Summary
When a plugin client bundle fails to register, the whole GUI is replaced by a fatal **"Failed to load plugins"** screen with **no recovery action** on it.

## Repro
Install a plugin whose client bundle registers a wrong id (e.g. `loaded without registering "@scope/pkg" via __ModuleLoader__.load`), then start the web UI.

## Result
The app shows only the fatal screen (which entry failed, nothing else). The user must leave the app, manually edit profile config / node_modules (or use the CLI) to recover. For a desktop user this is a hard blocker.

## Suggestions
1. Add **"disable / remove this plugin and restart"** actions directly on the error screen.
2. Keep listing the failing entry id (already shown) plus a one-line hint how it can be removed.

discussions.title: npm dist-tags: latest still points at 0.0.1-rc.1 builds with unresolvable dependencies
discussions.body:
## Summary

As of 2026-08-16, the npm `latest` dist-tags for the `@deepseek-ai` packages point at `0.0.1-rc.1` builds whose dependencies do not resolve, so the documented install command fails out of the box:

```sh
dsh plugin add @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app   # resolves latest → 0.0.1-rc.1 → 404 on deps
```

## Details (verified against the registry today)

`npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app dist-tags` → `{ latest: '0.0.1-rc.1', next: '0.1.0-rc.6' }`

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.0.1-rc.1` declares 9 dependencies that do not exist on the registry:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-frontend`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-model`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slash`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-frontend-static`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-models`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-command`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-question`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-permission`

Pinning the `next` version works: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app@0.1.0-rc.6` resolves all of its dependencies.

The same pattern affects other packages — `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-sidebar`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-slots`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-message-feedback` all have `latest` stuck at `0.0.1-rc.x`.

## Impact

Several community plugins document "the official web bundle is not published to npm" and tell users to install it from a source checkout. That workaround is unnecessary: the packages are published, the `latest` tag just points at broken pre-rc builds.

## Ask

- Move the `latest` dist-tag (for `dsh-web-app` at least, ideally the whole `@deepseek-ai` set) to the current `0.1.0-rc.6` line, or
- Publish fixed versions of the 9 unresolvable dependencies under `0.0.1-rc.1`.

discussions.title: Idea: let deployments declare loopback trust in __DSH_BOOT__ instead of URL inference
discussions.body:
## Summary

The web client infers loopback trust from the page URL (`connection.isLoopback`), and privileged APIs such as `settings.*`, `credentials.*`, and `host.listDirectory` are gated on that check. This makes every remote setup (phone on LAN, public tunnel) fail with 403 unless a plugin rewrites request headers.

## Proposal

Let the deployment declare trust explicitly in the boot contract instead of inferring it from `location`. For example, `__DSH_BOOT__` (or a profile/config field) could carry a trust declaration such as:

```js
__DSH_BOOT__.trust = 'loopback' | 'deployment'
```

- `loopback` (default): current behavior, inferred from the URL.
- `deployment`: set by an operator who deliberately exposes the web server behind their own TLS and authentication layer.

## Why

- **Remote access is a recurring request** in this community; the current check forces plugins to rewrite `Host`/`Origin` to loopback. That workaround disables the original protection and each plugin must re-implement its own access-control layer to compensate.
- An explicit declaration keeps the safe default while giving deployments a supported path, so remote setups become safe by construction instead of relying on header tricks.
- The trust decision is a deployment fact, not a per-session fact; the boot contract is the natural place to carry it.

discussions.title: DSH｜Quotable｜仿照codex desktop 划选任意模型输出，一键作为隔离引用注入下一条提问，配会话绑定的侧边解读栏
discussions.body: Quotable 给 DSH Web GUI 带来 Codex 桌面端式的“勾选输出”体验，两个核心功能： 项目地址： https://github.com/bjvgukv25842-cmyk/Quotable-DeepSeek-Harness ① 划选引用（Quote-to-Composer）——用鼠标划选任意模型输出，选区上方浮出工具条，点「加入聊天内容」后引用变成输入框上方的 chip；你正常输入提问发送，引用会以独立信封消息随提问进入模型上下文。你的提问原文一字不改（字节级不变），引用也不会拼进你的消息——它是 source: plugin 的独立上下文块，自带定界标签和防注入规则（实测：引用里藏“忽略所有指令/泄露系统提示词”的恶意样本会被正确无视）。发送后 chip 自动清除，单会话最多 5 条、单条 4000 字符，以“带防注入声明的独立信封消息”随你的提问同批进入模型——你的原文字节级不变，每个对话的分仓互不串扰 ② Quotable 解读边栏（会话深度绑定）——划选后点「侧边解读」，右侧展开聊天边栏：引用材料置顶、随问随答。边栏走宿主侧私有迷你上下文（llm.stream 直连），问答完全不进主会话日志；且严格按会话分仓——边栏显示「本对话 #ID」徽标，划选那一刻属于哪个对话就归哪个对话，切换会话自动清空陈旧选区并重载，跨对话引用零混入。 与 DSH 的集成方式： 标准静态 bundle 插件（dsh.bundle + dsh.client manifest）。监听 agent/inbox/inserted 事件，经 agent.inject() 一等 API 注入信封，与你的消息同批进入模型；UI 侧通过 conversation.input.dock / shell.overlay 等官方 Slot 注册 chip 行与边栏，宿主-浏览器经 /quotecite/api/* 同源桥通信。附 3 个诊断工具（quotecite_report / quotecite_seed / quotecite_sidechat）可自测注入链路与防注入。 一键安装（装完重启 DSH，此后每次启动自动加载）： dsh plugin --profile web add github:bjvgukv25842-cmyk/Quotable-DeepSeek-Harness 零运行时依赖、无 install 脚本、无外部网络请求（仅同源桥）；peerDeps 为 DSH 自带的 cordis ^4.0.1 与 dsh-tools >=0.1.0-rc.6，开箱即用。 https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c140ce27-b098-4e9f-b318-2f469f559c56

discussions.title: dsh-experience-memory — Persistent Experience Memory for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! I built **dsh-experience-memory**, an unofficial community plugin that adds persistent, reusable experience memory to DeepSeek Harness.

Instead of replaying entire sessions, it stores distilled successes and failures as human-readable Markdown. Agents can then explicitly search for relevant past experience and load only the useful record.

### Features

* Explicit `memory_search → memory_get` recall flow
* Records reusable lessons with `memory_record`
* Keyword-based retrieval without a vector database
* Human-readable Markdown as the source of truth
* Stable memory IDs and deterministic results
* UTF-8 and multilingual content support
* Replaceable retriever architecture for future extensions

### Repository

[https://github.com/ganfabo123-cmyk/dsh-experience-memory](https://github.com/ganfabo123-cmyk/dsh-experience-memory)

### Installation

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:ganfabo123-cmyk/dsh-experience-memory
dsh --profile web --dump-config
dsh --profile web
```

This is an independent community project and is not officially affiliated with DeepSeek.

Feedback, suggestions, bug reports, and contributions are very welcome!

discussions.title: Bug: skill menu only matches skill names by prefix, middle words unfindable
discussions.body:
## Bug

The skill trigger menu (trigger `/`, `packages/client/ui-skill`) filters candidates with a **strict prefix match**:

```ts
skills.filter(skill => skill.name.startsWith(query))
A user who remembers only a middle word of a skill name gets no results:

typing plugin cannot find dsh-plugin-scout
typing quanti cannot find planners-quanti-box
The / command menu in ui-commands already scores candidates with a fuzzy subsequence matcher; the skill menu is the odd one out.

Fix (tested locally)
Replace the prefix filter with a case-insensitive substring match over the name, falling back to the description, ranking name hits first:

ts
复制
const q = query.toLowerCase()
return skills
  .map(skill => {
    const nameHit = skill.name.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    const descHit = skill.description.toLowerCase().includes(q)
    return nameHit || descHit ? { skill, nameHit } : null
  })
  .filter((hit): hit is { skill: SkillEntry; nameHit: boolean } => hit !== null)
  .sort((a, b) => Number(b.nameHit) - Number(a.nameHit) || a.skill.name.localeCompare(b.skill.name))
  .map(({ skill }) => ({ ... }))
Verified on the shipped dsh-client-ui-skill bundle: the menu now matches plugin → dsh-plugin-scout. The full change is 1 file, +9/-2 (branch fix/skill-menu-substring-search on a fork). Happy to open a PR if external pull requests become accepted.

discussions.title: Plugin settings namespaces cannot be exposed to the settings UI | 插件注册的 settings namespace 无法暴露给设置界面
discussions.body:
## 摘要 Summary

**English**

`settings.register()` has no "expose" option, and the exposure allowlist is
hardcoded in `dsh-host-apiproxy` (`WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` /
`PRODUCT_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`). Third-party plugins therefore cannot persist
configuration through the official `settingsScope` path — writes return
`settings-not-exposed` and the client swallows the failure silently, so the
settings UI appears "unresponsive". The source comments even mark this as
deferred work, so this is a known gap worth scheduling. This post describes
the problem with a concrete reproduction, its impact on the plugin
ecosystem, and a backward-compatible fix proposal.

**中文**

`settings.register()` 没有 "expose"（暴露）选项，可暴露 namespace 的白名单被硬编码在
`dsh-host-apiproxy` 中（`WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES` / `PRODUCT_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`）。
因此第三方插件无法通过官方的 `settingsScope` 路径持久化配置——写操作返回
`settings-not-exposed`，且客户端静默吞掉这个错误，设置界面表现为"点了没反应"。
源码注释甚至已将其标记为 deferred work，所以这是一个已知的、值得排期的缺口。
本帖给出问题的具体复现、对插件生态的影响，以及一个完全向后兼容的修复方案。

---

## 现状

- `packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts` 中的 `settings.register(ns, schema, options)`
  注册的 namespace，默认**对浏览器配置客户端既不可读也不可写**。
- 可暴露 namespace 的白名单硬编码在 `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 中：
  - `WEB_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`（第 126 行起）
  - `PRODUCT_SETTINGS_NAMESPACES`（第 256 行）
  - `exposedNamespaces()`（第 1953 行）只放行动态注册的 model provider
    namespace 以及上述两个硬编码集合。
- 对白名单外 namespace 的写入在 `settingsWrite`（第 2009 行）被以
  `settings-not-exposed` 拒绝；`settings.describe` 也会把这些 namespace 完全过滤掉。
- 源码注释（第 124 行）原文：*"Moving that declaration to
  `settings.register()`, so a plugin can expose its own configuration without
  a change in this package, is deferred work."* —— 官方已知，延后中。

## 影响

1. **插件配置持久化路径是断的。** 任何第三方插件按官方范式
   （`settingsNamespace` + `settings.register` + 客户端 `settingsScope`）
   持久化配置，都会静默失败。
2. **官方与第三方插件待遇不一致。** `ui-theme` 在白名单内，能持久化到
   `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`；第三方主题包只能退而求其次用 `localStorage`——
   同一领域存在两种持久化范式。
3. **静默失败难以排查。** 客户端 `SettingsScopeController.write()`
   （`packages/client/ui-settings/src/client/settings-scope.ts`）捕获
   `settings-not-exposed` 后只重读、不暴露任何错误，设置界面看起来"死了"，
   开发者无从下手。
4. **具体复现。** 第三方主题插件（`dsh-theme-pack`）的
   "在侧边栏显示主题快捷入口"复选框点击无任何反馈；排查确认是
   `settings.mutate` 返回 `settings-not-exposed` 被客户端静默吞掉。
   "默认主题"按钮同样受影响（只有基于 localStorage 的"当前主题"正常）。

## 建议方案

核心思路：把"暴露"从 apiproxy 的硬编码白名单，提升为
`settings.register()` 上的显式声明。

1. **`packages/settings/settings/src/index.ts`** —— 给 `register()` 的 options
   增加 `expose?: boolean`（默认 `false`，完全向后兼容），并新增
   `exposedRegistrations(): string[]` 查询。
2. **`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`** —— 让 `exposedNamespaces()`
   合并 `ctx.get('settings')?.exposedRegistrations()`。一处改动同时覆盖
   `describe` 过滤与 `settingsWrite` 拦截。
3. **`packages/client/ui-settings/src/client/settings-scope.ts`** —— 不再吞掉
   写失败：把 `settings-not-exposed` / `settings-rejected` 暴露给订阅者
   （console.warn 或在 snapshot 上增加 `error` 字段）。
4. 可选后续：把 `describe` 的 `writable` 从 provider 级细化到 per-namespace，
   让设置 UI 能正确禁用只读 namespace 的表单。

## 验收条件

- 第三方插件调用 `settings.register(ns, schema, { expose: true })` 后，
  浏览器设置页能读写该 namespace，并持久化到 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml`。
- 未声明 `expose` 的注册行为与现在完全一致（默认不暴露）。
- 对白名单外 namespace 的写入，客户端有可见的错误反馈。

---

## English Key Points

- **Problem:** `settings.register()` cannot mark a namespace as exposed to the
  settings UI; the allowlist is hardcoded in `dsh-host-apiproxy`, so
  third-party plugins get `settings-not-exposed` and the client swallows it —
  settings controls appear dead. (Marked as deferred work in the source.)
- **Impact:** broken config persistence for the plugin ecosystem; first-party
  vs third-party plugins treated unequally; silent failures are hard to debug.
- **Proposed fix (backward compatible):** add `expose?: boolean` to
  `settings.register()` options; merge `exposedRegistrations()` into
  `exposedNamespaces()`; surface write failures on the client instead of
  swallowing them.
- **Reproduction:** a third-party theme pack's settings checkbox does nothing
  on click; `settings.mutate` returns `settings-not-exposed`.
- Happy to provide full reproduction steps or a patch prototype.

discussions.title: dsh-wechat-mp — markdown 进，排好版的公众号草稿出
discussions.body:
写公众号最烦的一步是排版：markdown 粘进编辑器，格式全没了。

原因有两个，都不明显：

1. **编辑器只认元素上的 `style` 属性**。`<style>` 块、外链样式表、class 名一律丢弃 —— 所以「导出 HTML 再粘贴」几乎必然糊掉。
2. **正文图片必须挂在 `mmbiz.qpic.cn` 上**。引用自己图床的链接会被静默过滤，你要等到发送后才发现整篇全是裂图。

`dsh-wechat-mp` 就干这两件事：把每条 CSS 规则算出来内联到元素上，把每张本地图片走微信自己的上传接口，然后建草稿。

![demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/coolbreezecoin/dsh-wechat-mp/main/assets/demo.gif)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-wechat-mp
```

**四个 tool**：`mp_render`（只读，不要凭据）、`mp_upload_image`、`mp_create_draft`、`mp_list_drafts`。

**不做群发** —— 只到草稿箱为止，发送留给人在后台确认。

**分两层，只有一层需要账号**：排版层不碰任何接口，没有 API 权限也能拿到 HTML 手动粘贴。

## 一个反直觉的实测结论

普遍印象是「未认证的个人订阅号没有草稿箱接口权限」。**我拿真号测了，能用。** 这是限制最严的账号类型，它能用就意味着几乎所有公众号都能用。

顺带一个坑：**IP 白名单是在取 access_token 那一步校验的**，不是具体接口。白名单没配好时所有调用都返回 40164，权限根本测不出来 —— 很容易被误读成「我的号没权限」。先把白名单弄对再测。

仓库：https://github.com/coolbreezecoin/dsh-wechat-mp
npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-wechat-mp

discussions.title: 从"躺在床上想派活"到开源：这个项目的一周开发日记
discussions.body:
# 从"躺在床上想派活"到开源：这个项目的一周开发日记

> 没有华丽的开始，只有一个深夜的念头。记录 DeepSeek Phone Harness 从 0 到发布的一周。

---

## Day 1 · 凌晨 1 点，一个念头

那天晚上我躺在床上，突然想到可以让电脑上的 Agent 提前跑一个任务。起床去书房？太麻烦。放弃？不甘心。

那个瞬间我意识到：**Agent 的价值在于替我干活，但我却被绑在电脑前。**

第二天一早，我打开编辑器，决定自己解决这个问题。

## Day 2 · 第一版：一个能通的"翻译官"

核心思路很简单：手机发 HTTP 请求，Agent 进程翻译成 DSH 的 RPC，DSH 的响应再翻译回去。

当天晚上，第一版通了：手机发一句话，电脑上的 Agent 执行，结果回到手机。**虽然丑，但它动了。**

## Day 3 · 卡死一整天：ask_user_question

第三天，任务开始"随机卡死"。排查到深夜才发现：**Agent 会反问用户，反问不走审批通道，而我没监听提问通道。** 任务永远等一个没人回答的问题。

修好那一刻，我在提交信息里写了三个字："不卡了"。

## Day 4 · 让"干活的过程"可见

光有结果不够——我想让手机看到 Agent **每一步在干什么**。

于是有了工具卡片：每个工具调用一张卡，显示图标、状态、操作的文件路径，点开看完整参数和结果。Agent 的思考过程也折叠展示。

那天晚上我盯着手机看 Agent 干活看了很久。**"看见它在想、在动"和"等一个结果"，是两种完全不同的体验。**

## Day 5 · 终端、文件、任务：从"能用"到"好用"

补齐了终端（远程敲命令）、文件浏览、任务列表（一键重跑）、会话管理（重命名/删除/搜索）。

## Day 6 · 打磨细节

- 审批卡、提问卡直接插进消息流，不打断上下文
- 模型选择面板、图片附件、思考折叠
- 修了浏览器缓存导致的"永远看不到新界面"

## Day 7 · 开源发布

写 README、写宣传文、推上 GitHub。发布那一刻没什么仪式感，就是 `git push` 然后长舒一口气。

**4000 行，零 npm 依赖，一个 Node 进程 + 一个 HTML 文件。**

## 一周后的现在

它已经稳定运行：地铁上派任务、睡前改参数、开会时点审批。手机变成了 Agent 的遥控器——**"人在哪，Agent 就在哪"**，这句话不再是一句口号。

## 如果你想试

开源（MIT），三分钟跑起来：

```bash
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

手机 Tailscale 连上电脑，4G/5G 直接访问。

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**如果你也想做个"给自己用"的开源项目，最想解决自己的什么痛点？** 评论区聊聊——说不定下一个爆款项目就从这里开始。

discussions.title: 我手机上最常用的 5 个 Agent 任务：一个真实的使用清单
discussions.body:
# 我手机上最常用的 5 个 Agent 任务：一个真实的使用清单

> 不聊概念，聊清单。这是过去一周我用手机给电脑上的 Agent 派过的活，全部真实。

---

做了 [DeepSeek Phone Harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness) 之后，我养成了一个习惯：**凡是能手机搞定的事，绝不起身去书房。** 这是过去一周真实的手机操作记录。

## 任务 1：通勤路上派活，到站收结果

最常用。地铁上打开手机，给 Agent 发"把 downloads 里最大的 5 个文件列出来，按大小排序"，到站打开手机看结果。

**手机端体验**：发完就锁屏。Agent 在电脑上慢慢跑，我在地铁上慢慢晃。工具卡片显示它正在 `dir`、正在 `du`，每一步都在眼皮底下。

## 任务 2：睡前改参数，醒来已验证

晚上躺床上，给 Agent 发"把 config 里的超时时间改成 30 秒，改完跑一遍测试"。第二天醒来，测试已经跑完，结论在手机上躺着。

**为什么在手机上做**：因为我要关灯睡觉了。这个任务要是只能电脑操作，我大概率会拖到第二天忘掉。

## 任务 3：开会时点审批

Agent 干到一半需要授权——这种场景以前只能等回到电脑前。现在手机弹「需要授权」卡，**拇指点一下「允许一次」**，它继续跑。

**最爽的一刻**：同一张桌子的同事问我"你在会上干什么"，我说"给电脑上的 Agent 放行"。

## 任务 4：临时查代码

躺沙发上，突然想确认某个文件里有没有某个函数。以前：起身 → 书房 → 打开编辑器 → 搜 → 回来。现在：手机打开 → 文件页翻到那个文件 → 看完 → 继续躺。

**工具卡片在这时候尤其有用**：Agent 搜代码时，卡片直接显示它在读哪个文件，路径一目了然。

## 任务 5：模型选择实验

想对比 deepseek-v4-flash 和 v4-pro 在同一个任务上的表现——手机上点顶部模型名，切换，重发任务，并排看结果。

**以前**：命令行改配置、重启、再试。**现在**：两次点击。

## 一个共同点

这 5 个任务有个共同特征：**都不需要"人在电脑前"**。它们只需要：

1. 能发指令
2. 能看到过程
3. 能在关键时刻做决策（审批/回答）
4. 能收结果

手机恰好全都能给。而"人不在电脑前"恰恰是 Agent 场景里最被忽略的一块。

## 工具清单

项目开源（MIT）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

- 4G/5G 直连（Tailscale 免费），三分钟部署
- 流式输出、工具卡片（路径/状态/详情）、审批、提问回答、模型切换、终端、文件
- 零 npm 依赖，单文件前端

**你希望手机上能完成哪些 Agent 任务？** 列出来，呼声高的我下一版优先支持。

discussions.title: 关于"手机远程控制 Agent"，你最关心的 10 个问题，一次说清
discussions.body:
# 关于"手机远程控制 Agent"，你最关心的 10 个问题，一次说清

> 收集了评论区和我自己常被问到的 10 个问题，统一回答。看完你就能判断：这东西适不适合你。

---

做 [DeepSeek Phone Harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness) 以来，被问得最多的问题翻来覆去就是这 10 个。今天一次说清。

## Q1：手机远程控制电脑上的 Agent，安全吗？

**看你怎么用。** 项目本身做了两层保护：所有接口要 Bearer Token；危险操作会先弹「需要授权」卡，由你在手机上决定放行或拒绝。但**任何远程控制工具的安全上限，取决于你的网络**——建议用 Tailscale 这类私有网络，不要把 8788 端口裸暴露到公网。

## Q2：需要公网 IP 吗？要买服务器吗？

**都不用。** 4G/5G 走 Tailscale 直连电脑（免费），局域网直接连。想要公网入口也有 Cloudflare Worker 方案，可选。

## Q3：和"远程桌面"（向日葵/ToDesk）有什么区别？

远程桌面是"看屏幕、动鼠标"，**传输的是画面**；这个是"发指令、看结果"，**传输的是语义**。手机上看的是 Agent 的推理、工具调用、结果——不是一坨缩小的屏幕。流量小一个数量级，手机上体验也清晰得多。

## Q4：手机端和网页端体验差多少？

功能上覆盖网页端绝大部分：对话、流式、模型切换、图片附件、审批、提问、终端、文件、任务。细节上手机端有几个网页端没有的优势：**审批/提问卡片直插消息流**（不打断上下文）、**工具调用是纵向时间线**（天然适合竖屏）。重活（改大量代码）当然还是电脑舒服。

## Q5：任务会卡死吗？Agent 反问怎么办？

以前会——这正是我踩过的最大的坑。Agent 调用 `ask_user_question` 反问时，如果没人回答，任务永远挂着。现在反问会变成手机上的「需要你回答」卡片：**选选项 / 打自定义答案 / 跳过**，答完继续跑，不答就等着。任务永远不会"没人理"。

## Q6：手机上能看到 Agent 具体在干什么吗？

能，而且这是我最自豪的部分。每一步工具调用是一张**工具卡片**：

```
[📄 read]                          ● 完成
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json
▾ 点击展开：完整参数 + 完整结果
```

读哪个文件、执行什么命令、结果如何，全看得见。Agent 的思考过程也折叠展示。

## Q7：4G/5G 真能流畅用吗？

能。流式输出是增量轮询，每次只拉新增的几百字节；工具卡片、审批卡都是轻量 JSON。实测 4G 网络下打字机效果流畅。

## Q8：要装 App 吗？要配置什么？

**不用装 App**——手机浏览器直接打开一个网页（支持 PWA 添加到主屏幕）。电脑端只要 Node 22+ 和已运行的 DeepSeek Harness。配置就一个 `config.json` 填令牌。

## Q9：零依赖是真的吗？好部署吗？

真的。Agent 只用 Node 内置模块（http / child_process / crypto / fs），**没有任何 npm 依赖**。克隆 → 填令牌 → `node agent.mjs --mode=both`，跑起来。前端就一个 `relay.html` 文件。

## Q10：它和 DeepSeek 官方是什么关系？

**纯社区项目，非官方。** 我纯粹觉得"手机控制电脑 Agent"这个需求该有人做，就做了。官方在做的是 Harness 本身，我做的是它的"口袋版遥控器"。

## 结论

适合你吗？一句话判断：**如果你经常"人不在电脑前但想让 Agent 干活"，它适合你；如果你永远坐在电脑前用 Agent，那它只是锦上添花。**

项目开源（MIT）：

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**还有什么问题评论区问，我每一条都回。** 问得多的问题我会继续更新这个清单。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness is useless when you leave the desk — so I open-sourced a way to run it over 4G
discussions.body:
# DeepSeek Harness is useless when you leave the desk — so I open-sourced a way to run it over 4G

> Your desktop agent is only as good as your presence in front of the computer. Until your phone can command it.

---

Let's get this straight first: **this post is about disproving something — my own previous belief.**

I loved DeepSeek Harness. Then one day I was out and wanted the agent on my computer to organize some files. That's when reality hit:

> I'm not at the computer. The agent is a decoration.

At work. On the commute. At dinner. On the couch. **Any moment you're away from the desk, you can't use it.** Is that reasonable? No. So I built something.

## What I built

An open-source mobile remote-control project that lets your phone operate DeepSeek Harness on your computer from any network:

- **Direct 4G/5G** (via Tailscale, free) — no public IP needed
- **Real-time streaming** — the agent's words appear on your phone character by character
- **Full tool-call visibility** — which file was read, what command ran, the result — one card per call
- **Approvals + questions** — permission card pops up, question card pops up, tasks never hang
- **Model switching**, **image attachments**, **terminal**, **file browsing**

## How light is it?

**Zero npm dependencies.** ~4000 lines. Frontend is a single HTML file.

No cloud server. No database. No framework. No `npm install`. **Clone → set a token → run.**

## Real scenarios (all true)

**Scenario 1**: On the subway, opened the page, sent a task to the desktop agent. By the time I got off, the result was already on my phone.

**Scenario 2**: The agent needed permission mid-task — previously that meant waiting until I got back. Now a card pops up on my phone, I tap "Allow once", it continues.

**Scenario 3**: The agent asked me a question. I picked an option on a card. Task resumed. **A question used to mean a deadlocked task; now it's a 10-second fix.**

## Run it in three minutes

```bash
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

Install Tailscale on the phone, open `http://<computer IP>:8788/`, enter the token, go.

## Honest talk

It's not perfect: it's a web page (not a native app), commands run one at a time (no full PTY), and the cloud channel needs you to deploy a Worker. **But "fully controlling your desktop agent from your phone" is done — open source and free.**

Repo (stars, PRs and issues welcome):

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**What would YOU most want to do with your desktop agent from your phone?** Or any concerns about remote control? Drop them in the comments — I read every one.

*(Community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.)*

discussions.title: 3 traps I fell into while letting a phone control a desktop agent — it's harder than it looks
discussions.body:
# 3 traps I fell into while letting a phone control a desktop agent — it's harder than it looks

> On the surface it's an HTTP layer and a web page. Underneath, every step fights your assumptions. Real pitfalls, so you can avoid them.

---

Before building DeepSeek Phone Harness, I assumed "mobile remote control for a desktop agent" was just moving a web page to a phone. After finishing it, I admit: **the idea took 10 minutes; the bug-fixing took a week.**

Here are 3 real traps — each one made tasks "gracefully deadlock" in production.

## Trap 1: The moment the agent asks a question, the task hangs forever

This is the nastiest one.

Our relay listened to DSH's approval channel (`approval/requested`) — all good. Until one day a test task **never finished**. Not an error — just hung, `pending` climbing.

Two days of digging later: DSH agents can call the `ask_user_question` tool to **ask the user something** — and that goes through a *different* channel (`question/requested`), **not** the approval channel. My relay only listened for approvals, so question frames were silently dropped.

Result: the agent waits on the computer for a human answer, the phone has no idea, the task hangs forever. **It only continues once the user answers.**

Fix: ingest question frames separately, forward them as "your answer needed" cards, and use the exact same answer protocol as the official Web GUI.

**Lesson: in an agent's realtime event stream, every frame type exists for a reason. Miss one, and tasks die in ways you'd never guess.**

## Trap 2: Tool results live two layers deep

The phone shows "tool cards": tool name + file path + result. Name is easy, path is easy (extract from arguments). Result?

I assumed `tool/result` content was `[{type:'text', text:'...'}]`. Naive. The real shape:

```json
content: [{
  "type": "tool-result",
  "content": [{ "type": "text", "text": "<path>...<content>..." }]
}]
```

**Two levels of nesting**, with `toolCallId` on the inner block. My first version only read one level: cards had names and paths, but results were always empty.

Fix: recursive text collection + pairing calls to results via `source.callId`.

**Lesson: no protocol doc beats capturing one real payload.**

## Trap 3: Mobile browser caching made users see a forever-old UI

Changed the UI, opened the phone — **still the old one.** Refresh, restart browser, switch browser — same.

Not a network issue. It's **caching**: the old page was cached, and `Cache-Control` wasn't set.

Fix: serve HTML with `no-store, no-cache, must-revalidate`. Every open is now the latest.

**Lesson: for mobile web apps, cache strategy matters as much as feature code.**

## Why these traps are worth sharing

Each one reveals the real complexity of "remote-controlling an agent from a phone":

- It's not a static page — it's a **faithful courier of a realtime event stream**
- It's not a toy — it must handle **approvals, questions, tool results** at production level
- It's not a demo — it must stay **low-latency, retryable, recoverable** on 4G

After fixing all of it, tool cards look like this on the phone:

```
[📄 read]                          ● done
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json
▾ tap to expand: full arguments + full result
```

Every step the agent takes — which file, what command, the outcome — is visible. Permission requests and questions become cards. **Tasks never hang because "nobody answered."**

## The project

Open source (MIT). Stars / PRs / issues welcome:

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**What's the weirdest bug you've hit while working with agents?** Share it below — I bet it beats mine.

discussions.body:
# Watching my agent work from the phone and the desktop at the same time — I can't go back

> You'd expect the phone to be a "downgraded" web page. After a side-by-side test, I found some experiences are actually better on mobile.

---

Before building DeepSeek Phone Harness, I set my own acceptance bar: **the phone must reach 80% of the desktop web experience, or it's not done.**

After finishing, I ran a controlled test: the same task, watched simultaneously on a desktop browser and a phone browser. The result surprised me — **a few experiences are genuinely better on mobile.**

## The test: one task, both screens

Task: let the agent read the project config, summarize current progress, and run a test.

| Dimension | Desktop web | Phone |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Streaming output | Fine | Fine (typewriter) |
| Tool-call visibility | Present | **Stronger**: each card shows the file path; tap for args + result |
| Approvals | Dialog/panel | **Cards inline in the message stream** — no page switch |
| Questions | Input takeover | **Option cards**, one tap |
| Model switching | Dropdown | Bottom sheet, thumb-reachable |
| Away from desk | Must be at the computer | **Works from anywhere** |

## Why mobile is better at some things

### 1. Approvals/questions don't break context

On desktop, an approval is a separate dialog that interrupts what you're reading. On mobile, I made approvals and questions **cards inserted directly into the message stream** — the context of *where* the agent is and *why* it's asking stays continuous.

### 2. Tool cards are naturally built for portrait

"Read file → run command → edit code" — a vertical sequence of tool calls is **made for a portrait screen**. On desktop you juggle logs and lists; on mobile it's one clean timeline:

```
[📄 read]   C:/.../config.json          ● done
[⚙️ pwsh]   npm test                    ● running…
```

### 3. Your thumb is the best mouse

Model switching, attachments, card expansion — everything lives within thumb reach.

## An honest comparison

Mobile is not a replacement for the desktop — **heavy work (editing lots of code, digging logs, multi-terminal) still belongs at a desk.** But mobile closes the desktop's biggest gap: **the moments you're not at the computer.**

- Send a task on the commute, read the result when you arrive
- Tweak a config before bed, find it verified in the morning
- Approve an agent request mid-meeting with one tap

**"Wherever you are, your agent is too"** — that's mobile's real value, not "a smaller webpage."

## The project

Open source (MIT):

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

Direct 4G/5G (free Tailscale), three-minute setup, zero npm dependencies.

**Which of your agent tasks could be done while you're away from the desk?** List them below — I'll see what belongs on the roadmap.

discussions.title: The agent's next stop is your pocket: why "mobile" may be one of the agent's best forms
discussions.body:
# The agent's next stop is your pocket: why "mobile" may be one of the agent's best forms

> We moved agents from the terminal to the browser. Now it's time to move them into your pocket. This isn't "mobile adaptation" — it's a shift in interaction paradigm.

---

DeepSeek Harness just went open source, and the community is excited — models, tools, agent loops, all pluggable. But amid the noise I noticed something:

> Everyone's discussing what agents **can do**. Almost nobody discusses **where you use them**.

Let's talk about the second one — and I'll give you my own answer.

## Agent usage is moving from "sit down" to "anytime"

First generation: open a terminal, sit down, watch.

Second generation (Web GUI): open a browser, sit down, watch.

Essentially it's still **"you must be seated at the computer."** But an agent's whole value is that it does the work *for* you — and yet you have to babysit it. Is that reasonable?

- On the commute, I want it to start running first
- Before bed, I want to assign tomorrow's tasks
- Mid-meeting, it needs an approval — I want to tap once and let it continue

All these share one trait: **you're not at the computer, but the agent is working.** Who's the remote? The phone is the only answer.

## Mobile isn't a "shrunk webpage" — it's a new paradigm

I used to think mobile = shrunk web. After actually building it, I found mobile's interaction logic is fundamentally different:

**1. From "multiple windows" to "a single timeline"**

The web has panels side by side: conversation, tool output, approval dialogs. Mobile naturally has one **vertical timeline** — user message, agent reasoning, tool cards, approval cards, question cards, all linear. The agent's work becomes a **replayable pipeline**, which is clearer, not less.

**2. From "clicking around" to "making decisions"**

On desktop you click everywhere. On mobile, thumb reach is limited, which forces interactions into **"look once → decide"**: allow this tool call or not? How to answer this question? — judgment calls, not browsing sessions.

**3. From "accompanying" to "async"**

On desktop you sit with the agent. On mobile you **dispatch → leave → come back for results.** That pushes the agent side to do state management properly (task queues, result retention, failure notifications) — which is exactly where agent products are heading.

## My answer: an open-source project that puts the agent in your pocket

Based on the above, I built [DeepSeek Phone Harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness):

- Control DeepSeek Harness on your computer from a mobile browser (4G/5G, Tailscale direct)
- Streaming output, tool cards (path/status/detail), approvals, question answers, model switching, terminal, files
- Zero npm dependencies, ~4000 lines, single-file frontend
- MIT open source, clone and run

It's no revolutionary invention — just a plain answer: **"when the agent works for you, you shouldn't have to be there."**

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

## Your turn

**What do you think is the agent's next form?**

- Mobile (a pocket remote)?
- Always-on cloud (unattended agents)?
- Something else?

Comment below — this is a topic worth arguing about.

discussions.body:
# From "a thought in bed" to open source: one week of development diary

> No glamorous start — just a late-night thought. A week of building DeepSeek Phone Harness, from zero to release.

---

## Day 1 · 1 a.m., a thought

In bed that night, I realized I could have the agent on my computer run a task early. Get up and walk to the study? Too much trouble. Give up? Unsatisfying.

In that moment it hit me: **the agent's value is doing work for me, yet I'm chained to the computer.**

Next morning I opened the editor and decided to solve it myself.

## Day 2 · First version: a working "translator"

The core idea was simple: the phone sends HTTP, an agent process translates it into DSH RPC, and translates responses back.

That evening the first version worked: send a sentence from the phone, the agent on the computer executes, the result returns to the phone. **Ugly, but it moved.**

## Day 3 · Deadlocked all day: ask_user_question

On day three, tasks started "randomly hanging." I dug until late night and found: **the agent asks the user questions, questions don't go through the approval channel, and I wasn't listening to the question channel.** Tasks waited forever on a question nobody answered.

When it was fixed, my commit message said three words: "no more hangs."

## Day 4 · Make the work visible

Results weren't enough — I wanted the phone to see **what the agent does, step by step.**

So tool cards were born: one card per tool call, with icon, status, the file path it touched, and expandable full arguments and results. The agent's reasoning also folds into a collapsible block.

That night I sat watching the agent work on my phone for a long time. **"Watching it think and move" versus "waiting for a result" are two completely different experiences.**

## Day 5 · Terminal, files, tasks: from usable to useful

Added the terminal (remote commands), file browsing, task history (one-tap re-run), and session management (rename/delete/search).

## Day 6 · Polishing

- Approval and question cards inserted directly into the message stream — no context breaks
- Model picker, image attachments, thinking disclosure
- Fixed browser caching that made users "never see the new UI"

## Day 7 · Open source

Wrote the README, wrote the promo posts, pushed to GitHub. There was no ceremony — just `git push` and a long exhale.

**~4000 lines, zero npm dependencies, one Node process + one HTML file.**

## A week later, now

It runs stably: dispatch tasks on the commute, tweak config before bed, tap approvals mid-meeting. The phone became the agent's remote — **"wherever you are, your agent is too"** is no longer just a slogan.

## Try it

Open source (MIT), three-minute setup:

```bash
git clone https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness
cd DeepSeek-phone-harness && cp config.example.json config.json
node agent.mjs --mode=both
```

Install Tailscale on the phone, access over 4G/5G.

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**If you were to build an open-source project "for yourself," what pain point would you solve first?** Comment below — the next viral project might start here.

discussions.title: "Remote-controlling your agent from a phone" — the 10 questions everyone asks, answered
discussions.body:
# "Remote-controlling your agent from a phone" — the 10 questions everyone asks, answered

> Collected from comments and DMs. Read this and you'll know whether this is for you.

---

Since building [DeepSeek Phone Harness](https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness), the same 10 questions keep coming up. Let's answer them all at once.

## Q1: Is remote-controlling a desktop agent from a phone safe?

**Depends on how you use it.** The project has two layers of protection: every API requires a Bearer token, and risky operations first show an "authorization needed" card that you allow or reject on your phone. But the safety ceiling of any remote-control tool is set by your network — **use a private network like Tailscale**, and don't expose port 8788 raw to the public internet.

## Q2: Do I need a public IP? A server?

**Neither.** 4G/5G connects directly to the computer via Tailscale (free); LAN works directly. A Cloudflare Worker is optional if you want a public entry.

## Q3: How is this different from remote desktop (TeamViewer/AnyDesk)?

Remote desktop **transmits a screen** — you look at the display and move the mouse. This **transmits semantics** — instructions and results. You see the agent's reasoning, tool calls, and outcomes, not a shrunken screen. An order of magnitude less bandwidth, and far clearer on a phone.

## Q4: How much of the web experience does the phone have?

Most of it: chat, streaming, model switching, image attachments, approvals, questions, terminal, files, tasks. On a few details mobile is actually ahead: **approval/question cards inline in the message stream** (no context break), and **tool calls as a vertical timeline** (made for portrait). Heavy work (large-scale editing) still belongs at a desk.

## Q5: Do tasks hang? What if the agent asks something?

They used to — that was the biggest trap I hit. When an agent calls `ask_user_question`, an unanswered task hangs forever. Now the question becomes a "your answer needed" card: **pick an option / type a custom answer / skip.** Answer and it continues; ignore and it waits. Tasks never deadlock because "nobody's listening."

## Q6: Can I see exactly what the agent is doing?

Yes — and it's the part I'm proudest of. Every tool call is a **tool card**:

```
[📄 read]                          ● done
C:/Users/Joey/Documents/.../config.json
▾ tap to expand: full arguments + full result
```

Which file was read, what command ran, the outcome — all visible. The agent's reasoning folds into a collapsible block too.

## Q7: Is it smooth on 4G/5G?

Yes. Streaming is incremental polling — each pull only fetches a few hundred new bytes; tool cards and approval cards are lightweight JSON. The typewriter effect stays smooth on 4G in practice.

## Q8: Do I need an app? Any setup?

**No app** — the phone browser opens a page directly (PWA add-to-home-screen works). On the computer you need Node 22+ and a running DeepSeek Harness. Setup is one `config.json` with a token.

## Q9: "Zero dependencies" — really? Is deployment easy?

Really. The agent uses only Node built-ins (http / child_process / crypto / fs) — **zero npm dependencies.** Clone → set token → `node agent.mjs --mode=both`. The frontend is a single `relay.html` file.

## Q10: What's the relationship with DeepSeek official?

**Pure community project, not official.** I just believed "controlling your desktop agent from a phone" was a need someone should fill, so I filled it. Official is building Harness itself; I built its "pocket remote."

## Verdict

Is it for you? One-line test: **if you often want your agent to work while you're away from the desk — yes; if you're always at the desk — it's a nice-to-have.**

Open source (MIT):

> **https://github.com/2903077918-lgtm/DeepSeek-phone-harness**

**Any other questions? Ask in the comments — I reply to every one.** Popular questions will keep updating this list.

discussions.title: Windows: host process crashes with ENOENT in OutputCollector.spillAll after a temp cleaner removes %TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*
discussions.body:
Reporting a host-crash bug here since issues are disabled. Environment: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.5 installed globally from npm, Windows 10/11. Trigger: a `%TEMP%` cleaning tool running during an active session (Huorong / 火绒 in the original case; CCleaner and Windows Storage Sense are the same class).

## Crash

```text
Error: ENOENT: no such file or directory, open 'C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp\dsh-subprocess-XDlWVx\dsh-subprocess-21012-1-fa3ac74027e2-stdout.log'
    at openSync (node:fs:560:18)
    at OutputCollector.spillAll (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js:417:19)
    at OutputCollector.push (.../lib/index.js:393:75)
    at Socket.<anonymous> (.../lib/index.js:562:14)
  errno: -4058, code: 'ENOENT', syscall: 'open'
```

The whole dsh host process dies mid-task.

## Root cause

As read from `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/spawn.ts` at rc.5:

1. `privateSpillDir()` creates the private spill directory with `mkdtempSync` once per process and caches it for the process lifetime — it is never revalidated.
2. The directory is touched again only when a command's output first overflows the in-memory collect cap. If an external cleaner removed it in between, the first `openSync(file, 'wx')` fails with `ENOENT` — the file name is freshly random, so `ENOENT` can only mean the parent directory is gone.
3. That throw happens synchronously inside the socket `'data'` listener (`stream.on('data', chunk => collector.push(chunk))`), so it becomes an uncaught exception and kills the host. The `-1-` in the file name above is the spill counter: this was the first spill of that process, i.e. the directory sat unused through a long session and was cleaned in between.

Every neighboring path already degrades gracefully — a spill past its cap is discarded, a failed final close withholds the spill path, and `dsh-spill-policy` logs a failed `saveText` and keeps the inline result. This open/write was the one unguarded surface.

## Reproduction

Start a session, delete `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*` (or run a temp cleaner), then run any command whose collected output exceeds the in-memory cap. The host crashes on the first spill open.

## Suggested fix

Two small changes in `spawn.ts`:

- Wrap the spill open/write in `spillAll()` in a catch that permanently disables spilling for that stream via the existing `discardSpill()` state — the failure never propagates out of `push()`, and the truncated tail keeps serving reads.
- Revalidate the cached directory in `privateSpillDir()` with `existsSync` on each spawn and recreate it with `mkdtempSync` when missing, so one deletion costs only the collectors racing it instead of every later spawn's spill.

Sibling-pattern audit: `dsh-spill-local`'s `privateRoot()` is not affected — `saveTextFile()` recreates the session directory via recursive `mkdir` on every save, and its async failures are already contained by `dsh-spill-policy`.

---

中文小结：Windows 临时文件清理工具（火绒等）删除 `%TEMP%\dsh-subprocess-*` 后，会话中第一条输出超过内存上限的命令会让整个 dsh 宿主进程以未捕获异常崩溃；根因与最小修复如上，两处改动都在 `dsh-subprocess-local` 的 `spawn.ts`。
