discussions.title: 【展示】实测优先的三个社区基础设施：dsh-lab / awesome-dsh-skills / awesome-dsh-presets
discussions.body:
三个仓库，同一个标准：**先验证，再发布。**

**为什么做这些**：社区插件已近千（目录 972 个且仍在涨），但「收录 ≠ 能用、star 高 ≠ 安全、自动榜单 ≠ 实测」。我们搭了隔离测试环境（独立 DSH_HOME，不碰真实配置），用官方 `dsh plugin add` 真机安装，每个条目过四关：安装 → 冒烟 → 安全快检 → 兼容钉版。

**1. dsh-lab — 插件实测实验室** https://github.com/hackerFish/dsh-lab
- 10 份实测报告：完整安装日志 + 静态扫描命中清单（逐条人工判读）+ 复现命令
- 6 个「目录收录但仓库已消失」的失效条目记录
- 4 个真实安装摩擦及解法：pnpm 9 的 ERR_PNPM_ADDING_TO_ROOT、git 协议网络拦截、大依赖树 registry 超时（npmmirror 解法）、git 插件 prepare 需 allowBuilds 放行
- 3 篇原创中文指南（上手 / 写插件 / 避坑）
- 零依赖扫描器开源；连我们自己扫描器的误报勘误都保留在案

**2. awesome-dsh-skills — 技能库** https://github.com/hackerFish/awesome-dsh-skills
- 12 个原创中文 SKILL.md，复制即用
- 每个技能过两关：格式校验器（逐条对照官方 dsh-skill-filesystem 规则，含字段白名单与 kebab-case）+ 隔离 DSH_HOME 加载冒烟

**3. awesome-dsh-presets — 预设与规则** https://github.com/hackerFish/awesome-dsh-presets
- 4 个预设：standard-zh / minimal-zh（官方 shipped 预设 MIT 派生，保留归因，仅改中文 persona）+ writer / researcher（原创组合，行结构逐行取自官方预设）
- 校验器含「包存在性」校验：引用的每个 @deepseek-ai/* 包必须在安装中真实存在
- 4 份可并入 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 的中文规则（代码质量 / 提交纪律 / PR 审查 / 安全护栏）

**诚实声明**：冒烟关需要模型凭据，目前如实标注 ⏳，将用自有凭据补测（单插件消耗上限 0.5 元等价 token）。所有结论欢迎复现后报「不一致」，我们复测并保留勘误。官方暂不接受外部 PR，我们按 CONTRIBUTING 的生态路线做贡献——若这些方向与官方愿景有偏差，恳请指正。

欢迎送测插件/技能/预设，欢迎挑错。

discussions.title: [Show and tell] KubeMD — evidence-first Kubernetes diagnosis skill with case memory
discussions.body:
**What it is**

`kubemd` (a.k.a. dsh-k8s-diagnosis) is a DSH skill for diagnosing **live, broken Kubernetes clusters** — not writing manifests. When a pod CrashLoops, a node goes NotReady, or a Service stops answering behind a NetworkPolicy deny, it runs a clinical 7-phase loop: capture context → build a red-capable feedback loop → collect signals → rank falsifiable hypotheses → dry-run fix → record the case → output contract.

**Verified, not vibes**

Verified against a real fault-injected kind cluster v1.36.1 (5 scenarios: CrashLoopBackOff / OOMKilled / ImagePullBackOff / Pending / NetworkPolicy deny — all reproduced and the playbook commands exercised). Full report in-repo: `verification-report.md`. Platform findings worth sharing broadly:
- OOMKilling events do NOT appear on kind + containerd v2 — rely on `lastState.terminated.reason == OOMKilled` + exit 137
- `kubectl top` needs metrics-server; kind ships without it
- `kubectl logs --previous` can be unavailable when the CRI already collected terminated logs; fall back to current-instance logs

**Why it fits the ecosystem**

The K8s/DevOps slot was empty in DSH skill listings — most community skills target coding/agents/vision. A Kubernetes runtime surgeon pairs well with the existing diagnosis-style skills (e.g. dsh-diagnose for DSH internals — complementary domains: DSH itself vs the clusters you run on it).

**Get it**

```bash
git clone https://github.com/guiyi-labs/kubemd ~/.dsh/skills/dsh-k8s-diagnosis
```

Ships a `go install` CLI twin (aiops diagnose / aiops cases) with the same deterministic engine: https://github.com/guiyi-labs/aiops-platform

Demo: https://github.com/guiyi-labs/kubemd (README has a 15s real-fault-cluster GIF)

Open to review, corrections, and real-world failure-mode feedback — the playbook roadmap is driven by what eats your debugging time.

discussions.title: macOS exFAT 卷上 pnpm install 必现失败：install-lefthook 锁的 inode 所有权校验在 exFAT 上永不成立（stale lock 与 ownership changed 交替循环）
discussions.body:
> 注：本帖初始版本有两处事实错误（系统版本、锁校验失败时机的描述），已根据复查结果更正，机制分析以本版本为准。

## 环境

- macOS 26.5（Darwin 25.5.0，arm64）
- 仓库位于 exFAT 卷（Samsung T7 USB SSD，`diskutil` 显示 File System Personality: ExFAT）
- master @ `47f943859b`，pnpm v11.7.0

## 现象与原始输出

`pnpm install` 在 postinstall 阶段退出 1，两种错误交替出现，删锁重跑也无法恢复。

**错误一（锁由上一次失败的 install 遗留）**，pnpm 实际输出（预先放置内容为 `999999 <uuid>` 的锁文件模拟遗留死锁后捕获）：

```
. postinstall$ node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
. postinstall: [install-lefthook] stale Lefthook installer lock "/Volumes/SamsungT7/git/deepseek-harness/.git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock". Confirm no Lefthook installer is running, remove it manually, and retry.
. postinstall: Failed
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
```

**错误二（手动删除锁文件后重跑）**，pnpm 实际输出：

```
. postinstall$ node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
. postinstall: [install-lefthook] Lefthook installer lock ownership changed for /Volumes/SamsungT7/git/deepseek-harness/.git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock; refusing to remove it
. postinstall: Failed
[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
```

### 直接复现（`node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs`，输出逐字未改）

复现错误一：先放置一个内容为 `999999 <uuid>` 的锁文件（模拟上次失败遗留的死 PID 锁），然后运行：

```
$ printf '999999 00000000-0000-0000-0000-000000000000\n' > .git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock
$ node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
[install-lefthook] stale Lefthook installer lock "/Volumes/SamsungT7/git/deepseek-harness/.git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock". Confirm no Lefthook installer is running, remove it manually, and retry.
exit=1
```

复现错误二（无锁的干净状态直接运行）：

```
$ node scripts/install-lefthook.mjs
[install-lefthook] Lefthook installer lock ownership changed for /Volumes/SamsungT7/git/deepseek-harness/.git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock; refusing to remove it
exit=1
```

每次失败都会在 `.git/` 遗留一个新锁文件，属主 PID 已随进程退出：

```
$ cat .git/dsh-lefthook-install.lock
94332 bf3d5d01-2959-4c77-9ee0-decbeacad1ae
```

于是下一次 install 又报 stale——形成循环，hooks 永远装不上（`core.hooksPath` 从未被写入，lefthook 从未安装）。

## 相关源码（`scripts/install-lefthook.mjs` @ `47f943859b`）

锁获取的关键路径（`acquireInstallLock`，line 381 起）——先 `openSync('wx')` 创建并用 fd 记录 `ownedStat`，**关闭句柄后**再按路径 `lstatSync` 复查并比对 `dev/ino`：

```js
const lockHandle = openSync(lockPath, 'wx', 0o600)          // line 388
let ownedStat
try {
  ownedStat = fstatSync(lockHandle)                         // exFAT：句柄打开时为接近 UINT64_MAX 的合成 ino
  writeFileSync(lockHandle, ownedRecord)                    // 记录 "PID UUID"
} finally {
  closeSync(lockHandle)                                     // exFAT：句柄关闭后，按路径 stat 的 ino 改变
}
const publishedStat = installLockStat(lockPath)             // lstatSync，line 400
if (
  publishedStat === undefined
  || !publishedStat.isFile()
  || publishedStat.isSymbolicLink()
  || publishedStat.dev !== ownedStat.dev
  || publishedStat.ino !== ownedStat.ino                    // exFAT 上恒不相等
) {
  throw lockOwnershipChangedError(lockPath)                 // → 错误二
}
```

stale 判定分支（同函数 catch 内，line 450，以下为源码原文）——锁已存在且属主 PID 不可达时要求人工恢复：

```js
if (!lockOwnerIsAlive(owner)) throw manualLockRecoveryError(lockPath, 'stale')  // process.kill(pid, 0) 为 ESRCH → 错误一
```

## 根因分析

问题出在 macOS 的 exFAT 驱动报告的 file ID 不稳定，且变化点正好落在上述时序上：**句柄仍打开时**，fd 的 `fstat` 与按路径的 `lstat` 返回同一个（合成的、接近 `UINT64_MAX` 的）ino；**`closeSync` 之后**，按路径 `lstat` 得到的 ino 变成另一个小值。实测（exFAT 卷上新建文件）：

```
fstat(句柄打开时):  ino 18446744073709085000   ← 接近 UINT64_MAX 的合成值
lstat(句柄打开时):  ino 18446744073709085000   ← 与 fstat 一致
lstat(句柄关闭后):  ino 950466                 ← 不一致（dev 相同，仅 ino 变化）
```

`acquireInstallLock` 恰好在 `closeSync` 之后才做路径复查，因此 exFAT 卷上每次 install 都必然在取得锁之后的校验处抛 `lockOwnershipChangedError`，进程退出后锁文件被遗留给下一次运行——这就是两种错误交替出现的完整链条。（对照实验：同一探测在 APFS 卷上句柄关闭前后 ino 均不变。）

最小复现（复刻脚本的时序）：

```js
const h = openSync(p, "wx", 0o600)
const f = fstatSync(h)
writeFileSync(h, "x")
closeSync(h)
lstatSync(p).ino === f.ino // APFS: true；macOS exFAT: false
```

## 想讨论 / 请教

1. 这种「fd 记录 inode + 路径复查」的防替换校验，是否可以考虑对不提供稳定 file ID 的文件系统降级？例如启动时探测一次 fstat/lstat 的一致性，不一致时退化为仅校验锁记录内容；或改用在该类文件系统上仍然稳定的所有权凭据。
2. 若判定为超出支持范围（要求 APFS/原生文件系统），是否值得在 README 或 troubleshooting 文档中注明，并在错误信息中提示 exFAT 场景？
3. 临时绕过（本机已验证）：`CI=true pnpm install` 可跳过 lefthook 安装（该脚本在 CI 环境下直接 return），依赖正常安装完成、退出码 0；或将仓库移至 APFS 卷（对照实验已确认 APFS 上该机制正常）。

以上分析如有误，欢迎指正。

discussions.title: [UX] 远程浏览器访问 Web UI 时，Settings → Plugins 配置页静默空白，没有任何"仅限本机"提示
discussions.body:
## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.6`（`dsh web`，macOS / Windows 各一台）
- 访问方式：Tailscale tailnet 内的 HTTPS 域名 + Caddy 反向代理（仅 tailnet 可达，非公网暴露）
- 浏览器：Chrome 128

## 现象

本机 `http://localhost:3080` 打开 Settings → Plugins，能看到 Shell / Agent loop / Web search 三张插件配置卡片和 "All plugins" 清单，一切正常。

通过 tailnet 域名（HTTPS）访问同一实例时，页面可以正常打开、会话功能全部可用，但 **Settings → Plugins 的"Plugin configuration" 标签页完全空白**——没有卡片、没有报错、没有任何"此功能仅限本机使用"的说明。Console 里没有相关错误，`/plugins/events` SSE 正常收到 graph，插件 client.js 全部 200。

用户第一反应是"插件加载坏了"，排查很久才发现是**有意的 loopback 门**。

## 代码定位

空白的根因是三个前端模块里的 loopback 判断，链条如下：

**1. 连接层计算 `isLoopback`（仅认页面 hostname）**
`packages/client/connection/src/…`（编译产物 `dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js:10167`）：

```js
isLoopback: pageLocation === void 0 || isLoopbackHostname(pageLocation.hostname),
```

`localhost` / `127/8` / `[::1]` 为 true，其余（含 tailnet 域名、LAN IP）一律 false。

**2. settings scope 在非 loopback 下切成 "memory" 模式**
`packages/client/ui-settings/…`（`dsh-client-ui-settings/lib/client.js:210`）：

```js
const controller = new SettingsScopeController(connection.api, spec,
  connection.isLoopback ? "host" : "memory");
```

`"memory"` 模式下 `enqueue()` 直接短路（同文件 `:131`：`if (this.persistence === "memory") return Promise.resolve()`），**永远不会调用 settings API**，scope 状态永远停在 `"unavailable"`（`:42`：`status: persistence === "host" ? "loading" : "unavailable"`）。代码注释也写明这是有意的："remote browsers remain process-local because settings RPCs are loopback-only."

**3. 卡片在 unavailable 时静默渲染 null**
`packages/client/ui-settings-plugins/…`（`dsh-client-ui-settings-plugins/lib/client.js:206`）：

```js
if (!state.available) return null;   // available = snapshot.status === "ready"
```

`PluginCard` 直接返回 null → 标签页空无一物。`dsh-client-ui-settings-models` 的欢迎卡片（`:2687`）和 `dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 的 settings 文档控制器（`:482`）有同样的 loopback 门。

## 与 Discussion #130 的关系

我完全认同 #130 的安全立场：在 remote auth 落地前，settings/credentials 等 privileged RPC 保持 loopback-only 是正确的默认值，不应通过绕过手段把 `dsh web` 暴露到不可信网络。

我实际使用的场景是 Tailscale tailnet-only + 反代（Caddy 统一改写 Host 为 localhost:3080），访问面限于本人设备，因此在本地打了一个把 `"memory"` 改成 `"host"` 的小补丁，恢复了远程查看/编辑配置的能力。这只适合自用、可信 tailnet 环境，**不建议任何人在公网/半可信网络这样做**（#130 描述的 Host 伪造 → settings.update → baseURL 劫持链是真实存在的）。

## 建议

想提的是两件小事，都不涉及放开安全边界：

**1. （小改动）远程浏览器渲染一张明确的提示卡片，而不是静默 null**

`PluginCard` 的 `available === false` 分支现在什么都不画。建议改成渲染一张只读卡片（或置灰卡片）：

> Settings for this deployment are only available from the local machine
> (loopback). Remote browsers cannot view or edit these values for security
> reasons — see [PRIVILEGED_METHODS / loopback-only policy].

一行说明就能省掉用户半小时的"为什么页面是空的"排查。同理，`dsh-client-ui-settings-general` 的文档编辑器在非 loopback 下消失时，也可以给个提示而非直接不渲染。

**2. （远期，与 #75 / #90 呼应）remote auth 落地后按认证级别分层**

`PRIVILEGED_METHODS` 目前是全有全无的 loopback 开关。社区对远程访问的需求很明确（#75、#90），建议未来支持 remote auth 时，把 settings 的 **读**（describe）与 **写**（update/mutate）分开分级：读可以随认证放开，写（尤其 baseURL/credential 类）保持更高门槛。这样远程场景至少能看到配置、诊断问题，而写路径仍然受控。

## 附：供维护者复现的最小信息

- 任意 `dsh web` 实例（127.0.0.1:3080）
- 用任意非 loopback 域名（如 tailnet 域名或 LAN IP 经反代）打开 Web UI
- 进入 Settings → Plugins → "Plugin configuration" → 标签页空白
- 同页 "All plugins"（inventory，走 Remote RPC）是正常的，说明问题只在 settings scope 这一条渲染路径

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] deepDDW — Memory + Knowledge Base + Document Search for DSH (on-demand RAG, no context bloat)
discussions.body:
**3-month production deployment** in a 5-20 person team: ~800 memory units, ~5-10 retrievals per conversation, **<8K tokens** context overhead.

## 4 core design choices

1. **Unit-based memory** — `debug-auth-module.unit` naming + brief (fast scan) / full (deep detail) dual layers
2. **NOT injected into system prompt** — on-demand RAG recall only (no context bloat)
3. **TTL auto-archive** — entries unreferenced for 7 days get degraded, then removed
4. **NAS SMB cross-device sync** — no cloud dependency, works on LAN

## Deployment

Docker Compose one-liner, SearXNG optional:
```bash
cp .env.example .env   # set DDW_ACCESS_TOKEN
docker compose -f deepddw-compose.yml up -d --build
```

## Honest comparison

| | Approach | Best for |
|---|---|---|
| dsh-plugin-meta-memory | Inject into system prompt | "all memories always live" |
| dsh-memory-plugin (OpenViking) | Cloud, self-evolving | Cloud-first teams |
| **deepDDW** | Local, on-demand RAG | Small teams (5-20) on LAN |

## Links

- Repo: https://github.com/ccch713/deepddw
- License: Apache-2.0
- Demo GIF: *(coming soon)*

---

**中文摘要**：deepDDW 是面向 5-20 人小团队的本地 memory + 知识库方案。单元式记忆（brief/full 双层）、按需 RAG（不入 system prompt，context 稳定 <8K token）、TTL 自动归档、NAS 跨设备同步。Docker Compose 一键部署。欢迎中文用户试用反馈。

discussions.title: 跨平台恢复 session 时 cwd 校验误拒合法绝对路径
discussions.body:
session 恢复时对 `cwd` 的绝对路径校验按*运行进程*的平台判断，而不是按*写入该记录时*的平台判断，导致跨平台读取同一份 session 存储时，本来合法的路径被误判为"非绝对路径"而拒绝恢复。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：在 Windows 主机上创建一个 dsh session（其 `cwd` 会存成形如 `C:\Users\bob\project` 的 win32 绝对路径）；随后把 `$DSH_HOME` 的 session 存储目录通过同步网盘 / WSL / 挂载卷等方式，在 POSIX 主机（Linux / macOS）上打开同一个 session。
- 实际结果：加载失败，抛出 `session header cwd must be an absolute path, got "C:\Users\bob\project"`，即便该 session 的 JSONL 数据本身完好无损。
- 预期结果：session 应能正常恢复，无论创建它的主机与恢复它的主机是否为同一操作系统。
- 环境：`packages/core/session/src/index.ts` 里的 `validateSessionHeader`。根因是它用 `node:path` 的 `isAbsolute`，该函数按*校验时*的 `process.platform` 解析为 `path.win32.isAbsolute` 或 `path.posix.isAbsolute`，而不是按*写入 `cwd` 时*所在的平台判断。反方向（POSIX 创建 → Windows 恢复）恰好因为 `win32.isAbsolute('/foo')` 同样接受以 `/` 开头的路径而不受影响，这也是这个问题此前没被注意到的原因。
- 验收条件：`validateSessionHeader` 对 `cwd` 的校验改为——只要 `path.posix.isAbsolute(cwd)` 或 `path.win32.isAbsolute(cwd)` 任一为真即可通过；并补充一条"恢复的 header 携带另一平台绝对路径"的用例。

</details>

---

因为仓库当前关闭了 Pull Requests，所以按 CONTRIBUTING.md 的建议改在这里报告。修复本身很小（约 6 行改动 + 1 条测试），已经在本地完成、通过测试/typecheck/lint，并按 `.agents/notes` 规范补了对应的双语 Agent Note，推到了 fork 分支，PR 功能开放后可以直接对比合入：

https://github.com/xu-kai-quan/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/session-restore-cross-platform-cwd

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] dsh-tool-transaction — Saga-style compensating transactions for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
## Problem

Agent workflows often execute multiple tools that produce real side effects.

A typical failure case looks like this:

```text
create_order        ✅
reserve_inventory   ✅
charge_payment      ❌
```

At that point, the previous side effects have already happened.

Retrying the whole workflow may create duplicates, while simply stopping leaves the system in an inconsistent state.

## Solution

**dsh-tool-transaction** adds Saga-style compensating transactions to DeepSeek Harness through a `ctx.transaction` service.

Each successful step can register a compensation action. If a later step fails, compensations are executed in **reverse order (LIFO)**.

```text
create_order
      ↓
reserve_inventory
      ↓
charge_payment ❌
      ↓
rollback
      ↓
release_inventory
      ↓
cancel_order
      ↓
ROLLED_BACK
```

> This plugin provides **Saga-style compensation, not distributed ACID transactions**.

## Features

* `ctx.transaction` service
* `begin / step / commit / rollback`
* LIFO reverse-order compensation
* Convenience `run()` API
* Transaction lifecycle events
* Partial rollback detection
* Fail-loud validation

### Transaction states

* `ACTIVE`
* `COMMITTED`
* `ROLLING_BACK`
* `ROLLED_BACK`
* `ROLLBACK_PARTIAL`

### Tool effect classification

* `read-only`
* `reversible`
* `compensatable`
* `irreversible`

Invalid combinations are rejected early, such as attaching compensation to a `read-only` step or directly executing an `irreversible` step inside a compensating transaction.

## Verified end-to-end

The plugin has been tested beyond unit-level mocks:

* ✅ 14/14 unit tests
* ✅ Clean TypeScript build / typecheck
* ✅ Clean `oxlint`
* ✅ Real DeepSeek Harness Profile E2E
* ✅ Real Agent + session-log verification
* ✅ Combined E2E with `@why-daydream/dsh-chaos`

### Chaos + Transaction E2E

```text
create_order        ✅
reserve_inventory   ✅
charge_payment      ❌ HTTP 500 injected by dsh-chaos

rollback
  ↓
release_inventory   ✅
cancel_order        ✅

final = ROLLED_BACK
```

This validates the combination:

```text
Fault Injection
      ↓
Side-effect Failure
      ↓
Saga Compensation
      ↓
Consistent Final State
```

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @why-daydream/dsh-tool-transaction
```

Or pin the current version:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @why-daydream/dsh-tool-transaction@0.1.0
```

## Links

* GitHub: https://github.com/WHY-Daydream/dsh-tool-transaction
* npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@why-daydream/dsh-tool-transaction
* Release: https://github.com/WHY-Daydream/dsh-tool-transaction/releases/tag/v0.1.0

This is the second plugin in my DSH reliability-oriented work:

* `dsh-chaos` → deterministic fault injection
* `dsh-tool-transaction` → side-effect compensation after failures

Feedback on the transaction model, effect classification, and additional recovery scenarios is welcome.

discussions.title: [Feature request] Request-only assistant prefill for agent/pre-step (header-logged, never a session message)
discussions.body:
## Background

My plugin [dsh-plugin-opencode-omo](https://github.com/royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo) replicates opencode + omo over dsh seams. On the budget-limited last step, opencode ends the request with an assistant-role `MAX_STEPS_PROMPT` continuation ([prompt.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts), [llm.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/session/runner/llm.ts), [max-steps.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/session/runner/max-steps.ts)). The role is the feature: the text reads as "the assistant already speaking", so the model keeps writing and stops calling tools.

dsh cannot produce that message. `agent/pre-step` listeners may only return `UserMessage[]`, the loop records the batch as `user/message`, and by the time `agent/request` runs the messages are already derived and frozen, so roles cannot be rewritten. The plugin's current workaround injects the same text as a synthetic user message — the role semantics change and the fidelity gap is observable.

## Current state

`PreStepDecision` is user-only ([runtime-types.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts)):

```ts
export type PreStepDecision =
  | { kind: 'reject' }
  | { kind: 'enter'; messages: UserMessage[] }
```

The loop hardcodes the event role ([agent.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts)):

```ts
for (const message of decision.messages) {
  this.session.append('user/message', message, { surfaceOp: 'append' })
}
```

This mirrors the inbox, not an anti-assistant guard: the entered batch preserves the claimed `UserMessage`s' `id`/`source`, and every feeding queue accepts complete `UserMessage`s ([core.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/core.md), [claimed-pre-step note](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-31-claimed-pre-step-inbox-lifecycle.md)).

`assistant/message` exists but is **the step's one assembled model response**, not a free assistant-role append. Widening `messages` and appending `assistant/message` events therefore breaks consumers that depend on that invariant:

- [session-stats](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/session/session-stats/src/projection.ts) closes the step boundary on the assembled response — a pre-step append would zero the step's `llmMs`/`ttftMs`/`decodeMs`/`decodeTokens`.
- [web turn-tail](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/turn-tail.ts) treats `assistant/message` as the finalized stream, so the UI would end the step early.
- [compaction-basic](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts) resets overflow recovery on any `assistant/message` — a prefill would fake a successful response.
- [token-meter](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts) anchors usage on the assembled response and validates `sourceEventSeqs` against `assistant/chunk`; injected text has no chunk provenance.
- [surface derivation](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/surface.ts) would render the prefill as a visible assistant bubble.

The [session-prefix note](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-07-07-session-prefix.md) supplies the correct pattern: **request-only, header-logged message material** — the prefix never enters the surface, its durable record is the `request/header`, and the invariant companion recomputes it against every request. That note also dropped a request-only *tail* slot because an every-step `after` slot re-pays tokens and busts cache. This proposal reuses the pattern but bounds the cost: the tail exists only when a listener returns one (opencode returns it once, on the final step), and header participation keeps it accounted.

## Proposal

1. Extend the enter variant ([runtime-types.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts)):

```ts
export type PreStepDecision =
  | { kind: 'reject' }
  | {
    kind: 'enter'
    messages: UserMessage[]
    /**
     * Optional request-only assistant continuation appended after the
     * derived history for this step. Logged on the request/header, never
     * appended as a session message. Omission preserves the historical
     * behavior.
     */
    assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage
  }
```

2. In [agent.ts](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts), do **not** append it to the session; pass it through `step()` → `buildRequest()`. The canonical header records it and the request messages become `[...boundaryMessages, assistantPrefill]`:

```ts
const header = canonicalHeader({
  config,
  ...system ? { system } : {},
  ...tools.length > 0 ? { tools } : {},
  ...assistantPrefill === undefined ? {} : { assistantPrefill },
})
// ...
messages: assistantPrefill === undefined
  ? boundaryMessages
  : [...boundaryMessages, assistantPrefill],
```

3. Add `assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage` to [`EpochHeader`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/types.ts), include it in [`canonicalHeader`/`headerEquals`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/request-header.ts), and make the loop's [invariant companion](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent-loop/src/invariant.ts) expect `derived messages + header.assistantPrefill`. "Model-visible ⟺ durably referenced" then holds: the header is the durable non-history record, exactly as for the prefix seam.

4. Make the token-meter price the prefill from the header, and add a regression test: no `assistant/message` before the first `assistant/chunk`, prefill present at the request tail and in the logged header, and `undefined` keeps requests byte-for-byte unchanged.

Why this is safe:

- **No session event is written**, so session-stats, turn-tail, compaction, token-meter chunk anchoring, and the visible transcript are untouched.
- **Reconstruction stays exact**: the prefill's one durable record is the step's `request/header`, folded by the invariant companion.
- **Backward compatible**: the field is optional; `undefined` means identical behavior and headers.
- **Cost is visible and bounded**: only steps whose listener returns a prefill log a header `change` (opencode: one final step).
- **General-purpose**: user input/context goes through the inbox, system text through the system prompt, model output through the loop — a request-only assistant continuation is the only homeless shape, so one role-typed field covers the whole class. Future growth should widen this field (e.g. to a tail message list), never add sibling fields.

## Appendix: patch

Have tested and checked in my plugin:

```diff
diff --git a/packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts b/packages/core/agent/src/runtime-types.ts
@@
-import type { AgentCancelCause, Session, SessionId, UserMessage } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
+import type {
+  AgentCancelCause, AssistantMessage, Session, SessionId, UserMessage,
+} from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session'
@@
 export type PreStepDecision =
   | { kind: 'reject' }
-  | { kind: 'enter'; messages: UserMessage[] }
+  | {
+    kind: 'enter'
+    messages: UserMessage[]
+    /**
+     * Optional request-only assistant continuation appended after the
+     * derived history for this step. Logged on the request/header, never
+     * appended as a session message. Omission preserves the historical
+     * behavior.
+     */
+    assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage
+  }
```

```diff
diff --git a/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts b/packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts
@@
-          const stepEnd = await this.step(decision.assembly)
+          const stepEnd = await this.step(decision.assembly, decision.assistantPrefill)
@@
-  private async step(assembly: PromptAssembly): Promise<StepEndReason | null> {
+  private async step(
+    assembly: PromptAssembly,
+    assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage,
+  ): Promise<StepEndReason | null> {
@@
        const { request, preparedCall } = await this.buildRequest(
-        turn, step, assembly.tools, system, this.session.deriveMessages(), signal,
+        turn, step, assembly.tools, system, this.session.deriveMessages(), signal, assistantPrefill,
       )
@@
   private async buildRequest(
@@
     boundaryMessages: Message[],
     signal: AbortSignal,
+    assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage,
   ): Promise<{ request: GenerateOptions; preparedCall?: PreparedLlmCall }> {
@@
     const header = canonicalHeader({
       config,
       ...preparedCall === undefined ? {} : { adapterDefaults: preparedCall.adapterDefaults },
       ...system ? { system } : {},
       ...tools.length > 0 ? { tools } : {},
+      ...assistantPrefill === undefined ? {} : { assistantPrefill },
     })
@@
     const request = markAgentLoopRequest(deepFreeze({
       ...header.config,
-      messages: boundaryMessages,
+      messages: assistantPrefill === undefined
+        ? boundaryMessages
+        : [...boundaryMessages, assistantPrefill],
       ...header.system !== undefined ? { system: header.system } : {},
       ...header.tools !== undefined ? { tools: header.tools } : {},
       sessionId: this.session.id,
       signal,
     }))
```

```diff
diff --git a/packages/core/session/src/types.ts b/packages/core/session/src/types.ts
@@
 export interface EpochHeader {
   config: LlmCallConfig
   adapterDefaults?: LlmCallConfigAdapterDefaults
   system?: string
   tools?: ToolSchema[]
+  /** Request-only assistant continuation appended after the derived history. */
+  assistantPrefill?: AssistantMessage
 }
```

Also required (same bookkeeping as the prefix seam): `request-header.ts` equality, the loop's invariant companion, token-meter header estimation, and the interception test from step 4.

## Questions to confirm

1. **Naming & vocabulary.** Does `assistantPrefill` fit dsh's existing vocabulary (symmetric with `session-prefix`'s `messagePrefix`), or would `requestTail` / `messageSuffix` better express "request tail, not a session message"?
2. **Message source semantics.** This text is plugin-provided but `assistant`-role. Reusing `AssistantMessage` stamps `source.kind: 'model'` on text the model did not produce, breaking source-as-provenance; should the channel define its own envelope type (minimal role/content/source) so the type boundary and source semantics are explicit?
3. **Cardinality & ordering.** Is the channel's contract one assistant message or an ordered tail list? If it starts singular, should future growth widen this same field (rather than adding sibling fields)? Is the tail's position fixed as "always appended after `deriveMessages()`"?
4. **Durable record & cache envelope.** Are `EpochHeader.assistantPrefill` + `canonicalHeader`/`headerEquals` the right durable home under reconstructable-requests? Beyond the invariant companion and token-meter, are there other request-envelope consumers (compaction / pressure / session export) that must fold in this tail?
5. **Loop-level validation & scope.** `agent/pre-step` currently passes `messages` through untouched. Should this tail likewise get only type-level validation (non-empty content, no tool-call blocks), or does the loop need any structural restriction — for reasons unrelated to any particular budget policy, is there a reason to limit it to a specific class of step?
6. **Observability.** Request-only means no session event and no transcript bubble. Is `request/header` sufficient as the only durable trace, or does dsh's UI/session export need a read-only marker (not a message bubble) for debugging and audit?

## Related

- [core.md](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/docs/subsystems/core.md), [agent README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent/README.md), [agent-loop README](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/agent-loop/README.md) — inbox, pre-step, and step-boundary contracts.
- [Agent Note: claimed pre-step inbox lifecycle](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-31-claimed-pre-step-inbox-lifecycle.md) — why the decision type is `UserMessage[]`.
- [Agent Note: reconstructable requests](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-07-05-reconstructable-requests.md) — why the prefill must be header-logged.
- [Agent Note: session prefix (archived)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/archived/feature/2026-07-07-session-prefix.md) — request-only/header-logged precedent and dropped tail-slot economics.
- [session event types](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/types.ts), [surface derivation](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/core/session/src/surface.ts), [session-stats](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/session/session-stats/src/projection.ts), [web turn-tail](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/turn-tail.ts), [compaction-basic](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts), [token-meter](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/llm/token-meter/src/index.ts) — why `assistant/message` must not be reused for injected prefill.
- opencode reference: [prompt.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/opencode/src/session/prompt.ts), [runner/llm.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/session/runner/llm.ts), [max-steps.ts](https://github.com/sst/opencode/blob/dev/packages/core/src/session/runner/max-steps.ts).
- Consumer patch: [dsh-plugin-opencode-omo patches](https://github.com/royenheart/dsh-plugin-opencode-omo/blob/main/patches/0001-agent-pre-step-assistant-prefill.patch).
- no existing discussion found covering an assistant-role continuation for `agent/pre-step`.

discussions.title: Windows 上 session 项目目录未折叠 cwd 大小写，导致同一项目被拆分
discussions.body:
Windows 上，同一个项目如果通过大小写不同的 `cwd` 拼写被访问（比如两个 ACP 客户端分别传 `C:\Users\Bob\App` 和 `c:\users\bob\app`），JSONL 会话存储会把它们哈希到两个不同的项目目录，把同一个项目的 session 历史拆分到两个 `list()` 永远不会合并的文件夹里。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：用同一个物理项目目录，但两次传入大小写不同的 `cwd`（例如 ACP 的 `params.cwd`，或 `dsh-sdk-server` 的调用方 `cwd`）分别创建 session，比如 `C:\Users\Bob\App` 和 `c:\users\bob\app`。
- 实际结果：两次创建的 session 落在两个不同的项目目录下（`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts` 的 `projectKey` 原样保留 `cwd` 大小写来生成目录名），项目会话列表因此被拆成两份。
- 预期结果：Windows 文件系统本身不区分大小写，同一个物理项目不论以哪种大小写拼写访问，都应该落在同一个项目目录下。
- 环境：`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts` 的 `projectKey`；只在 `process.platform === 'win32'` 时复现，POSIX 上两种大小写拼写本来就是不同目录，不受影响。
- 验收条件：`projectKey` 在构建目录名前，仅在 win32 上把 `cwd` 折叠为小写（与 `packages/fs/fs-sandbox` 的 `isPathUnder` 默认只把 win32 视为大小写不敏感的既有约定保持一致）；补充一条"大小写不同的两个 cwd 在 win32 上产出同一个 key，在 POSIX 上产出不同 key"的用例。

</details>

---

同样因为仓库关闭了 Pull Requests，改在这里报告。修复很小（约 7 行改动 + 2 条测试），已经在本地完成、测试/typecheck/lint 全部通过，并按 `.agents/notes` 规范补了双语 Agent Note，推到了 fork 分支，PR 功能开放后可以直接对比合入：

https://github.com/xu-kai-quan/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/session-project-key-case-fold

（这是这周报告的第二个类似跨平台问题，第一个见 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2405 ，session 恢复时 cwd 绝对路径校验按错了平台。）

discussions.title: dsh-multi-tenant-projects：多租户项目/用户管理插件，未来的 dsh 原生 SaaS基础设施 + 建议官方统一 Web/RPC/WS 权限横截面
discussions.body:
# dsh-multi-tenant-projects：多租户项目/用户管理插件 + 对 DSH 权限横截面的一点建议

这是我的仓库 ，欢迎体验： https://github.com/king-bcolor/dsh-multi-tenant-projects

我把普通用户权限控制到最小了，但是管理员和普通用户共用一台机器很难堵死所有的越狱渠道，所以我干脆不做那么细了，在用户ui层做了隔离，agent层用系统提示词做了软约束，但是如果用户给 dsh 安装了其他插件比如终端，那还是堵不死
做这个插件的时候发现了个很重大的问题，dsh 的权限系统很粗糙，只考虑了agent审批，但对于多角色的读写控制都不行

而且对于 ui、http接口、事件传输，这些地方都少了足够开放整齐的横截面，权限控制没办法做成中间件的样子，dsh 需要扩展一层甚至几层统一的横截面 api，后面不管什么都好做权限控制

如果有横截面拦截所有数据的插件确实安全性问题很大，这个东西最好有api调用的提示，让用户知道这个插件会用到什么数据

权限这块官方下场定标准是最好的了，大家都统一遵守，没有规则的插件在电脑里会打起来

权限搞好了，dsh 自己就能给自己做定制 SaaS 定制 ERP 了 ，让ds大模型在多变的业务规则和数据环境里进行挑战最便于实现AGI了

discussions.title: max-tokens responses containing tool calls can permanently break pi-ai session replay
discussions.body:
## Summary

A successful stream that terminates with `max-tokens` and contains a tool call can persist an assistant message whose durable content no longer matches its adapter replay state. On the next request, pi-ai history reconstruction rejects that message with:

```text
invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
```

The request fails during local history reconstruction, before it reaches the provider. Once such a message is stored, every subsequent “continue” for that session fails the same way.

## Impact

- The unsafe/truncated tool call is correctly not executed.
- Safe assistant content is retained.
- However, the original replay state still describes the removed tool-call block.
- The persisted assistant content and `replayState.blocks` therefore have different lengths.
- Existing sessions containing this deterministic mismatch become permanently unreplayable.

I reproduced this with a real session using a pi-ai-backed provider. The truncated block was a large tool call; the durable assistant content retained reasoning/text blocks while replay state retained reasoning/text/tool-call blocks.

## Root cause

`BlockAssembler.blocks()` intentionally removes tool calls on max-token truncation:

```ts
blocks(): ContentBlock[] {
  const blocks = this.order.map(index => this.assemble(this.mustGet(index), index))
  return this.finish.kind === 'max-tokens'
    ? blocks.filter(block => block.type !== 'tool-call')
    : blocks
}
```

But its replay-state accessor still returns the original terminal state:

```ts
get replayState(): unknown {
  return this._replayState
}
```

The agent loop then persists:

```ts
content: assembler.blocks(),
source: {
  provider: request.provider,
  model: request.model,
  ...assembler.replayState !== undefined
    ? { replayState: assembler.replayState }
    : {},
}
```

For example, the stored message can contain `[reasoning, text]` while replay state contains `[reasoning, text, tool-call]`.

On resume, pi-ai replay validation correctly enforces:

```ts
if (state.blocks.length !== message.content.length) {
  return invalidReplay('block count does not match assistant content')
}
```

That invariant is right; the writer violated it.

## Proposed fix

Patch branch: https://github.com/youkongling/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/max-tokens-replay-state  
Patch commit: https://github.com/youkongling/deepseek-harness/commit/f6bbb24a439c10c1901566b8f8b96ce08c50da36  
Raw patch: https://github.com/youkongling/deepseek-harness/commit/f6bbb24a439c10c1901566b8f8b96ce08c50da36.patch

### 1. Keep new writes aligned

When max-token safety filtering removes at least one tool call, `BlockAssembler.replayState` now returns `undefined`. The persisted assistant content and persisted replay metadata therefore remain consistent.

Max-token responses without tool calls retain replay state, as do normally completed responses.

### 2. Recover the known historical corruption without weakening validation

Sessions written by the old behavior may already contain the mismatch. The pi-ai conversion layer now recognizes only the exact legacy shape:

- replay `stopReason` is `length`;
- replay has more blocks than durable content;
- durable content contains no tool calls;
- after removing replay tool-call blocks, the remaining replay block sequence aligns with durable content.

Such a message is translated as provider-neutral history. Other malformed states, provider/model mismatches, unsupported versions, and unrelated block mismatches continue to fail explicitly with `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`.

This preserves fail-loud replay validation while unbricking sessions corrupted by this specific writer bug.

## Tests added

- `BlockAssembler` drops replay state when max-token filtering removes a tool call.
- `BlockAssembler` retains max-token replay state when no tool call was filtered.
- Agent-loop max-token regression verifies that tool calls are not executed and the logged assistant source has no replay state.
- pi-ai replay recovers the legacy `length` + dropped-tool-call corruption as provider-neutral history.
- pi-ai replay keeps valid max-token replay state when no tool call was dropped.
- pi-ai replay still rejects unrelated block-count mismatches.

Validation on top of current `master` (`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`):

```text
vitest run packages/llm/llm packages/core/agent-loop packages/llm/llm-pi-ai
49 test files, 955 tests passed

tsc -b tsconfig.host.json
oxlint <changed source/test files>
verify-translation-pairing packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/README.md
git diff --check
```

The same vulnerable logic is present in current `master` and in the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` runtime packages I inspected.

## 中文说明

这是一个 DSH 核心写入路径的持久化一致性 bug。

当模型输出达到 `max-tokens` 且包含 tool-call 时，DSH 会安全过滤掉可能被截断的 tool-call，避免执行不完整工具调用；但 `BlockAssembler` 仍会把描述原始 tool-call 的 `replayState` 返回给 agent-loop，并随 assistant message 一起持久化。

结果是持久化后的 assistant content 与 `replayState.blocks` 数量不一致。例如：

```text
assistant content: reasoning + text
replay blocks:    reasoning + text + tool-call
```

下次继续该会话时，pi-ai 历史重建会校验失败：

```text
invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
```

这个失败发生在本地历史重建阶段，请求不会真正到达模型，因此该会话后续“继续”会反复失败，表现为永久卡死。

修复思路：

1. 新写入路径：`max-tokens` 安全过滤移除 tool-call 时，同步丢弃 `replayState`，保证持久化内容与回放元数据一致。
2. 旧损坏会话：只窄化恢复确定性损坏特征——`stopReason = length`、replay blocks 多于 durable content、durable content 无 tool-call、去掉 replay 中的 tool-call 后两边完全对齐；此时转换为 provider-neutral 历史继续使用。
3. 其他 replay 版本错误、格式错误、provider/model 不匹配、无关 block mismatch 仍然保持 fail-loud，继续抛 `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`。

修复分支：

https://github.com/youkongling/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/max-tokens-replay-state

修复提交：

https://github.com/youkongling/deepseek-harness/commit/f6bbb24a439c10c1901566b8f8b96ce08c50da36

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness for VS Code
discussions.body:
A huge thank you to the DeepSeek team for open-sourcing DeepSeek Harness! 🙌 I really like how Harness brings agents, tools, and sessions together, while the Cordis architecture leaves plenty of room for community extensions. I built a VS Code sidebar on top of these capabilities.

🔗 Project: https://github.com/Lixxx1/dsh-vscode

Feedback, issues, and pull requests are all welcome! 🚀

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] Harness Desktop for Windows：桌宠、主题、插件市场与安全更新
discussions.body:
我把官方 `dsh web` 工作台封装成了一个开源 Windows 桌面客户端，目标是让不熟悉 Node.js 和命令行的用户也能直接安装使用。

项目与下载：

- 源码：https://github.com/baiyuscc13724-max/deepseek-harness-desktop
- 最新稳定版：https://github.com/baiyuscc13724-max/deepseek-harness-desktop/releases/latest
- 当前版本：v1.0.12（Windows 10/11 x64，中文安装版与便携版）

桌面端仍然使用官方 Harness Web UI 作为唯一工作台，没有重做会话、项目、权限或终端。桌面壳负责本机运行时启动、Windows 安装、系统托盘和经过 SHA-256 校验的更新。

额外提供的桌面功能：

- 设置内的 DSH 插件与 Skills 市场，英文简介可显示中文摘要；
- 主模型与子代理可以跟随或独立路由；
- 可切换主题、自定义背景，以及可选的女仆鲸桌宠；
- 代理环境适配、中文升级提示和安装位置保留；
- 用户主题、插件和模型路由保存在用户目录，更新官方 Harness 时不会覆盖。

项目是社区维护的非官方客户端，不代表 DeepSeek 官方背书。桌面壳采用 MIT License；女仆鲸美术资源单独采用 CC BY-NC-SA 4.0，仅限非商业使用。仓库保留了来源、许可证、安全边界和完整发布校验说明。

欢迎 Windows 用户反馈安装、代理、插件兼容和官方版本升级问题。现在的发布门禁包含 86 项自动测试、打包产物审计和安装包 SHA-256 校验。

---

Harness Desktop is an unofficial, community-maintained Windows client for the official DeepSeek Harness Web UI. It bundles the local runtime and adds a Chinese installer, portable build, verified updates, plugin and Skills discovery, model routing, themes, and an optional desktop pet. The official Harness workbench remains the only workspace UI.

discussions.title: 死循环
discussions.body:
# Harness Bug Report: run_code 脚本死循环 + 工具层数据一致性问题

- 仓库: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness (apps/cli, @deepseek-ai/dsh)
- 版本: 0.1.0-rc.6
- 环境: Windows 10 (10.0.19044), Node v24.18.0, pwsh 后端, Web GUI 会话
- 场景: agent 通过 `run_code` 编写脚本,对 ~200 个源文件做批量查找-替换迁移(utility/css、utility/attribute 等 C++ 工程)

## 1. [严重] 单次 run_code 执行无迭代/时长预算,工具调用循环可直接把会话卡死

agent 生成的脚本用 "grep 找下一个匹配 → edit 替换 → 再 grep" 的 while/guard 循环处理多文件。当一次 edit 的结果仍满足下一次 grep 的模式(例如替换文本中仍含被搜模式、或 old==new 时),循环在同一行上永远重新匹配,没有进度推进。harness 对单次 `run_code` 的工具调用总数/总时长没有任何上限或看门狗,于是会话(该任务)整体挂起,只能人工 kill 整个任务才能恢复。

复现要点(伪代码):

```ts
for (let guard = 0; guard < 80; ++guard) {
  const m = await tools.grep({ pattern: "X\\(\\w+\\);$", path: f });
  if (!m.matches.length) break;
  await tools.edit({ file_path: f, old_string: m.matches[0].line, new_string: sameText });
  // 若 new == old,下一次 grep 仍命中同一行 → 死循环
}
```

期望:harnharness 为 `run_code` 提供「单次执行最大工具调用次数 / 最大墙钟时间」并强制中断(类似 goal 轮次),或至少在无进展时终止。

## 2. [中] tools.grep 的 `$` 行尾锚点与 tools.read 的行内容不一致

观测:文件行 `  return GetAreaView()->GetAreaFeatures()->GetAlt();` 确实存在,但 `tools.grep({ pattern: "GetAlt\\(\\);$" })` 返回 0 条;去掉 `$` 后命中。说明 grep 侧对行尾(可能 \r\n / 尾随空白)的处理与 read 侧不一致。这一差异直接导致上一条的「找不到 → 反复重试」循环被写出。

## 3. [严重] tools.read 在大文件/超长行文件上静默丢行,配合 write 造成文件截断损坏

实测三次:

1. 一个 11,688 行的 .cc 文件,某次读-改-写循环后磁盘上只剩 1,718 行(中间函数被腰斩),git diff 显示 -12,462 行;
2. 一个 1,771 行的文件,单次 `tools.read({ offset: 1, limit: 2000 })` 只返回 1,482 行,而 `totalLines` 报告 1771 —— 丢行是静默的,没有任何报错;
3. 同一轮里 4 个子类文件(button/img/input/textarea_features.cc)分别丢失 30~45 行中间内容(函数体腰斩),导致后续编译报"函数内混入别的函数尾部"。

期望:`read` 返回的行数与 `totalLines` 必须一致或显式报错;绝不静默丢弃中间行。

## 4. [中] grep 行号在一次脚本内多次 edit 后漂移

同一个 `run_code` 里"先 grep 拿行号、再按行号 read 取内容"的流水线,在前面的 edit 改变了行数后,后面 grep 返回的行号指向旧内容(read 出来的首行与 grep 匹配文本不一致,出现大量 "nodef/set? 漂移" 跳过)。行号应被视为易失信息,建议 grep/read 提供内容级定位(如 `grep --with-context` 或按匹配文本直接返回)。

## 5. [低] edit 的 "requires reading first" 缓存语义不清

同一脚本内前几次 edit 成功,后续对另一文件的首次 edit 报 "requires reading first";而先调用一次小范围 read 再 edit 即可成功,说明"已读"状态有文件级缓存,但失效规则不透明。建议在错误信息中直接说明要求(读哪个文件)。

## 附加

- 受影响任务:utility/css + utility/attribute 的 String→U16String 迁移(外部项目,不涉及 harness 仓库代码)。
- 恢复手段全靠 `git checkout` + 重放 edit 列表,期间多次中断(用户 kill)。
- 复现环境即本机;如需要可提供最小化复现脚本。

discussions.title: Multi-plugin collaboration conventions for developing several tree-out plugins in one checkout
discussions.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek Harness 的文档已经很好地覆盖了「单个插件如何开发、打包、发布」(`docs/user/develop/basic/`)。但当我们**在同一个仓库 checkout 里同时开发多个独立插件**时（例如一个 `prototypes/` 目录，各自有 package.json 和 node_modules），缺少一份官方的协作约定，几个团队/agent 会话很容易互相踩到：

- 多个插件都要把自己加进 `pnpm-workspace.yaml`，互相覆盖；
- 共享的 `pnpm-lock.yaml` 被某一个插件的 install 改乱，影响其他插件；
- 一个会话的沙箱/构建行为（如 esbuild/tsx spawn）影响另一个会话；
- 插件的记忆文件（`.dsh/hme/*`）可能串到别的插件工作区。

## 建议

是否可以在 `docs/`（或一个面向插件开发者/贡献者的位置）补充一份「多插件同仓库协作约定」，涵盖：

1. 每个插件自包含（自己的 node_modules、src、tests）；
2. `pnpm-workspace.yaml` 只追加自己的条目，不覆盖别人；
3. 依赖安装在插件目录内，不碰根 lockfile；
4. 不改官方共享文件（AGENTS.md / packages/ / vendor/）；
5. 沙箱边界（no-pipe-spawn）与提权建议；
6. 插件记忆隔离 + 跨插件经验共享的落点。

## 我们的落地（可作参考）

我们在自己的 checkout 里放了一份 `prototypes/AGENTS.md` 作为本地约定（通过 agent-instructions 自动注入给该目录下的会话）。如果官方认可这个方向，我们可以把它整理成符合 DSH 文档规范的贡献提交 PR；或者官方如有更好的位置/形式，我们配合调整。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness: 0.1.0-rc.x (从源码运行)
- 场景: 同一 checkout 下开发多个 tree-out 插件

discussions.title: Show and tell: dsh-artifacts — Claude-Artifacts-style HTML rendering (Markdown + JSON -> documents/cards/dashboards/galleries)
discussions.body:
## dsh-artifacts — Claude-Artifacts-style HTML rendering for DeepSeek Harness

把 Agent 产出的 **Markdown + JSON** 一键变成漂亮、可分享、**自包含**的 HTML 文档 / 卡片 / 仪表盘 / 画廊。一条命令，零运行时依赖。

Turn raw agent output (Markdown + JSON) into beautiful, shareable, **self-contained** HTML documents, cards, dashboards, and galleries. One command, zero runtime dependencies.

### 为什么 / Why
- 不需要设计能力：选模板 + 主题即可（4 templates, 5 themes）。
- 自包含：CSS 全部内联，无外部请求，离线永久可用。
- 两种用法：CLI 给你用，`artifact_render` 工具给 Agent 用。
- 零运行时依赖（Node >= 18）。

### 安装 / Install
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artifacts
# or
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-artifacts
```

### CLI
```sh
pnpm add -g dsh-artifacts
dsh-artifacts notes.md --title "Release notes" --theme dark --out notes.html
dsh-artifacts --data metrics.json --template dashboard --theme brand
dsh-artifacts notes.md --serve 8080
```

### 截图 / Screenshots
![dashboard demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoahdev/dsh-artifacts/main/demo/preview-dashboard.png)
![doc demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zoahdev/dsh-artifacts/main/demo/preview-doc.png)

### 已验证 / Verified
- Tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools ^0.1.0-rc.6` and `@deepseek-ai/cordis ^4.0.1`.
- CI 全绿：build → unit tests → pack → 安装真实 tarball → 加载打包产物 → 真实执行 `artifact_render` handler → 断言输出。
- Runtime guard：解析到更旧的 RC 时直接报错，而不是运行时才翻车。

仓库 / Repo: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-artifacts
在线 Demo / Live demo: https://zoahdev.github.io/dsh-artifacts/

这是社区插件（非官方）。欢迎反馈——尤其是 Markdown 子集覆盖，以及是否需要 streaming / live-data 模式。

discussions.title: 终端卡片错误地把 Windows 盘符相对路径当成定根路径
discussions.body:
终端卡片在展示 cwd 时，会把 Windows 的盘符相对路径（比如 `C:temp\..\logs`，没有分隔符紧跟冒号，含义是"相对于 C: 盘当前的工作目录"）误当成盘符定根路径处理，导致展示出来的路径含义变了。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：让 bash/pwsh 工具调用的 `workdir` 参数是一个盘符相对路径，比如 `C:temp\..\logs` 或 `C:..\foo`，且当前没有已知的 session cwd 可供解析。
- 实际结果：`packages/client/ui-tool/src/client/tool/models/terminal-card-model.ts` 的 `normalizeSegments` 把 `C:temp\..\logs` 展示成 `C:\logs`——开头的 `..` 被静默丢弃，盘符后凭空多出一个它原本没有的分隔符，路径从"盘符相对"变成了"盘符定根"，含义完全不同。`C:..\foo` 同理会被错误展示成 `C:\foo`。
- 预期结果：盘符相对路径（冒号后没有分隔符）应该保持相对：`C:temp\..\logs` 应展示为 `C:logs`；`C:..\foo` 这种开头就是 `..` 且无处可解析的情况应原样保留为 `C:..\foo`（这和函数自己的文档承诺一致：无处可解析的 `..` 应当原样保留，不能被静默丢弃）。
- 环境：`packages/client/ui-tool/src/client/tool/models/terminal-card-model.ts` 的 `normalizeSegments`；纯展示层问题，不影响命令实际执行。
- 验收条件：是否"已定根"改为按"盘符后是否紧跟分隔符"判断（而不是"是否存在盘符"），`collapse` 和输出拼接的分隔符插入统一取用这个值；补充盘符相对路径的用例。

</details>

---

同样因为仓库关闭了 Pull Requests，改在这里报告。修复很小（约 5 行改动，还顺带少了一行 + 2 条测试），已经在本地完成、测试/typecheck/lint 全部通过，并按 `.agents/notes` 规范补了双语 Agent Note，推到了 fork 分支，PR 功能开放后可以直接对比合入：

https://github.com/xu-kai-quan/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/terminal-card-drive-relative-cwd

（这是这周报告的第三个类似问题，前两个见 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2405 和 https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2408 。）

discussions.title: Proposal: three minimal seams to enable a multi-session split-pane community plugin (with working prototype)
discussions.body:
## Summary

We prototyped a **multi-session split-pane UI** for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI (up to 4 panes: 2×2 / left-1-right-2 / side-by-side presets, per-pane session binding, persistence, empty-pane session picker reusing the sidebar's own session rows) by patching the published `0.1.0-rc.x` packages. It works and is validated by an 18-assertion real-browser E2E suite plus unit/smoke/render tests, with zero regression in single-pane mode.

The pane logic itself is pure plugin-shaped code (registers into slots, injects `sessions`/`workspaces`/`locale`/`layout`, ships its own locale NS). However, a **community plugin cannot be distributed cleanly today**, because three small capabilities are private to the core. This post proposes three minimal seams. Each is small, bounded, and generally useful beyond this feature (e.g., future side-by-side subagent viewing).

Proof-of-concept archive (patches + docs + full test suite): https://github.com/starsmaplee/dsh-multi-session-panes-study

---

## Seam 1 — Per-session binding provider (renderer)

- **Where**: `packages/client/web-react` (session-provider region, next to the existing `SessionProvider`); shell wiring in `apps/web/src/main.ts`.
- **Change**: export `SessionProviderFor({ id, empty, children })` that subscribes to a per-session provide cell and wraps children in the binding context (keyed remount on id change), and expose it from the shell as an official global (e.g. `window.__DSH_SESSION_PROVIDER_FOR__`).
- **Why**: the session binding context is currently private to the bundled renderer, so a plugin cannot render the conversation slot tree under an *arbitrary* session's scope — only "current".

## Seam 2 — Center-column slot seam (layout)

- **Where**: `packages/client/ui-layout` root registration (`AppFrame`); one conditional registration in `packages/client/ui-conversation`.
- **Change**: declare a `center` slot (`kind: "single", scope: "root"`) and render it in the center column with a fallback: `renderSlot("center", {}, { fallback: renderSlot("conversation", {}) })`. The conversation plugin additionally registers into `pane.conversation` behind `ctx.slots.inject("pane.conversation", …)` (the existing wait-for-declaration pattern), so it activates only when a panes plugin declares it.
- **Why**: the center column is currently hard-wired to the `conversation` slot; plugins cannot take it over without forking the whole frame.

## Seam 3 — Two generic multi-session runtime capabilities

- **Where**: `packages/client/runtime` (`SessionRuntime`).
- **Change**: add
  - `provideInfoCell(id)` — an observable per-session provide-bundle cell (snapshot falls back to the static no-session projection; notified on roster rebuilds and scope mint/drop), and
  - `adopt(id)` — opens a session's history window without moving the current selection (`resolve(id)` + `record.session.open()`, idempotent).
- **Why**: multi-pane rendering needs "subscribe to this session's provide info" and "stage a window that is not current"; both are generic, and today only "current" is observable.

## Evidence / feasibility

- A complete prototype exists; every behavior — presets, drag fidelity (1.0× mouse tracking), session binding from the picker, keyboard focus, persistence, no-console-errors — is covered by automated tests that can be contributed alongside.
- Single-pane behavior is unchanged by construction (the fallback path).
- The prototype's development also produced a lessons log (grid-collapse, drag-accumulation, click-vs-pointerdown, selector-equality pitfalls) that may be useful for plugin authors generally.

## Ask

Either (a) adopt these three seams upstream so community plugins can build on them, or (b) give feedback on the approach so we can adjust the prototype before finalizing. Happy to provide the test suite and the plugin-shaped code as reference.

---

## 中文概述

我们通过在已发布的 `0.1.0-rc.x` 包上打补丁，原型实现了 Web GUI 的**多会话分屏**（最多 4 窗格：2×2 / 左1右2 / 左右预设、每窗格独立绑定会话、持久化、空窗格会话选择器直接复用侧边栏行组件）。功能可用，并通过 18 项真实浏览器 E2E 断言及单元/烟测/渲染测试验证，单窗格模式零回归。

分屏逻辑本身完全是插件形态；但**社区插件目前无法干净分发**，因为三个小能力是内核私有的。本贴提案三个最小缝隙，每个都很小、有界，且在此功能之外具有通用价值：

1. **按会话绑定的渲染 Provider**（`packages/client/web-react` + `apps/web/src/main.ts`）：导出 `SessionProviderFor({ id, empty, children })` 并挂到官方全局——让插件能把会话槽位树渲染在任意会话的作用域下。
2. **中心栏槽缝**（`packages/client/ui-layout`）：声明 `center` 槽并以 `fallback: renderSlot("conversation", {})` 保持默认行为；conversation 插件经 `ctx.slots.inject("pane.conversation", …)` 条件注册。
3. **两个通用运行时能力**（`packages/client/runtime`）：`provideInfoCell(id)`（按会话订阅提供信息）与 `adopt(id)`（不动当前选择地打开窗口）。

可行性证据（补丁 + 文档 + 完整测试套件）：https://github.com/starsmaplee/dsh-multi-session-panes-study

**请求**：(a) 采纳这三个缝隙，或 (b) 对方案给出反馈，以便我们定型。我们乐于提供测试套件与插件形态代码作为参考。

discussions.title: 建议为 Context Compaction 增加事实级溯源索引（fact-level provenance）
discussions.body:
## 背景

我在阅读当前 context compaction 实现时注意到：DSH 已经很好地保留了原始会话事件，也会在 `compaction/summary` 中记录被遮蔽的范围和 `shadowedSeqs`；但压缩后的 checkpoint 仍是一段自由文本摘要，缺少“某一条事实具体来自哪些历史事件”的事实级索引。

因此，这里的缺口不是“原文被删除”，而是“摘要中的事实与原始证据之间没有可供模型使用的映射”。当后续任务突然需要某个被压缩掉的精确细节时，模型知道这段历史曾被压缩，却不知道应该优先读取哪个 event，只能依赖摘要、全文搜索或扫描整个被遮蔽范围。

以下观察基于 commit [`47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/commit/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a)。

## 当前行为

1. 摘要器逐字重放当前会话的 system prompt、tool schemas 和待压缩区域的 model-visible messages，然后将固定压缩指令作为最后一条 user message 追加。这保留了已有的 KV cache 前缀：[`region.ts#L488-L513`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts#L488-L513)、[`summarizer.ts#L145-L163`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts#L145-L163)。
2. 当前摘要模板要求保留文件路径、命令、错误字符串、标识符和数值，但没有要求输出这些事实的来源：[`summarizer.ts#L31-L66`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/summarizer.ts#L31-L66)。
3. 成功压缩后，`compaction/summary` 保存完整的 `shadowedSeqs`，replacement checkpoint 的 `sourceEventSeqs` 也引用整个被遮蔽范围，但它们表达的是“这份摘要来自这一段历史”，并不能回答“摘要里的事实 F001 来自 event 123”：[`region.ts#L447-L465`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/region.ts#L447-L465)。
4. 如果挂载了 `dsh-tool-session-query`，模型已经可以通过 `session_event_read` 精确读取事件；但 shipped host compositions 默认不挂载它，而且 checkpoint 本身也没有告诉模型应该读取哪个 seq：[`tool-session-query/README.md#L5-L16`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/session-query/tool-session-query/README.md#L5-L16)。

## 一个具体场景

假设历史工具结果中包含：

- 某次失败命令的完整参数；
- 一个只出现过一次的错误字符串；
- 用户明确否决过的实现方案；
- 某个文件在当时对应的精确路径和行号。

摘要可能正确保留“命令失败，后来改用方案 B”，但省略了精确参数。数十轮之后，模型发现必须重新核对这个参数。原始事件仍然存在，可当前 checkpoint 只提供整个 `shadowedSeqs` 集合，没有告诉模型这条事实最可能落在哪个 event。原文“可恢复”，但缺少低成本的恢复路径。

## 建议：为 checkpoint 增加事实级 provenance index

### 1. 给摘要模型提供确定性的 source labels

不要让模型自行编造引用。可以在最终的 compaction instruction 中附加一份由 Harness 生成的映射，例如：

```text
The model-visible messages above correspond, in order, to these durable sources:
M1 -> event:120
M2 -> event:124
M3 -> event:127
```

映射位于最后一条新 user message 中，不修改前面逐字重放的 system/tools/messages，因此理论上仍能保留当前的 warm-prefix KV cache 复用策略。

### 2. 在摘要中增加有上限的 `Fact Index`

例如：

```markdown
## Fact Index

- F001 | User rejected database migration A | sources: [event:120] | basis: user_instruction
- F002 | `pnpm test foo.spec.ts` failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` | sources: [event:124, event:127] | basis: observed
- F003 | Next edit should target `packages/example/src/index.ts` | sources: [event:130] | basis: inferred
```

只索引对继续任务有价值、未来可能需要核验的事实，不需要给摘要里的每个普通句子都加引用。可以配置或固定最大 facts 数量、单条引用数和总 token 预算，避免索引反过来让摘要膨胀。

### 3. 在落盘前校验引用

Harness 可以验证摘要引用的 event id 是否属于本次输入或其 provenance closure。无效引用不应静默进入 checkpoint。具体实现可以选择：

- 将 fact index 解析成机器可读字段存入 `compaction/summary`；或
- 先保留 Markdown 表达，但对引用语法和 event id 做确定性校验。

对于再次压缩旧 checkpoint 的情况，应保留仍然有效事实的 leaf-source ids，而不是把全部来源折叠成“上一份 checkpoint 的 event id”。

### 4. 将索引与按需读取连接起来

当 `session_event_read` 可用时，后续模型可以直接根据 `[event:127]` 获取完整原始 JSON，而不需要全文搜索。对于没有挂载 session-query tool 的组合，索引仍然能提升日志审计和人工调试能力；也可以考虑提供一个权限更窄、仅允许读取当前会话被引用事件的工具。

## 与 tool-result pruning 的关系

`dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner` 会在摘要前把超大 `tool/result` 改成 head + omission marker + tail，但原始结果仍通过 `sourceEventSeqs` 留在 append-only log：[`compaction-tool-result-pruner/README.md#L5-L17`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a/packages/compaction/compaction-tool-result-pruner/README.md#L5-L17)。事实索引无法恢复摘要模型从未看到的中间内容，但可以沿 replacement/source 链指回原始结果，使未来模型在确认需要细节时读取原文。

## 预期价值

- **降低摘要失真风险**：把“模型记得的事实”和“原始证据”分开，允许后续核验。
- **更低成本地恢复细节**：从扫描整个历史范围变成按 event 精确读取。
- **提升调试与审计能力**：可以判断某个结论来自用户消息、模型推断还是工具结果。
- **支持渐进式上下文**：常态只携带短摘要，只有真正需要时才展开原始事件。
- **保留现有缓存收益**：source map 作为最后一条 compaction instruction 的新增尾部，不必改写已有请求前缀。

## 建议的验收条件

- 每条被索引的事实至少带一个可验证的 source event；
- 摘要不能引用不存在或不属于 provenance closure 的 event；
- 多轮 compaction 后仍能追溯到原始 leaf events；
- 对被 prune 的 tool result，可以沿 source chain 找回原始事件；
- index 的 token/条目数有明确上限，且继续服从现有“摘要必须比原文更小”的收敛约束；
- 增加 source labels 后，原始 system/tools/message prefix 仍保持逐字一致，不破坏现有 KV cache 设计；
- 没有挂载 history-read 工具时，模型不会被提示调用不存在的工具。

这是一个设计建议。我比较想听听维护者对两个问题的判断：fact index 更适合成为 `compaction/summary` 的机器可读字段，还是先作为 checkpoint Markdown 的稳定约定；以及 current-session、cited-event-only 的按需读取能力是否值得进入默认 composition。

discussions.title: DSH | Token Dashboard | 本地 Token 用量周/日视图与持久化统计面板
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

项目地址：https://github.com/apodemakeles/dsh-token-dashboard  
最新版本：https://github.com/apodemakeles/dsh-token-dashboard/releases/tag/v0.2.0

## 项目介绍

Token Dashboard 是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 插件，用 GitHub Contributions 风格的周视图热力图和日视图柱状图，展示本机所有 DSH 会话的 Token 消耗。

它把已持久化的 usage 事件异步投影到本地 SQLite。面板打开时只查询一致快照，不扫描全部会话日志；首次安装会在后台初始化既有历史数据。数据只保存在本机。

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

- 通过 DSH `session/event` 和公共 persistence API 接收、确认用量事件。
- 在 Web GUI 侧边栏注册 **Token** 入口。
- 常驻 Worker 批量维护 SQLite Usage facts、checkpoint 和异常恢复状态。
- 提供 `status / verify / rebuild / backups / restore / cleanup` 本地维护 CLI。

## 界面截图

### 周视图

![Token Dashboard 周视图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apodemakeles/dsh-token-dashboard/main/docs/images/token-dashboard-weekly.png)

### 日视图

![Token Dashboard 日视图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/apodemakeles/dsh-token-dashboard/main/docs/images/token-dashboard-daily.png)

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:apodemakeles/dsh-token-dashboard
```

安装后重启 `dsh web`，打开任意项目会话，点击侧边栏的 **Token** 入口。

当前通过 GitHub 分发，尚未发布 npm 包。
