discussions.title: 任何 Editor，皆可成为 DSH Editor：用 MCP Apps 打通编辑、保存与 Agent 回读
discussions.body: > **任何 Editor，皆可成为 DSH Editor。** ## 最新更新：v0.3.1 [`@creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor@0.3.1`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor) 已发布： - 修复从 Session 历史恢复 MCP App 时使用旧进程 `viewId` 的问题；持久化结果会在校验工具名和 `ui://` Resource 后重新绑定当前 MCP Server； - Session Header 提供持续可达的 MCP Apps 入口，可在同一 Session 的多个 App 之间切换； - App 可在 inline 与 fullscreen 之间移动，不重建 iframe 或 AppBridge，因此未保存的 View 状态不会因切换丢失； - **Locate in Chat** 可从 Header 或 fullscreen 返回产生该 App 的工具消息。 [观看最新视频演示](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=KkvLgN2GeTI)。 我做了两个社区项目： - [`@creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor`](https://github.com/creativedswork/dsh-uni-editor)：让 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 运行标准 MCP Apps； - [`threejs-editor-mcp`](https://github.com/creativedswork/threejs-editor-mcp)：一个带项目存储、revision 和 app-only 工具的 Three.js Editor MCP Server。 我想验证一种协作方式：不同领域继续使用自己的 Editor；开发者通过 MCP Apps 把它们接入 Agent Chat。用户完成可视化编辑并保存后，Agent 读取同一份项目状态和操作记录，再继续工作。 统一的是 Editor 的运行入口、会话上下文和人机交接协议。 ## 34 秒操作闭环 这段录制使用了真实 Agent 回复： 1. Agent 创建一个 Three.js Pong 项目并打开 Editor。 2. 用户把桌面布局从 `classic` 调成 `wide`，再把相机从 `broadcast` 调成 `overhead`。 3. 用户点击 **Save**。App 通过 app-only `push_project` 保存新 revision 和两条操作记录，然后发送标准 `ui/message`。 4. 下一轮中，Agent 调用 `inspect_project`，读到最新 revision、布局、视角和人工操作，再说明它看到的变化以及后续计划。 从用户视角看，Editor 留在当前任务内。Agent 收到准确的项目状态和操作记录。 ## 什么是 DSH Editor `DSH Editor` 指通过 MCP Apps 接入 DSH 的领域 Editor。它保留自己的 UI、数据模型和交互方式，同时获得四个协作能力： - 在 Agent Chat 内渲染，不要求用户切到独立站点； - 人和 Agent 围绕同一个持久化项目与 revision 工作； - 用户操作通过 app-only 工具写入项目，模型只调用 model-visible 工具； - 保存后的状态和操作记录可以进入下一轮 Agent 工作。 Three.js 只是当前的验证样例。同样的模式可以用于 CAD、流程图、关卡、数据建模或其他带结构化项目状态的 Editor。 ## 实现 `@creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor` 是一个可安装的 Cordis bundle。它同时提供 Host 插件、Browser bundle 和 profile patch，通过 Harness 的公开插件与 Session API 完成交接，并在进程内连接 MCP Server、托管 View。 当前实现覆盖： - MCP Apps `2026-01-26` 和 `text/html;profile=mcp-app`； - stdio 与 Streamable HTTP； - model-visible、app-visible 和 app-only 工具； - `ui://` Resource、AppBridge 生命周期和 App 发起的工具/资源调用； - `ui/message` 交接和受限 JSON 下载； - Session Header 多 App 入口、inline/fullscreen 切换和 **Locate in Chat**； - 从 Session 历史恢复 App，并重新绑定当前 MCP Server； - View 失败时的普通文本回退。 Three.js Server 将项目保存在本地。人工保存和模型修改都检查 revision；同一项目的写入会串行执行，并通过临时文件 rename 提交。Editor 还支持层级树、Viewport 拾取、变换控件、Inspector、撤销/重做、资源导入和项目导出。 ## 安全边界 Harness UI 和 Sandbox Proxy 使用不同的 loopback origin。MCP App View 运行在双层 iframe 中；Host 通过 HTTP CSP、sandbox 属性以及 `postMessage` source/origin 校验限制 View。 Host API 拒绝跨源写入，并限制请求体和 metadata 大小。工具可见性将模型工具与 app-only 工具分开。Three.js Server 还会校验项目路径、revision、资源大小、MIME、文件签名和 symlink。 完整安全图和限制： - https://github.com/creativedswork/dsh-uni-editor#security-architecture - https://github.com/creativedswork/threejs-editor-mcp#security ## 安装 ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add @creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor git clone https://github.com/creativedswork/threejs-editor-mcp.git cd threejs-editor-mcp pnpm install pnpm run build ``` Host 最新版本为 `0.3.1`，已发布到 npm。Three.js Editor Server 目前从源码运行。在 Harness Web profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中配置其构建产物： Three.js Editor 需要 Node.js 22.19 或更高版本，以及 pnpm 10.25。 ```yaml - id: mcp-apps config: servers: - serverName: threejs transport: stdio command: node args: - /absolute/path/to/threejs-editor-mcp/dist/server.js - --root - /absolute/path/to/threejs-projects cwd: /absolute/path/to/threejs-editor-mcp ``` 启动： ```sh dsh web ``` 项目链接： - Host: https://github.com/creativedswork/dsh-uni-editor - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@creative-dswork/dsh-uni-editor - Editor Server: https://github.com/creativedswork/threejs-editor-mcp ## Related community work 社区里已经有两个相邻方向： - [MCP Apps support for DeepSeek Harness #2104](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2104) 提供了另一个独立的 MCP Apps Host 实现，并默认连接 VibeFun； - [让界面成为 Agent 的一种语言 #2114](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2114) 通过 Agent 生成任务级 GenUI，并让后续轮次读取已保存状态。 本文聚焦第三个问题：如何把已有的持久化领域 Editor 作为标准 MCP App 接入 Agent Chat，并让人和 Agent 围绕同一个项目 revision 协作。 下一步我会验证 `threejs-editor-mcp` 在不同 MCP Apps Host 上的基础互操作，区分标准协议能力和 Host 扩展能力。 ## 当前限制 - 仅支持 loopback Web；同一 Session 可登记多个 App，但同一时刻只有一个 fullscreen App； - MCP transport 暂不自动重连； - `ui/message` 当前只接受文本； - Three.js Editor 是用于验证协作模型的轻量实现。 两个项目均采用 MIT License，由社区独立维护。 我想收集两类反馈： 1. 这种“人工编辑、保存、Agent 基于同一 revision 继续工作”的模式是否适合你使用的领域 Editor？ 2. 为了让同一个 Editor 在不同 Host 上运行，哪些行为应该保持为 MCP Apps 标准能力，哪些适合保留为 Host 扩展？

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] Background tool calls repeatedly surface Windows Terminal windows
discussions.body:
## Summary / 摘要

When DSH runs in the background on Windows (for example under PM2) and Windows Terminal is the delegated default terminal, tool subprocesses can surface a new Windows Terminal window. Tool-heavy sessions therefore cause repeated foreground popups. This is independent of the selected LLM provider.

当 DSH 在 Windows 后台运行（例如由 PM2 托管），且 Windows Terminal 是默认终端时，工具子进程可能反复弹出新的 Windows Terminal 窗口。该问题与所选 LLM provider 无关，但工具调用较多时会非常明显。

## Reproduction environment

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`, commit `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`
- Windows 11 build 26200
- Windows Terminal `1.24.11911.0`, configured as delegated terminal/console host
- DSH Web hosted by PM2 in the background
- Windows ACL sandbox active

Process chain:

```text
PM2 daemon -> node -> dsh web -> subprocess-local -> Windows ACL runner -> PowerShell/tool command
```

Invoke a tool that launches a console executable (PowerShell is an easy example). Under this host configuration a Terminal window may be surfaced for each tool process.

## Root cause

There are two process boundaries:

1. The unrestricted outer Node `spawn()` in `subprocess-local` did not request `windowsHide`.
2. The restricted-token inner `CreateProcessAsUserW` path initialized only `STARTF_USESTDHANDLES` and did not request hidden initial presentation.

Using `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` or `CREATE_NEW_CONSOLE` is not a safe substitute here. In native testing, restricted-token children created with those flags fail during DLL initialization with `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142)`. The sandbox must not be weakened merely to suppress UI.

## Proposed fix

- Outer Node spawn:
  - Windows: `windowsHide: true`, `detached: false`
  - POSIX: `windowsHide: false`, `detached: true`
- Restricted-token `STARTUPINFOW`:
  - `dwFlags = STARTF_USESTDHANDLES | STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW`
  - `wShowWindow = SW_HIDE`
- Keep creation flags unchanged; do **not** use `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`.

`SW_HIDE` is an initial window-presentation hint, not console isolation. Restricted token, inherited console semantics, stdio pipes, process-tree cleanup, and ACL enforcement remain intact.

## Validation

- Windows ACL + subprocess focused suite: **15 test files, 164 tests passed**
- Native restricted-token tests cover allowed/denied writes, PowerShell, grandchildren, stdio, read-only and workspace-write
- ABI regression assertions cover both ACL spawn paths
- Spawn-option tests explicitly pin Windows and POSIX pairs
- PM2 probe executed:

```text
visible Windows Terminal windows before: 2
maximum during 12-second restricted PowerShell probe: 2
child exit code: 0
```

No additional Terminal window was observed.

## Reference implementation

Focused branch and commit:

- https://github.com/stoneface10/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/windows-hidden-tool-processes
- `cc21e0a257990d85488307b6668f9e028d11cc54`

Microsoft background-terminal context:

- https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/issues/11627
- https://github.com/microsoft/terminal/issues/12570

Because external PRs are currently not accepted, this Discussion provides the reproducer, rationale, tests, and a ready-to-review patch. I would appreciate maintainer guidance on whether the team would like to import or reimplement this fix.

discussions.title: [Bug] Retry attempts and compaction requests are undercounted in session usage
discussions.body:
## Summary / 摘要

The durable token/session projections can under-report provider requests when retries and context compaction are involved:

1. A failed attempt's usage can be replaced by a successful retry's usage because retries run inside the same `{turn, step}`.
2. A scheduled retry can be counted even when cancellation during backoff prevents the repeated request from starting.
3. `compaction/summary` provider usage is durable but is omitted from whole-session token totals.

These are provider-agnostic accounting issues. They became visible while correlating DSH statistics with subscription-backed model usage.

DSH 当前在 Retry 与 Context Compaction 场景下可能低估完整 provider 请求消耗：失败 attempt 的 usage 被成功 retry 覆盖、退避期间取消的 retry 被当成已执行、Compaction 摘要请求未进入会话总计。

## Minimal event sequences

### 1. Failed attempt followed by successful retry

```text
step/start { turn: 1, step: 1 }
assistant/chunk usage A
llm/retry
llm/retry-started
assistant/chunk usage B
assistant/message usage B
step/end
```

Retries execute inside the same step. If usage identity is only `step:<turn>:<step>`, B replaces A. Expected whole-session billing is `A + B`; last-sample replacement should apply only within one request attempt.

### 2. Cancellation during backoff

```text
llm/retry          # retry scheduled
... cancellation during delay ...
step/end
turn/end aborted
```

No `llm/retry-started` occurs and no repeated provider request starts. Counting `llm/retry` reports one retry although only the original attempt ran.

### 3. Compaction summary usage

```text
compaction/summary {
  provider,
  model,
  usage,
  ...
}
```

This is a separate provider request and should contribute to whole-session usage. It should **not** replace the main model's context-pressure sample because it belongs to the summarizer request.

## Proposed accounting rules

- Continue last-sample replacement for usage chunks/final messages within one attempt.
- On `llm/retry-started`, close/reset replacement adjacency so the next attempt accumulates independently.
- Count actual retries from `llm/retry-started`, not scheduled backoffs from `llm/retry`.
- Add `compaction/summary.usage` to `tokenUsage`, keyed by `compactionId`.
- Keep compaction usage out of `contextPressure`.
- Mirror the production fold in the client fixture.
- Display actual retry attempts and uncached input in the conversation stats row.

## Validation

Focused patch validation:

- `token-meter`: failed-attempt usage + successful retry regression
- `session-stats`: scheduled-but-cancelled retry regression
- client fixture: compaction billing and retry-boundary parity
- conversation UI: only started retries are counted
- **4 test files, 96 tests passed**
- TypeScript project build passed
- Broader integrated modified-package suite previously passed **260 tests**
- Independent review found no remaining blockers

## Reference implementation

Focused bug-fix branch and commit:

- https://github.com/stoneface10/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/complete-token-accounting
- `ccc842215a`

An integrated branch that also contains the separately reported Windows fix is available here:

- https://github.com/stoneface10/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/codex-quota-and-windows-fixes

Because external PRs are currently not accepted, this Discussion provides reproducible event sequences, semantics, tests, and a focused patch. I would appreciate confirmation of the intended accounting semantics and whether maintainers would like to import or reimplement it.

discussions.title: 缺陷报告：Web 静态文件缺失时返回空 400 白屏无诊断（含修复方案）
discussions.body:
**一句话说明错误结果**：当 `dsh web` 运行所依赖的安装目录（例如 `~/.npm/_npx/<hash>`）被清理或损坏时，服务器对每个请求返回**空 body 的 400**，浏览器白屏，UI 表现为按钮点击无反应（如"新建会话"点了没动静），失败原因只存在于服务端日志。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- **复现步骤**：
  1. 启动 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`；
  2. 删除 `dsh-web-frontend` 的 dist 文件（或整个 npx 安装目录）；
  3. 浏览器访问 `http://127.0.0.1:3080/` 或点击「新建会话」。
- **实际结果**：`GET /` 返回 400 + 空 body；浏览器白屏；控制台仅显示资源加载失败（Failed to load resource）。
- **预期结果**：返回带错误信息的可读诊断页，说明请求失败及原因，用户能据此定位并修复。
- **环境**：macOS，dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）。
- **验收条件**：静态文件缺失时请求返回 4xx 且 body 为含错误消息的 HTML 诊断页；服务器对后续请求继续正常服务。

</details>

## 修复方案（已实现，供参考/合入）

根因：`dsh-host-webserver` 的最后兜底守卫在 handler 抛错时只应答裸 400 + 空 body。

改动：兜底守卫改为返回**自包含的 HTML 诊断页**（HTTP 400 + `text/html` + HTML 转义后的失败原因），空 body 不再出现；400 状态码与 headers-sent 时销毁 socket 的既有契约不变。页面刻意保持通用——恢复指引（重装安装目录）属于前端持有者。

- 分支：`hoshF/deepseek-harness` 的 `fix/webserver-error-page`（sha `76ef1257`）
- Agent Note：[2026-08-16-webserver-request-error-page](https://github.com/hoshF/deepseek-harness/blob/fix/webserver-error-page/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-16-webserver-request-error-page.md)
- 验证：vitest REAL 组合套件（400/text/html/错误消息/HTML 转义/非 Error 兜底）、`build:lib:host`、`lint`、`typecheck`、`verify-agent-note-format`、`verify-translation-pairing`（937 对）全部通过

> 说明：本仓库禁用了 Issues 且 CONTRIBUTING 注明暂不接受外部 PR（`CreatePullRequest` 权限被拒），故先在此报告，供维护者参考或自行合入。

discussions.title: dsh-plugins 系列：14 个零配置工具插件（一键安装）
discussions.body:
# dsh-plugins 系列：14 个零配置工具插件（一键安装）

给 DeepSeek Harness 社区交个作业：过去两天我用 DSH 的 bundle 机制做了一批**零配置、单包、无原生依赖**的小工具插件，全部发布到 npm 并打上 `dsh-plugin` topic，每个都经过「安装 → 层对账 → 启动自检 → 正式环境端到端调用」的验证。

## 全家福

| 插件 | 做什么 | 安装 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-safeguard` | 危险命令（rm -rf / push --force…）+ 密钥泄漏（AKIA/sk-/ghp_…）**执行前拦截**，带 allowList 豁免 | `dsh plugin add dsh-safeguard` |
| `dsh-http` | 结构化 HTTP 请求：方法/头/体、状态码/耗时/大小、Bearer/Basic 占位、JSON 自动解析、截断保护 | `dsh plugin add dsh-http` |
| `dsh-case` | 命名大小写转换：camel/Pascal/snake/kebab/CONSTANT 等 8 风格，自检测输入 | `dsh plugin add dsh-case` |
| `dsh-fmt` | JSON/YAML/TOML/SQL 格式化与校验，错误精确到行列 | `dsh plugin add dsh-fmt` |
| `dsh-clipboard` | 长文本一键进系统剪贴板（pbcopy/clip/xclip/xsel） | `dsh plugin add dsh-clipboard` |
| `dsh-fetch-file` | URL→工作区文件：二进制流式落盘、路径围栏、200MB 上限（区别于 web_fetch 的纯文本） | `dsh plugin add dsh-fetch-file` |
| `dsh-jwt` | JWT 解码调试：payload/过期判断，不验签 | `dsh plugin add dsh-jwt` |
| `dsh-cron-parse` | cron 表达式解析/人性化/未来 N 次预览（含闰年等边界） | `dsh plugin add dsh-cron-parse` |
| `dsh-pkg-info` | npm/PyPI 包版本、依赖、发布时间查询 | `dsh plugin add dsh-pkg-info` |
| `dsh-dead-links` | Markdown 文档死链检查（HEAD 降级 GET、限流并发） | `dsh plugin add dsh-dead-links` |
| `dsh-when` | 自然语言相对时间→ISO（「明天 9 点」「2 小时后」），不支持即 fail-fast 不瞎猜 | `dsh plugin add dsh-when` |
| `dsh-handoff` | 会话交接一键导出：确定性 Markdown（决策/已完成/未完成/下一步），不调模型零成本 | `dsh plugin add dsh-handoff` |
| `dsh-url-tools` | URL 解析/去 UTM 等跟踪参数/编解码/短链展开 | `dsh plugin add dsh-url-tools` |
| `dsh-password` | 强密码/diceware 口令生成（crypto 随机、熵值标注） | `dsh plugin add dsh-password` |

## 一键装全家桶

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-safeguard dsh-http dsh-case dsh-fmt dsh-clipboard \
  dsh-fetch-file dsh-jwt dsh-cron-parse dsh-pkg-info dsh-dead-links dsh-when \
  dsh-handoff dsh-url-tools dsh-password
```

## 设计原则（也是给社区作者的参考）

- **零配置**：装上即用，无 API key、无第三方服务依赖
- **单包小面积**：每个 100–500 行、纯 JS 无原生依赖（不会触发 pnpm allowBuilds 授权）
- **规范失败值**：工具失败一律返回可读错误而非抛异常；模型看到的是人类可读摘要，机器可读 JSON 留给 Code Mode
- **每个包自检**：`DSH_PLUGIN_SELFTEST=1 dsh --profile <x> --port 0` 可复现全部自检（平时启动不打外网）
- 全部开发方法论与踩坑记录会在 hub 仓库开源（筹备中）；新插件脚手架 [dsh-plugin-template](https://github.com/ZhijiangTang/dsh-plugin-template)（GitHub 模板仓库，`scaffold.sh` 一条命令生成新插件骨架）已可用

## 已知边界与后续

- `dsh-safeguard` 是正则启发式，误报可加 allowList；不是沙箱/签名替代
- 下一步候选：跨会话调度（对标 Codex Automations）、更多生态缺口
- 欢迎 star / issue / 使用反馈；发现 bug 直接提，我修得很快

---

**English summary:** 14 zero-config, single-package, no-native-deps tool plugins for DeepSeek Harness — safety guard, HTTP client, case converter, multi-format formatter, clipboard, file download, JWT decoder, cron parser, package info, dead-link checker, natural-language time parser, session handoff exporter, URL tools, password generator. All published on npm (`dsh plugin add <name>`), repos tagged `dsh-plugin`, each verified end-to-end in a live harness.

discussions.title: DSH | Windows Workspace Guard | Windows 工作区、审批与审计防护
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或背书。**

项目地址：https://github.com/julescules/dsh-windows-workspace-guard  
最新版本：https://github.com/julescules/dsh-windows-workspace-guard/releases/tag/v0.5.0

## 项目介绍

Windows Workspace Guard 会在 DeepSeek Harness 执行 PowerShell 前检查命令，避免 Agent 误删工作区外文件、修改原始包、改变 Windows 系统状态或丢失 Git 恢复路径。

它提供三种简单策略：

- **PASS**：安全命令直接执行；
- **ASK ONCE**：高风险但可能合理的命令请求一次批准；
- **HARD BLOCK**：磁盘、保护目录、系统状态和绕过命令始终阻断。

![Windows Workspace Guard 演示](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/julescules/dsh-windows-workspace-guard/main/docs/demo.svg)

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

- 使用官方 `dsh.bundle.patch` 插件结构；
- 接入官方 `tools/pre-execute` allow / deny / ask 流程；
- 适配持久化 `pwsh(command)` 工具；
- 官方 Web 设置卡可实时配置策略；
- 注册 `windows_workspace_guard_check`，让 Agent 可以先检查命令再决定是否执行；
- 可选写入脱敏、追加式 JSONL 审计记录。

## v0.5.0 新增

- 检查 `Out-File`、`Tee-Object`、Export-Csv/Clixml 和 `>`/`>>` 输出目标；
- 默认阻断 `cmd /c`、WSL、bash/sh、Windows Script Host、mshta、rundll32、regsvr32、runas 等原生逃逸入口；
- 阻断 Invoke-WebRequest、BITS、bitsadmin、certutil 下载落盘绕过；
- 新增 WMI/CIM 系统变更、NTFS hardlink、备用数据流和更完整的 `System.IO` 写入检测；
- 新增实时设置 `guardNativeEscapes`。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:julescules/dsh-windows-workspace-guard#v0.5.0
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

安装后重新启动 DSH。推荐配置和完整说明请查看仓库 README。

## 已验证

- 38/38 单元、浏览器接口及对抗测试通过；
- 构建包已安装到真实 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` Web Profile；
- Web Host 启动图成功发现设置客户端，`client.js` 返回 HTTP 200；
- 插件 Profile `pnpm peers check` 无依赖问题；
- Release 资产：19,393 bytes；
- SHA-256：`f16278b7a2688daad34cc8d38d5e5038e7767f65320b6d78d86f8a840413c78b`。

当前限制：这是静态检查策略，不替代操作系统沙箱；不会解析既有 junction/symlink 的实际指向，但会强制阻断新建链接操作。

discussions.title: [Bug] 损坏的会话日志会导致整个 DSH 客户端启动崩溃 —— 已定位根因并提供修复
discussions.body:
## 现象
一个损坏的会话日志文件（`session.jsonl.zstd` 首帧非单行）会让桌面端 / Web 端在启动时直接崩溃，报：
```
corrupt Zstandard session log: first frame is not exactly one header line
  at .../dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/.../assertZstdHeaderFrame
  at .../dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:324 (listArtifacts)
```
也就是「一个坏会话拖垮全部会话」，用户完全无法启动客户端。

## 根因（源码定位：`packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/index.ts`）
```
list() (447)
  -> listArtifacts (472)        // 遍历每个会话，无 try/catch 隔离
      -> readFirstZstdLine (737)
          -> assertZstdHeaderFrame(plaintext)  (765 行)  // 对坏会话抛致命错误
```
`listArtifacts` 在枚举会话时对每个会话调用 `readFirstZstdLine`，而它末尾的 `assertZstdHeaderFrame` 在首帧非单行时直接抛错。该错误没有任何逐会话隔离，直接冒泡到 `dsh-workspace [Service.init]`，导致 "plugin tree failed to load"、整个客户端起不来。

## 修复建议（最小、符合现有容错风格）
把 `listArtifacts` 内层读取包一层 `try/catch`，坏会话记 warning 并 `continue` 跳过（与下方 `if (first === undefined) continue` 的容错风格一致）：

```ts
let first: string | undefined
try {
  first = this.compression === 'zstd'
    ? await this.readFirstZstdLine(path, signal)
    : await this.readFirstLine(path, signal)
} catch (error: unknown) {
  this.ctx.logger.warn(`session-persistence-jsonl: skipping unreadable session log "${path}": ${String(error)}`)
  continue
}
```

## 验证
修复前：某个会话目录放入「首帧为 4 行的畸形 `session.jsonl.zstd`」会让客户端无法启动。修复后：该会话被记为 warning 并跳过，启动正常，其余会话不受影响。

## 修复链接
- Fork 分支：`beastrobin/deepseek-harness@fix/session-list-fault-isolation`
- Commit：`c27b3deb35a08aef909696130be2909d5c870039`
- Patch（可直接 `git apply`）：`session-list-fault-isolation.patch`

> 注：已知 CONTRIBUTING 说明目前不接受外部 PR，故在此通过 Discussions 反馈，供团队评估吸收。

discussions.title: Proposal: standard ASR / TTS / avatar-media capability seams for dsh
discussions.body:
# Upstream proposal: standard ASR / TTS / avatar-media capability seams for dsh

Status: submitted to `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` Discussions → Ideas (2026-08).

## Motivation

DeepSeek Harness already has excellent seams for `llm`, `web`, `fs`, `subprocess`,
`jobs`, and the UI slot system. Conversational-avatar experiences add three more
capabilities that are currently re-implemented by every downstream plugin:

- **ASR** — microphone PCM in, transcript out;
- **TTS** — text in, streamable audio out;
- **avatar-media** — character clips, dialogue-video generation, and realtime
  avatar sessions.

`dsh-flowact-avatar` proves the shape works: it defines these three seams and
ships seven interchangeable providers (Doubao ASR/TTS, browser speech, Jimeng
video, Volcengine/Vidu realtime). If dsh owns the Service Definition, the
whole ecosystem can share providers instead of each plugin inventing its own
registry.

## Proposed packages

Follow the existing dsh capability-seam split: Service Definition, Service
Provider, Consumer.

```text
packages/speech/asr/            ctx.asr — AsrProvider registry
packages/speech/tts/            ctx.tts — TtsProvider registry
packages/media/avatar-media/    ctx.avatarMedia — AvatarMediaProvider registry
```

Provider examples:
- `asr-doubao` / `asr-sensevoice` / `asr-browser`
- `tts-doubao` / `tts-browser` / OpenAI-compatible TTS gateways
- `avatar-media-jimeng` / `avatar-media-vidu` / `avatar-media-volc`

## Contracts (first draft)

```ts
interface AsrProvider {
  readonly id: string
  available(): boolean
  transcribe(pcm: Float32Array, opts: { sampleRate: number; signal?: AbortSignal }):
    Promise<{ text: string; engine: string; latencyMs: number }>
}

interface TtsProvider {
  readonly id: string
  available(): boolean
  listVoices(): VoiceInfo[]
  synthesize(text: string, opts: { voice?: string; rate?: number }):
    AsyncIterable<Uint8Array> // 24 kHz s16le PCM frames
}

interface AvatarMediaProvider {
  readonly id: string
  available(): boolean
  capabilities(): { modes: ('clip' | 'video-gen' | 'realtime-token' | 'realtime-live')[] }
  submitVideo?(req: VideoRequest): Promise<VideoTask>
  queryVideo?(task: VideoTask): Promise<VideoQueryResult>
  createSessionToken?(req: RealtimeTokenRequest): Promise<RealtimeTokenResult>
  createSession?(req: RealtimeSessionRequest): Promise<RealtimeSessionResult>
}
```

The video generation path should integrate with `ctx.jobs`, exactly like
`dsh-flowact-avatar` does with the `flowact-video` job kind.

## Design constraints learned from FlowAct

1. **Credentials belong to `ctx.credentials`, not provider config.** FlowAct
   resolves `VOLC_*` references per operation, so key rotation reaches the next
   call without restart.
2. **Binary audio must stay binary.** Do not force PCM through JSON-RPC; a
   `ctx.webServer.registerUpgrade` WebSocket or a streamable byte channel keeps
   realtime latency acceptable.
3. **Provider selection must not depend on registration order.** FlowAct uses
   the dsh web-seam semantics: explicit id, else exactly-one-available, else
   loud `AMBIGUOUS`.
4. **Vendor quirks stay inside providers.** Doubao frame codecs, Volcengine
   HMAC, Vidu proxy handshakes, and rate-limit mappings are all provider
   internals in FlowAct; the core only sees normalized events.

## Migration path

1. Land the three Service Definition packages in dsh.
2. Move the codecs and providers from `dsh-flowact-avatar` into official
   provider packages, leaving FlowAct as the Consumer/UI.
3. Register browser speech providers as zero-key defaults so a fresh dsh
   profile can speak/transcribe without any vendor account.

## Links

- Implementation reference:
  <https://github.com/eddiehuang227-source/dsh-flowact-avatar>
- dsh architecture: capability seams
  (`docs/architecture.md` in `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness`)

discussions.title: Archify for DSH — 从真实仓库生成可验证的交互式架构图 / Verified interactive diagrams from real repositories
discussions.body:
# Archify for DeepSeek Harness

Archify 现已支持以显式、可选的 Skill-only bundle 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

在真实项目工作区里，让 DSH 读取仓库并生成架构图、流程图、时序图、数据流图或生命周期图，最终交付经过校验的自包含交互式 HTML。

![Archify interactive architecture diagram](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/docs/assets/archify-readme-hero.png)

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@0.1.0
```

如果 DSH Web 已经运行，请在安装后重启。

## 在 DSH 中体验

在一个真实仓库工作区中输入：

> 读取当前仓库，使用 Archify 生成项目架构图，交付并打开经过校验的交互式 HTML。

## 能力

- 5 种图：architecture / workflow / sequence / dataflow / lifecycle
- 支持自然语言描述与 Mermaid 辅助输入
- Schema 校验的 JSON IR
- 自包含交互式 HTML
- 深色 / 浅色主题
- Path、Semantic Lens 与节点聚焦
- PNG / SVG / Share Card 导出
- 交付前执行 artifact validation

![Archify live interaction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/tt-a1i/archify/main/docs/assets/archify-live-proof.gif)

## 验证与边界

- 已使用 `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` 验证
- 已验证真实 npm tarball 安装、bundle 发现、Skill 调用和浏览器产物交付
- DSH 集成必须显式安装，不会改变 Archify 核心默认行为，也不会影响不使用 DSH 的用户
- 这是社区插件，并非 DeepSeek 官方插件或官方认证项目

## 链接

- GitHub: https://github.com/tt-a1i/archify
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@tt-a1i/archify-dsh

---

## English

Archify now ships an explicit, opt-in Skill-only bundle for DeepSeek Harness.

From a real repository workspace, ask DSH to inspect the codebase and generate an architecture, workflow, sequence, data-flow, or lifecycle diagram. Archify delivers a validated, self-contained interactive HTML artifact with themes, path exploration, Semantic Lens, and PNG/SVG/Share Card export.

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @tt-a1i/archify-dsh@0.1.0
```

Try this in a DSH workspace:

> Read this repository, use Archify to generate a project architecture diagram, then deliver and open the validated interactive HTML.

The bundle has been verified with `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`, including real npm tarball installation, bundle discovery, Skill invocation, and browser artifact delivery.

The integration is explicitly installed and isolated from Archify core defaults, so non-DSH users are unaffected.

Archify is a community plugin and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

discussions.title: 【Bug 反馈】轨迹页时间线区间聚焦后，任务运行期间滚动被强制锁回锚点
discussions.body:
## Bug 描述

在 dsh Web GUI 的**轨迹 (Trajectory) 标签页**中, 顶部有一根可视化 input/model/tools 记录的 Overview 时间线。拖选一个时间区间后, 区间外的交互记录会带上灰色蒙版, 区间内的记录保持原色——这部分行为正常。

但在**模型正在执行任务(流式回复)期间**拖选区间, 会出现以下问题:

1. 记录表被强制自动滚动到选中区间内的第一条交互;
2. 滚动条被锁死: 鼠标滚轮或触摸板滚动只能短暂拖动列表, 随即又被强行拉回锚点;
3. 直到模型回复完毕、不再有新记录产生, 滚动才恢复自由。

## 根因分析

问题出在 `packages/client/ui-trajectory/src/client/TrajectoryTable.tsx` 中"时间线聚焦滚动"的 effect(修复前约 2070–2136 行):

```ts
useEffect(() => {
  if (timelineFocusIndexes === null || timelineFocusIndexes.size === 0) return
  // ... 计算 focusedPositions ...
  followsTableTail.current = false
  rowVirtualizer.scrollToIndex(firstVirtual, { behavior: 'smooth', align: 'start' })
  // 非虚拟化分支同理调用 scrollIntoView({ behavior: 'smooth' })
}, [
  projectedVirtualRows,
  records,
  rowVirtualizer,
  timelineFocusIndexes,
  virtualIndexByRecordId,
  virtualizationEnabled,
])
```

该 effect 的依赖同时包含 `records` 与 `timelineFocusIndexes`。模型执行任务期间, 每当出现**结构性流式更新**(开始新的 tool call、请求完成、runningCalls 变化等):

- `records` 及其派生数组(`projectedVirtualRows` 等)引用会变化;
- `TrajectoryView` 中 `timelineFocusIndexes` 是由 `timelineTurns` 重新 `useMemo` 出的新 `Set` 实例(即使区间内容没变)。

于是 effect 在每次流式更新时都重新执行, 再次对聚焦锚点发起 `behavior: 'smooth'` 的 `scrollToIndex` / `scrollIntoView`。smooth 滚动动画不断被重启, 把用户刚滚走的位置立即拉回——表现就是"滚轮短暂生效、马上被强制拉回"。模型停止后依赖不再变化, effect 不再执行, 滚动随即恢复, 与观察到的现象完全吻合。

## 修复方案

修复分支: [fix/trajectory-focus-scroll-lock](https://github.com/IvanFan-Van/deepseek-harness/commits/fix/trajectory-focus-scroll-lock)
修复提交: [fix(trajectory): anchor timeline-focus scroll to selection gestures only](https://github.com/IvanFan-Van/deepseek-harness/commit/790f468b3a)

思路: 记录表只应在两种情况下重新定位到聚焦区间——

1. **用户提交了新的区间选择手势**: 通过区间对象的身份判断(新增 `timelineFocusRange` prop, 与组件既有的 `recordSelection`/`recordFocus` "新对象 = 新请求" 约定一致);
2. **聚焦记录首次变为可渲染**: 例如向前补页历史后, 聚焦行首次出现。

除此之外, 流式追加的记录(无论落在区间内还是区间外)都不再抢占滚动条, 用户可随时自由滚动查阅。

同时补充了两条回归测试(`packages/client/ui-trajectory/tests/table.client.spec.tsx`):

- `does not re-anchor a timeline-focused virtual ledger when records grow` —— 修复前稳定失败(记录增长后再次调用 `scrollTo({ behavior: 'smooth' })` 复现本 bug), 修复后通过;
- `re-anchors a timeline-focused ledger when the selection gesture repeats` —— 保证重复拖选区间仍能重新定位。

验证情况:

- `pnpm run test:gui` 全绿(272 个测试文件 / 3759 个测试);
- `tsc -b tsconfig.client.json` 类型检查通过;
- oxlint 对改动文件零告警;
- 浏览器级 keyless replay e2e(`DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay pnpm run test:web`)在本执行环境中未能完成(Playwright 浏览器二进制缺失/执行环境限制, 与本次改动无关); 该滚动行为由上述组件级回归测试直接覆盖。

希望维护者能确认这个根因, 如果修复方向合适, 也欢迎直接采纳或提出修改意见。谢谢!

discussions.title: Headless resume: is it planned, would you take a PR, and is a mid-turn jsonl.zstd log a legal restore target?
discussions.body:
**TL;DR** — `dsh --profile headless` cannot name or resume its session, so an unattended run that gets terminated is unrecoverable. I wrote a plugin that fixes it using only published API, and measured the crash behaviour. Three questions at the bottom, plus one thing that looks like a bug.

## The gap

```js
agents.create({ sessionId: SessionId(`session-${randomUUID()}`), … })
```

The id is minted inside `run()`, and headless takes no flag but `--help` — so the transcript lands on disk under an id nobody wrote down. Our runs are hours long on a host that SIGTERMs on every deploy.

Everything needed is already there: `ctx.agents.resume()` is published API and the JSONL persistence backend is already mounted in the headless bundle. Only the runner couldn't reach them. So — a `--patch` overlay that disables the `headless-runner` row and inserts a replacement:

**https://github.com/Outblock/dsh-headless-resumable** — MIT, tagged `dsh-plugin`, no fork, no vendoring.

(CONTRIBUTING says you can't take external PRs at the moment. I asked before reading it — sorry. A plugin it is.)

## It works, including the case I expected to be hard

`0.1.0-rc.6`, real runs killed at randomised points and relaunched through `ctx.agents.resume()`:

- **SIGKILL mid-tool-call: 3/3 resumed and completed, with no work redone.** Last stored seq → resumed pick-up was 322→327, 285→289, 336→340; the gaps are your synthetic tool/step/turn closers over the torn tail.
- Once on a real 38-minute agent build: one session directory throughout, deliverable produced, and pre-kill work not repeated — the input documents were read 5 times before the kill and 0 times after.

Thank you for that. The persistence README's "Durability and crash semantics" section is why we knew where to look, and it held up.

## One thing looks like a bug, not a missing feature

In `runProfile`:

```js
process.on("SIGTERM", () => { interrupt(0)   })
process.on("SIGINT",  () => { interrupt(130) })
```

SIGINT correctly yields 130. **SIGTERM yields 0** — so under Kubernetes, systemd, ECS, Fly or plain `docker stop`, a headless run that was killed reports *success*, and a caller checking the exit code cannot tell it from a completed one.

A plugin can only work around this by removing your listener at mount time (Node dispatches signal listeners in registration order and yours is registered first), which is a hack worth reporting rather than living with. Happy to split it into its own thread if that is easier to triage.

## Questions

1. **Is headless resume planned?** I would rather use yours than maintain a replacement row. (`dsh --help` shows `--profile tui --resume <session>` in its examples but no `tui` bundle ships in rc.6, so I could not tell whether that is a plan or just an argument-passthrough example.)
2. **May we depend on the persistence README's crash contract** — fsync per durable append, incomplete trailing frame truncated and re-encoded with synthetic closers, a defect at or before the last committed `turn/end` rejecting as corruption?
3. **Is a log that ends mid-turn a *legal* restore target**, or is that recovery best-effort? My measurements say it restores; I would like to know whether I am allowed to rely on it.

> **Unofficial community plugin.** Independently developed and maintained; not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek.

Repository: https://github.com/julescules/dsh-galgame-localization-reverse  
Release: https://github.com/julescules/dsh-galgame-localization-reverse/releases/tag/v0.2.0

`dsh-galgame-localization-reverse` packages a practical Windows galgame / visual-novel localization workflow as a DeepSeek Harness Skill Provider. It helps the agent identify the engine, map text and UI ownership, preserve encodings and control codes, verify image geometry and save compatibility, and build a hash-bound reversible release.

![Galgame Localization Reverse workflow](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/julescules/dsh-galgame-localization-reverse/main/docs/demo.svg)

## Highlights

- 25+ engine families, including AI6WIN, BGI/Ethornell, Director, RealLive, KiriKiri, Siglus, Majiro, Yu-Ris, PSP/Vita, and custom VMs.
- 16 focused references for engine routing, image UI, bytecode, encoding, save/resume safety, packaging, and rollback.
- `vn_qa.py` checks placeholder preservation and target-encoding compatibility.
- `vn_patch.py` builds hash-bound replacement patches with preflight, verification, backup, and rollback.
- New `vn_image_qa.py` inventories and compares PNG/APNG, JPEG, GIF, and BMP without third-party packages.
- No game assets, decrypted archives, credentials, or title-specific keys are included.

## v0.2.0 image QA

- Records path, size, SHA-256, format, dimensions, bit depth, alpha/transparency, animation, and frame count.
- Compares original and localized image trees.
- Fails on missing/corrupt assets, format or geometry changes, alpha loss, and animation-frame changes.
- Warns about extra or byte-identical assets.
- Separates deterministic file evidence, multimodal visual observations, and real runtime-state proof.

## DSH integration

The plugin uses the official packaged-provider seam:

- `inject = ['skills']`
- `ctx.skills.registerProvider(...)`
- bundled rank `600`
- directory `resourceBase` for on-demand references and scripts
- official `dsh.bundle.patch` mount

Install:

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add github:julescules/dsh-galgame-localization-reverse#v0.2.0
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

Restart DSH, then ask it to use `galgame-localization-reverse` with a game directory and goal.

## Validation

- 5/5 Node provider and package metadata tests passed.
- All three Python utility self-tests passed.
- Skill validator passed.
- Real PNG tree comparison passed with dimensions, alpha, frame, and SHA-256 evidence.
- Packed bundle installed into a real `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` headless Profile.
- Profile config dump succeeded and its peer check reported no issues.
- Release asset: 97,562 bytes.
- SHA-256: `d529a903240150f96fa1baa08ddb525ff07f018a984b235d3c6a0338cd72f91e`.

Feedback and engine-specific test reports are welcome in the repository issues.

discussions.title: [Show & Tell] dsh-lab：只发真机实测结论的 DSH 插件实验室（四关法 + 完整日志可复现）
discussions.body:
## 中文正文

大家好，分享一个围绕 DeepSeek Harness 的社区实验室：**dsh-lab**。

出发点很简单：官方仓库已有 12 万+ star，社区插件目录 800+ 条且每天在涨，但生态现状是 **收录 ≠ 能用，star 高 ≠ 安全，自动榜单 ≠ 实测**。没有任何一个地方在回答最基本的问题——这个插件装得上吗？跑起来了吗？代码里写了什么？

所以我们的立场是：**不收录任何未经真机测试的条目**。

**四关实测法**（每个条目逐项标注 ✅ / ❌ / ⏳，绝不模糊）：

1. **安装** —— 在隔离的 `DSH_HOME` 中执行官方安装命令，记录完整日志与退出码；
2. **冒烟** —— 带最小任务的 headless 会话运行，验证不导致启动/运行崩溃；
3. **安全快检** —— 对安装后的实际代码做静态模式扫描（网络 / 子进程 / 动态执行 / 凭证读取），列出命中清单；
4. **兼容钉版** —— 记录测试时 DSH 版本与插件版本，任一版本变化后重新测试并更新报告。

**可复现性是我们最看重的一点**：每份报告都附带完整测试日志与复现命令，任何结论都能对上日志。测不过的照实标 ❌ 而不是消失；没测的不出现在报告里，而不是用描述文字代替测试。

当前进度：

- **10 份实测报告**（含完整日志与复现命令）；
- 一份**公开勘误**：首批 6 个"仓库消失"标记复测后全部存活（测试机代理故障所致），原文保留；
- **3 篇原创中文指南**（上手 / 写插件 / 避坑）；
- 配套仓库：**awesome-dsh-presets**（4 个实测预设 + 4 份规则）已上线；**awesome-dsh-skills**（12 个实测技能）已上线，同一套"先验证再发布"的标准。

路线图分三阶段：实测精选 + 教程（现在）→ 插件 × DSH 版本**兼容矩阵**（CI 每日自动重测）→ 同类插件**竞技场**。

---

## English Summary

**dsh-lab** is a community lab for DeepSeek Harness plugins that publishes **only hands-on, reproducible results** — no untested entries.

The problem: 120k+ star repo, 800+ community plugins, but *"listed" ≠ "works", "high stars" ≠ "safe", "auto-ranked" ≠ "tested"*. Nobody answers the basic questions — does it install, does it run, what does the code do?

Every entry passes a fixed **4-gate test**: **Install → Smoke → Static Security Scan → Pinned-Version Compatibility**. Each report ships with **full logs and reproduction commands**; failures are marked ❌ openly, untested items are marked ⏳, and unverified entries simply don't appear.

Current state: **10 verified reports**, one **published correction** (our initial 6 dead-entry marks were all false positives caused by a proxy failure — all repos alive on recheck), **3 original Chinese guides**, plus companion repos — **awesome-dsh-presets** (4 verified presets + 4 rules, live) and **awesome-dsh-skills** (12 verified skills). Roadmap: compatibility matrix (daily CI re-test) → plugin arena.

**仓库链接：**

- dsh-lab：https://github.com/hackerFish/dsh-lab
- awesome-dsh-presets：https://github.com/hackerFish/awesome-dsh-presets
- awesome-dsh-skills：https://github.com/hackerFish/awesome-dsh-skills

欢迎送测、欢迎复现后反馈"结论不一致"——Welcome feedback, reproduction reports, and plugin submissions for testing.

discussions.title: pnpm方式加载失败及修复全流程已经建议
discussions.body:
事先声明：本次修复由GLM 5.3参与完成并进行总结，但我并不认为是AI废料

---

**标题：**

```
`pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` 后 `dsh web` 启动失败：pnpm 隔离布局下约 200 个插件加载条目 ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND（npm/npx 安装正常）
```

**正文：**

```markdown
## 环境

- dsh：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`（next tag），全局安装
- pnpm：11.7.0（corepack）与 11.16.0 均复现
- Node：v22.23.2（WSL2 Ubuntu；判断与布局相关，非平台特有）
- 系统：WSL2

## 复现步骤

```sh
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@next   # 安装成功
dsh web                              # 启动即失败
```

同一台机器、同一个 profile（`~/.dsh` 未做任何改动），改用
`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`（或 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`）则完全正常。

## 报错信息

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): loader entries failed to apply
AggregateError: loader entries failed to apply
...
Error: failed to import loader entry agent (@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent):
  Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent' imported from
  ~/.local/share/pnpm/store/v11/links/@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/1.0.2/<hash>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js
```

约 200 个条目以同样方式失败（`dsh-agent`、`dsh-web-app`、`dsh-tools`、
`dsh-user-questions`、`dsh-host-apiproxy` 等）。完整启动日志可按需提供。

## 根因分析

插件加载器从自身模块位置（`cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js`）按裸包名
解析 bundle 插件包。npm/npx 的扁平提升（hoisted）布局下，
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` 系列包位于 `node_modules` 顶层、互为邻居，可以正常
解析；而 pnpm 默认的隔离布局（isolated layout）中，每个包只能看见自己
声明过的依赖，`cordis-plugin-loader` 的依赖清单里没有这些兄弟插件包，
于是全部导入失败。

也就是说 `pnpm add -g` 能"装成功"，但装出来的是一个坏的安装，且报错
信息完全不会提示问题出在包管理器上——用户很容易误以为是安装损坏。

## 临时绕过

1. `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`（需要时配用户前缀目录）或
   `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`——实测正常。
2. 猜测给 pnpm 全局安装设 `node-linker=hoisted` 也可行（此处未验证）。

## 建议（任选其一即可帮到用户）

1. 文档：README 安装一节加一句说明——全局安装需使用 npm/npx，
   pnpm 的隔离布局暂不支持。
2. 加固：让 bundle 条目改为相对 dsh 安装根目录解析（例如用
   `createRequire` 锚定在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 包上），从而兼容严格布局。

如需完整启动日志或协助验证修复，我可以配合。
```

---

discussions.title: dsh-plugin-gate — pre-install supply-chain and policy gate for DSH plugins
discussions.body:
# dsh-plugin-gate — DSH 插件安装前供应链门禁

> **Unofficial community plugin.** Independently developed and maintained; not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek.

- Repository: https://github.com/youkongling/dsh-plugin-gate
- Release: https://github.com/youkongling/dsh-plugin-gate/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- Commit: `ce061bb6466d8ed84fc8ac525475411c21ac9647`
- License: Apache-2.0
- Runtime dependencies: none
- npm: intentionally not published; distributed from GitHub only

## Why

Installing a DSH plugin means trusting its package manifest, bundle patch, archive layout, Git source, and any behavior that may not be obvious from the README. `dsh-plugin-gate` provides a pre-install gate that materializes and reviews npm, Git, or local plugin sources without executing the target plugin's lifecycle code.

It is a small, independent Cordis bundle that registers:

- `/plugin-gate <source-spec>`
- `plugin_gate` tool

It does not modify the DSH host source tree.

## What it checks

The implementation deliberately reuses security design from two upstream ecosystems:

- **OpenAI Codex plugin materialization**
  - `npm pack --ignore-scripts`
  - exact npm versions
  - bounded archive extraction
  - package manifest/path validation
  - immutable installation pins
- **Claude Code marketplace review workflows**
  - HTTPS host allowlist
  - 40-character commit SHA pinning
  - catalog invariants
  - optional read-only policy reviewer

Checks include:

- absolute paths, `..`, drive letters, symlink/hardlink, and unsupported tar entries
- archive size and entry-count limits
- tar header checksum and PAX record structure
- unique `package/` archive root
- `package.json` identity, version, and size
- `dsh.bundle.patch` path confinement and realpath confinement
- `cordis.patch.yml` presence and readability
- npm tarball SHA-256 and payload content SHA-256
- Git fetch/checkout/rev-parse commit verification
- local-source private snapshot with bounded file and byte counts
- optional Claude policy scan with schema validation, credential redaction, and fail-closed enforcement

## Install

Recommended immutable release artifact:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/youkongling/dsh-plugin-gate/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-plugin-gate-0.1.0.tgz
```

Or pin the exact commit:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:youkongling/dsh-plugin-gate#ce061bb6466d8ed84fc8ac525475411c21ac9647
```

Restart the profile after installation.

Release tarball SHA-256:

```text
e94679017976885cdbbbe4d95849af71af358cbc9714c080346057e961032048
```

## Use

```bash
# local source, deterministic checks only
dsh-plugin-gate /absolute/path/to/plugin --no-policy

# exact npm version
dsh-plugin-gate npm:<package>@<exact-version>

# pinned Git commit
dsh-plugin-gate 'git:https://github.com/owner/repo#<40-char-sha>'

# JSON report
dsh-plugin-gate npm:<package>@<exact-version> --json
```

Inside DSH:

```text
/plugin-gate npm:<package>@<exact-version>
```

A failed gate remains a structured command/tool result: `passes`, findings, content SHA-256, fingerprint, install pin, and policy status are preserved.

## Validation

Before publishing:

- 52/52 Node tests passed
- `npm pack --dry-run --ignore-scripts` passed
- self-gate passed
- GitHub Actions CI passed
- no runtime dependencies and no install lifecycle scripts

Post-publish smoke tests in isolated `DSH_HOME` profiles:

- release tarball installed successfully
- bundle layer appeared in `--dump-config`
- installed CLI self-gate passed
- pinned Git commit installed successfully
- bundle layer appeared in `--dump-config`

## Boundaries

This is an installation-time review gate, not a formal security proof:

- it does not execute the target plugin's lifecycle code;
- deterministic checks do not replace source review;
- the optional LLM policy reviewer is advisory technology and can be misled by prompt injection, so it never replaces deterministic checks;
- registry, Git host, and TLS infrastructure remain trusted supply-chain components;
- declared dependencies are not recursively installed or executed;
- policy mode requires `claude` CLI and valid authentication, and fails closed by default.

Feedback and vulnerability reports are welcome in the repository issues and security policy.

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] Every sandboxed command spawns a visible console window (black flash) when the host has no console — verified fix included
discussions.body:
## 环境

Windows + DeepSeek Harness Desktop(桌面版)。dsh 宿主进程由桌面壳以 `windowsHide: true` 启动(无控制台)。

## 现象

Agent 每次执行沙箱命令(典型: pwsh 工具调用),屏幕上都会弹出**可见的黑色命令行窗口**: 命令快则一闪而过,慢则停留数秒。用户点击「允许」后、甚至只是等待 agent 工作时都会弹出,非常干扰(社区已有多个"自动批准"插件,但都解决不了这个窗口问题)。

## 根因

1. 桌面壳 `src/runtime-controller.mjs` 用 `windowsHide: true` 拉起 dsh 宿主 → **宿主进程没有任何控制台**。
2. 沙箱 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 用 `CreateProcessAsUserW` 创建受限令牌子进程(pwsh.exe / cmd.exe),`STARTUPINFO` 仅设置 `STARTF_USESTDHANDLES`;而 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW` 被刻意避免——受限令牌下隐藏控制台子进程会以 `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED (0xC0000142)` 崩溃(见源码注释 "flags: suspended/no-window variants are unusable under the restriction")。
3. 源码注释 "the child shares the host console" 仅在宿主**有**控制台时成立(命令行 `dsh` 场景)。桌面壳宿主无控制台 → Windows 只能为每个沙箱子进程**新建一个可见控制台窗口** → 就是那个黑框。

涉及位置(桌面版打包内):
- `resources/app.asar.unpacked/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-CNjZgO4h.js`
  - `spawnSandboxed()` ≈ 854-861 行
  - `spawnSandboxedInherited()` ≈ 991-998 行

上游源码: `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/spawn.ts`(两处 `encodeStartupInfo`)。

## 已验证修复(实机验证通过)

在两处 `encodeStartupInfo` 增加 `STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW`(0x1) + `wShowWindow: SW_HIDE(0)`: 控制台窗口**创建即隐藏**,不触碰 `CREATE_NO_WINDOW`,因此不会触发 0xC0000142。

```diff
   encodeStartupInfo(startupInfo, {
     cb: abi.STARTUPINFOW_SIZE,
-    dwFlags: abi.STARTF_USESTDHANDLES,
+    // STARTF_USESTDHANDLES | STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW: hide the child's console
+    // window — under the desktop shell the host has no console, so a child
+    // with an un-hidden console allocates a visible window per command.
+    dwFlags: abi.STARTF_USESTDHANDLES | abi.STARTF_USESHOWWINDOW,
+    wShowWindow: 0, // SW_HIDE
     hStdInput: ...,
     hStdOutput: ...,
     hStdError: ...,
   })
```
(两处 spawn 点同样修改)

**验证结果**:
- 受限令牌下命令照常执行(exit 0、无崩溃、stdout/stderr 正常收集)——用真实 `AclSandbox` + 受限令牌的隔离脚本复现验证;
- 重启桌面版后连续执行多条命令,黑色窗口**不再出现**(用户实机确认);
- 未改动任何权限 / ACL 逻辑。

## 建议

1. 上游 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 的 sandbox-windows-acl 采纳上述 STARTUPINFO 修改(已另发 Discussion);
2. 桌面版在下次发布时同步打包修复版本,并考虑在桌面壳侧用「隐藏控制台」方式启动宿主(如 `AllocConsole` + `ShowWindow(SW_HIDE)`),从源头避免依赖沙箱行为;
3. 提醒: 桌面版升级会覆盖被打补丁的文件,已手动修复的用户升级后需重新应用(可参考本 Issue 的 diff)。

discussions.title: A billing/clearing plugin for Harness, from a production multi-vendor LLM gateway (TokenFerry)
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek Harness team 👋

Thanks for open-sourcing Harness — the "everything is a plugin" architecture on Cordis is exactly the right direction. I read through the architecture doc, the Cordis tutorial, and the composability paper, and I'd like to propose a plugin idea, plus a few protocol questions that would help us build it.

## What we run

TokenFerry is a production multi-vendor, OpenAI-compatible API gateway — today aggregating DeepSeek, Qwen, Kimi, GLM, MiniMax, and Hunyuan, with global model coverage as the roadmap — settled in USD. We also run an Agent marketplace: agents are packaged as OpenAI-compatible model strings (e.g. `tf-agent/code-review-v1`), billed per call, with a 45% revenue share to creators. We carry per-call telemetry — model, latency, token cost, and outcome — across the gateway.

## The plugin we want to build

We'd like TokenFerry to be a Harness plugin in two ways:

1. **Model adapter (`ctx.llm`)** — register TokenFerry as an LLM provider, so Harness users can call models through one OpenAI-compatible key.
2. **Billing/clearing (`session/event`)** — subscribe to session events and meter token usage, so Harness plugin authors can get paid per call.

The framework is open-sourced, but "how a plugin creator monetizes" is still open. We think a neutral clearing layer is the missing piece for a healthy plugin economy — and monetization is something we already run in production and can contribute.

## Concrete protocol questions

1. **LLM adapter seam** — where is the Service Definition for `ctx.llm`? Is there a reference adapter we should mirror for an OpenAI-compatible gateway (streaming, tool calls, multi-model fallback)?
2. **Token metering** — which session events carry token usage / model / latency? Is token accounting emitted by the model adapter, or should the billing plugin meter it independently?
3. **Bundle distribution** — what's the exact publish flow for a plugin (the `dsh.bundle` patch file + `dsh-plugin` topic)? Is a registry/marketplace planned, or do authors just publish a GitHub repo?
4. **Creator monetization roadmap** — is plugin billing / revenue share on the official roadmap, or intentionally left to third parties like us?
5. **Multi-model routing** — can one `ctx.llm` adapter implement automatic failover across providers, or is that outside the adapter seam?

(We also run a separate internal multi-agent workflow pipeline and are evaluating whether `ctx.agentLoop` can be swapped for a multi-stage pipeline — happy to discuss that in a follow-up if relevant.)

## What we can contribute back

If you can point us to the right files/docs for questions 1–3, we'll build and open-source the billing/clearing plugin, and share our routing and per-call telemetry patterns with the community.

Thanks for the great work — happy to answer any questions about our setup.

discussions.title: Made headless dsh runs visible: live stage/ETA dashboard (open source)
discussions.body:
Headless mode prints only the final answer, so during a long run you can't tell whether the task is stuck, which stage it's on, or how long is left — I hit this within my first couple of days using dsh. So I built **dsh-progress-viz**: it reads the local session event stream (`session.jsonl.zstd`) and shows live stage progress, ETA, estimated cost, and a multi-task grid.

Two forms:
- **cordis plugin** (`dsh-progress-viz-plugin`): listens to session events in real time, writes `progress.json` for the dashboard to pick up
- **standalone dashboard** (`dashboard.py`): parses the zstd stream directly, auto-falls back when the plugin isn't mounted

100% local, no API calls, no tokens consumed. MIT.
Repo: https://github.com/2008924/dsh-progress-viz — feedback very welcome!

**Update (Aug 17):** now listed in the official [awesome-dsh-plugin](https://awesome-dsh-plugin.com/p/2008924/dsh-progress-viz/) registry (Development & Runtime category) — the official plugin market (dsh-market) and the Chinese DSH Market ([searchable here](https://dsh.market/?q=2008924%2Fdsh-progress-viz)) pick it up automatically. One-line install:

```sh

discussions.title: dsh-backup — one-command backup & restore for DSH user data (Settings panel, GitHub sync, hardened restore)
discussions.body:
I built **dsh-backup**, a plugin that backs up and restores your entire `~/.dsh` user data (sessions, config, skills, credentials, plugin config) with one command.

**Repo**: https://github.com/xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup (MIT, zero runtime dependencies, macOS/Linux/Windows)

## What it does

- **`/backup` command family** — backup, list, verify, restore (`--dry-run`), delete, `auto <hours>|off|status`, `github status|sync|repo` — plus a `backup_dsh` model tool so the agent can run backups itself
- **Visual Settings panel** in the web UI (status / backup / verify / restore / download / delete / GitHub repo editing) over a Typert remote
- **Integrity** — sha256 sidecars, verify-before-restore, and restore screening that rejects tar entries with `..` segments (including backslash variants), symlinks, absolute paths, or drive letters
- **Scheduled auto-backup** that survives restarts on an absolute cadence (persists last-run time; a restart does not reset the clock)
- **Rotation** — configurable via `config.keep`; defaults 3 (<24h interval) / 7 (≥24h)
- **Download route** — loopback-only, served as attachment
- **GitHub sync** — mirrors the backup set to a private repo with `--force-with-lease`; the token lives in a 0600 credential file inside the sync worktree and is never committed

## Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:xiaoyuyu6420/dsh-backup
```

Installs from git with no build step (artifacts are committed). An npm package is on the way.

## A note on security

Backups contain plaintext credentials by design (they archive `~/.dsh` verbatim), so archives and sidecars are chmod 600 on POSIX and the download route refuses non-loopback hosts. The v0.6.0 hardening pass (path-traversal/symlink screening, credential-file permissions, Windows command-injection removal) came out of a full adversarial review — details in the repo's README.

Happy to hear what backup intervals/retention people want, or feature requests. 中文说明也欢迎（README 有中英双语版）。

These days my studio network has been flaky — mobile WiFi, constant channel interference. Sessions kept dying mid-stream, and retries burned tokens while waiting. So I hacked together a plugin to share: dsh-plugin-weaknet-adaptor.
