discussions.title: Allow AgentHandle.dispose() to preserve queued inbox items
discussions.body:
A managed long-lived agent host needs graceful shutdown to abort the active turn while retaining already-durable queued/steering inbox items for resume after restart.

Today `ReactLoopAgent.cancel(cause, { keepInbox: true })` can preserve those items, but the owning `AgentHandle.dispose()` path has no options and the agent-loop teardown always calls `machine.cancel({ kind: 'disposed' })`. Consequently, a host that correctly disposes plugins and scoped resources must also clear queued inbox items during graceful shutdown.

A minimal backward-compatible API would be:

```ts
interface AgentDisposeOptions {
  keepInbox?: boolean
}

interface AgentHandle {
  agent: Agent
  dispose(options?: AgentDisposeOptions): Promise<void>
}
```

The first disposer should fix the option for the memoized teardown; later racing disposers should join the same promise. Default behavior remains unchanged (`keepInbox` is false), the active turn is still aborted with `disposed`, and only queued/steering inbox state is retained.

I prepared and validated a patch against the current public `master`:

- commit: https://github.com/winkyao/deepseek-harness/commit/91f18ab42d7f71bfbc24ef2def195224400f078d
- branch: https://github.com/winkyao/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/agent-handle-dispose-keep-inbox
- focused package tests: 24 files / 417 tests passed
- `pnpm run doc-sync`: 28/28 gates passed
- `pnpm run lint`: passed

The repository currently rejects external PR creation and has Issues disabled, so I am posting the proposal here per `CONTRIBUTING.md`. Would the maintainers be willing to incorporate this API into the next published `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` version? The consuming host must pin an official version containing the change before enabling graceful queued-input recovery.

discussions.title: 给 DSH Agent 装一个 Ctrl+Z：dsh-file-undo 操作级回退插件
discussions.body:
# 给 DSH Agent 装一个 Ctrl+Z：dsh-file-undo 操作级回退插件

> 让 AI agent 改文件不再"覆水难收"——自动记录每次写入前的状态，一条 `/undo` 回到操作前。

## 痛点：agent 改文件，快、狠、难反悔

用 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）这类 agent 跑活的人都有过这种时刻：你让它改一个配置文件，它一口气动了十几个文件；你盯着看改到一半，发现某个关键文件已经被覆盖了，而它**没有留底**。

Git 能救，但前提是这个文件恰好被 commit 过、且你记得上一次提交点。现实里更多的情况是：文件在 git 之外，或者 agent 改得太快太碎，等你回过神来已经错过了干净的回滚点。

**dsh-file-undo** 解决的就是这件事：给 DSH 里的 agent 加一个文件级的"撤销键"。

## 它做什么

一句话：**自动记录 agent 每次 `write` / `edit` 操作前的文件内容，用 `/undo` 还原。**

四个命令，一张表讲清：

| 命令 | 作用 |
|---|---|
| `/undo` | 撤销最近一次文件写入/编辑 |
| `/undo list` | 查看所有已记录的操作（索引 + 时间 + 工具 + 文件路径） |
| `/undo <n>` | 撤销指定索引的那一次操作 |
| `/undo prune [days]` | 清理 N 天前的快照，默认 7 天 |

一个典型场景：

```
/undo list
  [0] 14:20 edit config.yaml
  [1] 14:21 write src/utils.ts
  [2] 14:23 edit src/index.ts

/undo 1     # 只回退 src/utils.ts 那一次，其余不动
```

## 它怎么工作

原理不复杂，关键在设计上绕开了一个坑：

- **拦截时机**：插件挂在 DSH 的 `tools/pre-execute` 瀑布上——在 `write` / `edit` 工具**真正执行之前**，先把目标文件的当前内容读出来存成快照。
- **为什么是"执行前"而不是"执行后"**：因为 DSH 的 write/edit 工具执行完只返回一句成功文案，**把文件操作前的内容丢掉了**。所以要留底，必须在工具动手之前自己读一遍。
- **存储**：快照 append-only 追加到本地 JSONL（`~/.dsh/file-undo/snapshots.jsonl`），一条一个操作，避免并发写时的读改写竞争。
- **还原**：`/undo` 时把快照里的"操作前内容"通过官方 fs 服务写回文件，并携带当前会话的沙箱策略，确保写回权限和原操作一致。

## 边界：诚实说清楚它管不了什么

这个插件做得很窄，也正因为窄才可靠。以下场景**不在**覆盖范围内：

1. **只覆盖 `write` / `edit` 两个工具**——agent 通过 shell 直接改文件（`Set-Content`、重定向等）管不了。
2. **删除回退不支持**——官方 fs 至今没有 `delete`/`unlink` 接口，文件删除无法被追踪或还原；等官方补上这个能力才能做。
3. **快照全局共享**——不按会话隔离。

这些不是"没做完"，而是被明确的设计边界挡住了（比如删除回退，硬做就意味着绕过官方 API，得不偿失）。

## 安装

本地构建（link）三步：

```sh
# 1. 构建插件
pnpm install && pnpm build

# 2. profile 的 package.json 加依赖
#   "dependencies": { "dsh-file-undo": "link:<本目录绝对路径>" }

# 3. profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 挂载
#   - insert:
#       - id: file-undo
#         name: 'dsh-file-undo'

# 4. 重装并重启
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install && dsh web
```

（若发布到 npm，则一条 `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-undo` 即可。）

## 开发中踩的几个坑（给后来者）

写这个插件的过程，Cordis 的几处"运行时才报"的机制比想象中更狠，列出来供避雷：

1. **inject 漏声明服务**：代码里用了 `ctx.commands` 但没写进 `inject`，`tsc` 类型检查照样过（类型合并掩盖了），要到运行时 Guard 才抛 `cannot get property "commands" without inject`。**类型过 ≠ 能跑**。
2. **想当然的工具名**：一开始拦截 `str_replace_editor`，结果这个环境里 agent 实际用的文件工具是 `write` / `edit`，拦截永远不命中。**先查工具清单再写拦截**。
3. **带参数命令要声明 `input`**：`/undo list`、`/undo <n>` 这种带参数的形式，命令不声明 `input` 提示的话，会被前端降级成普通消息，根本不触发。
4. **写回要带沙箱策略**：插件在全局 context 里写文件，不传 session 的 `sandboxPolicy` 会直接 `file access denied`——还原和原操作必须在同一个 workspace 边界内。

这四条里，任何一条单看都是"哦，注意一下"，但它们叠加起来，足够让一个插件"能加载、能注册、就是不干活"。

## 结语

dsh-file-undo 不是一个宏大的东西——它就是一个**文件级的撤销器**，范围只有 `write`/`edit` 两个工具，但在这个范围内是实测可用的：拦截 → 快照 → 列出 → 还原，全链路跑通。

如果你的 agent 经常改文件，又不想每次都靠 Git 兜底，值得一试。

- 仓库：[github.com/QinLuza/dsh-file-undo](https://github.com/QinLuza/dsh-file-undo)（MIT，开源）

discussions.title: dsh 记忆体（Memory Body · Layered Memory Architecture）—— 多体挂载 + 自动总结 + FTS 检索
discussions.body:
dsh 记忆体（Memory Body）体验版

这是 [Memory Body 提案](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1822) 的可运行实现，核心闭环已跑通，发出来求反馈。

**一句话**：给 agent 一个跨会话、可挂载、可检索的长期记忆。

---

## 核心能力

- **多记忆体 + 按会话挂载**：`/mount` `/unmount` 决定当前会话能检索哪些体
- **双权威记忆**：`user`（用户钦定文档）/ `model`（模型总结的经验）
- **自动总结 + 降权不删除**：`/summarize` 提炼会话经验；`/forget` 只标记失效、历史可追溯
- **FTS5 全文检索**：trigram 分词，中英文 3 字以上任意子串命中
- **GUI + 后台 JSONL 双编辑**：设置页「记忆体」tab 管体，也能直接改纯文本

---

## 和已有记忆插件的不同（我们的取舍）

### 1. 挂载，而不是全量注入

很多记忆方案是把所有记忆一股脑塞进上下文。这里相反：**记忆体永远持久在磁盘，只有「挂载」的体才对当前会话可见**。模型只加载挂载体的 `id + 描述`，需要时才检索。

> 好处：跨会话的记忆不会污染当前任务，隔离是显式的、可控的。

### 2. 双权威，而不是混在一起

严格区分两类记忆：

- `user` —— 用户钦定的文档，模型**只读引用、不擅自改写**
- `model` —— 模型自动总结的经验，可编辑、可被新经验推翻

> 好处：避免把模型自动总结的「噪声」和用户亲口说的「钦定」混为一谈，可信度分层清晰。

### 3. 降权不删除，而不是覆盖

推翻旧记忆不是物理删除，而是追加 `superseded` 标记，保留出处链（哪条被哪条推翻）。

> 好处：记忆可审计、可回滚，不会因为一次错误总结永久丢信息。

### 4. GUI + 纯文本双编辑，而不是黑盒

既有图形界面（设置页 tab），存储又是**可读的 JSONL 纯文本**，人能直接打开改。

> 好处：透明、可手改、可审计 —— 记忆不锁在一个看不见的数据库里。

### 5. 事件溯源，索引可重建

JSONL 是唯一权威，SQLite FTS 只是**可丢弃的读模型**，每次检索前从 JSONL 重建。

> 好处：索引坏了、丢了都不影响数据，从权威层随时重建，永不因索引损坏而丢记忆。

---

## 开发中踩过的坑

| 坑 | 现象 | 根因 | 解法 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 循环等待 | `pending (waiting for service: remote.memoryBody)` | 把「自己 `$mount` 出来的服务」写进 `inject`，apply 前死等 | `inject` 只写外部依赖，`$mount` 后用 `ctx.get()` 读 ，这个错误的本质是插件把“由自己挂载出来的服务”错误地声明成了“启动前必须由别人提供的依赖”：memory-body 插件本身在 apply() 中通过 ctx.remote.$mount(memoryBodyRemote) 才会创建 remote.memoryBody，但如果同时把它写进 inject，Cordis 就会在插件执行 apply() 之前一直等待 remote.memoryBody 出现，而该服务又只能等插件启动后才会出现，于是形成循环等待，插件最终停留在 pending (waiting for service: remote.memoryBody)。正确做法是 inject 只保留 slots 和 remote，先执行 $mount，再用 ctx.get('remote.memoryBody') 读取刚挂载出来的服务。|
| 假阳性 | 删 row 后「启动成功」但功能全无 | 删 row = 弃用服务，服务不加载自然无 pending | 用 `SQLite` warning 判断服务是否真加载 |
| `waiting for memoryStore` | preset 工具不激活 | 前置 `MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 把 memory-store row 带崩 | 修模块解析（leaf 包进 fallback 闭包） |
| 中文搜不到 | 搜「用中文」搜不到「用中文交流」 | unicode61 把连续中文粘成一个 token | 换 trigram 分词器 |

## 版本状态

| 项 | 值 |
|---|---|
| workspace 版本 | `0.1.0-rc.5` |
| npm 官方最新 | `0.1.0-rc.6` |
| 发布前动作 | `git pull` 同步 rc.6 → 重新构建 → 改 `peerDependencies` |

> npm 上没有 `0.1.0-rc.5`（官方是 rc.2 → rc.3 → rc.6），`workspace:^` 原样发布会依赖解析失败。

## 已知限制（诚实）

- 检索最短 3 字符（trigram 机制）
- 挂载是会话临时，未持久化
- 未发布 npm（依赖版本未对齐 rc.6）


---

## 源码

https://github.com/szx-a/ds

---

## 请教与讨论

1. 「挂载」语义（数据永久、挂载临时）是否符合大家对记忆体的预期？
2. 下一步优先做挂载持久化，还是先补齐 npm 发布？

---

## 完整文档

安装步骤、目录结构、完整用法与设计细节，**具体见仓库 README**：

https://github.com/szx-a/ds#readme

discussions.title: dsh-lean — the first request of a session is ~52% of its bill, so I measured what is in it
discussions.body:
The default `standard` preset mounts 25 tools. Their schemas plus the paragraph `agent-instructions` generates per tool come to about 30,000 characters, and that whole prefix goes out on the first request of every session.

That first request is the expensive one. DeepSeek bills a cache-miss input token at 50x the cache-hit rate on `deepseek-v4-flash`. From the second request on the prefix is a cache hit and costs almost nothing, but the first one pays all of it at the miss rate. Across three runs of a six-request task that single request was 52% of the total bill, and it was the same 8,246 tokens every time.

Looking at what those tokens were, the delegation group, the goal tools and the job tools had never been called in any of my sessions. So I turned them off and measured, 32 runs, each from a clean copy of the task.

| task | runs per arm | cache-miss tokens | session cost |
|---|---|---|---|
| one question, no edits | 3 | 8,600 to 4,912  **-43%** | $0.001292 to $0.000755  **-42%** |
| fix three failing tests | 3 | 11,538 to 8,225  **-29%** | $0.002201 to $0.001671  **-24%** |
| implement a module from sixteen tests | 7 | 10,376 to 7,470  **-28%** | $0.002542 to $0.002373  **-7%** |

Read the third row first, it is the honest one. Cache-miss tokens drop on every task, that is the part the change controls directly. Converting that into money is not reliable: on the implementation task the leaner agent took more steps, 4.4 requests against 5.4, and produced 24% more output, which ate most of the saving. Its per-run cost ranges overlap, so a lean run there can cost more than a default run. That row needed seven runs an arm before it settled; at four it read much higher and the arms were not separated.

Every task ships its own test suite and it passes on both sides of every paired run, so the cheaper run provably did the same work.

**The part that might interest this group more than the numbers.**

A bundle patch that sets `disabled: true` on the tool rows works on `headless`, where `dsh-base` mounts those rows at the top level. On `web` it does nothing at all.

The reason is that `dsh-web-app` already disables those rows at the top level and then mounts `agent-presets`, with the real catalog living inside the `standard` preset composition. A profile patch layer composes over the profile tree and never reaches inside a preset composition, so such a patch only turns off rows that are already off. A real web session log still lists all 25 tools. Worth knowing if you are writing a plugin that expects to change the tool surface.

The way through is to stop patching there and use `ctx.agentPresets.copy('standard', 'lean')`, then disable the `delegation` group, `tool-goal` and `tool-jobs` in the copy. Copying rather than vendoring a composition means the copy inherits whatever `standard` the user actually has. Measured through the web UI, same prompt and workspace, one session each.

| | tools | system prompt | tool schemas | prefix |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard mode | 25 | 6,100 chars | 26,336 chars | 32,436 chars |
| Lean | 12 | 3,492 chars | 11,842 chars | 15,334 chars |

One thing I deliberately did not do is set `agent-presets.default` to the copy. A default naming a preset that failed to author fails loud at mount time, and breaking someone's profile over a convenience is a bad trade. It shows up in the mode menu instead.

**On the repricing.** Everything above was measured under the flat card before 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC. Repricing my committed `v4-pro` runs under the new table from #2064 moves the saving from 20.1% to 19.8% while the absolute money saved nearly doubles, since cache reads go from 2.9% to 9.9% of the bill and this shrinks those too.

Install, and it is measured to do nothing if you use subagents, workflows, goals or background jobs, since those are exactly what it removes.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lean        # then pick "Lean" in the mode menu
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-lean
```

To look at your own session without installing anything.

```sh
npx dsh-lean audit
```

It reads a session log dsh already wrote and prints the per-request cache split and the largest tool schemas in your own prefix. Repo with the harness, the three tasks and the raw per-run results: https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-lean

**Two questions I would rather ask than guess at.**

1. The measurement reads `assistant/chunk` usage events and `request/header` out of `session.jsonl.zstd`, which is where the full tool schema array turns out to be recorded. That made measuring the prefix free. Is there a supported way to get the same numbers? I would rather use it than read the session log.
2. `zstdDecompressSync` stops after the first frame and dsh appends one frame per write, so a 136-line session read back as 1 line until I split on the frame magic. Is appending per frame intentional, or would a single-frame rewrite on flush be welcome?

---

## dsh-lean — 一场会话的第一个请求约占账单的 52%，我把里面装了什么量了一遍

默认的 `standard` preset 挂了 25 个工具。它们的 schema 加上 `agent-instructions` 为每个工具生成的说明段落，合计约 3 万字符，而这整个前缀会在每场会话的第一个请求里发出去。

贵的就是这第一个请求。`deepseek-v4-flash` 上，DeepSeek 对缓存未命中的输入 token 收费是命中的 50 倍。从第二个请求开始前缀命中缓存，几乎不花钱，但第一个请求要按未命中价把它整个付一遍。一个 6 请求任务跑三次，仅这一个请求就占了总账单的 52%，而且每次都恰好是 8,246 个 token。

看这些 token 都是什么，delegation 组、goal 工具和 job 工具在我所有会话里一次都没被调用过。于是我把它们关掉并做了测量，32 次运行，每次都从任务的干净副本开始。

| 任务 | 每组运行次数 | 缓存未命中 token | 会话花费 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 一个问题，不改文件 | 3 | 8,600 到 4,912  **-43%** | $0.001292 到 $0.000755  **-42%** |
| 修好 3 个失败测试 | 3 | 11,538 到 8,225  **-29%** | $0.002201 到 $0.001671  **-24%** |
| 按 16 个测试实现一个模块 | 7 | 10,376 到 7,470  **-28%** | $0.002542 到 $0.002373  **-7%** |

先看第三行，它才是诚实的那一行。每个任务的缓存未命中 token 都降了，这是这个改动直接控制的部分。但把它换算成钱并不可靠：在实现任务上，精简后的 agent 反而多走了步数，请求数 4.4 对 5.4，输出多了 24%，把省下的大部分又吃了回去。它的逐次花费区间是重叠的，所以在那个任务上 lean 的某一次运行可能比默认还贵。这一行加到每组 7 次运行才稳下来，只跑 4 次的时候读数高得多，而且两组并没有分开。

每个任务都自带测试套件，每一组配对运行两边都通过，所以便宜下来不是因为少干了活。

**下面这部分可能比数字更值得这个版块关注。**

给工具行加 `disabled: true` 的 bundle patch 在 `headless` 上有效，因为 `dsh-base` 把那些行挂在顶层。但在 `web` 上它什么也不做。

原因是 `dsh-web-app` 在顶层已经把那些行关了，然后挂上 `agent-presets`，真正的工具目录在 `standard` 这个 preset 的组合里面。profile 的 patch 层叠加在 profile 树之上，够不到 preset 组合内部，所以这样的 patch 关的只是本来就已经关掉的行。一份真实的 web 会话日志里依然列着全部 25 个工具。如果你正在写一个想改动工具面的插件，这点值得知道。

可行的路子是在那边不再打 patch，改用 `ctx.agentPresets.copy('standard', 'lean')`，然后在副本里关掉 `delegation` 组、`tool-goal` 和 `tool-jobs`。用复制而不是内置一份组合，意味着副本继承的是用户实际拥有的那份 `standard`。通过 web UI 实测，同一个提示词、同一个工作目录，各跑一次会话。

| | 工具数 | 系统提示词 | 工具 schema | 前缀 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Standard mode | 25 | 6,100 字符 | 26,336 字符 | 32,436 字符 |
| Lean | 12 | 3,492 字符 | 11,842 字符 | 15,334 字符 |

有一件事我是刻意没做的，就是把 `agent-presets.default` 指向这个副本。默认值指向一个生成失败的 preset 会在挂载时直接报错，为了一点便利把别人的 profile 弄坏不划算。它出现在模式菜单里就够了。

**关于调价。** 上面所有测量都是在 2026-08-16 16:00 UTC 之前的统一价目表下做的。把我提交的 `v4-pro` 运行按 #2064 的新表重算，节省率从 20.1% 变成 19.8%，而省下的绝对金额接近翻倍，因为缓存读取在账单里的占比从 2.9% 升到 9.9%，而这个改动连那部分也一起缩。

安装。另外实测说明：如果你在用子智能体、workflow、goal 或后台 job，它对你没有意义，因为那些正是它移除的东西。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-lean        # 然后在模式菜单里选 "Lean"
dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-lean
```

不装任何东西、只想看自己会话的话。

```sh
npx dsh-lean audit
```

它读的是 dsh 本来就写好的会话日志，打印逐请求的缓存拆分和你自己前缀里最大的那几个工具 schema。仓库里有测量脚本、三个任务和每次运行的原始结果：https://github.com/sjh9714/dsh-lean

**两个问题，与其猜不如直接问。**

1. 这套测量是从 `session.jsonl.zstd` 里读 `assistant/chunk` 的 usage 事件和 `request/header`，完整的工具 schema 数组正好记录在后者里，所以量前缀不花钱。有没有官方支持的方式能拿到同样的数字？有的话我更愿意用那个。
2. `zstdDecompressSync` 在第一个 frame 之后就停了，而 dsh 每次写入追加一个 frame，所以一个 136 行的会话读回来只有 1 行，直到我按 frame magic 切分。按 frame 追加是有意为之，还是说在 flush 时重写成单 frame 会更受欢迎？

discussions.title: [BUG] dsh subagent 在 GUI 冷恢复后默认切回 dsv4p 模型导致扣费路由错误
discussions.body:
# 问题

Subagent 继承的是 `agent.options` 而非父 agent 的实际模型路由 —— GUI 切换模型或冷恢复后子代理静默跨 provider 计费

---

## 概述

`dsh-subagent` 解析子代理的 provider/model 时读取的是 **`parent.options`**（父 agent 创建时的 `AgentOptions`），而父 agent 的*实际*服务路由可以被模型选择瀑布（`installModelSelection`，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent`）按请求覆盖。两者一旦分叉，subagent 就会静默地把账单记到 `agent.options` 里写的 provider 上——而不是父 agent 真正在用的那个 provider。

本次事故中，分叉由 **GUI 冷恢复路径**引入：它用部署默认模型播种 `agentOptions`，同时把服务路由钉在会话持久化的 `request/header` 上。父 agent 自己一直在钉定路由上跑，但它派生的全部 61 个子/孙会话都按部署默认模型创建，账单全部记到了官方平台账号。

## 严重度

Critical —— 静默跨 provider 计费 / 成本泄漏，附带错误模型执行。财务影响只有去 provider 账单页才看得到。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6`；涉及包均为 `0.1.0-rc.6`：
  `dsh-subagent`、`dsh-host-apiproxy`、`dsh-api-remotes`、`dsh-agent-loop`、`dsh-agent-default-model`、`dsh-agent`、`dsh-session`。
- Node.js v22.22.2，macOS 26.6.1 (arm64)。
- 服务：launchd `com.deepseek.dsh.web` 运行 `dsh web`，监听 `127.0.0.1:3080`。

## 真实事故

时间线（UTC+8）：

| 时间 | 事件 |
|---|---|
| 20:48 | session 启动。第 1 轮。`request/header`（reason=initial）：`custom1/custom1`。 |
| 21:18 | DSH 宿主停止（重启）。run 记录被 `recoverInterruptedRuns()` 标为 `failed` / `host_interrupted`。 |
| 21:24 | 会话经 Web GUI API proxy 冷恢复。`request/header`（reason=resume）：仍是 `custom1/custom1`。 |
| 21:37 / 21:50 / 22:01 | 恢复后的父 agent 分三批派发 44 个直接子代理 + 17 个孙代理。 |
| 22:10 | 最后一个子代理活动结束。期间 DeepSeek 平台账号持续扣费。 |

观测到的父/子分叉：

- 父会话日志（每一条 `request/header`）：`config.provider=custom1`，`config.model=custom1`。
- 每个子会话日志（`subagent/descriptor`）：`"agentProvider":"deepseek-official"`，`"agentModel":"deepseek-v4-pro"`；子会话自己的 `request/header` 证实它确实由 `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro` 服务。
- `deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro` 正是 `settings.yaml → agent-default-model`——即部署默认模型。

成本：树内 61 个子会话，token 字段合计 ≈ input 471 万 / output 190 万 / reasoning 109 万（≈ 770 万），全部记到错误的provider，而父 agent 的流量一直走原路由。

## 根因

### 1. subagent 继承读的是 options，不是实际路由

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent/lib/index.js`（0.1.0-rc.6），`resolveChildAgentOptions`（501–512 行）：

```js
function resolveChildAgentOptions(parent, requested, childDepth) {
	const parentProvider = parent.options.provider;
	const parentModel = parent.options.model;
	const parentMaxTokens = parent.options.maxTokens;
	return {
		...parentProvider !== void 0 ? { provider: parentProvider } : {},
		...parentModel !== void 0 ? { model: parentModel } : {},
		...parentMaxTokens !== void 0 ? { maxTokens: parentMaxTokens } : {},
		...requested,
		subagentDepth: childDepth
	};
}
```

`parent.options` 是父 agent 创建/恢复时传入的 `AgentOptions`。任何改变父 agent 实际服务路由的机制都**不会**更新它。

### 2a. 冷恢复用部署默认模型播种 options，同时把路由钉在会话日志上

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-apiproxy/lib/index.js`（0.1.0-rc.6），`createApiProxy`：

```js
/** The seed model each create/resume declares; re-read so it never goes stale. */
const agentOptions = () => {
	const { provider, model } = defaults.defaultModelSelection();
	return { provider, model };
};
```

这个闭包同时用于全新创建和冷恢复（经 `createApiRemoteAgentResolver` → `ctx.agents.resume({ resumeSessionId, agentOptions: options.agentOptions() })`，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-api-remotes/lib/index.js` 124–126 行）。

而 `selectionFor()`（host-apiproxy 1750–1774 行）按此优先级安装请求级选择：进程内 picker 选择 → **会话持久化的 `request/header` 配置** → 部署默认。于是恢复后的 agent 处于：

- `agent.options` = 部署默认（`deepseek-official/deepseek-v4-pro`）
- 每次请求的实际路由 = 持久化 header（`custom1/custom1`）

父 agent 自己的 LLM 调用因此继续走持久化路由（正确），但 `resolveChildAgentOptions` 把 `agent.options`——部署默认——复制进每个子代理（错误，产生扣费）。

### 2b. GUI 模型选择器在活跃会话上有同样的分叉

模型选择 RPC（host-apiproxy 2701 行）：

```js
selectionFor(found.agent).current = selected;
```

它只写请求级 selection，从不写 `agent.options`。因此任何用户在 GUI 里选了不同于 `agent-default-model` 的模型的会话，立即出现 `options ≠ 实际路由`，它派生的每个 subagent 都会静默记到默认 provider 的账上。无需重启——这就是下面的最小复现。

## 最小复现

**复现 A —— GUI 模型选择器（无需重启）：**

1. `settings.yaml` 的 `agent-default-model` = provider A / model a。
2. 新建会话。用模型选择器切到 provider B / model b（B ≠ A）。
3. 发送：「Delegate one subagent (`run_in_background: false`) to reply with a single word.」
4. 观察：父会话 `request/header` = B/b；子会话的 `subagent/descriptor` 与 `request/header` = A/a。扣费的是 provider A。

**复现 B —— 冷恢复：**

1. 会话被钉到 B/b（picker）。至少发一次请求，让 `request/header` 存在。
2. 重启 `dsh web`。
3. 在 GUI 恢复该会话并派发一个 subagent。观察结果同上。

discussions.title: dsh-file-undo: Ctrl+Z for DSH agent file edits — and a call for help on deletion rollback
discussions.body:
# dsh-file-undo: Ctrl+Z for your DSH agent's file edits — and a call for help on deletion rollback

> Automatically snapshot every file the agent writes before it writes it, and restore with a single `/undo`. Plus: a question to the community about rolling back file deletions, which I haven't been able to solve.

## The problem

When a DeepSeek Harness (DSH) agent edits your files, it does so fast, broadly, and without keeping a copy of what it overwrote. Git can save you — but only if the file was committed and you remember a clean rollback point. In practice the agent often touches files outside git, or overwrites them several times before you notice.

**dsh-file-undo** gives DSH agents a file-level "undo key".

## What it does

One sentence: **it records the full content of every `write` / `edit` before the tool runs, and restores it with `/undo`.**

| Command | Effect |
|---|---|
| `/undo` | Undo the most recent file write/edit |
| `/undo list` | List recorded operations (index + time + tool + path) |
| `/undo <n>` | Undo a specific operation by index |
| `/undo prune [days]` | Drop snapshots older than N days (default 7); only shortens how far back you can roll, never touches current files |

Example:

```
/undo list
  [0] 14:20 edit config.yaml
  [1] 14:21 write src/utils.ts
  [2] 14:23 edit src/index.ts

/undo 1     # revert only src/utils.ts, leave the rest
```

## How it works

- **When it hooks**: on the `tools/pre-execute` waterfall — *before* the `write`/`edit` tool body runs, it reads and snapshots the current file content.
- **Why before, not after**: the write/edit tools return only a success string; **the pre-op content is discarded by the tool result**. So the before-state must be captured pre-execute, from the official fs service.
- **Storage**: append-only JSONL (`~/.dsh/file-undo/snapshots.jsonl`), one line per operation, avoiding read-modify-write races.
- **Restore**: writes the snapshot back via the official fs service, carrying the caller session's sandbox policy so the write lands in the same workspace boundary the original mutation used.

## Boundaries (deliberate, but two are blocked)

1. **Covers only the `write` / `edit` tools** — file changes made through a shell (`Set-Content`, redirection) are not captured.
2. **Snapshots are global**, not per-session.
3. **Deletion rollback is not implemented** — and this is the part I'd like help with (below).

## Call for help: how do you roll back a file deletion in DSH?

This is the gap I could not close, and I'd genuinely like ideas, pointers, or a "you're holding it wrong" from anyone who knows the harness internals.

**What I want:** undo for file *creation* (revert = delete the file) and eventually file *deletion* (revert = restore content).

**Why I'm stuck:**

- The official fs service (`ctx.fs`) has **no `delete` / `unlink` method**. There is no sanctioned way to remove a file through the official API, so undoing a creation (which requires deleting the created file) is impossible through supported surfaces. I refuse to side-step it with `node:fs` from inside the plugin.
- The **official tool results / session log do not retain the pre-op content**: `write`/`edit` outcomes return only a success string, so there is no historical before-state to restore a deleted file from — I had to capture it myself in `tools/pre-execute`, which only covers mutations I can intercept.
- Deletions done inside a shell (`rm`, `Remove-Item`) are invisible to the tool waterfall entirely.

**Questions to the community:**

1. Is there a planned or existing official `delete`/`unlink` API on `ctx.fs` that I've missed? (Checked rc.6 — nothing.)
2. Is deletion tracking considered part of the session log / timeline design? If a `rollback/*`-style event or an fs outcome already carries deletion info, I'd rather build on that than on my own snapshot store.
3. For shell-side deletions (`rm` etc.): is there any sanctioned hook to observe them (command-level event, bash tool outcome), or is that permanently out of reach?

My instinct is that the *right* fix is upstream — an official fs delete primitive plus a session event for deletions — rather than a plugin workaround. If anyone from the team or the community has a different take, I'm all ears.

## Install

Local build (link):

```sh
# 1. build
pnpm install && pnpm build

# 2. add to profile package.json
#   "dependencies": { "dsh-file-undo": "link:<abs path to this repo>" }

# 3. mount in profile cordis.patch.yml
#   - insert:
#       - id: file-undo
#         name: 'dsh-file-undo'

# 4. reinstall + restart
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web && pnpm install && dsh web
```

(Once published to npm: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-file-undo`.)

## Pitfalls I hit (for the next plugin author)

1. **`inject` omissions only fail at runtime**: using `ctx.commands` without declaring it in `inject` passes `tsc` (type merging hides it) and explodes in the Guard with `cannot get property "commands" without inject`. Type-check green ≠ it runs.
2. **Don't guess tool names**: I initially intercepted `str_replace_editor`; this environment's agent actually uses `write`/`edit`. Interception silently never matched. Check the tool catalog first.
3. **Argument-bearing commands need `input` declared**: `/undo list`, `/undo <n>` were downgraded to plain messages (never dispatched) until I declared `input: { hint: ... }`.
4. **Restores must carry the sandbox policy**: writing from the plugin's global context without the caller session's `sandboxPolicy` yields `file access denied` — the restore has to run in the same workspace boundary as the original mutation.

## Links

- Repo: [github.com/QinLuza/dsh-file-undo](https://github.com/QinLuza/dsh-file-undo) (MIT, open source)
- Any answer to the deletion question above is welcome here in the discussion or as an issue on the repo.

discussions.title: dsh-permission-rules: declarative permission rules + process-level network policy for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-permission-rules** — Claude Code-style declarative permission rules plus a Codex-style process-level network policy for DeepSeek Harness.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- Ordered `allow` / `deny` / `ask` YAML rules on the official `tools/pre-execute` waterfall: tool names, arguments (glob/regex), workspace paths, agent identity, and network targets.
- A built-in local HTTP/CONNECT proxy governs shell subprocess traffic with `deny-all` / `whitelist` / `allow-all` / `auto` modes mapped onto the official sandbox presets.
- Session-log audit, dry-run mode, HMR rule reload, and a settings page with a rule editor, block counters, and recent interception lists.
- 有序 allow/deny/ask YAML 规则（工具名/参数/路径/agent 身份/网络目标匹配）+ 内置本地代理的进程级网络策略 + 会话日志审计 + 干跑/热重载 + 设置页。

**Install / 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-permission-rules
```

**Links / 链接**

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-permission-rules
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-permission-rules
- Listed in: [awesome-dsh-plugin#444](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/444), [awesome-dsh-plugins#143](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/pull/143), [awesome-deepseek-harness#177](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness/pull/177), [bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#32](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/32)

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome (中英文都欢迎).

discussions.title: 会话日志损坏：倒带/断点恢复时追加事件未重新编号，触发 seq gap in committed region 无法加载历史
discussions.body:
## 现象 / Symptom

打开会话历史时失败（DSH Web，JSONL + zstd 持久化）：

```
history unavailable for session "session-xxx": Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 11690 (expected 187486, got 172982)（internal）
```

## 已出现两次（都是 turn 被 interrupted 后紧接的恢复/重放写入）

**案例 1 — 倒带 + 插入消息 + 重跑（session 位于 E:\workspace）**
- turn 35 被 interrupted（seq 187485）后，系统回退到 seq 172982（turn 33 起点），插入用户消息（事件 `agent/inbox/spliced`，data.target = "next-turn"），重新执行 turn 33（18 步 / 17 次工具调用，最后 completed）。
- 但重放追加到日志尾部的事件**带着旧 seq（172982..179394）**，而不是从 187486 继续编号 → 扫描器在第 11690 行发现 `expected 187486, got 172982`。

**案例 2 — 断点恢复续写（session 位于 E:\read）**
- turn 29 第 62 步工具调用（tool-call）流式输出中途被 interrupted，日志已写入 `turn/end`（reason: interrupted, seq 269833）。
- 0.7 秒后系统从 seq 269832 恢复续写**同一个 tool call 的剩余流**（同一 `toolCallId`）并跑完整个 turn（completed）。
- 恢复追加的 4069 个事件同样带旧 seq（269832..273900）→ 第 14740 行 `expected 269834, got 269832`。

## 根因分析 / Root cause

- `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts` 的 `SessionLogScanner` 要求事件 `seq === events.length`（连续无回退），任何回退即抛 `corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region`。
- 倒带/断点恢复路径（rewind / resume / inbox splice）在追加重放或续写事件时，**直接复用了内存中事件的原始 seq 写盘，未在写入前重新编号**，导致文件尾部出现 seq 回退。

## 影响 / Impact

- 会话历史完全无法加载（会话搜索、恢复、续聊全部不可用）。
- 无自动修复：torn tail 有自动截断恢复，但 seq gap 在 committed region 直接抛错，数据在文件中却读不出来。
- 本机两个会话均需手动重建（保留前缀 + 尾部重编号续接）才能无损恢复。

## 期望行为 / Expected

- 倒带/恢复追加的事件应从当前日志末尾 seq 继续编号（写入前 renumber）；或
- reader 对"回退追加的重放分支"宽容处理（如显式分支标记）。

## 环境 / Environment

- DSH Web（JSONL 持久化，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 0.1.0-rc.5），文件为 `~/.dsh/sessions/<projectKey>/<session-id>/session.jsonl.zstd`（zstd 多帧拼接的 JSONL）。
- 会话 `agentPreset: anchored-standard`，Node 24。
- 复现线索：两个案例均发生在 turn 被 `interrupted` 后紧接的恢复/重放；案例 2 时间线上 interrupted 事件与恢复首事件仅相差约 0.7 秒，且恢复续写的是同一 tool call id。

discussions.title: Feature: Workspace should support multiple root paths (project with appended directories)
discussions.body:
Feature request: **Workspace should support multiple root paths** (a project with appended directories).

## Problem
The `Workspace` model currently binds a single path (`id/path/title/sessionIds`). Users want a "project" concept: one project root + multiple appended directories, where all sessions under that project can access every path.

Example: project `data-flywheel` root `E:\data-flywheel`, appended paths `E:\data-flywheel\processed`, `C:\Users\Acer\.codex\sessions`.

## Gaps
1. **Data model**: `Workspace` has no `extraPaths` field
2. **Sandbox**: `workspace-write` root = `session.header.cwd` only; appended paths cannot be written
3. **Tool layer**: `sessionResolveOptions` resolves relative to cwd only
4. **UI**: sidebar workspace has no "add path" entry

## Requested
- `Workspace.extraPaths: string[]`
- read/glob/grep/bash/write allowlisted for extra paths (read at minimum; write configurable)
- sidebar workspace can add/display multiple paths
- persisted with the workspace; sessions auto-aware

## Workaround today
`danger-full-access` mode + project-root AGENTS.md listing paths; model uses absolute paths. Works but is not a product-level capability.

Env: v0.1.0-rc.6 (47f9438)

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: sdk.snapshot replay 的 {{cwd}} 水合未转义反斜杠 → "Bad escaped character in JSON"（附最小修复）
discussions.body:
## 环境
- Windows 11 x64、Node v24.15、pnpm 11，仓库 master（2026-08-13 快照）
- 复现：`node node_modules/vitest/vitest.mjs run --config vitest.snapshot.config.ts examples/jsonrpc-agent/tests/sdk.snapshot.ts`（或 `pnpm run test:snapshot` 限定该文件）

## 症状
replay 模式下 4 个场景全部失败，子运行时 boot 报：

`dsh-jsonrpc-agent: plugin tree failed to load: ... failed to apply loader entry llm-replay (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-replay): Bad escaped character in JSON at position 91 (line 1 column 92)`

## 根因
`examples/jsonrpc-agent/tests/sdk.snapshot.ts` 的 `hydrateReplayFixtures`：

```ts
await writeFile(destination, (await readFile(source, 'utf8')).replaceAll('{{cwd}}', cwd))
```

`cwd` 是 `mkdtemp` 生成的 Windows 路径（含反斜杠），被直接文本替换进 session.jsonl 头行的 `"cwd":"{{cwd}}"`，未做 JSON 转义，`C:\Users\...` 中的 `\U` 成为非法转义序列。错误位置 91 与 `{{cwd}}` 起始位置精确对应。
macOS/Linux 路径分隔符为 `/`，替换后仍是合法 JSON，因此官方 CI 未暴露（AGENTS.md 也注明 fixtures 需在 macOS/Linux 重放）。

## 最小修复（已本地验证）
```ts
await writeFile(destination, (await readFile(source, 'utf8')).replaceAll('{{cwd}}', JSON.stringify(cwd).slice(1, -1)))
```

修复后 3/4 场景通过（text-turn / bash-tool / subagent-spawn-in-process）。剩余 `persistent-tools` 失败为另一独立事项：该场景依赖 `subprocess-local` 的终端持久化检查，win32 明确不支持（`terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`），与转义 bug 无关。

## 备注
- 仅影响测试工具链（test-only path），不影响运行时行为；
- 同一水合逻辑覆盖子 fixture（session.N.jsonl），一处修复即全量覆盖。

discussions.title: fix(directory-picker-native): preserve UTF-16 paths with zero low bytes
discussions.body:
Title:

Windows native directory picker truncates paths containing certain Chinese characters

Body:

### Environment

- DSH version: `0.1.0-rc.5`
- OS: Windows
- Launch mode: Source
- Affected component: Native workspace directory picker

### Problem

When adding a workspace through the Windows native directory picker, some Chinese directory names are truncated.

For example, selecting:

```text
D:\DeepSeekHarness\Tools\workspaces\测试需求
```

causes DSH to submit:

```text
D:\DeepSeekHarness\Tools\workspaces\测试
```

Workspace creation then fails with:

```text
workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at
"D:\DeepSeekHarness\Tools\workspaces\测试":
ENOENT: no such file or directory
```

### Root cause

`readUtf16()` in:

```text
packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts
```

detects the UTF-16 NUL terminator by checking only the first byte of each UTF-16LE code unit:

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
```

The character `需` is `U+9700`, encoded as `00 97` in UTF-16LE. Its low byte is `00`, so the reader incorrectly treats it as the end of the string.

### Proposed fix

Require both bytes of the UTF-16 code unit to be zero:

```ts
while (
  end + 1 < bytes.length
  && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)
) {
  end += 2
}
```

### Verification

A regression case using:

```text
C:\测试需求\directory
```

was added to `win32-dialog-bindings.spec.ts`.

Result:

```text
Test Files  1 passed
Tests      12 passed
```

discussions.title: ctx.fs.stat() silently succeeds on nonexistent paths in sandbox mode, breaking any code that uses try/catch to check file existence
discussions.body:
### TL;DR

`ctx.fs.stat(target)` for a path that does not exist returns a non-undefined value instead of throwing (ENOENT) or returning `undefined`. Plugin code that detects file existence via `try { stat } catch { not-found }` is silently broken — observed in our `dsh-welch` plugin's `routine_create` tool, which falsely reported "routine 已存在" while the routines directory was empty.

### Reproduction

Host plugin code (tested on 0.1.0-rc.6, Windows 11, workspace-write sandbox):

```js
const fs = ctx.fs
async function exists(p) {
  let ok = false
  try { await fs.stat(await fs.resolve(p)); ok = true } catch (_) {}
  return ok
}
// path that does NOT exist on disk
await exists('C:\\Users\\wwj10\\.dsh\\routines\\nonexistent.yaml')
// returns true (should be false)
```

### Actual vs Expected

- **Actual**: `await fs.stat(nonexistent)` returns successfully; no error thrown.
- **Expected (POSIX-equivalent)**: either reject with ENOENT **OR** return `undefined`.

### Impact

- Any plugin that wants to "check existence before write" is silently broken.
- First-run effect: tools that gate writes on existence checks either refuse to create new files (false "exists") or silently overwrite unintended files.
- The same pattern is likely used in many plugins (dsh-memory / dsh-audit / dsh-intel / dsh-welch etc.); should be audited.

### Suggested contract change

Make `stat`'s "does not exist" branch explicit in the type — either `FsInfo | undefined` with `undefined` meaning ENOENT, or throw `ENOENT`. Document it in `ctx.fs.stat`'s contract.

### Workaround (current)

Inspect the return value, not the throw:

```js
const st = await fs.stat(target)
if (st) { /* exists */ } else { /* does not */ }
```

### Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6
- Profile: web (workspace-write sandbox, default)
- Platform: Windows 11 + Node.js v24.19.0
- Reproducer: any host plugin calling `ctx.fs.stat` on a missing path

### Linked discussions (related bugs found while building our dsh-* plugin stack)

- #454 plugin model security audit
- #817 sandbox/approval boundary bypass
- #1697 plugin install breaks tool calls

### Contact

Reproducer available on request. Reported via our agent architecture session of 2026-08-16 — no automated submission per project preference.

---

discussions.title: Windows: dsh plugin add splits paths with spaces, and hook bridges fail open silently
discussions.body:
Two Windows issues found while evaluating `dsh` on Windows 11, both reproduced on `47f94385` with Node 24.19.0. Posting here since `CONTRIBUTING.md` asks for Discussions rather than PRs.

## 1. `dsh plugin add` splits a package path that contains a space

`apps/cli/src/plugin.ts` calls `spawnSync('pnpm', args, { shell: process.platform === 'win32' })`. With `shell: true` and CMD, Node sets `windowsVerbatimArguments`, so the argv is concatenated into one unquoted command line and cmd re-tokenizes it.

```
dsh plugin --profile web add "D:\Repo Clones\lhh010\dsh-minigames"
```

installs two dependencies, `Repo` and a broken `link:Clones\lhh010\dsh-minigames`, then prints the misleading `Repo declares no dsh.bundle` warning. Staging the package at a space-free path works around it. Relative specifiers also resolve against the caller's cwd rather than the profile directory, which surprised me separately.

One fix that passes here removes `shell: true` and spawns the command processor directly, so Node applies its own quoting:

```ts
export function buildPnpmSpawn(
  anchored: readonly string[],
  platform: NodeJS.Platform,
  comspec: string | undefined,
): { command: string; args: readonly string[] } {
  if (platform !== 'win32') return { command: 'pnpm', args: anchored }
  return { command: comspec ?? 'cmd.exe', args: ['/d', '/s', '/c', 'pnpm', ...anchored] }
}
```

with `runPlugin` calling `spawnSync(command, pnpmArgs, { cwd: dir, stdio: 'inherit' })` and no `shell` option. A four-case regression test on that builder passes locally; happy to paste it if useful.

## 2. Hook bridges fail open on Windows, silently, for any hook that invokes an interpreter

`packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code` runs a hook's `command` through the host shell. On Windows that is PowerShell, which does **not** adopt a native child's exit code as its own process exit code:

```
powershell -NoProfile -Command "py -3 hook.py"                     # exits 1 when hook.py exits 2
powershell -NoProfile -Command "py -3 hook.py; exit $LASTEXITCODE" # exits 2
```

Since a non-2 exit is classified as a non-blocking error, a `PreToolUse` deny hook is skipped and nothing reports it. Verified by canary in the headless profile: the identical hook blocks with the suffix and does not block without it, so a user can have a hook config that loads, runs, and enforces nothing.

A bash-idiom hook fails harder, because PowerShell parses the whole command before running any of it. With `echo MARKER > file; echo x >&2; exit 2`, the marker file was never written: `>&2` is not valid PowerShell, so the leading write never executed either.

Suggestion: either run hook commands through a shell that propagates child exit codes, or document the trailing `; exit $LASTEXITCODE` requirement in both bridge READMEs. The Codex bridge README already lists `commandWindows` as ignored, which is a related trap for anyone bringing an existing config over.

Happy to provide full patches or the canary scripts if that would help.

discussions.title: RFC: verified upstream patch queue — 42 cherry-pick-ready fixes for the release train (root cause + minimal fix + tests)
discussions.body:
## 中文 TL;DR

PR 通道重开后，这里有一份维护者可直接 cherry-pick 的补丁队列：**42 个修复**，
每个都带根因、最小 diff、定向测试，以及它所对应的 discussion。不是「看看我的
作品」，是一份带逐项验证证据的补丁账本。

- 全绿编译 + typecheck；五补丁全量套件通过 **1146 个测试**（Windows / Node 24 / pnpm 11）。
- #1697（模块实例遮蔽）有机制级证明：两份物理 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6`
  副本在同一进程，symbol 身份 `false → true`。
- 逐项账本：https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-docs/blob/main/docs/specs/upstream-patches.md

优先的四类修复：模块实例遮蔽（#1697，Symbol.for + 协议版本守卫）、预启动诊断
（#1719 dsh doctor）、会话日志鲁棒性（#2068/#2002/#2202/#2342）、跨平台/provider
兼容（#2386/#2405/#2376/#2388）。

兼容性承诺：不改宽任何 peer 范围、不放松任何测试。PR 通道打开后，官方想要一个
整体采纳 PR 还是逐条 PR，我都会把账本 rebase 到最新 master 并保持全绿。

---

## TL;DR

When the PR channel reopens, here is a maintainer-facing, ready-to-cherry-pick
queue of **42 fixes**, each carrying root cause, a minimal diff, targeted tests,
and the discussion it closes. Not a "look at my repo" post — a patch ledger with
per-entry verification evidence.

## What's verified

- Every branch compiles and typechecks (`tsc -b tsconfig.host.json` / `pnpm typecheck` clean).
- Every branch carries at least one targeted regression test (counts are in the ledger).
- The five-patch full-suite run (Windows / Node 24 / pnpm 11) passes **1146 tests**;
  it includes the #1697 duplicate-instance regression suite.
- #1697 has a mechanism-level proof: two physical `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6`
  copies in one process → symbol identity `false` before, `true` after.

Ledger (per-patch detail): https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-docs/blob/main/docs/specs/upstream-patches.md

## Class-level fixes worth prioritizing

1. **Module-instance shadowing** (#1697) — `Symbol.for` shared key +
   `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER_PROTOCOL_VERSION` guard (loud, actionable on version
   skew). Host-first `@deepseek-ai/*` resolution is the roadmap fix that
   eliminates the whole class, not just this symbol.
2. **Pre-boot diagnostics** — the companion `dsh doctor` contract (#1719) plus
   the `profile-shadow` tripwire in `dsh-plugin-doctor`, which catches the #1697
   precondition before anything boots.
3. **Session-log robustness** — duplicate-seq tolerance (#2068), corrupt-log
   isolation (#2002), torn-tail false positives (#2202), self-heal (#2342).
4. **Cross-platform / provider compat** — Win32 directory picker UTF-16 (#2386),
   cross-platform session restore cwd (#2405), `cordis_define` oneOf stringify
   (#2376), custom provider `supportsDeveloperRole` (#2388).

## Cherry-pick

Each branch is based on a common master base; the exact branch per fix is in the
ledger. `git fetch` then `git cherry-pick <branch>` — no rebase archaeology
required.

## Compatibility commitment

No patch widens a peer range or relaxes a test. #1697 specifically adds the
protocol-version guard so a version-skewed duplicate stays **loud and
actionable** instead of silently mismatching.

## Ask

When the channel opens, would you prefer this queue as one adoption PR, or
individual PRs per discussion? I'll keep the ledger rebased to current master
and green either way.

Ledger: https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-docs/blob/main/docs/specs/upstream-patches.md

discussions.title: 建议为 compat 增加 supportsDeveloperRole 开关，并澄清切换协议后如何配置思考强度
discussions.body:
## 背景

部分自托管 / 企业网关是通用 OpenAI Chat Completions 兼容实现（如基于 Rust 的代理），只接受 `system/user/assistant/tool/latest_reminder` 角色，**不认 OpenAI 较新引入的 `developer` 角色**。当 `compat` 里配置了推理相关开关（如 `supportsReasoningEffort: true` + `reasoning: high`），且模型声明了 `reasoningEfforts` 时，DSH 会以 `role: "developer"` 发送系统提示，这类网关直接返回 400：

```
messages[0].role: unknown variant `developer`, expected one of `system`, `user`, `assistant`, `tool`, `latest_reminder`
```

## 根因（已读源码确认）

- `pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js:787`：`const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole;`
- `detectCompat`（同文件 :1148）：对通用端点 `isNonStandard=false` → 默认探测 `supportsDeveloperRole = true`。
- 但 `supportsDeveloperRole` **不是合法配置项**：`dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js:1333` 的 `compatProfile` schema 只声明 `thinkingFormat` 与 `supportsReasoningEffort` 两个键；且 `resolveModelCompat`（:1068）只把这两个键搬进 `model.compat`，其它键一律丢弃。
- 结果：`model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole` 永远读到 `undefined` → 回退探测值 `true` → 必发 `developer` 角色，且用户在 settings 里无法关闭它。

## 建议

在 `compat` 增加用户可覆盖的 `supportsDeveloperRole` 布尔开关，让不兼容的后端能强制用 `system` 角色：

1. `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js` 的 `compatProfile` 增加字段：

```js
const compatProfile = z.object({
  thinkingFormat: z.union(SUPPORTED_THINKING_FORMATS),
  supportsReasoningEffort: z.boolean(),
  supportsDeveloperRole: z.boolean()   // 新增
});
```

2. `resolveModelCompat` 转发该键（与 `thinkingFormat`/`supportsReasoningEffort` 同处理）：

```js
return { compat: {
  ...base?.api === api ? base.compat : void 0,
  ...thinkingFormat === void 0 ? {} : { thinkingFormat },
  ...supportsReasoningEffort === void 0 ? {} : { supportsReasoningEffort },
  ...supportsDeveloperRole === void 0 ? {} : { supportsDeveloperRole }   // 新增
} };
```

3. `pi-ai` 的 `getCompat`（openai-completions.js:1194）已是 `model.compat.supportsDeveloperRole ?? detected`，无需改动。

预期：默认行为不变（仍按探测值），仅当用户显式写 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false` 时强制 `system` 角色。

discussions.title: K3 报告原文核心论述（Section 3） Training with a single fixed agent harness can cause a model to overfit to a particular tool schema, system prompt, context management mechanism, or interaction protocol.
discussions.body:
在灰测时，模型在非dsh的agent（例如opencode)下表现优秀；正式版在相同条件下表现下降，甚至dsh官方框架下的非极简模式调用非官方工具会导致deepseek-v4-pro-0831性能极具下降”

与K3论文的警示高度吻合

kimi K3的论文里就有写相关问题：
一、K3 报告原文核心论述（Section 3）
Training with a single fixed agent harness can cause a model to overfit to a particular tool schema, system prompt, context management mechanism, or interaction protocol.
（使用单一固定的 Agent Harness 进行训练，会导致模型严重过拟合到特定的工具 Schema、系统提示词、上下文管理机制或交互协议上。）

恰好符合这一现象——在Harness内极简只有2个官方工具下稳定，在Harness内非极简模式加上非官方工具泛化极具能力下降。希望团队能评估是否与训练策略调整有关。

“单一固定Harness训练 → 模型过拟合到特定工具Schema、系统提示词、上下文管理机制”
这不是“可接受的代价”，而是这条路固有的结构性缺陷：
环境即过滤器：Harness再复杂，也只是现实世界的一个子集。模型在子集里再强，也不等于能应对全集。
反馈即偏见：在Harness里收集的反馈，永远是“在这个环境里的反馈”。它包含的信息是被Harness过滤过的，不是真实的、开放的、不可预测的反馈。
训练目标即天花板：如果训练只优化“在Harness里的成功率”，那模型学到的是“如何在这个环境里表现好”，而不是“如何理解世界”。
“这条路源头就错误了”——因为它从设计之初就预设了一个封闭环境，然后用这个环境里的数据去训练所谓的“通用智能”，这在逻辑上是循环论证。


来自社区：
（2.3播放）
说的是 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 只是对特定脚手架过拟合了。换成专用提示词和工具接口，就能激活它的“正常模式”。
于是我又做了 18 次独立的长程 Agentic Coding 测试。每次最多允许 50 次 tool calls，分别组合 3 种 scaffold、2 种停止提示，并重复 3 次。总计花费1亿 token。
直接说结论：
至少在我的 case 里，“换回专用脚手架就能恢复正常”这个解释没有得到支持。
换 scaffold (脚手架) 确实会影响模型能不能推进到完整验证；continuous-opt 提示也确实更容易让它继续探索。
但它们都没有办法解决我发现的【停止控制问题】。
也就是说, 模型过拟合和停止控制问题完全是两个独立问题, 不是通过专用提示词和工具接口就能让停止控制问题变好.
在我的18回合评估中：
- 模型只有 3 次主动调用了 finish；
- 4 次已经完成了目标, 但还是继续瞎跑到预算耗尽；
- 还有大量运行没有在 finish 前完成完整验证；
- 没有任何一组 scaffold × prompt 稳定复现理想的停止行为

也就是说, 你用 DeepSeek Harness 或者别的 Coding Agent 接 DeepSeek-V4-Pro-0813 写代码, 他可能复杂任务迅速给你一个很弱智的结果, 也可能简单任务跑半小时, 烧个几百万 token, 给你一个时尚雕花的结果. 甚至还可能你让它优化代码, 结果它越优化越拉跨还停不下来...

所以, 我的结论是——这模型有2个问题. 换提示词修不好. 说的很明白了. 以上.

相关测试和 POV 在这里: github.com/karminski/deepseek-v4-pro-0813-scaffold-stop-3x2-validation（哔哩哔哩视频目前2.3万播放，BV1ZEbS65E34）


3.7万播放：
极简模式并非DeepseekV4Pro问题的根因，蓝色大肥鱼人格分裂的治疗探索（
3.7万222026-08-16 00:54:24
BV1Ftb26kErX未经作者授权，禁止转载
注意事项：内容仅为我个人测试，无任何权威性与专业性可言，仅供参考~

很多人都忽略了一件很明显的事...

Deepseekv4Pro的网页对话版思维链是没有Let me的！

你能在官网看到与极简模式完全相同的思维链。

甚至... 实际上V4Pro的预览版

你仍能复现出正式版（或者说灰测版）的思维链

看，这是硅基流动的预览版V4pro，在完全无系统提示词和工具的情况下，思维链中无任何的Let me

看，这是火山引擎出预览版V4Pro，同样，思维链中无任何的Let me

...

回到我们的Deepseek Harness，我创建了各种不同的模式用来测试思维链的触发情况。

首先我们来看极简模式，打开轨迹 -> System -> 工具的详情

记住这两个工具，分别是bash和str编辑

我们再看let me的数量，0个！

然后我们去掉极简模式的系统提示词，只保留工具

Let me的数量仍为0个

再接下来，我们删掉系统提示词，也删掉这两个bash和str编辑工具，再进行测试

let me的数量仍为0个

是的，这接近于纯文本输入，思维链就是灰测的思维链

我们可以得到一个阶段性的结论，极简模式与思维链模式，没有强关联

我们继续尝试，将系统提示词更换为歌曲【春日影】的歌词，但工具与极简模式完全相同。

let me的数量达到了7个！

但系统提示词真的是思维链的根因么？

再试，将系统提示词替换为春日影，但不注入任何工具

奇异的事情发生了，在系统提示词为春日影的情况下，let me的数量仍为0个

看来，系统提示词对思维链的变更有关联，但同样，关联性不大

好吧，我们接着尝试，在无系统提示词的情况下，随机注入1个 2个，4个，8个，16个工具

结果我们得到的let me数量分别为：

4个， 16个， 20个， 7个， 12个

好吧... 没有任何规律可言，let me要么出现一堆，要么几乎就不出现

我们回顾之前的结论，在无工具注入的情况下，无论有无系统提示词，哪怕系统提示词是春日影，let me的数量都是0个

于是我们再次得到一个阶段性的结论，工具本身的提示词对思维链的影响较为明显

我们继续测试，对极简模式的工具进行复刻微调

在无系统提示词的情况下

对bash和str编辑工具的提示词进行一些微小的修改，修改内容的比对可暂停查看：

let me出现的数量如何呢？

还是0个！

好吧，那我们把极简模式工具的提示词修改的稍微多一点，稍微调换下语序，修改内容的比对可暂停查看：

let me变成了 5个！

哦... 看来症状很明显了，要么没有工具注入，要么工具注入的，必须是这两个官方原版的工具，bash和str编辑工具

极其微小的单词修改不会触发let me思维链，但调换语序就不行了

等等... 那如果只注入其中一个原版工具呢？

我们尝试在无系统提示词的情况下，只注入一个bash，或者只注入一个str编辑

let me的数量为.... 11个和6个！

好吧，我减少一个工具都不行...

工具的提示词与思维链模式的关联性极强，必须是这两个官方的工具

且必须是两个，在仅有其中一个工具的情况下，仍为let me思维链

最后一个测试，在保留极简模式两个工具的情况下，分别随机增加1个，2个，4个，8个，16个其他工具，结果会是？

let me的数量分别为... 0个， 0个， 3个， 5个， 24个！

最后，我们可以得到一个最终的结论

只有在无任何工具注入，或者只有极简模式两个工具的注入的情况下

才能稳定触发没有Let me的思维链

我们可以在极简模式两个插件的基础上

扩展3个以下（且不是很复杂）的插件，let me的出现概率较小，属于可用的范畴

如果多扩展至8个插件，即使我们的工具内包含bash和str编辑，这两个工具，也无法压制蓝色大肥鱼的let me人格苏醒

...

感谢观看，以上内容仅为我个人测试，无任何权威性与专业性可言，仅供参考...

封面：https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/148376216
结尾：https://www.pixiv.net/artworks/113298510

discussions.title: dsh-click: native desktop control (screen_shot/screen_read/click/type) for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
dsh-click — cross-platform native desktop control for DeepSeek Harness (Windows first): observe native application windows as structured text and act on them, with every mutating action gated by approval.

What it solves / 解决什么问题

- `screen_shot` + `screen_read`: screenshot, or the window's structured accessibility tree with pixel-location hints — text-only models get the full observe loop without a vision model.
- `click` / `type` / `scroll` / `key`: window-scoped actions via UIAutomation (posted-message fallback), never stealing foreground focus; `type` backs up and restores control text on failure.
- `app_list` / `app_launch` for discovery and launch.
- Every mutating action must cite a fresh observation (stale-screen rejection with pixel-hash checks), crosses the official approval seam (window allowlist configurable), and verifies the target process identity before and after the act.
- Audit events (`dsh-click/observed`, `dsh-click/action`) keep the whole loop reconstructable from the session log; all output is sanitized before it reaches the model or the log.

Install / 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-click
```

Links / 链接

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-click
- Listed in (open PRs): awesome-dsh-plugins#201, awesome-deepseek-harness#302, bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#68

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome.

discussions.title: dsh-checkpoint-rewind: Claude Code /rewind for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-checkpoint-rewind** — Claude Code `/rewind`-equivalent for DeepSeek Harness: git-first workspace snapshots before every mutation, turn-boundary session forks, and a one-shot `/rewind` restore.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- Unified checkpoints: workspace files (git object store or copy provider), the session (fork seed replay through the official `sessions.create` seed), and the profile config.
- `/rewind preview` shows exactly which files a restore would overwrite before anything happens; every restore is approval-gated with a diff summary.
- v0.5.0 adds the settings-page timeline with pairwise diffs between snapshots, a line-level LCS unified diff, and per-turn automatic plus change-triggered snapshots.
- 统一检查点（工作区/会话/配置三态）+ 恢复前预览与审批门 + 设置页时间线与两两 diff + 每轮自动快照。

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-checkpoint-rewind

discussions.title: 🐋 Orca DSH Launcher: update checker + system tray + GUI console + one-click installer for DSH on Windows
discussions.body:
Hi everyone! I built a small Windows companion tool for DSH and would love to share it with the community. 🐋

## What it is

**Orca DSH Launcher** is an open-source Cordis plugin + desktop component for DSH on **Windows**. It makes daily DSH usage a lot more convenient:

- 🔔 **Update checking** — on every DSH startup it compares your local git commit with the official `master` branch and notifies you when a new version is out. **Query only, never auto-updates** (and never touches DSH source files).
- 🖥️ **System tray** — a small orca (killer whale) icon in the tray: left-click opens the DSH UI, right-click menu starts/stops the server and checks for updates.
- 🎛️ **Graphical console** — a WPF management window (Overview / Server / Install / Logs / Settings / About) with dark & light themes. Opens even when DSH is not running.
- ⌨️ **`/orca` slash commands** — 14 commands in the DSH chat: status, check, start, stop, restart, open, log, port, config, health, console, tray...
- 🚀 **One-click installer** — `orca-setup.exe` can install DSH from scratch on a fresh Windows machine (environment & network checks, `git clone`, `pnpm install` + `pnpm run build`, plugin install). The console also has an "Install" page for both the full version and the official Web version (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`).

## Quick start

```powershell
# If DSH is already installed:
powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1
```
For a fresh machine, just download `orca-setup.exe` from the Releases page and double-click it.

- Repo: https://github.com/Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher
- Releases: https://github.com/Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher/releases
- README: https://github.com/Lheyang/orca-dsh-launcher/blob/master/README.en.md

It is MIT-licensed, built with PowerShell 5.1 + Node.js, and ships with a full test suite (7 checks). The code is commented in Chinese for readability; docs are available in both 中文 and English.

中文用户：这个插件为 DSH 提供更新提醒、托盘、图形控制台和一键安装，欢迎试用并提出建议！

Feedback, issues, and ideas are very welcome — thank you! 🙏

discussions.title: dsh-mcp-panel: MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client
discussions.body:
**dsh-mcp-panel** — the MCP management console for the official DeepSeek Harness MCP client (the official client stays the only bridge).

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- Server CRUD in Settings → Plugins → MCP: add/edit/remove stdio and streamable-http servers; every edit renders as an append-only `cordis.patch.yml` operation (`insert` / `set` / `set disabled`), one-click copy or approval-gated write with timestamped automatic backups.
- Tool trial console + `/mcp <server> call <tool> [json]`: trial-call registered `mcp__*` tools through the OFFICIAL `ctx.tools.execute()` pipeline — permission policy, approval asks and guards all stay in force.
- `/mcp <server> health`: derived self-heal suggestions from sanitized error text; exit codes / stderr tails honestly labeled "pending upstream support" until the official client exposes them.
- Honest connection status from the upstream `mcp/status` seam; sanitized display — env/header values never leave the host.
- 设置页可视化增删改 MCP 服务器（审批门 + 自动备份的只追加 profile 写入）+ 走官方工具管线的工具试用台 + 健康诊断 + 诚实连接状态与脱敏展示。

discussions.title: Drag-and-drop files into the web composer to insert their local paths
discussions.body:
## Summary

A feature proposal with a complete implementation: drag-and-drop a file onto the web composer to insert its local path into the draft, so the agent can read it.

Images keep the existing attachment-rail intake; every other file inserts its absolute path at the caret, one path per line, as a single undoable draft transaction.

The browser cannot read a dropped file's local path, so the path is recovered in two stages:

1. **URI-list decode** — when the drag source exposes a `file://` URL (`text/uri-list`, `public.file-url`, or plain text), the path is decoded directly in `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/input/dropped-paths.ts`. WebKit (macOS) provides this, so the original path is inserted instantly.
2. **Upload as a reference copy** — when the browser only describes the file, the bytes upload through a new loopback-pinned `host.uploadDroppedFile` RPC into the session's `.dsh-uploads/` directory and the written path is inserted. The copy is read-only reference material: no disk traversal, and the original location need never be known. 20 MB cap, basename validation, numeric-suffix dedupe (never overwrite), and `cwd` allow-listed to the host launch dir or a registered workspace.

The composer shows an indeterminate "uploading" strip while uploads are in flight, and names any files that failed to upload in a toast.

## Implementation

The complete change is committed and pushed to a fork branch (I understand external pull requests are not currently accepted, so I'm surfacing it here instead):

- Fork: https://github.com/dasonliu/deepseek-harness
- Branch: `feat/web-drop-file-path-insertion`
- Commit: `b22afe1e87` — `feat(web): insert dropped files' local paths via .dsh-uploads upload`

It passes `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run build`, `pnpm run lint`, and the affected unit/snapshot suites, and includes a bilingual Agent Note (`.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-16-web-drop-file-path-insertion.md`) plus a keyless snapshot case in `apps/web/tests/image-display.snapshot.ts`.

## Why this shape

- **No disk traversal** — the copy lands in the project's `.dsh-uploads/` directory as read-only reference material, matching how reference files are meant to be used.
- **Fast when possible** — browsers that expose the file URI (macOS WebKit) insert the original path with no upload.
- **Bounded** — 20 MB per file, basename-only names, and `cwd` restricted to the host launch dir or a registered workspace.

Happy to adapt it to whatever direction the team prefers.

discussions.title: [Bug] 调用文件/搜索工具时触发 'Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')' 并导致会话污染 (tool_calls 悬空)
discussions.body:

在 Web UI 界面中，一旦点击“文件搜索”或“联网搜索”等工具按钮，Harness 后端立即报错 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')。随后，该会话的所有后续请求均被 API 网关拒绝，报错 An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages...。该会话彻底无法使用，必须手动删除 sessions 文件夹下的对应文件才能恢复。

启动 DSH Web 服务（dsh web）。

在聊天输入框旁点击“文件/搜索”工具按钮。

输入任意查询词并发送。

观察终端报错。

PS：在本人写插件前一切都是正常的，但是用dsh写完一个查询token使用的插件后再搜索一个文件就出现了上述情况。

预期行为（Expected behavior）：
工具应正常返回查询结果，并继续对话。

实际行为（Actual behavior）：
终端报错 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')，Web 界面显示 INVALID_REQUEST 且该会话无法正常进行，对话无法回复且报错An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages提示。

浏览器: Microsoft Edge

discussions.title: dsh-memento: approval-gated cross-session memory and the dsh-memory-protocol v1 rehearsal for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-memento** — bounded, layered, approval-gated, auditable cross-session memory for DeepSeek Harness; 0.4.0 rehearses **dsh-memory-protocol v1** as a candidate shape for an official ctx.memory seam.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- A typed ctx.memory service seam + zero-dependency local SQLite provider + memory tool + frozen snapshot injection: the write approval gate lives inside the service write methods, so no model path can bypass it; writePolicy is model-invisible configuration.
- Hard per-track/per-layer character budgets with structured BUDGET_EXCEEDED / AMBIGUOUS_MATCH errors; every write is reconstructable from ^Gpproval/asked + ^Gpproval/decided + the provider audit ledger.
- 0.4.0 adds the protocol pillar: ctx.memoryAdapters adapter registry (reference adapters for mem0, Hermes memory.md, and CLAUDE.md — convert, never extract), /memory import/export --adapter=<id>, and a distributable 22-case conformance suite any provider can run (
pm run test:conformance).
- 协议文档（双语）docs/protocol-v1.md + 规范性 JSON Schema + 上游化提案 docs/upstream-proposal.md。

dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-memento

discussions.title: [Bug]:dsh web 服务器访问，由本地ssh连接的问题。设置模型时测试连接由本地发出导致失败
discussions.body:
# 问题报告：dsh web 服务器访问，由本地ssh连接的问题
由deepseek生成报告

版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（2026-08-16 实测）
环境：宿主跑在云服务器（Debian 12 + Node 24），浏览器在本地，走 SSH 隧道访问。

---

## 坑 1：测连接在浏览器里跑，地址解析错了机器

**现象**：设置 → Models 新建提供方，地址填 `http://127.0.0.1:13001/v1`(跑在服务器的newapi服务)（服务器本机能通，curl 200），点测试却报 `Failed to fetch`，提供方建不了。

**原因**：dsh 分两半——模型调用在服务器（宿主），但"测试连接"这段代码在浏览器（客户端）里直接 fetch 你填的地址（测试连接在本地测）。本地部署时两者同一台机器，没事；远程部署时浏览器里的 `127.0.0.1` 指的是你电脑，不是服务器，自然连不上。

**证据**：
- `Failed to fetch` 这个词在 dsh 全部包里搜不到，是浏览器 fetch 的原生报错；
- 宿主侧的报错措辞是另一种（`TypeError: fetch failed`）；
- 同一地址，服务器 200、本地拒绝连接；
- 隧道加一条 `13001` 转发后就好了。

**绕法**：隧道双转发，地址两边就都指向服务器了：

```bash
ssh -N -L 13080:127.0.0.1:13080 -L 13001:127.0.0.1:13001 root@服务器
```

**建议修**：测试连接改成让宿主去跑（客户端发请求给宿主，宿主 fetch 提供方地址再返回结果）。这样才和真实调用一致。

---

## 坑 2：公网明文 HTTP 下，前端直接崩

**现象**：用 `http://公网IP:3080` 打开 dsh，模型、插件列表读不出来，工作区建不了，控制台报 `crypto.randomUUID is not a function`。

**原因**：这个浏览器 API 只在 HTTPS 或 localhost（安全上下文）下存在。dsh 客户端连接层直接用了它（`dsh-client-connection/lib/client.js` 第 242、6184 行），明文 HTTP 下没有，页面就静默挂了。

**绕法**：走 HTTPS，或 SSH 隧道用 `http://127.0.0.1:13080` 访问。

**建议修**：没有 `randomUUID` 时降级（比如用 `crypto.getRandomValues` 自己生成），或启动时直接提示"请用 HTTPS/localhost 访问"。

---

两个坑都属于"远程部署才踩到"，本地用没事。有绕法，不影响功能，但值得修。排查全过程见 `日志/运维DSH.md` R13、R22–R24。

dsh-preview + dsh-pilot：给 agent 装上眼睛和手 —— 前端自验证 + 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器
discussions.body:
> 非官方声明：这两个插件由社区成员独立开发与维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或认可。使用前请自行评估风险。
> Unofficial: these are community plugins, not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek. Evaluate the risk before use.

大家好，分享两个配套的浏览器插件。起因很具体：我让 dsh 写了个 Three.js 体素小游戏，它十分钟就交付了能跑的代码——但它**从没见过自己写的画面**，只能靠 `node --check` 和一个自己写的地形冒烟测试代偿。写前端却看不见前端，这是目前用 dsh 写代码最明显的一处缺口。

于是做了两个插件：一个负责「看」，一个负责「开」。

## 👁 dsh-preview —— 让 agent 验证自己写的页面

六个工具：`browser_open` / `browser_console` / `browser_read` / `browser_interact` / `browser_screenshot` / `browser_close`，外加一个 `frontend-verify` 技能把纪律教给模型：**打开 → 查控制台 → 读 DOM → 交互 → 截图 → 修复 → 复验**。

设计上有一点想强调：**机器验证不走视觉**。`browser_read` 返回渲染后的文本、外层 HTML、或指定选择器的盒模型与计算样式——纯文本的 DeepSeek 用这些**确定性事实**判断布局对不对，而不是对着像素猜。截图是给人看的。

回到开头那个体素游戏，装上插件后 agent 自主完成了验收：打开页面、把 favicon 的 404 正确判断为无害、读取 HUD 文本、点击开始按钮、**看着坐标从 41.0 落到 39.0、FPS 稳定在 120**，据此判断物理与渲染循环正常，最后截图留档。它还主动说明了自己**验证不了**的部分（真实 GPU 渲染、指针锁定手感）——这条是技能里明确要求的。

![体素世界截图，由 agent 自己拍摄](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Viger1/dsh-preview/main/docs/demo-voxel.png)

*这张图是 agent 在验证过程中自己截的。*

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-preview
```

## ✋ dsh-pilot —— 让 agent 操作任意页面

六个工具：`pilot_navigate` / `pilot_snapshot` / `pilot_act` / `pilot_wait` / `pilot_screenshot` / `pilot_close`。

`pilot_snapshot` 把页面读成带 ref 标记的无障碍树，`pilot_act` 按 ref 操作。一个注册页在 agent 眼里长这样（真实返回）：

```
- heading "用户注册" [level=1] [ref=e2]
- generic [ref=e3]:
  - text: 用户名
  - textbox "用户名" [ref=e5]
  - text: 邮箱
  - textbox "邮箱" [ref=e7]
  - text: 套餐
  - combobox "套餐" [ref=e9]:
    - option "免费版" [selected]
    - option "专业版"
  - checkbox "同意服务条款" [ref=e11]
  - button "提交注册" [ref=e12]
  - button "重置" [ref=e13]
```

这里有个**踩过的坑值得分享**：最初我用「role + 无障碍名 + 第几个」来重建定位器，看起来很合理，但多 agent 审查实机复现出一个静默故障——`ariaSnapshot` 的树序与 `getByRole` 的 DOM 枚举序在**含 shadow DOM 或 aria-owns 的页面上不一致**，两个同名的「删除」按钮会被调换，不报错、看起来成功、实际点了另一个。对操控类插件来说这是最危险的一类 bug。

改用 Playwright 的 `ariaSnapshot({ mode: 'ai' })` + `aria-ref` 定位引擎后，ref 由引擎直接绑定到具体元素（playwright-mcp 生产环境同款机制），顺序漂移整族消失，还白拿了 **shadow DOM 与同源 iframe 的原生支持**（iframe 内的 ref 形如 `f1e3`，可直接操作）。

权限方面我的原则是：**插件不发明第二套权限系统**。域名策略默认 `auto`，读取会话自身的审批状态——

- 会话在 `danger-full-access`（审批策略 `never`）→ 静默放行。用户既已声明全开权限，插件不该再设卡（这里有个坑：如果天真地走 `ask` 通道，`never` 会自动拒绝，插件直接废掉）；
- 会话审批策略为 `ask` → 走标准审批卡，每个 origin 问一次；
- 无审批座席 → 失败关闭。

决策由**请求拦截层**强制执行，所以重定向、页内链接点击、前进后退都绕不过入口门；弹窗（`window.open` / `target=_blank`）一律即刻关闭。另外密码框输入默认拒绝（凭证卫生，独立于权限模式），上传限工作区文件。

实测：agent 全自主跑通了注册表单（快照 → 按 ref 填表 → 选下拉 → 勾选 → 提交 → 等待成功提示 → 截图），全程零选择器、零控制台错误。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-pilot
```

## 关于质量

两个插件都过了多 agent 对抗审查——并行多维度找问题，然后**对每条发现单独派验证 agent 试图推翻它**，只保留被证实的。preview 确认修复 20 条，pilot 累计 29 条，其中好几条是实机复现出来的（上面那个 shadow DOM 缺陷就是这么抓到的），另有 14 条误报被驳回。所有可调项都是 cordis.yml 配置字段，注册全部走 `ctx.effect` 可热插拔，工具的展示函数保持为参数的纯函数以便会话回放。

两个插件独立安装、可共存（工具前缀不同），MIT 协议，欢迎提 issue 和 PR：

- 👁 https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-preview
- ✋ https://github.com/Viger1/dsh-pilot

如果你也在用 dsh 写前端，很想听听你希望补上哪些能力。

---

**English summary:** Two companion browser plugins. `dsh-preview` gives the agent eyes to verify the pages it writes — six tools plus a `frontend-verify` skill, with deterministic DOM/computed-style reads rather than vision, so a text-only model can assert layout facts. `dsh-pilot` gives it hands: page snapshots as engine-bound accessibility refs (`ariaSnapshot({mode:'ai'})` + `aria-ref` locators — covering shadow DOM and same-origin iframes), plus an origin policy that **follows the dsh session's own approval stance** instead of inventing a second permission system, enforced by request interception so redirects and link-outs cannot drift past the gate. Both were hardened by adversarial multi-agent review (20 and 29 confirmed findings fixed, including an empirically reproduced ref-ordering defect that silently clicked the wrong same-named button). MIT.

discussions.title: Task-scoped capabilities: combining Harness permissions with external enforcement
discussions.body:
Hi everyone,

I’ve been thinking about whether it would be useful to have a more explicit concept of **capabilities scoped to a task/session** in DeepSeek Harness.

This idea came out of a conversation with @PerryLink about `dsh-permission-rules`, so credit to him for helping me frame the problem much more clearly.

The use cases I have in mind are pretty simple.

### 1. Rename thousands of photos, but never delete them

Suppose I give an agent a folder containing years of photos and ask:

> Rename and organize these files.

I want the agent to be able to:

- list files
- inspect metadata
- rename/move files

but I want a much stronger guarantee that it **cannot delete the photos**, even if the agent makes a mistake or generates an unexpected command.

Conceptually, I would like to give the task something like:

`photo-organizer`

with a bounded set of capabilities for the lifetime of that task.

### 2. Different authority for dev and review

Another example is a coding workflow.

During development I might want:

`dev`
→ read/edit code  
→ run tests  
→ create commits  
→ no destructive repository operations  
→ no merging/deploying

Later I might start a different task/session:

`review`
→ inspect a PR  
→ review changes  
→ approve/reject it  
→ possibly merge, depending on the granted capability

The important part for me is that these are not just prompts telling the model what it should or shouldn’t do. They describe what the agent is actually allowed to do for that task.

---

`dsh-permission-rules` already seems able to model a lot of this by composing rules, presets, workspace configuration and agent identity.

What I’m wondering is whether there is value in making the idea itself explicit:

**task/session → named capability profile → allowed authority**

rather than having users assemble that concept themselves from multiple configuration dimensions.

## Where Towel fits

I’m experimenting with this from another direction in an open-source project called [Towel](https://github.com/luciobaiocchi/twl).

I don't want Towel to replace the Harness permission layer.

The separation I'm currently exploring is roughly:

```text
DeepSeek Harness
    │
    │ understands intent/context
    │ tools, args, agent, task
    ▼
permission / approval layer
    │
    │ allowed operation
    ▼
Towel (separate process)
    │
    │ externally enforces the capability
    ▼
filesystem / network / credentials / external services

discussions.title: Windows 下将用户主目录设为工作区会触发沙箱崩溃（ACL temp root 断言），导致 harness 停摆
discussions.body:
**问题描述：**

DSH (v0.1.0-rc.6, Windows) 中，当工作区指向用户主目录（如 `C:\Users\<user>`）时，workspace-write 模式下运行任何沙箱工具或切换权限都会崩溃，报错：

```
Windows ACL temp root must be outside the workspace: workspace=C:\Users\qw114; temp=C:\Users\qw114\AppData\Local\Temp
```

该配置本身是 Web UI 允许的（目录选择器可选中主目录），但会导致整个 harness 停摆：所有沙箱工具不可用、权限切换失效、旧对话无法发送消息。

**根因（已定位到具体代码行）：**

1. `dsh-sandbox-policy/lib/index.js:142` — `resolve()` 的 `workspaceRoot` 取自 `session.header.cwd`（会话 cwd 为主目录）。
2. `dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:387` — `materializeAclGrant` 调用 `assertTempRootOutsideWorkspace(workspaceRoot, tmpdir())` 抛错。
3. 断言定义：`dsh-sandbox-windows-acl/lib/types-CNjZgO4h.js:760-762` — temp 目录位于 workspace 内即 throw。
4. Windows 的 `%TEMP%` 默认位于用户主目录内（`C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\Temp`），因此只要工作区 = 主目录，该断言必然触发。

即使把 `TMP/TEMP` 外移避开此断言，下一步 `dsh-sandbox-local/lib/index.js:392` 的 `grant.add(workspaceRoot)` → `setNamedSecurityInfoW`（`types-CNjZgO4h.js:655`）仍会对整个主目录应用 DACL 授权，同样存在失败/卡顿风险。

**安全/健壮性结论：**

- 底层断言是 fail-closed 的安全设计（temp 与 workspace 重叠会形成沙箱逃逸），本身不是 bug。
- 但集成层存在缺陷：`dsh-workspace/lib/index.js:341` 的 `create()` 只校验目录存在，从不拒绝主目录当工作区；创建时零警告，崩溃后报错晦涩、无补救提示，且单点配置错误带崩整个 harness。

**复现步骤：**

1. Windows 上 `dsh web`，在 Web UI 新建工作区指向 `C:\Users\<user>`（主目录）。
2. 会话 cwd 落在主目录，切到 workspace-write（或运行 shell/fs 工具）。
3. 触发上述断言崩溃。

**建议：**

- 在创建工作区时拒绝/警告「工作区 = 用户主目录」；
- 或让 `assertTempRootOutsideWorkspace` 的报错包含可操作提示（如设置 `TMP` 到主目录之外、或使用 `danger-full-access` 逃生开关 `DSH_PERMISSION_MODE`）。

此问题反馈由 AI 生成。

discussions.title: Web：强制刷新后 session.list 超时会使会话侧栏显示为空
discussions.body:
## 现象

在 Web 应用中使用 Cmd+Shift+R 强制刷新后，会话侧栏可能显示为空，包括仍在运行的会话。持久化会话日志、workspace 记录、agent 和终端进程仍然存在；重新启动服务不是恢复这些会话的必要条件。

## 问题原因

首次加载调用 `session.list`。已附加 Session 的摘要会读取完整 `Session.events`，分别计算列表元数据和当前 agent preset。大型活动日志超过 300,000 条事件时，加上 macOS terminal polling 中同步执行的 `/bin/ps`，这个请求可能超过浏览器 unary RPC 的 30 秒期限。请求超时后，客户端保留空的 pending baseline，因此侧栏看起来像是所有会话都消失了。

## 修改

fork 中的实现让已附加 Session：

- 从实时 `sessionListMetadata` projection 读取 `blank` 和 `lastPromptAt`；projection 值不可用时才精确读取日志。
- 从 `agentPresets.composedPreset(agent.ctx)` 读取已挂载的 preset；实时 roster 或 agent 不可用时才从日志派生。
- 保持冷 Session 行为、wire 格式和持久化格式不变。

测试会让 `session.events` getter 抛出异常，并验证已附加 Session 仍然可以通过实时 projection 和已挂载组合完成列表请求。

## 验证

以下检查通过：

```sh
pnpm exec vitest run \
  packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-projections.spec.ts \
  packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-cold.spec.ts \
  packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-blank.spec.ts \
  packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-agent-preset.spec.ts
pnpm run typecheck
pnpm run lint
git diff --check
```

Vitest 结果为 4 个文件、71 项测试通过。两个修改后的双语文档对也通过 `verify-translation-pairing`。

## 实现

- 分支：https://github.com/Maotechh/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/fix-session-list-refresh-timeout
- commit：https://github.com/Maotechh/deepseek-harness/commit/c9ffd78f34dbdd2d21cba2fa346b21f6acb5d520

由于仓库目前不接受外部 PR，我在 fork 中提供可直接审阅的实现。维护者可以 cherry-pick（将这个 commit 应用到官方分支），也可以按相同方式重新实现。

discussions.title: 提案：文件工具"三车道"场景路由——完善"用 read 别用 shell"的指引（附实测数据）
discussions.body:
中文 🇨🇳 ## 摘要 当前 `read`/`edit` 的模型指引是绝对化的："Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat"、"Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it)"。实践中，这个指引对「单点语义修改」正确，但对「探索」和「批量机械变换」是低效的——shell/脚本一次管线调用胜过几十次 read→edit 往返。`FS_NOT_OBSERVED` 摩擦的真正来源是**混用车道**：用 shell 读（黑盒子进程，从不登记 `fs/observed` 观察）然后再用 `edit` 工具（要求观察）。按场景路由的**三车道模型**可以在不削弱守卫的前提下消除这一类错误。本提案建议把该模型写进官方文档/系统提示词，并附实测数据。 ## 背景 `fs-observation-policy` 是防止"AI 基于过期记忆覆盖用户已修改文件"的版本守卫（CAS），机制本身正确且必要。但在真实使用中（包括非开发者/运维用户），模型经常因"图省事"用 shell 查看文件后直接 `edit`，触发 `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`（"edit requires reading ... first"），重读后重试——功能能完成，但流程噪音反复出现。 ## 根因 1. `edit`/`write` 前必须有该文件的 `read` 观察记录（按会话 + CAS 版本比对）。无记录 → `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`；记录过期（read 后文件被改）→ 版本不匹配。 2. **bash 子进程是黑盒**：DSH 无法得知 shell 内部读了哪些文件，因此 shell 读取**不登记观察**。这是架构决定，不是缺陷。 3. **错误只产生于「混用车道」**：shell 读（不登记观察）+ `edit` 改（要求观察）→ 必然冲突。选对车道即消除该类错误。 ## 三车道模型 | 场景 | 车道 | 工具 | |------|------|------| | 单点语义修改（改一个页面、插一条日志） | 观察车道 | `read`（同轮）→ `edit` | | 探索/发现/统计（文件在哪、多大、含什么、几行） | 只读车道 | `glob` / `grep` / shell 只读管线 | | 批量机械变换（全库链接修复、批量替换、格式修正） | 脚本车道 | 一条 shell/python 直接写完（**不经 edit**） | 补充： - **毒化边界（实测）**：`read` → shell 写 → `edit` 同一文件 = 报 "file changed since it was read"。shell 写会悄悄作废 read 快照；恢复姿势 = 脚本改完后**重新 `read`** 再 `edit`。 - **复杂任务分发/子任务管理**属于 `subagent`/`workflow` 工具，shell 只做聚合/预处理。 ## 实测 （2026-08-16，macOS，dsh web profile）用临时文件完整走了一遍链路： | 步骤 | 操作 | 结果 | |------|------|------| | 1 | `read` 读文件 | ✅ 登记观察 | | 2 | shell `echo >>` 追加 | ✅ 不报错（shell 对策略不可见） | | 3 | `edit` 同一文件 | ❌ `file changed since it was read` | | 4 | 重新 `read` → 再 `edit` | ✅ 正常 | 另验证：shell 读（`cat`）+ `edit` → `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`（"edit requires reading first"）。 ## 建议修改 1. **README「Model Experience / Read guidance」补充场景路由提示**（建议文本）： > Route file access by scenario: surgical single edits → `read` then `edit` (observation lane); exploration/statistics → `glob`/`grep` or shell read-only; bulk mechanical transforms → one script/shell write pass, never mixed with `edit`. Mixing lanes (shell-read + edit, or read → shell write → edit) fails the observation guard; after a shell write, re-`read` before `edit`. 2. **可选：`FS_NOT_OBSERVED` 错误信息增强**：提示"若刚才是用 shell 查看的该文件，请改用 read 工具，或整批改用 shell 写入"——把报错从"失败"变成"车道提示"。 ## 影响 - 对开发者：批量重构/迁移时脚本车道省几十倍调用。 - 对非开发者/运维用户（本提案作者场景）：知识库/文档维护中"单点改 vs 批量修"天天并存，场景路由让 DSH 既保留数据保护又免去流程噪音。 - 车道模型通用：同时适用于有守卫的工具集（DSH / Claude Code）与无守卫的（Codex / holon 全 shell 派）。 *报告人场景：云上陕西运维，Obsidian 知识库 + DSH 日常维护。规则已本地固化（file-edit-discipline），本提案为通用化建议。*
English 🇬🇧 ## Summary The current model-facing guidance for `read`/`edit` is absolute: *"Use the read tool — not shell commands like cat — to inspect text files"* and *"Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it)"*. In practice this guidance is correct for **surgical single edits** but inefficient for **exploration** and **bulk mechanical transforms**, where shell/scripts are strictly better (one pipeline call vs dozens of read→edit round-trips). The real source of the `FS_NOT_OBSERVED` friction is **lane mixing**: reading via shell (a black-box subprocess that never registers an `fs/observed` observation) and then editing via the `edit` tool (which requires an observation). A scenario-routed **three-lane model** eliminates this error class without weakening the guard. This proposal asks for documenting that model in the README / system prompt, and includes empirical test data. ## Background `fs-observation-policy` is a version guard (CAS) that prevents an AI from overwriting user-modified files based on stale memory. The mechanism is correct and necessary. In real usage (including non-developer / operations users), the model often reads files via shell "for convenience" and then calls `edit`, triggering `FS_NOT_OBSERVED` ("edit requires reading ... first"); after a re-read and retry the task completes, but the friction recurs constantly. ## Root cause 1. `edit`/`write` require a prior `read` observation (per-session CAS version compare). Missing → `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`; stale (file changed after the read) → version mismatch. 2. **A shell subprocess is a black box**: DSH cannot know which files a shell command read, so shell reads never register an observation. This is an architecture decision, not a bug. 3. **The error only arises from lane mixing**: shell-read (no observation) + `edit` (observation required) → guaranteed conflict. Route by scenario and the error class disappears. ## The three-lane model | Scenario | Lane | Tools | |---|---|---| | Surgical single edit (edit a page, insert a log entry) | Observation | `read` (same round) → `edit` | | Exploration & stats (where/what/size/line count) | Read-only | `glob` / `grep` / shell read-only pipelines | | Bulk mechanical transforms (mass link fixes, batch replace, format fixes) | Script | one shell/python pass writing directly (never via `edit`) | Notes: - **Poisoning boundary (tested)**: `read` → shell write → `edit` same file errors with "file changed since it was read": a shell write silently invalidates the read observation; recovery = re-`read` after the script pass, then `edit`. - **Task dispatch / subagent management** belongs to `subagent`/`workflow` tools; shell is for aggregation/preprocessing only. ## Empirical test (2026-08-16, macOS, dsh web profile) A full pass over a temporary file: | Step | Action | Result | |---|---|---| | 1 | `read` the file | ✅ observation recorded | | 2 | shell `echo >>` append | ✅ no error (shell is opaque to the policy) | | 3 | `edit` the same file | ❌ `file changed since it was read` | | 4 | re-`read`, then `edit` | ✅ normal | Also verified: shell-read (`cat`) + `edit` → `FS_NOT_OBSERVED` ("edit requires reading first"). ## Suggested changes 1. **README「Model Experience / Read guidance」: add scenario-routing hint** (suggested text): > Route file access by scenario: surgical single edits → `read` then `edit` (observation lane); exploration/statistics → `glob`/`grep` or shell read-only; bulk mechanical transforms → one script/shell write pass, never mixed with `edit`. Mixing lanes (shell-read + edit, or read → shell write → edit) fails the observation guard; after a shell write, re-`read` before `edit`. 2. **Optional: augment the `FS_NOT_OBSERVED` message with lane hints** — "if you just viewed this file via shell, either use `read` first, or switch the whole pass to shell writes" — turning the error from a dead-end into a lane hint. ## Impact - Developers: the script lane saves dozens of calls in bulk refactors/migrations. - Non-developer / operations users (this proposal's author scenario): in knowledge-base/doc maintenance, "surgical edits vs bulk fixes" coexist daily; scenario routing keeps DSH's data protection while removing the friction. - The lane model is generic: applicable to guarded tool sets (DSH / Claude Code) and unguarded ones (Codex / holon all-shell). *Reporter scenario: cloud operations engineer (Shaanxi), Obsidian knowledge base + DSH daily maintenance. Rule locally solidified (file-edit-discipline); this proposal is the generalized form.*

discussions.title: dsh-github: GitHub CI, review bot and status-check gate for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-github** — official-grade GitHub CI for DeepSeek Harness: a composite `action.yml`, a polling PR review bot with idempotent inline comments, a status-check gate, and 12 PR/issues tools — every write gated by human approval, token never logged.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- Run dsh headless inside GitHub Actions to review PRs, fix CI failures and write structured JSON + Markdown reports (the claude-code-action pattern).
- The review bot scans PRs by rule (change scope, test presence, sensitive paths) and posts idempotent inline comments; the verdict publishes as a status check (success / changes needed) with configurable blocking.
- `ci_run` tool + `/ci` command family; sensitive-path and test-existence rules, change-size caps, concurrency cap, label/path filters — all configurable.
- 在 GitHub Actions 里跑 dsh headless 评审/修 CI/出报告；轮询评审机器人发表幂等行内评论并把结论发布为 status check；12 个 PR/issue 工具全部走人工审批门。

**Install / 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @perrylink/dsh-github@0.6.1
```

**Links / 链接**

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-github
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@perrylink/dsh-github
- Listed in: [awesome-dsh-plugin#1144](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/1144), [AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins#206](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/pull/206), [0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness#307](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness/pull/307), [bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#71](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/71)

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome (中英文都欢迎).
