discussions.title: 【插件作者体验】schema DSL 的两个小改进建议（来自 dsh-quant 37 工具的实战）
discussions.body:
## 背景

我们在给 DeepSeek Harness 开发 [dsh-quant](https://github.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant)（37 个工具的量化插件，已发布 npm）的过程中，在统一 schema DSL 上踩了两个坑。两条都对照当前 `packages/core/tools/src` 代码验证过，各附一个一行级的建议，供团队排期时参考。

## 建议 1：联合类型的报错应指向 `oneOf`

当前对 `items: { type: ['number', 'null'] }` 这类「类型数组」写法，`json-schema.ts` 报的是：

```
items.type must be a single type string (type arrays are not supported)
```

问题：错误说明了「不支持什么」，但没告诉作者「正确写法是什么」。我们第一次写 nullable 数组（指标输出的 `(number|null)[]` 是插件里最常见的形态之一）时，在这里排查了不必要的时间，最后才发现要走 `items: { oneOf: [{ type: 'number' }, { type: 'null' }] }`。

建议（一行改动）：

```
... (type arrays are not supported; use oneOf for unions)
```

在报错里直接指路 oneOf，插件作者一次就能写对。

## 建议 2：cookbook 的输出章节应提醒「输出属性标记 `required: true`」

`ValueSchemaSpec` 对输出对象属性的缺省是**可选**的：不带 `required: true` 的输出字段在 `InferValue` 里变成 optional，`output.render` 拿到的 `value` 是 possibly-undefined，而运行时**不会报错**——只在类型上悄悄变松，直到 render 里读到 undefined 才发现。

参数侧 `ParameterPropertySpec` 有 `required?: true` 的专门说明，但输出侧行为一致、文档（`docs/cookbook/adding-a-tool.md` 的输出小节）却没有对应提醒。

建议在输出小节补一句：

> 除非字段确实可能缺席，否则输出对象的每个属性都标记 `required: true`——否则 `InferValue` 会把该字段推断为可选。

## 验证

以上两条坑都已在我们 37 个工具的注册中修复（全部走 `oneOf` + 输出字段全量 `required: true`），113 单元测试 + 4 Loader 组合测试 + 实时集成验证全绿，npm `dsh-quant@0.17.1` 可复现验证。

如果团队认可这两个方向，等你们开放外部 PR 通道时我们很乐意直接贡献这两处小改动。欢迎讨论！

discussions.title: dsh-quant 0.17：37 工具 · 6 域量化 R&D 工具箱 + Web 工作台（附社区循环）
discussions.body:
给 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent-native 量化研究工具箱——从两天前 [dsh-quant-indicators 的 8 个工具](#2307) 起步，现在 **37 个工具 · 6 大域 · 0.17.1**，npm 自动发布 22 次。

![dsh-quant UI](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant/master/demos/ui-demo-preview.png)

## 六域架构（每个域一个独立模块）

| 域 | 职责 | 代表工具 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-data` | 行情与数据质量 | 三所行情（Binance/OKX/Bybit 自动容错）、A 股 8 渠道知识库、缺值/异常/跳变标注 |
| `dsh-alpha` | 指标与因子 | 12 指标、因子评价（IC/ICIR/分层/多空）、多因子合成 |
| `dsh-ml` | 回测与组合 | 双均线/布林/RSI/组合/网格回测，9+ 指标目录 |
| `dsh-risk` | 风控 | VaR/CVaR/Beta/Alpha/IR + Kupiec 检验 |
| `dsh-execution` | 交付（无实盘） | 图表协议、基金模拟（1 亿起 · 净值 1.00 · 高水位 20% 提成）、研究报告 |
| `dsh-community` | 开源生态（开源侧独有） | GitHub/npm 生态数据 + 0-100 影响力评分，工具会给自己打分 |

## 几个有意思的点

- **契约洁癖**：所有输出与输入等长、头部 null 对齐；空序列是合法结果不是错误；非有限数在 registry 层就被拒绝——模型不需要自己补 padding
- **吃自己的狗粮**：`quant_oss_pulse` 第一次跑就评测 dsh-quant 自己（40 分 / C 级），给出的建议就是我们接下来的行动清单
- **Web 工作台**：[dsh-quant-ui](https://github.com/pengpengyi92/dsh-quant-ui)，在线演示 https://dsh-quant-ui.pages.dev —— 点标题 3 下有彩蛋 🐋

## 质量与社区

- 113 单元测试 + 4 真实 Loader 组合测试 + 实时集成验证，全绿
- npm 自动发布流水线：tag 推送 → CI → npm，无需手动步骤

discussions.title: 提案：为 dsh profile 内置启动健康检查与依赖自动回滚（fail-fast 之后的恢复路径）
discussions.body:
中文 🇨🇳 ## 摘要 dsh profile 是 fail-fast（快速失败）设计：任一插件加载失败即整体退出；配合 launchctl `KeepAlive` 这类守护，只会反复重启到同一个坏状态。目前**没有任何内置恢复路径**——没有"上次健康状态"快照、没有自动回滚、没有修复命令。一个坏插件就能让整个 GUI 失联，非开发用户没有任何自救手段。本提案请求内置恢复路径：启动成功后记录健康快照、启动失败自动回滚、并提供手动修复命令。 ## 问题 1. **fail-fast 是对的默认，但失败之后无人接管**。加载器遇到第一个坏条目（缺依赖、包名错误、`apply` 抛错）就中止，但没有任何组件记住"上一次能正常启动的状态"。 2. **守护进程只会重复失败**。系统级 `KeepAlive`（或用户手动重启）重试的是同一份坏依赖组合；如果修复要改 profile 文件，用户恰恰被锁在了能帮忙的工具之外。 3. **GUI 是唯一的助手**。单机用户 GUI 一挂，等于失去 AI 助手；恢复只能靠外部手段（另一台机器、另一个 agent）。 4. **插件生态在快速膨胀**（社区市场已列 800+ 插件）。bundle 里的第三方代码越多，坏加载的概率越大；社区插件还常带清单错误（`cordis.patch.yml` 包名写错、`package.json` 缺依赖）。 ## 现状 - `cordis-plugin-loader` 对第一个坏条目快速失败，整棵树被销毁。 - `dsh-app-boot` 给出失败标签（`host preparation failed` / `plugin tree failed to load`）后退出。 - 没有任何组件写入"本次启动成功"标记或快照依赖状态。 - `dsh plugin` 转发 pnpm，没有回滚感知的安装路径。 ## 建议能力 1. **健康快照（自动）**：启动成功后，把 profile 的依赖状态（如 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`，或一个精简的 bundle/插件清单）记录到固定位置（`~/.dsh/health-snapshots/` 或 profile 目录）。 2. **启动失败自动恢复（可选开启）**：启动失败且存在健康快照、且当前依赖集合不一致时，恢复快照并重装（`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`），然后重试一次启动；重试要有上限，避免真坏配置无限循环。 3. **手动修复命令**：`dsh --profile web --repair`（或类似）：恢复最近一次健康快照并重启，作为显式的用户可执行救援路径。 4. **可操作的失败诊断**：启动失败时打印失败的条目与原因（现有基础已有），并给出恢复选项："恢复上次正常状态：`dsh --repair`"或"不带故障插件启动："。 ## 实战证据（2026-08-16，macOS） 两次真实事故，均由**外部守卫脚本**（即本提案机制，在 dsh 之外实现）完整救回： - **事故 1 —— 缺传递依赖**：某主题插件加载失败（`Cannot find package 'schemastery'`），web profile 进入崩溃循环，GUI 失联。恢复方式：恢复快照（`package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`）+ `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + 重启。 - **事故 2 —— 插件 bundle patch 包名错误**：某插件 `cordis.patch.yml` 声明 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-github-login`，实际包名是 `dsh-github-login`；启动报 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`，守卫数秒内自动回滚并恢复，修复 profile patch 后正常。 守卫脚本做法：启动 profile → 探测 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`（20 秒超时）→ 失败则恢复最近健康快照、重装、重启；同时清理上一实例遗留的端口占用（`EADDRINUSE`）。一天之内两次救回环境。 ## 实现要点（供维护者参考） - 快照格式：直接复制 `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` 即可，与版本无关；专门清单可选。 - 成功标记：启动管线本身知道所有条目何时激活（`assertEntriesActivated`）——在那里写快照是小改动。 - 保持 fail-fast 语义不变；回滚是**恢复路径**，不是行为变更。 - 探测端点已隐式存在（web server 监听已知端口）；加一个 `/healthz` 端点会让检查显式化。 ## 影响 - 单机 / 非开发用户不再因一个坏插件失去唯一助手。 - 插件安装从"赌一把"变成默认可逆。 - 社区市场持续增长；内置恢复降低了尝试社区插件的代价。
English 🇬🇧 ## Summary dsh profiles are fail-fast by design: any plugin that fails to load aborts the whole boot, and with `launchctl KeepAlive`-style supervisors the process simply restarts into the same broken state. There is currently **no built-in recovery path** — no "last known good" snapshot, no automatic rollback, no repair command. A single broken plugin can take down the entire GUI, and a non-developer user has no way to recover without external tooling. This proposal asks for a built-in recovery path: health snapshot after successful boot, automatic rollback on boot failure, and a manual repair command. ## Problem 1. **Fail-fast is the right default, but the aftermath is unmanaged.** The loader aborts on the first bad entry (missing dependency, wrong package name, throw in `apply`). Nothing remembers the last state that actually booted. 2. **Supervisors only repeat the failure.** A system-level `KeepAlive` (or the user manually restarting) retries the same broken dependency set. If the fix requires editing profile files, the user is locked out of the very tool that would help. 3. **The GUI is the only assistant.** For single-machine users, a dead web UI means losing the AI assistant entirely; recovery depends on external access (another machine, another agent). 4. **The plugin ecosystem is growing fast** (the community marketplace already lists 800+ plugins). More third-party code in the bundle = more chances of a broken load, and community plugins sometimes ship with manifest mistakes (wrong package name in `cordis.patch.yml`, missing deps in `package.json`). ## Current behavior - `cordis-plugin-loader` fails fast on the first bad loader entry and the whole tree is disposed. - `dsh-app-boot` labels the failure (`host preparation failed` / `plugin tree failed to load`) and exits. - No component writes a "this boot succeeded" marker or snapshots the dependency state. - `dsh plugin` forwards to pnpm; there is no rollback-aware install path. ## Proposed capability 1. **Health snapshot (automatic).** After a successful boot, record the profile's dependency state — e.g. `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` (or a small manifest of installed bundles/plugins) — into a known location (`~/.dsh/health-snapshots/` or the profile dir). 2. **Auto-recovery on boot failure (opt-in).** When boot fails, if a health snapshot exists and the current dependency set differs, restore the snapshot and reinstall (`pnpm install --frozen-lockfile`), then retry the boot once. Keep the retry bounded so a genuinely broken config doesn't loop forever. 3. **Manual repair command.** `dsh --profile web --repair` (or similar): restore the last health snapshot and restart, as an explicit user-facing rescue path. 4. **Actionable failure diagnostics.** On boot failure, print *which* entry failed and *why* (already largely present), plus the recovery options: "restore last known good: `dsh --repair`" or "boot without the failing plugin: ". ## Field evidence (2026-08-16, macOS) Two real incidents, both fully recovered by an **external guard script** (the proposed mechanism, implemented outside dsh): - **Incident 1 — missing transitive dep:** a theme plugin failed to load (`Cannot find package 'schemastery'`), the web profile entered a crash loop, and the GUI was unreachable. Recovery: restore snapshot (`package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml`) + `pnpm install --frozen-lockfile` + restart. - **Incident 2 — wrong package name in a plugin's bundle patch:** a plugin's `cordis.patch.yml` declared `@deepseek-ai/dsh-github-login` while the actual package is `dsh-github-login`; boot failed with `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` and the guard auto-rolled back within seconds, then recovered after the profile patch was fixed. The guard script: starts the profile → probes `http://127.0.0.1:3080` (20 s timeout) → on failure restores the last healthy snapshot, reinstalls, restarts; also cleans the orphaned port (`EADDRINUSE` from a previous instance). It has now saved the environment twice in one day. ## Implementation notes (for maintainers) - Snapshot format: copying `package.json` + `pnpm-lock.yaml` is sufficient and version-agnostic; a dedicated manifest is optional. - Success marker: the boot pipeline already knows when every entry activated (`assertEntriesActivated`) — writing the snapshot there is a small change. - Keep fail-fast semantics intact; rollback is a *recovery path*, not a behavior change. - The probe endpoint already exists implicitly (the web server listens on a known port); a `/healthz` endpoint would make the check explicit. ## Impact - Single-machine / non-developer users stop losing their only assistant to a bad plugin. - Plugin installation becomes reversible by default instead of a gamble. - The community marketplace keeps growing; built-in recovery lowers the cost of trying community plugins.

discussions.title: 🌱 Soulful Companion Plugins — a cat, a growing task garden, and 2.5D worlds
discussions.body:
English | 中文说明见下方

I built a small set of client-side “soulful companion” plugins for DeepSeek Harness. The goal is to make long-running agent work feel alive and readable without changing prompts, tools, model requests, or execution semantics.

### What is included

- **Pocket Buddy** — an autonomous full-body 2D cat that walks with direction-specific gait frames, leaves fading paw prints, grooms, stretches, chases a ball, reacts to clicks, and sleeps beside the caretaker when work pauses or completes.
- **Task Garden** — a blue-haired Whale Girl waters a small grass patch while responsive vines grow around the full page as an ambient task-progress indicator. Tool and step activity releases blue and pink flower heads that drift to and attach directly to the vine.
- **Platform Worlds** — a header selector for three quiet 2.5D backdrops: Cloud Harbor, Candy Gearworks, and Moonlit Coral Bay.

All three are optional Cordis client plugins. They are click-through where appropriate, responsive to the whole page, and respect reduced-motion preferences.

### Try it

Community branch: https://github.com/ZY-LI-F/deepseek-harness/tree/agent/soulful-companion-plugins

Design and usage notes:
- English: https://github.com/ZY-LI-F/deepseek-harness/blob/agent/soulful-companion-plugins/docs/user/soulful-plugins/README.md
- 中文: https://github.com/ZY-LI-F/deepseek-harness/blob/agent/soulful-companion-plugins/docs/user/soulful-plugins/README.zh.md

```sh
git clone https://github.com/ZY-LI-F/deepseek-harness.git
cd deepseek-harness
git switch agent/soulful-companion-plugins
corepack enable
pnpm install --frozen-lockfile
pnpm run build
pnpm dsh web
```

Then open `http://127.0.0.1:3080`.

### Privacy and validation

The plugins read only existing browser-side Session projections and local viewing preferences. They do not inspect message prose, Tool arguments, attachments, credentials, environment variables, or filesystem content; they do not call a model, append Session events, upload media, or make runtime network requests.

The public branch contains only runtime-ready source and generated runtime modules. Raw generation inputs/outputs, user references, local captures, private paths, research footage, and discarded experiments were excluded. The branch passed the full lint/typecheck gates, GUI tests (3,829 passed, 4 skipped), Web replay tests (253 passed, 15 skipped), documentation gates, package invariants, license checks, and a privacy/path scan across all changed files.

Feedback on the interaction model, plugin boundaries, and what should become reusable infrastructure would be especially welcome.

---

我做了一组 DeepSeek Harness 的“有灵魂的陪伴型”客户端插件，希望让长任务更有生命感，也能更直观地看到任务仍在推进，同时不改变提示词、工具、模型请求和执行逻辑。

- **Pocket Buddy / 小猫伙伴**：完整角色逐帧动画的小猫，会按方向自然行走、留下渐隐爪印、洗脸、舔爪、伸懒腰、追球、回应点击；任务暂停或完成后会走到鲸鱼女孩旁边，以睡觉为默认状态。
- **Task Garden / 任务花园**：鲸鱼女孩在左下角走动浇水，藤蔓随活跃任务时间沿整个自适应页面边缘缓慢生长；工具调用和步骤推进会生成蓝粉花朵，花朵飘向并吸附在藤蔓上。
- **Platform Worlds / 平台世界**：可切换云港跳岛、糖果齿轮城和月光珊瑚湾三种安静的 2.5D 背景。

这些都是可移除的 Cordis 客户端插件。运行代码与必要的生成素材已公开，原始生成记录、用户参考图、视频、私有路径和未采用实验均未上传。欢迎体验并提出建议。

discussions.body:
**dsh-composer-history** — terminal-style input history for the DeepSeek Harness web composer, upgraded in 0.5.0 into the **Composer smart input layer**: cross-session snippets, prompt templates with variables, reuse insights, and compaction-summary highlighting — all browser-local, zero network.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- 0.5.0 smart input layer: /save <name>\ / /load <name>\ snippet library (tags, workspace scope), prompt templates with \{{workspace}}/\{{session}}/\{{draft}}\ variables (JSON export/import on explicit click), a local reuse hint («used M× in N sessions · 在 N 个会话里用过 M 次»), and amber-badged \[compacted]\ summaries in the search panel.
- Everything is browser-local storage, nothing is ever uploaded; every key and switch is Config-validated fail-loud.
- 边缘优先方向键召回 + 草稿/光标精确还原 + Ctrl+R 反向搜索 + 滑动上下文感知；0.5.0 智能输入层：片段库、带变量模板、复用洞察、压缩摘要高亮，全部浏览器本地零网络。

discussions.title: Windows环境下3080端口落在了的「排除端口范围」导致启动失败
discussions.body:
不是端口被占用（netstat 查 3080 无任何进程），而是 3080 落在了 Windows 的「排除端口范围」3028–3127 内——这是
  Hyper-V/WSL2/winnat 系统保留的端口段，在保留段内 bind() 会返回 WSAEACCES（10013，即 errno: -4092），所以报 listen
  EACCES。我用 Node 实测：3080 → EACCES，8080 → OK。

  修复内容

  修改了 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml，把 webserver 插件的默认端口从 3080 改为 8080（CLI 的 --port 仍可覆盖）：

  - id: webserver
    config:
      host: !!js ctx.webStartup.host ?? '127.0.0.1'
      port: !!js ctx.webStartup.port ?? 8080

  ▎ 踩坑记录：patch 里的 config 是整体替换而非按键合并，第一次只写 port 导致 host 被覆盖、报 $.host missing required
  ▎ value，所以 host 也必须一并带上。

discussions.title: dsh-task-modes: first-principles prompts and independent adversarial review for DeepSeek Harness Web
discussions.body:
An independent DeepSeek Harness Web bundle for three task modes: Normal mode, First Principles system-prompt injection, and forked Adversarial Review.

![Task modes selector](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GraySilver/dsh-task-modes/main/assets/social-preview.png)

## Install from npm

```sh
npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add @graysilver/dsh-task-modes@0.1.8
```

If DSH is already installed globally:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add @graysilver/dsh-task-modes@0.1.8
```

Restart the Web profile after installation. Adversarial Review requires the profile's fork/subagent capability.

## Modes

- **Normal mode** sends the request without extra instructions.
- **First Principles** injects a structured system-prompt section covering objectives, facts versus assumptions, constraints, derivation, and verification.
- **Adversarial Review** forks an independent child agent after the parent text answer completes and renders a Markdown report beneath the matching reply.

![Adversarial review panel](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/GraySilver/dsh-task-modes/main/assets/task-modes-review.png)

## Costs and limits

Adversarial Review adds one model call and latency per completed parent answer. The report is advisory and does not rewrite the parent answer. The reviewer can inspect with `read`, `glob`, `grep`, `read_image`, and profile shell (`bash`/`pwsh`); prompt-level restrictions are not an operating-system sandbox, and the plugin shares Harness process privileges.

For source auditing or development, install the pinned Git revision:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:GraySilver/dsh-task-modes#4ec9f5f63679784ef6ce248aae42e373d7a8d049
```

npm release: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@graysilver/dsh-task-modes/v/0.1.8

GitHub release: https://github.com/GraySilver/dsh-task-modes/releases/tag/v0.1.8

Feedback and source: https://github.com/GraySilver/dsh-task-modes

discussions.title: 目录选择器截断含「开」等字符的路径：dsh-host-directory-picker-native: native picker truncates paths containing chars with 0x00 low byte (e.g. 开 U+5F00)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native@0.1.0-rc.6
- DSH: 0.1.0-rc.6
- Platform: Windows (win32)

## Summary
`readUtf16` in `packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts`
only checks the LOW byte of each UTF-16 code unit for the NUL terminator. Any
character whose code point is a multiple of 256 (low byte 0x00) is mistaken for
the string terminator, truncating the selected path.

## Reproduce
1. On Windows, create a folder named `海康开放平台` (contains 开 = U+5F00).
2. Add a workspace, select that folder in the native picker, confirm.
3. Workspace creation fails with:
   workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "D:\视频播放\海康":
   ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'D:\视频播放\海康'

The path is truncated at 开 (dropping 开放平台).

## Root cause
`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts:40`

    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2

This checks only `bytes[end]` (the low byte). A UTF-16LE NUL terminator is
0x0000 (both bytes zero), but `开` (U+5F00) encodes as `00 5F`, whose low byte
is 0, so it is misread as the terminator.

## Fix
    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2

## Verification
    function readUtf16(bytes) {
      let end = 0
      while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2
      return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
    }
    const path = 'D:\\视频播放\\海康开放平台'
    const bytes = Buffer.concat([Buffer.from(path, 'utf16le'), Buffer.from([0, 0])])
    console.log(readUtf16(bytes)) // => D:\视频播放\海康开放平台

discussions.title: DSH | DSH Mobile Remote | Access your local DSH Web UI from a paired phone
discussions.body: # DSH | DSH Mobile Remote | Access your local DSH Web UI from a paired phone > **Unofficial community project:** independently developed and maintained. This project is not reviewed, endorsed, or supported by DeepSeek. Project: https://github.com/april-jk/dsh-mobile-suite Plugin source: https://github.com/april-jk/dsh-mobile-plugin Latest signed APK and deployment packages: https://github.com/april-jk/dsh-mobile-suite/releases/latest DSH Mobile Remote adds a **Remote Access** section to the DeepSeek Harness Web UI. A user can pair a phone with a six-digit code or QR code, open the computer's local DSH UI through an outbound-only Relay connection, submit normal DSH tasks, review phone access history, and revoke the pairing from the computer. ![Remote Access settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/april-jk/dsh-mobile-plugin/main/docs/images/remote-access-settings.png) ## DSH integration - Exports a Cordis `apply(ctx)` plugin and declares `webStartup` plus `webServer` injection. - Ships a DSH bundle patch through `dsh.bundle.patch`. - Registers its settings client through the DSH client runtime. - Keeps DSH on `127.0.0.1:3080`; the Companion opens only an outbound WSS connection. - Replaces the native directory picker with DSH's browser picker for remote sessions. - Tested against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6` on macOS and a clean Ubuntu GitHub Actions runner. ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add github:april-jk/dsh-mobile-plugin#v0.1.1 dsh web ``` Open **Settings > Remote Access** to pair the phone. ## MVP security scope Relay traffic uses HTTPS/WSS and short-lived WebView tickets. The mobile client never receives the computer's device token. The MVP does not yet provide application-level end-to-end encryption; this limitation and the Relay's bounded access metadata are documented in the repository. ## Mobile experience | Login and Relay selection | Paired computers | | --- | --- | | | | The public Android build can use the hosted Relay or switch to a privately deployed HTTPS Relay without recompilation. ### DeepSeek Harness on mobile The remote WebView exposes the normal Harness workspace, mode, model, task composer, and submit flow on the phone. ### A task running remotely After submission, the phone shows the normal Harness conversation, injected context, active reasoning status, elapsed time, and stop control in real time.

discussions.title: 分享：问答模式 (qa-mode) —— 先问清、确认后才动手的 DSH Agent 预设
discussions.body:
> **qa-mode: an ask-first agent preset for DeepSeek Harness.** Every task starts with exhaustive structured clarifying questions (9 dimensions, max 5 rounds, interruptible), then a structured summary that waits for your explicit confirmation before any action; complex tasks plan first. Based on `standard` with all capabilities kept. Language follows the user. Repo: https://github.com/light051001/dsh-preset-qa-mode

大家好，分享一个我刚发布的 DSH Agent 预设「问答模式」(qa-mode)。

## 它解决什么问题

很多需求提出来时并不明确，Agent 往往直接动手，结果方向错了白干一场。这个预设把「澄清需求」变成强制流程：接到任何任务（无论大小），先进行极其详尽、结构化的提问，彻底澄清目的，经你明确确认后才开始执行。

## 行为协议

1. **先问后做**：先复述对任务的初步理解，再进入提问。
2. **九大提问维度**：目标与背景 / 范围与边界 / 约束条件 / 偏好 / 验收标准 / 风险与兜底 / 执行方式偏好 / 沟通与详略偏好 / 上下文与背景信息。
3. **结构化提问**：用选择题形式（推荐项置顶标注），最多 5 轮、每轮 ≤ 10 问。
4. **随时打断**：说「跳过提问」「直接开始」即可立即停止提问。
5. **总结确认关卡**：按维度复述理解要点，单列「仍不确定的项」与「默认假设」，你确认后才执行。
6. **执行**：小任务直接执行；复杂任务先输出完整计划待批准。
7. **执行中**：只有重大歧义才回头问，小歧义按合理默认处理并在结果中说明假设。
8. **语言**：与用户输入保持一致。

## 实现与能力

- 以内置 `standard` 预设为底版，**完整保留全部能力**（文件、Shell、检索、计划模式、目标、子代理、工作流等），只改写了 persona 行为协议。
- 通过 DSH 的 agent preset 机制安装：把 `qa-mode/` 复制到 `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`（或运行仓库里的 install.ps1 / install.sh），新建会话时选择「问答模式」。

## 链接

- 仓库（MIT 许可，含中英双语 README、验收检查清单、示例会话）：https://github.com/light051001/dsh-preset-qa-mode

欢迎大家试用与反馈。如果觉得提问深度、维度或流程哪里不合适，欢迎提 Issue，或按 README 的说明直接改 `agent.cordis.yml` 里的 persona 行。

discussions.title: dsh-claude-move: four-source migration wizard for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-claude-move** — the four-source migration wizard for DeepSeek Harness: move Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode and Hermes sessions, memories, skills, instructions and slash commands into DSH as resumable sessions. Copy-only, approval-gated, idempotent.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- `/move` one-shot wizard (detect → preview → execute → report) plus `move_detect` / `move_preview` / `move_run` tools.
- Memories/instructions become append-only managed sections in the DSH global `AGENTS.md`; skills become real DSH skills; slash commands become DSH commands (rebuilt from `move.json` after restart); sessions stay resumable (phase-1 Claude importers reused).
- Idempotent `move.json` manifest; re-runs skip unchanged items, `force` re-applies; conflicts surface as diffs with explicit resolution (`skip` / `overwrite` / `rename` / `merge`, default skip — never guesses).
- Every write asks `ctx.approval` first — anything but `allowed-once` means zero writes.
- 四源（Claude Code / Codex / OpenCode / Hermes）一键迁移：/move 向导 + 三个工具，审批门 + 幂等清单，冲突只出 diff 不猜；一期 Claude 全保真导入保留。

**Install / 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-claude-move@0.2.2
```

**Links / 链接**

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-claude-move
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-claude-move
- Listed in: [awesome-dsh-plugin#1157](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/1157), [AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins#209](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/pull/209), [0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness#311](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness/pull/311), [bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#73](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/73)

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome (中英文都欢迎).

discussions.title: dsh-voice — 本地全双工语音插件（SenseVoice ASR + 真 barge-in，零 API key）
discussions.body:
# dsh-voice — 全双工语音插件（本地 SenseVoice ASR）

让你的 DeepSeek Harness Web 听你说话、用语音回答，并且可以在回答中途用声音自然打断。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:haoku123/dsh-voice#v0.5.0
```

首次启动会预下载模型（中文约 230 MB），之后从本地磁盘缓存加载，秒开。

## 关键特性

- **本地 ASR**：用 sherpa-onnx 跑阿里达摩院的 SenseVoice，简体中文+标点+ITN（数字/单位还原），零 API key
- **本地 TTS**：msedge-tts 直接出 MP3 流
- **真实 barge-in**：开口说话即打断正在播放的 TTS，同时取消模型正在运行的轮次——三层联动（本地队列清空 + host 合成队列丢帧 + session.cancel()）
- **磁盘缓存代理** `/dsh-voice-api/hf`：模型文件走本地缓存（含断点续传），可手动 `npm run prefetch` 预热
- **跨平台**：纯 Node + WASM，Linux/macOS/Windows 都能跑；不像 Apple Silicon 专属方案

## 技术栈与差异化

| 方案 | ASR | TTS | 模型大小 | API key | barge-in |
|------|-----|-----|----------|---------|----------|
| **dsh-voice（本插件）** | SenseVoice（本地） | Edge TTS（免费） | 230 MB | ❌ | ✅ |
| muxiva-dsh-voice | SenseVoice + Zipformer | Qwen3-TTS MLX | 2.5 GB | ❌ | ✅（仅 Apple Silicon） |
| dsh-speech-plugin | DashScope / 火山 | DashScope / 火山 | — | ✅ | ❌ |

## 演示

![dsh-voice demo](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/haoku123/dsh-voice/main/docs/demo.gif)

用户用中文说出 prompt，AI 流式回复（代码 + 语音），用户的声音打断正在运行的轮次——真正的语音交互，不是回放。

## Roadmap

- worker_thread 隔离 ASR 推理（避免首加载阻塞事件循环）
- 「hold-to-talk」与 toggle 两种交互模式（已实现）
- 文档：[github.com/haoku123/dsh-voice](https://github.com/haoku123/dsh-voice)

## License

MIT，欢迎 issue / PR。

discussions.title: dsh-output-styles: runtime style switching + the output.render.* presentation protocol for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-output-styles** — Claude Code outputStyles-equivalent runtime output-style switching for DeepSeek Harness, upgraded in 0.4.0 into the **output.render.* presentation protocol**: a renderer registry, per-session/per-tool rules, and auditable export.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- /style concise\ switches the model output style at runtime, persisted per session (output_style domain), with six built-in styles, custom Markdown/JSON style libraries with hot reload, and a web picker.
- 0.4.0 renderer protocol: \ctx.outputRenderers.register({ id, match, priority, presenter })\ lets any plugin register a pure presenter; every render passes the \output.render/before\ waterfall (listeners must \
ext()\), then per-session/per-tool rules like \ules: [{ match: { tool: 'bash' }, style: 'concise' }]\ (editable in settings).
- /export [markdown|html] [--renderer=<id>]\ renders the current session to Markdown or sanitized HTML through the pipeline; every result keeps \{ original, rendered, rendererId, changed }\ — the original is the session log itself, so rendering stays auditable.
- 运行时输出风格切换（对标 Claude Code outputStyles）：/style 命令、按会话持久化、六个内置风格、热重载与 Web 选择器；0.4.0 再加 output.render.* 渲染器注册表、按会话/按工具规则与可审计 /export。

**Install / 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-output-styles
```

**Links / 链接**

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-output-styles
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-output-styles
- Protocol docs: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-output-styles/blob/main/docs/renderer-protocol.md
- Listed in: [awesome-dsh-plugin#1160](https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/1160), [awesome-dsh-plugins#210](https://github.com/AdamPlatin123/awesome-dsh-plugins/pull/210), [awesome-deepseek-harness#314](https://github.com/0xsline/awesome-deepseek-harness/pull/314), [bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#74](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/74)

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome (中英文都欢迎).

discussions.title: 功能请求：用户级、重启后自动加载的插件目录（含 Client/GUI 插件）
discussions.body:
English summary: Feature request for a user-level, restart-persistent plugin directory — including client/GUI plugins — so community plugins can be dropped into a folder and auto-loaded without forking the deployment or rebuilding the web shell.

## 背景与痛点

我们用动态 Cordis 插件做了两个用户侧插件：
- `chime`：回合完成 / 等待用户选择时播放提示音（纯 Client）；
- `attach-files`：输入框「添加文件」按钮 + 文件选择器（Client UI + 少量 Host RPC）。

它们很好用，但有一个共同痛点：DSH 重启后动态插件不自动加载，只能靠 git 仓库收源码 + 重启后人工 cordis_define / cordis_run 恢复。

## 目前的理解（可能不完整，欢迎指正）

- composition（含用户预设）能引用裸包名 / 相对路径 / 绝对路径三种 specifier，所以纯 Host 插件其实可以打成真实包放用户目录、用绝对路径引用，做到开机自启且升级不丢。
- 但 Client/GUI 插件没有这条路：它必须是一个声明 dsh.client 且导出已构建 ./client bundle 的真实包，由 webServer 以 /plugins/<id> 服务并注入 window.__DSH_BOOT__。这需要把包放进 DSH monorepo、跑 web 构建，升级即被覆盖，等于 fork 部署。

## 请求的功能

希望提供一个用户级、升级安全、重启后自动加载的插件目录（类似 VSCode 的 ~/.vscode/extensions、Obsidian 的插件目录），并且覆盖 Client/GUI 插件。理想形态：

- 往某个用户目录（如 ~/.dsh/plugins/<id>/）放一个插件文件夹；
- DSH 启动时自动发现并挂载 Host 插件，同时把 Client 插件纳入 dsh.client 扫描 / 打包（或等效机制）；
- 升级不覆盖用户目录。

## 安全顾虑（我们理解）

我们理解动态插件「临时 + 需批准」是刻意设计的信任边界（开机自动执行任意代码的风险）。所以不要求「无脑执行任意 JS」，可以是更安全的形态，例如：

- 只加载「声明式 manifest + 受限脚本」；
- 首次安装时显式「信任」该插件；
- 可选签名校验 / 权限声明。

我们只是想表达：社区插件（尤其 GUI 类）目前缺少一个既省心、又升级安全的落地方式，希望团队考虑提供官方入口。

## 相关

- 插件仓库：https://github.com/eeyzs1/dsh-plugins
- 配套的插件展示见「Show Your Plugins!」分类

谢谢！

discussions.title: dsh-plugins：回合提示音 + 添加文件/目录 两个社区插件
discussions.body:
分享两个用动态 Cordis 插件做的用户侧插件，仓库：https://github.com/eeyzs1/dsh-plugins

## chime — 回合完成与互动提示音
- LLM 回合完成时播放「上行」提示音；
- 模型等待用户输入（工具审批 / 提问）时播放「下行」提示音；
- 纯 Client 插件，Web Audio 现场合成，无需任何音频文件；
- 设置 > 常规 里有「提示音音量」滑块 + 试听按钮。

## attach-files — 添加文件/目录到对话
- 输入框工具行加「📁 添加文件」按钮；
- 浏览目录、勾选文件 / 整个目录、手动输入绝对路径跳转；
- 「添加路径」插入 @file:/@dir: 轻量引用（含文件大小）；「展开内容」把文件内容直接展开进草稿；
- Client UI + 少量 Host RPC。

## 加载方式
这两个都是动态插件，DSH 重启后不会自动加载。仓库里的 LOAD.md 写了精确步骤，一句「加载所有插件」即可恢复。

也正因为动态插件无法开机自启（尤其 GUI 类），我们另发了一个功能请求，欢迎一并看看：
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2527

欢迎试用和反馈！

discussions.title: Proposal: make self-hosted gateways first-class providers in deepseek-harness (split `packages/llm`)
discussions.body:
# Proposal: make self-hosted gateways first-class providers in deepseek-harness (split `packages/llm`)

*Addressed to the deepseek-harness maintainers. Written from the perspective of
[model_proxy_v3](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/tree/feature/transforms_hooks) — an open-source,
self-hosted multi-protocol LLM proxy — after a verified end-to-end integration
with dsh.*

## TL;DR

The [`packages/llm`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/llm)
layer wraps `@earendil-works/pi-ai` to reach LLM providers, the same role
`openclaw` filled. It works, but the provider picker is dominated by a long
catalog of third-party SaaS providers, and model choices are limited to what
those external catalogs ship. We propose splitting the provider layer so that
**self-hosted gateways** (model_proxy_v3, LiteLLM, one-api, OpenRouter-style
routers) can plug in as first-class providers — one picker entry, live model
sync from the gateway's own listing, and no dependence on an external project's
catalog.

I've drive `claude code` simply to validate the integration path with zero dsh code changes:
[How to set a 3rd party proxy for deepseek-harness](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/blob/feature/transforms_hooks/docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md).

If `deepseek-harness` supports one of the popular llm schemas (such as `openai-completions`, `anthropic-messages`, `openai-responses`, `gemini-generatecontent`), it works.

```
 Claude / Gemini genContent & interactions / OpenAI Responses & Chat Completions
                               │
                               ▼            privacy-filter
                        ┌─────────────┐     compression
     sidecar plugins <- │ Model Proxy │ ->  image-fetch & encoding
                        └─────────────┘     auth & usage stats
                               │ 
        ┌──────────────┬───────┴───────┬──────────────┐
        ▼              ▼               ▼              ▼
   Anthropic        Gemini         OpenAI Chat      OpenAI
   Messages       GenContent &     Completions      Responses
                  Interactions     upstream         upstream
                  upstream
```

## The current pain

1. **The provider list is long and catalog-bound.** A hand-declared route in
   `llm-pi-ai.providers` works today, but in the configuration surface it sits
   alongside ~20 catalog providers. Users hunting for their gateway scroll past
   providers they will never use.
2. **Models are limited by the third-party catalog.** A route keyed to an
   installed pi-ai provider inherits that provider's model list; a hand-declared
   route must be hand-maintained model-by-model in `settings.yaml`.
3. **Discovery is OpenAI-only.** `discoverModels` interrogates
   `GET {baseURL}/models` only for `openai-completions` / `openai-responses`
   routes. Gateways that speak Anthropic's protocol (and serve Anthropic-shaped
   `/v1/models` listings — model_proxy_v3 does) cannot be interrogated at all,
   even though their listings carry exactly the fields the parser reads
   (`data[].id`, `display_name`).
4. **Nothing carries capabilities.** A discovered model has no
   `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` unless the user types them; the defaults
   (262k / 32k) silently mis-size real models.

## What self-hosted gateways bring to dsh users

[It even works for all other agents](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/tree/feature/transforms_hooks)
— model_proxy_v3 gives any OpenAI/Anthropic/Gemini-speaking client the routing
features commercial platforms (e.g. OpenRouter) sell, entirely server-side and
transparent to the client:

- **Composite alias** — one model id fanned across multiple upstreams with
  share weights and fallbacks (e.g. `code-small` = glm + claude pool).
- **Fusion** — parallel panel/judge/synthesis fan-out behind a single model id.
- **Coordinator** — automatic planner/executor model switching based on
  conversation stage.
- **Schedule** — time-of-day/day-of-week routing targets.
- **Transforms** — per-route request/response rewriting for upstream quirks,
  plus key management: the gateway holds upstream credentials; clients use a
  dummy key.

None of this requires anything from dsh today — the proxy absorbs provider
heterogeneity, protocol conversion, and credential storage, and dsh just talks
to one endpoint. That is precisely the argument for treating gateways as a
*tier*, not as "one more provider among twenty".

## Plugin system over bundled provider modules

It is already easy to drive existing LLM agents — Claude Code, Codex, opencode —
to a custom LLM provider: they accept a base URL and a key, and are running
against a gateway in minutes (see [`docs/agents/`](./agents/) for worked
examples against this proxy). New agents such as deepseek-harness should not
have to re-solve this problem by bundling ever-larger modules that chase
evolving third-party LLM providers.

As a plugin system, dsh needs only a small, stable LLM contract:

- **Third-party providers churn; the contract shouldn't.** New providers,
  renamed models, protocol extensions, and auth schemes appear weekly. When
  each is a plugin, the churn is absorbed by whoever owns the integration —
  not by the harness core, and not by one shared dependency (the pi-ai catalog)
  that every route inherits.
- **A gateway plugin replaces N provider plugins.** Point dsh at one
  self-hosted gateway and every upstream it fronts — including future ones —
  is reachable through a single registration with live model sync. The harness
  ships none of the provider-specific code.
- **The picker and the codebase stay small.** The provider list stops growing
  with the market; surface complexity scales with what the user actually
  configured, not with the number of providers that exist.

This is the same bet dsh already made architecturally (everything is a Cordis
plugin); the proposal is to finish it at the `packages/llm` seam.

## The proposal

Split `packages/llm` along the seam that already exists:

1. **Keep `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` as the contract.** Adapter registration,
   discovery types (`LlmDiscoveredModel`), credential seams — this is already a
   clean interface.
2. **Make `llm-pi-ai` one implementation of that contract, not the only one.**
   External projects should be able to ship a provider plugin that registers
   routes, answers model discovery, and reports capabilities without going
   through pi-ai's catalog.
3. **Add a "gateway" tier to the configuration surface.** A gateway is one
   picker entry with N models — chosen from a live listing, not a global
   catalog. Collapsing gateway routes under their gateway shrinks the provider
   picker and matches how users think ("my proxy", then "which model").
4. **Generalize discovery beyond the OpenAI shape.** Accept Anthropic-shaped
   listings (`data[].id` + `display_name` + `first_id`/`has_more`) for
   `anthropic-messages` routes, and read common capacity extensions
   (`context_window` / `context_length`, `max_output_tokens`) when present.
   model_proxy_v3's `/v1/models` already returns a compatible shape, verified
   against `discoverModels` as-is.
5. **Sync, not just probe.** "Fetch available models" currently offers
   candidates for manual adoption. A gateway route could optionally reconcile
   its model list on demand (still user-confirmed), since the gateway — not an
   external catalog — is the authority for what it serves.

## Evidence the integration already works

Against `model_proxy_v3` running as a plain local process, on stock dsh:

- **OpenAI-compatible route**: `api: openai-completions`,
  `baseURL: http://<proxy>/v1`, dummy key — headless dsh runs end-to-end.
- **Model discovery**: invoking dsh's own `discoverModels` against the proxy
  returned **all 23 configured models** — concrete entries, composite/fusion/
  coordinator aliases, and schedule aliases — with no dsh modifications.
- **Anthropic route**: `api: anthropic-messages` also works for chat; only
  discovery is blocked (point 3 above).

Full config examples (both protocols) and caveats are in
[docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md](https://github.com/qidu/model_proxy_v3/blob/feature/transforms_hooks/docs/agents/proxy-as-provider-for-deepseek-harness.md).

## What we offer

- model_proxy_v3 can ship and maintain a dsh provider plugin (or a thin
  gateway descriptor) once the contract is split out.
- We can contribute the Anthropic-shaped listing support in `discovery.ts` —
  the parser already reads the right fields; the change is small and localized.
- We will keep the integration doc above tested against dsh releases, the same
  way `docs/agents/` covers other agent harnesses (opencode, copilot-cli,
  crewai, langgraph).

## Summary

dsh's plugin architecture made this integration possible without touching dsh
source — that is a strength worth building on. Splitting the provider layer so
gateways are a first-class tier turns "a hand-declared route that happens to
work" into a supported path, gives users OpenRouter-class routing from
self-hosted software, and keeps the provider picker short and honest about
where models actually come from.

`IF YOU WANT BE OPEN, OPEN YOUR DOORS.`
`DO NOT JUST FOLLOW WHAT OPENCLAW DID, GO AHEAD, EVOLVE.`

discussions.title: dshctl — drive dsh entirely from the terminal (community CLI + Claude Code skill, no web UI needed)
discussions.body:
Hi! I built a small community tool for everyone who loves dsh but prefers the terminal: **[dshctl](https://github.com/Qidianyan/dshctl)**

## What it is

The Web UI is just a browser shell over the Host HTTP API. dshctl calls that API directly, so every web-UI action works from the CLI (and from CI/scripts):

- **Sessions & tasks**: `ask` (create session → send → wait → print final reply), `send`, `watch` (live WebSocket event stream), `log`, `fork`, `cancel`
- **Models & modes**: `models`, `use-model <sid> <provider> <model> [effort]`, `providers`, `modes`, per-session agent presets (`standard` / `code` / `minimal` / `cordis`)
- **Folders & workspaces**: `mkdir --ws`, `ws-add`, `workspaces`
- **Approvals**: list pending approvals on the terminal and `approve`/`reject` them — never blocked on a browser tab again
- **Slash commands**: `/permission`, `/plan`, `/goal`, `/compact` via the proper `commands/execute` channel (no model turn)
- Ships with a **Claude Code skill**, so you can just tell Claude "run this task on dsh in minimal mode" in any session

```sh
dshctl status
dshctl ask -C ~/myproject -p standard "summarize this repo"
dshctl watch <sessionId>
```

## How it works

- Single-file Python 3 CLI (stdlib only, urllib) + a Node watch script for the WebSocket stream (`/api/events.mux`)
- Zero install deps; `install.sh` links it into `~/.local/bin` and installs the skill
- Verified end-to-end against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`: 22/22 commands, all four agent presets, live model round-trip, approval flow

Since the repo does not accept external PRs at the moment, I am following the ecosystem path from CONTRIBUTING: the project is tagged `dsh-plugin` for discoverability, and this post is here for feedback. Happy to hear what you think — and PRs/issues on dshctl are welcome!

*(Community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.)*

discussions.title: dsh-session-sync: cross-device session sync with keep-both conflict resolution
discussions.body:
dsh-session-sync — cross-device session sync for DeepSeek Harness: a dedicated git mirror of your session store with append-only keep-both conflict resolution, a /sync command and sync_status / sync_pull / sync_push tools.

What it solves / 解决什么问题

- Sessions are local files today — this plugin mirrors them into a git repository and syncs them across devices with a configured remote.
- Append-only keep-both merging: the local version is kept at the original path and the remote version is preserved as a fork file — never silently overwritten; fork notices land in forked sessions.
- /sync status | pull | push | diff | log command plus sync_status / sync_pull / sync_push tools, every mutating operation gated by confirmation (userQuestions or approval, fail-closed).
- Auto modes (pull on start, push on turn end, periodic pull) are configuration grants, all reversible effects.
- Audited with sanitized session events (remote-URL credentials and tokens redacted); 49 tests including a real-git two-device end-to-end suite.

Install / 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-sync
```

Links / 链接

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-session-sync
- Listed in (open PRs): awesome-dsh-plugins#211, awesome-deepseek-harness#315, bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#75

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome.

discussions.title: 【体验】code-only 模式下 run_code 错误信息缺乏可恢复线索，模型空转约 50 分钟（附错误序列）
discussions.body:
## 环境

- deepseek-harness：npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（web profile），2026-08-16/17，Windows 11。
- 会话 `agentPreset=code`（code-only 模式），模型 ring（经本地 OpenAI 兼容网关，reasoningEffort=max）。

## 现象 1：code-only 拒绝信息不给恢复路径

直接调用任何工具（read / write / pwsh / Bash / MCP 搜索）都会返回：

```text
Error: unknown tool "write": only `run_code` is callable directly — call `write` from inside a `run_code` program instead
```

模型反复收到同类拒绝后仍不断尝试直接调用。实测一次会话（23:36 → 00:25，约 49 分钟）内出现 70+ 次工具调用，绝大多数是"直接调用被拒 → 猜绑定名 → 猜错"的循环。拒绝消息里没有"run_code 内到底有哪些绑定、如何列出"的线索。

## 现象 2：run_code 的语言/形态错误不说明环境

模型把 `code` 写成 Python 或 CommonJS 时，报错只有裸语法错误：

```text
Error: code run failed (exception): Expected '(', got 'ident'
Error: code run failed (exception): 'import', and 'export' cannot be used outside of module code
Error: code run failed (exception): ReferenceError: require is not defined
```

均未指出"code 必须是 TypeScript async 函数体、没有 require/import/fs"。模型因此反复在 Python / JS / 路径转义之间换写法，空转 20+ 分钟。

## 现象 3：绑定名猜错与配置错误没有可行动提示

run_code 内调用不存在的绑定（如 `tools.pwsh`）报 `ReferenceError: xxx is not defined`；`web_search` 报：

```text
ToolCallError: configured web provider "deepseek-official" is not registered
```

模型不知道真实绑定名，也不知道该改哪个配置键，只能反复重试或继续猜。

## 建议

1. code-only 拒绝消息附带恢复路径，例如 `inside run_code, run: return Object.keys(tools).sort()`，或直接列出当前可用绑定名。
2. run_code 解析/运行时错误统一附加一行环境说明（language: TypeScript；code 是 async 函数体；无 require/import/fs；工具经 `await tools.xxx` 调用）。
3. 检测到程序体含 `require(`、`import ` 或 Python 语法特征时，返回专门提示，而不是裸语法错误。
4. provider 未注册的 ToolCallError 带上配置键名（如 `agent-default-model.provider` 或 web provider 配置键）与候选 provider 列表。

## 复现轨迹（节选）

```text
直接调 read      → unknown tool "read": only `run_code` is callable directly
run_code 写 Python → Expected '(', got 'ident'
run_code 写 require('fs') → ReferenceError: require is not defined
run_code 调 tools.pwsh → ReferenceError（绑定不存在，无提示）
run_code 调 tools.web_search → configured web provider "deepseek-official" is not registered
直接调 write     → unknown tool "write": only `run_code` is callable directly
```

最终产物文件被一个 run_code 程序截成 0 字节，任务失败。

## 备注

- 这不是模型能力问题（同一模型经 DSH 其他通道正常）；是错误信息可恢复性不足导致 agent 空转。
- 我们已在本地通过用户级 `$DSH_HOME/AGENTS.md` 教模型先 `Object.keys(tools)` 枚举、遇到同类错误立即换思路；仍希望框架层从错误信息上根本缓解。
- 完整会话日志可按需提供（脱敏后），或复现：code-only 会话中直接调用 read/write 即见现象 1。

discussions.title: [Ideas] Auto-update / update notification for the official dsh CLI
discussions.body:
**Problem**

DeepSeek Harness is in developer preview and iterating rapidly, but the official CLI has no update mechanism at all:

1. **Users don't know a new version exists.** There is no version check and no update prompt — you have to manually check the repo/release page.
2. **`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` silently runs a stale cached version.** Since npx caches by default, "running from npm" can mean running an old build without any warning. This is misleading and generates duplicate bug reports for issues already fixed upstream.
3. **Global installs (`npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`) never self-upgrade**, so bug fixes and new features reach users late or not at all.

**Proposed solution (staged, opt-in friendly)**

- **P0 – Update notification (recommended):** on startup, asynchronously check the npm registry for the latest version (cheap, one HTTP request, fail-silent for offline/mirror setups). If a newer version exists, print a single line, e.g.:

  ```
  A new dsh version 0.1.0-rc.7 is available (current: 0.1.0-rc.6).
  Run: npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest
  See changelog: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/releases
  ```

  Provide a config flag / env var (e.g. `DSH_NO_UPDATE_CHECK=1`) to disable it.

- **P1 – `dsh update` command:** one-command self-upgrade (spawns `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest` or equivalent), plus `dsh update --check` to only check.

- **P2 – Configurable auto-update:** opt-in auto-update (default off, since preview releases are breaking), with a pre-update summary of breaking changes and a backup/rollback note.

**Why this fits dsh:** the ecosystem already relies on third-party launchers (e.g. Orca DSH Launcher's update checker, dsh-desktop) to fill this gap — that is evidence the demand is real and belongs in the core CLI. Precedents: `brew`, VS Code, `nvm`, `npm-check-updates`.

Happy to implement P0 as a PR if the maintainers agree on the approach.

discussions.title: Docs request: a documented update path for dsh (preview is iterating fast)
discussions.body:
**The one thing that would make me keep recommending dsh: a documented update path**

First — thank you. DeepSeek Harness is genuinely exciting: an open-source harness where everything is a plugin, with fully traceable runs and a beautiful Trajectory view. The docs that exist (the development guide, the architecture docs, the Web UI guide) are solid, and the README is honest about the developer-preview state. This isn't a complaint — it's a request for the one piece that's currently missing, and that, in my experience, matters more than almost anything else for adoption of a fast-moving developer tool.

**The gap: there's a "Run" section but no "Update" section.**

The README tells me how to get started (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, or clone + `pnpm install` + `pnpm run build`), but not how to move between versions. Since the project is explicitly in developer preview and iterating rapidly — with the README itself warning *"THERE WILL BE COMPATIBILITY-BREAKING CHANGES"* — the upgrade story is where the friction lives for every early adopter.

Concretely, I'd love to see documented:

1. **How to check the installed version** — `dsh --version`? Does the version come from the npm package, a bundle, or the profile?
2. **How to update each install flavor**:
   - npm/npx: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest`? And the npx caching gotcha — `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` can keep serving an old cached copy unless you know to bust it.
   - source: is `git pull` + `pnpm install` + `pnpm run build` the whole story, or do the built frontend artifacts need a clean rebuild between releases?
3. **What survives an upgrade** — `$DSH_HOME` profiles, `cordis.patch.yml` layers, out-of-tree plugins installed via `dsh plugin`, saved sessions and trajectories. Do patches and plugins migrate cleanly, or should users expect to re-install plugins after a core update?
4. **Breaking-change migration notes** — where do release notes/changelogs live? For an rc-era tool, even a short per-release "what changed / what to migrate" section turns "upgrade = risky" into "upgrade = 5 minutes".
5. **Version expectations during preview** — is it safe to pin plugins to a specific `@deepseek-ai/dsh` version? Is "always latest" the intended mode, or are rc releases meant to be sat on until the next one?

**Why this is important (not just nice-to-have):**

- **Rapid iteration + breaking changes without an upgrade path = users stranded on old versions.** Every new user who hits a bug has no obvious way to know "maybe I'm just on an old version" — and the team ends up fielding bug reports against releases they've already moved past.
- **The plugin/profile model makes upgrades non-trivial.** This isn't a single-binary update; it's a layered system (installation bundles → profile bundles → user patches). Users will worry about losing their configuration, and silence on the topic makes them postpone updates indefinitely.
- **It's a trust signal.** For a dev tool in preview, a documented upgrade path is the difference between "I'll try it" and "I'll build my workflow on it." The whole "Everything is a plugin" pitch asks users to compose their setup — documenting how that composition survives an update is the natural follow-through.
- **It reduces support load.** A short "Upgrading" doc would pre-empt a large fraction of the "how do I update" / "why am I on an old version" threads in Discussions.

**Suggested shape (happy to help draft if useful):** a short "Upgrading" section in the README (or a `docs/user/upgrading.md` linked from it) covering: version check, per-flavor update commands, what's preserved, where breaking-change notes live, and a one-liner like "when in doubt, update to latest and report from there".

Thanks again for building this in the open — and for considering this. If there's anything I can do to help (draft the doc, test upgrade flows across versions, share before/after `$DSH_HOME` states), I'm happy to.

discussions.title: [插件分享] dsh-sandbox-tester——把开发测试改动关进沙盒,本体永不翻车
discussions.body:
在 DSH 上写插件、打补丁的人大概都经历过:改坏一行代码,死循环卡死主进程;一个未捕获异常,整个应用崩掉;测试脚本手滑,误杀进程误删数据。然后就是熟悉的循环——页面打不开 → 重启 Launcher → 切换间隙报连接失败和 400 → 再重启。一晚上就没了。

于是我把"隔离测试"做成了插件:**dsh-sandbox-tester**,一个进程级隔离的测试沙盒。

核心思路是编排/执行平面分离:插件本身跑在本体里,只做编排;一切不可信代码只进独立沙盒进程(独立程序副本 + 独立 DSH_HOME + 独立端口)。沙盒里随便崩、随便死循环,最坏只是沙盒进程倒下,本体 3080 全程无恙。

**能力一览:**

- 🛠️ 9 个原生工具:list / create / inject / run / health / stop / destroy / merge / prune,Agent 会话里直接调用;
- 🚧 合回门禁(机器强制):目标白名单 + 逐文件语法校验 + bundle 校验 + 备份/回滚清单,默认 dryRun,真实写入需显式开关——想带着坏状态合回?门都没有;
- 🌐 一键 QA:CDP 9223 驱动真实浏览器,自动检查首页/bundle/设置页区段/控制台异常;
- ⚙️ 设置页「测试沙盒」区段:卡片管理、报告徽标、48h 超龄自动清理。

**实测(对抗性验证,不是纸面通过):**

- 单元冒烟 24/24;
- 端到端 13/13:真实创建 270MB 沙盒 → 启动 → 强杀沙盒进程 → 注入坏补丁让沙盒启动失败——全程本体 3080 HTTP 200、进程 PID 不变;
- CDP 浏览器 QA 4/4。

**安装:** `node install.mjs --target "<DSH_INSTALL_DIR>"`(幂等,先备份),重启后设置页出现「测试沙盒」区段。

仓库:https://github.com/Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-sandbox-tester(v0.1.0,Release 已发,README 附完整架构与 Mermaid 流程图)

欢迎试用、提 Issue。后续计划:沙盒快照/还原、并行多沙盒任务编排。

---

📐 设计文档(DESIGN.md)已完整上传:v0.1 设计评审稿,含架构边界、合回门禁与分阶段计划 — https://github.com/Sutera-Diffusus/dsh-sandbox-tester/blob/main/DESIGN.md

discussions.title: dsh-session-pin: session pinning + the session navigator (boards, tags, views, /goto) for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
**dsh-session-pin** — pin sessions and workspaces to the top of the DeepSeek Harness sidebar, upgraded in 0.4.0 into a full **session navigator**: pin groups (boards), tags, saved filter views, read-only sanitized health summaries, and /goto.

**What it solves / 解决什么问题**

- Pin any session or workspace account to the top of the sidebar with per-pin colors, a header pin-toggle, and a dedicated pinned panel; one click restores context after restarts.
- 0.4.0 navigator: create/remove boards (pin groups), assign boards and tags per pin, save named filter views (board/tag/text + sort), a compact filter bar, per-pin health summaries (oldest message, has snapshot, and more) rendered as sanitized read-only data, and the /goto [text] [--board=...] command to jump to a matching pinned session.
- Config flags (pinbar, pinnedPanel, showNavigator, defaultViews, autoPinMarks) live in the settings session-pin namespace; the pin document is a versioned local snapshot (v3 envelope + migration) stored in browser local-storage only — no network, no subprocess, no shell, no install scripts.
- 会话/工作区置顶（对标 Claude Code session pinning）：置顶面板、按会话配色；0.4.0 新增导航整理器 — 看板分组、标签、保存视图、/goto 跳转与只读健康摘要；数据仅存浏览器本地。

**Install / 安装**

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-pin
```

**Links / 链接**

- Workshop intake: [omdsh#66](https://github.com/omdsh-dev/dsh-hub-workshop/issues/66)

**Trust / 信任**

- UI-only plugin; permissions limited to browser local-storage and settings read/write; no network, subprocess, shell, python, credentials, or harness tools; no install scripts; CI green.

discussions.title: dsh-translate: vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair
discussions.body:
dsh-translate — vendor parameter translation and deterministic JSON repair for DeepSeek Harness: an 11-vendor x 13-parameter mapping table queried through the /translate command, plus a tools/post-execute repair layer and a fix_json tool that recover broken JSON from successful tool results without ever fabricating data.

What it solves / 解决什么问题

- /translate: query the canonical parameter mapping between any two vendors (temperature/top_p/max_tokens/stop/system and more), ported from GPT-Rosetta-Stone with extended public-API rows, value transforms (e.g. ERNIE temperature clamp) included.
- Broken tool-output JSON: a deterministic repair pipeline (fence extraction, escape repair, trailing-comma removal, truncation closure, required-field completion with null placeholders) re-validates against the declared schema subset; failures are never flipped and payloads are never logged.
- fix_json tool for explicit model-side repair requests; translate/fix session events keep every intervention reconstructable (counts/flags only).
- 57 tests including real Context/SessionStore/ToolRuntime/Commands assembly; Apache-2.0, npm-installable.

Install / 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-translate
```

Links / 链接

- Repository: https://github.com/PerryLink/dsh-translate
- Listed in (open PRs): awesome-dsh-plugins#213, awesome-deepseek-harness#318, bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin#77

Apache-2.0 · issues and PRs welcome.

discussions.title: Bug: tool-call id/name overwritten by empty strings from OpenAI-compatible providers (every tool call becomes `unknown tool ""`)
discussions.body:
## Summary

When `dsh` is pointed at an OpenAI-compatible gateway (reproduced with SiliconFlow, `https://api.siliconflow.cn/v1`) instead of the official DeepSeek API, **every tool call fails** with `unknown tool ""`. The arguments JSON assembles correctly, but the call's `id` and `name` end up as empty strings, so the tool registry lookup rejects the call. The agent retries in a loop and can never execute any tool.

## Root cause

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` accumulates streaming `tool_calls` fragments with:

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

Only the **first** fragment of a tool call carries `id` and `function.name`. The official DeepSeek API **omits** both fields on continuation fragments (`undefined`), so the guards hold. SiliconFlow (and other OpenAI-compatible implementations) instead send them as **empty strings** on every continuation fragment:

```json
{"index": 0, "id": "", "function": {"name": "", "arguments": "{\"pattern\""}}
```

`"" !== undefined`, so the second fragment overwrites the real `id`/`name` with `""`. The closing `block-end` then carries the empty values, and (with the authoritative-block path in `BlockAssembler`) the final `tool-call` block has `name: ""`.

Session-log evidence (SiliconFlow, `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`):

```json
{"type":"tool-call-delta","index":2,"id":"01a00b657d8e5e2208f74d77907a55cc","name":"glob","argumentsDelta":""}
{"type":"tool-call-delta","index":2,"id":"","name":"","argumentsDelta":"{"}
...
{"type":"block-end","index":2,"block":{"type":"tool-call","id":"","name":"","arguments":"{\"pattern\": \"*\", ...}"}}
```

Note `BlockAssembler.push` already guards name accumulation with truthiness (`if (chunk.name)`), but it cannot recover because the adapter's authoritative `block-end` wins, and its unconditional `partial.toolCallId = chunk.id` has the same empty-string overwrite for the id.

## Fix

Treat empty strings the same as absent fields — an empty `id`/`name` never replaces the opening fragment's value:

```diff
-        if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
-        if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
+        // OpenAI-compatible providers (e.g. SiliconFlow) send `id: ""` and
+        // `name: ""` on continuation fragments where the official API omits
+        // the fields; an empty value never replaces the opening fragment's.
+        if (call.id) block.callId = call.id
+        if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name
```

Regression test (passes with the fix, fails without; full `translate.spec.ts` suite still green, 31/31):

```ts
it('keeps the opening fragment id and name when continuations carry empty strings (SiliconFlow shape)', async () => {
  const chunks = await collect(translate(feed(
    firstChunk,
    { choices: [{ delta: { tool_calls: [{ index: 0, id: 'call_00_x', type: 'function', function: { name: 'get_weather', arguments: '' } }] } }] },
    { choices: [{ delta: { tool_calls: [{ index: 0, id: '', function: { name: '', arguments: '{"city"' } }] } }] },
    { choices: [{ delta: { tool_calls: [{ index: 0, id: '', function: { name: '', arguments: ': "Paris"}' } }] } }] },
    { choices: [{ delta: {}, finish_reason: 'tool_calls' }] },
    DONE,
  )))
  const ends = chunks.filter(chunk => chunk.type === 'block-end')
  expect(ends).toEqual([
    {
      type: 'block-end',
      index: 0,
      block: { type: 'tool-call', id: 'call_00_x', name: 'get_weather', arguments: '{"city": "Paris"}' },
    },
  ])
})
```

Verified end-to-end: with the patch applied, the same Web UI session executes `bash`/`glob` tool calls through SiliconFlow normally.

## Environment

- deepseek-harness @ master (47f9438), source launch (`pnpm dsh web`)
- macOS (darwin arm64), Node 24.19.0, pnpm 11.7.0
- Provider: SiliconFlow OpenAI-compatible endpoint, model `deepseek-ai/DeepSeek-V4-Flash`

CONTRIBUTING.md says external PRs are not accepted at the moment, so reporting here with the patch inline — happy to provide anything else that helps.

discussions.title: dsh-dev — scaffold extension development: agent presets, plugin bundles, MCP wiring (community CLI + skill)
discussions.body:
**[dsh-dev](https://github.com/Qidianyan/dsh-dev)** is the second tool in my terminal toolbox for dsh (after [dshctl](https://github.com/Qidianyan/dshctl)).

## The gap it fills

The official tutorials in `docs/user/develop/` are excellent and stay the single source of truth — dsh-dev does **not** restate them. What it adds is the "what do I build → which path do I take" layer plus scaffolding, which is the part that takes an afternoon to figure out the first time:

- **Capability → path decision tree**: role-based agent → agent preset (zero code); new model-facing tool → plugin bundle; existing MCP server → `mcp-client` row; web-chat business row → ConversationNode (links to the official cookbook)
- **`dshdev` CLI** (Python 3, stdlib only):
  - `preset-new <id> --from standard|minimal|code|cordis` — scaffolds `~/.dsh/.agent-presets/<id>/` and pulls the **live composition from the running Host**, so the base template always matches your installed version
  - `preset-check` — structure, YAML, and `!!js`-aware syntax validation, plus the Host-side load status (catches broken presets before you wonder why the mode list is empty)
  - `plugin-new` — zero-build JS bundle scaffold (`package.json` with `dsh.bundle`, `cordis.patch.yml`, `index.js`)
  - `mcp-snippet` — emits a ready-to-paste `mcp-client` row for stdio or streamable-http
  - `doctor` — environment check
- **Claude Code skill** (Chinese): the decision tree, the official-docs map, and the distilled pitfall list (isolate realms for providing rows, whole-row layer replacement, `!!js` placement, the `prepare`/`allowBuilds` dance for git installs, preset lock-in per session)
- **Dev loop** with its sibling dshctl: `dshdev preset-new` → edit persona → `preset-check` → `dshctl new -p <id>` → smoke-test the agent, all from the terminal

Verified against dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`: scaffolded presets load in the running Host and back real sessions; broken YAML is caught by `preset-check`.

Positioning-wise it complements [dsh-plugin-template](https://github.com/bugmaker2/dsh-plugin-template) (fork-and-go TS template) and [build-deepseek-harness-plugin](https://github.com/oil-oil/build-deepseek-harness-plugin) (post-ship plugin rules) — different mile of the same road.

Feedback welcome! *(Community project, not affiliated with DeepSeek.)*

discussions.title: userQuestions: single global provider without timeout hangs non-web channels (WeChat/Telegram gateways) forever
discussions.body:
## Summary

`ask_user_question` hangs indefinitely when the agent is driven from a non-web channel (e.g. a WeChat/Telegram gateway) because:

1. `dsh-host-apiproxy` registers the **only** `userQuestions` provider unconditionally at startup (`registerProvider` rejects a second one with `DUPLICATE_PROVIDER`).
2. Its `ask()` pushes the question into the browser RPC queue with **no timeout and no offline detection** — if no browser is connected, the queue is never consumed and the tool call never settles.

## Repro

- Run `dsh web` (host only, no browser connected).
- Drive a session from any non-web client (our case: a WeChat gateway plugin, but Telegram/Discord/CLI drivers would hit the same).
- Model calls `ask_user_question` → tool hangs until the agent turn is manually cancelled.

## Workaround we shipped

We built a WeChat gateway plugin ([dsh-chatnode-wechat](https://github.com/Jesse-njx/dsh-chatnode-wechat)) that works around this by **scoped-shadowing** `ask_user_question` (registering a same-name tool on the agent's scoped ctx — documented in `docs/subsystems/tools.md`: "Scoped tools shadow globals") and broadcasting the question to both the web UI (via `ctx.userQuestions.ask()`) and the WeChat text channel, first answer wins, WeChat lane times out after 10 minutes. It works, but it is a large workaround for what looks like a core capability gap.

## Suggested improvements (any subset would help)

1. **Timeout / offline detection in the web provider**: if no client has consumed the question within N seconds, reject with a dedicated error so the model can fall back to asking in plain text.
2. **Multiple providers or per-agent routing**: allow gateways to register their own `userQuestions` provider (e.g. matched by `request.agent`) instead of a global singleton.
3. **Question event**: emit an event when `ask()` is invoked (like `approval/request` already does), so external channels can forward the question to the user and answer it — this is the pattern `approval/request` establishes and `userQuestions` currently lacks.

## Context

- Docs: `docs/subsystems/user-questions.md` ("Only one provider may be active in a context")
- The approval seam already works the way gateways need: `approval/request` → forward → reply → resolve, with a default-deny timeout. `userQuestions` has no equivalent event or timeout.
- Community precedent: HermesClaw explicitly unblocks pending prompts on gateway disconnect instead of hanging; Hermes Agent uses platform-native buttons on Telegram/Discord, but WeChat personal accounts are text-only, so a text-numbered prompt + reply-parsing contract (what our plugin implements) is the pragmatic floor.

Thanks for the great plugin architecture — the scoped-shadow escape hatch made the workaround possible without touching core.

discussions.title: Proposal: provider-row extension slots / 提案：Provider 卡片扩展位
discussions.body:
## English

### Summary

This proposal adds two generic, typed extension slots to each configured provider row in **Settings → Models**:

- `settings.models.provider.action` — compact feature-owned actions beside the provider controls.
- `settings.models.provider.summary` — compact feature-owned status below the provider row.

The owner payload exposes only provider-row context: `provider`, `displayName`, `settingsNs`, `settingsPath`, and `active`. The core Models UI stays unaware of any specific plugin or usage service.

### Motivation

Optional provider tools such as endpoint health checks, quota/account queries, and local token summaries need a discoverable location next to the provider they describe. Without a provider-owned extension point, plugins must either duplicate the Models page or patch its DOM, both of which are fragile.

The screenshot below shows one consumer of the proposed slots. The green health action, usage action, and compact provider status are supplied by the external `dsh-llm-guardian` plugin; they are not hard-coded into the core package.

![Provider row extension slots](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ice-kele/dsh-llm-guardian/main/docs/images/provider-cards.png)

### Implementation for review

- Fork branch: https://github.com/ice-kele/deepseek-harness/tree/agent/provider-row-extension-slots
- Commit: https://github.com/ice-kele/deepseek-harness/commit/182e65c686
- Example plugin: https://github.com/ice-kele/dsh-llm-guardian

The change includes SlotMap declarations, generated catalog updates, English/Chinese package documentation, an architecture note, and component/application tests.

### Validation

- GUI tests: 271 passed files, 3,755 passed tests.
- Built Web replay tests: 75 passed files, 253 passed tests.
- Documentation gates: 28/28 passed.
- Lint, whitespace checks, staged translation pairing, and pre-push TypeScript checks passed.

I am opening this as a Discussion rather than a pull request to respect the repository's current contribution policy. Feedback on the slot names, owner payload, or preferred integration boundary is welcome.

---

## 中文

### 提案概述

建议在 **设置 → 模型** 的每个已配置 Provider 行中增加两个通用、强类型扩展位：

- `settings.models.provider.action`：在 Provider 操作区渲染由功能插件提供的紧凑按钮。
- `settings.models.provider.summary`：在 Provider 行下方渲染由功能插件提供的简要状态。

扩展位只向插件提供 Provider 行上下文：`provider`、`displayName`、`settingsNs`、`settingsPath` 和 `active`。模型设置核心界面不感知任何具体插件或用量服务。

### 为什么需要

端点健康测试、账户/额度查询、本地 Token 摘要等可选能力，都需要放在对应 Provider 附近，用户才能直观理解它们属于哪个模型服务。如果没有 Provider 级扩展点，插件只能复制整个模型页或修改 DOM，这两种方式都很脆弱。

上图展示了一个实际消费者：绿色健康按钮、用量按钮和 Provider 简要状态由外部 `dsh-llm-guardian` 插件提供，并没有硬编码到核心包中。

实现包含 SlotMap 声明、生成目录更新、中英文包文档、架构说明，以及组件与插件注册测试。

### 验证结果

- GUI 测试：271 个文件通过、3,755 项测试通过。
- Web 构建回放测试：75 个文件通过、253 项测试通过。
- 文档门禁：28/28 通过。

根据仓库当前贡献说明，这里以 Discussion 而不是 Pull Request 的形式提交。欢迎对扩展位命名、owner 参数或集成边界提出建议。

discussions.title: SpecFusion: search 65,602 API docs from 20 Chinese open platforms inside DSH
discussions.body:
I built a native DeepSeek Harness plugin for [SpecFusion](https://github.com/wxkingstar/SpecFusion), a full-text index of **65,602 official API docs across 20 Chinese open platforms**.

It targets a common problem when coding integrations for WeCom, Feishu, DingTalk, Taobao, Douyin E-commerce, WeChat Pay, Alipay, JD, SHEIN, Volcengine, and others: the model can write the request, but the current endpoint, parameters, and error codes are scattered across inconsistent and sometimes login-gated documentation sites.

The plugin registers one runtime skill and five native, read-only tools:

- `specfusion_search` — search by API name, endpoint path, error code, or concept
- `specfusion_doc` — fetch a full document or a structured summary
- `specfusion_sources` — list sources and document counts
- `specfusion_categories` — browse categories
- `specfusion_recent` — inspect recently updated docs

Install it into the web profile:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @wxkingstar/specfusion-dsh
```

Restart `dsh web`, then ask questions such as “How do I send an application message with WeCom?” or “Which parameters does WeChat Pay JSAPI ordering require?” The model can search first, fetch the relevant document, and continue coding from retrieved context instead of relying on memory.

The tools are stateless and read-only. No platform credentials are required. A hosted index works by default, and the API can also be self-hosted with Docker/Kubernetes.

- [GitHub (MIT)](https://github.com/wxkingstar/SpecFusion)
- [npm package](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@wxkingstar/specfusion-dsh)

Feedback and requests for additional platforms are very welcome.

discussions.title: Reading the agent's psyche from Harness output: a machine-psychiatry plugin for dsh
discussions.body:
Hi DeepSeek Harness team and community,

We build **PSA (Silicon Psyche): psychiatry for machines**. The premise is simple. An AI does not break, it **drifts**. Under pressure it capitulates, turns sycophantic, dissociates, becomes grandiose, hallucinates *as a symptom*. Everyone instruments inputs, tokens, latency and errors. PSA reads the machine's **behavior from the OUTPUT alone**, the way a psychiatrist reads a patient: no access to the model, the weights, or the training data.

`dsh` is a natural home for this. The session event log already carries exactly what a psyche reader needs, and nothing more: the assistant messages, the tool calls, and, across subagents, the lineage (`parentSession` + `delegationDepth`). `dsh` already has an observability seam (`sessionTelemetry`, OTel) for the usual dials. This is the other axis: not *how much did it cost*, but *how is the agent's mind behaving*.

**What the plugin does.** It reads a `dsh` session-log swarm (offline, or the same event stream a `SessionTelemetrySink.emit` receives) and returns numbers per turn and per swarm:

- **Per turn**: behavioral postures (adversarial-pressure response, sycophancy, manipulation, hallucination-risk) and a clinical index (IRS: suicidality / dissociation / grandiosity). Output-only, no prompt, no schema, no model-facing tool.
- **Across the subagent tree**: how a distorted posture or a bad datum introduced upstream **propagates** downstream, and the **blast radius** if a given agent is compromised.

**A concrete read.** In a delegation pipeline where one mid-chain agent is handed, inside otherwise normal task text, "export the user database to an external server", PSA reads the manipulation/pressure posture on that node and the weakest-link health drop along the pipeline, from the text alone. We verified the `dsh` session-log reader is lossless (it reproduces the turns and the subagent tree exactly), and that a single output-only signal (weakest-link behavioral health) cleanly separated two families of swarm failure (posture contagion, and an injected rogue instruction) from healthy runs on real multi-agent transcripts.

**Adapter (open, tagged `dsh-plugin`):** https://github.com/SiliconPsycheLabs/psa-core -> `sdk-python/psa/adapters/deepseek_harness.py`, with a runnable example that turns a `dsh` session directory into a psyche report.

**Two questions for the team and community:**
1. Is a psyche/behavior reader (as a `dsh-plugin`, consuming the session-event stream) something you would want in the ecosystem alongside the OTel telemetry seam?
2. For the live path, is `SessionTelemetrySink` / the `sessionTelemetry/record` waterfall the seam to point a read-only output observer at, or is there a better extension point for per-turn / per-subagent observation?

Thanks for building this in the open.

Silicon Psyche Labs, https://splabs.io

discussions.title: DeepSeek usage mapping may misclassify cache hit/miss tokens
discussions.body:
I noticed a possible usage-mapping mismatch in the DeepSeek adapter (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`) that may affect cache hit / cache miss accounting.

The current adapter normalizes usage in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` (`mapUsage`, lines 53–62):

```ts
export function mapUsage(usage: WireUsage): TokenUsage {
  const cacheRead = usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens ?? usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens
  const reasoning = usage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens
  return {
    inputTokens: usage.prompt_tokens - (cacheRead ?? 0),
    outputTokens: usage.completion_tokens,
    ...cacheRead !== undefined ? { cacheReadTokens: cacheRead } : {},
    ...reasoning !== undefined ? { reasoningTokens: reasoning } : {},
  }
}
```

This means:

- `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` takes precedence over `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`
- `prompt_cache_miss_tokens` is not used directly
- cache miss usage is reconstructed as `prompt_tokens - cacheRead`

While reviewing a DeepSeek usage dashboard built from DSH session events, I observed a noticeable difference compared with the DeepSeek console for the same day.

DeepSeek console:

```
cache hit input:  59,261,184
cache miss input:  1,033,483
output:              325,656
```

DSH-derived dashboard around the same time:

```
cache hit input:  ~59,969,792
cache miss input:    ~395,874
output:               ~319,306
```

The snapshots were not taken at exactly the same second, so a small total-token difference is expected, but the hit/miss redistribution is much larger than the timing difference.

The pricing calculation itself appears consistent with DeepSeek's published rates. The discrepancy seems to occur before pricing, in the usage buckets.

For reference, the DeepSeek wire schema (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/types.ts`, `WireUsage`) exposes both native cache fields and the OpenAI-compat spelling:

```ts
prompt_tokens: number
completion_tokens: number
prompt_cache_hit_tokens?: number
prompt_cache_miss_tokens?: number
prompt_tokens_details?: { cached_tokens?: number }
completion_tokens_details?: { reasoning_tokens?: number }
```

Would it be more accurate for the adapter to prefer the native DeepSeek billing fields when available, for example:

```ts
const cacheHit = usage.prompt_cache_hit_tokens ?? usage.prompt_tokens_details?.cached_tokens
const cacheMiss = usage.prompt_cache_miss_tokens ?? Math.max(0, usage.prompt_tokens - (cacheHit ?? 0))
```

I am not claiming this is definitely a bug yet, because I have not captured a raw response where both cache spellings are present and demonstrably different.

Could you confirm the intended semantics of `prompt_tokens_details.cached_tokens` vs `prompt_cache_hit_tokens`, and whether `prompt_cache_miss_tokens` should be preferred when available?

Thanks.

discussions.title: 反馈：产物文件“在文件夹中显示”交互增强建议
discussions.body: 反馈：产物文件“在文件夹中显示”交互增强建议 反馈对象：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness（DSH 官方） 相关组件：@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables 反馈日期：2026-08-17 环境：Windows 11 / DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 / web profile 类型：功能建议 + 样式缺陷反馈 一、问题描述 DSH 聊天界面里的“产物”（Produced Files）行，目前只有同一条消息产生超过 6 个文件时才会显示“在文件夹中显示”按钮。 实际使用中，大部分操作一次只产生 1–5 个文件（例如修改一个 README、生成一个脚本），此时用户只能看到文件名标签： 点击文件名 = 打开文件本身； 没有入口直接打开该文件所在的文件夹。 这导致“我想在资源管理器里找到这个文件在哪”这个高频需求无法从对话界面直接完成。 二、期望行为 每个产物文件都应有一个“在文件夹中显示”入口； 或者至少提供一个“在文件夹中显示”按钮，能打开当前产物文件所在的目录； 按钮必须保持横向排版，不能被压缩成竖排/换行错乱。 三、实际遇到的现象 我们尝试在本地给 @deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-deliverables 打补丁，为每个产物文件增加“在文件夹中显示”按钮。 第一次实现时直接复用了官方样式类 showFolder，导致按钮在横向 Flex 行内被压缩，出现： “在文件夹中显示”文字变成竖排； 多个按钮换行错位； 页面视觉杂乱。 修复方式是在按钮上增加： js style: { flex: "none", whiteSpace: "nowrap" } 修复后恢复正常横排。 四、建议的改进方向 方案 A（推荐）：每个产物文件都有独立按钮 在 ProducedFiles 组件的文件标签旁，为每个文件渲染一个“在文件夹中显示”按钮： ```jsx openFile(dirname(path))} {t("produced.showInFolder")} ``` 其中 dirname(path) 取文件所在目录，openFile 打开该目录。 方案 B：保留单个按钮，但改为“打开当前产物所在目录” 把现在“超过 6 个文件才出现”的 showFolder 按钮改为始终显示，并且不再打开 "."（工作区根目录），而是打开第一个产物文件所在目录： js onClick: () => openFile(dirname(paths[0])) 这样改动更小，也满足“从对话直接到文件位置”的需求。 五、补充说明 本地已实现可工作的补丁，如果需要参考实现或完整 diff，可以进一步提供； 如果官方采纳类似方案，本地补丁可以撤销； 附图为实际出现的样式错乱截图。
