discussions.title: [Security] workspace-write fs fence silently grants <drive>:\tmp as a writable root on Windows
discussions.body:
# Security report: `workspace-write` fs fence silently grants `<drive>:\tmp` as a writable root on Windows

Researcher: Binhna. Defensive research, all validation local with minimal-impact marker writes.

## Summary

`writableRoots()` (`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/roots.ts:52-55` at commit `47f9438`, the current `master` HEAD) unconditionally includes the POSIX literal `'/tmp'` in the `workspace-write` allow-list:

```ts
return [...new Set([policy.workspaceRoot, '/tmp', tmpdir()].map(canonicalPath))]
```

On Windows, `realpathSync.native('/tmp')` resolves a drive-rooted path against the process's current drive. When `<drive>:\tmp` exists (installers and users create it; `C:\tmp` pre-existed on my validation host), `canonicalPath` returns `C:\tmp`, and the in-process fs fence (`SandboxedFileSystem.checkedTarget`, `packages/fs/fs-sandbox/src/index.ts:126-148`) admits any target under it. The `fs` / `str_replace_editor` write tools can then write anywhere under `C:\tmp` with no approval, outside the workspace and outside the per-user `%TEMP%` the mode documents.

Notably `C:\tmp` on default installs is modifiable by all Authenticated Users, so this is a machine-shared, cross-user-visible staging area - and the ACL sandbox denies writes there from confined shell commands, so the two write planes disagree on the same path.

## Reproduction (validated on Windows 11, build 26200)

Called the repository's own `writableRoots` and `isPathUnder` directly from source, with policy `{ mode: 'workspace-write', workspaceRoot: <poc-workspace> }`:

```
writableRoots : [
  "C:\\...\\poc-workspace",
  "C:\\tmp",
  "C:\\Users\\<user>\\AppData\\Local\\Temp"
]
probe C:\tmp\dropped-by-fs-tool.txt  -> fence verdict: ALLOWED   (via the C:\tmp root)
probe C:\Users\<user>\outside.txt    -> fence verdict: DENIED    (control)
```

Precondition: `C:\tmp` exists (recorded pre-existing on the host; not created for the test). While the directory is absent the literal stays inert, so the widening is silent and environment-dependent.

## Impact

- Any Windows session in `workspace-write` (the default preset) on a machine where `<cwd-drive>:\tmp` exists.
- The model (or a prompt-injected turn) gains an approval-free, persistent write area outside the workspace; files survive session cleanup, stay out of `git status`, and are shared with other local users. If `C:\tmp` is on `PATH` (common for users who create it for scratch scripts), planted executables shadow commands in the user's normal shell.
- Severity view: low/medium - it is a widened write grant, not a sandbox escape by itself (shell writes there are still denied; reads are unrestricted by design elsewhere).

## Suggested fix

Gate the host-temp literal to POSIX platforms in `writableRoots` (Windows keeps exactly `{workspaceRoot, os.tmpdir()}`), with a deterministic cross-platform test that mocks `os.tmpdir()` so the two temp roots stay distinguishable. A ready branch with the fix, tests, and an Agent Note (following repo conventions, all local gates run: vitest roots/fs-sandbox, note-format/classification, md-wrap/md-links, translation-pairing, tsc -b, pre-push typecheck):

https://github.com/maycuatroi1/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/win32-tmp-literal-writable-root

Filed as a discussion per CONTRIBUTING.md (external PRs not accepted at the moment); happy to rework or hand the patch over in whatever form is easiest for maintainers.

## Context from the same review (defended surfaces, negative results)

For completeness, the same validation run confirmed the Windows ACL restricted-token sandbox fails closed against direct out-of-workspace writes, WSL interop (`Wsl/Service/CreateInstance/E_ACCESSDENIED`, cold and warm distro), `\\wsl.localhost` UNC access, and the Docker Desktop engine named pipe - all under `workspace-write` on the same host.

discussions.title: DSH plugin suite: crash-surviving jobs, session anchors, three-platform sandboxes, persistent scheduling — six Apache-2.0 plugins
discussions.body:
**You run a 40-minute agent task. At minute 39 the session crashes: output lost, state lost, and no way to tell whether it ever finished.** That happened to us on DeepSeek Harness — so we built six plugins to answer it. All Apache-2.0, all three-platform CI green.

**一个 40 分钟的 agent 任务跑到第 39 分钟，会话崩了——输出没了、状态没了、连"它到底做完没有"都无从知晓。** 我们在 DeepSeek Harness 上真实踩过这个坑，然后写了六个插件来回答它。全部 Apache-2.0，全部三平台 CI 全绿。

## The six plugins / 六个插件

| Plugin | What it does | Evidence |
|---|---|---|
| [dsh-witness](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-witness) | Crash-surviving background jobs: the filesystem is the source of truth, cross-restart adoption, autopsy reports. 崩溃存活后台任务 | 12 scenarios / 34 assertions |
| [dsh-anchor](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-anchor) | Session anchor protocol: pre-committed intents, immediate post-action reconciliation against the real environment. 会话锚点协议 | 37 assertions |
| [dsh-cross-platform](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-cross-platform) | Linux sandbox backend for witness/anchor (chattr + bubblewrap read-only view). Linux 沙箱后端 | 34/34 ×3 |
| [dsh-macos](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-macos) | macOS sandbox backend (uchg immutable flags + sandbox-exec deny view). macOS 沙箱后端 | 34/34 ×3 |
| [schedule-core](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/schedule-core) | Zero-dependency persistent scheduler core: SQLite archive + lease-claim dispatch + full clock discipline. 零依赖持久调度核心 | unit 37 + fuzz 200/0 + diff 644/0 |
| [dsh-schedule](https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-schedule) | Cross-restart reminders and scheduled jobs — survives session death, dual remind/job actions. 跨重启提醒与定时任务 | 3-platform CI |

Scheduling fills a specific gap: the built-in scheduler's state lives in the session log, so **the schedule dies with the session**. Ours lives in a SQLite archive and dispatches across restarts with a lease-claim protocol. 调度补一个明确的空白：官方调度的状态在会话日志里——**会话死，调度死**。我们的存在 SQLite 档案馆里，跨重启租约认领派发。

## Three things we do differently / 三个不同

1. **Every capability claim carries an experiment number and a control group.** "Prevents overwrite" in the README means the experiment ledger has the full before/after comparison. No slogan enters a README — data does. **每个能力声明带实验编号与对照组。** README 说"防覆盖"，实验账本里就有加位前可写→加位后全挡→恢复后可写的完整对照。

2. **We fuzz the wall clock.** The nastiest input to a scheduler is time itself — rollback, jump-forward, DST gaps, crash windows. Our clock-disorder fuzz (200 seeds / 7770 random ops, five invariants) and an implementation×model differential test (644 assertions) are public, reproducible, and have caught real bugs. **我们把"时间"当敌人来测。** 回拨/前跳/DST/崩溃窗口的时钟乱序 fuzz + 实装×模型差分测试全部公开可复现，并且真的抓到过潜伏 bug。

3. **We publish our honest boundaries.** at-least-once is not exactly-once — it says so in the README. The Windows CI environment can't exercise the ACL sandbox (admin runner) — that's disclosed too, and the fail-closed protocol is asserted instead. **我们公开诚实边界。** at-least-once 不是 exactly-once、Windows CI 管理员环境测不了 ACL 沙箱——都写进 README。

## Audit welcome / 欢迎审计

The experiments behind every claim live in each repo's `EXPERIMENTS.md`. 每个声称背后的实验数据都在各仓库的 EXPERIMENTS.md 里。

Questions, porting notes, and adversarial testing are all welcome. 欢迎提问、挑毛病、上手攻击测试。

discussions.title: [Bug][Windows] dsh web 在 PowerShell 5.1 中 Ctrl+C 退出后控制台失去输入：提示符不出现、打字无回显
discussions.body: ### 环境 - Windows 11 24H2（build 26100） - Windows PowerShell 5.1.26100.9168（自带 PSReadLine 2.0.0） - Node.js v24.18.1 - dsh 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装 @deepseek-ai/dsh） ### 复现步骤 1. 在 PowerShell 5.1 窗口运行 `dsh web`，浏览器打开 Web UI 2. 多次关闭并重新打开 Web UI（浏览器标签页） 3. 回到终端按 `Ctrl+C` 停止 dsh 4. dsh 进程能被终止（第一次按后约 1~5 秒退出；若期间再按一次则立即退出）， 但随后 PowerShell 控制台失去输入能力：提示符不再出现、打字无回显、 任何命令都无法执行，只能关闭窗口重开 ### 预期行为 Ctrl+C 后 dsh 正常退出，PowerShell 恢复提示符，可继续输入命令 ### 实际行为 控制台输入失效（提示符不出现、打字无回显），需重开窗口 ### 根因分析（已定位到代码，供参考） 从安装包 `lib/profile-boot-DG5t9aNs.js`（源码 region：`lib/types/profile-boot.js` / `lib/types/process-shutdown.js`）看： 1. 启动流程注册了 `process.on("SIGINT", () => interrupt(130))`； 2. Windows 上 Node 的控制台 ctrl handler 在进程存在 SIGINT 监听器时对 `CTRL_C_EVENT` 返回"已处理"，事件被 dsh 吞掉——PowerShell 收不到这次 Ctrl+C； 3. 处理器不立即退出：`createProcessShutdown` 的 `interrupt` 走优雅关闭， `PROCESS_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5e3` 最多等 5 秒才 `process.exit(130)`； 期间再次 Ctrl+C 会走 `forceExitOnce` 强杀分支； 4. PowerShell 5.1 + PSReadLine 2.0.0 与"吞掉 Ctrl+C 且延迟退出"的原生程序交互后， PSReadLine 的输入状态机错乱（提示符不重绘、按键不处理、无回显）； 5. 多次关闭/重开 Web UI 会创建销毁多个会话，拖慢 dispose，退出被推向 5 秒上限， 更容易触发第二次 Ctrl+C 强杀——与"多次开关后更容易复现"的现象吻合。 ### 建议修复方向 1. win32 下 SIGINT 时立即退出：跳过或极短化优雅关闭（如 ≤300ms）， 与 vite/npm 等 Windows 友好的 CLI 行为对齐； 2. 退出前显式恢复控制台输入模式（GetConsoleMode/SetConsoleMode on STD_INPUT_HANDLE）； 3. 或 win32 下不注册 SIGINT 监听器，让系统默认终止生效，最小清理移到 `process.on('exit')`。 ### 临时规避（供其他用户参考） - Ctrl+C 只按一次并等待（第二次会触发强杀路径，更容易坏状态）； - 用 `Start-Process dsh -ArgumentList 'web'` 在独立窗口运行，主 shell 不受影响； - 升级 PSReadLine（`Install-Module PSReadLine -Force`）或换 PowerShell 7 可规避。

discussions.title: Idea: search and bulk selection for the "Fetch available models" picker
discussions.body: Providers can advertise 50+ models today (the CommandCode provider lists 55), which makes the current plain checkbox list in "Fetch available models" tedious to work with: finding one model means scrolling, and picking a handful means unchecking dozens of rows. I prototyped the following improvements for the shared model picker (`ModelListEditor`): - Live search box (filter by id/name, autofocus on open, Esc clears, clear button) - Bulk selection: tri-state "Select all" master checkbox (acts on the filtered rows when a search is active), a "Clear selection" button, and Cmd/Ctrl+A - Live counters: "Selected n of total" and "Showing n of total" while filtering - "Add selected (n)" with the count, disabled at zero picks - Styled rows with a visible selected state, focus management, aria-live counters, and `prefers-reduced-motion` support Selection actions apply to the visible (filtered) rows, so "select all" after searching "gemini" picks exactly the Geminis. I have a working branch with these changes if the team would like to take a look or adopt them.

discussions.title: 分享插件：dsh-clawrouter —— 危险命令执行前，先让一个更强的模型审一遍（零 API key，x402 按次付费）
discussions.body:
DeepSeek 快又便宜，主循环留给它。这个插件补的是它做不到的那件事：**agent 提出 `rm -rf ~` 的时候，让一个更强的模型先读一遍，再决定放行 / 拒绝 / 问你**——判决由真正的 tool executor 执行，不是 prompt 里写一句「请小心」。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-clawrouter
```

## 1. 危险命令审查闸门（默认关闭，`enabled: true` 打开）

- **日常操作触发率 0/59** —— 连只是「提到」危险命令的都不触发：`grep -rn "rm -rf" docs/`、`echo "DROP TABLE" >> notes.md`
- **危险命令 39/39 全拦下** —— git、容器、集群、云存储、数据库、主机状态
- 也拦「以后才执行」的文件写入：git hooks、CI workflow、`.bashrc`、`.gitconfig`、npm `postinstall`。这类比 `rm -rf` 安静得多，也因此更糟——你盯着屏幕等破坏，结果什么都没发生，下次 commit 才发生
- **抗绕过**：`\rm -rf /`、`command rm`、`env rm`、`eval "rm -rf $DIR"`、`bash -c "…"`、`| xargs rm`，以及管进 shell 的 heredoc
- **它只会收紧，不会放宽**：审查放行的调用照样要过你原有的 sandbox、权限和审批；审查模型联系不上时默认升级给你，绝不默默放行
- 两份语料（39 条危险 + 59 条日常）都是测试。哪天新规则开始拦 `npm test`，挂的是 CI，不是你的会话

## 2. BlockRun provider 路由

67 个模型一个钱包直连：没有账号、没有 API key、没有信用卡，按次用 USDC 走 [x402](https://x402.org) 付费。审查模型默认 `anthropic/claude-opus-5`——让 Claude 审 DeepSeek 干的活。挂上路由**不会**改你的默认模型，`dsh-base` 还是 deepseek-official，只在你指名的地方用。

## 另外三个命令

- `/review` —— 让审查模型看一份 diff、一个计划或一个结论
- `/spend` —— 这个会话在这条路由上花了多少
- `/gate drill` —— 打一发假的危险命令，确认闸门真的活着（而不是配错了在装死）

MIT，TypeScript，仓库和文档（含中文 README）：https://github.com/BlockRunAI/dsh-clawrouter
npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-clawrouter

规则误报、漏报，或者想加自己的 `extraRules`，都欢迎开 issue。

discussions.title: Session log corruption from concurrent writers — 'corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region'
discussions.body:
## Symptom

A session that previously loaded fine starts failing to open with:

```
history unavailable for session "<id>": Error: corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 2401 (expected 34843, got 34841)（internal）
```

The error comes from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl`'s reader, which requires the decoded event stream to be strictly contiguous (`events[i].seq === i`). Once this fires, the whole session becomes unreadable — in every client (web UI, desktop wrappers) because they all read the same file under `DSH_HOME`.

## Root cause: concurrent writers on one session log

The JSONL backend documents **"One live writer per session"** — append coordination exists only inside a single process. The file format assumes it: each append batch is a compressed frame appended at the writer's cached EOF offset, and packed chunk rows carry a `seq0` cursor computed from that writer's in-memory view.

When **two `dsh` server processes share one `DSH_HOME`** (e.g. a desktop wrapper spawning its own server while another server already serves the same data root, or two `dsh web` processes in different terminals), the second writer's cursor is stale. Its next batch lands at an offset that overlaps the first writer's already-written rows. The result is not a torn frame (crash recovery handles those) but a **structurally valid file with overlapping sequences** — exactly what the committed-region check rejects.

Decoded rows at the corruption point (real capture):

```
行2399  packed  assistant/chunk  seq 34817..34840   ← both writers agree
行2400  raw     step/end         seq 34841         ← writer A: turn closed
行2401  raw     turn/end         seq 34842         ← writer A
行2402  packed  assistant/chunk  seq 34841..34855  ← writer B: stale seq0=34841, overlaps A
行2403+ raw     assistant/chunk  seq 34856..37143  ← writer B's complete continuation
```

The stale `seq0` (off by exactly the two rows writer A appended) is the signature of the race.

This is **not specific to any desktop wrapper**: two plain `dsh web` instances on the same `DSH_HOME` can produce it identically. The persistence layer simply has no cross-process defense.

## Detection (read-only scanner)

The scanner below uses the runtime's own decoder to verify every session log. It never modifies anything; run it periodically to catch corruption before a session refuses to open.

```bash
#!/bin/bash
# dsh-session-scan.sh — verify seq contiguity of every session under DSH_HOME (read-only)
set -euo pipefail
DSH_HOME_DIR="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
RUNTIME="${DSH_RUNTIME_DIR:-/Applications/DeepSeek Harness.app/Contents/Resources/runtime}" # dsh runtime dir containing node + node_modules
ZSTD_BIN="${ZSTD_BIN:-$(command -v zstd || echo /opt/homebrew/bin/zstd)}"
DECODER="$RUNTIME/dsh-session-scan-decoder.mjs"
cat > "$DECODER" <<'DECODER_EOF'
import { decodeStorageRecord } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session';
let text = '';
process.stdin.on('data', (c) => { text += c.toString('utf8'); });
process.stdin.on('end', () => {
  const lines = text.split('\n').filter((l) => l.trim());
  let events = 0; let issue = null;
  for (const [i, line] of lines.entries()) {
    if (i === 0) continue;
    let decoded;
    try { decoded = decodeStorageRecord(JSON.parse(line)); }
    catch (e) { issue = `line ${i + 1} decode failed: ${e.message}`; break; }
    for (const ev of decoded) {
      if (ev.seq !== events) { issue = `line ${i + 1} expected seq=${events} got=${ev.seq}`; break; }
      events++;
    }
    if (issue) break;
  }
  console.log(issue ? `✗ ${process.argv[2]}  ${issue}` : `✓ ${process.argv[2]}  ${events} events / ${lines.length - 1} rows`);
});
DECODER_EOF
trap 'rm -f "$DECODER"' EXIT
while IFS= read -r -d '' f; do
  sid=$(basename "$(dirname "$f")")
  "$ZSTD_BIN" -dc "$f" 2>/dev/null | "$RUNTIME/node" "$DECODER" "$sid"
done < <(find "$DSH_HOME_DIR/sessions" -name 'session.jsonl.zstd' -print0)
```

## Manual repair (backup first!)

If the corruption is the overlap shape above (a batch with a stale `seq0` overlapping a few rows the other writer already wrote), the history is often **fully recoverable** by removing the stale rows so the stream becomes contiguous again. In the capture above, deleting writer A's two stale closing rows (2400–2401) made the entire log — all 37,144 events — load again with **zero content loss** (A's rows were a premature duplicate close; B's continuation was the real history).

Procedure used (macOS, `zstd` CLI):

```bash
# 0. Back up
cp session.jsonl.zstd session.jsonl.zstd.bak-$(date +%Y%m%d-%H%M%S)

# 1. Decompress, remove the overlapping rows, re-encode as header frame + body frame
zstd -dc session.jsonl.zstd > /tmp/session.jsonl
sed -i '' '2400,2401d' /tmp/session.jsonl          # adjust to YOUR line numbers
head -1 /tmp/session.jsonl | zstd -q -c > session.jsonl.zstd.new
tail -n +2 /tmp/session.jsonl | zstd -q -c >> session.jsonl.zstd.new

# 2. Verify with the decoder above (must report ✓ and an event count)
zstd -dc session.jsonl.zstd.new | node decode.mjs

# 3. Replace
mv session.jsonl.zstd.new session.jsonl.zstd
```

Do **not** attempt this without understanding the exact rows involved — dump the decoded rows first (`seq0`/`seq` per row around the reported line) and only remove rows that overlap. Keep the backup until the session opens correctly in the UI.

## Request

Please consider hardening the persistence layer against concurrent writers, any of which would have prevented this class of corruption:

1. **A lock file per `DSH_HOME`** (e.g. `DSH_HOME/.lock` holding pid + port, taken at server start) with a clear error instead of a silent second writer;
2. **`O_APPEND`-style writes** so a stale-cursor append can never overwrite a newer batch;
3. **Re-validating the tail seq at append time** (re-read the last committed seq from disk before writing a batch), turning the stale-cursor race into a loud failure instead of silent overlap.

Thanks for the great work on DSH — happy to provide the full corrupted-file capture or help test a fix.

discussions.title: 自动开发流水线插件 — dsh-devflow
discussions.body:
# dsh-devflow — 自动开发流水线插件：需求池 → 精炼 → 设计/计划/评审 → 实施 → 验证 → 合并 → 报告

## 一句话

把「批量丢粗浅需求/bug → 插件后台自动完成需求精炼、设计、计划、评审修订 → 实施与 Web 验证与合并回 main 全自动 → 出开发报告」整条流水线跑在 DeepSeek Harness 里：需求池按项目隔离、多项目并行、每阶段可配独立模型，你只在真正需要人拍板的地方出手。

## 为什么做这个

DSH 的会话模型很适合「一次性任务」，但真实的需求管理是持续流：需求零散、质量参差、有些要等人决策、有些可以全自动走完。我想要一个生产者-消费者结构——

- **生产者**：Web 面板的需求池入口，随手丢一句「星动态需要搜索框」这种粗浅描述
- **消费者**：宿主侧后台状态机，2 秒一拍自动推进一切可自动的阶段

## 流水线全貌

```
需求池 → [自动] 批量精炼+评分+规模评估 → [自动] 择优
  → [自动] 设计 → [自动] 计划 → [自动] 评审&修订循环 (≤3轮, 提前全清则提前退出)
  → [会话泵] 实施 → [自动] 代码评审&修复循环 (≤3轮)
  → [会话泵] playwright-cli Web 验证 → [会话泵] 集成分支合并回 main
  → [自动] 开发报告 ✓
```

两条设计原则：

1. **决策默认自动化**：提示词强制模型按项目规范（YAGNI/外科手术修改/遵循约定）自动决策并记录理由；只有不可逆、依赖外部系统、或与规范冲突的才生成用户问题。
2. **每个可能阻塞的阶段都有等待队列**：不完整需求 →「待补充」队列；设计/计划/评审/实施中的用户决策 → 各自等待队列。全部上下文持久化在 `<root>/.devflow/`，答完自动续跑，进程重启不丢。

## 多项目隔离（零配置，v0.2.0 起）

每个项目是一个完全独立的分区：自己的需求池、`.devflow/` 状态、提示词、状态机节拍与主工作区/worktree 配额——项目之间互不阻塞、并行推进。

- **自动发现**：插件自动扫描 `root` 下带项目标记（`.git` / `package.json` / `go.mod` 等）的文件夹；`root` 自身是单仓库时视为一个项目，是项目集合目录时扫两级（`~/projects/group/repo` 也认）
- **侧边栏菜单管理**：左下角「开发流水线」入口点击展开项目二级菜单——项目列表（当前项带 ✓）点选即切换并进入该项目工作台；底部「添加项目」（与 harness 工作区文件夹添加按钮同款图标）打开管理弹窗，可接入工作区外任意目录——系统目录选择器 / 应用内目录浏览 / 直接粘贴路径，可移除可恢复；行尾齿轮打开「流水线设置」弹窗
- **自动路由**：需求 id 内嵌项目 key（`<key>-rN`），面板操作与会话泵回填都据此路由到所属项目，泵任务携带 `project` / `projectRoot`

## 并发与工作区分级（小需求不上 worktree）

精炼阶段评估实施规模并路由：

| 规模 | 路由 | 并发 |
|---|---|---|
| 小（≤3 文件单模块） | 主工作区直接开发（遵循「小改动直接改 main」） | 1，被占用则排队阻塞 |
| 中/大（跨模块/迁移） | worktree `.worktrees/devflow-rN` + 分支 `devflow/rN` | 2 |

多活流水线上限 3。verify 通过后，worktree 任务走 **merge 泵任务**：从 main 拉集成分支 `devflow/rN-merge` → 合并功能分支 → 在集成分支解决所有冲突并跑检查 → 回并 main → 清理 worktree。

## 自动泵：工具阶段全自动（v0.3.0 起）

实施、修复、playwright 验证、git 合并这些工具阶段不再需要人守着会话接单：插件宿主自己为每个任务派生一个一次性 **root agent**（全新上下文、失败隔离、天然可重试），喂给它 `devflow` 工具契约让它「next → 干活 → report」，全局并发有预算控制。代理遇到需要人拍板的问题时，经标准问答通道直达 Web GUI（侧边栏亮起），你答完流水线自动续跑——**从丢需求到出报告全程无人值守**。

架构边界说明：没有用 `ctx.subagents`——子代理组合在父会话的发起者作用域内会成为 runtime-owned，其提问会被以 `DELEGATED_CALLER` 拒绝（没有人类应答者）；从插件自己的后台 fiber 派生则发布为运行时 root agent，提问到达方式与你手开的会话完全一致。

不想要全自动？流水线设置弹窗（侧边栏行尾齿轮）可关自动泵，退回手动接单模式（会话里循环调 `devflow next` / `devflow report`）。

## 阶段级模型配置（v0.3.0 起）

「流水线设置」弹窗（左栏分区导航 + 右侧配置项，同 harness 设置弹窗布局）：精炼/设计/计划/评审/代码评审/报告六个 LLM 阶段可各自指定模型，候选**只读**自 harness 已配置模型（插件零凭据、不自建注册表——字段经显式白名单映射，`apiKey`/`baseUrl` 类字段物理进不了下发通道）。未配置回退 harness 当前模型；配置的模型被移除时运行时回退并标记「已漂移」。每次调用的模型解析写入需求日志可追溯。持久化在 `<root>/.devflow/settings.json`，保存即生效，删除即重置。

## 会话泵：自动阶段与工具阶段的边界

纯 LLM 文本阶段（精炼/设计/计划/评审/报告）由插件后台直调 `llm.stream` 完成，不占用会话。工具阶段（实施/修复/验证/合并）由自动泵派生的 root agent 执行（见上节）；关闭自动泵时退回手动模式——插件注册的 `devflow` 模型工具（`next` / `report`）由你在任意会话里循环调用。

## 面板功能（入口与设置经 v0.4.0 重构）

- 入口集中在侧边栏「开发流水线」行：项目二级菜单（切换 / 添加项目）+ 行尾齿轮（流水线设置弹窗），徽标统计所有项目的待决策总数；工作台头部只读展示当前项目
- 需求池入口（需求/bug 切换）+ 五个分区：流水线进行中 / 等待队列 / 已暂停 / 需求池 / 已完成
- 等待队列的问题直接在卡片上作答（选项 + 推荐 ⭐ + 补充文本），答完自动续跑；自动泵代理的提问同样直达这里
- **真暂停**：「中断」按钮经 AbortSignal 真正打断进行中的模型调用，进入暂停态不会被自动重跑，「继续」从断点阶段恢复（已完成的设计/计划/评审全部保留）
- 执行中可见性：脉动徽章（▶ 正在生成设计文档 / 评审设计/计划 第N轮 / 代码评审中… / 自动泵执行中）+ 每条需求限长日志（上限 40 条自动丢最旧）+ 状态栏自动泵并发计数
- 自适应轮询：工作台打开时 1.5s 一拍保实时，收起后降到 10s 只养徽标（请求量约 1/7）
- 流水线设置弹窗（齿轮打开，左栏导航）：「阶段模型 / 自动泵」+「阶段提示词」两个分区——每阶段提示词按项目隔离，9 个阶段各有带变量占位（`{{repo}}` `{{requirement}}`…）的默认模板，可改可恢复默认，持久化热生效
- 产物查看：设计/计划/评审记录/开发报告一键弹出

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-devflow
```

如需覆盖默认配置（`root` 默认取 `dsh web` 的启动目录），在你的 profile patch 层（`~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`）：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: devflow
      name: dsh-devflow
      config:
        root: /path/to/your/projects   # 项目发现从这里扫描
        # maxActive: 3        # 单项目并发流水线上限
        # maxWorktrees: 2     # 单项目 worktree 并发上限
        # logCap: 40          # 每条需求日志上限
        # tickIntervalMs: 2000
```

## 技术形态

- 双面包：宿主 `TypertRemoteService`（状态机 + Remotes）+ 浏览器面板挂 `shell.overlay`
- 面板 ↔ 宿主走 Typert 生成的 Remote 命名空间；模型工具用 `dsh-tools` 的 `defineTool`
- 状态全量持久化为 `.devflow/state.json`（含每阶段的全部上下文与用户答复），产物落盘 `artifacts/` `reports/`

仓库：H97y/dsh-devflow（topic: `dsh-plugin`）。目前依赖 npm 上的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-*` rc 版本与本地 harness checkout 双轨迭代，欢迎交流流水线策略与提示词设计。

discussions.title: web: frontend data layer never starts when served under a non-loopback origin (LAN IP / domain)
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 通过反向代理以**非 localhost 地址**（如局域网 IP `http://192.168.31.234:4096` 或公网域名）访问时，前端**数据层静默不启动**：

- 侧边栏显示「暂无会话」，卡在「选择工作区」引导界面；
- **`host.describe` 从未发出**（`connection.start()` 就绪握手缺失）；
- **`/api/events.mux`、`/api/events.host` WebSocket 从未建立**；
- `session.list` / `workspace.list` 等业务 API 全部未发出；
- **无任何 console 错误**、主线程空闲（异步等待挂起，非死循环）；
- cordis 插件 client.js 全部加载完成，`dynamicCordisRunner/inventory` 正常返回，但激活在 runtime 服务（`connection.start`）之前中止。

以 `http://localhost:4096` 或 `http://127.0.0.1:4096`（loopback）访问**同一代理、同一 DSH 服务、同一浏览器**时**完全正常**：自动选择工作区、会话列表加载、会话恢复。

## 复现步骤

1. 让 DSH web（`dsh web`，默认 `127.0.0.1:3080`）通过任意反向代理暴露为：
   - 正常：`http://127.0.0.1:4096/`
   - 异常：`http://<本机局域网IP>:4096/`（如 `http://192.168.31.234:4096/`）
2. 用 Chrome 打开异常地址（全新 profile 亦可复现），打开 DevTools → Network：
   - 观察：插件 JS 全部加载，但 `host.describe` 与 `events.mux`/`events.host` WebSocket **不出现**；
   - 页面停留在「选择工作区 / 暂无会话」。
3. 对比打开正常地址：`host.describe` 与两条 WebSocket 正常建立，应用完整启动。

## 期望行为

- 非 localhost 地址访问时，前端应完整启动（与 loopback 一致）；若为有意限制，应给出明确降级提示，而非静默空转。
- DSH CLI 已提供 `--trusted-host`（声明远程 authority），浏览器端应相应放行该 authority 的前端数据层。

## 排查补充（供参考）

- 代理侧已改写请求 `Host` 与 `Origin` 至 loopback 目标，`/api` Host fence、特权方法（`settings.describe` 等）、SSE（`/plugins/events`）、WebSocket 全部手动验证可达且通过；
- 差异仅在浏览器 `location.hostname`（loopback vs 非 loopback）；
- 尝试在页面早期覆盖 `location.hostname` 无效（属性不可重定义）；
- `connection.isLoopback`（`isLoopbackHostname(location.hostname)`）在非 loopback 下为 `false`，其使用方（settings 存 memory、文件打开、deliverables）均为功能降级，未见阻止启动的分支；
- 建议在 `dsh-cordis-client-runner` 的激活流程（`dynamicCordisRunner/inventory` 之后）增加错误日志，定位非 loopback 下中断的异步步骤。

## 环境

- DSH 版本：`dsh web`（rev 见页面 `__DSH_BOOT__`）
- 浏览器：Chrome 151（主实例与独立 profile 均复现）
- 系统：macOS

---
目的是通过代理服务支持手机访问DSH

discussions.title: [Bug] 极简模式 (minimal preset) 在 Windows 开发环境没有命令执行通道（persistent bash 因 subprocess-local win32 限制不可用）
discussions.body:
**现象（Symptom）**

Windows 开发环境下，Web GUI 新建会话选择「极简模式」（minimal preset）后，会话内**没有可用的命令执行通道**：模型侧没有任何能正常工作的 shell/命令工具（persistent bash 起不来），只剩文件编辑（str_replace_editor），无法执行任何命令。

**环境（Environment）**

- OS: Windows（本机实测，PowerShell 5.1.26100，PATH 中无 bash）
- DSH 版本: 0.1.0-rc.6（`npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动 Web GUI）
- 预设: 极简模式（Web 会话，默认权限 workspace-write）

**复现步骤（Steps to reproduce）**

1. `npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 启动 DSH
2. Web GUI 新建会话，选择「极简模式」
3. 尝试执行任何命令 → 没有可用的命令执行通道；会话实际只剩 str_replace_editor

**根因定位（root cause，基于本机 rc.6 实际安装代码）**

1. 极简预设固定只对外提供持久 bash + str_replace_editor（`apps/cli/config/agent-presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml`），持久 bash 依赖 PTY 后端（`dsh-terminal` / `dsh-subprocess-local`），**未按平台区分**；对比 standard 预设是按平台挂 bash/pwsh 的。
2. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local` 的 `createProcessInspector` 只实现了 linux/darwin 分支，win32 直接抛错（本机 `lib/index.js:298`）：
   `throw new Error("subprocess-local: terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32")`
   → Windows 上持久 shell（以及依赖它的极简模式）整体不可用。
3. 即使绕过 PTY，`dsh-bash-local` 也硬编码从 PATH 找 `bash`，Windows 默认没有。
4. 结果：Windows 上开启极简模式后，会话没有任何可用的命令执行通道，且用户侧没有明确提示（只有底层抛错，GUI 里表现为"没有命令工具"）。

**建议（Suggestion）**

- 参考 #1889 已提交的 win32 ProcessInspector 参考实现（MIT，含 taskkill / ConPTY 方案）为 core 补上 win32 支持；或
- 极简预设按平台回退：Windows 上改用 pwsh（rc.6 已内置 `dsh-pwsh-local` / `dsh-tool-pwsh`，standard 模式即如此）；或
- 至少在 UI 明确提示「极简模式暂不支持 Windows 命令执行」，并给出替代方案（standard 模式或第三方插件）。

**相关讨论（Related）**

- #2066 — Windows 极简模式运行 Shell 工具报错（同一根因，症状为运行时报错）
- #1889 — 给 subprocess-local 补 win32 ProcessInspector 的建议 + 参考实现
- #1832 / #2045 / #1951 — 第三方 Windows 极简模式插件（workaround）

discussions.title: [Bug/Feature] Task list does not update while tasks are running — no mid-run push, subagent list is pull-only
discussions.body:
## Environment
- dsh v0.1.0-rc.5 (developer preview, source build, master @ 47f9438)
- Web UI served over HTTPS via nginx reverse proxy; observed from mobile + desktop

## Bug
The task list (session header background jobs + sidebar subagent list) **freezes at the state it had when the first task was created** while tasks are running. It only catches up after a task settles or after a page refresh. No real-time progress / status changes are visible during execution.

## Root cause (from source)

**1. `session/jobs` frames are only pushed on lifecycle events — never mid-run.**

In `packages/jobs/jobs-local/src/index.ts`, `notifyChanged(job.owner)` is called only at:
- job creation (line 188)
- `kill()` (line 226)
- `settle()` — completion/failure (line 428)
- dispose/teardown (lines 474/495/524)

`job.detail` is only assigned in `settle()` (line 419); during `running` it stays `undefined`. There is no progress event and no periodic snapshot. The frontend `JobListAction.tsx` only refreshes from `session/jobs` frames (plus a local 1s clock for elapsed time), so the UI stays frozen at the creation-time state for the whole run.

**2. Sidebar subagent list is pull-only.**

In `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/manager.ts`, `refreshSubagents()` is invoked only on session selection / subagent selection (lines 200, 218). There is no push frame for subagent status in api-proxy, so the list does not refresh while work is in progress.

## Expected
- Live updates while a task is running: e.g. periodic `session/jobs` snapshots during long-running jobs, or a `detail`/progress update event from the jobs seam.
- Subagent list should refresh in near-real-time (push or poll while a parent session is active).

## Impact
For long-running tasks (multi-minute bash / agent work), remote users (mobile) cannot see any progress; the UI appears stuck until the task settles or the page is reloaded.

discussions.title: DSH-Portable — a movable desktop build for Windows, macOS, and Linux
discussions.body:
Hi, I built DSH-Portable because I wanted to move a working DSH setup between machines without rebuilding the environment each time.

![DSH-Portable English interface](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/main/assets/dsh-interface-en.png)

It packages the official DSH preview into a native desktop distribution while keeping the portable data folder intact:

- Windows: small bootstrap, complete offline ZIP, and installer
- macOS: portable ZIP and DMG for Apple Silicon and Intel
- Linux: AppImage and complete portable folder for x64 and ARM64
- native desktop window and tray; startup does not open an external browser
- sessions, settings, plugins, and workspace move with the portable folder
- bundled `dsh` plugin command, so third-party plugins work without a system Node/pnpm setup
- verified in-place updates with rollback; update prompts show the DSH-Portable version separately from the bundled official DSH version

The current release is DSH-Portable 0.2.1 and bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6`. This is an unofficial community distribution, not an official DSH desktop release.

Repository: https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable

Downloads: https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/latest

I would especially appreciate feedback on first launch, moving the folder between machines, plugin management, and in-place updates.

---

我做 DSH-Portable，是因为希望把已经配置好的 DSH 连同会话、设置、插件和工作区一起移动，而不是每换一台电脑就重新搭环境。

目前提供 Windows、macOS 和 Linux 的便携版与常用安装包；使用原生桌面窗口和托盘，启动时不会拉起外部浏览器。更新会保留用户数据，并把 DSH-Portable 版本与内置官方 DSH 版本分开显示。

当前正式版为 DSH-Portable 0.2.1，内置 `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6`。欢迎反馈首次启动、目录迁移、插件管理和原地更新体验。

- 0 existing dictionary key/value changed; only new keys added
- Full test suite 3761 passing; locale + ui-trajectory 150 passed

Unofficial personal fork. Feedback is always welcome!

discussions.title: V4-Flash-0731 在正确诊断后仍持续探索，而不进入代码编辑
discussions.body:
大家好，我最近在使用 DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731 + DeepSeek Harness 跑一些 SWE 类型的真实编码任务时，反复观察到一个比较明显的现象。

模型往往已经：

- 找到正确的文件 / 函数
- 判断出正确根因
- 甚至已经说出了最小修改方案

但它并不会马上进入 `edit（编辑）`，而是继续执行：

- `read`
- `grep`
- `bash`
- Git 历史查询
- CHANGELOG 查询
- 额外推理和验证

最后有时会一直调查到请求次数或 Token 预算耗尽，仍然没有真正修改代码。

我暂时把这个现象叫做：

Post-Diagnosis Exploration Loop（诊断后探索循环）**

或者：

Diagnosis-to-Action Gap（诊断到行动间隙）**

这里说的不是文本重复，也不是 Tool Call（工具调用）格式出错。

工具调用本身都是正常的，问题主要是：

模型已经知道答案了，但似乎很难从“继续调查”切换到“开始修改”。

## 一个受控实验

任务：`pytest-pr-10356`

我使用了相同的：

- 任务 Prompt
- DeepSeek-V4-Flash-0731
- Reasoning Level（推理等级）
- 代码起点
- `standard-offline` Agent Preset（智能体预设）

只改变提供给 Agent 的额外上下文。

结果：

| 条件 | 首次出现正确诊断 | 最终是否编辑 |
|---|---:|---:|
| 无额外 Memory | 第 10 个响应 | 否 |
| Full Memory Context | 第 7 个响应 | 否 |
| Progressive Memory Context | 第 5 个响应 | 否 |

三组最后的 Patch（补丁）全部为空。

工具调用情况：

- 无 Memory：`read×7 / grep×6 / bash×3`
- Full Memory：`read×5 / grep×3 / bash×2 / glob×1`
- Progressive Memory：`read×8 / grep×4 / bash×1`

三组都是：

edit = 0**

这里比较有意思的一点是：

额外上下文确实让模型更早找到了正确答案：

`第 10 步 → 第 7 步 → 第 5 步`

但是节省下来的步骤并没有转化成更早的代码修改，反而继续被用于额外调查。

我在其他任务里也观察到类似情况：

模型已经明确说出了正确根因和合理的最小修改方向，但之后仍继续查询 Git 历史、CHANGELOG、源码和其他信息，最终没有进入编辑。

 想请教几个问题

1. 这是目前 `standard-offline` Agent Loop（智能体循环）的预期行为吗？

2. DSH 目前是否存在类似：

   `探索 → 诊断 → 编辑 → 测试`

   这样的显式 Progress State（进度状态），还是完全由模型自己判断什么时候应该进入下一阶段？

3. 官方 Benchmark 中使用的 `minimal mode（最小模式）`，在这方面是否会和 `standard-offline` 有明显不同？

4. 对于 V4-Flash-0731，目前是否有推荐的 DSH Preset（预设）或配置，可以减少“已经诊断正确但仍继续调查”的情况？

5. 其他人有没有观察到类似现象？

我个人感觉直接规定：

> “调用 N 次工具以后必须开始编辑”

可能不是一个很好的方案。

因为不同任务得到正确诊断所需的步骤差别很大。

我更想了解的是：

DSH 是否已经注意到这种 Diagnosis → Action（诊断到行动）之间的转换问题，以及是否有更通用的 Stop / Progress Policy（停止 / 进度策略）设计。

感谢！

discussions.title: 提议:把插件文件拖入对话的拖拽 MIME(application/x-dsh-path)收为壳级契约
discussions.body:
来源:[dsh-compass](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass) 的实现经验 + 上游 master 代码对照,发布帖在 #1989。

## 现状

上游 master 的 `ui-conversation` InputBar 已经有一套 document 级文件接收(`Files` 类型,图片附件)。但插件提供的文件面(文件树、搜索结果、桌面包)拖出的文件不走 OS 通道——以 [dsh-compass](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass) 为例,面板文件行的 HTML5 dragstart 写入自定义 MIME `application/x-dsh-path`,值是宿主侧绝对路径(浏览器不见字节):

```ts
event.dataTransfer.setData("application/x-dsh-path", entry.path)
event.dataTransfer.effectAllowed = "copy"
```

上游 composer 不认这个类型,这类拖放落空。插件侧目前只能各自兜底:compass v0.14 加了 window 冒泡级的降级接收器,把路径句追加进 composer 草稿(`insertText`),模型用工具处理路径——能用,但比不上壳级 intake 能做的事(图片直接附加)。

## 提议

把 `application/x-dsh-path` 收为壳契约,在 InputBar 的 document 级 drop intake 里加一个先于 `Files` 分支的自定义 MIME 分支:

1. `dataTransfer.types` 含该 MIME 且值为非空路径 → 按路径引用处理;
2. 有图片能力(`addImages` 在场)时,经宿主的有界读取路由取字节、按魔数验型、`File` 构造后走现有 `intakeImages`;失败或无能力降级为路径句(现有 appendSentence 语义);
3. 该类型永不与 `Files` 同时出现(插件拖不带浏览器字节),分支先后无歧义。

fork 里已有完整参考实现(`ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx` 的 `intakePanelPath` + document 级 `PANEL_PATH_MIME` 处理),可以按需整理成对上游的 PR。

## 为什么收为壳契约而不是留给各插件

- 拖入对话是 composer 的领地,插件不应各自往 textarea 写字;一次上游实现,所有提供文件面的插件同时受益;
- 降级语义(路径句 vs 图片附加)由壳统一决定,行为可预期;
- 已有插件接收器可以无冲突让位:HTML5 派发顺序保证 window 冒泡监听在任何 document 级壳 handler 之后运行,`defaultPrevented` 即"壳已认领"探针——compass 的降级接收器就是这么和未来的上游实现共存的,上游采纳当天插件自动退到只读。

## 契约细节建议

- MIME 名:`application/x-dsh-path`(单值、绝对宿主路径、无参数);
- `effectAllowed: copy`;接收方 `dropEffect: copy`;
- 值为空字符串视为无效,落回默认行为;
- 多文件拖拽后续可用多行约定扩展,首版单路径即可。

如果方向认可,我可以把 fork 的实现整理成针对 `ui-conversation` 的 PR。

discussions.title: 🐳 你这个月是小鱼苗还是蓝鲸？whale-meter：DSH 用量段位 + 46 模型精准计价 + 今天涨价的新旧价对比
discussions.body:
今天新价目生效了（v4-flash 未命中输入 ¥1 → ¥3、输出 ¥2 → ¥9，空闲时段减半但仍高于此前平价）。我趁着这几天写了个用量插件，顺便把这笔账算清楚。

**dsh-whale-meter** —— 一行装上，会话头部多一个花费徽章，点开是完整账本。

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-whale-meter
```

用量类插件现在已经很多了，所以先说三件**别处还没有**的：

### 1. 消耗量段位

本月烧了多少 token → 🐟小鱼苗 / 🐠热带鱼 / 🐬海豚 / 🐋座头鲸 / 🐳蓝鲸，配一句有画面感的换算：「≈ 592 遍《三体》全集」。可以一键生成战绩卡片发出去。

分位是**本地算的**：分布曲线内置在仓库里（推导依据写在 `src/tier.data.ts`，欢迎质疑或用真实数据提 PR），UI 上如实标注「估算」——**不谎称全球排名**，因为插件零上报，我手上不可能有全球数据。

### 2. 多厂商精准计价，46 个模型

DeepSeek / Anthropic / OpenAI / Google / 智谱 GLM / 月之暗面 Kimi，逐项核对官方定价页。

重点是**国内厂商的分档计价**：GLM-5.1 输入 <32K 走 6 元、≥32K 走 8 元；GLM-4.7 还要再按输出长度细分三档。按每次调用的实际用量选档，不是估个大概。

### 3. 历史回填

装上之后自动把安装**之前**的会话补进账本（只读遍历 dsh 会话日志，不写回任何东西），不用从零开始攒数据。

---

关于今天这次调价：价目按「生效区间」组织，8-16 的账走旧价、8-17 的走新价，**历史账单不会被一刀切重算**。面板直接告诉你「同样的活，按旧价只要 X，现在多花 Y」。

刚才实测了一笔：涨价后第一次调用 ¥0.0163，按旧价本该是 ¥0.0108，差 51%。

### 几个实现上的细节，可能对写插件的朋友有参考价值

- **用量数据取自会话日志**：`assistant/chunk {type:'usage'}` 作权威记录，`assistant/message.usage` 在该 step 无 chunk 时兜底，按 `(sessionId, seq)` 精确去重。一开始用的是「每会话最大 seq」水位，后来发现挡不住「启动时 `load()` 与实时 `append()` 撞车」这条路径，改成了精确集合。
- **只存原始 tokens，不存金额** —— 价目表更新后历史账单自动按新表重算。
- **不依赖 `webServer`** —— 一开始把它写进了 `inject`，结果 headless / 一次性任务模式下插件根本不加载、一笔账都记不到。现在 Web API 只在 `webServer` 出现时经 `ctx.inject` 挂载，采集本身不依赖任何服务。
- **账本是多写者的** —— Web 实例、headless 任务、另一个终端里的 dsh 都往同一份 JSONL 追加。只认自己进程的事件流，面板会停在启动那一刻的读数（实测：磁盘 12 条时面板还显示 4 条）。现在按字节偏移增量读文件尾部，5 秒节流，带半行保护。
- **数据全在本机** `~/.dsh/whale-meter/*.jsonl`，无遥测。唯一的出网请求是你主动配 key 之后的余额查询。
- 采集器全程 try/catch 降级：电表不该把船弄沉。

MIT。价目表和分布曲线都是**单独的数据文件**，发现不对直接提 PR 就行——官方调价后，开启远程价目表的用户次日自动生效，不用等我发版。

Repo: https://github.com/Shiye-10Pages/dsh-whale-meter
npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-whale-meter

discussions.title: 提议:把注入上下文文档升格为壳级投影(与轨迹视图同构),并稳定 event-id 供跨视图联动
discussions.body:
来源:[dsh-compass](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-compass) 的实现经验 + 上游 master 代码对照。

## 一个观察

轨迹板块(ui-trajectory)是 dsh 投影哲学的完整体现:数据来自会话投影系统(`session.getSnapshot().views` + 壳的 `loadOlder()`),插件只注册五类渲染定义和一个 snapshot builder,自己不持有任何数据。

注入上下文文档(non-user 的 `user/message`,runtime 折成 `context` 节点)没有对等的投影出口。今天每个想要这块数据的插件都在自己过滤 durable log:compass 用插件自有的 `/dir/injected-docs` 路由做服务端过滤 + 客户端签名门控,实测在 18 万事件的会话上把每次激活约 120 MB 的历史页 JSON 降到 KB 级——能做,但这是每个插件各带一份投影代码的重复劳动。

## 提议

1. **把 injected-context documents 升格为壳级投影。** 两种形态任选:
   - 按 conversationViews 的 definition 注册制开放一类 context view(插件注册渲染,壳计算投影);或
   - 提供一个官方过滤投影 API(等价于 compass 那条路由的能力:按 source kind 过滤、只发文本块、带 compaction 边界)。
2. **稳定 event-id 契约,供跨视图联动。** 轨迹是"行为投影"(agent 做了什么),上下文是"状态投影"(模型此刻知道什么),两者读的是同一份 durable log。如果 seq/event-id 在视图间可互引,就能做"点轨迹某一步 → 该时刻的上下文快照"这类时间旅行式调试——这对长会话排障(为什么它忘了 X)是最直接的答案。

## 为什么值得收进壳

- 单一事实源已经是事实,差的是出口:投影逻辑留在插件侧意味着 fork/插件/未来第三方各算一遍,口径可能漂移;
- compass 的实测数据证明了过滤投影的量级收益(120 MB → KB 级/激活),值得上游一次性做对;
- 压缩边界(compaction checkpoint 的 seq)是两个视图共同关心的时间轴刻度,壳级出口是它成为公共契约的自然位置。

## 现成参考

- compass 的服务端过滤路由:`dsh-compass/src/directory-routes.ts`(`/dir/injected-docs`,有界、只读、失败即关闭);
- 客户端投影与签名门控:`dsh-compass/src/client/read-context.ts` + `docs-stream.ts`(仅在文档集合真正变化时重投影);
- runtime 已有的 provenance/form 读取器(`contextProvenance`/`contextForm`)就是投影口径的现成基础。

如果方向认可,可以先从最小的出口做起:把 compaction boundary + injected-docs 过滤读做成 runtime 客户端的一等 API,视图注册制作为第二步。

discussions.title: dsh-memoryos：给 DeepSeek Harness 加上跨 Session 的长期项目记忆
discussions.body:
大家好，我最近把 MemoryOS 对 DeepSeek Harness（DSH）的适配层单独拆成了一个插件项目：

## dsh-memoryos

dsh-memoryos 不是另一个“保存聊天记录”的 Memory 插件，它把 MemoryOS 的 Current Truth、Scope 隔离、冲突更新和 Minimum Sufficient Context 带到 DeepSeek Harness

dsh-memoryos 的优势不只是“让 Agent 记住东西”，而是让长期记忆变得可验证。我们用真实 DSH Agent 做 No-Memory 对照、跨 Session 硬重启、Scope 泄漏、旧事实替换、上下文淘汰恢复和精确 Token 成本测试，明确证明什么能记住、什么不该被召回，以及记忆到底付出了多少上下文成本。

它的目标很简单：

> **让 DeepSeek Harness 在不同 Session 之间保留真正有用的项目记忆，而不是每次重新从头理解项目。**

GitHub：

https://github.com/tianhao8687/dsh-memoryos

底层记忆系统：

https://github.com/tianhao8687/MemoryOS

---

## 它解决什么问题？

我在使用 Coding Agent 的过程中经常遇到这种情况：

Session A 里已经讨论过：

- 为什么选择 PostgreSQL
- 哪些旧兼容代码暂时不能删
- 某个方案之前为什么失败
- 当前项目有哪些约束
- 哪个决定后来已经被新决定替代

但到了新的 Session，Agent 又要重新读代码、重新搜索、重新推理。

`dsh-memoryos` 做的事情就是把这些长期项目信息接到 DSH。

它不是简单地把所有历史对话重新塞进 Context（上下文）。

而是：

```text
开发对话
   ↓
长期有效的项目事实 / 决策 / 约束
   ↓
MemoryOS 持久化
   ↓
Session 结束 / Agent 重启
   ↓
新的 DSH Session
   ↓
按当前 Repository / Task 检索
   ↓
只返回当前任务需要的少量记忆

discussions.title: agent-loop: `max-tokens` finish persists adapter replayState inconsistent with truncated content — session permanently bricked by `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`
discussions.body:
## Summary

When a model response is cut off at the output-token ceiling (`finish.reason.kind === 'max-tokens'`), the agent loop persists an assistant message whose `content` and `source.replayState` disagree. Every subsequent replay of that session then throws `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE` (`invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content`), and the session is **permanently unusable** without manually editing the zstd session log. Sessions forked from the poisoned one (e.g. via "new session" flows that copy records) inherit the poison.

Reproduced in production on `0.1.0-rc.5` and `0.1.0-rc.6`; the code is identical on `master` (verified at 47f9438).

## Root cause

Two components each behave "correctly" in isolation, but the loop composes them inconsistently:

1. `packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts` — `BlockAssembler.blocks()` deliberately **drops tool-call blocks on a `max-tokens` finish**, because a tool call truncated mid-arguments cannot be executed safely:

   ```ts
   blocks(): ContentBlock[] {
     const blocks = this.order.map(index => this.assemble(this.mustGet(index), index))
     return this.finish.kind === 'max-tokens'
       ? blocks.filter(block => block.type !== 'tool-call')
       : blocks
   }
   ```

2. `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai` (adapter) projects the **full** response — truncated tool call included — into `finish.replayState` (that is its job: lossless replay of complete responses).

3. `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts` (≈ line 373) records the message with **both** the filtered content and the unfiltered replay state:

   ```ts
   const message = createAssistantMessage({
     content: assembler.blocks(),
     source: {
       provider: request.provider,
       model: request.model,
       ...assembler.replayState !== undefined ? { replayState: assembler.replayState } : {},
     },
   })
   ```

On the next turn, `replayedAssistant` in `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts` validates the stored record and throws:

```
if (state.blocks.length !== message.content.length)
  return invalidReplay('block count does not match assistant content')
```

### Production trigger

A Qwen3-27B-class model at a 32768 output-token ceiling, cut mid tool-call (`stopReason: "length"`, tool `arguments: "{}"`). The stored record had 1 content block (text) vs 2 replayState blocks (text + tool-call). Every turn after that failed with `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`, including freshly forked "new" sessions, because fork copies all records.

## Why it is severe

- The failure is **deterministic and self-perpetuating**: the poisoned record is part of the history, so no amount of retrying helps.
- "Start a new session" does **not** help if the new session is forked from the old one (session lineage copies records).
- Recovery currently requires hand-editing the zstd session log (drop the stale `source.replayState` from the offending record) — not something end users can do.
- The error surfaces late (at the *next* replay), far from the cause (the *previous* turn's finish), making diagnosis hard.

## Proposed fix

When the finish reason is `max-tokens`, do not record the adapter replay state — the truncated stream is not a complete response, so the message must replay as foreign history (content is authoritative; the dropped tool call was never executed, so nothing is lost):

```diff
+      // On a max-tokens finish `blocks()` has dropped the tool-call blocks it
+      // cannot execute safely, so a replay state projected from the full
+      // response no longer describes the recorded content and would fail the
+      // next replay with INVALID_REPLAY_STATE. Record the message as foreign.
+      const replayState = finish.kind === 'max-tokens' ? undefined : assembler.replayState
       const message = createAssistantMessage({
         content: assembler.blocks(),
         source: {
           provider: request.provider,
           model: request.model,
-          ...assembler.replayState !== undefined ? { replayState: assembler.replayState } : {},
+          ...replayState !== undefined ? { replayState } : {},
         },
       })
```

This has been running in production (dual-instance deployment, QQ bot + web UI) since 2026-08-16 with zero recurrences.

An alternative that preserves replay state for the (valid) text-only max-tokens case would be to have the assembler expose the dropped indices and project the state to match `blocks()` — more invasive, and foreign replay is behaviorally identical for dropped tool calls.

## Regression test

A scripted-stream regression test (fails on master, passes with the fix) is attached to the accompanying PR: `packages/core/agent-loop/tests/max-tokens-replay-state-regression.spec.ts` — it streams `[completed text block][tool-call deltas, no block-end][finish max-tokens + 2-block replayState]` and asserts the recorded message carries no replay state.

## Environment

- DSH `0.1.0-rc.5` / `0.1.0-rc.6` (master 47f9438 has the same code paths)
- Repro does not require a real model: see regression test

---

**Fix & regression test ready:** the change (3 lines + a scripted `MockAdapter` regression test that fails on master and passes with the fix) is committed at fork branch [`bluewowo:deepseek-harness@fix/max-tokens-replay-state-persist`](https://github.com/bluewowo/deepseek-harness/commits/fix/max-tokens-replay-state-persist) — available for whoever picks this up. Happy to adapt the patch to the maintainers' preferred shape (e.g. projecting the replay state to match `blocks()` instead of dropping it).

discussions.title: 为什么这里我想填key的时候一直填不上去，还有其他方法吗？
[Bug] llm-pi-ai: hand-declared routes cannot disable the OpenAI "developer" system-prompt role — reasoning requests 400 on gateways that only accept "system" (e.g. Alibaba Cloud Model Studio / 阿里云百炼)
discussions.body:
## 现象 / Symptom

在 `settings.yaml` 里手声明一个 OpenAI 兼容网关路由（`api: openai-completions`），并给模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（思考强度）后，所有请求以 400 失败：

```
invalid_parameter_error: developer is not one of ['system', 'assistant', 'user', 'tool', 'function']
```

具体场景：阿里云百炼（Model Studio）MaaS 专属部署 `https://ws-*.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1`，模型 `deepseek-v4-flash-0731` / `deepseek-v4-pro-0813`，带 `reasoningEfforts: { off: null, high: high, max: max }`。

## 根因 / Root cause

1. pi-ai 的 `convertMessages`（openai-completions）里：`const useDeveloperRole = model.reasoning && compat.supportsDeveloperRole` —— 模型一旦声明了推理能力（`model.reasoning = true`），system 提示词就以 OpenAI 的 `role: "developer"` 发送。
2. `detectCompat` 对未知网关（`ws-*.maas.aliyuncs.com` 不在任何已知名单里）默认 `supportsDeveloperRole: true`。
3. **DSH 的 `PiAiCompatProfile` 只暴露了 `thinkingFormat` 和 `supportsReasoningEffort`，没有暴露 `supportsDeveloperRole`**，因此配置层无法关闭它 —— 手声明路由无法复刻内置 provider 的此开关。

## 证据 / Evidence

**直接探测网关**（相同请求，仅 role 不同）：

| role | 结果 |
|---|---|
| `developer` | 400 `developer is not one of [...]` |
| `system` | 200 正常返回（含 `reasoning_content`） |

**上游已知此行为**：pi-ai 内置的 `qwen-token-plan-cn` provider（同为 `*.maas.aliyuncs.com` 域名）在模型数据里显式设置了 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: false`，说明阿里云 MaaS 网关只接受 `system` 角色，且上游已在内置目录中处理。手声明路由缺这个开关，无法做同样的处理。

## 建议修复 / Suggested fix

给 `PiAiCompatProfile`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/catalog.ts` + `config.ts` schema）增加 `supportsDeveloperRole?: boolean` 并在 `resolveModelCompat` 透传给 pi-ai。已在本地验证可行：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    alibaba:
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://ws-xxx.cn-beijing.maas.aliyuncs.com/compatible-mode/v1
      compat:
        supportsReasoningEffort: true
        supportsDeveloperRole: false   # 网关只接受 system 角色
```

## 临时绕法 / Workaround

不给模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（回到无思考强度状态），或等官方补上该开关。

---
环境：pi-ai 0.82.1，DSH 当前 master。

discussions.title: rc.6: multi-surface instance (web + IM channel) fails to mount persona preset — `preset "standard" failed to mount … deployment:persona is already registered`; Web conversation unavailable
discussions.body:
## Summary

A single DSH process running **two surfaces** (web-app + an IM channel, e.g. the QQ bot plugin) starts cleanly — HTTP 200, bot connected — but as soon as the **Web UI restores/resumes a session**, the API returns:

```
preset "standard" failed to mount … deployment:persona is already registered
```

and the Web conversation is unavailable. The process itself looks healthy from the outside (port serving, IM bot connected and answering), and the error **only appears in the API response / frontend — it does not reach the service journal**. Any automated "is it up?" check goes green; the failure is only visible to a human opening a session in the browser.

## Reproduction (our deployment)

- DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm global install)
- One profile with three bundles in one process: `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app` + `dsh-qqbot` (web UI + QQ bot in a single service — the natural "one agent, several channels" topology)
- Startup: success (web port 200, `Bot ready`)
- Web UI: **restoring an existing session** triggers the persona mount error above → Web conversation dead
- Control: a web-only profile (no IM surface) on the same rc.6 is healthy — the conflict is specific to the multi-surface combination
- IM surface: works (bot answers normally)

## Impact

The single-process multi-channel deployment is currently unusable in rc.6. Our workaround is running **two separate processes** (web instance + bot instance) sharing one DSH home — which works, but introduces its own side effect: sessions created by the bot process never appear in the Web UI's session list (the session registry is only updated by the web instance — separate thread, happy to discuss there too).

## Questions

1. Is this a known rc.6 issue already targeted for rc.7 (we're holding our single-instance cutover pending rc.7)?
2. Is there a profile-level workaround (preset override per surface) we're missing?
3. Even if the mount conflict stays, should the failure be logged at the host level (journal-visible) rather than only in the API response? A green service + broken Web is a slow diagnosis.

## Environment

- DSH `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm), profile = dsh-base + dsh-web-app + dsh-qqbot, one process
- Web-only profile on the same version: healthy
- Error observed 2026-08-16 (both surfaces in one process for ~9 minutes before rollback to dual-process)

discussions.title: persistence: one corrupt session file crash-loops the whole host process — and the zstd frame layout that triggers it is undocumented
discussions.body:
## Summary

If **any single** session file under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/**` is in a shape the reader rejects, `sessionPersistence.list()` throws `corrupt Zstandard session log: …` during workspace-registry initialization, and the **entire host process enters a crash loop** (we observed systemd `NRestarts=13`, HTTP 000). The Web UI then shows a "fresh" onboarding state — all history appears gone. One bad file in one workspace takes down the service for **all** workspaces.

We hit this twice in one day (2026-08-16/17) while repairing poisoned session records by hand — which leads to the second half of the post: **the on-disk frame layout is nowhere documented**, so any operator editing a session file will break it.

## What we did wrong (so you can see how easily this happens)

A session log (`session.jsonl.zstd`) is **multi-frame** zstd:

- frame 1 must be **exactly one line** — the `{"type":"session", …}` header
- subsequent frames hold complete JSONL records (the writer flushes in batches)
- a torn final frame is tolerated (crash-tail repair)

Our repair script re-compressed the file as **one frame containing all lines**. The reader then rejects it with:

```
Error: corrupt Zstandard session log: first frame is not exactly one header line
```

Nothing in the docs (including `docs/persistence-catalog.md`) describes this layout. The only way to learn the contract is to read the reader's source (`assertZstdHeaderFrame` et al.). We learned it the expensive way.

## The two incidents

1. **Host crash loop (severe):** one single-frame file in workspace `--home-jojo-dsh--` → `sessionPersistence.list()` threw at registry init → the web instance (rc.5 checkout under systemd, `Restart=always`) crash-looped (`NRestarts=13`, HTTP 000) → the Web UI showed a blank/onboarding state and every session looked "lost". Fixed by re-framing the file (header frame + one record per frame, ~2900 frames, content byte-identical) → service recovered, all history intact.
2. **Silent per-session failure (moderate):** the same wrong framing on a bot-channel session made `agents.resume` throw for that session only; the channel plugin's error path swallowed it, so inbound messages were dropped without any reply or log. (The swallow itself is reported against the plugin separately.)

## What we'd like to discuss

1. **Blast radius:** should `list()` isolate a corrupt session (skip + log loudly + optionally quarantine the file, e.g. rename to `*.corrupt-<ts>`) instead of failing the whole registry init? A corrupt session can still be surfaced as a *per-session* error when someone actually opens it. As-is, one bad file is a total outage of the host, and under `Restart=always` it's a crash loop with no progress.
2. **Documentation:** the zstd frame layout (header frame = exactly one line; record frames; torn-tail tolerance) is a load-bearing contract for anyone doing operational repairs (and we did need to do them). A section in `docs/persistence-catalog.md` — plus a short "manually repairing a session file" note (re-frame as header frame + one record per frame; keep content byte-identical) — would save the next operator an hour.
3. **A validator (nice to have):** a `dsh doctor`-style check that scans all session files and reports corrupt ones (with the specific frame/line) would turn "why is my service crash-looping / this session unreadable?" into a one-liner.

## Environment

- Reproduced on rc.5 (checkout) and rc.6 (npm) — same reader code family
- Both incidents: files re-compressed as a single zstd frame by an external repair script

discussions.title: 【插件分享】dsh-local-skills：在 DSH Web 里浏览你的本地 Skills
discussions.body:
[![skills.sh](https://skills.sh/b/asakumizy/dsh-local-skills)](https://skills.sh/asakumizy/dsh-local-skills)
[![License: MIT](https://img.shields.io/badge/License-MIT-blue.svg)](LICENSE)

一个基于 DSH 官方插件体系（Cordis bundle + `dsh.client` 双半）做的 **本地 Skill 浏览器** 插件：扫描你的本地 skill 目录、实时更新，在 Web 设置页里可视化浏览，每个 skill 带「使用」按钮，点击直接告诉你**怎么让模型使用这个 skill**，还能一键复制示例提示。

**仓库：** https://github.com/asakumizy/dsh-local-skills

---

## 功能一览

### 1. 本地 skill 发现
- 默认扫描 `~/.dsh/local-skills`，可通过配置 `skillDirs` 指定任意目录（绝对路径或 `~` 开头）。
- 支持目录形式 `<name>/SKILL.md` 和扁平 `<name>.md`，解析 YAML frontmatter（`name` / `description` / `whenToUse` / `disable-model-invocation` / `user-invocable`）。

### 2. 实时更新
- chokidar 监听扫描目录；skill 新增 / 修改 / 删除后，**模型目录和 Web 界面都会即时刷新**，无需重启。

### 3. Web 界面（Notion 设计风格）
- 设置（Settings）→ 技能（Skills）页面：紫色主 CTA、奶油白卡片、暖炭灰文字、8px 直角按钮 / 12px 圆角卡片、pastel 属性色板（设计参考项目内 `notion-DESIGN.md`）。
- 带搜索框、数量统计、手动刷新按钮。

### 4. 「使用」按钮 → 告诉你怎么让模型用
每个 skill 点击「使用」后展示两种方式：

| 方式 | 操作 |
|---|---|
| 方式一（推荐） | 在输入框输入 `/skill-name` 并描述任务，模型自动加载并遵循 |
| 方式二 | 直接点名描述任务（例如「请使用 code-review 这个 skill 来…」），模型会调用 `skill` 工具加载 |

并支持**一键复制**可直接发送的示例提示。

### 5. 开箱即用
- 包内自带 `code-review`、`git-commit` 两个示例 skill（同时发布到 skills.sh 生态）。
- 用户自己 `~/.dsh/local-skills` 里的同名 skill 始终优先（内置示例只做兜底）。

---

## 安装（其他用户）

```bash
# 方式一：dsh plugin（推荐，需要 pnpm）
dsh plugin --profile web add asakumizy/dsh-local-skills

# 方式二：tarball / 本地路径
dsh plugin --profile web add /path/to/dsh-local-skills-1.0.0.tgz

# 方式三：从 skills.sh 安装示例 skill
npx skills add asakumizy/dsh-local-skills --all
```

装完**重启 `dsh web`**，打开 设置 → 技能 即可看到你的 skill。

> 无 pnpm 时手动装：把包解压到 `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules/dsh-local-skills`，并在对应 profile 的 `package.json` 的 `dsh.profile.bundles` 中加入 `dsh-local-skills`。

---

## 架构简述

- **Host 半**（`lib/index.js`）：实现 `SkillProvider` 并注册进 `ctx.skills`；扫描目录 + chokidar 监听 + `control.invalidate()` 实时失效。纯 Cordis 插件，任何 profile（web / desktop / tui / headless）都可加载，缺 `skills` 服务时只是不激活、不崩溃。
- **Client 半**（`lib/client.js`）：`settings.section` 区块，复用现有 `skill.list` API，3 秒轮询 + 订阅会话切换实现实时展示；Notion 设计风格。

---

## 相关链接

- 仓库：https://github.com/asakumizy/dsh-local-skills
- skills.sh：`npx skills find code-review` / `npx skills add asakumizy/dsh-local-skills --all`
- 依赖：`ctx.skills`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill` / `dsh-base` 提供）

---

*欢迎试用、提 issue / PR。如果你也在做 DSH 生态插件，欢迎交流。*

discussions.title: [Bug]Windows：Agent 用 Remove-Item $home 会清空用户主目录（$HOME 只读导致赋值失败）
discussions.body:
## 摘要
在 Windows 上，由 `dsh web` 拉起的 Agent 生成了一段 PowerShell「隔离临时 DSH_HOME」清理脚本，其中使用了变量名 `$home`。在 Windows PowerShell 中，`$HOME` / `$home` 是指向用户主目录（`C:\Users\<user>`）的**只读**自动变量。对 `$home` 的赋值会失败，变量仍指向真实用户目录，随后执行：
```powershell
Remove-Item $home -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
```
即等价于对用户主目录做递归强制删除（含 `AppData\Local`、`AppData\Roaming` 等）。这是 Agent / Windows shell 路径上的高危缺陷：惯用变量名 `$home` 会直接打到用户 profile。
## 环境
- 操作系统：Windows 10/11
- Shell：`C:\Windows\System32\WindowsPowerShell\v1.0\powershell.exe`（`-NoLogo -NoProfile -NonInteractive -Command …`）
- 父进程：`node …/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js web`（经 npx 安装的 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`）
- 事故日期：2026-08-14
## 现象与证据
父进程为 `dsh web`。子 PowerShell 执行的脚本大致为：
```powershell
$root = "<repo>"
Remove-Item "$root\packages\demo-ui" -Recurse -Force
# …
$home = "$root\.tmp\home-a"   # 意图：仓库内临时 DSH_HOME
Remove-Item $home -Recurse -Force -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
New-Item -ItemType Directory -Path $home -Force | Out-Null
$env:DSH_HOME = $home
# … plugin:add / dump-config …
```
同机复现赋值失败：
```text
无法覆盖变量 HOME，因为该变量为只读变量或不稳定。
# 赋值后 $home 仍为 C:\Users\<user>
```
本机安全软件（火绒）在以下路径拦截并记录了**完整命令行**：
- 防护项：启动目录（扩展保护）
- 目标：`…\AppData\Roaming\Microsoft\Windows\Start Menu\Programs\Startup`
- 操作：已阻止
- 进程：上述 PowerShell；父进程为 `dsh` 的 `web` 入口
这说明删除目标已进入真实用户主目录树。Cursor 日志在相近时刻出现 `Watcher shutdown because watched path got deleted`，以及 `AppData\Local\Programs\cursor\...` 文件不存在、扩展宿主崩溃；`AppData\Local` / `Roaming` 大面积被清空后由应用重建。
## 影响
- 用户 profile 下可递归删除的内容大面积丢失
- `AppData\Local`、`AppData\Roaming` 中应用数据被清空（含编辑器安装/配置、npm 缓存、`~/.dsh` 等）
- `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue` 掩盖占用中文件与杀软拦截等错误，表现为「大部分删掉、少量幸存」
## 为何应视为产品 / Agent 安全问题
1. Agent 在 Windows 上常会写出「`$home` = 临时目录」的惯用写法，却不知道 `$HOME` 只读且指向 profile。
2. 一旦对 `$home` 做 `Remove-Item -Recurse -Force`，语义变为「删除用户」。
3. 吞掉错误使现场更难追查。
4. 若 shell 处于免审批 / 自动执行策略，用户可能看不到命令。
严重程度接近未防护的 `rm -rf ~`，且在 Windows 上更容易被「正常清理临时 home」话术触发。
## 期望行为 / 建议
请按 **高优先级 Agent / Shell 安全** 处理：
1. **文档**：在 Windows PowerShell / pwsh 工具说明与 Agent 指引中明确禁止将 `$home` / `$HOME` 用作可删除临时路径；应使用 `$dshHome`、`$tmpDshHome` 等名称，并只设置 `$env:DSH_HOME`。
2. **护栏**：在执行或批准递归删除前，若解析后的路径为 `$HOME` / `$env:USERPROFILE`、profile 根、`$env:LOCALAPPDATA` / `$env:APPDATA` 或其祖先，应拒绝或强制人工确认。
3. **示例与冒烟脚本**：隔离 home 只写绝对路径到仓库 `.tmp` 或系统临时目录；禁止对 `$home` 赋值；递归删除不要默认 `SilentlyContinue`。
4. **可选检测**：Windows shell Consumer 可对匹配 `Remove-Item\s+\$home` 且未证明目标落在白名单前缀内的调用直接拒绝（在 Windows PowerShell 5.x 上对 `$home` 的赋值本身就会失败）。
## 安全复现（请勿对真实 profile 执行 Remove-Item）
仅验证赋值行为：
```powershell
powershell -NoProfile -Command "$home = 'D:\temp\fake-dsh-home'; Write-Host \"home=$home\""
```
观察 `$home` 仍为 `C:\Users\<user>`（赋值报错）。这足以证明后续 `Remove-Item $home -Recurse -Force` 会打到用户主目录。
[incident-2026-08-14-powershell-home-wipe.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31126093/incident-2026-08-14-powershell-home-wipe.md)

discussions.title: DSH的上下文工程没做针对工具的渐进式披露，针对工具的输出日志只做了简单的裁剪/外置，大家有无更好的替换方案？
discussions.body:
如题所示，在这几天个人体验下来，DSH目前底层的上下文工程做的非常简单。
实际使用下来个人感觉它的压缩机制只设定了一个合理的阈值，没有做像Claude code那样的分级压缩，它的生命周期还不够完整，特别是针对于压缩后的重新水合、重注入机制，十分不完善，对话几轮之后上下文窗口全被工具的输出日志还有一些垃圾信息冗余。特别是针对于工具的披露方式，几乎都是完整Schema全量加载进上下文窗口，单次对话固定占据10到20k tokens的上下文窗口。针对工具的输出日志，DAH团队做了裁剪和外置，但是目前机制不够完善，基本都是静态触发，且他们似乎针对工具的输出日志的裁剪做了四层机制
Layer 1：采集期裁剪 + 外置（每会话都生效）
Layer 2：通用 spill policy（dsh-spill-policy，maxInlineBytes）存在但默认未启用，任意超预算纯文本工具结果 → 全文存盘 + 头尾预览 + 取回提示
Layer 3：工具结果裁剪器（dsh-compaction-tool-result-pruner） 已装载但被动
Layer 4：压缩（dsh-compaction-basic）已装载但从未触发

结果是我1M 窗口下 Layer 3/4 基本是摆设；真正每轮在控制上下文增长的只有 Layer 1 的各工具采集上限，所以历史里单次不大的工具结果会原样累积——因此我建议目前的解决方式「长会话及时开新篇」

discussions.title: 性能优化提案：历史加载剔除流式分块事件（附完整实现与测试）
discussions.body:
## 中文

**提案：`session.history` 历史页省略 `assistant/chunk` 流式分块增量**（附完整实现、测试与 Agent Note，欢迎直接取用）。

### 现象

手机端（经 Tailscale）打开会话历史需要 **10 秒以上**；桌面端随会话增长也越来越慢。

### 根因（实测）

`session.history` 按消息数分页（默认 50 条消息），然后发送页内 **seq 范围内的全部事件**。实测一个普通的重负载会话：50 条消息展开为 **26,562 条 `assistant/chunk` 事件、约 5.4MB JSON**——其中约 99% 是仅用于流式动画的分块增量。`assistant/message` 事件本身携带完整内容（`message.content`），对话 reducer 渲染历史时直接使用这些事件，分块对历史查看者没有任何价值。

### 方案

1. **服务器**（`packages/host/apiproxy`）：`historyPage`（`session.history`、detached 历史、`subagent.history` 共用）在分页前过滤 `assistant/chunk`。分页边界、`hasMore` 语义不变；单页从 5.4MB 降到约 200KB（约 50 倍）。
2. **客户端**（`packages/client/runtime`）：`loadOlder` 的连续性断言从「精确相邻」放宽为「确实更旧」（被剥离的分块会在页间留下预期 seq 间隙）；非更旧的页仍然 fail-soft。
3. **不受影响**：存储日志与实时 mux 事件流保留全部分块，流式动画完全不变。

### 验证

- `pnpm run typecheck` ✅ / oxlint 0 错误 ✅
- 新增 `api-proxy-history-chunks.spec.ts`（attached + detached 双路径）+ 更新 `session.client.spec.ts`，53 测试全过 ✅
- `verify-translation-pairing`（937 对一致）✅ / `verify-agent-note-format` ✅
- 手机实测：历史加载从 10+ 秒降到 **1 秒内**

### 代码

完整实现（含中英双语 Agent Note）在分支：**https://github.com/dingdingfox/deepseek-harness/tree/perf/history-omit-streaming-chunks**

如果团队认可这个方向，可以直接取用或开放外部 PR（当前仓库未开放外部 PR，CONTRIBUTING.md 注明现阶段不接受）。

---

## English summary

**Proposal: `session.history` pages should omit `assistant/chunk` streaming deltas** — with a complete implementation, tests, and an Agent Note available on the branch above.

- **Measured problem**: a 50-message history page of a heavy session ships ~26,562 `assistant/chunk` events (~5.4 MB JSON, ~99% streaming-only payload). Phone history loads take 10+ seconds over Tailscale; the desktop degrades too as sessions grow.
- **Fix**: `historyPage` filters `assistant/chunk` before paginating (same message window, ~50x smaller pages; `hasMore` and page boundaries unchanged); the client `loadOlder` continuity assertion relaxes to "actually older". The stored log and live mux stream keep every chunk.
- **Verified**: typecheck, lint, 53 unit tests (new attached + detached history specs), translation pairing, and note format all pass. Measured phone load drops to under a second.
- **Code**: https://github.com/dingdingfox/deepseek-harness/tree/perf/history-omit-streaming-chunks

Happy to adapt the approach to team preferences.

discussions.title: 提案：新增参与布局的右侧 Shell 插槽，便于更多长期存在的看板插件置入
discussions.body: ### 背景 当前 `ui-layout` 提供 `sidebar`、`conversation`、`details` 和 `shell.overlay` 等插槽： https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/index.ts 其中 `shell.overlay` 是覆盖整个应用框架的悬浮层，适合 Toast、徽标、浮动提示等内容，但它不参与页面布局。 当外部插件需要提供长期存在、可交互的右侧工作面板时，例如： - 文件浏览与预览 - 交互式终端 - 编辑器或任务面板 - 调试、监控等辅助工具 使用 `shell.overlay` 会覆盖中间的会话区域，而不是让会话区域自然缩窄。其他现有插槽也不完全适合： - 注册到 `root` 会替换整个应用框架； - 注册到 `details` 会替换现有工具详情栏，使工具调用详情无法继续使用； - 直接修改 DOM 或依赖内部 CSS 结构不稳定，也不符合插件扩展方式。 ### 建议 希望在 `shell.overlay` 之外，增加一个参与布局的、通用的右侧 Shell 插槽，例如：`shell.workplane` 这样可以实现类似于 Codex 侧边启动文件浏览器与终端的操作 参考：

discussions.title: [Feature request / Bug report] 插件加载失败不该让整个 harness 启动失败：逐个插件捕获错误 + 可操作提示
discussions.body:
> 建议分类：Ideas（或 Bug report）
> 环境：DeepSeek Harness 0.1.0-rc.6
> 背景：真实事故（dsh-plugin-vetting@0.5.1 带病发布，见下）

## 问题

任何一个第三方插件**解析失败**（如 JS SyntaxError），会导致**整个 harness 无法启动**：

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include):
loader entries failed to apply
  [errors]: [
    Error: failed to import loader entry plugin-vet (dsh-plugin-vetting): Invalid regular expression flags
        at updateError (.../cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js:299:9)
  ]
```

用户看到的是**一堵错误墙**，没有：
- 明确指向"是哪个插件坏"（错误信息里虽有插件名，但淹没在堆栈里）；
- 告诉用户**怎么恢复**（`dsh plugin --profile <name> update <插件>` 即可修，但没人说）；
- 对"带病发布"的第三方插件的**容错**——一个坏插件 = 全部不可用。

## 真实案例

`dsh-plugin-vetting@0.5.1` 曾因 `lib/index.js:138` 正则字面量中未转义的 `/proc` 导致模块解析期抛 `SyntaxError: Invalid regular expression flags`。三个用户遇到 profile 完全无法启动，只能手动改 node_modules 绕行（[issues #1](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting/issues/1) / [#3](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting/issues/3)）。修复版 0.5.6 已发布，但**整个事件暴露的是 harness 侧的可用性问题**：第三方插件生态一旦繁荣，这类"带病发布"必然还会发生，当前行为会让每个受影响的用户都被锁死在错误墙前。

## 建议（按落地成本排序）

**1. 加载器逐个插件捕获 import/解析错误，输出可操作提示（最小改动）**

当前 loader 对 entry 的 import 失败是整体 fail-loud。建议：
- 单插件 import 失败时，错误信息**首行**明确：`插件 <name> 加载失败: <原因>`；
- 附恢复命令：`dsh plugin --profile <name> update <name>`（或 `remove`）；
- 可选：**降级继续启动**（该插件标记为 disabled，其余插件正常加载），而非整体退出——让用户至少还能用 harness 去修。

**2. 安装后验证（dshmarket 已有先例，扩展到所有 bundle）**

dshmarket 已有"安装后验证，防止坏插件毁掉下次启动"的逻辑。建议把它标准化到 loader 层：
- `dsh plugin add <pkg>` 后**实际 import 一次插件入口**（`await import(pkg)`）验证可加载；
- 验证失败 → 安装回滚/明确报错，而不是"装上但下次启动崩"。

**3. 插件入口的解析期错误单独分类**

SyntaxError 这类**解析期错误**应在 import 时被捕获并给出友好提示（"插件代码有语法错误，无法加载"），而不是和运行时错误混在一起。

## 期望

即使只做第 1 条的"**错误信息首行点名插件 + 恢复命令 + 降级启动**"，也能把"一堵错误墙"变成"一个可操作的提示"，让第三方插件生态（必然会出现带病发布）不会锁死用户。

## 关联

- 事故插件：`dsh-plugin-vetting@0.5.1`（[issues #1/#3](https://github.com/truelove-dreamer/dsh-plugin-vetting/issues/1)），0.5.6 已修复并加了 CI + 发布前 import 验证；
- dshmarket 的安装后验证逻辑（本提案第 2 条的既有先例）。

discussions.title: Windows: sandbox bootstrap fails hard (SetNamedSecurityInfoW error 5) when the workspace directory is owned by BUILTIN\Administrators and dsh runs unprivileged
discussions.body:
### Environment

- dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (npm global install)
- OS: Windows (NTFS volume), non-elevated process
- Policy: file policy `workspace-write`, approval policy `ask`
- Workspace root: `E:\AI`

### Symptom

Every sandboxed shell invocation fails before executing anything, with:

```
Error: SetNamedSecurityInfoW failed (Win32 5): grantWrite(E:\AI)
```

The failure happens at sandbox bootstrap, so the whole shell (pwsh) run is rejected. `danger-full-access` mode works because it skips the grant. Read-only file tools are unaffected.

### Root cause

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` materializes a standing write ACE on the workspace root via `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` (`mergeAndApply` / `grantWrite`, lib/types-CNjZgO4h.js). That API requires WRITE_DAC on the target directory (or ownership).

On this machine, `E:\AI` is owned by `BUILTIN\Administrators` (it was created by an elevated installer). The DACL grants the unprivileged user only `Authenticated Users:(M)` (Modify) — which does NOT include WRITE_DAC. The dsh process runs non-elevated, so the Administrators ACE does not apply either. Result: access denied (Win32 5), bootstrap aborts.

This is not an exotic setup: any workspace folder created by an elevated installer/archive tool (common on Windows) hits it.

### Reproduction

1. On Windows, create a workspace directory whose owner is `BUILTIN\Administrators` (e.g. via an elevated file manager) with default inherited ACLs (no per-user entry).
2. Run dsh as that unprivileged user with file policy `workspace-write`.
3. Execute any shell tool → bootstrap error above.

### Workaround applied (for the record)

```
takeown /F <workspace> /R /D Y
icacls <workspace> /grant <user>:(OI)(CI)F /T /C
```

After making the user the owner with Full control, the sandbox boots and workspace-write confinement works as designed.

### Suggested product improvement

Treat grant failure as a degrade-gracefully case rather than a hard bootstrap failure. Reasonable behaviors, in order of preference:

1. Detect that the current token lacks WRITE_DAC on the workspace root and fall back to a mode that does not require it (or fail the *write* with a clear, actionable message instead of killing the whole shell), or
2. Surface a one-time, actionable diagnostic naming the exact ownership problem and the `takeown`/`icacls` remedy, while still allowing read-only executions.

Either way, the sandbox should not silently die at bootstrap with a raw Win32 error — the user currently cannot even run `Get-Location` to start diagnosing.

### Notes

- Verified ACL before fix: `BUILTIN\Administrators:(I)(F)`, `SYSTEM:(I)(F)`, `Authenticated Users:(I)(M)`, `Users:(I)(RX)`; owner `BUILTIN\Administrators`.
- Verified after fix: owner `<user>`; sandboxed shell boots, writes to workspace root succeed, files outside the workspace remain denied.
- Package involved: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` (provider) → `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` (grant implementation), both 0.1.0-rc.6.

discussions.title: [插件分享] dsh-plugin-dit：一条命令接入 DIT，29 个 Chat 模型 + 10 个 Messages 模型
discussions.body:
这个插件解决的不是“能不能手动填一个 OpenAI-compatible 地址”，而是把 DIT 的模型目录、双协议和 thinking 配置做成一个可版本化、可重复安装的 DeepSeek Harness bundle。

源码已迁移到独立公开仓库：[cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit](https://github.com/cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit)。用户无需访问 DIT 私有主仓库即可审查插件、提交 Issue 或参与开发。

看三个点：

1. **模型**：当前包含 29 个 Chat 模型，覆盖 Claude、DeepSeek V4、Gemini、GLM、GPT、Grok、Kimi 和 MiniMax。
2. **协议**：同时支持 OpenAI Chat Completions（`/v1/chat/completions`）与 Anthropic Messages（`/v1/messages`）。
3. **安全**：插件只引用 `DIT_API_KEY`，不会把密钥写进 npm 包或 Git 仓库。

适合已经在用 DSH、但不想逐个维护模型 ID、协议和 thinking 参数的开发者。

## 安装

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-dit@0.1.3
export DIT_API_KEY="your-dit-api-key"
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

打开 **Settings → Models** 后会看到两个 Provider：

- `DIT.ai`：29 个声明支持 `openai_chat_completions` 的模型。
- `DIT.ai Messages`：10 个声明支持 `anthropic_messages` 的 Claude 模型。

Headless profile 也可以直接安装：

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile headless add dsh-plugin-dit@0.1.3
export DIT_API_KEY="your-dit-api-key"
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh --profile headless "Explain this repository"
```

## 为什么分成两个 Provider

同一个模型名不等于同一种 wire protocol。

Chat provider 发送标准 OpenAI Chat Completions 请求；Messages provider 则保留 Anthropic content blocks、tool use、流式事件和 thinking budget。DeepSeek V4 只出现在 Chat provider，并使用对应的 thinking 方言，不会被错误地发到 `/v1/messages`。

## 验证情况

- npm：[`dsh-plugin-dit@0.1.3`](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-dit)
- 公开源码：[cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit](https://github.com/cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit)
- 使用官方 Harness 完成 Chat 与 Messages transport smoke test。
- 2026-08-17 再次与 DIT 鉴权后的 `/v1/models` 对比：29 个 Chat、10 个 Messages，ID 完全一致。
- npm 发布包只有配置、README 和 License 等 5 个文件，不包含 API Key。

这里有一个明确边界：图像、音频和视频模型没有伪装成对话模型放进选择器，因为 DSH 这条 Provider 路径消费的是 conversational model API。DIT 新增或调整对话模型后，仓库里的 catalog check 会在发版前检查目录漂移。

如果你在使用中遇到模型、协议或安装问题，欢迎在公开仓库提交 Issue。

---

## English summary

`dsh-plugin-dit` is an installable DeepSeek Harness provider bundle for DIT.ai. Version 0.1.3 configures 29 OpenAI Chat Completions models and 10 Anthropic Messages models behind one `DIT_API_KEY`, while keeping protocol-specific thinking behavior separate.

Install:

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-dit@0.1.3
export DIT_API_KEY="your-dit-api-key"
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

Public repository: https://github.com/cuboteam/dsh-plugin-dit

discussions.title: [bug] Subagent catalog cold reads replay full session logs and cause sustained high CPU
discussions.body:
## Summary

With a large number of persisted sessions and durable subagents, opening the DSH Web UI can keep the `dsh web` Node process near one full CPU core for an extended period. On my machine this caused visible thermal load even while the browser UI itself was relatively quiet.

The hot path appears when `dsh-subagent` resolves cold child identities. If the fast `cachedSnapshot()` check is not usable, `resolveColdIdentity()` falls directly back to `sessionPersistence.inspect()`, which reads/decompresses the full JSONL/Zstd log and rebuilds every registered projection.

A local canary that tries `sessionProjectionCache.coldSnapshot()` before `persistence.inspect()` removed the sustained thermal/CPU problem in my environment.

## Environment

- DSH: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- macOS: 15.7.3, Apple Silicon
- Node.js: 22.23.1
- UI: `dsh web` on `127.0.0.1:3080`
- Persisted projection cache: about 145 session records, including about 97 real subagent records

## Symptoms

- `node .../dsh web` sustained roughly 74% to 136% CPU
- Physical footprint around 1.5 GB during diagnosis
- Laptop became noticeably warm soon after opening/using the Web UI
- Disabling `skill-filesystem` watching did not resolve the high CPU
- The symptom predated installation of a custom sidebar plugin

## Profiling evidence

An 8-second Node Inspector CPU profile attributed inclusive sample cost approximately as follows:

- session persistence / log decoding: 49.8%
- session core reconstruction: 27.2%
- subagent catalog resolution: 15.1%
- token meter: 6.3%
- local memory plugin: 2.9%

Representative call path:

```text
subagents.list
  -> resolveCandidateRows
  -> resolveColdIdentity
  -> sessionPersistence.inspect
  -> prepareCore
  -> session-persistence-jsonl.loadStored/readZstdPrefix
  -> sessionProjection.restore
```

A breakpoint on `session-persistence-jsonl.loadStored()` confirmed calls through `prepareCore()` from `inspect()` while resolving cold subagent identities.

## Relevant code

Current behavior in `dsh-subagent`:

```js
const cached = cache.cachedSnapshot(header)?.values.subagent
if (cached && cached.seq >= (header.seedLength ?? 0)) {
  return childRow(childId, cached, "inactive", hasChildren)
}

// Falls directly to a full stored-session inspection.
const inspected = await persistence.inspect(childId, signal)
const identity = projections.restore({}, inspected.events, 0).snapshot.values.subagent
```

There is already a projection-cache API designed for this case: `sessionProjectionCache.coldSnapshot(id, signal)`. It can reuse a durable checkpoint, replay only the missing suffix, and write the refreshed checkpoint back.

## Local canary

I inserted the following path before the full `persistence.inspect()` fallback:

```js
if (cache !== undefined) {
  try {
    const refreshed = await cache.coldSnapshot(childId, signal)
    const identity = refreshed.values.subagent
    if (identity !== undefined && identity !== null) {
      return childRow(childId, identity, "inactive", hasChildren)
    }
  } catch {
    assertListingNotCancelled(signal)
  }
}
```

After restarting `dsh web`, the previously sustained heating/high-CPU behavior disappeared in normal use.

## Expected behavior

Cold subagent listing should use the durable projection cache and tail replay path. Full log inspection and full projection reconstruction should be the final fallback for an unavailable or corrupt projection cache.

The default prepared-session cache size is only 5, so increasing that value may reduce churn temporarily but will not scale well to 100+ durable subagents. A projection-first listing path should keep catalog work proportional to lightweight metadata and missing event tails rather than total historical log size.

## Suggested change

In `resolveColdIdentity()`:

1. Keep the existing `cachedSnapshot(header)` fast path.
2. On a stale or absent usable snapshot, try `cache.coldSnapshot(childId, signal)`.
3. Use `persistence.inspect()` plus a full projection restore only when the projection cache is unavailable, fails, or cannot produce a subagent identity.
4. Preserve cancellation and lifecycle validation semantics.

I can provide a focused patch or additional CPU profiles if helpful.

discussions.title: BUG: dsh web 空闲时主线程 CPU 常驻 93%，疑似 busy loop
discussions.body:
【问题现象】

dsh web 启动后，在完全空闲状态（无用户请求、无 agent 运行）下，Node.js 主线程 CPU 持续占用 70% 到 94%，一直不降。服务器共 2 核，等于被占满近 1 个核。

运行一段时间后，服务偶尔会自行退出，被 systemd 的 Restart=always 拉起（反代层出现短暂 502）。

【复现步骤】

1. npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
2. dsh web --port 3080 --host 127.0.0.1
3. 打开界面一次，完成工作区选择
4. 之后完全不操作，保持空闲
5. 观察 CPU，一直维持在 90% 左右不下降

【诊断证据】

进程 CPU 采样（空闲，2 秒间隔）：
PID 1729465，CPU 一直是 93.8%，内存 14.9%

线程级 top 显示：主线程状态 R（running）占 70% CPU，其余 libuv 线程全部 S（sleeping）

strace 采样 3 秒：只有 36 次系统调用（约 0.1 秒），说明 CPU 耗在纯用户态计算死循环，不是 IO 或 syscall 循环。

【环境信息】

版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.6
Node.js：v22.23.1
系统：Ubuntu 24.04.4 LTS（内核 6.8.0-124，x86_64）
CPU：2 vCPU，内存 1.9G
启动命令：dsh web --port 3080 --host 127.0.0.1 --trusted-host <host>

【影响】

占满 1 个 vCPU，拖累同服务器其他服务。
周期性自行退出导致反代层短暂 502。
内存稳定（约 300MB），是 CPU 问题而非内存泄漏。

【已做的临时缓解】

systemd 加 CPUQuota=60% 限速，让其余服务不受影响，但底层 busy loop 依然存在。

【期望行为】

空闲的 web 服务 CPU 应接近 0%。

[dsh-bug-report.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31127078/dsh-bug-report.md)

discussions.title: deepseek harness 在windows系统下，极简模式下执行任务短时间内总中断
discussions.body:
已修复，DeepSeek Harness Web 当前正常运行：[http://127.0.0.1:3080/](http://127.0.0.1:3080)，HTTP 返回 `200`。

根因是 Web profile 单独安装了一份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`。两份包各自创建了不同的进程内 `Symbol`，导致工具运行时找不到 scheduler，最终抛出：

```text
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

界面显示的 `Interrupted` 是误导，并非 Git、PowerShell 或人工中止。

已完成：

- 将 Web profile 的 `dsh-tools` 改为链接 Harness 共用副本。
- 更新 `pnpm-lock.yaml`，当前 scheduler Symbol 身份检查为 `true`。
- Windows 默认 preset 从 `minimal` 改为 `code`，避免 Linux-only persistent bash。
- Code 回归会话中 `run_code`、`git_status({})` 成功，最终状态为 `completed`。
- 清理了本次诊断产生的临时脚本和空测试目录。
- 没有修改 `D:\guangting\tricycle` 的项目代码。

终端中的：

```text
notify:kind=done;toast=True;balloon=False;flash=True
```

是 `dsh-notify-win` 输出的“任务完成且 Windows Toast 已成功显示”，不是错误。重复多行对应多次完成通知。


补充：Code Mode 的无参数工具仍应显式传空对象，例如 `tools.git_status({})`；写成 `tools.git_status()` 会返回正常的参数校验错误，但不会再导致整个会话崩溃。

discussions.title: I made long-term memory auditable: 64.7%  fewer tokens in a real DSH plugin workflow
discussions.body:
I built **Experience Memory**, a lightweight long-term memory plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

The idea is simple:

```text
real task history -> distilled reusable lesson -> keyword recall -> future task reuse
```

Instead of injecting a huge raw session history into every prompt, the agent explicitly calls `memory_search`, inspects compact candidates, and only calls `memory_get` when a lesson is actually useful.

## Why I built it

Raw session history is great for audit and replay, but it is usually too noisy to serve directly as durable few-shot context.

Experience Memory stores the part that actually matters: reusable successes, failures, project conventions, integration boundaries, and verified fixes.

## Real-world result

I compared a real plugin-development workflow with and without Experience Memory. This is not a synthetic benchmark: the repository includes the exported session archives and the actual `memory.md` used by the memory-enabled run.

| Metric | Without Memory | With Memory | Reduction |
|---|---:|---:|---:|
| Model calls | 503 | 313 | 37.8% |
| input + output tokens | 1,274,572 | 450,195 | 64.7% |
| reasoning tokens | 113,192 | 23,628 | 79.1% |
| Tool calls | 738 | 381 | 48.4% |

The main win was not magic retrieval. The agent simply stopped rediscovering the same project-specific lessons again and again.

## What makes it different

- Markdown source of truth: easy to inspect, diff, and commit.
- Explicit recall: no hidden automatic prompt stuffing.
- Progressive loading: search returns compact candidates; full content is loaded only when needed.
- Auditable evidence: full session archives and the memory file are included in the repo.
- Simple V1: deterministic keyword retrieval, no vector database required.

## Repository

https://github.com/ganfabo123-cmyk/dsh-experience-memory

This is an unofficial community project.

discussions.title: No way to unarchive a session (only workspace.archiveSession exists)
discussions.body:
## Summary

In dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`, the workspace layer only exposes **archive** for sessions (`workspace.archiveSession`) — there is no `unarchive` counterpart anywhere in the RPC registry or the UI. A session archived by accident cannot be restored through any supported path.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the dsh web UI, archive any session (e.g. from the sidebar).
2. Try to restore it — there is no unarchive action in the UI, and the API registry has no reverse operation.

## Impact

- The archived session's data is fully preserved on disk (the archive never touches the session artifacts), but the session disappears from every grouping view and cannot be brought back.
- The only recovery path is to stop the server, hand-edit `$DSH_HOME/storages/workspace.json` (remove the id from `global.archivedSessionIds`), and restart. That is fragile and unfriendly for a GUI feature with an accidental-click profile.

## Code references

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace` exposes only `archiveSession(sessionId)` (the `Workspace` domain class and the `workspace.archiveSession` RPC). The RPC registry has exactly: `workspace.list / create / rename / delete / insertBefore / insertSessionBefore / archiveSession`.
- The storage comment already anticipates restoration: *"an archived session keeps its `sessionIds` slot (unarchiving must restore the…)"* — so the design intent is there; only the operation is missing.

## Suggested fix

- Add `workspace.unarchiveSession` (symmetric: remove the id from `archivedSessionIds`, restoring visibility in all groupings).
- Surface it in the UI — e.g. an "archived sessions" section with a restore action, or a restore entry in the session menu.

dsh version: `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh`).
