discussions.title: 我在装某些插件的时候，会出现 pnpm 在 profile 里“克隆”了一份 dsh 核心包，导致工具系统精神分裂
discussions.body:
下面是我通过 ai 进行解决的，但是治标不治本，后续安装某些插件还是会出现问题的

 本轮运行失败Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')

本轮运行失败An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)

根因：装 dsh-codex-connect 时，pnpm 在 profile 里“克隆”了一份 dsh 核心包，导致工具系统精神分裂

今天 13:18 你安装 dsh-codex-connect / dsh-web-extras 时，pnpm（nodeLinker: hoisted 模式）把 8 个 dsh 核心运行时包提升进了 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/，其中就包括 dsh-tools（工具调度核心）。

于是运行时出现了两份独立的 dsh-tools 模块：

插件加载器从 profile 根解析 → 加载了 profile 副本的 ToolRuntime 服务
而 dsh-agent-loop（来自全局 dsh 安装）用的是全局副本的调度器 Symbol
我用 node 实测验证：两份的 TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER === 结果为 false（Symbol 描述一样但身份不同）。跨副本用 Symbol 取调度器 → 拿到 undefined → 崩溃。

💥 两个错误的关系
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') —— 根因。模型发起工具调用（bash/glob），agent-loop 调 scheduler.prepare() 时调度器是 undefined，整个回合当场崩死，工具结果没能写回会话。
tool_calls must be followed by tool messages... —— 连锁反应。上一步崩溃后，会话历史里留下了「模型说要调工具、但没有任何工具返回结果」的残缺消息。之后这个会话每次发消息，API 都因为这段残缺历史直接拒绝（400），换个新对话才能恢复。
🔧 修复内容
确认 8 个被复制的包（dsh-tools、cordis、cosmokit、schemastery 等）与全局版本完全一致（全部 0.1.0-rc.6）后，已从 profile 的 node_modules 移除
备份在 ~/.dsh/backups/core-dupes-20260817/，出问题随时可还原
起了测试实例验证：boot 无报错、68 个插件条目全部注册、codex-connect / dshmarket 服务正常
📌 你需要做的
重启 dsh web，然后新建一个对话再试工具调用（liblib-tv 那个 14:20 的旧会话历史已残缺，救不回来了）
以后用 pnpm 装完插件，如果 ~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/ 里又冒出 @deepseek-ai/ 目录，把这批核心包再删一次即可（hoisted 模式每次安装都会重新提升）——这也是个上游设计缺陷

discussions.title: Expose DSH_SESSION_ID and DSH_HOME to hook processes for runtime identification
discussions.body:
---
name: Feature
about: Add or intentionally change observable behavior
title: 'Inject DSH runtime-identifier environment variables into hook processes (DSH_SESSION_ID / DSH_HOME)'
labels: ''
assignees: ''
type: Feature
---

Allow hook processes to reliably determine that they are running inside DeepSeek Harness through dedicated environment variables, without having to infer the runtime from payload shape or from the absence of Claude Code / Codex signals.

<details>
<summary>Motivation & details</summary>

## Motivation

DeepSeek Harness runs user command hooks by reusing the Claude Code / Codex hook protocol through the `dsh-hooks-claude-code` and `dsh-hooks-codex` bridges. A hook therefore receives a stdin payload whose shape matches Claude Code or Codex, but its process environment carries no signal identifying that the actual runtime is DeepSeek Harness:

- `hooks-codex`'s `base()` (`packages/hooks/hooks-codex/src/index.ts:292`) injects no runtime-identifier environment variables, and the Codex-native signals (such as `CODEX_THREAD_ID`) do not exist in DSH.
- `hooks-claude-code` injects only `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR` (`packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/index.ts:151`).

This is a correctness problem for any hook that needs to distinguish its runtime. For example, a hook that performs runtime-specific bookkeeping can misclassify DSH as Codex — because the payload looks like Codex — and then read Codex-specific state that does not exist on the machine.

## Notable implementation facts

1. `runHook` in `runner.ts` (`packages/hooks/hook-protocol/src/runner.ts`) already supports injecting environment variables via `options.env`, merged after the executor's credential scrub.
2. `hooks-claude-code` already demonstrates the injection path: `runPoint()` builds `hookEnv = { CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR: projectDir }` and passes it to `runHook` (`src/index.ts:150-166`).
3. `hooks-codex` passes no `env`, making it the only bridge without any environment injection.
4. The session id is available through `agent.session.header.id`, which both bridges already access.
5. The DSH config root already follows the `$DSH_HOME` / `~/.dsh` convention (`packages/util/home-paths`), and `resolveDshHome()` can be reused.

## Proposed change

At the hook execution sites in both bridges, uniformly inject a set of DSH runtime-identifier environment variables, for example:

- `DSH_SESSION_ID` — the current session id (from `agent.session.header.id`; empty when no agent is available)
- `DSH_HOME` — the DSH config root (from `resolveDshHome()`)

A hook would then be able to detect the runtime deterministically via the presence of these variables, without conflicting with existing signals such as `CLAUDE_CODE` / `CODEX_THREAD_ID`.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] When `hooks-codex` runs a hook, the process environment contains `DSH_SESSION_ID` (non-empty when an agent is present) and `DSH_HOME`.
- [ ] When `hooks-claude-code` runs a hook, the same variables are injected and coexist without conflict with the existing `CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR`.
- [ ] The variables do not throw or crash for detached events that have no agent (for example, `SessionStart`).
- [ ] Unit tests cover the env-merge behavior (see `hooks-claude-code/tests` and `hooks-codex/tests` for reference).

## Additional considerations

- A runtime identifier could additionally be exposed in the payload (rather than only in the environment) for non-shell hook types.
- The proposed variables are additive and backward compatible; they do not change existing payloads or existing environment variables.

</details>

discussions.title: [Bug Report] macOS: directory-picker-auto resolves "native" for GUI-less launches (nohup/daemon) — "Add workspace" silently does nothing
discussions.body:
## Summary

On macOS, when `dsh web` runs without an interactive user-interaction context (started via `nohup … & disown`, a service manager, or any automation detached from the launching terminal), `directory-picker-auto` still resolves the `native` backend. Native picking then cannot work — and in this variant it fails **with no feedback at all**: no dialog, no in-page error, nothing in the log. The button just appears dead.

#335 looks like the GUI-adjacent variant of the same root cause, where osascript at least surfaces `execution error: 不允许用户交互。 (-1713)` ("user interaction not allowed"). In the detached-process case reported here, even that error never reaches the user.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, default `web` profile)
- macOS 26 (Darwin 25.5.0), Apple silicon; Chrome 150
- Launch: `zsh -lc 'nohup npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web > ~/dsh-web.log 2>&1 & disown'`

## Steps to reproduce

1. Launch as above — the point is that the server process has no controlling terminal / Aqua interaction context.
2. Open http://127.0.0.1:3080, dismiss the testing notice.
3. Click **Add workspace** (sidebar icon) or the **Choose workspace** chip.

## Actual behavior

- No native dialog appears, no in-page dialog appears, and `dsh-web.log` stays silent.
- The click handler does run: the workspace chip toggles to `aria-expanded="true"`, but zero `[role="dialog"]` / `[role="menu"]` nodes are ever added to the DOM.
- Net effect: workspace creation via the GUI is impossible, with nothing telling the user why.

## Expected behavior

Either the `browse` backend is selected for a deployment that cannot serve a native chooser, or the native failure is surfaced (the auto README promises the wrong-choice case "degrades to the backend's existing retryable failure dialog") instead of a silent no-op.

## Root-cause analysis

`resolveDirectoryPickerBackend` (`packages/host/directory-picker-auto`) picks `native` when: loopback bind ✓, `SSH_CONNECTION`/`SSH_TTY` unset ✓, and "a servable display session — **assumed on darwin/win32**". A nohup'd/daemonized process on macOS passes all three checks while having no user-interaction capability, so `native` wins and fails downstream (cf. #335's `-1713`).

The package README's Known Limitations already anticipates this family ("a Darwin process outside an Aqua session still counts as displayed") — but the failure mode observed here is silence, not the documented retryable dialog.

## Workarounds that work today

**1. Create the workspace over RPC** (works headless, no UI involved):

```bash
curl -s http://127.0.0.1:3080/api/workspace.create -H 'content-type: application/json' \
  -d '{"type":"client-request","rpcId":"cli","method":"workspace.create","payload":{"path":"/abs/path/to/project"}}'
```

Reload the page — the workspace appears and is selectable; sessions, tools, and file writes all work normally afterwards.

**2. Launch dsh from a real interactive terminal** (Aqua session) — the native picker then behaves as designed.

**3. What did *not* work:** pinning `-browse` via `cordis.patch.yml` (the seam's documented swap point). The host half mounts fine, but the browse client UI never renders — that half reproduces on macOS exactly as described in #1523 for Windows; details added there.

## Suggestions

- On darwin, replace the "assumed displayed" heuristic with a boot-time interaction probe (mirroring the linux zenity/kdialog probe) — e.g. a trivial osascript attempt with a short timeout, or an Aqua-session check — before resolving `native`.
- Make native-pick failures loud in the web UI; the silent path makes this look like a dead button.

Related: #335 (mac, GUI variant with `-1713`), #2683 (native dialog opens behind the browser window), #1523 (Windows native worker crash + browse client UI gap).

---
Full walkthrough with the working headless recipe (ambient key discovery, patch semantics, RPC surface): https://github.com/Grimnirobser/running-dsh-headless

discussions.title: Let out-of-repo plugins write durable session events (the deferred registration surface)
discussions.body:
`CONTRIBUTING.md` points bug reports and gaps here rather than at PRs, so this is a report plus a concrete (small) request. It concerns the deferred registration surface named in `known-event-types.ts`.

## Who is asking

I maintain [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh) ([npm](https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi2dsh)), a compatibility layer that runs Pi ecosystem plugins on DSH unmodified — installed the ordinary way (`dsh plugin add pi2dsh`, then `dsh plugin add <any-pi-plugin>`). It is a single out-of-repo plugin; there is no per-package code in it.

## The gap

Pi's extension API includes `appendEntry(customType, data)` — a plugin records an entry of its own type in the session. Reading the source of the 50 most-downloaded Pi packages, 12 of them call it, so it is not an exotic corner of that API.

DSH has the matching concept, and in-repo packages use it: declare the type into `SessionEventMap` and `session.append(...)`. `dsh-command-feedback` and `dsh-llm-retry` both do exactly that.

For an out-of-repo package, that path is closed today, and closed in a way that is invisible until it is too late:

- `packages/core/session/src/known-event-types.ts` is generated from `SessionEventMap` members **declared in this repository**, and its own comment says: *"Downstream (out-of-repo) plugin events are outside this list by construction; a registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists."*
- `packages/session/session-persistence/src/coordinator.ts` gates the read path on it:
  ```ts
  if (KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES.has(event.type) || event.ignorable === true) continue
  ```
- `Session.append<T extends SessionEventType>(type, data, ...opts)` has no way to set `ignorable`. In this repository only the seed path (`Session.create(id, events)`) produces an event carrying it.

So an out-of-repo plugin that declares its own type and appends it **succeeds at write time and produces a session that later refuses to load**. Writing is unguarded; the cost appears on the next read, as user data.

## What we do instead, and what it costs

pi2dsh keeps those entries in its own file next to the session, keyed by the same session id. That avoids corrupting anything, at a price worth naming: the entries are not in DSH's log, so **the host's own conversation view can never show them**, they are outside session export/replay, and it is a parallel store living beside a durable log that already solves this problem — which is precisely the kind of thing a compatibility layer should not have to build.

## The request

The smallest version, and the one we would use: **let `append` mark an event `ignorable: true`.**

```ts
session.append('pi/entry', data, { ignorable: true })
```

Nothing else has to change. The skip contract already exists, is documented on `SessionEvent.ignorable`, and is covered by tests in `packages/core/session/tests/session.spec.ts`. An out-of-repo type would then round-trip: written into the real log, skipped by any build that does not know it, never silently dropped when it matters.

A larger version, if you would rather have the vocabulary stay explicit: a namespaced registration (`ctx.sessions.registerEventType('pi2dsh/entry')`) that adds to the known set at runtime for this composition, with `ignorable` applied automatically. We do not need the typed ergonomics — the envelope marker is enough.

## Why now

The comment defers this "until such a consumer exists". This is that consumer, with a concrete shape: one plugin, one event type, log-only, never on the model-visible surface. Happy to be the guinea pig for whichever design you prefer, and to report back how it behaves in a real composition.

discussions.title: Web UI 中文输入法（IME）无法上屏 / 拼音残留
discussions.body:
Web UI 中文输入法（IME）无法上屏 / 拼音残留
环境：@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6（npm latest），dsh web @ http://127.0.0.1:3080；macOS（Apple Silicon）+ Chrome + macOS 简体拼音。

关联：#1051（IME 无法激活）、#1281（拼音残留）、#629 / #1417（透明输入框）。

TL;DR（English）
The composer <textarea> breaks macOS IME because of four independent defects in the InputBar implementation. I captured a live event log from the running GUI: on a healthy field, one compositionstart → accumulating compositionupdate → one compositionend; on the composer, compositionstart fired on every single keystroke (the composition was killed and restarted per key, so preedit never accumulated and committed text could be clobbered). Four fixes below make it work reliably.

根因（四个独立缺陷，叠加表现为时好时坏）
packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx：

1. readOnly 随 machineBusy 翻转，切断 macOS 的 IME 输入上下文
ts
复制
readOnly: machineBusy || workspaceTrigger
// machineBusy = input?.phase === "adjudicating" || input?.phase === "submitting"
Agent 开始/结束提交时，输入框在"只读/可写"之间翻转；macOS Chrome 下这会把该字段的 NSTextInputContext 直接切断，表现为"中文候选框永远调不出来，只能打英文"。

2. 组合期间受控值回写，逐键杀死组合（主因）
textarea 是受控组件 value: draft，而 draft 存于外部状态机（SessionInputShell → snapshot store）。IME 组合期间 React 会延迟 onChange（到 compositionend 才触发），于是 draft 保持旧值/空串，DOM 里却已经出现拼音 preedit。随后任意一次 React 的受控值校验/重渲染都会把旧值写回 DOM——每按一个字母组合就被杀掉一次，这就是事件日志里 compositionstart 逐键重来的原因，也直接导致"拼音残留"。

3. 提交瞬间旧值覆盖 + preedit 不可见
compositionend 时状态若未追上，选好的汉字会被旧 draft 覆盖（"选完词字就消失"）；且 textarea 是 color: transparent（可见文字由 backdrop 镜像层绘制），浏览器自绘的拼音下划线/候选不可见，加剧"打字只见英文"的观感。

4. 程序化 focus() 卡死 IME text-service（渲染进程级）
ts
复制
useEffect(() => { el.focus({ preventScroll: true }); ... }, [locked, sessionId])
挂载/切会话/locked 翻转时程序化 focus()，macOS Chrome 下可能把该渲染进程的 IME 会话卡死，且普通刷新无法恢复（复用同一渲染进程），只有新开标签页/窗口才行——这正是 #1051 里"重开窗口就好"的机制。

修复（已在本机 bundle 实测验证）
组合期间把 DOM 实时值镜像进受控 prop（核心）：新增 compValue state + 原生 input 监听，组合中 value = compValue，使 React 的 value 恒等于 DOM，杜绝旧值回写。
compositionend 后用 DOM 最终值回写 draft（带 ~10ms settle，兼容 Safari 的 Enter 确认时序）。
移除 readOnly 随 machineBusy 翻转（改用其他方式表达 busy）。
移除程序化 focus()，仅在用户已聚焦时做光标位置调整。
composingRef 生命周期加固：settle 定时器用句柄管理、compositionstart 清挂起、blur 强制复位（防止标志永久卡 true）。
CSS：组合中给 textarea 打 data-composing 属性，令 preedit 可见（textarea 恢复文字色、backdrop 临时透明）。
修复后事件日志恢复正常：每个词 compositionstart ×1 → compositionupdate 累积 → compositionend 上屏汉字，无逐键重启。

建议的上游修法（供 maintainer 参考）
组合期间采用 uncontrolled-during-composition 模式（或上述 compValue 镜像法），这是 React 受控输入框 IME 的标准解法；
所有程序化 focus() / 受控值写操作，用 composingRef || e.nativeEvent.isComposing 加守卫；
不要用 readOnly 翻转表达 busy，改 disabled 样式 / aria-busy；
composingRef 复位改为同步 + blur 兜底，去掉裸 setTimeout 竞态。

discussions.title: ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND for bundle plugins when dsh is installed with pnpm (non-flat node_modules)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- Node.js v22.22.2
- pnpm 11.20.0 (isolated `node_modules` layout, global virtual store on another drive)
- Windows 11 (win32 x64)

## Repro

```powershell
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
dsh web
```

Boot fails with `dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include)`. The aggregate error contains:

```
Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer' imported from ...\cordis-plugin-loader\lib\index.js
Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm' imported from ...
Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plan' imported from ...
(4 entries total)
```

The same package boots fine via `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`, which produces npm's flat `node_modules` layout.

## Analysis

Two separate problems surfaced:

1. **The flat fallback misses transitive bundle plugins.** `dsh-app-boot` maintains `$DSH_HOME/profiles/node_modules` as "one symlink per package in the dsh app's resolvable dependency closure". Under pnpm's isolated layout the closure walk comes up short: links are created for packages `@deepseek-ai/dsh` reaches directly, but bundle plugins such as `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` and `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-plan` get no link, and `@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-timer` gets a dangling one. Their plain dynamic `import(name)` fallback in `cordis-plugin-loader` then throws `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`, because with pnpm the loader's own real path can only see the loader's declared dependencies.

2. **Self-healing via the profile install also fails.** Installing the bundles into the profile (`dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-base @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`) produces an incomplete tree: the generated `pnpm-workspace.yaml` pins `autoInstallPeers: false`, while the plugins peer-depend on each other (e.g. `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm` imports `@deepseek-ai/dsh-timeout`, which never gets installed). After this, boot fails for every plugin entry (~110 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` errors), which is worse than the initial state.

## Workaround

A dedicated hoisted install boots fine and the Web UI serves on 127.0.0.1:3080:

```yaml
# pnpm-workspace.yaml next to a package.json that depends on @deepseek-ai/dsh
packages:
  - .
nodeLinker: hoisted
autoInstallPeers: true
allowBuilds:
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local': true
  '@google/genai': true
  koffi: true
  node-pty: true
  protobufjs: true
```

## Suggestion

- Build the `profiles/node_modules` fallback from the full bundle closure (or resolve plugin specifiers relative to the profile directory before falling back to a plain `import()`), and/or
- generate the profile scaffold with `autoInstallPeers: true`, so pnpm-managed installs behave like the npm/npx flat layout.

discussions.title: Idea: render settled mermaid fences as diagrams in the web GUI
discussions.body:
## Summary

Assistant replies carrying ` ```mermaid ` fences currently render as plain code blocks in the web GUI. The fence language already declares the intent — rendering the diagram in place would save a copy-paste round trip to an external renderer.

## Proposal

Add a settled-only `mermaid` branch to the markdown renderer's fence handling (`packages/client/ui-primitives`, mirroring the existing `math` fence precedent):

- Load mermaid behind a dynamic import (~500 KB stays out of the boot chunk; sessions without diagrams never pay it).
- Initialize once with `securityLevel: 'strict'` — fence source is untrusted assistant output, and mermaid DOMPurify-sanitizes labels before emitting the SVG.
- Validate with `mermaid.parse` before `mermaid.render`; any failure (chunk load, parse, or render) degrades to the source CodeBlock instead of throwing, matching the unknown-grammar fallback rule.
- While streaming, the fence stays a plain CodeBlock so the frozen-block streaming cache never bakes in async work.
- Theme: mermaid's built-in `neutral` palette. (`base` + `themeVariables` mapped to `--dsw-*` tokens was rejected: mermaid's color math cannot parse CSS `var()` references, and literal colors would violate the tokens-only styling rule and freeze diagrams against light/dark switches.)

## Working implementation

I have this implemented and fully gated on a fork branch: [`feat/mermaid-fence-rendering`](https://github.com/MarchLiu/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/mermaid-fence-rendering) (reviewable diff: [MarchLiu/deepseek-harness#1](https://github.com/MarchLiu/deepseek-harness/pull/1)).

- Unit tests mock the mermaid module and pin the loading/fallback contract; `MermaidBlock.tsx` and `render.tsx` hold 100% line/branch coverage; the byte-pinned markdown DOM-parity fixtures are untouched.
- A keyless assembled-browser e2e scenario (`apps/web/tests/mermaid-fence.e2e.ts`, hand-authored session fixture + Playwright Chromium + aria golden) proves the diagram replaces the source CodeBlock in the real app with no console warnings.
- Full local ladder green: `test:gui` (273 files / 3765 tests), `lint`, `doc-sync` (28 gates), `duplication`, `hygiene`, `DSH_SNAPSHOT=replay test:web` (76 files / 255 tests), and the full-repo `vitest run --coverage` gate (804 files / 13411 tests). An Agent Note in the repo's format is included.

I understand external pull requests are not accepted at the moment — posting this here in case the team wants to pick the idea (or the branch) up. Happy to adjust the design (theme mapping, error affordance, rendering site) if a different direction fits better.

discussions.title: directory-picker-auto resolves native behind reverse proxies (tailscale serve etc.) - proposed trustedHosts fix
discussions.body:
## Summary

When `dsh web` serves remote browsers through a reverse proxy on a loopback bind (tailscale serve, cloudflared, SSH remote forwarding), the adaptive directory picker resolves the **native** backend: `resolveDirectoryPickerBackend` chooses `native` for any `127.0.0.1` bind on darwin/win32, assuming every browser behind the bind sits at the host display. A remote browser cannot drive the host OS chooser — the dialog opens on the unattended host, and picking a workspace directory fails from a phone or laptop.

## Evidence this is a real gap

- The shipped web composition itself works around it: `apps/web/tests/pin-browse-picker.overlay.yml` pins the browse interaction for the Playwright smoke because "the resolved native backend cannot be driven from the page".
- Remote deployments must hand-apply the same disable+insert overlay to be usable (there is a growing ecosystem of docs for exactly this: tailscale serve + `--trusted-host` guides).

## Proposed fix (small, boot-time only)

Add a `trustedHosts` signal to `DirectoryPickerHostFacts`, sampled once at boot from the composing bundle's `webRuntime` service (the same authorities the /api browser-trust fence serves). A non-empty sample resolves `browse` before the platform display signals:

```ts
export function resolveDirectoryPickerBackend(facts: DirectoryPickerHostFacts): DirectoryPickerBackendKind {
  if (facts.bindHost !== '127.0.0.1') return 'browse'
  if (facts.trustedHosts.length > 0) return 'browse'
  if (present(facts.env.SSH_CONNECTION) || present(facts.env.SSH_TTY)) return 'browse'
  // ...unchanged
}
```

A deployment that names `--trusted-host` authorities (or derived LAN literals) serves remote browsers by definition, and the in-browser picker works everywhere. Deployments without authorities keep the prior resolution (attended loopback still resolves `native`). The bundle's `directory-picker` row injects `webRuntime`, mirroring the existing `connection` row pattern.

## Verification

- 31 tests green (unit cases + real-Loader composition with a `webRuntime` stub; bundle web-app tests unchanged)
- Full-repo `pnpm run typecheck` and `pnpm run lint` pass

## Status

Reproduced on a real tailscale serve + `--trusted-host` deployment (phone browser could not pick a workspace directory), fixed locally, and shipped to the ecosystem as a plugin: [dsh-remote-picker](https://github.com/Yuuichu/dsh-remote-picker) (npm `dsh-remote-picker@0.1.0`, install: `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-remote-picker`). Happy to inline the full 10-file diff here if useful.

discussions.title: [RFC] dsh 社区插件互操作标准 v0.15 —— Manifest、Capability 协商与事件契约（社区讨论稿，征求意见）
discussions.body:
RFC: dsh 社区插件互操作标准 v0.15 —— Manifest、Capability 协商与事件契约

字段 | 内容 -- | -- 日期 | 2026-08-17 状态 | 社区 Draft v0.15。社区讨论稿，不是官方标准，也不自称官方标准 来源 | community#23（首轮 RFC + 13 条评论）→ community#24（v0.1 定稿 + 第三轮 5 条评论）→ 本文（v0.15）。另参考 dsh-community-fabric 中的 4 份 Draft RFC 反馈方式 | 直接在本帖评论，或到 omdsh-dev/community 开 issue / PR。新评论不会静默改写 Draft：变更先过审查，再更新处置记录

本文由 dsh 社区生态开发者共同讨论形成。感谢 btspoony、morlay、mattheliu、shine-233、r05En1cU、Lipraty、qing3a、T-Auto、Yan-Zero、Qiuner、t4wefan 等所有参与讨论的开发者。对正文有意见请直接回复；想认领某份子 RFC（0002 / 0003 / 0004）的评审，到 omdsh-dev/community 开 issue 即可。

# RFC: dsh 社区插件互操作标准 v0.15 —— Manifest、Capability 协商与事件契约 ## 0. 一句话摘要 给 dsh 生态定一套**与 dsh 上游版本解耦**的插件标准：插件用一份静态 manifest 声明"我是谁、我需要什么能力"；宿主（GUI / Web UI / TUI / 启动器）先协商、再授权、再按统一的生命周期激活插件。做一件事只有一种明确的方法。 类比一句话就能懂：**我们要做的是 Chrome 扩展那套（manifest + 权限声明 + 统一 API），而不是每家浏览器自己发明一遍插件机制。** Minecraft 社区用 Forge/Fabric 证明过：即使官方不参与，社区标准也能成为事实标准。 v0.15 相比 v0.1 主要变了三件事（§5 有完整清单）： 1. **内核瘦身成"元协议"**：协商内核只认契约坐标，不再内置任何具体业务字段；每项能力契约独立版本化，改一个领域不用全生态跟着发版。 2. **引入 Facet 对象模型**：正面回答"一个插件同时需要后端逻辑和界面呈现怎么办"——这不是特例，是常态（调研样本 12 个插件里 9 个是双面的）。 3. **消息内容对齐 MCP `ContentBlock`**：行业已经收敛到这个结构了，我们不自造格式。 范围仍然刻意很小：**没有沙箱承诺、没有可修改拦截、没有插件间 service、没有跨端 UI——这些全部显式延期为独立 RFC**（§6）。 --- ## 1. 我们要解决什么问题 dsh 火了之后，社区自发长出了三种主要终端（GUI、Web UI、TUI）、若干启动器和分发渠道，awesome 目录快照已经收录了 **3,809 个插件仓库**。生态很繁荣，但底下有三条裂缝，而且都在变宽。 **第一条：插件靠 patch 活着。** 我们对 12 个代表性开源插件做了源码调研（[[完整报告](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/master/dsh-community-fabric/docs/research/dsh-plugin-needs.zh.md)](https://github.com/anywhere-labs/deepseek-harness-desktop/blob/master/dsh-community-fabric/docs/research/dsh-plugin-needs.zh.md)），多数插件靠源码 patch、monkey patch、内部事件名或 `ctx.get()` 反射探测来实现功能。这不是插件作者的错——官方接缝缺失时他们别无选择——但结果是 dsh 每更新一次，生态就批量炸一轮。分发渠道被迫用"插件 A@0.1 + B@0.3 + dsh@0.5.0"式的整包锁版本对抗接口不稳定，治标不治本。历史还演过一次更惨的：早期大家各写各的 loader，官方引入统一注册方式后，所有第三方 loader 一夜全废。教训很清楚：**依赖实现的生态会死，依赖标准的生态才能穿越上游的更新周期。** **第二条：装上才知道炸。** 现有 manifest 只有包名和 patch 文件列表。宿主、市场、启动器都无法在执行代码前回答最基本的问题：这个插件需要图形界面吗？要读会话吗？要联网吗？能在 TUI 上跑吗？用户在 TUI 里装一个需要 GUI 的插件，唯一的"报错方式"是崩溃。 **第三条：谁后加载谁赢。** 多个插件改同一个行为时，没有声明、没有顺序、没有冲突规则，实际仲裁者是加载顺序。插件互相打架时，用户和排障者都回答不了"这个东西到底是谁改的"。 上游改内核的意愿和节奏我们控制不了，社区也明确不接受激进的内核改动。所以本标准的第一原则是：**标准的存续不依赖 dsh 上游的任何决定。** ## 2. 三轮讨论收敛出的八条原则 每条背后都有具体反例撑着，出处见附录 A。 **① 静态可分析。** manifest 是包根目录里的一个静态 JSON 文件，禁止运行代码生成，宿主加载时也不从网络取 schema。这样市场、启动器、校验工具不用执行插件代码就能完成发现、校验和协商——"装上才知道炸"从机制上消失。 **② 五类声明不混淆。** "我依赖什么"（requires）、"我申请什么授权"（permissions）、"我能给别人提供什么"（provides）、"我给产品贡献什么静态元数据"（contributes）、"我想订阅什么事件"（subscriptions）是五种不同的语义，不能压进一个泛化的 capabilities 容器里。v0.15 的 schema 只接受已有具体契约的子集，并且**直接拒绝** `provides` 和 `requires.services`——插件间服务的组合规则还没定（归 RFC 0003），定好之前不开口子。 **③ 协商 + 诚实降级。** required 能力缺失 → 装/激活之前就明确拒载，并用人话解释原因（"该插件需要图形界面能力，当前终端不支持"）；optional 能力缺失 → 走插件声明过的降级路径。市场对每个插件只展示五种状态，且不许互相升级：**声明兼容 / 等待授权 / 已实测 / 不兼容 / 未知**。"声明兼容"永远不等于"已实测"，更不等于"安全"。 **④ capability 不是沙箱，这话必须说在明处。** v0.15 是 trusted-in-process 档位：插件和宿主跑在同一个 Node.js 进程里，受信任的代码在技术上完全可以绕过 `ctx` 直接调系统接口。capability 声明服务于兼容判断、用户授权和事后审计，**不构成安全边界**——宿主必须显著公示这一点，不许把"声明过了"包装成"被拦住了"。真正的隔离执行（进程/realm 隔离、受控 IPC）是独立的后续 RFC。 **⑤ 上游变化收敛到 Adapter，扛不住就明说。** 插件只依赖稳定契约；版本化的 DSH Adapter 是整个体系里**唯一**允许 import 上游 runtime 的层，也是唯一吸收上游变化的地方。上游哪天不再暴露某项能力需要的观察点，Adapter 必须下线对应 capability 并报告原因——**不能用私有 patch 猜语义，返回一个"看起来成功"的近似结果**。运行时方法替换这类技术（dsh-neoforge 的 mixin PoC）只能作为锁定版本的 Adapter 实验存在，它的私有 target 永远不进插件可见的 API。 **⑥ 确定性与可归属。** 加载顺序永远不做冲突仲裁。所有标准注册都经过 Broker，归属到"哪个插件的哪一次激活"，并记进一份最小 effect ledger——排障时能直接回答"这个命令/面板/残留资源是谁创建的，停用之后清理干净了没有"。 **⑦ 元协议内核，领域契约各自升级。**（v0.15 新增）协商内核是领域无关的：它只认 `apiVersion + kind` 形式的契约引用和 requires/supports 声明，本身不含任何业务字段。commands、storage、messages——以及未来的 model provider、tool、settings——每一项都是独立版本化的契约，自己演进。为什么要这样：Model Provider、工具渐进式披露、Response/Reasoning 字段这些东西是上游模型生态推着跑的，演进极快，中心化的固定 SDK 扛不住这个节奏。某个领域升级时，只有那份契约和用它的插件需要动，内核、无关插件和宿主都不用重新发版。 **⑧ 参考实现不是标准。**（v0.15 从验收标准提升为原则）Fabric、Desktop、TUI 都只是参考实现和一致性证据的提供方。一个行为只有写进**规范文本 + registry + fixtures + 一致性测试**才算契约；任何单一实现的行为——包括参考实现——都不自动成为标准。 ## 3. 架构与对象模型 ### 3.1 四层架构 ```text 插件代码 ──只依赖──▶ Fabric SDK / 稳定契约 ▼ Capability Broker（校验、协商、授权、生命周期、资源归属） ▼ 版本化 DSH Adapter（唯一允许吸收上游变化的层） ▼ 官方 dsh / Cordis runtime（不要求任何修改） ``` 官方现有的 package manifest、Cordis service、slot、profile 组合机制原样继续工作，一行都不用改。 ### 3.2 元协议内核：内核只认"面单"，不管"包裹"（v0.15 新增） v0.1 把三项 capability 的定义和协商器写在一起。第三轮讨论指出这是个中心化发版瓶颈：任何一个领域标准微调，主 SDK 和 Broker 就得发新版，然后全生态跟进——这恰恰是我们批评过的"整包锁版本"的翻版。 v0.15 把它拆开。可以把内核想成快递系统：**它只认面单格式，不管包裹里装的是什么。** - **内核（元协议）** 只做三件事：解析参与者声明、解析 `apiVersion + kind` 契约引用、做 requires/supports 匹配，最后输出一份机器可读的协商报告。宿主、市场、启动器、CI 消费的是同一份报告格式。 - **领域契约（独立版本化）** 是 Registry 里一条条带不可变 schema hash 的独立规格书，用类 Kubernetes 的坐标标识（示意，最终命名以 Registry 定案为准）： | 契约坐标（示意） | kind | 对应 v0.1 里的名字 | | --- | --- | --- | | `commands.dsh/v1alpha1` | `Command` | `commands` | | `storage.dsh/v1alpha1` | `LocalStorage` | `storage.local` | | `messages.dsh/v1alpha1` | `MessageObserver` | `messages.observe` | `v1alpha1` 老老实实标明这是实验期（可能 breaking），不伪装成稳定 `1.x`。私有扩展继续用组织命名空间（`x-org.example.*`），Registry 里为官方保留了命名空间——未来官方能力可以直接以一等身份入驻。 这次重构**不改变** v0.15 的能力范围（还是那三项），只改变它们的标识和版本化方式。已有一个独立探索实现验证了这条路：[[Yan-Zero/dsh-std](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std)](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-std)。 ### 3.3 Facet 对象模型：插件的"分身"（v0.15 新增方向） 调研里最扎眼的数字：12 个样本插件里 **9 个**同时需要宿主侧逻辑和客户端呈现。跨面（face）不是少数特例，是有一定复杂度的 dsh 插件的常态。v0.1 只有一个 `entrypoints.host`，到了 TUI / Web / Remote SSH 场景必然捉襟见肘。 v0.15 引入四级对象模型作为规范术语： ```text Component（分发包——一个 dsh-plugin.json 对应一个） └─ Facet（分面——插件在某个位置的"分身"：host / client / worker） └─ Activation（一次激活——生命周期与清理的作用域） └─ Participant（协商实体——上岗后去和 Broker 谈 requires/supports 的代表） ``` 打个比方：Component 是你下载的那个安装包；Facet 是插件派驻到不同位置的分身——host 分身跑在宿主侧管逻辑，client 分身贴着界面管呈现，worker 分身在后台干重活；Activation 是某个分身的一次"上岗"，上岗期间创建的所有资源都记在这次上岗名下，下岗时统一回收；Participant 是上岗时去和 Broker 谈判的代表——"我需要这些能力，我能提供这些东西"。 **v0.15 只规范 `host` facet 的契约**；`client` 和 `worker` 作为保留名，它们的契约要和 Runtime / Presentation 分层一起在 RFC 0002 里定——Remote SSH 反例已经证明"代码在哪执行、界面长什么样、谁有权批准"是三个独立维度，靠 `isRemote` / `hostType` 这种字段修补只会埋新雷。 插件代码长这样（已在 dsh-codex 的便携化重构里跑通，见[[分支](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-codex/tree/agent/std-facet-runtime)](https://github.com/Yan-Zero/dsh-codex/tree/agent/std-facet-runtime)）： ```ts export default defineFacet(activation => { activation.extensions.publish( { apiVersion: 'commands.dsh/v1alpha1', kind: 'Command' }, 'codex', commandHandler) activation.scope.add(() => commandHandler.dispose()) }) ``` 插件只依赖标准 Facet 上下文，通过契约扩展点发布能力，生命周期由作用域自动回收——不碰宿主私有 API，不被任何特定运行时绑死。 ### 3.4 一个最小 manifest 长什么样 ```json { "$schema": "https://dsh-std.example/schemas/dsh-plugin/v0.15.json", "id": "com.example.better-sidebar", "name": "Better Sidebar", "version": "1.2.0", "manifestVersion": "0.15", "facets": { "host": { "entry": "dist/host.js", "apiVersion": "v1alpha1" } }, "requires": { "contracts": [ { "apiVersion": "storage.dsh/v1alpha1", "kind": "LocalStorage" }, { "apiVersion": "messages.dsh/v1alpha1", "kind": "MessageObserver", "optional": true } ] }, "permissions": [], "contributes": { "commands": [{ "id": "com.example.better-sidebar.toggle", "title": "Toggle Sidebar" }] }, "subscriptions": ["messages.observe"] } ``` 两个容易被问到的细节： - 文件名**特意不叫 `plugin.json`**——那个名字已经被 [[Agent Plugins Specification](https://agent-plugins.org/)](https://agent-plugins.org/) 占了。一个包可以同时携带两份文件、支持两套生态，互不干扰。 - `contributes` 里的 id 用反向域名风格并要求全局唯一，所以校验器能做**跨插件的静态冲突检测**：两个插件贡献了同一个 id，装之前就报"冲突，不能共存"，而不是等加载时互相覆盖。 ## 4. v0.15 的精确范围 原则不变：**每一项进入范围的能力，都必须同时有 schema、fixture 和能在 headless 环境跑的一致性测试。给不出测试的能力，一律延期。** ### 4.1 交付物清单 | # | 交付物 | 一句话说明 | | --- | --- | --- | | 1 | `dsh-plugin.json` Manifest Schema | 包根目录静态 JSON；`$schema` 必填；含 `facets` 结构（v0.15 仅规范 `host`） | | 2 | Host Descriptor Schema | 宿主的机器可读自述：实现了哪些契约（坐标 + 版本）、执行环境与信任档位、平台 | | 3 | Capability / Event Registry | 权威注册表，带不可变 schema hash，按 §3.2 坐标组织；不许从 RFC 正文自行发明"等价"名称；为官方保留命名空间 | | 4 | 元协议协商内核 | 纯函数：manifest × Host Descriptor → 兼容/拒载/待授权 + 机器可读报告；领域无关，不依赖 dsh 就能测试 | | 5 | 生命周期契约 | `discover → validate → negotiate → authorize → activating → active → deactivating → disposed`；以 runtime generation 为作用域的 eager 激活（无按需激活）；正常关闭 best-effort 停用，插件清理必须设计成可重复执行 | | 6 | 三项领域契约 | 见 §4.2 | | 7 | Broker + 最小 effect ledger | 注册归属 + 只追加的转移记录（create / bind / replace / release / cleanup-failed）；默认不写消息正文和 secret | | 8 | Conformance 套件 | 合法/非法 fixtures + headless 测试：协商、授权拒绝、激活顺序、异常捕获、重复激活、清理 | ### 4.2 三项领域契约细则 **`storage.local`** —— 插件私有持久化，按 Component 隔离。不提供跨插件共享：共享存储本质是插件间组合问题，归 RFC 0003。 **`commands`** —— 只支持 flat action leaf：一个全局唯一 ID 对应一个 handler，完事。没有 command tree、没有交互式 prompt、没有流式输出——这三样全都依赖 Runtime / Presentation 分层（Remote SSH 场景下子命令树丢在半路的具体反例见 #23 讨论），归 RFC 0002。 **`messages.observe`** —— **不可修改**的消息观察事件，带版本化信封：`eventId`、scope 内单调序号、`privacyClass`、裁剪摘要、不可变 payload。（v0.15 新增）payload 里的消息内容采用与 [MCP `ContentBlock`](https://modelcontextprotocol.io/specification/2026-07-28/schema#contentblock) 对齐的结构——理由很简单：ACP / MCP / ToolCall 返回已经在收敛到这个结构了，我们自造一套格式，收益是零，代价是传递信息丢失外加一层多余的序列化。对齐的精确字段边界是本轮征求意见的重点（§9 第 3 问）。 ### 4.3 版本模型 六个版本维度，不许混成一个字段：插件自身 `version`｜`manifestVersion`（manifest 结构）｜facet `apiVersion`（要求的 Host API 范围）｜**各领域契约版本（v0.15 起随契约坐标独立演进）**｜宿主产品版本｜SDK 发布版本。v0 阶段按"minor 可能 breaking"的实验规则明确标注。 ### 4.4 验收标准与表述边界 v0.15 从 Draft 晋级，需要**至少两个独立宿主产品/集成**（可以共享同一个版本化 DSH Adapter，但集成与 descriptor 证据必须独立）与**三个示例插件**跑通同一组 headless 场景。dsh-TUI 已认领第一个标准兼容宿主的落地（Manifest 严格校验、协商拒载提示、生命周期顺序、机器可读能力清单，与溯源记录联动）。 表述边界划死：宿主只能说"通过 v0.15 Host conformance"，插件只能说"通过 v0.15 plugin validation"——**谁都不能说"安全插件"或"官方认证"。** ## 5. v0.1 → v0.15 变更记录 第三轮讨论（#24 下 5 条评论）的全部意见与处置： | 意见（提出者） | 处置 | 落点 | | --- | --- | --- | | 内核应为领域无关元协议，契约可拔插、独立版本化，避免中心化 SDK 频繁发版（Yan-Zero，附 dsh-std 探索实现） | 标准管理的插件走标准入口；非标准插件与内置扩展在迁移期是明确的产品边界，不受影响。 3. **不代表官方发声。** 所有文档均标注"社区标准、非官方"；一致性表述有明确边界（§4.4）。 ### 7.2 我们请求什么 1. **观察点变更的可见性。** Adapter 是整个体系里唯一吸收上游变化的层，它需要的不是"上游别变"，而是"变了能知道"。请求：session / message / tool 调用等核心业务事件的观察点发生变更或移除时，在 changelog 或 release note 里标注一下。**这是成本最低、对生态稳定性收益最大的一项。** 2. **命名空间确认。** 请求确认：包根目录 `dsh-plugin.json` 文件名、`*.dsh/*` 契约坐标、`dsh-*` 前缀，是否与官方现有或近期规划冲突。Registry 已为官方保留命名空间，未来官方能力可直接以一等身份入驻。 3. **参与治理，深度自选。** 治理 RFC（RFC 0000：评审期、决策方式、异议流程、breaking change 与弃用窗口）正在起草。观察员、评审者、共同维护者，任意身份都欢迎；也欢迎对 §9 的具体问题直接给意见。 ### 7.3 对官方的价值 3,809 个插件仓库背后的 patch 与内部接口依赖，目前每一次都由官方更新"背锅"。互操作层落地后，兼容压力从"官方 vs 所有插件"收敛为"Adapter 一个点"，上游迭代的生态阻力显著下降；兼容信息静态化后，"装上就炸"类负面体验不再归因于 dsh 本体。标准由社区治理并承担维护成本；官方任意时点采纳的成本都很低（映射一层 Adapter），不采纳也不受损。 ## 8. 落地计划 | 阶段 | 内容 | 状态 | | --- discussions.title: https://www.deepseek.com/harness/ crashes with "Application error" when WebGL is unavailable
discussions.body:
Environment: Chrome 151, macOS 14, Apple Silicon (M3 Max), GPU/driver healthy.
Trigger: Chrome's "Use hardware acceleration when available" is disabled, so WebGL 
context creation fails.

Console errors:
  THREE.WebGLRenderer: A WebGL context could not be created. Reason: ... 
  GL_VENDOR = Disabled, GL_RENDERER = Disabled ... BindToCurrentSequence failed
  THREE.WebGLRenderer: Error creating WebGL context.
  Error: Error creating WebGL context. (2c7bdfb3.js)

Reproduce:
  1. chrome://settings/system → disable "Use graphics acceleration when available"
  2. Fully restart Chrome
  3. Open https://www.deepseek.com/harness/ → whole page shows 
     "Application error: a client-side exception has occurred"

The hero 3D animation (three.js) has no fallback when WebGL is unavailable, and the 
exception takes down the entire page via the Next.js error boundary.

Suggestion: detect WebGL support before initializing three.js and render a static/CSS 
fallback, so the page still works on browsers/devices without WebGL.

discussions.title: Bug: native folder picker opens without focus when adding a workspace (Windows)
discussions.body:
## Summary

When adding a workspace from the Web GUI on Windows, the "Select Workspace Directory" dialog opens but does **not** receive keyboard focus. The operator has to click the dialog before typing/selecting, and the picker appears to "flash" in the taskbar instead of activating.

## Environment

- OS: Windows (reproduced on Windows 11, Node 24)
- DSH: web GUI at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`, host running locally
- Browser: any — the GUI runs in the browser while the node host is a background process

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start DSH locally (web GUI + node host).
2. Make sure the browser window is the foreground window.
3. Click **Add workspace** in the GUI.
4. The native folder dialog appears — but without focus.

## Expected vs actual

- **Expected:** the dialog opens with keyboard focus so the user can immediately select a folder.
- **Actual:** the dialog opens unactivated; focus stays in the browser; the taskbar button flashes.

## Root cause

The Windows picker is implemented as a spawned child process (`IFileOpenDialog` via koffi in `packages/host/directory-picker-native`). The original design assumed that because the dialog is the child's first window, Windows would activate it automatically. That only holds when the spawning process is the foreground process. Here the dialog child is spawned by the node host, which is a background server — the foreground process is the browser — so the child fails Windows' foreground-lock conditions and the dialog opens without activation (Windows flashes the taskbar instead).

## Suggested fix

Before showing the dialog, the child process should attach its thread's input queue to the foreground thread's input queue (`AttachThreadInput`), then detach after `Show` returns. Sharing the queue makes the system treat the child as having received the foreground's last input event, so the dialog's window-creation activation passes the foreground lock. The attach should be best-effort: no foreground window / UIPI integrity separation falls back to the current unfocused behavior, and the pick itself is never blocked.

## Additional info

- Reproduced and fixed locally on Windows; the fix was verified with a smoke test asserting `GetForegroundWindow` belongs to the dialog process while it is open.
- A local branch with the fix exists for reference (kept in a fork only — not submitted as an external PR, per the contribution policy).

discussions.title: 建议：提供官方插件更新生命周期与“重启扩展服务”能力
discussions.body:
> 这是对 [#1231](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1231) 的中文补充。#1231 主要讨论安全重启宿主；这里希望进一步讨论从“发现新版本”到“安全生效、失败回滚”的完整插件更新链路，以及长期是否需要类似 VS Code Extension Host 的独立扩展宿主。

## 背景

我正在为一个第三方插件增加基于 GitHub Tags 的版本检查。实际开发中发现：

- **检查新版本比较容易**；
- **把新版本安全安装并立即生效很难**。

当前已加载的插件代码涉及 ESM 模块缓存和仍在运行的 Cordis 注册。插件直接覆盖自身文件后，很难保证旧代码已完整卸载；使用 cache-busting 重新导入还可能产生重复模块实例。另一方面，让普通插件自己处理 Windows、Linux、Docker、systemd、PM2 等环境下的进程重启，也会带来权限、安全和可靠性问题。

因此，插件更新流程往往只能停在“更新已安装，请手动重启 DeepSeek Harness”。

## 已有社区实践

社区已经出现了相关尝试：

- [#1812 dsh-check-update](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1812) 已实现 DSH 与插件的新版本检测，但更新后仍需要用户执行命令或手动重启；
- [#2687 社区插件市场](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2687) 展示了插件安装、启停、卸载、备份回滚和一键重启的完整流程。

这些实践说明插件更新和生命周期管理存在明确需求。但目前相关能力由社区插件自行实现，不同插件需要分别处理包管理、配置修改、进程重启和跨平台兼容，也需要获得较高的系统权限。

因此，这些案例更适合作为官方提供统一、最小权限生命周期接口的依据，而不是长期让每个插件重复实现一套进程管理方案。

## 建议：分阶段提供官方能力

### 第一阶段：官方的安全重启能力

可以先提供一个由宿主控制的生命周期接口，例如：

```ts
await ctx.appLifecycle.requestRestart({
  reason: "Plugin update installed",
  waitForIdle: true,
})
```

建议同时提供：

- 设置页中的“重启扩展服务”或“重启 Harness”按钮；
- 重启前检测正在运行的任务，并允许等待任务结束或由用户确认中断；
- 保留会话、配置和轨迹数据；
- Web 页面在短暂断开后自动重连；
- 为 PM2、systemd、Docker、Windows 等环境定义统一的重启契约，例如稳定退出码或官方 launcher 行为；
- 仅允许经过授权的插件请求重启，真正的进程控制仍由宿主执行。

即使第一阶段暂时只能重启整个 Harness，也能先解决社区插件“更新后无法安全生效”的核心问题。

### 第二阶段：标准插件更新生命周期

建议由 Harness/CLI 提供统一的更新执行能力，而不是每个插件自行调用包管理器或修改运行目录：

1. 从 npm、GitHub Releases/Tags 等来源发现版本；
2. 下载到临时目录；
3. 校验插件清单、版本兼容性、校验和（未来可加入签名）；
4. 备份当前版本并原子替换；
5. 等待活动任务结束；
6. 重启扩展服务或 Harness；
7. 执行健康检查，失败时自动回滚。

插件可以负责展示版本信息和发起请求，但安装、替换、重启、回滚应由官方宿主能力完成。

### 长期方向：独立的扩展宿主进程

如果架构允许，可以考虑类似 VS Code Extension Host 的模式：

- 插件运行在独立进程；
- 更新插件时只重启扩展宿主，不必重启 Web UI 和核心服务；
- 单个插件崩溃不直接拖垮整个 Harness；
- 更容易实现权限隔离、资源限制和故障恢复；
- 从根本上避免已加载模块缓存导致的更新困难。

这会明显增加架构复杂度，因此可以作为长期方向；短期先落地官方的安全重启接口。

## 期望的用户体验

> 检查更新 → 查看版本与变更 → 用户确认 → 宿主下载并校验 → 备份旧版本 → 等待活动任务结束 → 重启扩展服务/Harness → 自动重连并健康检查 → 失败自动回滚

这样既能接近 VS Code 插件更新的体验，也能避免普通插件自行获得过大的文件系统和进程控制权限。

## 想请教维护者

1. 官方是否认可类似 `appLifecycle.requestRestart()` 的宿主能力？
2. 当前架构是否计划支持独立的插件/扩展宿主进程？
3. 官方期望的插件更新来源和安装接口是什么：npm、GitHub Release，还是统一 registry？
4. 是否可以采用“插件只能请求，宿主负责执行”的权限模型？

## 与 #2714 的关系

[#2714 社区插件互操作标准](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2714) 主要解决插件 Manifest、Capability 协商、兼容性判断与确定性生命周期问题；本提案聚焦其上层的实际更新执行链路，包括安装替换、安全重启、健康检查和失败回滚。

如果 #2714 的契约方向得到采用，本提案中的 `plugin.update`、`lifecycle.restart` 等能力可以作为独立 Capability Contract 接入其协商机制，两者可以互补而不必形成两套体系。

## 相关讨论

- [#2714 社区插件互操作标准 v0.15](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2714)
- [#1231 Host capability: graceful self-restart for plugin managers](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1231)
- [#1812 dsh-check-update：DSH 更新检查器](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1812)
- [#1846 Community plugin registry contract + first-class plugin checks](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1846)
- [#2687 社区插件市场：生命周期管理与一键自动重启](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2687)

discussions.title: dsh-executive-diligence：用 DSH 写的高管背调技能（Apache-2.0 开源）
discussions.body:
用 DeepSeek Harness 写了一个完整的「企业高管背调」技能插件，已开源：**[dsh-executive-diligence](https://github.com/bocai-harry/dsh-executive-diligence)**（Apache-2.0）。

## 它能做什么

- 五阶段背调工作流：基础信息 → 全网检索（可叠加 deep-research）→ 社交监控 → 事件脉络 → 报告 + 负面台账（Excel）
- 三种模式（快速 / 标准 / 深度），开始时可让用户选择
- 多平台扫码登录获取 Cookie：微博 / 小红书 / 抖音 / 知乎 / 视频号助手 / 公众号平台 / 微信网页版
- 搜狗公众号检索工具（翻页 + 去重 + 日期解析 + JSON 输出）
- 全程只用公开信息；事实 / 指控 / 传闻三级标注；同名他人明确区分；每条结论带信源

## 用 DSH 开发的体验

整个 skill 就是 `SKILL.md` 指令文档 + 几个 Python 脚本（`login.py` / `get_cookies.py` / `sogou_search.py` / `build_ledger.py`），agent 按文档驱动流程执行。平台边界（比如微信视频号没有网页检索渠道、小红书未登录也下发匿名 `web_session` 会误触发自动检测）都是实测踩坑后沉淀成 [platform-matrix.md](https://github.com/bocai-harry/dsh-executive-diligence/blob/main/docs/platform-matrix.md) 文档。

## 链接

- 仓库：https://github.com/bocai-harry/dsh-executive-diligence
- 文档：https://github.com/bocai-harry/dsh-executive-diligence/blob/main/docs/platform-matrix.md
- 贡献：DCO + CLA（[CLA.md](https://github.com/bocai-harry/dsh-executive-diligence/blob/main/CLA.md)）

> 说明：这是社区技能插件，与 deepseek-ai 官方仓库无关联，仅作为使用 DSH 开发插件的示例分享。欢迎 Issue / PR。

discussions.title: key欠费导致中断后，充值之后任务无法恢复也无法终止
MacOs 上报错 posix_spawnp failed 的可能原因？
discussions.body: - 极简模式 - Full Access - 中转站的 gpt-5.6-luna - MacOS 26.6.1 疑似是安装时候的 OpenCode 分析如下 ```md 根因：node-pty 1.1.0 的 spawn-helper 丢失执行位 posix_spawnp failed.（注意带句号、无 errno）是 node-pty 的固定报错文本，不是 bash 命令本身的问题。你的机器上存在 node-pty 1.1.0 的知名上游 bug（microsoft/node-pty#850 (https://github.com/microsoft/node-pty/issues/850)）：npm tarball 里 macOS 预编译的 spawn-helper 以 0644 发布，pnpm（含 pnpx）保留该权限，导致二进制不可执行。 复现（你的 pnpm store 里）： $ ls -la .../node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-arm64/ -rw-r--r-- spawn-helper ← 无执行位 $ node -e "const pty=require('node-pty'); pty.spawn('/bin/bash',...)" THROW: posix_spawnp failed. ← 就是你看到的报错 $ chmod +x spawn-helper && 重跑 DATA: "PTY-OUTPUT works" ← 立即恢复 修复 chmod +x \ ~/Library/pnpm/store/v11/links/@/node-pty/1.1.0/*/node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-arm64/spawn-helper \ ~/Library/pnpm/store/v11/links/@/node-pty/1.1.0/*/node_modules/node-pty/prebuilds/darwin-x64/spawn-helper pnpm 的 links 是软链到 store 同一 inode，改一次即对所有项目生效。根治方案：等上游 node-pty ≥1.2.0-beta（tarball 已修复为 0755）。 ``` 经验证， 在 pnpx 启动 dsh 的时候， 不安装 node-pty， 不会再发生这个错误。

discussions.title: [bug]沙箱提权 `same-mode` 请求报 `not strictly wider` 并导致模型重试死循环
discussions.body:
## 现象

配置 OpenAI 类模型（如 `gpt-5.6-sol`，走 `openai-responses` 代理）后，会话里持续刷红：

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
```

模型反复重试、反复报错，几乎每次 `bash` 调用都被拒，进入死循环。

## 复现条件

1. 使用 OpenAI/Codex 类模型；
2. 会话有效沙箱权限切换到 `workspace-write` 或 `danger-full-access`；
3. 模型在工具调用里**预防性地**带上 `sandbox_permissions` + `justification`，而不是只在看到 `[sandbox: file access denied ...]` 拒绝标记后才作为一次性重试。

## 根因

沙箱提权只允许「向更宽的一档跳」：

```
read-only  →  workspace-write  →  danger-full-access
```

`approveEscalation()`（`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`）执行的是严格 widening 校验：

- 模型填了**当前权限本身**（例如已处于 `danger-full-access` 又填 `danger-full-access`，或已处于 `workspace-write` 又填 `workspace-write`）→ 判定「不是更宽」，抛 `not strictly wider`；
- 填**更低/未知权限** → 同样拒绝。

而某些模型不遵守「看到拒绝标记才提权」的约定，会预防性填字段。于是「同档请求被拒 → 模型看到报错 → 换值重试 → 再被拒」形成死循环。本质是 fail-closed 设计对不守约定模型的鲁棒性缺口——`danger-full-access` 已是天花板，此时任何 `sandbox_permissions` 取值都不再合法，模型每加一次就红一次。

## 修复思路

1. **same-mode 幂等放行**：当 `requestedMode === effectiveMode` 时，直接按当前有效模式执行、**不弹审批**（不授予任何更宽权限，安全）。更低的、未知的仍然拒绝。

2. **按会话有效权限收窄 schema 枚举**（把「从某模式还能往哪升」抽成 `widerModesFor()`）：
   - `read-only` → 暴露 `['workspace-write', 'danger-full-access']`
   - `workspace-write` → 只暴露 `['danger-full-access']`
   - `danger-full-access` → **不再暴露 `sandbox_permissions`**

   即：schema 不再永远展示完整的 `['workspace-write', 'danger-full-access']`，而是按会话当前有效模式动态收窄，从源头避免把「永远不可能成功」的参数摆给模型。

3. **统一收口**：`bash`、`pwsh`、`write`、`edit` 四个工具，以及 Native 与 Code Mode（SDK）两条 schema 投影路径，共用同一套收窄逻辑（给 `ToolDefinition` 增加一个按 agent/session 解析参数的钩子，投影时传下去）。

## 验证（本地）

按上述思路在本地实现后：

- host / client 两侧 `tsc -b` 类型检查均通过；
- 相关 4 个测试文件（sandbox escalation + bash/pwsh/fs tools）共 234 个用例全部通过。

discussions.title: Performance: large DSH conversations freeze browser for ~30s (44k DOM nodes / 4.7k SVGs / ~500MB heap)
discussions.body:
## Summary

Opening a large DSH Web conversation freezes Chrome for about 30 seconds, with severe whole-system mouse stutter. This reproduces with hardware acceleration enabled and disabled, so it is not GPU-specific.

## Reproduction

1. Serve DSH Web on WSL2 Debian-12, port 3080.
2. Open a conversation that contains a large tool list / session log, for example `可用的工具与继续任务`.
3. About 3 seconds after clicking into the conversation, Chrome freezes for roughly 30 seconds.

## Measurements (via Chrome DevTools Protocol)

- DOM nodes: 43,939
- SVG elements: 4,681
- HTML size: about 10.5 MB
- JS heap: about 473-485 MB
- Same values with `--disable-gpu --disable-gpu-compositing`

## Impact

The browser main thread is blocked while building and rasterizing this page, and the whole system UI becomes unresponsive for a while.

## Suggested fixes

- Virtualize or lazy-render large conversation contents, tool lists, and trajectory rows.
- Collapse tool details by default.
- Cap initial DOM/HTML for old or very large sessions.
- Consider an explicit compact mode when opening large sessions.

## Notes

This is not caused by a third-party plugin. It reproduces in a fresh Chrome profile with only DSH Web open.

discussions.title: [BUG_REPORT] dsh_unknown_tool delta calling
discussions.body:
// 中文报告在下方
# [English-Ver][BUG] Streaming tool-call loses tool name mid-stream via DeepSeek official-API route → infinite `unknown tool ""` loop → session permanently corrupted (cannot load history)

**Category:** Bug report
**Component:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` (session persistence / tool-call assembly)
**Version:** dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` `0.1.0-rc.6`
**Platform:** Windows 11 (repro environment: opencode-go gateway registered in dsh, model `deepseek-v4-flash` w/ `variant: max`)

---

## Summary

When the opencode proxy is (mis-)configured to route to the **DeepSeek official API** (`deepseek-official` provider, i.e. the OpenAI-compatible endpoint), the streaming tool-call delta stream **drops `id`/`name` on every delta after the first one**. dsh assembles the final `tool-call` block with an **empty tool name** (`name: ""`), executes it, fails with `ToolNotFoundError: unknown tool ""`, and the model retries — producing an **infinite/looping failure loop** (7 occurrences in one session).

Worse, these failed calls are persisted as `tool/result` events whose `message.source.callId` is an **empty string**. On history reload, `assertMessageEventShape` rejects them (`callId === ""`) with `session event at seq 55 message must have tool source`, wrapped as `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` — the whole session becomes **permanently unreadable**.

Two suggestions for the team:
1. **Defense in depth during streaming assembly** — if a later `tool-call-delta` carries empty `name`/`id`, fall back to the first-seen non-empty `name`/`id` instead of overwriting them.
2. **User-facing config guard** — when a provider claims to be `deepseek-official` / direct official-API routing, surface a clear warning that the official opencode gateway (`opencode-go`) should be used, so misconfiguration is obvious instead of degrading into a silent loop.

---

## How to reproduce

1. In dsh, register the opencode proxy but point its token/baseURL at the DeepSeek **official** API (OpenAI-compatible endpoint) — i.e. provider resolves to `deepseek-official`.
2. Start a new session and ask a question that triggers a tool call (e.g. "list files").
3. Observe the stream: the **first** `tool-call-delta` carries the correct `{id, name}`; every subsequent delta carries `id: ""`, `name: null`, accumulating only `argumentsDelta`.
4. dsh emits a `tool/call` with `name: ""` → `ToolNotFoundError: unknown tool ""` → model retries → loop.
5. Close/reload the session → `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError`.

---

## Actual behavior

Captured from a corrupted session file (`session-2becd145-.../session.jsonl.zstd`, 198 events):

### 1) Stream assembly — name lost after first delta

```jsonc
// seq 41 — first delta: CORRECT
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"call_2a1bac4e49e948ea99039624", "name":"bash", "argumentsDelta":""}

// seq 42-48 — every subsequent delta: id/name EMPTY, arguments keep accumulating
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"{"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"\"command\": \"pwd && ls"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" -la && find"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" . -maxdepth"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" 2 -ty"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"pe f | head -"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"100\"}"}

// seq 50 — assembled tool-call block: name ends up EMPTY
{"type":"block-end", "index":1, "block":{
  "type":"tool-call",
  "id":"",
  "name":"",            // <-- tool name lost!
  "arguments":"{\"command\": \"pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -100\"}"
}}
```

### 2) Execution failure & loop

```jsonc
// seq 53 — assistant message, source confirms the offending route
"message": { "...", "source": {"kind":"model", "provider":"deepseek-official", "model":"deepseek-v4-flash"} }

// seq 54 → tool/call with empty name
// seq 55 → tool/result
"error": {"name":"ToolNotFoundError", "code":"UNKNOWN_TOOL"}
```

In this single corrupted session the loop repeated **7 times** (`UNKNOWN_TOOL` at seq 55, 94, 165, 242, 291, 385, 438), all with `source.callId === ""` and `toolCallId === ""`.

### 3) Persistence corruption — permanent

Persisted `tool/result` event:

```jsonc
"message": {
  "role": "user",
  "source": {"kind": "tool", "callId": ""},   // <-- empty callId
  "content": [{"type":"tool-result", "toolCallId": "", "content":[{"type":"text","text":"Error: unknown tool \"\""}], "isError": true}]
}
```

Reload validation (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` `lib/index.js:1255-1265`):

```js
// type === "tool/result", line 1261:
if (sourceRecord["kind"] !== "tool" || typeof sourceRecord["callId"] !== "string" || sourceRecord["callId"] === "")
  throw new Error(`${subject} message must have tool source`);
```

→ `callId === ""` throws `session event at seq 55 message must have tool source`, wrapped by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence` as `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` — the session **can never be loaded again** (history unavailable).

---

## Expected behavior

- A tool call with a valid name in its first delta should never degrade to `name: ""`; subsequent empty deltas should not overwrite earlier non-empty values (`name ?? firstNotNull`).
- Executing an empty-name tool should produce a clear, recoverable error (e.g. "provider returned a malformed tool call") instead of `unknown tool ""` retry loops.
- On reload, a `tool/result` with empty `callId` should be repairable (synthetic placeholder id) or rejected *transiently* with an explicit message naming the raw log path — **not** permanently corrupt the entire session.
- **Config guard:** routing with `provider: deepseek-official` (official OpenAI-compatible endpoint) should raise an immediate, visible warning telling users to use the official opencode gateway (`opencode-go`) instead, since the official API's streaming tool-call encoding is not fully compatible with dsh's delta assembly.

---

## Impact

- 🔴 **Permanent data loss:** affected sessions become unreadable; history cannot be restored from the UI or API.
- 🟠 **Cost waste:** the failure loop keeps calling the model repeatedly, burning tokens while doing nothing.
- 🟡 **Poor diagnosability:** no warning at config time; the only symptom is a confusing `unknown tool ""` loop.

---

## Environment details

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.0-rc.6` |
| dsh-session | `0.1.0-rc.6` |
| Model | `deepseek-v4-flash` (`variant: max`) |
| Misconfigured provider | `deepseek-official` (DeepSeek official OpenAI-compatible endpoint) |
| Working route (after fix) | `opencode-go` (official opencode gateway registered in dsh) |






# [Chinese-Ver][BUG] 经 DeepSeek 官方 API 直连路由时：流式 tool-call 中途丢失工具名 → 无限 "unknown tool \"\"" 循环 → 会话永久损坏、历史无法加载

**分类：** Bug 报告
**组件：** `@deepseek-ai/dsh`（工具调用组装 / 会话持久化）
**版本：** dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` `0.1.0-rc.6`
**平台：** Windows 11（复现环境：dsh 注册 opencode-go 网关，模型 `deepseek-v4-flash` / `variant: max`）

---

## 摘要

当 opencode 代理被（错误地）配置为走 **DeepSeek 官方 API**（`deepseek-official`，即 OpenAI 兼容端点）时，流式 tool-call delta 中**除第一个分片外，后续分片全部丢失 `id`/`name`**。dsh 最终组装出的 `tool-call` 块工具名为**空字符串**（`name: ""`），执行时报 `ToolNotFoundError: unknown tool ""`，模型重试后陷入**循环失败**（单个会话内出现 7 次）。

更严重的是，这些失败调用以 `tool/result` 事件落盘时，其 `message.source.callId` 是**空字符串**。重载历史时，`assertMessageEventShape` 校验拒绝（`callId === ""`）并抛 `session event at seq 55 message must have tool source`，被包装为 `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` —— **整个会话从此永久无法读取**。

向官方团队提两点建议：

1. **流式组装的纵深防御** —— 若后续 `tool-call-delta` 的 `name`/`id` 为空，应回退到首次出现的非空值（`name ?? 首个非空值`），而不是被空值覆盖。
2. **配置错误的用户提示** —— 当 provider 显示为 `deepseek-official`（官方 API 直连）时，应立即弹出明确警告：应使用官方 opencode 网关（`opencode-go`），让配置错误在第一时间暴露，而不是静默退化成死循环。

---

## 复现步骤

1. 在 dsh 中注册 opencode 代理，但把 token/baseURL 指向 DeepSeek **官方** API（OpenAI 兼容端点），最终 provider 解析为 `deepseek-official`。
2. 新建会话并提问一个会触发工具调用的需求（例如"列出文件"）。
3. 观察流：**第一个** `tool-call-delta` 携带正确的 `{id, name}`；其后的每个 delta 都变成 `id: ""`、`name: null`，只累积 `argumentsDelta`。
4. dsh 产出 `tool/call` 且 `name: ""` → `ToolNotFoundError: unknown tool ""` → 模型重试 → 循环。
5. 关闭/重载该会话 → `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError`。

---

## 实际行为

以下全部来自一个已损坏的会话文件（`session-2becd145-.../session.jsonl.zstd`，共 198 个事件）：

### 1) 流式组装 —— 首个 delta 之后工具名丢失

```jsonc
// seq 41 —— 第一个 delta：正常
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"call_2a1bac4e49e948ea99039624", "name":"bash", "argumentsDelta":""}

// seq 42-48 —— 后续每个 delta：id/name 全空，仅参数持续累积
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"{"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"\"command\": \"pwd && ls"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" -la && find"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" . -maxdepth"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":" 2 -ty"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"pe f | head -"}
{"type":"tool-call-delta", "index":1, "id":"", "name":null, "argumentsDelta":"100\"}"}

// seq 50 —— 组装出的 tool-call 块：工具名最终为空
{"type":"block-end", "index":1, "block":{
  "type":"tool-call",
  "id":"",
  "name":"",            // <-- 工具名丢失！
  "arguments":"{\"command\": \"pwd && ls -la && find . -maxdepth 2 -type f | head -100\"}"
}}
```

### 2) 执行失败与循环

```jsonc
// seq 53 —— 助手消息，source 证实了出问题的路由
"message": { "...", "source": {"kind":"model", "provider":"deepseek-official", "model":"deepseek-v4-flash"} }

// seq 54 → tool/call 空名调用
// seq 55 → tool/result
"error": {"name":"ToolNotFoundError", "code":"UNKNOWN_TOOL"}
```

该会话内循环重复了 **7 次**（UNKNOWN_TOOL 出现在 seq 55、94、165、242、291、385、438），全部是 `source.callId === ""` 且 `toolCallId === ""`。

### 3) 持久化损坏 —— 永久性

落盘的 `tool/result` 事件：

```jsonc
"message": {
  "role": "user",
  "source": {"kind": "tool", "callId": ""},   // <-- 空 callId
  "content": [{"type":"tool-result", "toolCallId": "", "content":[{"type":"text","text":"Error: unknown tool \"\""}], "isError": true}]
}
```

重载校验（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` `lib/index.js:1255-1265`）：

```js
// type === "tool/result"，第 1261 行：
if (sourceRecord["kind"] !== "tool" || typeof sourceRecord["callId"] !== "string" || sourceRecord["callId"] === "")
  throw new Error(`${subject} message must have tool source`);
```

→ `callId === ""` 触发 `session event at seq 55 message must have tool source`，被 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence` 包装成 `SessionPersistenceCorruptionError` —— **该会话再也无法加载**（历史不可用）。

---

## 预期行为

- 首个 delta 中拥有合法名称的工具调用，绝不应退化成 `name: ""`；后续空 delta 不应覆盖先前非空值（`name ?? 首个非空值`）。
- 执行空名工具时，应给出清晰、可恢复的错误（如"provider 返回了损坏的工具调用"），而不是 `unknown tool ""` 重试循环。
- 重载时遇到空 `callId` 的 `tool/result`，应可修复（合成占位 id）或以**带原始日志路径的明确提示**临时拒绝 —— **而不是让整个会话永久损坏**。
- **配置防护：** 使用 `provider: deepseek-official`（官方 OpenAI 兼容端点）时，应立即给出醒目的警告，提示用户改用官方 opencode 网关（`opencode-go`）——因为官方 API 的流式工具调用编码与 dsh 的 delta 组装并不完全兼容。

---

## 影响范围

- 🔴 **永久数据丢失：** 受影响会话完全不可读，无法从 UI/API 恢复历史。
- 🟠 **成本浪费：** 失败循环反复调用模型，空转烧 token。
- 🟡 **难以定位：** 配置时无任何提示，唯一症状是令人困惑的 `unknown tool ""` 循环。

---

## 环境信息

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| dsh | `0.1.0-rc.6` |
| dsh-session | `0.1.0-rc.6` |
| 模型 | `deepseek-v4-flash`（`variant: max`） |
| 误配置的 provider | `deepseek-official`（DeepSeek 官方 OpenAI 兼容端点） |
| 切换后正常的路由 | `opencode-go`（官方 opencode 网关，已在 dsh 注册） |

discussions.body:
基于dsh的简述：
用户任务：打开XX软件，搜索关键词，校验结果，下载文件
1 Planner（大模型）：把任务拆解成步骤

discussions.title: Bug report: session log `seq` continuity is broken by three lifecycle paths, making history unloadable
discussions.body:
# Bug report: session log `seq` continuity is broken by three lifecycle paths, making history unloadable

> **Category**: Bug report
> **Environment**: Windows 11, Node 24.16.0, `dsh` 0.1.0-rc era (web profile), browser GUI + mobile companion
> **Severity**: High — session history becomes permanently unloadable; requires out-of-band repair
> **Related component**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` / `@deepseek-ai/dsh-core-session`

## Summary

DSH session logs enforce a strict invariant: **event `seq` must be monotonically increasing from 0** (`SessionLogScanner` in `packages/session/session-persistence-jsonl/src/format.ts`: `event.seq !== events.length` ⇒ `corrupt session log`). We hit **three different lifecycle paths** that each break this invariant in the real world, and in every case the UI then refuses to load the session's history (`history unavailable ... (internal)`).

All three were reproduced on our machine; all were repaired by an out-of-band renumbering tool with **zero event loss**. We believe they share one root cause: **`seq = log.length` is reused across multiple lifecycles (interrupt recovery / crash rebuild / process restart) without a monotonic allocator.**

---

## Defect 1 — Interrupt recovery writes stale `seq` for unfinished tool chunks

**Symptom**

```
corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line 5365 (expected 81828, got 81826)
```

**On-disk evidence** (physical lines 5364–5366)

```
L5364  step/end          seq=81826   turn=5, step=13
L5365  turn/end          seq=81827   turn=5, reason="interrupted"   <- turn was interrupted
L5366  tool-call-chunks  seq0=81826  turn=5, step=13                <- late output reusing the old seq
```

**Mechanism**: while turn 5 was executing a long `pwsh` command (tool arguments streamed across several frames), the turn was interrupted (`turn/end reason: interrupted`). The tool-call deltas that had not finished streaming were **appended afterwards with an already-committed seq** (81826 collided with the committed `step/end`).

**Likely location**: `packages/core/session/src/index.ts` (the `seq = log.length` contract) together with the agent-loop chunk streaming path.

**Repro**: start a turn with a long tool call (long argument list / multi-frame output), cancel it mid-execution, then let the session continue; scan the log for a seq regression right after the interruption point.

---

## Defect 2 — Crash truncation rebuild does not renumber `seq` from 0

**Symptom**

```
line 1: gap (expected 0, got 697744)         <- log starts at seq 697744, missing seq 0..697743 (~700k events)
line 475: gap (expected 705374, got 711694)  <- a second gap mid-log
```

and, after naive renumbering only (v1), a secondary failure:

```
invalid seed event at index 6427: sourceEventSeqs must reference earlier events: 697749 >= current seq 6427
```

**Mechanism**: after a corrupt log, DSH's crash-repair truncated at the damage point and rebuilt from the last complete frame, but:
1. **`seq` was not renumbered from 0** — surviving events kept their original large seq values;
2. two truncations permanently dropped ~110 early turns;
3. event-internal seq references (`sourceEventSeqs`, `surfaceOp.start/end`) still pointed at the old seq values, so they dangle after renumbering.

**Location**: the crash-rebuild path in `session-persistence-jsonl`; validation lives in `packages/core/session/src/surface.ts` (`assertProvenance`).

**Impact**: early turns unrecoverable (no data in the log); a correct repair must remap internal seq references, not just rewrite `seq`.

---

## Defect 3 — Restart race: `session/end-seed` and `agent/inbox/spliced` collide on the same `seq`

**Symptom** (after a normal restart, first message fails to load history):

```
turn/end                seq=166826  12:06    turn=22 completed
session/end-seed        seq=166827  12:08:18 (restart marker)
agent/inbox/spliced     seq=166827  12:08:36 <-- duplicate!
turn/start              seq=166828  12:08:36 turn=23
```

**Mechanism**: a single-instance restart race:
1. the old process, on graceful exit, appends `session/end-seed` (`core/session/src/index.ts` ≈ L545–546) with `seq = log.length = 166827`;
2. the new process cold-starts, restores the seed, and the first user message appends `agent/inbox/spliced` (`core/agent/src/inbox.ts` ≈ L186) — also with `seq = log.length = 166827`;
3. the two lifecycles interleave at the restart boundary and produce a duplicate seq.

**Repro**: finish a turn (log ends with `turn/end`), stop the host gracefully, restart it, reopen the same session and immediately send a message; scan the log — `session/end-seed` and the next `agent/inbox/spliced` share a seq.

---

## Root cause and suggested fix (shared)

All three defects couple the **"seq must be strictly contiguous"** invariant to **multiple lifecycles reusing `seq = log.length`**. Suggested directions for the upstream team:

1. **Centralized seq allocator** (a per-session monotonic counter) so every write path — ordinary appends, `end-seed`, chunk continuation, crash rebuild — goes through one allocator and can never reuse a seq;
2. **Explicitly advance `seq`** at interrupt/restart boundaries (or write a placeholder), so the persistence layer is immune to lifecycle interleaving;
3. On crash-truncation rebuild, **renumber from 0 and remap event-internal seq references** (`sourceEventSeqs`, `surfaceOp.start/end`);
4. Add a **startup seq-integrity self-check** with an actionable recovery hint instead of silently refusing to load history.

## Appendix — out-of-band repair tooling we used (not official)

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `repair-seq.mjs` | renumber `seq`/`seq0` only (v1) |
| `repair-seq-v2.mjs` | renumber + remap `sourceEventSeqs` / `surfaceOp.start/end` (v2, fixes v1's gap) |
| `scan-seq3.mjs` | independent seq-continuity checker (mirrors DSH unpacking) |
| `fix-and-restart.ps1` | one-shot: stop host → repair → verify → restart host |

Happy to provide full logs, a minimal repro script, or the repair tools if useful.

discussions.title: 源码里一个小BUG，中文名识别问题。
discussions.body:
源码里的BUG，K3帮忙找的：找到根因了！这是 DSH 自身的一个 bug。在 win32-dialog-bindings.ts 的 readUtf16 函数（37-42 行）里，扫描 UTF-16 字符串结尾 NUL 终止符时只检查了每个字符的低字节：

let end = 0
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2   // 只查低字节！
而你的路径里 "开"字（U+5F00）的 UTF-16LE 编码低字节恰好是 0x00，扫描到它就误判为"字符串结束"，于是 D:\个人文件\个人开发\MRO子包 被截成了 D:\个人文件\个人。

discussions.title: canOpenPath is reported but never consulted: dead file controls on hosts without a desktop
discussions.body:
`host.describe().canOpenPath` already tells a client that this host has no native opener — it is `false` on Linux with no `DISPLAY`/`WAYLAND_DISPLAY` — and `ctx.connection.hostDescription` publishes it to the browser, documented as "Generation-scoped Host facts, **including native path-open capability**".

Some shipped surfaces consult it and degrade correctly. Three do not, and on any host without a desktop each is a control that cannot work — one of them answering every click with a visible error.

This reproduces on any headless Linux host, and on any deployment where the browser and the backend are not the same machine: `dsh web` reached remotely, a container, a devcontainer, a sandbox. We hit it running dsh's backend inside a per-tenant sandbox, but nothing about it is specific to that.

Observed on `0.1.0-rc.6`; code references are against `master` at `47f9438`.

---

## 1. `settings.describe().hasDocument` answers a different question than the same field on `agentPreset.list`

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts`:

```ts
// settings.describe
hasDocument: settings.documentPath !== undefined      // does the FILE exist?

// agentPresets.list
hasDocument: canOpenPaths()                           // can anything OPEN it?
```

`ui-settings-general`'s `settings-document-store.ts` gates the "Open configuration file" action on the first. The file always exists, so the action is always shown, and on a host with no opener every click ends in `openDocument.error` — "Could not open configuration file".

The agent-preset page, gating on the second, renders "show location" instead of "open location". That reads like the intended behaviour, and settings looks like it missed it.

**Suggested fix:** `hasDocument: settings.documentPath !== undefined && canOpenPaths()` — or keep both facts as separate fields, which would also let a client offer to *display* the document. On a host the user cannot reach, displaying it is the only useful gesture, and it is what we ended up building.

## 2. `ui-conversation`'s `openFile` never consults the capability

`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/apply.ts`:

```ts
openFile: (path) => {
  const cwd = sessions.list.getSnapshot().byId[sessionId]?.cwd
  void workspaces.openPath(resolveWorkspacePath(cwd, path)).catch(() => {
    // Host/OS open failures stay silent in the chat row; the native
    // app surfaces its own error dialog when the path is unusable.
  })
},
```

The comment is right, and its premise does not hold here: there is no native app to surface anything. Every tool-row path and every produced-file chip is a link that silently does nothing.

## 3. `ui-deliverables` gates one action and not the row above it

The clearest evidence that 1 and 2 are oversights rather than decisions is inside a single package. From `packages/client/ui-deliverables/README.md`:

> a second-line **Show in folder** action opens the session workspace through that same owner path **only while the page is loopback and the current Host handshake reports `canOpenPath`**; direct remote Web and headless/container Linux Hosts omit the action by default.

The produced-file chips rendered immediately above that action call the same `openFile` with no such check.

---

## Why a plugin can work around 1 but not 2 or 3

We could replace 1 from a plugin: shadow the `settings.action` cell and register a Settings page that reads the document back instead. 2 and 3 we could not — `openFile` is injected by `ui-conversation` into its own chat view rather than offered through a slot, so the only way to change it is to take over `conversation.view` entirely, i.e. reimplement the transcript. That is not a reasonable thing for a deployment to carry, so we left the dead links in place and documented them.

CONTRIBUTING says external pull requests are not being accepted at the moment, so this is a report rather than a patch — happy to supply anything more useful if it helps.

discussions.title: 【Enhancement】第三方 bundle 双实例依赖缺少防护导致 deepseek-harness 工具调度崩溃
discussions.body:
# 第三方 bundle 双实例依赖缺少防护导致 deepseek-harness 工具调度崩溃

崩溃会导致 deepseek-harness 无法启动或者无法对话，没办法使用 DSH 自查寻找问题，今天搞了大半天，重装了 deepseek-harness 好几次才定位到。

第三方 bundle 若把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 声明为 `dependencies` 而非 `peerDependencies`，`dsh plugin add` 会在 profile 里装出第二份实例，导致**所有**工具调用（含内置 `pwsh`）崩溃，报 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`。

## 根因

1. pnpm 把 dsh-tools 装进 `profiles/<name>/node_modules`（副本）。
2. 宿主 junction 在父级 `profiles/node_modules`，Node 就近解析时 bundle 命中了副本。
3. 副本与宿主是两个模块实例，`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是模块顶层 Symbol，两枚互不互通。
4. agent-loop 用宿主 Symbol 查 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 得 `undefined`，`.prepare()` 崩溃。

## 排查

- 安装阶段零报错，pluginInventory 里两个插件行都显示 active。
- 报错信息 Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare') 与依赖重复毫无关联，指向了工具调度内部。
- 官方文档已写明「内置组合包名称始终从 dsh 安装目录本身解析，pnpm 只管理树外的包」，但没有明确警告第三方 bundle 若把 @deepseek-ai/* 当 dependencies 会触发双实例。
- 尝试复现：`package.json` 里 `"dependencies": { "@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools": ">=0.1.0-rc.6" }`，代码 `import { defineTool } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools'`，`dsh plugin add` 后调用任意工具即崩。卸载后恢复。

## 建议

1. `dsh plugin` 安装后检测 profile 里与宿主重名的 `@deepseek-ai/*`，命中即警告。
2. 调度器捕获到 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 为 `undefined` 时，提示"疑似重复安装"而非裸报 `reading 'prepare'`。
3. 文档补一句：`@deepseek-ai/*` 运行时包必须用 `peerDependencies`。

discussions.title: run_code sandbox file tool anomalies
discussions.body:
# Bug Report: run_code sandbox file tool anomalies

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|------|-------|
| DSH version | 0.1.0-rc.6 |
| Install path | ~/.nvm/.../lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh |
| Node.js | v24.15.0 |
| OS | macOS (Darwin) |
| File policy | workspace-write |
| Workspace | .../xxx |

## Summary

When calling file tools inside run_code, multiple tools behave abnormally:
bash/glob/grep can access workspace files, but read/write/edit all fail on
workspace files, and str_replace_editor is completely unusable.

## Repro: tool results inside run_code

| Tool | workspace | /tmp | Error |
|------|-----------|------|-------|
| bash | OK | OK | - |
| glob | OK | - | - |
| grep | OK | - | - |
| read | FAIL | OK | "not found" |
| write | FAIL | OK | "read-only" |
| edit | FAIL | - | "read-only" |
| str_replace_editor | FAIL | FAIL | "/repo does not exist" |

Repro code:

  // bash OK
  await tools.bash({ command: "ls -la" });

  // glob OK
  await tools.glob({ pattern: "*.gradle" });

  // grep OK
  await tools.grep({ pattern: "group", include: "*.gradle" });

  // read FAIL: "not found"
  await tools.read({ file_path: "build.gradle", limit: 5 });

  // write FAIL: "read-only"
  await tools.write({ file_path: "test.txt", content: "test" });

  // edit FAIL: "read-only"
  await tools.edit({ file_path: "test.txt", old_string: "a", new_string: "b" });

  // str_replace_editor FAIL: "/repo does not exist"
  await tools.str_replace_editor({ command: "view", path: "/repo" });

Note: top-level tool calls (not via run_code) all work correctly.

## Key Findings

1. bash/glob/grep work inside run_code sandbox
2. read fails with "not found" even though bash ls sees the file
3. write/edit fail with "read-only" despite workspace-write policy
4. /tmp read/write works fine; only workspace mount is affected
5. str_replace_editor is completely broken: /repo never initialized
6. Top-level calls unaffected; bug is in extra sandbox layer

## Root Cause (speculative)

@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread mounts the workspace
with a read-only flag (or incorrect path mapping) when initializing
the worker sandbox.

## Suggested Fixes

1. Fix workspace mount permissions in dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread
2. Unify file access paths across read, bash, glob, grep
3. Initialize /repo virtual filesystem for str_replace_editor

discussions.title: [严重 Bug] 中文/工具密集长会话出现 compaction thrashing：持续阻塞正常使用
discussions.body:
## 环境

- DSH：`0.1.0-rc.6`
- 入口：`dsh web`
- Agent preset：标准配置（`compaction-basic` 默认参数）
- 模型路由：`openai-codex/gpt-5.6-sol`
- Context window：`272000`
- 会话特征：中文内容较多、工具调用和 JSON/工具结果密集、长时间持续运行

## 严重程度与用户影响

**严重程度：严重，已阻塞正常使用。**

这不是偶发的一次慢请求。进入该状态后，长 session 会在几乎每个 step 后花费约 70 秒进行一次或两次压缩，且取消旧任务、在同一 session 启动新任务后仍无法恢复。实际工作时间大部分消耗在 compaction，session 已基本不可用。

该问题已经直接导致用户无法继续使用 DSH 完成长任务，不得不终止当前 session，并改用其他方式继续工作。

## 问题描述

在一个长会话中取消旧 turn 后，继续在同一 session 发起新任务。新 turn 并非主要慢在模型推理或工具执行，而是陷入非常频繁的自动压缩：几乎每个 step 结束后都会触发 compaction，且默认 `compactionRetries: 1` 会让同一压力检查连续尝试两次。

压缩完成后上下文仍高于 80% 阈值，因此下一 step 又会重复压缩，形成 compaction thrashing。

## 现场数据（已脱敏）

诊断时该 session 约有：

- `429` 个 turn
- `1970` 个 step
- 约 `455000` 个持久事件
- session artifact：约 `20 MB` Zstd，解压后约 `48 MB`

最近一次提供方 usage / 压力数据：

```text
contextWindow:         272000
threshold (80%):       217600
provider pressure:     239617  (约 88.1%)
heuristic surface:      47187
heuristic system:        1521
heuristic tools:         6376
```

默认 `retainRatio: 0.16` 对应：

```text
272000 × 0.16 = 43520
```

在本地启发式表层只有约 `47187` 的情况下，头部可选压缩范围非常小；现场多次 compaction 的 `shadowedTokenCount` 仅约 `3451`、`3745`、`4826`、`7559`，而摘要输出通常约 `3900–4200` tokens。

因此频繁出现：

```text
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content
```

例如：

```text
summary is not smaller than the shadowed content
(3453 estimated framed tokens >= 3449)
```

统计快照：

- `120` 次 compaction start
- `119` 次已结束
- `79` 次生成 summary
- `37` 次因 summary 不小于源内容而失败
- compaction 平均耗时约 `64.3s`
- P95 约 `77.0s`
- 单次常见耗时 `73–79s`
- 累计 compaction 耗时约 `7654s`（约 2.1 小时）

新 turn 的一个连续区间中：

- 3 个普通 step 合计约 `77s`
- 同期前 5 次已完成 compaction 合计约 `379s`
- 约 83% 的等待时间消耗在 compaction

提供方 prompt 从约 `251K` 缓慢下降到约 `239K`，但始终高于 `217.6K` 阈值，所以每个后续 step 仍会继续触发。

## 复现特征

1. 创建中文、工具调用/工具结果密集的长 session。
2. 持续运行至提供方报告的上下文压力超过 80%。
3. 触发自动 compaction。
4. 在同一 session 中继续多个工具 step；取消一个 turn 后再启动新 turn 也可以继续观察。
5. 可见每个 step 后重复 compaction，部分压缩报 `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content`，压缩后压力仍高于阈值。

## 初步定位

从当前实现和运行数据看，压缩触发与压缩范围选择使用了不同尺度：

- `measurement.totalTokens` 可以锚定提供方真实 usage；
- `selectCompactableRange()` 的近期尾部保留和节点定价来自固定字符启发式；
- 文档也注明 CJK 文本和 JSON schema 会被该启发式严重低估。

在该现场，同一上下文的本地 heuristic breakdown 约 `55K`，提供方实际压力约 `240K`，相差 4 倍以上。结果是名义上保留 16% 的近期尾部，实际仍对应模型窗口的大部分；每次只能选择很小的头部范围，摘要很难产生有效净缩减。

## 预期行为

- 一次自动压缩后，上下文压力应明显回落到触发阈值以下；
- 不应在没有显著净缩减的情况下每个 step 重复昂贵的摘要调用；
- `summary is not smaller than the shadowed content` 连续发生时，不应形成持续的压缩重试循环。

未附带原始 session、路径、用户内容或凭据；如维护者需要，可以进一步提供脱敏后的事件时序与统计脚本输出。

discussions.title: Background subagent responses are queued rather than steered
discussions.body: Background subagents are usually spawned when the main agent has other work to do but expects a response from the harness when the subagent returns. But this return is a queued message (available only at the end of the run and not earlier). This is a bad design decision and I would ask that subagent return shall be treated as steering type messages.

discussions.title: 做了一个 Chat / Agent 切换插件：dsh-autonomy
discussions.body:
昨天在 #1644 看到有人提议给 DSH 加一个 Chat / Agent 开关。这个需求很具体：有时想让 agent 放手查文件、跑命令、持续执行；有时只是想在同一个会话里讨论一下，不希望一句普通问题也触发一整轮工具调用。

所以我做了 dsh-autonomy。它在 Web 输入框上方放了一个常驻的 Chat | Agent 开关，不换模型、不换 preset，也不会丢掉当前会话和未发送的草稿。

这里的 Chat 不是只靠一句提示词：

- 发给模型的请求里不再暴露工具 schema；
- 如果 provider 仍然返回了工具调用，执行门也会拒绝；
- 不会继续进入自主工具循环。

切回 Agent 后，原来的工具集合、sandbox 和 permission policy 会恢复，插件不会另起一套权限系统。选择按会话保存，刷新、重启和 fork 后仍然有效。

安装：

```sh
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-autonomy
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

仓库：https://github.com/JinkaiLiu/dsh-autonomy
npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-autonomy

目前版本是 0.1.0，针对 DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 做了测试。它不是 token 硬上限：历史长度、输出长度和模型价格仍然会影响花费；它解决的是“这一轮到底允不允许 agent 动手”。另外，已经开始执行的工具不会因为切到 Chat 而被回滚，需要中止时仍然应该用 Stop。

如果你也有“讨论几句，但不想新开会话或换 preset”的使用场景，欢迎试一下。尤其想听听大家对切换位置、状态提示和会话恢复是否自然的反馈。
