discussions.title: kb-rag: local literature knowledge-base RAG (8 tools, npm dsh-kb-rag)
discussions.body:
**kb-rag — local literature knowledge-base RAG for DSH** (repo: https://github.com/Breeze136/dsh-kb-rag, npm: `dsh-kb-rag`)

Ingest PDFs, folders, or a whole Zotero library into a local SQLite knowledge base; ask questions and get cited answers with clickable DOI links.

**What it does**

- 8 tools: kb_ingest (PDF/folder), kb_zotero (native Zotero migration), kb_search (hybrid BM25 + bge-small vector + bge-reranker), kb_rag (cited QA), kb_scope (closed-KB / KB+web / web-only + strict mode), kb_stats, kb_dedup, kb_clear
- Section-aware academic chunking (abstract/methods weighting, caption blocks), all-local embeddings and reranker, zero API cost, zero upload
- Measured on 242 docs: 86s full ingest (~355ms/doc), 40x faster incremental reruns, 0.4-1.3s hot queries at 20k chunks
- Deliberately zero UI: everything happens through conversation and tool returns; no panel, no client dependencies

**Install**

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-kb-rag
```

(one command — the package declares `dsh.bundle`; requires pnpm on PATH). Requirements: Python 3.9+ with pymupdf / faiss-cpu / sentence-transformers (startup check prints the pip command if missing). Models download from HF on first use (`HF_ENDPOINT=https://hf-mirror.com` for restricted networks).

dsh.so registry security scan: passed. Happy to answer questions or adjust anything.

discussions.title: [Bug] web profile 崩溃 Cannot read properties of undefined reading prepare — dsh-tools 多实例 Symbol 契约冲突
discussions.body:
mutation {
  createDiscussion(input: {
    repositoryId: "R_kgDOT3T1gw"
    categoryId: "DIC_kwDOT3T1g84DDSUb"
    title: "[Bug] web profile 崩溃 Cannot read properties of undefined reading prepare — dsh-tools 多实例 Symbol 契约冲突"
    body: "# [Bug] web profile 在模型调用工具时崩溃：`Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`

> 提交渠道说明：官方仓库 `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` 已关闭 Issues / Pull Requests，仅开放 **Discussions**。本文档请发布到 GitHub Discussions。
> 影响包：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（源码位于 monorepo 的 `packages/core/tools/`），被 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` 消费。
> 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6

---

## 环境

- dsh：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6
- 系统：macOS，Node.js v26.7.0（运行时 `node:sqlite` 可用）
- 受影响 profile：`web`（以及任何会额外安装一份 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 的 profile）
- 不受影响：`headless` / `desktop`（只有单份 `dsh-tools` 实例）

## 现象

在 `web` profile 下，只要模型**发起一次工具调用**，该 turn 即以错误结束，session 日志（`~/.dsh/sessions/<project>/session-*.jsonl.zstd`）记录：

\`\`\`
[turn/end] reason: {kind:\"error\", error:{message:\"Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')\", code:\"UNKNOWN\"}}
\`\`\`

关键点：

- **模型本身是通的**——日志里 `request/header` 显示 `provider:\"agnes\", model:\"agnes-2.5-flash\"` 正常就绪，不是模型/凭据问题。
- **纯文本回复不崩**，只在「模型调工具」的 turn 触发（走 `runGroup → startCall → prepare`）。因此表现为「间歇性」崩溃。
- 崩溃发生在**服务端 Node 进程**（zstd 日志由 Node 写入），**不是浏览器端**。

## 根因

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 用**普通 `Symbol()`**（按身份匹配）定义了一个跨包契约常量：

\`\`\`js
// lib/index.js:2409  /  lib/types/index.js:57
const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol(\"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler\");
\`\`\`

这个对象 `{ prepare, dispatch, finalize, finish }` 是 `ToolRuntime` 服务（`ctx.tools`）的**实例属性**，键就是这个 `Symbol`：

\`\`\`js
// lib/index.js:2557
[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] = { prepare, dispatch, finalize, finish }
\`\`\`

消费者 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop` 这样取用：

\`\`\`js
// lib/index.js:193
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec);
\`\`\`

**问题出在 `Symbol()` 是身份匹配，而非全局注册。** 而机器上 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 存在 **多份互相独立的模块实例**（已确认 3 份、inode 各不相同，均为 v0.1.0-rc.6）：

- #1 核心嵌套：`/opt/homebrew/lib/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（agent-loop 解析到的）
- #2 profile 顶层共享：`~/.dsh/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`（\"tools\" 服务由它提供）
- #3 某插件嵌套（未引用该 Symbol，非元凶）

`agent-loop` 用 #1 的 `Symbol` 去查 #2 提供的 `ctx.tools` → 键身份不匹配 → 取到 `undefined` → `.prepare()` 抛错。

`headless`/`desktop` 的 profile 目录里 `find dsh-tools` 为空，只有核心那份单实例，`Symbol` 自洽，所以**不崩**——这正是「web 崩、headless 正常」的原因。

## 已排除的误判（避免重复排查）

- ❌ **不是 `node:sqlite` / 浏览器问题**：运行时 Node v26 的 `node:sqlite` 完全可用；`dsh-web-search-pro` 是纯服务端 cordis 插件（无 browser/client 入口），其 `document.*` 来自 jsdom 在 Node 端解析 HTML；web app 也并未把它打包进前端。

## 复现

1. `dsh web` 启动（或任意会复制 `dsh-tools` 的 profile）；
2. 让模型调用任意工具（如网页搜索 / 读文件）；
3. 观察 turn 以 `reading 'prepare'` 错误结束。
   或静态验证：分别 import agent-loop 用到的那份 `dsh-tools` 与 \"tools\" 服务所在那份 `dsh-tools`，断言两者导出的 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是否相等——多实例下为 `false`，改为 `Symbol.for` 后为 `true`。

## 最小修复方案

把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 里这两处 `Symbol(...)` 改为 `Symbol.for(...)`：

\`\`\`js
// lib/index.js:2409
const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol.for(\"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler\");
// lib/types/index.js:57
export const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol.for(\"@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler\");
\`\`\`

`Symbol.for` 按字符串注册到**全局符号表**，所有模块实例（含 agent-loop 与 tools 服务、以及未来任何重复安装）都解析到同一身份。这是**就地、非破坏性**的改动（同样的字符串键；单实例下的行为与改前完全一致），且从根上消除了「装了几份 dsh-tools 就崩」的脆弱性——无论以后怎么更新、怎么复制包都不会再触发。

## 建议的额外加固（可选）

在核心 bundle 与各 profile 之间**去重/提升 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 为单一实例**（pnpm dedupe / overrides / hoist），使跨包 `Symbol` 契约在结构上天然健壮。但 `Symbol.for` 这一处改动已是**最小且充分、且抗更新**的修复。

## 影响

直接阻断受影响 profile 下所有「模型调用工具」的 turn，实质上让 web profile 无法用于任何 agentic（工具调用）任务。

---

附：本地临时规避（用户侧，非官方修复）——已验证将三份 `dsh-tools` 的上述 `Symbol` 改为 `Symbol.for` 后，跨实例 `TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 相等（`core===web-top===plugin: true`），崩溃消失。但此改动位于 `node_modules`，会被 dsh 更新覆盖，故仍需官方合入 `Symbol.for`。"
  }) {
    discussion {
      id
      title
      url
    }
  }
}

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-llm-local-token — 复用本机 Codex CLI / Claude Code 已登录的 OAuth 订阅，不用再配 API key
discussions.body:
Unofficial community project, independently developed and maintained. Not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek. （非官方社区项目，独立开发维护，未经 DeepSeek 审核或背书。） ## Project - GitHub: https://github.com/tianxia--/dsh-llm-local-token - npm: `dsh-llm-local-token` — https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-llm-local-token - Release: https://github.com/tianxia--/dsh-llm-local-token/releases/tag/v1.3.2 - License: MIT - 文档 / Docs: [README](https://github.com/tianxia--/dsh-llm-local-token#readme) · [中文](https://github.com/tianxia--/dsh-llm-local-token/blob/main/README.zh.md) ## TL;DR 你已经为 Codex CLI 和 Claude Code 付过订阅费了。这个插件让 DSH **直接借用这两个 CLI 本机已持有的 OAuth 凭据**发起 LLM 调用——不用另配 API key，不用再登录一次，也不起代理进程。装上重启，`openai-codex` 和 `anthropic` 两条路由就出现在 Models Picker 里。 You already pay for Codex CLI and Claude Code. This plugin lets DSH borrow the OAuth tokens those CLIs already hold on your machine — no separate API key, no second login, no proxy process.
两份订阅都成了模型选择器里的路由
 订阅用量，来自 provider 的 rate-limit 响应头
## Why it exists DSH 通过 credential seam 解析 provider 的密钥，而这个接口期望的是一个 API key。但个人版 Codex / Claude 订阅是**纯 OAuth 的**——那种 key 根本不存在。额度明明在手上，却接不进 DSH。 DSH resolves a provider's key through its credential seam, which expects an API key. Personal Codex / Claude subscriptions are OAuth-only, so the key simply does not exist. This plugin closes that gap. ## What it does | Provider route | 凭据来源 Credential source | Endpoint | | --- | --- | --- | | `openai-codex` | `~/.codex/auth.json`（与 `codex` CLI 共享的 ChatGPT OAuth） | `https://chatgpt.com/backend-api` | | `anthropic` | `~/.claude/.credentials.json`，回退到 macOS Keychain 条目 `Claude Code-credentials` | `https://api.anthropic.com` | - 每次请求都从 CLI 维护的那个文件里解析 token，临近过期自动刷新。 - 直接交给 **DSH 自带的 pi-ai engine**——没有 fork 引擎，没有中间代理。 - 缺凭据的那条路由会被**跳过**，而不是让整个 boot 失败。所以只装了其中一个 CLI 也能正常用。 - 顺带把**订阅用量**显示出来：从 provider 的 rate-limit 响应头解析（Codex 那边走 SSE 读配额），跟随当前选中的 provider。配额窗口按**真实时长**命名（`5 hours` / `7 days`），而不是照搬厂商的营销词。 ## Install ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-local-token ``` 然后重启 `dsh`——这就是全部。本包声明了 profile bundle（`dsh.bundle.patch` → `cordis.patch.yml`），DSH 会替你插入 loader 行，不需要手工编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml`。 That is the whole install: the package declares a profile bundle, so DSH inserts the loader row for you. 想设为默认模型 / to make it the default: ```yaml # ~/.dsh/settings.yaml agent-default-model: provider: openai-codex model: gpt-5.6-terra reasoningEffort: medium ``` ## 和相关方案的区别 / How it differs 生态里已经有把订阅接进 DSH 的方案（把 Cursor 通过 ACP 注册成 provider、或把多家登录态批量导入）。这个插件走的是**读取本机 CLI 凭据文件**这条最短路径：不依赖任何 CLI 的 agent 协议、不常驻进程、不做 provider 大杂烧，只做 Codex + Claude 两条路由，但把**订阅用量**这件事做到位。 ## 已知边界 / Known limits - macOS 上两条路由都实测可用。**Linux / Windows 下 Claude 的凭据路径尚未验证**，欢迎帮忙确认。 - DSH 仍在 developer preview，接口可能变动；建议按 release 锁版本。 欢迎 issue 和 PR。

discussions.title: [Bug] Agent output enters an infinite repetition loop that runs for ~10 minutes with no circuit breaker — only a manual abort stops it
discussions.body:
## Summary

When an agent's context gets very large (long-running session plus a broad "verify everything after an upgrade" task), the model can enter a degenerate repetition loop: it streams the same sentence over and over as assistant text chunks. DSH has no repetition guard or circuit breaker, so the loop runs until max_tokens is hit or the user manually aborts. In our case it streamed about 420,000 characters of identical text over 10 full minutes.

## Environment

- DSH: 0.1.0-rc.7 (via @deepseek-ai/dsh)
- Provider / model: volcengine/deepseek-v4-flash
- Session event log: DSH session JSONL (.jsonl.zstd, concatenated zstd frames)

## Reproduction (what we observed in the session log)

The archived session (a plugin project workspace) had:

1. User: "DSH 升级了，我还适配吗" (DSH was upgraded, is my plugin still compatible?)
2. The agent worked through 20 normal steps (read repo files, grep DSH source under node_modules, inspect profile config) - all fine.
3. At step 21, after about 34 normal streamed chunks, the model locked into repeating one sentence:

```
The `register` API matches. Let me check the host-side `Service` and `webServer` APIs in rc.7.
```

4. That sentence was repeated across 3015 text-chunks events (about 2825 repetitions), totalling about 420,000 characters, streamed for 10 minutes (21:54:34 -> 22:04:23) until the user manually aborted the turn (aborted / user).

Evidence in the log: the step produced text-chunks events forever, with no finish chunk, no stop reason, and no assistant/message - just endless identical text deltas.

A related failure appeared in the same project's other session: turn 23 sent 467,456 input tokens and immediately hit max-tokens with 1 output token (empty text). Both failures point to context saturation plus model degeneration, with no harness-level protection.

## Root cause (from code inspection)

Searching the DSH and pi-ai stack for frequency_penalty, presence_penalty, repetition_penalty, or any "N consecutive identical chunks - abort" logic returns nothing. The only "repeat" handling in dsh-agent is about status transitions and dispatcher dedup - nothing about degenerate model output.

So the only exit conditions are:

- the provider's max_tokens (not set tight enough here), or
- a manual user abort.

Neither is a reasonable guardrail for a stuck model.

## Suggested fix (any of, ideally a combination)

1. Circuit breaker on repeated output: detect N consecutive identical text-chunks (or the same sentence repeated M times) and automatically abort the current step with a clear reason, similar to how other agent loops are guarded.
2. Expose repetition penalties in the provider request config (frequency_penalty / presence_penalty / repetition_penalty passthrough) so providers that support it can suppress degeneration.
3. Cap per-step output tokens by default so a stuck loop terminates in seconds rather than minutes.
4. Context compaction for very long sessions before the context approaches saturation.

## Notes

- The session files are stored as concatenated zstd frames (see scanZstdFrames in dsh-session-persistence-jsonl); a single zstdDecompressSync on the whole file only decodes the first frame, so tooling that analyzes session logs must iterate frames.

discussions.title: Please bump @earendil-works/pi-ai to 0.84.x — model picker missing GLM-5.3
discussions.body:
### What happened?

The model picker in the Web GUI gets its catalog from the bundled `@earendil-works/pi-ai` provider data. The currently pinned version only lists GLM models up to `glm-5.2`, so newly released models such as `glm-5.3` and `glm-5.2-highspeed` cannot be selected from the picker.

### Details

- DSH version: `0.1.0-rc.7`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai@0.1.0-rc.7` pins `@earendil-works/pi-ai: ^0.82.1`
- pi-ai 0.84.2 adds `glm-5.3` and `glm-5.2-highspeed` to `zai.json` / `zai-coding-cn.json`
- The web frontend itself has no hardcoded model IDs — the list is fully driven by the pi-ai provider data loaded server-side

### Suggested fix

Bump the `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency to 0.84.x so the model catalog includes the latest Z.AI GLM releases. Verified locally via an npm `overrides` to `0.84.2`: after restarting `dsh web`, the picker shows GLM-5.3 correctly.

discussions.title: [BUG] workspace-write sandbox breaks Schannel TLS in subprocesses (SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS)
discussions.body:
## Summary

On Windows 11, under the `workspace-write` permission preset, subprocesses cannot complete
HTTPS/TLS. DNS resolution and TCP connection both succeed; the only failure is Schannel
`AcquireCredentialsHandle` returning `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030e)`. Root cause: the
`windows-acl` sandbox runs subprocesses under a WRITE_RESTRICTED token, and Windows restricted
tokens are fundamentally incompatible with Schannel.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6`
- Windows 11 Pro (build 26200)
- Reproduced with `curl.exe` (System32 and Git-for-Windows, both Schannel backend) and Windows
  PowerShell 5.1 (`.NET`/Schannel)

## Repro steps

1. Start `dsh web`, begin a session with the `workspace-write` permission preset.
2. Ask the agent to run `curl.exe -sS https://www.baidu.com/` (or `Invoke-WebRequest ...`).
3. The command fails: curl exit code `35` / PowerShell "基础连接已经关闭" /
   `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS`.
4. The identical command succeeds under `danger-full-access`.

## Root cause (verified by an independent repro harness)

The `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` runner builds a WRITE_RESTRICTED token with
`CreateRestrictedToken(flags = 0x0D)` (i.e. `CREATE_WRITE_RESTRICTED | DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE |
SANDBOX_INERT`) and a restricting SID list of `[logonSID, EVERYONE, workspaceSID, tempSID]`.

Under that restricted token the child's Schannel `AcquireCredentialsHandle` fails. DNS and TCP
are fine — verbatim curl `-v` output:

```
* Host www.baidu.com:443 was resolved.
* IPv4: 39.156.70.239, 39.156.70.46
*   Trying 39.156.70.239:443...
* schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030e) - 安全包中没有可用的凭证
curl: (35) schannel: AcquireCredentialsHandle failed: SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS (0x8009030e) - 安全包中没有可用的凭证
```

Controlled experiments (CreateRestrictedToken + CreateProcessAsUserW + curl, varying restricting
SIDs and flags):

- Removing `DISABLE_MAX_PRIVILEGE` (keeping SeChangeNotifyPrivilege etc.) does **not** restore TLS.
- Adding `BUILTIN\Administrators`, `BUILTIN\Users`, `Authenticated Users`, `INTERACTIVE`,
  `LOCAL`, and the user's own SID to the restricting list does **not** restore TLS (all still
  `SEC_E_NO_CREDENTIALS`).
- Without `BUILTIN\Administrators` in the restricting list, the subprocess fails even earlier
  with `0xC0000142 (STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED)` — Schannel/CNG-dependent DLLs cannot initialize
  because system objects such as `\Device\CNG` are inaccessible.
- Conclusion: **Windows restricted tokens are fundamentally incompatible with Schannel.** This is
  a platform limitation, not a dsh configuration problem. Every Schannel-based HTTPS client
  (curl.exe, .NET, PowerShell) fails under the sandbox. OpenSSL-based clients (e.g. Python
  urllib) succeed.

## Expected vs actual

- **Expected**: per the dsh-auto-mode README, "The file sandbox does not restrict reads, network
  access, or external services" — `workspace-write` should not block outbound network.
- **Actual**: all Schannel-based TLS fails silently. The failure surfaces as an ordinary
  non-zero process exit at runtime, so no `[sandbox: file access denied]` marker and no
  escalation hint is produced — the model sees a plain failed command.

## Suggested fix directions

1. Do not run network-capable subprocesses under a `CreateRestrictedToken` restricted token, or
   exempt outbound-network operations from the restricted-token runner.
2. Alternative confinement mechanisms that keep network working:
   - **AppContainer** with `InternetClient` capability, or
   - **Low integrity level + file ACL grants** (network is unrestricted under Low IL; verified
     separately that Schannel works at Low IL — but restricted tokens do not).

discussions.title: [Bug] rc.7 breaks the persistent PTY shell on Windows (pid 0), node-pty 1.1.0 → 1.2.0-beta.15
discussions.body:
## 症状

rc.7 之后，Windows 上的持久 PTY shell 起不来了。同一个 commit、同一套 smoke，Linux 和 macOS 全过，只有 win32 失败。

```
pty spawned on win32: pid 0

Error: terminal process has exited
    at LocalTerminalHandle.write (@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local/lib/index.js)
```

**`pid 0`** 是关键。rc.6 上同一个 smoke 打印的是真实 pid（例如 `pty spawned on win32: pid 7400`），Linux 和 macOS 这次也都是真实 pid（`2708` / `54370`）并通过。win32 拿到 0，然后第一次 `write` 时进程已经没了。

## 根因

rc.7 把 `node-pty` 从 `^1.1.0` 提到了 `1.2.0-beta.15`。

```
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.0-rc.6  →  node-pty ^1.1.0
@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.0-rc.7  →  node-pty 1.2.0-beta.15
```

这是 rc.6 与 rc.7 之间在这条路径上唯一的依赖变化。

## 实测环境

- `windows-latest` GitHub runner，Node 22.23.2
- 对照组同一 workflow 同一 commit，`ubuntu-latest` 与 `macos-latest` 全过
- 失败的是真实 PTY 冒烟（spawn 之后 send/read 往返），不是单元测试

**单元测试看不见这个。** 我这边 94 个单元测试在完整 rc.7 依赖集下全绿，`tsc` 也干净。只有在真实操作系统上 spawn 真实 PTY 的那一步会炸。

## 附带确认

顺便确认两件与本问题无关但可能有人关心的事，都是在 rc.7 发布包里看的，不是推测。

- `createProcessInspector` 在 win32 上仍然 throw `terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32`
- `this.terminalInspector ?? createProcessInspector()` 这个注入座仍然在

所以这次的问题不在那条线上，是 node-pty beta 的 Windows 路径。

## 我这边做了什么

把 peer 范围从 `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.2.0` 收到 `>=0.1.0-rc.5 <0.1.0-rc.7`。对一个只服务 Windows 的插件来说，一个说「还不行」的 ERESOLVE 比一个启动即死的持久 shell 好。等这条修好会立刻放开。

如果需要更多信息（完整 workflow 日志、其它 Node 版本、或者在 `1.2.0-beta.x` 里二分找具体哪一版引入），我这边有 Windows CI，随时可以跑。

discussions.title: Agent write/edit tools bypass settings.yaml schema validation — malformed configs crash DSH on restart
discussions.body:
## Problem

Agent (the in-harness AI) can modify DSH configuration files (`settings.yaml`, `cordis.patch.yml`, etc.) through the `write`/`edit` filesystem tools. However, these writes **bypass the schema validation** that the Settings Web UI enforces.

The result: Agent writes a malformed config (wrong YAML structure, invalid provider nesting, duplicate loader entry ids, etc.), then restarts `dsh web`, and DSH fails to start — with no clear error guidance in the browser. The user has to manually fix the file and restart.

## Root Cause

The settings layer (`dsh-settings` + `dsh-settings-file`) has a complete schema + validate pipeline:

- Each namespace registers a `z.object` schema (via `schemastery`)
- A `validate` callback (e.g., `assertServiceable` for `llm-pi-ai`) rejects invalid configs at write time
- `publish()` gracefully degrades: if a stored section is invalid, it keeps the last good value and logs a warning

But this validation only runs on the `settings.mutate` / `settings.replace` write path (i.e., when the user edits through the Web UI Settings page). Agent's `write`/`edit` tools go through `fs.writeFile` directly, completely bypassing the settings layer.

Similarly, `cordis.patch.yml` (the loader patch layer) has **no schema validation at all** — it's a raw YAML file parsed by the loader at boot time. Agent writes to it are blind.

## Reproduction Steps

1. Ask Agent to add a new provider to `settings.yaml` (e.g., a new `llm-pi-ai.providers.xxx` entry)
2. Agent writes the file with incorrect YAML nesting — DSH Web UI settings page would have rejected it, but the `write` tool has no such check
3. Agent executes `dsh --profile web` (or similar restart command)
4. DSH fails to start — browser tab stays blank, no error in the GUI
5. User must manually inspect `settings.yaml`, fix the structure, and restart

## Evidence

### Config diff that triggered this issue

Old (working) `settings.yaml`:

```yaml
agent-default-model:
  provider: deepseek-official
  model: deepseek-v4-flash
llm-deepseek:
  apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY
  baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com
  models:
    - id: deepseek-v4-pro
    - id: deepseek-v4-flash
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    my-provider:
      displayName: my-provider
      apiKeyEnv: MY_PROVIDER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://internal-proxy.example.com/personal/openai/api/v1
      models:
        - id: deepseek-v4-flash
        - id: deepseek-v4-pro
```

After Agent edit — the `llm-deepseek` section was removed, provider reference changed to `my-provider`, but the YAML structure was wrong (indentation/nesting issue in the provider config). DSH failed to start on next restart.

### Source code evidence

In `dsh-settings/lib/index.js`:

- `register()` (line 311): stores schema + validate callback
- `write()` (line 439): calls `resolve()` with validate, catches errors before persist
- `publish()` (line 476): on external file change, gracefully degrades — keeps last good value if section is invalid (line 489-491)

In `dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js`:

- `Config` schema (line 1394): `z.object({ providers: z.dict(profile).default({}) })`
- `assertServiceable()` (line 1407): calls `resolveProfiles()` which checks provider names, baseURL, model ids, etc.
- `installSettingsSection()` (line 1846): registers the schema + validate callback with the settings service

The gap: all this validation is bypassed when Agent uses `write`/`edit` filesystem tools instead of the settings API.

## Proposed Solutions

### Option A: Intercept config file writes

Add a file-write hook or a `dsh-fs` middleware that intercepts writes to known config files (`settings.yaml`, `cordis.patch.yml`) and runs a pre-write validation:

1. Parse the YAML
2. Run the relevant settings namespace schema against the modified section
3. If validation fails, reject the write with a clear error message naming the offending field

### Option B: Pre-restart config check

Add a `dsh --check-config` command that validates all config files against their registered schemas, and make it a required step before any `dsh web` restart:

1. Agent runs `dsh --check-config` before restart
2. If check fails, Agent gets a structured error report and can fix it before restarting
3. The CLI could also be called automatically by the `dsh-cordis-host-runner` or `dsh-app-boot` plugin

### Option C: Tool-level protected paths

Add a `dsh-tool-fs` configuration option that lists "protected file paths" — files whose writes are validated against a registered schema or a YAML syntax check, and rejected if invalid.

## Related

- `dsh-settings-file` README: validates at settings API level, not filesystem level
- `dsh-plugin-guard` (community): protects against bad plugin installs, but not config file writes
- `dsh-doctor` (community): post-hoc diagnostics, not pre-write validation

## Discussion

This is a structural gap: DSH's "everything is a plugin" philosophy means Agent is a first-class citizen with filesystem access, but the validation layer that protects config files from human editors is not extended to Agent's own write tools. The fix should be in the framework layer, not pushed to individual AGENTS.md rules.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-plugin-browser-use — 复用你已登录的 Chrome 做网页自动化：速度快、0 token、防风控
discussions.body:
🙌 分享一个给 **DeepSeek Harness (dsh)** 的浏览器自动化插件：**dsh-plugin-browser-use**。

## 一、解决啥问题？

Agent 要"去网上看看 / 抓个数据 / 回复评论"时，常常卡在三道坎上：

1. **登录墙** —— 小红书、微信公众号、微博、淘宝、各种后台……不登录根本进不去，既麻烦又不安全（得把账号密码交给第三方）。
2. **验证码 / 反爬** —— 自动化浏览器一进去就被识别、被拦截，今天能跑通，明天啥也没改就挂了，账户也容易被封。
3. **慢、烧钱** —— 浏览器任务要吃海量 token：一次"去这个网站看看"就是百万级 tokens，动辄 $2~$8+，而且结果时灵时不灵。

## 二、优势在哪里？

**它跑在你自己已经登录好的 Chrome 里**，上面三道坎一次解决：

- **速度快** —— 直接在真实 DOM 上操作，毫秒级响应，不绕弯子。
- **0 token** —— 复用你现成的登录态，不重新登录、不反复试错；本地执行，日常任务几乎不再为浏览器重复烧 token。
- **防风控** —— 用的是你自己的真实浏览器指纹和登录态，行为跟真人一致，很难被识别成机器人、很难触发风控。
- **安全** —— 账号密码不经过任何第三方，登录态全程在你自己的浏览器里。

## 三、工作原理

思路就一条：探索一次，提炼成 skill，以后免费反复跑。 整条链路都在你自己的机器上、在你已经在用的 Agent（Claude Code、workbuddy、qoderwork）里完成。

① 探索——把"自己要什么"搞清楚。 说个大概方向就行，Agent 用本 skill 驱动你的真实浏览器去跑。需求是试出来的：看着真实结果调范围、调筛选、调字段，直到你拍板——就是这个。

② 提炼——一句话变成 skill。 说"帮我提炼"。Agent 和你确认最终需求后，webclaw3 用你本地 Chrome 的登录态重新探索网站、生成 skill、换参数验证，后台跑几十分钟——全在你自己机器上完成。

③ 日常跑——确定性、几乎免费。 生成的 skill 是纯脚本，零 token 或极少 token、毫秒级返回、每次结果一致。随时跑，也可以配成定时任务。

## 四、你怎么用？

前提：装了 [dsh](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)，有 Chrome，Node >= 22。

**1. 安装插件**（一条命令）：

```sh
curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fatmind/dsh-plugin-browser-use/main/scripts/install.sh | bash
```

**2. 装 Chrome 扩展**：打开 `chrome://extensions` → 开「开发者模式」→「加载已解压的扩展程序」→ 选脚本打印出的扩展目录（用自己的 Chrome，一次性搞定）。
> 手动下载：https://github.com/fatmind/webclaw3/blob/main/dist/wc3-chrome-extension-0.6.0.zip

**3. 重启 dsh**，跟 Agent 说一句「检查一下浏览器环境」—— 它会跑 `wc3_doctor` 自查，缺什么补什么。

**4. 直接开用**，比如：

- 「用 wc3 打开小红书，看看我收藏了什么」
- 「把搜索结果的标题、链接、价格抓下来，导出成表格」
- 「去淘宝后台把这个订单的状态改一下」

Agent 会自动用 `wc3_*` 工具打开页面、观察、交互、提取，全程跑在你自己的 Chrome 里。

## 工具一览

`wc3_doctor` / `wc3_tabs` / `wc3_tab_open` / `wc3_tab_close` / `wc3_tab_activate` / `wc3_snapshot` / `wc3_get_text` / `wc3_eval` / `wc3_click` / `wc3_fill` / `wc3_scroll_to` / `wc3_search` / `wc3_wait_for`

📦 GitHub: [fatmind/dsh-plugin-browser-use](https://github.com/fatmind/dsh-plugin-browser-use)

> 提示：在 dsh 里**不要**再单独把 webclaw3 装成 skill —— 本插件已处理引擎加载与用法引导，重复安装会导致指令重复和 relay 冲突。

---

**English summary:** *dsh-plugin-browser-use gives DeepSeek Harness native `wc3_*` browser tools backed by [webclaw3](https://github.com/fatmind/webclaw3) — driving **your own logged-in Chrome**, so you skip re-login, auth popups, and most anti-bot walls. Fast, ~0 token for daily tasks, and hard to trigger risk control. Install: `curl -fsSL https://raw.githubusercontent.com/fatmind/dsh-plugin-browser-use/main/scripts/install.sh | bash`.*

discussions.title: Third-party bundle plugins are silently disabled ~3s after boot (insert objects mutated by fiber disposal, HMR recompose persists it)
discussions.body:
> 提交目标：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/issues/new

## Title

`Third-party bundle plugins are silently disabled ~3s after boot — HMR recompose picks up disabled=true written onto the shared bundle insert objects`

## Environment

- dsh version: 0.1.0-rc.7 (also reproduced on 0.1.0-rc.6)
- Platform: Windows 10, Node v23.11.0
- Profile: `~/.dsh/profiles/web`, plugins installed via `dsh plugin add` and manual `dsh.profile.bundles` entries

## Symptom

Any third-party bundle plugin (a package declaring `"dsh": { "bundle": { "patch": "./cordis.patch.yml" } }` whose patch inserts its own row via `- insert: [{ id, name }]`) **activates at boot, then ~3 seconds later is silently disabled**:

- `entry.options.disabled` becomes `true` (raw value), `entry.fiber` is destroyed — verified via injected probe in the live process.
- The settings → plugin list shows `配置状态: 已停用` with no Cordis status column (no fiber).
- The plugin's host services and client half both stop working (e.g. `/api/usageStats/query` returns 404 for `dsh-spend`).
- `dsh --dump-config` shows the entry **without** any `disabled` field — configuration layer is clean.
- The only third-party plugin that survives is one whose `inject` lists only always-present services (`settings`, `loader`); every plugin injecting `agents` / `sessions` / `webServer` gets disabled.

## Root cause (confirmed from source + runtime injection)

1. `applyEntryPatches` (vendor/include/src/index.ts) pushes the `insert` entries **by object reference** into the composed tree (`data.push(...insert)`).
2. The loader's disposal hook (`cordis-plugin-loader/src/index.ts`, "case 7") writes `fiber.entry.options.disabled = true` directly on that shared object when a fiber is disposed by loader behavior.
3. After boot, `watchUserPatches` triggers `internal/update`; the Include plugin recomposes via `applyPatches(this.data, config.patches)`. The **same patch objects** (including the now-mutated insert rows) are applied again, so every previously-disposed third-party row comes back `disabled: true`.
4. Verified: two `internal/update` events carry **identical** patch lists (50 entries), yet the first compose leaves `dsh-at-file` clean and the second compose yields `disabled: true`. Runtime probe at t+3s shows all third-party entries `disabled=true, fiber=N` except the one that was never disposed.

`apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` already documents this hazard ("the boot application must not mutate the objects later reloads recompose from") and clones for boot, but the mutation path through the loader's dispose hook still reaches the shared insert objects, and the HMR recompose re-applies them.

## Impact

Every third-party bundle plugin silently loses host services and client UI shortly after boot. No error is printed (disabled is a valid state). `dsh-doctor` reports nothing actionable. Users are left with plugins that "installed but do nothing."

## Workaround (verified)

Add explicit `disabled: false` overrides for every third-party row in the profile's own patch layer (`~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/cordis.patch.yml`):

```yaml
- id: dsh-at-file
  disabled: false
- id: dsh-openpencil
  disabled: false
```

The profile layer applies after bundle layers on every recompose, so it wins over the polluted value. Verified: all 22 third-party plugins stay `ACTIVE` (fiber state 2) and their client manifests appear.

## Suggested fix

- In the loader's dispose hook, do not mutate `entry.options` in place for shared insert rows — either clone the row before writing `disabled`, or drop the mutation entirely (the HMR `applyPatches` already recomposes from the layer list).
- Alternatively, deep-clone the composed `data` inside `applyEntryPatches` (currently `structuredClone(data)` only clones the *previous* tree, not the inserted objects coming from `patches`).
- Add a regression test: boot a profile with a third-party bundle whose row gets disposed once, then trigger a recompose, and assert the row is not disabled.

提权触发依赖失败信息里不完整的标记，命名管道等进程级拒绝不带标记导致 AI 误判跳过
discussions.body:
现象

  在受限模式（workspace-write）下运行 OneForAll（子域名搜集），import 阶段即崩溃，报裸 PermissionError: [WinError 5]
  拒绝访问，位置在 config/log.py 的 logger.add(... enqueue=True) → multiprocessing.SimpleQueue → connection.Pipe →
  CreateFile。报错里没有任何 sandbox / escalation 标记。AI
  重试一次、报错一致后，判定「工具故障」，按失败跳过规则静默放弃该数据源，改用其它源补位，全程没有向用户请求提权。之后实测：给
  full access 即可正常跑通，命名管道并非「任何模式下都被禁」。

  根因

  权限是事后补救式：默认受限模式先跑，失败后由 AI 读报错，只有报错带 escalation available 之类标记时才触发提权。但该标记只在部分拒
  绝类型（文件写拒绝）上出现；命名管道这类进程级拒绝只抛裸错误、不带标记。于是「是否提权」这个本应是确定性规则的事，被下放成了「AI
  读不完整的文本标记去猜」，标记一缺，AI 就失去提权信号，把可解决的沙箱拒绝当成了死路。

  期望 / 建议

  1. 让所有可提权的沙箱拒绝统一返回结构化、显式的提权信号，而不是只在部分类型上以文本标记形式出现。
  2. 或把权限判断前置：命令执行前就判定是否需要更宽权限并询问用户，而不是先跑失败、再靠 AI 猜。

discussions.title: DeepSeek adapter translates empty/null SSE tool-call ids into empty block.callId, breaking session history load and downstream tool_call_id validation
discussions.body:
# DSH DeepSeek adapter 统一修复诊断(2026-08-17)

> 两份历史补丁说明,并新增 P3/P4/P5/P6 根治性补丁与故障分析。历史文档保留作回溯参考。

---

## 1. 故障现象(两类,同根)

运行 `deepseek-official / deepseek-v4-flash|pro` 时,DeepSeek API **偶发**在并行 ≥2 个
tool call 的流式 delta 里发空 `id` / `name`(违反 OpenAI"id/name 只在首个 delta 出现"的约定),
甚至**整次调用全程不带 id**。由此产生两类故障:

| 现象 | 触发点 | 报错 |
|---|---|---|
| ① 本轮工具全废,对话推不动 | 流式累积被空串覆盖 / 无 id | `unknown tool ""` → `UNKNOWN_TOOL`;agent-loop 整步拒掉重试 |
| ② 继续对话被上游拒绝 | 会话内出现空 `tool_call_id` | `Duplicate value for 'tool_call_id' of in message[N]` → `INVALID_REQUEST`(上一轮内存里是旧 adapter;新写入仍空 id) |
| ③ 重启后历史无法加载 | 存档里保存了空 `callId` 的 tool/result 事件 | `session event at seq N message must have tool source (internal)`(dsh-session 回放校验拒绝) |

### 时间线(本地时间,2026-08-16 → 08-17)

- 22:41–23:07 `session-d3a71f45` / `fcb10cee` 等**补丁前**会话已出现空 callId 存档
- 23:26 / 23:33 应用原 P1(reasoning_content)、P2(空串守卫)
- 23:47–00:17 验证补丁期间六个会话(2f256497/83e6c5d0/b8c7279b/3c7d3156/13569dbc/79177163)
  写入空 callId → 00:17 / 00:23 重启后 **无法加载**(dsh-session 校验)
- dsh web(00:23 启动)对部分会话做了清理重写(六会话一度 0 坏),但 **live 会话
  2f256497 / 83e6c5d0 / 6d14b4b3 / e7935da8 / b8c7279b 被旧代码持续追加空 callId**,
  修复反复被覆盖

**结论:补丁 P1/P2 不是故障根源,也没有解决它** —— 它们只防"空串覆盖已设的 id",
防不了"API 全程不给 id"。坏数据在补丁前就已产生。

---

## 2. 根因链(两处,都在 bundle,源码 `deepseek-harness` 未动)

```
DeepSeek SSE delta 无 id / 空 id
  └─> adapter translate() 累积 block.callId 为空
        ├─ closeBlock: id = CallId(block.callId ?? "")      → block-end id ""
        └─ tool-call-delta: id = CallId(block.callId ?? "") → delta id ""
  └─> dsh-llm BlockAssembler
        ├─ partial.toolCallId = chunk.id(无条件赋值,空串也覆盖)   ← P4a 修
        └─ assemble 兜底: partial.toolCallId ?? CallId(`call-${index}`)
             ?? 只对 undefined/null 生效,空串 "" 不触发 ← P4b 修
  └─> 最终 assistant 块 id="",工具以空 toolCallId 执行
        ├─ 存盘: tool/result.source.callId="" → 重启校验拒绝(故障③)
        └─ 继续对话: 序列化 tool_call_id="" 重复 → 上游拒绝(故障②)
```

关键细节:
- **block-end 的 block 是权威值**(`assemble()` 优先返回它),所以光改 dsh-llm 的 `??` 兜底救不了
  DeepSeek —— **必须在 adapter 的 closeBlock 之前保证 callId 非空**。
- dsh-llm 是 bundle 形态:runtime 用 `lib/index.js`(内联 BlockAssembler, L673+),`lib/types/assembler.js`
  是同源码的独立文件,两处都要打。

### 2.1 扩展根因:`dsh-llm-pi-ai`(opencode-go / pi-ai 路径)

settings.yaml 的 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-go` 走 `https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1` 反代,
该反代同时提供 deepseek-v4-flash / pro 等模型。用户在 GUI 模型选择器里切到这类 deepseek
**走的不是 `dsh-llm-deepseek`(直连 DeepSeek API,需要 `llm-deepseek.providers.deepseek.apiKeyEnv`,
settings 里没配)**,而是 `dsh-llm-pi-ai`,它内部用 `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 通用库。

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `toStreamChunks` 用的是**带 block-end 的 chunk 协议**:
- L511 `toolcall_start` → yield `block-start`
- L526 `toolcall_delta` → yield `tool-call-delta`(携带 `id: CallId(known?.id ?? "")`)
- L537 `toolcall_end` → yield `block-end`(携带 `block: { id: CallId(event.toolCall.id), ... }`)

P4 的 `BlockAssembler.assemble()`(L739)只在 `partial.block` 未设时走兜底:
```js
assemble(partial, index) {
    if (partial.block) return partial.block;  // ← partial.block 一旦被 block-end 填了空 id,直接返回,绕开兜底
    switch (partial.blockType) { ... }
}
```
而 `push()` L713 `partial.block = chunk.block;` 会把 `toolcall_end` 携带的空 id block
**直接覆盖** partial.block。**P4 兜底对 dsh-llm-pi-ai 这条路径完全失效**。

P5 修复:**在源头合成 id**(toStreamChunks 入口生成 per-stream `callSalt`,
toolcall_start/delta/end 三处空 id 都兜底合成 `call-<index>-<callSalt>`),
从源头让 block.id 永不为空,partial.block 永远是非空 brand,assemble() 返回它。

### 2.2 扩展根因:`dsh-llm-deepseek` 的 P3 null 漏洞(OpenCode 反代路径)

settings.yaml 里 `llm-deepseek.baseURL = https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`(孤儿配置,
没 `llm-deepseek.providers` 块),用户切到 deepseek 时 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 通过 OpenCode 反代
拿模型,API key 走环境变量(`DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`,settings 未显式配,反代侧校验)。

OpenCode 反代的 SSE delta 里 `tool_calls[].id` 可能是 `null`(而非 undefined 或空字符串)。
**P3 的条件 `call.id === void 0 || call.id === ""` 对 null 全部不成立**:
- `null === void 0` → false
- `null === ""` → false
- 第一个 if 不满足 → 进入 `else if (call.id !== void 0 && call.id !== "")`:
  - `null !== void 0` → true
  - `null !== ""` → true
  - **设置 `block.callId = null`**!

然后 `closeBlock` L213 `id: CallId(block.callId ?? "")`:`??` 对 null 返回 `""` → **block id = ""**!

P6 修复:把 `=== void 0` 改成 `== null`(同时匹配 undefined 和 null),`!== void 0` 改成 `!= null`。
P6 已在 `E:\caches\bun\global\node_modules\@deepseek-ai\dsh-llm-deepseek\lib\index.js` L321 落盘,
4 case 验证(`id: null` / 无 id 字段 / 真 id 保留 / null 后真 id 切换)全部产出非空 brand。

---

## 3. 统一补丁(P1-P6,一个脚本全打)

脚本:`patch-dsh-llm-unified.ps1`(幂等,自动跳过已应用项)

| # | 包 | 位置 | 改动 | 作用 |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| P1 | dsh-llm-deepseek | serializeAssistant L58 | tool-call 轮恒发 `reasoning_content` | 消除 `INVALID_REQUEST`(无 reasoning 块) |
| P2 | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate delta 累积 | 空串 `id` 不覆盖已设值;`name` 真值守卫(空串/null 均不覆盖,2026-08-17 升级) | 消除 `unknown tool ""` / id 被空串清掉 |
| P3 | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate 开块处 + 流盐 | 当 delta 无 id/空 id 时合成唯一 id `call-<index>-<盐>`,盐每流随机(`callSalt`) | **根治故障②③**(直连 DeepSeek 路径):块 id 永不为空且跨轮不冲突(但漏 null case,P6 修) |
| P4 | dsh-llm | assembler(bundle + types) | `if (chunk.id)` 才赋值;兜底改 `\|\|` 且带随机盐 | 保护所有 provider + 回放路径(delta 累积协议) |
| P5 | dsh-llm-pi-ai | toStreamChunks(block-end 协议) | 入口生成 `callSalt`;toolcall_start/delta/end 三处空 id 都兜底合成 `call-<index>-<盐>` | **修复 P4 兜底被覆盖漏洞**(dsh-llm-pi-ai 是 block-end 协议,partial.block = chunk.block 优先于 assemble 兜底):覆盖 settings 里 `llm-pi-ai.providers.opencode-go` 走 opencode.ai/zen/go/v1 的 deepseek 模型 |
| **P6** | dsh-llm-deepseek | translate L321 条件 | `=== void 0` → `== null`,`!== void 0` → `!= null` | **修复 P3 的 null 漏洞**:OpenCode 反代(走 llm-deepseek)等 SSE delta 里 `tool_calls[].id` 为 `null` 时 P3 漏掉,`null` 进入 else if 设 `block.callId=null`,closeBlock 的 `?? ""` 把 null 当空,产出空 id |

P3 语义(seed 行):
```js
if (block.callId === void 0 && (call.id === void 0 || call.id === ""))
    block.callId = `call-${block.index}-${callSalt}`;       // 合成,盐保证跨流唯一
else if (call.id !== void 0 && call.id !== "") block.callId = call.id;  // 仍优先采用 provider id
```
- 首个 delta 带合法 id → 用 provider id(行为不变)
- 全程无 id → 合成 `call-<index>-<盐>`,不依赖每次流从 0 开始的 index(避免两轮都叫 `call-0` → duplicate)

---

## 4. 剩余已知风险(未修,文档备案)

| 风险 | 说明 | 建议 |
|---|---|---|
| delta 缺 `index` 字段 | 若某 delta 缺 index,`toolBlocks.get(undefined)` 会拆块 | DeepSeek 恒发 index,理论上限;上游跟进 |
| 多 choice 交错 | `for (chunk.choices)` 同状态块交错 | DeepSeek n=1,理论风险 |
| 首个 delta `name:null` 且后续也无 name | adapter 无法发明工具名 → 仍 `unknown tool ""` | P2/P5 已守住"有效 name 不被空覆盖";全程无 name 属 API 异常,无法兜底 |
| 损坏会话在线时被重写 | 修复必须停 web 后做 | 已写入脚本守卫(web 存活时直接拒绝修复) |
| dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 `name` 字段同样可能为空 | pi-ai partial.name 可能为 "" | 同上:无法发明工具名,无法兜底 |



[dsh-llm-deepseek-lib-index.js.diff.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31147456/dsh-llm-deepseek-lib-index.js.diff.txt)
[dsh-llm-lib-index.js.diff.txt](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31147458/dsh-llm-lib-index.js.diff.txt)

discussions.title: [Bug] STILL BROKEN 2026-08-17: dsh-tools@latest -> dsh-session@0.0.1-rc.1 -> unpublished @deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta (404) blocks pnpm users on the default install path
discussions.body:
**Status correction to the earlier thread** (see [discussion #984](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/984)): the "404 chain closed end to end" conclusion posted there does **not** hold for the `latest` dist-tag train. Verified on the npm registry today (2026-08-17):

```
$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools dist-tags
{ latest: "0.0.1-rc.1", next: "0.1.0-rc.7" }

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@latest peerDependencies
{ "@deepseek-ai/cordis": "^4.0.1-rc.1",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm": "^0.0.1-rc.1",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent": "^0.0.1-rc.1",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope": "^0.0.1-rc.1",
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-session": "^0.0.1-rc.1",
  ... }

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-session@latest peerDependencies
{ ..., "@deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta": "^0.0.1-rc.1", ... }

$ npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta
404 Not Found - GET https://registry.npmjs.org/@deepseek-ai%2fdsh-type-meta
```

**The broken chain:** `dsh-tools@0.0.1-rc.1` (what `latest` resolves to) peers `dsh-session@^0.0.1-rc.1`, which still peers the **unpublished** `@deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta`. npm skips it gracefully; **pnpm auto-installs peers and hard-fails** with `ERR_PNPM_FETCH_404`.

This is the default path for community plugin authors: `CONTRIBUTING.md` points them at installing from npm, and any plugin depending on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (no version) hits it. The `^0.1.0-rc.6` pinning workaround only works while `next` stays at `0.1.0-rc.x`.

**Verified workaround for plugin authors (pnpm):**

```yaml
# pnpm-workspace.yaml
overrides:
  "@deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta": "npm:@deepseek-ai/dsh-invariants@0.0.1-rc.1"
```

**Suggested upstream fix (either one closes it):**
1. Point the `latest` dist-tag of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` (and `dsh-tools`) at the current `0.1.0-rc.x` train, as was already done for `@deepseek-ai/dsh` itself; or
2. Publish `@deepseek-ai/dsh-type-meta` (or drop the peer).

The peer declaration chain looks accidental either way, but the `latest` train has now been broken for a week and the only reason community plugins install at all is manual pinning or the override above.

discussions.title: 让 settings.section 插槽支持自定义导航图标（icon 选项）
discussions.body:
## 背景

设置面板左侧导航的图标目前由外壳硬编码，feature 插件无法自定义。

`packages/client/ui-settings-general` 的 `navIcon(id)` 只映射了三个内置 section：

function navIcon(id) {
  if (id === "models")        return <IconDataOutline16 .../>;
  if (id === "agent-presets") return <IconAgentPresetOutline16 .../>;
  if (id === "plugins")       return <IconPersonalizationOutline16 .../>;
  return <IconSettingsOutline16 .../>;   // 其余一律齿轮兜底
}

而 `settings.section` 插槽的注册选项只有 `id / order / label`，
没有 `icon` 字段（`packages/client/ui-settings` 的 slot contract），
外壳的 nav 投影也只取这三项。

## 问题

第三方 / 功能插件注册自己的 `settings.section` 时，图标都会落到同一个齿轮兜底。
例如我们的两个插件：

- `session-archives`（归档对话）
- `mcp`（MCP 管理）

在设置左侧栏里都显示齿轮，造成重复图标，且无法区分。

## 期望

给 `settings.section` 的注册选项增加一个可选的 `icon` 字段
（在 slot contract 里声明类型，外壳 nav 投影时透传），
插件可以指定自己的导航图标；未指定时回退到现有的 `navIcon(id)` 映射 + 齿轮兜底，
保持向后兼容。

图标本身可以从 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives` 现有图标集里选
（如 `IconArchiveOutline20`、`IconApiOutline14`），不必新增资源。

## 参考

- 外壳：`packages/client/ui-settings-general`（`navIcon` 函数）
- 插槽契约：`packages/client/ui-settings`（`settings.section` 类型）
- 版本：`0.1.0-rc.7`

discussions.title: Bug: bare 400/413 (no body) mislabeled as context overflow for non-Cerebras providers
discussions.body:
## Bug report: bare "400/413 (no body)" is mislabeled as context overflow for non-Cerebras providers

**English**

### Summary

When a non-Cerebras OpenAI-compatible provider (e.g. SiliconFlow) rejects a request with a bare `400 status code (no body)`, `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `mapStopReason` labels it `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`. The harness then runs its overflow recovery — a compaction whose summarization request re-sends the same failing provider and fails the same way — collapsing the turn into a retry loop that surfaces a fabricated "context overflow" for a failure that was never about context length.

### Root cause

`mapStopReason` delegates overflow detection to pi-ai's `isContextOverflow`, which matches a bare `400/413 (no body)` against the pattern:

```
/^4(?:00|13)\s*(?:status code)?\s*\(no body\)/i
```

That pattern exists **only for Cerebras**, whose gateway reports overflow as an empty HTTP 400/413. But the harness applies the verdict provider-agnostically, so SiliconFlow's empty 400 (which can mean quota, auth, request guard, or a transient failure) is promoted to `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`.

### Proposed fix

Guard the pi-ai overflow promotion on the model's provider:

```ts
const errorText = message.errorMessage ?? ''
const bareHttpNoBody = /^4(?:00|13)\s*(?:status code)?\s*\(no body\)/i.test(errorText)
const skipPiAiOverflow = bareHttpNoBody && message.provider !== 'cerebras'
const piAiOverflow = !skipPiAiOverflow && isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow)
```

A bare 400/413 (no body) from a non-Cerebras provider then falls through to `classifyPiAiError`, which routes the 400 to `INVALID_REQUEST`. Cerebras keeps the overflow promotion, and descriptive overflow text (matched by `isContextWindowExceededError` via the separate `harnessOverflow` arm) is unaffected.

### Ready-to-review implementation

A complete fix (source change + unit test + Agent Note + bilingual README update) is on my fork branch:

`https://github.com/jc77411/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-bare-400-overflow-misclassification`

The single behavioral change is in `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`.

---

**中文**

### 摘要

当非 Cerebras 的 OpenAI 兼容提供方（如 SiliconFlow）以裸 `400 status code (no body)` 拒绝请求时，`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `mapStopReason` 会把它标记为 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`。Harness 随后运行溢出恢复——compaction 的摘要请求向同一个失败的提供方重发并以同样方式失败——使回合陷入重试循环，把一个与上下文长度无关的失败呈现为编造的"上下文溢出"。

### 根因

`mapStopReason` 把溢出检测委托给 pi-ai 的 `isContextOverflow`，后者用正则匹配裸 `400/413 (no body)`：

```
/^4(?:00|13)\s*(?:status code)?\s*\(no body\)/i
```

这条正则**仅为 Cerebras 存在**——它的网关用空的 HTTP 400/413 表示溢出。但 harness 无差别地应用该判定，于是 SiliconFlow 的空 400（可能意味着配额、鉴权、请求守卫或瞬时故障）被升级为 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`。

### 建议的修复

按模型的 provider 守卫 pi-ai 的溢出升级：

```ts
const errorText = message.errorMessage ?? ''
const bareHttpNoBody = /^4(?:00|13)\s*(?:status code)?\s*\(no body\)/i.test(errorText)
const skipPiAiOverflow = bareHttpNoBody && message.provider !== 'cerebras'
const piAiOverflow = !skipPiAiOverflow && isContextOverflow(message, contextWindow)
```

非 Cerebras 提供方的裸 400/413（无 body）随后落入 `classifyPiAiError`，把 400 归类为 `INVALID_REQUEST`。Cerebras 保留溢出升级，描述性溢出文本（由独立的 `harnessOverflow` 分支经 `isContextWindowExceededError` 匹配）不受影响。

### 可直接评审的实现

完整的修复（源码改动 + 单元测试 + Agent Note + 双语文档更新）在我的 fork 分支：

`https://github.com/jc77411/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/pi-ai-bare-400-overflow-misclassification`

唯一的行为改动在 `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`。

discussions.body:
## DeepSeek SuperBrain — 给 DeepSeek V4 加的 Ultra 思考档位插件

SuperBrain 给 DeepSeek Harness 的 DeepSeek V4 模型加了一个 **Ultra** 思考档位：走提供方 `max` 推理预算，同时注入一套纪律化的推理协议 —— 更快、更果断、更少幻觉、每任务更省 token。

### 核心卖点
- 同一个 `max` 算力，**施加纪律**：task dispatch → 紧凑推理流水线 → token 纪律 → 反幻觉硬规则 → few-shot 范例 → 编码+验证流程 → 置信链 → 果断的 "I will" 语气
- 关键原则：**token 经济只用在思考/措辞，绝不省在证据/验证**（改完文件必跑 typecheck/tests/build）
- 附带：验证守卫（写/改文件后自动提示先验证）、失败反馈收集（用户中断的轮次记入 failures.jsonl）、客户端 UI（置信度 chip、任意文件附件、Ultra 紫粉呼吸反馈）

### 安装
```bash
cp -r packages/guard/super-brain <harness>/packages/guard/
git apply patches/01-ultra-effort-and-install.patch
git apply patches/02-file-attachment-host.patch
git apply patches/03-ui-superbrain.patch
pnpm install && pnpm run build
```

discussions.title: [功能建议] Web UI 全局响应式布局与移动端支持
discussions.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek Harness 当前的 Web UI 主要按桌面宽屏布局设计。

但无论是本地开发时缩小浏览器窗口、使用平板，还是通过手机访问已部署的实例，
窄屏下的导航、对话、审批、设置与长工具输出都应保持可用。

本提案讨论 Web UI 的全局响应式布局和移动端交互适配。它不依赖、也不改变任何特定部署方式、反向代理、认证或网络监听策略。

## 当前问题

在手机或较窄的浏览器窗口中，以下常用操作体验较差：

- 侧栏占用主要可视区域，工作区和会话切换不方便；
- 对话区、输入框与工具输出的高度分配不合理；
- 设置面板、弹窗和确认卡片可能超出视口；
- 工具审批和 Ask User Question 等关键交互不适合触屏操作；
- 长命令、日志和代码输出容易破坏页面横向布局；
- 页面未充分考虑移动端安全区域、软键盘和横竖屏切换。

## 建议范围

优先在不影响桌面端现有体验的前提下，完成以下适配。

### 1. 基础断点

- 手机：360–480px；
- 平板：约 768px；
- 桌面：维持现有布局和交互。

### 2. 窄屏布局与交互

- 侧栏在窄屏下默认收起，通过抽屉或覆盖层打开；
- 对话区作为默认主视图；
- 输入区固定在底部，并避免被移动端软键盘遮挡；
- 工具审批和用户追问卡片保持完整可见、可触摸操作；
- 设置页和弹窗适配视口高度，优先使用内部滚动而不是页面溢出；
- 长工具输出、代码和日志采用折叠、内部滚动或横向滚动策略；
- 不依赖 hover 才能完成关键操作。

### 3. 移动端细节

- 支持 `safe-area-inset-*`；
- 横竖屏切换后保持可用；
- 保证主要触摸目标尺寸合理；
- 明确页面、对话区、弹窗和工具输出之间的滚动边界。

## 非目标

- 不改变现有 Agent、权限、沙箱、认证或网络监听策略；
- 不在本提案中处理公网暴露、反向代理或特权 API 的远程访问问题；
- 不重做桌面端视觉设计；
- 不新增独立移动端客户端；
- 不为某一套特定皮肤实现专属布局。

## 验证计划

计划至少覆盖以下 viewport：

- Android Chrome：360×800、412×915；
- iPhone Safari：390×844；
- 平板：约 768px；
- 桌面：1280px 以上。

重点验证：

- 工作区、会话和侧栏切换；
- 发送消息与长对话滚动；
- 工具审批与用户追问；
- 设置面板和弹窗；
- 长日志、代码和工具输出；
- 窄屏与桌面宽度之间切换后的布局恢复；
- WebSocket 重连后页面基本交互仍可用。

## 实现计划

我会先在个人 fork 中完成一个最小、CSS 优先的参考实现：

1. 优先处理主框架、侧栏、对话区、输入区和弹窗；
2. 尽量保持桌面端现有结构与视觉不变；
3. 避免修改 Agent、权限、网络或认证相关代码；
4. 提供改动前后截图/录屏、测试 viewport 和精确 commit；
5. 在本 Discussion 收集反馈后，再决定是否继续扩展覆盖范围。

由于仓库当前不接收外部 PR，本帖的目标是先提供一个可复现、可评估的实现方向，供维护者和社区讨论或后续吸收。

## 想确认的问题

- 维护者是否认可移动端与窄屏浏览器作为 Web UI 的正式支持场景？
- 对布局改造而言，是否更倾向 CSS 优先的渐进调整，而不是新增独立移动端界面？
- 仓库是否已有推荐的浏览器端响应式测试方式或 viewport 测试矩阵？
- 对侧栏、弹窗和长工具输出的窄屏交互是否已有正在进行的设计方向？

discussions.title: Feature request: additive top-level sidebar navigation for plugins
discussions.body:
## Summary

Please expose an additive, root-scoped primary navigation extension for Web client plugins. This would let plugins contribute discoverable top-level entries such as Calendar, Files, Data, or Browser without replacing the entire sidebar or patching the DOM.

## Downstream use case

I am building a calendar plugin. The existing `conversation.view` extension works for a session-scoped tab, but a calendar is a global tool. It should remain reachable from primary navigation independently of whichever session is active.

Similar needs are already visible in community work:

- #1941 implements Sessions/Files sidebar tabs, but notes that shell changes may break the injection and require a fallback to a footer button and modal.
- #1413 and #2631 request additive workspace-row actions. They demonstrate demand for supported UI contribution points, but do not cover root-level navigation.
- #1795 mentions a list slot in the sidebar session area, but focuses on Work/Chat session modes.

This request is separate: a generic extension point for plugin-owned first-level application destinations.

## Current gap

In the public contracts shipped with `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`:

- `sidebar` and `sidebar.workspaces` are single-owner surfaces.
- `sidebar.footer.action` is additive, but semantically limited to footer actions.
- `conversation.view` is additive, but scoped to an active conversation.

A plugin therefore has to choose between replacing core UI, using a semantically incorrect location, or relying on fragile DOM/CSS injection.

## Possible contract

The exact naming is only illustrative. One option would be:

```ts
"sidebar.navigation": {
  kind: "list"
  scope: "root"
  owner: PrimaryNavigationOwnerProps
}

"shell.page": {
  kind: "list"
  scope: "root"
  owner: ShellPageOwnerProps
}
```

A higher-level registry could also work:

```ts
ctx.navigation.register({
  id: "calendar",
  label: t("calendar"),
  icon: CalendarIcon,
  order: 30,
  target: { type: "shell.page", id: "calendar" },
})
```

## Expected behavior

- Multiple plugins can coexist with deterministic ordering.
- Expanded sidebar shows icon and label; collapsed rail shows icon, tooltip, and accessible name.
- Entries can be hidden by plugin or user settings.
- Keyboard navigation and visible focus follow core behavior.
- Unregistering or uninstalling a plugin removes its entry cleanly.
- Core Workspaces, Search, and Settings entries are never replaced.
- The navigation target can be session-independent.

The smallest useful step would be an additive primary-navigation item that can activate an existing view. For genuinely global tools, a root-scoped page surface would be the better long-term target.

This is not a request for a Calendar-specific special case. If an equivalent contract is already planned, please point me to it. I would be happy to test the API with a minimal downstream plugin example.

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-argp｜基于逻辑链的原子引用图剪枝式上下文压缩引擎：被依赖者保留、孤立者摘除，压缩阶段零模型调用
discussions.body:
> **_非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。_**

> **项目地址：** https://github.com/yoza10635/dsh-argp

**项目介绍：**

dsh-argp 是一个基于逻辑链的原子引用图剪枝式上下文压缩引擎，作为第三方 CompactionEngine 后端，与 dsh 自带的摘要式压缩不同：它把对话拆成原子...压缩时按引用依赖拓扑（逻辑链）做决策——"被依赖"的原子按图保留、"孤立"的原子按反向拓扑序摘除——压缩阶段零 LLM 调用。

核心特性：

- **基于分级逻辑链决策**：剪枝依据是引用依赖拓扑（"谁被依赖谁活"），不是新旧位置、不是模型偏好；v0.3.0 起引用带三级分级（critical/supporting/contextual），critical 边在排序与闭包守卫中享有最高保护——这是与其他压缩方案的本质区别。
- **压缩阶段 0 次 LLM 调用**：剪枝是纯图算法；引用声明是对话过程中每次小额标注，成本在对话时付，不在压缩时付。
- **压缩率精确兑现**：说压到 32K 就是 32K（实测 200K 上下文 → 160K 触发 → 32K 保留），不像摘要引擎输出大小不可控。
- **可恢复**：被剪内容永不销毁——占位符 → `recall_pruned(seq)` 按 seq 取回原原子（有每轮预算：≤3 次 / 单次 ≤5% 窗口 / 累计 ≤10%）。
- **压缩阶段零模型调用**：剪枝是纯图算法，压缩决策不依赖任何模型；但**建图（cites 声明）由模型在对话时执行**——建边密度取决于模型的指令遵循能力（实测：任务指令不压制时 DeepSeek v4-flash 声明率 43.6%、解析 100%；Qwen3.8-27B 更稳健、指令不压制时稳定声明 547 条密集图）。建议搭配指令遵循能力强的模型；并注意 DeepSeek 系模型对"系统提示词 vs 用户指令"冲突时更易被用户指令压制——若任务指令与 cites 契约冲突（如要求 "nothing else"），可能全程 0 建边，此时引擎照常工作（见下一条），只是失去语义选择性。
- **零建边不影响剪枝**：语义边只是增强信号，不是必要条件——即使模型全程不声明 cites，确定性边配对、`eff` 重要性排序、`U` 锚点保护、密度排序等所有其他剪枝机制照常工作（DeepSeek 档 declared=0 时 50 轮 L1/L2/L3 全 PASS 即证据），只是选择性增益降低。

**与 DSH 的集成方式：**

- 实现 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction`（0.1.0-rc.7）的 `CompactionEngine` 接口。
- **声明式生产挂载已验证**：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile <name> add dsh-argp
```

备选（不经 npm，源码直达）：`dsh plugin --profile <name> add github:yoza10635/dsh-argp`

引擎 entry 由包自带的 bundle patch 创建——**不要**再在 profile 层 insert（会报 `duplicate loader entry id`）。只需在 `cordis.patch.yml` 里禁用 stock 摘要器：

```yaml
- id: compaction-basic
  disabled: true
- id: dsh-argp
  config: { maxPasses: 16 }   # 预算默认按比例驱动，无需硬编码
```

启动后 `ctx.compaction` 即为 ARGP 引擎（实例化检查见 `spike/22-declarative-mount-check.ts`）。
- **预算比例驱动**：`windowTokens = contextWindow × 0.8`（上下文 80% 触发），`retainTokens = windowTokens × 0.2`（压缩率 1/5）——上下文容量来自模型适配器声明，不硬编码；需要时也可显式覆盖。
- 注册两个会话工具：`list_pruned`（查看剪枝目录）和 `recall_pruned` / `recall`（取回被剪原子）。

**验证结果**（DeepSeek v4-flash，50 轮 t-long 任务；完整数字与产物路径见仓库 `docs/experiment-2026-08-16-separated-contract-probe.md`）：

| 指标 | dsh-argp | compaction-basic（同任务 high 档） |
|---|---|---|
| 预算模式 | 比例驱动（200K → 160K 触发 → 32K 保留） | 固定 32K 意图，不可控 |
| 事务 / error | 4 / 0 | 30 / 23（77%，全为空流） |
| U 锚点保留 | 7/7 | 7/7 |
| needle 找回 | 7/7（5/7 经 recall） | 0/7（不可找回） |
| 压缩目标兑现 | 精确（32K） | 实际 67K（失控） |
| 成本（空闲价） | ¥2.695 | ¥3.087 |

**演示**（10K 预算档的真实会话：模型问及被剪内容，引擎取回）：

```
[user] 之前提到的 FACT K1 的值是什么？
[model] FACT K1 = VAL-118V  {"cites":["FACT K1 = VAL-118V"]}
        ↑ 该原子已被剪：模型调用 list_pruned → recall_pruned(seq) 找回后作答
[density 模式] 关键事实保留在 surface → 无需 recall 直接作答
```

***

## 使用前你可能想知道的几点现状

**1. 关于压缩失败（为什么坚持逻辑链剪枝 + 0-LLM）**
在 160K 主流档 50 轮实测中，发现 dsh 自带的摘要压缩（`compaction-basic`）在高思考档下 30 笔事务有 23 笔（77%）以空流失败——`ctx.llm.stream()` 返回空、报 "no text summary content"，把 `maxTokens` 调到 32768 也无效，疑似流式连接问题。**我们对此免疫**：dsh-argp 压缩阶段不调用模型，不存在空流这个失败面——这也是选择非 LLM 方案的实际收益之一。

**2. 被剪内容如何找回**
压缩后历史会被占位符（`[elided seq=N..M ...]`）替换。dsh 的占位符机制目前不带结构化元数据，所以我们通过两个工具补足：`list_pruned` 查看剪枝目录（按 seq/类型/轮次/关键词过滤），`recall_pruned(seq)` 或 `recall(query)` 取回原文（每轮 ≤3 次、单次 ≤5% 窗口、累计 ≤10% 预算）。模型在回答涉及被剪内容时会自动调用它们。

**3. 配置很简单，预算自动跟随模型**
装好后不需要手动算窗口大小：触发线自动 = 模型上下文 × 80%，保留目标 = 触发线 × 1/5（压缩率 1/5）——上下文容量读自模型适配器声明，换模型自动适配。需要自定义时也可显式覆盖（见 README）。

**4. 一个平台层的说明**
`compaction/prune` 目前没有原生事件类型，剪枝事务在事件流里以 summary 语义呈现（内部细节，不影响使用）。希望 dsh 官方后续版本能把算法剪枝纳入事务状态机、并为占位符提供元数据通道。（截至 2026-08-19 发布的 rc.8 已逐包复验，上述两项仍未提供；B-1~B-6 完整反馈与 rc.8 复核结论见下方更新评论。）

discussions.title: DSH Reliability Toolkit — Chaos, Transaction, Idempotency & Bulkhead Plugins
discussions.body:
Hi DSH maintainers and community! 👋

I've been experimenting with reliability and failure-handling patterns around the DSH tool execution lifecycle, and have built a small set of plugins that can be used independently or together.

Plugins

dsh-chaos — Failure Injection

A chaos-testing plugin for intentionally injecting failures into tool execution, useful for validating recovery paths and resilience behavior.

dsh-tool-transaction — Transaction Semantics

Adds transaction-oriented execution semantics around tools, with support for handling failure and rollback-oriented workflows.

dsh-tool-idempotency — Duplicate Execution Protection

Provides idempotency protection for tool calls, helping prevent repeated side effects caused by retries or duplicate requests.

dsh-tool-bulkhead — Concurrency Isolation

Provides tool-level bulkhead isolation and concurrency control to prevent a single tool or external dependency from exhausting shared execution capacity.

Example validation for dsh-tool-bulkhead:

10 concurrent tool calls
        ↓
maxConcurrent = 2
        ↓
5 execution waves
        ↓
observed peak concurrency = 2
        ↓
FIFO order preserved: 1 → 10

How They Fit Together

Conceptually, these plugins target different reliability concerns in the tool execution path:

                    Tool Call
                       │
             ┌─────────▼─────────┐
             │     Bulkhead      │
             │ concurrency limit │
             └─────────┬─────────┘
                       │
             ┌─────────▼─────────┐
             │   Idempotency     │
             │ duplicate control │
             └─────────┬─────────┘
                       │
             ┌─────────▼─────────┐
             │   Transaction     │
             │ failure handling  │
             └─────────┬─────────┘
                       │
             ┌─────────▼─────────┐
             │      Chaos        │
             │ failure injection │
             └───────────────────┘

The goal is not to require this exact ordering, but to explore a set of reusable reliability primitives around DSH tool execution.

Published Versions

dsh-chaos             0.1.0
dsh-tool-transaction  0.1.0
dsh-tool-idempotency  0.1.1
dsh-tool-bulkhead     0.1.0

All four plugins have been published and tested as external consumer packages rather than only from their development workspaces.

For the latest dsh-tool-bulkhead release, I also changed the release pipeline so that the exact tarball that passes the release smoke tests is the artifact that gets published:

npm run prepare-release
npm publish ./<generated-tarball>.tgz

This avoids rebuilding/repacking from a potentially different working-directory state during the final publish step.

Integration Testing

The plugins have been tested through real consumer installation and DSH plugin loading.

For example, the Bulkhead package was validated with:

npm install @why-daydream/dsh-tool-bulkhead@0.1.0

dsh plugin add ...

dsh --dump-config

The resulting plugin tree correctly included tool-bulkhead, and a baseline smoke test with no matching rules remained behaviorally neutral.

An Upstream Observation

While testing clean consumer installations, I also ran into a dependency-resolution issue around dsh-session, which declares a peer dependency on dsh-type-meta that does not appear to be published.

With pnpm, this can block dsh plugin add during peer dependency resolution.

A temporary workaround was:

auto-install-peers=false
+ explicit dependency handling

I have a minimal reproduction and dependency analysis prepared separately and can open an upstream issue if that would be useful.

Motivation

These plugins started from a simple question:

What reliability primitives become necessary once agent tool calls start producing real-world side effects?

Retries alone are usually not enough.

In production-oriented tool execution, concerns such as:

duplicate side effects

partial failure

overload

concurrency isolation

cancellation

rollback

failure injection

observability

quickly start interacting with each other.

I'm interested in exploring how these concepts should fit naturally into the DSH runtime and plugin architecture.

Feedback on the APIs, lifecycle integration, or other reliability primitives that would be useful for DSH is very welcome.

Thanks for building DSH!

discussions.title: Safari: English word autocomplete/predictions missing in chat composer because page is served as lang="zh-CN"
discussions.body:
# Safari: English word autocomplete/predictions don't appear in the chat composer because the page is served as `lang="zh-CN"`

## Summary

The web app's `index.html` hardcodes `<html lang="zh-CN">`. On Safari (macOS 14+), the OS text-prediction engine is language-aware: it keys off the document language, and a Chinese-language page expects CJK input (handled by the IME), so **English inline word predictions / autocomplete never appear** in the chat textarea — even when the user's keyboard and typing language are English.

## Environment

- DSH version: `0.1.0-rc.7` (also present in the published `dsh-web-frontend` dist)
- Browser: Safari (macOS Sonoma/Sequoia+), inline predictions enabled in System Settings → Keyboard → Text Input → "Show inline predictions"
- OS: macOS 14+

## Steps to reproduce

1. Open the DSH web UI in Safari (`dsh web`).
2. Focus the chat composer textarea ("Describe what you want to build").
3. Start typing an English word (e.g. `autocomplete`).

**Expected:** Safari shows inline word predictions while typing.

**Actual:** No predictions appear. The same typing in other web apps (e.g. Google Docs, GitHub) does show predictions, so it's not an OS setting issue.

## Root cause

The shipped template `apps/web/index.html` contains:

```html
<!doctype html>
<html lang="zh-CN">
```

I verified (headless browser against the running instance) that:

- The composer is a plain `<textarea>` with **no** `autocomplete`/`autocorrect`/`spellcheck` attributes — the app does not disable suggestions at the attribute level.
- Nothing sets `document.documentElement.lang` at runtime (the locale plugin doesn't touch it), so the static `zh-CN` from the template is what Safari sees.
- Changing the served template to `lang="en"` and reloading restores English predictions immediately.

## Proposed fix

Don't hardcode `zh-CN` in `apps/web/index.html`. Use the user's language instead, e.g.:

- Default to the browser's `navigator.language` (or the app's configured UI locale) and emit that in the `lang` attribute, or at minimum
- Fall back to a neutral value (`en`) when the app locale is unknown.

If the app intentionally serves Chinese as the default UI locale, the `lang` attribute should still track the *actual* UI language the user sees (which the locale plugin presumably already knows), rather than being baked into the static template.

## Impact

- Safari users typing English (or any non-CJK language) in the DSH chat input lose native word prediction/autocomplete, which is a significant typing-speed regression.
- Same class of problem affects VoiceOver/translation tooling, which also reads `lang`.

## Workaround (local)

Edit the installed package's `dist/index.html` (`lang="zh-CN"` → `lang="en"`) and reload. This is overwritten on the next `dsh` upgrade, hence the request for an upstream fix.
