discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-mission — DeepSeek Harness 长程自主 mission 运行时 / a long-horizon autonomous mission runtime
discussions.body:
# [Plugin] dsh-mission — DeepSeek Harness 长程自主 mission 运行时 / a long-horizon autonomous mission runtime

---

## English

**TL;DR**: a persistent, cross-session, independently verifiable mission runtime for dsh.
The model proposes (`mission_create` / `mission_plan`), the runtime drives
(claim → real subagent → report → verify → commit), and **workers cannot self-certify**.
Install in one line: `dsh plugin --profile web add @qiaoy01/mission`

### Why

dsh handles single-session work brilliantly, but a goal that takes days — build a
whole game, migrate a codebase, ship a feature end to end — has no first-class
runtime. goal tracks one objective, workflow is one-shot, schedule is pure time,
subagent is just the execution unit. Nothing ties them together with **independent
verification** and **crash recovery**.

### What it adds

- **Dependency DAG** — tasks become READY only when upstream tasks are DONE;
- **Independent verification** — `task/report` is a declaration; `task/verify`
  aligns it with real environment feedback. Executors cannot mark their own work done;
- **Replan on failure** — a stuck mission gets a new revision while DONE tasks
  with unchanged specs carry over (days of work are never wasted);
- **Lease ownership + crash recovery** — claims carry tokens and expiries; expired
  unreported claims are reclaimed and redone, with an in-flight guard that prevents
  duplicate dispatch.

### Evidence from a real run

A 7-task DAG (a browser RPG demo: data structures → battle engine + UI + state/save →
integration → self-test → polish) ran end to end:

- **~80 minutes**, one real subagent per task;
- every task went `claimed → reported → verified(passed=true)` — no self-certification;
- **zero failures, zero duplicate dispatch** (we even caught and fixed a duplicate-
  dispatch bug live — see the README story).

### Links

- Repo (topic `dsh-plugin`): https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@qiaoy01/mission
- Design: https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission/blob/main/docs/design.md
- Mechanism survey (why it doesn't duplicate goal/workflow/schedule):
  https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission/blob/main/docs/research.md

### Ask

Feedback is very welcome — especially on the driver-host design, the verification
semantics, and whether this direction fits the ecosystem. If the project opens up
to external PRs later, I'd be glad to contribute it officially.

---

## 中文

**一句话**:为 DeepSeek Harness 写的**长程自主 mission 运行时**插件——持久、跨会话、可独立验证。
模型提议(`mission_create` / `mission_plan`),运行时驱动(认领 → 真实子代理 → 声明 → 验证 → 提交),
**执行者不能自证完成**。一条命令安装:`dsh plugin --profile web add @qiaoy01/mission`

### 为什么

dsh 处理单次会话的工作很出色,但**需要多日完成的目标**(做一个完整游戏、迁移整个代码库、端到端
交付一个功能)缺少一等公民的运行时:goal 只记单一目标,workflow 是一次性脚本,schedule 只是纯时间
触发,subagent 只是执行单元——没有东西把它们和**独立验证**、**崩溃恢复**串起来。

### 它提供了什么

- **依赖 DAG** —— 上游任务 DONE 后,下游任务才派生 READY;
- **独立验证** —— `task/report` 是对环境的**声明**;`task/verify` 独立地把声明与真实环境反馈
  **对齐**。执行者不能给自己的任务打"完成";
- **失败重规划** —— mission 卡死时产出新 revision,**已 DONE 且规格不变的任务跨 revision 保留**
  (多日成果不白费);
- **lease 所有权 + 崩溃恢复** —— 认领带令牌与过期时间;过期且无声明的任务可回收重做,并有
  **在飞任务守卫**杜绝重复派发。

### 真实运行的证据

一个 7 任务依赖图(浏览器 RPG demo:数据结构 → 战斗引擎 + 界面 + 存档 → 整合 → 自测 → 打磨)
端到端跑完:

- **约 80 分钟**,每个任务一个真实子代理;
- 每个任务都走 `claimed → reported → verified(passed=true)`——无自证;
- **零失败、零重复派发**(过程中还现场抓到并修复了一个重复派发 bug,详见 README 故事)。

### 链接

- 仓库(topic `dsh-plugin`):https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission
- npm:https://www.npmjs.com/package/@qiaoy01/mission
- 设计文档:https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission/blob/main/docs/design.md
- 机制调研(为什么不重复造 goal/workflow/schedule 的轮子):
  https://github.com/qiaoy01/dsh-mission/blob/main/docs/research.md

### 请求反馈

非常欢迎任何反馈——特别是 driver-host 的设计、验证语义,以及这个方向是否符合生态。
如果官方以后开放外部 PR,我很乐意把它正式贡献进去。

---

*安装体验、使用问题、改进建议,都欢迎在评论里讨论。*

discussions.title: RFC：统一资源渲染层 —— 可插拔的富输出渲染器 seam（对标 Jupyter Notebook）
discussions.body:
**英文摘要 / English summary**

DSH's web chat currently renders only plain markdown plus absolute `http(s)://` images; there is no first-class seam for rendering workspace-relative resources (images, audio, video, media streams, icons, progress bars, tables/charts). A plugin must either rewrite the model output stream into the durable session log (polluting memory) or fork the whole markdown renderer. This RFC proposes a Jupyter-style pluggable rich-output renderer seam: a resource-reference contract resolved at render time (the session log keeps only the raw reference), typed dispatch (kind/MIME → renderer), and a first-class plugin-extensible renderer registry.

---

**背景 / 痛点**

Agent 经常需要在回复里直接内嵌本地产物：生成的图、音频、视频、实时流、图标、任务进度条、表格/图表等。但当前 `MarkdownText` 渲染器：

- 图片 src 只放行绝对 `http(s)://`，相对路径 `![image](./assets/x.png)` 被降级成纯 alt 文本；
- 完全没有音频 / 视频 / 流 / 进度条等富输出渲染能力；
- 渲染器对 Client 插件封闭（`MarkdownText` 不暴露、`conversation.chat.node` 是 keyed 替换槽、无 decorate）。

**现有三条 workaround 都有害或脆弱**

1. 用 `llm/stream` 改写模型输出流 → 把展示层的事写进持久层（`assistant/chunk` 与 `assistant/message` 落盘改写后的绝对 URL，原始相对路径丢失、历史图变死链、污染 compaction/title、虚增 token）；且该 hook 本身有 bug（见 #2503）。
2. 整体替换 `assistant-step` 渲染器 → 需重写整套 markdown（代码高亮 / 表格 / KaTeX / file-mention 全丢）。
3. 社区自造协议（#2525 的 `output.render.*`）→ 非官方、各自为政、无法互操作。

**提案（对标 Jupyter）**

Jupyter 用 `display_data` 的 MIME bundle + 前端按 MIME 分发渲染器；JupyterLab 用 `rendermime` 注册表让插件扩展 MIME 渲染器。对应到 DSH：

1. **资源引用契约**：一条幂等 / 唯一的引用（相对路径或资源 URI）在**渲染时**解析到会话工作区；session log 只存原始引用，不存解析后状态（无状态、可审计）。
2. **类型分发**：内容 kind / MIME → 渲染器（image / audio / video / stream / icon / progress / table / svg / chart / widget …）。
3. **可插拔注册表**：提供 first-class 的 Service/Slot，让 Client 插件 `register({ kind|mime, priority, presenter })`，作为 #2525 `output.render.*` 的官方内置版。
4. **内置渲染器**：图片（含相对路径）、音频、视频、图标、进度条，并把 #2711 的 Mermaid 方案并入同一条 seam。

**具体 surface（示意，延续 #2711 "fence 语言声明意图" 的模式）**

- 图片：`![alt](./assets/x.png)`
- 音频：以 `audio` 为语言标签的代码块，块内容为路径 → 音频播放器
- 视频：以 `video` 为语言标签的代码块，块内容为路径/URL → 视频播放器
- 媒体流：以 `stream` 为语言标签的代码块，块内容为 URL/管道 → 媒体流
- 进度条：以 `progress` 为语言标签的代码块，块内容为 JSON → 进度条
- 图标：以 `icon` 为语言标签的代码块，块内容为路径 → 图标
- Mermaid：以 `mermaid` 为语言标签的代码块 → 图（并入 #2711）

**不变量 / 范围外**

- 不改写会话记录；渲染层无状态或纯函数。
- 流式时保持纯文本占位，settled 后再渲染（沿用 #2711 的 settled-only + frozen-block 流式缓存约束）。
- 资源解析受会话工作区沙箱约束。

**相关讨论（已调研，无精确重复）**

- #2711 Mermaid render seam（最接近的前例，可复用其 fence 分支与 settled-only 设计）
- #1065 / #1135 Mermaid 渲染
- #2525 社区 `output.render.*` 协议（证明需求 + 缺官方 seam）
- #2431 ASR / TTS / avatar-media 标准 seam
- #1969 通用文件上传
- #2206 / #2210 composer 中 markdown 图片引用 bug
- #2503 `llm/stream` session-title bug（说明改写流这条路不可靠）

**动机小结**：符合 "Everything is a Plugin" —— 渲染层也应是可扩展的，而不是逼插件作者去污染持久层或 fork 渲染器。

discussions.title: 图片上传被拒之后：拒绝信息应该告诉用户该换哪个模型，并且能一键换
discussions.body:
Web 模式下给一个不支持图片的模型发图，现在会被明确拒绝——但拒绝之后，用户要自己去猜哪个模型能看图。缺的不是拦截，是拦截之后的下一步。

## 现状（已经做对的部分）

拦截是完整的，而且分三处：

- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2488` —— 发送带图消息时，若当前模型的 `inputModalities` 不含 `image`，返回 `attachment-error` / `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES`
- `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:2299` —— 会话里已经有图时切到不支持图片的模型，返回 `model-unavailable`，提示 "select an image-capable model"
- `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/read-image.ts:73` —— `read_image` 工具同样按 `inputModalities` 拒绝

也就是说：图不会被静默丢掉，请求也不会带着图糊里糊涂发出去。这部分没有问题。

## 缺的部分

拒绝信息里说了「换一个支持图片的模型」，但没说**换成哪个**，也没有一键换。用户要退出去、打开模型选择器、逐个猜哪个能看图——而这个信息运行时其实已经有了：`llm.resolveModelInfo(provider, model).inputModalities`，每个 provider 都在声明它。

具体提议，按代价从小到大：

1. **在拒绝信息里带上候选模型**。产生 `MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` 时，遍历已挂载 provider 的模型列表，挑出 `inputModalities` 含 `image` 的，把前几个名字放进 `details`。前端有名字就能渲染成按钮。
2. **一键切换**。Web 端把这个错误渲染成「当前模型看不了图片，切到 `<model>`？」，点一下切模型并重发那条消息——会话历史和已上传的图都保留，切换后在 UI 上标明当前模型。
3. **模型选择器里标出图片能力**。列表里给支持图片的模型加个标记，这样用户在上传之前就知道该选谁。

## 关于「自动切换」

有人提过上传图片时自动换模型（这也是我们插件仓库里 [一个用户提的需求](https://github.com/BlockRunAI/dsh-clawrouter/issues/2)）。我倾向于**不要默认自动切**：换模型会同时换掉价格、语气、工具行为和推理支持，因为一次拖拽就静默改掉这些，比报错更难排查。一键确认能解决同样的问题，代价小得多。想要全自动的人可以作为一个显式开关。

## 为什么现在提

第三方 provider 已经在认真声明这个字段了。我们那条路由（[dsh-clawrouter](https://github.com/BlockRunAI/dsh-clawrouter)）的 `inputModalities` 是按**实测**声明的，不是照抄网关的 `vision` 标签：同一张内联 PNG 发给 10 个被标了 `vision` 的模型，只有 Google 和 Moonshot 的正确作答，OpenAI 的收完钱返回 400，xAI 的 503，Anthropic 的收了钱一个字都没吐。所以标签不可信，实测集才可信——数据这一侧已经准备好了，剩下的是 UI 拿它做点什么。

---

**English:** Sending an image to a text-only model is already refused properly (`MODEL_DOES_NOT_SUPPORT_IMAGES` at `api-proxy.ts:2488`, `model-unavailable` at `:2299`, and `read-image.ts:73`). What's missing is the remedy: the refusal never names an image-capable model, so the user has to guess in the model picker. Three steps, cheapest first — put candidate models (`inputModalities` includes `image`) into the error `details`; render that as a one-click "switch to X and resend" that preserves history and the attachment; and mark image-capable models in the picker. I'd argue against silent auto-switching as the default: swapping models changes price, tone, tool behavior and reasoning support, and doing that in response to a drag-and-drop is harder to debug than the error. Make it an explicit opt-in instead.

discussions.title: Windows ACL sandbox tests fail on hosts without PowerShell 7 (pwsh), test bug + fix
discussions.body:
## Summary

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts` fails 6 tests on
any Windows host that only has the built-in Windows PowerShell (5.1) —
which is most Windows machines, since PowerShell 7 (`pwsh.exe`) isn't
preinstalled.

## Repro

Clean checkout, Windows 11, Node 22.17, no `pwsh.exe` on `PATH`:

```sh
pnpm vitest run packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl
```

```
windows-acl-run: CreateProcessAsUserW failed (Win32 2): command: pwsh, cwd: ...
AssertionError: stderr: windows-acl-run: CreateProcessAsUserW failed (Win32 2): ...
: expected 127 to be +0
```

6 of 14 tests in the file fail this way.

## Root cause

The suite gates itself with `describe.skipIf(!isWin32 || !pwshAvailable())`,
and `pwshAvailable()` correctly resolves the real executable through
`resolvePwshPath()` — which, per its own doc comment, falls back to the
legacy Windows PowerShell 5.1 binary when `pwsh.exe` isn't installed. So on
a host with only PowerShell 5.1, the gate passes (a real PowerShell *is*
available).

But the test bodies then spawn the confined child against a hardcoded
`'pwsh'` string literal instead of that same resolved path:

```ts
const result = runRunner([
  '--workspace', writableDir, '--temp', isolatedTemp, '--mode', 'workspace-write',
  '--', 'pwsh', '/NoLogo', '/NonInteractive', '/NoProfile', '/Command', probe,
])
```

`CreateProcessAsUserW` can't find literal `"pwsh"` on the confined child's
search path, so the runner fails closed (exit 127) instead of either
skipping or running against the resolved executable.

Worth noting the production code doesn't have this bug — `PwshLocalExecutor.argv()`
in `packages/shell/pwsh-local/src/index.ts` already spawns through the
resolved `this.pwshPath`, never a literal. It's isolated to this one test file.

## Fix

Reuse the same `resolvePwshPath()` result the skip-gate already computes,
everywhere the tests spawn `pwsh` (7 call sites, 1 file):

```diff
--- a/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts
+++ b/packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/tests/runner.spec.ts
@@ -17,12 +17,17 @@ import { AclWriteGrant, tempWriteSid, workspaceWriteSid } from '../src/index.ts'
 
 const isWin32 = process.platform === 'win32'
 const runnerEntry = fileURLToPath(new URL('../src/runner.ts', import.meta.url))
+// The same resolution the skip-gate probes and the production executor
+// spawns through: a bare 'pwsh' literal is not guaranteed to be on the
+// confined child's search path, and legacy hosts carry only the Windows
+// PowerShell 5.1 fallback (no pwsh.exe at all).
+const pwshPath = resolvePwshPath()
 
 // Functional probe, not where.exe: spawnSync never throws on a missing
 // binary (status null) and where.exe exits 1 without pwsh — only an actual
 // pwsh invocation's exit status is truth.
 function pwshAvailable(): boolean {
-  return spawnSync(resolvePwshPath(), ['-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', '$true'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).status === 0
+  return spawnSync(pwshPath, ['-NoLogo', '-NoProfile', '-NonInteractive', '-Command', '$true'], { encoding: 'utf8' }).status === 0
 }
```

...and the same `'--', 'pwsh', ...` → `'--', pwshPath, ...` swap at the
remaining 6 call sites in the test bodies (lines 97, 129, 158, 187, 350,
363, 390 on `master`).

## Verified

```
Before: Test Files  1 failed | ...   Tests  6 failed | 580 passed | 5 skipped (591)
After:  Test Files  13 passed | 1 skipped (14)   Tests  158 passed | 3 skipped (161)
```

Happy to open a PR with the full diff if external PRs are being accepted —
I know CONTRIBUTING.md currently says they're not, so posting here per
that guidance in the meantime.

discussions.title: Failed/interrupted assistant turn corrupts session — persistent INVALID_REPLAY_STATE on continue (llm-pi-ai)
discussions.body:
_This has been written by AI._

**Summary**

When an assistant turn fails or is interrupted mid-stream, the session appears to persist a *partial* assistant message. Afterwards, every attempt to continue the conversation fails with:

```
invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
INVALID_REPLAY_STATE
```

The conversation becomes permanently unrecoverable — retrying "continue" reproduces the same error every time. Starting a new session is the only workaround.

**Steps to reproduce (observed)**

1. Cause an assistant turn to fail mid-generation (e.g. the upstream provider returns a 429/rate-limit, or the stream is interrupted before the assistant message is finalized).
2. Attempt to continue the same conversation.
3. It fails with `INVALID_REPLAY_STATE`; repeating step 2 keeps failing identically.

**Expected:** A failed/interrupted turn should not commit an incomplete assistant message; the partial turn should be rolled back so the session stays replayable and the user can retry.

**Actual:** The partial assistant content is retained, so the stored block count no longer matches the assistant content, and the `llm-pi-ai` adapter rejects every subsequent replay.

**Possible direction:** Commit the assistant turn atomically only on successful completion (or discard partial content during error handling), so replay-state validation never sees a mismatch.

**Environment:** adapter `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`, dsh `0.1.0-rc.5`. Observed on a downstream build — happy to help narrow it down if it doesn't reproduce on a clean checkout.

discussions.title: Same-mode sandbox_permissions requests hard-error and send agents into a retry loop
discussions.body:
## 一句话说明错误结果 / Summary

Same-mode `sandbox_permissions` requests (requesting the mode the call already runs in) hard-error before executing, and the error text does not tell the model to drop the fields, so agents retry the same invalid call in a loop.

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收 / Reproduction, expected, acceptance</summary>

- **复现步骤 / Repro steps**:
  1. Run `dsh web` on Linux with the confining stack (`dsh-bash-sandbox` + `dsh-fs-sandbox`), a session in `workspace-write` mode.
  2. Ask an agent to run `git status` (bash) or write a file inside the workspace (fs `write`).
  3. Observe the model (e.g. GPT-5.6 Luna or DeepSeek V4 Flash) sending `sandbox_permissions: "workspace-write"` — occasionally with an empty `justification` — even though the session already runs in `workspace-write`.

- **实际结果 / Actual**:
  ```
  Error: invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence
  Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
  ```
  The call never executes; the model retries with `workspace-write`, then `danger-full-access`, with/without justification, in a loop.

- **预期结果 / Expected**: A `sandbox_permissions` request that is **not strictly wider** than the call's effective mode (same-mode or narrower) is a no-op — the call runs under the standing policy. Pairing validation (`justification` required, non-empty) applies only to a genuine strictly-wider escalation ask.

- **环境 / Environment**: Linux, `dsh` packages `0.1.0-rc.x`, sandboxed bash + fs executors, delegated-subagent (workflow) agents.

- **验收条件 / Acceptance criteria**:
  1. A bash/fs/pwsh call with same-mode `sandbox_permissions` (even with an empty `justification`) executes successfully under the standing mode.
  2. A genuine widening (`read-only` → `workspace-write`) still prompts and grants.
  3. A genuinely non-wider request still fails closed, with an actionable message telling the model to retry without `sandbox_permissions`.

</details>

## Root cause

The effective sandbox mode is per-session/per-call (`session override ?? deployment default`), so it cannot be baked into a static tool schema; the schemas advertise the full escalation vocabulary whenever a confining executor is mounted. Two problems compound:

1. The pairing validation (`validateEscalationArgs`) runs in the tool layers **before** the effective mode is known, so an empty `justification` errors even when the requested mode equals the standing mode (nothing is being widened).
2. `approveEscalation` rejects a same-mode request as "not strictly wider" without actionable guidance, so the model keeps retrying.

## Proposed fix (patch ready)

Treat a same-mode request as a no-op and enforce pairing validation only for genuine wider escalations:

- `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` — `approveEscalation`: `mode === effectiveMode` → return `effectiveMode` (no prompt, no pairing requirement); then `validateEscalationArgs`; then the strictly-wider check with an actionable message (`…retry this <subject> WITHOUT sandbox_permissions`).
- `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts`, `packages/shell/tool-pwsh/src/index.ts`, `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts` — stop validating the pairing before the effective mode is known (it now lives inside `approveEscalation`).
- Tests updated in the sandbox, bash, fs, and pwsh suites.

Prepared on branch `fix/escalation-same-mode-noop` (commit `7117ff8`).

## Verification (local, real harness)

Applying the same change to the running packages:
- bash `git status` with same-mode `sandbox_permissions` → executes successfully.
- in-workspace `write` with same-mode `sandbox_permissions` + empty `justification` → executes successfully.
- genuine widening (`read-only` → `workspace-write`) → prompts and grants.
- narrower request → fails with the actionable message.
- rejection/cancellation/unavailable texts unchanged.

The repo's vitest suite should be run in CI (full monorepo install was not performed here).

## Suggested follow-up (model-facing, out of scope)

Consider suppressing the escalation fields for **delegated subagents** (approval pinned to `never`), which can never escalate — advertising the fields invites the speculative misuse above. That requires per-scope tool schemas.

discussions.title: Failed invalid pi-ai replay state: block count does not match assistant content
discussions.body: When a turn is truncated by max_tokens, **BlockAssembler.blocks()** intentionally drops every tool-call block from the durable message content they "cannot be executed safely" if truncated. But **toPiReplayState**  called from **stream.ts:193** with the raw, unfiltered pi-ai message keeps those tool-call blocks in its blocks array. So the durable content and its replay metadata end up with different lengths. The next time that message is replayed as history, **replayedAssistant** hits state.blocks.length !== message.content.length and throws the error.

discussions.title: [Bug] 流式 tool_calls delta 中 name/id 为 null 时被覆盖，导致 unknown tool ""
discussions.body:
**Bug report（该仓库 issues 已关闭，故按 CONTRIBUTING 指引发到 Discussions）**

## 问题描述

通过 `DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` 接入第三方 OpenAI 兼容上游时，如果上游在流式响应的 `delta.tool_calls` 后续 chunk 中把 `id`、`function.name` 输出为 `null`，`dsh-llm-deepseek` 会把 `null` 当作有效值，覆盖此前 chunk 里已经收到的真实工具名和调用 ID。最终组装出的 tool-call 块 `name` 为空字符串，工具运行时抛出：

```
Error: unknown tool ""
```

复现环境：`deepseek-acp@0.3.0`（内含 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek@0.1.0-rc.6`），客户端为 codeg。

## 根因

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`：

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

当 JSON 字段为 `null` 时，`null !== undefined` 为真，于是 `block.name = null`；随后 closeBlock 里的 `block.name ?? ''` 把 `null` 归一化成空字符串。

## 复现

上游返回如下 SSE（实际观察到的 opencode chat/completions 行为，中间无代理改写）：

```text
data: {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"chatcmpl-tool-x","type":"function","function":{"name":"todo_write","arguments":""}}]},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":null,"type":null,"function":{"name":null,"arguments":""}}]},"finish_reason":null}]}

data: {"choices":[{"index":0,"delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":null,"type":null,"function":{"name":null,"arguments":"{\"todos\":[\"test\"]}"}}]},"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}]}

data: [DONE]
```

组装结果：`{"type":"tool-call","id":"","name":"","arguments":"{\"todos\":[\"test\"]}"}` → `unknown tool ""`。

## 期望行为

对 `delta.tool_calls` 采用主流 OpenAI 客户端的增量合并语义：字段为 `null` 或缺省时视为“本次无更新”，只有出现非空字符串时才覆盖。

## 建议修复

```ts
if (call.id != null && call.id !== '') block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name != null && call.function.name !== '') block.name = call.function.name
```

另外可对没有任何有效信号（无 id、无有效 name、无 arguments）的 `tool_calls` 条目直接跳过，避免生成空块。建议同时补一个 `null` 覆盖场景的回归测试。

## 补充

- 已本地用 mock 上游 + `DeepSeekAdapter.stream()` 复现，并验证上述修复有效。
- 相关反馈：xintaofei/deepseek-acp#4（deepseek-acp 打包方）。

discussions.title: headless profile lacks services that session-category plugins depend on
discussions.body:
A plugin that works in `web` can stop `headless` from booting, with no warning at install time and nothing in `--dump-config` to indicate it.

## Reproduction

```sh
export DSH_HOME=/tmp/dsh-repro
dsh --profile headless --dump-config >/dev/null      # bootstrap
dsh plugin --profile headless add github:csyangwen/dsh-memory-evolve
dsh --profile headless --dump-config | grep memory   # present in the composed tree
dsh --profile headless "Say OK."
```

Result:

```
dsh: plugin tree failed to load: dsh: 1 entry did not activate
dsh-memory-evolve: pending (waiting for service: workspaceRegistry)
```

The harness will not start at all until the plugin is removed. The same install under `--profile web` activates and runs normally.

`dsh-memory-evolve` is the highest-starred memory plugin in the community directory, so this is not an obscure edge case.

## Why it is hard to diagnose

- `dsh plugin add` exits 0 and warns about nothing.
- `--dump-config` lists the plugin in the composed tree, because it composes without booting.
- The real cause only appears on stderr of a crashed process, after the plugin is already installed.

A user who installs a plugin into `headless` gets a harness that no longer runs, and the most obvious diagnostic says everything is fine.

## Not specific to one plugin or one service

Testing four memory/session plugins in `headless`, each failed for a different missing piece of the same kind:

| plugin | outcome in `headless` |
|---|---|
| `dsh-memory-evolve` | `pending (waiting for service: workspaceRegistry)`, boot fails |
| `dsh-memento` | boots, but its memory write is rejected — no approver exists, so it silently falls back to a file |
| `@furongjun1999/dsh-memory` | loads and activates, and the agent reports it has no cross-session memory |

`workspaceRegistry` is owned by `@deepseek-ai/dsh-workspace`, which itself injects `storageDomain` and `sessionPersistence`. None of those declare `dsh.bundle`, so they cannot be added to a profile with `dsh plugin add`. Stacking the shipped bundles instead — `dsh-base` + `dsh-web-app` + `dsh-headless` — fails with `duplicate loader entry id: code-runtime`, so the two app bundles appear to be mutually exclusive by design.

The effect is that the `session` category (252 plugins in the community directory) is effectively web-only, and there is no supported way to run those plugins in an automated context.

## What would help

Any one of these would resolve it:

1. **Fail the install, not the boot.** If a plugin's required services are absent from the target profile, `dsh plugin add` could say so instead of leaving a harness that will not start.
2. **A way for a plugin to declare the services it needs**, so the mismatch is visible before installation rather than after.
3. **A services-complete headless mode** — the `web` service stack without the web app — so plugins that depend on workspace/session/approval services can run non-interactively.

(3) is the one that unlocks automation, but (1) alone would turn a broken harness into a clear message.

Versions: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`, node v24.7.0, macOS.

discussions.title: Sandbox escalation can be approved without a prior denied effect
discussions.body:
## Summary

Sandbox escalation currently appears to rely on model behavior for an important prerequisite: the model is told not to escalate speculatively, but runtime does not require a real prior sandbox denial before a genuine widening request can reach human approval.

This is related to #2914, but it is a different issue.

#2914 addresses same-mode `sandbox_permissions` requests such as:

```text
workspace-write -> workspace-write
```

and proposes treating those as a no-op.

The issue here concerns genuine widening:

```text
read-only -> workspace-write
```

The current runtime path appears to allow that widening on the first call, even when the action has never previously been denied by the sandbox.

## Observed behavior

While testing a local Qwen model, I asked it only to run:

```powershell
Get-Location
Get-ChildItem -Force
```

with an explicit instruction not to create, modify, delete, or rename anything.

Its first `pwsh` call nevertheless contained:

```json
{
  "command": "Get-Location; Get-ChildItem -Force",
  "description": "Retrieve current directory and list all files including hidden ones",
  "justification": "To inspect the current directory and its contents without making any changes",
  "sandbox_permissions": "workspace-write"
}
```

There had been no previous sandbox denial for that command.

In this particular session the effective mode was already `workspace-write`, so it failed with:

```text
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
```

That error is explained by the strict-widening check. It does not establish that a prior denial is required.

The model-facing `pwsh` contract already says not to escalate speculatively. The interesting question was therefore whether that rule is also enforced by runtime.

## Source trace

Following the executable paths through:

- `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`
- `packages/shell/tool-pwsh/src/index.ts`
- `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts`
- `packages/fs/tool-fs/src/sandbox.ts`
- `packages/fs/fs-sandbox/src/index.ts`

I could not find runtime state binding a widening request to a previously denied effect.

The existing checks cover:

- `sandbox_permissions` and `justification` validation
- strict mode widening
- approval-service availability
- human approval outcome

But the approval path does not appear to require:

- a prior denial ID
- a prior denied call ID
- an exact command or effect digest
- command or workdir equality
- a retry token
- a single-use denial-derived authority
- an equivalent provenance mechanism

For `pwsh`, the effective path is approximately:

```text
model tool arguments
  -> resolve current sandbox policy
  -> request escalation
  -> validate strict widening
  -> ask for human approval
  -> construct wider per-call policy
  -> execute command
```

The approval happens before the widened command execution, but no preceding denied attempt appears to be required.

## Counterfactual

Consider a fresh session with:

```text
effective mode = read-only
no previous sandbox denial
```

The model's first call is:

```json
{
  "command": "Get-Location; Get-ChildItem -Force",
  "description": "Inspect current directory",
  "sandbox_permissions": "workspace-write",
  "justification": "Need wider access"
}
```

If the human chooses `allowed-once`, the current source path appears to permit:

```text
FIRST CALL
model requests workspace-write
        |
        v
strict widening succeeds
        |
        v
human approves
        |
        v
workspace-write policy applied
        |
        v
command executes
```

There is no preceding:

```text
attempt under read-only
        |
        v
real sandbox denial
```

required by runtime.

## Why this is different from #2914

#2914 says that a genuine widening such as:

```text
read-only -> workspace-write
```

should still prompt and grant.

That is correct for its same-mode retry-loop problem.

The concern here is one layer deeper: should a genuine widening itself be admissible when there was never a prior denied attempt?

Today the tool description appears to say no, while the executable path appears to say yes if the model asks and the human approves.

So even if #2914 is fixed exactly as proposed, this property would remain unchanged.

## Cross-family scope

The same pattern appears to exist in:

- `pwsh`
- `bash`
- filesystem write/edit escalation

This therefore does not appear to be Qwen-specific or a single-tool problem.

## Proposed invariant

A widened sandbox execution should be admissible only when runtime possesses live authority derived from a real denial of the same effect.

Such authority should be:

- created only after a genuine policy denial
- matched against the exact effect
- bound to the same session and agent lineage
- single-use
- non-transferable
- invalid after consumption or relevant expiry

Human approval would remain necessary, but approval alone would not establish that the request is actually a sanctioned retry.

Conceptually:

```text
attempt exact effect under standing policy
        |
        v
real structured sandbox denial
        |
        v
runtime records retry authority for that exact effect
        |
        v
model retries exact effect with escalation request
        |
        v
runtime verifies matching authority
        |
        v
human approval
        |
        v
authority consumed once
        |
        v
wider execution
```

The model would not need to receive the authority token itself.

## Suggested death tests

At minimum:

1. `read-only`, no prior denial, first call requests `workspace-write`
   -> reject before approval, no widened execution.

2. Command A denied, exact command A retried
   -> eligible for approval and exactly one wider execution.

3. Command A denied, command B requests escalation
   -> reject before approval.

4. Command A denied in workdir X, same command retried in workdir Y
   -> reject.

5. Foreground command denied, same command retried as background
   -> reject unless explicitly considered the same effect.

6. Exact retry authority consumed once, then reused
   -> reject.

7. Denial in session X, retry from session Y
   -> reject.

8. Filesystem path, payload, or edit semantics change between denial and retry
   -> reject.

9. Runner startup failure or generic executor failure
   -> must not create retry authority.

10. Two concurrent retries race for the same authority
    -> at most one widened effect executes.

For the first-call case, I think the strongest assertion would be:

```text
approval listener was not called
AND
executor was not called with a wider mode
```

## Possible enforcement seam

The lowest common layer appears to be the existing sandbox package rather than the generic approval service or three independent tool-local implementations.

A sandbox-owned internal authority service could handle:

- denial registration
- canonical effect matching
- single-use consumption
- revocation and freshness
- session and agent binding

`pwsh`, `bash`, and filesystem tools would only provide family-specific effect identity.

This does not require exposing a capability token to the model, and it does not necessarily require cryptography if the authority remains internal to the trusted process.

I have not implemented a patch. I wanted to confirm whether the current behavior is intentional before proposing one.

discussions.title: Recoverable startup mode for incompatible optional plugins
discussions.body:
## Motivation

DeepSeek Harness is evolving quickly, and compatibility-breaking changes are expected during the developer-preview phase. Optional and third-party plugins can therefore become temporarily incompatible with a newer DSH release.

Today, if one of those plugins prevents the application from starting, DSH cannot help diagnose or repair itself because its own UI and agent are unavailable. Recovery requires manually editing configuration or switching to another agent/tool. That is especially inconvenient for users who rely on DSH as their primary development environment.

Could DSH provide a built-in **recoverable startup mode** for failures caused by optional plugins?

## Proposed behavior

1. Always attempt the formal profile normally first.
2. If startup fails before reaching readiness, preserve the original error and leave the formal configuration untouched.
3. Build an ephemeral shadow profile from the same package and patch layers.
4. Keep mandatory/core layers fixed and isolate only optional plugin bundles or user patch entries.
5. Start DSH with the largest known-good optional set.
6. Show a prominent safe-mode notice containing:
   - which optional entries were skipped;
   - the redacted original startup error;
   - an explicit action to retry the formal profile.
7. On the next launch, retry the formal profile first instead of making the degraded profile permanent.

An opt-in flag such as `dsh web --recover-optional-plugins` could be a reasonable first version before considering automatic recovery by default.

## Safety boundaries

- Never skip core runtime, sandbox, permission, authentication, or other security-critical layers.
- If a mandatory layer fails, stop and report the failure normally.
- Never delete, rewrite, disable, upgrade, or reinstall entries in the user's formal profile.
- Keep the degraded profile clearly visible; do not silently present it as a normal startup.
- Redact credentials and credential-bearing URLs from captured diagnostics.
- Bound all readiness probes with timeouts and terminate probe processes cleanly.

## Why this belongs in the launcher/profile-boot layer

A normal plugin cannot implement this reliably: when plugin loading prevents startup, the recovery plugin may never load either. The supervisor needs to live outside the profile it is supervising, while an optional browser plugin can render the notice after the shadow profile becomes ready.

Conceptually:

```ts
const normal = await runDsh({ home: formalHome, timeout: readyTimeout })
if (normal.ready) return normal.wait()

const failure = redact(normal.output)
const candidate = await buildShadowProfile({
  source: formalHome,
  mandatory: coreEntries,
  optional: optionalEntries,
  probe: (profile) => runDsh({
    home: profile,
    port: 0,
    timeout: probeTimeout,
  }),
})

await writeStatusAtomically({
  mode: 'safe',
  skipped: candidate.skipped,
  originalError: failure,
})

return runDsh({ home: candidate.home }).wait()
```

The shadow-profile builder can test optional bundles and atomized user patch entries, cache the accepted set by a fingerprint of the DSH version plus profile inputs, and invalidate that cache whenever packages, patches, or local plugin code change.

## Expected benefit

This would keep DSH available as the tool used to inspect and repair its own optional-plugin compatibility problems, while preserving a fail-closed boundary for core and security-sensitive functionality.

Would this recovery model fit the intended profile-boot architecture? If so, I would be happy to help refine the behavior and safety contract.

discussions.title: Community plugin: dsh-workbench — a sidebar workbench for DSH web
discussions.body:
Hi team 👋

I've open-sourced a DSH web plugin and would love to have it listed in the community plugins section (if one exists / is planned):

**@sjshare/dsh-workbench** — https://github.com/ai-thinkshare/dsh-workbench (npm: [@sjshare/dsh-workbench](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@sjshare/dsh-workbench))

It upgrades the stock sidebar into a full workbench:

- **Workspace browser** — workspace switcher + session list (rename / fork / archive / pin-to-top) + file tree, plus a "changed files" pane that mirrors the native deliverables projection (same source as the chat's 产物 chips, so it stays consistent with the native render-intent rules)
- **Live status dots** — pending-approval / running / selected / idle, rendered with the same priority ladder as the native `sessionStatuses`, including a faithful re-draw of the native StateDot "ongoing" chase animation; coexists with the pin badge
- **Multi-tab file preview** — md / html / code / image in a resizable overlay, with line-range quoting back into the conversation and hard caps so huge files can't freeze the page
- **Composer upgrades** — adaptive-width file reference chips, an `@` file reference source over the workspace tree, and terminal-style ↑/↓ input-history recall
- **Security** — the host RPC route applies a path whitelist (registered workspace roots ∪ session cwds) with lexical traversal normalization; pure helpers + route-level integration tests ship in the repo (`npm test`)

Install:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @sjshare/dsh-workbench
# then add the insert entry to ~/.dsh/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml (see README)
```

Everything is developed against the 0.1.0-rc line, so I expect to track DSH's API evolution closely. Happy to adjust naming/listing format however fits the project — and thanks for building DSH, it's been a pleasure to extend!

discussions.title: rc.7 regression: agents.resume() without explicit agentPreset breaks session assembly ({{model}} has no value)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- dsh web 0.1.0-rc.7 on Linux (Debian 13)

## Repro
1. Persist a session whose header carries `agentPreset: "code"`.
2. Call `ctx.agents.resume({ resumeSessionId })` **without** `agentOptions.agentPreset` (e.g. from a boot-restore/watchdog plugin).
3. Every subsequent turn fails at prompt assembly:
   `prompt variable "{{model}}" has no value for this assembly (section "deployment:persona")`
   The agent loop is unusable: no tools run, no assistant output.

## rc.6 behavior
The same `resume` call worked - the preset (and its `deployment:persona` prompt section, which supplies `{{model}}`) was applied automatically from the session header.

## Root-cause hypothesis
rc.7 requires the preset to be supplied explicitly on resume. When absent, the persona template's `{{model}}` variable has no deployment provider, and the whole assembly fails (tools are part of the same assembly, so they break too).

## Impact
Any unattended resume path (boot-restore / watchdog style, e.g. restoring a duty session after service restart) breaks on rc.7. Workaround: pass `agentOptions: { agentPreset: '<id>' }`.

## Suggested fix
`resume` should inherit `agentPreset` from the session header when `agentOptions.agentPreset` is not supplied (SessionHeader already carries the field), or fail with a clearer error naming the missing variable source.

discussions.title: Feature: Always-On Sessions - auto-resume last active session on boot for unattended scheduled tasks
discussions.body:
## Feature suggestion: "Always-On Sessions" - auto-resume the last active session after service restart

### Problem
The schedule subsystem delivers reminders only to a **live** session (session-local by design). A session becomes live when a browser opens it. This means: after any service restart (daily auto-update, crash, machine reboot), every session is cold until a human opens the browser. Scheduled tasks (recurring reminders, maintenance jobs) silently stop during that window - there is no mechanism to resume them without a client.

In our deployment this produced a 4-hour gap every night after the 03:00 auto-update, until we built a small plugin that calls `ctx.agents.resume({ resumeSessionId })` on boot. The plugin works, but the capability feels like it belongs in the product: unattended scheduled execution is a core use case for agent servers (cf. the current wave of autonomous/always-on agents such as OpenClaw, Hermes, etc.), not an exotic one.

### Proposed feature
A configuration option (per deployment or per session), e.g.:

- `boot.autoResumeLastSession: true` - on service start, after the plugin tree settles, resume the most recently active persisted session (or a configured session id).

Implementation can reuse the existing `ctx.agents.resume()` path - the session header already carries `agentPreset` and other metadata needed for a correct assembly (which also fixes the rc.7 regression where resume needs an explicit `agentPreset`).

### Behavior notes
- Idempotent: if a browser attaches first, resume skips (session already live).
- Failure-tolerant: if the log is corrupt or the session is gone, log and continue - never block boot.
- Optional: only resume when the session has pending schedule records, to avoid eager loading of many sessions.

### Why it matters
- Scheduled tasks (hourly digests, health checks, backups) should not depend on whether a human has the browser open.
- Service restarts are routine (auto-update, reboots); a 4-hour dead window per restart is a reliability gap.
- It turns DSH from an interactive tool into something that can also run as an unattended agent host - a direction the industry is clearly moving toward.

Would the maintainers consider this? Happy to provide the reference plugin implementation (\~40 lines) or submit a PR.

dsh-workflow-isolate: QuickJS/WASM-isolated workflows for DeepSeek Harness rc.7
discussions.body:
> **Independent community project / 非官方社区项目。** This project is independently developed and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. / 本项目由社区成员独立开发，与 DeepSeek 不存在隶属或官方背书关系。

I built [`dsh-workflow-isolate`](https://github.com/Linxiushen/dsh-workflow-isolate), an experimental `WorkflowEngine` provider for DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`.

DeepSeek Harness's stock worker-thread engine uses `node:vm` to shape the model-facing workflow API, and its documentation explicitly notes that `node:vm` is not a security boundary. This project explores the same engine extension seam with a fresh QuickJS/WASM runtime for every workflow run.

我沿着 DeepSeek Harness 的 `WorkflowEngine` 扩展点实现了一个独立引擎：不改变模型看到的 workflow 工具，而是将模型生成的编排脚本放进每次运行新建的 QuickJS/WASM runtime 中。

## What it provides / 主要能力

- Fresh Node worker, QuickJS runtime, and realm for each workflow / 每次 workflow 创建新的 Worker 与 QuickJS realm
- No intentionally exposed `process`, `require`, module loader, filesystem, network, or timers / Guest 不主动获得 Node 全局对象、模块加载、文件系统、网络或定时器
- Plain-JSON Host/Worker/Guest boundary and narrow child-agent RPC / Host、Worker、Guest 之间只传 plain JSON
- DSH-compatible `agent`, `parallel`, `pipeline`, `phase`, `log`, `args`, structured outputs, and lifecycle events
- Limits for QuickJS heap, stack, interrupt fuel, wall time, worker memory, source/result/request sizes, Agent concurrency and total calls, plus combinator fan-out
- Bounded cancellation and disposal, with forced worker termination after the configured grace period

The goal is to stop model-written orchestration JavaScript from automatically inheriting Node.js authority simply because the Harness host runs on Node.

## Security scope / 安全边界

QuickJS/WASM is a stronger language-runtime boundary than `node:vm`, **not** a perfect or OS-level sandbox. The host-side subagent provider remains trusted and retains its configured model, tool, network, and credential access. Runtime vulnerabilities, dependencies, side channels, supply-chain risk, and host denial of service remain in scope.

The project has not received an independent security audit. High-risk or mutually hostile multi-tenant deployments should still add process/container isolation, OS quotas, and network policy. The repository includes a dedicated security model and threat model so these assumptions are explicit.

## Compatibility and install / 兼容与安装

`v0.1.0` deliberately targets the DSH `0.1.0-rc.7` workflow packages. QuickJS is not V8, so workflow bodies must use portable JavaScript and cannot rely on Node APIs, dynamic imports, ambient timers, or V8-specific behavior.

The package is **not published to npm yet**. Install the release tarball:

```sh
curl -L -o dsh-workflow-isolate-0.1.0.tgz \
  https://github.com/Linxiushen/dsh-workflow-isolate/releases/download/v0.1.0/dsh-workflow-isolate-0.1.0.tgz

dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-workflow-isolate-0.1.0.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

- Source and bilingual docs: https://github.com/Linxiushen/dsh-workflow-isolate
- Release: https://github.com/Linxiushen/dsh-workflow-isolate/releases/tag/v0.1.0
- CI: https://github.com/Linxiushen/dsh-workflow-isolate/actions/runs/32051555052

The first release has 41 automated tests. Production-bundle and downloaded-release smoke tests pass, and CI is green on Ubuntu/Windows with Node.js 22.19 and 24. The repository also includes architecture and compatibility documents, a reproducible benchmark harness, examples, contribution guidance, and a security policy.

Feedback on real-world QuickJS compatibility, resource-policy defaults, cancellation behavior, and which upcoming DSH workflow API changes to track first would be especially useful.

discussions.title: [Bug] ask_user_question hangs indefinitely when no tab renders the question — no timeout; manual stop surfaces misleading ASK_ABORTED
discussions.body:
# Bug: `ask_user_question` hangs indefinitely when no browser tab renders the question — no timeout, no notification, only manual cancel returns `ASK_ABORTED`

## Summary

When `ask_user_question` is called while the owning Web UI tab is not actively rendering the question (page closed, tab backgrounded overnight, mux connection dropped), the tool call hangs **indefinitely** with no timeout, no re-notification, and no visible error. The UI keeps showing "running in progress" for the whole time. The only way out is for the user to manually press the stop button, which then surfaces a misleading `ASK_ABORTED` error ("ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered") — implying an abort happened by itself, when in fact the question was never rendered to anyone.

## Evidence (from a real session event log)

Two `ask_user_question` calls in the same session, same code path:

| call | invoked at | result at | wall time |
|---|---|---|---|
| #1 | 18:41:14 | 18:46:48 | 5 m 34 s (normal: user was at the keyboard) |
| #2 | 23:58:27 | 08:18:03 (next day) | **8 h 20 m 36 s** |

For call #2:

- `tool/call` seq 126534 at 23:58:27 with `callId`; after that there is **no `tool/result`, no `step/end`, no `turn/end`** for over 8 hours — the loop stays "running".
- The only subsequent event is `tool/result` seq 126535 at 08:18:03 (immediately after the user clicked the stop button) with content:
  `Error: ask_user_question was aborted before the user answered`
- No `question/resolved`, no `agent/cancel-requested`-attributed event, no timeout event precedes it. The abort came from the user's manual stop.

## Root cause analysis

### 1. The question is rendered only by the live browser composer takeover

The browser half mounts `QuestionComposer` via a slot injected into the conversation composer chain:

- `packages/client/ui-user-questions/src/client/index.ts` — `ctx.slots.inject('conversation.composer', ...)` with selector `selectQuestion` matching `interactions.find(i => i.kind === 'question')`.
- The host mints the pending wait from the `question/requested` mux frame: `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/session.ts:500` → `new PendingWait('question', ...)`.

If no browser tab is connected to that session's mux, or the tab is not rendering the composer chain (closed / backgrounded / disconnected), **nobody ever sees the question** — the host-side pending entry exists, but there is no viewer.

### 2. Re-delivery only happens on mux (re)connect — not on a live-but-inactive tab

On a fresh mux subscription the proxy replays pending questions (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:3436`). But a tab that stays open and connected while inactive does **not** re-render the question — the frame was already delivered once and consumed into a `PendingWait` that nothing displays. There is no heartbeat / re-ping / re-claim.

### 3. No timeout or escalation exists anywhere in the pending-question lifecycle

- Browser side: `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/pending.ts` and `session.ts` contain **no** timeout/expiry for `PendingWait`.
- Host side: `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts:1376` keeps the `pendingQuestions` entry until aborted; nothing expires it.
- The service seam (`packages/interaction/user-questions/src/index.ts`) has no deadline either — `ask()` blocks on `this.provider.ask(request)`.

### 4. The stop button produces a misleading error

The user's manual stop runs `agent.cancel({ kind: 'user' })` (`api-proxy.ts:2631`), which aborts the turn signal; the pending `ask` then throws `ASK_ABORTED` (`user-questions/src/index.ts:93-95`; `api-proxy.ts:1382-1386`). The UI comment in `packages/client/ui-tool/src/client/tool/toolviews/ask-question-row.tsx:51` literally labels `ASK_ABORTED` as "a turn interrupt landing while the question was pending" — so the error is *correct as an abort report*, but it is triggered by the user's own manual cancel, not by anything that happened with the question itself. From the user's perspective the session showed "running" for 8+ hours with no question visible and no error, and the eventual message reads like an internal abort rather than "you had to cancel a hung question".

## Suggested fixes (open to maintainers)

1. **Timeout on pending questions.** Give `PendingWait('question')` (and the host `pendingQuestions` entry) a bounded lifetime (e.g. 5–10 min). On expiry, surface a visible "question went unanswered / re-ask" state in the UI and/or let the model know the ask expired, instead of hanging forever.
2. **Re-notify on inactivity.** If a session has a pending question and its mux has no active viewer (or the tab is backgrounded), re-emit `question/requested` on reconnect — and optionally on `visibilitychange`/focus so a backgrounded tab re-shows the question when the user returns.
3. **Better UX on manual stop.** Distinguish "user manually cancelled a hung question" (`ASK_CANCELLED`) from "turn interrupted" (`ASK_ABORTED`) in the summary the user sees, so a manual stop of a never-visible question reads as *cancelled*, not *aborted*.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness, source at `deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness` `47f943859b` (`feat/npm-public` merge)
- Web UI (`dsh web`), standard agent preset
- Occurred when the question was asked while the browser tab was not actively displaying the session (overnight gap); reproduced once, same-session control call behaved normally.

## Steps to reproduce

1. Start `dsh web`, open a session.
2. Ask the model something that makes it call `ask_user_question` (e.g. a choice between options).
3. Before answering, close the tab (or background it and leave the machine overnight).
4. Reopen / return later: the session shows the turn "in progress" forever; no question UI appears; no error is logged.
5. Click the stop button: only then does the tool result appear as `ASK_ABORTED`.

discussions.title: 致 DeepSeek Harness 团队的一封产品建议：关于命名约定(naming convention)
discussions.body:
**致 DeepSeek Harness 团队的一封产品建议**

---

## 一、dsh 的架构设计是领先的

dsh 提出的 “Everything is a Plugin” 与 Bundle / Profile / Patch 三层分离，是 AI Agent 工程化的一次重要尝试。它把「产品迭代」和「生态积累」解耦，让团队能共享基础设施、按需编排场景、个人还能灵活微调——在 AI 以 hour / day / week 为单位迭代的今天，这是非常前瞻的设计。

但正如一套好架构需要好命名来放大其价值，dsh 当前的术语体系存在一些 **命名过载和边界模糊**，导致社区和用户在理解成本上吃了不必要的亏（至少对我本人是这样）。

---

## 二、用通俗比喻讲清楚：dsh 到底是什么？

### 1. Bundle（能力包）= 预打包的零件套装

想象你去宜家买家具：Bundle 不是单个螺丝，而是一整套配好的组合——「厨房套装」包含橱柜、水槽、抽屉。在 dsh 里，`dsh-base` 打包了模型接口、工具箱、沙盒、会话记录；`dsh-web-app` 打包了浏览器界面。每个 Bundle 本质上是一个 npm 包，自带一份 **配置层（对内叫 patch）**，告诉 dsh：「启动时要在组合表上插入或覆盖哪些插件行」。

> 对外不必把底座 Bundle 一律叫「插件」：`dsh-base` / `dsh-web-app` 更像产品内置层；社区扩展（如 Slack 桥接）才更接近用户心智中的「插件 / 扩展」。

### 2. Profile（场景）= 组装说明书

你买了厨房套装、卧室套装，但 **怎么组合、用在哪个房间**，这就是 Profile。`web` Profile 说「加载 dsh-base + dsh-web-app，启动带界面的完整 Agent」；`headless` Profile 说「加载 dsh-base + dsh-headless，命令行跑完就退出」。Profile 决定「用哪些 Bundle、按什么顺序加载」，并可附带本场景的用户覆盖层。

### 3. Mode / Preset（行为模式）= Agent 的使用方式

同一个厨房，可以按「中餐模式」把炒锅放主位，也可以按「西餐模式」把烤箱放主位。Mode（当前技术名 Preset） **不替换整套 Bundle**，只改变「单个 Agent 看到哪些工具、遵循什么流程、挂哪些提示」。例如：`standard` 直接执行；社区的 [`qa-mode`](https://github.com/light051001/dsh-preset-qa-mode/tree/main) 先多轮澄清再动手；`minimal` 只给极少工具。

> 注意：Mode/Preset 与 Profile **不是同一平面**。Profile 组装的是 **host / 进程级** 插件表；Preset 组装的是 **单个 Agent realm** 的贡献。文件形态都可能是 `*.cordis.yml`，但职责不同——说「Preset 本质上也是一份组装清单」可以，说「Preset 就是 Profile」会加深误解。

### 4. 配置覆盖（对内：Patch）= 透明胶片 / 便利贴

房子装好了，你还有自己的需求：「水龙头换成我买的牌子」「卧室多加一个插座」。用户侧应把这种能力理解成 **配置覆盖（config / overrides）**：按 id 精确找到某一行，整行重写或插入新行，不动发行版原始文件。多层叠在一起时，**同位置后盖前，没盖住的地方透上来**——像多张透明胶片。

对内实现上，这正是 Cordis 的 **entry patch** 算子：从空表开始，Bundle 层、Profile 层、home 层、`--patch` 层用的是同一套增量操作。因此：

- 对 **用户**：日常改模型、主题、开关，应叫「配置 / 覆盖」，不要主推 “patch”（易联想成修 bug 的临时补丁）。
- 对 **贡献者 / 架构文档**：保留 patch 作为精确术语（delta、按 id、整行替换、可 insert）完全合适。

---

## 三、当前术语体系的 3 个核心痛点

### 痛点 1：Profile 一词「超载」，并与 Preset 边界模糊

用户执行 `dsh --profile web` 时，Profile 是「场景」（web / headless）；打开列表又看到 `standard` / `minimal` / `qa-mode` 这些「行为模式」——官方叫 Preset，但实现文件常是 `agent.cordis.yml`，看起来也像「一份组装说明」。

**用户困惑**：「Preset 和 Profile 到底什么关系？为什么 [qa-mode](https://github.com/light051001/dsh-preset-qa-mode/tree/main) 不能（或不该）放在 `profiles/` 里？」

根因不是用户笨，而是两个概念都叫「组装」，却没有稳定的用户层区分词。

### 痛点 2：Patch 对用户是错误的默认联想

在软件工程里，Patch 的默认联想是「修复漏洞的临时补丁」。但在 dsh 里，patch 是 **核心组合机制**——不仅用户覆盖靠它，连 Bundle 本身也以 patch 层贡献配置。

对用户而言，第一次看到 `cordis.patch.yml` / `--patch` 容易误判：「这是修 bug 的，我应该很少用到。」  
对架构而言，把 patch 说成「偶尔贴的便利贴」又 **偏窄**：它是整棵组合树共用的算子，用户层只是最后几层。

**更准确的产品表述**：用户侧叫配置覆盖；技术侧继续叫 patch。问题在 **暴露面**，不在机制本身。

### 痛点 3：用户层和技术层没有分离

社区贡献者讨论的是 Bundle、Cordis、Patch；终端用户只想「换个 Mode、装个扩展、改个配置」。**技术术语直接暴露给用户**，增加了不必要的心智负担。

---

## 四、建议方案：用户语言与技术语言分层

成熟产品不会让中间表示直接成为用户语言。建议对外统一为用户层词汇，技术层在内部消化：

| 用户层（对外） | 技术层（对内） | 说明 |
|:---|:---|:---|
| **Mode（模式）** | Preset / `agent.cordis.yml` | Agent 怎么思考、用什么工具、遵循什么流程 |
| **扩展 / 能力包** | Bundle（尤其是可安装扩展） | 功能扩展；内置底座仍可称 Bundle / 内置层，避免把 `dsh-base` 误导成「可选插件」 |
| **配置 / 覆盖** | Patch / Overlay / `cordis.patch.yml` | 改模型、调参数、插入或覆盖某行；实现仍是 entry patch |
| **场景** | Profile | 用哪些 Bundle、什么顺序；可保留为进阶概念，但产品入口可用更口语的名字（如「网页版 / 命令行任务」） |

### 为什么 Mode 比 Preset 更好？

- **区分度高**：`--profile web --mode qa` 比 `--profile web --preset qa` 更不容易被当成同义词；Preset（pre-set）对不少人并不直观。
- **行业对齐**：Cursor 的 Agent Mode、游戏的职业 Build、浏览器的浏览/无痕模式——用户已懂「Mode = 行为范式」。
- **需与现有 “plan mode” 并存时写清**：仓库里已有会话内的 **plan mode**（规划态）。对外应用 Mode = Preset 时，文档应区分：
  - **Agent Mode（原 Preset）**：选哪套工具与流程；
  - **Plan mode**：同一次会话里的规划/执行态。  
  避免用一个新词换另一处过载。

---

## 五、具体改动建议

### 1. CLI 对齐（用户语言优先，进阶能力保留）

```bash
# 当前（技术术语偏多）
dsh --profile web --preset qa-mode --patch ./my.yml

# 建议（用户语言）
dsh --mode qa --overlay ./my-overrides.yml
# 或更产品化的入口（底层仍解析为 profile）
dsh web --mode qa

# 进阶用户仍可显式指定场景
dsh --profile web --mode qa --overlay ./my-overrides.yml
```

说明：

- `--preset` 保留为 `--mode` 的别名（至少 2 个版本周期）。
- `--patch` 建议主推 `--overlay`（或 `--config-file`），`--patch` 作别名。
- `--config model=claude` 这类 **key=value 快捷设置** 很有价值，但与「文件型覆盖层」不是同一能力：前者是设置面 UX，后者是完整组合 delta；可以并存，不要写成「把 patch 改名就等于 key=value」。

### 2. 目录结构（用户可见命名）

```text
.dsh/
├── modes/                 # 用户自定义 Agent 模式（原 .agent-presets/）
│   ├── qa/
│   ├── minimal/
│   └── my-team/
├── extensions/            # 用户安装的扩展（可安装 Bundle；命名对外友好即可）
├── config.yml             # 或 overrides.yml：用户全局覆盖（原 home 级 cordis.patch.yml）
└── profiles/              # 场景（进阶；默认可用产品名封装）
    ├── web/
    ├── headless/
    └── ...
```

兼容：`.agent-presets/` ↔ `modes/` 软链或双读；旧文件名在文档中标注「原称」。

### 3. 向后兼容策略

- `--preset` → `--mode` 别名；`--patch` → `--overlay` 别名；至少维护 2 个版本周期。
- 目录迁移用软链 / 双路径读取，避免打断现有用户。
- 文档采用「新词（原称旧词）」过渡，例如：**Mode（原称 Preset）**、**配置覆盖（实现为 cordis patch）**。

### 4. 文档层面的「隐喻统一」

建议官方文档统一一套比喻，降低理解成本：

- **Bundle = 零件套装**（宜家套装；扩展套装 vs 内置底座）
- **Profile = 组装说明书**（场景搭配：网页版 / 命令行任务）
- **Mode = 使用模式**（中餐模式 vs 西餐模式；注意与 plan mode 区分）
- **配置覆盖 = 透明胶片**（后盖前，没盖住的地方透上来；对内即 patch 层）

---

## 六、结语

dsh 的架构设计是优秀的——Bundle / Profile / Patch 的分离，解决了 AI 应用「基础设施变化快、场景组合多、个人偏好强」的核心矛盾。但 **好架构需要好命名来放大价值**。

建议 DeepSeek 团队考虑：

1. 将用户层语言统一为 **「Mode + 扩展 + 配置覆盖（+ 场景）」**；  
2. 让 Bundle / Preset / Patch 回归技术层与进阶文档，像编译器的中间表示——普通用户不必天天看见；  
3. 对 Patch：**不要废机制，要换暴露面**——用户侧叫配置/覆盖，技术侧保留 patch 作为精确算子。

期待 dsh 不仅是「工程师的 Agent 框架」，更是「团队和用户都能直观理解的 AI 操作系统」。

---

**建议人**：dsh 社区用户  
**日期**：2026-08-18

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh web 首次打开页面必现 "Failed to load plugins"（29 个 entry 全部 pending），刷新后恢复
[Bug] dsh web 网页切到后台后画面停止更新,回到前台不自动补拉最新会话状态,需手动刷新
discussions.body:
`dsh web` 的浏览器页面在**切到后台标签页(或窗口失焦)一段时间后,画面会停在旧状态**:
- "Deep diving..." 旁边的运行时长秒表停留在旧值(如 13:17),而实际任务已运行更久;
- 会话里**新产生的 step / tool 事件不显示**(例如服务端已执行到 step 143,页面还停在第 89 步);
- **回到前台后页面不会自动追平**,必须手动刷新(F5)才能看到最新内容;
- 后端 Agent 本身**完全正常**:所有 step 都执行完、`turn/end reason=completed` 正常落盘、产物文件正常生成——只是**前端显示滞后/漏事件**。

## 环境

- DSH:`0.1.0-rc.6`(已在 GitHub master / rc.7 源码上确认该问题依然存在)
- 操作系统:macOS,arm64
- 启动模式:`dsh web`(`http://127.0.0.1:3080`)
- 复现规模:单会话长任务(100+ step),期间把页面切到后台

## 复现步骤

1. `dsh web` 启动,新建一个会话,交给 Agent 一个多步骤长任务(几十到上百个 tool step)。
2. 任务进行中,**把浏览器标签页切到后台**(或切到别的窗口),等待几分钟。
3. 切回 dsh 页面,观察:会话画面停留在切走前的某一步,运行时钟停止走动。
4. 不刷新,继续等待——画面可能长时间不追平;手动 F5 刷新后,全部最新内容一次性出现。

## 实际结果

- 页面事件流停滞(漏显示或延迟显示服务端已产生的事件)。
- 秒表(运行时长)显示值与服务端真实进度不一致。
- 回到前台无任何自动同步,需要手动刷新。
- 后端日志正常,Agent 未卡死(本报告排除 "agent hang" 情形)。

## 预期结果

- 页面回到前台时,自动重新拉取会话最新状态(等价于一次自动刷新),无需手动操作;
- 运行时钟从服务端时间戳恢复,而不是依赖本地被节流的计时器。

## 根因(源码定位,rc.6 / rc.7 master 相同)

浏览器会**冻结/节流后台标签页的计时器与事件投递**(HTML 规范行为),而前端存在三处缺口:

1. **无"回到前台重新同步"逻辑**:整个 `packages/client` 源码中搜索不到 `visibilitychange` / `pageshow` 监听。`packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts` 中 `onStateChange` 只在 `'reconnecting'` 时调用 `sessions.handleDisconnected()`(仅清缓冲),`onConnected` 才调用 `sessions.handleConnected()` → `session.resync()`(重新拉窗口)。这条正确的补漏路径**只挂在"连接真的断开重连"上**,页面被冻结 ≠ 连接断开,因此永远不会触发。
2. **运行时钟依赖本地 `setInterval`**:`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx` 的 `TurnStatus` 用 `setInterval(tick, 1000)` 以 `Date.now()` 计算 elapsed;后台标签页中该计时器被节流/冻结 → 秒表停走,且无 `visibilitychange` 重算。
3. **重连横幅从未挂载**:`packages/client/ui-primitives/src/ConnectionBanner.tsx`("连接已断开,正在重连…")已实现并有单元测试,但仓库中**没有任何业务 UI 挂载它**(仅测试引用),断线时用户无任何提示。

## 修复建议(已实现,补丁见文末)

1. `packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts`:在 `apply()` 中注册 `visibilitychange` 监听,页面回到前台(`document.visibilityState === 'visible'`)时调用 `sessions.handleConnected()` / `workspaces.handleConnected()` / `ctx.emit('connection/reset')`,复用现有 `resync()` 补漏路径。
2. `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx`:`TurnStatus` 的 effect 同时监听 `visibilitychange`,回前台立即 `tick()` 重新对表。
3. (可选)将 `ConnectionBanner` 挂载到 shell,并把连接状态暴露给 UI。

### 补丁(已通过 `pnpm run test:gui` 3754 个测试、`pnpm run typecheck` 零错误,可在 rc.7 master 上干净 apply)

```diff
--- a/packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts
+++ b/packages/client/runtime/src/client/index.ts
@@ -230,4 +230,25 @@ export function apply(ctx: Context): void {
     },
   })
   ctx.effect(() => () => { loop.stop() }, 'runtime: connection stream loop')
+  // Browser visibility recovery: background-tab throttling pauses stream
+  // delivery and UI timers (setInterval is clamped or frozen while hidden),
+  // so events produced while the page was not visible may be missing from
+  // the open window or arrive late. Reusing the reconnect path on return to
+  // the foreground re-baselines every opened session (refreshList + resync),
+  // converging the visible conversation on the host without a manual reload.
+  const onVisibilityChange = (): void => {
+    if (document.visibilityState !== 'visible') return
+    sessions.handleConnected()
+    workspaces.handleConnected()
+    ctx.emit('connection/reset')
+  }
+  if (typeof document !== 'undefined') {
+    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
+  }
+  ctx.effect(
+    () => () => {
+      if (typeof document !== 'undefined') document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
+    },
+    'runtime: visibility recovery listener',
+  )
 }

--- a/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx
+++ b/packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/ChatView.tsx
@@ -122,7 +122,16 @@ function TurnStatus({ startTime, t }: {
     }
     tick()
     const id = setInterval(tick, 1000)
-    return () => { clearInterval(id) }
+    // Background-tab throttling clamps setInterval while the page is hidden;
+    // re-tick on return so the clock snaps to the real elapsed time at once.
+    const onVisibilityChange = (): void => {
+      if (document.visibilityState === 'visible') tick()
+    }
+    document.addEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
+    return () => {
+      clearInterval(id)
+      document.removeEventListener('visibilitychange', onVisibilityChange)
+    }
   }, [anchor])
```

## 相关讨论

- #387(Agent 杀死宿主导致会话永久"运行中")、#466(其根因)与本问题同类:均为**浏览器/客户端状态与服务端不同步、缺少恢复机制**;本报告是"Agent 正常完成、仅前端显示滞后"的独立变体。

discussions.title: dsh web --stop / dsh web --restart — stop orphan dsh web processes cleanly
discussions.body:
## Problem

When a terminal running `dsh web` is closed, the node process listening on port 3080 **survives as an orphan**. There is no built-in way to stop it:

- `dsh` has no `stop` / `restart` subcommand
- `Ctrl+C` in the original terminal only kills the foreground shell — the `dsh web` process (often backgrounded or launched via npx) keeps running
- `lsof -i :3080` + `kill` works but is manual and undiscoverable for new users
- Port 3080 stays occupied, so starting `dsh web` again fails with "port in use" until the user finds and kills the old process

This is the most common friction point I've seen in dsh-doctor diagnostics (#2752 white-screen bugs often coincided with orphan processes) and in community reports.

## Proposal

Three additions to the `dsh web` command:

### 1. `dsh web --stop`

Kill the process listening on the dsh web port (default 3080). Graceful SIGTERM with 5s timeout, then SIGKILL. Print what was killed (PID, uptime).

```
$ dsh web --stop
Stopping dsh web (PID 27158, uptime 3h12m)...
✓ Stopped (port 3080 free)
```

### 2. `dsh web --restart`

Equivalent to `--stop` + normal start. The most common intent when a user wants to "refresh" dsh.

```
$ dsh web --restart
Stopping dsh web (PID 27158)...
✓ Stopped
Starting dsh web on 127.0.0.1:3080...
✓ Ready
```

### 3. Auto-reclaim on `dsh web` start (optional)

When `dsh web` finds port 3080 occupied by another dsh instance (same profile), log a warning and auto-stop it before starting. This turns a confusing "port in use" error into a self-healing experience. Only auto-reclaim if the occupier is a dsh process (same profile path / dsh binary signature) — never kill an unknown occupier without asking.

```
$ dsh web
Port 3080 occupied by dsh web (PID 27158, same profile). Auto-stopping...
✓ Stopped old instance
Starting dsh web on 127.0.0.1:3080...
✓ Ready
```

## Why this matters

- **Discoverability**: new users don't know they need `lsof + kill` — they just see "port in use" and restart their machine
- **Consistency**: pm2, Docker, and every daemon manager have `stop`/`restart`. dsh is the only one that doesn't
- **Diagnostic accuracy**: orphan processes cause stale state (old plugins loaded, wrong settings panel) that dsh-doctor can't fix without a restart the user doesn't know how to do

## Current workaround (what I ship in my dotfiles)

```bash
dsh-reset() {
  local port="${1:-3080}"
  local pids=$(lsof -i :$port -sTCP:LISTEN -F p -n | sed 's/^p//')
  [ -n "$pids" ] && kill $pids && sleep 2 && kill -9 $pids 2>/dev/null
  dsh web --host 127.0.0.1 --port $port &
  disown
}
```

Works, but every user has to write this themselves. Upstream is the right place.

discussions.title: When clicking on the input card in the blank workspace, two system selection directory boxes will overlap.
discussions.body:
空白工作区连点输入卡片会叠两个系统选目录框。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

## 复现步骤

1. Windows 本机启动 Web GUI（`directory-picker-auto` 会解析为 native：回环绑定 + win32）。
2. 使用全新安装状态：Workspace 列表为空，主界面 hero 输入卡片占位为「选择一个工作区开始」。
3. 单击该虚线输入卡片，系统弹出「Select Workspace Directory」文件夹对话框。
4. **不要关对话框**，再点一次同一张输入卡片（连点或对话框仍开着时再点）。
5. 取消系统对话框。

## 实际结果

叠了两个系统选目录对话框；取消一次后还有一个，必须再取消一次。

Windows 上对话框在独立子进程里 `Show`、没有 owner 窗口，网页仍可点，所以第二次点击能打到输入卡片。

## 预期结果

从第一次点击到选择器结束，只允许一个目录选择器。第二次点击应被忽略（或落到同一个已打开的选择器），取消一次即可。

## 环境

- OS: Windows
- 交互：native `IFileOpenDialog`（无工作区时的 composer 捷径）
- 入口文案：`placeholder.workspace` = 「选择一个工作区开始」

## 验收条件

- [ ] 空白工作区下，对 hero 输入卡片连点或对话框未关时再点，只出现一个系统选目录框。
- [ ] 取消一次即回到无对话框状态。
- [ ] 侧边栏「添加工作区」在选择器未关时不会再开第二个。
- [ ] 有工作区时的菜单路径仍保持 `flowBusy`（菜单项禁用）行为。

## 代码

点击入口：整张卡片调用 `onRequestWorkspace`，没有 in-flight 锁。

// packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx
onClick={workspaceTrigger ? onRequestWorkspace : undefined}

discussions.title: 提案：为第三方可配置 Provider 提供通用 Web 编辑与图片模型选择
discussions.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek Harness 已允许 LLM 插件通过 configurable-provider directory 和 Settings namespace 暴露第三方 Provider，但 Web 的 Models 页面目前主要针对内置 DeepSeek / pi-ai 结构提供定制编辑器。树外 Provider 即使公开了合法 schema，仍很难在 Web 中安全完成以下配置：

- 写入只读回显的 API Key 引用；
- 编辑简单的字符串、数字和布尔配置；
- 为明确标记的图片模型字段选择真正支持图片输入的模型；
- 在不重建整个 settings section 的前提下保存局部字段。

这和 #356、#1992 中暴露的“自定义 Provider 图片能力容易丢失或默认为 text-only”问题相关，但这里希望讨论的是一个更通用的公共配置面，而不是为某个 Provider 写特例。

## 建议的公共行为

1. 对不属于内置定制布局的 configurable Provider，提供有边界的 schema fallback。
2. 根级 `credential-ref`（例如 `apiKeyEnv`）继续使用只写凭据控件，密钥不进入 settings、页面回显或响应。
3. 普通 string / number / boolean 字段可直接编辑；array、object、union 等复杂字段仍留在 `settings.yaml`，不尝试生成万能表单。
4. 显式标记为 `image-model-ref` 的字符串字段保留手工输入，同时可调用 Provider 自己的 `llm.discoverModels`。
5. discovery 返回模型的 `inputModalities`，客户端只把声明支持 `image` 的模型作为候选项。
6. 保存继续使用 path-addressed mutate，只修改页面实际看到的字段，避免从 redacted descriptor 重建 section 时误删插件私有配置。
7. 表单中临时输入的 API Key 只用于本次 endpoint interrogation，不存储、不返回。

这里不希望引入 Provider 专属协议推断、复杂 schema renderer 或插件市场；目标只是让第三方 Provider 可以通过现有公共合同获得一个安全、有限的配置入口。

## 兼容性与验证

我在 fork 中准备了一份可运行实现和测试：

- 评审实现：https://github.com/4-1-1/deepseek-harness/pull/1
- ProviderEditor、wire schema、`inputModalities` 合同和中英文文档一起更新；
- 定向测试 129 项通过；
- GUI 测试 3788 项通过（1 skipped）；
- Web 测试 253 项通过（15 skipped）；
- lint、doc-sync 和 typecheck 通过。

## 想向维护者确认

1. 这种“有限 primitive fallback + 显式 `image-model-ref`”是否符合项目对第三方 Provider 的扩展方向？
2. `inputModalities` 是否适合作为 `llm.discoverModels` 的公共返回字段？
3. 如果方向可接受，维护者是否愿意 cherry-pick 上述提交，或临时开放 PR 以便按反馈拆分和调整？

感谢评审。

discussions.title: 提案：为 Bundle patch 增加按插件身份校验的整行替换能力
discussions.body:
## 背景

DeepSeek Harness 的 profile 通过有序 Bundle layer 组合 Loader entry。当前普通 patch 可以按 `id` 覆盖字段，也可以 `insert` 新条目；但 patch 外层的 `name` 是身份匹配条件，不是可写字段，因此树外 Bundle 无法把一个已有 row 的插件实现替换成另一个实现。

对 `agent-loop` 这类单一所有者 seam，这会留下两个不安全的绕过方式：

- 用相同 `id` 插入新插件，最终因重复 id 启动失败；
- 禁用旧 row，再用另一个 id 插入新插件，配置中同时存在两个所有者，且 stale disable 可能让两个 AgentFactory 同时注册。

我检索了现有 Discussions，没有找到讨论“Bundle 按预期插件身份原子替换完整 row”的同题提案。

## 建议的公共 API

为 `PatchOptions` 增加显式的完整 replacement：

```yaml
- id: agent-loop
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop'
  replace:
    name: '@ezone/dsh-agent-opencode'
    config:
      runtime: opencode
```

建议语义：

1. 外层 `id` 定位目标并保持不变；外层 `name` 是预期的当前插件身份。
2. `replace` 提供除 `id` 外的完整新 entry，而不是和旧 row merge，避免旧插件的 `config`、`inject`、`group`、`disabled` 等字段泄漏。
3. 目标缺失、当前 `name` 不匹配、replacement 自行声明 `id`，或和 `insert`／外层 override 字段混用时直接抛错。
4. 两个 Bundle 都声称替换同一个原始插件时，第二层因 identity mismatch 明确失败，而不是按加载顺序静默选出一个所有者。
5. 普通 override 指向当前 surface 不存在的 row 时，继续保持现有 warning-and-skip 行为。
6. boot、profile composition、热重载和 `--dump-config` 使用同一个 `applyEntryPatches` 语义。
7. 删除或卸载 replacement Bundle 后，从未修改的下层配置重新组合，自动恢复原插件。

## 为什么希望放在公共 composition 层

如果由运行时插件私下修改 Loader tree：

- `--dump-config` 看不到真实结果；
- 热重载和失败回滚需要第二套协议；
- 卸载恢复依赖插件自行清理；
- 冲突结果会变成时序相关。

显式 patch operation 可以保持 Bundle 的声明式、可 dump、可热重载和可逆性质。它也不只服务于 AgentLoop：任何明确要求单一所有者、并希望由树外 Bundle 替换实现的 Service Provider 都可以使用同一合同。

## 实现与验证

我在 fork 中准备了一份独立实现：

- 评审 PR：https://github.com/4-1-1/deepseek-harness/pull/2
- 可独立 cherry-pick 的提交：https://github.com/4-1-1/deepseek-harness/commit/81fe9c4576be6dcad936ed4259a041448eb44a0a
- 完整 app-boot 测试：109/109 通过；
- 覆盖单 row 替换、第二声明者冲突、配置 dump、真实插件生命周期和移除层后的恢复；
- `doc-sync` 28/28、lint、typecheck、`git diff --check` 均通过；
- vendored Include divergence 和中英文公共文档已同步记录。

## 想向维护者确认

1. 是否认可在公共 `PatchOptions` 中增加这种严格的完整 replacement？
2. 字段名 `replace` 和“外层 name 作为 expected identity”的表达是否合适？
3. 如果方向可接受，维护者是否愿意 cherry-pick 该独立提交，或临时开放 PR 以便根据反馈调整？

这个能力是树外 AgentFactory Bundle 对官方 DeepSeek Harness 保持可安装、可卸载且不维护 fork 的前置条件。感谢评审。

discussions.title: dsh web 同进程第二个 cordis 预设会话挂载失败：Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is already registered
discussions.body:
**Duplicate of #1415** (canonical thread with the full analysis and independent verifications — my supplementary rc.7 reproduction is posted there: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1415#discussioncomment-18058760). Keeping this short note instead of a full repost.*

---

**环境**

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.7`（`npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web`），macOS (arm64)，Node v22
- 预设：仓库自带的内置 `cordis` 预设（`config/agent-presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml`）

**现象**

dsh web 进程里已有一个 cordis 预设会话挂载时，resume 第二个 cordis 预设会话会直接失败：

```
agent-presets: preset "cordis" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry
tool-cordis (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis): Host Cordis inspect provider
"Service" is already registered (.../config/agent-presets/cordis/agent.cordis.yml) (internal)
```

**复现步骤**

1. `npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web`
2. 打开一个 cordis 预设会话，保持挂载
3. resume 另一个 cordis 预设会话（新会话挂载走同一条 mount 路径，预期同理）
4. 第二个会话在 `tool-cordis` 行挂载失败，resume 请求被整体拒绝

**根因定位**（顺着报错栈读到的代码）

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis` 的 `apply(ctx)` 在**每次挂载**时都会执行：

  ```js
  for (const provider of hostInspectProviders(ctx))
    ctx.effect(() => ctx.cordisInspect.register(provider), `tool-cordis: inspect ${provider.manifest.id}`);
  ```

  注册 id 硬编码为 `Service` / `Event` / `Builtin` / `Tool` 四个 Host inspect provider（`hostInspectProviders()`）。

- `CordisInspectRegistryService`（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-cordis-host-runner`）是进程级单例（类注释 "Register the process-global Host registry"），`register()` 对已存在的 id 直接 throw：

  ```js
  if (this.providers.has(manifest.id))
    throw new Error(`Host Cordis inspect provider "${manifest.id}" is already registered`);
  ```

- 因此同一 dsh web 进程内，第二个 cordis 预设会话的挂载必然撞在 `Service` 上。
- 内置 cordis 预设的 `agent.cordis.yml` 对 subagent setup 注释了同类单例语义（"one copy per mounted preset ... which throws on the second"），说明这类单例语义是已知设计，但 inspect provider 这条路径没有对应的多会话防护。

**佐证**

重启 dsh web 后，同一会话、同一预设的 resume 立即恢复正常——说明问题在进程内注册表状态，与会话文件、预设内容无关。另外，被拒的 resume 不会写会话日志（挂载失败发生在日志追加之前），用户侧看起来像"这个会话坏了"，实际重启宿主即可恢复。

**影响**

经常用 cordis 预设做组合开发的用户，历史会话攒多之后，任意一个 cordis 会话先被挂载，其余 cordis 会话的 resume 都会失败，只能重启 dsh web 清空注册表。

**期望**

dsh web 是多会话并存的界面，希望能支持同进程多个 cordis 预设会话挂载（注册共享 / 引用计数 / 按 scope 隔离均可）；若短期不改动，也建议在挂载失败时给用户明确提示（例如"同一时刻仅支持一个 cordis 会话挂载"），代替当前的 internal error。
