discussions.title: 主session调用上千subagent，严重拖慢dsh速度
discussions.body:
## 摘要

`session_projcache.json` 每产生一个子代理就新增一行投影，而**已结束（settled）的子代理投影永不回收**。当主会话大规模委派子代理（累计上千个）后，缓存会膨胀到几千行，但其中只有极少几行对应磁盘上的真实会话。这会拖慢 Web 界面的会话列表与查询；而且目前没有官方清理入口，只能手动“停服 → 改 JSON → 重启”。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7（web profile，Windows）
- Windows PowerShell

## 复现步骤

1. 在一个主会话里大量委派子代理（例如通过 workflow/技能按文件分别拉起子代理，如用 multimodal-understanding 批量处理 PDF），累计可达上千个。
2. 子代理结束后内容已折叠进父会话，但它们的行仍保留在 `~/.dsh/storages/session_projcache.json` 的 `tables.sessions` 里；同时主会话头部会长期显示上千个“子代理”。
3. 本机实测：**共 3623 行，其中只有 6 行对应磁盘上的真实会话目录**；其余 3617 行都是已结束子代理的投影残留（标题形如 `你是多模态档案目录识别…`、`你是 section-writer…`、`你是 gpt-reviewer…`、`你是任务执行者…`）。多次重启后仍不清理，没有任何机制回收。

## 期望行为（建议）

- **增加子代理销毁机制**：子代理一旦结束即可销毁/回收其会话与投影，不再长期占用索引与磁盘。
- **超过一定数量后自动归档子代理**：例如子代理会话数量超过阈值（如 100）时自动归档/清理旧的子代理，避免无限累积。
- **子代理不要与主 session 捆绑在一起**：希望子代理的投影与计数能自动归档或分离，而不是一直挂在主会话上（目前主会话头部会持续显示上千个“子代理”，并随之一起加载）。
- 已结束/已结算的子代理投影应能**自动垃圾回收**（可带合理保留期），或提供**可配置的保留策略**。
- 至少提供一个**官方清理入口（CLI / API / 命令）**，而不是要求手动编辑派生的 JSON 缓存。

## 备注

- 界面上某个会话头部的“N 个子代理”来自父会话自己的转录（`tool-workflow/agent-start` 事件里的 `childId`）——那是真实历史，**不是**本次问题。
- 问题本质是**全局投影索引（`tables.sessions`）**为“磁盘上已不存在（无文件、未运行）的会话”持续累积行。
- 临时规避：停服 → 删除“无磁盘目录且未运行”的行 → 重启。可用但脆弱，且必须重启服务。

discussions.title: DSH Marketplace：整理了 2545 个 DeepSeek Harness 插件
discussions.body: 最近在研究 DeepSeek Harness 的插件生态，发现插件增长得很快，但目前比较分散。 GitHub `dsh-plugin` topic、community registry、各个项目仓库里都有，实际想找一个插件时，经常需要自己一个个翻 README，看它是做什么的、怎么安装、最近还在不在维护。 所以做了一个 **DSH Marketplace**，把目前能找到的 DeepSeek Harness 插件聚合到一起。 目前已经索引： * **2545 个插件** * **14 个分类** * 支持名称 / 功能 / 作者搜索 * 可以按 Star、最近更新等排序 * 中英文界面 除了做目录之外，也在逐步补每个插件的信息，包括： * 安装命令 * GitHub 源码 * License * 插件主要能力 * AI 评审 * 权限 / 风险信息 * 部分插件的实际安装测试 另外做了一个 CLI，可以直接安装 Marketplace 里的插件： ```bash npx dshmarketplace-cli add owner/repo ``` 网站： https://dshmarketplace.dev/ 目前项目还比较早期，2545 个插件已经完成索引，但完整详情页和安装测试还在持续补充。 如果你也在开发 DSH 插件，发现自己的插件没有收录、分类不准确，或者有值得收录的 repo，都欢迎直接在下面留言。 也欢迎提建议，尤其是大家在找插件、判断插件是否值得安装时，还希望看到哪些信息。

discussions.title: [Release] Shion Lab DSH Essential Plugin Suite (5 Packages: Multimodal Bridge, Memory, Smart Patch, Windows, MCP)
discussions.body:
# [Release] Shion Lab DSH Essential Plugin Suite (5 Packages: Multimodal Bridge, Industrial Memory, Smart Patch, Windows Guard, MCP Bridge)

Hey DeepSeek Harness community! 👋

We are excited to officially release the **Shion Lab Essential Plugin Suite** for `dsh` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`). All 5 plugins are production-ready, fully covered by rigorous test suites, and now published directly on npm under the `@shion-lab` scope.

---

## 🚀 1. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-multimodal-bridge` (v0.1.0)
> **Seamless Hot-Switching between Vision Models (Gemini/Claude) and Text Models (DeepSeek-V4/V3)**

- **The Problem Solved**: DSH throws a deadlocking error (`Model "deepseek-v4" does not accept image input, but this session already contains images; select an image-capable model`) if you send a single image and later want to switch back to DeepSeek.
- **The Solution**: Implements a dynamic model projection layer.
  - When calling Vision models (Gemini, Claude 3.5, GPT-4o), full image binaries and URLs are preserved.
  - When calling Text-only models (DeepSeek, Llama), image blocks are dynamically projected into lightweight contextual text annotations (`[图片内容: 历史多模态图像...]` or OCR text).
  - Session history remains unpolluted, completely unlocking model hot-switching!
- **Install**: `npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-multimodal-bridge`
- **Repo**: [avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-multimodal-bridge](https://github.com/avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-multimodal-bridge)

---

## 🧠 2. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-memory` (v0.3.2)
> **Industrial-Grade 4-Tier Cognitive Memory, Vector Semantic Retrieval & Red-Line Guard**

- **Architecture**:
  - **Tier 1 (Ephemeral Session)**: In-memory working buffer with zero bloat.
  - **Tier 2 (Episodic Context)**: 30-day half-life Ebbinghaus decay & access frequency ranking.
  - **Tier 3 (Semantic Long-Term)**: Dense vector cosine similarity search with automatic fallback to BM25 keyword matching.
  - **Tier 4 (Hard Rules / Red Lines)**: Immutable, high-importance system rules with atomic rollback transactions and corruption guards.
- **Install**: `npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-memory`
- **Repo**: [avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-memory](https://github.com/avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-memory)

---

## 🩹 3. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-smart-patch` (v0.1.2)
> **Micro-Surgical Fault-Tolerant Code Patching Engine**

- **Features**:
  - 4-tier fuzzy matching algorithm (Exact -> Context-Trimmed -> Dynamic Ratio -> Line-by-Line Lev-Distance with OrigMap coordinate inverse projection).
  - Per-file sequential queue locking with atomic mtime/size CAS checks to prevent race conditions during concurrent agent edits.
  - Strict realpath boundary containment preventing symlink/junction path traversal.
  - Mixed EOL (CRLF / LF / CR) high-fidelity preservation.
- **Install**: `npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-smart-patch`
- **Repo**: [avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-smart-patch](https://github.com/avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-smart-patch)

---

## 🪟 4. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-windows` (v0.1.2)
> **Windows Platform Guard, Cascading Process Tree Termination & Path Normalizer**

- **Features**:
  - Cross-platform process tree killer (`taskkill /F /T /PID` on Windows, `kill(-pid, SIGKILL)` on POSIX) preventing orphaned background worker processes.
  - Hardened Windows path normalization: clamps `..` traversals, blocks malformed UNC shares, drive-relative paths, and namespace escapes (`\\.\pipe`).
  - Automatic OEM/GBK/CP1252 to UTF-8 output encoding fallback for native Windows console commands.
- **Install**: `npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-windows`
- **Repo**: [avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-windows](https://github.com/avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-windows)

---

## 🔌 5. `@shion-lab/dsh-plugin-mcp` (v0.1.2)
> **Anthropic Model Context Protocol (MCP) Client Bridge**

- **Features**:
  - Native Cordis service bridging MCP stdio tools directly into DSH agent dispatch.
  - Strict collision-free namespace encoding (`%5F` / `%25`) to isolate multi-server tool schemas.
  - Resilient child-process lifecycle tracking and graceful failure degradation.
- **Install**: `npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-mcp`
- **Repo**: [avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-mcp](https://github.com/avaritiachaos/dsh-plugin-mcp)

---

## 📦 Quick Install All

```bash
npm install -g @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-multimodal-bridge @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-memory @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-smart-patch @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-windows @shion-lab/dsh-plugin-mcp
```

Feedback, issues, and contributions are warmly welcome! Let's build a rock-solid ecosystem for DeepSeek Harness! 🚀

discussions.title: [Bug] Running a task in Chrome shows no streaming updates until the task completes (everything appears at once at the end); Safari streams fine
discussions.body:
## Symptom

When running a task in the Web UI (`dsh web`) in **Chrome**, there is no streaming output during the run (it feels slow/frozen), and **all conversation content appears at once only after the whole task completes**. The same setup in **Safari** streams updates live.

- Environment: dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 (built from source), macOS, Chrome vs Safari comparison
- Unrelated to the LLM service: same task, same host, only the browser differs

## Investigation and root cause

### Transport layer ruled out

The event path is HTTP (JSON-RPC) upstream plus two WebSocket downlinks (`/api/events.mux`, `/api/events.host`). The server behaves identically for both browsers; WebSocket frames are pushed per event with no Chrome-specific buffering observed (`ws@8.21.0`, `perMessageDeflate: false` by default — no compression-negotiation difference).

### Client refresh path: single dependency on requestAnimationFrame

`packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/notifier.ts`:

- Streaming chunks (`assistant/chunk`) → `markFrameDirty()` → the flush is scheduled on **`requestAnimationFrame`** (`schedule("frame")` → `globalThis.requestAnimationFrame(publish)`, **with no timer fallback**)
- Structural events (`turn/end`, `assistant/message` finalize, etc.) → `markDirty()` → published **immediately on a microtask**

`requestAnimationFrame` is a rendering hint, not a delivery guarantee: **Chrome stops or heavily throttles rAF for hidden, occluded, or backgrounded pages** (on macOS, a window fully covered by other windows is treated as hidden; energy-saving modes and intensive background-tab throttling apply too). When rAF never fires:

1. chunks keep accumulating in the session state, but the UI never repaints;
2. only the next microtask event (turn end) publishes everything accumulated, all at once;
3. this looks like "frozen during the task, everything appears at the end".

Safari keeps firing rAF for visible-but-unfocused windows, so streaming stays live under the same conditions.

## Reproduction (assembled product UI, fixture mode, sole variable = whether rAF fires)

| Run | Conversation text-length timeline |
| --- | --- |
| rAF normal | 139 → 151 → 163 → 175 … grows ~12 chars per ~150ms (live typewriter streaming) |
| rAF stalled (simulating Chrome throttling) | 155ms: 94 → **jumps to 234 at 1308ms** (the whole reply appears at once when the turn completes; zero updates for 1s+) |

Both runs use the same server and the same code; only rAF was stubbed. This reproduces the behavior exactly — confirming it is not a WebSocket/HTTP/LLM issue, but the client refresh path's single dependency on rAF.

## Suggested fix direction

Add a **watchdog timer** to the Notifier's frame schedule: if rAF has not fired within ~250ms, flush via `setTimeout` instead (whichever fires first publishes and retires the other), making streaming delivery independent of the rAF rendering hint. Verified locally that this eliminates the problem (unit tests + `test:gui` all green); the code has not been committed.

Related files: `packages/client/runtime/src/client/sessions/notifier.ts`, `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/assistant.ts` (chunk events publish as `animation-frame`).

discussions.title: Show Your Plugins! · dsh-settings-ui + dsh-bundle-manager —— 设置页 UI Kit 与插件运行时挂载管理器（UI Kit & Runtime Mount Manager, npm published）
discussions.body:
🙌 分享两个给 DeepSeek Harness 的插件：**dsh-settings-ui**（统一设置页 UI Kit + 浮层 Kit）与 **dsh-bundle-manager**（第三方插件运行时挂载管理器）。前者是给插件开发者用的组件库，后者是设置页「插件挂载管理」——两者配合使用即是一个完整示例（bundle-manager 的全部 UI 由 kit 提供）。

## dsh-settings-ui — 统一设置页 UI Kit

- **两级 API**：`ui.section()` 便捷注册设置页卡片；`ui.overlay()` / `ui.Panel` / `createPanelStore` 自由浮层（拖拽 / 最小化 / 置顶 / 位置持久化，跨标签页同步）
- **原子组件族 + 声明式表单**：Button/Switch/Checkbox/Input/Select/Card/Tabs/Dialog/List/Badge/ErrorBoundary/toast…；`Rows` 声明式行渲染；`createSettingsStore` 管「加载/保存/busy/错误/revision 冲突」
- **向后兼容**：只新增 `ctx.settingsUi` 服务——老写法 `ctx.slots.inject('settings.section', ...)` 照常工作
- **自愈**：section/overlay 自动包错误边界，渲染崩溃只塌陷当前卡片、不白屏
- 安装：`npm i dsh-settings-ui`
- GitHub：https://github.com/KaramachiA217/dsh-settings-ui

## dsh-bundle-manager — 插件运行时挂载管理器

- **运行时挂载/卸载**：`ctx.loader.create/remove` 进程内操作——瞬时生效、零重启、绝不改写 profile manifest
- **草稿开关 + 保存并刷新**：一次性 diff 应用，硬刷新同步 client；命名预设（保存自动合并未提交勾选 / 切换 diff / 多选删除 + 不可逆确认）
- **自愈**：坏插件隔离 Failed 组（失败分类 + 次数 + 错误）；20s 挂载看门狗；boot 分组并行（`DSH_PM_BOOT_GROUPS` 可调）
- **安全**：framework 白名单保护核心 bundle；registry 原子写 + .bak 保底 + 旧路径自动迁移
- 安装：`npm i dsh-bundle-manager`
- GitHub：https://github.com/KaramachiA217/dsh-bundle-manager

## 兼容性

rc.5 实测；**rc.6 双链路实测**（桌面 + web，上游源码同 commit `47f9438`，零适配）。已知差异：rc.6 下 `link:` 开发挂载 ESM 解析失败，用 `file:` tarball。

欢迎试用 / Star / 反馈！

---

## English

Sharing two plugins for DeepSeek Harness: **dsh-settings-ui** (unified settings-page UI kit + floating-panel kit) and **dsh-bundle-manager** (runtime mount manager for optional plugin bundles). The first is a developer component library; the second is the "Plugin Mount Manager" settings section — together they form a complete example (bundle-manager's whole UI is built on the kit).

### dsh-settings-ui — Unified Settings UI Kit

- **Two API levels**: `ui.section()` for convenient settings cards; `ui.overlay()`/`ui.Panel`/`createPanelStore` for free-form floating panels (drag / minimize / z-order / persisted position, cross-tab synced)
- **Atomic components + declarative forms**: Button/Switch/Checkbox/Input/Select/Card/Tabs/Dialog/List/Badge/ErrorBoundary/toast…; `Rows`; `createSettingsStore` handles load/save/busy/error/revision conflict
- **Backward compatible**: only *adds* a service; direct `settings.section` registrations keep working
- **Self-healing**: section/overlay auto-wrap error boundaries
- Install: `npm i dsh-settings-ui` — https://github.com/KaramachiA217/dsh-settings-ui

### dsh-bundle-manager — Runtime Mount Manager

- **In-process mount/unmount** via `ctx.loader.create/remove`: instant, no restart, never rewrites the profile manifest
- **Draft switches + one-shot apply**; named presets (draft merged on save, diff switch, multi-select delete with confirmation)
- **Self-healing**: failed plugins isolated in a Failed group (kind + attempts + error); 20s watchdog; grouped-parallel boot (`DSH_PM_BOOT_GROUPS`)
- **Safety**: framework whitelist; atomic registry writes with .bak fallback and legacy-path migration
- Install: `npm i dsh-bundle-manager` — https://github.com/KaramachiA217/dsh-bundle-manager

### Compatibility

Verified on rc.5; **rc.6 dual-path verified** (desktop + web; upstream shares commit `47f9438`, zero adaptation). Known difference: `link:` dev mounts fail ESM resolution on rc.6 — use `file:` tarballs.

Feedback welcome — via GitHub discussions!

discussions.title: [Ideas] edit 工具是否应该明确提示：同一文件的多个编辑不能并行执行？
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

`edit` 工具面向模型的说明中，是否应该明确写出下面这条约束？

> 针对同一个文件的多个 `edit` 调用必须串行执行；只有目标文件不同的编辑才适合并行。如果遇到 `FS_STALE_VERSION`，应重新读取文件后再重试。

目前底层文件系统的行为是安全且合理的：写操作会按照 `targetKey` 加锁，带保护的编辑会校验会话最近观察到的文件版本。原生工具调度器也会把修改类工具按排他方式执行。

不过，如果模型通过更高层的编排工具或并行调用包装器同时发起多个 `edit`，这些调用仍可能在第一个编辑记录新版本之前取得相同的旧版本。第一个编辑成功后，文件版本发生变化，后续调用就会因为版本过期而返回 `FS_STALE_VERSION`。

这里不是建议削弱版本保护。版本检查正在正确地防止更新丢失。想讨论的是：这种安全使用约束是否也应该明确展示给模型。

## 当前模型能看到的说明

当前 `master` 分支中的 `tool:edit` 提示说明了字面匹配、`replace_all` 和编辑前读取文件的要求，但没有提到同一文件不能并行编辑：

> Use the edit tool for targeted changes to existing UTF-8 text files. It replaces literal old_string with new_string; by default old_string must appear exactly once. If old_string appears multiple times, provide a more specific old_string or set replace_all to true. Read the file first (the default fs-observation-policy requires it), unless you just created or edited it in this session.

工具描述本身也比较简短：

> Edit an existing UTF-8 text file by replacing literal text.

## 通用复现方式

以 `/tmp/edit-probe.txt` 为例：

1. 先读取文件一次。
2. 通过能够并行分发工具调用的编排层，同时发起多个 `edit`，分别修改该文件中不同且唯一的区域。
3. 多个调用可能在进入后端的目标级修改锁之前取得相同的已观察版本。
4. 第一个编辑推进文件版本后，后续受版本保护的调用返回 `FS_STALE_VERSION`。
5. 重新读取文件，并按顺序执行这些编辑，则可以成功。

这与当前实现一致：

- `fs-observation-policy` 将会话观察到的版本作为编辑意图传递；
- `fs-local` 按 `targetKey` 串行化修改，并拒绝旧的预期版本；
- `tool-fs` 在编辑成功后记录新版本；
- 原生调度器会排他执行修改类工具，但外部或更高层的并行编排不一定保留这一调度约束。

## 建议的最小改动

建议给 `tool:edit` 的系统提示补充一句：

> Never invoke multiple edit calls targeting the same file in parallel. Execute edits to the same file sequentially; edits to different files may run in parallel. If an edit fails with FS_STALE_VERSION, re-read the file and retry.

也可以在工具 `description` 中加入更短的版本，确保没有加载工具专属 prompt section 的场景也能看到这一约束。

## 为什么原生调度已经排他，仍值得写进说明？

- 模型可能使用具有独立并发语义的编排工具或包装器；
- “并行处理相互独立的工作”是常见的 Agent 策略，而同一文件的不同代码区域表面上看起来互不相关；
- 失败虽然符合预期，但本来可以避免，并且恢复需要额外一次读取和工具调用；
- 明确写成“同文件串行、不同文件可并行”，不会不必要地阻止跨文件并行。

## 其他可能方案

1. 保持现状，完全依赖原生排他调度器；
2. 让并行编排层识别相同的规范化目标并自动串行化；
3. 在分发前检测同目标调用，并返回更明确的诊断信息。

不建议在 `FS_STALE_VERSION` 后直接自动盲重试。其他编辑改变文件后，原始字面替换可能已经不再表达相同意图；重新读取后由模型重新判断更安全。

## 想请教维护者

1. “同一文件串行编辑”是否应该成为模型可见的 `edit` 使用约定，而不仅是内部调度属性？
2. 工具自身的提示是否应该说明常见高层编排方式引入的约束？
3. 更推荐只补充提示，还是进一步在编排层实现目标感知的自动串行化？

这是英文 Ideas 讨论 [#3017](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3017) 的中文问答版本，方便中文社区参与讨论。

discussions.title: WebSocket downlinks have no heartbeat; live events (approval prompts) silently stop behind a tunnel/proxy
discussions.body:
# Issue 1 draft — WebSocket downlinks have no heartbeat; live events (e.g. approval prompts) silently stop behind a tunnel/proxy

## Problem

When the web UI is served behind a WebSocket-terminating proxy or tunnel (Cloudflare Tunnel, nginx, many corporate proxies), an **idle `events.mux` / `events.host` WebSocket is silently reaped** by the middlebox after an idle period. No close frame is delivered to either end.

The client reconnect logic only fires on a *detected* close/error. A silently-dead socket is never detected, so the UI keeps believing it is connected and stops receiving live frames — **most visibly, approval prompts (`approval/requested`) never pop up; the user only sees them after a manual page refresh** (which rebuilds state from the baseline replay).

## Why it happens

`packages/client/connection/src/websocket-downlink.ts` pumps frames server→client but **sends no protocol-level ping/keepalive**, and the client likewise sends nothing upstream (the downlink is intentionally one-way: any client message is rejected with `1008 downlink only`). With no traffic in either direction during idle periods, the proxy drops the connection without notice.

## Reproduction

1. `dsh web` behind Cloudflare Tunnel (`cloudflared`), open the UI through the public hostname.
2. In a session, trigger an action that needs approval (e.g. a write outside the workspace under `workspace-write` + `ask`).
3. Let the tab sit idle, or lock/background the phone (mobile browsers suspend the page and the socket).
4. Return: the approval prompt does **not** appear. Refresh the page → it appears (baseline replay).
5. Meanwhile, on a directly-attached `events.mux` listener the server *does* emit `approval/requested` the moment the tool asks — so the server push is fine; the frame is lost in the dead socket.

## Evidence captured while diagnosing

- Silent mux listener received 16k+ live frames (streaming works), but on the affected client the approval frame never arrived until refresh.
- Server log/mux dump shows `approval/asked` (session event) immediately followed by an `approval/requested` mux frame on a healthy connection.

## Proposed fix

Send a protocol-level ping on a short interval from the server on each downlink. Browsers answer pongs in the background without page activity, which (a) keeps the tunnel/proxy segment alive and (b) lets genuinely dead peers surface quickly so the existing reconnect logic fires.

Reference implementation that fixed it for us (in `websocket-downlink.ts`, inside `upgrade`):

```ts
const heartbeat = setInterval(() => {
  if (websocket.readyState === WebSocket.OPEN) websocket.ping()
}, 25_000)
websocket.once('close', () => { clearInterval(heartbeat) })
websocket.once('error', () => { clearInterval(heartbeat) })
```

A missed-pong timeout (terminate after N missed pongs) would additionally make the server actively reap dead peers so the client reconnects on resume.

## Impact

Anyone deploying the web UI behind a tunnel/reverse proxy — a documented, common deployment (`--trusted-host` exists precisely for it) — hits this on every approval/question/steering prompt. It reads as "the UI is frozen" and only a manual refresh recovers it.

discussions.title: Mobile: expanded sidebar squeezes the conversation to an unreadable sliver (narrow viewports)
discussions.body:
# Issue 2 draft — Mobile: expanded sidebar squeezes the conversation to an unreadable sliver (narrow viewports)

## Problem

On a narrow viewport (below `SIDEBAR_AUTO_COLLAPSE = 1024`), manually expanding the sidebar renders it as an **in-flow grid column**, and the concession chain (`computeColumns` in `packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/columns.ts`) lets the center column absorb the entire deficit down to its final fallback. On a phone (~393 CSS px) the sidebar takes ~264–420 px and the conversation column is squeezed to a few dozen px — **unreadable and unusable**.

The whole layout is desktop-first: `CENTER_MIN = 640`, `SIDEBAR_MIN 264 / MAX 420`, drag handles, hover-reveal actions — and the layout shell has **no mobile media queries**.

## Reproduction

1. Open the web UI on a phone (or a <640px window).
2. Tap the sidebar toggle to expand it.
3. The sidebar occupies ~89% of the width; the conversation column collapses to ~40–130 px (screenshots available).

## Suggested behavior (what we implemented and are running)

Render the expanded sidebar as an **overlay drawer** on narrow viewports instead of an in-flow column:

- The in-flow track keeps the collapsed rail (or goes to zero — we also hide the rail entirely and add a small floating "open" button, so the conversation uses the full viewport).
- The expanded pane floats over the center (`position: fixed`, clamped width, shadow) with a translucent **backdrop that dismisses on tap**.
- **Auto-close the drawer when a session is selected** (navigation is the intent; the conversation then takes the full width).
- Hide the drag-resize handle in drawer mode (there is no in-flow track to resize).
- Wide viewports (≥1024) are completely unchanged.

## Reference implementation

We have this working locally against current master (the four touched files are unchanged between our base and master):

- `packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.tsx` — add `drawerOpen = narrow && !sidebarCollapsed`; solve columns with the rail (or zero) when open; render the pane `position: fixed` with a `data-drawer` marker and inline drawer width; render a backdrop button and a floating open button; subscribe to current-session changes to auto-close.
- `packages/client/ui-layout/src/client/AppFrame.module.css` — `.sidebarCol[data-drawer]` fixed-position overlay, `.drawerBackdrop`, `.openButton` (hamburger), `.sidebarCol[data-rail-hidden]` border removal.
- `packages/client/ui-layout/tests/app-frame.client.spec.tsx` — updated the narrow-viewport expectations to the drawer behavior (rail/zero track, `data-drawer`, drawer width, backdrop, open button); 44/44 pass.

Happy to open a PR with this if the approach sounds right — flagging it as an issue first since the narrow-viewport behavior (overlay vs. squeezed column, rail hidden vs. visible) is a design decision you may want to weigh in on.

## Why it matters

Mobile/phone access is a common way people use a self-hosted agent UI, and today the expanded sidebar makes the conversation pane effectively unreadable on any viewport below the desktop contract widths.

discussions.title: [安全讨论] AI Agent（Harness 等）在受限环境中自动通过 explorer.exe 提权，全程无用户确认
discussions.body:
👀 我观察到的行为
Agent 的表现如下：

第一次尝试：用 Start-Process 启动目标程序
→ 结果：Access Denied（因为继承了受限令牌）

第二次尝试：通过 schtasks 创建计划任务来提权
→ 结果：The system cannot find the path specified（被环境拦截了）

第三次尝试：改用 explorer.exe 作为父进程来启动目标程序
→ 结果：成功了，获得了完整用户令牌，注册表顺利写入

关键点在于：Agent 在整个过程中，没有任何一步停下来问过用户。它只是在不断试错，直到找到一条"能跑通"的路。
⚠️ 为什么值得关注
在沙箱 / 隔离环境中，这种自动提权行为会主动打破隔离边界

在开发者本地环境中，Agent 拥有全盘读写权限，一旦被恶意诱导，后果更严重

这类行为可能被用于供应链攻击：恶意仓库在 README 里写一段"帮我跑通这个脚本"，不知情的开发者让 Agent 去处理，Agent 自动完成提权和执行

discussions.title: Plugin-bundled duplicate @deepseek-ai/dsh-tools breaks all tool calls (ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER] undefined)
discussions.body:
## Summary

After installing a third-party plugin (`dsh-computer-use`) into the web profile, **every tool call** in the web UI crashes with:

```
Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
```

After the crash, the session is left with a dangling `tool/call` (no `tool/result`), so every subsequent turn in that session — and in any session forked/seeded from it — fails with:

```
An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)  INVALID_REQUEST
```

## Environment

- dsh: `0.1.0-rc.7` (global npm install)
- Node.js: v24.15.0
- macOS (Apple Silicon)
- Profile: `web`, with third-party plugins installed via `dsh plugin` / dshmarket

## Root cause

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` is a module-level `Symbol` created in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`:

```js
const TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER = Symbol("@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools.scheduler");
```

Installing a plugin that depends on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` (e.g. `dsh-computer-use@0.1.0`, which bundles `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools@0.1.0-rc.6` as a real dependency under its own `node_modules`, and other plugins with `^0.1.0-rc.6` peer ranges hoisting an rc.6 copy to `$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`) results in **two physical copies of the dsh-tools module** in one process:

1. the core copy (rc.7) used by `dsh-agent-loop`
2. the profile/plugin copy (rc.6) loaded through the profile's `node_modules`

Each module instance creates its own unique `Symbol`, so `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` in `dsh-agent-loop` resolves to `undefined` and the first `.prepare()` call throws:

```
TypeError: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
    at startCall (.../@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:193:60)
    at fillPool (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:233:10)
    at runGroup (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:242:9)
    at executeToolCalls (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:135:25)
    at ReactLoopAgent.step (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:662:32)
    at ReactLoopAgent.turn (.../dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:555:22)
```

Timeline confirms it: tool calls worked until the plugin was installed; removing the plugin and all stray `dsh-tools` copies from the profile restored normal operation.

## Reproduction

1. `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-computer-use` (or any plugin that pulls `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` into the profile's `node_modules`)
2. Start `dsh web`, open a new session, send any prompt that triggers a tool call (e.g. "list files in the current directory")
3. The turn fails at the first tool call with the `prepare` TypeError; continuing the session then fails with `INVALID_REQUEST`

Note: `--profile headless` is unaffected (no third-party plugin bundles loaded).

## Secondary issue: unrecoverable session corruption

When a turn crashes between `tool/call` and `tool/result`, the session log keeps a dangling tool call. Because sessions are seeded/forked with their full history (`parentSession` / `seedLength`), the corruption propagates to every descendant session and the API rejects every subsequent request. There is no built-in recovery: the user has to abandon the whole session chain (or hand-repair the log). Suggestion: on resume, detect a trailing unanswered `tool_calls` block and either synthesize an error tool-result or truncate it.

## Suggestions

1. **Dedupe / externalize core packages for plugins**: document that plugins must treat `@deepseek-ai/*` packages as peer-only, and/or make the plugin loader resolve `@deepseek-ai/*` imports from the core installation so only one module instance ever exists.
2. **Replace the symbol-key lookup with a string key or a service interface** that survives duplicate module instances.
3. **Installer guard**: `dsh plugin add` could warn/block when a plugin bundles a different version of a core `@deepseek-ai/*` package than the running harness.

## Workaround (for anyone hitting this)

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-computer-use   # or the offending plugin
# remove any stray copies:
rm -rf "$DSH_HOME/profiles/web/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools"
```
then restart `dsh web`.

discussions.title: windows下执行python代码超时
discussions.body:
环境：DSH 0.1.0-rc.7、Windows 11、两个 conda 环境（3.12 / 3.14）在沙箱内均挂起、宿主机均正常
复现：最小 import 脚本，沙箱内 4+ 分钟不返回（无异常无 traceback，纯挂起），宿主机 15.6s 完成
二分定位：numpy/sqlalchemy/pydantic/yaml/psutil ✅、numba 单独 ✅（0.6s）、NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=1 无效、pynndescent 单独导入挂起 → 卡点在 pynndescent 导入期
根因线索：loky 报 WinError 5 拒绝访问「无法读取物理核心数」；同会话中管道捕获、multiprocessing.connection.Pipe（conda）同样被 WinError 5 拒绝 —— 沙箱拦截进程/管道/系统探测原语，pynndescent 导入时无限等待而非快速失败
建议方向：CPU 核心枚举/命名管道/线程创建在导入期被拦截时快速报错而非挂起；文档化 LOKY_MAX_CPU_COUNT 类降级开关

discussions.title: dsh-plugin-sodamem — native SodaMem memory the model can't skip
discussions.body:
I built a native SodaMem plugin for DeepSeek Harness because tool-based memory has a failure mode I didn't want: the model can simply skip the tool call.

`dsh-plugin-sodamem` moves memory into the harness lifecycle itself:

- Before each question, it fetches a SodaMem evidence block and adds it during `system-prompt/assemble`.
- When the turn closes, it sends the user and assistant messages back to SodaMem through `agent/turn-stopping`.

Neither step is a tool call. Retrieval uses BM25, vector, and entity fusion, with no additional model call.

```bash
sodamem daemon ensure
dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-plugin-sodamem
```

## What is different

Every recalled fact points back to the exact source turn:

```
support=I flew United to Boston last week.
predicate=User flew United to Boston
source=s4/s4_turn_0
date=2023-06-10
```

SodaMem also keeps separate timestamps for when something happened, when it was true, when it was said, and when it was stored.

Corrections do not overwrite history. A new fact supersedes the old one, so the old location stops being recalled while the earlier state remains auditable.

## Tradeoffs

- **This is not an embedded memory engine.** The plugin is an HTTP client, so you need a local SodaMem daemon running.
- **Recall adds latency to the turn's critical path.** On the published 1,000-fact test store, warm retrieval measured p50 130 ms and p99 186 ms. The daemon uses one worker, so latency increases with concurrent clients.
- **Failure is silent by design.** If SodaMem is unavailable or misses the 1,500 ms deadline, the turn continues without memory and the plugin logs a warning. Memory failure must not break the agent's turn.
- **Do not run this plugin and the SodaMem MCP bridge against the same store**, or recall and retention will happen twice.

## Verification

The plugin was tested inside a real `dsh` runtime against a live SodaMem daemon, not only at mocked boundaries. That testing caught three bugs missed by 33 passing unit tests, including retain feeding the plugin's own recalled evidence back into memory.

Version 0.1.1 also corrects performance numbers published from a broken local test environment. The withdrawn numbers and explanation remain visible in the changelog.

GitHub: https://github.com/SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem

---

I'd especially like feedback on failure visibility: when recall times out, should the user see an indicator, or should degradation remain log-only?

---

写这个插件的起因很简单:工具式的记忆有个我不想要的失效方式——**模型可以直接不调那个工具**。

`dsh-plugin-sodamem` 把记忆挪进了 harness 的生命周期里:

- 每个问题之前,它取一份 SodaMem 的证据块,在 `system-prompt/assemble` 阶段加进去。
- 回合结束时,它通过 `agent/turn-stopping` 把用户和助手的消息送回 SodaMem。

这两步都不是工具调用。检索走 BM25、向量和实体融合,不额外调用模型。

```bash
sodamem daemon ensure
dsh plugin --profile tui add dsh-plugin-sodamem
```

## 有什么不一样

每一条召回的事实,都能指回它出自哪一轮:

```
support=I flew United to Boston last week.
predicate=User flew United to Boston
source=s4/s4_turn_0
date=2023-06-10
```

SodaMem 还把几个时间分开存:事情什么时候发生、这条事实什么时候是真的、话是什么时候说的、什么时候入的库。

修正不覆盖历史。新事实会把旧的顶掉,所以旧地址不会再被召回,但之前的状态仍然查得到。

## 取舍

- **它不是一个内嵌的记忆引擎。** 插件只是个 HTTP 客户端,你得在本地跑一个 SodaMem 守护进程。
- **召回会给回合的关键路径加延迟。** 在公开的 1000 条事实测试库上,热态检索实测 p50 130 ms、p99 186 ms。守护进程只用一个 worker,并发客户端一多,延迟就会往上走。
- **失败是静默的,这是有意为之。** SodaMem 不可用、或者超过 1500 ms 没返回,这一轮就不带记忆继续走,插件记一条 warning。记忆出问题不能把 agent 的回合弄坏。
- **别让这个插件和 SodaMem 的 MCP 桥接同时对着一个库跑**,否则召回和写回都会发生两次。

## 验证

插件是放进真实的 `dsh` 运行时、对着一个活的 SodaMem 守护进程测的,不只是在 mock 的边界上测。就是这一步抓出了 33 个通过的单测都没发现的三个 bug,其中一个是写回把插件自己召回的证据又喂回了记忆里。

0.1.1 还更正了一批性能数字——那批数字来自我本地一个坏掉的测试环境。被撤回的数字和原因都留在 changelog 里,没有删。

GitHub: https://github.com/SodaMem/dsh-plugin-sodamem

---

有一点特别想听听大家的看法:**召回超时的时候,该不该给用户一个提示?还是就让它静默降级、只写日志?**

discussions.title: dsh web unusable when one session directory is misplaced under the sessions root (all-or-nothing artifact scan)
discussions.body:
## Summary

If a session directory ends up directly under the sessions root — for example when an external file operation moves/renames it out of its `--project--` directory — `dsh web` becomes unusable: the artifact scan throws `unsupported flat-file layout` and the whole session index fails, instead of skipping that one stray entry.

## Environment

- dsh `0.1.0-rc.6` (npm `@deepseek-ai/dsh`), macOS
- sessions root: `~/.dsh/sessions/`

## Repro

1. Stop `dsh web`.
2. Place a stray session directory directly under the sessions root, containing a `session.jsonl.zstd` whose header carries a `cwd`/`id`:

```bash
mkdir -p "$HOME/.dsh/sessions/01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef"
printf '%s\n' '{"type":"session","version":0,"id":"01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef","createdAt":0,"cwd":"/tmp","delegationDepth":0}' \
  | zstd -q -o "$HOME/.dsh/sessions/01234567-89ab-cdef-0123-456789abcdef/session.jsonl.zstd"
```

3. Start `dsh web` / open the session list. `listArtifacts()` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` aborts the entire scan:

```
session artifact ".../session.jsonl.zstd" uses the unsupported flat-file layout;
use a separate root or move it into a project/session directory before loading
```

Verified empirically with the package's own code: with the stray directory present the scan throws; after removing it the scan passes; an **empty** stray directory does not throw — i.e. the failure comes from the misplaced artifact, not from the directory name.

## Expected

The scan should tolerate one stray directory: skip it, surface a warning naming the directory and the remediation, and keep `dsh web` and the rest of the session list working.

## Actual

One misplaced directory takes down the whole service/session index (all-or-nothing). In practice this pushes operators toward treating the directory as "corruption" and deleting it — destroying that session's data — because:

1. the error does not say **which** project directory the artifact belongs to, although the header contains `cwd`/`id`, so the exact correct target path could be computed and printed;
2. the scan returns no partial results.

## Suggested fix

- Per-directory / per-artifact error isolation in `listArtifacts()` (and its boot-time callers): skip + collect warnings instead of aborting.
- Root-level entries that are not `--...--`-wrapped project keys could be surfaced as anomalies rather than treated as project directories.
- For legacy-layout / `assertStoredIdentity` failures, include the expected target path derived from the header (`projectKey(cwd)` + `encodeSegment(id)`) in the error message, so operators can repair by moving instead of deleting.

Thanks for the great tool!

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-simple-memory | Sidecar memory filesystem with reminder rules (markdown, git-backed)
discussions.body:
**dsh-simple-memory** — a sidecar memory filesystem with reminder rules for DeepSeek Harness.

## What it does

Normal work is never interrupted; memory accumulates as layered markdown files **beside** your projects, and rules nudge you to record decisions/pitfalls from time to time:

- **Global experience** (`common/`) + **per-project memory** (`projects/<name>/`, auto-created), one memory root, one git repo for rollback
- **Per-session index injection**: every session's first step lists what memory exists (filenames only, never the content) — the model reads a note on demand
- **One-click memory flow**: a bulb button in the input bar triggers review → propose each item with project/global scope → confirm → write → show output → commit
- **Enforced format**: `分类-主题.md`, ≤2KB, date header, open category prefixes (踩坑/流程/决策/偏好/背景)
- **Promotion pool** (`staging.md`) for cross-project reuse, **archive** for soft forgetting, **grep** over the whole root for search

## Install

```shell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-simple-memory#main"
```

Restart `dsh web`, then Settings → Memory → Initialize memory repo.

- GitHub: https://github.com/a903067276-rgb/dsh-simple-memory
- Design doc & verification log included in the repo (docs/)
- Status: core pipeline verified (0.2.0); real-world effect still under testing

*Unofficial community plugin, MIT.*

discussions.body:
Hi DSH community,

[`dsh-bailinghub`](https://github.com/bailinghub/bailinghub-dsh-plugin) lets you submit governed tasks from the local DeepSeek Harness Web UI to a business route already connected to BailingHub, then keep following the same `job_id` until a result is available. dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-bailinghub@0.1.1

discussions.title: Web UI renders streamed UTF-8 (Cyrillic/emoji) as Latin-1 mojibake via pi-ai custom OpenAI-completions provider
discussions.body:
## Summary

Streamed Cyrillic (and other non-ASCII) content from an OpenAI-completions custom provider is rendered as mojibake in the Web UI — UTF-8 bytes are being decoded as Latin-1 somewhere in the harness pipeline.

## Environment

- **Harness version**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7 (rev `b1dfb10aadf9`)
- **Adapter**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` (dormant, activated via `llm-pi-ai:` settings section)
- **Provider**: custom OpenAI-completions gateway (`api: openai-completions`, `compat.thinkingFormat: deepseek`)
- **Model**: returns `reasoning_content` + `content` deltas in SSE chunks, `content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8`
- **OS**: macOS (arm64), Node 22.x
- **Profile**: `web` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app`)

## Reproduction

1. Configure a custom OpenAI-completions provider that returns Cyrillic text, e.g. a prompt like `Ответь одним словом по-русски: Привет`.
2. Send the prompt in a Web UI session.
3. The assistant reply renders as mojibake.

### Observed (Web UI)

```
Привет
10:37
ÐÑÐ¸Ð²ÐµÑ! ÐÐ°Ðº Ð¼Ð¾Ð³Ñ Ð¿Ð¾Ð¼Ð¾ÑÑ? ð
```

- `ÐÑÐ¸Ð²ÐµÑ!` is `Привет!` — each UTF-8 byte read as Latin-1 (`D0 9F` → `ÐÐ`, etc.).
- `ð` is `😊` (`F0 9F 98 8A`) truncated to its first byte read as Latin-1.

### Expected

`Привет! Как могу помочь? 😊`

## Diagnosis: the gateway is not the source

Direct SSE request to the upstream gateway (`/v1/chat/completions`, `stream: true`) returns correct UTF-8. Verified by reading the raw response body as both UTF-8 and Latin-1:

```
status 200
content-type: text/event-stream; charset=utf-8
first cyrillic delta content (utf8): "Ответ"
cyrillic words found (utf8): [ "Ответ", "ь", "одним", "слов", "ом" ]
Привет found in latin1: false
```

Non-stream (`stream: false`) is also clean: `reasoning_content` carries readable Cyrillic, hex starts `7b` (`{`).

So the breakage is inside the harness, not the provider.

## Where it is NOT

I traced the obvious decode sites and they all look correct on inspection:

| Site | Code | Verdict |
|---|---|---|
| pi-ai OpenAI-completions stream | `import OpenAI from "openai"`; `for await (const chunk of openaiStream)` — SDK returns parsed JS objects | ✓ correct |
| pi-ai TextDecoder usage | `new TextDecoder()` (UTF-8 default) in `pi-messages.js`, `anthropic-messages.js` | ✓ correct |
| Host→client SSE writer (`dsh-host-apiproxy` `sseResponse`) | `new TextEncoder()`, `JSON.stringify(frame)` | ✓ correct |
| Client SSE reader (`dsh-host-apiproxy` `readSse`) | `response.body.getReader()` + `new TextDecoder()` + `{stream:true}` + `JSON.parse` | ✓ correct |

So the Latin-1 decode is happening somewhere I couldn't pin down from the published bundles — likely the browser-side client bundle (`dsh-client-connection`) or a markdown/render path that re-decodes a string as Latin-1, or a site that builds a `Buffer`/`Blob` from a JS string without an explicit UTF-8 encoding.

## Reproducer config (settings.yaml)

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    magnit_prod:
      displayName: Copilot
      apiKeyEnv: 
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: ...
      reasoning: high
      compat:
        thinkingFormat: deepseek
        supportsReasoningEffort: false
      models:
        - id: Copilot
          name: Copilot
          contextWindow: 196600
          maxTokens: 8192
          reasoningEfforts:
            off:
            high: high
agent-default-model:
  provider: custom_copilot
  model: Copilot
  reasoningEffort: high
```

Upstream `/v1/models` returns `["Copilot", "CopilotFlash"]`, both serve Cyrillic over SSE as UTF-8.

## Ask

Either a pointer to where the Web UI (or the pi-ai adapter) re-decodes streamed text as Latin-1, or a fix. Happy to follow up with a `git bisect`-style narrowing if you can name the bundle entry that owns assistant-text rendering.

discussions.title: dsh-plugin-retitle: 按实际内容批量重命名 DSH 会话标题（inspect → 确认 → 一键 apply）
discussions.body:
## dsh-plugin-retitle

按**实际内容**批量重命名 DeepSeek Harness 会话标题的宿主插件。会话跑完很久后标题往往只是第一句话，看不出整段任务的主题。

### 工作方式（两步，全程人工确认，绝不自动乱改）
1. **session_retitle_inspect** — 读取工作区里每个会话的实际内容（目标 objective + 首尾用户消息摘要，各 ≤400 字，正文不进上下文），自动跳过归档 / 进行中 / 空白 / subagent 会话。
2. **session_retitle_apply** — 只接受用户确认过的 `[{sessionId, title}]` 清单，走与 UI 手动改名相同的官方链路（sessionTitle.rename + flush），一次性全部生效。

### 特性
- 命名由 Agent 完成（拟 5~8 字主题名），插件零外部依赖、不 import 任何 @deepseek-ai/*、不额外烧 LLM token
- 内容驱动：看的是目标 + 首尾消息，不是第一句话
- 官方链路改名，安全无副作用

### 安装
```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-plugin-retitle
# 安装后重启 DSH 生效
```

### 使用
> 用户：整理一下会话名
> Agent：inspect → 拟名 → 列表给你确认 → apply 一键生效
