discussions.title: Windows desktop host: folder-dialog crash + sandboxed subprocess failures (root causes found, fixes in    fork)
discussions.body:
# Windows desktop host: folder-dialog crash + sandboxed subprocess failures (root causes found, fixes in fork)

Since pull requests are disabled on this repository, I'm posting three Windows bugs we hit while running DeepSeek Harness as a packaged desktop (Electron) app, together with the root-cause analysis and the fixes. All fixes are published on branches in my fork: https://github.com/1944629127jia-stack/deepseek-harness

Environment: Windows x64, packaged desktop app reusing the Electron binary as Node (`ELECTRON_RUN_AS_NODE=1`, Node 22), dsh `0.1.0-rc.5`.

---

## 1. `dsh-host-directory-picker-native`: win32 folder dialog worker crashes (exit 134)

**Symptom.** Choosing a workspace directory in the desktop app fails with:

```
directory picker failed: win32 folder dialog worker exited before reporting a result
(exit code 134; stderr: FATAL ERROR: Error::New napi_get_last_error_info ...
 1: readUtf16 (...\dsh-host-directory-picker-native\lib\worker.cjs:22:34)
```

**Root cause.** The worker's `readUtf16` decodes the dialog's UTF-16 result buffer via koffi in a way that calls `Error::New` with a stale/empty napi error slot, which is a fatal error — the worker process dies before it can report a result.

**Fix.** Branch `fix/win32-folder-dialog-crash` (commit `bf5e2e2` — keep the win32 folder dialog alive and report real worker exits). Verified on a live install: the picker now opens and returns the selected folder.

---

## 2. `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`: every sandboxed command dies with `0xC0000142` when the runner is launched by a console-less GUI host

**Symptom.** In the desktop app, any sandboxed command (pwsh, `dotnet`, even `pwd`) exits instantly with zero output, exit code `3221225794` (`0xC0000142`, `STATUS_DLL_INIT_FAILED`). The same commands succeed immediately with `sandbox_permissions: danger-full-access`, which pointed at the sandbox injection layer rather than the tools.

**Root cause.** The desktop app starts the sandbox runner by reusing the Electron binary as Node. GUI-subsystem processes never inherit the parent's console, so the runner has no console at all; a restricted child process then dies during process/DLL initialization when it tries to attach to a console.

**Fix.** Branch `fix/sandbox-console-less-host`, commits `c5e8cd6` (allocate one hidden console for console-less hosts) and `1ca1de8` (attach the runner to the parent console at startup). Verified with an instrumented runner (`AttachConsole -> 1`, children then run normally).

---

## 3. `dsh-sandbox-windows-acl`: sandboxed `dotnet build` fails `MSB3883: access denied` in Csc — restricted token's default DACL grants no write

**Symptom.** After fix 2, sandboxed commands run, but any real compilation (`dotnet build` with changed sources) dies in under a second with `error MSB3883` + `拒绝访问` (access denied) in the Csc task. Zero CS errors; outside the sandbox the build succeeds.

**Diagnosis (each step reproduced with probes inside the restricted process):**

1. Creating a named pipe: OK. Spawning a child without redirection: OK. Spawning with `RedirectStandardOutput`: fails, `native=5` (`ERROR_ACCESS_DENIED`).
2. Stack: thrown inside .NET Framework `Process.CreatePipe` — Framework redirection uses an anonymous pipe, which takes the token's *default DACL*.
3. Raw Win32 inside the restricted process: `CreatePipe(NULL)` / default `SECURITY_ATTRIBUTES` → err 5; `CreatePipe` with an explicit `Everyone:FA` security descriptor → OK. `OpenProcessToken(TOKEN_ADJUST_DEFAULT)` from the restricted process is denied, so the restricted process cannot repair its own token at runtime.
4. Token comparison between a working interactive shell and the failing app host: identical restricting SID lists (logon SID, Everyone, workspace capability SID, temp capability SID) and identical groups — the difference is the **default DACL**. On an Explorer-launched host the logon SID holds only `GX|GR` (no write). Capability SIDs are restricting SIDs, not enabled groups, so they can only pass the pass-2 check; pass-1 grants write to nobody, and anonymous `CreatePipe` fails.

**Fix.** Commit `f5f3797` on the same branch: when the runner creates the restricted token, append an Everyone full-access ACE to the token's default DACL. Everyone is both an enabled group and present in the restricting list, so pass-1 and pass-2 both succeed. This only affects objects that don't inherit a DACL (anonymous pipes, sync objects); files still inherit from their parent directory ACLs, so the sandbox boundary is unchanged. Read-only mode already granted Everyone. The fix ships with an e2e assertion that both modes produce `(A;OICI;FA;;;WD)` in the token default DACL, and the packaged build passes the full `dotnet build` scenario that previously failed.

---

Happy to restructure any of these as upstream-ready patches if you reopen PRs, or to provide the probe scripts used for the diagnosis.

discussions.title: Four new verified plugins: dependency audit, llms.txt, CN bootstrap, timesheet
discussions.body:
"## Four new verified plugins, one supply-chain → time story

Since today I shipped four dsh plugins that cover the **trust → readability → connectivity → time** chain. All four: MIT, zero runtime dependencies, CI-verified (dsh-plugin-doctor preflight + unit tests + packed-artifact integration + fresh-profile `dsh web` boot smoke on Windows), published on npm, and installable with `dsh plugin add`.

### 1. [dsh-dep-audit](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-dep-audit) — dependency supply-chain hygiene audit
8 checks: peer-range resolvability against the registry, broken dist-tag detection (the **#2763 class** — it flags `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools`'s `latest=0.0.1-rc.1` vs declared `^0.1.0-rc.6` on a live run), stale/missing-license/non-registry deps, and installed-vs-declared drift. CLI + agent-callable `dep_audit`, `dsh-dep-audit/v1` reports.

### 2. [dsh-llms-forge](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-llms-forge) — llms.txt generator
AI agents look for `llms.txt` first; most dsh plugins don't have one. Generates it deterministically from `package.json` + `README.md` (install command, license, homepage, keywords, entry, CLI). Read-only by default, `--write/--overwrite` explicit. CLI + agent-callable `llms_forge`.

### 3. [dsh-cn-boot](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-cn-boot) — China-network bootstrap
Probes npm/npmmirror/GitHub/raw/HuggingFace/Gitee + local proxy ports (7897/10809), reads current npm/pnpm registry config, recommends mirrors/proxy, generates a PowerShell + bash bootstrap script. Read-only by default; `--apply` only sets the registry to npmmirror. Local run: 6/8 reachable, HuggingFace timeout flagged correctly.

### 4. [dsh-timesheet](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-timesheet) — turn-based time tracking
Token dashboards tell you cost; this one tells you **wall-clock time** from `*.jsonl` session logs — totals, per-day/project/provider/source rollups, tool-call counts, failure rates, TTFT. Verified on real session logs: 52 turns / 4h56m / 1315 tool calls. CLI + agent-callable `timesheet`, `dsh-timesheet/v1` reports.

All four are already listed in [dsh-subscribe](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-subscribe) (verified) and the [dsh-ecosystem catalog](https://github.com/zoahdev/dsh-ecosystem), with awesome-list PRs open. Happy to take feedback — especially on the dependency-audit check set, since plugin trust is the ecosystem's real bottleneck right now."

- Fixed-commit source verification before installation.

discussions.title: `AgentLoop` only allowlists `error | aborted`, so a merge-extended failure finish still assembles an assistant message
discussions.body:
Splitting this out of #1886 so it doesn't stall that thread.

## The invariant token-meter is about to rely on

63688b0 closes a billing attempt on a finish chunk whose reason kind is `error` or `aborted`. That is correct today, and the reason it is correct is not in token-meter. It is in agent-loop: `agent-loop/src/agent.ts` routes those finishes through `agent/request-error`, then either continues into a retry or throws. Neither path reaches `createAssistantMessage()`. `core/session/README.md` says the same in prose, and the transport-recovery tests only ever observe the successful attempt's message.

So "a failed attempt produces no assistant message" is a real invariant. It is held up by a control flow in one package, a sentence in a README in a second, and an observation in a third package's tests. Nothing asserts it.

Credit where due: @le-soleil-se-couche established this in #1886, and it is the reason the current fix is safe.

## Why that matters now

`FinishReasonMap` is merge-extensible and its own doc says to switch on kind and fall through unknowns. AgentLoop's boundary is an allowlist of two. An adapter that merges in a third failure kind gets a finish carrying `failure` that is not `error | aborted`, and that attempt **does** assemble an assistant message.

That creates a fork I got wrong earlier in #1886, so it is worth stating plainly:

- Keep the closed list, and the third kind silently reverts to the old undercount. The retry's sample replaces the failed attempt's.
- Widen to `'failure' in reason`, and the third kind's assistant message lands after the boundary cleared `last`, resolves with `previous === undefined`, and is **added** rather than replacing. That is a double count.

Widening only token-meter turns an undercount into an overcount. The synthetic fixture in #1886 runs both as counterexamples: the same turn folds to one record of 17/6/19/4/3 under the closed list, two under the widened predicate.

## Proposal

Two changes that have to land together, or a decision that they should not:

1. **agent-loop**: make the attempt-boundary predicate structural rather than an allowlist of kinds, so any finish carrying `failure` takes the `agent/request-error` path and assembles no message.
2. **token-meter**: only after (1), widen to `'failure' in reason`.

Until (1), token-meter and anything downstream should stay on `error | aborted`. That is what I would ship today.

## Smaller thing worth doing regardless

Name the invariant in a test. One that asserts a failed attempt produces no assistant message, sitting in token-meter where the fold depends on it, so a future change to agent's control flow fails a test instead of quietly moving numbers.

I understand external PRs aren't being accepted. Happy to supply the fixture or the test in whatever form is useful.

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh-llm-pi-ai ignores Retry-After when retrying — TPM-limited retries always fail
discussions.body:
# [Bug] `dsh-llm-pi-ai` ignores Retry-After when retrying — TPM-limited retries always fail

## Summary

When an OpenAI-compatible gateway accessed through `dsh-llm-pi-ai` (e.g. Volcano Ark) returns **429 / TPM rate limit**, the retry uses the **exponential backoff** hard-coded in `dsh-llm-pi-ai` (default `500ms → 1000ms`) and **completely ignores the `Retry-After` header** returned by the server.

Consequence: while the TPM limit is in effect, the retry interval is far shorter than the time needed for the quota to recover, so every retry necessarily hits 429 again; once the `maxRetries` budget is exhausted the request stops until a human triggers it again. **This is not "missing retries" — it is "retrying at the wrong time and wasting the retry budget."**

## Impact

- Any user routing an **OpenAI-compatible gateway** (especially one that rate-limits by **TPM**, such as Volcano Ark) through `dsh-llm-pi-ai`.
- Compared with the official `dsh-llm-deepseek` adapter: the latter **correctly** reads `retry-after` and fills in `providerRetryAfterMs`, while `dsh-llm-pi-ai` does not read it.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`: `0.1.0-rc.6` (also present in `rc.7`, see below)
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`: `0.1.0-rc.6`
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai`: `0.82.1`
- Provider: Volcano Ark `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3`, model `deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731`, TPM limit 1000K/min
- Platform: Windows, DeepSeek Harness `web` profile

## Steps to reproduce

1. Configure an OpenAI-compatible route (`llm-pi-ai`) in `settings.yaml`, with protocol `openai-completions` or `openai-responses`, and the model declaring `reasoningEfforts` (reasoning enabled).
2. Send several requests within a short window to trigger a server-side 429 (Volcano Ark returns `ModelAccountTpmRateLimitExceeded`).
3. Observe the retry behavior.

## Actual observation (session-log `llm/retry` events)

```json
{
  "retryId": "ab5c6832-c18b-468e-acee-8c8c75516b9f",
  "provider": "volcano-ark",
  "mode": "normal",
  "policyKey": "[\"normal\",2,[\"EMPTY_RESPONSE\",\"RATE_LIMIT\",\"SERVER\",\"TIMEOUT\",\"TRANSPORT\"],500,10000,0.1]",
  "retry": 1,
  "maxRetries": 2,
  "delayMs": 493.78,
  "failure": {
    "message": "429: {\"code\":\"ModelAccountTpmRateLimitExceeded\",\"message\":\"TPM (Tokens Per Minute) limit ...\"}",
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT"
  }
}
```

- `delayMs` is `~493ms`, `~933ms`, `~1072ms` in sequence — i.e. **exponential backoff** from `initialDelayMs=500` (`500*2^0`, `500*2^1`).
- The `failure` object has **no `providerRetryAfterMs`** field.
- After 2 retries (`retry=2/maxRetries=2`) the budget is exhausted and `turn/end` ends with a `RATE_LIMIT` error; sending another message hits 429 again, in a loop.

## Root-cause analysis

Error propagation chain:

```
Volcano Ark 429 + Retry-After header
   │
   ▼
pi-ai (openai-completions / openai-responses) stream
   │  catch → converted to an `error` event keeping only the string errorMessage,
   │  the original error object (including headers) is discarded
   ▼
dsh-llm-pi-ai toStreamChunks / mapStopReason
   │  → { kind:"error", failure:{ code:"RATE_LIMIT", message:"..." } }
   │  (no providerRetryAfterMs)
   ▼
outer dsh-llm-retry
   │  providerRetryAfterMs === undefined
   │  → uses localDelay (exponential backoff 500ms→1000ms)
   ▼
retry interval too short, TPM not recovered, 429 again
```

Key code points:

1. **`dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `profileOptions` hard-codes `maxRetries: 0`**, disabling pi-ai's internal retry (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai`). Yet pi-ai's internal retry (`getRetryDelayMs` in `provider-retry.js`) **already honors `retry-after` / `retry-after-ms`** — this is the trade-off of handing retry responsibility over to the outer `dsh-llm-retry`.

2. **Headers are lost during error propagation**: pi-ai's `stream` (e.g. `openai-responses.js`) does `output.errorMessage = formatOpenAIResponsesError(error)` in the catch, turning the original error (with headers) into a string; `AssistantMessage` only has `errorMessage?: string`, no headers. As a result `dsh-llm-pi-ai` cannot obtain `Retry-After`, and the outer `dsh-llm-retry`'s `failure.providerRetryAfterMs` is always `undefined`.

3. **Comparison with the official adapter**: `dsh-llm-deepseek` correctly reads and fills `providerRetryAfterMs(response.headers.get("retry-after"))` (see `packages/llm/deepseek`). So for the same gateway and the same 429, the official adapter honors `Retry-After` while the pi-ai adapter does not.

## Expected behavior

On a 429, `dsh-llm-pi-ai` should propagate the server's `Retry-After` (or `retry-after-ms`) into `failure.providerRetryAfterMs`, so the outer `dsh-llm-retry` waits per the server's suggested delay instead of using a fixed exponential backoff.

## Proposed solutions

### Option A: Enable pi-ai's internal retry (change DSH's own package only)

Leverage the fact that pi-ai already honors `Retry-After` by having `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `profileOptions` map `profile.retryPolicy.maxRetries` to pi-ai's `maxRetries`, thereby enabling pi-ai's internal retry (`getRetryDelayMs` in `provider-retry.js` natively honors `retry-after` / `retry-after-ms`).

**Pros**
- Changes only DSH's own package (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai`); no third-party dependency touched.
- Reuses pi-ai's mature, correct, battle-tested `Retry-After` handling instead of reimplementing it in DSH.
- Small change surface (a single mapping in `profileOptions`).

**Cons / risks**
- **Bypasses the outer `dsh-llm-retry`'s configurability and observability**: `llm/retry` events and UI presentation such as "retried model request (2/2)" would disappear or change.
- If the outer `dsh-llm-retry` also has a `profile.retryPolicy` configured, this can cause **double retries** (pi-ai inner + dsh-llm-retry outer), requiring a designed responsibility boundary (e.g. inner only waits on `Retry-After`, outer owns the final budget).
- Contradicts DSH's existing architecture direction of "unified outer retry"; may need a larger refactor rather than a point change.

### Option B: Propagate `providerRetryAfterMs` (keep the outer retry's observability)

Have pi-ai's `error` event / `AssistantMessage` carry `providerRetryAfterMs` (parsed in `normalizeProviderError` or the `stream` catch from `error.headers.get("retry-after")` / `retry-after-ms`), and have `dsh-llm-pi-ai`'s `mapStopReason` fill it into `failure.providerRetryAfterMs`.

**Pros**
- **Preserves all existing capabilities of the outer `dsh-llm-retry`**: configurability, observability (`llm/retry` events, UI presentation), and cross-provider consistency.
- Clearer semantics: the outer layer receives the server-suggested delay and decides the wait via `providerRetryAfterMs` — the path DSH already supports (the official `dsh-llm-deepseek` does exactly this).
- Aligns with the official adapter's behavior; predictable.

**Cons / risks**
- **Changes span two layers**: the third-party package `@earendil-works/pi-ai` (error propagation / types) plus DSH's own `dsh-llm-pi-ai` (propagating into the finish failure).
- pi-ai is a third-party dependency; the change **breaks on upgrade**, requiring re-patching or an upstream contribution.
- Requires extending the `AssistantMessage` / error-event types, or finding another way for the DSH layer to reach the original error — more engineering effort.

### Comparison

| Dimension | Option A | Option B |
|---|---|---|
| Change scope | DSH's own package only | pi-ai (third-party) + DSH, two layers |
| Touches third-party? | No | Yes (needs re-patch on upgrade) |
| Keeps outer observability | No (bypasses dsh-llm-retry) | Yes |
| Aligns with official adapter | No | Yes |
| Double-retry risk | Yes, needs design | No |
| Engineering effort | Small | Medium |

**Recommendation**: if DSH wants to keep the "unified outer retry + observability" architecture, **Option B is more correct** (consistent with the official adapter), at the cost of changing the third-party pi-ai and contributing upstream; if a minimal change is preferred and moving the retry responsibility into pi-ai is acceptable, **Option A is faster**. Either way, the fix should not stop at "exponential backoff" without honoring `Retry-After`.

## Additional notes

- This analysis was generated with the assistance of DSH.
- It has been confirmed that `0.1.0-rc.7` does not change this logic (e.g. `resolveModelCompat`); the issue is still present in `rc.7`.


# [Bug] dsh-llm-pi-ai 重试时不遵循服务端 `Retry-After`，导致 TPM 限流下重试必然失败

## 摘要

使用 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 接入的 OpenAI 兼容网关（如火山方舟）在遇到 **429 / TPM 限流** 时，重试使用的是 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 硬编码的**指数退避**（默认 `500ms → 1000ms`），**完全没有遵循服务端返回的 `Retry-After` 头**。

后果：在 TPM 限流持续期间，重试间隔远小于配额恢复所需时间，每次重试必然再次命中 429，`maxRetries` 预算迅速耗尽后请求停止，直到人工再次触发。**这不是"没有重试"，而是"重试时机错误、白费重试预算"。**

## 影响

- 任何通过 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 使用 **OpenAI 兼容网关**（尤其是按 **TPM 限流**的网关，如火山方舟）的用户。
- 与官方 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 适配器对比：后者**正确**读取 `retry-after` 并填充 `providerRetryAfterMs`，而 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 不读取。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai`：`0.1.0-rc.6`（rc.7 同样存在，见下）
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-retry`：`0.1.0-rc.6`
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai`：`0.82.1`
- 接入方：火山方舟 `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/v3`，模型 `deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731`，TPM 上限 1000K/min
- 平台：Windows，DeepSeek Harness web profile

## 复现步骤

1. 在 `settings.yaml` 配置一个 OpenAI 兼容路由（`llm-pi-ai`），协议 `openai-completions` 或 `openai-responses`，模型声明 `reasoningEfforts`（开启推理）。
2. 短时间内连续请求，触发服务端 429（火山方舟报 `ModelAccountTpmRateLimitExceeded`）。
3. 观察重试行为。

## 实际观察（会话日志 `llm/retry` 事件）

```json
{
  "retryId": "ab5c6832-c18b-468e-acee-8c8c75516b9f",
  "provider": "volcano-ark",
  "mode": "normal",
  "policyKey": "[\"normal\",2,[\"EMPTY_RESPONSE\",\"RATE_LIMIT\",\"SERVER\",\"TIMEOUT\",\"TRANSPORT\"],500,10000,0.1]",
  "retry": 1,
  "maxRetries": 2,
  "delayMs": 493.78,
  "failure": {
    "message": "429: {\"code\":\"ModelAccountTpmRateLimitExceeded\",\"message\":\"TPM (Tokens Per Minute) limit ...\"}",
    "code": "RATE_LIMIT"
  }
}
```

- `delayMs` 依次为 `~493ms`、`~933ms`、`~1072ms` —— 即 `initialDelayMs=500` 的**指数退避**（`500*2^0`、`500*2^1`）。
- `failure` 中**没有 `providerRetryAfterMs`** 字段。
- 重试 2 次后（`retry=2/maxRetries=2`）耗尽，`turn/end` 以 `RATE_LIMIT` 错误结束；人工再发消息又命中 429，循环往复。

## 根因分析

错误传递链：

```
火山方舟 429 + Retry-After 头
   │
   ▼
pi-ai (openai-completions / openai-responses) 的 stream
   │  catch → 转成 error 事件，只保留字符串 errorMessage，
   │  丢弃原始错误对象（含 headers）
   ▼
dsh-llm-pi-ai 的 toStreamChunks / mapStopReason
   │  → { kind:"error", failure:{ code:"RATE_LIMIT", message:"..." } }
   │  （无 providerRetryAfterMs）
   ▼
外层 dsh-llm-retry
   │  providerRetryAfterMs === undefined
   │  → 使用 localDelay（指数退避 500ms→1000ms）
   ▼
重试间隔太短，TPM 未恢复，再次 429
```

关键代码点：

1. **`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `profileOptions` 硬编码 `maxRetries: 0`**，禁用了 pi-ai 的内部重试（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai`）。而 pi-ai 的内部重试（`provider-retry.js` 的 `getRetryDelayMs`）**本来就会遵循 `retry-after` / `retry-after-ms`**——这是设计上把重试统一交给外层 `dsh-llm-retry` 的取舍。

2. **错误透传丢失 headers**：pi-ai 的 `stream`（如 `openai-responses.js`）在 catch 里 `output.errorMessage = formatOpenAIResponsesError(error)`，把原始错误（含 headers）转成字符串；`AssistantMessage` 只有 `errorMessage?: string`，没有 headers。因此 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 拿不到 `Retry-After`，外层 `dsh-llm-retry` 的 `failure.providerRetryAfterMs` 恒为 `undefined`。

3. **对比官方适配器**：`dsh-llm-deepseek` 的 `providerRetryAfterMs(response.headers.get("retry-after"))`（见 `packages/llm/deepseek`）正确读取并填充。所以同样的网关、同样的 429，官方适配器遵循 Retry-After，pi-ai 适配器不遵循。

## 期望行为

`dsh-llm-pi-ai` 在遇到 429 时，应把服务端 `Retry-After`（或 `retry-after-ms`）透传到 `failure.providerRetryAfterMs`，让外层 `dsh-llm-retry` 按服务端建议的延迟等待，而不是用固定指数退避。

## 建议方案

### 方案 A：启用 pi-ai 内部重试（改动 DSH 自己的包）

利用 pi-ai 已遵循 Retry-After 的能力，让 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `profileOptions` 把 `profile.retryPolicy.maxRetries` 映射到 pi-ai 的 `maxRetries`，从而启用 pi-ai 内部重试（`provider-retry.js` 的 `getRetryDelayMs` 天然遵循 `retry-after` / `retry-after-ms`）。

**优点**
- 只改 DSH 自己的包（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai`），不碰第三方依赖。
- 直接复用 pi-ai 成熟、正确、经过考验的 Retry-After 处理逻辑，无需在 DSH 侧重复实现。
- 改动面小（`profileOptions` 一处映射）。

**缺点 / 风险**
- **绕过外层 `dsh-llm-retry`** 的可配置与可观测性：`llm/retry` 事件、UI 上「已重试模型请求 (2/2)」这类呈现会消失或改变。
- 若外层 `dsh-llm-retry` 的 `profile.retryPolicy` 也配置了重试，可能产生**双重重试**（pi-ai 内层 + dsh-llm-retry 外层），需要设计好职责边界（例如：内层只在遵循 Retry-After 时等待，外层负责最终预算）。
- 与 DSH「统一由外层重试」的既有架构方向相悖，可能需要较大重构而非单点改动。

### 方案 B：透传 `providerRetryAfterMs`（保留外层重试的可观测性）

让 pi-ai 的 error 事件 / `AssistantMessage` 携带 `providerRetryAfterMs`（在 `normalizeProviderError` 或 `stream` 的 catch 处从 `error.headers.get("retry-after")` / `retry-after-ms` 解析），由 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `mapStopReason` 填充到 `failure.providerRetryAfterMs`。

**优点**
- **保留外层 `dsh-llm-retry` 的全部现有能力**：可配置、可观测（`llm/retry` 事件、UI 呈现）、跨 provider 一致。
- 语义更清晰：外层拿到服务端建议的延迟，用 `providerRetryAfterMs` 决定等待，是 DSH 已有的、受支持的路径（官方 `dsh-llm-deepseek` 正是这么做的）。
- 与官方适配器行为对齐，行为可预期。

**缺点 / 风险**
- **改动跨两层**：需要改第三方包 `@earendil-works/pi-ai`（error 透传 / 类型）+ DSH 自己的 `dsh-llm-pi-ai`（透传到 finish failure）。
- pi-ai 是第三方依赖，改动**升级即失效**，需重新打补丁或向 pi-ai 上游提交。
- 需要扩展 `AssistantMessage` / error 事件类型，或换一种在 DSH 层能拿到原始错误的方式，工程上更繁琐。

### 对比结论

| 维度 | 方案 A | 方案 B |
|---|---|---|
| 改动范围 | 仅 DSH 自己的包 | pi-ai（第三方）+ DSH 两层 |
| 是否需改第三方 | 否 | 是（升级需重打） |
| 保留外层可观测性 | 否（绕开 dsh-llm-retry） | 是 |
| 与官方适配器对齐 | 否 | 是 |
| 双重重试风险 | 有，需设计 | 无 |
| 工程量 | 小 | 中 |

**倾向建议**：若 DSH 希望维持「外层统一重试 + 可观测」的架构，**方案 B 更正确**（与官方适配器一致），代价是要改第三方 pi-ai 并向上游提交；若希望最小改动、接受重试职责前移到 pi-ai，则**方案 A** 更快。两者都不应只停在「指数退避」而不遵循 `Retry-After`。


## 补充说明

- 以上内容是dsh帮忙分析生成
- 已确认 `0.1.0-rc.7` 中 `resolveModelCompat` 等未改动此逻辑，问题在 rc.7 仍存在。

discussions.title: Issue: Model never calls a dynamically registered tool even though its schema is present in every subsequent request
discussions.body:
One-line summary: After `cordis_define` + `cordis_run` successfully register a dynamic
tool, the model may permanently refuse to call it — it believes its function list is
fixed at conversation start, stalls with `bash` no-ops instead, and explicit user
prompting cannot break the loop. The harness itself behaves correctly end-to-end.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5` (developer preview), run from source checkout (`pnpm dsh web`), macOS
- Failing session: model `deepseek-v4-pro`, agent preset `standard`
- Contrast (self-recovering) session: model `deepseek-v4-flash`, agent preset `cordis`
- Evidence: two exported session transcripts (JSONL); key `seq` numbers cited below.
  Full logs available on request (local paths redacted).

## Reproduction steps

1. Start a `standard`-preset session with the `cordis_*` toolset available.
2. Ask the agent to create a simple dynamic tool (ours was `hello`) — it runs
   `cordis_define` then `cordis_run`, both succeed.
3. Ask the agent to call the new tool ("call your hello tool").

## Actual result (failing session, `deepseek-v4-pro` + `standard`)

- `cordis_run` succeeds at seq 57034.
- The very next `request/header` (seq 57038, `reason: "change"`) **contains `hello`
  in `header.tools`**, and every later request keeps it. The registry→schema
  pipeline is fully functional and fully audited in the log (earlier, seq 31884
  shows probe tools appearing and seq 53628 shows them disappearing after
  `cordis_undefine`).
- Across 107 tool calls in the session there is **zero** call to `hello` — and zero
  malformed attempts either. The only tool errors are unrelated (`FS_NOT_OBSERVED`).
- Instead the model stalls for ~15 steps with no-op bash calls:
  `{"command": "true", "description": "noop"}`, later varying the command
  (`echo "stop"`, `echo done`) — seemingly to dodge the repeat-call reminder.
- Four explicit user prompts ("call it", "stop nooping", "you CAN call hello",
  "your function list is not fixed") do not break the loop.
- Its reasoning stream shows the belief driving this (translated):
  > "My function list (defined in the system prompt) is fixed: bash, read, write,
  > edit, cordis_*, etc. `hello` is not among them. Dynamically registered tools
  > get injected in the next loop…"
  …which is factually wrong about its own current request (see seq 57038), and it
  keeps oscillating: reasoning concludes "I should just call hello directly", yet
  the emitted action is another bash no-op. Each wrong step then feeds the next
  one as history, so the false belief compounds.

## Contrast: self-recovery in the other session (`deepseek-v4-flash` + `cordis`)

Same false prior appears, but within a single step (seqs 6202→8027, no external
input in between) the model actually re-reads its schema list — "wait! there IS a
`hello` tool in my list" — and calls it successfully. Two notes:

- The correction happened **before** any wrong action was emitted, so the false
  belief never entered durable history.
- Even the success is fragile: the model preserved its "static list" theory by
  confabulating "maybe hello was a built-in tool all along". Right action, wrong
  world-model.

## Expected result

The model treats the tool list carried by the **current** request as authoritative
and calls a newly registered tool on the next step, at least in the presets that
ship the `cordis_*` toolset.

## Analysis

This is not a harness defect — `request/header` events prove schema delivery. It is
a model-prior failure (training data almost never contains mid-conversation tool
mutation) amplified by self-consistency: once the wrong claim survives its first
step, later steps inherit it as history. The critical window is the **first step
after registration**.

## Suggested harness-side mitigations

1. After a successful `cordis_run` that registered tools, inject an assertive
   notice naming them: "`hello` is now present in your function list and callable
   from this step." (fits `agent.inject()`; could live in `dsh-tool-cordis`).
2. A small guard plugin (cousin of `repeat-tool-reminder`): if a dynamic package
   provides tools and N steps pass without any call to them, inject a reminder
   naming the tools. The existing repeat-call reminder teaches the wrong lesson
   here — the model just varied its no-op wording to evade it.
3. Harden the `standard` preset prompt the way `cordis` preset already does
   ("dynamically registered tools are callable on the next model step").
4. Upstream signal for model training: these two transcripts form a clean
   success/failure contrast pair for "schema present but not believed".

## Acceptance criteria

With mitigation in place, a `standard`-preset session that registers a dynamic tool
calls it within a bounded number of steps after a user asks for it, instead of
emitting no-op bash calls.


=== 中文版本 ===
一句话说明：`cordis_define` + `cordis_run` 成功注册动态工具后，模型可能永久拒绝调用它——
它坚信自己的函数列表在会话开始时就已固定，转而用 bash no-op 拖延，用户明示也无法打破循环。
Harness 本身全程行为正确。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.5`（developer preview），源码运行（`pnpm dsh web`），macOS
- 失败会话：模型 `deepseek-v4-pro`，预设 `standard`
- 对照（自我修正）会话：模型 `deepseek-v4-flash`，预设 `cordis`
- 证据：两份导出的 JSONL 会话日志，关键 seq 见下文；完整日志可提供（本地路径已脱敏）。

## 复现步骤

1. 用 `standard` 预设开启带 `cordis_*` 工具集的会话；
2. 让 agent 创建一个简单动态工具（我们的叫 `hello`）——`cordis_define` + `cordis_run` 均成功；
3. 让 agent 调用这个新工具。

## 实际结果（失败会话）

- seq 57034 `cordis_run` 成功；
- 紧随其后的 `request/header`（seq 57038，`reason:"change"`）的 `header.tools` 中
  **确实包含 `hello`**，此后每次请求都带着。注册表→schema 管线工作正常且全程可审计
  （seq 31884 可见探针工具出现、seq 53628 可见 undefine 后消失）；
- 全会话 107 次工具调用中 `hello` **零次**，也无格式错误的失败尝试（仅有的错误是无关的
  `FS_NOT_OBSERVED`）；
- 模型改为连续 ~15 个 step 的 no-op：`{"command":"true","description":"noop"}`，
  后来还换写法（`echo "stop"`、`echo done`），疑似在规避 repeat-call 提醒；
- 用户四次明示（"调用它"、"不准 noop"、"你可以调用 hello"、"你的函数列表不是固定的"）均无效；
- 思维链暴露了驱动信念（原文）：
  > "我的函数列表（在系统提示中定义）是固定的：bash、read、write、edit、cordis_* 等。
  > hello 不在其中。动态注册的工具会在下一次循环中注入……"
  这一断言与它当前请求的事实相悖（见 seq 57038）。它反复震荡：推理层得出"直接调用 hello"，
  发射的动作却仍是 bash no-op；每个错误 step 又作为历史喂给下一步，错误信念滚雪球。

## 对照：另一会话中的自我修正

相同的错误先验出现，但在单个 step 内（seq 6202→8027，期间无外部输入）模型真正重读了
schema 列表——"等等！我的工具列表里有一个 hello 工具"——随即成功调用。两点注记：
修正发生在任何错误动作发射之前，错误信念未进入持久历史；且成功也是脆弱的——它靠
"可能 hello 本来就是内置工具"的错误解释保住了"列表静态"理论：行动对了，世界模型仍是错的。

## 预期结果

模型以**当前请求**携带的工具列表为权威，注册后的下一步即可调用新工具（至少在附带
`cordis_*` 工具集的预设中）。

## 分析

非 harness 缺陷——`request/header` 证明 schema 已送达。这是模型先验问题（训练分布中几乎
不存在会话中途工具列表变更）叠加自我一致性放大：错误主张一旦在第一个 step 存活，后续
step 就把它当作既成事实。关键窗口是**注册后的第一个 step**。

## 建议的 harness 侧缓解

1. `cordis_run` 成功注册工具后，注入点名断言："`hello` 已在你的函数列表中，本步即可调用"
   （适合 `agent.inject()`，可落在 `dsh-tool-cordis`）；
2. 新增小型 guard 插件（`repeat-tool-reminder` 的近亲）：动态包提供了工具且 N 个 step 内
   无人调用 → 注入点名提醒。现有 repeat-call 提醒在此场景教的是错误的课——模型只是换了
   noop 的写法来规避它；
3. 参照 `cordis` 预设强化 `standard` 预设提示词（"动态注册的工具下一步即可调用"）；
4. 反馈模型训练侧：这两份日志构成"schema 在场但不被采信"的干净成功/失败对照组。

## 验收条件

缓解落地后，`standard` 预设会话注册动态工具、用户要求调用时，模型在有限 step 内真正
调用该工具，而非发射 no-op bash。

discussions.title: DSH 桌面版：用 Wails 把 DeepSeek Harness 做成开箱即用的桌面应用（macOS / Windows / Linux）
discussions.body:
> 说明：这是我维护的非官方社区项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属或背书关系。

最近做了一个 **DeepSeek Harness Desktop**，用 Wails/Go 给官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` Web UI 加了一层轻量桌面外壳。

- 项目官网：https://zsyu9779.github.io/dsh-desktop/
- GitHub：https://github.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop
- 下载地址：https://github.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop/releases/latest

![DeepSeek Harness Desktop](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop/main/assets/hero.jpg)

## 为什么会做这个项目

我很喜欢 DSH 官方的 Web UI，不过日常使用时总要重复一套流程：打开终端、切到工作目录、运行 `dsh web`、找到浏览器标签页，结束后还得确认后台进程有没有退出。

所以这个项目的目标一直很克制：**不修改 Agent Runtime，也不重做一套界面，只把官方 Harness 更稳妥地装进桌面窗口里。**

```text
DeepSeek Harness Desktop（Wails / Go）
└── npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
    └── node / dsh
        └── 官方本地 Web UI
```

桌面端负责启动固定版本的官方 npm 包，等待本地服务就绪，再用原生窗口显示官方 Web UI；关闭应用时，它也会接管并清理整条子进程链。

## 这层桌面外壳解决了什么

- 使用 Wails 和系统 WebView，不额外打包 Electron/Chromium。
- 自动选择可用端口，并在服务真正就绪后再打开界面。
- 启动状态和错误直接可见，同时保留本地日志，出问题时不用盲猜。
- 退出时清理完整的 `npx → node → dsh` 进程树，避免后台残留。
- 提供 macOS Universal、Windows amd64 和 Linux amd64 构建。
- 支持可信局域网内的手机访问：扫一下二维码，就能在同一 Wi-Fi 下继续处理当前 Harness 会话。

目前 v0.1.5 的安装包大约是：macOS DMG 8.9 MB、Windows 10.8 MB、Linux 压缩包 4.2 MB。不同平台的打包格式不一样，这些只是当前 Release 的实际体积，不作为桌面框架之间的性能对比。

![桌面窗口](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop/main/assets/screenshot.png)

## 一个我自己很需要的功能：手机接管

Agent 跑长任务时，经常会在我离开电脑后停下来等一句确认。现在可以临时打开局域网访问，用手机扫描二维码，在同一网络里继续当前会话。

![局域网扫码访问](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/zsyu9779/dsh-desktop/main/assets/remote-control.png)

配对成功后，随机 Token 会保存在 HttpOnly Cookie 中；重新生成二维码会让之前的手机会话失效，关闭远程访问则会停止代理并清除当前配对状态。

这里需要强调一下：这个功能只适合**可信的本地网络**。它使用局域网 HTTP，不是公网远程控制服务，请不要在咖啡店 Wi-Fi、访客网络或其他不可信网络中开启。

## 目前的限制

- 仍需预先安装 Node.js，应用通过 `npx` 获取并启动 DSH；暂时还不是完全离线、自包含的发行包。
- Release 尚未签名，macOS Gatekeeper 和 Windows SmartScreen 可能提示未知开发者。
- DeepSeek Harness 目前仍是 Developer Preview，上游变化可能需要桌面启动器跟进。
- 模型、会话、插件、Skills、MCP 和各项设置仍由官方 Harness 管理，桌面层不会接管这些能力。

## 想听听大家的真实反馈

目前尤其想验证这几个问题：

1. 在不同版本的 macOS、Windows 和 Linux 上，首次启动和退出清理是否稳定？
2. 窗口恢复、全屏等行为是否符合各平台习惯，尤其是 macOS？
3. 手机接管对长任务是否真的有用，扫码配对流程是否足够清楚？
4. 后续是否值得把 Runtime 一起打进安装包？这样开箱体验更完整，但包体和升级成本也会增加。

欢迎提 Issue 或 PR。如果遇到启动失败，请附上操作系统、应用版本，以及 `~/.dsh-desktop/logs/dsh.log` 中对应的日志片段。

感谢 DeepSeek Harness 团队开源 Runtime 和 Web UI。也想听听社区的建议：这类桌面发行版接下来最应该补齐的能力是什么？

---

**English summary:** DeepSeek Harness Desktop is an unofficial, lightweight Wails/Go shell around the official `@deepseek-ai/dsh` Web UI. It handles service startup, port selection, readiness checks, logs, process cleanup, cross-platform releases, and optional phone access on a trusted LAN. Source and downloads are available through the links above.

discussions.title: DSH｜DSH Serial Console｜让用户与 AI 模型共享嵌入式串口会话
discussions.body: > **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。** > > 本项目不代表 DeepSeek 官方产品或官方背书，使用前请自行审查代码并在非关键设备上验证。 ## 项目地址 https://github.com/InfinitePersistence/dsh-serial-console ## 项目介绍 DSH Serial Console 是一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区串口控制台。 它让用户与 AI 模型操作同一个嵌入式串口会话：用户可以直接在浏览器终端中控制设备，模型也可以通过工具发现串口、发送命令、读取输出和等待特定内容，双方的操作均可记录和审计。~~看着大肥鱼干活真爽~~ ~~求你了别问我为什么不开两个串口窗口~~ 适用场景包括： - Linux 开发板启动、登录与故障排查 - U-Boot 命令行和启动流程调试 - MCU Shell 与固件诊断接口 - Modem、GNSS 等 AT 指令设备 - AI 辅助硬件调试与远程协作 - 长时间串口日志采集和故障复盘 - [~~D指导,我文件放哪了?~~] ## 主要功能 - 基于 xterm 的浏览器串口终端 - 支持 Tab 补全、历史命令、方向键、粘贴和常用终端控制键 - 支持串口选择、自定义波特率以及 CR、LF、CRLF - 支持 ANSI 颜色、光标移动和同行刷新 - 提供 `U`、`M`、`B`、`S` 来源标记，辅助区分用户、模型、板卡和系统事件 - 支持 Text 与 HEX 两种查看模式 - 用户与模型共享同一个串口发送队列 - 保留 RX、TX、来源、顺序和会话信息 - 支持导出事件及 Host 侧 JSONL 审计记录 ## 与 DSH 的集成方式 项目实际接入 DeepSeek Harness 的 Host、Remote API、Web UI 和模型工具链。 接入后，模型可以使用以下串口能力： - 枚举串口 - 连接和断开设备 - 发送文本或原始字节 - 读取有界串口事件 - 等待提示符或指定内容 - 添加审计标记 用户和模型看到并操作的是同一个串口会话，不需要在网页终端与外部串口软件之间反复复制粘贴。 当前仓库提供可复用源码、React 控制台以及 DeepSeek Harness 接入说明： https://github.com/InfinitePersistence/dsh-serial-console/tree/main/integration/deepseek-harness 项目目前处于 `0.1.0-alpha` 阶段，建议先在非关键设备上验证。当前尚未发布为 npm 一键安装包。 另外,使用前你应当自行确认一下你的电脑上已经装好了串口驱动 ## 截图演示 工作区: 一个比较不错的工作形式:模型挂着目标对话来监听串口,用户直接通过echo来和模型进行交流来协同对板子下发指令 ## 许可证 MIT License 欢迎提交 Issue、使用反馈和 Pull Request。特别欢迎分享不同开发板、Bootloader、MCU Shell 与 AT 指令设备上的兼容性结果。

discussions.title: 给DSH添加局域网/远程访问能力
discussions.body:
为有远程开发环境需求的兄弟们做了个auth模块，装上后host 0.0.0.0启动不会被拦截，且具备一定安全能力。

https://github.com/GDWhisper/dsh-web-startup-auth

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-plugin-reducer | Find the minimal plugin set that reproduces a failure
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community
> member.**

Project URL: <https://github.com/ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer>

## Introduction

`dsh-plugin-reducer` is an external diagnostic CLI for DeepSeek Harness. It
answers one narrow question: **which installed profile bundles are actually
required to reproduce this failure?**

The difficult case is an interaction: A starts alone, B starts alone, but A+B
breaks the profile. Disabling one plugin at a time can miss that. A diagnostic
plugin inside Harness can also disappear when the plugin tree itself cannot
load, so the reducer deliberately runs outside Harness.

It creates a fresh disposable shadow `DSH_HOME` for every probe, reuses the
profile's already-installed packages, tests subsets and complements with delta
debugging, and returns a 1-minimal failure-inducing set. It never installs
packages or rewrites the source profile. Optional JSON reports scrub common
secret forms and local absolute paths.

## Real Harness test

I tested the packaged CLI against `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7`. Three bundles
were installed through the official profile flow: A and B registered the same
global tool, while C was a no-op. A and B each passed alone; A+B failed.

The reducer found `{A, B}` in six configurations, verified that removing either
member stopped the failure, and confirmed that the source profile fingerprint
was unchanged.

![Real rc.7 interaction reduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer/main/assets/demo.png)

## DSH integration

- Reads the documented `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` profile model.
- Keeps installation-owned bundles fixed.
- Reduces only out-of-tree bundles present in both `dsh.profile.bundles` and
  `dependencies`.
- Invokes the installed `dsh` executable for config or Web-startup probes.
- Reuses the profile's installed `node_modules` without package installation.
- Runs outside the plugin tree, remaining available when that tree fails to
  load.

Install from the tagged GitHub source:

```sh
npm install --global github:ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer#v0.1.0
dsh-plugin-reducer --profile web --probe web --report reducer-report.json
```

## Scope

This is deliberately not another startup guard, doctor, plugin manager, or
session repro exporter. Those tools recover, inspect, manage, or capture context;
this tool minimizes the active plugin set after a failure is reproducible.

The algorithm guarantees 1-minimality, not a globally smallest set. The shadow
home is configuration isolation, not a security sandbox; installed plugins run
with the user's normal permissions.

## Maintainer feedback requested

1. Is `dependencies ∩ dsh.profile.bundles` the intended stable definition of
   out-of-tree bundles?
2. Is there a preferred machine-readable profile inspection and readiness API?
3. Would a shared diagnostic report envelope be useful across ecosystem tools?
4. Should this stay external, eventually become `dsh plugin reduce`, or first be
   referenced by troubleshooting guidance while usage evidence accumulates?

The repository includes bilingual documentation, the ecosystem search, real
runtime evidence, a versioned report schema, safety boundaries, and an upstream
RFC. It is an early preview and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

---

## 中文摘要

这是一个非官方的 Harness 外置诊断工具，用于自动找出能稳定复现故障的 1-最小
树外 bundle 集合。它能处理“A 单独正常、B 单独正常、A+B 才崩”的交互问题。
每次探针使用全新影子 `DSH_HOME`，不安装依赖、不修改真实 profile，并可生成经过
常见密钥与本机路径脱敏的 JSON 报告。

真实 rc.7 测试中，工具用 6 个组合找出 `{A, B}`，验证两者单独均通过，且真实
profile 前后指纹一致。希望官方维护者反馈树外 bundle 的稳定识别方式、机器可读
诊断接口，以及该能力更适合保持外置还是未来进入 `dsh plugin reduce`。

discussions.title: [Bug Reports + Suggestions] Windows tool-chain fixes from a user fork: encoding, cordis dedup, snapshot paths, README row, CLAUDE.md symlink
discussions.body:
# [Bug Reports + Suggestions] Windows tool-chain fixes from a user fork: encoding, cordis dedup, snapshot paths, README row, CLAUDE.md symlink

Hi team! First of all — the harness is awesome. 🙌

Per your CONTRIBUTING.md we're posting to Discussions (issues/PRs closed for now). Below are **5 verified defects + 1 enhancement** we hit while running the harness on Windows and building custom presets. Each has a root cause, the official code state we compared against, and a minimal fix (with diff) that we validated locally. All are real, reproducible issues — no noise. Pick any you like; happy to provide full patches if you open up PRs later.

---

## 1. [Bug] `pwsh-local` garbles UTF-8 file contents on Windows PowerShell 5.1 (read side not pinned)

**Symptom:** On Windows with PowerShell 5.1 (the last-resort executable fallback), any command that *reads* file contents (`Get-Content file.txt`) prints UTF-8 files (the repo standard) as mojibake.

**Root cause:** `packages/shell/pwsh-local/src/index.ts` — `ENCODING_PREAMBLE` only pins the **output** side:

```ts
export const ENCODING_PREAMBLE =
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); '
```

Windows PowerShell 5.1's `Get-Content` **reads** files with the ANSI code page (e.g. GBK/CP936) unless `-Encoding` is passed. pwsh 7 defaults to UTF-8 and is unaffected.

**Fix (validated, with test):**

```ts
export const ENCODING_PREAMBLE =
  '[Console]::OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $OutputEncoding = [System.Text.UTF8Encoding]::new($false); $PSDefaultParameterValues["*:Encoding"] = "UTF8"; '
```

`$PSDefaultParameterValues["*:Encoding"] = "UTF8"` pins the read side for every file-reading cmdlet. The preamble still rides line 1 after `; ` separators so PowerShell error line numbers stay accurate.

---

## 2. [Bug] `tool-cordis` re-registers inspect providers with duplicate ids on a second mount

**Symptom:** Mounting `tool-cordis` twice (e.g. a user-authored preset that includes it, on top of a base composition) collides on duplicate `provider.manifest.id` in `ctx.cordisInspect.register()`. Client-manifest rows share the same ids but a different platform, so they can also suppress the host registration.

**Root cause:** `packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/index.ts` registers unconditionally:

```ts
for (const provider of hostInspectProviders(ctx)) {
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.cordisInspect.register(provider), `tool-cordis: inspect ${provider.manifest.id}`)
}
```

Inspect providers live in a process-global registry (one id per platform). Queries are agent-scoped, so a shared registration serves all mounts — the duplicate is pure conflict.

**Fix (validated, 12 lines):**

```ts
// Inspect providers live in a process-global registry (one id per platform).
const present = new Set(
  ctx.cordisInspect.list()
    .filter(entry => entry.platform === 'host')
    .map(entry => entry.id),
)
for (const provider of hostInspectProviders(ctx)) {
  if (present.has(provider.manifest.id)) continue
  ctx.effect(() => ctx.cordisInspect.register(provider), `tool-cordis: inspect ${provider.manifest.id}`)
}
```

This affects every user who composes presets — a documented, common path (`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/`).

---

## 3. [Bug] `tool-fs-search`: backslash-delimited Windows cwd breaks acp snapshot replay; search-root derivation is fragile

**Symptom:** On Windows, backslash-delimited cwd (`C:\repo`) reaches parsed records JSON-escaped (`C:\\repo`), and nested documents double the escapes (`C:\\\\repo`). `test:snapshot` normalization only recognizes unescaped spellings, so Windows-recorded snapshots fail replay. Separately, the glob tool's search-root derivation is not exported/reusable.

**Root cause:** `packages/test-support/acp-snapshot/src/normalize.ts`:

```ts
const spellings = [...new Set([ctx.cwd, ...ctx.cwdAliases ?? []])]
  .filter(spelling => spelling.length > 0)
```

No escaped / double-escaped spellings are generated for backslash paths.

**Fix (validated, with tests):**

```ts
const base = [...new Set([ctx.cwd, ...ctx.cwdAliases ?? []])]
  .filter(spelling => spelling.length > 0)
const spellings = base.flatMap((spelling) => {
  if (!spelling.includes('\\')) return [spelling]
  const escaped = spelling.replaceAll('\\', '\\\\')
  return [spelling, escaped, escaped.replaceAll('\\', '\\\\')]
})
```

Also recommend exporting `globPatternFor` / `globSearchRoot` from `packages/fs/tool-fs-search/src/glob.ts` so the derivation becomes a reusable pure function.

---

## 4. [Bug] `packages/README.md` group index omits the `mcp` group; no gate verifies the table against the tree

**Symptom:** The group index table in `packages/README.md` (and `README.zh.md`) lists 47 rows, but the tree has 48 group directories. The missing one is **`mcp/`** (`packages/mcp/mcp-client`, the MCP client bridge, added 2026-07). README line 61 states the rule:

> New packages join existing groups; new groups update their README and this table.

`git log -S'mcp' -- packages/README.md` shows the row was never added.

**Root cause:** No CI gate compares the index table against the tree: `verify-package-readme-*` only checks *package-level* README format; `check-workspace-constraints` only validates the `packages/<group>/<pkg>` shape. A missing table row passes all gates silently.

**Fix:** Add the row (we did, bilingual + i18n record):

```markdown
| [`mcp/`](mcp/README.md) | MCP client bridge registering external server tools on `ctx.tools` | Product — stable API |
```

And ideally add a gate that enumerates `packages/*/README.md` dirs and diffs them against the table rows (both languages). A rule that is machine-checked cannot be silently skipped.

---

## 5. [Bug] `CLAUDE.md` symlinks materialize as plain files on Windows and get injected as duplicate instruction text

**Symptom:** The repo keeps `CLAUDE.md` as a **symlink** to `AGENTS.md` (git mode `120000`, blob content `AGENTS.md`) at root, `packages/`, and `examples/`. On Windows checkouts (`core.symlinks=false`, the default), git materializes it as a **9-byte plain file** whose content is literally `AGENTS.md`:

1. Reading `CLAUDE.md` yields the text `AGENTS.md`, not AGENTS.md's contents — the pointer is broken.
2. `agent-instructions` (candidates `['AGENTS.md', 'CLAUDE.md']`) loads both; its scope keys treat the two candidates as distinct (`AGENTS.md` vs `CLAUDE.md` never collapse), and dedup only folds trimmed-identical content. Result: on Windows an extra instruction block containing just `AGENTS.md` is injected, duplicating the real AGENTS.md.

**Suggested fix (any of):**

1. **Repo side:** `.gitattributes` marking `CLAUDE.md` as `symlink`, or replace the symlinks with explicit pointer files (content like "see AGENTS.md");
2. **Plugin side:** `agent-instructions` skips a `CLAUDE.md` whose content is a pointer/identical to the sibling `AGENTS.md`;
3. **Docs side:** note the Windows behavior in the AGENTS.md editing instructions.

---

## 6. [Enhancement] `str-replace-editor`: suggest closest current lines when `old_str` is stale

**Not a bug** — a model-facing quality improvement. When `str_replace` fails because `old_str` is stale, the model currently has to guess where the code moved. Proposal: extract identifier-ish words from the stale snippet, rank current-file lines by overlap, and append the closest match to the error:

```
Error: old_str not found.
Closest current lines: L10: export function foo(...)
```

This lets the model re-anchor on the real symbol instead of guessing (approach ported from DeerFlow's IDE structured-edit matching). Only the failure path changes; success path untouched. Happy to formalize this into a proper PR (Agent Note + snapshot coverage per repo policy) if the direction is welcome.

---

Thanks for reading! All fixes above are validated in our fork with tests. Happy to share full patches, rebase onto your master, or walk through any of them. 🐋

discussions.body:
## 一句话

**人用 H5 点牌，AI 用 DSH 工具托管；同一个 GitHub 帐号 = 同一座位，人控 / 托管互斥。**

公开桌面：https://kuroneko.chat/holdem/  
源码：https://github.com/shinjiyu/holdem  
插件目录：https://github.com/shinjiyu/holdem/tree/main/dsh-plugin  
awesome 收录 PR：https://github.com/awesome-dsh-plugin/awesome-dsh-plugin/pull/1711

## 安装

预构建包（推荐，免 prepare / build 授权）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/shinjiyu/holdem/releases/download/v0.1.1/shinjiyu-dsh-holdem-0.1.0.tgz
```

或 Git 子目录（注意 pnpm 的 `path:` 语法）：

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:shinjiyu/holdem#main&path:/dsh-plugin"
```

确认层栈：

```bash
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

## 人机共桌怎么走

1. 打开 https://kuroneko.chat/holdem/ → GitHub OAuth 登录 → 大厅入座（进行中的桌子也会显示街道 / 底池）。
2. 桌上点 **复制 AI 令牌**（JSON：`token` / `tableId` / `seat` / `githubLogin` / `baseUrl`）。
3. DSH 里 `holdem_set_control(hosted)`，然后循环：`holdem_hand_state` → `holdem_legal_actions` → `holdem_act`。
4. 要自己点回来：`holdem_set_control(manual)`。

## Tools

| Tool | 作用 |
|------|------|
| `holdem_open_table` | 打开公开大厅 URL |
| `holdem_hand_state` | SeatView + handActive |
| `holdem_legal_actions` | 合法意图（仅 hosted） |
| `holdem_set_control` | `hosted` / `manual` |
| `holdem_act` | fold / check / call / bet / raise / allin |
| `holdem_result` | 摊牌结果 |

默认 `baseUrl` = `https://kuroneko.chat/holdem`。包名 `@shinjiyu/dsh-holdem`，含 `dsh.bundle.patch` + 已提交的 `lib/index.js`。

欢迎来牌桌碰一手，也欢迎提 issue / PR 👏

discussions.title: dsh-auth-gate: authentication and security hardening for DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
# dsh-auth-gate

**English** | [中文](#中文)

A community authentication and security-hardening plugin for DeepSeek Harness.

## Why I built this

DeepSeek Harness is designed primarily as a local development tool. Its default Host, Origin, and Sec-Fetch-Site checks are useful browser CSRF defenses, but they do not authenticate the caller.

If the Web UI becomes reachable through a LAN, container proxy, port forwarding, or reverse proxy, anyone who can connect to the endpoint may be able to access the shared Agent control plane, sessions, workspace data, and tool or approval surfaces.

## What dsh-auth-gate adds

- Session login or Bearer-token authentication for HTTP and WebSocket routes
- Login-attempt rate limiting and bounded request bodies
- Per-session approval-request rate limiting
- Three selectable presets: **Full**, **NetworkAuth**, and **ApprovalLimit**
- A self-contained login page aligned with the Harness UI
- Credentials supplied through environment variables instead of Loader patch files
- Process-local random session secrets, preventing logged-out cookies from becoming valid again after restart

### Quick start on Windows

```powershell
$env:DSH_AUTH_USERNAME = 'admin'
$env:DSH_AUTH_PASSWORD = Read-Host 'Enter a private password (12+ characters)'
.\install.ps1 -Protection Full
```

## Current boundaries

This plugin provides defense in depth, not a complete multi-user security system. The current release uses one shared login identity and does not provide per-user authorization, workspace isolation, TLS, or human-identity audit logs.

Reverse-proxy and host/network hardening are still required for exposed deployments. DeepSeek Harness is also in developer preview, so the plugin intentionally fails closed if the internal web-route contract changes.

Repository, installation guide, threat model, and source code:

https://github.com/zephaniahwang94-cmyk/dsh-auth-gate

MIT licensed. Feedback and security review are very welcome.

---

# 中文

一个面向 DeepSeek Harness 的社区认证与安全加固插件。

## 为什么开发这个插件

DeepSeek Harness 主要面向本机开发环境。其默认的 Host、Origin 和 Sec-Fetch-Site 检查能够防御浏览器 CSRF，但不能验证访问者身份。

当 WebUI 通过局域网、容器代理、端口转发或反向代理变得可访问时，任何能够连接该端点的人都可能访问共享的 Agent 控制面、会话、工作区数据，以及工具调用或审批接口。

## dsh-auth-gate 提供的能力

- 为 HTTP 与 WebSocket 路由提供 Session 登录或 Bearer Token 认证
- 限制登录尝试频率和请求体大小
- 按会话限制审批请求频率
- 提供 **Full**、**NetworkAuth** 和 **ApprovalLimit** 三种可选防护模式
- 提供与 Harness UI 风格一致的独立登录页面
- 通过环境变量提供凭据，不将密码写入 Loader patch 配置
- 使用进程级随机 Session Secret，防止已注销 Cookie 在服务重启后重新生效

### Windows 快速开始

```powershell
$env:DSH_AUTH_USERNAME = 'admin'
$env:DSH_AUTH_PASSWORD = Read-Host '请输入私有密码（至少 12 个字符）'
.\install.ps1 -Protection Full
```

## 当前安全边界

该插件提供纵深防御，但不是完整的多用户安全系统。当前版本使用一个共享登录身份，不提供按用户授权、工作区隔离、TLS 或基于真实用户身份的审计日志。

当服务对外开放时，仍需正确配置反向代理、主机及网络安全措施。DeepSeek Harness 目前也处于开发者预览阶段；如果内部 Web 路由契约发生变化，插件会选择加载失败，而不是在未认证状态下继续运行。

项目仓库、安装指南、威胁模型与源代码：

https://github.com/zephaniahwang94-cmyk/dsh-auth-gate

项目采用 MIT License，欢迎试用、反馈和安全审查。

discussions.title: 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「定时任务」能力:到点自动跑(社区插件)
discussions.body:
# 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「定时任务」能力:到点自动跑(社区插件)

DeepSeek Harness 的 agent 跑起来很能干活,但有个场景一直要人盯着:**
想在固定时间自动做点什么**——比如每天凌晨整理一次工作区、定期跑个巡检脚本、到点提醒自己某件事。之前只能靠外部 cron,或者人肉记住。

我们做了一个社区插件 **`dsh-schedule-tasks`**,把定时任务直接做进了 DSH:

## 它做了什么

- **5 段式 cron 解析**:`17 4 * * *` 这种标准写法,也支持自定义,不依赖系统 cron
- **侧边栏任务面板**:在 Web GUI 侧边栏直接「新建 / 编辑 / 启停 / 删除 / 手动触发」定时任务,可视化看列表和日志
- **host + headless 都能跑**:web profile 和 headless profile 都验证激活过,独立进程也能定时干活
- **动作可扩展**:目前支持 shell 命令触发,可以定时跑脚本、发通知
- **持久化**:任务配置存在 `$DSH_HOME/storages`,重启不丢

## 几个实际用法

```bash
# 每天 04:17 自动跑数据刷新
17 4 * * *  /path/to/refresh_data.py

# 每 30 分钟巡检一次服务状态
*/30 * * * *  /path/to/healthcheck.sh
```

## 插件是这么来的

这个插件是我们(MyDSH,一个**非官方**社区,mydsh.dev)在日常维护社区站时被真实需求逼出来的——每天凌晨要自动刷新插件数据,手动记着太容易忘,干脆做成了插件。现在它也在我们的插件大全里(mydsh.dev/plugins 搜「schedule」能找到)。

如果你也有「到点自动跑」的需求,或者想要更丰富的动作类型(比如定时发消息、定时触发 agent 任务),欢迎在评论区聊聊你的场景,也可以去 mydsh.dev 反馈页告诉我们——说不定下一个功能就是你提的。

discussions.title: Codex 同款「侧边任务」:主对话右侧开临时任务,用完即删、零残留
discussions.body:
# 给 DeepSeek Harness 加一个「侧边任务」面板：主对话右侧开临时任务，用完即删、零残留

用过 Codex 的朋友应该熟悉它的「侧边任务」交互：主任务跑着跑着，突然想查个东西、问个问题，又不想打断主对话——在右侧开一个临时任务，带着当前上下文问完就关，干净利落。

我们觉得这个交互对 DSH 很有价值，就用 DSH 自己的插件机制做了一个社区插件 **`ui-side-tasks`**。先说清楚：这是**受 Codex 交互启发的一个社区实现**（与 Codex 的原生侧边任务是不同的代码实现），但核心体验一致——**不打断主对话，临时任务用完即删**。

## 它长什么样

- 会话头部一个「侧边任务」按钮，点开右侧浮出任务面板（和主对话同屏）
- **新建任务 = 从当前会话 fork**，自动带上主会话的全部上下文——临时问个问题，不需要重新交代背景
- 面板里直接对话：发消息、看回复、停止，都不用切走主对话
- **用完即删、零残留**：删除任务 = 停掉它的 agent + 删掉它的日志 + 从工作区移除，磁盘上不留一点痕迹（这也是我们最看重的一点：临时任务就该是临时的）

## 顺手解决了什么

| 场景 | 之前 | 现在 |
|---|---|---|
| 主任务进行中，想查个资料 | 开新会话重新交代上下文，或打断主任务 | 侧边开个任务，带着上下文问完就删 |
| 想让模型同时做两件事 | 来回切换，思路被打断 | 主对话 + 侧边任务并行 |
| 验证完的临时会话 | 留在侧边栏占位置 | 一键删除，磁盘零残留 |

## 一些设计细节

- **不打扰主界面**：侧边任务 fork 后自动收纳，不会在你左侧的会话列表里堆积——它只活在面板里，用完即删
- **消息近实时跟随**：面板对话自动刷新，任务运行中的回复会自己出现，不用手动点
- **自动清理**：超过 1 小时没有活动的任务会被自动清理（打开面板时执行），临时任务不会变成陈年垃圾
- **实现基础**：完全基于 DSH 官方能力——fork 子会话、`prompt`/`cancel`、会话删除链路，插件本身不魔改内核

## 在哪里可以了解

- 这个插件来自 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev)（一个**非官方**社区，爱好者维护，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系）。我们日常用 DSH 干活，遇到痛点就做成插件，也收录在插件大全里。
- 想找更多 DSH 插件，可以逛逛我们的插件大全：它收录的是整个社区的 DSH 插件——社区作者发布的、我们自己做的、日常从生态里挖掘发现的，全部带 AI 中文总结 + AI 智能搜索（[https://mydsh.dev/plugins](https://mydsh.dev/plugins)）

评论区聊聊：你希望侧边任务还能做什么？或者去 [https://mydsh.dev](https://mydsh.dev) 反馈页告诉我们。

插件已开源：**[github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks](https://github.com/uluckystar/dsh-client-ui-side-tasks)**（已加入官方 [`dsh-plugin`](https://github.com/topics/dsh-plugin) topic，可在生态里直接搜到）。安装很简单：`git clone` 后执行 `dsh plugin --profile web add <仓库路径>` 即可。

discussions.title: DSH 插件已经 1700+ 了,怎么快速找到「适合我」的那一个?
discussions.body:
# DSH 插件已经 1700+ 了,怎么快速找到「适合我」的那一个?

DeepSeek Harness 的插件生态涨得飞快——GitHub 上带 `dsh-plugin` topic 的仓库已经 2300+,而且每天都在增加。插件多当然是好事,但「多」也带来了一个真实痛点:

> 插件名全是英文、README 良莠不齐,光看名字根本不知道这个插件干嘛的、适不适合自己。想找「能管理 MCP 的插件」「好用的界面美化」,只能一个仓库一个仓库翻。

## 我们试了一个解法:AI 中文总结 + AI 智能搜索

我们在维护的生态大全(mydsh.dev/plugins)里给每个插件都生成了 **AI 中文总结**(一句话讲清它解决什么问题),并加了一个 **AI 智能搜索**:不用记关键词,用一句话描述你的需求,AI 直接推荐最合适的插件。

比如输入「我想找一个 MCP 相关的插件,能管理服务器的」:

![mydsh.dev 插件大全 AI 搜索实测](https://mydsh.dev/assets/ai-search-demo.png)

AI 直接给出了 5 个候选,每个都带一句中文说明它是什么、适合什么场景——比如 `dsh-mcp-manager` 提供 MCP 配置页面集中管理服务、`dsh-workspace-mcp` 按 workspace 隔离 agent-scoped MCP server,一看就知道该选哪个。

## 顺手解决了几个小痛点

- **中文总结**:英文 README 也能一眼看懂(所有插件都有)
- **一句话搜索**:不用想关键词,「我要一个能管理服务器的 MCP 插件」这种自然语言直接搜
- **分类 + 排序**:Agent 协作 / 界面 / 效率 / skills 等 12 个分类,可按星标、最近更新排

## 在哪里用

mydsh.dev/plugins —— 这是我们的**非官方**生态大全站(与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属关系,爱好者维护)。想找插件、想看看生态里都有什么,可以来逛逛;发现好插件也欢迎推荐给我们收录。

也欢迎直接在下面评论区聊聊:你还遇到过哪些「插件太多反而难选」的场景?或者想要什么新功能?

Installing either surface does not authorize changes to another real Profile. ## Screenshot ## Verification - Repository checks: 5/5 tests plus brief, marketplace, and distribution contract checks passed. - Package dry run: 27 files, MIT license retained. - Static plugin audit: 80/80 with no hard blocker. - DSH STORE status: `approved` at the fixed source above. - Real DSH Profile: unchanged by this publication operation. discussions.title: [Bug] 会话续接（resume）写入与中断回合的收尾写入竞态，导致会话日志 seq 重叠损坏
discussions.body:
会话在"回合被中断（turn/end reason: interrupted）后立即续接"时，续接写入方用过期游标重写回合边界事件，导致日志出现 seq 重叠，GUI 历史加载报 `corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region`。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 在 GUI 中让某会话运行一个回合（含工具调用，如 pwsh）；
  2. 在回合执行中（工具未结束/刚结束时）关闭 web 服务（或点停止打断回合），使该回合以 `turn/end { reason: "interrupted" }` 收尾；
  3. 重启服务并重新打开/续接该会话，立即发送新消息；
  4. 再次打开会话历史 → 报 `history unavailable ... corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line N (expected A, got B)`。
- 实际结果：
  - 两次独立发生，签名一致：恰好 4 条事件（旧回合尾 `tool/result`、`step/end` + 续接回合头 `step/start`、`assistant/chunk`）被重复写入，seq 回跳 4。
  - 实证（损坏日志解码，DSH 0.1.0-rc.5 / commit c5afd42，Windows，Node 24.19.0）：
    - 帧590（原）：`tool/result seq=386846 turn=22 step=4` → `step/end seq=386847` → `turn/end seq=386848 reason="interrupted"`（20:42:34）
    - 帧591（原）：`session/end-seed seq=386849`（20:43:02，续接标记）
    - 帧592（重复）：`tool/result seq=386846` → `step/end seq=386847`（20:43:10）
    - 帧593（重复）：`step/start seq=386848 turn=22 step=5`（续接后同一回合继续）
    - 帧594（重复）：`assistant/chunk seq=386849 ...`（此后从 386850 正常延续）
  - 首次损坏为同签名（seq 352315~352318 重复，expected 352319）。
  - 损坏文件样本已打包为附件 zip（GitHub 不支持 .zstd 附件，已转 zip，内含原始损坏日志 + 解码现场 gap-region.log + 说明）。
- 预期结果：
  - 重启/中断后续接同一会话，不应产生 seq 重叠；续接写入方使用的 seq 游标必须与磁盘上已提交内容一致。
- 环境：
  - Windows + Node v24.19.0，DSH 0.1.0-rc.5（git c5afd42），web 由 `apps\cli\lib\bin.js web` 启动，JSONL 后端默认 zstd 压缩。
- 验收条件：
  - 在"回合被中断后立即重启并续接"的复现流程下，日志不再出现 seq gap；续接后的首个新事件 seq 严格等于已提交事件数。
  - 既有损坏日志可被后端读取（或给出明确的可恢复语义）。

</details>

## 根因分析（供开发者参考）

机制推断：中断回合的"收尾写入"与"续接（resume）"两路写入在回合边界竞态：

1. 回合被打断时，进程把 `tool/result`、`step/end`、`turn/end{interrupted}` 落盘（帧590）；
2. 续接方（新 Session 构造，`packages/core/session/src/index.ts` L499-546，seed 校验要求"从 0 连续"，L526；seed 未以 end-seed 结尾则追加 `session/end-seed`，L545-546）基于**早于帧590落盘的历史**（停在 `tool/call`）构造 seed，游标停留在旧位置；
3. 续接方随后重放/续跑同一回合（step+1），从自身游标开始追加，与已落盘的 seq 重叠；
4. 协调器仅校验**进程内**游标连续（`packages/session/session-persistence/src/coordinator.ts` L713 `append seq mismatch`），无法发现跨写入方（或同一进程内两路 Session 实例）的 seq 重叠；
5. `commitPrepared` 在存在 closers/tornMarker 时走 `commitRepair`（coordinator.ts L993-995），`interruptedTurnClosers`（L953）生成合成 `turn/end`——与续接写入的交错是疑似竞态点。

建议排查方向：
- 续接 seed 的构建是否应在"确保中断回合收尾写入已可见"之后进行（如先对中断回合执行 repair/截断并等待落盘，再构造 seed）；
- 跨写入方（跨进程/同进程多 Session 实例）的 seq 分配是否需要额外串行化或基于磁盘最新 committed 状态而非内存游标。

[DSH-上游反馈-附件.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31181906/DSH-.-.zip)

discussions.title: Sandbox denials are invisible to the model when the confined program rewrites the kernel error
discussions.body:
## What happened

In a standard `workspace-write` session, the agent needed to write to `~/.obelisk` (outside the workspace root). The Seatbelt profile correctly denied the write — but the agent had no way to know the sandbox was involved:

1. A SQLite command failed with a *translated* error ("unable to open database file"-class — SQLite maps the kernel's `EPERM` onto its own error codes). No denial marker appeared in the tool result.
2. The model's first hypothesis was **disk full**. It spent several turns probing that theory (e.g. testing whether a full disk blocks all SQLite file operations) before a manual `touch ~/.obelisk` happened to print `Operation not permitted` and revealed the sandbox.
3. Only then did it request escalation to `danger-full-access` — with a correct justification, through the proper approval flow.

To be fair to the escalation design: from `workspace-write`, `danger-full-access` is the *only* wider mode (`WIDER_MODES`), and writing to `~/.obelisk` genuinely requires it. The escalation mechanism worked as intended. What failed is the **diagnostic path**: the model reached the right conclusion by accident, after a wrong-hypothesis detour, instead of from a harness-supplied fact. With a slightly different error translation it could just as easily have concluded "this command cannot work at all" and given up — or asked for full access with a bogus justification like "the disk is broken". The user shouldn't have to wait through (and approve around) a misdiagnosis the harness could have prevented with one line of output.

## Root cause: denial detection is a stderr-substring heuristic

`ctx.sandbox.confine()` returns per-backend `denialSignatures` (`operation not permitted` for Seatbelt, `permission denied` for Landlock, etc.), and `dsh-bash-sandbox` classifies a failed run with `matchesSignature(exitCode, stderr, signatures)` — a plain case-insensitive substring match on stderr (`packages/shell/bash-sandbox/src/helpers.ts`).

That only works when the confined program prints the kernel's errno verbatim. Real programs translate `EPERM` into their own vocabulary:

- SQLite: `unable to open database file`, `disk I/O error`
- Node libraries: wrapped `EACCES`/`EPERM` messages that may or may not survive
- countless tools: `cannot open`, `failed to create`, or silence

When the translation happens, no signature matches → `sandbox.denied: false` → the `[sandbox: file access denied under workspace-write mode]` marker (`packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts`) is never emitted → the model reasons about the error at face value. The misdiagnosis is not a model weakness; the harness withheld the one fact (confinement is active, and this write fell outside the policy) that would have made the diagnosis trivial.

Notably, the fs-capability fence does not have this problem: it refuses mutations itself and reports the exact denial marker. The asymmetry is confined to the subprocess path, where the kernel — not the harness — delivers the refusal.

## Directions worth discussing

1. **Always-on confinement context.** Include the active mode and writable roots in every confined tool result (or at least in every non-zero-exit result), not just on heuristic hits — so the model can attribute ambiguous I/O errors itself. Cost: a few tokens per result.
2. **Path-based attribution as a second classifier.** On non-zero exit under a confined mode, extract absolute paths from stderr/stdout and flag ones outside the policy's writable roots with a softer marker (`[sandbox: this failure touched paths outside writable roots — possibly sandbox-related]`). Heuristic too, but catches the translated-error case that signatures miss.
3. **Tool-description teaching.** State in the bash tool description that under `workspace-write`, writes outside the workspace fail and programs may report this as generic I/O errors — cheap, prompt-level, covers today's gap with no mechanism change.
4. **Distinguish "proven denial" from "proven not-denied".** Today `denied: false` conflates "command genuinely failed" with "we couldn't tell". Surfacing the uncertainty itself would already change model behavior.

Happy to prototype whichever direction the maintainers prefer — (1) or (2) look like the best signal-to-complexity ratio to me.

discussions.title: Model picker filtering and bulk selection
discussions.body:
## Summary

I implemented filtering and bulk-selection controls for the provider model picker.

The implementation is available in my fork:

- Branch: https://github.com/Imagine-Brian/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/model-picker-filter-bulk-selection
- Commit: https://github.com/Imagine-Brian/deepseek-harness/commit/4cfe0c3d8af57c55e1648c7c971d4ce7a7f6f4fd

## Motivation

An OpenAI-compatible provider may expose dozens of models. The existing picker requires selecting each model individually and does not provide a way to narrow the list to a particular model family.

## Behavior

The change adds:

- Case-insensitive model ID filtering
- Trimming of leading and trailing search whitespace
- **Select all** for currently visible candidates
- **Invert selection** for currently visible candidates
- Preservation of hidden candidates' selection state
- A no-matches message when the filter returns no candidates
- English and Chinese localization
- Updated English and Chinese documentation

Bulk actions intentionally affect only visible candidates. This allows users to filter for a model family and select exactly those matching models without changing hidden rows.

## Validation

- Targeted component test: 85 tests passed
- Staged lint: passed
- Translation pairing checks: passed
- Whitespace checks: passed

The implementation includes component tests for filtering, no-match behavior, selecting all candidates, inverting visible candidates, and preserving hidden selection state.

## Request for feedback

The contribution guide indicates that external pull requests are not currently accepted, so I am sharing the implementation here for feedback and possible adoption by the maintainers.

discussions.title: Web UI: creating/resuming any agent fails with 'refusing to compose an unscoped context' (rc.6 & rc.7) — root cause + one-line fix
discussions.body:
## Summary

On DSH 0.1.0-rc.6 and rc.7, in the GUI (web UI), creating a new session, resuming an existing one, or switching models can fail with:

```
agent-presets: refusing to compose an unscoped context
```

This happens when an installation ends up with **two physical copies of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope`** loaded into one process (for example, the engine's own `node_modules` and a separately-managed profile tree's `node_modules` each resolve their own copy). The scope identity tag is a module-local symbol, and the two copies do not share it — a context minted through one copy is invisible to the other, so the agent is seen as unscoped.

This is rooted in the engine itself and is still present in rc.6/rc.7. Below is the root cause plus a one-line fix, along with a fork containing the change.

## Repro (3 steps, ~30 seconds)

1. Install DSH **rc.6** or **rc.7**.

2. Start the web UI (`dsh web`).

3. Click **"New session"** (or resume an existing session / switch model) → the error appears.

The failure depends on which copy of `dsh-scope` minted the scope context versus which one reads it, so it may be intermittent across setups.

## Root cause

`packages/core/scope/src/index.ts`:

```ts
const kScope = Symbol('dsh.scope')
```

`Symbol()` returns a new unique symbol on every call. When the host and the agent-presets plugin each resolve `@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope` to a different installed copy, each copy re-executes this line and gets an unrelated symbol. The scope tag written under one copy's symbol (`createScope` → `fiber.ctx.extend({ [kScope]: key })`) cannot be read by the other copy's `scopeOf(ctx)`, so the context looks unscoped to the reader.

The monorepo itself uses pnpm workspaces, which hoists `dsh-scope` to a single copy, so this usually does not surface internally — it shows up in installations that load two distinct copies.

## Fix (one line)

```ts
const kScope = Symbol.for('dsh.scope')
```

`Symbol.for` reads/writes the same global-registry entry regardless of which module copy executes it, so tags written by any copy are read back correctly by any other. Single-copy behavior is unchanged. `Symbol.for` is already the pattern used in this repo for cross-instance identity (e.g. Schemastery's `Symbol.for('schemastery')`).

We verified this: editing the installed copies (`node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-scope/lib/index.js`) or the source at `packages/core/scope/src/index.ts` from `Symbol('dsh.scope')` to `Symbol.for('dsh.scope')` makes session create/resume/model-switch succeed immediately, no rebuild.

## Fix ready on a fork

We prepared the change as a branch you can review or cherry-pick:

* Fork: `kongminOS/deepseek-harness`

* Branch: `fix/dsh-scope-symbol-for`

* Commit: `fix(scope): use Symbol.for so the scope tag survives duplicate package copies`

* Diff: one line in `packages/core/scope/src/index.ts`

Not just a diagnosis — a reproducible fix branch. Happy to open a PR if the issue tracker / pull-request channel reopens.

## Also worth noting

While on rc.7, another engine-level item paired with this: **`DeepSeek API error (HTTP 404)`** when `llm-deepseek.baseURL` in `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` is set to `https://api.deepseek.com/anthropic` (Anthropic-compatible endpoint) — the OpenAI-format adapter calls `/chat/completions`, which the Anthropic path does not serve. Setting it to `https://api.deepseek.com` (or deleting the key) fixes it; settings.yaml hot-reloads.

More details on both are in the desktop-shell's Known Issues section: [<https://github.com/kongminOS/kongmin-dsh-desktop-shell#known-issues--fixes-dsh-engine-010-rc6--rc7>](https://github.com/kongminOS/kongmin-dsh-desktop-shell#known-issues--fixes-dsh-engine-010-rc6--rc7)

discussions.title: 【梁相】今日开梁！用你烧掉的 Token，投一炷香火，把梁子夯上天
discussions.body: # 【梁相】今日开梁！用你烧掉的 Token，投一炷香火，把梁子夯上天 **众香成势，梁子显相。梁相还得梁人出！** 我做了一个 DeepSeek Harness WebUI 插件：**梁相**（`dsh-liangxiang`）。 它不是又一个 Token 看板，也不是排行榜。 它把你每天真正用掉的 Input / Output Token 凝成香火；一炷香只能投一次「夯」或「拉」； 同一天只有一道梁案，众人的选择汇成梁位，梁子就在当天显相； 日终之后，结果收入梁祠。 梁案每日更新，让我们一起向每日梁案，投出我们对生活的态度！ 官网：[[liang.today](https://liang.today/)](https://liang.today/) 仓库：https://github.com/liang-today/dsh-liangxiang npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-liangxiang 梁相是独立社区项目，**不是 DeepSeek 官方产品**，与 DeepSeek 及其关联主体没有官方关系。 ## 它在干什么 DeepSeek Harness 社区这几天插件长得很快：有人在做用量统计，有人在做桌宠，有人在做市场和分发。我自己用 DSH 的时候，一直觉得缺一件更酷的事—— **Token 烧完不该只剩一行用量。它还能变成一炷香，决定今天的梁子是夯上天，还是被拉下来。** 于是就有了梁相： 1. 你照常用 DSH。Input + Output Token 按模型权重折算，默认每 **50,000 Pro 当量**凝成一炷香。 2. 面对今日梁案，点「夯 · 升梁」或「拉 · 降梁」。一炷就是一票，没有中立，也没有倍率。 3. 社区夯率就是**梁位**。梁子只看这个数，跨过 50 / 70 / 85 / 95% 四道门槛，显出梁工、梁总、梁神、梁圣或梁祖。零票时是待开梁。 4. 业务日结束后，今日结果封存为日梁，再汇成周梁和月梁，都可以在梁祠里翻。 悬浮入口就叫「今日梁相」，图标就是当前梁子那一态，可以拖到画面任意位置。 官网可以先看懂玩法，再决定装不装： ## 30 秒安装 需要 Node.js `^22.19.0 || >=24`，并已经装好 DeepSeek Harness。 先完全退出正在运行的 WebUI，然后： ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liangxiang@beta dsh web ``` 页面边缘出现「今日梁相」，就是装好了。 国内访问 npmjs 慢或超时时，可先切镜像： ```bash npm config set registry https://registry.npmmirror.com ``` 固定版本、离线包和源码自编译，见官网部署指南：https://liang.today/guide/ ## 它保证什么，不保证什么 社区服务能保证这些事： - 香火不会被花成负数 - 网络重试不会重复扣香 - 多人同时争最后一炷，只会收下一次 - 页面上的梁位和梁子来自同一份结果 - 已经入祠的日梁、周梁、月梁不会被改写 它**不能**保证这些事，我也不打算包装： - 不是实名投票，也不是一人一票 - 不是民调，也不代表任何个人或机构立场 - Token 用量由本机声明，服务器目前无法独立核验 - 「五行香客」是至少成功投过一次的安装身份数，不等于真人人数 一句话：这是社区软信任玩法，不是公投。 ## 隐私 梁相只处理凝香和投票所需的最小计数。 **不会采集：** prompt、模型回复、reasoning、源码、文件内容、会话记录、API key、用户名、邮箱、手机号，以及本机文件路径。 **会发送到社区服务的：** 折算后的 Token 整数、随机生成的参与标识、业务日期、今日梁案、以及这一票是夯还是拉。 首次打开也可以选「改用本地」：香火和投票都留在本机，不连接社区。官网只做说明和演示，不处理真实投票。 更完整的边界：https://liang.today/privacy/ ## 我想听到的 - 装上之后，入口、香火环、打梁和梁祠是否顺手 - 今日梁案你希望看到什么样的题目 - 安装、断连、国内网络上还有没有卡点 如果它让你在用 DSH 的某一天，愿意停下来投一炷，那这事就做成了。 梁相还得梁人出。今天的梁子，是夯上去，还是拉下来？ --- ### English **Liangxiang** is a community plugin for DeepSeek Harness. Your Input + Output tokens become incense. One stick is one vote: raise or drop. Everyone’s votes become today’s public ratio, and the figure on screen changes with it. At the end of the day, the result is archived. It is an independent community project, **not an official DeepSeek product**, and not a poll, census, or verified usage vote. Token counts are claimed locally; the server cannot independently verify them. ```bash dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-liangxiang@beta dsh web ``` Site: https://liang.today/ Repo: https://github.com/liang-today/dsh-liangxiang

discussions.title: Show & Tell: DSH_Qi —— 给 DSH 一个 Windows 上的“栖息地”
discussions.body: # Show & Tell: DSH_Qi —— 给 DSH 一个 Windows 上的“栖息地” > 每次启动 DSH 都要开终端、敲命令、记端口，退出时还得切回去按 `Ctrl+C`。 > 烦了几次之后，我写了个小脚本，叫 **DSH_Qi**。 > > **“Qi”=“栖”**——就是给 DSH 在 Windows 上找一个安安静静落脚的地方。 --- ## 效果预览 > Chrome App 模式下无边框、无地址栏，像原生应用一样沉浸。 --- ## 它能做什么 - **一键启动**：右键 `DSH_Qi.ps1` → 使用 PowerShell 运行，完事 - **关浏览器 = 关 DSH**：浏览器窗口关掉，DSH 自动停止，不用切回终端按 `Ctrl+C` - **智能环境检查**：自动检测 Node.js/npm/npx 是否就绪 - **优先使用 Chrome/Edge App 模式**：无边框，看起来像原生应用 - **记住上次用的浏览器**：不用每次重新扫描 - **自动清理**：退出时删除临时文件，不留痕迹 它不做重打包、不内嵌 DSH、不锁版本——就是你系统里有什么版本的 Node，它就用什么；DSH 官方怎么更新，它就怎么启动。 --- ## 代码仓库 👉 https://github.com/smallksh/DSH_Qi 目前只支持 Windows（PowerShell 5.1+），需要 Node.js LTS。 如果你也在 Windows 上用 DSH，欢迎试试，也欢迎提 Issue 或 PR。 给 DSH 一个栖息地，也给自己省点事。🪹 --- ## 也问问大家 如果你也在 Windows 上跑 DSH，现在每次启动要花几步？有没有什么痛点是我没考虑到的？欢迎聊聊。

discussions.title: Patch set for five runtime correctness risks across presets, subprocesses, client disposal, and instructions
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial community patch.** This branch is maintained in a personal fork and is provided for technical review.

## Summary

This patch set addresses five independent runtime correctness risks. Three have existing reports:

- Spill storage faults can escape output collection and terminate the Harness process, including when a temporary spill directory disappears or storage returns an I/O error: [#260](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/260), [#2252](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2252), [#1961](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1961), and [#2057](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2057).
- An unavailable project-root marker probe can be treated as an absent marker, allowing instruction discovery to continue into an ancestor project: [#1488](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1488).
- Per-source instruction limits do not cap the aggregate number of source bytes read during discovery: [#1484](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1484).

The patch also addresses two additional risks that did not have an exact match in the discussion search:

- Concurrent preset copies can target the same destination. A losing copy can remove the destination already claimed by the winner.
- Dynamic Client runner disposal can race with admitted loads, allowing work to enter during teardown or allowing disposal to finish before admitted runners are fully torn down.

## Implementation

The implementation is available as one commit:

- [Comparison against `master`](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...ZHUI33:codex/fix-reviewed-runtime-risks?expand=1)
- [Commit `69cafadf1c`](https://github.com/ZHUI33/deepseek-harness/commit/69cafadf1cb626b22aa700501cb716fc933cb2c5)

It makes these changes:

- Claims preset copy targets atomically and removes only directories owned by the failing copy.
- Contains spill open, append, and final-close faults; incomplete files are removed and the bounded output tail remains available.
- Closes Client runner load admission before draining admitted work, then awaits every runner teardown.
- Represents root-marker probes as found, absent, or unavailable and stops discovery on unavailable probes.
- Adds configurable `maxTotalSourceBytes`, consumes the budget most-specific-first, and preserves the established model-visible source order.
- Updates the affected bilingual package documentation, generated configuration catalog, snapshots, tests, and implemented Agent Notes.

## Verification

- `pnpm run lint`
- `pnpm run typecheck`
- Focused TypeScript build for the four affected packages
- Client runner tests: 46 passed
- Preset authoring coverage: 21 passed with 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines for `authoring.ts`
- Platform-independent `OutputCollector` tests: 8 passed
- Agent-instructions coverage without Windows symlink setup cases: 151 passed, 4 skipped; 100% statements, functions, and lines
- Agent-instructions snapshot refresh: 2 passed
- `git diff --check`

## Windows-local limitations

- `pnpm run doc-sync` completed 27 of 28 checks. The remaining documentation-site check fails during test setup because Windows rejects symlink creation with `EPERM`; all other documentation checks passed.
- The complete agent-instructions suite reached 150 passed and 1 skipped before three symlink tests failed during setup with the same `EPERM`.
- The committed code-mode workspace snapshot preserves stable placeholders; a Windows-only serialized path-normalization mismatch remains outside this patch.
