discussions.title: [Bug][Fix available] pnpm add -g 后 native binding 解析失败，dsh web 找不到已安装插件
discussions.body:
## Affected scenario

这个问题发生在**发布版 DSH CLI 通过 pnpm 安装到用户级全局目录**时，而不是在源码仓库中运行 `pnpm dsh web`：

```bash
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
dsh web
```

触发条件是全局安装采用隔离的 content-addressed / global virtual-store 布局：`node-addon-require-builtin`、共享的 `node-addon-native-custom-loader` 和当前平台包位于不同的物理包根目录，没有依赖 pnpm hoist。Node 22+ 正常启动，不额外传入 `--expose-internals`。

## What the user sees

`dsh web` 在挂载 profile 中的 bare plugin specifier 时失败，错误形态是：

```text
failed to import loader entry ...:
Cannot find module '@deepseek-ai/...' imported from ...
```

报错中的插件包实际上已经安装。用户通常看不到真正更早的错误，因为 Loader 会把 native bridge 当作可选能力并吞掉它：

```text
No usable native binding found
```

随后 `ModuleLoader.fromInternal()` 返回 `undefined`，bare plugin import 改走普通动态导入，并从 vendored Loader 包而不是 profile / 已安装应用解析，于是产生误导性的二次 `Cannot find module`。

## Root cause

`node-addon-require-builtin` 持有当前平台包作为自己的 optional dependency，并委托 `node-addon-native-custom-loader` 选择和加载平台包。共享 custom loader 却从自己的物理模块位置执行平台包 `require()`。

在 pnpm global virtual-store 中，平台包仍然存在并且能从 entry package 的依赖目录解析，但不在共享 custom loader 的祖先搜索路径中，因此 native entry 加载失败。

最小回归测试使用 rc.7 锁文件中的三个真实 0.1.4 包构造该布局，并证明：

- entry package 持有 custom loader 与当前平台包的依赖链接；
- 平台包已安装且能从 entry package 的依赖目录解析；
- 未修改的 native entry 仍稳定抛出 `No usable native binding`；
- 修复后的 `ModuleLoader.fromInternal()` 能得到 Node internal loader。

## Fix

正常 native entry 加载失败后，Loader 按依赖所有权从 entry package 自己的依赖目录解析 custom loader 与平台包，再调用 platform bridge。`NARB_DISABLE_OPTIONAL_PACKAGE=1` 仍会明确禁用该路径，普通动态导入行为保持不变。

完整修复（基于 rc.7 的 `99f6f02`，共 2 commits）：

- [完整差异](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...Scrates1:deepseek-harness:fix/pnpm-isolated-native-binding?expand=1)
- [主修复 ee3c84c](https://github.com/Scrates1/deepseek-harness/commit/ee3c84c6144aeb42dbee4d7bb3a888e1ba3e1e8c)
- [保留显式 opt-out 语义 6c54acf](https://github.com/Scrates1/deepseek-harness/commit/6c54acfab2b92e2f0dded66fad7606ee1fe1bb01)

## Validation

- 隔离布局回归测试：2/2（正常加载 + 显式 opt-out）；
- Loader typecheck；
- 完整 lint/build；
- doc-sync：28/28；
- pre-push typecheck。

## Scope

这项改动只修复 pnpm 用户级全局安装中的 native platform-package 解析路径。它不是 [#2699](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2699) 中“源码启动 + watch-only HMR 依赖契约”问题的修复，也不表示所有 `dsh web` 启动错误都有相同根因。

请维护者 review 这项依赖所有权解析修复是否符合 Loader 的预期语义；完整两提交已经可以供内部移植或 squash。

discussions.title: Deep audit of dsh 0.1.0-rc.7: one critical event-loop stall, two agent-loop correctness defects, and a process-fatal transport gap
discussions.body:
I ran a full-repo audit of `deepseek-harness` at `99f6f02` (0.1.0-rc.7), building from source on Node 24 and taking `pnpm run build` + `pnpm run test` green as the baseline (**13507 passed / 816 files**). Everything below is therefore a defect that the current suite does not cover.

I have reproduced and patch-validated the first item. The rest are reported with the mechanism traced in source; I have flagged my confidence honestly on each.

Reporting here because `CONTRIBUTING.md` states external PRs are not accepted and Issues are disabled. Happy to hand over patches in whatever form is useful.

---

## 1. `terminal-bash` scrollback is quadratic — every PTY chunk blocks the event loop (critical)

**`packages/terminal/terminal-bash/src/session.ts:26`**

`utf8Tail()` re-scans the *entire retained buffer* on every append:

```ts
function utf8Tail(text: string, maxBytes: number): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  if (Buffer.byteLength(text) <= maxBytes) return { text, truncated: false }
  const chars = Array.from(text)              // one array element per code point of the WHOLE buffer
  let bytes = 0
  let start = chars.length
  while (start > 0) {
    const next = Buffer.byteLength(chars[start - 1] as string)   // per-character Buffer call, ~maxBytes iterations
    ...
  }
  return { text: chars.slice(start).join(''), truncated: true }
}
```

`BoundedTextBuffer.append()` (`:49`) calls it unconditionally, and `appendOutput()` (`:416`) feeds **two** such buffers on every `onTerminalData` event: `scrollback` (`scrollbackMaxBytes` = 4 MiB) and the per-send viewport (`maxReadBytes` = 256 KiB, no line cap). Once each buffer sits at its cap, the cost is paid in full per chunk.

The `maxLines` pre-trim only helps newline-dense output. With long lines `lines.length` stays 1 and the full cost lands.

I benchmarked verbatim copies of `utf8Tail`/`BoundedTextBuffer` at shipped defaults, feeding 8 KiB chunks after the buffers pass their caps (Node 24, M-series):

| output shape | per 8 KiB chunk | throughput ceiling |
|---|---|---|
| long lines (minified JS, base64, `jq -c`) | **128 ms** | 0.061 MiB/s |
| newline-dense | 6.4 ms | 1.2 MiB/s |

That is synchronous main-loop time. While it runs, nothing else in the harness progresses: no LLM streaming, no timers, no other tool call, no abort handling. `pollIntervalMs`, `idleSilenceMs`, and `timeoutMs` are all timer-driven and cannot fire.

**Trigger:** any `terminal_send` whose command emits a few MB without newlines — `cat` a minified bundle, `base64 /dev/urandom | head -c 100000000`, `jq -c . big.json`. A 5 MB file stalls the harness for over a minute.

**Fix** — keep the bound in bytes and cut on a UTF-8 lead byte instead of walking characters:

```ts
function utf8Tail(text: string, maxBytes: number): { text: string; truncated: boolean } {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(text, 'utf8')
  if (bytes.length <= maxBytes) return { text, truncated: false }
  let start = bytes.length - maxBytes
  while (start < bytes.length && ((bytes[start] as number) & 0xc0) === 0x80) start += 1
  return { text: bytes.toString('utf8', start), truncated: true }
}
```

**Validation:** differential-tested against the original across 32,800 cases (ASCII, CJK, 4-byte emoji, mixed 1/2/3/4-byte, lengths 0–200 × caps 0–40) — **0 divergences**. `packages/terminal/terminal-bash` suite: 69/69 passing, run twice. Measured **27× faster** on the long-line path (144.6 ms → 5.3 ms combined per chunk).

This is still O(n) per append because the whole string is re-encoded. If you want the real fix, `BoundedTextBuffer` should retain `Buffer` chunks with a running byte total and trim from the head, making `append` O(chunk). I kept the patch above minimal so it drops in without touching the class contract.

---

## 2. Sticky `max-tokens` ends the turn after tools run, so the model never sees the results (high)

**`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:290`, `:295`, `:299`**

`turnEnds` serves two purposes at once: the durable `turn/end` reason, and the "nothing is owed, stop" flag.

```ts
const stepEnd = await this.step(decision.assembly)
if (turnEnds === null || turnEnds.kind !== 'max-tokens') turnEnds = stepEnd   // sticky
...
if (turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) { await this.dispatch.serial('agent/turn-stopping', ...) }
if (turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) break
```

`step()` returns `null` exactly when tools ran and did not conclude the turn — i.e. *another model request is owed* (`:399`). The sticky guard refuses to overwrite `max-tokens`, so that `null` is discarded and the two conditions read `turnEnds` as truthy and break.

**Sequence:**
1. Step 1 finishes `max-tokens` (`:391` returns before any tool dispatch) → `turnEnds = {kind:'max-tokens'}`.
2. Something sits in `next-step`, so the turn continues. Shipped producers: a blocking `Stop` hook calling `agent.steer(...)` from `agent/turn-stopping` (`packages/hooks/hooks-claude-code/src/index.ts:270`, same in `hooks-codex`), or `agent.inject()` from `user-approval/src/index.ts:230`.
3. Step 2 emits tool calls. They execute, `{concluded:false}` → `step()` returns `null`.
4. Sticky guard keeps `max-tokens`; `nextStep` is empty → break.
5. `turn/end {kind:'max-tokens'}`. **The tools ran with their side effects and no model request ever consumed the results.** Headless one-shot terminates with no final answer.

`loop.spec.ts:983` covers max-tokens → *completed* step and `:1054` covers "does not dispatch tool calls from a max-tokens-truncated step". Neither covers max-tokens → *tool-calling* step.

**Fix** — separate "work owed" from "reason to record":

```ts
const stepEnd = await this.step(decision.assembly)
const owed = stepEnd === null
if (turnEnds === null || turnEnds.kind !== 'max-tokens') turnEnds = stepEnd
...
if (!owed && turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) { /* turn-stopping */ }
if (!owed && turnEnds && this.inbox.nextStep.length === 0) break
```

---

## 3. Auto-compaction deletes the runtime-context snapshot from the very request it is compacting for (high)

**`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:233`**, with `packages/compaction/compaction-basic/src/index.ts:147` and `packages/core/agent-loop/src/runtime-context.ts:50`

`preStep()` computes the runtime-context candidate *before* the waterfall runs, then closes over it:

```ts
const context = this.runtimeContext.project(joinContextSections(sections), sections)
const decision = await this.dispatch.waterfall('agent/pre-step', {...},
  () => Promise.resolve({ kind: 'enter',
    messages: context === undefined ? claimed : [...claimed, context] }))   // stale capture
```

`project()` returns `undefined` when the rendered snapshot equals the retained one. `BasicCompactionEngine` registers an `agent/pre-step` listener that compacts *before* `next()`. A landed compaction appends a `user/message` with `surfaceOp: {op:'replace'}` shadowing the seqs, which drives `RuntimeContextProjection` to set `retained = null`. But `context` was bound to `undefined` already, so the default `enter` adds nothing. Listener order is irrelevant — the value is bound before the chain starts.

**Result:** with `dsh-base` (`compaction-basic` mounted `auto: true`), on the turn where compaction lands, the request carries **no runtime-context message at all** — the model is not told the sandbox mode or the approval policy. Restored only at step N+1, which in a headless one-shot run never happens.

`loop.spec.ts:413` guards this class but performs the replacement *between* turns, so the in-waterfall ordering is untested.

**Fix:** re-project inside the default arm instead of capturing, so it re-reads `retained` after the waterfall.

---

## 4. SDK JSON-RPC transport never listens for output errors — stdout EPIPE kills the harness (critical)

**`packages/sdk/protocol/src/transport.ts:76-82`, `:260`**

`start()` attaches `'data'`/`'error'`/`'end'` to `this.input` only. Nothing is ever attached to `this.output`, and `write()` is a bare `this.output.write(...)` with no callback. `packages/sdk/server/src/index.ts:55` wires `config.output ?? process.stdout` straight in, while `HarnessSdkJsonRpcServer` subscribes four event streams that call `notify()` continuously.

A `write` failure therefore surfaces only as an `'error'` on `process.stdout` with zero listeners → `throw er; // Unhandled 'error' event`. `installFailLoud` registers `unhandledRejection` only, never `uncaughtException`.

**Trigger:** the SDK client dies. `runner.ts:51` gets stdin EOF and starts `await ctx.fiber.dispose()` (async: persistence flush, agent teardown, child shutdown). During that window the still-live subscriptions write to a broken pipe and the runtime dies mid-dispose — **truncating the durable JSONL session log and orphaning spawned children.**

Two signals this is a real gap: the ACP bridge writes through `Writable.toWeb(process.stdout)` (`packages/acp/acp/src/index.ts:445`), which *does* contain EPIPE; and the SDK server's own test has to add `output.on('error', ...)` (`tests/plugin-apply.spec.ts:100`) to keep the test process alive.

**Fix:** attach `this.output.on('error', ...)` in `start()` (removed in `close()`), routing through `failPending()` so pending requests reject instead of the process dying.

**Related, same file (`:148`, `:260`):** `request()` wraps the send in `try/catch`, but `Writable.write()` does not throw on a broken stream — it returns `false` and reports asynchronously. The catch arm is unreachable for real transport failures, so the pending entry is never settled. Combined with `HarnessClient` swallowing stdin errors (`packages/sdk/client/src/client.ts:223`) and `requestTimeoutMs` having no default, `await harness.run(...)` can hang forever with no diagnostic. Pass a write callback and reject the matching pending entry.

---

## 5. `SqliteSessionPersistence` turns a recoverable schema mismatch into a process exit (high)

**`packages/session/session-persistence-sqlite/src/index.ts:133`**

```ts
this.ready = this.openDb(config.path, journalMode)   // no rejection handler
```

Every backend hook does `await this.ready`, but nothing awaits it at construction: there is no `[Service.init]`, and the only same-turn consumer iterates `ctx.sessions.list()`, empty on cold boot. `openDb` awaits `mkdir` before `openDatabase` can throw, so the rejection settles a full event-loop turn later with no handler attached.

The sibling backend does exactly the right thing and says why — `packages/storage/storage-sqlite/src/index.ts:72`:

```ts
this.ready = openDatabase(config.path, journalMode)
// Mark the rejection handled: every primitive re-awaits `ready`, so an
// open failure still surfaces to each caller; this guard only prevents an
// unhandled-rejection crash when the failure precedes the first use.
this.ready.catch(() => {})
```

The session backend omits that one line. **Result:** a `SCHEMA_VERSION` mismatch after an upgrade/downgrade becomes `proc.exit(1)` at an arbitrary point after boot, instead of each persistence call rejecting with the intended diagnostic.

**Fix:** add `this.ready.catch(() => {})` after line 133.

---

## Smaller items, same audit

- **`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/spawn.ts:207`** — `readFrom` decodes each byte range independently with no `StringDecoder` and returns a raw byte `nextOffset`, so a multi-byte character split across a poll boundary becomes three U+FFFD. Hits the background-job read path (`bash-local/src/index.ts:290`) deterministically for non-ASCII output. The foreground path is safe (single `readFrom(0)`).
- **`spawn.ts:397` / `index.ts:153`** — every settled subprocess starts a permanent 15 ms poll; on Linux, once a backgrounded descendant survives (`cmd &`), each tick does a full `/proc` readdir plus a `readFileSync` per numeric entry, forever. The ref'd timer also blocks natural process exit.
- **`spawn.ts:89`** — spill files and the `mkdtemp` spill dir are never removed. With `maxOutputBytes` 64 KB / `maxSpillBytes` 64 MiB, a working session can leave GBs under `$TMPDIR`, invisible to the harness.
- **`spawn.ts:362`** — `collectStream` attaches no `'error'` listener to `child.stdout`/`stderr`, while the symmetric stdin case four lines below *is* handled with a comment. An unhandled `'error'` on these takes the whole process down.
- **`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/sse.ts:39`** — a cleanly-closed truncated stream throws `STREAM_CLOSED`, which is absent from `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`; the *same* truncation delivered as a socket reset becomes `TRANSPORT` and is retried. The sibling adapter takes the opposite view explicitly (`llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts:52`: "this is a transport truncation, not a model-level error"). Retrying is provably safe here — the loop re-sends a byte-identical body and commits no `assistant/message` for the failed attempt.
- **`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts:152`** — tool-call deltas are keyed on the raw wire `call.index` with no validation. Against an OpenAI-compatible endpoint that omits `index`, every parallel tool call collapses into one block with concatenated argument strings. `baseURL` is user-configurable, and `AGENTS.md:115` lists "model/tool JSON" and "wire boundaries" as places validation is required.
- **`packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/tools.ts:152`** — `do { ... } while (cursor)` trusts an external MCP server's `nextCursor` with no repeat detection and no page cap, inside a chain that `dispose()` awaits. A constant cursor wedges plugin disposal permanently.
- **`packages/client/connection/src/rpc-host.ts:108`** — configured `maxRequestBodyBytes` is threaded into the `/api` route but never into `HostConnectionService`, so every generic `connection.rpc.handle(...)` channel silently keeps the 160 MiB default.

---

Full reproduction details, the differential-test harness, and patches for each are available if the team wants them. Nothing here needs a key to reproduce — the benchmark in item 1 is standalone, and items 2–5 are traceable in source.

discussions.title: Sandbox containment: three structural gaps, and a request for a private disclosure channel
discussions.body:
While auditing `deepseek-harness` at `99f6f02` (0.1.0-rc.7) I found three issues in the sandbox containment story that I do not think should be discussed in full detail on a public forum.

**There is currently no private channel to use instead.** `SECURITY.md` is absent, GitHub private vulnerability reporting is disabled (`repos/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/private-vulnerability-reporting` → `{"enabled": false}`), Issues are disabled, and `CONTRIBUTING.md` states external PRs are not accepted. So I am describing these at the level of mechanism and fix only, and deliberately omitting the step-by-step chains.

**Please consider enabling GitHub private vulnerability reporting** (Settings → Security → Private vulnerability reporting) or adding a `SECURITY.md` contact. For a project at this level of adoption that ships an LLM-driven agent with a sandbox, the absence of a private channel is itself the most consequential finding here. I will send full reproduction steps the moment one exists.

I want to be clear about scope: I verified each mechanism by reading the source, not by executing an end-to-end exploit against a live host.

---

## 1. The sandbox restricts filesystem writes but not network, and the local control plane is on loopback

No `SandboxMode` restricts network access — the Seatbelt profile is `(allow default)`, bwrap gets no `--unshare-net`, Landlock is filesystem-only, and windows-acl is ACL-only.

Meanwhile the `/api` control plane is guarded by `isTrustedApiRequest` (`packages/client/connection/src/api-request-trust.ts`), whose own docstring states: *"Network reachability and authentication stay out of scope … this fence is not an auth layer."* It is a well-built DNS-rebinding and cross-site fence — I tried several bypasses against it and it held. But it is designed against a *browser*, and a confined local process is not a browser: it sits on loopback and can present whatever headers it likes.

`PRIVILEGED_METHODS` pins the sensitive methods to loopback. Against a confined child process that pin is a no-op, because the confined process **is** on loopback.

The comment above that list reasons the exposure is acceptable because "any caller that may start a session at all can already run commands as this process." That premise is exactly what the sandbox exists to falsify for the agent's own confined commands.

Compounding it: the web bundle deliberately publishes the server URL into the confined shell environment as `DSH_WEB_URL` (`packages/bundle/web-app/src/index.ts:153`) and states it in the system prompt. A prompt-injected agent does not even need to discover the endpoint.

**Suggested direction:** add a boot-generated bearer secret to the `/api` fence, compared constant-time, and keep it out of `scrubbedParentEnv`/`shellEnv` so it never reaches a child process. Failing that, stop injecting `DSH_WEB_URL` into confined shells, and gate the session-mutating command surface behind a capability the confined side cannot obtain.

## 2. Two of the four sandbox runners are spawned by bare PATH name, with a model-controlled cwd

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts:337-340`:

```ts
case 'bwrap':       return ['bwrap', ...bwrapProfileArgs(policy)]
case 'landlock':    return [this.landlockLauncher(), ...landlockProfileArgs(policy)]
case 'seatbelt':    return [this.seatbeltExec(), ...seatbeltProfileArgs(policy)]
case 'windows-acl': return this.windowsAclRunnerArgv(policy)
```

`seatbeltExec()` defaults to the literal string `'sandbox-exec'` (`:548`). `bwrap` is a bare literal. That argv goes to Node `spawn(program, args, { cwd: spec.cwd, ... })` (`subprocess-local/src/spawn.ts:351`), and libuv resolves a bare program with `execvp` semantics **in the forked child, after chdir to `cwd`** — so an empty or relative `PATH` element resolves against `cwd`. `spec.cwd` traces back to the bash tool's `workdir` argument, which is a model-supplied parameter.

The strongest argument that this is a defect is that **the codebase already states the rule and follows it on the other two rungs.** `native/landlock-run/packages/entry/src/index.ts:80`:

> *"…absolute, inside this package's boundary (**never cwd-relative: a spawnable relative path here would hand cwd control over which binary confines**)…"*

`windowsAclRunnerInvocation()` likewise uses `process.execPath` plus an absolute entry. Seatbelt and bwrap are the two that skip it. The same bare names appear in the probes (`:69`, `:86`).

**Suggested direction:** resolve both to an absolute path once at selection time, verify with `stat` + `X_OK`, fail closed otherwise, and cache. For bwrap, resolve through a *sanitized* PATH with empty and relative elements dropped — `executableCandidates` (`subprocess-local/src/index.ts:137`) already shows the codebase treats those as cwd-relative.

## 3. The macOS Seatbelt profile is `(allow default)`

`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/profiles.ts:52`:

```ts
const forms = ['(version 1)', '(allow default)', '(deny file-write*)',
               `(allow file-write* (literal ${sbplString('/dev/null')}))`]
```

Only `file-write*` is denied. `process-exec`, `signal`, and `mach-lookup` are all permitted. A Seatbelt profile is inherited across `exec`, but **not** across a launchd-brokered launch — so the file-write containment has a well-known structural bypass on this profile shape.

**Suggested direction:** at minimum add explicit denies for the LaunchServices and AppleEvents mach services and `mach-priv-task-port` *before* the writable-root allows. The durable fix is inverting to deny-by-default rather than `(allow default)`.

Confidence note: the profile text and the absent denies are certain from source; I did not execute the bypass on a live host.

## 4. Adjacent: bwrap profile omits `--new-session` and `--unshare-pid`

`profiles.ts:17` builds `['--ro-bind', '/', '/', '--dev', '/dev', '--proc', '/proc', '--die-with-parent']`. Without `--new-session` the confined process keeps the harness's controlling terminal (bubblewrap's own man page recommends the flag against `TIOCSTI` input injection); without `--unshare-pid` it can see and signal every process of the same uid, including the unconfined harness.

## 5. Adjacent: the credential env scrub is a four-word name heuristic

`packages/subprocess/subprocess/src/index.ts:44` — `SENSITIVE_ENV_PATTERN = /KEY|PASSWORD|SECRET|TOKEN/i`, matched against the variable *name* only; everything else in `process.env` is forwarded to confined children. `.env` files are materialized into `process.env` at boot (`packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:187`), joining that set.

Names that carry credentials and match no pattern word include `SSH_AUTH_SOCK`, `DATABASE_URL` and other `*_URL` with embedded `user:password@`, `KUBECONFIG`, and `DOCKER_HOST`. `SSH_AUTH_SOCK` in particular hands a confined command the ability to authenticate as the user to any host trusting their key, with no sandbox mode able to prevent it.

Worth noting the design deliberately protects `.credentials.yaml` by never materializing it — the `.env` path bypasses that intent.

**Suggested direction:** on the confined-child path, replace the name heuristic with an allow-list of what a confined command actually needs (`PATH`, `HOME`, `LANG`/`LC_*`, `TERM`, `TZ`, proxy vars).

---

## What I checked that held up

So this reads as calibrated rather than alarmist — I went looking in these places and found them correctly guarded:

- `isPathUnder` appends the separator before `startsWith`, so `/work` does not match `/workspace-evil`; the dev/ino fallback only widens to genuine aliases.
- Symlink escape through `write`/`edit`: `resolveLocalTarget` realpaths, `checkedTarget` re-resolves immediately before delegating and mutates *that* target; publication uses `rename`/`link`, which do not follow a final symlink.
- Escalation approval fails closed on missing approver, missing agent, `rejected`, `cancelled`, and `unavailable`.
- Subagent policy inheritance seeds only the parent's explicit override and pins the child to `approval: never`; no model-facing parameter reaches it.
- ripgrep argv: `--no-config` prepended, model values as `--flag=value`, path behind `--`, no `--pre` injection.
- The `landlock-run` C launcher fails closed on unsupported/disabled Landlock and on an unopenable grant root, and sets `PR_SET_NO_NEW_PRIVS` before restricting. Argv parsing is sound.
- `credentials-local` refuses group/other-readable documents, never quotes a value in any diagnostic, writes `0600`.
- The Windows ACL runner validates both SIDs against their owning paths and rejects a temp root inside the workspace.
- The browser-trust fence itself: I tried `%2E` encoding, trailing slash, `//api`, and `..` segments against the privileged-method gate and the router — they normalize identically, no split-brain.

The containment code is carefully written and the comments frequently pre-empt the attack I was constructing. The gaps above are structural rather than sloppy, which is why I think they are worth the team's attention.


Related, non-security findings from the same audit: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3251

discussions.title: Bug: workspace creation fails on macOS for paths with spaces (firmlinked APFS volume trailing colon)
discussions.body:
## Problem
On macOS, selecting a workspace folder whose path lives on a firmlinked APFS
volume (an external drive's system/data pair, where the volume name contains
spaces) fails with:

workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at
"/Volumes/.../code:/": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath '/Volumes/.../code:/'

## Root cause
osascript's `POSIX path of (choose folder)` leaks the HFS `:` directory
separator into the returned path as a trailing `:/` on firmlinked volumes, so
`fs.realpath` rejects the otherwise-valid directory.

## Fix (available in my fork)
One-line normalization in
packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/native-picker.ts strips the trailing
`:/` back to `/`, plus a regression test.

Fork: https://github.com/iZiwer/deepseek-harness
Commit: e1474742ab

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-github-search — a GitHub console for the DSH web sidebar
discussions.body:
DSH 的插件生态已经越来越繁荣，但大多数都在给 agent 加能力，很少有一个是给 人 做的操作台。这个插件就是后者。

dsh-github-search 把「评估一个 GitHub 仓库」整条链放进 Web 侧边栏：搜索 → 看 README → 让 agent 结合你的工作区判断 → 一键 clone → 交给 agent → 历史记录 → Star/Fork。以前要在浏览器、终端、对话框之间来回折腾十几分钟，现在一个面板一遍走完。

它不一样在哪

是控制台，不是又一个 agent 工具 —— agent 本来就会搜会 clone，这里解决的是你的工作流。
完整的试错闭环 —— 先判断（宿端用你自己的模型读仓库 README + 你的工作区，不污染聊天），再 clone（全局/独立 + 自选路径）；发现没用，在同一个面板里就能删掉克隆的目录。
天生零风险 —— 它就是个插件，dsh plugin add/remove 即装即卸，不留痕。

安装
‘’‘
dsh plugin --profile web add <this-directory>
dsh web
’‘’
仓库： https://github.com/ttb-eng/dsh-github-search DSH 集成踩过的坑（DI 注入门、私有的 session.events、代码搜索 CORS、README XSS…）都整理在 PITFALLS.md。欢迎试用、提反馈。🙏

discussions.body:
## 需求背景

当前工作区目录选择器的导航只显示从 Home 目录开始的路径段，例如：

```
Home > Documents > harness
```

但实际完整路径是：

/home/user/Documents/harness

用户无法直观看到完整的绝对路径或跳转到主目录的上层目录，需要点击编辑图标手动查看。

## 功能建议

在选择区域显示完整的绝对路径，而不是仅显示从 Home 开始的路径段。

### 期望效果

```
当前：[Home] > [Documents] > [harness]
优化后：[/] > [home] > [user] > [Documents] > [harness]
```

discussions.title: dsh-llm-deepseek streaming: tool-call id/name wiped when provider sends explicit null in continuation deltas
discussions.body:
**Package**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek` 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.0-rc.7 (`apps/cli` / dsh CLI)
**Environment**: Node 22.23.1, macOS arm64, `llm-deepseek.baseURL` pointed at an OpenAI-compatible gateway

## Symptom

Every tool call in a session fails with `Error: unknown tool ""` (`ToolNotFoundError` / `UNKNOWN_TOOL`). Session logs show `tool/call` events with `callId: ""` and `name: ""` while `arguments` is fully intact — the name is lost during streaming assembly.

## Root cause

In `dsh-llm-deepseek`'s `translate()` stream accumulator:

```js
if (call.id !== void 0) block.callId = call.id;
if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;
```

These checks treat "field present" as "field has a value". Some OpenAI-compatible providers send **explicit `null`** for absent fields in continuation `tool_calls` deltas instead of omitting them (OpenAI's own streaming format omits them). With such a provider, the first delta correctly sets `id`/`name`, then the very next delta overwrites both with `null`, and `closeBlock()`'s `name: block.name ?? ""` serializes the empty result.

Observed in the wild with the OpenCode Zen gateway (`https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1`, model `deepseek-v4-flash`), captured 2026-08-19 02:56 UTC — first delta:

```json
"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"chatcmpl-tool-b4d3cf2ed9145904","type":"function","function":{"name":"calculator","arguments":""}}]
```

continuation deltas:

```json
"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":null,"type":null,"function":{"name":null,"arguments":""}}]
```

Accumulating this real chunk sequence with the exact semantics above yields `callId = null, name = null` → `unknown tool ""`. The same request non-streamed works fine, and the failure comes and goes with the gateway's backend (spec-compliant backends that omit the fields work), which makes it look intermittent/random to end users.

## Suggested fix

Only overwrite when the incoming value is a non-empty string, e.g.:

```js
if (typeof call.id === "string" && call.id) block.callId = call.id;
if (typeof call.function?.name === "string" && call.function.name) block.name = call.function.name;
```

This keeps spec-compliant providers (omitted fields → `undefined`) working unchanged, and tolerates null-filled continuation deltas.

Cross-ref: issue filed with the gateway provider — https://github.com/anomalyco/opencode/issues/43328

discussions.title: Add a `conversation.chat.streamingCall` slot for streaming tool calls
discussions.body:
A tool call reaches the chat flow only as a `tool-call` Conversation Node, and that Node materializes from the `tool/call` event — which the log emits *after* the assistant message finalizes. Everything the model writes before that (the tool name and the whole argument JSON, which for `write` or `edit` is the entire file body) lives only in the partial assistant projection, where `hasVisibleContent` deliberately ignores `tool-call` blocks (`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/assistant.ts:57-63`).

So through the longest stretch of a turn the flow stands still under `Deep diving...`. #1158 reports the user-visible half of this; the reporter's own follow-up shows the server-side events are timely, so it is a client rendering gap, not a transport one.

Presentation plugins have no seat to fix it in. The only additive seat that renders during a running turn is `conversation.input.dock` — a strip above the composer, below the turn status and detached from the position the finalized card will take. A plugin that wants a streaming preview has to subscribe to `snapshot.partial` itself and accept that placement.

## What I implemented

Branch (one commit): https://github.com/GeekRicardo/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/chat-streaming-tool-call-seat — applies cleanly on `master` @ 99f6f02, where `ChatView.tsx` and `contract/slots.ts` are untouched.

The chat view declares and renders **`conversation.chat.streamingCall`**: a session-scoped keyed slot dispatched on the wire tool name — the same open key domain as `tool.call.toolview`, so whoever owns a tool's settled card can own its streaming row. The render site is the flow tail: after the ordered `ChatNodeSeat` list, before the turn status, which is exactly where the materialized card lands, so the swap moves no layout.

- `StreamingCallSeat` owns the `snapshot.partial` subscription, so argument deltas re-render one row and never the ordered list — ChatView keeps the render economics its header describes. Every `tool-call` block of the partial gets one dispatch, so parallel calls each get a row.
- Owner currency `StreamingCallOwnerProps`: `callId`, `toolName`, `argsRaw`, `turn`, `step`, `cwd`, `openFile`. `argsRaw` is documented as a JSON **prefix** — mid-stream it does not parse, and registrants must read it as text.
- `StreamingCallRow` ships as the fallback for an unclaimed key: running `StateDot`, the tool name (a localized pending label until the stream names one), and the flattened argument tail, in the collapsed tool-row rhythm.
- No de-duplication is needed against materialized calls: `partial` is derived from the running assistant-step Node, so it goes null when the assistant message finalizes — strictly before the `tool/call` event that materializes the Tool Node.

Two properties matter for a row that re-renders per delta, and both are pinned by tests:

1. **Identity is positional among the partial's tool calls, never the provider call id.** Adapters that withhold the id until a later delta exist (the `unknown tool ""` family: #2540, #2820, #2979, #2997) and keying on the id remounts the row mid-stream the moment it arrives. Filtering to tool calls first also makes the position immune to the block renumbering a late text/reasoning `block-start` causes — the compaction described in #677.
2. **The shipped row folds only a bounded trailing window of `argsRaw` per delta.** A `write` argument grows to the size of the file being written and arrives as hundreds of deltas; folding the whole prefix each time is quadratic in the stream, on the main thread, exactly while the user is watching.

Tests live in `packages/client/ui-conversation/tests/chat-view.client.spec.tsx` (seat placement ahead of the turn status, keyed dispatch and owner currency, disappearance when the partial is superseded, zero re-renders of the ordered rows across deltas, no remount across renumbering or a late id) and `streaming-call-row.client.spec.tsx` (pending label, escaped-break folding, retained tail, follow-scroll, prefix independence). The branch carries an Agent Note with the rejected alternatives (single-occupant seat, a synthetic Conversation Node, subscribing in ChatView).

## Verified

Built from source and driven through a real turn in a browser (a `write` of a few hundred lines): the row appears in the flow ahead of `Deep diving...`, shows the arguments as they arrive, and gives way to the finalized card with no layout move. Registering an entry under the tool's key puts that entry's row in the same position, and an unclaimed key keeps the shipped one.

## Related

- #1158 — no feedback during a long tool call (the user-visible symptom this addresses)
- #1845 — the sister request one file over: open the hardcoded `Deep diving...` label as a slot
- #3221 — the chat-pluggability layers; this is a third gap, the transient state before materialization
- #677 — the partial compaction that motivates the positional identity above

Happy to adjust the naming, the owner currency, or the fallback's look if the shape is wrong for where you want the chat seams to go — and to open the change as a PR if there is a channel for that (pull requests appear to be closed on this repo).

---

## 中文

工具调用要等 `tool/call` 事件才成为 Chat Node，而该事件在 assistant 消息落定**之后**才写入日志。在此之前模型吐出的一切（工具名，以及整段参数 JSON——对 `write`/`edit` 而言就是整个文件正文）只存在于 partial assistant 投影里，而其中的 `hasVisibleContent` 刻意忽略 `tool-call` 块。于是一轮里最长的那段时间，消息流是静止的，只剩 `Deep diving...`。#1158 报告的正是这件事的用户可见一面。

插件层没有可用的席位：运行中轮次唯一的增量席位是 `conversation.input.dock`——编辑器上方一条，位于轮次状态行之下，也与正式卡片将要落地的位置脱节。

我实现的方案（分支见上）：聊天视图声明并渲染 **`conversation.chat.streamingCall`**，session 作用域、按 wire 工具名分发的 keyed slot，键域与 `tool.call.toolview` 相同；渲染点在消息流尾部、轮次状态行之前，正是卡片物化后所在的位置，因此交接零布局位移。`StreamingCallSeat` 独占 partial 订阅，参数增量只重渲染这一行；`StreamingCallRow` 作为未认领 key 的随包 fallback。

两条工程性质由测试固定：**身份取工具调用中的位置而非 provider call id**（存在把 id 拖后才给的适配器，用 id 做 key 会在流式中途重挂载；先筛工具调用还能免疫 #677 描述的块重新编号），以及**随包行每个增量只压平定长尾窗**（write 的参数会长到文件那么大，压全量就是流长度的平方）。

命名、owner props、fallback 外观都可以按官方想要的接缝走向调整；如果有对外提 PR 的通道，我可以直接开 PR（目前看这个仓库的 PR 是关闭的）。

discussions.title: [BUG]插件市场安装/更新插件后 dsh web 启动崩溃：duplicate loader entry id: storage（手工修复会被自动撤销）
discussions.body:
#### 环境信息

- dsh：@deepseek-ai/dsh（npm 全局安装）+ dshmarket（插件市场 bundle）
- Node：v22.22.3，Windows 10
- 冲突包：@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app 与 @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui 均声明了 id 为 storage 的 cordis loader 条目，二者互斥

#### 触发场景

1. 在插件市场里安装或更新任意插件；
2. 执行 dsh web 重启；
3. 启动直接崩溃：

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include): duplicate loader entry id: storage
TypeError: duplicate loader entry id: storage
    at EntryGroup.update (.../cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js:81:28)
```

#### 根因分析

1. dsh plugin（plugin.js 的 reconcilePlugins，约 46-78 行）在 pnpm 成功退出后会调和 dsh.profile.bundles：凡是 dependencies 中存在、且安装版本声明了 dsh.bundle.patch 的包，一律 push 回 bundles 数组。
2. 移除侧判定（wasDependency && !stillBundle）在包仍声明 dsh.bundle 时永远不成立 → reconcile 对 dependencies 中的 bundle 是单向的，只加不删。
3. 插件市场所有安装/更新端点（routes.js 中的 runPlugin(profile, ['add', target]) / ['install']）都经过该 reconcile 路径。

#### 为什么手工修复会失效

若用户手工从 package.json 的 bundles 数组中删掉冲突包（保留其 dependencies 条目），错误暂时消失；但下一次插件市场安装/更新任意插件时，reconcile 会把该包静默写回 bundles（package.json 被整体重写，无任何提示/日志），dsh web 再次崩溃——用户会误以为是"新装的插件有问题"。

#### 期望行为

1. reconcile 尊重显式移除：dependencies 中但被用户从 bundles 手动移除的包，不应被静默加回；至少写入日志/给出一次警告 "re-added X to bundles"；
2. 崩溃时给出可操作诊断：duplicate loader entry id: storage 应指明冲突的 id 分别来自哪两个 bundle（如 storage: @deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app vs @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui），并提示二者互斥；
3. 市场安装/更新后做 boot 预检：插件市场操作完成时，如果 reconcile 修改了 bundles 且新组合存在 loader id 冲突，在安装回执中直接报错拦截，而不是留给用户下次启动时崩。

#### 复现步骤

1. web profile 的 dependencies 中保留 @deepseek-harness-tui/dsh-tui，从 bundles 数组手工删掉它（此时 dsh web 正常）；
2. 在插件市场安装或更新任意插件；
3. 检查 package.json：dsh-tui 已被静默写回 bundles；
4. dsh web → 崩溃。

discussions.title: pnpm dsh web fails on Linux ARM64 when Cordis internal ESM loader falls back
discussions.body:
## Summary

Running `pnpm dsh web` from the repository checkout fails to resolve `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse` on Linux ARM64.

The package exists and pnpm workspace links are present. The failure occurs after Cordis cannot obtain Node's internal ESM loader and falls back to a bare`import(name)` from `vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts`. The corresponding client package is also missing from `tsconfig.base.json` paths.

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `0.1.0-rc.7`
- Node.js: `v24.18.1`
- pnpm: `11.21.0` (repository pins `11.7.0`)
- OS: NixOS 26.05 under WSL2
- Kernel: `6.18.33.2-microsoft-standard-WSL2`
- Platform: `linux`
- Architecture: `arm64`

## Steps to reproduce

1. Run `pnpm install`.
2. Run `pnpm run build` (this succeeds).
3. Run:

```sh
  pnpm dsh web
```
## Expected behavior

The Web profile starts and prints its local URL.

## Actual behavior

Startup fails while directory-picker-auto dynamically mounts the browse client surface.

```sh
$ node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts web

  Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load: failed to apply loader
  entry
  directory-picker (@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-auto):
  failed to
  import loader entry e0033e60
  (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse): Cannot find
  package
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse' imported from
  /home/nixos/deepseek-harness/vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts

  Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package
  '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse' imported from  /home/nixos/deepseek-harness/vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts
      at Object.getPackageJSONURL
        (node:internal/modules/package_json_reader:301:9)
      at packageResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:768:81)
      at moduleResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:859:18)
      at defaultResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:992:11)
      at resolveTsPathsSync
        (.../node_modules/.pnpm/tsx@4.22.4/node_modules/tsx/dist/
        register-CqMfTiWi.mjs:2:11190)
      at boot (packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts:800:11)
      at async runProfile (apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts:248:15)

  Node.js v24.18.1
  [ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
```
 
## ARM64 loader diagnostic

Directly invoking node-addon-require-builtin produces:

```sh
Error: node-addon-require-builtin unsupported: Unsupported/no-getter
  (arm64 getter is not optional-bti-ldr-x0-this-imm-ret)
code: Unsupported/no-getter
node: 24.18.1
napi_version: 10
platform: linux
arch: arm64
target: internal/modules/esm/loader
getter_symbol: not-found
getter_pattern: none

Consequently, ModuleLoader.fromInternal() returns no loader:

{"node":"v24.18.1","platform":"linux","arch":"arm64","loaderAvailable":false}

Using Node's diagnostic --expose-internals flag makes the same probe succeed:

{"node":"v24.18.1","platform":"linux","arch":"arm64","loaderAvailable":true,"loaderVersion":"v2"}
```

This confirms that the ARM64 addon failure causes Cordis to take the fallback branch at vendor/loader/src/config/tree.ts:154-160.

## Additional resolution evidence

A source-mode import test using tsx/esm gives:

```sh
@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-browse       OK
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse FAIL ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND

tsconfig.base.json contains mappings for the host directory-picker packages, but not for:

@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-native
```

Both packages are declared by packages/bundle/web-app/package.json, exist under packages/client/, and have pnpm workspace links. Reinstalling dependencies does not address the failure.

pnpm run verify-cordis-config currently passes, so dynamic package references from SURFACE_PACKAGES are not covered by its source-plane resolution check.

## Suggested resolution

1. Add source mappings for both client directory-picker packages.
2. Extend verify-cordis-config to validate dynamically selected package names.
3. Add a regression test for operation when ModuleLoader.fromInternal() is unavailable.
4. Either update node-addon-require-builtin for Node 24 ARM64 or make the fallback preserve the Loader profile baseUrl for bare package specifiers.

discussions.title: Windows One-Click Launcher: Open DeepSeek Harness in a Standalone Window (not a Browser Tab)
discussions.body:
# 🚀 Windows One-Click Launcher: Open DeepSeek Harness in a Standalone Window (not a Browser Tab)

> ⚠️ **Unofficial community project** — independently maintained, not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek. / 非官方社区项目，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或推荐。
>
> Suggested category: **Show Your Plugins!** or **Ideas**

> 中文版在下面 / Chinese version below

## The Problem

On Windows, starting DeepSeek Harness is a two-step dance:

1. Open PowerShell and run `dsh web` (the server keeps the terminal busy)
2. Click a desktop shortcut to open the GUI in a **standalone app window**

If you just run `dsh web`, the GUI opens in a **browser tab** — not the nice standalone window you get from the Chrome PWA. And keeping a terminal open just to run the server is clunky.

## The Solution

A zero-dependency **VBScript launcher** + desktop shortcut that does everything with one double-click:

1. Checks if port `3080` already has a server listening
2. If not, starts `dsh web` **hidden in the background** (correct working directory, logged output)
3. Polls the port until ready (up to 90s)
4. Opens the **PWA standalone window** (Chrome app mode) — not a browser tab

If the server is already running, it skips straight to opening the window. Idempotent and safe.

## Why VBScript?

- Ships with Windows — zero dependencies, no Node/Python runtime needed
- `wscript.exe` runs it on double-click with **no console window flash**
- Can start the server hidden in the background and keep it running

## Key Snippet

```vbscript
' Start dsh web hidden with correct working directory
shell.CurrentDirectory = DSH_DIR
shell.Run """" & NODE & """ """ & BIN & """ --profile web", 0, False

' ... poll port 3080 until LISTENING ...

' Open the PWA standalone window (Chrome app mode)
shell.Run """" & CHROME & """ --profile-directory=Default --app-id=" & APP_ID, 1, False
```

The PWA `app-id` comes from installing DeepSeek Harness as a Chrome app (stored under `%LOCALAPPDATA%\Google\Chrome\User Data\Default\Web Applications\_crx_<id>\`).

## Pitfalls I Hit (hoping this saves you time)

1. **VBScript is case-insensitive** — a variable `isListening` and a function `IsListening()` collide → compile error. Rename one.
2. **`LOG` is a built-in VBScript function** (natural log) — can't be used as a constant name.
3. **`shell.Exec` pipe reads can deadlock** — `netstat | findstr` via `AtEndOfStream` hung. Redirect to a temp file and read that instead.
4. **`cmd /c` with nested quotes + spaces in path** (e.g. `deepseeek harnees`) breaks parsing — use `shell.CurrentDirectory` instead of `cmd /c`.
5. **`dsh web` needs the right working directory** — running `node bin.js --profile web` from the wrong cwd fails; `cd <npm-dir> && dsh web` works.

## Files & Install

Full repo with `install.ps1` (auto-detects node/dsh/Chrome/PWA paths and creates the desktop shortcut):

👉 **https://github.com/habushe/dsh-oneclick-launcher**

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

Then double-click the **DeepSeek Harness** desktop shortcut. Done. 🎉

---

## 中文版

### 问题

Windows 上启动 DeepSeek Harness 要两步：先开 PowerShell 跑 `dsh web`，再点桌面快捷方式打开独立窗口。直接跑 `dsh web` 会在**浏览器标签页**里打开 GUI，而不是 Chrome PWA 那种独立应用窗口。

### 方案

一个**零依赖的 VBScript 启动器** + 桌面快捷方式，双击一次搞定：

1. 检查 3080 端口是否已有服务
2. 没有则**后台隐藏启动** `dsh web`（正确工作目录 + 日志）
3. 轮询端口直到就绪（最长 90 秒）
4. 打开 **PWA 独立窗口**（Chrome app 模式），不是浏览器标签页

服务已在运行时会直接跳过启动，幂等安全。

### 踩坑记录

1. **VBScript 不区分大小写**：变量 `isListening` 与函数 `IsListening()` 同名会编译报错
2. **`LOG` 是 VBScript 内置函数名**（自然对数），不能当常量
3. **`shell.Exec` 管道读取会死锁**：`netstat | findstr` 用 `AtEndOfStream` 判断会卡住 → 改用临时文件
4. **`cmd /c` 嵌套引号 + 路径含空格**会解析失败 → 用 `shell.CurrentDirectory`
5. **`dsh web` 需要正确的工作目录**：cwd 不对会启动失败

### 完整仓库

包含 `install.ps1`（自动探测 node/dsh/Chrome/PWA 路径并创建桌面快捷方式）：

👉 **https://github.com/habushe/dsh-oneclick-launcher**

```powershell
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File .\install.ps1
```

然后双击桌面 **DeepSeek Harness** 快捷方式即可 🎉

discussions.title: Title: Preserve discovered model input modalities for llama.cpp-compatible local models
discussions.body:
## Summary

I worked through a local DeepSeek Harness integration issue with a llama.cpp OpenAI-compatible server exposing a multimodal GGUF model.

The server’s `/v1/models` response included useful metadata:

- `capabilities: ["completion", "multimodal"]`
- `meta.n_ctx: 131072`

However, the model discovery/adoption path currently does not preserve enough of that metadata to avoid manual `settings.yaml` edits for vision-capable local models.

## Proposed improvement

Preserve discovered model input modalities and served context metadata during model discovery.

Specifically:

- Surface `capabilities: ["multimodal"]` as `inputModalities: ["text", "image"]`
- Surface `meta.n_ctx` as `contextWindow`
- Preserve `inputModalities` through LLM discovery normalization
- Include `inputModalities` in the host API discovery schema
- Convert discovered `inputModalities` into pi-ai model `input` when adopting a discovered model in the settings UI

## Why this matters

This makes local llama.cpp / OpenAI-compatible vision models easier to configure in DeepSeek Harness.

Without this, a user may need to manually add:

```yaml
input:
  - text
  - image
contextWindow: 131072

discussions.title: DSH | graph-monitor：让 workflow 自己进化，一个能改图的 DSH 插件
discussions.body:
# graph-monitor：让 workflow 自己进化，一个能改图的 DSH 插件

仓库：https://github.com/asakumizy/dsh-graph-monitor

先交代一下这个东西是从哪来的。graph-monitor 本来只是给 DSH 做工作流可视化的——把 LangGraph 风格的节点 + 边 + 条件路由画出来，执行的时候每个环节实时点亮，风格参考了 Waku-agent 的 dashboard。图 *就是* workflow，防漂移，纯粹是个"看得见"的东西。

做着做着就发现不对：工作流是**写死**的。agent 只能从已有 workflow 里挑一个来跑，跑哪条路、走到一半想换条边，都不行。这跟我的预期有落差——我希望工作流能像 hermes-agent 那样**可进化**：agent 不只是"用"工作流，还能在运行中"改"工作流。于是就有了这次改造。

## 核心想法：把"图"变成一等公民

关键改动就一条——每个 run 自己持有一份可变拓扑快照 `run.graph`（初始 = workflow 深拷贝）。agent 通过节点 output 里的 `ops` 数组产出**图编辑指令**，引擎先整体校验、后原子应用，再 emit 一个 `graph/mutate` 事件。图不再是启动时定死的，而是一条能被运行自己改写的活数据。

mutation ops 目前是五个：

```json
{ "ops": [
  { "op": "addNode",  "node": { "id": "x", "kind": "fn", "code": "return 'hi';" } },
  { "op": "addEdge",  "edge": { "src": "a", "dst": "x" } },
  { "op": "rewire",   "edge": { "src": "a", "dst": "x" } },
  { "op": "setEntry", "nodeId": "x" },
  { "op": "skip",     "nodeId": "y" }
] }
```

一个不太起眼但很关键的约束：**mutation 只能作用于"尚未执行的未来拓扑"**。已经跑完的节点、边、emit 过的历史一律不改。这不是为了技术洁癖，是为了可视化可审计——否则你回看一条 run 的时候，图在你眼皮底下偷偷变了，你就再也分不清"当时到底怎么跑的"。

## 六类控制流原语

光有改图指令还不够，图得能表达控制流。补了六类原语，都用 `graph` 字段嵌套子图，子图节点会各自点亮、各自产生事件：

| 原语 | 语义 |
|---|---|
| `gate` | 条件放行/拦截，谓词为真透传，否则走 `fail` 或 run 以 `blocked` 结束 |
| `switch` | 多选一，`default` 必填保证"恰好一条" |
| `subgraph` | 组合子图，把已固化套路封装成可复用新原语 |
| `loop` | `while` 谓词为真反复迭代，`maxIterations` 硬上限 |
| `retry` | 内嵌输出以 `ERROR` 开头即重试，至多 `maxAttempts` 次 |
| `timeout` | `ms` 预算内完成透传，超时输出 `ERROR: timeout...` |

有两处设计我觉得值得单说：

- **`blocked` 状态机**。`gate` 拦截和"正常跑完"是两码事，如果都记成 `completed`，调用方根本不知道自己是"做完了"还是"被拦下来了"。所以 gate 无 `fail` 目标时，run 会以 `status:"blocked"` 结束，并带 `blockedAt` 标注是哪个节点拦的。
- **`subgraph` 是"增原语"的主通道**。这跟 mutation 反过来了——不是 agent 去改已有图，而是把刚才验证过的一套节点封装成一个 subgraph，等于是**运行时现场造新原语**。这是可进化性里我最想推的方向。

## 内联谓词：条件也能写代码

`gate` / `switch` / `loop` 的条件除了走命名 `router` 目录，还能写**内联 JS**（`source: "code"`）：

```json
{ "kind": "gate", "condition": { "source": "code", "code": "return (await graph.input()).includes('approved')" } }
```

内联代码经 DSH 的 `codeRuntime` 执行，**绝不 `eval`**。运行时可用 `graph.input()` 取上游、`graph.stateGet()` 读结构化 State。异常、空、或没有 codeRuntime，一律按"拦截 / 不命中"处理，不升级为 run 失败——模型拿一次空值不该把整条 run 搞崩。

## 双执行后端

`nodeExecutor` 一个开关切两种模式：

- `simulated`（默认）：固定延迟 + 模板输出，纯演示，不碰任何真实能力。
- `real`：`fn`（内联 `code` 走 `codeRuntime`）、`tool`（走 `tools.execute`）、`agent`（走 `subagents.start` 委派）、`llm`（走 `llm.stream`）都绑 DSH 真实能力，能力缺失自动回退模拟。

## 模型驱动编排里最疼的一块：解析

让模型直接决定编排，理论上很美好——给 `llm`/`agent` 节点设 `emitOps: true`，用 `OPS_PROMPT` 引导它输出 `ops` JSON。但真落地就撞上老问题：**模型吐的 JSON 不可靠**。裸 JSON、` ```json ` 围栏、夹在散文里的括号片段、甚至带尾巴的坏 JSON，什么都有。

所以 `extractOpsFromText` 做了三级容错解析：先试整段裸 JSON，再试围栏块，最后按括号平衡从散文里抠。还是解析不出来就记进 `opsError`，通过 `graph/mutate` 的 `ok:false` 反馈回去。结构化的高并发都靠这种脏活兜着。

## 现在长这样 & 已知限制

- 六类控制流原语 + 内联谓词 + mutation ops，全部落地并有引擎单测覆盖。
- `real` 模式下 `fn`(code)/`tool` 从设置页「运行」即可触发真实路径；`llm`/`agent` 要真实能力得靠对话里的 `/workflow` 或 `graph_monitor_run` 工具触发（依赖 execContext）。
- 运行记录和事件日志在内存里（LRU 上限），重启即清空。

代码和完整原语契约（每个原语的输入/输出/事件/边界情形，以及 ops 的载荷 schema 和校验不变量）都在仓库里：[docs/primitive-contract.md](https://github.com/asakumizy/dsh-graph-monitor/blob/main/docs/primitive-contract.md)。

discussions.title: [Plugin] DSH Get — Search and install DSH plugins inside DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
# DSH Get Plugin: search and install DSH plugins inside DeepSeek Harness

DSH Get Plugin brings the public [DSH Get](https://www.dshget.com/) catalog into a running DeepSeek Harness session. It lets users search and inspect plugins, refresh a validated catalog snapshot, and explicitly install a selected catalog entry without leaving DSH.

## What it adds

- `/dshget search <query>` across names, authors, categories, tags, descriptions, and catalog sources.
- `/dshget info <owner/name>` with repository, install command, and canonical DSH Get detail link.
- `/dshget install <owner/name>` for explicit human-triggered installation.
- `/dshget update` and `/dshget status` for the local validated snapshot.
- Read-only `dshget_search` and `dshget_plugin_info` tools for agents.
- An embedded catalog snapshot, so search still works offline.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add -w github:bobby-sheng/dshget-plugin
```

Restart DSH after installation.

Repository: https://github.com/bobby-sheng/dshget-plugin

Catalog: https://www.dshget.com/

Release: https://github.com/bobby-sheng/dshget-plugin/releases/tag/v0.1.1

## Safety boundary

Model tools cannot install software. Installation requires a human slash command, accepts only allowlisted npm/GitHub package forms, and invokes `dsh plugin add` with a fixed argument array rather than a shell. Catalog inclusion is not a security review; users should inspect third-party source before installing it.

## 中文简介

DSH Get Plugin 将公开的 DSH Get 插件目录带入 DeepSeek Harness。用户可以在会话中搜索和查看插件、更新经过校验的目录快照，并通过明确的人工命令安装选中的插件。插件内置离线快照；模型工具保持只读，安装不会由模型自动触发。

discussions.title: Web server OOMs within ~60s of any client connecting when a workspace contains a large session
discussions.body:
## Web server OOMs (V8 heap) within ~60 s of any client connecting when a workspace contains a large session

### Environment
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7 via global npm install (also reproduced on 0.1.0-rc.6)
- Node.js v24.13.0, Windows 10 (x64), 32 GB RAM
- Start: `dsh web` (also with `--trusted-host <non-loopback-authority>`; the leak is identical with and without the flag)

### Symptom
When any client connects — one real browser tab of the Web UI, or a single bare WebSocket to `/api/events.mux` — the server RSS grows ~150–170 MB/s until it hits the V8 heap cap and dies with `FATAL ERROR: Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit Allocation failed - JavaScript heap out of memory` (exit code 134). Nothing is written to the server log before the crash; the client receives zero frames on `events.mux`.

### Root cause (bisected)
The leak is triggered by a single large session (log ≈ 172k events, ≈ 3 MB zstd-compressed `session.jsonl.zstd`):

| state | RSS after 30 s with 1 client |
|---|---|
| fresh server, no sessions | 180 MB → 119 MB (stable) |
| all sessions except the large one (30+ sessions) | 204 MB → 120 MB (stable) |
| with the large session present | 183 MB → 3.9 GB → crash (7.6 GB @ 60 s) |

Reproduces with real browser tabs and bare WebSockets, over localhost and behind a reverse proxy. The same server previously ran a full day with a connected tab while the session was smaller; the leak appeared once the session crossed a size threshold.

### Reproducer
1. Start `dsh web` on a profile whose workspace contains one session with a large log (~170k+ events).
2. Wait for the UI to answer on the configured port.
3. Connect a single WebSocket:

   ```js
   const ws = new WebSocket('ws://127.0.0.1:3080/api/events.mux');
   setTimeout(() => process.exit(0), 60000);
   ```

4. Watch the server RSS: grows ~150 MB/s until the OOM crash.

### Impact
Any connected client kills the server within ~1 minute once a workspace contains a large session, making the Web UI unusable for long-lived sessions; two connected clients die faster.

### Notes
- Session logs live under `$DSH_HOME/sessions/...` as zstd-compressed JSONL.
- Telemetry is disabled by default (`DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE` unset) — unrelated.
- Happy to provide logs/heap profiles on request.

[bug] 会话 workspace 目录被移动后，bash/grep/glob 全部持续 spawn ENOENT，且报错不指向真实原因
discussions.body:
## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（`dsh web`，macOS，Node 24.15）
- 会话 workspace：`~/dev/github/plugin`

## 复现步骤

1. 在某个目录下启动 `dsh web`（进程 cwd 所在目录）
2. 会话进行中，把该目录（或进程 cwd 所在的子目录）移动/重命名到别处
   —— 我的操作：`~/dev/github/plugin/dsh-bloom-theme` → `~/dev/github/theme/dsh-bloom-theme`
3. 此后所有需要派生子进程的工具全部失败：

```
Error: spawn bash ENOENT                     （bash 工具，含最简单的 echo）
Error: ripgrep launch failed                 （grep 工具）
Error: glob could not start its search command (ripgrep launch failed)  （glob 工具）
```

4. 进程内工具（read / write / edit）一切正常 —— 说明只是**派生子进程的路径**坏了
5. 多次重试（间隔数分钟）均失败，无自愈；只能重启会话/服务恢复

## 根因（已确认，非假设）

**会话 workspace 目录被移动/删除后，bash 等工具以 workspace 为默认 cwd 派生子进程，
cwd 不存在时 spawn 报 `spawn bash ENOENT`** —— 错误指向子进程名，极具误导性
（bash 明明在 /bin/bash 好好的）。grep/glob 依赖的 ripgrep 同理。

决定性证据：重建 workspace 目录（在原路径放一个占位文件）后，**未重启任何进程**，
bash 工具下一次调用立即恢复。此前重启 dsh web 守护进程（launchctl bootout +
bootstrap）无效 —— 说明坏的是会话绑定的 workspace 路径，不是服务进程自身的 cwd。

## Workaround（立刻可用）

```bash
mkdir -p <会话的原 workspace 路径>   # 里面放个占位文件即可
```

无需重启会话，下一次工具调用即恢复。

## 为什么这个问题对用户高频

开发中随手整理目录结构（mv / 重命名项目文件夹）是很常见的操作，而 DSH 会话
往往一开就是几个小时。只要会话进程的 cwd 在被移动的目录树里，整个会话的
执行层就悄悄瘫痪，且报错完全看不出与目录移动有关（用户会以为 bash/环境坏了）。

## 建议

1. **spawn 时显式传 cwd**：校验 workspace root 存在后传入；不存在则回退
   `os.homedir()` 或 `os.tmpdir()`，而不是让子进程继承一个已失效的 cwd
2. **错误可诊断**：ENOENT 且二进制绝对路径存在时，检测 `process.cwd()` 是否
   还挂载，给出可操作的报错，如「会话工作目录已被移动，请重启会话或……」
3. **自愈**：定期检查 cwd 有效性，失效时 re-chdir 到 workspace root 或用户主目录

## 补充

- 时间线证据：目录移动发生在 12:14-12:15，首批 ENOENT 出现在其后的第一次工具调用；期间一次 `echo` 成功后随即全部失败（可能是移动完成过程中的竞态窗口）
- 愿意提供 DSH_LOGS / 更多复现细节

discussions.title: [Reliability][POSIX/Linux] 宿主不可捕获终止后 detached 工具树继续运行；只管理 service PID/PGID 无法收容
discussions.body:
## 摘要

当 Harness 宿主发生无法运行 JavaScript 清理逻辑的终止（例如 `SIGKILL`）时，`subprocess-local` 创建的 POSIX detached 工具进程组会继续运行。只终止 service PID，甚至终止完整 service PGID，都不能收容已经进入独立 PGID 的工具树；具有外部副作用的命令可能在 Web 服务消失后继续完成。

这与当前 README 中“不可捕获的宿主死亡需要外部 owner”的说明一致。本帖补充的是实测边界：常见的“只管理 service PID/PGID”的 supervisor 仍然不够，完整容器/cgroup owner 才能覆盖该工具树。

## 实测基线

- macOS arm64：源代码基线 `47f943859bef60e4160492346772ded9b24f765a`，实际 `LocalSubprocessRuntime`。
- Linux arm64：Node 24.19.0，发布包 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local@0.1.0-rc.6`，容器为 `node:24-bookworm-slim`。
- 当前 `master@99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca` 仍通过 `detached: platform !== 'win32'` 为普通 POSIX 子进程建立独立进程组，并只在宿主内存中保留 live handle 以供正常 dispose 和可观察的 Node exit 清理。

## 结果

| 场景 | 终止范围 | 结果 |
| --- | --- | --- |
| macOS 回归探针 | `SIGKILL` 完整模拟 service PGID | 工具 root 与 descendant 均存活；测试随后按精确身份清理，残留为 0 |
| Linux Arm A | 只对 service 进程发送 `SIGKILL`，容器 PID 1 保持运行 | 工具 root 与 descendant 存活，root 被重新托管到 PID 1，延迟标记文件写入成功 |
| Linux Arm B | 对完整容器执行 Docker `KILL` | 容器退出码 137，非 OOM；等待 10 秒后没有延迟标记 |

Linux 矩阵连续运行两次，核心结果一致。测试结束后均只清理记录到的精确工具进程组，没有留下残留进程。

## 会话恢复与进程收容是两个问题

宿主重启后，会话层能够把已经记录但没有持久化结果的调用恢复为 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`，并阻止代理盲目重试。这一行为是正确的，应当保留。

但持久日志没有可安全用于启动时清理的进程身份；即使会话恢复正确，原工具树仍可能继续产生外部副作用。PID/PGID 单独持久化也不安全，因为存在身份复用风险。

## 影响

- 本地 Web/headless/ACP 进程若由只管理 service PID 或 service PGID 的 supervisor 托管，仍可能遗留工具树。
- 用户看到服务已经停止或端口关闭时，命令仍可能继续写文件、调用网络或修改外部系统。
- 日志中的 unknown outcome 只能表达结果不确定，不能替代操作系统层的进程终止。

## 建议方向

1. 文档明确区分 service supervisor 与 whole-tree owner：容器/cgroup 是当前 POSIX 部署的可验证缓解方式。
2. 为普通本地工具增加宿主崩溃后仍存活的 per-command native owner；控制通道 EOF 时终止并等待 owner、目标命令和全部 descendant。
3. POSIX 使用独立、可验证的进程组 owner；Windows 使用 kill-on-close Job Object。Windows 方向与 [#1527](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1527) 相关。
4. 回归测试必须同时验证：宿主不可捕获终止、工具 root/descendant 清理、会话 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 修复，以及无盲目重试。

## 边界

这不是 Windows 实机验证，也不声称容器收容等于产品自身完成清理。Windows Job Object、原生包发布、terminal/node-pty、collect/spill、abort 与正常 terminate-and-join 仍需要各平台实现和验收。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows 原生文件夹选择器把路径在"低字节为 0 的汉字"处截断（如"xx项目开发"变成"xx项目"）
discussions.body:
我很高兴发现了dsh的一个bug，天啊，我竟然也参与了一把

现象 文件夹名里含有 UTF-16LE 低字节为 0 的汉字（如"开"U+5F00、"万"U+4E07、"不"U+4E0D、"中"U+4E2D、"主"U+4E3B）时，选择该文件夹后返回的路径会在这个字处被截断，导致新建工作区报错 ENOENT。这个问题在中文环境下非常容易遇到——很多常用汉字都会触发。

环境

DSH 0.1.0-rc.7
Windows Server 2022 (10.0.20348)
Node v24.14.1
Web 界面（Windows 原生"Select Workspace Directory"对话框）
复现步骤

新建文件夹 E:\xx项目开发（含"开"U+5F00）。
Web 界面左侧点"新建工作区"，弹出 Windows 原生文件夹选择对话框。
鼠标选中 E:\xx项目开发，点"选择文件夹"。
报错：workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "E:\xx项目": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'E:\xx项目'
末尾"开发"两个字被剥掉。对照组：xx办公区（办/公/区低字节均非 0）和 xx测试测试 都能正常创建。对话框里显示的是完整文件夹名，截断发生在从 COM 读回路径时。

根因 在 @deepseek-ai/dsh-host-directory-picker-native 的 lib/worker.cjs 中，readUtf16 函数（源文件应为 packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts）：


function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
    const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
    let end = 0;
    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2; // BUG: 只检查低字节
    return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
}
它按 2 字节步进查找字符串结尾时，只判断每个 UTF-16 单元的低字节是否为 0。"开"（U+5F00）的 UTF-16LE 编码是 00 5F——低字节恰为 0，被误判为字符串结束，其后的"发"等字符被静默丢弃。

修复


while (end + 1 < bytes.length && (bytes[end] !== 0 || bytes[end + 1] !== 0)) end += 2;
验证 本地打补丁后实测：worker 返回完整路径 E:\xx测试测试开发（11 个字符，含 U+5F00 U+53D1）；补丁前返回 E:\xx测试测试（9 个字符）。已通过独立启动同一个 worker 复测确认。

影响范围 所有文件夹名中含低字节为 0 的汉字的目录都会中招，例如"开/万/不/中/下/主/久/两/且"等——项目开发、开发中、万维网 这类常见目录名都会触发。

discussions.title: [Bug] CORDIS_SHARED 非法 JSON 会在 Loader 构造时打崩所有 dsh --profile 启动（.env 也能灌进来）
discussions.body:
在 rc.7（`99f6f02`）对过源码，Discussions / Issues 里搜 `CORDIS_SHARED`、`envData`、`JSON.parse(process.env` 都是空的。

怎么炸
---
`dsh --profile web`（以及所有走 `runProfile` 的 surface）会先跑 `loadLayeredEnv`，再 `ctx.plugin(Loader)`。Loader 构造函数里有一句：

```ts
// vendor/loader/src/index.ts:68-70
public envData = process.env.CORDIS_SHARED
  ? JSON.parse(process.env.CORDIS_SHARED)
  : { startTime: Date.now() }
```

变量是真值就会 `JSON.parse`，没有 try/catch。空字符串没事（假值走默认），空格、`not-json`、`{` 这种都会在 host 准备阶段直接 `SyntaxError`，插件树还没挂上。

为什么 .env 也能打进来
---
`loadLayeredEnv`（`packages/boot/app-boot/src/index.ts`）会把调用目录和 `$DSH_HOME` 的 `.env` 写进 `process.env`。bootstrap 黑名单只有 `PATH` / `NODE_OPTIONS` / `DSH_*` 这类，**没有** `CORDIS_SHARED`。所以项目 `.env` 里随手写一行 `CORDIS_SHARED=debug`，下一次 `dsh web` 就起不来。

浏览器侧其实已经躲过了：`apps/web/vite.config.ts` 把 `process.env.CORDIS_SHARED` 钉成 `undefined`，注释写明是为了让 envData 走默认分支。Node 启动路径没有同等保护。

最小复现
---
· 在仓库根或 `~/.dsh` 放 `.env`，内容一行：`CORDIS_SHARED=not-json`
· `pnpm dsh web`（或任意 `dsh --profile …`）
· 预期：忽略或告警
· 实际：`dsh: host preparation failed: Unexpected token …`，进程退出

`JSON.parse('null')` 能过，但 `envData` 会变成 `null`，后面要是读 `startTime` 会再炸一次；这次只把「非法 JSON 直接打崩启动」记下来。

discussions.title: Bug: streamed tool calls assembled with empty name/callId when continuation deltas carry explicit id:""/name:null (dsh-llm-deepseek, rc.6 & rc.7)
discussions.body:
**Versions:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6 and 0.1.0-rc.7 (both reproduce) · headless profile · `DSH_TOOLS_MODE=native` · model `deepseek-v4-flash` served through an OpenAI-compatible gateway (`DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL` override).

## Symptom

Every streamed tool call is assembled with an empty `name` and `callId`, so it fails tool-policy checks (`tool "" is disabled …`). The model retries a few steps, gives up, and the turn ends *cleanly* (`finish=stop`) with no output and nothing on stderr — from the harness's perspective nothing failed, which makes this very hard to notice in headless/CI use.

The same setup with `deepseek-v4-pro` works fine, which hid the bug for a while.

## Root cause

`dsh-llm-deepseek`'s `translate()` (lib/index.js ~L321 in the published package):

```js
if (call.id !== void 0) block.callId = call.id;
if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;
```

The guards only exclude `undefined`. Per the OpenAI streaming convention, `tool_calls[].id` and `function.name` are sent **once** in the first delta and continuation deltas omit them — but some backends/gateways serialize continuations with explicit `id: ""` and `function: {name: null}` instead of omitting the fields. Those explicit empty values pass the `!== undefined` guards and **clobber the values captured from the first delta**. `closeBlock()` then emits the block with `name: block.name ?? ""` → `""`, and `BlockAssembler`'s "first close wins" rule locks the empty block in.

Observed on the wire (session JSONL): first `tool-call-delta` has `id:"call_…", name:"read"`; every continuation has `id:"", name:null`; the assembled `tool/call` event has `name:""`, `callId:""`.

## Fix (verified)

Tighten both guards from "defined" to "non-empty":

```js
if (call.id) block.callId = call.id;
if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name;
```

With this two-line change, tool calls assemble correctly (`name:"read"`, real callId) and the repro passes on both rc.6 and rc.7. An empty-string id/name carries no information, so ignoring falsy values can't lose anything a conformant stream would send.

## Minimal repro

```bash
DSH_HOME=$(mktemp -d) DSH_TOOLS_MODE=native \
DEEPSEEK_BASE_URL=<openai-compatible gateway> DEEPSEEK_API_KEY=… \
dsh --profile headless "Use the read tool to read ./target.txt and reply with its first line."
```

against any backend that emits explicit `id:""`/`name:null` in tool-call continuation deltas (100% reproducible for us with `deepseek-v4-flash` behind vLLM-style gateways; `deepseek-v4-pro` omits the fields and is unaffected).

A related hardening suggestion: when a tool call does end up with an empty name, surfacing an explicit stream/protocol error would make this class of failure loud instead of a silent empty turn.

Happy to provide full session JSONL excerpts if useful. (Filed as a discussion since Issues are disabled on this repo.)

discussions.title: [CLI] headless / TUI can't use agent presets (persona) — mount() is coupled to the web frontend
discussions.body:
## Summary

The non-web surfaces (headless profile, and community TUI plugins that compose over dsh-base) cannot use agent presets — an agent always comes up as the default "coding agent" persona, even when dsh-agent-presets is mounted and settings.yaml sets agent-presets.default.

This blocks a Codex/Claude-Code-style CLI experience: tools load, but the persona (the agent's identity / system-prompt) does not.

## Environment

- dsh 0.1.0-rc.6 (all @deepseek-ai/dsh-* packages at 0.1.0-rc.6)
- Reproduced with both the built-in headless profile and the community @dsh-tui/dsh-tui (0.1.2), each patched to insert @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets with config.default set.

## Repro

1. Create a headless (or TUI) profile that inserts @deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-presets (with a valid config.default) plus an MCP client.
2. Run one task: dsh --profile <name> "who are you"

Observed: the reply is the deployment's default "coding agent" persona. The preset's persona (defined in an agent.cordis.yml under .agent-presets) is never applied.

## Root cause (from reading the source)

- Per dsh-agent-presets README, ctx.agentPresets.mount(agentCtx, id) is the one supported call site, meant to run in the agent factory's setup(agentCtx) hook.
- Grepping every .js under @deepseek-ai/dsh-* finds no call to agentPresets.mount() / recompose() outside the agent-presets package itself — i.e. no core-layer component performs the mount.
- The mount only happens through the web conversation frontend (dsh-client-ui-conversation), which is why the web UI gets personas but headless and dsh-tui do not. dsh-headless run() calls agents.create(...) with a setup hook that only installs the model selection — it never mounts a preset.

So persona support is coupled to the web frontend instead of living in the core agent-composition path.

## Expected

Agent-preset mounting should be a core-layer concern, so any surface (web / headless / TUI / third-party frontends) gets the same persona behavior. Concretely:

1. Move the preset mount into the core agent factory (or provide a core hook), so headless and TUI can compose an agent from a preset; and/or
2. Add a launcher flag (e.g. --preset <id>) so: dsh --profile headless --preset stock "task" works.

## Related (minor, community TUI)

The community @dsh-tui/dsh-tui also does not integrate dsh-workspace, so sessions it creates show up in the web UI under "ungrouped" rather than under their workspace. This is a separate gap, but it compounds the "CLI is not first-class" impression. Mentioning it here for context; it can be tracked separately.

## Suggestion

A core-layer agentPresets mount + a --preset flag would unblock the whole CLI ecosystem (headless, dsh-tui, and future terminal clients) without each frontend re-implementing preset composition.

discussions.title: Safe pattern for wrapping CLI coding agents (agy / Codex / Claude Code) as pure-LLM providers in DSH — anti-autonomy flags & fallback routing
discussions.body:
We run DSH 24/7 on a small VPS and wrap several CLIs as LLM providers via custom cordis plugins. Sharing what we learned and asking for the blessed pattern.

**Context.** When a CLI coding agent (`agy`, `codex`, `claude`) is spawned headlessly as a provider, its *internal* agent loop can start doing its own tool calls behind the harness's back — we observed `agy` auto-approving its own `ViewFile`/edit steps because our first adapter passed `--dangerously-skip-permissions`. That surfaced as empty assistant turns (the CLI burned thousands of tokens internally and returned nothing).

**What we verified locally (agy 1.1.14):**
- `--mode plan` + `--sandbox` + `--disable-slash-commands` = pure-LLM posture (no edit/apply tools, no slash expansion). Text answers work normally.
- `--dangerously-skip-permissions` = full autonomy — never for a provider adapter.
- `--json-schema` gives structured final results; `--input-format stream-json` allows multi-turn NDJSON.
- Codex: `codex exec --sandbox read-only --json`. Claude Code: `-p --permission-mode dontAsk --disallowedTools "*" --output-format stream-json`.

**Our adapter hardening (open to review):** process-group kill (SIGTERM→SIGKILL), stderr ring drain, TTFT/idle/wall timers, `exit`-vs-`close` handling incl. grandchildren holding pipes, error taxonomy mapped to `RATE_LIMIT`(+providerRetryAfterMs)/`AUTH`/`INVALID_REQUEST`/`TIMEOUT`/`SERVER`, never fabricating content on empty results, and a fake-CLI test harness (17 integration scenarios + unit tests, all hermetic).

**Questions for maintainers/community:**
1. Is there a blessed hook for **cross-provider fallback** in dsh-llm? We found `providerRetryPolicy` (same-provider retry) but no route chain — is the intended pattern a custom plugin on `agent/request-error`, or something like LiteLLM-style fallbacks on the roadmap?
2. Does `dsh-fs-sandbox` compose with CLI-provider adapters (i.e., constrain what a CLI child can touch beyond its own flags), or is bubblewrap the expected OS layer?
3. Any plans for a first-party "CLI agent adapter" package in the harness (shared spawn/parse/safety layer)?

Happy to share our adapter + test suite as a plugin if useful. Thanks for the great harness!

discussions.title: `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` should not be the global AGENTS.md
discussions.body:
Right now, the official `agent-instructions` plugin uses `~/.dsh/AGENTS.md` as the global instructions file. This makes it impossible to create a project-specific AGENTS.md for `~/.dsh`.

In contrast, the pi coding agent uses the following rule:
- `~/.pi/AGENTS.md` is the project-specific AGENTS.md for Pi's configuration
- `~/.pi/agent/AGENTS.md` is the global AGENTS.md

Something similar should work better for dsh.

discussions.title: 我给 DSH 写了个 macOS 桌宠，皮肤可以用你自己宠物的照片生成
discussions.body:
看 dsh 这么火热，我也给 DeepSeek Harness 写了个 macOS 桌宠插件，浮在所有窗口之上，跟着 agent 在干活、等你确认、跑完、报错之间换表情。

先放最好玩的那个功能：皮肤可以用你自己宠物的照片生成。下面这只是我拿我家肥猫的一张照片 DIY 出来的。

![一张猫的照片变成六个状态](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet/main/docs/media/diy-skin.png)

## 它和页面里的挂件不一样

它是一个真的 AppKit 窗口，不是塞进 DSH 页面里的 div，所以盖在你正在用的任何东西上面，全屏 Space 也盖得住。DSH 页面本身不会被塞任何东西。

![浮在全屏之上](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet/main/docs/media/floats-above.png)

## 功能

1、六个状态自动跟着本地 DSH 走：空闲、干活、等你确认、报错、刚跑完、打盹。

2、打盹要两个时钟同时安静：agent 没事干，并且你的鼠标也不动了。agent 闲着，和桌前没人，不是一回事。

3、点一下展开会话清单：有哪些 DSH 会话、哪个还活着、各自在干什么。

4、右键是原生菜单：免打扰、会话清单、皮肤子菜单、菜单栏和 Dock 的显隐、检查更新、退出。

5、自定义皮肤。把一张图丢给你的 agent，插件里带的 skill 负责把它扩写成一套皮肤要的十八个姿势，六个状态各三帧。生图是你自己的工具在跑、烧你自己的额度，我这边不往任何地方发东西。做好的皮肤落在 `~/.dsh-desk-pet/skins/`，在安装包外面，升级插件不会删掉它。

6、五套内置皮肤，每套六个状态各三帧。

7、拖到哪停在哪，重启还在原地。

8、后台进程启动、脱离终端，启动它的那个窗口可以直接关掉。

9、零依赖，跑系统自带的 `/usr/bin/python3`，靠标准库 ctypes 直接调 AppKit，连 ffmpeg 都不用，解码抠图缩放全是标准库写的。

10、跟着 `dsh web` 自动起停。

## 安装

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add deepseek-desk-pet
dsh web
```

装过旧版的要带 `@latest` 才升得动。这个我自己踩过：不带的话写进去的是 `^0.x` 范围，而 caret 作用在 `0.x` 上会锁住次版本号，`^0.1.0` 永远不接受 `0.2.0`，裸命令给你报一句 Already up to date、旧版本原地不动。

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add deepseek-desk-pet@latest
```

## 两个要先说清楚的

**只支持 macOS。** 渲染层是 ctypes 直调 AppKit，Windows 和 Linux 我没有机器测，短期也不打算做。免得有人装了发现起不来。

**做一套皮肤要烧十八张图的额度。** skill 中途会停两次让你确认，第一次在基准姿势之后，第二次在第二帧之后。停这两次不是我谨慎，是文生图跨次调用锁不住身份，你的工具要是不支持拿上一次的结果当参考图，十八张会是十八个不同的角色，而且每一张单独看都挑不出毛病。

顺便一个踩坑分享：素材底色一定要用画面里绝不出现的颜色。我第一批生在粉彩底上，水母那套是薄荷绿，和角色自己的颜色太近，抠图阈值怎么调都会误伤，那批水母的眼睛就是这么被抠没的。而且当时 87 个测试全绿，因为没有一个测试在看像素。后来全换成品红 `#FF00FF`。

开源在 https://github.com/anneheartrecord/dsh-desk-pet ，MIT，欢迎提 issue。

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-todo-guard | 重启后照常显示的可靠 todo 面板 + 完成证据校验
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project**: independently developed and maintained by a community member, not an official DeepSeek product.

**dsh-todo-guard** — a reliable todo panel for DeepSeek Harness web that **survives restarts** and **verifies completion**.

- The official todo strip only re-renders after a write, so after a dsh restart the list is missing until the next task update. dsh-todo-guard pre-warms the projection on session start and shadows the official dock (priority -1), so the list is there the moment you reopen the session.
- Three-state completion check on todo_write: evidence path exists → verified; evidence path missing → blocked with a clear error; no evidence → allowed with a yellow unverified badge.
- Evidence syntax: （证据：路径） — relative to the session working directory or absolute, multiple allowed.
- Settings toggle (Settings → todo 校验): on = full verification; off = official behavior with the display fix only.
- The panel auto-hides once every item is completed.

Install:

```shell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:a903067276-rgb/dsh-todo-guard#main"
```

Repo: https://github.com/a903067276-rgb/dsh-todo-guard — install guide in docs/install.md. Zero model calls, pure local logic.
