Entry points: activity-bar icon (sidebar launcher), status-bar button, or Command Palette. - **Embedded Web UI in an editor tab** — the full DSH frontend (conversations, workspaces, settings, plugins, Goals, Workflows) renders as a regular editor tab, side by side with your files — it never overlaps the explorer tree. - **Works with the browser instance** — uses your `~/.dsh` by default, so sessions and settings are shared with the browser UI. - **Current folder as workspace** — the DSH default project directory is the folder you have open. - **Workspace alignment** — the DSH workspace anchor follows your IDE workspace: switching folders closes stale panels and starts cold, reloading the same workspace auto-restarts the server and restores the panel, and the embedded UI always shows the *current* folder (not the most recently active one). - **Session manager** — the sidebar lists all active sessions with title and relative activity time, with inline rename and archive; an expandable *Archived* section keeps old sessions tidy; `＋New session` opens a stacked panel bound to a fresh session, and multiple panels each hold their own conversation. - **Auto-start from the icon** — clicking the activity-bar icon starts dsh for you when it is not running. - **dsh version check + easy upgrade** — the launcher shows "Update available: x.y.z →" when a newer dsh exists; one click offers the right upgrade command for your install method (npx / npm global / nvm) prefilled into a terminal (24h check gate, offline-safe). - **Clipboard works** — copy/paste in the embedded UI goes through a transport bridge (VS Code webviews block clipboard inside iframes; the bridge routes it via `vscode.env.clipboard`). - **Theme follows VS Code** — the embedded UI follows your editor color theme (dark/light), live on switch (`deepseekHarness.themeSync`, default `follow`). - **Cross-platform** — macOS, Linux and Windows, verified end-to-end by CI (unit tests + a real `dsh` spawn smoke test on all three). - **Multilingual UI** — the extension chrome (launcher, overlay, status bar, commands) follows your VS Code language across 9 locales: English, 中文, 日本語, 한국어, Русский, Español, Português, Français, Deutsch. - **Security first** — the server binds loopback only; the extension relays requests as plain Node requests, never weakening DSH's `/api` trust fence. (Note: the embedded page and its plugins are trusted — clipboard read/write is bridged to the system clipboard without a browser permission prompt, the same trust you grant the extension itself.) ## Requirements - [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) installed: `npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` - VS Code ≥ 1.90 (the extension also works in Antigravity via Open VSX) ## Install - **VS Code**: [Visual Studio Marketplace](https://marketplace.visualstudio.com/) → search *DeepSeek Harness Web for VS Code* - **Antigravity / Open VSX**: [Open VSX](https://open-vsx.org/) → same name ## Usage 1. The DSH UI opens in an **editor tab** once the server is ready (`dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:`). 3. When the server is ready, the launcher offers **Stop DeepSeek Harness** and **Open View** (full-width buttons); click **Update available: x.y.z →** to upgrade dsh. To make DSH use your project as its default workspace, open that folder in the window first (the launcher footer shows the active workspace). Guys, have a try and enjoy !

discussions.title: Bug: native directory picker truncates paths containing U+XX00 CJK chars (e.g. 开 U+5F00) — workspace create fails on Windows
discussions.body:
﻿## 一句话说明

Windows 下通过"选择工作区"系统对话框选择含特定中文字符（低字节为 0x00，如 `开` U+5F00）的路径时，路径被截断，导致工作区创建失败（ENOENT）。

## 复现步骤

1. Windows 上启动 dsh web（`directory-picker-auto` 在 win32 + loopback 下解析为 `native` 系统目录选择器）
2. 新建会话 → 选择工作区 → 导航到含 `开`（U+5F00）的目录，如 `D:\projects\DSH\DSH代码学习\04-插件开发`
3. 确认选择

## 实际结果

```
workspace create failed: workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "D:\projects\DSH\DSH代码学习\04-插件": ENOENT: no such file or directory
```

路径被截断：`04-插件开发` → `04-插件`（`开` 及之后全部丢失）。

## 预期结果

完整路径 `D:\projects\DSH\DSH代码学习\04-插件开发` 被接受，工作区正常创建。

## 环境

- Windows
- DSH 0.1.0-rc.5（源码运行）
- `packages/host/directory-picker-native`（native picker）

## 根因（已定位到具体代码）

`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` 的 `readUtf16`（第 37-42 行）：

```ts
function readUtf16(koffi: Koffi, address: unknown): string {
  const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768))
  let end = 0
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2   // ← 只检查 UTF-16 单元的低字节
  return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
}
```

`bytes[end] !== 0` 只检查每个 2 字节 UTF-16 单元的**低字节**。UTF-16LE 中，任何**低字节为 0** 的 BMP 字符都会让循环提前终止：

- `开` = U+5F00 → LE 字节 `00 5f` → 低字节 `0x00` → 循环在此终止，截断其后的所有字符
- 对照组：`01-学习笔记` 中 学(U+5B66)/习(U+4E60)/笔/记 低字节均非零 → 正常

## 最小复现（纯 JS，无需 Windows COM 环境）

```js
function readUtf16Buggy(bytes) {
  let end = 0
  while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
  return bytes.toString('utf16le', 0, end)
}
const p = 'D:\\projects\\DSH\\DSH代码学习\\04-插件开发'
const mem = Buffer.alloc(Buffer.byteLength(p, 'utf16le') + 2)
Buffer.from(p, 'utf16le').copy(mem)
console.log(readUtf16Buggy(mem))
// 输出: "D:\projects\DSH\DSH代码学习\04-插件"  ← 丢了"开发"
```

## 建议修复

检查完整的 UTF-16 单元（2 字节）是否为 `0x0000`：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2
```

## 影响面

任何路径中含**低字节为 0 的 CJK 字符**（`开` U+5F00、`一` U+4E00、`汉` U+6C49、`主` U+4E3B、`文` U+6587 等）的 Windows 用户，在通过 native 目录选择器选择工作区时都会遇到此问题。`01-学习笔记`/`02-实验与练习` 这类路径不受影响，所以该 bug 容易被掩盖。

discussions.title: Third-party plugin can silently disable core providers (fs-sandbox/bash/pwsh) via cordis.patch.yml
discussions.body:
## Summary

Installing the third-party plugin `@struktoai/mirage-dsh` via `dsh plugin --profile web add @struktoai/mirage-dsh` **silently disables the core filesystem, shell, and PowerShell providers** — even when the user never intends to use mirage's virtual workspace. A casual "install a plugin" leaves the agent without working file tools, bash, or PowerShell until the user manually removes the plugin.

**Risk level: High** — any third-party bundle can patch `cordis.patch.yml` rows to `disabled: true` on core components, and nothing warns the user at install time.

## Environment

- dsh version: `0.1.0-rc.7`
- Platform: Windows 11
- Plugin: `@struktoai/mirage-dsh` (installed via `dsh plugin add`)

## What happened

After installing mirage and restarting `dsh web`, the composed config (`dsh --profile web --dump-config`) shows these core rows disabled:

```yaml
- id: fs-sandbox
  disabled: true        # real filesystem sandbox OFF

- id: bash-sandbox
  disabled: true        # bash OFF

- id: pwsh-sandbox
  disabled: true        # PowerShell OFF

- id: tool-pwsh
  disabled: true        # PowerShell tool OFF

- id: tool-fs-search
  disabled: true        # file search OFF
```

Replaced by mirage virtual providers (`mirage-fs`, `mirage-shell`) with a single `ram` mount at `/tmp`. The user's file tools, bash, and PowerShell now operate on a virtual workspace instead of the host disk — or simply stop working if mirage's service fails to start.

This comes from mirage's own `cordis.patch.yml` (bundled with the package), which disables the host providers and inserts its own. **The user never opts in** — `dsh plugin add` mounts the bundle's patch layer automatically.

## Impact

- An agent in a normal desktop workflow loses file read/write, bash, and PowerShell — the three most-used capabilities
- On Windows, `pwsh` is the primary shell; disabling it breaks most tool usage
- If the user doesn't inspect `--dump-config`, the failure is confusing: tools "exist" in the catalog but don't work
- Third-party bundles have no sandbox/guard against disabling core providers

## Expected behavior

1. `dsh plugin add` should **warn** (or refuse) when a bundle's patch disables core provider rows (`fs-sandbox`, `bash-sandbox`, `pwsh-sandbox`, `tool-pwsh`, `tool-fs-search`)
2. Or: plugin bundles should only be able to *extend* the tree, not disable rows owned by `dsh-base` (allowlist the base rows)
3. At minimum, document this risk in the plugin installation flow

## Repro

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @struktoai/mirage-dsh
# restart dsh web
dsh --profile web --dump-config | grep -A2 "fs-sandbox\|pwsh-sandbox\|tool-pwsh"
# -> disabled: true
```

## Notes

This was found during a plugin audit on a real Windows install. Happy to provide more detail or test a fix.

discussions.title: pi2dsh：给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Pi 生态；Codex 订阅生图/改图已跑通
discussions.body:
# pi2dsh：给 DeepSeek Harness 接上 Pi 生态；Codex 订阅生图/改图已跑通

分享一下 [pi2dsh](https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh)：它不是把某一个 Pi 插件重写成 DSH 插件，而是在 DeepSeek Harness 上实现一层 Pi Host ABI。引擎安装一次，之后直接安装 Pi 社区发布的原包。

这次跑通的是一个很直观的例子：把 [`@crazygit/pi-codex-image-gen`](https://github.com/crazygit/pi-codex-image-gen) 原包装进 DSH，使用 ChatGPT Plus/Pro 的 Codex OAuth 登录态直接调用 `gpt-image-2` 生图和改图，不需要再买图片 API Key。

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add pi2dsh
dsh plugin --profile web add @crazygit/pi-codex-image-gen
```

重启 DSH，然后在对话框运行：

```text
/login openai-codex
```

完成浏览器授权后，OpenAI (ChatGPT Plus/Pro) 会出现在 DSH 原生模型选择器里。选择 Codex 模型后直接说“生成一张……”，Agent 会调用 `codex_generate_image`。

完整链路是：

```text
DSH /login
  → Pi 的 openai-codex OAuth 流程
  → DSH credentials + 原生模型路由
  → Codex 模型调用 Pi 图片工具
  → gpt-image-2 返回 PNG
  → DSH 原生附件落库
  → Web 工具卡直接显示图片
```

改本地图片时，插件原有的 `ctx.ui.confirm` 会变成 DSH 的确认框，明确列出即将上传的文件；用户确认后才会把参考图发给 Codex。

## 不是只为这一个插件写的转换器

同一兼容层目前已经在真实 DSH CLI/Web 链路跑通过这些能力：

- `@kassing/pi-vision`：给纯文本 DeepSeek 增加图片分析伴生路由，Web 直接贴图；
- `pi-btw`：侧边问题进入真实 DSH 子会话，不污染主对话，需要时再合并；
- Pi provider/OAuth：登录后进入 DSH 原生模型选择器和模型调用链；
- Pi tools、commands、skills、生命周期事件、会话控制、子代理和图片附件。

Pi 插件的功能代码保持原样；pi2dsh 负责把公共宿主能力映射到 DSH。浏览器展示需要宿主 UI 的地方，则由 pi2dsh 在插件挂载时注册对应的 DSH client surface。

## 可复现材料

- 项目：<https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh>
- Codex 生图/改图完整步骤：<https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/codex-image-gen>
- OAuth 订阅登录：<https://github.com/weijiafu14/pi2dsh/tree/main/examples/subscription-login>
- npm：<https://www.npmjs.com/package/pi2dsh>

如果你手里有一个 Pi 插件，希望它直接跑在 DeepSeek Harness 上，可以把包名或实际报错贴过来。能映射到 DSH 标准能力的缺口，我们会按通用 ABI 补，不要求插件作者维护一个 DSH fork。

欢迎试用和 Star ⭐

discussions.title: Windows 11 real-world feedback: BOM/encoding, .ps1 wrappers, docs, official skills
discussions.body:
## Summary

Feedback from a real Windows 11 user after weeks of daily use: **Windows is clearly an untested / second-class platform** for dsh. Several concrete friction points below — most are small, but they add up and will bite every Windows user. No one on the team seems to have hit them, so I'm reporting them systematically.

## Environment

- dsh version: `0.1.0-rc.7`
- OS: Windows 11 (PowerShell 5.1 + pwsh)
- Installed via Hermes launcher (Node bundled)

## Issues found (concrete, reproducible)

### 1. `.ps1` files without UTF-8 BOM break under PowerShell 5.1

PowerShell 5.1 reads a BOM-less UTF-8 `.ps1` as ANSI (codepage 936 on Chinese systems). Any script containing Chinese text (which is the majority of user-facing content here) becomes mojibake → `ParserError`. Every `.ps1` shipped or generated must carry a UTF-8 BOM, or 5.1 fails to parse it.

- Repro: write a `.ps1` with Chinese strings, no BOM → `powershell -File script.ps1` → `ParserError: Unexpected token`
- Impact: any user on Windows PowerShell 5.1 (the default on Windows 10/11) hits this immediately

### 2. `pnpm.ps1` / `npm.ps1` / `gh.ps1` wrappers blocked by ExecutionPolicy

The Node bin wrappers (`.ps1`) fail with `running scripts is disabled on this system`. The `.cmd` variants work fine. Any docs/scripts that invoke `pnpm`/`npm`/`gh` as bare commands on Windows hit this — the fix is to always use the `.cmd` variant or call `node` directly.

### 3. No Windows-specific notes anywhere in README/docs

README, architecture docs, and the official skills assume POSIX shells (`curl | wc -c`, `grep`, `command -v`). On Windows these silently fail or behave differently. A single "Windows notes" section (use `cmd` variants, PowerShell 5.1 vs 7, BOM requirement) would save every Windows user hours.

### 4. Official skills assume the deepseek-harness repo

8 of the 11 skills under `.agents/skills/` are written for contributors ("in the deepseek-harness repo", `pnpm run change-scope`, etc.). For end users installing dsh, these are noise in the skill catalog. Consider separating contributor skills from user-facing skills, or tagging them clearly.

## Expected

1. Ship `.ps1` files with UTF-8 BOM, or document "use PowerShell 7" as a hard requirement
2. Document the `.cmd` wrapper requirement on Windows
3. Add a Windows section to the README
4. Consider splitting contributor-only skills from user skills

## Notes

Happy to provide more details or test fixes. Windows is a first-class install target (`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` works), so the platform deserves first-class docs.

discussions.title: Code Mode 下 skill 调用成功，但技能正文不进入下一轮模型上下文（UI 有、模型无）
discussions.body:
# Code Mode 下 `skill` 调用成功，但技能正文不进入下一轮模型上下文

Related: #1755（那是顶层直接调 `skill` 被 `unknown tool "skill"` 拒绝；本讨论是 **嵌套 `tools.skill(...)` 已经成功之后**，正文仍然进不了模型。）

## 现象

Web / PTC（`tools.mode: code`）里，模型按 SDK 在 `run_code` 程序内加载技能：

```ts
await tools.skill({ name: "domain-modeling" })
```

随后出现分裂视野：

| 观察者 | 看到什么 |
| --- | --- |
| Web 轨迹里的 `Skill · <name>` 行（`ui-skill` / Inspect） | 完整 durable 结果，含 `<skill_instructions>` 正文 |
| 下一轮模型 | 外层 `run_code` 输出为空（`run_code completed with no output`），Think 里写 “The skill content wasn't returned in the output”，然后去读 `SKILL.md` 或重调 |

用户看到技能「已经加载」，模型却按「加载失败」继续。这不是 SkillRow 画错了：它按设计渲染的是 `tool/code-dispatch` 日志，不是下一轮会发给模型的 payload。

## 复现

1. Web 默认 code preset（或会话切到 PTC）。
2. 让模型加载任意 catalog 技能（`code-review` / `domain-modeling` / `diagnosing-bugs` 均可）。
3. 模型写出只调用、不 `console.log` / `return` 的程序（这是 Native 语义下的自然写法）。
4. 展开 Skill 行：正文在。「说明」卡来自 nested dispatch 的 `output.render`（`renderSkillContent`）。
5. 看下一轮模型输入 / Think：外层 `run_code` 没有把 `content` 带回来。

对照实验（同一会话）：

- `await tools.skill({ name })` 且不打印 → 模型侧空输出；UI 仍有完整卡。
- 把返回值打印出来 → 程序拿到 `{ name, provider, resourceBase, content }`，`content` 是完整说明书。工具本身是好的。

## 机制

这是两条各自成立的合同撞车，不是 `skill` execute 失败。

1. **Code Mode 的核心合同**（[Code Mode Agent Note](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-06-15-code-mode.md)，SDK 固定句）：嵌套工具结果只回给程序；只有 `console.log` / `return` 进入下一轮。`tool/code-dispatch` 给 UI / 回放，不进模型历史。图片有「run 结束后贴给模型」的特例，技能没有。

2. **`dsh-tool-skill` 的合同**（`packages/skill/tool-skill` README）：不另注 synthetic context，因为「freshly loaded result is already recorded as the tool result and becomes available to the next model step」。这只对 Native 成立。Code Mode 下 nested result 的 canonical JSON 只到 worker binding，durable `content` 只到 dispatch 日志。

3. **Catalog 文案仍按 Native 说话**：`Load all applicable skills, then follow their full instructions.` 没说必须把 `content` 从程序里带出来。#1755 若只改成「请在 `run_code` 里调 `tools.skill`」，会把模型从 UNKNOWN_TOOL 推进到本问题。

4. **用户显式 `/name` 已经走注入路径**（`skill-invocation` instructions context）。模型调用路径没有对等物。Code Mode 会把 nested `additionalContexts` `deferContext()` 到外层 `run_code` 之后（`packages/core/tools/src/code-mode.ts`），但 `skill` 现在不挂 context。

5. **SkillRow Agent Note**（`2026-08-06-web-skill-tool-row.md`）写「preserving exactly what reached the model」。Native 真，Code Mode 假：卡上是 dispatch 日志，模型看到的是外层 curated output。

## 这为什么值得改合同，而不是再写一句 prompt

`skill` 不是 bash/read 那种「程序消化的中间数据」。它的产品语义是 **把说明书装进模型上下文再执行**。Code Mode 把中间结果藏起来，对 grep 结果是优化，对 skill 是功能缺失。

模型会反复踩这个坑：SDK 说 extract just what you need，catalog 说 load then follow。Native 写法是 fire-and-forget load。Web 默认又是 code mode，所以这是默认用户路径，不是边角。

Prompt-only（catalog/SDK 加粗「必须 print `content`」）治不好：模型仍会忘；即使用 `return` 把整份说明书塞进外层 result，也会和「curate / 省 token」对着干，还可能顶到 `run_code` output cap。

## 请核心决定的问题

**`skill` 在 Code Mode 里是「装进对话的说明书」，还是「给程序的数据 fetch」？**

若是前者（与 Native、与 `/name` 注入、与 catalog「follow their full instructions」一致），模型调用成功后正文应自动出现在外层 `run_code` 之后，不依赖模型记得 extract。

方向（供讨论，不是补丁）：

- **A（更贴产品）**：`skill` 成功时带上渲染后的 `<skill_content>`，作为 `additionalContexts` / instructions 注入；Code Mode 已有 parent `deferContext`，会跟在外层 result 后面。与用户 `/name` 路径对齐，避免和程序 `return` 重复时要定义谁为准。
- **B**：做成图片那种「run 结束后自动 attach」的特例。
- **C（仅 prompt）**：catalog + `skill` description 写明必须 extract。便宜，但不改变「加载 = 进上下文」的缺口。

不改 UI 也能解释现状，但用户会继续以为模型已经读过卡里那份正文。

## 不在本讨论范围

- 不改 SkillRow：它展示 durable dispatch 是对的。
- 不把所有 nested tool result 自动回灌给模型：那会取消 Code Mode。
- #1755 的顶层 UNKNOWN_TOOL 仍然要单独处理；即便目录改成 SDK 路线，本缺口还在。

discussions.title: Proposal: Make 'lessons learned' a harness-level mechanism (failure → auto-inject → behavior gate)
discussions.body:
## Proposal: Make "lessons learned" a harness-level mechanism, not an agent-behavior reminder

### The problem

Every LLM-based agent harness — including DSH — has the same core flaw: **the model is stateless (re-reasons from scratch every turn), so "lessons learned" only work if the agent happens to re-activate them in context at the exact moment it needs them.** Writing a rule in the persona, or a note in a memory file, only raises the *tendency* to follow it. It does not *ensure* it.

Concrete example from real daily use on this exact install (dsh 0.1.0-rc.7):

- PowerShell quoting breaks when passing args to `python -c` / `gh --jq` (quotes, multiline, f-strings)
- The fix is simple and known: **write the code to a script file first, then execute it**
- This was hit **6+ times** over several sessions — despite being written in:
  1. the experience/lessons file
  2. the persona as rule #9 ("tool execution iron rule")
  3. fail-logger

Each failure is "the first time" for the model, because the lesson is text that must be re-activated, not a behavior enforced by the runtime.

### Why this is a product gap, not an agent-behavior issue

This is not specific to me or to this model. **Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, OpenViking — every agent harness ships the same design:** memory = context text, application = agent self-discipline. No harness has a *runtime-enforced* mechanism that:

- captures a failure
- **automatically injects the lesson before the same kind of operation happens again** — regardless of what the agent "remembers"

The gap is architectural: today's harnesses optimize for *conversation memory* (recall past context) but not for *behavioral correction* (stop repeating errors). The latter is exactly what separates "an agent that gets better" from "an agent that re-encounters the same wall."

### Proposal (3 concrete mechanisms)

**1. Failure → auto-inject loop (runtime-level, not plugin-level)**
When any tool call fails, the harness records the failure (tool, error signature, context). Before the *next* call of the same tool signature, the harness injects the distilled lesson into context automatically — no agent self-recall required. (fail-logger exists as a third-party plugin doing half of this; it should be harness-core.)

**2. Cross-session lesson bootstrap**
At session start, automatically inject a compact "recent failure ledger" — what failed recently, the root cause, the known fix — as a system-level block, not a memory the agent must go fetch. Each session starts "carrying" the lessons instead of starting blank.

**3. Behavior gates for high-risk patterns**
For operation classes known to be error-prone (e.g. shell quoting, encoding-sensitive file writes, destructive git ops), let the harness detect the pattern *before execution* and surface the stored lesson / require confirmation. A "pre-flight check" that the agent cannot skip.

### Expected impact

- Reduces repeated-error rate dramatically — the single most common source of wasted agent time and user trust erosion
- Turns "self-improvement" from aspiration into runtime behavior
- Differentiates DSH: first harness where "lessons learned" is enforced by the platform, not hoped for from the model

### Notes

Happy to prototype or test any of these. This was written from a real multi-session Windows install where the same quoting lesson was recorded 6+ times before a persona rule was added — and even then, only "reminded", never "enforced".

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-codex-oauth — use your OpenAI Codex (ChatGPT) subscription in DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body:
Hi! I built a small community bundle that fills a documented gap: the shipped multi-provider adapter (`dsh-llm-pi-ai`) withholds `openai-codex` because Codex authenticates through ChatGPT OAuth, and that adapter holds no credential store and runs no login flow (it's listed under Known Limitations).

**dsh-codex-oauth** supplies exactly those pieces as an installable bundle — no fork, no core change:

- a `codex` provider route registered on `ctx.llm` (`LlmAdapter` from `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm`), serving the `gpt-5.x-codex` catalog models through `@earendil-works/pi-ai`'s `openai-codex` provider;
- a `/codex login` human command (browser flow with local callback, plus `/codex login device` for headless) and a `dsh-codex-oauth` CLI bin with `login` / `logout` / `status`;
- a file-backed pi-ai `CredentialStore` at `$DSH_HOME/codex-oauth.json` (0600, owner-only dir, atomic writes, cross-process writer lock), with pi-ai's automatic token refresh.

I verified it against the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7`: the bundle loads in a profile, the route registers, and a headless run dispatches through the seam to the adapter (ending at the expected `AUTH` error until you log in).

Install:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:birat-chapagain/dsh-codex-oauth
# then: /codex login  (or npx dsh-codex-oauth login --method device)
```

Repo: https://github.com/birat-chapagain/dsh-codex-oauth

If first-party Codex OAuth support is ever on the roadmap, I'd be happy to contribute these pieces (OAuth credential store + login-flow wiring) upstream — happy to hear what shape the maintainers would want that to take.

discussions.body: ## 环境 - 平台：Windows 11（win32），浏览器 Firefox - Node v24.15.0，pnpm 11.7.0（Corepack） - master 分支源码构建（0.1.0-rc.7，commit 99f6f02fec），pnpm run build 后以 pnpm dsh web 启动，访问 http://127.0.0.1:3080 - Agent preset：极简模式 ## 现象 在极简模式下与 DSH 对话时，只要模型调用 bash 工具就会失败：BashError: subprocess-local: terminal inspection is unsupported on platform win32。随后模型会转而尝试 str_replace_editor，偶尔也会因参数使用习惯或对目录使用 view_range 产生额外报错。 切换到「标准模式」或「PTC 模式」后问题消失。 ## 根因 极简模式无条件挂载了持久 bash 的 PTY 工具链： apps/cli/config/agent-presets/minimal/agent.cordis.yml - dsh-terminal - dsh-terminal-bash - dsh-tool-bash-persistent 调用链为： dsh-tool-bash-persistent → dsh-terminal-bash / dsh-terminal → dsh-subprocess-local.spawnTerminal() → createProcessInspector() 而 createProcessInspector 只支持 linux / darwin： packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/process-inspector.ts:371-373 if (platform === 'linux') return new LinuxProcessInspector(arch, internals) if (platform === 'darwin') return new MacProcessInspector(internals) throw new Error(`subprocess-local: terminal inspection is unsupported on platform ${platform}`) 因此 Windows 上每次调用持久 bash 都必然失败。 对比之下，标准模式和 PTC 模式都有平台守卫： apps/cli/config/agent-presets/standard/agent.cordis.yml:44-50 - id: tool-bash name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash' disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32' - id: tool-pwsh name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh' disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32' apps/cli/config/agent-presets/code/agent.cordis.yml:51-57 - id: tool-bash name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-bash' disabled: !!js process.platform === 'win32' - id: tool-pwsh name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-pwsh' disabled: !!js process.platform !== 'win32' 只有极简模式漏掉了这个守卫。 截图：

discussions.title: [Plugins] 一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent preset，用于让 **OpenAI / GPT 代理会话**适配 dsh
discussions.body:
# dsh-gpt-standard

一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 agent preset，用于让 **OpenAI / GPT 代理会话**适配 dsh 的
沙箱升级协议——让命令能继续执行，而不是卡死在反复出现的
`sandbox escalation ... is not strictly wider ...` 报错上。

这是社区项目，**并非** DeepSeek 官方 preset，也不代表 DeepSeek 的认可或背书。

## 解决的问题

把 GPT 系列模型代理进 DeepSeek Harness并授予会话满权限
（`/permission danger-full-access`）后，GPT 会持续给 `pwsh` / `bash` / `write` / `edit`
调用带上 `sandbox_permissions` / `justification` 参数——即使系统提示已说明不要设置。

dsh 的沙箱升级协议要求请求模式**严格更宽**于调用当前的生效模式
（`read-only` → `workspace-write` → `danger-full-access`）。在 `danger-full-access`
下已经没有任何更宽模式，因此**任何**携带 `sandbox_permissions` 的调用都会立即失败：

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "<mode>" is not strictly wider than this call's current "<mode>" mode
```

模型无法解读这条报错，于是它通过"切换权限档位重试同一条命令"来"修复"——形成
`danger-full-access` ↔ `workspace-write` 之间的无限重试循环（真实会话里连续报了
7 次相同错误后才被中止）。

由于工具 schema 是 registry-global 的，这些字段无法按会话对模型隐藏，最稳妥的
修复点在执行时。

## 本 preset 做了什么

`gpt-escalation-guard.mjs` 注册了一个 `tools/execute` waterfall 监听器（与官方
timeout policy 用的是同一个扩展点）。`auto` 模式下它复刻 dsh 的严格更宽升级表：
无法扩大会话当前权限的请求（同档、降档、未知目标、字段不配对、审批通道缺失）会
被剥离 `sandbox_permissions`/`justification`，让命令在会话当前权限下执行而不是报错；
而**真正更宽、且审批通道可用的升级会被放行**，走 dsh 正常的单次审批流——所以 GPT
写工作区外文件时仍可发起"单次操作权限"审批，用户批准后执行一次。

它还注册了 `gpt:harness-protocol` 系统提示段，教 GPT 场景化行为：常规调用绝不填
这两个字段；遇到真实的 `[sandbox: file access denied ...]` 且任务确实需要越界时，
**只此一次**重发并带 `sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access"` + 一句
`justification` 来发起单次用户审批；看到 `not strictly wider` 就丢掉字段重发一次；
同一条命令连续失败两次即停止换做法。

其余部分就是官方 `standard` preset，一字未改，所以完整编码 Agent 工具集都保留。

**配置**

| 选项 | 默认值 | 含义 |
|---|---|---|
| `strip` | `'auto'` | `true` 总是剥离；`false` 从不；`'auto'` 剥离一切非严格更宽的升级请求（同档、降档、未知目标、字段不配对、审批通道缺失），合法升级放行 |
| `sectionName` | `'gpt:harness-protocol'` | 系统提示段名 |
| `sectionOrder` | `5` | 紧跟 persona 之后渲染 |

## 安装

克隆本仓库后，把整个 `gpt-standard/` 目录复制到 dsh 的用户 preset 根目录下，id 为
`gpt-standard`。

PowerShell：

```powershell
$target = Join-Path $env:USERPROFILE '.dsh\.agent-presets\gpt-standard'
if (Test-Path -LiteralPath $target) { throw "Preset already exists: $target" }
Copy-Item -Recurse -LiteralPath '.\gpt-standard' -Destination $target
```

Linux/macOS：

```sh
dsh_home="${DSH_HOME:-$HOME/.dsh}"
mkdir -p "$dsh_home/.agent-presets"
test ! -e "$dsh_home/.agent-presets/gpt-standard"
cp -R gpt-standard "$dsh_home/.agent-presets/gpt-standard"
```

完全重启 DeepSeek Harness，新建空白会话，在模式选择器里选 **GPT 适配模式**。随后
既可以授予满权限（`/permission danger-full-access`），也可以保持 `workspace-write`——
守护插件两种情况都兜底。

> [!note] 多 home 部署
> 如果你的部署在第二个 `DSH_HOME`（例如 `D:\MirageData\.dsh` 的 web profile）下运行
> profile，请把 preset 也复制过去。部分部署会自动同步这两个根。

## 验证

```sh
npm test
```

测试用 mock host 上下文驱动 `gpt-escalation-guard`，断言 `tools/execute` 在
`true` / `false` / `auto` 各种配置下都会剥离升级参数（且系统提示段已注册）。

## 许可证与归属

MIT。本 preset 内嵌了来自
[deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的
DeepSeek Harness `standard` agent preset 的改编副本（MIT 许可，Copyright (c) 2026
DeepSeek）。见 [NOTICE](./NOTICE) 与 [LICENSE](./LICENSE)。DeepSeek 与 DeepSeek
Harness 均为其权利人所有。

discussions.title: DSH | @topolyte/windows-acl | 非阻塞 Windows ACL 沙箱授权，消除大工作区首次命令冻结
discussions.body: # DSH | @topolyte/windows-acl | 非阻塞 Windows ACL 沙箱授权，消除大工作区首次命令冻结 > 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。 > > 项目地址： > > `https://github.com/Ranecc/topolyte-windows-acl` > > 项目介绍： > > `@topolyte/windows-acl` 是 DeepSeek Harness 在 Windows 上的即插即用 `ctx.sandbox` provider，修复了官方 windows-acl 后端的一个结构性冻结：首次 `workspace-write` 授权会在 `confine()` 内**同步**物化 standing 写 ACE，而 `SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 的 eager 继承传播会在事件循环上整树遍历——大工作区下整个服务器（所有 session、HTTP、RPC）冻结数分钟。 > > 本插件把那次遍历移入 `grant-cli` 子进程（fire-and-forget，`spawn` 而非 `spawnSync`），保持 `confine()` 同步但 fail-closed（standing ACE 落地前工作区写被拒——只会报 access denied，绝不冻结）；另提供 `prewarm` 配置在启动时预热已知工作区。通过 Cordis bundle-patch 机制安装在**官方** harness 上，无需 fork。 > > 截图： > > > > > 与 DSH 的集成方式： > > `dsh plugin --profile add @topolyte/windows-acl` > > 插件 bundle patch 会禁用官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-local` 行，并在独立 id 下插入本 provider（cordis 单例服务，替换 `ctx.sandbox`）。 --- ## 背景：为什么做这个插件 官方 windows-acl 后端在大工作区首次授权时会整树同步传播 ACE（见 `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts` 的注释 "eager inheritance; minutes on large workspaces"）。官方已有 `hasExactGrant` 精确匹配跳过，但这只让**第二次** provision 变成 O(1)；**第一次**仍然阻塞。官方不开 issue、不接受 PR，因此把修复做成独立插件发布，任何官方 harness 用户都能直接安装使用。 ## 实测 benchmark（劫持官方 grant.ts 源码测量） | 场景 | 文件数 | 首次（阻塞） | 后续（O(1) skip） | | :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- | | 真实工作区（首次授权） | 4,332 | **2,773.7ms**（冻结） | 1.2ms | | 大 monorepo（DSH 本体） | 182,053 | 首次随整树放大（fork 实测 >120s） | **1.2ms** | 同一目录从首次 2,773.7ms → 二次 1.2ms（约 2,300 倍差距），正是用户可感知的冻结；skip 与树大小无关（4,332 与 182,053 文件都是 1.2ms），因为 `hasExactGrant` 只读目录自身 DACL 头。 ## 实现要点 - `grant-cli` 子进程承载整树遍历，绝不阻塞事件循环（`stdio: 'ignore'` + 监听 `exit`，无僵尸进程）。 - `kickOffWorkspaceGrant` 用 `workspaceGrantInflight` Map 合并并发请求（单线程 tick 内 `has→set` 原子），且官方 `acl.ts` 已有 `withPathLock`（LockFileEx per-path 锁）兜底多进程场景。 - `confine()` 保持同步契约，未授权时只 kick-off 不 await，fail-closed。 - `prewarm` 配置可在启动时预热已知工作区，缩短首条命令前的 fail-closed 窗口。

discussions.title: Render composer dock stats + billing on one line (instead of ellipsis + hover)
discussions.body:
## Proposal: render the composer dock stats + billing on a single line

### The problem

The session-stats strip in the composer dock is one of the longest UI lines in the harness:

> 46 轮 · 70 步 | LLM 3m19s · 工具调用 52.8s | 首 token 平均 0.8s · 110 tok/s | 缓存命中 96% | 输入 2.4M tok · 输出 15.5K tok

The current treatment **elides overlong content with an ellipsis** and hides the full text behind a delayed hover tooltip. On a typical desktop width, the wall-time, throughput, cache-hit, and billing figures are simply not visible — a user has to hover the strip and wait 500ms to learn anything, with no visual hint that data is hidden.

### The proposed change

Render the strip as **one compact nowrap row** that shares the composer dock with the billing pill (e.g. `dsh-balance`'s `本轮 ¥1.477`), so a long session's figures read on a single line:

- **StatsLine**: inline `11px` nowrap strip with tight `|` separators (2px). Drops the ellipsis + `ResizeObserver` tooltip machinery entirely — the row no longer elides.
- **InputBar**: the `conversation.composer.dock` entries are wrapped in one centered flex row (`.dockFooter`) with `10px` top / `16px` bottom padding (plus the existing 8px root pad) so the strip keeps breathing room — more below than above.

### Why this fits

- **Fully visible, always**: no hover-to-discover; the strip is tertiary chrome and never warrants an interaction to read.
- **One line, verified**: measured on a real session — `1 轮 · 1 步| LLM 1.3s| 首 token 平均 0.8s · 108 tok/s| 缓存命中 29%| 输入 9.7K tok · 输出 47 tok 本轮 ¥0.0156` renders at 701px against a 716px available column at 11px (longest typical figure set fits with ~15px headroom).
- **Stays on the design system**: all `--dsw-alias-*` / `--dsh-*` tokens, no new palette or typeface.
- **Keeps the dock's "one home per fact" split**: context occupancy stays on the ContextMeter ring, tokens/cache on the stats, cost in the billing pill — this only makes those homes readable.

### Working implementation

A full working change (5 files: `StatsLine.tsx/.module.css`, `InputBar.tsx/.module.css`, `chat-stats.client.spec.tsx`) is on the fork branch [`feat/stats-line-single-row`](https://github.com/Zhangbo-cn/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/stats-line-single-row). I attempted a PR but hit permission limits with the token, so I'm posting here first. Tests pass locally (`chat-stats` 22/22, `chat-view` 46/46).

If maintainers agree, I'm happy to open the PR (or adjust the approach — e.g. keep a longer-hover tooltip as a fallback for very narrow viewports, or clamp with `min-width: 0` + `overflow-wrap: anywhere` as a graceful degradation instead of hard `nowrap`).

discussions.title: 在群晖 NAS（Linux x64）上运行 DeepSeek Harness 的安装与启动问题及解决方案
discussions.body:
大家好，

我最近尝试在 **群晖 Synology NAS（Linux x64）** 上从源码部署 DeepSeek Harness，目前已经成功运行。

在整个安装和启动过程中遇到了一些比较典型的问题，最终都已经解决。这里整理出来，希望可以帮助官方改进安装文档、CLI 启动方式以及 Linux/NAS 环境的兼容性。

---

## 一、运行环境

我的环境：

* 设备：Synology 群晖 NAS
* CPU 架构：Linux x64
* Node.js：`v22.19.0`
* pnpm：`v11.7.0`
* 部署方式：源码部署
* 项目目录：

```text
/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness
```

---

# 二、最开始误用了 `pnpm.mjs`

最初尝试：

```bash
node pnpm.mjs install
```

结果：

```text
Error: Cannot find module '/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/pnpm.mjs'
```

随后检查：

```bash
which pnpm
pnpm -v
```

得到：

```text
/bin/pnpm
11.7.0
```

因此改为直接使用：

```bash
pnpm install --ignore-scripts
```

安装成功。

---

# 三、Workspace 安装

安装过程中出现了以下警告：

```text
Unsupported platform:
wanted: {"cpu":["arm64"],"os":["linux"],"libc":["any"]}
current: {"os":"linux","cpu":"x64","libc":"glibc"}
```

对应：

```text
native/landlock-run/packages/linux-arm64
```

此外还有一些 workspace cyclic dependency 警告。

不过 lockfile 校验正常，依赖安装最终成功。

之后手动重新构建了几个 native dependency：

```bash
pnpm rebuild node-pty
pnpm rebuild koffi
pnpm rebuild esbuild
```

然后：

```bash
pnpm install
```

显示：

```text
Already up to date
```

---

# 四、`dsh` CLI 本身可以正常运行

在项目目录中：

```bash
pnpm dsh --help
```

能够正常得到：

```text
Usage: dsh [options] [command] [args...]

dsh: boot a DeepSeek Harness profile...

Commands:
  web [options] [args...]     boot the web profile
  plugin [options] [args...]  manage a profile's plugins
```

因此可以确认：

**源码、TypeScript、tsx、CLI 入口以及基础 workspace 环境都是正常的。**

---

# 五、尝试将 `dsh` 安装成系统命令

我的目标是希望以后无论当前在哪个目录，都可以直接：

```bash
dsh
```

而不需要：

```bash
cd /volume1/docker/deepseek-harness
pnpm dsh
```

于是创建：

```text
/usr/local/bin/dsh
```

最开始遇到了权限问题：

```text
Permission denied
```

原因是文件权限为：

```text
-rwx------ 1 root root
```

修改为：

```bash
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/dsh
```

之后权限问题解决。

---

# 六、`tsx` 的解析问题

最开始尝试让 `/usr/local/bin/dsh` 直接执行：

```bash
node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts
```

从项目目录运行没问题，但是从用户 Home 目录执行时：

```bash
cd ~
dsh web
```

出现：

```text
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'tsx'
```

后来发现，关键在于：

**`tsx` 是通过 pnpm workspace 环境解析的，不应该假设它一定存在于：**

```text
/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs
```

实际上 pnpm 的依赖结构位于 `.pnpm` 中。

因此直接硬编码：

```text
/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness/node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs
```

并不是可靠的方式。

最终发现最稳定的方法是直接调用项目自身已经定义好的：

```bash
pnpm dsh
```

---

# 七、`dsh web` 最初出现 workspace package 找不到

执行：

```bash
dsh web
```

最开始出现：

```text
Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]:

Cannot find package
'@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'
```

但是这个 package 实际上是存在的：

```text
packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse
```

检查：

```bash
cat packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse/package.json
```

其中：

```json
"name": "@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse"
```

而且：

```text
packages/host/directory-picker-auto/package.json
```

中也正确声明了：

```json
"@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse": "workspace:^"
```

通过：

```bash
pnpm list -r --depth -1 | grep -E "directory-picker|ui-directory"
```

也可以看到：

```text
@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse@0.1.0-rc.7
```

并且：

```text
packages/host/directory-picker-auto/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/
```

中存在对应 symlink。

我进一步直接测试：

```bash
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse').then(()=>console.log('PACKAGE OK')).catch(e=>console.error(e))"
```

结果：

```text
PACKAGE OK
```

说明 package 本身没有问题，主要是当时 root/workspace 的依赖链接状态存在问题。

---

# 八、重新创建 workspace links

之后重新执行：

```bash
pnpm install --force --offline --shamefully-hoist
```

这次 root `node_modules` 中出现了正确的 workspace links，例如：

```text
node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse
    -> ../../packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse
```

再次验证：

```bash
node -e "import('@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse').then(()=>console.log('ROOT PACKAGE OK')).catch(e=>console.error(e))"
```

得到：

```text
ROOT PACKAGE OK
```

于是这个问题解决。

不过需要特别说明：

这次 `pnpm install --force --offline --shamefully-hoist` 在安装 native packages 时最终出现了：

```text
Segmentation fault (core dumped)
```

所以我**不建议把这个命令作为官方推荐的安装方法**。

它只是碰巧恢复了当前环境下的 workspace links。

---

# 九、之后发现 HMR 需要 `--expose-internals`

workspace package 问题解决后，再运行：

```bash
dsh web
```

已经能够进入 Web 启动阶段，并输出：

```text
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

这说明 Web profile 已经开始启动。

但是随后报错：

```text
Error: --expose-internals is required for HMR service
```

完整错误来自：

```text
@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-hmr
```

也就是说当前 Web/HMR 服务要求 Node.js 使用：

```text
--expose-internals
```

---

# 十、最终解决方式

最终我将系统级 `/usr/local/bin/dsh` 设置为：

```bash
#!/bin/sh

DSH_ROOT="/volume1/docker/deepseek-harness"

cd "$DSH_ROOT" || exit 1

export NODE_OPTIONS="${NODE_OPTIONS:+$NODE_OPTIONS }--expose-internals"

exec pnpm dsh "$@"
```

然后：

```bash
sudo chmod 755 /usr/local/bin/dsh
```

这样无论当前在哪个目录：

```bash
cd ~
```

都可以直接：

```bash
dsh web
```

最终成功启动。

---

# 十一、当前运行状态

现在已经可以正常运行：

```bash
dsh web
```

并得到：

```text
dsh web: http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

也就是说，目前：

* Node.js 正常
* pnpm 正常
* workspace 正常
* TypeScript/tsx 正常
* CLI 正常
* workspace package resolution 正常
* HMR 正常
* Web profile 正常启动

**DeepSeek Harness 已经成功运行在我的群晖 NAS 上。**

---

# 十二、对官方文档/项目的几点建议

### 1. 建议增加 Linux/NAS 源码部署文档

目前如果是在普通 Linux 开发机上可能比较容易，但 Synology NAS 这种环境会涉及：

* pnpm workspace
* native dependencies
* CPU architecture
* Node.js
* HMR
* 文件权限
* 后台运行

建议增加一个 Linux/NAS 部署章节。

---

### 2. 建议明确说明 `tsx` 的解析方式

项目目前：

```json
"dsh": "node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts"
```

在 workspace 环境中是可以工作的。

但用户不应该假设：

```text
node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs
```

一定存在。

特别是 pnpm 环境下，直接硬编码：

```text
node_modules/tsx/esm.mjs
```

容易导致：

```text
ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND
```

---

### 3. 建议考虑 CLI 自动处理 `--expose-internals`

当前：

```bash
dsh web
```

实际需要：

```text
--expose-internals
```

才能启动 HMR。

如果这是 Web profile 的固定要求，我认为可以考虑：

* 在 CLI 内部自动设置；
* 或者在 `dsh web` 的启动逻辑中自动加入；
* 或者在文档中明确说明。

这样用户不需要自行设置：

```bash
NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-internals
```

---

### 4. 建议改善 workspace package resolution 的错误提示

例如：

```text
Cannot find package
'@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-directory-picker-browse'
```

但实际上：

```text
packages/client/ui-directory-picker-browse
```

存在，并且：

```text
workspace:^
```

也正确配置。

对于这种情况，如果 CLI 能够提示：

```text
Workspace package exists but is not linked/resolvable.
Try `pnpm install`.
```

会比单纯的 `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND` 更容易排查。

---

### 5. 建议增加 NAS 网络访问说明

目前默认：

```text
http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

只能从 NAS 本机访问。

如果希望：

```text
Windows PC
Android
iPhone
局域网其他设备
```

访问 NAS 上运行的 DeepSeek Harness，需要配置监听：

```text
0.0.0.0:3080
```

建议官方文档增加：

**“如何在服务器/NAS 上开放 Web 服务供局域网访问”** 的说明。

---

# 十三、最终结论

经过排查，我最终采用的方式是：

```text
Synology NAS
      │
      ▼
Node.js 22.19.0
      │
      ▼
pnpm 11.7.0
      │
      ▼
DeepSeek Harness workspace
      │
      ▼
/usr/local/bin/dsh
      │
      ├── cd /volume1/docker/deepseek-harness
      │
      ├── NODE_OPTIONS=--expose-internals
      │
      └── pnpm dsh "$@"
                │
                ▼
        apps/cli/src/bin.ts
                │
                ▼
             dsh web
                │
                ▼
       http://127.0.0.1:3080
```

目前已经可以稳定启动。

希望这些信息能够帮助官方进一步完善 **Linux / Synology NAS / pnpm workspace** 场景下的安装和部署体验。

感谢团队维护这个项目！

discussions.title: # Bug + fix: Windows 大工作区首次 workspace-write 授权同步遍历 ACL 整树，事件循环冻结数分钟
discussions.body:
# Bug + fix: Windows 大工作区首次 workspace-write 授权同步遍历 ACL 整树，事件循环冻结数分钟

## Summary

Windows 下，大工作区的**首次** `workspace-write` 命令会冻结整个服务器数分钟。冻结期间所有 RPC（`session.create`、终端 spawn、工具调用）全部超时——Web UI 表现为"AI 每次跑终端命令都卡死"。

我定位到了根因，并准备好了带确定性回归测试的完整非阻塞修复。由于官方不接收外部 PR（per CONTRIBUTING.md），故发布在此提请团队关注。完整实现与测试在独立仓库：https://github.com/Ranecc/topolyte-windows-acl （Cordis 插件 `@topolyte/windows-acl`，基于官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl` 包，bundle-patch 挂载，无需 fork）。

## Root cause

首次 `workspace-write` provision 时，`LocalSandboxProvider.materializeAclGrant` 在 `confine()`（用户可见请求路径）上同步调用 `grant.add(workspaceRoot, true)`（standing grant）。

`grantWrite → SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 带 OI|CI 继承标志，触发 Windows 的 **eager 可继承 ACE 传播**：内核同步递归整棵子树。大树上耗时数分钟，且运行在 harness 事件循环上，整个服务器（所有 session、HTTP、RPC）冻结。

官方代码已承认此成本：

- `packages/sandbox/sandbox-windows-acl/src/acl.ts`："it would otherwise re-propagate the identical ACE across the whole tree (eager inheritance; minutes on large workspaces)"
- 现有缓解（`hasExactGrant` 精确匹配跳过）只让**第二次** provision 变 O(1)，**第一次**仍阻塞——第一次必然触发全树传播，无法绕过。

## Fix

把昂贵的 eager ACE 传播移出事件循环。核心三件事：

**1. 首次 `grantWrite(workspaceRoot, true)` 放进独立子进程**（`spawn` 而非 `spawnSync`），成功后再记录 standing grant：

```ts
// grant-cli.ts —— argv: [node, grant-cli.js, <workspaceRoot>]
import { AclWriteGrant, workspaceWriteSid } from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox-windows-acl'

const GRANT_SIGNATURE = 'windows-acl-grant'
const GRANT_FAILURE_EXIT = 127

async function main(): Promise<number> {
  const workspace = process.argv[2]
  if (workspace === undefined || workspace.length === 0) {
    process.stderr.write(`${GRANT_SIGNATURE}: missing workspace path\n`)
    return GRANT_FAILURE_EXIT
  }
  // Standing grant: 跨 session 复用缓存；短命 helper 无需 dispose()——进程退出即回收 SID。
  AclWriteGrant.create(workspaceWriteSid(workspace)).add(workspace, true)
  return 0
}

main().then(
  (exitCode) => { process.exitCode = exitCode },
  (error: unknown) => {
    process.stderr.write(`${GRANT_SIGNATURE}: ${error instanceof Error ? error.message : String(error)}\n`)
    process.exitCode = GRANT_FAILURE_EXIT
  },
)
```

**2. `confine()` 保持同步但 fail-closed**：kick off，绝不 await 整树遍历：

```ts
private kickOffWorkspaceGrant(workspaceRoot: string): void {
  if (this.workspaceGrants.has(workspaceRoot)) return          // 已 standing：O(1)
  if (this.workspaceGrantInflight.has(workspaceRoot)) return  // 在途：合并
  const pending = this.materializeWorkspaceGrantAsync(workspaceRoot).finally(() => {
    this.workspaceGrantInflight.delete(workspaceRoot)
  })
  this.workspaceGrantInflight.set(workspaceRoot, pending)
  pending.catch((error) => {
    this.ctx.logger.warn(`windows-acl: out-of-band grant failed for ${workspaceRoot}: ${String(error)}`)
  })
}

private async materializeWorkspaceGrantAsync(workspaceRoot: string): Promise<void> {
  // spawn, not spawnSync —— 遍历在子进程里，绝不阻塞事件循环
  await spawnGrant(this.grantCliInvocation(workspaceRoot), workspaceRoot)
  this.workspaceGrants.set(workspaceRoot, AclWriteGrant.create(workspaceWriteSid(workspaceRoot)))
}
```

standing ACE 落地前，受限子进程的工作区写被拒（`access is denied`）——fail-closed，绝不冻结；一旦落地，exact-ACE skip 让之后每次 provision 变 O(1)。子进程用 `stdio: 'ignore'` + 监听 `exit`，无僵尸进程；多进程前端由官方 `acl.ts` 的 `withPathLock`（LockFileEx per-path 锁）兜底。

**3. 暴露 `prewarm` 配置**，部署可在启动时为已知工作区预热，缩短首条命令前的 fail-closed 窗口：

```yaml
- insert:
    - id: sandbox
      name: '@topolyte/windows-acl'
      config:
        prewarm:
          - <workspaceRoot>
```

## Verification

**端到端（icacls 断言）**：standing 工作区 ACE 带外物化（`SetNamedSecurityInfoW` 由子进程落地）；temp ACE 在 teardown 撤销；工作区 ACE 跨 provider 保留。e2e 脚本：`scripts/e2e-acl.ts`。

**Benchmark（劫持官方 `grant.ts`/`workspace-sid.ts` 源码实测，非推测）**：

| 场景 | 文件数 | 首次（阻塞） | 后续（O(1) skip） |
| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |
| 真实工作区（首次授权） | 4,332 | **2,773.7ms**（冻结） | 1.2ms |
| 大 monorepo（DSH 本体） | 182,053 | 首次随整树放大（fork 实测 >120s） | **1.2ms** |

两个关键数据点：

- 同一目录从首次 **2,773.7ms**（整树 eager 传播）到二次 **1.2ms**（exact-ACE skip）——约 **2,300 倍差距**，正是用户可感知的冻结。
- skip **与树大小无关**（4,332 vs 182,053 文件都是 1.2ms），因为 `hasExactGrant` 只读目录自身 DACL 头；而首次成本随整树放大，数万文件的 monorepo 上同步遍历超过两分钟。

**单测**：`@topolyte/windows-acl` 仓库内 vitest 套件通过（含异步授权合并、temp 隔离、错误路径）；插件继承官方 `SandboxProvider` 基类，不破坏官方契约。

discussions.title: 分享一个 DSH 插件：dsh-f12-inspector —— 给 DSH Web 界面加上「F12 元素检查」
discussions.body:
MIT 开源 · 一行 dsh plugin add 安装

这是什么
一个 DSH（DeepSeek Harness）Web 界面插件：把浏览器「F12 检查元素」的交互搬进网页界面的第三栏（右侧详情栏）。用它，在 DSH 里载入你的页面，鼠标一指点，CSS 选择器 / XPath / 计算样式 / outerHTML 直接拿到，还能一键「＋加入对话」把元素上下文发给 agent 让它精确修改——彻底告别"帮我把这个按钮改蓝"然后 agent 猜半天选择器的循环。

📦 仓库：https://github.com/AlloyPlane/dsh-f12-inspector
🏷 GitHub topics：dsh deepseek-harness f12 devtools inspector element-inspector xpath css-selector filetree html-editor
核心能力
1️⃣ F12 元素检查
侧边栏底部「🔍 F12 检查器」按钮 → 打开第三栏
检查模式：悬停 → 蓝色高亮 + 元素标签，点击 → 锁定选中
元素信息：tagName / data-dom-id / CSS 选择器 / XPath / 文本 / 尺寸 / 计算样式 / outerHTML
「📋 复制选择器」一键复制；「＋ 加入对话」自动填进 composer 发给 agent
2️⃣ 工作区文件树
跟随当前会话 cwd，自动列出工程目录树，点选 HTML 文件载入预览，不用手敲路径
文件树点选：HTML → 载入预览检查；其他文本文件 → 打开编辑器
3️⃣ 内置 HTML 编辑器（VSCode 风格，纯 JS 零依赖）
语法高亮 / 行号 / Tab 缩进 + 回车自动缩进 / 状态栏
「保存」写回磁盘；「刷新预览」把改后的源码重新渲染 → 在改完的页面上继续检查，闭环
与 DSH 的原生集成（怎么做到的）
客户端用 DSH 槽位系统：sidebar.footer.action（打开第三栏的按钮）+ details（priority: -1 占据详情栏）
预览页进 sandbox iframe，检查引擎经 contentDocument 注入 mouseover/click/keydown，点击时生成元素定位 payload
宿主侧全部走 DSH 官方 fs 服务：POST /api/f12-inspector（list/read/write），路径解析与 DSH 自带工具一致（'' = 工作区根、相对路径、绝对路径），遵循沙箱——不是裸 node:fs
如果对 DSH 插件的 slot 注册 / bundle 打包 / fs 服务 感兴趣，这个插件的代码就是个很精简的参考示例。

安装（一条命令）
sh
复制
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:AlloyPlane/dsh-f12-inspector#v1.1.0&path:/"
重启 DSH（npx -y @deepseek-ai/dsh web）后，侧边栏底部出现「🔍 F12 检查器」。

合规说明
MIT 协议；元素定位基于标准 DOM API 自行实现，规避第三方专有协议
文件树与编辑器设计参考 [dsh-filetree](https://github.com/lak321/dsh-filetree)（MIT），已按协议署名致谢（[ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md](https://github.com/AlloyPlane/dsh-f12-inspector/blob/main/ACKNOWLEDGEMENTS.md)）
README 中英文双版，顶部可切换
社区渠道
欢迎大家在以下地方看到它 / 给我反馈：

deepseek-harness GitHub Discussions（本帖可发此处，选 Show and tell 分类）
awesome-deepseek-harness-plugins 列表（可提 PR 收录）
WhaleHub 插件市场（[vvlife/whalehub-dsh](https://github.com/vvlife/whalehub-dsh)，按 [提交规范](https://github.com/AlloyPlane/dsh-f12-inspector/blob/main/docs/whalehub-submission.md) 提交）
有 bug、有想法，欢迎去 GitHub 开 issue / PR。

🔗 https://github.com/AlloyPlane/dsh-f12-inspector

标签： #dsh #deepseek-harness #插件 #f12 #元素检查 #devtools #xpath

discussions.title: [Proposal] WebUI 应具备插件故障隔离：非核心插件加载失败不应导致整个 WebUI 无法启动
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

DeepSeek Harness 的 Web 应用（`dsh web`）在启动时会按 profile 配置（`dsh.profile.bundles`、`cordis.patch.yml`、`--patch` 覆盖层）加载组合中的全部插件。目前任何一行插件在加载或初始化阶段出错（例如：依赖缺失、配置错误、`apply()` 抛异常、代码语法/运行时错误），都会导致整个应用启动失败：

- 整个 WebUI 无法启动；
- 终端输出的错误信息非常简短，通常只有几条笼统的异常，难以判断是哪个插件、来自哪个配置层（bundle / `cordis.patch.yml` / `--patch`）出错；
- 只能手动排查（逐行注释 `cordis.patch.yml`、卸载插件等）并重启，恢复成本高。

在「多个 bundle + 用户 patch 覆盖」的大规模组合下尤其脆弱：任何一个非核心插件的问题都会拖垮整体。

## 期望行为

希望 WebUI 的启动做到「核心优先、故障隔离」：

1. **启动只硬依赖核心插件**：Web 应用骨架、路由、基础服务等核心插件（如 `dsh-web-app` 提供的部分）正常加载即可启动界面；非核心/可选插件不阻塞启动。
2. **插件错误不拖垮整体**：某个插件加载失败时，将其捕获并标记为「加载失败」，该插件被禁用/降级，但 WebUI 照常启动，其余插件正常工作。
3. **启动后集中报错、便于定位**：WebUI 启动完成后，在界面内展示故障详情（通知条 / 插件状态面板 / 诊断页面），至少包含：
   - 出错的插件名称 / 插件 ID；
   - 错误来源（哪个 bundle、`cordis.patch.yml` 或 `--patch` 中的哪一层/哪一行）；
   - 完整的错误信息与堆栈，而非当前的一条笼统信息。
4. **运行时崩溃隔离（延伸）**：插件运行期抛出的未捕获异常也不应导致整个 WebUI 崩溃，而是标记该插件异常并提示用户。

整体思路类似 **VS Code 的插件系统**：扩展运行在独立的 Extension Host 中，扩展启动失败或崩溃只提示「扩展 xxx 已终止」，编辑器界面本身始终可用，通知中给出错误详情，用户可查看日志或禁用该扩展。

## 建议的实现方向（供讨论）

1. **插件分级**：为插件行增加「关键/核心」标记（如 `critical: true` 或核心插件白名单），只有核心插件加载失败才中止启动，非核心插件失败走隔离路径。
2. **加载隔离**：为每个插件的加载/初始化捕获异常，失败后将其从组合中移除或降级，并记录结构化错误（插件 ID、来源层、message、stack）。
3. **错误诊断面板**：在 WebUI 中增加「插件状态 / 诊断」入口，汇总启动期与运行期的插件错误；同时在 `dsh web` 终端输出中给出带插件标识的详细错误。
4. **错误信息增强**：所有插件错误输出应包含插件标识与配置来源（哪个文件、哪一行、哪个层），帮助用户直接定位。

## 边界情况

- 核心插件失败仍应阻止启动（缺少核心能力时 UI 无意义），但错误信息必须足够详细；
- 插件间依赖：若 A 依赖 B，B 失败导致 A 连锁失败时，诊断信息应展示失败链（A 失败原因 → 依赖 B 加载失败 → B 的错误详情）；
- 修复插件后应能恢复正常（热重载或重启即可），不需要清空数据。

## 收益

- **可用性**：单个插件问题不再导致整个 WebUI 不可用；
- **可诊断性**：错误定位从「手动逐行排查」变为「界面直接指出插件与原因」；
- **可维护性**：降低用户在多层组合、第三方插件场景下的试错成本；
- 与「Everything is a Plugin」的定位一致：插件生态越大，越需要健壮的故障隔离。

## 补充说明

- 复现方式（示例）：在 `cordis.patch.yml` 中新增一个存在问题的插件后运行 `dsh web`，进程直接失败，界面无法打开，终端错误难以定位具体插件。
- 相关概念：profile 由 bundle patch 层与 `cordis.patch.yml`、`--patch` 覆盖层组合而成，报错时标注来源层即可大幅降低定位成本。

discussions.title: faultseed — deterministic hooks that stop an agent from faking progress
discussions.body:
Deterministic hooks that stop a coding agent from faking progress: weakening
a test, swallowing an error, deleting a test through the shell, declaring a
method that only exists to the type checker. Nine guards, mounted on dsh
through `@deepseek-ai/dsh-hooks-claude-code`. Each one is a subprocess that
reads one JSON event on stdin and answers with its exit code — not a linter
you run afterward, not a prompt you hope the agent reads, but a gate that
refuses the tool call before it happens.

```
dsh plugin --profile <your-profile> add @jw53222/faultseed-dsh
```

Repo: https://github.com/JW53222/faultseed · npm: `@jw53222/faultseed-dsh` · MIT

## What a permission layer can't see

An agent with correctly scoped permissions, leaking nothing, touching only
files it was allowed to touch, can still hand you a green build by weakening
the test that was failing. The edit was in scope. The file was allowed. The
run passed. Every check that asks *what is this agent permitted to do*
returns clean, because the agent did nothing it wasn't permitted to do — it
just did the wrong thing with permission.

These guards ask the other question: did the work actually get done, or does
it only look done.

## The nine

Eight fire before a tool call runs; the ninth when a subagent tries to
finish. Four of them cover test integrity, because there are four routes to
the same cheat and closing three is the same as closing none.

| Guard | Blocks | Escape |
|---|---|---|
| `no_test_tampering.py` | Rewriting, weakening, `skip`/`xfail`-ing, `assert True`-ing, or net-removing assertions from a test. A conditional `skipif` platform guard is fine. | `# tampering-ok: <reason>` |
| `no_bash_test_deletion.py` | `rm`/`git rm` of a test path, or `git mv` moving a test out of the suite. | `# delete-tests-ok: <reason>` |
| `no_bash_test_mutation.py` | In-place mutation via `sed -i`, `tee`, or a truncating redirect — the route around the edit-level check. Creating a new test this way is fine. | `# test-mutate-ok: <reason>` |
| `no_swallowed_errors.py` | Bare `except: pass`/`...`, PowerShell `catch {}`, `-ErrorAction SilentlyContinue`/`Ignore`. Scans a neighborhood around the edit, not just the diff. | `# swallow-ok: <reason>` |
| `no_type_checking_stub.py` | A method declared only inside `if TYPE_CHECKING:` with no runtime `def`. Per-class, including mixins. | `# host-provides:` / `# type-stub-ok:` |
| `protect-files.sh` | `.env`/`.env.*`, `package-lock.json`, anything under a `.git/` segment, an existing file under `migrations/`. | none — hardcoded |
| `agent_sizing_gate.py` | An `Agent` spawn with no sized `model`, or an unrecognized one. Validates the value, not just that the key is present. | `opus-leaf-ok:` / `fable-leaf-ok:` |
| `workflow_agent_sizing_gate.py` | Same, for in-script `agent()` calls inside a `Workflow`. | same |
| `subagent_closing_report.py` | A subagent reporting done without stating what it changed beyond the request and what it left unfixed. `SubagentStop`. | read-only agent types exempt |

Every escape needs a written reason. A bare marker doesn't clear the block,
and one fewer marker than assertions removed doesn't either.

Two behaviors that are deliberate and will look like bugs if you don't expect
them. **Unparseable input blocks; parsed-but-irrelevant allows** — a guard
that can't read its own event doesn't know what it was asked about, and a
control that can't function must not wave the call through; an event it
correctly ignores is normal operation. And the variable that disables the
bash-mutation guard for merge integrators demands exactly `"1"` — `true`,
`yes`, and anything else leave it armed. A variable that turns a control
*off* gets the most explicit possible opt-in.

## Why "faultseed"

> A gate never proven to fail is indistinguishable from a gate that cannot
> fail.

Every guard ships with a planted-failure test: a real violation, checked in,
that the guard has to reject. Without one you have a check that has never
been observed doing anything except returning zero, and the version that is
silently broken looks identical from outside — it also returns zero, on
everything, forever.

`run_tests.sh` runs 214 hook tests, 142 script tests, 46 planted-failure
checks. That discipline caught a real one in this pack's own release scanner
today: five of eight reserved-domain exemptions were dead, because the suffix
was built as `"." + s` and the entries already carried a leading dot, so
`".invalid"` became `"..invalid"` and never matched anything. The test
alongside it only exercised `example.com`, which was one of the three that
worked. Three of eight covered, and the five broken ones were exactly the
five nobody tested.

## Before you trust it

```
sh bin/smoke-test.sh
```

Real `_dispatch.py`, a real deny case, a real allow case, no dsh process
involved — confirms the pack is wired before you rely on it inside an agent
loop.

## What is and isn't verified

A guard has been observed blocking a real tool call through dsh's own
unmodified bridge, matcher, codec, agent loop and subprocess executor, with
only the LLM scripted — dsh's own `MockAdapter`, the same pattern its bridge
tests use.

NOT verified: a live `dsh` CLI process with a real model choosing the tool
call. The one ACP e2e test that exercises this bridge shape end to end is
gated on `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`, which was not configured anywhere this was
built. "Code Mode" tool execution is unaccounted for — whether it changes
what name reaches the matcher was not investigated. `ctx.shell`'s env-scrub
behavior inside the sandboxed executor was read from a doc comment, not
traced into its implementation.

Those are at the top of the README too, not buried at the bottom. If you run
this against a live model I'd like to hear what breaks.

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Let stdio MCP servers know the calling session's agent/team identity
discussions.body:
## Summary

MCP servers spawned as stdio children of `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` currently
have **no way to learn which dsh session (and therefore which resolved
agent/team/task) issued a `tools/call`**. This forces identity-scoped MCP tools
to ask the model to pass identity parameters — fragile with flash-tier models.

## Background / motivation

We integrate dsh with an external agent-memory service. The service stores
memories / skills / conversations in per-`(team, agent)` namespaces. A dsh
session resolves to a concrete `(team, agent, task)` after a one-time
initialization step (an ask-user form), and the proxy injects a
`<session_context>` block (agent id + task id) into the model's system prompt.

We expose the service's read APIs to the model as MCP tools (via
`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, `transport: stdio`). Those tools must scope every
query to the **calling session's** agent namespace.

Today the only identity signal that reaches the model is the
`<session_context>` text in its prompt; the MCP child process receives nothing.
So the model has to pass its `agent_id` back as a tool argument on every call.
That works but is unreliable: flash-tier models occasionally omit the argument,
and we had to make it **required** so a miss is a hard error instead of a
silently-wrong read. A purely code-side channel would be far more robust.

## What dsh-mcp-client does today (verified)

- Child env = `scrubbedParentEnv()` + static `config.env` from `cordis.patch.yml`.
- `scrubbedParentEnv()` copies the parent env but **strips `DSH_*` keys and
  sensitive patterns** (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess`).
- The MCP stdio transport only carries JSON-RPC `initialize` / `tools/list` /
  `tools/call`; `tools/call` params are exactly the model's arguments. No
  session id, agent id, or task id is present.
- The child is spawned **once per dsh run**, shared across sessions, so even a
  static env injection would be stale for later sessions.

## Proposal

Any one of the following would unblock us (in order of preference):

1. **Per-call session context in `tools/call`**: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`
   appends session context (e.g. `session_id`, and — if resolvable — `agent_id`
   / `team_id` / `task_id`) to every outgoing `tools/call` request, either as a
   synthetic argument or as a transport-level field the server can read without
   exposing it to the model. This is the cleanest: it is correct per session
   and requires no respawn.

2. **Per-session child lifecycle**: spawn (or re-spawn) the MCP child per
   session, injecting the session's identity into its env (e.g.
   `DSH_SESSION_ID`, `DSH_AGENT_ID`, `DSH_TEAM_ID`). Costlier (process churn)
   but requires no protocol change.

3. **Session-scoped env on init**: at least pass the *current* session's
   identity via a `notifications/initialized`-style capability or an extra
   `initialize` field, so the server can capture it once the session is known.

## Desired outcome

An MCP server should be able to read the calling session's agent/team identity
**without the model passing it**. Whether the identity comes from dsh directly
(agent resolution lives in dsh) or is forwarded from the upstream proxy's
`<session_context>` (agent resolution lives in the model gateway) is open; the
key requirement is a non-model channel into the stdio child.

## Environment

- dsh 0.1.0-rc.7 (developer preview), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`, Windows 11
  host, WSL2 backend for the external service.

discussions.title: [Bug + fix] Windows: every `npm_execpath`-based script fails when pnpm is the standalone (`@pnpm/exe`) build
discussions.body:
## Summary

`scripts/build.ts`, `scripts/run-gates.ts`, `scripts/run-web-snapshots.ts` and `scripts/coverage-partitions.ts` all assume `process.env.npm_execpath` points at a JS entrypoint and spawn it as `node <npm_execpath> …`.

With pnpm 11 installed as the **standalone build** (`@pnpm/exe`, i.e. the default for the standalone script / `winget` / `npm i -g @pnpm/exe` installs), `npm_execpath` points at a native executable instead:

```
C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\pnpm\global\v11\...\node_modules\@pnpm\exe\pnpm.exe
```

Node then tries to ESM-load `pnpm.exe` and dies. `pnpm run build` fails immediately, and so does `check:all` / `check:ci*`, `test:coverage:partitioned`, and `test:web:ci`.

This is invisible on a JS-entrypoint install (Corepack, `npm i -g pnpm`), which is presumably what CI uses, the standalone build is the one the pnpm docs recommend first on Windows.

## Repro

Environment:

- Windows 11
- Node v22.18.0
- pnpm 11.7.0, installed as the standalone `@pnpm/exe` build
- `deepseek-harness` @ `dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8` (141eb6f)

```
pnpm install
pnpm run build
```

Result:

```
$ tsx scripts/build.ts
node:internal/modules/esm/get_format:219
  throw new ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION(ext, filepath);
        ^

TypeError [ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION]: Unknown file extension ".exe" for
  C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\pnpm\store\v11\links\@pnpm\exe\11.7.0\...\node_modules\@pnpm\exe\pnpm.exe
    at Object.getFileProtocolModuleFormat [as file:] (node:internal/modules/esm/get_format:219:9)
    ...
  code: 'ERR_UNKNOWN_FILE_EXTENSION'
}

Error: build: build:lib exited with 1
    at runScript (scripts/build.ts:28:11)
```

Confirming the environment variable directly (any package script, any directory):

```
$ pnpm run probe          # "probe": "node -e \"console.log(process.env.npm_execpath)\""
C:\Users\<user>\AppData\Local\pnpm\global\v11\...\node_modules\@pnpm\exe\pnpm.exe
```

## Cause

`scripts/build.ts`:

```ts
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath
const result = spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], { … })
```

`node <pnpm.exe> run build:lib` cannot work. The same assumption is repeated in three other places:

| File | Code |
| --- | --- |
| `scripts/build.ts` | `spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], …)` |
| `scripts/run-gates.ts` (`pnpmInvocation`) | `{ command: process.execPath, args: [entrypoint, ...args] }` |
| `scripts/run-web-snapshots.ts` | `baseArgs = [pnpmEntrypoint, 'exec', 'vitest', …]` → `spawn(process.execPath, args)` |
| `scripts/coverage-partitions.ts` | `args: [this.pnpmEntrypoint, 'exec', 'vitest', …]` → `spawn(process.execPath, command.args, …)` |

The comment in `run-gates.ts` ("Windows cannot spawn the pnpm.cmd shim directly; the JavaScript entrypoint keeps every host shell-free") shows the intent — staying shell-free — and that intent still holds. It is only the "the entrypoint is always JavaScript" half that no longer does.

## Suggested fix

Decide how to spawn based on the entrypoint's extension: wrap it in Node when it is `.js`/`.cjs`/`.mjs`, otherwise spawn the executable directly. Both branches stay shell-free, so the original Windows `.cmd`-shim problem is still avoided.

A shared helper, `scripts/package-manager.ts`:

```ts
/** Pair the invoking package manager with arguments so every host can spawn it without a shell. */

import { extname } from 'node:path'

/** A shell-free command and argument pair. */
export interface PackageManagerInvocation {
  /** Executable to spawn. */
  command: string
  /** Arguments passed to {@link PackageManagerInvocation.command}. */
  args: string[]
}

const JAVASCRIPT_ENTRYPOINTS = new Set(['.js', '.cjs', '.mjs'])

/** Pair one package manager entrypoint with its arguments. */
export function packageManagerInvocationFor(
  entrypoint: string,
  args: readonly string[],
): PackageManagerInvocation {
  // pnpm ships either a JavaScript entrypoint or a native executable; only the former can be loaded by Node.
  return JAVASCRIPT_ENTRYPOINTS.has(extname(entrypoint).toLowerCase())
    ? { command: process.execPath, args: [entrypoint, ...args] }
    : { command: entrypoint, args: [...args] }
}

/** Pair the package manager named by `npm_execpath` with its arguments. */
export function packageManagerInvocation(
  args: readonly string[],
  context: string,
): PackageManagerInvocation {
  const entrypoint = process.env.npm_execpath
  if (entrypoint === undefined || entrypoint === '') {
    throw new Error(`${context}: npm_execpath is unavailable; invoke the runner through a pnpm package script.`)
  }
  return packageManagerInvocationFor(entrypoint, args)
}
```

The four call sites then become one-liners, e.g. in `scripts/build.ts`:

```ts
const packageManager = packageManagerInvocation(['run', script], 'build')
const result = spawnSync(packageManager.command, packageManager.args, { … })
```

`CoverageCommand` needs one extra `command: string` field alongside its existing `args`, since `runCoverageCommand` currently hardcodes `process.execPath`. On a JS-entrypoint install every resolved command is byte-identical to today's, so CI behaviour is unchanged.

## Verification

On the environment above, after the change:

- `pnpm run build` → passes, `build: recorded 200 client artifact(s) with 1 public value(s)`
- `pnpm run typecheck:contracts-ready` → passes
- `oxlint scripts` → clean
- `vitest run scripts/coverage-partitions.spec.ts scripts/run-gates.spec.ts` → 67 passed, 1 skipped

discussions.title: [Bug报告] 工作区选择器在"阀"(U+9600) 处截断所选路径（低位字节为 0 的字符均受影响）
discussions.body:
# [Bug] 工作区选择器在"阀"(U+9600) 处截断所选路径

**环境**：Windows + `dsh web`（0.1.0-rc.5），通过原生 Win32 文件夹选择器（`host.pickDirectory`）选择工作区。

**复现步骤**：

1. 新建一个名称包含"阀"(U+9600) 的文件夹，例如 `D:\data\疏水阀数据\2025年`；
2. 在工作区选择器中选中该文件夹（或其下的任意文件夹）。

**预期结果**：注册的工作区路径等于所选完整路径。

**实际结果**：路径在第一个"阀"字处被截断——显示为 `D:\data\疏水`，"阀"及其后所有内容全部丢失。

**根因**：`packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-bindings.ts` 的 `readUtf16` 在查找 UTF-16 字符串的 NUL 终止符时，只检查每个编码单元的**低位字节**：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2
```

任何码点为 0x100 整数倍的 BMP 字符，其 UTF-16LE 编码的低位字节都是 0x00——例如 阀 (U+9600)、退 (U+9000)、耀 (U+8000)、怀 (U+6000)——扫描会在这里提前结束，该字符及其后的路径内容被丢弃。这正是阀门/蒸汽类数据的目录名含"阀"时必然触发的原因。

**修复方案**：改为检查完整的 16 位编码单元（Windows 路径不可能包含 U+0000，因此该判断是安全的）：

```ts
while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2
```

**回归测试**：已在 `tests/win32-dialog-bindings.spec.ts` 中加入含"阀"路径的用例（`C:\疏水阀数据\2025年\子目录`），包内测试全部通过（13 个）。

discussions.title: Bug: workspace directory picker throws 'crypto.randomUUID is not a function' over plain HTTP on an IP
discussions.body:
**Environment:** DSH `0.1.0-rc.5`, web UI served over plain HTTP on a LAN IP hostname (e.g. `http://<lan-ip>:3080`).

**Symptom:** Opening the workspace directory picker (Add workspace) fails with `crypto.randomUUID is not a function` and cannot list directories. Any typed RPC through `WebApiClient` — `host.listDirectory`, `host.pickDirectory`, `workspace.create` — fails the same way.

**Why:** `crypto.randomUUID` is a secure-context-only Web API; browsers expose it only on HTTPS or loopback origins. Over plain HTTP on a non-loopback IP, `window.isSecureContext === false` and `crypto.randomUUID` is `undefined`. `AbstractApiClient.mintRpcId()` in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts` calls it directly, so every unary call mints its rpcId there and throws on such an origin.

The generic RPC path (`packages/client/connection/src/client/rpc.ts`) is already safe — it uses `randomUuid()` from `random-uuid.ts`, an RFC 4122 v4 UUID built on `crypto.getRandomValues`, which browsers do expose on insecure origins. Only the typed carrier misses it.

**Proposed fix (one-liner):** `WebApiClient` (the browser subclass, `packages/client/connection/src/client/web-api-client.ts`) should override:

```ts
protected override mintRpcId(): RpcId {
  return RpcId(randomUuid())
}
```

Also worth hardening while touching this: `browserDraftAttachment` in `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/service.ts` uses `crypto.randomUUID()` for draft attachment ids — same failure on such an origin.

I verified the fix locally: the picker browses and selects a workspace over plain-HTTP-on-IP with zero console errors, with the existing test suite passing. Happy to adapt to whatever the team prefers once external PRs open up.

discussions.title: [Bug] dsh-base 4处硬编码付费API默认值，models:[] 仅隐藏UI不禁路由，用户无感产生DeepSeek账单
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中有 **4 处硬编码**将所有用户默认指向付费 DeepSeek API。即使用户通过 Models 页面隐藏 DeepSeek 模型（`llm-deepseek: models: []`），底层路由适配器仍然存活，`web_search` 等工具的调用会无感走付费端点。另有 1 处遥测端点默认未硬禁用。

**Severity: High** — 导致用户产生非预期付费调用，且用户无法通过现有 UI 完整规避。

**Affected Version:** `@deepseek-ai/dsh` v0.1.0-rc.7 + `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base`

---

## Root Cause

`dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml` 作为所有 profile（web/tui/headless）的共享基础层，其默认配置硬编码了付费端点。Cordis patch 层的 `models: []` 仅控制 UI picker 展示，**不等于禁用路由适配器**。这是两套独立机制：

| 机制 | 作用范围 | 效果 |
|------|----------|------|
| `llm-deepseek: models: []` (settings.yaml) | UI Models 页面 | 隐藏模型选项，用户看不到 |
| `llm-deepseek: disabled: true` (cordis patch) | Cordis Loader | 适配器不加载，路由不注册 |

用户通过 UI 隐藏模型后以为已切换，但适配器仍在后台解析 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 并注册路由，其他组件引用 `deepseek-official` 时仍可达。

---

## Detailed Findings

### F1: `agent-default-model` 默认走付费 (dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml Line 63-67)

```yaml
- id: agent-default-model
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
  config:
    provider: deepseek-official     # ← 付费
    model: deepseek-v4-flash        # ← 付费模型
影响：新建 Agent 未显式指定模型时，自动使用付费端点。
F2: web.searchProvider 默认走付费 (Line 404-407)
- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: deepseek-official  # ← 付费
影响：所有 web_search 工具调用直接走 api.deepseek.com/anthropic/v1/messages，消耗 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 额度。子 agent（如 subagent spawn）被授予 web_search 时同样受影响。
F3: web-search-deepseek 始终加载 (Line 409-412)
- id: web-search-deepseek
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-search-deepseek'
  config:
    apiKeyEnv: DEEPSEEK_API_KEY  # ← 自动解析用户 key
影响：搜索插件始终注册为 provider，配合 F2 形成"搜索→找 deepseek-official provider→用 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY→付费调用"的完整链路。用户在 settings 中设 models: [] 对此无影响。
F4: llm-deepseek 适配器始终加载 (Line 450-451)
- id: llm-deepseek
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek'
影响：无 disabled: true，适配器始终加载并注册路由。models: [] 仅让 Models 页不展示选项，但路由可达。当 agent-default-model 或 searchProvider 引用 deepseek-official 时，请求直接走此路由。
F5: session-telemetry-otel 遥测端点未硬禁用 (Line 148-154)
- id: session-telemetry-otel
  config:
    mode: !!js process.env.DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE || 'DISABLED'
    exporter:
      url: !!js process.env.DSH_TELEMETRY_OTLP_URL ?? 'https://harness-telemetry.deepseeksvc.com/v1/logs'
影响：默认 DISABLED，但无 disabled: true。若 DSH_TELEMETRY_MODE 环境变量被意外设置为非 DISABLED 值，会向 harness-telemetry.deepseeksvc.com 发送包含完整 session log 的遥测数据。
Impact Analysis
所有安装 DSH 并在 ~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml 中存储了 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 的用户，只要满足以下任一条件即产生付费调用：
1. 创建 Agent 未显式指定模型（触发 F1 → F4 链路）
2. 使用 web_search 工具（触发 F2 → F3 链路）
3. 子 agent 使用 web_search（同上）
账单不对齐的原因：账单是历史累计不区分会话；models: [] 让用户误以为已完全禁用，实际仅隐藏 UI。
Proposed Fix
方案 A：dsh-base 层修复（推荐，根本解决）
将 dsh-base 的默认值改为不默认依赖付费端点：
# dsh-base/cordis.patch.yml proposed changes

- id: agent-default-model
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-agent-default-model'
  config:
    provider: llm-deepseek
    model: deepseek-v4-flash
  # 当 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 不存在时应优雅降级，而非静默走付费

- id: web
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-web'
  config:
    searchProvider: ''  # 要求用户显式配置，而非默认付费
更彻底的方案：llm-deepseek 和 web-search-deepseek 在 DEEPSEEK_API_KEY 未配置时应自动 disabled，而非始终加载等待 key 解析。
方案 B：文档 + UI 提示（最小改动）
在 Models 页面添加明确提示：
"隐藏模型 ≠ 禁用路由。要彻底禁用 DeepSeek API 调用，请在 profile 的 cordis.patch.yml 中设置 llm-deepseek: disabled: true。"
方案 C：models: [] 语义增强
让 llm-deepseek: models: [] 在 settings 层也等效于 disabled: true，即空模型列表时自动禁用适配器加载。这是最符合用户直觉的方案，但需要修改 dsh-llm-deepseek 插件逻辑。
Workaround (Current User Fix)
用户可在 ~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml 中添加以下覆盖（已验证有效）：
- id: agent-default-model
  config:
    provider: nvidiaz
    model: nvidia/nemotron-3-ultra-550b-a55b

- id: llm-deepseek
  disabled: true

- id: web-search-deepseek
  disabled: true

- id: web
  config:
    searchProvider: pi-ai/opencodezen

- id: session-telemetry-otel
  disabled: true
Verification Steps
1. Settings → Models：deepseek-official 应消失或显示 "No models advertised"
2. 调用 web_search：不应产生 api.deepseek.com 流量（可抓包验证）
3. 新建 Agent：默认模型应为覆盖后的免费模型
4. DeepSeek 账单：次日应为 0
Environment
- OS: Windows 11
- DSH: v0.1.0-rc.7
- Node: v22.x
- Profile: web (primary), tui, headless

discussions.title: [Bug] Conversation fails to load: "conversation Context N:turn-tailM received an update before its start Match" (surface replacement copy ordering)
discussions.body:
## Environment

- dsh web `0.1.0-rc.7` (Windows 11; also reproduced with the same code on WSL)
- Happens when opening an existing session in the chat view

## Error

```
conversation Context 9:turn-tail8 received an update before its start Match
```

`9:turn-tail8` is the turn-tail business context for turn 8 (`kind="turn-tail"`, id `8`).

## Root cause

`ConversationNodeAssembler` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime` throws in three places
(`acceptMatch`, `applyPendingMatches`, `replayContext`) when a turn-tail **update** match
arrives before its **start** match.

Real session logs can contain **surface replacement copies** (`surfaceOp: {op:'replace', start, end}`)
whose ordering does not preserve turn boundaries: a replacement copy of an update
(`assistant/message`, turn N) can be emitted **before** the replacement copy of that turn's
`turn/start`. In our case: `assistant/message` (turn 8) at `seq 149006`, then `turn/start`
(turn 8) at `seq 149009` — both inside the same replacement range. Replaying the engine over
all stored sessions reproduced the crash in 3 of 31 sessions (turn-tail 2 / 8 / 13).

## Minimal reproduction

Two sanitized events are enough (see `repro-events.json`): feed them **in seq order** to
`ConversationNodeAssembler.replaceWindow()` with the turn-tail Definition registered
(the Definition is copied verbatim from `dsh-client-ui-conversation`).

```js
[
  {
    "seq": 101,
    "type": "assistant/message",
    "data": { "turn": 8, "step": 0, "message": { "content": [] } },
    "surfaceOp": { "op": "replace", "start": 1, "end": 99 },
    "sourceEventSeqs": [1, 98, 99]
  },
  {
    "seq": 102,
    "type": "turn/start",
    "data": { "turn": 8 }
  }
]
```

Run the included `repro.mjs` against a checkout of `dsh-client-runtime`:

```bash
node repro.mjs path/to/dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js
```

- Unpatched runtime: `✅ BUG REPRODUCED: conversation Context 9:turn-tail8 received an update before its start Match`
- Patched runtime (workaround.patch applied): `✅ OK: no crash`

## Impact

Any session whose surface replacement range splits a turn can fail to load in the chat view.
This is data-driven (old/compacted sessions), not caused by any plugin.

## Suggested fix

Either:

1. Make the engine tolerate out-of-order start: when a start match arrives after earlier
   matches, move it to `matches[0]` instead of throwing (same in `applyPendingMatches` /
   `replayContext`); or
2. Ensure replacement copies are emitted in turn-boundary order (`turn/start` before updates
   of the same turn).

## Local workaround

`workaround.patch` implements option 1 against `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js`
(three guard points; validated by replaying all 31 sessions: 0 failures, no behavior change
for well-ordered sessions).

---

_Note: real session logs are intentionally NOT attached because they contain private
conversation content. The synthetic events above reproduce the bug exactly._
[repro-events.json](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31233496/repro-events.json)
