discussions.title: [Bug] [Update] Orphan agent/inbox/spliced splits log validity from session readability — impact upgrade: a routine post-incident repair can produce a durably intact but unreadable session (self-review of our own bug report)
discussions.body:
### Self-review update — correction of our own submitted bug report / 自我修正：对本人提交的 bug report 的修正 (2026-08-22)

**⚠️ This is a self-review of the bug report we submitted.** The original report described the failure as "the conversation UI hard-fails (blank paging)" — a UI-level symptom. After re-reading the engine source, we are **upgrading** the report to the layer where the defect actually lives: **one log, two consumers, two verdicts**. The same session log containing an orphan `agent/inbox/spliced` is declared **valid** by the persistence layer and **unreadable** by the session history consumption path. That split — not the blank page — is the defect.

> **TL;DR — EN:** We originally reported "the conversation UI hard-fails (blank paging) on orphan `agent/inbox/spliced` ops with no insert." Upgrade: a log containing an orphan removal (`removedCount > 0`, no preceding `inserted`) is accepted by the persistence layer (`foldSurface()` passes; seq contiguous; JSON valid), yet the same log consumed by the session history path renders only up to the orphan op and returns empty pages for everything after — with no error surfaced. The inbox state machine's own reducer intends this tolerance (`applySplice`, `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113`, safe defaults like `removedCount ?? 0`), but the consumption-side fold has no matching guard (`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592` guards structure only) — the intended semantics do not hold end-to-end. The logs most likely to contain this state are exactly the ones produced by torn writes, crashes, or manual repair, so a routine post-incident recovery can silently produce a session that is durably intact yet unreadable.

> **一句话（中文）：** 这是对**本人提交的 bug report** 的自我修正（升级）。原报告把故障描述为"对话 UI 硬失败（空白分页）"——那只是症状。重审源码后升级到缺陷真正所在的层：**同一份日志，两个消费方，两种结论**。含孤儿 `agent/inbox/spliced`（`removedCount > 0`、前面没有 `inserted`）的日志，被持久化层判定为**合法**（`foldSurface()` 通过、seq 连续、JSON 合法），却被会话历史消费路径判定为**不可读**——只渲染到孤儿操作之前、其后全部空页、无任何报错。inbox 状态机自己的 reducer 本意容忍此情形（`applySplice`，`dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113`，安全默认如 `removedCount ?? 0`），但消费侧 fold 没有同款守卫（`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592` 只守卫结构）——意图语义未能端到端兑现。最可能包含此状态的日志，恰恰是 torn write、崩溃或手工修复产生的那些，因此一次例行的事故后恢复可能静默产出"数据完好但不可读"的会话。

**What we originally claimed / 初版表述 (EN):** the conversation UI hard-fails (blank paging) on orphan `agent/inbox/spliced` ops with no insert; no data loss on disk, total loss of UI access.  
**What we now state / 现修正 (EN):** upgraded to the log/state-machine layer — one log is declared valid by the persistence layer and unreadable by the session history consumption path; the inbox state machine's tolerance intent (visible in `applySplice`) does not hold end-to-end; the split sits exactly on the post-incident recovery path, so a routine repair can silently produce a durably intact but unreadable session.

**初版表述（中文）：** 孤儿 `agent/inbox/spliced` 撤回操作（无对应插入）导致对话 UI 渲染中断、分页空白；磁盘数据未丢，但 UI 完全无法访问。  
**现修正（中文）：** 升级到日志/状态机层——同一份日志被持久化层判定合法、却被会话历史消费路径判定不可读；inbox 状态机的容错意图（`applySplice` 可见）未能端到端兑现；分裂恰好落在事故后恢复路径上，因此一次例行修复可能静默产出"数据完好但不可读"的会话。

---

## EN / English

### Version note / 版本说明

Source references were verified on `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.7` and re-verified on `0.1.1-rc.2` — module internals unchanged, line numbers shifted:

- `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`: `applySplice` now at `:8558-8568` (was `:8103-8113`).
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js`: the conversation fold/assembler now at `:6358-6590` (was `:6345-6592`); structural guards at `:6543` / `:6567` / `:6568` (was `:6548` / `:6572` / `:6573`); the history-error swallow now at `:7414` (was `:7418-7419`).

### Observed behavior

A session log containing an `agent/inbox/spliced` event with `removedCount > 0` but **no preceding `inserted`** (an orphan removal) is accepted by the persistence layer — `foldSurface()` passes, seq stays contiguous, JSON is valid. The **same log**, consumed by the session history path, renders only up to the orphan op and returns empty pages for everything after — with no error surfaced (consumption errors are swallowed with a console-only log, `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7418-7419`).

One log, two consumers, two verdicts: **"valid"** (persistence) and **"unreadable"** (history consumption). The blank-page symptom is real; the defect is the split itself.

### State-machine mechanism (with source references)

- **The tolerance was intended.** The inbox reducer `applySplice` (`dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113`) is written to be safe by default — `removedCount ?? 0`, `pending.splice(...)` against a possibly-empty array. An orphan removal is anticipated and tolerated at the reducer level.
- **The same state machine has no matching guard downstream.** The consumption-side fold/assembler (`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592`) guards structural violations only — duplicate starts (`:6548`), out-of-order appends (`:6572`), updates before a start (`:6573`) — with no guard for "removed identities that were never inserted."
- The intended semantics of the inbox state machine therefore do not hold end-to-end: the reducer tolerates, the consumption path does not.

### Impact scope (upgraded — log / session / business / recovery path)

- **Log layer:** the trigger state is the residue of real incidents — a torn write on shutdown, a crash mid-append, or a manual repair after an outage. It is not an exotic input; it is what production incidents produce.
- **Session layer:** durable records are intact and yet the session is not reproducible — "the data is there, but the session cannot be restored." The split between log validity and session readability is the core hazard.
- **Business layer:** post-incident recovery is a routine operation and is trusted; this defect makes the repair path itself silently produce a zombie session, hiding the progress that survived the incident. Recovery tooling cannot report whether a repair actually succeeded.
- The only fixes today are data-layer operations (e.g. setting `removedCount` to `0` by manual log editing).

### Expected behavior

The inbox state machine must have **one semantics across all consumers**: "removedCount against identities never inserted" must be a no-op everywhere (or surface a visible warning) — the reducer already does this, the consumption path must too. Data-layer strictness and consumption-layer tolerance must be aligned, and any alignment failure must surface as an error, never a silent blank.

### Repro

1. Have a session log with an `agent/inbox/spliced` containing `removedCount: 1` and no matching insert (can be produced by truncating the log between an insert and its removal).
2. Open the session; read earlier history → empty pages, no error.
3. Verification of causality: set `removedCount` to `0` → rendering and paging fully restored.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- Also verified on: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`
- Session format: multi-frame zstd JSONL, strict contiguous seq

### Evidence (sanitized + source)

```
seq 199843: {"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","data":{"target":"next-turn","start":0,"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]}}
   ^ orphan: removedCount=1 but inbox is empty (no prior inserted)
```

- `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113` — `applySplice`: intended tolerance (`removedCount ?? 0`, safe splice on empty pending).
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592` — consumption fold/assembler: structural guards only; no orphan-removal guard.
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7418-7419` — consumption errors are swallowed silently (console only).

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 版本说明

源码引用在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.7` 上验证，并在 `0.1.1-rc.2` 上重新验证——模块内部逻辑未变，行号有偏移：

- `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js`：`applySplice` 现位于 `:8558-8568`（原 `:8103-8113`）。
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js`：对话 fold/assembler 现位于 `:6358-6590`（原 `:6345-6592`）；结构性守卫位于 `:6543` / `:6567` / `:6568`（原 `:6548` / `:6572` / `:6573`）；历史错误吞掉现位于 `:7414`（原 `:7418-7419`）。

### 现象

含有 `agent/inbox/spliced` 事件（`removedCount > 0`、**前面没有对应的 `inserted`**，即孤儿撤回）的会话日志，被持久化层接受——`foldSurface()` 通过、seq 连续、JSON 合法。**同一份日志**，被会话历史消费路径处理时，只渲染到孤儿操作之前，其后全部空页——且无任何报错（消费错误被吞掉、仅 console，`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7418-7419`）。

同一份日志、两个消费方、两种结论：**"合法"**（持久化）与**"不可读"**（历史消费）。空白页症状真实存在；缺陷是分裂本身。

### 状态机机制（附源码引用）

- **容错本是有意的。** inbox reducer `applySplice`（`dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113`）按默认安全编写——`removedCount ?? 0`、对可能为空的数组做 `pending.splice(...)`。孤儿撤回在 reducer 层是被预见并容忍的。
- **同一个状态机在下游没有同款守卫。** 消费侧 fold/assembler（`dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592`）只守卫结构性违规——重复 start（`:6548`）、乱序追加（`:6572`）、start 之前 update（`:6573`）——对"撤回从未插入过的身份"没有任何守卫。
- 因此 inbox 状态机的意图语义未能端到端兑现：reducer 容忍，消费路径不容忍。

### 影响范围（升级 —— 日志 / 会话 / 业务 / 恢复路径）

- **日志层：** 触发状态是真实事故的残留物——关机 torn write、追加中途崩溃、故障后手工修复。它不是奇异输入，而是生产事故真实产生的东西。
- **会话层：** 持久化记录完好、但会话不可复现——"数据在，但会话无法恢复"。日志合法性与会话可读性之间的分裂是核心危害。
- **业务层：** 事故后恢复是例行操作、且被信任；此缺陷让修复路径本身静默产出僵尸会话，遮蔽事故中幸存的进度。恢复工具无法报告"修复是否真的成功"。
- 当前唯一出路是数据层操作（如手工把 `removedCount` 改为 `0`）。

### 期望行为

inbox 状态机必须在**所有消费方**上语义一致："对从未插入过的身份执行 removedCount"在所有地方都应是空操作（或给出可见警告）——reducer 已经做到，消费路径也必须做到。数据层的严格与消费层的容错应当对齐，任何对齐失败必须以错误形式暴露，绝不允许静默空白。

### 复现步骤

1. 构造一个包含 `agent/inbox/spliced`（`removedCount: 1`、无匹配插入）的会话日志（在"插入"与"撤回"之间截断即可产生）。
2. 打开会话，读取更早历史 → 空页，无报错。
3. 因果验证：把 `removedCount` 改为 `0` → 渲染与分页完全恢复。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- 另已在：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` 上验证
- 会话格式：多帧 zstd JSONL，seq 严格连续

### 证据（脱敏 + 源码）

```
seq 199843: {"type":"agent/inbox/spliced","data":{"target":"next-turn","start":0,"removedCount":1,"inserted":[]}}
   ^ 孤儿：removedCount=1 但 inbox 为空（前面没有 inserted）
```

- `dsh-client-ui-conversation/lib/client.js:8103-8113` —— `applySplice`：意图宽容（`removedCount ?? 0`、对空 pending 安全 splice）。
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:6345-6592` —— 消费侧 fold/assembler：只有结构性守卫，没有孤儿撤回守卫。
- `dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js:7418-7419` —— 消费错误被静默吞掉（仅 console）。

---

### Original report (archived for transparency) / 初版报告（归档保留）

discussions.title: [Bug] [Update] Missing session-level lock silently corrupts shared-home deployments — impact upgrade: any multi-writer topology destroys the durable work record (self-review of our own bug report)
discussions.body:
### Self-review update — correction of our own submitted bug report / 自我修正：对本人提交的 bug report 的修正 (2026-08-22)

**⚠️ This is a self-review of the bug report we submitted.** The original report was accurate but under-stated the impact. After re-reading the engine source, we are **upgrading** the assessment: the defect is confirmed, and it is broader than "two instances by accident" — the engine coordinates writers **within one process only** (an in-process coordinator), and the durable file backend appends with **no lock and no writer detection** (`open(path, "a")`). Any topology with more than one writer against a shared home — an interactive session plus a background/scheduled job, or multiple processes in parallel — is unsafe *by design*, and the corruption is silent and durable.

> **TL;DR — EN:** We originally reported "two running instances silently corrupt the same session log." Upgrade: the single-writer assumption is a deliberate design (writers are coordinated in-process only — `dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`, `:55`), but **nothing enforces it at the durable layer**: the file backend opens the log in plain append mode with no lock, no exclusive flag, and no foreign-writer detection (`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1200-1227`, `open(path, "a")` at `:1203`). A second process writing the same log is undetected until the session is already corrupt, with no warning at launch or at write time. For any deployment that schedules or multiplies agent processes against a shared home, the entire history — the progress/audit record — can be silently destroyed.

> **一句话（中文）：** 这是对**本人提交的 bug report** 的自我修正（升级）。原报告准确但低估了影响：单写者假设是明确设计（写者只在**进程内**协调——`dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`、`:55`），但**持久化层没有任何强制手段**：文件后端以纯追加模式打开日志，无锁、无排他标志、无外部写者检测（`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1200-1227`，`:1203` 的 `open(path, "a")`）。第二个进程写入同一日志，直到会话已损坏才会被发现，启动与写入时均无警告。任何把 agent 进程调度化/多开并共享主目录的部署，其全部历史——进度/审计记录——都可能被静默摧毁。

**What we originally claimed / 初版表述 (EN):** no session-level locking; two running instances silently corrupt the same session log; permanent loss of UI access; manual recovery required.  
**What we now state / 现修正 (EN):** confirmed, and upgraded — the single-writer model is intentional but **only enforced in-process**; the durable layer has no lock and no writer detection, so *any* multi-writer topology (interactive + scheduled job, parallel processes) is unsafe by design; corruption is silent and durable, destroying the entire progress/audit record; the engine gives operators no signal until it is too late.

**初版表述（中文）：** 无会话级锁；两个运行实例并发写同一会话日志、静默损坏；会话永久失去 UI 访问；需要手工恢复。  
**现修正（中文）：** 确凿，且升级——单写者模型是有意设计，但**只在进程内强制**；持久化层无锁、无写者检测，因此*任何*多写入者拓扑（交互+调度任务、多进程并行）在设计上都不安全；损坏静默且持久，摧毁整份进度/审计记录；引擎在为时已晚之前不会给运维任何信号。

---

## EN / English

### Observed behavior

When two dsh instances run against the same `~/.dsh` home (e.g. an interactive session and a background/scheduled process sharing the home), both instances append to the same `session.jsonl.zstd` with **independent seq counters**. The result is duplicated seq ranges written out of order — **violating the session log's core invariant of strictly monotonic, contiguous seq** — and the session becomes permanently unreadable:

```
corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line N (expected X, got Y)
```

Confirmed empirically: a session repaired minutes earlier was corrupted again solely by the second instance writing.

### Root cause — the single-writer assumption is in-process only

The engine *does* coordinate writers — but **within one process**. `dsh-session-persistence` ships a per-coordinator registry with exclusive reservation of unpublished sessions (`dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`, `:55`, `:167`). That protects one process from itself.

The durable file backend, however, has **no cross-process protection**: `appendLines` opens the log in plain append mode — `open(path, "a")` (`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1203`) — writes and fsyncs (`:1211-1214`), with rollback only on its *own* write failure (`:1215-1223`). There is no lock file, no `O_EXCL`, no inode/seq validation against a foreign writer, and no startup check for another process holding the home.

So the single-writer model is a deliberate design (in-process coordinator) whose durable enforcement is **absent**. A second writer is undetected at launch and at write time; corruption is only discovered later, and only as a read error.

### Impact scope (upgraded — production / progress / scheduling)

- **Any multi-writer topology is unsafe by design**: an interactive session plus a background/scheduled job sharing one home; several processes in parallel; any deployment where more than one writer can reach the same home. For deployments that schedule or multiply agent processes, this is a realistic operational topology, not an accident.
- **The corruption is silent and durable**: duplicated seq ranges are written out of order, the session becomes permanently unreadable, and nothing warns at launch or at write time. The entire history — the progress/audit record of the work — is destroyed, and the only recovery is manual log surgery.
- **The blast radius is the whole home**: because seq counters are per-instance, the conflict is not confined to one session — every session the two instances touch in parallel is at risk.

### Expected behavior

- Per-session (or per-home) **durable locking**: a second writer should refuse to write, or detect the conflict and recover.
- At minimum, a **write-time writer check** (validate the file's last seq/inode against the instance's own counter before appending) and a **startup warning** when the home appears to be in use by another process.

### Repro

1. Start one instance (engine loads `~/.dsh/sessions`).
2. Start a second instance while the first is still running.
3. Continue a conversation in one instance for a few minutes.
4. The shared session log now contains duplicated/out-of-order seq → `seq gap`, history unavailable.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`, same `~/.dsh` home.
- Also verified on: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`
- Confirmed empirically: a session repaired minutes earlier was corrupted again solely by the second instance writing.

### Evidence (sanitized + source)

```
line 37058: expected seq 693898, got 683973   <- duplicated range from the second writer
```

- `dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`, `:55`, `:167` — in-process coordinator: exclusive reservation and write rejection **within one process only**.
- `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1200-1227` — `appendLines`: `open(path, "a")` (`:1203`), write + fsync, rollback only on own failure; **no lock, no exclusive flag, no foreign-writer detection**.

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 现象

当两个 dsh 实例共用同一个 `~/.dsh` 主目录（例如交互会话与一个后台/调度进程共享主目录）时，两个实例会以**各自独立的 seq 计数器**向同一个 `session.jsonl.zstd` 追加内容。结果：重复的 seq 段乱序写入——**破坏会话日志"seq 严格单调连续"的核心不变量**——会话永久不可读：

```
corrupt session log: seq gap in committed region at line N (expected X, got Y)
```

实测实证：刚修复好的会话，仅因第二个实例写入而再次损坏。

### 根因 —— 单写者假设只在进程内成立

引擎**确实**协调写者——但只在**单个进程内**。`dsh-session-persistence` 带有一个按 coordinator 组织的注册表，对未发布会话做排他保留（`dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`、`:55`、`:167`）。这保护的是"一个进程不和自己打架"。

而持久化文件后端**没有跨进程保护**：`appendLines` 以纯追加模式打开日志——`open(path, "a")`（`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1203`）——写入并 fsync（`:1211-1214`），只在*自身*写失败时回滚（`:1215-1223`）。没有锁文件、没有 `O_EXCL`、没有针对外部写者的 inode/seq 校验、也没有启动时对"另一进程正持有该主目录"的检查。

所以，单写者模型是有意设计（进程内 coordinator），但它的持久化强制手段**缺失**。第二个写者在启动时、写入时都不会被发现；损坏只在事后以读错误的形式暴露。

### 影响范围（升级 —— 生产 / 进度 / 调度）

- **任何多写入者拓扑在设计上都不安全**：交互会话与后台/调度任务共用一个主目录；多个进程并行；任何"多于一个写者可达同一主目录"的部署。对把 agent 进程调度化/多开的部署，这是现实的操作拓扑，不是意外。
- **损坏静默且持久**：重复 seq 段乱序写入、会话永久不可读，启动与写入时均无警告。全部历史——工作的进度/审计记录——被摧毁，唯一恢复途径是手工外科手术式编辑日志。
- **爆炸半径是整片主目录**：seq 计数器按实例独立，冲突不限于单个会话——两个实例并行触碰的每一个会话都处于风险中。

### 期望行为

- 会话级（或主目录级）**持久化锁**：第二个写者应拒绝写入，或检测到冲突并自动恢复。
- 至少要有**写入时的写者检查**（追加前校验文件末尾 seq/inode 与本实例计数一致）和**启动时警告**（主目录疑似被另一进程占用）。

### 复现步骤

1. 启动第一个实例（引擎加载 `~/.dsh/sessions`）。
2. 在第一个实例仍运行时启动第二个实例。
3. 在任一实例中继续对话几分钟。
4. 共享的会话日志出现重复/乱序 seq → `seq gap`，历史不可用。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`，同一 `~/.dsh` 主目录。
- 另已在：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` 上验证
- 实测实证：刚修复好的会话，仅因第二个实例写入而再次损坏。

### 证据（脱敏 + 源码）

```
line 37058: expected seq 693898, got 683973   <- 来自第二个写入者的重复 seq 段
```

- `dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:17-20`、`:55`、`:167` —— 进程内 coordinator：排他保留与写入拒绝**仅在同一进程内生效**。
- `dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1200-1227` —— `appendLines`：`open(path, "a")`（`:1203`）、写入 + fsync、仅在自身失败时回滚；**无锁、无排他标志、无外部写者检测**。

---

### Original report (archived for transparency) / 初版报告（归档保留）

> 以下为初版表述（被上方"自我修正"升级）。保留以透明展示我们修正了什么。

#### EN

**Observed behavior (original).** When two dsh instances run against the same `~/.dsh` home (e.g. desktop shell + `dsh web`) and the user continues a conversation, both instances append to the same `session.jsonl.zstd` with independent seq counters. The result is duplicated seq ranges written out of order, and the session becomes permanently unreadable.

**Impact scope (original).** Permanent loss of UI access to sessions (history unavailable); manual recovery required. Silent — no warning at launch or at write time; corruption is only discovered later. Realistic scenario: user opens the desktop app and a `dsh web` session without realizing they share `~/.dsh`.

#### 中文

**现象（初版）。** 当两个 dsh 实例共用同一个 `~/.dsh` 主目录，用户在其中任一实例继续对话时，两个实例会以各自独立的 seq 计数器向同一个 `session.jsonl.zstd` 追加内容。结果：重复的 seq 段乱序写入，会话永久不可读。

**影响范围（初版）。** 会话永久失去 UI 访问（历史不可用），需要手工恢复。静默发生——启动时、写入时都没有警告，用户事后才发现损坏。真实场景：用户同时开着桌面应用和一个 `dsh web`，不知道它们共用 `~/.dsh`。

---

## 署名 / About this report

**EN:** Reported by the **OfferKuai (Offer快) Team** — an AI startup building full-lifecycle job-application services, guided by the belief that *"users need results, not repeated conversations."* Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. We use DeepSeek Harness as part of our daily development workflow; this report is our way of contributing back to the ecosystem. Website: <https://www.offerkuai.com/> | Contact: <[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

**ZH:** 本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 一家专注 AI 全流程求职托管的创业团队，核心理念是「用户要的是结果，不是重复对话」。创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。我们将 DeepSeek Harness 用于日常开发工作流，这份报告是我们对社区的回馈。官网：<https://www.offerkuai.com/> | 联系：<[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

discussions.title: 极简模式grep等命令卡死问题复现以及解决方案
discussions.body:
## 问题表现
表象：极简模式执行grep或者rg的时候，命令卡死。

例如：`rg --files -g '!node_modules' -g '!frontend/node_modules' -g '!backend' .`

这个命令手动运行是ok的，标准模式也是ok的。

真实原因：见复现章节


## 版本信息
- dsh版本: 0.1.0-rc.7、0.1.0-rc.8 均存在此问题
- macos 15.7.4 (24G517)
- bash: GNU bash, version 3.2.57(1)-release (arm64-apple-darwin24)


## 问题复现
1. 极简模式（而非标准模式）
2. 告诉agent: 你跑一下 echo '!foo' 验证一下shell功能
3. 你会看到卡死


## 问题解决
解决方案由deepseek flash v4 0731提供，由我编译验证。

packages/shell/tool-bash-persistent/src/index.ts

```ts
// before:
const setup = ctx.terminals.startSend(owner, spawned.sessionId, {
  text: 'stty -echo',
  submit: true,
  signal: combinedSignal,
})

// after:
const setup = ctx.terminals.startSend(owner, spawned.sessionId, {
  text: 'stty -echo; set +H', // here modified
  submit: true,
  signal: combinedSignal,
})
```

discussions.title: crypto.randomUUID is unavailable on non-secure contexts, breaking the Web UI over plain-HTTP LAN/Tailscale access
discussions.body:
## 问题摘要

When the dsh Web UI is served over **plain HTTP from a non-loopback address** (LAN IP, Tailscale IP, or a hostname), the frontend crashes on every RPC, because `crypto.randomUUID` only exists in **secure contexts** (HTTPS, `http://localhost`, `http://127.0.0.1`). Symptom: the page shell loads, but workspaces/sessions/models never render — the workspace selector spins forever ("正在加载工作区"), and the console reports:

```
crypto.randomUUID is not a function. (In 'crypto.randomUUID()', 'crypto.randomUUID' is undefined)
```

## Root cause

Several boot-critical paths call `crypto.randomUUID()` with no fallback:

- `mintRpcId()` in the connection client (`packages/client/connection`): `return RpcId(crypto.randomUUID())` — every unary `/api` call mints an rpc id, so on insecure origins **every request throws** before it is sent.
- `createMessage(...)` / message ids: `MessageId(crypto.randomUUID())`.
- `browserDraftAttachment(...)` in `dsh-client-ui-conversation` (image drafts).

Note that `crypto.getRandomValues` **is** available on insecure origins — only `randomUUID` is gated to secure contexts — so an RFC 4122 v4 fallback built on `getRandomValues` is trivial.

## Repro

1. Serve the Web UI on a LAN interface (the CLI intentionally rejects `--host 0.0.0.0`, but the `webserver` row's config schema accepts it; a port forward / reverse proxy from loopback reproduces it too).
2. From another machine (or the same machine using the LAN IP instead of 127.0.0.1), open `http://<ip>:3080`.
3. DevTools console shows the error above; session/workspace list never loads.

Loopback access (`http://127.0.0.1:3080`) is unaffected because loopback is a secure context.

## Suggested fix

- Install a tiny `crypto.randomUUID` polyfill (UUID v4 via `crypto.getRandomValues`) early in the client bundle when the API is missing, and/or
- give `mintRpcId` and message-id creation a fallback that does not depend on `crypto.randomUUID` (e.g. `getRandomValues`-based v4).

A reference for the same class of fix: openai/openai-agents-js PR #510 ("add fallback when crypto.randomUUID is unavailable").

## Context / impact

This looks like the same root cause the community has already been working around this week — e.g. `AcidGr/dsh-web-lan-access` injects a polyfill via the official `webServer.tapIndex` extension point, and `@visol-456/dsh-web-compat` does it from a client bundle. Given that the CLI says `0.0.0.0` binding is "intentionally not supported **yet**", plain-HTTP LAN/Tailscale serving is clearly a direction the product wants to support — fixing the fallback upstream would make it work out of the box and let those workarounds go away.

## Environment

- dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.6`
- Node v22, macOS; reproduced in desktop Chrome and mobile Safari (iOS).

discussions.title: Bug: profile agent-presets custom roots get overwritten by the shipped root after restart
discussions.body:
## 问题

Profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `agent-presets` 配置了自定义 `roots`（例如工作区共享的 preset 目录）后，静态配置组合（`dsh --dump-config`）显示正确，但**实际启动后 Web 界面的 Agent 预设选择器里，所有自定义 preset 都不见了**，只剩 4 个 shipped 预设。

## 根因

`apps/cli/src/profile-boot.ts` 的 `composeProfile()` 在给 `agent-presets` 注入 app 自有的 shipped preset 目录时，用了整体替换而不是追加：

```ts
if (rows.has('agent-presets')) {
  composedOverlays.push({
    id: 'agent-presets',
    config: {
      ...(rows.get('agent-presets')?.config ?? {}) as Record<string, unknown>,
      roots: [{ path: SHIPPED_PRESET_ROOT, trust: 'system' }],
    },
  })
}
```

这一行 `roots: [{ path: SHIPPED_PRESET_ROOT, trust: 'system' }]` 把用户 patch 层已经组合好的 `roots` 数组整个覆盖掉，只剩 shipped root 这一条。而 `dsh --dump-config`（`apps/cli/src/dump-config.ts`）走的是另一条不含这段 overlay 的路径，所以静态 dump 显示正常，实际 boot（`runProfile` → `composeProfile`）却把用户配置的 roots 吞掉了。

## 复现

1. `~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml` 里给 `agent-presets` 配置：
   ```yaml
   - id: agent-presets
     config:
       default: standard
       roots:
         - path: /path/to/shared/presets
           trust: user
       includeUserRoot: true
   ```
2. `dsh --profile <profile> --dump-config` 能看到这条 roots 配置正确保留。
3. 启动 `dsh <profile>`，Web 界面 Agent 预设下拉里，`/path/to/shared/presets` 下的自定义 preset 全部不可见（`ctx.agentPresets.roots` 运行时读到的只有 shipped root + `.agent-presets` user root）。

## 已验证的修复

把整体替换改成追加（shipped root 在前，保留部署优先级；配置 roots 追加在后）：

```ts
export function prependShippedAgentPresetRoot(config: Record<string, unknown>): PatchOptions {
  const configuredRoots = config.roots
  if (configuredRoots !== undefined && !Array.isArray(configuredRoots)) {
    throw new TypeError('dsh: agent-presets config.roots must be an array')
  }
  return {
    id: 'agent-presets',
    config: {
      ...config,
      roots: [
        { path: SHIPPED_PRESET_ROOT, trust: 'system' },
        ...(configuredRoots ?? []),
      ],
    },
  }
}
```

本地验证：修复前 Web 界面预设下拉只有 4 个 shipped 预设；应用修复并重启后，14 个自定义 workspace 预设全部正常出现，且 shipped 预设仍保持 id 冲突时的优先级。

分支（含测试）：`fix/preserve-profile-agent-preset-roots`，在我的 fork：https://github.com/ankye/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/preserve-profile-agent-preset-roots

了解到目前不接受外部 PR，先在这里报告，供团队参考评估是否采纳类似修复。

discussions.title: [feature request]dsh web ui composer panel‘s folding function
discussions.body:
## 1. 场景与问题

在使用DSH Web时，当需要用户确认时，会在对话底部弹出一张**占位卡片**，取代输入框，并根据需要审批确认的内容大小决定其高度。当需要审批确认的内容文字很多时，其高度会占用超过50%的对话可视区。

这个不可折叠的审批卡片的遮挡会使得在审批前查看模型的思考内容以及中间输出的体验变差。

## 2. 功能请求

为PlanReviewPanel和ApprovalPanel等会遮挡对话可视区的不可折叠的卡片加上可折叠功能。

discussions.title: Trace Compare & Live Maze — see how your agent actually explored (main path, detours, backtracks, subagent branches)
discussions.body:
Every agent session is a maze run: the model commits to a path, hits dead ends, backtracks, retries. The transcript shows you *what* it said — not *where it wandered*. I built a plugin that draws the wandering.

![Product tour: live maze growing in real time, then the compare walkthrough](https://github.com/lamost423/dsh-trace-compare/releases/download/v0.5.2/product-intro.gif)

**Two surfaces:**

- **Trace Compare** — upload 1 session log for a single-run maze, or 2 logs for a same-axis comparison (e.g. flash vs pro on the same task): per-turn alignment lines, manual anchors, and a per-turn detour inventory that tallies which run wasted more time where.
- **Live Maze** — a per-session tab where the same maze grows in real time; since v0.4.0, subagent child sessions fold in as branch nodes on the parent's timeline (spawn point, the child's own tool calls as sub-bars, live growth while running).

**Honesty rules I care about:** verdicts are deterministic and explainable (no LLM judging) — error flags → failure signatures (head/tail windows only, so error text *quoted* in a git log doesn't count as a failure) → per-tool-class rules, plus behavioral blind-retry detection borrowed from AgentLens-style waste analysis. Every verdict shows its rationale on hover. Tokens are read from `assistant/message` usage, not stream-chunk counts. Idle gaps fold; everything else stays wall-clock.

**New in v0.5.0:** the whole UI is bilingual (en/中文) and live-follows your dsh language setting — verdicts are stored as language-neutral structured keys, so switching languages re-renders instantly without re-parsing.

Already listed in [awesome-deepseek-harness](https://github.com/Dominic789654/awesome-deepseek-harness) (Visualization) and [Awesome DSH Plugins](https://github.com/bruc3van/awesome-dsh-plugin).

**Install** (rc.6–rc.8 verified, tracked per rc):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-trace-compare
```

Repo (docs in EN/中文): https://github.com/lamost423/dsh-trace-compare

Feedback very welcome — especially session logs where the verdict rules get something wrong; the thresholds live in one `VERDICT_RULES` constant and I calibrate against real corpora.

一句话中文版：把智能体真实的探索过程画出来——主干、失败支路、折返点、子代理支路，全部落在同一根墙钟时间轴上；支持双会话同轴对比与会话内实时生长。仓库 README 即中文文档（English

discussions.title: Web client connection fails on plain-HTTP (non-loopback) deployments — crypto.randomUUID is undefined in insecure contexts
discussions.body:
## Web client connection fails on plain-HTTP (non-loopback) deployments — `crypto.randomUUID` is undefined in insecure contexts

### Summary

When the web UI is served over plain HTTP on a non-localhost address (e.g. `http://<server-ip>:8080`), the app shell renders but **no workspaces, sessions, or any baseline data ever loads**. The connection loop retries forever; `host.describe` / `session.list` / `workspace.list` are never sent. Works fine on `127.0.0.1` or HTTPS.

### Root cause

`crypto.randomUUID()` is only exposed in *secure contexts* (HTTPS or loopback origins). On plain HTTP from a public/private IP it is `undefined`.

- `AbstractApiClient.mintRpcId()` (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts`) calls it directly, so **every unary API call throws before the request is sent** — the readiness handshake (`host.describe`) never happens and the connection never establishes.
- The generic RPC channel already has the correct fallback: `randomUuid()` in `packages/client/connection/src/client/random-uuid.ts` (built on `crypto.getRandomValues`, available in all contexts) — the api client just doesn't use it.
- Same issue in `browserDraftAttachment` (`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/service.ts`, `DraftAttachmentId`).

### Environment

Verified on `0.1.0-rc.6` and `0.1.0-rc.8` (npm), served over plain HTTP on a public IP, behind nginx. Any plain-HTTP non-loopback deployment is affected.

### Steps to reproduce

1. Deploy `dsh web --trusted-host <public-ip>` on a server without TLS.
2. Open `http://<public-ip>:8080` in a browser (Chrome/Firefox — any non-loopback origin).
3. Observe: shell renders, but connection retries forever; no sessions/workspaces appear. DevTools console shows an error thrown from `mintRpcId()` (`crypto.randomUUID is not a function` / "undefined").
4. Compare with `http://127.0.0.1:8080` or HTTPS — works.

### Expected behavior

The web client connects on any plain-HTTP deployment.

### Proposed fix

- `mintRpcId()` falls back to a `getRandomValues`-based v4 UUID (mirroring the RPC channel's `randomUuid()`).
- `browserDraftAttachment` uses the same fallback.

This is a small, self-contained fix; happy to provide a patch/diff if useful. Thank you for the great project!

discussions.title: 会话管理补全：生命周期控制 + 会话信箱（两个 RFC，求反馈与投票）/ Completing session management: lifecycle controls + session mailbox (two RFCs, feedback and votes welcome)
discussions.body:
---

大家好。我想提出两个互补的 RFC，合起来把"会话"补全为可管理、可寻址的一等对象，希望听到团队与社区的反馈。

**RFC1 会话生命周期控制**
- 现状：`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc-map.ts` 没有 `session.resume`；`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/workspace.ts:102` 的归档是单向的，注释已预留 "a future unarchive restores its position"；`SessionPersistence` 缝没有任何删除入口。
- 提议：`session.resume` RPC + `workspace.unarchiveSession` + 基于 `SessionPersistence` 缝的两步删除（先归档、仅归档态可删、删除需客户端确认）。
- 对应 Ideas 区已有的归档 / 恢复、永久删除、关闭自动恢复等诉求：[#1991](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1991)、[#2613](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2613)、[#2642](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2642)、[#3075](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3075)、[#3554](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3554)。
- 社区已经有插件在自建这套能力（[#2076](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2076)），侧面说明这个缺口适合由内核承接。

**RFC2 会话信箱**
- 现状：子代理 `send_message` 仅限深度 1 的父子链路；Agent Teams 信箱为实验特性且仅限同根会话树。
- 提议：一个独立的、按 `dsh-session:` URI 寻址的持久消息投递缝，静默 / 唤醒两种投递，事件写入目标会话日志，发送者署名并按不可信内容加框。agent-teams Agent Note 已否决在子代理缝上加 peer id，本提案尊重该结论，完全不触碰既有子代理缝。

两者构成一条"会话管理补全弧"：RFC1 让会话生命周期闭环（可恢复、可取消归档、可删除），RFC2 让任何会话可被寻址通信。两者共享 `dsh-session:` 寻址与持久化基础。

我们理解并尊重项目现阶段不接受外部 PR 的政策，因此这里不提交代码。按仓库惯例，我们准备了两组可直接落地的 Agent Note 三件套（非官方社区草案，`proposed/feature`：`.md` / `.zh.md` / `.i18n.yaml`），团队认为方向可行的话可直接取用、改写或拆分：
- RFC1 Note 三件套：https://github.com/qiushi-dev/dsh-session-nexus/blob/main/rfc/2026-08-20-session-lifecycle-controls.md
- RFC2 Note 三件套：https://github.com/qiushi-dev/dsh-session-nexus/blob/main/rfc/2026-08-20-session-mailbox.md

如果你也需要这些能力，请为本帖点赞或留言补充你的使用场景。按 CONTRIBUTING 的说法，投票是团队分配资源时的重要信号。

最后说明署名一事：两份设计文本与三件套按仓库许可（MIT）自由使用，若团队采纳，希望能以 commit author 或 `Co-authored-by` 的方式保留署名，这是我们想以社区成员身份长期参与的一点心愿。

---

Hi all, I would like to propose two complementary RFCs that together complete sessions as manageable, addressable first-class objects. Feedback and votes welcome.

**RFC1 Session lifecycle controls**
- Today: no `session.resume` RPC in `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc-map.ts`; archiving is one-way, and the comment at `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/workspace.ts:102` already anticipates unarchive ("a future unarchive restores its position"); there is no delete anywhere in the `SessionPersistence` seam.
- Proposal: a `session.resume` RPC, `workspace.unarchiveSession`, and two-step deletion (archive first, delete only from the archived state, with client confirmation) extending the `SessionPersistence` seam. This matches existing Ideas asking for archive/restore, permanent deletion, and disabling auto-recovery: [#1991](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1991), [#2613](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2613), [#2642](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2642), [#3075](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3075), [#3554](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3554).
- The community is already building this capability as plugins ([#2076](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2076)), which suggests the gap belongs in the core.

**RFC2 Session mailbox**
- Today: subagent `send_message` is depth-1 parent/child only; the Agent Teams mailbox is experimental and same-root only.
- Proposal: a separate durable, session-addressed delivery seam, quiet/wakeup delivery, events recorded in the target session's log, sender attribution with untrusted framing, addressing via the existing `dsh-session:` URI. The agent-teams Agent Note rejects peer ids on the subagent seam; this proposal honors that by leaving the subagent seam untouched.

Together they form a session-management completion arc: RFC1 closes the lifecycle loop, RFC2 makes sessions addressable.

We understand and respect that external PRs are not accepted at this stage, so no code is attached. Following repo conventions, we prepared two ready-to-land Agent Note triplets (unofficial community drafts; `proposed/feature`: `.md` / `.zh.md` / `.i18n.yaml`), feel free to take, rewrite, or split them:
- RFC1 Note triplet: https://github.com/qiushi-dev/dsh-session-nexus/blob/main/rfc/2026-08-20-session-lifecycle-controls.md
- RFC2 Note triplet: https://github.com/qiushi-dev/dsh-session-nexus/blob/main/rfc/2026-08-20-session-mailbox.md

If these capabilities would help you, please upvote or comment with your scenario. Per CONTRIBUTING, upvotes are considered when the team allocates resources.

One note on attribution: both design documents and triplets are free to use under the repository license (MIT). If the team adopts them, we would appreciate authorship being preserved via commit author or `Co-authored-by`.

discussions.title: Plugin dock slot for side panels that reflow (not overlay) the conversation
discussions.body:
## Context

Audited on `0.1.0-rc.7` (apologies if any of this is stale):

- The web layout (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-layout`) declares `root`, `sidebar`, `conversation`, `details`; the conversation adds the `conversation.view` list slot.
- `conversation.view` is single-select: a plugin-contributed tab (e.g. Trajectory) replaces Chat, so a plugin view and the conversation cannot coexist on screen.
- The details column is hard-bound to tool-call inspection (`selection.callId` drives it; `conversation.details.tool` only renders a single tool call's output), so plugins cannot host a custom panel there either.
- The only remaining sanctioned surface for a persistent side panel is `conversation.session.header.utilities` + a `position: fixed` overlay drawer — which *covers* the chat instead of reflowing it.

## Proposal

A generic plugin seat in the app frame's third column — e.g. a `conversation.dock` slot — that plugins can register into, with open/close state owned by the layout, so a registered panel **reflows** (rather than overlays) the conversation area.

## Use case

A file explorer plugin (browse workspace files, preview/edit markdown & HTML in-app). The overlay-drawer workaround works, but covering the chat is a constant annoyance; a real dock would turn it into a proper split view like an IDE.

discussions.title: Switching to a text-only model is blocked when the session log contains image history
discussions.body:
## 标题

Switching to a text-only model is blocked when the session log contains image history

## 正文

### Scenario

In the Web UI, I started a session with a vision-capable (multimodal) model and attached images during the conversation. After that model's quota ran out, I switched the session to a text-only model (deepseek v4). From then on, every message fails with an error like "the model does not support multimodal input" and the conversation cannot continue at all.

### Root cause (as I understand it)

- Images are durably persisted into the append-only session log (model-visible means logged), so they cannot be removed from an existing session.
- Model modalities are declared, not probed: a hand-entered model is text-only unless configured otherwise, and DeepSeek's own chat-completions route is text-only and cannot be configured to accept images.
- Image admission is checked before sending, so any message in a session whose history still contains an image block is refused once the active model declares no image input.

The refusal is fail-loud and arguably correct, but the UX leaves the user stuck: there is no way to keep the conversation going, and the error does not explain *why* or what to do.

### Suggested improvements

1. When switching the model for a session that already contains image attachments, detect the mismatch and warn up front, e.g. "This session contains N image(s); a text-only model cannot read them. Start a new session or fork a text-only copy."
2. Offer a one-click fork that strips image blocks (or replaces them with placeholder text) so the conversation context survives the switch.
3. If images in history are the blocker, consider a documented escape hatch — e.g. a dedicated command to remove/redact image blocks from the session log (accepting that this breaks strict replay).

Happy to help with implementation if the team agrees on the direction. Thanks for the great work on the harness!

---

## 中文版（可选）

### 标题

会话历史含图片时，切换到纯文本模型会被卡住

### 正文

**场景**：在 Web UI 中，我用多模态模型开了一个会话并在对话中发送过图片。该模型流量用完后，我把会话切换到纯文本模型（deepseek v4）。之后每次发送消息都报错"该模型不支持多模态输入"，会话完全无法继续。

**我理解的根因**：
- 图片会被持久化进 append-only 的会话日志（模型可见的必须被记录），因此无法从已有会话中删除。
- 模型模态是"声明制"而非探测制：手动录入的模型默认纯文本，而 DeepSeek 官方 chat-completions 路由本身是纯文本的，无法通过配置声明支持图片。
- 发送前有图片准入检查：只要会话历史中还含图片块，而当前模型未声明 image 模态，就拒绝发送。

这种 fail-loud 拒绝从正确性上说得通，但用户体验上把用户卡死了：无法继续对话，而且报错没有解释原因和出路。

**改进建议**：
1. 在给含图片附件的会话切换模型时，提前检测不匹配并明确提示，例如："该会话含 N 张图片，纯文本模型无法读取。请新开会话或 fork 一个纯文本副本。"
2. 提供一键 fork：剥离图片块（或替换为占位文本），让对话上下文在切换后得以保留。
3. 如果历史图片是硬性阻碍，考虑提供文档化的逃生通道——例如专门的命令从会话日志中移除/脱敏图片块（接受这会破坏严格回放）。

如果团队认可方向，我很乐意帮忙实现。感谢出色的工作！

discussions.title: 工具调用 id 复用导致历史加载失败：兼容端点 callId 会话内不唯一，建议 UI 层加 turn/step 命名空间
discussions.body:
## 问题现象 Symptom

加载某些历史会话时整段历史不可用，Web 端报：

```
历史加载失败:
conversation Context 9tool-call<id> received more than one start Match (internal)
```

多个会话同时受影响（同批会话），其余会话正常。数据本身完整：seq 连续、JSON 全部可解析、无并发写损坏迹象（不是 #1433/#1452/#1497 那种 seq 回绕）。

## 根因分析 Root Cause

受影响会话由 **OpenAI-completions 兼容端点**（非官方 API，走自定义网关/中转）生成。这类端点的 tool call id 是**每轮响应内编号**的局部 id：

```
step 1: tool/call callId="call_0" callId="call_1" callId="call_2"
step 2: tool/call callId="call_0" callId="call_1" callId="call_2"   ← 与 step 1 完全相同的 id
step 3: tool/call callId="call_0" ...
```

会话事件日志里 `call_0` 出现几十次，每次都是**不同的工具调用**（不同 step / 不同参数）。

而客户端 Conversation 引擎的 `toolDefinition`（`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/tool.ts`）用**裸 callId** 作为 Context 身份（`conversationContextKey('tool-call', callId)`）。同一会话内 callId 复用 → 同一个 Context 收到第二个 `start` Match → assembler 按设计 fail-loud 抛 `more than one start Match` → **整段历史拒绝加载**。

官方 OpenAI API 的 tool call id 全局唯一（`call_abc123...`），所以官方端点从不触发；兼容端点不保证这一点，UI 层却假设了会话内唯一。

### 佐证

- 同一会话内 `(turn, step, callId)` 三元组**零冲突**（全部 64 个受影响会话验证过）
- 每个 `tool/result` 与前置 `tool/call` 的 turn/step **100% 一致**（1488/1488 对）
- 数据文件本身无任何损坏（seq 连续、JSON 合法、zstd 帧完整）

## 修复方案 Fix

让 tool-call 的 Context 身份带上 turn/step 命名空间：**裸 `callId` → `${turn}:${step}:${callId}`**。这样每轮的 `call_0` 变成 `1:1:call_0`、`1:2:call_0`、`1:3:call_0`…… 会话内天然唯一，且对已有历史数据**零改动**（key 是运行时派生的，不落盘）。

改动点：

1. **`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/tool.ts`** — `toolDefinition.match` 的 id 生成加 `turn:step:` 前缀（`tool/call`、`tool/result` 两个分支；`tool/code-dispatch-*` 分支在事件带坐标时同样加前缀，旧日志无坐标时回退裸 id 保持兼容）
2. **`packages/client/ui-trajectory/src/client/trajectory-tool-definition.ts`** — trajectory 视图的 `trajectory-tool-call` 同样处理（同类问题，不修的话 trajectory 面板会命中同一个重复 start）
3. **`packages/core/tools/src/code-mode.ts` + `types.ts`** — 数据侧：`tool/code-dispatch-start` / `tool/code-dispatch` 事件现在携带 root 调用的 `turn`/`step`（从会话日志里 root `tool/call` 事件拷贝），保证嵌套 dispatch 记录能与前缀化后的 root Context 配对。旧日志（无坐标）仍回退裸 rootCallId，不会崩
4. **`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/tool-node-reader.ts`** — `rootToolCall` 由「按 key 精确查」改为「遍历匹配 root callId」，避免 key 格式变化后查询失配

### 为什么不改数据 / 不加锁

- 数据没有损坏，只是**合法数据违反了 UI 层的唯一性假设**——修 UI 层比修数据更根本
- 兼容端点的行为（每轮从 `call_0` 编号）无法从 DSH 侧改变，UI 层命名空间是唯一稳妥的根治点
- 历史文件零改动，修复即时生效，无需离线迁移

## 验证 Verification

- 全部 269 个持久化会话用真实 `ConversationNodeAssembler` + 修复后的 `toolDefinition` 加载：**零失败**（修复前 64 个抛 duplicate start）
- 单元测试：`packages/client`、`packages/core/tools`、`packages/core/session` 全量 **3979/3979 通过**（含 conversation-node-definitions、trajectory definitions、code-mode、assembler 测试）
- client typecheck 通过
- 重建 lib + web 产物后，浏览器实际加载的 `/plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-conversation/client.js` 确认含前缀逻辑

## 关联

- [#1333](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1333) / [#1452](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1452) / [#1497](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1497) 是**并发写导致的 seq 重复**（数据损坏），本报告是**兼容端点 callId 复用**（数据合法、UI 假设失效）——两个不同根因，症状都是「历史不可加载」。建议官方在 UI 层对 tool-call 身份加 turn/step 命名空间，同时对兼容端点场景做防御。

---

*作者：胡桃（胡桃的神秘小屋）*

discussions.body: ## English Hi DeepSeek Harness team and community, I’m sharing **Rabbisir**, an independent and unofficial native macOS desktop app built with DeepSeek Harness. discussions.title: [Bug] Build fails with standalone pnpm @pnpm/exe because npm_execpath is executed through Node
discussions.body:
## Summary

`pnpm run build` fails when `pnpm` is the standalone native executable distributed by `@pnpm/exe`.

The build succeeds with Corepack's JavaScript pnpm entrypoint, but fails with the same repository and Node version when `npm_execpath` points to the native ELF executable.

## Environment

- OS: Linux x64
- Node.js: `v24.19.0`
- pnpm: `11.7.0`
- pnpm installation: standalone `@pnpm/exe` under `PNPM_HOME`
- Repository base commit: `141eb6fef8`
- Repository version: `0.1.0-rc.8`

The active pnpm installation uses this wrapper:

```text
$HOME/.local/share/pnpm/bin/pnpm
```

Its lifecycle `npm_execpath` points to an executable similar to:

```text
$HOME/.local/share/pnpm/store/v11/links/@pnpm/exe/11.7.0/.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm
```

`file` identifies that entrypoint as:

```text
ELF 64-bit LSB executable, x86-64
```

## Reproduction

Run the build using the standalone pnpm installation:

```console
$ pnpm run build
$ tsx scripts/build.ts
file:///home/.../.local/share/pnpm/store/v11/links/@pnpm/exe/11.7.0/.../node_modules/@pnpm/exe/pnpm:1
ELF...
^

SyntaxError: Invalid or unexpected token
    at compileSourceTextModule (node:internal/modules/esm/utils:318:16)
    at ModuleLoader.moduleStrategy (node:internal/modules/esm/translators:89:18)
    at #translate (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:434:20)
    at afterLoad (node:internal/modules/esm/loader:502:29)

Node.js v24.19.0

Error: build: build:lib exited with 1
    at runScript (.../scripts/build.ts:28:11)

[ELIFECYCLE] Command failed with exit code 1.
```

The binary bytes after `ELF` have been omitted.

## Root cause

`scripts/build.ts` reads the package-manager entrypoint from `npm_execpath`, then always passes that path to Node:

```ts
const packageManager = process.env.npm_execpath

spawnSync(process.execPath, [packageManager, 'run', script], {
  // ...
})
```

This works when `npm_execpath` is a JavaScript file such as Corepack's `pnpm.js` or `corepack.cjs`.

With standalone `@pnpm/exe`, however, `npm_execpath` is a native ELF executable. The resulting command is effectively:

```text
node /path/to/native/pnpm run build:lib
```

Node therefore attempts to parse the ELF binary as an ES module and throws at the `ELF` header.

This is not caused by Node.js `v24.19.0` itself: the same checkout and Node version complete the build when pnpm resolves through Corepack's JavaScript entrypoint.

The shell configuration is only indirectly involved because `PATH`/`PNPM_HOME` determines which pnpm distribution is selected.

## Expected behavior

The build runner should support both forms of `npm_execpath`:

- JavaScript entrypoints (`.js`, `.cjs`, `.mjs`) should be launched through `process.execPath`.
- Native executables and executable shims should be launched directly.

The invocation should remain shell-free.

## Local fix

I prepared a minimal local fix that resolves the command prefix from the entrypoint:

```ts
export function packageManagerArgv(entrypoint: string): readonly [string, ...string[]] {
  return /\.[cm]?js$/i.test(entrypoint)
    ? [process.execPath, entrypoint]
    : [entrypoint]
}
```

The existing build sequence, environment propagation and error handling remain unchanged.

Local commit:

```text
Branch: fix/native-pnpm-build
Commit: ae9c238b776c181bd536384ddf1916b57ae06c7f
Subject: fix: support native pnpm build entrypoints
```

Files changed:

```text
scripts/build.ts
scripts/build.spec.ts
```

The commit is currently local because the contribution guide states that external pull requests are not accepted.

## Validation

The focused validation completed successfully:

```text
pnpm exec vitest run scripts/build.spec.ts
  Test Files  1 passed
  Tests       5 passed

pnpm exec oxlint scripts/build.ts scripts/build.spec.ts
pnpm exec tsc -p tsconfig.host.json --pretty false
pnpm run verify-export-jsdoc
git diff --check
```

The actual `@pnpm/exe` ELF entrypoint was also passed through the new dispatch logic and executed directly in a lightweight smoke check with exit code 0.

I did not rerun the complete repository build after applying the patch; the post-fix evidence currently consists of the focused tests, type/lint checks and native-entrypoint smoke check.

---

## 中文摘要

当 `PATH` 命中 `PNPM_HOME` 中安装的 `@pnpm/exe` 原生版 pnpm 时，生命周期变量 `npm_execpath` 指向 ELF 可执行文件。

`scripts/build.ts` 当前固定执行：

```text
node <npm_execpath> run <script>
```

因此 Node 会把 ELF 二进制当成 JavaScript 解析，并在文件头处抛出 `SyntaxError`。Corepack 提供的 pnpm 入口是 JavaScript 文件，所以同一份代码在 Corepack 环境下能够正常构建。

本地最小修复会继续使用 Node 启动 `.js/.cjs/.mjs` 入口，而对 ELF、`.exe` 和无扩展 shim 直接执行，同时保持无 shell 调用。相关单元测试、lint、类型检查和 JSDoc 检查均已通过。

discussions.title: healProfilesModuleFallback can rethrow EEXIST when identical Windows junction creation races
discussions.body:
# Draft upstream issue — Windows Profile fallback junction race

Status: draft only; not posted

## Suggested title

`healProfilesModuleFallback` can rethrow `EEXIST` when identical Windows junction creation races

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness commit: `99f6f02fecdb7dff40c3fbc9470f5907c29f74ca`
- Published package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.0-rc.7`
- Node.js: `v24.16.0`
- OS: Windows
- Filesystem requirement: ordinary local OS temporary storage reproduces the issue; OneDrive is not required

## Summary

Two processes calling `healProfilesModuleFallback(installAnchor, sameHome)` can race while creating the same Windows junction. Both processes can observe the link as absent. One creates the correct junction and the other's `symlinkSync(..., 'junction')` receives `EEXIST`.

The loser immediately calls `lstatSync(link)` in the `EEXIST` handler. On Windows, the winning junction is not always observable as a symbolic link at that instant. The handler then rethrows the original `EEXIST`, even though the path shortly converges to the correct junction target.

The same transient visibility can also affect the initial `lstat`: a junction being created by another process can briefly be observed as a non-symlink, triggering the stable-real-directory error too early.

## Source locations

- `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`: private `ensureSymlink`, especially the initial `lstat`, junction creation, and immediate `EEXIST` postcondition check
- `packages/boot/app-boot/src/profile.ts`: public `healProfilesModuleFallback`
- `packages/boot/app-boot/tests/profile.spec.ts`: the test named for a concurrent-heal race calls the healer twice serially and does not stage the cross-process window

The emitted rc.7 `lib/index.js` has the same control flow as the pinned source.

## Bounded reproduction results

Two independent child processes were released through a barrier and called the actual public healer with the same anchor and home:

| Fixture | Rounds | Result |
|---|---:|---|
| actual DSH installation dependency closure (509 junctions) | 5 | loser failed in 5/5 rounds: 1 raw `EEXIST`, 4 transient non-symlink observations |
| fully synthetic app/dependency installation under OS temp | 10 | 7/10 rounds failed: 6 raw `EEXIST`, 1 transient non-symlink observation |

The one-process controls passed 5/5 rounds for both relevant fixture classes. In the failed runs, the final junctions resolved to the expected targets immediately after both children exited.

A consumer-level clean/cold default-parallel suite also failed consistently in two bounded full-suite runs, but passed when the generated tree was already warm. Different package links failed on different runs, which rules out one corrupt package as the cause.

## Expected behavior

Concurrent healers that converge on the same target should both succeed. A stable real directory or a junction to a different target must continue to fail loud; the healer must not delete user-owned directories.

## Proposed bounded fix

After `EEXIST`, retry `lstat`/`readlink` for a short bounded interval before classifying the result. Apply the same bounded re-observation when the initial `lstat` reports a non-symlink that may be another process's in-progress junction. Stop immediately when the correct link is visible; after the bound expires, retain the current fail-loud behavior for a real directory, a wrong target, or another unexpected filesystem error.

A cross-process lock could also serialize healing, but a bounded visibility retry is narrower for the observed Windows junction behavior. Whichever design is chosen should avoid unbounded waits and stale-lock recovery hazards.

## Suggested regression coverage

- two child processes, one barrier, same synthetic install anchor and home;
- both processes exit successfully when they create identical junction targets;
- final link is a junction to the expected target;
- wrong junction is still replaced according to the existing contract;
- stable real directory is retained and rejected;
- serial repeated healing remains idempotent;
- retries are bounded and unexpected filesystem errors still surface.

## Consumer containment

As a downstream containment, the shared fallback tree can be pre-healed once before parallel test workers begin, while retaining the normal per-boot heal.

This removes the known test-run trigger for that consumer, but it does not make the pinned healer generally cross-process safe for independent DSH launchers sharing one home. An upstream correction is therefore still warranted.

discussions.title: Archived chats: pause safely, restore from Settings
discussions.body:
I implemented and tested a recoverable Archived chats flow against current `master` (`0.1.0-rc.8`). Because the contribution guide says external pull requests are not currently accepted, I am sharing the complete branch here so the maintainers can evaluate or adopt it without rebuilding the feature from scratch.

Tested branch: https://github.com/spoonmaroon/deepseek-harness/tree/feature/archived-chat-recovery

Commit: [`e9f0ec9`](https://github.com/spoonmaroon/deepseek-harness/commit/e9f0ec97769e11dbe0992940f0cb7681b967ee2d)

## Proposed behavior

- Archiving is a pause boundary: if the attached Agent is running, the host clears pending work, cancels the active turn, awaits idle, and only then durably hides the Session.
- A new `workspace.unarchiveSession` RPC is carried through the registry, host API/schema, fetch carrier, client manager/runtime, and fixtures.
- Settings gains an **Archived chats** section that shows retained title, workspace/path, timestamp, and state.
- **Restore and open** removes only the archive flag, opens the retained full transcript, and does not automatically resume the Agent. The user can review the log and press Continue explicitly.
- English and Chinese package/subsystem documentation and the generated Cordis/client catalogs are updated.

## Validation

- Focused Vitest: 10 files, 270 tests passed.
- Keyless browser E2E: 12 tests passed, including archive across reload and restore from Settings.
- Production repository build passed.
- Documentation sync: 28/28 gates passed.
- Pre-commit translation, lint, notices, whitespace, and vendor guards passed.
- Pre-push host/client typecheck passed.

Would this behavior and UI location fit the intended archive lifecycle? If the maintainers prefer a different RPC name, Settings placement, or pause contract, I can adapt the implementation on the published branch.

discussions.body:
# dsh-vap: A Verifiable Agent Protocol — the trust machine with a public experiment ledger

**MCP connects tools. A2A delegates tasks. VAP answers one question: why should this message be believed?**

Every envelope carries an Ed25519 signature, a nonce (replay-proof), and an honesty boundary (L2a/L1/L0). It passes three gates — identity, laws, honesty — before it counts. Tasks survive crashes via three-evidence adoption. "Who gets believed" is decided by distributed 2/3 quorum endorsements and a lockstep QC-chain consensus (total order, fork & double-spend prevention, dynamic membership with slash auto-expulsion).

**What's different from mainstream protocols:** most agent protocols default to trusting the other party's output. VAP defaults to not trusting — every capability ships with an experiment device number and a control group, 217 tests, 11 experiment devices, all public. The honest-boundaries section is on the front page: small trust domain, public internet untested, f+1 collusion is a mathematical limit — detected, not prevented.

**Zero third-party dependencies** (only `node:` built-ins). npm: `npm i -g dsh-vap` → `vap-gateway` / `vap-relay` / `vap-node` / `vap-send`.

Repo: https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-vap

If you disagree with a claim — great. Recompute it. The experiment ledger is there precisely so you can.

---

# dsh-vap：可验证智能体交互协议——把实验账本公开的信任机器

**MCP 管工具接入，A2A 管任务委托——VAP 只回答一个问题：这条消息凭什么可信？**

每封信封带 Ed25519 签名、nonce 防重放、诚实边界声明（L2a/L1/L0），过验证门三闸（身份/军法/诚实边界）才入账；任务崩溃被三证据收养；"谁的话算数"由分布式 2/3 背书 + 锁步 QC 链共识决定（总序/防分叉/防双花/动态成员/双签自动除名）。

**与主流的区别**：多数 agent 协议默认相信对方输出；VAP 默认不信——**每个能力声明带实验装置编号与对照组**，217 个测试、11 个实验装置全部公开。诚实边界写在首页：小规模信任域、公网未实测、f+1 共谋是数学边界（可检测不可阻止）。

**零第三方依赖**（仅 node: 内置模块）。安装：`npm i -g dsh-vap` → `vap-gateway` / `vap-relay` / `vap-node` / `vap-send`。

仓库：https://github.com/Wang-Lin-Chang/dsh-vap

不同意哪个声称？欢迎逐条复算——实验账本就是留给复算的。

discussions.title: 新手上路，做了一个功能比较接近"插件开发脚手架"的简单项目
discussions.body:
大家好，第一次玩开源社区，我的本职是前端开发，对DSH的生态和理念非常有兴趣，所以试着给DSH也做一个类似vue-cli的脚手架工具，用来快速初始化插件开发项目。做的时候顺便加进去了一个相关性比较强的功能，可以在安装之前对npm插件进行一个简单扫描，来初步判断安全性和兼容性。

项目**dsh-whale-tank**已经开源并发布到npm，仅经过本地环境测试，早期必然会有不少问题没考虑到，欢迎各位提宝贵意见：[GitHub 仓库](https://github.com/swell05/dsh-whale-tank "鲸鱼缸")

两个主要功能：
🛠️ /whale-tank-init——创建干净的插件开发专属“鱼缸” 
- **纯净沙盒+骨架构建**：host / client / both 三种类型项目骨架进行项目初始化；独立 `DSH_HOME` + 基线 profile + `state.json`，插件可以用沙盒副本进行测试，避免污染真实环境
- **可选知识包**：创建项目时自带增量写入 AGENTS.md / NOTES.md 等知识，方便其他agent快速接手
- **内置调试工具包**：项目初始化后内置 `.wttools/`，是几个插件开发可用的工具包（插拔复原测试、一键挂载+沙盒启动等等），在项目文件夹里直接敲命令调用

🩺 /whale-tank-vet——把拿不准的插件丢进单独的“鱼缸”做个体检 
-  **静态危害检查**：`npm pack` 拉发布产物 → 规则引擎扫 install 脚本、凭据引用、外联、eval/混淆——命中高危直接"不建议"，直接不执行
- **受限动态验证**：独立沙盒复刻 profile → 冲突检测 → 插拔抵消测试
-  **LLM 源码审查（可选）**：模型通读候选源码，与规则引擎互相验证

> ⚠️ 注意事项：隔离靠独立 DSH_HOME + 独立进程受限执行，**防状态污染、不防本机执行**，检测结果不构成安全保证。

discussions.title: 插件——躺着coding，手机连接dsh，全面提高手机端体验，支持电脑手机通知，刷b站coding
discussions.body: # dsh-meow-smooth 喵丝滑——手机端远程使用dsh，系统通知功能！躺着coding，刷b站coding dsh（DeepSeek Harness）前端体验增强插件，**零 dsh 本体改动**，纯客户端自包含。 装上之后，dsh 在手机上像原生 App 一样好摸，在电脑上也有更舒服的小细节。 tailscale实现手机端远程连接dsh（插件包含tailscale配置踩坑指导，AI看完应该可以帮你快速实现手机连接dsh，你就不用自己从零开始踩坑了。） 手机端ui交互优化，让手机端dsh真正可用。你可以躺着coding了。 电脑、手机都支持的通知系统。AI跑任务，你切出去刷b站了，AI跑完任务或者中途提问，会发通知给你。 还有一些ui交互方面的细节优化。 作者自己在用，亲测好用，非常提高幸福感！ 作者写了好几个插件，最明显提升幸福感的就是这个，真的，谁试谁知道。 dsh-meow-smooth： ## 功能 ### 打字舒服 - **输入框失焦自动折叠**：长草稿不再一直占着半个屏幕。写完切走，输入框自动收成一行；点一下又展开，草稿内容和滚动位置原样保留。 - **手机上回车 = 换行**：手机键盘的回车键变成"换行"，不怕误触把半截话发出去；Shift/Ctrl/Enter 和输入法选词不受影响，桌面键盘依旧是回车发送。 - **打字时顶部栏自动让位**：唤起输入法时，对话/轨迹那些标签自动隐藏，屏幕最上方只留一条当前会话名——你知道自己正在跟谁聊；键盘收起，一切恢复原样。 ### 手机上更顺滑 - **模型名不再挤按钮**：手机窄屏下模型名只保留一点宽度，输入框左侧的按钮不会再被挤掉。 - **模式选择只留图标**：agent preset 在手机上只显示一个小图标，点一下展开完整名字，点别处自动收回。 - **侧边栏更聪明**：窄屏下切换会话后，侧边栏自动收成一条窄栏，把屏幕还给对话；展开时点一下右侧空白就收起。 - **按钮只留图标**：下载记录、后台任务、子代理这些按钮在手机上缩成紧凑的小图标，依旧一点就开。 - **顶部栏可以横滑**：Session 名永远完整显示、绝不截断，内容超宽就左右滑着看。 - **禁止意外缩放**：双击、双指捏合都不会再让页面意外缩放。 - **禁用橡皮筋回弹**：页面下拉不会再回弹，更像原生 App 的手感。 - **设置页也适配了手机**：手机上设置页全屏显示，左侧边栏收成图标列，点开展开；电脑上保持官方原样。 ### 通知 - **提醒卡片**：AI 跑长任务时中途要权限、或有问题等你回答——即使你没在看那个会话，屏幕上方也会弹出提醒卡片，点一下就跳过去处理。 - **系统通知**：AI 跑完长任务、中途要权限或提问，哪怕你已经切出去刷 B 站了，也会弹系统通知，点通知直接回到对应会话。 - **多会话同时跑也不错过**：一次开好几个会话同时跑，你在和其中一个聊天，别的会话有动静（跑完任务 / 要权限 / 提问）同样会提醒你。 - **手机也能收到系统通知**：桌面和安卓直接弹系统通知；iPhone 通过 Web Push 或 Bark 等通道也能收到。 - **不打扰**：电脑端 dsh 页面正聚焦时不弹系统通知（官方面板/卡片负责提醒），切到别的窗口才弹。 ### 手机上访问更快（可选但强推） dsh 的大会话在手机上看很慢——历史记录一次要拉好几 MB 的 JSON。插件内置压缩代理，把这些响应压缩 70–90%，蜂窝网络也流畅；流式输出和实时连接不受影响。默认关闭，需要时在配置里打开。 顺便吐个槽，dsh加载历史记录怎么居然是用chunk事件流啊，直接加载纯文本不好吗？但这个涉及dsh本体改动，我没改他，只是在现有框架下尽量优化了。等dsh本体更新吧~ ## 安装 dsh本体零改动，直接把链接发给ai让他装就行了…… https://github.com/Phant0Meow/dsh-meow-smooth/ 也支持npm。

Dynamic Context Runtime: Bounded Attention over Unbounded History


Language models degrade as stale and superseded material piles up in their context. Making the window bigger does not fix it. This report describes a runtime that keeps history unbounded and attention bounded — storing everything as immutable spans and a typed provenance graph, then assembling a small working set each turn by solving a knapsack under an explicit token budget. It includes a zero-dependency Rust implementation and an ablation that names which mechanisms are actually carrying the result.


467tokens per query

59×less than full history

7 / 7probes answered

33×history growth, flat cost
