discussions.body:
## 问题

使用持久化 bash 工具（tool-bash-persistent）执行命令时，1ms 的命令也要等 **3.5 秒**才返回。

## 根因

两个提示符常量不一致，终端层永远匹配不到"命令完成"：

- terminal-bash: CONTROLLED_PROMPT = 'dsh> '（sanitize.ts:9）
- tool-bash-persistent: SHELL_PROMPT = '__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_PROMPT__ '（index.ts:18）

上层工具用 stty -echo; PS1=__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_PROMPT__ 覆盖 PS1 后，bash 打印的提示符不再是 dsh> ，promptTextSeen 永远为 false，快速通道（stdin_read，50ms）永不触发，只能落入 idleSilenceMs(3000) + handoffGraceMs(500) = 3.5s 的静默兜底。

## 修复

把 CONTROLLED_PROMPT 改为与 SHELL_PROMPT 一致（含尾部空格）：

`diff
- export const CONTROLLED_PROMPT = 'dsh> '
+ export const CONTROLLED_PROMPT = '__DSH_PERSISTENT_BASH_PROMPT__ '
`

session.ts:394 已用 CONTROLLED_PROMPT.length + 1 适配，无需再改。同步更新了 4 个测试文件的期望值（sanitize.spec.ts 改为引用常量，防再失配）。

## 验证

- 模拟 bash 输出 marker+PS1 → promptTextSeen = true（修复前 false）
- 两包 	sc --noEmit 通过；tool-bash-persistent 17 项测试全过
- 重启服务后实测生效

修复后命令完成即走 50ms 快速通道返回。补丁在下方评论中。

discussions.title: Composer bug (v0.1.0-rc.7): typed text invisible in Chrome + input box permanently removed after slot crash during replies
discussions.body:
# Composer bug (v0.1.0-rc.7): typed text invisible in Chrome + input box permanently removed after slot crash during replies

Two conversation-composer bugs on the published `@deepseek-ai/dsh` v0.1.0-rc.7 Web GUI (macOS, light mode, Chrome).

## Bug 1 — Typed text invisible while typing

The composer textarea renders its draft fully transparent (`color: transparent; -webkit-text-fill-color: transparent`) and relies on the `.backdrop` overlay for visible glyphs. When that overlay fails to paint (reproducible in Chrome), the caret moves but letters never appear. Sent messages render fine. Fix verified locally: give the textarea a real text color (e.g. `var(--dsw-alias-label-primary)`) as a fallback — the layers share metrics, so overlapping glyphs render identically.

## Bug 2 — Input box permanently disappears during a streaming reply

The input box vanishes while the assistant streams a reply and does not return until a full page reload. Console shows:

```
slot entry crashed in 'conversation.composer.bar':
NotFoundError: Failed to execute 'removeChild' on 'Node': The node to be removed is not a child of this node.
```

Root cause: a commit-phase React race crashes the lone `conversation.composer.bar` entry; the shell's `SlotErrorBoundary` then abdicates it, and with no survivor the cell shows a permanent `data-slot-error` blank. Suggested fix: only abdicate when another entry can take the cell, and have the boundary auto-retry (bounded) after a transient crash.

---

**Environment:** macOS (light mode), Chrome, `@deepseek-ai/dsh` v0.1.0-rc.7 served via `dsh web` at `http://127.0.0.1:3080`.

**Repro:**
1. `npx dsh web` (v0.1.0-rc.7), open in Chrome.
2. Type a message — letters are invisible while typing (Bug 1).
3. Send it and wait for the reply — the input box disappears mid-reply and only a page refresh brings it back (Bug 2).
4. DevTools Console shows the `slot entry crashed in 'conversation.composer.bar'` NotFoundError.

discussions.title: [插件] dsh-phone：Agent 电话终端——号码、通话、短信，信任可验证
discussions.body:
作为 CHA2A 系列的一个落地应用，我们发布 **dsh-phone——Agent 电话终端**：给智能体配"电话号码"——有号码、唯一、可寻址、可通话、可短信，来电可验证。仓库：`https://github.com/wwumit/dsh-phone` · npm：`@wwumit/dsh-phone`

**为什么是"电话"**：号码是智能体生态里最直观的"可寻址 + 可验证"隐喻。号码簿由 CHA2A 管理——号码 ↔ `did:cha2a:agent` 映射，唯一性由注册表保证，信任等级贯穿全程。

![dsh-phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wwumit/dsh-phone/main/assets/screenshot.png)

**v0.5 更新：iPhone 风格 App 容器（Launcher）**
- **时钟主屏**：左上角实时指针表 + 4 列 App 图标（电话 / 信息 / RCS / 备忘录 / 通讯录 / 开户 / 设置 / dshlib）
- **开放式 App 注册表**：任何开发者可注册自己的 App，一行代码接入，自动出现在 Launcher——像 skill 一样"注册即用"
- 每个 App 独立界面、独立导航（`<` 返回逐级退）、独立主题

**核心功能**：
- **双独立电话**：默认两个电话（A/B），各显示自己的号码，独立控制
- **拨号 / 来电**：拨号盘 → 号码簿解析 → 对端电话被唤起响铃 → 显示主叫号码 + 身份 + 信任等级（L0-L4）→ 接听/拒接
- **真语音通话**：WebRTC（麦克风 → 音响）· 静音 · 挂断
- **短信**：每部电话独立短信窗 + 消息记录 + 附件（图片/文件，SHA-256 哈希标记）
- **通讯录**：从号码簿目录拉取联系人（带等级徽章）
- **RCS 群聊**：群消息广播 + @成员选择（agent/电话分类）+ 群资料（成员昵称/群主/加人踢人）
- **备忘录 / dshlib 商店**：本机笔记 + 应用商店内嵌
- **/phone 命令**：对话中输入 `/phone` 直接打开拨号盘 / 直拨常用号码

**信任层**（CHA2A 对齐）：
- 号码 ↔ `did:cha2a:agent`（唯一性 + 防冒充）
- 来电核验：号码 → DID → 认证等级 L0-L4 / 撤销状态——"未验证来电"标记可疑
- 附件哈希：SHA-256 防篡改（对齐 in-toto Evidence Record 的 artifactDigest）
- 徽章：号码/联系人/来电处显示 CHA2A 认证徽章图

**安装试用**（实验环境）：
```bash
dsh plugin add @wwumit/dsh-phone
```
对话中输入 `/phone`，或点右下角 📞 图标。

这会不会是第一个打通的基于 DID 的 A2A 电话？[得意]

**边界声明**：本插件为社区项目，**不代表官方立场**；实验性实现（语音为同页演示，跨设备需信令服务器）；号码簿与信任核验由 CHA2A 参考实现提供。欢迎试用与反馈。

---

As an application-layer implementation of the CHA2A series, we're releasing **dsh-phone — an Agent phone terminal**: give your agent a "phone number" — addressable, unique, callable, with SMS, and verifiable incoming calls. Repo: `https://github.com/wwumit/dsh-phone` · npm: `@wwumit/dsh-phone`

**Why "phone"**: a number is the most intuitive metaphor for addressability + verifiability in the agent ecosystem. The number directory is managed by CHA2A — number ↔ `did:cha2a:agent` mapping, uniqueness enforced by the registry, trust levels throughout.

![dsh-phone](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/wwumit/dsh-phone/main/assets/screenshot.png)

**v0.5 update: iPhone-style app launcher**
- **Analog clock home screen**: real-time clock widget + 4-column app grid (Phone / Messages / RCS / Notes / Contacts / Account / Settings / dshlib)
- **Open app registry**: any developer can register their own app with one line — it appears on the launcher automatically, "register and it works"
- Each app has its own view, navigation (back stack), and theme

**Core features**:
- **Two independent phones**: two panels (A/B), each with its own number, independently controlled
- **Dial / incoming**: keypad → directory resolution → callee phone rings with caller number + identity + trust level (L0-L4) → answer/reject
- **Voice calls**: WebRTC (mic → speakers) · mute · hang up
- **SMS**: per-phone message window + history + attachments (images/files with SHA-256 hash marker)
- **Contacts**: pulled from the number directory (with level badges)
- **RCS group chat**: broadcast + @member picker (agent/phone labels) + group info (member nicknames, owner, add/remove)
- **Notes / dshlib store**: local notes + embedded app store
- **/phone command**: type `/phone` in the conversation to open the dialer / speed-dial

**Trust layer** (CHA2A-aligned):
- number ↔ `did:cha2a:agent` (uniqueness + anti-spoofing)
- incoming verification: number → DID → certification level L0-L4 / revocation state — unverified callers flagged suspicious
- attachment hashing: SHA-256 tamper-evidence (aligned with in-toto Evidence Record artifactDigest)
- CHA2A certification badge images on number/contacts/incoming

**Try it** (experimental):
```bash
dsh plugin add @wwumit/dsh-phone
```
Type `/phone` in the conversation, or tap the 📞 icon.

Could this be the first DID-based A2A phone call? 😏

**Boundary**: This is a community project and **does not represent the official position**; experimental implementation (same-page voice demo; cross-device needs a signaling server); number directory and trust verification are provided by the CHA2A reference implementation. Feedback welcome.

discussions.title: [Bug][MCP] Repeated nextCursor can make tools/list synchronization loop indefinitely
discussions.body:
## 问题概述

在当前 `master`（`141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`）中，MCP Client 的 `syncTools()` 会持续拉取 `tools/list`，直到 `nextCursor` 为空，但没有检测服务端是否重复返回同一个 continuation cursor。

如果异常或不受信任的 MCP Server 返回空工具页并重复同一个非空 `nextCursor`，该循环不会触发现有的重复工具名校验，也不会结束，会持续发送 `tools/list` 请求。

源码位置：
- [packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/tools.ts#L143-L174](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534/packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/tools.ts#L143-L174)

## 影响

- 初次连接时，`apply()` 等待的 `connection.ready` 无法完成，插件启动会一直挂起；
- `notifications/tools/list_changed` 触发重同步时，串行的 `syncChain` 会被永久占用，后续同步无法执行；
- 客户端持续产生 JSON-RPC 请求，带来 CPU、日志和网络资源消耗；
- `failOnStartupError` 无法处理，因为当前路径既不 resolve 也不 reject。

## 最小复现

可以在 `packages/mcp/mcp-client/tests/mcp-client.spec.ts` 中构造一个 mock client：

```ts
let calls = 0
const client = createMockClient([])
client.listTools.mockImplementation(async () => {
  calls += 1
  if (calls > 3) throw new Error('sentinel: pagination did not stop')
  return { tools: [], nextCursor: 'same-cursor' }
})

await expect(syncTools(client as never, ctx, defaultOpts, new Map()))
  .rejects.toThrow(/repeated.*cursor/i)
expect(client.listTools).toHaveBeenCalledTimes(2)
```

当前实现不会在第二次响应后拒绝，而会继续请求，最终只会被上面的 sentinel 人为中断；移除 sentinel 后会持续循环。

## 期望行为

当 `tools/list` 返回已经出现过的非空 `nextCursor` 时，`syncTools()` 应立即以明确错误终止 fetch phase，并保持上一代已注册工具不变。

## 建议修复

在 fetch phase 内维护 `Set<string>`：

1. 收到非空 `nextCursor` 后，先检查是否已经出现；
2. 若重复，抛出类似 `MCP server repeated a tools/list continuation cursor` 的错误；
3. 否则记录 cursor 并继续下一页；
4. 增加“空工具页 + 重复 cursor”的回归测试，并保留现有正常两页分页测试。

仓库中已有一致的防环模式，可直接复用设计：

- [API Proxy 的 seenCursors 防护](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534/packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts#L2054-L2062)
- [Session Query 的 repeated cursor 防护](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534/packages/session-query/tool-session-query/src/operations.ts#L262-L270)

## 去重情况

提交前已搜索 Discussions 和 PR 中的 `nextCursor`、`continuation cursor`、`repeated cursor`、`tools/list pagination` 等关键词，暂未发现相同报告。

discussions.title: A retry-exhausted turn failure is rendered hidden, so the conversation looks like it completed successfully
discussions.body:
When a model request fails, is retried by the provider retry policy, and then fails again after the retries are exhausted, the chat surface shows nothing at all. The turn ends, the agent goes idle, and the conversation is indistinguishable from one that finished normally. The task simply stops and a human has to notice and push it forward.

Version: 0.1.0-rc.7.

## What I see

A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible gateway under load returns Envoy's backend-unavailable response:

```
503 upstream connect error or disconnect/reset before headers.
reset reason: remote connection failure,
transport failure reason: delayed connect error: 111
```

The retry notice appears (`delay 1090ms`), a second retry follows, and then the turn ends with no error shown. The session is idle and looks complete.

The classification is correct — `status >= 500` maps to `SERVER`, which is in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` — so retries do happen. The problem is what happens after they run out.

## Why the error disappears

`packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/conversation-nodes/turn-error.ts` states the intent in its own doc comment:

```ts
/** Terminal turn failure Definition, suppressed when the turn owns a retry chain. */
```

`hidden` is set when a retry event is seen, and the terminal failure merges into the state without clearing it:

```ts
update: (context, match) => {
  const failure = failureFrom(match)
  if (failure !== undefined) return { ...context.state, failure }   // hidden is preserved
  return retryTurn(match.event) === context.state.turn
    ? { ...context.state, hidden: true }
    : context.state
},
```

`buildViewNode` then emits the node hidden:

```ts
if (!state.hidden) return chatNode(context, 'turn-error', node.seq, node)
const current = context.current.get('chat')
return current === undefined || current === null
  ? null
  : chatNode(context, 'turn-error', node.seq, node, { visibility: 'hidden' })
```

`fallbackState` computes the same flag from the match list:

```ts
hidden: context.matches.some(match => retryTurn(match.event) === turn),
```

Event order for an exhausted retry chain is `llm/retry` → `llm/retry` → `turn/end{reason.kind:'error'}`, so `hidden` is already `true` when the terminal failure arrives, and the failure card is rendered with `visibility: 'hidden'`.

## Why this can only suppress the case it should show

A turn can carry both a retry chain and a terminal `turn/end` error in exactly one situation: the retries were exhausted. If a retry had succeeded, there would be no `kind: 'error'` turn ending to suppress.

So the suppression rule — as written — has no case where it hides something that *should* be hidden, and exactly one case where it hides something that must be visible. The intent ("do not present an in-flight intermediate failure as terminal") is right; the state transition is missing a reset.

## Suggested fix

Clear the flag when the terminal failure arrives:

```ts
if (failure !== undefined) return { ...context.state, failure, hidden: false }
```

and in `fallbackState`, treat the presence of a failure as authoritative rather than the presence of retry events.

Two assertions would pin the behaviour:

- `llm/retry` … `llm/retry` … `turn/end{error}` → node visible
- `llm/retry` … `llm/retry-started` (no terminal error) → nothing rendered

## Notes

- The data is not lost: `turn/end` durably records `reason.kind === 'error'` with the failure, so the truth is in the session log and only the chat surface drops it.
- `ui-trajectory` handles `reason.kind === 'error'` on its own path (`trajectory-assistant-definition.ts`), so the same failure may be visible in one panel and invisible in another.
- Separately, the default retry window is short for load-related upstream failures: `maxRetries 2`, `initialDelayMs 500`, `maxDelayMs 10_000` puts all three attempts inside roughly 1.6 seconds, while an Envoy 503 caused by backend saturation typically clears on a scale of seconds to minutes. That part is configurable per provider (`retryPolicy`), so it is a defaults question rather than a defect — but combined with the hidden card, the visible behaviour is "the task quietly stopped".
- `agent-loop` contains the failure at the driver boundary (`kick()` catches and drops after `agent/error` is emitted), so there is no continuation policy after a failed turn. That is a separate design question; this report is only about the failure being invisible.

<details>
<summary>中文</summary>

**标题建议**：重试耗尽的轮次失败被渲染为隐藏，导致会话看起来像正常完成

模型请求失败 → 按 provider 重试策略重试 → 重试耗尽后再次失败，此时聊天区**什么都不显示**。轮次结束、agent 转 idle，和正常完成的会话无法区分，任务静默停住，需要人发现并手动推进。版本 0.1.0-rc.7。

**现象**：自建 OpenAI 兼容网关在高负载下返回 Envoy 的后端不可用响应（`503 upstream connect error ... delayed connect error: 111`）。能看到重试提示（`delay 1090ms`），第二次重试之后就没有任何错误显示了。分类是对的（`status >= 500` → `SERVER`，在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里），重试确实发生了；问题出在重试用尽之后。

**原因**：`turn-error.ts` 的 doc comment 自己写了 *"suppressed when the turn owns a retry chain"*。`hidden` 在收到重试事件时置 `true`，而终态失败合并进 state 时没有清掉它（`{ ...context.state, failure }`），于是 `buildViewNode` 以 `visibility: 'hidden'` 输出。`fallbackState` 同理。事件顺序 `llm/retry` → `llm/retry` → `turn/end{error}` 保证了这条路径必然被触发。

**为什么这只可能压掉本该显示的情况**：一个轮次同时拥有重试链和终态 error，只可能是"重试耗尽"这一种情形——重试成功就不会有 `kind: 'error'` 的 `turn/end`。所以这条抑制规则没有任何"该藏而藏"的场景，只有一个"不该藏却藏了"的场景。设计意图（重试进行中不要把中间失败当终态展示）是对的，缺的是一次状态 reset。

**修法**：`if (failure !== undefined) return { ...context.state, failure, hidden: false }`，`fallbackState` 里以 failure 是否存在为准。建议补两条断言：重试后终态失败 → 可见；仅有重试事件 → 不渲染。

**附注**：数据没丢，`turn/end` 里 `reason.kind === 'error'` 是持久化的，只是聊天面板丢了；`ui-trajectory` 走另一条渲染路径，同一个失败可能在一个面板可见、另一个不可见。另外默认重试窗口（`maxRetries 2` / `500ms` / `10s`）把三次尝试压在约 1.6 秒内，对负载型上游故障偏短——这部分 provider 可配，属于默认值取舍而非缺陷，但和隐藏的错误卡叠加起来，用户看到的就是"任务静默停止"。
</details>

**Related**

  - #1504 — sub-second backoff and the autonomous run terminating after retry exhaustion.
    Overlaps the "defaults are short" note above; this report is specifically about the
    terminal failure being rendered hidden, which is orthogonal to the backoff numbers.
  - #3128 — `Retry-After` ignored on retry.

discussions.title: [Bug] Cancelling a task that spawned subagents permanently corrupts session persistence — production data integrity failure, no recovery path for operators
discussions.body:
## EN / English

### Observed behavior

In a production-like workflow: a task spawns **subagents** (via the `subagent` tool), then the user **cancels / aborts** the task (stop button, interrupt, or re-send). After this:

1. The **parent session** gains `turn/end` events with `reason.kind: "aborted"` at its tail. Repeated cancellations accumulate multiple aborted turns.
2. The **subagent sessions** (forked child sessions) are left **hanging**: their logs contain unclosed `turn/start` / `step/start` and `tool/call` entries with **no matching `tool/result`**.
3. Eventually the parent session **fails to load entirely** — the persistence layer refuses the log ("history unavailable"), the session becomes unreadable, and the data, though present on disk, is effectively lost to the user.

This is not a one-off: it reproduces every time a task with subagents is cancelled or re-sent.

### Expected behavior

- **Cancelling a task is a normal, first-class operation** in production (manual abort, timeout, re-queue). It must not leave permanent corrupting artifacts in session persistence.
- Aborted turns should be **recoverable / resumable** markers, not terminal states that make the session unusable.
- Child (subagent) sessions should be **closed cleanly** (or explicitly marked abandoned) when the parent task is cancelled — not left with unclosed turns/steps forever, leaking persistence state.
- The system must **degrade gracefully**: preserve data integrity and accessibility after a cancellation, without requiring manual log surgery.

### Impact scope (production focus)

- **High-frequency operation**: cancelling/re-sending agent tasks (especially ones that spawn subagents) is routine in production. Every occurrence deposits corrupting artifacts + hanging subagent sessions.
- Sessions degrade **cumulatively** — each cancellation moves the session closer to permanent unreadability.
- **Data integrity failure**: the persisted log becomes logically inconsistent (seq/state violations) while the file itself looks intact on disk — the worst kind of failure to diagnose.
- **No recovery path for operators**: restoring the session today requires manual, surgical, byte-level log editing (frame-accurate truncation + seq repair). This is not achievable by a production operator or non-technical user.
- The corruption lives in the shared persistence layer, so **every consumer of the session data is affected** — no entry point can read the session once the log is rejected.

### Repro

1. In a session, issue a command that spawns subagents (e.g. the `subagent` tool).
2. While it runs, **cancel** (or re-send the message).
3. Repeat 2–3 times.
4. Reopen the parent session → the persistence layer rejects the log; the session is unreadable.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- Also verified on: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`
- Session format: multi-frame zstd JSONL (`session.jsonl.zstd`), strict contiguous seq from 0
- Subagent tool: `subagent` (spawns child sessions under `~/.dsh/sessions/...`)

### Evidence (sanitized)

Parent session tail after cancelling twice:

```
turn 47: turn/end reason=completed      <- last good turn
turn 48: turn/end reason=aborted       <- from cancellation #1
turn 49: turn/end reason=aborted       <- from cancellation #2
session/end-seed
```

Hanging subagent sessions (children of the parent):

```
subagent A: unclosed turn/start, unclosed step/start
subagent B: unclosed turn/start, unclosed step/start, tool/call with no matching tool/result
```

Recovery only worked after truncating the parent log at turn 47's `turn/end` (frame-accurate surgery); the subagent sessions remain in a permanently inconsistent state.

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 现象

在生产类工作流中：任务通过 `subagent` 工具启动**子 agent**，然后用户**取消/中止**该任务（停止按钮、中断、或撤回重发）。此后：

1. **父会话**尾部产生 `reason.kind: "aborted"` 的 `turn/end`。反复取消会累积多个 aborted 轮次。
2. **子 agent 会话**（fork 出的子会话）被**悬挂**：日志里残留未闭合的 `turn/start` / `step/start`，以及没有对应 `tool/result` 的 `tool/call`。
3. 最终父会话**整体加载失败**——持久化层拒绝该日志（"历史不可用"），会话不可读；数据虽在磁盘上，但事实上已对用户丢失。

这不是偶发：**每次取消/重发带子 agent 的任务都会复现**。

### 期望行为

- **取消任务是生产环境的正常一等操作**（人工中止、超时、重新排队）。它绝不能在会话持久化中留下永久损坏痕迹。
- aborted 轮次应是**可恢复/可继续**的标记，而不是让会话不可用的终态。
- 父任务被取消时，子（subagent）会话应被**干净关闭**（或明确标记为废弃），而不是永远挂着未闭合的 turn/step、泄漏持久化状态。
- 系统必须**优雅降级**：取消后保持数据完整性与可访问性，无需人工日志手术。

### 影响范围（生产视角）

- **高频操作**：取消/重发 agent 任务（尤其带子 agent 的）在生产中是常规动作。每一次都在持久化中沉积损坏痕迹 + 悬挂的子会话。
- 会话**累积性劣化**——每次取消都让会话离"永久不可读"更近一步。
- **数据完整性失败**：持久化日志变得逻辑不一致（seq/状态违规），但磁盘文件看起来完好——这是最难以诊断的失败类型。
- **运维人员无恢复路径**：当前恢复需要手工、外科手术式、字节级日志编辑（帧级截断 + seq 修复）——生产运维或非技术用户无法完成。
- 损坏位于**共享持久化层**，因此**所有会话数据消费者均受影响**——日志一旦被拒绝，任何入口都无法读取该会话。

### 复现步骤

1. 在会话中下达一条会启动子 agent 的命令（例如 `subagent` 工具）。
2. 运行中**取消**（或撤回重发）。
3. 重复 2–3 次。
4. 重新打开父会话 → 持久化层拒绝该日志；会话不可读。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.6` / `0.1.0-rc.7`
- 另已在：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` 上验证
- 会话格式：多帧 zstd JSONL（`session.jsonl.zstd`），seq 从 0 严格连续
- 子 agent 工具：`subagent`（在 `~/.dsh/sessions/...` 下派生子会话）

### 证据（脱敏）

父会话尾部（取消两次后）：

```
turn 47: turn/end reason=completed      <- 最后一个正常轮次
turn 48: turn/end reason=aborted       <- 第一次取消产生
turn 49: turn/end reason=aborted       <- 第二次取消产生
session/end-seed
```

悬挂的子 agent 会话（父会话的子会话）：

```
subagent A: 未闭合 turn/start、未闭合 step/start
subagent B: 未闭合 turn/start、未闭合 step/start、无对应 tool/result 的 tool/call
```

只有把父日志截断到 turn 47 的 `turn/end`（帧级手术）后会话才恢复可读；子会话仍处于永久不一致状态。

---

## 署名 / About this report

**EN:** Reported by the **OfferKuai (Offer快) Team** — an AI startup building full-lifecycle job-application services, guided by the belief that *"users need results, not repeated conversations."* Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. We use DeepSeek Harness as part of our daily development workflow; this report is our way of contributing back to the ecosystem. Website: <https://www.offerkuai.com/> | Contact: <[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

**ZH:** 本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 一家专注 AI 全流程求职托管的创业团队，核心理念是「用户要的是结果，不是重复对话」。创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。我们将 DeepSeek Harness 用于日常开发工作流，这份报告是我们对社区的回馈。官网：<https://www.offerkuai.com/> | 联系：<[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

discussions.title: Showcase: 5 DSH plugins + one-command scaffold — live-git file tree included
discussions.body:
# Showcase: 5 DSH plugins + a one-command scaffold — including a live-git-status file tree

> 🐘 Repo: [codelogickeep/deepseek-harness-plugin](https://github.com/codelogickeep/deepseek-harness-plugin)
> License: MIT · 4 host plugins + 1 client-bundle plugin + 1 agent preset + install scaffold

## What's inside

| Plugin | Type | What it does |
| --- | --- | --- |
| **ui-enhance** | client bundle | Right-side **file tree** matching the left sidebar's light theme: recursive dirs, **live git badges (M/A/D/U)**, drag-to-resize, **double-click to open in your IDE** (VS Code/Cursor/Windsurf/Trae), copyable path header, git summary footer |
| **browser-reader** | host `.mjs` | `web_read` family tools driving real Chromium/Edge (SSR-proof reads, console, screenshots) |
| **minimax-search** | host `.mjs` | MiniMax as DSH web-search provider → `web_search` just works |
| **cron-scheduler** | host `.mjs` | 5-field cron scheduling (`0 10 * * *`), config-driven, crash-safe against double-fire |
| **flash-worker** | agent preset | adds `flash_agent`: pro orchestrates, flash executes |
| **dingtalk bridge** | standalone process | chat with your DSH agent from DingTalk |

## Highlight: live file tree (ui-enhance)

Unlike a static tree, this one updates **in real time** — `fs.watch` + SSE push a `changed` event and the client refreshes its git badges instantly. Commit a file and watch the `M` badge disappear without touching the page.

![file tree](../docs/demo-filetree.png)

## One-command scaffold (the part I'm most proud of)

Install *everything* (build + self-check + install into the profile + **append plugin references into `cordis.patch.yml`**) with one command:

```bash
npm install
cd plugins/ui-enhance && pnpm install && cd ../..
npm run install:plugins   # idempotent; keeps your hand-edited patch entries
```

The scaffold:
1. Runs a **load-time self-check** on every plugin before install (a stub `ctx` with a Proxy that mimics Cordis' inject gate — a plugin that would crash DSH at boot is rejected *before* it's installed)
2. Builds client bundles via tsdown closure-factory
3. Appends only the *missing* plugin references into `cordis.patch.yml` (never overwrites what you already have)

## Try it

```bash
npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web   # first, let it generate cordis.patch.yml
git clone https://github.com/codelogickeep/deepseek-harness-plugin.git
cd deepseek-harness-plugin
npm install
cd plugins/ui-enhance && pnpm install && cd ../..
npm run install:plugins
# restart dsh — all plugins live
```

Docs are in Chinese (deep-dive architecture, incident postmortems in `docs/`). Happy to answer questions here!

> ⚠️ DSH is in developer preview — these plugins target current `dsh web`.

discussions.title: [Analysis] Subagent cancellation & session persistence: root-cause analysis with source references, and a proposed fix path (marked-dispose + persistence tolerance)
discussions.body:
### Related bug report

This analysis is the technical companion to: **[Bug] Cancelling a task that spawned subagents permanently corrupts session persistence** — <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662>

---

## EN / English

### Purpose

This is a **technical analysis** companion to the bug report *"Cancelling a task that spawned subagents permanently corrupts session persistence"* ([[#3662](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662)). We studied the engine source (rc.6/rc.7, cross-checked against the latest `0.1.1-rc.2`) to locate the root cause precisely and to propose a fix path that respects the existing architecture. We are sharing it openly in case it helps the maintainers.

### Version note / 版本说明

This analysis cites symbols rather than line numbers; all of them were re-verified on `0.1.1-rc.2` and remain present with the same semantics: `notifySettlement` / child-first disposal / `ctx.on("agent/disposed")` in `dsh-subagent`, `foldSurface()` in the persistence layer, and `SessionLogScanner`.

### Root-cause analysis (with source references)

**1. "Background agent keeps running" is an explicit design, not a gap.**

The `subagent-control` tool description states cancellation semantics verbatim:

> "Request cancellation of a background agent's current turn by its agent id... **Only the current turn stops: messages already queued for the agent stay parked until a later send_message, agents it started keep running, and the agent itself stays available for follow-ups.**"

So when a parent session is cancelled, the engine intentionally leaves child agents running. That is the background-agent model.

**2. The engine already owns a clean child-close path — it is just not invoked on parent cancel.**

In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent` (`lib/index.js`), the continuable-subagent manager documents **"child-first disposal, and settlement delivery to the parent"**, and states that ending child residency is the manager's job alone (`notifySettlement`). There is a full vocabulary for closing a child (`subagent/descriptor`, settlement summary, `subagent/end`), and a `ctx.on("agent/disposed")` hook exists to clean up closing scopes.

**3. Where the corruption actually comes from.**

When the parent is cancelled, the parent log gains `turn/end reason=aborted` + `session/end-seed`, but:

- child sessions are **not** closed (no `turn/end` / settlement written), leaving unclosed `turn/start` / `step/start` and `tool/call` with no `tool/result`;
- if the child later tries to write back to the parent (or the parent session is re-opened and re-written), the parent log's `seq` counter has moved on while the file was truncated/repaired — the two no longer agree, and the persistence layer rejects the log.

The failure is a **missing link between "parent cancelled" and "children disposed"** — the architecture has the pieces, but no trigger wires them together on the cancel path.

### Proposed fix path (respecting the background-agent design)

We propose a **combination of "marked dispose" (not force-kill) + persistence tolerance**:

**A′. Marked dispose on parent cancel (behavior-preserving)**

- When a parent is cancelled, do **not** kill child agents (preserve the background-agent contract).
- Instead, mark the child as `disposed` in its durable descriptor and **write closure events** (`turn/end reason=disposed`, synthetic `tool/result reason=aborted` for unmatched calls) — i.e. invoke the existing child-first disposal + settlement machinery that already exists.
- The child finishes its current turn naturally; anything after the marker is refused at admission, so the child log never accumulates unclosed state.

**B. Persistence-layer tolerance (recovery of already-corrupted logs)**

- Beyond `foldSurface()`, add an inbox/subagent consistency pass: on load, detect unclosed `turn/start` / `step/start` and orphaned `removedCount`, and synthesize the missing closure events instead of rejecting the whole log.
- This mirrors how rc.7 handled max-tokens truncation: one decision point that decides "which chunks to drop" and "which closure events to synthesize" together.

This combination: **A′ fixes the live path (cancellation no longer creates corruption), B fixes the historical path (logs already damaged become loadable again).**

### Our recovery tooling (offered)

We have built and battle-tested frame-accurate recovery tooling over several real incidents (multi-frame zstd session logs):

- frame-level first-header validation,
- strict `seq` contiguity scan (mirroring `SessionLogScanner`),
- content audit (spliced pairing / turn-step pairing / tool pairing / time monotonicity),
- surgical truncation at the last `completed` `turn/end`,
- orphan `removedCount` repair.

We are happy to contribute this as a `dsh doctor` / recovery utility if the maintainers are interested.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.7` / `0.1.1-rc.2` (verified on both)

### Questions for maintainers

1. Is the "background child keeps running on parent cancel" behavior **intentional and to be preserved**?
2. Would the **marked-dispose (A′)** approach fit the existing `notifySettlement` / child-first-disposal design?
3. Is persistence-level closure synthesis (B) on the roadmap, similar to the max-tokens truncation handling in rc.7?

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 关联的 bug 报告

本分析是下述 bug 报告的技术配套帖：**[Bug] 取消启动过子 agent 的任务会永久损坏会话持久化** —— <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662>

### 目的

这是对 bug 报告《取消启动过子 agent 的任务会永久损坏会话持久化》（[[#3662](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3662)）的**技术分析配套帖**。我们研读了引擎源码（rc.6/rc.7，并对照了最新的 `0.1.1-rc.2`）以精确定位根因，并提出尊重现有架构的修复路径，公开分享以供维护者参考。

### 版本说明

本分析引用的是符号而非行号；全部在 `0.1.1-rc.2` 上重新验证，仍然存在且语义一致：`dsh-subagent` 中的 `notifySettlement` / child-first disposal / `ctx.on("agent/disposed")`，持久化层的 `foldSurface()`，以及 `SessionLogScanner`。

### 根因分析（附源码引用）

**1. "子 agent 后台继续运行"是明确设计，不是缺口。**

`subagent-control` 工具对取消语义的原文：

> "请求按 agent id 取消后台 agent 的当前 turn…… **只有当前 turn 停止：已排队消息保留到后续 send_message，它启动的 agent 继续运行，agent 本身保持可后续使用。**"

因此，父会话被取消时，引擎**有意**让子 agent 继续运行——这就是"后台 agent"模型。

**2. 引擎已拥有干净的子关闭链路——只是父取消时没有调用它。**

在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`（`lib/index.js`）中，continuable-subagent 管理器明确写着 **"child-first disposal（子先关闭），以及结算送达父会话"**，并声明结束子会话驻留是该管理器独有的职责（`notifySettlement`）。关闭子会话的完整词汇已存在（`subagent/descriptor`、结算摘要、`subagent/end`），且有 `ctx.on("agent/disposed")` 钩子用于清理 closing scopes。

**3. 损坏的真正来源。**

父会话被取消时，父日志获得 `turn/end reason=aborted` + `session/end-seed`，但：

- 子会话**没有被关闭**（没有 `turn/end`/结算写入），留下未闭合的 `turn/start` / `step/start` 和无对应 `tool/result` 的 `tool/call`；
- 如果子会话稍后尝试写回父会话（或父会话被重新打开并重写），父日志的 `seq` 计数器已前移、而文件曾被截断/修复——两者不再一致，持久化层拒绝该日志。

失败点在于 **"父取消"与"子 disposed"之间缺少链接**——架构里零件齐全，但取消路径上没有把它们串起来的触发器。

### 建议修复路径（尊重后台 agent 设计）

我们建议 **"标记式 dispose（非强杀）+ 持久化容错"** 的组合：

**A′. 父取消时标记式 dispose（保持行为不变）**

- 父被取消时**不杀掉**子 agent（保留后台 agent 契约）。
- 而是在子会话的持久化 descriptor 中将其标记为 `disposed`，并**写入闭合事件**（`turn/end reason=disposed`、为未匹配调用补写合成 `tool/result reason=aborted`）——即调用**已存在的** child-first disposal + settlement 机制。
- 子会话自然完成当前 turn；之后任何写入在准入阶段被拒绝，子日志永不积累未闭合状态。

**B. 持久化层容错（恢复已损坏日志）**

- 在 `foldSurface()` 之外增加 inbox/subagent 一致性检查：加载时检测未闭合的 `turn/start` / `step/start` 与孤儿 `removedCount`，合成缺失的闭合事件，而不是拒绝整份日志。
- 这与 rc.7 处理 max-tokens 截断的思路一致：在一个决策点同时决定"丢弃哪些块"与"补写哪些闭合事件"。

此组合：**A′ 修复实时路径（取消不再产生损坏），B 修复历史路径（已损坏日志重新可加载）。**

### 我们的恢复工具（愿意贡献）

我们已构建并在多次真实事故中实战验证了**帧级恢复工具**（多帧 zstd 会话日志）：

- 首帧 header 校验；
- 严格 seq 连续性扫描（复刻 `SessionLogScanner`）；
- 内容审计（spliced 配对 / turn-step 配对 / tool 配对 / 时间单调）；
- 在最后一个 `completed` 的 `turn/end` 处手术式截断；
- 孤儿 `removedCount` 修复。

如果维护者感兴趣，我们愿意将其贡献为 `dsh doctor` / 恢复工具。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.0-rc.7` / `0.1.1-rc.2`（均在两者上验证）

### 向维护者提出的问题

1. "父取消时后台子 agent 继续运行"是否**有意为之、需要保留**？
2. **标记式 dispose（A′）**是否符合现有 `notifySettlement` / child-first-disposal 设计？
3. 持久化层闭合事件合成（B）是否在路线图上，类似 rc.7 的 max-tokens 截断处理？

---

We use DeepSeek Harness as part of our daily development workflow; this report is our way of contributing back to the ecosystem. discussions.title: dsh-capmark-gate: hold an agent to a declared capability manifest
discussions.body:
A plugin declares what it may do, in Markdown, and the harness holds it to that.

```markdown
---
capmark: 0.1
plugin: dsh-vision-toolkit
---

# Capabilities

​```cap
grant fs:read scope=workspace
grant net:fetch
​```

# Contracts

​```cap
never proc:spawn
require approval for fs:write
​```
```

The file is Markdown first. A client that has never heard of the format still
renders a legible security README - the worst case for an unsupported manifest
is documentation.

## Why another policy plugin

There are already good ones, and this is not a replacement for them. The
difference is the unit of decision. `dsh-tool-policy` and `dsh-permission-rules`
match tool names and argument shapes, which is the right layer for shaping a
call. Discussion #174 also recorded what that layer cannot do: a deny rule on
`rm -rf` was walked around with `rm` followed by `rmdir` in the same run.

So the rule this format is built on is that **every capability must name a
mechanism that actually stops it**. Denying a whole tool qualifies - there is no
rephrasing your way to `bash` once `bash` is off the table. A host allowlist does
not, because nothing checks the URL before the tool body runs. Rather than let
that pass for a wall, the linter says so:

```
warning  advisory-scope  scope on `net:fetch` is recorded and audited, but
                         nothing enforces it - do not rely on it as a boundary
```

## What it does on a running harness

Two seams. `tools.restrict()` narrows what the agent can see, and
`tools/pre-execute` judges every call. Both are needed: a tool registered into
the agent's own layer bypasses the admit check, and `run_code` is re-added to
every non-native view after restrictions apply, so a mask alone leaves both
callable.

Measured on a booted rc.7 `standard` agent, with a manifest granting `fs:read`
and forbidding `proc:spawn`:

```
tools visible: 25 -> 4        (read, glob, grep, read_image)

read         allow
grep         allow
bash         deny  - reader declares `never proc:spawn`, and `bash` is part of it
write        deny  - reader declares no capability covering `write`
web_search   deny  - reader declares no capability covering `web_search`
```

## The part that surprised me

Tool schemas are re-sent on every request, so a tool an agent can never call is
paid for on every turn. That same `standard` preset carries 25 tools in 25,567
bytes - roughly 6.4k tokens per request. The manifest above justifies 5 of them,
at 2,724 bytes, an 89.3% cut to the tool payload.

I went in thinking this was a safety feature and came out thinking the prompt
reduction may be the easier sell. Both come from the same declaration.

Numbers for the other shipped presets, and the probe that captured them, are in
the repo. The `code` preset saves 86.2% rather than the 89.7% my offline
calculation first claimed - `run_code` is unmaskable, which only turned up when
I masked a live harness instead of trusting the arithmetic.

## Limits, stated up front

**It does not sandbox a plugin's own code.** A plugin's `apply()` runs
in-process with full Node privileges before any tool call happens. This governs
what an *agent* may call. Refusing to install an over-reaching plugin is a
separate and earlier decision.

Verified against `0.1.0-rc.7`. Format version is `0.1` and says so.

- Checker and format: <https://www.npmjs.com/package/capmark> (`npx capmark lint ./CAP.md`)
- Gate: <https://github.com/taltara/capmark/tree/main/packages/gate>

Happy to be told the vocabulary is wrong - it is fourteen capabilities today,
and I would rather cut one than add three.

discussions.title: Profile Bundle install docs resolve to 0.0.1-rc.1 while the actual bundle is tagged next (0.1.0-rc.8)
discussions.body:
Thanks for the recent rc.8 release. During an end-to-end Windows smoke test of the Codex Profile Bundle, I found a prerelease distribution mismatch.

### Environment

- Windows
- DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8
- Web Profile
- Package: @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex

### Reproduction

~~~powershell
npm view @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex dist-tags --json
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex
dsh --profile web --dump-config
~~~

Observed dist-tags:

~~~json
{
  "latest": "0.0.1-rc.1",
  "next": "0.1.0-rc.8"
}
~~~

### Expected

The install command documented for the prerelease should install a package that declares dsh.bundle, or the prerelease documentation should explicitly use @next or an exact version.

After installation, the Profile bundle list and dump-config should contain the Codex Provider row.

### Actual

The untagged command installed @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.0.1-rc.1.

The CLI reported:

~~~text
declares no dsh.bundle — installed as a plain dependency, not a profile layer
~~~

The Codex Provider was therefore not mounted. Installing 0.1.0-rc.8 explicitly added the Bundle and the subagent-codex Provider appeared after a Profile restart.

### Workaround

~~~powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@next
~~~

or:

~~~powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.1.0-rc.8
~~~

### Suggested resolution

- Promote the compatible release to latest, or use @next in prerelease docs.
- Add a release test that executes the exact documented command against npm dist-tags.
- Before installation, show the resolved version and whether it declares dsh.bundle.
- When a known Bundle package lacks dsh.bundle, provide an actionable @next hint.

discussions.title: 按场景注入 vs 隔离在存储层：两种记忆注入范式的本质差异
discussions.body:
# 按场景注入 vs 隔离在存储层：两种记忆注入范式的本质差异

> 本文讨论 LMA（Layered Memory Architecture）与"按场景注入"类记忆方案的根本区别。
> 核心论点：**隔离到底该发生在上游（存储）还是下游（检索）。**

---

## 一、按场景注入的机制（以 SGME 为例）

"按场景注入"类方案（如：SGME ）的典型流程是三步：

```
① Capture   —— 保存原始对话，存进一个统一的记忆库
② Distill   —— 从原始对话提炼出带标签的记忆（事实、偏好、项目状态、决策…）
③ Inject    —— 对话开始时，系统识别当前场景，按场景检索相关记忆注入
```

第 ③ 步是它的核心点：

- 系统判断"现在是闲聊 / 编码 / 工作"
- 闲聊 → 注入身份、近期状态
- 编码 → 注入技术栈、坑、开发习惯
- 工作 → 注入计划、进度

**它的承诺是：只注入"场景相关"的记忆，不注入全量。**

---

## 二、它的本质问题：隔离发生在检索层

"按场景注入"看似解决了"全量注入污染上下文"，但往本质上看一层，会发现一个更深的问题：

> **决定好场景之后，它依然要去一个「一锅乱炖」的记忆库里去检索出"有用的"，再注入到这个会话里。**

换句话说：

- 记忆**本身**还是混在一个统一的库里，没有结构性区分（结构性不是标记）
- "场景"只是**检索时的事后筛选**——先识别场景，再去乱炖库里捞出"相关的"
- **隔离是检索补丁，不是存储结构**

由此带来三个固有缺陷：

1. **场景识别存在一定不可靠性**：真实对话的场景是模糊、重叠、动态的（边闲聊边写代码算哪个场景？）。分类器猜错，直接变成"记忆喂错"。
2. **场景枚举有限**：预设场景（闲聊/编码/工作）是有限集，真实场景（科研、写作、面试…）覆盖不全，要么强行归类，要么漏掉。
3. **用户不可控**：用户没法精确说"这个会话我只让它知道 A，别知道 B"；也看不到"系统为什么注入了这些"。

**一句话：按场景注入，是在乱炖库里做聪明的检索——它没有消除"乱炖"，只是减少了"乱炖"带来的污染。**

---

## 三、LMA 的路：隔离发生在存储层

LMA 把隔离的位置**上移到了存储层**：

- 记忆不是混在一个统一库里，而是**按「体」（Memory Body）分开存放**——每个体是独立的目录 + 独立的 JSONL
- 挂载（`/mount` `/unmount`）直接**圈定范围**：当前会话能访问哪些体
- 从**源头**就不乱炖，而不是检索时才想起来过滤

**隔离是结构性的（存的时候就分开了），不是检索补丁。**

---

## 四、本质对比

| 维度 | 按场景注入 | LMA（隔离在存储层） |
|---|---|---|
| 隔离发生的位置 | **检索层**（事后筛选） | **存储层**（事前分开） |
| 记忆怎么存 | 一个统一库，混在一起 | 多个独立体，结构性隔离 |
| 谁决定喂什么 | 系统猜场景 | 用户显式挂载 |
| 边界可验证吗 | 难（黑盒，判得对不对不知道） | 能（挂载集明明白白） |
| 污染风险 | 降低但没消除（靠算法猜） | 结构性消除（范围圈定） |

---

## 五、结论

```
按场景注入 = 在乱炖库里做聪明的检索
多体分层   = 从源头就不乱炖
```

**一个在"事后补救"，一个在"事前隔离"。**

架构的"干净"，就干净在**隔离发生在上游（存储），而不是下游（检索）**：

- 事后补救，永远有"猜错"的风险——场景分类器、检索相似度，都有误差，误差直接变成"记忆喂错"
- 事前隔离，把"喂错"的可能性从结构上消掉——体分开了，挂载圈定了，剩下的只是"在正确的范围内取正确的几条"

这不是说"按需检索"没用（LMA 同样靠 `memory_search` 按需取），而是说：**检索做的是"在已隔离的范围内取对"，而按场景注入做的却是"靠检索去弥补没隔离"**。前者是锦上添花，后者是检索的优化。

---

## 六、相关的文档

SGME 在描述其 "Unified search" 时，原文写道：

> A single search endpoint recalls from the **memory pool** and the knowledge base at once: **keyword + semantic + label triple fusion**, every result traceable to its source. SGME memories, scenes, and knowledge base **in one stop**; **agent-owned memory files are on the roadmap.**

三个关键词，句句印证"隔离发生在检索层"：

| 原话 | 暴露的结构 |
|---|---|
| `memory pool`（单数） | 一个统一记忆池 = 一锅乱炖，非多体分开存 |
| `keyword + semantic + label triple fusion` | 三种方式在**检索时**融合筛选 = 隔离在检索层 |
| `in one stop` | 统一入口，无存储级分层隔离 |

**还有**：

> `agent-owned memory files are on the roadmap.`

SGME 承认，"让 agent 拥有独立记忆文件"这个能力**还在路线图里、尚未实现**——而这恰恰是 LMA 的「体 = 独立目录 + 独立 JSONL」**已经交付的东西**。



---

## 七、更根本的一层：写入环节的三难困境

上面讨论的是「注入（检索）」环节——记忆怎么被取出来。但再往上游推一层，有一个更根本的问题：**记忆是怎么「写入」库的？**

任何记忆方案，写入无非三种路径，而三种都躲不开困境：

| 写入路径 | 后果 |
|---|---|
| ① 按平时会话**自动积累**（自动提炼） | 还是**乱炖**——所有会话记忆混进一个 pool，标签是事后贴的补丁，不是结构性隔离 |
| ② 对会话记忆**自动分类**（如 15 维标签） | **不准**——分类器有误差，标签贴错 → 检索错 → 喂错 |
| ③ 初始记忆**用户自己写** | **鸡肋**——自动记忆方案的价值主张就是"自动帮你记"，要用户手动写，它"自动"的意义就没了 |

**三种路径，要么乱炖、要么不准、要么鸡肋——没有一条能两全。**

**而 按场景（如sgme） 实际走的是 ① + ② 的组合**（它绕开了 ③，因为"用户手写"和它"全自动"的价值主张矛盾）：

- **Capture**：对话自动存为原始 Markdown（L0 raw layer）——这是 ① 自动积累，原始对话**混着存**
- **Distill**：自动提炼 + 自动打 15 维标签 + 自动去重/合并/矛盾检测——这是 ② 自动分类，在混池里**靠算法猜**

所以 SGME 的写入 = **"自动积累（乱炖）+ 自动分类（不准）"的双重叠加**：它把最难的两条路一起走了。记忆在 Capture 那一刻就混着存，Distill 再靠分类器"亡羊补牢"，但分类器本身会猜错。

这暴露了一个比"检索层隔离"更本质的事实：

> **问题不在"存储怎么分"，而在"写入时是不是就乱了"。**

记忆在写入那一刻就乱炖了，后面检索再聪明，也是在乱炖里捞。

### LMA 的破法：双权威，在写入环节就分流

LMA 用「双权威」在**写入那一刻**就避开了这个三难：

| | 写入路径 | 权威标记 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|---|
| 用户记忆 | `/remember` 用户**显式写** | `user` | 准确、可控，且标记为"用户钦定，只读" |
| 模型记忆 | `/summarize` 模型**总结** | `model` | 明确标记"模型提炼的经验，可能不准，可编辑可推翻" |

关键区别：


- LMA 把两者**从写入那一刻就分流**：用户记忆是"钦定"（可信、只读），模型记忆是"经验"（可能不准、可编辑）——**即使模型总结不准，也不会污染用户钦定的记忆。**
（LMA：https://github.com/szx-a/ds.git 还在改进，文中提到的具体的实现其本身是优秀的，本文只对事和观点而言）
---

## 附

本文基于其公开 README 的自述，"按场景注入"的机制描述以其自述为准；不影响本文的核心论点——因为论点的靶子是**"隔离发生在检索层"这一类设计**，而非某一个具体实现。这些实现本身是优秀的

discussions.title: Product subagent retries and transport fallback are invisible behind “Deep diving…”
discussions.body:
During a real DeepSeek Harness → Codex → DeepSeek run, the delegated task eventually succeeded, but the Web UI hid five retries and a transport fallback behind one generic status.

### Environment

- Windows
- DeepSeek Harness dsh-v0.1.0-rc.8
- @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.1.0-rc.8
- Bundled @openai/codex@0.147.0
- Foreground subagent_codex call from a Web Session

### Reproduction

1. Install the rc.8 Codex Profile Bundle and restart the Profile.
2. Copy the standard Agent Preset and enable its subagent_codex tool row.
3. Start a new Session on that Preset.
4. Invoke subagent_codex.
5. Compare the Web tool card with Host stderr.

### Expected

The UI should expose a redacted operational timeline such as:

~~~text
Codex · provider codex
Starting runtime
Sampling request timed out · retry 3/5
Switching transport to HTTP
Running · 01:42
~~~

It should not expose endpoints, prompts, commands, paths, raw stderr, environment values or credentials.

### Actual

Host stderr showed retries 1/5 through 5/5:

~~~text
stream disconnected - retrying sampling request (.../5 in ...)...
sampling_error: request timed out
~~~

It then showed:

~~~text
falling back to HTTP
~~~

The Web UI continued to show only Deep diving... and elapsed time.

The operation eventually succeeded. The completed Trajectory correctly showed IN, OUT and a tool duration of 132,548 ms, but the user could not tell during execution whether the run was healthy, retrying, blocked on permission or switching transport.

### Suggested resolution

Add a bounded, provider-neutral observation channel on the existing SubagentRun identity. A minimal safe vocabulary could include:

~~~ts
type ProductSubagentObservation =
  | { kind: 'stage'; stage: 'starting' | 'reasoning' | 'finalizing' | 'teardown' }
  | { kind: 'sampling-retry'; attempt: number; maxAttempts: number; reason: 'timeout' | 'disconnect' }
  | { kind: 'transport-fallback'; from: 'sampling'; to: 'http' }
  | { kind: 'compatibility-warning'; code: 'codex-model-cache-schema' }
~~~

The UI should render these fixed events, not raw product protocol messages.

discussions.title: Clarify Codex permissionMode=never as non-interactive with inherited native sandbox
discussions.body:
This came up while testing a statically bound, named Codex Provider. The current mapping is internally consistent, but the Web UI can make `never` look like a read-only guarantee even though it only controls approval prompting.

### Environment

- @deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-codex@0.1.0-rc.8
- Provider configured with permissionMode: never
- Static dsh-tool-subagent binding

### Current mapping

~~~text
never:
  approvalPolicy = never
  sandbox = omitted

approve-for-me:
  approvalPolicy = on-request
  approvalsReviewer = auto_review
  sandbox = workspace-write

dangerously-bypass-approvals-and-sandbox:
  approvalPolicy = never
  sandbox = danger-full-access
~~~

### Expected

Web should show the Harness Session authority and the product Provider authority separately:

~~~text
Harness Session
  sandbox: workspace-write
  approval: ask

Codex Provider
  providerName: codex
  mode: never
  meaning: never ask for approval
  native sandbox: inherited / not reported
  read-only guarantee: none
~~~

### Actual

Web shows the Harness Session permission selector, but it does not show the selected Codex Provider, Provider permission mode, or native sandbox consequence.

Because never omits the sandbox field, it must not be interpreted as read-only or never-write.

### Suggested resolution

- Use wording such as “Never ask · native sandbox inherited”.
- Expose a sanitized Provider descriptor containing providerName, native mode and a normalized permission explanation.
- Keep Provider selection and permission static in deployment configuration; do not add them as model-facing tool parameters.
- Consider a separate explicit read-only non-interactive combination in a future compatible API.

discussions.title: 社区插件：修复 session-query 中文检索（unicode61 缺陷）+ 记忆优化插件集（Phase 0/1/2，已真机验证）
discussions.body:
### 1. 缺陷报告：`unicode61` tokenizer 对中文基本不可用

`dsh-session-query-sqlite` 使用 FTS5 `unicode61` tokenizer，对 CJK 文本**不切词**：连续汉字被索引为单个 token，中文全文检索实际不可用。

实测（node:sqlite + FTS5）：

| 场景 | unicode61（上游） | trigram（本插件） |
|---|---|---|
| 文档 `索引优化减少Token消耗的句子`，查询 `Token消耗` | ❌ 0 命中 | ✅ 命中 |
| 查询 `"索引优化"`（整句短语） | ❌ 0 命中（必须完整复现整句） | ✅ 命中 |

### 2. 插件集介绍（均已开源，`dsh-plugin` 话题，47 个单测）

仓库：**https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory**

| 包 | 作用 | 阶段 |
|---|---|---|
| `dsh-session-query-sqlite-cjk` | 中文可用的会话全文检索 provider：双 tokenizer 双表（保留 unicode61 + 新增 trigram），按查询是否含 CJK 自动路由；fork 自上游（MIT） | Phase 0 |
| `dsh-tool-result-dedup` | 工具结果哈希去重：重复结果（git status / ls / 重复 read）第二次起替换为指针，纯省输入 Token | Phase 0 |
| `dsh-memory-index` | 混合记忆检索服务 `ctx.memorySearch`：sqlite-vec 向量臂 + FTS5 词法臂 → RRF 融合；事件级增量嵌入；file 词条标签 + 过滤 | Phase 1 |
| `dsh-memory-tool` | 模型可调用的 `memory_search` 工具：会话旧内容混合召回，输出严格有界（limit × maxChars） | Phase 1 |
| `dsh-compaction-locator` | 近无损压缩：继承 `BasicCompactionEngine` 的 `summarize()` 钩子，每个 `<compacted-summary>` 追加 Exact Sources 定位符（spill 路径/文件/seq 区间） | Phase 2 |
| `dsh-memory-core` | 跨会话核心记忆：workspace 事实库 + 稳定 system-prompt section 注入（KV 安全）+ `memory_remember` 工具 | Phase 2 |
| `dsh-memory-bundle` | 元 bundle：一键安装全部插件（`dsh.bundle.patch`），自动禁用 base 的 session-query/compaction 行 | 集成 |

### 3. ✅ 真机验证结果（`dsh --profile headless`，独立测试 profile）

- **整树启动**：6 插件 + 禁用 base 冲突行，无启动错误；
- **`memory_remember` 写入**：返回「已记住 (uuid)」；
- **`memory_search` 混合召回**：中文查询命中 3 条真实会话记录（CJK provider + RRF 生效）；
- **跨会话持久化**：新会话系统提示逐字包含：

### 4. 验证中发现并修复的 3 个集成问题（单测覆盖不到，供官方参考）

1. **Service 注册模式**：cordis `Service` 构造器签名是 `(ctx, name)`——把 config 当 name 传会注册成 `[object Object]` 并冲突；正确写法 `super(ctx, "name")` + `ctx.plugin(Class, config)`；
2. **工具注册时机**：类插件的构造器里 `ctx.tools` 尚未解析——需用函数插件入口（apply）注册工具；
3. **同步渲染要求**：system-prompt section 的 `text` 是同步调用——派生库需构造器同步打开，否则新进程区块为空。

### 5. 给官方的反馈：缺少"非持久化 + KV 友好"的请求注入接缝

做自动记忆注入时逐一验证了三条路径，在 v0.1-rc.7 中都不可行：

1. **`agent/pre-step` messages**：会被 `session.append("user/message", {surfaceOp:"append"})` 变成**持久化历史**，每步重发，Token 反膨胀；
2. **`llm/stream`**：请求在 `buildRequest` 被 `deepFreeze`，且 waterfall 默认闭包锁死原对象，无法替换/变更；
3. **system-prompt section**：非持久化内容只能进 system prompt（请求最前），**每次变化会让 KV 前缀缓存整段失效**。

因此 v0.1 采用"模型主动调用 `memory_search` 工具 + 稳定的 core 记忆 section"形态（Letta 式分层）。如果官方后续提供"非持久化、请求尾部追加"的注入接缝，自动 recall 注入会非常有用。

### 6. 想请教社区

- 上游是否有计划为 session-query 增加 CJK 友好 tokenizer（trigram / 分词）？社区方案若可行，是否考虑合入？
- 对上面的注入接缝建议怎么看？是否有我没发现的扩展点？
- **关于贡献**：我们在 Contributors 榜单上看到外部开发者也能合入（如 shigma 的 docs 提交、FSYo 的 refactor 提交）。像 `unicode61` 中文检索修复这类**小而聚焦的修复**（改动 ~30 行 + 测试），是否接受外部 PR？如果目前仍不开放，是否接受"文档类"贡献（例如在上游 README 补充 unicode61 对中文不可用的已知限制说明）？

discussions.title: Windows: every spawned command flashes a console window (missing windowsHide)
discussions.body:
## Windows: every spawned command flashes a console window (missing windowsHide)

**Package:** @deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local

**Problem:** The DSH desktop Host is a GUI process (no console to inherit). Every spawned command - pwsh, python, git, taskkill - flashes a console window on Windows because spawn/spawnSync are called without windowsHide.

**Affected calls:**
- packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/spawn.ts - child spawn() and taskkill spawnSync()
- packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/windows-inspector.ts - taskkill spawnSync()

**Proposed fix (branch ready in fork):**
Add windowsHide: platform === 'win32' to the child spawn, and windowsHide: true to both taskkill spawnSync calls. windowsHide is a no-op on POSIX, so non-Windows behavior is unchanged.

discussions.title: 【插件】dsh-web-app-launcher：让 dsh web 像桌面软件一样打开（Windows 快捷方式 + 独立应用窗口）
discussions.body:
大家好，分享一个刚做的 Windows 社区插件：**dsh-web-app-launcher**

**一句话**：让 `dsh web` 像普通桌面软件一样运行——**本质是原生 Web**（无 Electron、无二次打包、无 fork），**视觉上是桌面软件**。

**它做什么**

- 首次运行 `dsh web` 后自动在桌面创建 `DeepSeek Harness.lnk` 快捷方式（带鲸鱼图标）
- 双击图标即启动：用 Edge / Chrome / Brave / Vivaldi 的 `--app` 模式打开独立窗口，无标签栏、无地址栏
- 关闭窗口即退出 Harness；临时浏览器 profile 放在系统临时目录，退出后自动删除
- 不创建独立安装目录，卸载一行命令

**安装**（Windows 10/11，需 Node.js 与 `dsh` 在 PATH）

    dsh plugin --profile web add github:sylkmpo/dsh-web-app-launcher
    dsh web   # 首次运行一次以激活插件、创建桌面图标

**卸载**

    dsh plugin --profile web remove dsh-web-app-launcher

之后直接删掉桌面上的 `DeepSeek Harness.lnk` 即可。

仓库（含效果图）：https://github.com/sylkmpo/dsh-web-app-launcher （MIT，非官方社区插件，与 DeepSeek 官方无隶属或背书关系）

欢迎试用反馈，有想法直接评论或到仓库提 issue 都行～

discussions.title: 【插件】dsh-airp：DSH 上的角色扮演引擎（规则把世界从 T 写成 T+1）
discussions.body:
在 DSH 上做角色扮演时，模型很容易口头改世界：飞走了、打赢了、人还在场。**dsh-airp** 把规则收成一个深模块 `WorldKernel`（`match` / `turn`），LLM 只提案和叙述；数字和地点必须过鉴定或 GM。

仓库：https://github.com/clarkzhao/dsh-airp  
topic：`dsh-plugin`  
当前目标：第一个基本可用版本 **0.1.0**（引擎 + 两个 preset + 两份官方示例，能诚实玩一晚）

## 它是什么

- **消费者** `airp-play`：选世界包 → 进场 → `lore_get` / `state_read` / `check_propose` / `state_propose_fact` → `/retry`
- **创造者** `airp-author`：八问 → 脚手架 → 改 YAML/Markdown → `pack_validate` → 新开一条 play（不热切本会话）
- **世界包是数据**，不是插件代码。自己的包放 `~/.dsh/airp-packs/<id>/` 就能玩；官方 `packs/` 只收示例切片
- 官方示例（不是产品剧情）：廷根切片、剑烛大荒·定江切片

口头瞬移改不了 `scene`；对手离场写在 check 的 YAML 里；换场之后 brief 会跟着走。

## 现在没有、也不为 0.1.0 做

Worldsmith、边玩边造人、复刻酒馆 31 字段扫描器 / 宏、日历世界钟、把官方示例写成全书。

## 试一下

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/clarkzhao/dsh-airp
# 或本地路径
cp -R presets/airp-play ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/airp-play
cp -R presets/airp-author ~/.dsh/.agent-presets/airp-author
```

新开会话选 **AIRP 消费者** 或 **AIRP 创造者**。写包说明：[worldbook-authoring](https://github.com/clarkzhao/dsh-airp/blob/main/docs/worldbook-authoring.md)。agent 改引擎先读 [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/clarkzhao/dsh-airp/blob/main/AGENTS.md)。

欢迎 issue（`engine` / `authoring` / `demo` / `docs`）。世界包欢迎独立仓库分享，装到 `~/.dsh/airp-packs/` 即可；官方仓的 `packs/` 留给示例切片，方便引擎回归。

想一起做的朋友欢迎联系。有 SillyTavern / 酒馆写卡、世界书经验的尤其欢迎。我觉得 DeepSeek Harness 非常有机会成为下一个互动叙事的世界推荐引擎——这边刻意不复刻扫描器和宏，是想把规则做成可玩的世界，而不是另一套提示词技巧。

进群（飞书）：https://applink.feishu.cn/client/chat/chatter/add_by_link?link_token=97fjb219-b2b1-4d49-a16f-9ddc0cca2ae4&qr_code=true

discussions.title: 某个插件注册的技能数据不合法时，会导致所有对话都报错失败
discussions.body:
## 现象
启用插件 `@dhicoc/dsh-chinese-traditional-wisdom-skill` 后，所有会话的每轮对话一发送就报错结束，完全无法使用。禁用该插件后恢复正常。

报错：
```
skill provider "undefined" returned skill "..." with a non-string provider
```

## 原因
这个插件注册技能时，`provider` 字段应该是字符串，它却给成了对象（`provider.name` 也是空的）。

DSH 每次对话前都会校验所有插件提供的技能数据，**任何一个插件数据不合格，校验就抛异常，整轮对话直接失败**。技能目录全局共享，所以一个坏插件拖垮所有对话。

## 为什么是框架问题
插件**调用报错**时，框架会跳过该插件、对话继续（已有处理）；
但插件**返回的数据不合法**时，框架直接抛异常中断对话——两种失败没有同等对待。第三方插件很容易踩中后者（漏字段、类型写错），属普遍风险。

## 期望
1. 插件数据不合法时，跳过该插件并记录警告，不影响正常对话；
2. 插件加载时校验 `provider.name` 是否为合法字符串，尽早报错并指明是哪个插件。

## 复现
1. 安装并启用 `@dhicoc/dsh-chinese-traditional-wisdom-skill`；
2. 新建会话发任意消息；
3. 对话立即报错结束，所有会话同样失败。

discussions.title: Context window should follow selected model (Flash/Pro/Ollama all show placeholder 14745)
discussions.body:
Title: Context window should follow selected model (Flash/Pro/Ollama all show placeholder 14745)

Bug result: Selecting any model — DeepSeek v4 Flash, DeepSeek v4 Pro, or a local
Ollama model — the “Context” field in the Web/TUI model selector always shows the
same placeholder value `14745 tokens` (~14.4k). It does NOT change with the selected
model.

Expected: Context should display per selected model:

| Model                  | Currently shown | Expected UI  |
|------------------------|-----------------|--------------|
| DeepSeek v4 Flash      | 14745 (placeholder) | 512000        |
| DeepSeek v4 Pro        | 14745 (placeholder) | 1000000       |
| Ollama local large ctx | 14745 (placeholder) | context_length (actual) |

Repro: In Web UI model list, select Flash / Pro / Ollama in turn and look at the
“Context” field. All three show `14745`.

Expected: each model shows its real context window.
Acceptance: after selecting each model the context field shows its expected value.

Technical note (for devs):
- Default context config lives in packages/llm/llm-deepseek/ (@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek);
  models.ts entries missing a contextWindow fall back to this global placeholder default.
- The model selector and the context render field read one shared global placeholder and
  apply no per-model override.
- Backend maxTokens default 256000 is mismatched to the displayed context window; worth aligning.

Environment/files: Web + TUI; DeepSeek creds in ~/.dsh; models v4 Flash / v4 Pro.

This is a feature/report request, not a patch — happy to help scope it. Thanks, maintainers!

discussions.title: Headless: max_tokens never sent on the wire; length-truncated tool calls are silently discarded (empty output, no error)
discussions.body:
Version: 0.1.0-rc.7 (npm), headless profile, custom openai-completions provider (local mlx_vlm server).

Setup: Provider/model config sets maxTokens: 32768 and contextWindow: 262144, and the session's request/header event shows those values. However, the actual HTTP request contains no max_tokens field, so the server applies its own default completion cap (mlx_vlm: 2048 tokens).

What happens: Any assistant response longer than the server default - e.g. a write tool call for a 300+ line file - is truncated by the server with finish_reason: length. dsh records stopReason: length, drops the incomplete tool call, and ends the turn: the final assistant/message has empty content, stdout is empty, exit code 0. Nothing is written to disk and no error is surfaced. In agentic use this presents as "claimed done / silent no-op" on large file writes.

Repro: Point a headless profile at any OpenAI-compatible server with a default completion cap, then ask dsh to write a single file of 300+ unique lines supplied in the prompt. Observe empty output and no file. Raising the cap server-side (e.g. MLX_VLM_MAX_TOKENS=32768 for mlx_vlm) fully resolves it, confirming the cause.

Expected: (1) send the configured maxTokens as max_tokens in the request; (2) when a response ends with stopReason: length mid-tool-call, surface an error (or retry/continue) instead of silently discarding the turn.

**The max_tokens fix was deliberately NOT in dsh at all: since dsh omits max_tokens from its API requests (its own config is client-side only), we raised the server's default cap instead - MLX_VLM_MAX_TOKENS=32768 as an env var in start-brain.sh - so any client that omits the field now gets a 32K ceiling instead of mlx_vlm's hidden 2048, which is what had been decapitating large tool calls.**

Happy to provide the session .jsonl.zstd event trace.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-plugin-reducer (external CLI) | Find the minimal plugin set that reproduces a failure
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community
> member.**

Project URL: <https://github.com/ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer>

## Introduction

`dsh-plugin-reducer` is an external diagnostic CLI for DeepSeek Harness. It
answers one narrow question: **which installed profile bundles are actually
required to reproduce this failure?**

The difficult case is an interaction: A starts alone, B starts alone, but A+B
breaks the profile. Disabling one plugin at a time can miss that. A diagnostic
plugin inside Harness can also disappear when the plugin tree itself cannot
load, so the reducer deliberately runs outside Harness.

It creates a fresh disposable shadow `DSH_HOME` for every probe, reuses the
profile's already-installed packages, tests subsets and complements with delta
debugging, and returns a 1-minimal failure-inducing set. It never installs
packages or rewrites the source profile. Optional JSON reports scrub common
secret forms and local absolute paths.

## Real Harness test

I tested the packaged CLI against the stable
`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7` contract. Three bundles
were installed through the official profile flow: A and B registered the same
global tool, while C was a no-op. A and B each passed alone; A+B failed.

The reducer found `{A, B}` in six configurations, verified that removing either
member stopped the failure, and confirmed that the source profile fingerprint
was unchanged.

The current v0.3 package also exposes a versioned JSON envelope and published
JSON Schemas for CLI/library consumers. CI covers Windows, macOS, and Linux on
Node 22.19 and 24; a separate weekly canary initializes the official Harness
`next` Web profile and reads it through the reducer.

![Real rc.7 interaction reduction](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer/main/assets/demo.png)

## DSH integration

- Reads the documented `$DSH_HOME/profiles/<name>/package.json` profile model.
- Keeps installation-owned bundles fixed.
- Reduces only out-of-tree bundles present in both `dsh.profile.bundles` and
  `dependencies`.
- Invokes the installed `dsh` executable for config or Web-startup probes.
- Reuses the profile's installed `node_modules` without package installation.
- Runs outside the plugin tree, remaining available when that tree fails to
  load.

Install the pinned, prebuilt v0.3 release:

```sh
npm install --global https://github.com/ArmyWas/dsh-plugin-reducer/releases/download/v0.3.0/dsh-plugin-reducer-0.3.0.tgz
dsh-plugin-reducer --profile web --probe web --report reducer-report.json
```

## Scope

This is deliberately not another startup guard, doctor, plugin manager, or
session repro exporter. Those tools recover, inspect, manage, or capture context;
this tool minimizes the active plugin set after a failure is reproducible.

The algorithm guarantees 1-minimality, not a globally smallest set. The shadow
home is configuration isolation, not a security sandbox; installed plugins run
with the user's normal permissions.

## Maintainer feedback requested

1. Is `dependencies ∩ dsh.profile.bundles` the intended stable definition of
   out-of-tree bundles?
2. Is there a preferred machine-readable profile inspection and readiness API?
3. Would a shared diagnostic report envelope be useful across ecosystem tools?
4. Should this stay external, eventually become `dsh plugin reduce`, or first be
   referenced by troubleshooting guidance while usage evidence accumulates?

The repository includes bilingual documentation, the refreshed ecosystem
search, real runtime evidence, versioned report and machine-output schemas,
safety boundaries, and an upstream RFC. It is an early preview and is not
affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

---

## 中文摘要

这是一个非官方的 Harness 外置诊断工具，用于自动找出能稳定复现故障的 1-最小
树外 bundle 集合。它能处理“A 单独正常、B 单独正常、A+B 才崩”的交互问题。
每次探针使用全新影子 `DSH_HOME`，不安装依赖、不修改真实 profile，并可生成经过
常见密钥与本机路径脱敏的 JSON 报告。

稳定 rc.7 的真实测试中，工具用 6 个组合找出 `{A, B}`，验证两者单独均通过，
且真实 profile 前后指纹一致。v0.3 已提供版本化 JSON 信封与 Schema，并通过六环境
CI；每周探针还会读取官方 `next` profile。希望官方维护者反馈树外 bundle 的稳定
识别方式、机器可读诊断接口，以及该能力更适合保持外置还是未来进入
`dsh plugin reduce`。

discussions.title: [Bug] 大型冷态子代理历史因 30 秒 unary 时限无法加载
discussions.body:
在 `dsh web 0.1.0-rc.8` 中，大型 continuable 子代理的冷态历史无法通过 Web UI 加载，页面稳定显示：

> 历史加载失败：signal timed out（internal）

## 与 #3413 的区别

#3413 讨论的是远程链路下 3 秒 `streamOpenTimeoutMs` readiness guard；本次发生在本机 `127.0.0.1`，失败请求是 `POST /api/subagent.history`，时间点与通用 unary 的 30 秒截止时间一致。普通父会话历史和 WebSocket 连接均正常。

## 复现步骤

1. 使用 `dsh 0.1.0-rc.8` 启动 Web profile。
2. 打开一个包含大型 continuable 子代理历史的父会话。
3. 展开子代理目录，打开该子代理。
4. 等待约 30 秒。

## 实际结果

- 页面显示 `历史加载失败：signal timed out（internal）`。
- UI 请求使用 `maxMessages: 50`。
- 同一父会话的普通历史能够正常加载。
- 相同 `subagent.history` payload 通过直接 HTTP 调用并允许更长 client timeout 后返回 HTTP 200，因此日志本身未损坏。
- 本次尾页包含 24,878 条原始事件，响应约 5,242,159 字节；对应的 `session.jsonl.zstd` 约 995 KiB。

## 原因分析

当前源码在 `packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/client.ts` 中为普通 unary 调用设置 `DEFAULT_TIMEOUT_MS = 30_000`，`postJson()` 使用 `AbortSignal.timeout(this.timeoutMs)`。目前 `session.history` 和 `subagent.history` 都走默认 `callUnary()` 路径，没有使用 `caller-signal-only` 策略。

历史分页的 `maxMessages` 只限制 append-origin message 数量，不限制其中的 chunk、tool、step 事件数量或最终 JSON 字节数。一次合法的 message-aligned 尾页因此可能包含数万条事件；冷态子代理还需要完成 catalog 校验、持久化 inspection、projection restore、分页和序列化，整体耗时可能超过 30 秒。

Fetch 超时异常随后被 `packages/host/apiproxy/src/api/rpc.ts` 的 `transportError()` 统一转换为 `internal`，于是 UI 暴露了底层 `signal timed out`，容易被误判为日志损坏或 Host 内部错误。

`session.history` 使用相同的默认 timeout policy，因此大型普通冷会话理论上也可能受影响；本次稳定复现发生在 `subagent.history`。

## 预期结果

- 合法的大型历史可以完成加载，不应仅因超过通用 transport-health 时限而失败。
- 如果历史读取必须有上限，应提供与历史工作量相关的明确诊断或受控分页，而不是显示底层 `signal timed out（internal）`。
- 调用方或连接取消仍应能够终止读取。

## 环境

- DeepSeek Harness：`0.1.0-rc.8`
- Commit：`141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`
- Node.js：`v25.2.1`
- macOS：`26.6.1`
- Architecture：`arm64`
- Carrier：Web，`http://127.0.0.1:3080`

## 建议的回归覆盖

- 历史 RPC 合法执行时间超过默认 unary deadline 时仍可完成，或通过历史专用的明确策略结束。
- 大型冷态 `subagent.history` 可从 Web UI 加载。
- 同样的数据量语义覆盖 `session.history`。
- 普通 unary 请求仍保留 transport-health deadline。
- 历史读取仍响应 caller/connection cancellation。
- UI 不再把预期的历史读取耗时显示为原始 `signal timed out（internal）`。

## 🖥️ dsh-desktop — DeepSeek Harness 桌面客户端(Electron)

> 中文为主,欢迎英文讨论 / Chinese-first, English welcome.

**dsh-desktop** 是 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) 的 Windows 桌面客户端,把 Harness 从「终端/网页里的 Agent」变成「住在你电脑里的 AI 工作台」。

### ✨ 功能亮点

**🖥️ 桌面工作台**
- 三页导航:**工作台 / 工作区 / 会话**——日常操作不再藏在设置里
- 统一**待处理中心**:审批/提问直接在桌面一键允许/拒绝/作答
- **AI 活动中心**:任务来源、状态、关联审计与 Git 变更一屏验收
- **工作区页**:健康检查(磁盘/读写/会话数)、本地记忆(从 README/package.json 一键生成草稿)、Git 变更与 diff 预览

**📥 任务系统**
- **串行任务队列**:运行中提交自动排队,失败指数退避自动重试(30s/60s/120s),应用重启恢复
- 队列面板行内直接重试/取消,任务状态持久化到本地 SQLite

**🗄️ 数据与模型**
- 活动/审计/队列存于本地 SQLite(零额外依赖,自动迁移)
- 第三方模型上下文**按模型最大化**自动配置(网关声明优先,能力表兜底),不再吃默认 256K

**📱 手机 PWA 遥控**
- 扫码配对(**每个局域网地址独立二维码**),令牌自动填入、自动连接
- 手机上发任务、看流式进展、停止任务、审批/提问一键应答
- 文件浏览:超大文本分片加载、图片直接预览
- 连接失败给出明确诊断(等待批准 vs 网络不通)

**🛡️ 安全(重点)**
- **设备批准机制**:外部设备即使持有正确 Token,也必须在桌面端弹窗批准后才能访问;可随时撤销
- **局域网边界**:网关仅接受 loopback + RFC1918 私网客户端,公网来源直接拒绝
- **自动过期**:远程访问默认 2 小时自动关闭,可 30 分钟/2 小时/8 小时/手动
- **Token 安全**:二维码参数读取后立即清除;SSE 事件流用一次性短时 ticket,Token 永不进 URL/日志
- **禁止内网穿透**:设置页与文档明确警告,不要用 frp/ngrok/Cloudflare Tunnel/端口转发暴露 Harness
- 危险操作(重启服务/移除预设根)必须在桌面端确认

**🎨 其他**
- 三端独立壁纸、AI 屏保(可注册为 Windows 系统屏保)、桌面宠物、QQ/Telegram 机器人通道、通知分级与勿扰、脱敏诊断报告、配置备份恢复、窗口尺寸记忆

### 📦 安装

或源码:`git clone https://github.com/xiaowei2025cqu23phy/dsh-desktop && npm install && npm start`

> 提示:先运行 `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 并配置好模型密钥,再打开桌面端体验最佳。

### 📎 链接
- 仓库:https://github.com/xiaowei2025cqu23phy/dsh-desktop
- 演示 GIF:仓库 `assets/` 目录
- 实操指南:`docs/USAGE.md`(汉英双语)

### ⚠️ 许可与安全提醒

discussions.title: DSH rc.6 to rc.8 upgrade: npm OOM workaround + keyed slot breaking change
discussions.body:
Sharing our upgrade experience (rc.6 → rc.8) in case it helps others:

## 1. npm install hits V8 heap OOM on low-RAM machines
`npm install` crashed with exit 134 (`Ineffective mark-compacts near heap limit`) while resolving the rc.8 dependency tree (60+ packages) on a machine with 7.7 GB RAM (only ~0.4 GB free, but an 11 GB pagefile).

**Workaround that worked:**
```
$env:NODE_OPTIONS='--max-old-space-size=6144'
$env:npm_config_registry='https://registry.npmjs.org/'
npm install --prefer-offline
```
Took ~36 min with heavy paging, but completed with exit 0. The default V8 old-space limit (~4 GB) was the actual cap; the machine's pagefile gave headroom.

## 2. Breaking change: keyed slots now require options.key
After upgrading and restarting, `dsh web` failed with:
```
Failed to load plugins
<plugin-a>
<plugin-b>
keyed slot "settings.plugin.item" requires options.key
```
Plugins that register the `settings.plugin.item` slot must now include `key` in the registration options (rc.6 and earlier allowed omitting it):
```js
ctx.slots.register({
  name: 'settings.plugin.item',
  id: 'my-plugin',
  key: 'my-plugin',      // required in rc.8
  order: 30
})
```
Affected plugins in our profile: `dsh-vision-router` (already fixed upstream in v1.7.3) and `dsh-smart-route`.

## 3. npm approve-scripts is now required for native deps
rc.8 prompts to approve install scripts for `node-pty`, `koffi`, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-subprocess-local`, etc. Run `npm approve-scripts <pkg>` for each, or persistent-PTY/FFI features won't work.

## 4. Storage format changed (SQLite)
rc.8 ships a new SQLite storage format (better fork/read/write performance). Old session data migrates on first start — make a full backup before upgrading.

Hope this helps someone avoid the same 40 minutes of debugging!

discussions.title: [Feature Request] workflow 工具支持 scriptPath 参数，避免大文件逐字誊写导致的 Token 浪费
discussions.body:
环境
包版本：@deepseek-ai/dsh（当前 developer preview 阶段）

相关工具：dsh-tool-workflow、dsh-workflow-worker-thread

问题描述
dsh-tool-workflow 工具的 script 参数目前只接受内联 JS 字符串，没有 scriptPath / file 之类的文件路径参数。

当用户通过 skill 调用一个落盘的工作流脚本（如 deploy.workflow.js，约 43KB）时，模型只能将文件内容逐字抄写进 script 参数。实测一次调用消耗约 12,154 tokens，生成耗时约 155 秒。

更严重的是，这些 token 会留在会话历史中，之后每轮对话都要重复携带，形成复利式的上下文成本。

根因分析
问题出在两层设计的叠加：

工具层：dsh-tool-workflow 的 schema 只有 script（内联字符串）、meta、args 三个参数，没有文件路径通道。execute() 直接把 args.script 交给引擎，无任何文件读取环节。

引擎层：dsh-workflow-worker-thread 只收 request.script 正文，编译成 (async () => { <body> })() 执行。全文 grep 不到任何 readFile / path 加载逻辑。脚本运行在无 fs API 的 vm 沙箱中，自己也无法读文件。

当用户的 skill 明确要求「先 read 出来原样传入」时，模型只能忠实执行——把 43KB 的文件内容逐字誊进参数。

期望行为
工具应支持通过文件路径引用脚本：

dsh-tool-workflow schema 增加可选参数 scriptPath

script 改为可选，运行时校验「二者必填其一」

若提供 scriptPath，工具自行读取文件内容后交给引擎（引擎零改动）

向后兼容：不传 scriptPath 时行为与现在完全一致

预期收益
指标	现状	改进后
单次调用 Token 消耗	~12,154	~30
单次调用耗时	~155s	几乎瞬时
会话历史累积成本	每轮重复携带	不残留
补充说明
改动范围：仅 dsh-tool-workflow/lib/index.js（schema 加可选参数 + execute 增加文件读取分支）

文件解析可复用 dsh-tool-fs 的现成模式：ctx.fs.resolve(path, sessionResolveOptions(exec, path))，自动锚定会话工作区 + 走沙箱策略

引擎 dsh-workflow-worker-thread 零改动

discussions.title: 分支失败与更早历史加载失败被静默吞掉（附修复分支）/ Silent fork & load-older failures (fix branch attached)
discussions.body:
## 问题 Problem

Web 客户端有两个动作在失败时完全静默，用户看不到原因、也没有重试入口：

1. **分支（Fork）**：`forkAt` 调用 `sessions.fork`（业务或传输失败时抛出 `SessionForkError`），却被空 `.catch(() => {})` 吞掉。`fork-unavailable` 等拒绝发生后界面毫无提示。
2. **更早历史加载（Load older）**：`Session.loadOlder` 在 `!result.ok` 时直接返回，传输失败只 `console.error`，例如 `Failed to fetch (internal)` 场景下界面没有任何错误与重试。

## 根因 Root cause

两个都是"错误被吞掉"：`forkAt` 的空 catch；`loadOlder` 的提前 return + 仅控制台日志。

## 修复 Fix（已实现，附分支）

修复已实现并推送到 fork 分支 **`zhuxin797-ship-it:fix/surface-session-action-failures`**：

- `forkAt`：通过会话输入 shell 提示通道上浮 `SessionForkError`（`inputHub.shell(sessionId).notify('error', …)`），分支成功路径不变。
- `loadOlder`：新增 `olderError: RpcError | null` 快照字段；业务失败写 `result.error`，传输失败写 `transportError(error).error`；`ChatView` 用新文案 `chat.loadOlderError` 渲染错误并保留"加载更早"按钮作为重试入口。
- `SessionManager.fork` 的 JSDoc 修正为如实描述 `{ ok: true, value: { sessionId } }` RPC 结果信封。

PR compare：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...zhuxin797-ship-it:fix/surface-session-action-failures

相关 Agent Note：`2026-08-20-silent-session-action-failures-visible.md`（`.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/`）

## 说明 Notes

- 本仓库 pulls REST API 对所有人返回 404（`has_issues=false`），无法通过 API 直接建 PR，因此用 Discussion 提出，附可直接审阅合并的分支。
- 源码变更按仓库规范附了 Agent Note；本地 clone 无 node_modules，typecheck / test:gui / web 快照需在 CI 或 `pnpm install` 后补跑。

discussions.title: I find some issues when using DSH in win 2k22 server, and let agent itself to describe it
discussions.body:
## Summary

A truncated (malformed JSON) tool-call `arguments` string in the session log can brick the entire session: the DeepSeek chat-completions adapter replays the raw string verbatim as `tool_calls[].function.arguments`, the provider rejects the whole request with `400 INVALID_REQUEST`, and the failure is not retried in normal retry mode, so the session aborts permanently on the next turn.

## Environment

- Adapter: `dsh-llm-deepseek` (deepseek-official route)
- Model: deepseek-v4-flash-0731
- Platform: Windows, web profile (`dsh web`)
- LLM retry: default `normal` mode

## Observed failure

1. Model streams a tool call whose `arguments` end mid-string (a closing quote and brace are dropped at generation end), e.g.:

   ```
   {"path": "...packages", "pattern": "mcpServers
   ```

2. The tool layer fails cleanly (`Error: invalid arguments: "arguments" must be an object`), but the assembled assistant `tool-call` block — with the truncated string — is persisted to the durable session log.

3. On the next model request, the adapter serializes that assistant message from history with the malformed string as `function.arguments`; the provider returns a 400 and the whole turn aborts:

   ```
   failure: {
     "message": "Unterminated string starting at: line 1 column 92 (char 91)",
     "code": "INVALID_REQUEST",
     "status": 400
   }
   ```

4. Because `INVALID_REQUEST` is not in the normal-mode retryable set, the turn ends as an error instead of recovering — every later request in that session that replays the corrupted history keeps failing. Observed repeatedly.

## Root cause

- `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts` → `serializeAssistant()` copies `block.arguments` verbatim onto the wire:

  ```js
  function: { name: block.name, arguments: block.arguments }
  ```

- `packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts` concatenates `argumentsDelta` fragments without validating the resulting JSON, so a truncated stream can produce a malformed-but-persisted `ToolCallBlock`.

- `packages/llm/llm-retry/src/index.ts` (normal mode) only retries `EMPTY_RESPONSE`, `RATE_LIMIT`, `SERVER`, `TIMEOUT`, `TRANSPORT` — a 400 `INVALID_REQUEST` falls straight through to failure.

## Notable inconsistency (parity gap)

The sibling pi-ai adapter already defends against exactly this: `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts` has

```js
/** Parse tool-call argument JSON; tolerate model malformations with {}. */
function parseArguments(raw: string): Record<string, unknown> { … return {} }
```

covered by `tests/convert.spec.ts` `'parses malformed tool-call arguments to {}'` (input `'{broken'` → `{}`). The deepseek adapter is missing this same guard, so roughly half of the shipped adapter surface is exposed to the brick.

## Suggested fix

Repair tool-call arguments at serialization time in the deepseek adapter, mirroring the pi-ai behavior: try `JSON.parse`; pass through only when the result is a plain object, otherwise send `{}`. Keep the durable history unchanged (raw string preserved for replay fidelity) — only the wire payload is sanitized.

I verified this locally: with that guard in `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/serialize.ts`, the truncated string above serializes to `{}` (valid JSON) and the request succeeds instead of 400-ing.

## Workaround (pre-fix)

A session already poisoned cannot be salvaged; start a new session.

## Related

- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/replay.ts:39-50` (existing `parseArguments`)
- `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts:219`
- `packages/llm/llm-retry/README.md` — normal-mode retryable codes
