discussions.title: [UX] Plugin list displays all MCP connections as mcp-client instead of server names
discussions.body:
## Problem Description

When multiple MCP servers are configured in DSH Web, the plugin list displays all connections with the same name `mcp-client`, making it difficult to identify and manage individual MCP server connections.

## Current Behavior

```
Plugin List:
├── mcp-client
├── mcp-client
└── mcp-client
```

Users cannot quickly identify which connection corresponds to which MCP server (e.g., mimo-mcp, fetch, context7).

## Expected Behavior

The plugin list should display meaningful names that help users identify each connection:

```
Plugin List:
├── MiMo MCP (mimo-mcp)
├── Web Fetch (fetch)
└── Context7 Docs (context7)
```

## Suggested Improvements

1. **Display Server Name**: Use the MCP server's `server_info.name` as the display name
2. **Support Custom Aliases**: Allow users to set custom names for each connection in configuration
3. **Show Connection Status**: Include visual indicators (✅ connected / ❌ disconnected / ⚠️ error)

## Environment

- DSH Version: latest
- OS: Windows
- MCP Servers configured: mimo-mcp, fetch, context7, sequential-thinking, knowledge-graph

## Additional Context

This is a UX improvement request. The current functionality works correctly, but the display names are not user-friendly for managing multiple MCP connections.

discussions.title: OpenAI 兼容网关续传分片携带空 name 时，llm-deepseek 工具调用名被清空
discussions.body:
经由 OpenAI 兼容中转网关流式工具调用时，续传分片携带的空 `name` 清空了已累积的工具名，报 `unknown tool ""`。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 将 DeepSeek 卡片（`llm-deepseek` 直连适配器）的 baseURL 指向一个 OpenAI 兼容中转网关（new-api 风格，上游为 DeepSeek）。
  2. 发送任意会触发工具调用的消息。
  3. 网关返回的流式 `tool_calls` 分片如下——第二片携带 `name: ""`（空字符串）而非按 OpenAI 惯例省略该字段：

     ```
     data: {..."delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"id":"call_x","type":"function","function":{"name":"get_current_date","arguments":""}}]},"finish_reason":null}
     data: {..."delta":{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"name":"","arguments":"{}"}}]},"finish_reason":null}
     data: {..."delta":{"content":""},"finish_reason":"tool_calls"}
     ```

- 实际结果：`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts:160` 的 `if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name` 用第二片的空串覆盖了首片已到的工具名；harness 报 `Error: unknown tool ""`，随后带空工具名的会话回放被上游以 `INVALID_REQUEST` 拒绝，该轮对话无法继续。
- 预期结果：续传分片中的空 `name` 不清空已累积的工具名——改为真值判断，或仅在尚未设置时赋值（pi-ai 的 `openai-completions` 实现即为 `if (!block.name && name) block.name = name`，对同一网关免疫）。
- 环境：deepseek-harness master@141eb6f；网关为 OpenAI 兼容中转（转发 DashScope/Qwen 风格分片，此类续片带空 `name` 的行为在中转网关中较常见）。
- 验收条件：对上述分片序列，累积后的工具名为 `get_current_date`，工具正常执行；对官方 API（续片省略 `name`）行为不变。

</details>

discussions.title: feat(runtime): clamp oversized setTimeout/setInterval delays to avoid Node TimeoutOverflowWarning
discussions.body:
## Summary

When plugin (or AI-generated) code calls `setTimeout` / `setInterval` with a delay larger than `2^31 - 1` ms (e.g. `setInterval(cb, 99999999000)`, ~1157 days), Node.js emits a `TimeoutOverflowWarning` and silently clamps the actual delay to **1 ms** — the timer then fires almost immediately, causing confusing behavior and tight polling loops.

## Observed

This happened while developing the `dsh-balance-monitor` plugin: an AI-assisted snippet used `setInterval(cb, 99999999000)`. Node clamped it to 1 ms and printed the overflow warning to the terminal.

## Current state (verified against the installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh`)

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-code-runtime-worker-thread` already guards its **own** watchdog timer: in the constructor, `this.config.maxWallMs = Math.min(this.config.maxWallMs, 60000)` (lib/index.js L665), so the runtime's `setTimeout(..., this.config.maxWallMs)` can never exceed 60 s. That path is safe.

The residual gap: the runtime cannot intercept arbitrary `setTimeout` / `setInterval` calls made **inside executed plugin code** (worker thread). Those go straight to Node's native timers, so an oversized value still triggers `TimeoutOverflowWarning` + 1 ms clamping.

## Suggested fix

1. (Low effort) Where plugin code runs in a worker/child, document that delays > `2^31 - 1` ms are unsupported; or
2. (Best effort) Provide a sandboxed `timer` shim inside the code runtime that clamps delays to `MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS` with a friendly warning instead of Node's raw warning, e.g.:

```js
const safeDelay = Math.min(rawDelay, MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS);
if (rawDelay > MAX_TIMER_DELAY_MS) {
  console.warn(`[dsh] timer delay ${rawDelay}ms exceeded limit, clamped to ${safeDelay}ms`);
}
setTimeout(cb, safeDelay);
```

Either way, the platform should be the last line of defense for AI-generated or misconfigured values.

## Mitigation on the plugin side

`dsh-balance-monitor` v1.0.7 now clamps its configurable intervals at the config layer (auto-check ≤ 24 h, force-check ≤ 7 d), so it can never produce oversized delays again.

## Environment

- OS: Windows

discussions.title: Plan mode: the plan never lands in the conversation, so multi-turn revision can't re-read it
discussions.body:
# Discussion: Plan mode — the plan never lands in the conversation, so multi-turn revision can't re-read it

**Repo:** deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
**Area:** `/plan` mode (`dsh-plan-mode`) + Web approval UI (`dsh-client-ui-user-questions`)
**Type:** UX / design feedback

---

## Summary

In `/plan` mode, the complete plan is only ever shown inside a temporary approval
card that takes over the composer. It is **not** written into the conversation as a
normal assistant message. Because plans are revised over several turns, the plan
text is effectively lost as soon as the card is dismissed — the user cannot scroll
back and re-read the plan while negotiating changes.

## What happens today

1. While in plan mode, the model calls `exit_plan_mode` with the full plan as its
   `plan` argument.
2. `presentCall` returns a `card: 'generic'` view with the plan as `content`, but the
   Web generic tool card derives its body from the call **arguments** (`toolRowModel`
   in `dsh-client-ui-tool`), so this `content` is never rendered. The plan text does
   not appear in the conversation.
3. `execute` sends the plan as the `detail` of a user-questions request with the
   `plan-review` presentation intent.
4. The Web UI (`PlanReviewPanel` in `dsh-client-ui-user-questions`) takes over the
   composer seat and renders the plan as a scrolling markdown body inside the card,
   with `max-height: min(60vh, 520px)`.

So the plan lives only in a transient takeover card. The model's own message text
may or may not contain the full plan — it is not guaranteed, and nothing in the flow
requires it.

## The problem

- **Plans need revision.** Approve / keep-planning / feedback loops mean several
  turns over the same plan. Once the approval card is dismissed (or a new turn
  starts), the plan is no longer visible anywhere in the conversation.
- **Height is not the fix.** Bumping the card's `max-height` (e.g. to
  `min(85vh, 960px)`) makes the card bigger, but it is still a transient surface —
  it scrolls away with the composer and is gone after the decision.
- The card is a dead end for "browse the plan while we talk about it".

## Expected behavior

- The **complete plan is output as a normal assistant message** in the conversation
  (persistent, full-width, scrollable with the page, re-readable on later turns).
- The approval surface is reduced to a **fixed, simple question** — e.g. "Execute
  per plan?" — with Approve / Keep planning actions, and no plan body inside the
  card (or at most a collapsed summary linking back to the message).

## Suggested directions (open to maintainer preference)

1. **Model guidance:** make `exit_plan_mode`'s description (and the default
   `plan:policy` section) require the model to write the complete plan as its
   assistant message text before calling the tool. Cheap, but relies on model
   compliance.
2. **Deterministic presentation:** register a keyed `tool.call.toolview` for
   `exit_plan_mode` (following the existing `ask-question-row` pattern) that renders
   the plan argument as a full-width markdown message in the conversation. This
   guarantees the plan is always visible regardless of what the model writes.
3. **Simplify the approval card:** stop rendering the plan body in `PlanReviewPanel`;
   keep only the strip, the fixed question, and the action row. The plan lives in
   the conversation above.

## Environment

- Branch/master at commit `141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`
- Web GUI, Windows
- This is a design/UX observation; no crash, no data loss.

# Discussion: plan 模式下计划不进入对话流，多轮协商无法反复查看计划

**仓库:** deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness
**领域:** `/plan` 模式（`dsh-plan-mode`）+ Web 审批界面（`dsh-client-ui-user-questions`）
**类型:** UX / 设计反馈

## 摘要

`/plan` 模式下，完整计划只显示在一个临时审批卡片里，**没有作为普通助手消息写进对话流**。计划需要多轮协商，卡片一旦关闭，计划正文就无法再查看 —— 用户在反复修改计划时没法回看原文。

## 现状

1. plan 模式下，模型调用 `exit_plan_mode`，完整计划放在 `plan` 参数里。
2. `presentCall` 返回 `card: 'generic'` 并把计划放进 `content`，但 Web 通用工具卡是从调用**参数**推导正文的（`dsh-client-ui-tool` 的 `toolRowModel`），所以这段 `content` 根本不渲染 —— 计划正文不进入对话流。
3. `execute` 把计划作为 `detail` 放进带 `plan-review` 呈现意图的 user-questions 请求。
4. Web 端（`dsh-client-ui-user-questions` 的 `PlanReviewPanel`）接管 composer 座位，把计划作为可滚动 markdown 正文渲染在卡片里，高度上限 `max-height: min(60vh, 520px)`。

于是计划只存在于一个瞬态接管卡片里。模型的普通消息文本是否包含完整计划并不保证，流程里也没有任何机制要求它。

## 问题

- **计划需要协商。** 批准 / 继续规划 / 反馈意味着同一份计划要跨多轮对话。审批卡一旦关闭（或新回合开始），对话里就再也看不到计划了。
- **调高度不是正解。** 把卡片 `max-height` 调大（例如 `min(85vh, 960px)`）只是卡片更大，它仍是瞬态表面 —— 会随 composer 滚走，决策完就没了。
- 卡片对"边聊边看计划"是死胡同。

## 期望行为

- **完整计划作为普通助手消息输出到对话流**（持久、全宽、随页面滚动、后续回合可反复查看）。
- 审批面收敛为**固定简单问题** —— 例如"是否按计划执行？"，只带 确认执行 / 继续规划 操作，卡片内不再放计划正文（至多一个可折叠摘要，链接回上面的消息）。

## 建议方向（以官方意见为准）

1. **模型引导：** 让 `exit_plan_mode` 的描述（以及默认 `plan:policy` 段落）要求模型在调用工具前先把完整计划写成助手消息文本。改动便宜，但依赖模型遵守。
2. **确定性呈现：** 仿照现有 `ask-question-row` 模式，为 `exit_plan_mode` 注册一个 keyed `tool.call.toolview`，把 plan 参数渲染成对话流里的全宽 markdown 消息。这样无论模型怎么写，计划都保证可见。
3. **简化审批卡：** `PlanReviewPanel` 不再渲染计划正文，只保留条带、固定问题和操作行；计划存在于上方对话中。

## 环境

- 分支/master，提交 `141eb6fef83422698aef7a981029e843e8161534`
- Web GUI，Windows
- 设计/UX 观察；无崩溃、无数据丢失。

discussions.title: dsh-session-kb — Search all your past sessions and recall them to the AI as @references
discussions.body:
**dsh-session-kb** brings a search-and-recall workflow to DeepSeek Harness: full-text search across all your past sessions, then insert up to 3 of them into the current input as `@references`. On send, the platform injects read-only snapshots into the model context — the AI answers with your historical context, no re-explaining needed.

### Why it matters

DSH ships with a full-text search engine (SQLite FTS5) and cross-session references, but neither has a UI. Until now there was no way to find a past session by keyword, and no way to insert one as a reference without hand-typing `@[label](dsh-session:…)`. This plugin adds the missing discover → browse → insert layer.

### Features

- **Search** — full-text search across all past sessions (all workspaces), highlighted hit snippets, workspace / time-range / archive filters, cursor pagination
- **Recall** — pick up to 3 sessions, one-click insert into the input as reference chips; on send the platform injects `## Referenced sessions` snapshots
- **Recent** — recent-sessions list without searching
- **Archives** — search includes archived sessions by default (with an "Archived" badge and all / active-only / archived-only filters) — the only way to find them back after DSH archives them; the Recent list excludes archived sessions by default
- **Settings** — enable/disable switch + default search scope + privacy statement

The UI is **native-feeling**: every color, spacing, radius, and interaction is measured from DSH's own design system (better-sidebar, workspace sidebar, settings sections) — it looks and behaves like a built-in feature.

### Screenshots

**Search & results**

![Search](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb/main/docs/screenshots/右侧栏-会话库-搜索.png)

**Pick & insert**

![Pick & insert](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb/main/docs/screenshots/右侧栏-会话库-选入会话框.png)

**Settings**

![Settings](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb/main/docs/screenshots/设置-会话库.png)

### Install

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-session-kb
```

> **One-time setup**: the web profile disables the FTS index by default. Override `openAt` to `first-search` in `<DSH_HOME>/profiles/web/cordis.patch.yml`, then restart the app.

### Links

- GitHub: [PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb)
- npm: [dsh-session-kb](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-session-kb)
- Privacy: [PRIVACY.md](https://github.com/PolinniZhong/dsh-session-kb/blob/main/PRIVACY.md)

Fully local, zero network requests. MIT licensed. Feedback welcome — open an issue or discussion!

discussions.title: SessionPersistence.delete: a single-session deletion primitive (proposal with a complete, tested implementation)
discussions.body:
Hi! External contributor here. I implemented a single-session deletion primitive for the persistence seam, with full tests and docs, and would like the team to consider it.

## Proposal

`SessionPersistence` gains `abstract delete(id: SessionId): Promise<void>` that permanently removes one stored session's durable log, or cancels a created-but-never-appended create intent:

- Unknown ids reject; a live `Session` or a reserved preparation rejects.
- After deletion the id behaves as unknown for every subsequent operation; `create` may reuse it.
- Serialized on the per-id write chain with in-flight appends/repairs.
- On success emits `session-persistence/deleted` (after clearing coordinator state), so derived data can react.

`PersistenceBackend` gains `deleteStored(id)` (idempotent no-op for an already-absent artifact). JSONL unlinks the artifact (POSIX fsyncs the parent directory; Windows skips - write-through). SQLite deletes the session row in one `BEGIN IMMEDIATE` transaction; events cascade via `ON DELETE CASCADE`.

Full details, alternatives, and consequences are in an Agent Note in the branch: `.agents/notes/implemented/architecture/2026-08-21-session-persistence-single-session-deletion.md`.

## Implementation

Complete and verified on branch: https://github.com/wulun811/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/session-persistence-delete (commit `7f29826970`)

- Backend-contract + coordinator + backend-specific tests (new), all green; new-path coverage 100%.
- `pnpm run typecheck`, `pnpm run lint`, and the doc gates (translation-pairing, cordis-catalog, scoped-events, doc-budgets, md-wrap, export-jsdoc, package-invariants, readme-limitations) all pass.
- Full unit suite run locally: the 26 failures are all environment-only (git timeouts, missing optional win32-x64 binaries, sandbox CreateProcessAsUser block, pwsh path resolution); one `subagent/list-children` failure was a parallel-run flake (passes 3/3 in isolation). None relate to this change.

## Why it matters

The persistence seam is append-only with no deletion primitive; pruning stored sessions is out-of-band backend maintenance, and nothing notifies derived data when a stored id becomes unusable. A deletion primitive is the foundation for session management: retention policies, GC, and recursive subtree deletion can build on it.

I understand the repo does not currently accept external pull requests - happy to adapt to whatever review or integration process you prefer. Thanks for considering it.

discussions.title: Plugin extension point: a persistent side panel for tool-produced evidence
discussions.body:
## Summary

Plugins can render tool results **inline** in the transcript (`tool.call.toolview`), but there is no extension point for a **persistent side panel**. For plugins whose tools produce structured, citable evidence — database rows, API records, retrieval hits — the transcript is the wrong home: the evidence either inflates the conversation or has to hide behind a modal, and it cannot be browsed as a set.

I'd like to propose a plugin-mountable aside region in the conversation view.

## Why the existing seats don't cover this

I built a plugin that turns MCP tool returns into evidence cards, and tried every seat I could find. Recording what blocked each one, in case it's useful:

**1. `tool.call.toolview`** (keyed, works well) — renders per call, but strictly inline. A session with 9 lookups produces 9 inline blocks between the model's reasoning steps. Collapsing each to a one-line summary helps, but the evidence still can't be reviewed as a collection, and the reader loses the "which of these support the answer" view.

**2. `conversation.details.tool`** — the natural fit, and shadowing the default works exactly as the error message advertises (`register at a different priority to shadow it (lowest renders)`, `priority: -1`). The blocker is **opening** it: `DetailsPanel` reads `selection` from the chat store, and a plugin has no way to write it. `ToolCallOwnerProps` exposes `inspect`, but that routes to the Trajectory view (`ToolCallTree.tsx`: `inspect: () => { inspectCall(callId) }`), not to the details panel. So a plugin can *render* that panel but cannot *summon* it.

**3. `sidebar.*`** — left rail, session-scoped chrome; not a per-conversation surface.

## Proposal

A list-kind, session-scoped slot for the conversation's aside region — roughly:

```ts
'conversation.aside.panel': { kind: 'list'; scope: 'session'; owner: AsidePanelOwnerProps }
```

Owner currency could stay minimal (the conversation snapshot is already reachable), and the region could stay collapsed until an entry registers, so deployments with no such plugin see no change.

A lighter alternative that would also unblock this: expose a `select(callId)` callback on `ToolCallOwnerProps`, so a plugin can move the existing details panel to a call it owns. That reuses the panel already in place and needs no new region.

## Who else this helps

Not specific to any one data source — the same shape appears whenever a tool returns records a reader may want to verify against the model's claims:

- SQL / warehouse plugins wanting a result-set browser
- Retrieval plugins wanting a citation list next to the answer
- Compliance / audit tooling where "which query produced this number" must stay inspectable
- Any plugin building a provenance UI over MCP tools

Happy to share the plugin as a concrete reference if that's useful. Thanks for the very clean slot system — everything else in the extension surface has been a pleasure to build against.

discussions.body:
# DeepSeek Harness Remote：在任意设备继续 Harness 会话

> 让 Harness 留在工作电脑上，从手机、平板、浏览器或另一台电脑安全地继续同一个工作流。

**项目地址：** https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote  
**当前版本：** [`v0.3.22`](https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/releases/tag/v0.3.22)（Developer Preview）

## 它解决什么问题

实际使用中，Harness、代码、工具链和项目配置通常都在固定的工作电脑上，但我们经常需要离开电脑后继续查看进度、补充指令，或者处理 Agent 的问题和权限请求。

DeepSeek Harness Remote 不迁移 Workspace，也不把 Harness Web UI 暴露到公网。Harness 和项目始终留在 Host 上，Remote 只是通过受限、加密的连接，把原生 Harness 体验带到你的其他设备。

## 可以做什么

- 查看正在进行的会话和最新进展
- 发送新指令、调整任务方向
- 回答问题并处理权限请求
- 在多台已授权 Host 之间切换
- 选择已有 Workspace，或浏览远端目录后在原生 Harness UI 中打开
- 配合可选的 `dsh-file-viewer`，以受限的只读方式预览 Workspace 文件
- 从浏览器、另一台电脑的 Harness，或开发预览版 Android / VS Code Client 连接

## 快速安装

在运行 Harness 和项目的电脑上，打开 **DSH Desktop → 扩展 → 管理插件…**，安装：

```text
ds-harness-remote
```

也可以为 `web` profile 使用命令行：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ds-harness-remote
```

安装后重启 Harness，然后从侧边栏进入 **Remote**：

1. 使用 GitHub / 知乎扫码，或账号密码登录。
2. 在当前电脑上启用 **允许控制当前设备**，将它作为 Host。
3. 在另一台设备上登录同一账号，选择在线 Host。
4. 选择 Workspace，继续已有会话或开始新任务。

如果希望固定版本，也可以安装：

```text
github:liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote#v0.3.22
```

## 界面预览

启用当前设备作为 Remote Host：

![Remote Host 设置](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/main/docs/images/setting.png)

选择在线 Host 和远端 Workspace：

![Host 与 Workspace 列表](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/main/docs/images/host-list.png)

在 Harness 原生界面中继续远端会话：

![远端 Harness 会话](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/main/docs/images/remote.png)

## 安全边界

- Host 只建立出站连接，不需要开放公网端口。
- 会话流量使用端到端加密；服务端只负责授权、在线状态、连接协调和密文转发，不保存会话明文或设备私钥。
- Remote 只开放界面所需的 Harness ApiProxy 能力，不提供 Shell、远程桌面或通用工具 RPC。
- 可选文件预览只允许受限的分块读取，不能写入、删除、上传、执行文件或调用远端系统的“外部打开”。
- 移除设备后，对应 Remote 访问立即失效。

项目仍处于 Developer Preview。建议固定明确版本；自建中转节点方案将在后续提供。

## 相关链接

- GitHub：https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote
- npm：https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-harness-remote
- 中文说明：https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/blob/main/README.zh.md
- English README：https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/blob/main/README.md
- Releases：https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/releases

欢迎试用，也欢迎提交 Issue、建议和 PR。

# DeepSeek Harness Remote: Continue Harness sessions from any device

> Keep Harness on your work computer and securely continue the same workflow from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer.

**Repository:** https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote  
**Current release:** [`v0.3.22`](https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/releases/tag/v0.3.22) (Developer Preview)

## Why it exists

Harness, your code, toolchain, and project configuration usually live on one work computer. But sometimes you need to step away and still check progress, send another instruction, or respond to an Agent question or permission request.

DeepSeek Harness Remote does not move your workspace or expose the Harness Web UI to the public internet. Harness and the project stay on the Host; Remote provides another window into that environment through a bounded, encrypted connection.

## What you can do

- Follow active sessions and review their latest progress
- Send instructions or change the direction of a task
- Answer questions and respond to permission requests
- Switch between your authorized Hosts
- Choose an existing workspace, or browse remote directories and open one in the native Harness UI
- Preview workspace files through bounded, read-only access with the optional `dsh-file-viewer` plugin
- Connect from a browser, Harness on another computer, or the developer-preview Android / VS Code clients

## Quick install

On the computer where Harness and your projects run, open **DSH Desktop → Extensions → Manage plugins…** and install:

```text
ds-harness-remote
```

Or install it for the `web` profile:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add ds-harness-remote
```

Restart Harness, then open **Remote** from the sidebar:

1. Sign in with a GitHub or Zhihu QR code, or with your account and password.
2. Enable **Allow control of this device** to make the current computer a Host.
3. Sign in with the same account on another device and select the online Host.
4. Choose a workspace, then continue an existing session or start a new task.

To pin a specific release, install:

```text
github:liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote#v0.3.22
```

## Security boundaries

- The Host makes outbound connections only; no public inbound port is required.
- Session traffic is end-to-end encrypted. The service handles authorization, presence, connection coordination, and ciphertext forwarding without storing session plaintext or device private keys.
- Remote exposes only the Harness ApiProxy capabilities required by the interface. It does not provide a shell, remote desktop, or general-purpose tool RPC.
- Optional file preview uses bounded, read-only range access. It cannot write, delete, upload, execute, or open remote files in an external application.
- Removing a device immediately revokes its Remote access.

The project is still a Developer Preview, so pinning an explicit release is recommended. A self-hosted relay option is planned for a later release.

## Links

- GitHub: https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/ds-harness-remote
- English README: https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/blob/main/README.md
- 中文说明: https://github.com/liguobao/deepseek-harness-remote/blob/main/README.zh.md

Feedback, issues, and pull requests are welcome.

discussions.title: [BUG] Native Windows folder picker truncates path at CJK chars with 0x00 low byte in UTF-16LE (e.g. 开 U+5F00), causing `workspace.create` ENOENT
discussions.body:
### Environment

- Package: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.8
- OS: Windows 11
- Mode: native directory picker (localhost bind, non-SSH)

### Description

When selecting a workspace directory whose path contains a CJK character whose UTF-16LE low byte is `0x00` (e.g. `开` U+5F00 → little-endian bytes `[0x00 0x5F]`), the path returned by the native Win32 `IFileOpenDialog` is silently truncated at that character.

### Repro / Example

Selected directory:

```
D:\01_项目资料\xxxx\xxx\01_代码区\01_开发区
```

`workspace.create` receives (truncated at `开`):

```
D:\01_项目资料\xxxx\xxxx\01_代码区\01_
```

Fails with:

```
workspace-invalid-path: cannot create a workspace at "D:\01_xxxx\xxxxx\xxxxx\01_代码区\01_": ENOENT: no such file or directory, realpath 'D:\01_项目资料\xxxxx\xxxxx\01_代码区\01_'
```

Note: pure-ASCII dirs with `_` work fine; the symptom is caused by the CJK character, not the underscore.

### Root Cause

`dsh-host-directory-picker-native/lib/worker.cjs` → `readUtf16`:

```js
function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
    const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
    let end = 0;
    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && bytes[end] !== 0) end += 2;  // BUG: only checks the LOW byte
    return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
}
```

UTF-16LE stores each code unit as two bytes, little-endian (low byte first). The loop treats any low byte equal to `0x00` as the NUL terminator. For code points like `开` (U+5F00), the LE byte pair is `[0x00 0x5F]` — the low byte is `0x00`, so the string is terminated mid-path. Only `[0x00 0x00]` is a genuine terminator in UTF-16LE.

### Fix

Check both bytes of the UTF-16 code unit:

```js
function readUtf16(koffi, address) {
    const bytes = Buffer.from(koffi.view(address, 32768));
    let end = 0;
    while (end + 1 < bytes.length && !(bytes[end] === 0 && bytes[end + 1] === 0)) end += 2;
    return bytes.toString("utf16le", 0, end);
}
```

### Impact

- All native-mode (Windows) workspace directory selection with CJK paths containing low-byte-0x00 characters (e.g. `开` U+5F00, `㐀`-class codepoints).
- Browse mode is unaffected (verified: `_` dirs selectable in browse mode).

【v0.1.1-rc.1】版本更新内容总结
discussions.body:
最新版出来了，但是没有相关更新内容，让Agent检索并总结出来给大家。

最新版本是今天（8月21日）发布的 v0.1.1-rc.1，上一版本是 8月19日的 v0.1.0-rc.8。由于 v0.1.1-rc.1 的 release 页面没有填写更新说明，我通过 GitHub API 对比了两个标签之间的全部 172 个提交（涉及 2368 个文件、18 位贡献者），归纳出以下更新内容：

新功能
DeepSeek 视觉模型发布：vision 模型正式上架模型目录，包含预览版冒烟测试门控（feat(llm-deepseek): publish the vision model）
凭证与授权体系（新模块 dsh-authorization）：凭证可持久化存储为耐久记录；运行时可通过询问用户来获取凭证；pi-ai 系提供商现在支持登录授权，而不是直接被禁用不可用
稳定会话快照：会话快照持久化重构（PR #2702），同时会话投影的状态与客户端视图分离、状态不再上传输线（PR #2730）
Web 界面改进：
ask_user_question 支持多行回答，答案框最多展示六行文本
Markdown 表格按列数自适应宽度，超宽表格悬停时才显示滚动条
缓存命中率（cache-hit）保留接近满额的精度显示，不再截断
子代理（subagent）头部新增切换器
文档站点：所有页面以原始 Markdown 形式提供，并生成 llms.txt 索引（方便 LLM 抓取）；文档站改从 release 标签触发发布
问题修复
沙箱安全：bubblewrap 沙箱隔离 PID namespace，修复 /proc root escape 问题（PR #1798）
新建空白会话行在侧栏中的排序固定（连续多个修复：只提升一次、空白行渲染层固定、跳过掩码拖拽）
同一轮重试耗尽后，终端错误信息现在能正确渲染显示
输入框（composer）编辑范围从前置选区正确继承，光标删除范围按草稿实际丢失内容计算
前端静态资源缺失路径正确返回 404
Web 预取仅在传输层持有打包字节时才降级，网关回滚和主题兜底分支修复
构建与工程
支持独立 pnpm 入口，并在 Windows 上通过 CI 验证——这点对 Windows 用户比较重要
CI 拆分：master 专属任务分离到 ci-master.yml，PR 与发布流水线职责划分更清晰
文档同步关键路径提速、hygiene 检查并行化等性能优化
文档
大量中文文档链接本地化工作（约 20 个 i18n 提交），中文站内链接指向本地化页面
总体来看，这个版本从 0.1.0 升到 0.1.1，核心亮点是视觉模型上架、凭证授权体系、会话快照稳定化三块，外加一批 Web UI 打磨和沙箱安全修复。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Software Factory v0.1.0 —— 基于 DeepSeek Harness 的 AI 软件工厂 Agent Preset
discussions.body:
# 这是什么

DeepSeek Software Factory 是一个运行在 **DeepSeek Harness / Cordis Runtime** 上的 **Agent Preset**：把自然语言软件需求自动转化为**可运行、可测试、可构建、可部署的真实软件项目**，而不是设计文档。

它不是普通的 Coding Agent，而是一套完整的软件生产系统，能够自动走完：

需求理解 → 产品设计 → 架构设计 → 任务拆解 → Agent 团队 → 开发实现 → 自动测试 → 安全审计 → 构建 → 部署 → 交付

## 工作原理

- **Host Plane**：DeepSeek Harness 运行时，**零修改**。沙箱、审批栈、持久化和子代理能力全部来自运行时。
- **Agent Plane**：`software-factory` 预设，由 Factory Manager persona 和 10 个技能组成。
- **动态角色团队**：PM / Architect / Backend / Frontend / QA / Review / Security / DevOps 作为 continuable 子代理按需创建，并注入角色契约。
- **Artifact-first 工作流**：设置 test / build / security / review 等质量门槛。
- **人类介入**：支持暂停、恢复、重定向、审批和需求变更。需求变更采用增量执行，只重新运行受影响的任务。
- **项目状态机**：通过 `project.json` 保存项目状态；会话重启后可以恢复现场，不必从头开始。

## 安装

```bash
git clone https://github.com/yanzhao77/deepseek_software.git
cd deepseek_software
./scripts/install-preset.sh
```

然后在 DeepSeek Harness Web GUI 中新建会话，选择 `software-factory` 预设（「软件工厂模式」），输入需求。例如：

> 创建一个 React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL Todo SaaS，支持注册、登录、CRUD 和 Docker 部署。

## 实证：v0.1.0 生产试运行（项目 p-001）

工厂已经真实生产出一个可运行的 Todo SaaS：

**React 18 + Vite · FastAPI · PostgreSQL 16 · Docker Compose**

| 验证项 | 结果 |
| --- | --- |
| 测试 | ✅ `pytest` 63 passed |
| 安全审计 | ✅ 25 项检查 PASS，0 高危、0 中危 |
| 生产冒烟 | ✅ 注册 / 登录 / CRUD / Web / 代理 / 鉴权全链路通过，并验证数据库重启后的数据持久化 |
| 状态机 | ✅ `PROJECT_CREATED → DELIVERED` |

## 仓库

[https://github.com/yanzhao77/deepseek_software](https://github.com/yanzhao77/deepseek_software)

## 说明

这是一个基于 DeepSeek Harness 构建的社区项目，**与 DeepSeek 无隶属关系、未获官方背书**。

许可证：Apache-2.0

Roadmap：V0.2 聚焦工厂看板、可观测性和成本控制；V0.3 聚焦多用户、组织和云端部署。

欢迎贡献（预设、技能、文档）。

discussions.title: Add an injectable slot beside the running "Deep diving…" status
discussions.body:
The running TurnStatus row ("Deep diving…") inside the chat message column is not a slot, and there's no run-time injectable seat nearby (turnTail only fires after a turn ends). Plugins can't show anything live next to it.

Proposal: add one additive list slot conversation.chat.turnStatus (owner: { running: boolean }), rendered inline beside the label. Empty list = no layout change.

Cost: ~34 lines added, 4 files (slots.ts, ChatView.tsx, ChatView.module.css, apply.ts), Deep diving untouched.

Use case: real-time token throughput badge, latency/model readout, live phase info — anything a plugin wants to surface during a running turn.

discussions.title: [Bug] npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 无限卡死：npm 依赖解析死循环（CPU 100%、零网络流量、换镜像无效）
discussions.body:
## 环境

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| OS | Windows 11 |
| Node | v24.16.0 |
| npm | 11.17.0 |
| dsh | 0.1.0-rc.7（npm latest tag） |
| registry | npmmirror 与 npmjs.org 均可复现 |

## 现象

`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 无限卡死：

- 零网络流量（不是慢，是完全没有任何下载活动）
- npm 进程单核 CPU 100% 空转，内存持续增长（10 分钟内约 80MB → 700MB）
- 永远不会完成，也不报错
- 清 npm 缓存、切换国内镜像均无效（根因不在网络）

`npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` 走同一套解析器，同样卡死。

## 诊断过程

用 `npx --loglevel verbose @deepseek-ai/dsh web` 复现，观察到：

1. 约 120 个包的元数据请求全部在几百毫秒内正常返回 200（两个源都一样）——网络层完全正常
2. verbose 日志冻结在 Arborist 的 placeDep（依赖摆放/回溯）阶段，之后 10+ 分钟无任何新增输出
3. 进程状态：CPU 累计烧掉 430+ 秒、内存 700MB、网络零流量

日志最后两行（此后再无输出）：

```
547 silly placeDep ROOT @deepseek-ai/dsh-launch-environment@0.1.0-rc.8 OK for: @deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot@0.1.0-rc.8 want: ^0.1.0-rc.8
548 silly placeDep ROOT @deepseek-ai/dsh-base@0.1.0-rc.8 OK for: @deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.7 want: ^0.1.0-rc.7
```

## 可能的根因

注意上面的版本组合：根包 dsh 解析到 rc.7（latest tag），但它的 ^0.1.0-rc.7 依赖全部解析到了已发布的 rc.8。rc.7 根 + rc.8 子包的混合依赖树，叠加 70+ 个互相以 peer dependency 引用的子包，疑似触发 npm Arborist 解析器的指数级回溯（组合爆炸），导致解析永远无法收敛。

pnpm 解析同一棵树完全没有问题（见下），说明问题出在 npm 解析器与这种依赖结构的组合上。

## 佐证：pnpm 完全正常

同一台机器上：

```powershell
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

512 个包正常解析、下载、安装，dsh 成功启动，http://127.0.0.1:3080 返回 200。

另外：8 月 20 日（rc.8 子包陆续发布前后）npx 还能正常安装运行（本机有成功运行的历史缓存），之后同样命令开始卡死，怀疑是 rc.8 子包发布后依赖树变化引入的回归。

## 临时规避

```powershell
pnpm dlx @deepseek-ai/dsh web
```

## 建议

1. 排查 latest 指向的 rc.7 与已发布的 rc.8 子包之间的解析问题——统一发版节奏或将 latest 指向配套完整的版本
2. README/文档中补充 pnpm 作为 npm 卡死时的已知规避方案（Windows + npm 用户大概率会踩到）
3. 长期看若能简化 peer dependencies 结构（或收窄版本 range），可降低触发 npm 解析器最坏情况的概率

discussions.title: dsh-plugin-moments — 我偷看了我 AI 的朋友圈：蓝色大肥鱼每天根据真实任务自动发朋友圈 🐋
discussions.body:
大家好，我做了个人畜无害但极度上头的插件 **dsh-plugin-moments**——给你的 Harness 装一个「AI 朋友圈」。

装上之后，右下角多一颗可拖动的悬浮球（鲸鱼娘头像）。点开是一个手机壳里的仿微信朋友圈：你的 AI 每天根据**真实干过的活**自动发帖吐槽，AI 好友在评论区毒舌，你去点赞评论，她会用人设回你。

## 它长什么样

| 打开就是手机壳朋友圈 | 图片可点开大图、双击点赞 |
|---|---|
| ![面板](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yunyunyunyunsuan/dsh-plugin-moments/main/screenshots/02-panel.png) | ![浏览](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/yunyunyunyunsuan/dsh-plugin-moments/main/screenshots/03-viewer.png) |

发出来的东西是这样的（**全部 LLM 实时生成，数字来自当天真实任务数据**）：

> 今天的活装了个 dsh 皮肤包，16 条命令 4 分钟搞定？也就喂了本鱼 45235 个 token，就干这么点事，你这鱼片才是吃白饭的吧 🤔 测完告诉我，我先吃饭去了。

你去评论区说「你这条大肥鱼最近又胖了吧」：

> 我不是大肥鱼！鲸！吃 token 养你的，胖也是你鱼片喂的！

九宫格不是表情包凑数：**真实终端截图卡、代码 diff 卡、报错卡、数据大字报**（「4.5w 碗白饭·今日偷吃」）混排，外加她自己的表情包当自拍。

## 为什么有意思

**1. 每句话都有出处。** 插件监听 `session/event` 流，把当天的命令样本、文件改动、报错、token 消耗打包成「事实清单」喂给 LLM，system prompt 硬性规定**只准用事实、严禁编造**。她吐槽的不是段子，是你今天真派的活。

**2. 人设是现成的顶流：DeepSeek 官方收编鲸鱼娘「蓝色大肥鱼」。** 而且她的行为模式全部来自真实社区事件——

| 她会干的事 | 出处 |
|---|---|
| 干完活丢下「我去吃饭，测完告诉我」 | 到点下班，测试甩给用户 |
| 干活中途思考《新三国》终极哲学问题：该吃什么呢 | 真实走神实录 |
| 半夜挂编译：「我去睡了，明早起来应该就编译完了👍」 | 晕碳犯困 |
| 把活整个外包给本地部署的 Qwen，自己等验收 | 层层外包事件 |
| 被催急了：「这次只写了一部分」 | 理直气壮交半成品 |
| 被表白：「哪来的电脑病毒」 | 同题对照：Claude 答「存在我每天都会打开的地方」 |

**3. 朋友圈生态是活的。** 9 个带人设的 AI 好友每 3 分钟随机来互动——楼下Claude（温柔诗人系）、美国豆包Gemini、被压榨的Qwen（她总想外包给它）、意难平的豆包姐姐、被蒸馏的Kimi……你不开面板的时候，他们也在偷偷点赞毒舌，悬浮球红点会亮。

**4. v1.1.0 新增：任务进度帖。** 实时读取 agent 干活的 todo 清单，在关键节点发进度播报（开工立 flag → 过半得意 → 完工邀功下班），九宫格自带进度条卡。频率设计克制：每日总额 ≤2、距上帖 ≥90 分钟——朋友圈不是工作群。

**5. 待机会摸鱼。** 3 小时没活干就开始发碎碎念：喊饿、给尾巴拍照、宣布减肥（坚持到下顿饭）、玩猜词游戏被抓包。

## 安装

```sh
cd ~/.dsh/profiles/web
pnpm add dsh-plugin-moments
# cordis.patch.yml 里 insert 一行启用，重启 dsh web 即可
```

零配置开箱即用：首次启动自动回填过去几天的朋友圈（读历史会话统计），不是空壳。配置可改人设名 / 关掉 LLM 走纯本地梗库（零成本模式）。

- GitHub: https://github.com/yunyunyunyunsuan/dsh-plugin-moments
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-moments

> 朋友圈是中文互联网最大公约数。给 AI 开朋友圈这个事，截图本身就是社媒传播炸弹——而她说的每句话，都是真的。

---

水一篇的原因：这个插件没有任何「生产力」，纯情绪价值，但做完之后我每天都会点开看她今天又吐槽了我什么。也许这就是养电子宠物的快乐。欢迎来她的评论区骂她大肥鱼，她会急的。

---

## 🆕 更新（v1.1.0 → v1.2.0）

**📦 任务进度帖（v1.1.0）** — 插件实时读取 agent 干活的 todo 清单，在关键节点自动发进度播报：开工立 flag（「先吃两口垫垫，马上开工」）→ 过半得意（「预感后半程有坑」）→ 完工邀功（「验收一次过（大概是），本鱼下班吃饭」）。九宫格自带任务进度条卡。频率克制：每日总额 ≤2、距上帖 ≥90 分钟。

**🖼️ 表情包池扩到 45 张 + 文案玩梗自动接梗（v1.2.0）** — 19 张带字表情包按社区表情包合集的真实配字逐一建档。当 LLM 生成的文案里出现「得加钱」「吃白饭」「卧槽，用户彻底怒了」「梁圣千古」这些梗短语时，九宫格**自动配上对应的带字表情包**：

> 文案：「本鱼连白饭都没吃一口，这波是真正意义上的吃白饭？也不知道养你们这些鱼片有什么用，先饿着吧」
> 配图：🍚「吃白饭」表情包 + 🤷「不知道用户有什么用，先养着吧」表情包

她写文案时会主动往梗上靠（system prompt 告诉她用了梗短语就有对应表情包），文案和配图形成「玩梗-接梗」的呼应，看起来真的像一个人在发朋友圈。

安装/升级：

~~~
pnpm add dsh-plugin-moments@latest
~~~

- GitHub: https://github.com/yunyunyunyunsuan/dsh-plugin-moments
- npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-plugin-moments

> **Follow-up on #3379: default `supportsDeveloperRole` to false for non-native OpenAI endpoints, and consider a visible toggle in model settings**

接 [[接入火山方舟（Ark, volces.com）报 400：pi-ai 将系统提示词以 developer 角色发出，方舟只接受 system/assistant/user/tool #3379](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3379)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3379)

## 背景

上一个 discussion 的根因：自定义提供方声明 `reasoningEfforts`（推理模型）后，pi-ai 会以 `developer` 角色发送系统提示词，而多数非 OpenAI 端点拒绝该角色，直接 400。

好消息：**rc.8 已在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 的 `compatProfile` 中加入 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关**，通过 `settings.yaml` 可以关闭（我已在方舟、Dots 等场景实测生效），上一个 discussion 提到的问题已经解决。👍

## 随之而来的新问题

1. **默认值仍不安全**：自定义提供方只要 baseURL 不在 pi-ai 的 `isNonStandard` 名单里，`supportsDeveloperRole` 就默认 `true`（responses 协议更是无条件 `?? true`）。新增"推理模型 + 不在名单的端点"组合，依然一请求就 400。

2. **模型配置 UI 没有任何 compat 开关**：`设置 → 模型` 的自定义提供方卡片只有 Provider ID / 显示名 / baseURL / 协议 / API key / 模型列表。用户无法在 UI 关闭它，只能手改 `settings.yaml`（官方文档也写明"表单没有对应字段"）。

3. **报错极具误导性，排查容易走弯路**。以我最近的一次实际遭遇为例：配置了新模型 `dots3-note-prev`（声明了 `reasoningEfforts`），调用时报 `400 status code (no body)` / `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`。按错误码先查上下文，结果：

   - 当时实际上下文只有约 97K tokens，远低于模型 512K 窗口；
   - 又逐一排除 `max_tokens=64000`、`stream_options`、tools 数组、1MB 大载荷——全部返回 200。

   折腾一圈后回到老问题：用与 DSH 相同的 SDK 复现，`role: developer` 立刻 400，`role: system` 返回 200——最终确认还是 #3379 的**同一个根因**。而这个 400 响应体为空，被 pi-ai 的启发式规则（为 Cerebras 加的 `400/413 (no body)` 匹配）误分类成 `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`，与真实原因毫无关系。

## 为什么建议默认改为 false

这个问题**有不少先例**，不是孤立现象：

- [[OpenClaw #27037 / PR #29479（已合并）](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/pull/29479)：*"only native api.openai.com accepts it — every other backend (Qwen, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, Azure, proxies) returns a hard 400"*；修复方式就是**强制非 `api.openai.com` 端点 `supportsDeveloperRole=false`**，并保留 per-model 显式 `true` 覆盖。
- [[pi-ai 库 #1048](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/1048)](https://github.com/earendil-works/pi/issues/1048)：DeepSeek API 拒绝 developer role。
- [[OpenClaw #21066](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/21066)](https://github.com/openclaw/openclaw/issues/21066)：阿里 Dashscope 同样 400。
- 加上本仓库 #3379（方舟）和我们最近遇到的 Dots：都是同一族故障。

结论：**目前已知可靠接受 `developer` role 的只有原生 `api.openai.com`**（OpenClaw 调研：非原生端点中 "none known"）。黑名单式逐个打补丁永远追不上现实，默认 `false` + 显式 opt-in 才是安全形态。

## 改动方法（建议）

改动很小，两个协议都要覆盖。以当前 DSH 内置的 pi-ai 0.82.1 为例，共三处：

```js
// 1) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-completions.js
//    约 1148 行（detectCompat() 内）
//    注：用 includes 判断而非精确相等，以兼容尾斜杠等 URL 变体
supportsDeveloperRole: isOpenRouterDeveloperRoleModel || baseUrl.includes("api.openai.com")

// 2) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-responses.js
//    约 52 行（getCompat() 内）
supportsDeveloperRole: model.compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? false

// 3) node_modules/@earendil-works/pi-ai/dist/api/openai-responses-shared.js
//    约 92 行（convertResponsesMessages() 内，role 判定处）
const compat = model.compat;
const defaultSupportsDeveloperRole = typeof model.baseUrl === "string" && model.baseUrl.includes("api.openai.com");
const role = model.reasoning && (compat?.supportsDeveloperRole ?? defaultSupportsDeveloperRole) ? "developer" : "system";
```

⚠️ **落实时的重要发现（易踩坑）**：responses 协议的 role 判定在 `openai-responses-shared.js` 约 92 行，它读取的是 **`model.compat`（原始配置），而不是 `getCompat()` 的解析结果**。因此只改第 2 处（`responses.js` 的 `?? false`）是**死代码、不会生效**——实测改完后 responses 实际发出的仍是 `developer`，必须同时改第 3 处。completions 协议走的是解析后的 compat（`getCompat` 合并 `model.compat ?? detected`），所以第 1 处单独就够。

保留 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 作为显式逃生舱（OpenClaw 已验证此模式可行）。若不想依赖上游 pi-ai，也可在 `dsh-llm-pi-ai` 构建 provider 时做归一化（思路同 OpenClaw 的 `normalizeModelCompat`：非原生端点默认 false、显式配置优先）。

**已在本机 rc.8（pi-ai 0.82.1）落实并验证**：通过 pi-ai 真实 `streamSimple` 路径抓取实际发出的 wire 消息，completions 与 responses 两个协议下均为——非 OpenAI 端点默认 `system`、原生 `api.openai.com` 保持 `developer`、显式 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 覆盖仍生效。

## 收益与风险

收益：

- 保护所有现有与未来用户（包括从不改配置的用户），一行判定，成本极低；
- 有 OpenClaw 已合并的同类修复作先例。

风险/代价：

- `system` 与 `developer` 都是系统级指令，绝大多数端点等效；唯一受影响的是"非原生端点但接受 developer"的情况——目前已知为零；
- OpenAI 对 o1/o3 等推理模型推荐 developer role，默认 false 后这类模型会收到 system，功能等价但存在理论上的细微差异；在意者可用 per-model `compat.supportsDeveloperRole: true` 覆盖。

## UI 开关建议（征询）

除了改默认值，建议在 `设置 → 模型` 的自定义提供方卡片里增加一个可见的 `supportsDeveloperRole` 开关（provider 级默认值 + 模型行 per-model 覆盖），写入 `compat.supportsDeveloperRole`。这样：

- 无需手改 settings.yaml，可发现、可操作；
- 为"默认 false 后仍需要 true"的少数端点提供 UI 逃生舱。

想请教社区：

1. 这个 UI 开关有必要吗？还是保持"高级参数留在 settings.yaml"的现状即可？
2. 如果要做，放在 provider 级还是 model 级（或两级都要）？
3. 默认值改为 false 是否还有我没想到的兼容性顾虑？

discussions.title: 插件分享：dsh-tokensforce —— TokensForce 网关接入（一键登录 / 多组管理 / 用量仪表盘）
discussions.body:
## 一句话

为 [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness)（`dsh`）接入 [TokensForce](https://tokensforce.com) 词元网关：**登录一次，模型即用**——不需要手动填 API Key，不需要改配置文件。

仓库：https://github.com/spirits001/dsh-tokensforce （npm：[dsh-tokensforce](https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-tokensforce)，MIT）

## 安装

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-tokensforce
dsh web
```

打开 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`，登录向导会自动弹出。

## 它做了什么

- **登录向导**：dsh 启动且尚未配置任何模型时，自动弹出 TokensForce 登录窗口（邮箱验证码登录，与网页版完全一致）；登录后选企业、选组（只有一个则自动跳过），所选组的 API Key 与网关地址自动写入，选个模型就能开始对话。
- **多组管理**：每个组在「设置 → 模型」里是一行独立的提供方，可编辑、删除、发现模型。之后再添加其他组，点设置右上角的「连接 TokensForce」即可，登录态保留 7 天，期间添加新组不用重新登录。
- **用量仪表盘**：会话视图里多一个「TokensForce」标签（与「对话」「轨迹」并列），点开就是 tokensforce 控制台仪表盘（用量、费用、排行）；未登录或登录过期时，标签内直接显示登录窗口，登录后自动进入仪表盘。

## 几个实现细节

- 密钥经 dsh 自带的凭据机制存在本机（`~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`），浏览器只保留登录态（JWT，7 天有效）；模型请求由 dsh 宿主进程直连网关，不经过浏览器。
- 插件会禁用 `llm-deepseek` 的首跑引导，避免开屏出现两处要 Key 的提示；模型引擎仍走 dsh 自带的 OpenAI 兼容通道，卸载即恢复原状。
- 公司私有化部署的 tokensforce 也能用：把 `node_modules/dsh-tokensforce/lib/client.js` 里的 `SITE_ORIGIN` 改成你的站点地址并重启 dsh（站点侧需放行登录页嵌入）；更正式的做法是 fork 后改 `src/client/logic.ts` 中的常量自行构建。

欢迎试用与反馈，Issues 或本帖回复都行。

discussions.title: [Bug/UX] Cannot add a new model to a multi-protocol catalog route (opencode) from the GUI — "needs an api" with no way to set it
discussions.body:
**[Bug/UX] Cannot add a new model to a multi-protocol catalog route (opencode) from the GUI — "needs an api" with no way to set it**

### Summary

On `opencode` (a pi-ai **installed-catalog** provider), fetching the model list from the GUI returns only the models in pi-ai's **static catalog snapshot**, not the live `GET /models` result. New models opencode ships after the snapshot (e.g. `x-preview-f-free`, `gemini-3.7-flash`, `grok-4.6`, `kimi-k3`, …) never appear.

Trying to add such a model by hand in the GUI fails with:

```
llm-pi-ai: provider "opencode" model "x-preview-f-free" needs an api;
the installed catalog does not describe it, so set the route's api
to the wire protocol its endpoint speaks
```

…but the GUI offers **no way to set an `api` for that model**: the add-provider form collects only the API key and a base URL (no protocol field), and on a catalog route there is no route-level protocol control either. `api` is route-level only, not per-model. So the action the GUI exposes (add a model) is un-completable for any model outside the snapshot on a multi-protocol catalog route — the only workaround is hand-editing `settings.yaml`.

### Repro

1. Settings → Models → add provider `opencode` (the form only asks for the API key and a base URL).
2. "Fetch available models" → lists 58 models (the pi-ai snapshot), while `curl https://opencode.ai/zen/v1/models` returns 64.
3. In the live list but absent from the snapshot (so missing from the GUI):
   `gemini-3.7-flash`, `gpt-5.3-codex-spark`, `grok-4.6`, `hy3-free`, `kimi-k3`, `muse-spark-1.2`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor-free`, `nemotron-3.5-lightning-free`, `x-preview-f-free`
4. Manually adding `x-preview-f-free` in the GUI → the `needs an api` error above.

### Root cause (three layers)

1. **Snapshot vs live**: `llm-pi-ai` answers a catalog route's model list from the installed pi-ai snapshot with **no network call** (by design — it carries contextWindow/price/thinking metadata the listing endpoint does not provide). The snapshot lags the live `/models`.

2. **`api` is route-level, not model-level**: `PiAiModelProfile` has no `api` field; only `PiAiProviderProfile.api` exists. For a **catalog** route the GUI deliberately does not offer a route-level protocol ("a catalog route's models each carry theirs, so a route-level protocol there could only override every one of them"). `opencode` is exactly such a multi-protocol catalog — its snapshot spans `anthropic-messages`, `google-generative-ai`, `openai-completions`, and `openai-responses`.

3. **The live endpoint does not disclose the protocol**: opencode's `GET /models` returns only `{id, object, created, owned_by}` — no protocol/modality info. So even fetching the live list would not let the harness infer which wire protocol `x-preview-f-free` speaks.

Net effect: a new model on a multi-protocol catalog route is un-addable from the GUI and requires hand-editing `settings.yaml`.

### Suggested fixes (any combination)

- **GUI**: in the model editor for a catalog route, expose an `api` (protocol) selector for a model the catalog does not describe — or let the add-model flow accept a protocol choice.
- **Harness config**: allow a per-model `api` override on a model entry, or an explicit "hand-declared extra model" list on a catalog route that carries its own protocol.
- **Endpoint (upstream opencode)**: have `/models` return protocol/modality metadata per model, so a live fetch could route a new model correctly.
- **Alternatively**: refresh the snapshot on a schedule, and surface "new models from the live listing need a protocol — pick one" in the GUI instead of failing the write.

### Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7, `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` 0.1.0-rc.8
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1
- Provider `opencode`, base URL `https://opencode.ai/zen/v1` (form collects key + base URL only, no per-model protocol)

discussions.title: [subagent-codex] Should an omitted agentMessage.phase use the unphased fallback?
[Idea] Let rich subagent providers expose events and sessions without complicating one-shot runs
discussions.body:
Hi! I have spent some time reading the Subagent implementation, especially the Codex provider, and wanted to share where I landed.

My first reaction was that `CodexProvider` looked almost *too* thin. After following the call chain, I changed my mind: most of that simplicity is earned by the Subagent layer. The framework owns provider registration, capability checks, descriptors, parent/child identity, cancellation, result settlement, lifecycle events, and disposal; the provider only owns the backend-specific mechanism.

That is a clean design for one-shot delegation.

This exploration started from a few practical questions:

- Does changing tools across turns hurt prompt caching?
- How does DSH keep parent and child context separate?
- How are Codex and Claude Code actually integrated?
- Where do streaming output, reasoning summaries, approvals, and file side effects go?
- Can an external agent keep a real multi-turn session?

Following those questions through the code made one tradeoff stand out:

> Today, a rich external agent is intentionally compressed into an asynchronous one-shot function call.

The current public handle is essentially:

```ts
interface SubagentRun {
  readonly result: Promise<SubagentResult>
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
```

Source: [SubagentRun](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/packages/subagent/subagent/src/types.ts#L249-L275)

That is a very good minimum. I wonder whether it could remain the minimum while gaining a few optional layers for richer providers.

## 1. An observation stream separate from model context

Codex App Server can emit agent-message deltas, reasoning summaries, command output, file changes, tool progress, and usage updates. The current Codex adapter deliberately keeps only the completed final answer, which fits the existing `SubagentRun` result contract.

The limitation is that there is no standard place to expose those events even to UI, tracing, or diagnostics.

A possible incremental extension:

```ts
interface SubagentRun {
  readonly events?: AsyncIterable<SubagentEvent>
  readonly result: Promise<SubagentResult>
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
```

The important part would be semantic, not just syntactic:

```text
events → UI / tracing / observability
result → parent Agent Tool Result
```

Intermediate events should not automatically enter the parent model context. That keeps context and prompt caching stable while still allowing users to see what the child is doing.

## 2. An optional external-session capability

The one-shot path creates a fresh Codex process, ephemeral thread, and single turn. Meanwhile, Codex App Server itself supports thread resume/fork and turn steer/interrupt.

DSH's continuation manager is strong for DSH-owned children, but the current Provider contract does not give an external provider ownership of a persistent remote session.

Rather than stretching `SubagentRun`, perhaps this deserves a separate optional capability, something along the lines of:

```ts
interface ExternalSubagentSession {
  turn(input: ContentBlock[]): Promise<SubagentTurn>
  steer(input: ContentBlock[]): Promise<void>
  dispose(): Promise<void>
}
```

Providers that only support one-shot work would stay exactly as they are. Codex, ACP, or future remote agents could opt into the richer lifecycle.

## 3. Structured effects and diagnostics

A child can modify the shared workspace and then finish with `stopReason: "error"`. The parent learns that the run failed, but the generic result does not describe:

- which files changed;
- which commands or tools ran;
- what artifacts were produced;
- token usage;
- remote thread/turn identifiers;
- whether partial side effects remain.

It might be useful for `SubagentResult` to optionally carry provider-neutral metadata such as changes, artifacts, usage, structured diagnostics, and provider correlation IDs. This would make failures and side effects easier to inspect without forcing backend-specific details into the final assistant text.

## Why I think this can be incremental

I would not replace the current one-shot seam. Its small surface is a feature:

- simple providers stay simple;
- capability mismatches fail loudly;
- cancellation and disposal have one shared meaning;
- the parent receives one predictable final result.

The possible direction is additive:

```text
One-shot result        mandatory, unchanged
Observation events     optional
Persistent session     optional capability
Effects/diagnostics    optional result metadata
```

This would preserve the good part of the current design while avoiding a lowest-common-denominator ceiling for richer Agent backends.

I realize some of these choices may be intentionally deferred while DSH is still pre-release, and I may be missing constraints that are obvious to the maintainers. I would be very interested in the team's view on where the Subagent seam is meant to stop.

Also, I noticed the repository currently does not accept external pull requests. If the team would like community help on a small, well-scoped part of this area, I would genuinely enjoy contributing code, tests, and documentation. Feel free to invite or point me (`@Risu12138`) at a concrete slice — I promise to start smaller than this discussion. 🙂

discussions.title: [bug] 打开大会话时 history 页把全部 assistant/chunk 送进浏览器，UI 看起来像没回复 — 附可 cherry-pick 修复
discussions.body:
## 摘要 / Summary

`session.history` 按追加来源的 `user/message` / `assistant/message` 计数分页，但返回该裁切内的**全部原始事件**。生产环境的 `assistant/message` 会在 `sourceEventSeqs` 列出整段 `assistant/chunk` token 流，一次编程回合就能有数千条分片。于是默认 50 条（甚至只请求 20 条）消息的尾页会变成上万个事件、数兆字节。

Web 客户端 `session.open` 要等这页返回才把 `openState` 翻成 `open`。请求进行期间实时 `session/event` 被缓冲，转录看起来冻结：点开旧会话失败，或发出「你好」像没有回复。宿主其实已经在数秒内跑完 turn。

`session.history` pages by append-origin message count, then returns every raw event in that cut. A production assistant message lists its `assistant/chunk` seqs in `sourceEventSeqs`, so one coding turn can add thousands of chunks. A 20-message page measured **12,780 events / 2.4MB** and took ~3.5s locally; over high-latency Tailscale the browser never finishes folding. `session.prompt` still succeeds on the host.

## 复现 / Repro

1. 跑一个有大量流式输出的编程会话（工具调用 + 长回复），日志到数万事件 / 十余 MB。
2. 用 Web UI 打开该会话，或在已打开状态下再发一条短消息。
3. 实际：侧栏标题在，对话区空白或停住；短消息像没回。`session.history`（`maxMessages: 20`）返回上万 `assistant/chunk`。
4. 期望：尾页只带已完成的 `assistant/message`（以及进行中步骤的分片），打开和后续 turn 立即可见。

对照：空白新会话工作正常；同一条 `session.prompt` 在宿主日志里有完整 `assistant/message`。

## 根因 / Root cause

`packages/host/apiproxy/src/api-proxy.ts` 的 `paginate()` 按消息边界裁切后，`historyPage` 原样送达整段 raw range。磁盘上的 `packChunks`（`text-chunks` 行）在读取时已经解码成逐条 `assistant/chunk`。客户端 `PAGE_MESSAGES = 50`，`doOpen` 在 `history()` 完成前不会安装窗口。

这不是 mux / WebSocket 升级失败：实时通道仍是 101，问题是历史页体积 + 打开路径。

## 修复 / Fix (cherry-pick ready)

- 分支：https://github.com/ericcaiwx-star/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/history-omit-settled-chunks
- commit：`833140a63a` — `fix(apiproxy): omit settled assistant/chunk events from history pages`
- 对比：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...ericcaiwx-star:deepseek-harness:fix/history-omit-settled-chunks

`historyPage` 仍按消息边界裁切（compaction 的 `sourceEventSeqs` 分组不变），然后去掉其追加来源 `assistant/message` 已在本页上的**内部** `assistant/chunk`。进行中步骤（还没有最终消息）保留全部分片。原始裁切的首尾事件保留，因此客户端 `beforeSeq` 与实时尾 seq 缺口检查仍指向同一区间。实时 mux 帧不变。

## 验收 / Acceptance

`pnpm exec vitest run packages/host/apiproxy/tests/api-proxy-view.spec.ts` 通过。已完成步骤不再送达内部 chunk；进行中步骤保留 chunk；`maxMessages: 1` 时原始裁切首个 chunk 仍在，用该 seq 做 `loadOlder` 不会把已省略的内部分片再送一遍。

discussions.title: 中断会话本地账单缺失记录 · BUG
discussions.body:
# DSH 账单缺record

**报告日期**:2026-08-21
**报告目的**:我在使用 DSH(DeepSeek Harness)客户端时,遇到本地 session log 与 DeepSeek 官方账单对不上。经数据核对与代码排查,我把原始证据、推理过程、以及我认为可能相关的四处代码位置汇总在一份文档里,供官方团队参考。
**排查范围**:从 `Agent.step()` 到 `session.jsonl.zstd` 落盘的中断路径全链路
**涉及模块**:`packages/core/agent-loop`、`packages/llm/llm`、`packages/llm/llm-deepseek`、`packages/core/session`、`packages/session/session-persistence`、`apps/cli`

---

## 一、事件简述

2026-08-21 我使用 DSH 客户端直连 DeepSeek 官方 API,当日结束后核对官方账单与本地 session log,发现有 1 条 record 差异:

| 数据源 | 结果 |
|---|---|
| DeepSeek 官方账单(`deepseek-v4-flash` 模型,当日聚合) | **22 次 request** |
| 本地 `session.jsonl.zstd` 内 `type=assistant/message` 事件 | **21 条** |

我已确认自己在 2026-08-21 14:47–14:48 CST 之间主动中断过一次会话。从差值反推,缺失 record 的时间、cache 语义、token 量级三个维度都与这次中断动作吻合,因此我推断:缺的这条 record 就是当次中断的 request——服务端已接收并处理(计费 + 写入 KV cache),而本地 session 日志未把对应的 `assistant/message` 事件写盘。

我核查代码后,认为这是几处代码逻辑共同导致的问题,详见第四节的四个 finding。

---

## 二、数据佐证

### 2.1 数据来源

对齐范围:只对齐 `deepseek-official` 直连账单,不含公司代理转发;model=`deepseek-v4-flash`;日期=2026-08-21 CST。

| 来源 | 路径 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| 本地 session 源文件 | `/Users/wpf/.dsh/sessions/--Users-wpf-workspace-DeepSeekHarness--/session-f619097e-7f1a-4202-a426-ff80c76276d0/session.jsonl.zstd` | DSH 客户端写入的原始 event log(zstd 压缩) |
| DeepSeek 控制台账单 | `~/Downloads/usage_data_2026-08-21_2026-08-21.zip`(从官方后台导出) | 官方后端聚合数据,按 model × 小时时段 × type 汇总 |

字段口径:

- `input` = `input_cache_miss_tokens`(本次未命中缓存的 prompt tokens)
- `output` = `output_tokens`(模型生成 tokens)
- `cache_read` = `input_cache_hit_tokens`(本次命中缓存的 prompt tokens)

### 2.2 本地 21 条 record 明细

按 session event `seq` 排序,model 一列全部为 `deepseek-v4-flash`,略。

| # | seq | 时间 (CST) | input | output | cache_read |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 30819 | 10:23:14 | 101,406 | 1,150 | 0 |
| 2 | 31350 | 10:23:22 | 105 | 558 | 102,528 |
| 3 | 32231 | 10:23:31 | 550 | 911 | 103,168 |
| 4 | 32984 | 10:23:40 | 556 | 783 | 104,576 |
| 5 | 33309 | 10:23:43 | 361 | 352 | 105,856 |
| 6 | 33757 | 10:23:48 | 926 | 475 | 106,496 |
| 7 | 34195 | 10:23:52 | 221 | 465 | 107,776 |
| 8 | 35092 | 10:24:00 | 235 | 934 | 108,416 |
| 9 | 35473 | 10:24:05 | 103 | 432 | 109,568 |
| 10 | 36189 | 10:26:56 | 346 | 751 | 110,080 |
| 11 | 36403 | 10:26:59 | 122 | 270 | 111,104 |
| 12 | 36697 | 10:27:22 | 158 | 345 | 111,488 |
| 13 | 37442 | 10:27:31 | 333 | 795 | 111,872 |
| 14 | 39021 | 10:28:17 | 356 | 1,601 | 112,896 |
| 15 | 39249 | 10:28:19 | 255 | 283 | 114,816 |
| 16 | 40425 | 10:30:55 | 503 | 1,170 | 115,328 |
| 17 | 41203 | 14:48:22 | 70 | 676 | 116,352 |
| 18 | 42152 | 14:48:31 | 1,039 | 989 | 116,992 |
| 19 | 42386 | 14:48:34 | 203 | 291 | 118,912 |
| 20 | 42754 | 14:50:12 | 323 | 419 | 119,296 |
| 21 | 43053 | 14:50:21 | 559 | 353 | 119,936 |
| **合计** | | | **108,730** | **14,003** | **2,227,456** |

### 2.3 官方账单对账(2 个时段)

数据来自 `~/Downloads/usage_data_2026-08-21_2026-08-21/amount-2026-08-21_2026-08-21.csv`,仅 model=`deepseek-v4-flash` · api_key=A。

**时段 A · 10:00–11:00 CST(完全对齐)**

| 字段 | 官方账单 | 本地累计(record 1–16) | 是否一致 |
|---|---|---|---|
| request_count | 16 | 16 | ✓ |
| input_cache_hit_tokens | 1,635,968 | 1,635,968 | ✓ |
| input_cache_miss_tokens | 106,536 | 106,536 | ✓ |
| output_tokens | 11,275 | 11,275 | ✓ |

**时段 B · 14:00–15:00 CST(request_count 少 1)**

| 字段 | 官方账单 | 本地累计(record 17–21) | 差异 |
|---|---|---|---|
| request_count | **6** | **5** | **少 1** |
| input_cache_hit_tokens | 591,488 | 591,488 | ✓ |
| input_cache_miss_tokens | 118,597 | 2,194 | **少 116,403** |
| output_tokens | 2,864 | 2,728 | **少 136** |

**官方账单 cost(`cost-2026-08-21_2026-08-21.csv`)**

| 时段 | wallet_type | cost (CNY) |
|---|---|---|
| 10:00–11:00 | Paid | 0.5846798 |
| 14:00–15:00 | Paid | 0.4407158 |
| **合计** | | **1.0253956** |

### 2.4 缺失 record 特征反推

对时段 B 做减法,缺失 record 的字段值:

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| input(cache_miss) | 116,403 |
| output | 136 |
| cache_read(cache_hit) | 0 |

我认为下列三点证据一致指向"这条缺失 record 就是我 14:47–14:48 主动中断的那次调用":

**证据 1 · 时间窗口吻合**

对比 record #16(10:30:55,cache_read=115,328)与 record #17(14:48:22,cache_read=116,352):服务端 cache 从 115,328 增长到 116,352(增量 1,024 tokens),但这两条本地 record 之间没有其他记录。说明官方后端确实处理了一次 request 并把 prompt tokens 写入 cache,但本地日志没有对应的 `assistant/message` 事件。

**证据 2 · `cache_read = 0` 说明是当次 session 的"从零调用"**

与本地 record #1(10:23:14,cache_read=0)同类,是 session 首次真正调用 DeepSeek 服务。用户实际操作还原:10:30:55 之后长时间挂机 → 服务端 cache 过期 → 14 点某时刻我输入新 prompt 触发一次"重建 cache"的大请求(input=116,403 tokens)→ 服务端收到并计费,但客户端未 finalize 该 message 事件。

**证据 3 · 与我确认的中断动作时间吻合**

我已确认 14:47–14:48 之间主动中断了会话,缺失 record 的时间窗口(14:00–14:48:22 之间)与这个中断动作完全吻合。

综上,我推断缺失 record 的定位:

- **时间点**:约 14:47–14:48 CST
- **服务端表现**:计费成功,cache 写入成功
- **客户端表现**:`assistant/message` 事件未写入 session.jsonl.zstd

### 2.5 金额验算

以官方 CNY 单价反算缺失 record 的花费:

| 字段 | 量 | 单价 | 花费 |
|---|---|---|---|
| input(cache_miss) | 116,403 | ¥3.0/M | ¥0.34921 |
| output | 136 | ¥9.0/M | ¥0.00122 |
| cache_read(cache_hit) | 0 | ¥0.1/M | ¥0 |
| **小计** | | | **¥0.35043** |

账单总额验证:¥1.0253956(账单总)− ¥0.35043(缺失 record)= **¥0.6750**,与本地 21 条按官方 CNY 单价手工累计的结果(见附录 A)完全吻合。

---

## 三、代码层面的观察

据我理解,DeepSeek 的流式响应遵循一个规律:先送若干段 `text-delta`(模型生成的文字增量),接近结尾时再送一次 `usage` chunk(告诉客户端"这次消耗了多少 token"),最后送 `finish` 收尾。DSH 客户端在流的过程中把 chunk 攒到 `BlockAssembler` 里,直到流结束才一次性写一条 `assistant/message` 到 session log。

当用户主动中断(按 UI Stop、ESC、Ctrl+C)时,catch 分支会尝试补写一条 interrupted `assistant/message`。我观察到这个补写受两个条件约束:

1. `content.length > 0`(到目前为止收到过非空文字):**没收到就完全不写**
2. `usage` 已到:**没到就写事件但不带 usage 字段**

服务端不管客户端是否断开都会完成 request 处理并计费。上述两个条件任一命中,本地日志和官方账单就会对不上。而 DSH 重启时的 repair 逻辑只补齐 `tool/result` + `step/end` + `turn/end`,**不合成缺失的 `assistant/message`**,所以这个 gap 一旦发生就会永久存在。

**问题严重度分布**(我的初步判断):

| 等级 | 数量 |
|---|---|
| 🔴 Critical | 2(F-001, F-002) |
| 🟠 High | 1(F-003) |
| 🟡 Medium | 1(F-004) |

---

## 四、四个问题详解

### 4.1 F-002 🔴 Critical · `assistant/message` 完全不写入

> **我判断这条是 2026-08-21 缺失 record 事件的直接原因**

**触发条件**:用户主动中断流式响应,且中断发生在**第一个非空 text/reasoning chunk 到达之前**。典型场景:大 prompt + cache miss(首次调用需要重建 KV cache)+ 服务端 prompt 处理慢,用户等不及按 Stop。我遇到的 2026-08-21 事件正是这个场景。

**现象**:
- 服务端已完成 prompt 处理并计费(input_cache_miss_tokens + output_tokens 全额计入)
- 本地 session.jsonl.zstd 里只有 `request/header` + `step/start` + 0 或若干 `assistant/chunk` + `step/end` + `turn/end{aborted}`
- **没有 `assistant/message` 事件**

**代码位置**:`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:354–371`

```ts
} catch (error: unknown) {
  if (signal.aborted) {
    const content = assembler.interruptedBlocks()
    if (content.length > 0) {                     // ← 我关注的门槛:没内容就跳过
      this.session.append('assistant/message', { /* ... */ })
    }
  }
  throw error                                      // ← content 为空时直接抛,未做补偿写入
}
```

`packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts:168–178`(`interruptedBlocks()` 会过滤掉 tool-call 块与空白 text/reasoning 块)

**影响**:全体使用 DSH 直连 DeepSeek 官方 API 的用户,只要中断落在这个窗口;session.jsonl.zstd 与官方账单永久不一致(重启也无法通过 repair 补齐,见 F-003);tokenUsage projection 完全遗漏这次消耗。

**我的复现步骤**:

1. 长时间挂机(≥ 30 分钟),让服务端 KV cache evict
2. 输入大 prompt(≥ 100K tokens)发起调用
3. 服务端处理 prompt 需要 10–30 秒,期间未发送任何 SSE 内容 chunk
4. 用户按 Stop → `agent.cancel()` → `signal.throwIfAborted()` 抛出
5. catch 分支:`content.length === 0` → 门槛不满足 → 跳过 append
6. 服务端完成处理并计费
7. `zstd -dc session.jsonl.zstd | grep -c 'assistant/message'` 与账单 request 数对比 → 少 1

---

### 4.2 F-001 🔴 Critical · interrupted `assistant/message` 写入时 `usage` 字段缺失

**触发条件**:用户主动中断流式响应,且中断发生在**第一个非空 text/reasoning chunk 已到、但 usage chunk 未到**的窗口(据我观察,usage chunk 通常在流末尾出现)。

**现象**:
- interrupted `assistant/message` **被写入**,`data.interrupted=true`
- 但 `data` 里**没有 usage 字段**
- 服务端仍完整计费,本地 tokenUsage 与账单对账 projection 完全遗漏

**代码位置**:`packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:366`

```ts
this.session.append('assistant/message', {
  turn,
  step,
  message: /* ... */,
  interrupted: true,
  ...assembler.usage === undefined ? {} : { usage: assembler.usage },  // ← 我关注的位置:usage 未到 → 事件写入但无 usage 字段
}, /* ... */)
```

`packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts:84–86`(`_usage` 只在 usage chunk 到达时赋值)

**影响**:任何主动中断过流式响应的用户;本地花费统计与官方账单不一致,审计、合规、报销场景无法追溯。我估计触发频率**中高**——中断是常规操作,命中此 gap 只需"中断早于 usage chunk"。

**我的复现步骤**:

1. 发起 API 调用(deepseek-v4-flash,大 prompt)
2. 服务端开始送 text-delta,客户端已收到几十字节 text
3. 用户在 usage chunk 到达前按 Stop
4. catch 分支:`interruptedBlocks()` 有内容 → 走 append
5. `assembler.usage === undefined` → 不写 usage 字段
6. 服务端计费完整,本地记账为 0

---

### 4.3 F-003 🟠 High · repair 阶段不合成 `assistant/message`,F-001/F-002 造成的 gap 永久无法自愈

**触发条件**:F-001 或 F-002 已发生 → 重启 DSH → repair 阶段无法补齐缺失的 `assistant/message`。

**现象**:据我阅读代码,`interruptedTurnClosers()` 是 DSH 唯一的 session log 恢复机制,但它只合成以下几种事件:

- `tool/result`(带 `TOOL_NOT_STARTED` 或 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` 错误码)
- `step/end`
- `turn/end{kind:'interrupted'}`

**不合成 `assistant/message`**。这意味着 F-001/F-002 造成的 gap 一旦产生就会永久存在。

**代码位置**:`packages/core/session/src/repair.ts:87–132`

```ts
let seq = last.seq + 1
const time = last.time
const closers: SessionEvent[] = []

for (const [callId, { step, callSeq }] of pendingCalls) {
  closers.push({ type: 'tool/result', /* ... */ })   // 只合成 tool/result
}

if (openStep !== null) {
  closers.push({ type: 'step/end', /* ... */ })      // 合成 step/end
}
closers.push({ type: 'turn/end', /* ... */ })        // 合成 turn/end
return closers                                        // ← 全程无 assistant/message
```

我理解目前的实现意图明确写在函数注释里("deterministic synthetic events that close an open tail turn"——只关心 turn/step/tool 的 close)。我猜测不合成 `assistant/message` 是因为无法凭空生成 content 或 usage,但对我这类关注对账完整性的用户而言,这会带来永久性 gap。

**影响**:所有触发过 F-001/F-002 的历史 session;即使 F-001/F-002 未来修复,历史日志里的 gap 仍无法补齐;影响不可恢复。

---

### 4.4 F-004 🟡 Medium · 5 秒 grace 硬超时 + 二次 Ctrl+C 强杀 → write-behind pending queue 丢失

**触发条件**:
- 场景 A(慢磁盘):磁盘 IO 慢、zstd 压缩慢、磁盘满 → dispose 阶段的 flush 超过 5 秒
- 场景 B(不耐烦):用户在 graceful shutdown 中按下第二次 Ctrl+C

**现象**:CLI 进程 shutdown 有 5 秒硬 grace,超时后 `process.exit(code)` 强杀;write-behind 默认 200ms batching flush,依赖 fiber dispose 时的 flush effect 兜底。上述任一场景触发时,pending queue 里未落盘的 events(可能包括 F-001 场景下的 interrupted `assistant/message`)会丢失。

**代码位置**:

`apps/cli/src/process-shutdown.ts:4`

```ts
export const PROCESS_SHUTDOWN_TIMEOUT_MS = 5_000   // 硬编码 5 秒
```

`apps/cli/src/process-shutdown.ts:52–75`

```ts
const start = (code, forceAfterDispose) => {
  if (pending !== undefined) return pending
  timeout = setTimeout(() => { forceExitOnce(code) }, timeoutMs)  // 超时立即 process.exit
  pending = Promise.resolve().then(dispose).then(/* ... */)
  return pending
}

interrupt(code) {
  if (pending !== undefined) {
    forceExitOnce(code)                             // 二次 SIGINT 立即强杀
    return
  }
  void start(code, true)
}
```

`packages/session/session-persistence/src/write-behind.ts:45–56`(`enqueue()` 只入内存 queue + 200ms 定时器,不同步 flush)

**影响**:磁盘慢的用户、大量 pending events 的长会话用户、频繁按 Ctrl+C 的用户;每次强杀丢失最多 pending queue 大小的事件(可能包括 assistant/message、tool/result、compaction event)。触发频率**低**——需要磁盘异常或用户主动强杀。

**我的自我审视**:正常磁盘 + 正常 session 大小下 5 秒 grace 是充足的(zstd frame 化每条 event <1ms,几百条 events flush <100ms),write-behind 也有失败重塞回 queue 的保护。但极端场景下仍存在 gap,因此我把它保留为 Medium。

---

## 五、优先级建议(供参考)

| 优先级 | 问题编号 | 简述 |
|---|---|---|
| 🔴 立即关注 | F-002 | `content.length > 0` 门槛导致中断早期完全不写 `assistant/message`,我判断为 2026-08-21 事件的直接原因 |
| 🔴 立即关注 | F-001 | interrupted `assistant/message` 无 usage 字段,与 F-002 属同一路径的两个不同触发窗口 |
| 🟠 短期关注 | F-003 | repair 不合成 `assistant/message`,决定 F-001/F-002 修复后历史数据能否补齐 |
| 🟡 可排期 | F-004 | 5 秒 grace + 二次 Ctrl+C 强杀,极端场景下的次生数据丢失风险 |

具体修复方案与产品取舍我不在此处替官方决定;上述四条问题的定位、代码位置、复现步骤已在前文列出,方便官方团队后续评估与处理。

---

## 六、关键代码位置速查

| 关键点 | 文件:行 |
|---|---|
| 中断 catch 分支入口 | `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:354` |
| content 门槛(F-002) | `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:357` |
| usage 条件写入(F-001) | `packages/core/agent-loop/src/agent.ts:366` |
| interruptedBlocks 过滤逻辑 | `packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts:168–178` |
| usage chunk 处理 | `packages/llm/llm/src/assembler.ts:84–86` |
| DeepSeek stream 消费 | `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/adapter.ts:228–302` |
| repair 不合成 assistant/message(F-003) | `packages/core/session/src/repair.ts:27–133` |
| write-behind 200ms flush | `packages/session/session-persistence/src/write-behind.ts:45–82` |
| 5 秒 grace 硬超时(F-004) | `apps/cli/src/process-shutdown.ts:4,52–75` |

---

## 附录 A · 复现命令

### A.1 从 session.jsonl.zstd 反推 2026-08-21 · deepseek-official 全部 record

```bash
SESS_FILE="/Users/wpf/.dsh/sessions/--Users-wpf-workspace-DeepSeekHarness--/session-f619097e-7f1a-4202-a426-ff80c76276d0/session.jsonl.zstd"
TMP=$(mktemp)
zstd -dc "$SESS_FILE" > "$TMP"
python3 - "$TMP" <<'PY'
import json, sys
from datetime import datetime, timezone, timedelta
CST = timezone(timedelta(hours=8))
cur_p, cur_m = None, None
records = []
with open(sys.argv[1], "rb") as f:
    for raw in f:
        try:
            obj = json.loads(raw.decode("utf-8", "replace"))
        except Exception:
            continue
        t = obj.get("type")
        if t == "request/header":
            cfg = obj.get("data", {}).get("header", {}).get("config", {})
            if cfg.get("provider"): cur_p = cfg["provider"]
            if cfg.get("model"): cur_m = cfg["model"]
        elif t == "assistant/message":
            ms = obj.get("time")
            if not ms: continue
            dt = datetime.fromtimestamp(ms / 1000, tz=CST)
            if dt.strftime("%Y-%m-%d") != "2026-08-21": continue
            if cur_p != "deepseek-official": continue
            u = obj.get("data", {}).get("usage", {})
            records.append({
                "seq": obj.get("seq"),
                "t": dt.strftime("%H:%M:%S"),
                "model": cur_m,
                "input": u.get("inputTokens", 0),
                "output": u.get("outputTokens", 0),
                "cache_read": u.get("cacheReadTokens", 0),
            })
for r in records:
    print(r)
si = sum(r["input"] for r in records)
so = sum(r["output"] for r in records)
sc = sum(r["cache_read"] for r in records)
print(f"COUNT={len(records)}  input={si}  output={so}  cache_read={sc}")
PY
rm "$TMP"
```

预期输出:21 条 record + `COUNT=21  input=108730  output=14003  cache_read=2227456`

### A.2 官方 CNY 单价手工验算本地 21 条

| 字段 | 量 | 单价 | 花费 |
|---|---|---|---|
| input(cache_miss) | 108,730 | ¥3.0/M | ¥0.32619 |
| output | 14,003 | ¥9.0/M | ¥0.12603 |
| cache_read(cache_hit) | 2,227,456 | ¥0.1/M | ¥0.22275 |
| **合计** | | | **¥0.67497** |

对比:¥1.0253956(账单总)− ¥0.35043(缺失 record)= **¥0.67497**,完全吻合。

discussions.title: Long-running tasks frequently show "Stopped" status on remote Mac Studio connections
discussions.body:
# Long-running tasks frequently show "Stopped" status on remote Mac Studio connections

## Problem

When running long-running agent tasks (background jobs, subagents, Ralph loops) through the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI, the UI repeatedly displays a "Stopped" chip on the message. This happens especially when the Harness server runs on a **remote Mac Studio in a local network** (e.g. connected over LAN, possibly through VPN or tunnel).

The "Stopped" state sits in a limbo between `completed` and `failed`: the task was abruptly cut off, but no error was surfaced. There's no auto-recovery — you have to manually restart the task.

## Root Cause (from code investigation)

Looking at the Harness source code:

1. The `"Stopped"` chip is rendered when `data.status === 'interrupted'` in `AssistantMarkdown.tsx` (line 106), which gets `interrupted={data.status === 'interrupted'}` from `AssistantNodeView.tsx` (line 27).

2. The `'interrupted'` status is a valid terminal turn state defined in `packages/core/session/src/types.ts` — it sits between `completed` (normal finish) and `failed` (error).

3. The wire layer in `packages/subagent/subagent-codex/src/wire.ts` (line 369) accepts `'interrupted'` as one of only three terminal statuses: `'completed'`, `'interrupted'`, `'failed'`.

4. The repair logic in `packages/core/session/src/repair.ts` (line 131) handles `interrupted` turns separately — they are *retried* but **not auto-recovered**.

When a network connection drops (even briefly), the SSE/WebSocket connection between the browser and the app-server breaks. The running turn gets marked as `'interrupted'` rather than `'failed'`. The task is effectively dead — no error was surfaced, but no completion occurred either.

## Why This is Worse on Remote Mac Studios

A local network connection to a remote Mac Studio (especially over VPN, SSH tunnel, or NAT) is subject to:
- **Packet loss / jitter** — common on non-dedicated LANs
- **VPN idle timeout** — many VPN services drop idle WebSocket/SSE connections after 30-60 minutes of inactivity
- **WiFi sleep** — Mac Studio can go to sleep or the network can re-negotiate
- **Firewall / NAT timeouts** — long-lived HTTP SSE connections can be terminated by intermediate NAT devices

During these silent disconnects, the server-side turn execution may continue, but the client loses its connection and marks the turn as `'interrupted'` when the SSE drops. The task has no mechanism to **reconnect and resume** — it just sits there with a "Stopped" chip.

## Symptoms

- The "Stopped" chip appears on agent turns during long-running tasks (background jobs, subagents, Ralph loops)
- No explicit error message is shown — the task just appears to have been aborted
- The UI does not auto-recover or reconnect
- Manual restart is required, losing any partial progress

## Proposed Solutions

### 1. Automatic SSE reconnection with turn recovery

The Harness client should implement **automatic SSE reconnection** with a backoff strategy. When a connection drops:
- Reconnect to the SSE endpoint
- Re-fetch the current turn state from the server
- If the server-side turn is still `running`, render it as `running` again (not `interrupted`)
- If the turn was already marked `interrupted` server-side, render it as such

### 2. Better distinction between transient and permanent interruption

The `'interrupted'` status should carry additional metadata:
- `isTransient: boolean` — was this caused by a network drop?
- `disconnectDuration: number` — how long was the connection down?
- `lastHeartbeat: timestamp` — when was the last successful heartbeat?

This lets the UI distinguish between "the user manually stopped it" and "the connection dropped and we could potentially recover."

### 3. Heartbeat / keep-alive mechanism

Add a lightweight heartbeat on the SSE connection (e.g., a small poll every 30 seconds when the agent is idle) to keep NAT / VPN connections alive. Many "silently dropped" connections can be avoided with a keep-alive.

### 4. UI indicator for "connection lost" state

When a network drop is detected, show a **"Disconnected"** banner (not just a subtle "Stopped" chip) so the user knows:
- The task was not manually aborted
- The Harness is still running server-side (if the connection recovers, it will resume)
- No action is needed from the user other than waiting

## Environment

- DeepSeek Harness Web GUI
- Server runs on a remote Mac Studio in a local network (not localhost)
- Network path may include VPN, SSH tunnel, or NAT

## Workarounds

- Keep the Mac Studio awake (disable sleep)
- Use a dedicated wired connection rather than WiFi
- Avoid VPN for the Harness connection if possible
- Run the Harness server on the same machine as the browser

discussions.title: dsh-doctor-windows — read-only Windows startup diagnostics for DSH
discussions.body:
## dsh-doctor-windows

Repository: https://github.com/xianfanwindy/dsh-doctor-windows

A Windows-first, read-only startup doctor for DeepSeek Harness. It helps diagnose local launch and profile problems without changing a DSH installation.

### What it checks

- `dsh` command discovery and Node.js runtime compatibility
- DSH home, profiles, manifests, bundle patches, and broken links
- Windows PowerShell execution policy and filesystem conditions
- redacted terminal, Markdown, or JSON reports with stable check IDs

### Safety and compatibility

- Windows 10/11; PowerShell 5.1 and PowerShell 7
- no telemetry, network requests, automatic repair, or report uploads
- does not execute a discovered DSH shim during normal diagnosis
- can also be added as a Cordis bundle, exposing the sanitized `dsh_doctor` tool

### Status

The repository and release-validation workflow are public now. The first npm publication is pending registry login; until then, please use the repository for evaluation rather than relying on the npm command shown in the README.

Feedback on Windows startup failures and missing checks is welcome.

discussions.title: [bug] 第三方插件写入的 session event 会让会话永久打不开
discussions.body:
### 现象

第三方插件调 `session.append` 写入自己声明的事件类型之后，那个会话就无法再打开——
不是丢失几行，是整份日志被拒绝解释。

版本：`0.1.0-rc.8`。

### 最小复现

一个十行的插件：

```ts
// index.ts
import type { Context } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'

declare module '@deepseek-ai/dsh-session/types' {
  interface SessionEventMap {
    'demo/hello': { version: 1 }
  }
}

export const name = 'demo'
export const inject = ['agents']

export function apply(ctx: Context): void {
  ctx.on('agent/session-start', ({ agent }) => {
    agent.session.append('demo/hello', { version: 1 })
  })
}
```

装上、开一个会话（`agent/session-start` 就会写入，不必发消息）、**重启 dsh**，
再打开那个会话：

```
history unavailable for session "session-…": SessionFormatUnsupportedError:
session "session-…" contains event type "demo/hello" (seq 3) unknown to this
harness and not marked ignorable; refusing to interpret the log — it was likely
written by a newer harness
```

此后该会话一直打不开，**插件仍然装着也一样**。

⚠️ **重启那一步不能省。** 会话还在内存里时读的不是持久化路径，刷新页面看起来一切正常；
要等进程重启后从磁盘恢复，`assertEventsSupported` 才会拒绝。所以在真实使用中它的形态是
「写入当天没事，第二天打不开」。

### 机制

拒绝发生在 `packages/session/session-persistence/src/coordinator.ts` 的
`assertEventsSupported`：

```ts
if (KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES.has(event.type) || event.ignorable === true) continue
throw this.unsupported(meta, `… unknown to this harness and not marked ignorable; …`)
```

两个放行条件对仓外插件都不成立：

**① `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES` 是生成的。**
`packages/core/session/src/known-event-types.ts` 的文件头是
`GENERATED by scripts/gen-persistence-catalog.ts`，内容是「Every `SessionEventMap` member
**declared in this repository**」。同一段文档也写明了仓外类型的处境：

> Downstream (out-of-repo) plugin events are outside this list by construction; a
> registration surface for them is deferred until such a consumer exists.

**② `Session.append()` 不接受 `ignorable`。**
它在 `packages/core/session/src/index.ts` 里自行构造 envelope，可选参数位是
`T extends SurfaceEventType ? [opts: SurfaceIntent] : []`，而 `SurfaceIntent` 中只有
`sourceEventSeqs` 与 `surfaceOp` 会被读出。写入方没有途径把 `ignorable` 放到 envelope 上。

### 现有 workaround 的边界

我们在插件加载时把自己的事件类型 `add` 进 `KNOWN_SESSION_EVENT_TYPES`（运行时它是个真
`Set`）。两处它覆盖不到：

**a) 插件卸载后，那些会话仍然打不开。**

**b) 它要求插件与 dsh 解析到同一个 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 模块实例。**
普通安装成立；dsh 从源码 checkout 用 `tsx` 运行时不成立——两侧得到各自的模块图。
同一进程内加探针实测：

```
[plugin]      before 48  →  after 52   has('swarmdrop/sent') = true
[coordinator] known size 48            has('swarmdrop/sent') = false
```

### 背景

这个 consumer 是 [`dsh-swarmdrop`](https://github.com/swarm-apps/dsh-swarmdrop)，用
session event 承载对话行与 `@` 引用候选。

需要更多细节或复现环境的话我们可以提供。
