discussions.title: fix proposal: non-widening sandbox_permissions should be a no-op, not an error (GPT-family models loop on it)
discussions.body:
## Problem

GPT-family models are heavily trained on shell-tool conventions where escalation fields (`with_escalated_permissions` + `justification`) may ride any call speculatively. Under DSH they habitually attach `sandbox_permissions` to `bash` calls whose effective mode already suffices, and the verbatim error

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
```

turns that trained habit into a hard failure loop: the model reads the error as a *denial*, escalates again (sometimes inventing a `justification` such as `"none"` to satisfy the non-empty check), and burns turn after turn without ever running the command.

Observed live on `dsh web` (0.1.0-rc.7, reproduced on 0.1.1-rc.1 sources) with GPT-series models in the executor role: **every single `bash` call failed this way**, across fresh sessions, and the model eventually routed around its own shell by delegating to subagents — which inherit the same habit.

Prompt-level mitigation does not stick. We tried twice with increasingly explicit persona rules (down to "when you see `not strictly wider`, drop both fields and resend"); the habit is trained in, and the tool description's own escalation clause ("escalating up front is fine only when this session already denied the same access") reinforces the loop after the first error, because the model misreads the argument error as a denial.

## Why a no-op is safe

A non-widening request is behaviorally identical to the call the model should have made:

- nothing widens — the call runs under the confinement it already had;
- nobody is prompted — same as today (`A non-widening request never prompts a human`);
- the fail-closed sequence for **widening** asks is untouched: strict widening + non-empty `justification` + user approval through `ctx.approval` are all still required before anything runs wider.

The only thing that changes is that a semantically meaningless argument stops being a hard error that burns the call.

| call | today | proposed |
|---|---|---|
| non-widening `sandbox_permissions` (any justification state) | `not strictly wider` error, command never runs | runs at current mode, no prompt |
| lone `justification` | `only valid together with sandbox_permissions` error | ignored, command runs |
| widening, missing/blank `justification` | pairing error | same errors, kept |
| widening, justified | approval prompt → grant/reject | unchanged |

## Complete implementation, ready to take

Since external PRs are not accepted at this stage, we put the full change on a public branch — feel free to cherry-pick or reimplement:

**https://github.com/Rogers-F/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/tolerate-non-widening-sandbox-escalation**

Scope (15 files, +104/−98):

- `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` — `approveEscalation` resolves a non-widening request as a no-op grant of the call's effective mode; the justification checks move into the widening path (an approval prompt still never fires without a reason); `validateEscalationArgs` is removed since the widening path now owns its guards and a lone justification drives nothing.
- `tool-bash` / `tool-pwsh` / `tool-fs` — enter escalation on `sandbox_permissions` alone and delegate the judgment to `approveEscalation`.
- Tests updated across the four packages (230 tests in the touched files pass; `pnpm typecheck` clean; lefthook staged gates pass).
- Both shell tool READMEs (en/zh) and their translation-pairing records updated.

Happy to rework it behind a config switch instead of the new default if you'd prefer, or adjust in any other direction — the branch is there to be taken, not to be merged as-is.

---

## 中文摘要

**问题**：GPT 系模型被 Codex 风格的 shell 工具约定（`with_escalated_permissions` + `justification` 可随时预防性携带）深度训练过，在 DSH 里会习惯性地给 `bash` 调用带上 `sandbox_permissions`。当会话已是最宽模式时，`not strictly wider` 硬报错会让模型把"参数错误"误读成"沙箱拒绝"，于是反复升权、连环失败，一条命令都跑不成，最终绕道子代理（子代理同样带这个习惯）。提示词层面压制两轮均告失败——这是训练进权重里的惯性。

**方案**：未拓宽的升权请求改为**无操作放行**（按当前模式照常执行，不弹任何审批）——它与"模型本该发出的那次调用"行为完全等价，安全面零变化；**真正要求拓宽**的请求完整保留 fail-closed 链路：严格更宽 + 非空理由 + 用户审批，缺一不可。

**完整实现**已放在上面的公开分支（含 4 个包的源码、测试、中英文档同步，相关 230 个测试全绿），欢迎直接 cherry-pick；如果团队倾向做成配置开关而非默认行为，我们也乐意配合调整。

discussions.title: [Bug] llm-deepseek loses tool name when later deltas repeat an empty name
discussions.body:
## Summary

Some DeepSeek-compatible gateways send a non-empty `function.name` on the first streamed tool-call delta, then repeat `function.name: ""` while streaming argument fragments. The `llm-deepseek` translator currently treats every defined name as authoritative, so a later empty string erases the valid tool identity that was already received.

I verified that the official `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.1` source is still affected.

## Minimal reproduction

The deltas below all belong to tool-call index 0:

~~~json
{ "name": "bash", "arguments": "" }
{ "name": "", "arguments": "{\"command\":" }
{ "name": "", "arguments": "\"pwd\"}" }
~~~

The current translator updates the accumulated name with:

~~~ts
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
~~~

Because an empty string is defined, the second and third deltas replace `bash` with `""`. The resulting final block is effectively:

~~~json
{ "type": "tool-call", "name": "", "arguments": "{\"command\":\"pwd\"}" }
~~~

Expected result:

~~~json
{ "type": "tool-call", "name": "bash", "arguments": "{\"command\":\"pwd\"}" }
~~~

## Impact

`executeToolCalls` passes the final `block.name` directly to the tool registry. The affected stream therefore dispatches a tool named `""` and returns `UNKNOWN_TOOL`, even though the adapter had already received the valid name `bash`. The durable `tool/call` event also records the empty name.

This is not a downstream UI or integration-layer recognition problem: the name has already been lost in the provider translator before consumers receive the authoritative final block.

## Suggested fix

Only accept non-empty name updates:

~~~ts
if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name
~~~

This does not guess a missing name:

- A stream that never supplies a non-empty name still follows the existing empty-name fallback and unknown-tool path.
- A later non-empty name can still update the block.
- Empty placeholder values can no longer degrade a known tool identity.

The OpenAI Node SDK uses the same non-empty update rule when accumulating Chat Completions tool-call deltas: https://github.com/openai/openai-node/blob/v6.26.0/src/lib/ChatCompletionStream.ts#L477-L493

## Patch and validation

A complete patch based on the current upstream `master` / `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.1` is available here:

- Commit: https://github.com/Shulychee/deepseek-harness/commit/8238798a7cb249af152df8475ae77d979f108653
- Branch: https://github.com/Shulychee/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/llm-deepseek-sticky-tool-call-name-rc1

Validation completed:

- All 31 `llm-deepseek` translator tests pass, including the observed three-delta regression.
- The `llm-deepseek` TypeScript project build passes.
- English/Chinese translation-pairing checks pass.
- Repository pre-push checks pass.

External pull requests are currently disabled, so the branch is provided for maintainers to cherry-pick or reimplement.

rc.8 复现 #1695 崩溃链:prepare 抛错后会话永久 400,直至完整退出进程。

<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

  - 示例会话 B:`tool/call skill`(`call_00_zfNTZ4tcMLpgNJZLJDFL7876`)→ 同一 `undefined.prepare` → 下一轮 400。
  - 五个会话连环(损坏进程内新会话同样复现,与 #1695 一致):

    | 会话 | `undefined.prepare` 次数 | 后续 400 次数 |
    |------|--------------------------|---------------|
    | e2be1cf3 | 8 | 4 |

- 预期结果：

  2. 请求序列化前校验 assistant `tool_calls` 与 `tool` 结果一一配对;发现历史遗留的不完整配对时,给出可诊断的会话修复路径,而非裸 400。

  | 项 | 值 |
  |----|----|
  | dsh | 0.1.0-rc.8(工具链安装) |

  | Node | v24.19.0 |
  | 入口 | `dsh web` |
  | 社区插件 | dsh-tool-lens、dsh-data-agent、dsh-better-sidebar、dshmarket |

- 验收条件：
  - 修复版本上按上述复现步骤不再产生悬空 `tool_calls`,或崩溃后同一会话下一轮可正常继续;
  - 官方确认受影响版本范围(rc.6、rc.8 均已复现;0.1.1-rc.1 更新日志未提及此修复)。

相关:#1695(rc.6 首报,已附英文事件级证据评论);本讨论按仓库 bug 模板以中文提交,便于检索。

discussions.title: UI shows multiple "Context compacted" rows from one compress call — consider grouping same-call blocks
discussions.body:
## 标题: UI shows multiple "Context compacted" rows from one compress tool call — consider grouping same-call blocks

### English body

**Summary**: When the model's `compress` tool is called once with a batched `content` array (multiple ranges), the UI renders **one "Context compacted" row per block** — N ranges = N rows with different summaries/items/tokens. Users may read this as "the context was compacted N times" and worry about repeated KV-cache rebuilding. It is not a bug (one call → one LLM request → one prefix rebuild), but a UX consideration: same-call blocks could be grouped into a single row ("Compacted N segments").

**Reproduction evidence** (session log, real harness):

```
966737 tool/call  name="compress"  arguments={"content":[3 ranges...]}   ← ONE call
966738→966741    compaction transaction #1 (start/summary/checkpoint/end)
966742→966745    transaction #2
966746→966749    transaction #3
966750 tool/result                                               ← ONE result
966751 compaction/prune
```

Every row in the conversation is a `source.plugin === 'compact'` replacement checkpoint node (`CompactionItem.tsx`): title = block topic, subtitle = "Compacted {items} history items (~{tokens} tokens)" from that block's own `compaction/summary` event (`conversation-nodes/command.ts`). So one batched call renders N rows, each with different content — by design, since each row is independently expandable.

**Cost analysis** (why this is NOT a performance bug): all N transactions complete within the same step (between `tool/call` and `tool/result`); the next LLM request carries all N checkpoints at once, so the provider prefix cache is rebuilt exactly once. The cache-invalidation start point is the earliest rewrite among the batch — independent of N. Batching is actually cheaper than N separate calls (which would cause N LLM round-trips).

**Context**: This pattern is produced by ACP-family engines (billion-context-dsh / billion-context-pi / opencode-acp) whose `compress` tool accepts a multi-range `content` array and lands one durable block per range. It is the same "one compression action = one row" model the host already uses; the only difference is one tool call can now own several rows.

**Proposed direction (Ideas)**: optionally group checkpoint nodes belonging to the same tool call into a single row — e.g. "Compacted 3 segments (~12.4K tokens)" — while keeping per-block expandability (click to see each segment's summary). Grouping must NOT merge rows from different engines / different compaction actions: each independent compression stays its own row (multiple backends can coexist, e.g. `compaction-basic` automatic pressure compaction + a model-driven ACP tool).

Evidence source: DeepSeek Harness session log (`session.jsonl.zstd`), `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/chat/CompactionItem.tsx`, `conversation-nodes/command.ts`.

---

### 中文摘要

**现象**：模型一次调用 `compress` 工具、`content` 数组携带多段（batch）时，UI 会为**每个块渲染一行"上下文已压缩"**——N 段 = N 行，行间摘要/条数/tokens 各不相同。用户容易误读为"上下文被压缩了 N 次"，担心反复重建 KV 缓存。

**证据**（真实会话日志，一次调用）：

```
966737 tool/call  name="compress"  arguments={"content":[3 段…]}   ← 单次调用
966738→966741    压缩事务 #1（start/summary/检查点/end）
966742→966745    事务 #2
966746→966749    事务 #3
966750 tool/result                                               ← 单次返回
966751 compaction/prune
```

每行对应一个 `source.plugin === 'compact'` 的替换检查点节点（`CompactionItem.tsx`）：标题=该块 topic，副标题=`已压缩 {items} 条历史记录（约 {tokens} tokens）`，取自该块自己的 `compaction/summary` 事件。因此一次批量调用渲染 N 行、内容各异——这是设计使然（每行可独立展开）。

**成本分析**（为何这不是性能问题）：N 个事务都在同一步骤内完成（`tool/call` 与 `tool/result` 之间），下一次 LLM 请求一次性携带全部 N 个检查点 → 前缀缓存**只重建一次**；失效起点 = 本批最靠前的改写点，与段数无关。批量反而比 N 次单独调用更省（后者有 N 次 LLM 往返）。

**来源**：该模式由 ACP 家族引擎（billion-context-dsh / billion-context-pi / opencode-acp）产生——其 `compress` 工具接受多段 `content` 数组，每段落一个 durable 块。与宿主既有的"一次压缩动作 = 一行"模型一致，唯一区别是一次工具调用可拥有多行。

**建议（Ideas）**：可选地把属于同一次工具调用的检查点节点**聚合成一行**（如"已压缩 3 段（约 12.4K tokens）"），同时保留逐块展开（点击查看每段摘要）。聚合**不得**合并不同引擎/不同压缩动作的行：每次独立压缩保持自己的行（多个后端可并存，如 `compaction-basic` 自动压力压缩 + 模型驱动的 ACP 工具）。

证据来源：DeepSeek Harness 会话日志、`CompactionItem.tsx`、`conversation-nodes/command.ts`。

discussions.title: Support OAuth-protected MCP servers in @deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client
discussions.body:
# Support OAuth-protected MCP servers in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client`

## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` can only authenticate to MCP servers via a static
`headers` map. Servers that use OAuth (the auth mechanism specified for remote
MCP servers, and increasingly common for hosted/internal ones) cannot be used at
all.

The underlying `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` — already a direct dependency of this
package — ships a complete OAuth client implementation, and the transports this
plugin constructs already accept an `authProvider` option that wires it up. The
gap is that DSH never passes one.

## Environment

| | |
|---|---|
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh` | `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` | `0.1.0-rc.7` |
| `@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` | `1.30.0` (declared `^1.12.0`) |
| Node | `v22.23.1` |
| Platform | macOS |

## Reproduction

Register any OAuth-protected Streamable HTTP MCP server, e.g. in
`~/.dsh/profiles/<profile>/cordis.patch.yml`:

```yaml
- id: mcp-example
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: example
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://example.internal/mcp
```

The server responds to `initialize` with:

```
HTTP/2 401
www-authenticate: Bearer error="unauthorized",
  error_description="Authorization needed",
  resource_metadata="https://example.internal/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource"
```

and that `.well-known` document advertises standard protected-resource metadata:

```json
{
  "resource": "https://example.internal",
  "authorization_servers": ["https://example.internal"],
  "scopes_supported": ["openid", "email"],
  "bearer_methods_supported": ["header"]
}
```

Result: discovery fails. With `failOnStartupError: false` (the default) the
plugin activates with **no tools** and the server is silently unusable; with
`true` it rejects activation. There is no configuration that succeeds, because
the only auth surface is a static header and the token these flows issue is
short-lived (the case that prompted this: ~1 hour, requiring refresh).

Other MCP clients (e.g. Claude Code) connect to the same server with nothing
more than `{"type": "http", "url": "…"}` — they run the OAuth flow themselves
and persist the resulting tokens.

## Why this is a small change

Everything needed is already vendored in the SDK this package depends on.

**1. The transports already accept an auth provider.**
`StreamableHTTPClientTransportOptions.authProvider?: OAuthClientProvider`, with
documented behaviour (`dist/esm/client/streamableHttp.d.ts`):

> When an `authProvider` is specified and the connection is started:
> 1. The connection is attempted with any existing access token from the `authProvider`.
> 2. If the access token has expired, the `authProvider` is used to refresh the token.
> …
> If an `authProvider` is not provided, and auth is required, an `UnauthorizedError` will be thrown.

The 401-retry, refresh, and re-auth logic is implemented in the transport
(including a circuit breaker against auth-success-then-401 recursion). `sse.js`
has the same option.

**2. The OAuth protocol work is implemented.**
`dist/esm/client/auth.js` exports, among others:

- `auth()` — the full orchestration entry point
- `discoverOAuthProtectedResourceMetadata()` — consumes exactly the
  `resource_metadata` pointer above
- `discoverAuthorizationServerMetadata()` / `discoverOAuthServerInfo()`
- `registerClient()` — dynamic client registration
- `startAuthorization()` / `exchangeAuthorization()` — PKCE authorization code
- `refreshAuthorization()` — token refresh

**3. DSH currently opts out.** The transport is constructed as:

```js
new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(new URL(config.url) /*, no authProvider */)
```

## Proposed change

Implement an `OAuthClientProvider` and pass it to the transport when a server is
configured for OAuth. The interface is a set of small persistence accessors:

| Member | Role |
|---|---|
| `clientMetadata` / `clientInformation()` / `saveClientInformation()` | client identity, incl. dynamic registration |
| `tokens()` / `saveTokens()` | access + refresh token persistence |
| `redirectToAuthorization()` | begin the interactive leg |
| `saveCodeVerifier()` / `codeVerifier()` | PKCE |
| `state?()` | CSRF state |

Suggested config surface (additive, backwards compatible — `headers` keeps
working unchanged):

```yaml
- id: mcp-example
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: example
    transport: streamable-http
    url: https://example.internal/mcp
    auth:
      mode: oauth            # or: none (default) | client-credentials
      scopes: [openid, email]   # optional; else from resource metadata
```

### Design questions worth settling in review

- **Token storage.** Tokens and refresh tokens are secrets and must not land in
  `cordis.patch.yml` or logs. DSH already has `~/.dsh/storages/` and
  `~/.dsh/.credentials.yaml`; an OS-keychain-backed store is the stronger
  option on macOS. Storage should be keyed per `(serverName, resource)` so two
  servers on one host don't collide.
- **The interactive leg.** `redirectToAuthorization()` needs a browser plus a
  loopback redirect listener. DSH has an advantage here: the Web GUI is already
  a local server (`127.0.0.1:3080`), so the callback route and an
  "authorize this MCP server" affordance have a natural home, rather than
  needing a throwaway HTTP listener.
- **Headless / remote sessions.** Where no browser is available, support a
  non-interactive path. The SDK explicitly allows `redirectUrl: undefined` for
  `client_credentials` and `jwt-bearer`, which covers service accounts — this
  is likely the right default for CI and server deployments.
- **Refresh vs. reconnect budget.** Token refresh should not be conflated with
  the existing `reconnect.maxAttempts` outage budget; an expiring token is a
  routine, expected event, not an outage.
- **Failure surfacing.** A server needing authorization should say so clearly
  (matching the existing user-visible reconnect logging) rather than presenting
  as "activated with zero tools", which is what happens today.

## Impact

Without this, DSH cannot use any OAuth-protected MCP server. That currently
includes hosted/managed MCP offerings and internal corporate servers behind
SSO — a growing share of non-local servers, and the ones where the stdio
"just spawn it locally" escape hatch does not apply. The workaround, pasting a
short-lived bearer token into a config file, means writing a live credential to
disk and re-pasting it on every expiry.

discussions.title: dsh-llm-gateway-compat — OpenAI-compatible gateway dialect fixes (community plugin)
discussions.body:
Community plugin, **not an official DeepSeek package**. It is not endorsed by DeepSeek.

OpenAI-compatible gateways (Bailian, DashScope compatible-mode, vLLM, custom proxies) often break DSH in two ways:

1. Streamed tool-call fragments send empty `id` / `name` after a valid first fragment → `unknown tool ""`
2. Reasoning requests go out as `role: "developer"` and `max_completion_tokens` → HTTP 400

This bundle does three things:

- wraps `llm/stream` so empty identity cannot overwrite a nonempty value
- on those two 400s, writes the official `llm-pi-ai` `compat` fields and retries the same step once
- optionally owns Chat Completions routes that default to `system` + `max_tokens`, plus `extraBody` / `api-key` headers / thinking dialects

## Install

From npm (recommended — ships built `lib/`, no install-time build):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-gateway-compat
```

Restart `dsh web`.

From GitHub, pin the tag. pnpm ≥10 may ask you to allow `prepare`:

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:snowshadow/dsh-llm-gateway-compat#v0.3.0
```

```yaml
allowBuilds:
  dsh-llm-gateway-compat: true
```

npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-llm-gateway-compat  
Repo: https://github.com/snowshadow/dsh-llm-gateway-compat

This does not replace an official adapter fix. It is a community mitigation for:

- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1500
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3464
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3767
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2388
- https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/2587

---

社区插件，**不是 DeepSeek 官方包**，也未获 DeepSeek 背书。

OpenAI 兼容网关（百炼、DashScope compatible-mode、vLLM、自建代理）常见两类失败：流式 tool-call 空 `id`/`name` 变成 `unknown tool ""`；推理请求带 `developer` / `max_completion_tokens` 被 400。

这个 bundle：消毒 `llm/stream`、把那两种 400 写进官方 `llm-pi-ai` compat 并重试一次、还可以自己挂默认 `system`+`max_tokens` 的 Chat Completions 路由。

推荐安装：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-llm-gateway-compat
```

请自行 review 源码后再安装。

discussions.title: [Plugin]DSH Insider 助你看清DSH底层插件运行时
discussions.body: 最近在学习 DSH(DeepSeek Harness)，我们都知道DSH提出了一切皆插件（Everything is a plugin）的理念。为了实现这一理念，DSH 里有不少很重要的概念，比如 Plugin、Context、Fiber、Service 和 Effect等。 为了理清这些概念，同时考虑到随着 DSH 使用时间越来越长，安装的插件也会越来越多，我觉得我们需要一个插件，能够直观地展示当前 DSH Runtime 由哪些插件组成、插件之间如何关联与协作，以及每个插件当前的运行状态。 这样，我们就能从整体上理解 DSH Runtime 的结构，而不必再通过代码和配置逐个追踪插件之间的关系。 所以我做了 dsh-runtime，尝试把这些原本藏在运行时里的关系可视化出来： 1.查看 DSH / Cordis 的实时运行状态 2.用关系图谱展示插件与插件之间的依赖 3.展示插件提供和注入的 Service 4.点击图谱左上角的节点类型能快速查看同一类型的插件/服务 5.点击节点查看服务提供者、消费者和关联插件 6.观察 Context、Fiber 和 Effect 等运行时概念 7.按 Session 和 Agent Turn 查看请求追踪 希望它不只是一个监控面板，也能成为理解 DSH / Cordis 运行机制的辅助工具。 安装到 Web Profile： `dsh plugin --profile web add @howardchan/dsh-runtime ` 安装到 Desktop Profile： `dsh plugin --profile desktop add @howardchan/dsh-runtime ` 如果你的桌面端使用了其他 Profile 名称，把命令中的 desktop 替换成实际名称即可。安装完成后，请重启对应的 DSH Profile。 项目目前还在持续打磨中，希望它能对你理解 DSH 的一些核心概念有所帮助。也欢迎试用后反馈问题、想法和改进建议 🙌。 如果对你有帮助希望能给我的仓库一个_**Star**_谢谢。 GitHub：[Howe829/dsh-runtime](https://github.com/Howe829/dsh-runtime) npm：[@howardchan/dsh-runtime](https://www.npmjs.com/package/@howardchan/dsh-runtime)

discussions.title: dsh 不从网关实时拉取模型列表，只用 pi-ai catalog 快照：opencode-go 新模型显示不出来；临时方案（手动声明 openai-completions 路由）又因协议不同，同一提供商的模型被拆成两个 provider
discussions.body:
背景 / 痛点
Web 设置 → 模型页的「拉取可用模型（Fetch available models）」本意是自动获取某提供商在线在售的模型清单。但实测发现：

对 pi-ai catalog 路由（如 opencode-go），它不会发任何网络请求，直接返回已安装 @earendil-works/pi-ai 包内写死的 catalog 快照；
结果就是 opencode-go 网关新上线的模型永远不显示，只能手动逐条填写；
想绕开 catalog 走实时拉取，必须手动声明一个 openai-completions 协议的路由（如 opencode-go-live）。但 opencode-go 这个 gateway 在 catalog 里默认用的是非 openai 协议，于是同一个提供商的一批模型被迫拆到两个 provider 下配置，无法合并成一个提供商，管理和切换都很别扭。
复现
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8，安装 pi-ai 适配器；在 $DSH_HOME/settings.yaml 加目录路由 opencode-go（仅 apiKeyEnv）；
Web → 设置 → 模型 → opencode-go → 「拉取可用模型」；
结果：只返回已安装 pi-ai@0.82.1 快照里的 16 个模型，零网络请求；
而 opencode-go 线上端点（
https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1/models
）实际在售 28 个模型。
根因
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai/lib/index.js 的 discoverModels() 对 catalog 内已存在的提供商直接短路：

js
复制
if (request.provider !== void 0) {
    const installed = catalogModels(request.provider);
    if (installed.size > 0) return [...installed.values()].map(...) // 直接返回快照，不 fetch
}
只有 pi-ai 不认识（未内置）的提供商才会走到 GET {baseURL}/models 实时探测，且此时协议必须是 LISTABLE_PROTOCOLS（如 openai-completions）里可读取列表的那几类。

证据
pi-ai 0.82.1（已安装）：opencode-go catalog = 16 个模型；
线上端点：28 个，其中 12 个不在快照里（如 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna、qwen3.5-plus、mimo-v2-omni、kimi-k2.5、hy3-preview、ox-alpha-free、muse-spark-1.2-contributor 等）；
下载 0.84.2 tarball 核对：opencode-go 仍只有 19 个——只新增 glm-5.3、qwen3.8-max、gpt-5.6-luna，12 个里仍有 9 个缺失（快照永远追不上线上）；
dsh-llm-pi-ai 最新版（0.1.1-rc.1）仍钉死 @earendil-works/pi-ai: ^0.82.1（0.x 的 caret 语义 = <0.83.0），所以官方 npm i -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest 也升不到 0.83/0.84。
为什么「手动配置」也救不了这个使用体验
为了拿全量，我用手声明路由 opencode-go-live（api: openai-completions + baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1）实时拉到了 28 个模型。但问题在于：

协议被迫分家：同一个网关，catalog 里的 opencode-go 用其原生协议；手动声明又只能用 openai-completions。于是同一个提供商的 28 个模型分裂在两处，用户得在 UI/配置里维护两份 provider，无法用一个 opencode-go 统一包含 catalog 全部 + 新模型；
丢失元数据：实时拉取拿不到 catalog 提供的 contextWindow、maxTokens、reasoningEfforts、compat、input 多模态等字段，多模态识图能力（input: [text, image]）还得靠用户逐个去查证后手填（我为此查了 pi-ai catalog 与多篇厂商资料才补全 13 个可识图模型）；
每新增一个模型都要手动处理。
建议（满足任意一条即可明显改善）
catalog 路由也支持实时探测：点「拉取可用模型」时，对已内置 catalog 的 provider 同时请求其端点 GET /models，把线上结果放进选择器供用户勾选采纳，而不是只回快照；
同一 provider 可多协议并存 / 能合并实时结果进 catalog 路由的 models：让用户能把「opencode-go 原生协议 catalog」和「openai-completions 实时拉取」合并在一个 provider 里，避免同一提供商模型被拆成两个 provider；
显示快照版本：标出每条路由当前用的是哪个 pi-ai catalog 快照，让滞后可见、也知道该等哪次升级；
放宽依赖范围（^0.82.1 → 可更新），让 catalog 更新能随正常的全局升级落地；
（可选） 提供「把 catalog / 实时拉取结果同步写进路由 models」的动作，自动带上 contextWindow/maxTokens/input 等元数据，控制权仍归用户。
连带发现
内置 DeepSeek 官方适配器（@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek）根本没有注册模型发现能力（没有 registerModelDiscovery），即使 DeepSeek 官方有 OpenAI 兼容的 GET /models，内置的 deepseek-official 提供商也同样无法自动获取模型——同类问题。

环境
dsh 0.1.0-rc.8（全局 npm），macOS
@earendil-works/pi-ai 0.82.1
Web 模型设置页（dsh-client-ui-settings-models）

discussions.title: Proposal: built-in local Skill Manager for invocation policy
discussions.body:
I built a focused, built-in Skill Manager proposal for DSH Web. It is intentionally narrower than the community dsh-skill-hub discussed in #3161: this surface manages invocation policy for the winning local disk-backed definitions only; it does not install, delete, scaffold, or provide a Skill market.

What it adds:

- Settings → Plugins → Skill Manager with local search and lazy instruction preview.
- Row-level `Automatic invocation` and `/name invocation` controls.
- Source, provider, and path visibility when a row is expanded.
- Host-resolved session cwd and preset scope; the browser never submits a filesystem path.
- Provider-owned mutation with YAML validation, a cross-process writer lock, atomic replacement, and catalog invalidation.
- Bundled definitions and symbolic links remain visible but read-only.

Implementation branch (rebased on current `master`):
https://github.com/SLin-code/deepseek-harness/tree/codex/skill-manager

discussions.title: Agent falls into infinite bash loop while intending to call a dynamic tool (reasoning/action decoupling)
discussions.body:
## Environment
- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.7 (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`, apps/cli)
- Model: deepseek-v4-flash (provider: deepseek-official)
- Session ran under a cordis dynamic plugin that registered 8 host tools (`team_create`, `team_spawn`, `team_assign`, `team_msg`, `team_task`, `team_status`, `team_interrupt`, `team_collect`)

## Summary
The agent's **reasoning layer says it will call tool X, but the action layer repeatedly emits tool Y (bash)**. Because bash always succeeds (`isError: false`), the loop never receives a failure signal and spins until the user manually interrupts it.

## Reproduction
1. Register dynamic host tools via `cordis_define` (tools confirmed present in the model request: `request/header` tools list contained all 8 `team_*` tools, schemas valid).
2. Ask the agent to smoke-test `team_create`.
3. Observed: 1139 bash calls in one session, 966 of them no-op `echo` markers (`echo "calling team_create"`, `echo "direct"`, `echo "invoke"`, ...).

## Evidence (from session log)
- The model's reasoning text explicitly says: *"我需要直接调用 team_create 工具...让我直接调用。"* ("I need to call team_create directly... let me call it directly.")
- But the emitted tool-call in the same turn is: `name: "bash"`, `arguments: {command: echo "=== 冒烟测试：调用 team_create ==="}` — i.e. the model generated bash, not `team_create`.
- Every bash result returns `isError: false` with the echoed text, so the model reads "success" and in the next turn repeats: "now call team_create for real" -> emits bash again. Reasoning and action each loop independently and never converge.
- Context at loop time: `cacheReadTokens=237568`, fresh `inputTokens=78` per turn — 42 tools in the list, model repeatedly picked the early `bash` tool over `team_create` (position ~34).
- The existing duplicate-call guard only fires on *byte-identical* calls (`"You are repeating the exact same tool call"` fired twice); the loop alternated echo strings (`direct`/`invoke`/`calling`/`skip`/`true`) and later repeated `echo "direct"` 6 times without interception.

## Root causes (hypotheses)
1. **No intent-action consistency check**: reasoning declares tool X, action emits tool Y, no harness-level guard interrupts the mismatch.
2. **Tool-selection degradation under long context + many tools**: 237K-token cached context, 42 tools, flash-class model repeatedly selects the early-listed `bash` instead of the intended dynamic tool.
3. **Duplicate-call guard granularity too coarse**: content-level repetition (same tool, same command text) is not caught, only byte-identical calls.

## Suggested fixes
1. Add an intent-action consistency check: if reasoning declares tool X but N consecutive emitted calls are tool Y, inject a correction.
2. Upgrade the duplicate-call guard to content-level (same tool + same command text => warn/stop), not just identical parameters.
3. Add a per-turn tool-call budget / circuit breaker to bound runaway loops.
4. Consider mitigations for long-context tool-selection degradation (tool list reordering/trimming, or model switch for long sessions).

Happy to provide the full session log path or more extracted evidence on request.

discussions.title: [Upstream Issue] dsh-mcp-client 不发送 MCP roots / rootUri，codegraph MCP 默认项目指向宿主启动目录而非当前工作区
discussions.body:
## 环境

- DSH（`@deepseek-ai/dsh` v0.1.0-rc.7），`dsh-mcp-client` 插件（`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js`）
- CodeGraph MCP server v1.5.0（stdio transport，`codegraph serve --mcp`）
- macOS，单 DSH 实例 + 多工作区（workspace）工作流

## 现象

在一个 DSH 实例内切换工作区时，`codegraph_explore` 等工具的**默认项目始终指向 DSH 宿主进程的启动目录**，而不是当前会话的工作区。

实测：DSH 宿主从 `~/Documents/code/DataNex/scripts` 启动（工作区为 `~/Documents/code/private-aiagentos`），codegraph MCP 默认项目解析到 DataNex（Rust 项目），本项目的 `.codegraph/` 索引只有显式传 `projectPath` 时才会被打开。

## 根因（源码证据）

**1. dsh-mcp-client 建立连接时不声明任何 MCP capabilities，也不发送 workspace 信息：**

```js
const generation = new Client({
  name: "dsh-mcp-client",
  version: "0.0.1"
}, { capabilities: {} });   // ← 空 capabilities，不声明 roots
```

- 不发送 `rootUri` / `workspaceFolders`（initialize 参数）
- 不声明 `capabilities.roots`，因此 codegraph 不会发起 `roots/list`
- 唯一传给子进程的路径是 transport 的 `cwd`（`config.cwd`），即 DSH 宿主进程启动目录，与当前会话 workspace 无关

**2. codegraph v1.5.0 的默认项目解析顺序（`mcp/session.js` handleInitialize + resolveRoot）：**

1. 客户端 `initialize` 带 `rootUri` → 用 `fileUriToPath(rootUri)`
2. 客户端 `initialize` 带 `workspaceFolders[0].uri` → 用之
3. 服务器启动参数 `--path`
4. 客户端声明 `capabilities.roots` → 启动后 `roots/list` 拉取第一个 root
5. 以上全部缺失 → **兜底 `process.cwd()` 向上找最近的 `.codegraph/`**（`findNearestCodeGraphRoot`）

DSH 对 1/2/4 全部不提供（3 也由配置决定），于是永远走到第 5 条 = 宿主启动目录。

## 影响

- 多工作区单实例是 DSH 的正常用法，但 codegraph 默认项目被"钉死"在启动目录，无法跟随当前工作区；
- 依赖默认项目的 agent 规则（如本项目 AGENTS.md 的 codegraph-first 约定）在 DSH 下会静默查错项目；
- 只能靠每次调用显式传 `projectPath` 绕开，agent 工作流容易漏传。

## 期望行为

codegraph 默认项目应跟随 DSH 的**当前会话 workspace**：

- 方案 A（推荐）：dsh-mcp-client 声明 `capabilities: { roots: { listChanged: false } }`，并实现 `roots/list` 处理器返回当前 workspace root（`file://` URI）；codegraph 侧已原生支持（clientSupportsRoots → roots/list 优先于 cwd）。
- 方案 B：连接时把当前 workspace 作为 `rootUri` 发送（LSP 风格，codegraph 最高优先级）。
- 方案 C：至少支持按会话/连接粒度注入 `--path`。

## 复现步骤

1. 在项目 A 目录启动 DSH（`cd A && dsh web`），工作区切换到项目 B；
2. 调用 `codegraph_explore`（不传 projectPath）；
3. 观察返回的源码来自项目 A 而非项目 B；
4. `lsof -p <codegraph-mcp-pid> | grep cwd` 确认其 cwd = 项目 A。

## 建议

在 dsh-mcp-client 中补充 MCP workspace 集成：声明 roots capability 并响应 `roots/list`（返回当前 `ctx.sessions` workspace 根），使 DSH 的 workspace 概念贯通到 MCP 层。codegraph 端无需改动。

## 相关文件

- DSH：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js`（`new Client(..., { capabilities: {} })`、`StdioClientTransport({ cwd })`）
- CodeGraph v1.5.0：`lib/dist/mcp/session.js`（`handleInitialize` rootUri/workspaceFolders/--path 分支、`roots/list`、cwd 兜底）、`lib/dist/mcp/directory.js`（`findNearestCodeGraphRoot`）

discussions.title: Bug: streamed tool_call id/name clobbered by empty strings from OpenAI-compatible gateways (llm-deepseek), breaks session reload
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek`'s `translate()` merges streamed `tool_calls` deltas with presence checks (`!== undefined`). Some OpenAI-compatible gateways echo `"id": ""` / `"name": ""` on continuation deltas instead of omitting those fields, and the empty strings clobber the real `id`/`name` received in the first delta.

Live sessions look fine (rendering follows in-memory deltas), but blocks are finalized and persisted with empty ids/names — so **persisted sessions fail to reload after a dsh restart**, and follow-up requests are reassembled with broken `tool_call_id` references.

## Root cause

`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts` (L159–160 on current master):

```ts
if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

- A continuation delta carrying `"id": ""` satisfies `!== undefined`, so the first delta's real id gets overwritten by an empty string. The official OpenAI SDK uses truthy checks at the same spot (`if (id) tool_call.id = id`) and is immune.
- `closeBlock()` finalizes with `block.callId ?? ''` / `block.name ?? ''`, persisting the damage.

Observed impact in production behind such a gateway:

- 60/60 sampled tool-call blocks persisted with empty id → 59/59 empty `tool_call_id` references in reassembled follow-up requests.
- 11/60 blocks also lost their name → `unknown tool ""` dispatch failures.

The gateway's behavior is arguably non-conformant (we're reporting that to the vendor separately), but the adapter shouldn't let empty strings destroy values it already received — the official SDK's truthy semantics are the right defense.

## Fix

```diff
- if (call.id !== undefined) block.callId = call.id
- if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
+ if (call.id) block.callId = call.id
+ if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name
```

A ready-to-use patch with a regression test (gateway chunk shape: continuation deltas carrying empty-string id/name; asserts the finalized block keeps the first delta's values) is on this branch:

https://github.com/AlphaCatMeow/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/toolcall-empty-string-clobber

Verified: the new test fails on master (30 passed / 1 failed) and 31/31 pass with the fix. I tried to open a PR but external PR creation appears to be restricted, so per CONTRIBUTING.md this Discussion is the report — feel free to cherry-pick the commit.

discussions.title: llm-pi-ai drops the reasoning-token breakdown pi-ai already reports
discussions.body:
`mapUsage` in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai` does not map pi-ai's `Usage.reasoning`, so `TokenUsage.reasoningTokens` is always absent on a pi-ai route even when the provider reports a breakdown.

The README explains the omission as an absence upstream:

> pi-ai folds reasoning tokens into output usage; there is no separate reasoning count to map.

The first half is accurate — `output` already includes those tokens — but pi-ai does expose the breakdown separately:

```ts
// @earendil-works/pi-ai dist/types.d.ts:263
/**
 * Reasoning/thinking tokens, when the provider reports them. This is a subset of
 * `output`: `output` already includes these tokens.
 */
reasoning?: number;
```

It is populated for `openai-completions` (`dist/api/openai-completions.js:1077`):

```js
reasoning: rawUsage.completion_tokens_details?.reasoning_tokens || 0,
```

but `lib/index.js:418` maps only four fields:

```js
function mapUsage(usage) {
	return {
		inputTokens: usage.input,
		outputTokens: usage.output,
		...usage.cacheRead > 0 ? { cacheReadTokens: usage.cacheRead } : {},
		...usage.cacheWrite > 0 ? { cacheWriteTokens: usage.cacheWrite } : {}
	};
}
```

`TokenUsage.reasoningTokens` exists (`dsh-llm/lib/types/types.d.ts:128`) and `dsh-llm-deepseek` maps it (`lib/index.js:326-331`), so the two adapters disagree about the same endpoint shape.

## Reproduction

A local OpenAI-compatible server returning `completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens`, driven through `ctx.llm.stream()` with the same prompt on each adapter:

```
llm-pi-ai      (api: openai-completions)  usage = {"inputTokens":26,"outputTokens":63}
llm-deepseek   (same endpoint)            usage = {"inputTokens":56,"outputTokens":62,"reasoningTokens":55}
```

The endpoint's own response carries the breakdown in both cases:

```json
"completion_tokens_details": {"reasoning_tokens": 42}
```

## Suggested fix

Reasoning is a subset of output, so it rides alongside the output count rather than adding to it:

```js
...usage.reasoning === void 0 ? {} : { reasoningTokens: usage.reasoning }
```

Tested against `0.1.1-rc.1`: `reasoningTokens` then arrives and stays `<= outputTokens`.

Filed here rather than as an issue because this repository has Issues disabled.

discussions.title: 消除硬编码的两语言假设，使发行语言集合成为单一可配置来源
discussions.body:
把"应用恰好发行两种语言（zh/en）"这一硬编码假设从代码中消除：客户端 locale 层、字典 parity 门禁、文档配对门禁、合并驱动与网站投影全部从同一个可配置的发行语言集合派生；新增一种语言只加字典与一条配置，不再需要改动门禁与类型系统。

<details>
<summary>验收与细节</summary>

## 现状：两语言假设散落在哪些地方

客户端 locale 层（`packages/client/locale`）：

- `src/locale-settings.ts`：`LOCALE_IDS = ['zh', 'en'] as const`；`LocaleSettingsSchema.preference` 用 `z.union([...LOCALE_IDS])`。
- `src/client/index.ts`：展示列表 `LOCALES`、`DOCUMENT_LANGUAGE`（`<html lang>` 映射）、`FALLBACK_LOCALE = 'en'` 全部硬编码；`register(ns, dicts: Record<LocaleId, LocaleDictOf<N>>)` 的类型要求"恰好所有发行语言"；`detectBrowserLocale` 只在硬编码列表中匹配主子标签。
- 26 个客户端包的 `locales.ts` 全部按 `{ zh, en }` 成对注册。
- `scripts/locale-dictionary-parity.spec.ts` 只做 zh/en 键集对等校验。

文档配对层（`docs/` + `scripts/`）：

- `scripts/verify-translation-pairing.ts` 以 `*.zh.md` 后缀发现配对；`foo.i18n.yaml` 恰好两个 blob 哈希；语言切换为双向链接；结构签名按 source ↔ zh 两两比对。
- `scripts/translation-pairing-merge.ts` 与 `.gitattributes` 的 `dsh-translation-pairing` 合并驱动只组合两哈希三元组。
- `docs/i18n/README.md`、`translation-rules.md`、`terminology.md` 以"成对三文件"（`foo.md` + `foo.zh.md` + `foo.i18n.yaml`）为契约。
- `website/` VitePress 按 root(zh)/en 两个 locale 投影。

## 问题

"恰好两种语言"不是内容决策，而是被写进了类型系统、schema、门禁与合并驱动。任何第三种语言（例如土耳其语诸变体，或任何未来语言）都无法只靠"加字典"落地：注册表类型、parity 门禁、配对发现、一致性记录、切换链接、结构签名、合并驱动、网站投影都要先做机制改造。这让多语言成为一次性大工程，而不是可持续演进的增量能力。

## 目标行为

- 发行语言集合有单一来源（常量或配置），其余全部派生：`LocaleId` 联合类型、settings schema、注册表 `Record<LocaleId, ...>`、回退语言、`<html lang>` 映射、parity 门禁、文档配对发现/记录/切换/签名、合并驱动、网站 locale。
- 新增一种语言 = 新增该语言的字典 + 在集合里加一项；所有门禁自动覆盖新语言，无需改动门禁实现。
- 回退语义明确：主字典缺失时按固定回退链（如 → en → key），但"回退到哪种语言"由集合派生而非散落的硬编码常量。
- 既有 zh/en 行为保持不变，全部门禁保持绿色。

## 验收条件

- 在集合中加入一个占位语言（或真实新语言），仅改动集合与字典文件，`pnpm run typecheck`、`pnpm run test:gui`、`locale-dictionary-parity`、`doc-sync` 全部通过，且新语言被 parity 与配对门禁覆盖。
- 设置面板语言选择器、`<html lang>`、`navigator` 主子标签匹配对新语言生效。
- 文档侧：`.i18n.yaml` 可容纳 N 个哈希；新语言文件被要求成对、结构签名逐侧校验；合并驱动在 N 哈希下仍 fail-closed。
- 除可配置项外，未触碰任何门禁实现代码即可完成上述验收。

## 用户或模型可见变化

- 设置面板出现新语言选项；文档网站出现新语言切换。
- 门禁错误信息按语言列出问题项。

## 测试证据

- 扩展 `locale-dictionary-parity.spec.ts`、`translation-pairing.spec.ts`、`translation-pairing-merge.spec.ts` 与 locale 包测试，覆盖 N 语言场景（缺失一侧、哈希失配、切换不全、合并冲突）。
- 用一个真实样例语言走通端到端（字典 → 选择器 → parity → 配对 → 网站投影）。
- 全量 `pnpm run doc-sync`、`pnpm run test:gui`、`pnpm run website:build` 跑绿。
</details>

discussions.title: Auto-dismiss the Session export modal after the browser starts the download
discussions.body:
## Problem

After exporting a Session, the browser download starts successfully but the modal remains open with “Session download started”. Because the modal continues to block the interface, it looks like the export is still running and invites users to wait or retry.

## Reproduction

1. Open a Session in the Web UI.
2. Click **Session log** (or run `/export`).
3. Choose a destination and let the browser accept the ZIP download.
4. Observe that the success modal remains open until **Close** is clicked.

## Suggestion

Close the modal automatically once the browser accepts the download. Keep the modal open for preparation and preflight failures so errors remain visible. This matches the actual lifecycle the page can observe: after handing the GET URL to the browser download manager, the page cannot reliably track the browser's download progress.

I prepared a minimal implementation on my fork:

- Commit: https://github.com/duliangkuan/deepseek-harness/commit/ce11683f2c231c8560c15eda6b35ca0970525370
- Branch: https://github.com/duliangkuan/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/auto-dismiss-session-export

The patch changes the successful controller state to `open: false`, preserves the error path, updates the English/Chinese README pair, and adds controller + dialog regression coverage.

Validation:

- 10 focused tests passed
- 100% coverage for `controller.ts`
- package TypeScript check passed
- staged lint and whitespace hooks passed
- repository pre-push typecheck passed
- documentation gates: 27/28 passed initially; the only failure was the expected stale bilingual pairing record, which was then re-recorded and its scoped check passed

I noticed `CONTRIBUTING.md` says external PRs are not currently accepted, so I am sharing the suggestion and reviewable patch here instead of opening a PR against the repository.

discussions.title: Model switch fails when history contains images — text-only models reject instead of omitting
discussions.body: Environment: dsh 0.1.1-rc.1, web profile Steps to reproduce: 1. Start a session with deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 2. Attach an image and send 3. Switch the session model to deepseek-v4-flash or deepseek-v4-pro 4. Next request throws UNSUPPORTED_CONTENT — model switch effectively fails Expected: switching to a text-only model should either omit historical images (reusing the existing [image omitted...] placeholder mechanism) or convert them to placeholder text, so the session stays usable. Root cause hint: in dsh-llm-deepseek adapter, the hasImages check (messages.some(contentHasImage)) throws when the selected model's inputModalities lacks image — there is no fallback path for historical images. The placeholder substitution (offloadRequestImages) only handles the maxRequestImageBytes overflow case, not the text-only-model case. Impact: any session that ever contained an image cannot switch back to a text-only model, forcing users to start a new session and lose context.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-plugin-mall | 安装前预检、冲突拦截与失败回滚的插件市场
discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

项目地址：https://github.com/1e0zj/dsh-plugin-mall

最近做了一个直接集成到 DeepSeek Harness Web 设置页的插件市场：`@1e0zj/dsh-plugin-mall`。它可以搜索 GitHub 上带有 `dsh-plugin` topic 的仓库，自动验证是否是真正的 DSH 插件，并完成风险检查、安装、更新和卸载。

我做它时最关心的不是“能不能一键安装”，而是：**给插件安装加一道尽量可恢复的安全边界，避免一次试装直接把正在使用的 dsh Web profile 搞到无法启动。**

![插件市场入口和已安装插件](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/be94dc5a-48f5-41e0-9715-0cd40aae453e)

## 安装前就显示适配风险

市场会读取候选仓库的 `package.json`，验证它是否声明了 `dsh.bundle` 或 `dsh.client`。默认的“只看已验证插件”会过滤只有 topic、但实际上不是 DSH 插件的仓库。

搜索结果还会对照当前 profile 显示 **适配 / 有风险 / 冲突 / 适配未知**，让风险在点击安装之前就可见。

![搜索结果和适配标签](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/f2cc4a2d-552c-48ff-b535-4800a8373e2a)

## 隔离预检和分级处置

真正安装前，候选插件会先以禁用安装脚本的方式装进临时目录，再与当前 profile 组合扫描，包括：

- loader ID 重复和同一模块重复挂载
- 覆盖或遮蔽宿主模块
- 停用、替换或重写现有插件配置
- 另一套前端/终端门面与当前 Web profile 冲突
- peer、Node 和操作系统版本不兼容

确定会破坏当前组合的硬冲突会直接拦截，并说明具体原因。

![检测到门面冲突并阻止安装](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/898667c8-404b-40d0-908b-dfbad59f8993)

不确定会造成破坏、但确实存在风险的情况不会静默放行，而是列出问题，由用户明确确认是否继续。

![普通风险由用户知情确认](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/4c0b1efb-af8b-45a6-b3d1-c3e1758bf544)

## 生命周期脚本不会静默执行

如果插件或传递依赖包含 `install`、`postinstall` 等脚本，市场会暂停安装，展示实际包名、版本、具体命令、下载量和 provenance 信息。只有用户明确批准的包才能运行脚本，新出现的包不会顺带获得权限。

安装前会给 profile 的关键配置拍快照；安装失败或落盘校验不通过时回滚。可选的 `guard launch` 还能提供启动观察期：新插件在观察期内导致 dsh 非零退出时，会恢复安装前状态，并用原命令重新启动一次。

![风险确认后安装完成](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/c89cadd7-80c3-48a8-827c-1d581cacb979)

## 与 DSH 的集成方式

这是一个同时包含 host bundle 和 Web client 的 DSH 插件：

- Web client 在“设置 → 插件”中注册“插件市场”页面；
- host bundle 提供搜索、检查、安装、卸载和已安装查询等 agent 工具；
- 浏览器与服务端通过 loopback-only RPC 通信；
- 安装结果写入 DSH profile 的 bundle/client 配置，重启后由 DSH 正常加载。

## 安装

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add @1e0zj/dsh-plugin-mall
```

安装完成后完整重启 `dsh web`，然后进入：

> 设置 → 插件 → 插件市场

当前版本：`0.4.0`，MIT License。

如果你开发了 DSH 插件，只需给 GitHub 仓库添加 `dsh-plugin` topic，就可以被市场发现，不需要单独提交收录申请。

欢迎试用和反馈，尤其欢迎提供特殊 bundle patch、宿主依赖或多插件组合下的误报与漏报案例。

discussions.title: 【插件】dsh-openclaw-persona：把 OpenClaw 五件套 Persona 定义搬进 DeepSeek Harness
discussions.body: # dsh-openclaw-persona > **改 md 即改 Persona，下一条消息生效。** > 把 OpenClaw 五件套 Persona 定义搬进 DeepSeek Harness——侧边栏直接编辑，保存即生效。 [![npm][npm-badge]][npm] [npm-badge]: https://img.shields.io/npm/v/@lynsucceed/dsh-openclaw-persona?logo=npm&color=cb3837 [npm]: https://www.npmjs.com/package/@lynsucceed/dsh-openclaw-persona --- ## 🖼️ 界面预览 侧边栏入口，点开即编辑，标签页切换五个文件，**保存后下一条消息立即生效**。 ## ✨ 核心特性 - **🖊️ 即改即生效** — 聊到一半觉得 Agent 回答风格不对？点开侧边栏改两笔，**下一条消息**就按新设定来。不用重启、不用重载配置。 - **📐 五文件分层定义** — 借鉴 [OpenClaw](https://openclaw.ai) 的成熟范式：行为准则 / 身份设定 / 用户画像 / 长期记忆 / 工具备忘，各司其职，改哪块动哪块。 - **🎛️ Web GUI 编辑器** — 标签页切换 5 个文件，Markdown 直接写，保存即写入磁盘。也可以用你喜欢的编辑器直接改文件，效果完全一样。 - **⚡ mtime 缓存，KV-cache 友好** — 文件没变就复用缓存文本，不打乱模型端 KV-cache；文件改动立刻生效，两全其美。 - **🏗️ 两级回退** — 先找项目内 `.dsh/persona/`（每个仓库一套设定），找不到再回退到全局 `~/.dsh/persona/`（默认设定）。项目覆盖全局，天经地义。 - **🔌 即插即用** — 一个命令装上，侧边栏自动出现入口；首次启动写入示例模板，**绝不覆盖你已有的编辑**。 ## 🚀 一分钟上手 ```bash # 安装插件（web profile） dsh plugin --profile web add @lynsucceed/dsh-openclaw-persona # 重启 DSH Web dsh web ``` 重启后侧边栏会出现 **「Custom Persona」** 入口——点开就能编辑 5 个 Persona 文件。 > 也可以从 GitHub 安装：`dsh plugin --profile web add github:lynsucceed/dsh-openclaw-persona` ## 🧩 五文件体系 | 文件 | 管什么 | 组合顺序 | |---|---|---| | `SOUL.md` | 行为准则 — 语气、边界、价值观 | 1 | | `IDENTITY.md` | 身份设定 — 角色定位、背景、说话方式 | 2 | | `USER.md` | 用户画像 — 称呼、时区、相处之道 | 3 | | `MEMORY.md` | 长期记忆 — 值得记住的信息 | 4 | | `TOOLS.md` | 工具 / 环境备忘 — TTS 声线、设备别名等 | 5 | 五个文件按顺序拼接，替换 DSH 的 `deployment:persona` 提示段。**任何一个文件都可以留空或删除**——缺失的部分会被安静跳过，不会报错。 ## 🎯 使用方式 ### 在 Web GUI 里编辑（推荐） 1. 点击侧边栏 **「Custom Persona」** 2. 切换标签页，在对应的 Markdown 文件里写设定 3. 点 **「保存」** 4. 发下一条消息——Agent 已经按新设定应答了 ✨ ### 直接改文件 编辑磁盘上的 `~/.dsh/persona/*.md`（全局）或 `<项目目录>/.dsh/persona/*.md`（项目级），效果完全一样。mtime 缓存会自动检测变化。 ### 项目级覆盖 想给某个项目单独配一套 Persona？在项目根目录下建 `.dsh/persona/`，把要覆盖的文件放进去就行。没放的文件仍然从全局读取。 ## ⚙️ 配置（可选） 默认开箱即用。如果想自定义，可以在 cordis 配置里传参： ```yaml plugins: '@lynsucceed/dsh-openclaw-persona': dir: persona # 目录名，默认 persona files: # 文件列表 + 顺序，默认是下面这 5 个 - SOUL.md - IDENTITY.md - USER.md - MEMORY.md - TOOLS.md ``` - **`dir`** — 在 `.dsh/` 和 `~/.dsh/` 下查找的子目录名 - **`files`** — 自定义文件名和组合顺序，想用几个用几个 ## 🛠️ 开发 ```bash pnpm install # 安装依赖（devDependencies 直接从 npm 拉，不需要本地 DSH checkout） pnpm build # tsc 生成类型 + tsdown 打包（host ESM + client ModuleLoader） pnpm typecheck # 仅类型检查 ``` 运行时依赖通过 `peerDependencies` 由宿主 profile 注入，打包产物里不包含 cordis / dsh-* 包。 ## 📄 许可 Apache-2.0

discussions.title: [BUG] git 源插件安装后 bundle 组合异常，工具层空结果致会话循环且恢复后无响应
discussions.body:
## Summary

macOS + DSH rc.8（web profile，PM2 托管）通过 `dsh plugin --profile web add` 安装一个 git 源第三方插件（`dsh-api-relay-audit`，bundle=github:toby-bridges/api-relay-audit#00ce802）后，出现以下级联现象：

1. pnpm git 源安装过程出现死锁；
2. 安装后 `dsh --profile web --dump-config` 的输出行数从正常值（约 658 行）骤降到 17 行，疑似 bundle 组合层异常；
3. 会话内工具结果全部为空（`tool/result` 307 条均为 `ok=None`，无一条 `ok=True`）；
4. agent 对空结果持续重试，形成 24 轮循环（末段 11 分钟内 8 轮）；
5. `pm2 restart` 后会话恢复，但此后对每条用户消息仅返回空的 `assistant/message`（无内容、无工具调用），该会话无法再正常使用，只有新建会话才恢复。

## Environment

| Item | Value |
|---|---|
| DSH | `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8`（web profile，`npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web`，PM2 托管） |
| Node.js | v26.3.1 |
| OS | macOS (darwin-arm64) |
| Provider | volcengine (ark, `https://ark.cn-beijing.volces.com/api/coding/v3`) |
| Model | `deepseek-v4-flash-ga-260731` |
| 触发插件 | `dsh-api-relay-audit@2.4.0`（bundle=github:toby-bridges/api-relay-audit#00ce802，git 源） |
| 会话 | `session-9186ec1a-d8b6-4079-a7ac-56695befaa0e`（会话日志约 3.1MB） |

## 复现链 / 证据

| 阶段 | 观察 |
|---|---|
| 安装 | `dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-api-relay-audit`（git 源）→ pnpm 安装死锁 |
| bundle 组合 | 安装后 `--dump-config` 输出 17 行；卸载插件后恢复 658 行 |
| 工具结果 | 会话日志 `tool/result` 307/307 `ok=None`（0 条 `ok=True`） |
| 循环 | 会话共 24 轮，末段 11 分钟内 8 轮；期间反复执行 `pm2 restart`、`job_output` 轮询、清理残留进程 |
| 恢复后 | 重启后对每条用户消息返回空 `assistant/message`，无内容、无工具调用 |

## 可能的根因（推测，请确认）

- git 源插件的 bundle 注册可能影响 cordis 组合层，使 `dump-config` 组合树不完整，工具执行层返回空结果而非错误；
- agent loop 对连续空结果缺少熔断/健康检查，持续重试形成循环；
- 大量空事件累积到会话上下文后，恢复时模型产出空回复，会话无法继续。

## 建议（供参考）

1. 工具层：连续 N 次工具结果为空时停止重试并明确报错，而非继续循环；
2. 会话层：恢复会话时若检测到大量异常/空事件，可自动触发已有的 compaction，或明确提示用户新建会话；
3. 插件层：`dsh plugin add`（尤其 git 源）安装后校验 `dump-config` 组合完整性；git 源安装提供避免死锁的路径（如 tarball）。

## 相关讨论

- #3802（第三方插件写入 session event 导致会话无法打开）
- #3808（prepare 崩溃后会话永久卡死 400）
- #3819（Agent 陷入 infinite bash loop）
- #3797（大会话打开时 UI 看起来无回复）

discussions.title: system-prompt: literal `{{ }}` in an authored persona always fails — no escape syntax (proposed opt-out, tested branch included)
discussions.body:
## Problem

Every prompt section is interpolated: `{{…}}` is strict variable syntax —
malformed or unknown references throw at render, and there is no escape
syntax for a literal `{{`.

That is the right default for template sections, but the **persona** is
frequently not a template. An application embedding dsh supplies the persona
as arbitrary authored prose, and such text legitimately contains literal
`{{ … }}` — the most common case being embedded code samples. Example: a
persona that includes a Python recipe using f-string escapes:

```python
driver.execute_script(f"""
    slides.forEach(s => {{
        s.classList.remove('active');
    }});
""")
```

Today this fails the whole session at prompt time:

```
malformed prompt variable reference "{{
    s.classList.remove('active');
…}}" in section "deployment:persona" (variable names match /^[a-z][a-z0-9_]*$/)
```

There is no workaround on the embedder's side that preserves the text: any
transformation (`{ {`, zero-width separators) corrupts code the model is
expected to reproduce byte-exact, and substituted variables can't produce
`{{` either.

## Related reports (same root cause, different surfaces)

- #3541 — `{{…}}` in **tool descriptions** breaks Code Mode
- #3454 — `{{hexagon}}` in **MCP-provided content** raises "unknown prompt variable"

All three are one failure class: strict `{{…}}` scanning applied to text that
is not a template (authored personas, tool descriptions, MCP content). This
proposal addresses the authored persona/section surface; the same opt-out
could naturally extend to tool-description rendering.

## Proposed change: an opt-out flag, strict by default

| Surface | Field | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `PromptSection` (core registration) | `interpolate?: boolean` | `true` |
| `SystemPrompt` plugin config | `interpolatePersona?: boolean` | `true` |
| `persona` preset row config | `interpolate?: boolean` | `true` |

A section registered with `interpolate: false` renders verbatim —
`renderPrompt` skips variable scanning for that section only. Everything
else is untouched: other sections keep strict semantics, contexts are
unaffected, all existing error paths are preserved, and the flag threads
through `AssembledSection` so custom renderers can observe it.

## Tested implementation

Since external pull requests are closed, a ready implementation is available
for the team to review, adapt, or absorb:

- Branch: https://github.com/ngstcf/deepseek-harness/tree/system-prompt-interpolate-opt-out
- Diff vs `master`: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...ngstcf:deepseek-harness:system-prompt-interpolate-opt-out

Three files, +73/−0: the core flag + threading, the persona preset
pass-through, and a new spec (`interpolate-opt-out.spec.ts`) covering the
verbatim persona, strict-by-default, and per-section scoping. The full
`packages/core/system-prompt` suite passes with the change (84/84).

Happy to adjust naming/shape to whatever fits the project's direction.

discussions.title: [Bug] Web UI 输入框中按 Backspace 删除键会删除整个输入框内容
discussions.body:
描述：

在 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的主输入框中输入文字后，尝试按 Backspace（退格键） 删除最后一个字符时，输入框内的所有文本会被一次性全部删除，而不是按预期只删除光标前的一个字符。该问题在新建会话时极易复现，严重影响正常文本编辑和对话输入体验。

将光标置于文本末尾，按下键盘上的 Backspace（退格键）。

观察输入框，所有文字被一次性清空。

浏览器：Chrome  版本 126.0.6478.115（正式版本） （64 位）

Node.js：v24.15.0

discussions.title: 执行 oxlint 检查时发生 Rust 核心崩溃
discussions.body:
在 Node.js 22.19.0 下执行 lint 时，oxlint 仍会崩溃。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. Clone `https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness.git` 。
  2. 在 commit `528c682e061696f5a160f363f236ecbf53cbd006` 上执行 `pnpm install`。
  3. 使用 Node.js `v22.19.0` 执行 `pnpm lint:contracts-ready`。
- 实际结果：
  oxlint `1.76.0` 终止并返回 exit code `134`，输出：
  `thread 'tokio-rt-worker' panicked at crates/oxc_allocator/src/pool/fixed_size.rs:112:67: called Result::unwrap() on an Err value: ()`
- 预期结果：
  lint 应正常完成，或返回可诊断的 lint 错误，不应触发 Rust panic。
- 环境：
  - OS：Ubuntu 24.04 linux/amd64
  - Node.js：v22.19.0
  - pnpm：11.7.0
  - oxlint：1.76.0
- 验收条件：
  - 在项目声明支持的 Node.js 22.19.0 环境执行 `pnpm lint:contracts-ready` 不再触发该 panic；
  - 若问题来自 oxlint，上游版本或项目配置应明确固定到不会触发该崩溃的组合；
  - 若无法支持该组合，文档与 `engines` 应明确给出可工作的版本范围。

</details>

依赖审计发现运行时依赖存在多个待修复公告。

</details>
<summary>问题与证据标准</summary>

- 核心问题：
  - 在 commit `528c682e061696f5a160f363f236ecbf53cbd006` 的工作区执行 `pnpm audit --json`，审计结果包含 38 个 advisory。
  - 当前依赖树中可见：`hono@4.12.29`、`@hono/node-server@1.19.14`、`js-yaml@4.2.0`。
  - 审计结果将以下项目标记为需要升级或进一步确认：
    - `hono` 相关公告建议版本为 `>=4.12.34`；
    - `@hono/node-server` 的 Windows `serve-static` 路径穿越公告建议版本为 `>=1.19.15`；
    - `js-yaml` 的相关公告建议版本为 `>=4.3.0` 或 `>=4.3.1`，具体取决于公告。

- 证据标准：
  - 维护者可在相同 commit 执行 `pnpm audit --json`，确认 advisory、受影响版本、依赖路径与 patched version；
  - 逐项确认受影响包是否进入发布包、运行时服务、Windows `serve-static` 或 YAML 解析的可达路径；
  - 升级后重新执行 `pnpm audit`，并运行项目既有 build、test 与发布包验证。
- 交付结论：

  - 若某个公告只影响 devDependency、未进入发布包或不可达功能路径，请在依赖安全记录中明确说明，而不是简单忽略；
  - 若无法立即升级，请记录暂缓原因、受影响路径及临时缓解措施。
- 可能的后续工作：
  - 更新 `package.json` 与 `pnpm-lock.yaml`；
  - 建立 CI 中的依赖审计门槛，并区分生产运行时依赖与开发依赖；
  - 对无法直接升级的传递依赖建立追踪项目。

</details>

discussions.title: 修复 subprocess-e2b 测试中未 await 的 Promise 导致潜在测试崩溃
discussions.body:
测试文件 `subprocess.spec.ts` 存在未 `await` 的异步断言。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 在 `packages/e2b/subprocess-e2b/tests/subprocess.spec.ts` 第 471 行左右，有一处断言：
     `void expect(service.spawnTerminal(...)).rejects.toThrow(...)`
  2. 运行 `pnpm test` 时，Vitest 会在 stderr 输出警告：`Promise returned by expect(actual).rejects.toThrow(expected) was not awaited.`。
- 实际结果：
  使用了 `void expect(...).rejects`，导致异步断言的 Promise 没有被测试框架等待，可能会在下一个 Vitest 大版本中导致测试直接失败，或引发 Unhandled Rejection 泄漏。
- 预期结果：
  所有的异步断言（如 `.rejects.toThrow`）都应该被正确 `await`。
- 环境：
  - 代码路径：`packages/e2b/subprocess-e2b/tests/subprocess.spec.ts` 约第 471 行
- 验收条件：
  - 将 `void expect(...)` 修改为 `await expect(...)`。
  - 运行测试时不再出现 `was not awaited` 的 Vitest 警告。

</details>

discussions.title: [Bug Report] 会话中断恢复后合成收尾事件与续写事件 seq 重叠，导致日志损坏、历史无法加载
discussions.body:
# [Bug Report] 会话中断恢复后合成收尾事件与续写事件 seq 重叠，导致日志损坏、历史无法加载

> 提交渠道：deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness GitHub Discussions（Bug Report 分类）
> 提交链接：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/new
> 本报告由实际日志分析 + 源码定位得出，证据如下。

## 环境

- 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.6（npm 全局安装，桌面应用内嵌 `dsh web` 子进程）
- Node：v24.19.0
- 平台：Windows（Electron 桌面应用）
- 会话日志物理格式：`session.jsonl.zstd`（拼接 zstd 帧：头帧 + 每批事件一帧，`packChunks` 打包分片行）

## 现象

加载某个会话历史时失败，错误信息：

```
history unavailable for session "session-37374e34-...": Error: corrupt session log:
seq gap in committed region at line 9551 (expected 165985, got 165983)
```

读端校验器（`dsh-session-persistence-jsonl` 的 `SessionLogScanner.consumeEventLine`，lib/index.js:275-300）要求每个事件的 `seq` 从 0 严格连续递增；发现重叠即判定日志损坏并拒绝加载。该会话因此**永久无法加载历史**（无自动修复路径，只能手动改日志文件）。

## 日志证据：两个"边界事件"是崩溃恢复合成的，不是正常写入

损坏点前后（原始 JSONL 行号）：

| 行 | 事件 | seq | time |
|---|---|---|---|
| 9549 | `reasoning-chunks`（turn 6 step 1，最后一段分片） | seq0=165958，含 25 个 chunk | time0=1786886027781 |
| 9550 | `step/end`（turn 6 step 1） | **165983** | 1786886027971 |
| 9551 | `turn/end`（turn 6, `reason:{kind:"interrupted"}`） | **165984** | 1786886027971 |
| 9552 | `reasoning-chunks`（**同一 turn 6 step 1，同一段推理文本续写**） | seq0=**165983**（重叠！） | time0=1786886028008 |
| … | 恢复后一直续写，seq 165983→183873，内部连续 | | |
| 10477 | `turn/end`（turn 6, `reason:{kind:"completed"}`） | 183873 | 1786886243823 |

三点吻合 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-session` 的 `interruptedTurnClosers()`（lib/types/repair.js:21-125）：

1. **事件形状**：该函数正是"先补 `step/end`（若 step 未关闭），再补 `turn/end { reason: { kind: 'interrupted' } }`"（repair.js:120-123）；
2. **时间戳**：注释明确"合成事件复用最后一个真实事件的时间戳"（repair.js:76-80）。验证：raw 9549 最后 chunk 的 time = time0(1786886027781) + Σdt(190) = **1786886027971**，与两个合成事件 time 完全一致；
3. **seq**：`let seq = last.seq + 1`（repair.js:79），即 165983。

即：**turn 6 的流被中断后，durable 日志尾部留下一个未关闭的 turn（最后真实事件 seq 165982）；某次恢复/冷加载路径（`dsh-session-persistence` 的 `prepareCore` → `interruptedTurnClosers` → `commitRepair`）检测到未关闭 turn，向文件追加了这两个合成收尾事件（seq 165983/165984）。随后同一 turn 在 37ms 后恢复续写（同一段推理文本无 user/message 隔断，最终 turn 6 completed），但续写事件的 seq 从 165983 重新开始——与文件中已有的两个事件重叠。**

## 根因：写端两条路径的 seq 状态不同步

- **崩溃恢复路径只写文件、不推进内存游标**：`commitPrepared`（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:1019-1028）在 `tornMarker/closers` 非空时调用 `backend.commitRepair(...)` 后**直接 return，没有 `this.states.set` / cursor 推进**；`commitRepair`（dsh-session-persistence-jsonl/lib/index.js:1031-1035）也只做 truncate + appendLines，纯文件操作。
- **实时写入路径只校验内存游标**：`appendCore`（dsh-session-persistence/lib/index.js:829-835）检查 `event.seq !== state.cursor + i`，但 `state.cursor` 是内存值，落后于文件已提交长度（165985），所以续写事件 165983 通过了校验。
- **读端校验严格、写端不严格**：读端 `SessionLogScanner` 要求 seq 全局连续，重叠即抛错；写端只与内存游标比对，检测不到与文件的重叠。
- 正常情况下有防护：`adoptLivePrefix`（lib/index.js:1285-1302）的 `seedCoversPrefix` 会拒绝"live 种子不覆盖已持久化前缀"的情况——但本次流程中恢复续写未走该防护（很可能是同一进程内 live Session 未释放、写路径直接续写），故未被拦截。

## 影响

- 触发条件：会话运行中 turn 被瞬时中断（流错误/超时/内嵌 harness 重启等），随后同一 turn 恢复续写。日志尾部出现 seq 重叠 → 该会话历史**永久不可加载**，且无自动修复。
- 已损坏会话只能手动修复：删除两个合成收尾事件（step/end、turn/end interrupted）后，恢复段恰好从 seq 165983 无缝衔接，日志即恢复连续（本次修复后 183874 事件、seq 0..183873 连续、turn/step 边界平衡，内容零丢失）。

## 建议修复

1. **提交修复（commitRepair）后同步推进 coordinator 的 durable cursor / 清掉陈旧 state**，使后续 append 的校验基准与文件已提交长度一致；或
2. **写端校验改为与文件已提交长度对齐**（append 前读取 committed 前缀长度，或对落后事件重新编号为 `committedLength + i`），而不是只对内存游标做弱校验；或
3. **拒绝续写**：当 live 写路径的 next-seq 与 durable 尾部不一致时抛错（把 `seedCoversPrefix` 的防护扩展到 seq 对齐），而不是静默写出重叠事件。

## 附件 (Attachments)

见同目录 `DSH-BUG-REPORT-attachments/`(说明见其中 `README.md`):

| 文件 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| `corrupt-log-session-37374e34-e3c7-4a0e-a67b-5d1e2522d403.jsonl.zstd` | **第一次损坏的原始日志**(2.9 MB,未修改),复现 `seq gap at line 9551 (expected 165985, got 165983)` |
| `repair-seq-gap.js` | 自包含修复脚本(仅 Node 内置模块),修复单处向后重叠损坏 |
| `repaired-log-session-37374e34.jsonl.zstd` | 第一次修复结果(1.2 MB):183,874 事件 |
| `corrupt-log2-session-37374e34.jsonl.zstd` | **第二次损坏的原始日志**(2.5 MB,未修改),复现 `seq gap at line 12736 (expected 225878, got 225875)` |
| `repair-current-session.js` | 针对第二次损坏的修复脚本(严格结构断言,内容零丢失) |
| `repaired-log2-session-37374e34.jsonl.zstd` | 第二次修复结果(1.8 MB):261,456 事件 |

## 附录:同一会话上复发(重要证据)

第一次修复(2026-08-17)后,会话继续运行;**同一 bug 于 2026-08-20 再次触发**,且形态更严重。新报错:`seq gap at line 12736 (expected 225878, got 225875)`。分析发现日志含**两处重叠区域 + 一处乱序插入**:

1. **区域 A**(0..225877):turn 13 被用户中断,崩溃恢复追加 3 个合成收尾(`tool/result` TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN@225875、`step/end`@225876、`turn/end` interrupted@225877)——与第一次完全相同的模式;
2. **区域 B**(225875..235973):turn 13 以陈旧游标恢复续写:真实 `tool/result`@225875、`step/end`@225876、**乱序插入的 `session/end-seed`@225878**(其 seq 与分片流冲突,写在 `step/start`@225877 之前)、steps 2-9 真实执行,`step/start`@235973(step 10)后进程被杀、无任何收尾;
3. **区域 C**(225879..251360):重新加载后,用户挂起的"继续"消息被拼入 inbox(`agent/inbox/spliced`,target next-turn),`turn/start`@14 → turn 14(completed)→ turn 15(completed),日志结束。

第二次修复(内容零丢失):删除 3 个合成收尾 + 1 个乱序 `session/end-seed`,区域 C 重编号 +10095 与区域 B 尾部衔接 → 261,456 事件,seq 0..261455 连续,末事件 `turn/end@261455 completed`。已验证:真实 `readPrefix` 通过、GUI `session.history` 返回 ok。唯一不平衡为 turn 13 未关闭(step 10 启动后进程死亡),读端全部容忍。

**结论:同一会话两次损坏、形态一次比一次复杂,强烈指向写端系统缺陷**(崩溃恢复路径 `commitRepair` 与实时写入路径的 seq 游标不同步,且无任何防护拦截重叠写入)。建议优先修复写端,并考虑在追加时校验"incoming seq 与文件已提交长度一致"。

## 备注

- 会话 id：`session-37374e34-e3c7-4a0e-a67b-5d1e2522d403`
- 损坏日志备份：`~/.dsh/sessions/--C-Users-...--/session-37374e34-.../session.jsonl.zstd.corrupt-bak`(第一次)、`...corrupt-bak2`(第二次)
[Uploading DSH-BUG-REPORT-attachments.zip…]()

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness Desktop for .NET — full runtime bundled, download & run｜求测 macOS Intel (x64) / Windows 真机 🙏
discussions.body: Hi everyone! I built a **.NET (C#) desktop client** for DeepSeek Harness: **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** — the terminal user never needs to install Node or DeepSeek Harness. The app bundles the full runtime (Node binary + `@deepseek-ai/dsh` closure) and launches `dsh web` in a private `DSH_HOME` inside a native system-WebView shell. **Download & run.** Key features: - ⚡ **Zero-setup** — bundled Node + dsh closure (falls back to a PATH `dsh` if present) - 🔒 **Lightweight native shell** — C# backend on system WebView (WebView2 / WKWebView / WebKitGTK), NativeAOT-ready, deny-by-default capability sandbox - 🔄 **Crash self-healing** — supervises the dsh child process; on crash it auto-restarts in the same window with a **stable port**, so you land back in your previous conversation - 🧩 **Plugin market pre-installed** — `dsh-market` bundled, auto-installs on first launch (1200+ plugins searchable) ### Platforms | Platform | CI-built | Real-device tested | |---|---|---| | Linux x64 / arm64 | ✅ | ✅ (self) | | macOS arm64 | ✅ | ⚠️ limited | | **macOS Intel (x64)** | ✅ | ❌ **needs your help!** | | **Windows x64** | ✅ | ❌ **needs your help!** | I don't have an Intel Mac or a Windows machine, so the **macOS-x64 and Windows packages are only CI-built and self-checked — never tested on real hardware**. If you're on either platform, please give it a try and report back — **even a "it just works" reply is valuable** 🙏 ### How to help 1. Download your platform package from **Releases** → 2. Install — packages are **unsigned** (open source, no paid signing): - macOS: Gatekeeper → right-click **Open** (or System Settings → Privacy & Security → Open Anyway) - Windows: SmartScreen → More info → **Run anyway** 3. Try: launch the app, open a session, install a plugin from the market, kill/restart it… 4. Report: file an issue with the **Test Feedback** template (OS / package / version fields pre-structured) → — or just reply in this discussion. Repo → · README → 中英双语 --- 大家好！我用 .NET（C#）给 DeepSeek Harness 做了个桌面客户端： **DeepSeek Harness Desktop** —— 终端用户**无需安装 Node / DeepSeek Harness**，应用内置完整运行时（Node 二进制 + `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 依赖闭包），在私有 `DSH_HOME` 里拉起 `dsh web`，跑在原生系统 WebView 壳里，**下载即开即用**。 特点： - ⚡ **零环境** —— 内置 Node + dsh 闭包（缺内置时回退 PATH dsh） - 🔒 **原生轻量壳** —— C# 后端跑系统 WebView（WebView2 / WKWebView / WebKitGTK），NativeAOT 就绪，能力沙箱 deny-by-default - 🔄 **崩溃自愈** —— 监督运行时子进程：崩溃 → 自动重启 → 同一窗口、**端口保持稳定**，回到之前对话 - 🧩 **插件市场预装** —— `dsh-market` 随包，首启静默安装（1200+ 插件可搜一键装） ### 平台状态 | 平台 | CI 出包 | 真机测试 | |---|---|---| | Linux x64 / arm64 | ✅ | ✅（自测） | | macOS arm64 | ✅ | ⚠️ 有限 | | **macOS Intel (x64)** | ✅ | ❌ **求测！** | | **Windows x64** | ✅ | ❌ **求测！** | 我没有 Intel Mac 和 Windows 机器，所以 **macOS x64 和 Windows 的包只有 CI 出包 + 自检，从未上过真机**。这两个平台的朋友麻烦帮忙试试，**哪怕回一句「能跑」都很有价值** 🙏 ### 怎么帮忙 1. 从 **Releases** 下载对应平台安装包 → 2. 安装（开源项目**未签名**）： - macOS：Gatekeeper → 右键「打开」（或 系统设置 → 隐私与安全性 → 仍要打开） - Windows：SmartScreen → 更多信息 → 仍要运行 3. 试用：启动、开会话、市场装插件、杀掉进程看自愈…… 4. 反馈：用 **Test Feedback / 测试反馈** 模板提 Issue（平台/包格式/版本已结构化）→ ，或直接回帖。 仓库 → · README 中英双语
