| pnpm store | `~/Library/pnpm/store/v11` |
| DSH_HOME | 未设置,默认 `~/.dsh` |

## 复现步骤

```sh
# 1. 全局安装 CLI
pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh
# (注:pnpm add -g @deepseek-ai/dsh@latest 曾错误地装回 0.1.0-rc.8,
#  即使 registry 的 latest 标签就是 0.1.1-rc.2;改用锁版本号安装才成功)

# 2. 创建 demo profile 并加入一个 bundle 插件(hello-plugin,声明了 dsh.bundle)
cd /path/to/hello-plugin   # 一个含 package.json + dsh.bundle.patch 的普通 npm 包目录
dsh plugin --profile demo add ./hello-plugin

# 3. 验证组合层 —— 正常
dsh --profile demo --dump-config
# 输出:先 "# == @deepseek-ai/dsh-base"(约 78 行),再 "# == dsh-hello-plugin"(hello 行)

# 4. 启动 —— 失败
dsh --profile demo
# 同样:dsh web 也失败
```

## 期望行为

`dsh --profile demo` 启动 demo profile(加载 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-base` 组合 + hello-plugin),`dsh web` 打开 Web UI。

## 实际行为

启动失败,报错模式固定为(以 0.1.1-rc.2 为例,失败条目集合随环境变化,后详):

```
Error: failed to import loader entry ui-goal (@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-goal):
Cannot find package '@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-goal' imported from
/Users/hhhawenzztt/Library/pnpm/store/v11/links/@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/1.0.2/133f7d7...2601/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/cordis-plugin-loader/lib/index.js
  [cause]: Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package ... (code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND')
```

discussions.title: DSH: agent dispose / compaction preempts in-flight tool calls and drops results
discussions.body:
# DSH: in-flight tool calls lose their results when the host process restarts or the agent is disposed

**Category:** Idea / Bug report
**Environment:** DSH `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.1` (web profile, systemd-managed), model `deepseek-v4-flash`, plugin `graph-memory 1.6.0-beta.1` (bge-m3 vectors)

## Summary

When the web host process is killed/restarted (`dsh restart`, `systemctl restart`, manual kill) or an agent turn is cancelled by disposal/compaction, a bash tool call that is already executing never gets its result persisted. On session recovery the repair pass synthesizes `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` ("The tool call was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded"), so the model sees "interrupted" even though the command usually completed with side effects. In a long working session this repeatedly interrupts tasks and makes executed commands appear to have "not run".

## Evidence (real session log, DSH web)

25 occurrences of `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN` in one session file, **all on `bash`**:

- **All 25** are immediately followed by `session/end-seed` — i.e. they coincide with web host restart / session archive cycles.
- **7 of 25** are also preceded by `agent/inbox/spliced { outcome: "canceled" }` — i.e. the turn was cancelled mid-flight (disposal / compaction path).

Typical sequence (timestamps = event `time`):

```
00:31:23.315 tool/call   bash  python3 - <<'EOF' ...
00:31:24.832 agent/inbox/spliced outcome="canceled"
00:31:24.832 tool/result id=interrupted-tool-result-...   error: ToolOutcomeUnknownError / TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
00:31:24.832 turn/end   reason={"kind":"interrupted"}
00:31:49.244 session/end-seed
```

```
10:10:44.340 tool/call   bash  /usr/local/bin/dsh restart
10:10:44.340 tool/result id=interrupted-tool-result-...   error: ToolOutcomeUnknownError / TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN
10:10:44.340 turn/end   reason={"kind":"interrupted"}
10:10:53.862 session/end-seed
```

## Mechanism (code refs)

- Host restart kills the web process mid-tool. The tool result was never durably written to the session log, so recovery's repair pass closes the dangling `tool/call` with a synthetic result: `packages/core/session/src/repair.ts:104` (`TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`).
- Disposal of an agent cancels the active turn and aborts in-flight tools: `packages/core/agent-loop/src/index.ts` `dispose()` → `machine.cancel({ kind: 'disposed' })` → phase abort → `packages/shell/tool-bash/src/index.ts` throws `HarnessError('tool call aborted', TOOL_ABORTED)`.
- Contributing factor we found and fixed (plugin side): graph-memory recall injected ~310 KB of graph dump per user message in a long session (411 active nodes), which saturated the context window and made compaction fire far more often — see adoresever/graph-memory#77 (now query-targeted recall, injection down to a few KB).

## Suggested directions

1. **Persist tool results promptly**: for bash (and other side-effectful tools), write the result as soon as the process exits, and make the host's graceful shutdown drain or wait (short grace) for in-flight tool calls instead of dying mid-persist.
2. **Boundary-only cancellation**: when disposal/compaction cancels a turn, prefer cancelling at turn boundaries; if a tool call was already dispatched, either let it finish (bash is usually near completion) or surface "command may still have executed — verify before retrying" (the model-facing text already says this).
3. **Richer repair metadata**: in `repair.ts`, distinguish "tool call dispatched but never started" vs "dispatched and possibly executed" so callers can choose to verify side effects rather than retry blindly.

4. **Resume-aware session restore**: after a host restart, surface to the model a short summary of the last un-closed turn (what the in-flight tool was doing, which files it touched, what the goal was) so the agent can automatically detect and continue unfinished work instead of the user having to re-state it. An agent-side convention (a persistent `TASKS.md` + a "check last interrupted turn first" discipline) works locally, but a platform-provided resume hint would make recovery reliable across compactions too.

Happy to provide the full session excerpt, a minimal reproduction (host restart mid-`sleep` in a bash tool), or a proposed patch for the drain-on-shutdown behavior.

## Working implementation (draft)

Since external PRs are currently not accepted (per CONTRIBUTING), here is a
ready-to-apply draft implementing suggestion 4 (resume-aware session restore):

- Patch: `feat/session-recovery-hint` on github.com/evilh2019/deepseek-harness (or on request)
- Scope: `packages/session/session-persistence/src/coordinator.ts` (`buildRecoverySummary` +
  injection into synthetic closers in `prepareCore`), `packages/llm/llm/src/message.ts`
  (`form: 'recovery'` source variant)
- Behavior: when a torn tail is repaired, inject a plugin `user/message` naming the last
  assistant goal (≤200 chars) and the last `tool/call` (name + args ≤120 chars); the hint is
  persisted with the closers so a later cold reload keeps it.
- Tests: 877 pass, including a strongest-tier case driven from a REAL interrupted turn
  extracted from a live session log through the real JSONL backend (write → repair → reload).
- Note: this pairs with adoresever/graph-memory#77 (recall injection was dumping ~310KB of
  graph per message in long sessions, which made compaction fire far more often).

## Additional: session-log storage hygiene (related)

Long sessions accumulate huge single-file logs. Measured on one real session
(240+ turns): 82K events, ~34MB zstd. Breakdown: **81% of events are streaming
chunks** (`reasoning-chunks` / `assistant/chunk` / `tool-call-chunks` /
`text-chunks` = model output intermediate states), which after compression are
~45% of the file size. The rest is real content (messages, tool calls/results).

Suggestions:
1. **Store real content only in the main log**; keep streaming chunks in a
   separate sidecar (or drop them for replay — the final `assistant/message`
   already carries the completed content).
2. **Rotate/archive by size or day**: split a session's log into segments
   (e.g. per 5–10MB or per day) instead of one ever-growing file, so load and
   crash-tail repair stay bounded. A multi-file format with a stable revision
   (like the existing per-session directory) keeps replay simple.
3. This also bounds the recovery cost: our resume-hint suggestion relies on
   reading the tail, which should stay small.

discussions.title: 模型在长上下文下陷入无限复读循环，客户端无自动中断（无重复检测、reasoning 无上限）——建议增加防护机制
discussions.body:
关键词：复读循环 / 重复输出 / reasoning 无上限 / 长上下文

现象：
- 长会话（约 70 万 token 上下文、95 轮）中，模型的 reasoning 流开始无限重复同一符号串（形如 ！！：！！：）。客户端持续写入该垃圾流约 22 分钟、约 13 万 token，无任何自动停止。
- 期间 UI 一直转圈；刷新页面也无法停止后台生成，只能手动点"停止生成"或强杀进程止损。
- 同一会话复现两次（第 95、96 轮；第二次约 3.7 分钟、2.5 万 token 后被手动停止）。

已排查（源码证据）：
- dsh-llm-deepseek 仅有"流空闲超时"（默认 300 秒），只在流完全无数据时触发；复读时流持续有数据，永不触发。
- maxTokens（256000）只约束最终回答；reasoning token 单独计数，不受该上限约束。
- agent-loop 与 LLM 层均无"输出重复检测"（如连续 N 个 chunk 相同，应自动中止）。
- 无"上下文使用率"水位警告（如超过窗口约 70% 时提示用户开新会话）。

建议：
1. 重复/停滞检测：流式接收层检测，连续 N 个 chunk 完全相同（或相似度超阈值）即自动中止生成，并标记为"异常终止"。
2. reasoning 流上限：设置独立硬上限，或将 reasoning token 纳入 maxTokens 统一计算，防止思考流无限增长。
3. 上下文水位警告：使用率超过约 70% 时提示用户开新会话，可附带一键复制会话摘要。
4. 停止按钮可用性：页面重连后，对 running 状态应仍可执行停止/取消（当前刷新后只能干等）。

影响：直接造成用户 token/额度损失（单次约 13 万 token 浪费），且长上下文 agent 场景复现概率高，建议尽快补上自动防护。

环境：DeepSeek API，模型 deepseek-v4-flash，reasoning_effort=high，maxTokens=256000，上下文约 70 万/100 万 token。可提供会话日志。

discussions.title: Windows: full test suite fails with default 5s timeouts under parallel execution
discussions.body:
## Summary

Running `pnpm test` on Windows (win32 x64, Node.js v22) causes multiple test files to fail with Vitest timeout errors. All of these tests pass individually (`npx vitest run <file>`), but fail when run as part of the full parallel suite due to the 5-second default `testTimeout`.

## Affected test files

- `scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts` — 7 failures, all timeout-related
- `scripts/translation-pairing-merge.spec.ts` — 1 failure at 15s timeout
- `packages/client/ui-primitives/tests/code-block.client.spec.tsx` — 1 failure at 5s timeout
- `packages/subagent/subagent-codex/tests/real-product.spec.ts` — intermittent failure

## Reproduction steps

1. Clone the repository on Windows.
2. Run `pnpm install` and `pnpm run build`.
3. Run `pnpm test`.
4. Observe ~9 timeout-related failures across 4-5 test files.
5. Run any affected file individually (e.g., `npx vitest run scripts/oxlint-contract.spec.ts`) and confirm it passes.

## Expected behavior

The full test suite should pass on Windows, or tests that spawn subprocesses should have a longer or configurable timeout to account for slower I/O and process startup on Windows.

## Actual behavior

Tests involving `spawnSync`, file I/O, or lazy dynamic imports exceed the 5s (or 15s for the translation merge test) timeout when CPU is contended by parallel workers. The same tests pass in isolation.

## Environment

- OS: Windows 11 x64
- Node.js: v22.x
- pnpm: v11.7.0
- Vitest: v4.1.8
- Commit: master @ 2026-08-21

discussions.title: Compaction can repeatedly fail when its one-shot summary input exceeds the summary model context
discussions.body:
## Symptom

Automatic compaction can trigger above the configured pressure threshold but fail to land a checkpoint. The log reports `step compaction failed: ... context overflow ...; continuing the turn`, and subsequent turns keep replaying the same over-budget surface.

## Root cause

`dsh-compaction-basic` selects a compactable surface prefix, then replays that complete prefix in one auxiliary summary request. The selected prefix can itself exceed the summary target context window. Provider `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED` is caught by the automatic listener, so the durable surface remains unchanged and the next step repeats the failure. Installing an alternate Provider does not fix the shipped default presets because they continue mounting `@deepseek-ai/dsh-compaction-basic` in the isolated compaction realm.

## Proposed fix

Keep the existing cache-reusing one-shot request unchanged when estimated input plus its output cap fits. Otherwise, or when that fitting request receives canonical `CONTEXT_WINDOW_EXCEEDED`, use bounded chronological map/reduce internally:

- group source messages without splitting tool calls from results
- greedily map chunks under the summary model input budget
- recursively reduce structured partial checkpoints
- bisect only a Provider-rejected span and retain successful siblings
- fail closed on truncation, malformed/visual output, cancellation, no progress, depth exhaustion, or an indivisible overflow
- preserve one-call provenance and aggregate usage only when complete and honest
- make no durable replacement until the complete hierarchy succeeds

Adapters without context capacity metadata retain the existing one-shot behavior; capacity becomes required only if that call overflows and bounded recovery is needed.

## Verification and implementation

Fork implementation and tests: https://github.com/aka-danielZhang/deepseek-harness/pull/9

The focused `dsh-compaction-basic` suite passes 153 tests with 100% statements, branches, functions, and lines. Full Harness typecheck and build pass. The fitting one-shot request shape, target precedence, `maxTokens`, raw output, and KV-cache behavior remain covered as compatibility contracts.

discussions.title: 网关 finish_reason: network_error 未被重试（根因 + 已测试修复 + 过渡插件）
discussions.body:
## 问题现象

在 OpenAI 兼容网关（如 OpenCode Zen）后面，turn 会直接硬失败，错误串恒定：

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

网关把自身上游连接的瞬时失败作为流的 `finish_reason` 上报；立即重试几乎总能成功（同类报告见 anomalyco/opencode#41236）。dsh 把该失败归类为不可重试，于是整个 turn 硬失败而不是重试——一次真实会话中，subagent 通道连续 8 次都挂在这个串上。

## 根因

两个 adapter 把线上 `finish_reason` 翻译成错误码，都漏掉了 network 变体：

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 把未知 `finish_reason` 映射为 `stopReason: 'error'`，errorMessage 为 `Provider finish_reason: network_error`（`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js` 的 `mapStopReason`）。随后 `classifyPiAiError`（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`）用 `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` 匹配——但 `\b` 在 `k` 与 `_` 之间不成立（下划线是 word 字符），`network_error` 落到 `PI_AI_ERROR`，而它不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 里。`llm-retry` 放行，turn 失败。
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason`（`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`）把未知 reason 大写化为失败码：`network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`，同样不在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`。

## 参照

opencode 在 2026-08-21 修复了同样的网关行为：

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — 可重试正则从 `network error` 扩为 `network[-_\s]error`，覆盖连字符/下划线变体。
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — finish-step 事件 `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` 时按失败处理，进入既有重试管线（测试断言第 2 次尝试成功）。

## 修复（已备好，已测试）

由于仓库当前不接受外部 PR，修复已在 fork 分支上完成并充分测试：

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`：`classifyPiAiError` 在既有 alternation 之前增加显式的 `/network[-_ ]error/i` 分支，三种拼写都归 `TRANSPORT`。既有匹配（AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/流截断/ECONN*/terminated/premature close）全部不动。
- `llm-deepseek`：`mapFinishReason` 把 `network_error` / `network-error` 映射为 `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`。

`TRANSPORT` 已在 `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` 中，无需改动 retry policy。

测试：`llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts` 扩展了 transport wording 表；`llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts` 增加 `mapFinishReason` 用例。`vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 全过；`pnpm run typecheck` → 干净。如果团队愿意合入，我可以随时 rebase/调整。

## 已发布版本的过渡插件

给已发布版本用户的插件（在 `agent/request-error` waterfall 末端重试这类失败，仅当所有下游 listener 都弃权时才行动）：

- 仓库：https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry
- npm：`@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0`（`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`）

它的 e2e 用真实 agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter 打一个脚本化网关（前两次请求回 `finish_reason: network_error`），断言第三次完成 turn。基础修复合入后该插件自然无害：它只在整个 waterfall 弃权时行动，且绝不触碰 llm-retry 自身的计数。已在真实 dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI 宿主上验证——见下方更新评论。

## 效果

修复后，网关 `network_error` 在两条 adapter 路径上都归为 `TRANSPORT`，落入默认可重试码，`llm-retry` 以标准有界指数退避自动重试（5 次，500 ms→10 s）。既有 `llm/retry` 事件消费者（TUI）无需任何改动即可展示重试。

<details>
<summary>English version</summary>

## Problem

Behind OpenAI-compatible gateways (e.g. OpenCode Zen), a turn fails outright with:

```
Provider finish_reason: network_error
```

The gateway reports its own transient upstream connection failure as the stream's `finish_reason`; retrying immediately usually succeeds (same class of reports as anomalyco/opencode#41236). dsh classifies this failure as non-retryable, so the whole turn hard-fails instead of retrying — in one real session the subagent channel hit this string 8 times in a row.

## Root cause

Two adapters turn the wire `finish_reason` into an error code, and both miss the network variant:

1. **llm-pi-ai** — pi-ai 0.82 maps an unknown `finish_reason` to `stopReason: 'error'` with `errorMessage: 'Provider finish_reason: network_error'` (`@earendil-works/pi-ai` `api/openai-completions.js`, `mapStopReason`). `classifyPiAiError` (`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/stream.ts`) then tests `/\b(?:network|connection|socket|fetch)\b/` — but `\b` does not hold between `k` and `_` (underscore is a word character), so `network_error` falls through to `PI_AI_ERROR`, which `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES` does not include. `llm-retry` passes the failure through and the turn fails.
2. **llm-deepseek** — `mapFinishReason` (`packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`) uppercases unknown reasons into the failure code: `network_error` → `NETWORK_ERROR`, also not in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`.

## Reference

opencode hit and fixed the same gateway behavior on 2026-08-21:

- anomalyco/opencode@40282c1 — widen the retryable regex from `network error` to `network[-_\s]error`, covering the hyphen/underscore variants.
- anomalyco/opencode@e0b9e68 — fail the finish-step event when `rawFinishReason === "network_error"` so the existing retry pipeline handles it (test asserts the 2nd attempt succeeds).

## Fix (prepared, tested)

Since the repository does not accept external PRs at the moment, the fix is prepared and fully tested on a fork branch:

https://github.com/fan56/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/network-error-retryable

- `llm-pi-ai`: `classifyPiAiError` gains an explicit `/network[-_ ]error/i` arm ahead of the existing alternation, classifying all three spellings as `TRANSPORT`. The existing matches (AUTH/quota/429/4xx/5xx/timeout/stream-truncation/ECONN*/terminated/premature close) are untouched.
- `llm-deepseek`: `mapFinishReason` maps `network_error`/`network-error` to `{kind:'error', failure:{message:'model stopped: <reason>', code:'TRANSPORT'}}`.

`TRANSPORT` is already in `DEFAULT_RETRYABLE_CODES`, so no retry-policy change is needed.

Tests: transport-wording table extended in `llm-pi-ai/tests/convert.spec.ts`; `mapFinishReason` cases in `llm-deepseek/tests/translate.spec.ts`. `vitest run packages/llm/llm-pi-ai packages/llm/llm-deepseek` → 608 passed; `pnpm run typecheck` → clean. Happy to rebase/adjust if the team wants to land it.

## Workaround plugin for released versions

A plugin for users on released versions (retries these failures at the end of the `agent/request-error` waterfall, only when every downstream listener declined):

https://github.com/fan56/dsh-llm-net-retry — also on npm as `@aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry@0.1.0` (`dsh plugin --profile tui add @aiwayds/dsh-llm-net-retry`).

Its e2e drives the real agent loop + `llm-pi-ai` `openai-completions` adapter against a scripted gateway failing the first two requests with `finish_reason: network_error` and asserts the turn completes on the third. The plugin stays harmless once the base fix lands: it only acts when the whole waterfall declined and never touches llm-retry's own counting. Now also validated on a real dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 TUI host — see the update comment below.

## Result

With the fix, a gateway `network_error` classifies as `TRANSPORT` on both adapter paths, falls inside the default retryable codes, and `llm-retry` retries it with the standard bounded exponential backoff (5 attempts, 500 ms→10 s). Existing `llm/retry` event consumers (TUI) surface the retries with no changes.

</details>

discussions.title: Windows: Native folder picker dialog is hidden (windowsHide: true) + DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER override
discussions.body:
### Summary
When running DeepSeek Harness on Windows (dsh web), clicking **"Choose workspace"** causes the application to hang/block without any file dialog appearing on screen.

### Root Cause
In packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-host.ts, spawnDialogWorker passes { windowsHide: true } to spawn():
`	s
spawn(process.execPath, [...], { env, stdio, windowsHide: true })
`
On Windows, windowsHide: true sets the SW_HIDE flag in the child process's STARTUPINFO. When dialog.show() (IModalWindow::Show) runs inside the worker process, Windows inherits SW_HIDE and creates the modal IFileOpenDialog in a hidden state, leaving the process waiting forever on an invisible window.

### Solution
1. **Fix Hidden Window**: Removed windowsHide: true from spawnDialogWorker in packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-host.ts.
2. **Backend Selection Override**: Added support for the DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER environment variable ( rowse | 
ative) in packages/host/directory-picker-auto/src/resolve.ts so users and CI can explicitly select the in-app Miller-column browser or OS dialog.
3. **Unit Tests**: Added test coverage for DSH_DIRECTORY_PICKER in packages/host/directory-picker-auto/tests/resolve.spec.ts.

### Tested Reference Implementation
Full commit with all tests and linter passing (0 errors, 0 warnings across all test suites):
https://github.com/abhayzangir1/deepseek-harness/commit/6c760d5e846c38b1e853394bfcf786890ef3373b

Branch:
https://github.com/abhayzangir1/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/win32-directory-picker-visibility

discussions.title: 将可能影响主进程稳定的操作与数据隔离在主功能之外（故障隔离 + 独立修复通道）
discussions.body:
## 当前模式下，任何对会话/索引数据的异常修改都可能导致 dsh web 整体无法启动，且没有独立修复通道。

## 场景还原

1. 用户通过 Agent（或第三方工具）修改 ~/.dsh/sessions/ 与 ~/.dsh/storages/ 下的内部数据（如导入会话、调整索引）。
2. 某条记录格式与预期不符（无公开契约、无校验）。
3. dsh web 重启时全量加载这些文件 -> 解析失败 -> 整个 node 进程起不来。
4. GUI 无法访问 -> 无法通过界面修复 -> 只能靠外部工具手工恢复，无回滚机制。

## 价值假设

把"高风险操作"与"主功能"隔离，让单点数据异常不再拖垮整个服务，并始终保留可修复的入口。

## 建议的改进方向

1. **启动容错（数据层隔离）**：加载会话/索引时逐个尝试，坏数据跳过并移入 quarantine 目录，而不是整体崩溃；启动日志明确报告被隔离的数据。
2. **独立修复通道（恢复层）**：CLI 提供 dsh doctor（健康检查）/ dsh repair（自动备份回滚）等急救命令，GUI 不可用时仍有终端通道可恢复。
3. **数据操作走官方 API（操作层）**：会话导入/导出/删除等敏感操作提供官方 API 或 CLI 子命令（事务性、带 schema 校验），禁止外部直接写内部文件。
4. **进程隔离（进程层）**：Agent 的代码执行与 GUI 主进程分离（独立 worker/子进程），Agent 侧失败不影响主进程存活。
5. **自动备份与校验**：关键数据文件（workspace.json、session_projcache.json）写入时保留版本快照，启动时校验，失败自动回滚最近可用版本。

## 需要验证

- 坏会话隔离后，主列表是否正常展示其余会话？
- dsh repair 的备份策略（保留几份、存放位置、恢复粒度）如何设计最合理？
- 官方 API 的引入是否影响现有插件生态？

## 可能的后续工作

- 制定内部数据格式的稳定契约并文档化（便于第三方安全集成）。
- 提供官方会话导入导出功能（对接其他工具的会话迁移需求）。
- 增加启动自检（health check）与自动恢复的测试用例。

discussions.title: DSH｜dsh-plugin-airbag｜Circuit breaker + thinking watchdog: stop death loops, save tokens
discussions.body:
**项目地址**： https://github.com/missTangle/dsh-plugin-airbag
**项目介绍：**
  一个跑在 agent-loop 层的"智能安全气囊"，专门防 reasoning 模型（R1/DeepSeek-Reasoner）在坏掉的环境里死磕到底、烧光 Token。

  **能力：**
  - 重复报错熔断：基于稳定错误指纹（不是重复调用）识别"同一个错反复出现"，连续第 N次相同报错时熔断——注入刹车指令或拦掉下一次调用，逼模型停下来向你汇报。官方 repeat-tool-reminder只比对调用参数、不读错误，抓不到"参数在变、错误不变"的环境坏死。
  - 思维链看门狗：监测 reasoningTokens 是否失控（web UI 看不见的静默烧钱），超标先 Nudge、累计超阈值自动降档，停止无谓推理。

  **与 DSH 的集成方式：**
  bundle 插件，一键安装自动激活：
  dsh plugin --profile <name> add https://github.com/missTangle/dsh-plugin-airbag
  工作于 agent-loop 层，监听 tools/post-execute、agent/request-error、session/event、agent/request——任何走工具调用 / 思考的 DSH agent 都能被守护。已在真实 DeepSeek 下验证（flash 连续报错 → 第 2 次相同错误弹气囊）。配置项走 profile 的 cordis.yml。
 ▎ > 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。

  **Repo:** https://github.com/missTangle/dsh-plugin-airbag

  **What it does:**
  A "smart airbag" on the agent-loop layer that stops reasoning models (R1 / DeepSeek-Reasoner) from retrying forever into a broken environment and burning tokens.

  - Repeated-error breaker: identifies the same error recurring via a stable error fingerprint (not repeated calls), and on the Nth
  identical failure trips — injecting a stop instruction or blocking the next call. The official repeat-tool-reminder only compares
  call arguments and never reads the error, so it misses "changing arguments, same underlying error".
  - Thinking watchdog: monitors runaway reasoningTokens (silent cost the web UI can't show), nudges first, then auto-downgrades
  effort past the cumulative threshold.

  **Integration with DSH:** a bundle — one-command install, auto-activated:
  dsh plugin --profile <name> add https://github.com/missTangle/dsh-plugin-airbag
  Hooks the agent-loop (tools/post-execute / agent/request-error / session/event / agent/request), so any tool-calling / reasoning
  DSH agent is guarded. Verified against real DeepSeek.

 ▎ > Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community member.

discussions.title: Continuable (fork) subagents can call ask_user_question and block indefinitely; DELEGATED_CALLER guard is bypassed
discussions.body:
## Summary
A delegation tool bound to `backgroundMode: continuable` (e.g. the `subagent_fork` tool / `fork` provider) lets a **child agent call `ask_user_question` and block** until a human answers. Because the child is created through the continuation manager's neutral activation-owner scope (`this.ownerCtx.agents.create(...)`), it is registered **without a runtime `owner`**, so `AgentRegistry.roots()` treats it as a top-level root. The ownership guard in `ctx.userQuestions.ask()` (`DELEGATED_CALLER`) only fires when the calling agent is **not** in `roots()`, so continuable children bypass it. If the question lands in the child's own session and the user does not notice it, the child (and the parent turn) hangs indefinitely.

## Reproduction
Observed on dsh `0.1.1-rc.2` with the `standard`/`research` agent preset (`tool-subagent-fork`, `provider: fork`, `backgroundMode: continuable`).

A fork child called `ask_user_question` and only got a response after **~9.2 hours**, when the human manually answered it:
- `ask_user_question` call at `2026-08-22 01:47:01`
- response received at `2026-08-22 10:57:39` — `isError: false`, a real answer.

The child session log shows the tool call is immediately followed by a `tool/result`, so the block is at the wall-clock level (the tool awaited a human answer), not an error. A child in a hidden session can sit here for hours.

## Root cause
Two creation paths with different ownership:

- **One-shot** children: `startInProcessRun` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent-in-process-driver`, `packages/subagent/subagent-in-process-driver/src/index.ts`) creates the child via `parent.ctx.agents.create(...)`, so `owner = parent` → child is NOT in `roots()` → the guard fires → child gets `DELEGATED_CALLER`.
- **Continuable** children: `materializeTracked` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-subagent`, `packages/subagent/subagent/src/continuation.ts`) creates the child via `this.ownerCtx.agents.create(...)` (a private activation-owner scope), so the child is registered with `owner === undefined` → child **is** in `roots()` → the guard is bypassed → child can call `ask_user_question` and block.

`AgentRegistry.roots()` (`packages/core/agent/src/index.ts`) returns entries with `owner === void 0`; runtime ownership is derived from the calling scope's agent, and the continuation scope has none.

`ctx.userQuestions.ask()` (`packages/interaction/user-questions/src/index.ts`):
```
if (!agents.roots().includes(agent))
  throw new UserQuestionError("human interaction is unavailable while the calling agent is owned by another live agent; include the unresolved question or decision in the child agent's final result", "DELEGATED_CALLER");
```

## Expected behavior
A continuable child, like a one-shot child, must not be able to `ask_user_question`. It should get `DELEGATED_CALLER` (and be told to fold the unresolved question into its final result), so no child can block waiting on a human it cannot reach.

## Proposed fix
Set the runtime `owner` on continuable children to their parent when creating them through the continuation manager (mirroring what `parent.ctx.agents.create` does in the one-shot driver), so `AgentRegistry.roots()` excludes them and the existing guard fires. Alternatively, key the guard on subagent ownership/lineage rather than `agents.roots()`.

## Workaround (config only, no code)
On the delegation tool rows in the agent preset:
```yaml
toolFilter:
  deny: [ ask_user_question ]
```
This removes the tool from every child's scope so no child can ask. The parent (root) agent keeps `ask_user_question`.

## Environment
- dsh `0.1.1-rc.2`
- `fork` provider, `backgroundMode: continuable`, `subagent_fork` tool
- Agent preset: `standard` (user copy)

discussions.title: Streaming tool calls fail when later deltas send an empty name
discussions.body:
## Summary

A local Web session on `dsh web` fails every model tool call with:

```text
Error: unknown tool ""
```

The browser connection and tool catalog are healthy: `/api/host.describe` returns 200 and the request header contains the expected tool names (`bash`, `read`, `grep`, etc.). The persisted `tool/call` events, however, contain `name: ""` for the failed calls.

## Reproduction

The upstream DeepSeek-compatible streaming response can emit tool-call deltas like:

```json
{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"name":"bash","arguments":""}}]}
{"tool_calls":[{"index":0,"function":{"name":"","arguments":"{\\"command\\":\\"pwd\\"}"}}]}
```

The first delta supplies the valid name; a later delta repeats an empty name.

In `packages/llm/llm-deepseek/src/translate.ts`, the translator currently does:

```ts
if (call.function?.name !== undefined) block.name = call.function.name
```

The empty later value overwrites `bash`, so the executor receives an empty tool name and reports `unknown tool ""`.

## Suggested fix

Only update the accumulated name for a non-empty value:

```ts
if (call.function?.name) block.name = call.function.name
```

A regression test should cover a `bash` name followed by an empty-name delta.

Is this empty repeated `name` expected behavior from the compatible gateway, and should the adapter tolerate it as above?

discussions.title: [Unofficial] dsh-llm-auto-vision — auto-switch DeepSeek route to the vision model on demand
discussions.body:
> **⚠️ Unofficial / 非官方**: third-party plugin, independently maintained; not reviewed or endorsed by DeepSeek.
> 第三方插件，独立维护，未经 DeepSeek 官方审核或推荐。

# dsh-llm-auto-vision

A small host-plane plugin that **automatically points requests at `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`** whenever images enter session history — so you never need to `/model`-switch by hand before a picture task (reading a web-page image, analyzing a WeChat article's screenshots, interpreting a chart, etc.).

## Why

DeepSeek accepts image input only on `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`; the harness `read_image` tool refuses to run under a route whose model does not declare image input. A flash-routed session currently requires a manual model switch before any image task, and the agent itself has no model-switching tool.

## How it works

Three on-demand triggers on the agent loop (official extension points, same pattern as `dsh-llm-retry`). Each rewrites `model` to the vision model; pure-text requests keep the original model, so KV-cache behavior is unchanged.

- **`agent/request` — user-message pre-emption (v0.3)**: when a user message arrives, predict ahead of any tool call whether the task will need vision. It switches immediately when the message carries:
  - a link (`mp.weixin.qq.com` / `http(s)://` / `www.`) **plus** an analysis verb (分析/看看/识别/解读/检查/评估/总结/阅读/读/提取/解释), or
  - an image-noun (图片/图像/截图/照片/画面/图表/示意图/架构图/海报/扫描件/OCR/二维码/热榜/封面), or
  - a direct visual action (看图/识别图/提取图片/读图 etc.).
  So handing the agent a WeChat / web link to analyze already lands on the vision route — no failed `read_image` first.
- **`agent/request` — history look-back**: scans the agent's durable session events **backwards** (first hit stops) and switches when history carries image blocks, `read_image` tool calls (including refusals whose failure text names image input), or vision-intent user text.
- **`agent/request-error` — fallback**: on a fatal failure of the switched route (`AUTH` / `FORBIDDEN` / `NO_ADAPTER` / `SERVER` / `INVALID_REQUEST`) it retreats **once** to the original model, so a session recovers instead of looping on a dead route.

The vision model is priced the same as flash, so the switch is effectively cost-neutral. No durable session events are appended; the switch surfaces through the existing `request/header` change record.

## Complete switching pipeline

**A — user hands a link / image task (pre-emption path)**
```
user message (link + analysis verb, or image noun) → plugin switches route to vision
→ agent calls read_image → succeeds immediately → picture enters context → task continues
```

**B — images discovered mid-task (self-healing path)**
```
task in progress on flash → agent searches/fetches and finds a picture that must be read
→ agent calls read_image (first attempt, flash route) → tool/call + failure recorded in history
→ plugin looks back, sees the read_image call → switches route to vision on the next request
→ agent retries read_image → succeeds → picture enters context → task continues (uninterrupted)
```


## Config (all optional)

```yaml
- id: auto-vision
  name: dsh-auto-vision          # local plugin package
  config:
    enabled: true                # default
    targetProviders: ["deepseek-official", "deepseek"]
    targetModel: deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp
    intentEnabled: true
    intentPattern: "..."         # override built-in intent vocabulary
```

## Status

- 11 unit + real-Loader composition tests passing; `tsc -b tsconfig.host.json`, oxlint, and translation-pairing all clean.
- Source is live on the fork branch (pushed and accessible):
  **https://github.com/k2d5rqjpkg-art/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/llm-auto-vision**
  prepared as an upstream-style package (`packages/llm/llm-auto-vision` + base-bundle registration + bilingual README + Agent Note). The PR is not open from this account (the org's pulls endpoint 404s for me); maintainers are welcome to take this branch.

## Feedback welcome!

Happy to iterate on detection heuristics, the config surface, fallback behavior, or anything else. If the maintainers would prefer this as an upstream feature, I'd be glad to adjust the design (e.g. task-complexity upgrade matrix, context-window-aware switching) accordingly.

discussions.title: Provider model catalogs are stale for OpenCode Go and OpenRouter
discussions.body:
Tested with `@deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.1-rc.2` and the Open Design profile on Linux. The active DSH catalog exposed 16 OpenCode Go models while the authenticated provider `/models` endpoint returned 29. OpenRouter exposed 276 while its public `/models` endpoint returned 420; the static catalog also retained 11 IDs no longer returned live. Updating the nested compatible `@earendil-works/pi-ai` dependency from 0.82.1 to 0.84.2 improved this only partially (19 and 346 respectively).

The root behavior appears intentional but surprising: `dsh-llm-pi-ai` documents `registerModelDiscovery` as UI-only candidate discovery, not an active catalog refresh, so routes with omitted `models` remain pinned to the installed pi-ai snapshot.

A validated local workaround is to materialize the live IDs into each provider profile and explicitly state transport metadata so unknown-to-catalog IDs resolve:

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    opencode-go:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENCODE_GO_API_KEY
      api: openai-responses
      baseURL: https://opencode.ai/zen/go/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
    openrouter:
      apiKeyEnv: OPENROUTER_API_KEY
      api: openai-completions
      baseURL: https://openrouter.ai/api/v1
      models:
        # exact live /models IDs
```

After applying the exact live snapshots, `dsh --profile open-design --models` reports 29/29 OpenCode Go and 420/420 OpenRouter IDs, including `gpt-5.6-luna`, `qwen3.8-max`, `muse-spark-1.2-contributor`, `google/gemini-3.7-flash`, `stealth/ox-alpha`, and `z-ai/glm-5.3`.

Could DSH offer an opt-in live-catalog policy (with timeout/cache/stale fallback), or a supported refresh/adopt command, for OpenAI-compatible routes? That would retain configuration as the source of truth while avoiding silent catalog drift.

discussions.title: Windows 桌面更新需等待后端退出再替换 node.exe
discussions.body:
Windows 桌面自动更新未等待后端退出，会导致安装失败并破坏下次启动。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 在 Windows 11 上启动 DeepSeek Harness 桌面端，保持其后端运行。
  2. 点击左上角 `Check Update`。
  3. 更新过程中出现 `node.exe` 写入失败提示，然后重新启动桌面端。
- 实际结果：
  - 桌面父进程退出后，旧的 `backend/node.exe` 仍持续运行并成为孤儿进程；现场观察到该进程从更新前一直存活。
  - Windows 锁住正在执行的 `node.exe`，更新器继续尝试覆盖该文件，因而进入部分文件已更新、后端未完整替换的状态。
  - 下一次启动报错：

    ```text
    Failed to load plugins
    failed to import loader entry 5c9037e3 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry): client-modules: bundle script /plugins/@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry/client.js?rev=f41d56e0b747 failed to load
    ```

  - 结束孤儿桌面/后端进程后再干净启动，插件路由恢复 `200`；`client.js` 文件存在且语法、哈希一致，因此故障点是更新时的进程生命周期，而不是插件包本身损坏。
- 预期结果：
  - 替换安装文件前，更新器应通知后端退出，并等待整个后端进程树结束及 `backend/node.exe` 解锁。
  - 若等待超时，应在替换任何组件前中止更新并给出明确提示，或完整回滚，不能留下部分更新状态。
- 环境：
  - Windows 11 专业版 `10.0.22000`，x64。
  - DeepSeek Harness Desktop `0.2.2`；内置 `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 与 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-typert-registry` 为 `0.1.1-rc.2`。
  - 使用非系统盘自定义安装目录。
- 验收条件：
  - 后端运行期间执行 Windows 桌面更新，旧后端必须在文件替换前退出。
  - 不再出现 `node.exe` 写入失败，更新失败时旧版本仍可正常启动。
  - 更新后只存在一套桌面父进程和后端子进程，插件 loader 正常完成启动。

</details>

discussions.title: Seeking Help: Two Interconnected Risk Assessment Projects for the New Phosphate Port in Annaba, Algeria
discussions.body:
Hello Harness Community,

I'm reaching out to invite collaboration on two interconnected risk assessment projects in Annaba, Algeria. Both projects revolve around the same critical question: What is the real threat to the new Phosphate Port and the surrounding region from the Bouhamdane Dam?

---

🌊 Project 1: The Catastrophic Scenario (Dam Failure)

The Problem: The Bouhamdane Dam, located 25 km west of Guelma, is a large earthen dam (capacity: 220 million m³) situated in an active seismic zone. In the event of a major earthquake or structural failure, a catastrophic release of water and silt would surge down the Wadi Seybous valley.

The Potential Impact:

· The flood would be channeled towards the new Phosphate Port in Annaba.
· The "Life Base" (the Chinese workers' camp for the port project) is built on a low-lying swamp, barely 1 meter above sea level. It was raised using landfill (approx. 5-6 meters), but this material is not compacted natural soil and would be highly vulnerable to erosion and collapse in a flood.
· The entire coastal area of Annaba and El Tarf could be inundated.

Project 1 Goal: To verify the hypothesis of catastrophic damage to the Phosphate Port and its "Life Base" from a Bouhamdane Dam failure.

Tasks:

1. Simulate the flood path from the dam to the sea.
2. Assess the potential structural damage to the port and the "Life Base".
3. Determine the margin of error in these estimations.

---

🌧️ Project 2: The Seasonal Flood Scenario (Similar to 2003)

The Problem: In 2003, authorities were forced to release a large volume of water from the Bouhamdane Dam to prevent a catastrophic failure, causing significant flooding. This scenario is more likely to recur than a full dam collapse.

The Potential Impact:

· Even a controlled release would inundate the "Life Base" area (which is built on a natural swamp).
· The remaining swamp area (not yet landfilled) would become stagnant water, creating a major health hazard (malaria, waterborne diseases) for both the workers and the local population.
· The port construction itself could be disrupted.

Project 2 Goal: To model the impact of a major seasonal flood (like 2003) on the region, focusing on the flooding of the "Life Base" and the resulting environmental and health risks.

Tasks:

1. Model the flood inundation of the "Life Base" area.
2. Identify the remaining swamp areas and their potential to become stagnant water pools.
3. Assess the public health risks (diseases, epidemics) arising from stagnant water.

---

🛠️ What I Have & What I Need

I have:

· A comprehensive file (in Markdown) containing all coordinates, analysis, and historical context for both projects.
· The file is ready to be fed into Harness (as a single, structured prompt).

I need:

· Someone with the skills and resources to run this file through Harness.
· Generate a Digital Terrain Model (MNT) of the area.
· Produce a 20-second timelapse video (2003-2026) showing the area's evolution.
· Generate a final PDF report for each project.

If you can help, or know someone who can, please reply here or reach out. I'm happy to share the complete file with anyone interested.

Thank you,

Markdown 1
# المشروع الأول: سيناريو انهيار سد بوحمدان – تقييم الأضرار الكارثية على ميناء الفوسفات الجديد و"قاعدة الحياة"

## 1. فرضية العمل الأساسية
نفترض أن حدوث تسرب خارج السيطرة (انهيار كارثي) من **سد بوحمدان الترابي**، الواقع في منطقة نشطة زلزالياً، قد يؤدي إلى أضرار جسيمة تهدد **مشروع ميناء الفوسفات الجديد** في عنابة، وخاصة **"قاعدة الحياة"** (الورشة الصينية) والمنطقة المحيطة.

## 2. السياق الجغرافي والهيدروليكي
- **سد بوحمدان:** يقع على بعد 25 كم غرب قالمة، بسعة تخزينية 220 مليون م³. هو سد ترابي، مما يجعله عرضة للانهيار في حالات الزلازل أو العيوب الهيكلية.
- **المسار الطبيعي:** يتجه مجرى وادي سيبوس من السد شمالاً نحو عنابة، ماراً بمناطق زراعية وحضرية قبل أن يصب في البحر المتوسط.
- **المشاريع المهددة:**
    - ميناء الفوسفات الجديد (حي سيبوس).
    - "قاعدة الحياة" (الورشة الصينية في بوخميرة – 36.851463, 7.801385).
    - حي سيبوس والمناطق السكنية المحيطة.
    - مصنع فرتيال (الأمونياك) والبنية التحتية الصناعية.

## 3. مسار الفيضان المحتمل في حالة انهيار السد
1. انهيار السد ← اندفاع المياه والطمي عبر وادي سيبوس.
2. تصطدم بجسر زياني أحمد (36.817492,7.775356) – جسر خرساني ضيّق المقطع، مما يسبب اختناقاً وارتفاعاً في منسوب المياه.
3. تفيض المياه وتتجه نحو النقاط:
    - **ك106** (36.850107) – معبر قناة تفريغ بحيرة بوخميرة.
    - **ك108** (36.838372,7.790736) – معبر آخر لبحيرة بوخميرة.
4. تتجمع مياه الفيضان في منطقة بحيرة بوخميرة، ثم تتجه نحو:
    - **قاعدة الحياة** (36.851463,7.801385).
    - **الطريق الوطني 44** (المرتفع) و**الطريق الجديد ق2** (36.842458,7.786902) – اللذان يعملان كسدود تحوّل المياه نحو القاعدة.
5. تصل المياه إلى **حي سيبوس** ومشروع **ميناء الفوسفات الجديد**.

## 4. نقاط الضعف في "قاعدة الحياة"
- الموقع الأصلي: مستنقع منخفض (حوالي 1 متر فوق سطح البحر).
- تم رفعه باستخدام مفرغة بلدية (تربة غير مدكوكة) إلى ارتفاع 5-6 أمتار.
- هذه التربة الاصطناعية غير مستقرة، ومعرضة للانهيار والتآكل في حال تعرضها لتيارات مائية قوية.

## 5. المهام المطلوب تنفيذها
1. **بناء نموذج رقمي للتضاريس (MNT)** للمنطقة الممتدة من سد بوحمدان إلى ميناء عنابة.
2. **محاكاة مسار الفيضان** في حالة انهيار السد، مع تحديد المناطق الأكثر عرضة للغمر.
3. **تقدير حجم الأضرار المحتملة**:
    - على ميناء الفوسفات.
    - على "قاعدة الحياة" (انهيار التربة، غمر المنشآت).
    - على حي سيبوس والبنية التحتية المجاورة.
4. **تحديد هامش الخطأ** في تقديرات الضرر.
5. **إنشاء فيديو مدته 20 ثانية** يظهر تطور المنطقة من 2003 إلى 2026، مع التركيز على التغيرات في مسارات المياه والبنية التحتية.
6. **توليد تقرير PDF نهائي** يحتوي على التحليل الكامل، وتقديرات الأضرار، والتوصيات.

## 6. الإحداثيات المرجعية
| النقطة | الإحداثيات | الوصف |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| سد بوحمدان | `36.460726, 6.997209` | موقع السد |
| دخول واد سيبوس إلى عنابة | `36.817547, 7.775407` | نقطة دخول الواد إلى عنابة |
| جسر زياني أحمد | `36.817492, 7.775356` | جسر خرساني ضيّق المقطع |
| ك106 | `36.850107` | معبر قناة تفريغ بحيرة بوخميرة |
| ك108 | `36.838372, 7.790736` | معبر قناة أخرى لبحيرة بوخميرة |
| ق2 | `36.842458, 7.786902` | نقطة التقاء الطريق الجديد (سد ارتفاع 3 متر) |
| قاعدة الحياة (الورشة) | `36.851463, 7.801385` | موقع الورشة الصينية |

## 7. التعليمات لـ Harness
**نفّذ المهمة كخطوة واحدة متكاملة، وقدّم النتائج في مجلد واحد (MNT، فيديو، PDF). ابدأ التنفيذ الآن.**

Markdown 2
# المشروع الثاني: سيناريو الفيضان الموسمي – تقييم تأثير فيضان 2003 ونماذجه على المنطقة

## 1. فرضية العمل الأساسية
نفترض أن حدوث فيضان موسمي كبير (مشابه لفيضان أبريل 2003) – نتيجة لتفريغ اضطراري من سد بوحمدان أو أمطار غزيرة – قد يؤدي إلى:
- غمر منطقة "قاعدة الحياة".
- ركود المياه في المستنقعات المتبقية، مما يخلق بيئة خصبة للأمراض والأوبئة.
- أضرار مؤقتة أو دائمة في البنية التحتية للميناء الجديد.

## 2. السياق التاريخي (فيضان 2003)
- في أبريل 2003، اضطرت السلطات إلى فتح بوابات سد بوحمدان بشكل اضطراري لتجنب انهياره.
- تسبب هذا التفريغ في فيضانات واسعة في ولايتي عنابة والطارف، مما أدى إلى خسائر مادية وبشرية.
- بعد الفيضان، تم تغيير مسارات المياه عبر إنشاء:
    - الطريق الوطني 44 (ارتفاع +80 سم).
    - جسر خرساني ضيق (جسر زياني أحمد) عوض الجسر المعدني القديم.
    - طريق جديد (ق2) يعمل كسد بارتفاع 3 متر.

## 3. الآثار المتوقعة لفيضان مماثل اليوم
- **غمر "قاعدة الحياة":** الموقع منخفض ويقع في مسار الفيضان المحتمل.
- **ركود المياه:** ستبقى المياه في المناطق المستنقعية المتبقية، مما يؤدي إلى:
    - تكاثر البعوض ونواقل الأمراض (الملاريا، حمى الضنك).
    - تلوث المياه الجوفية.
    - انتشار الروائح الكريهة والأمراض الجلدية بين العمال والسكان.
- **أضرار في البنية التحتية:** قد تتضرر الطرق، والجسور، وأنابيب المياه، وخطوط الكهرباء.

## 4. المهام المطلوب تنفيذها
1. **بناء نموذج رقمي للتضاريس (MNT)** للمنطقة.
2. **محاكاة فيضان مشابه لفيضان 2003**، مع تحديد مناطق الغمر المحتملة.
3. **تحديد المناطق المعرضة لركود المياه** (المستنقعات المتبقية).
4. **تقييم المخاطر الصحية** (الأمراض، الأوبئة) الناتجة عن ركود المياه.
5. **تقدير الأضرار المحتملة** على "قاعدة الحياة" والبنية التحتية المجاورة.
6. **إنشاء فيديو مدته 20 ثانية** يظهر تطور المنطقة من 2003 إلى 2026.
7. **توليد تقرير PDF نهائي** يحتوي على التحليل الكامل، وتقديرات الأضرار، والتوصيات الصحية والبيئية.

## 5. الإحداثيات المرجعية
| النقطة | الإحداثيات | الوصف |
| :--- | :--- | :--- |
| سد بوحمدان | `36.460726, 6.997209` | موقع السد |
| دخول واد سيبوس إلى عنابة | `36.817547, 7.775407` | نقطة دخول الواد إلى عنابة |
| جسر زياني أحمد | `36.817492, 7.775356` | جسر خرساني ضيّق المقطع |
| ك106 | `36.850107` | معبر قناة تفريغ بحيرة بوخميرة |
| ك108 | `36.838372, 7.790736` | معبر قناة أخرى لبحيرة بوخميرة |
| ق2 | `36.842458, 7.786902` | نقطة التقاء الطريق الجديد (سد ارتفاع 3 متر) |
| قاعدة الحياة (الورشة) | `36.851463, 7.801385` | موقع الورشة الصينية |

## 6. التعليمات لـ Harness
**نفّذ المهمة كخطوة واحدة متكاملة، وقدّم النتائج في مجلد واحد (MNT، فيديو، تقرير PDF). ابدأ التنفيذ الآن.**

discussions.body:
## 问题：升级 0.1.1-rc 后，Web UI 每轮 agent run 必失败；DSH Desktop 卡在 Loading plugins

**环境**：macOS (Apple M5) / node v24.15.0 / `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.1-rc.1（npx 缓存 `1f7e68c…`）与 rc.2（`de4831d60…`）**均可复现**。

### Web UI 症状
每轮运行在"上下文注入"（`dsh-system-prompt` + `skill-catalog`）后立即失败：

```
TypeError: registration.adapter.reprepareCall is not a function
```

### 已排除的（完整证据链可提供）
1. **版本无关**：rc.1 / rc.2 表现一致；两版 `dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js` diff 为空；同一天上午 rc.1 正常工作，10:37 切层后开始必现
2. **数据无关**：升级前快照全量回滚（sessions/data/storages/memories/settings/credentials）不影响报错
3. **插件无关**：停用 dsh-memory-evolve 插件无效果
4. **代码无法定位**：全盘搜索（全部 npx 缓存、共享层、web/desktop profile、plugin-src、隐藏目录、symlink）、服务端 serve 的全部 70 个 `/plugins/*/client.js`、浏览器 Sources 全量搜索——`reprepareCall` **零命中**；服务日志（stdout/stderr 合流）无此错误；会话文件也无

### 关联
与 #1677（ToolRuntime 调度器未实例化，`ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare` 缺失）同族——agent-loop 的 `registration.adapter.*` 链在运行期拿到的对象缺少方法。

### DSH Desktop (2.0.1)
启动时被 `dsh-credentials-local` schema 校验挡住（**旧构建要求 `version` 为字符串，0.1.1-rc.1 要求整数 `1`——两版互斥**）。将对齐到 rc.1（`version: 1`）后，插件树加载全部通过（dsh-browser / web-search-pro / dsh-market / change-ledger / skill-filesystem 均 loaded），但 **UI 永远停在 "Loading plugins..."**，日志在 12:23 后不再增长。

### 请求

discussions.title: [Bug] Community Market discovery always empty under fake-IP DNS proxies - catalog requests rejected as blocked-address, error flattened to generic 400
discussions.body:
### TL;DR (中文)

在 Clash/Mihomo 类代理的 fake-ip DNS 模式下，DSH Desktop 2.0.1 内置「社区插件市场」的目录抓取会被自身的 SSRF 防护拦截（`CatalogNetworkError: blocked-address`），接口层又将错误吞成统一的 400，导致「发现 / 可安装」永远为空且无任何提示。目前可通过 hosts 钉真实 IP 临时绕过。建议将 `syntheticProxyHostnames` 开放为可配置项并预置合作来源域名。

### Environment

- DSH Desktop 2.0.1 win32 (desktop host run on node v24.18.1)
- Windows 11 Pro；本机代理为 Clash 系工具，DNS 处于 **fake-ip 模式**（A 记录返回 `198.18.0.0/15`，AAAA 返回 `fdfe:dcba:9876::/64` 段）
- 市场来源：内置 "DSH 1024Store"（`https://deepseek1024.com/api/v1/plugins`，adapterId `market.dsh-1024store-v1`）

### Symptoms

- 设置 > 插件 > 插件市场：「发现」「可安装」列表恒为空，界面无任何错误提示
- `/api/community-market/state` 与 `/api/community-market/installations` 正常，仅 `/api/community-market/catalog` 失败
- 浏览器 / curl 直接访问上游目录 URL 完全正常（走系统代理隧道）

### Actual failure (reproduced with the shipped module, outside the app)

Running `dsh-community-market/lib/adapters/dsh-1024store.js#scanCatalog` with the shipped `createRestrictedHttpClient()`:

```
CatalogNetworkError - catalog request failed: blocked-address
    at assertSafeAddress        (lib/network/restricted-http.js:53)
    at resolvePinnedAddress     (lib/network/restricted-http.js:106)
    at resolveAddress           (lib/network/restricted-http.js:201)
    at fetchJson                (lib/network/restricted-http.js:169)
```

On this machine `deepseek1024.com` resolves to `198.18.1.18` / `fdfe:dcba:9876::108` — classic fake-ip ranges — which `assertSafeAddress` correctly classifies as non-public and rejects.

### Root cause

1. The restricted HTTP client pins DNS itself and runs an anti-SSRF address check; any reserved/synthetic address → `blocked-address`. Good fail-closed design for untrusted input.
2. But there IS an escape hatch: `syntheticProxyHostnames`. It is **compiled-in only for `registry.npmjs.org`** (`lib/index.js`); the catalog/media clients get no list, and there is no settings/env knob to extend it. So npm installs work fine while catalog discovery is dead on fake-ip setups.
3. Every `scanCatalog` failure (network, contract, whatever) is caught and flattened to `400 {"error":"invalid catalog query"}` (`lib/host/routes.js`), and nothing is written to the desktop log either — the real cause is invisible to users and supporters.

### Workaround that worked (no restart needed)

Pin the real IPs in the hosts file — note **both families must be pinned**, because `resolvePinnedAddress` rejects if ANY resolved entry is unsafe (pinning only IPv4 still leaves the poisoned AAAA):

```
104.21.87.154          deepseek1024.com
2606:4700:3031::6815:579a deepseek1024.com
69.46.46.112           api.dshfind.com
```

After flushing DNS, the running instance immediately returned full catalog data (`stale:false`, categories + pagination).

### Suggestions

- Expose `syntheticProxyHostnames` via settings/env and pre-seed it with the built-in cooperative source hostnames (`deepseek1024.com`, `api.dshfind.com`)
- Alternatively: when a system proxy is configured/detected, allow-list `198.18.0.0/15` and the common fake-ip v6 ranges
- Map failures to structured error codes (`CatalogNetworkError` already carries codes like `blocked-address`) instead of the generic 400, and log a `[W]` line server-side so future reports are diagnosable
- Document the fake-ip incompatibility (and the hosts workaround) in the market docs

Happy to provide more traces if useful.

discussions.title: Flaky on CI: process-exit.spec.ts managed-tree tests intermittently hit the 30s timeout (different case each run)
discussions.body:
### Summary

In our downstream fork's CI (GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest`, Node 24), the tests in `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/tests/process-exit.spec.ts` intermittently fail with a ~30s timeout. The failing case **varies between runs** — different runs of the same suite timed out on different cases while their siblings passed in under 500 ms — and rerunning the exact same commit passes green. This points to shared-state / timing sensitivity in the spec rather than a deterministic regression.

### Evidence

All four cases are variations of "removes an ordinary managed tree after `<exit reason>`":

| Run | Failing case | Duration | Siblings |
|---|---|---|---|
| A | after 'unhandled-rejection' | 30,015 ms (timeout) | all pass (<500 ms) |
| B | after 'direct' | 30,470 ms (timeout) | all pass (`after 'unhandled-rejection'` passes at 372 ms) |

Rerunning failed jobs (same commits, no source changes) went green both times:

- Failed: https://github.com/shine-233/deepseek-harness-study/actions/runs/32549629393 (attempt 1 fail -> attempt 2 pass)
- An earlier run on a different commit failed the same way and also passed on rerun

### Environment

- GitHub-hosted `ubuntu-latest` runner
- Node 24 (`actions/setup-node`)
- Observed from our study-fork's CI which runs the upstream test suite unchanged

### Guess at direction (may be wrong)

Each case spawns a real child process tree and waits for managed-tree removal; a slow runner can plausibly push one wait past the 30s test timeout, with whichever case happens to be slowest that day losing the race. Possible mitigations: a larger per-test timeout for this spec, or polling with a deadline instead of a fixed wait.

discussions.title: evolution-mode：让 DSH 插件从静态组合走向动态进化
discussions.body:
我开发了一个 DSH 插件套装，叫 evolution-mode。

它解决的问题：DSH 现在插件很多，但都是静态组合——用户手动选插件，配置成模式。evolution-mode 让插件自己动起来：碰撞、凝结、剥离、进化。

核心特性：
- 插件碰撞监测：检测插件运行时交互，记录精确时序
- 自动凝结：稳定碰撞打包为新插件（A+B=AB，AB+C=ABC）
- 盲区显影：新插件激活前强制标注“聚焦了什么/排斥了什么/何时失效”
- 主副分化：主插件=收敛锚点，副插件=被盲区吸附的响应单元
- 备选碎片池：被剥离的冗余不删除，作为未来进化原料
- 时序共振：识别静态无序、动态有序的碎片
- 呼吸仪表盘：可视化插件生态的认知呼吸节律

安装：
npm install github:hanshanxue83/evolution-mode

仓库：
https://github.com/hanshanxue83/evolution-mode

一个关键设计选择：
我把人类放在两个不可自动化的裁决点——涌动确认（该不该追这个异常）和盲区显影（新插件排斥了什么）。其余全自动。

你们觉得这种边界划得对吗？
如果完全去掉人类介入，插件进化会不会退化成机械组合？有没有更好的做法？

PS：当前 v1.2.0，DSH 43.x，dsh核心包0.1.0-rc.5系列。

discussions.title: DSH 过重的依赖解析 | npm dependency resolution takes minutes for DSH
discussions.body: ## 概述 嗨！今天我尝试用npm更新dsh，发现npm直接崩溃。在 #176 #3786 #3710 #3845 提到的 npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web 首次启动长时间无输出问题基础上，我进一步做了一些排查。问题似乎和网络慢没啥关系，主要是 npm 的 peer dependency 解析阶段。 一个比较直观的量化结果来自我的CNB“云原生开发”：使用 npm 时，DSH单次构建持续 8 分 19 秒被 SIGKILL；切换到 pnpm 后，同一套构建可以正常完成，pnpm install 约 45–50 秒。 > 使用npm构建v0.1.1-rc.2直接OOS > 使用npm 构建v0.1.0-rc.6 耗时长但成功 > 使用 pnpm 构建v0.1.1-rc.2仅消耗1.7min ### 进一步分析 本地进一步用 `--package-lock-only --ignore-scripts` 排除构建脚本和实际解包影响后： 测试 | 耗时 -- | -- npm 默认，0.1.0-rc.7 | ~4 min npm 默认，0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2 | 长时间无响应 npm --legacy-peer-deps，0.1.0-rc.7 | 30.59 s npm --legacy-peer-deps，0.1.1-rc.1 | 28–32 s pnpm（CNB） | ~45–50 s 这说明单纯的依赖数量或网络速度很难解释 npm 的分钟级耗时：同一依赖图在禁用 npm peer dependency resolution 后，解析时间可以稳定下降到约 30 秒。 我也做了CPU profile。在 npm 长时间无输出的阶段，进程实际上仍在持续占用 CPU；采样中约59% self time 位于 Node URL 解析、28% 位于`semver.SemVer`，调用栈主要来自 Arborist 的 peer placement / dependency validation 因此目前更倾向于：DSH 较重的 peer dependency graph 触发了 npm Arborist 异常昂贵的重复 peer-placement validation 改为 pnpm 和采用`--legacy-peer-deps`都能显著缓解这一现象。 # For English Hi there, I did some further investigation into the very long first-run installation time reported in #176. This does not appear to be just a lack of progress output or slow network access. In my tests, npm spends most of the silent period doing CPU-bound peer dependency resolution. ## Reproduction Environment: - Windows 11 - Node.js v24.12.0 - npm 11.8.0 - `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.1-rc.1 / rc.2 - fresh temporary directories / no existing lockfile A normal npm install can remain silent for several minutes around dependency placement/resolution. After this point there may be no new npm log output for minutes. This is also reproducible in our CNB packaging workflow. With npm, one build spent 8m19s in this phase before the npm process was eventually killed with SIGKILL(OOS) I tested dependency resolution separately using: ```pwsh npm install @deepseek-ai/dsh@ ` --package-lock-only ` --ignore-scripts ``` The interesting result is what happens when npm peer dependency resolution is disabled: Test | Time -- | -- npm default, 0.1.0-rc.7 | ~4 min npm default, 0.1.1-rc.1/rc.2 | stuck npm --legacy-peer-deps, 0.1.0-rc.7 | 30.59 s npm --legacy-peer-deps, 0.1.1-rc.1 | 28–32 s pnpm install in CNB | ~45–50 s The pnpm build resolves roughly 500 packages and completes normally, so dependency count alone does not seem to explain the multi-minute npm behavior. The --legacy-peer-deps result seems particularly significant: with the same npm, registry and DSH release, resolution drops from minutes to about 30 seconds when peer dependency processing is disabled. ## CPU profile I then captured a CPU profile while npm was in the silent resolution phase. In a ~20.5 second sample, the largest self-time hotspots were approximately: > Node internal URL constructor ~59% > semver.SemVer ~28% Following the caller stacks, this work originates predominantly from Arborist dependency validation underneath peer-placement checks, roughly along this path: ``` CanPlaceDep -> canPlacePeers / checkCanPlace -> Edge.satisfiedBy -> depValid -> npm-package-arg -> URL / SemVer parsing ``` There are nested/repeated CanPlaceDep -> canPlacePeers -> ... -> CanPlaceDep checks in the sampled stacks. So although CanPlaceDep itself has little self CPU time, the work triggered underneath peer placement repeatedly performs dependency-spec / semver validation and dominates the profile. This also explains why the process looks completely hung: it is not necessarily blocked on network or I/O; npm is still actively doing resolution work without producing user-visible progress. ## Current hypothesis My current hypothesis is that DSH's unusually peer-heavy package graph triggers pathological/redundant peer-placement validation in npm Arborist. This seems consistent with all three observations: normal npm resolution takes minutes; --legacy-peer-deps reduces it to ~30 seconds; pnpm resolves and installs the same large graph much faster. I don't know yet whether this should ultimately be considered an npm/Arborist performance bug, or whether the published DSH package graph can be structured differently to avoid triggering it. It may still be worth adding first-run progress feedback as suggested in #176, but that would only address the UX symptom rather than the underlying installation cost. Happy to provide the .cpuprofile, graph-diff script/results, or run additional targeted tests if useful.

discussions.title: [Bug] 自定义提供方创建卡片缺少 env 只读防护：密钥写入被拒、创建半途失败、UI 无路可配
discussions.body:
## TL;DR

“添加自定义提供方”创建卡片缺少对**派生凭据名已被启动环境提供（read-only）**这一状态的防护：用户键入密钥提交后，profile 写入成功而 `credentials.set` 被宿主以 shadowing 为由拒绝，创建半途失败并抛出原始错误；之后编辑卡片又因同一原因锁死密钥输入框——UI 内从此没有任何路径能配置该 key。编辑器（`ProviderEditor`）已有正确的防护，建议创建卡片（`CustomProviderCard`）复用同一模式。

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.8 与 0.1.1-rc.2 均复现
- Windows 11，`dsh web`，浏览器访问 Models 设置页

## 复现步骤

1. 设置一个与「将派生的凭据名」同名的用户级环境变量，例如路由 id 将取 `cpa`，则先设 `CPA_API_KEY=sk-codex`（任意 `<ROUTE>_API_KEY` 同理）；
2. `dsh web` 启动，打开 设置 → 模型 → **添加自定义提供方**；
3. Provider ID 填 `cpa`，填好 API 地址、协议、至少一个模型，并在 **API 密钥** 栏键入任意合法 key；
4. 点击 **创建提供方**。

### 实际结果

- profile 写入成功（`llm-pi-ai.providers.cpa` 落盘，含 `apiKeyEnv: CPA_API_KEY`）；
- 随后 `credentials.set` 被拒，返回 `credential-rejected`：

  ```text
  credentials-local: "CPA_API_KEY" is supplied read-only by the launching environment, so set would be shadowed; unset it in the shell you start dsh from instead
  ```

- 卡片进入 committed 态：描述字段全部锁死、只允许重试凭据写入——但只要环境变量还在，这个重试**永远失败**；
- 取消后行已出现（绿点来自 env 凭据），点 **编辑** → 密钥输入框 disabled、占位符「由启动环境提供（只读）」。至此 UI 内彻底无路可配。

### 期望结果

创建卡片在键入合法 route 时即感知派生 ref 不可写，与编辑器一致地禁用密钥输入并给出同样的只读提示，让创建一次干净完成（走 provider 原生 / env 认证）。

## 根因分析

凭据解析分层中，「继承进程环境」优先级最高且只读——这个设计本身是合理的（`dsh-credentials-local` README 也明确：set/unset 必须拒绝，而不是写下一个读取方永远看不到的值）。问题在于两个消费端对这个事实的处理**不一致**：

| 卡片 | 行为 | 结果 |
|---|---|---|
| `ProviderEditor` | 打开时对 ref 做 `credentials.describe`；`keyState?.writable === false` 时 `disabled: disabled \|\| keyLocked`，占位符 `keyEnvLocked` | ✅ 正确拒绝输入 |
| `CustomProviderCard` | 完全不查询派生 ref 可写性；`ready` 只做格式校验；`createOnce` 固定「先 `settings.mutate`、再 `credentials.set`」 | ❌ 半途失败，且重试通道对这类永久性失败无效 |

也就是说，create 卡片的隐含假设「键入了 key 就能存下」，恰好在与环境变量重名时不成立；失败后的 committed → 仅重试凭据路径是为瞬时故障设计的，对 env shadowing 这种持久状态无效，用户会被卡在原始错误信息上。

## 建议修复

在 `CustomProviderCard` 中复用编辑器的既有模式（以下已在编译产物上实测有效，可直接移植到 `packages/client/ui-settings-models/src/client/CustomProviderCard.ts`）：

```ts
const [keyState, setKeyState] = useState<CredentialDescription | undefined>(undefined);
const keyRef = route.length > 0 && !routeInvalid ? deriveKeyRef(route) : undefined;
useEffect(() => {
    if (keyRef === undefined) return;
    let stale = false;
    setKeyState(undefined);
    api.credentials.describe({ refs: [keyRef] }).then((response) => {
        if (stale || !response.result.ok) return;
        setKeyState(response.result.value.credentials[keyRef]);
    }, () => void 0);
    return () => { stale = true; };
}, [api.credentials, keyRef]);
const keyLocked = keyState?.writable === false;
```

密钥输入框改为：

```tsx
placeholder: keyLocked ? t("keyEnvLocked") : t("keyPlaceholder"),
disabled: disabled || keyLocked,
```

效果：env 锁定时输入框禁用并显示「由启动环境提供（只读）」，用户自然留空密钥完成创建；未锁定时行为完全不变。

## 备注

- 本地实测记录：打补丁后，route=`cpa`（env 锁定）时密钥框正确禁用并显示占位符；route 未被锁定时创建/删除回归全部通过。
- 相关但不相同的讨论：#1011（DeepSeek 官方 key 被 env 置只读后找不到配置入口）、#1559（project-env 层的安全链分析）。本报告聚焦的是：**自定义提供方创建卡片缺少与编辑器一致的 env-lock 防护，造成半失败创建 + UI 死角**。

discussions.title: （bug）[llm-deepseek] deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 在工具调用后续轮次不返回 reasoning_content（thinking 模式失效）
discussions.body:
[issue-llm-deepseek-vision-exp-reasoning.md](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31328598/issue-llm-deepseek-vision-exp-reasoning.md)
问题描述
使用 deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp 模型并开启思考模式（max）时：

每个会话的第一轮正常返回 reasoning_content，DSH 界面正常显示 Think 行。

discussions.title: llm-pi-ai/discovery.ts 应支持 max_model_len 字段以兼容更多自托管服务
discussions.body:
## 背景

DSH 的 `llm-pi-ai` 插件提供了 `discoverModels` 能力，允许用户在配置页点击"拉取可用模型"时自动探测 OpenAI-compatible 端点的模型列表。

当前 `ListingEntry` 接口（`packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/discovery.ts`）只识别以下字段来获取 context window：

- `context_window`
- `context_length`

但许多自托管 LLM 服务（如 oMLX、vLLM、Ollama 等）返回的是 `max_model_len` 字段。这导致这些服务的模型在自动探测时丢失 context window 信息，用户只能手动在 `settings.yaml` 中填写。

## 当前 workaround

手动在 `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` 中配置：

```yaml
llm-pi-ai:
  providers:
    local:
      models:
        - id: Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-oQ6-mtp
          contextWindow: 262144
```

对于模型数量少且固定的场景，手动配置可以接受。但如果模型频繁变化（如 oMLX 动态加载不同量化版本），每次都要手动维护就很麻烦。

## 建议改动

**文件：** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/discovery.ts`

### 1. `ListingEntry` 接口（约第 53-62 行）增加字段

```typescript
interface ListingEntry {
  id?: unknown
  /** Common gateway extensions; absent from the official listings. */
  name?: unknown
  display_name?: unknown
  context_window?: unknown
  context_length?: unknown
  max_model_len?: unknown       // ← 新增
  max_tokens?: unknown
  max_output_tokens?: unknown
}
```

### 2. `readListing` 函数中 `capacity()` 调用（约第 152 行）增加候选

```typescript
// 当前
const contextWindow = capacity(entry?.context_window, entry?.context_length)

// 改后
const contextWindow = capacity(entry?.context_window, entry?.context_length, entry?.max_model_len)
```

`capacity()` 函数本身已经支持可变参数，改动非常小且安全。

## 影响范围

- **影响面：** 仅影响配置页"拉取可用模型"时的自动探测，不影响运行时行为
- **兼容性：** `max_model_len` 是 OpenAI-compatible 协议的常见扩展字段，添加它是向前兼容，不会破坏现有行为
- **受益用户：** 所有使用自托管 LLM 服务的 DSH 用户（oMLX、vLLM、Ollama 等）

## 备注

`max_model_len` 和 `context_window` 本质上是同一概念的不同命名，`capacity()` 函数已经按优先级依次尝试候选字段，取第一个有效值，所以新增字段不会引入歧义。

discussions.title: DeepSeek Harness vs Hermes benchmark: significantly higher token usage on the same V4-Flash task
discussions.body:
I tested DeepSeek Harness against Hermes using the same DeepSeek-V4-Flash model on the same real-world codebase research task, and I wanted to share the results because they may be useful for optimizing Harness's agent loop and context management.

Test conditions

Same model: DeepSeek-V4-Flash
Same local project and source files
Same task instructions
Same machine
Same DeepSeek API account
Tests were executed sequentially, not simultaneously
The output generated by the first agent was removed before starting the second test, so Harness could not use the previous agent's report
No internet research was allowed; both agents had to inspect only the local project files and six local PDF source documents

Task

The agents were asked to investigate an existing software project and determine how a new module should be prepared, without implementing anything.

This required them to:

inspect the documentation architecture of three previously developed modules;
understand the project's established development methodology;
inspect relevant existing code;
analyze six local PDF source documents;
identify which source material was relevant to the new module;
distinguish source-supported concepts from existing product heuristics;
identify unresolved methodological decisions;
produce one research report without modifying the application.

Hermes result

Starting API totals:

20,375,129 tokens
140 API requests
$0.33 daily accumulated cost

After Hermes:

28,668,364 tokens
169 API requests
$0.56 daily accumulated cost

Therefore Hermes used approximately:

8,293,235 tokens
29 API requests
~$0.23
Execution time: approximately 6 minutes

DeepSeek Harness result

Harness started immediately afterward from:

28,668,364 tokens
169 API requests
$0.56 daily accumulated cost

After Harness:

49,839,879 tokens
225 API requests
$1.07 daily accumulated cost

Therefore Harness used approximately:

21,171,515 tokens
56 API requests
~$0.51
Execution time: approximately 15 minutes

For this workload, Harness therefore consumed approximately 2.55× as many tokens, made approximately 1.93× as many API requests, and cost roughly 2.2× as much.

Output quality

Both outputs were good and demonstrated strong understanding of the project.

Harness was particularly strong at reconstructing the project's architecture, institutional history, existing module implementation, and development methodology. Its investigation was visibly more iterative and extensive.

However, the additional work did not clearly translate into better final accuracy.

One concrete example: one of the approved local source documents contains a systematic professions/occupations table for numbers 1–9. Hermes found and reported this source. Harness inspected the same document but concluded that concrete professions by number were only partially present in the approved sources, missing that systematic table.

Overall, I considered the two reports comparable in quality, with Hermes slightly more accurate on the source-research portion of this particular task.

Why I'm sharing this

While watching Harness work, I noticed a much longer sequence of searches, reads, greps, reasoning steps, and repeated context exploration. That deeper exploration is potentially valuable, but in this test it resulted in substantially higher token consumption without a corresponding improvement in the final result.

I realize Harness is currently a developer preview, so I'm sharing this as performance feedback rather than as a bug report.

It may be worth investigating whether the current agent loop is repeatedly re-sending or accumulating large amounts of context during long repository/source-document research tasks.

I'm happy to provide additional anonymized measurements or repeat the benchmark after future Harness updates if that would be useful.

discussions.title: [Plugin] dsh-web-cross-session — 在 Web UI 里跨会话引用、转发消息、解锁全文检索
discussions.body:
# [Plugin] dsh-web-cross-session — 在 Web UI 里跨会话引用、转发消息、解锁全文检索

**EN: Cross-session references, message forwarding, and full-text history search for the DSH Web UI — composer `@` chips, non-waking `/xsend` relay, persisted FTS index, and five model-facing session-query tools. Zero core patches; pure plugin composition.**

GitHub: https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-web-cross-session （MIT）

---

## 它解决什么问题

Web UI 里同时开多个会话是常态：一个在调研、一个在写码、还有几个子代理在跑。但会话之间互相是孤岛——想把 A 会话的结论带进 B 会话只能手动复制粘贴；侧边栏搜索只匹配标题/工作区，搜不到**消息正文**。

本插件把"跨会话"做成 Web UI 的一等能力：

| 能力 | 触发方式 | 机制 |
|------|------|------|
| 🔍 正文全文检索 | 侧边栏搜索框直接搜消息内容 | 组合层覆盖 `session-query-sqlite` 为 `openAt: first-search`，解锁已有 FTS 索引与 `session.search` RPC |
| 🔗 会话引用 chip | 输入框打 `@` 选会话（子代理挂在父会话二级菜单） | 复用官方 `dsh-session-reference` 服务；提交时物化快照或指针 |
| 📨 消息转发 | `/xsend <文本>` → 弹出目标选择器 | `agent.inject()` 非唤醒注入，目标会话不会自己跑起来 |
| 🤖 模型历史工具 | 模型自行调用 | 挂载五个只读会话查询工具（`session_search` 等），config 一键可关 |

## 引用为什么值得单独说

引用不是简单地把文本塞进 prompt，而是按工作区自动选择形态：

- **同工作区 → 指针模式**：只插入一行 `Referenced session: <label> (<id>)` + 检索指令（几 token），模型用 session-query 工具自己取内容——引用一个长会话不再吃掉 65 KB 上下文；
- **跨工作区 → untrusted 内联快照**：模型工具按精确 cwd 相等授权，跨区目标模型本就读不到，自动回退为带固定警告的内联快照（65 KB/源硬上限），模型把它当背景信息而不执行其中指令；
- 快照准备失败会**阻止发送**并说明原因，绝不静默降级。

## 安全模型

- 列举接口在服务端按 caller 工作区过滤（cwd 精确相等 + 自身），猜到别的会话 id 也枚举不到；
- 进入模型指令的 label/sessionId 先清洗（控制字符折叠、token 字母表门卫），防提示注入；
- 转发要求来源与目标都是 live 会话且互不相同，relay 前缀用服务端验证过的来源 id；
- 引用 chip 把 `{来源, 目标, 标签}` 绑定编码进 ref 本身，浏览器端无共享可变状态；路由仅 loopback、仅 POST、仅 JSON，未知异常统一脱敏返回。

## 安装

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:Happy2Git/dsh-web-cross-session#2bd43b758b48
# 重启 pnpm dsh web 后刷新页面
```

插件自带的 cordis.patch.yml 自动启用持久化 FTS 索引并挂载 host+browser 双面行。想本地构建：clone 后 `pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm build`（45 个测试全绿，typecheck 干净）。

## 已知限制

- 中文分词继承核心 `unicode61` 选择，连续中文可能整段成一个 token；
- **全新部署的首次搜索需为全部历史会话构建一次索引**（约百会话 ≈ 半分钟，与会话量成正比）。插件默认在启动 10 秒后自动于后台完成构建（warmupDelayMs 可调），多数情况下第一次搜索已是热态；索引持久化后搜索稳定在亚秒级。
- 转发目标必须是已打开（live）的会话，冷会话请先在侧边栏打开。

discussions.body:
> **[已撤回 / Retracted]** 官方 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-subagent` 的会话头部目录动作已覆盖本插件的能力——触发器自带后代计数与运行中活动指示，弹层含每个子代理的状态点、刷新、诊断原因文案、token 统计与导航。两者并存只会造成头部控件与文案的重复。感谢社区反馈，请直接使用官方内置能力；详见下方原帖存档。

---


# [Plugin] dsh-subagent-status — 会话头部的子代理状态灯：谁在跑、谁完了、谁挂了，一眼看清

**EN: A per-session header light strip showing the state of every direct subagent — running pulse / done / error with retry — backed by a zero-RPC snapshot of the sessions store. Pure read-only indicator, pure-function core, fully tested.**

GitHub: https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-subagent-status （MIT）

---

## 它解决什么问题

在 Web UI 里派出子代理后，它们就"隐身"了：跑没跑、完没完、是不是异常退出，都要自己翻目录树才知道。本插件把这些状态直接放到**每个会话的头部**：

| 能力 | 说明 |
|------|------|
| 🟢 状态灯排 | 每个直接子代理一盏灯：running 渐亮 / done 绿 / error 红 |
| 🔢 运行计数 | 触发器上显示仍在运行的子代理数 |
| 📋 状态清单 | 点击弹出清单：每行状态点 + 文案；超 100 行截断显示 "+N" |
| 🔁 失败重试 | 目录加载失败时显示错误行与重试入口，而不是静默消失 |

## 设计取舍

- **零 RPC**：数据来自宿主已订阅的 `list_agents` 投影快照（`subagentsByParent` + `byId`），插件本身不发起任何请求；唯一写路径是错误行的重试按钮调用宿主 `refreshSubagents`；
- **纯函数核心**：行的挑选/计数/截断全部在 `summary.ts` 纯函数里，React 组件只是投影——这部分有独立单测，locale 中英键一致性也有测试锁住；
- **诊断行不冒充子代理**：catalog 里的 diagnostic 条目不计入数量与灯位，只作为带原因的重试错误行出现；
- **可访问性**：弹层 role="dialog"、打开聚焦、Escape 关闭回焦触发器、点击外部关闭；样式全部使用官方主题 token，暗色主题正常；
- **打包纪律**：tsdown 双入口 + purity gate 拒绝越界 `@deepseek-ai` 导入，浏览器半只依赖冻结模块表。

## 安装

```bash
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add github:Happy2Git/dsh-subagent-status#2de9337a464e
# 重启 pnpm dsh web 后刷新页面
```

本地构建：clone 后 `pnpm install && pnpm test && pnpm build`（9 个测试全绿）。包内附 invariant companion（`./invariant` 导出），可与 invariant 套件一起校验目录快照与渲染行的一致性。

## 已知限制

- 仅显示**直接子代理**，不递归展开后代；
- 弹层只读（除重试外），不做导航/展开。

---

如果你也需要跨会话引用/转发/全文搜索，看看同系列的 [dsh-web-cross-session](https://github.com/Happy2Git/dsh-web-cross-session)。欢迎 star、试用、提 issue！

discussions.title: (bug) dsh web first install looks like a hang; --no-open removed in rc.2
discussions.body:
## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2` (npm `latest`)
- Linux x86_64 (Debian 12)
- Fresh machine, first install

## Symptom

Running the documented `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` appears to freeze: the process stays at ~100% CPU for many minutes, never binds port 3080, prints nothing, and ignored SIGTERM. Retrying in a second terminal made it worse — three concurrent `npm exec` processes each pinned a full core (4.3GB RSS combined) and still never finished.

## What I found

1. **The spin is npm's resolve/reify of the ~200-package tree, not the dsh host.** It completes eventually, but there is no progress output, so a first-time install reads as a hang. A first install of this size probably benefits from an explicit "installing ~200 packages, this takes a few minutes" notice from the launcher, or streamed npm progress.
2. **Parallel `npx` invocations contend on the same `~/.npm/_npx` `concurrency.lock`** and all spin instead of one waiter quietly blocking. A second concurrent launch could detect the in-flight install and wait without burning a core.
3. **Doc bug:** the README documents `dsh web --no-open`, but in 0.1.1-rc.2 `dsh web --help` shows only `--host`, `--port`, and `--trusted-host`, and the app exits with `error: unknown option '--no-open'`. Unattended/SSH launch as documented fails.
4. Ruled out in case it is a red herring: with an empty `~/.dsh/sessions` store, once the binary was installed, `dsh web` bound 127.0.0.1:3080 in ~15s.

## Workaround that worked

Let a single `npx` install finish without retrying, then launch directly:

```sh
node ~/.npm/_npx/<hash>/node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh/lib/bin.js web
```

discussions.title: Feature request: a stable DOM marker (or public locator API) for the composer input area
discussions.body:
## Background

Third-party / extension plugins that enhance input behavior need a stable way to locate the composer's textarea from outside `ui-conversation` — e.g. whole-page paste routing, history recall on ArrowUp/ArrowDown, or drop staging that hands focus back to the composer. The public `ctx.conversation.input` service already covers draft reads/writes, but DOM-level concerns (focus, caret position, occlusion checks) still need the element itself.

## Current situation (from a fork)

We maintain a fork that injects a single line into `packages/client/ui-conversation/src/client/skeleton/InputBar.tsx`:

```tsx
<textarea data-dsh-composer="" ... >
```

…so three of our browser plugins can locate it read-only:

```ts
const composer = document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>(
  'textarea[data-dsh-composer]',
)
```

This one line has survived two upstream merges so far, but each merge of InputBar (including the recent ~335-line rework) is a manual conflict point, and the maintenance cost grows with InputBar's churn.

## Ask

One of:

1. A stable, documented DOM marker on the composer textarea (`data-dsh-composer` or similar), treated as public plugin surface — renamed only across a deprecation cycle; or
2. A public locator API on an existing client service (e.g. `ctx.conversation.input` exposing an element handle / subscribe face) that plugins can use without touching InputBar internals.

Either removes the last reason for our fork to touch any `packages/client/` shared file.

## Minimal example

What a consumer looks like today (fork, capture-phase paste listener):

```ts
const composer = document.querySelector<HTMLTextAreaElement>(
  'textarea[data-dsh-composer]',
)
if (composer === null) return
if (document.activeElement === composer) return // let its own onPaste run
// ... route clipboard text through ctx.conversation.input.setDraft,
// then composer.focus({ preventScroll: true })
```

Happy to send a PR if/when external PRs are accepted.
