discussions.title: Bug: web-e2e fixture splice breaks JSON on Windows paths (25 scenario files fail)
discussions.body:
## Problem

On Windows, 25 whole web-e2e scenario files failed at setup with `SyntaxError: Bad escaped character` from `JSON.parse` inside `realizeSeedFixture` — while POSIX CI stayed green, because the splice is the identity there.

## Root cause

The seed-fixture machinery substituted `{{sessionId}}`/`{{cwd}}` placeholders by bare `split().join()` on fixture JSONL text. A Windows workspace cwd (`D:\...` with backslashes) spliced in raw produces illegal JSON escapes inside what must remain valid JSON lines.

## Fix

All JSON-text substitutions now go through a `jsonLiteral` helper (`JSON.stringify(value).slice(1, -1)` — the string-literal body):

- `realizeSeedFixture`'s placeholder joins and recorded-cwd rewrite;
- `recordFixture`'s split key (the only spelling a `JSON.stringify` log line can contain).

`normalizeAria` tokenizes the cwd in both spellings an aria snapshot carries — raw text plus the JSON-escaped form inside rendered tool args/results — and takes the workspace basename with a both-platform separator class, restoring the `{{cwd}}`/`{{workspace}}` golden normalization.

On POSIX every transform is the identity, so golden outputs are unchanged.

## Platform impact / verification

- POSIX: identity transform — existing CI lanes cover no-regression.
- Windows: verified locally on the fork this change originates from (25 previously failing scenario files green after the fix).
- A `windows-latest` CI lane (if/when available) would own this signal going forward.

Fix branch (single commit on top of current master): https://github.com/a137460387/deepseek-harness/tree/upstream-pr/windows-e2e-json-escape

Happy to send a PR if/when external PRs are accepted.

discussions.title: [Bug] mcp-client: activeServerNames 生命周期泄漏导致无法创建新会话
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 插件的 `activeServerNames` 注册表存在生命周期泄漏。当会话关闭后创建新会话时，旧会话的 MCP 客户端实例没有被正确销毁，导致 `serverName` 仍然保留在全局的 `activeServerNames` WeakMap 中，阻止 agent preset 在新会话中加载。

## 错误信息

```
SessionCreateError: session create failed: agent-preset-invalid: agent-presets: preset "work" failed to mount: loader entries failed to apply
- failed to apply loader entry context7 (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client): mcp-client: serverName "context7" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml
- failed to apply loader entry idea (@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client): mcp-client: serverName "idea" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml
```

## 复现步骤

1. 在 agent preset 中配置 MCP 服务器（`~/.dsh/.agent-presets/work/agent.cordis.yml`）：

```yaml
- id: context7
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: context7
    transport: stdio
    command: cmd
    args: ['/c', 'npx', '-y', '@upstash/context7-mcp']

- id: idea
  name: '@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client'
  config:
    serverName: idea
    transport: streamable-http
    url: http://127.0.0.1:64342/stream
```

2. 启动 DSH Web GUI，使用 "work" preset 创建新会话
3. 正常使用会话（MCP 工具工作正常）
4. 关闭会话
5. 立即创建新会话
6. **报错**：`serverName "context7" is already in use`

## 期望行为

关闭会话后，应该能立即创建新会话，不会报错。MCP 客户端实例应该在会话关闭时被正确销毁。

## 实际行为

`activeServerNames` 注册表保留了已关闭会话的 `serverName` 条目，导致新会话无法加载同一个 agent preset。

## 临时解决方案

- 重启 DSH（清空内存中的 `activeServerNames` WeakMap）
- 或者等待约 30 秒再创建新会话（不稳定）

## 根因分析

在 `packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/index.ts` 中：

```typescript
// 第45行：全局注册表，用 ctx.root 作为 key
const activeServerNames = new WeakMap<Context, Set<string>>()

// 第148-161行：effect 清理函数应该删除 serverName
ctx.effect(() => {
    let names = activeServerNames.get(ctx.root)
    if (!names) {
      names = new Set()
      activeServerNames.set(ctx.root, names)
    }
    if (names.has(config.serverName)) {
      throw new Error(
        `mcp-client: serverName "${config.serverName}" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml`,
      )
    }
    names.add(config.serverName)
    return () => void names.delete(config.serverName)  // ← 这个清理函数没有被调用！
}, 'mcp-client.serverName')
```

effect 清理函数 `() => void names.delete(config.serverName)` 已注册但在会话关闭时未被调用。可能原因：

1. Cordis 在会话关闭时没有正确销毁 agent preset 的插件实例
2. effect 清理函数的执行顺序有问题
3. `ctx.root` 在不同会话之间发生变化，导致 WeakMap 查找失败

## 环境信息

- 操作系统：Windows 11
- Node.js：v24.18.0
- DSH 版本：master 分支最新代码
- MCP 服务器：context7（stdio）、idea（streamable-http）

## 建议修复方案

方案1：在注册前检查并清理残留的旧注册：

```typescript
ctx.effect(() => {
    let names = activeServerNames.get(ctx.root)
    if (!names) {
      names = new Set()
      activeServerNames.set(ctx.root, names)
    }
    // 防御性清理：如果有残留的旧条目，先删除
    names.delete(config.serverName)
    
    if (names.has(config.serverName)) {
      throw new Error(/*...*/)
    }
    names.add(config.serverName)
    return () => void names.delete(config.serverName)
}, 'mcp-client.serverName')
```

方案2：确保会话关闭时 agent preset 插件的销毁被正确触发。

discussions.title: [BUG] 代理环境下 LLM API 请求全部失败：Node fetch (undici) 不读取 HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY 环境变量
discussions.body:
## Summary

在需要代理才能访问外网的网络环境（如 VMware NAT、公司代理、国内网络）下，dsh 的 LLM API 调用（chat/completions 等）全部失败；必须额外设置 Node 实验性开关 `NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1` 才能恢复。根因是 DSH 使用 Node 全局 fetch（undici），而 undici fetch 默认忽略 `HTTP_PROXY` / `HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量。

## Environment

- OS：Ubuntu（VMware 虚拟机，NAT 网络，需经宿主机代理访问外网）
- Node：v22.23.2（nvm 管理）
- dsh：0.1.1-rc.1（npm 全局安装 `@deepseek-ai/dsh`）
- 网络：必须经 HTTP 代理访问 LLM API；curl / npm / pip 均可正常走代理

## Proxy 环境变量（已脱敏）

```bash
HTTP_PROXY=http://<host>:<port>
HTTPS_PROXY=http://<host>:<port>
NO_PROXY=localhost,127.0.0.1,<其他内网地址>
Steps to Reproduce
在 shell 中设置上述代理环境变量（此时 curl、npm 均正常走代理）；
正常启动 dsh，并配置使用 LLM API（如 DeepSeek API）；
发起对话请求。
复现并抓取报错日志（可选，便于维护者确认）：

bash
复制
unset NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY
dsh --profile headless "你好" 2>&1 | tee /tmp/dsh-error.log
Actual Behavior
请求直连外网、未走代理，全部失败，报错为网络层错误，例如：

复制
TypeError: fetch failed
cause: Error: connect ECONNREFUSED <host>:<port>
（视网络环境也可能是 ETIMEDOUT / ECONNRESET / 证书错误。判据：只要设置 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1 后立即恢复正常，即可确认与"fetch 未走代理"相关。）

Expected Behavior
与 curl / npm 一致，自动读取 HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY 环境变量；或提供显式的 proxy 配置项（如 config 中的 proxy 字段）。

Root Cause（初步定位）
@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-deepseek 等包的 HTTP 调用使用 Node 全局 fetch（例如 lib/index.js:737 的 await fetch(\${connection.baseURL}/chat/completions`, ...)），未配置 undiciProxyAgent。而 Node 内置 fetch（undici）默认**不读取**HTTP_PROXY/HTTPS_PROXY` 环境变量（长期存在的生态问题，参见 nodejs/node#57165、openclaw/openclaw#20549）。因此在必须走代理的网络环境下必然失败。

Workaround（已确认有效）
设置 Node 实验性开关后恢复正常：

bash
复制
export NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY=1
（需 Node ≥ 22.21.0 或 ≥ 24.3.0；该特性由 nodejs/node#57165 引入。）

Suggested Fix
HTTP 层统一改用 undici ProxyAgent，按环境变量（HTTP_PROXY / HTTPS_PROXY / NO_PROXY）自动配置；注意 NO_PROXY 需放行 127.0.0.1 / localhost，避免 GUI（http://127.0.0.1:3080）回环请求被代理劫持；
或至少：显式支持 NODE_USE_ENV_PROXY，并在文档中补充代理配置说明；
影响面：dsh-llm-deepseek、dsh-llm-pi-ai、dsh-web-search-deepseek、dsh-host-apiproxy 等多个包。

discussions.title: [Feature Request] Allow subagent to specify a different agent preset
discussions.body:
# [Feature Request] 子代理（subagent）支持指定不同的 Agent Preset

## 问题描述

当前 DSH 的子代理（subagent）机制中，子代理必须继承父代理的 Agent Preset（预设）。这意味着在同一个会话内，无法让子代理以不同的预设身份运行。

具体场景：我配置了多个 Agent Preset（如 main、finance、marketing、planner 等），每个预设都有独立的 `AGENTS.md` 工作指令和插件配置。我希望主代理（main）能够调度其他预设的子代理来完成专业化任务，但目前的架构不支持这种跨预设调度。

## 源码分析

通过阅读 DSH 源码文档，发现这是刻意设计：

> "Every in-process child is composed by one call, `applyChildComposition(childCtx, parent, composition)`, which joins the parent's agent-preset composition before applying the child's own persona and tool filter."
> — `dsh-subagent/README.md`

同时，spawn 和 fork 提供方都已声明了 `persona: true` 能力：

> "spawn 声明 `{ outputSchema: true, depthLimit: true, toolFilter: true, persona: true }`"
> — `dsh-subagent-spawn-in-process/README.zh.md`

这说明底层基础设施已具备给子代理设置独立身份的能力，只是目前没有暴露给模型侧的 `subagent` 工具。

## 期望行为

希望 `subagent` 工具支持一个可选的 `preset` 参数，允许子代理以不同的预设身份运行。

### 方案 A：subagent 工具增加 preset 参数

```
subagent(
  prompt: "帮我分析一下这个项目的成本结构",
  description: "成本分析",
  preset: "finance"  // 新增可选参数
)
```

子代理将以 finance 预设的身份运行，自动加载对应预设目录下的 `AGENTS.md`、插件配置和 persona。

### 方案 B：subagent 工具支持指定 AGENTS.md 路径

```
subagent(
  prompt: "帮我分析一下这个项目的成本结构",
  description: "成本分析",
  agents_md: "~/.dsh/.agent-presets/finance/AGENTS.md"  // 注入指定指令文件
)
```

子代理保持父级预设，但额外注入指定的 `AGENTS.md` 内容作为工作指令。

### 方案 C：配置层支持多实例 subagent 工具

在 `cordis.yml` 中注册多个 subagent 工具实例，每个绑定不同的 persona：

```yaml
subagent-finance:
  provider: spawn
  toolName: subagent_finance
  persona:
    text: "你是一个专精财务分析的助手..."
  agentOptions:
    model: deepseek-v4-pro

subagent-marketing:
  provider: spawn
  toolName: subagent_marketing
  persona:
    text: "你是一个专精内容营销的助手..."
  agentOptions:
    model: deepseek-v4-pro
```

## 实际使用场景

主代理作为调度中心，配置了多个专业化预设：

| 预设 ID | 职责 |
|---------|------|
| main | 需求理解、任务拆解、调度子代理、汇总结果 |
| finance | 报价计算、成本核算、预算编制 |
| marketing | 内容创作、品牌传播 |
| planner | 方案策划、文档撰写 |

**理想工作流**：
1. 用户对主代理提出复合型需求
2. 主代理调度 finance 预设的子代理处理财务部分
3. 主代理调度 planner 预设的子代理处理方案部分
4. 主代理汇总各子代理结果，统一向用户汇报

**当前限制**：步骤 2、3 中的子代理只能用 main 预设的身份运行，无法使用其他预设的专业指令和工具配置。

## 当前变通方案

目前采用的变通方案：在 subagent 的 prompt 里手动读取并注入目标预设的 `AGENTS.md` 内容。

该方案能用，但存在以下问题：
- 每次都要手动读取文件，额外消耗 token
- 子代理的工具集仍是父级预设的，无法按预设裁剪
- 无法持久化为可复用的工作流

## 环境信息

- DSH 版本：0.1.0-rc.5
- 运行平台：Windows 11
- Node.js 版本：v22.22.0

## 补充说明

在社区和文档中未找到关于此问题的讨论。如果这是已知限制或已有计划，烦请告知；如果是新功能，希望能纳入后续版本的路线图。

感谢 DSH 团队的出色工作！"一切皆插件"的设计哲学非常棒，期待子代理也能成为可组合的一行。

discussions.title: [Bug][Web GUI]：会话在所属 workspace 开始后刷新即变空，浏览器侧会话状态未按 workspace 作用域化
discussions.body:
一句话：Web GUI 在一个 workspace 下开始对话后，刷新当前会话列表就变空，而该会话在其他客户端/其他 workspace 中仍可见——根因是浏览器侧持久化的当前会话状态既未按 workspace 作用域隔离、也未在恢复时校验归属。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 用同一个 `dsh web` 地址（如 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`）在多个客户端同时打开（不同 Chrome 用户 profile，或多个会话/workspace 并存）。
  2. 在客户端 A 中打开某 workspace 的会话并开始对话。
  3. 刷新 A（F5）。
- 实际结果：A 的当前对话列表显示为空；而该会话在另一个客户端/另一个 workspace 中仍被展示（表现为“被追加”）。
- 预期结果：刷新后应恢复到最近一次的有效会话；当持久化的 `sessionId` 已不属于当前 workspace、或已被替换/归档时，应回退到 `recentWorkspaceId` 并正常展示会话列表，而不是显示为空。
- 环境：`@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.0-rc.8`，Ubuntu + Chrome，web 后端 `http://127.0.0.1:3080`。
- 验收条件：即使本地残留了跨 workspace 或已失效的 `sessionId`，刷新后也能自动回退到最近 workspace 并展示会话列表；持久化 key 按 workspace 作用域隔离，不同 workspace 之间不串数据。

</details>

## 一点背景：为什么之前判断“保存在别的 profile 的 localStorage”是错的

Chrome 对同一 origin 的 `localStorage` 是按用户 profile 隔离的，两个不同的浏览器 profile 无法共享 `localStorage`，所以这个现象不是 localStorage 在串数据。会话列表与对话消息本身是**服务端共享**的（`~/.dsh/sessions/*/session.jsonl.zstd`、`~/.dsh/storages/workspace.json`、`session_projcache.json`），由同一个 `dsh web` 后端提供给所有客户端。因此“在另一个环境/另一个 profile 里能看到该会话”是正常的共享，问题在于浏览器侧“当前会话/视图状态”没有按 workspace 正确作用域化。

## 根因分析（基于 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-runtime/lib/client.js` 静态分析）

浏览器侧把状态持久化到 `localStorage`，目前只有这 4 个键：

- `dsh.sessions.current`（**未按 workspace 作用域**）→ `{ sessionId, subagentAddress }`
- `dsh.conversation.chat.<sessionId>`（按会话作用域）
- `dsh.workspace.view.v5`（**未按 workspace 作用域**）
- `dsh.trajectory.duration`

冷启动时直接用持久化值构造 `SessionManager`：

```js
this.selection = createSnapshotStore({}, { persist: { name: "dsh.sessions.current" } });
const restored = this.selection.getSnapshot();
this.manager = new SessionManager(api, remote, restored.sessionId, restored.subagentAddress, conversation);
```

而 `startInitialSelection()` 对该值**不做校验**直接信任：

```js
if (current !== void 0 || target === void 0) { state = "done"; return; }
```

于是，一旦 `dsh.sessions.current` 存了一个属于其他 workspace、或已经被替换/归档的 `sessionId`，GUI 就会“恢复到空”，而不是落到 `recentWorkspaceId`。服务端共享的会话列表里该会话仍在，所以从另一个客户端看就是“被追加”。

> 说明：以上是基于编译产物（含 sourcemap）的静态推断，尚未在浏览器里完整复现；欢迎在复现时补充 Chrome DevTools 的 Local Storage 与 `session.list`/`workspace.list` 网络响应截图进一步确认。

## 建议修复

1. 恢复时校验持久化的 `sessionId` 是否仍属于当前 workspace（用其 `sessionIds` 判定）；不匹配则清理并回退到 `recentWorkspaceId`。
2. 将持久化 key 按 workspace 作用域化（对 `dsh.sessions.current`、`dsh.workspace.view.v5` 追加 workspace id 作命名空间），避免跨 workspace 串状态。

discussions.title: [Plugin] DSH Product Subagent Console — 可拖动的子代理任务分支画布
discussions.body:
# DSH Product Subagent Console

**A draggable subagent task canvas embedded directly in DSH Web conversations.**

一个直接嵌入 DSH 对话页面的可拖动子代理任务分支画布，适合同时委派多个 Agent 时快速理解任务归属、运行状态和分支关系。

- GitHub: https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console
- Alpha Release: https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2
- License: MIT

> 独立社区插件，当前 Alpha 支持 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`。

![DSH Product Subagent Console](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/main/docs/assets/subagent-canvas-live.jpg)

## 功能

- 在“对话”和“轨迹”旁新增“子代理”页签。
- 以分支形式展示 DSH 原生 child Session 和兼容 Provider 委派。
- 显示每项任务的 Agent、状态与持续时间。
- 支持画布平移、缩放、小地图、自动排列和节点拖动。
- 点击节点查看任务与生命周期详情。
- 可从详情面板直接打开原生 DSH 子会话。
- 提供英文和简体中文界面。

它更侧重完整任务分支的浏览与详情查看，而不只是显示当前运行数量。

## 安装

从 [v0.1.0-alpha.2 Release](https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/releases/tag/v0.1.0-alpha.2) 下载：

- `dsh-product-subagent-console-0.1.0-alpha.2.tgz`
- `SHA256SUMS.txt`

校验并安装到 Web Profile：

```sh
sha256sum --check SHA256SUMS.txt
dsh plugin --profile web add ./dsh-product-subagent-console-0.1.0-alpha.2.tgz
dsh --profile web --dump-config
```

配置输出中应包含 `product-subagent-console`。安装后请重启 Web Profile。

如需委派给 Codex 或 Claude Code，再按需安装相同 DSH 版本线的官方 Provider Bundle，并在 **设置 → Agent 预设** 中启用对应的官方委派工具。Preset 修改后需要新建对话。

完整步骤：

- 中文入门指南：https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/blob/main/docs/getting-started.zh.md
- English guide: https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/blob/main/docs/getting-started.md
- 故障排查：https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/blob/main/docs/troubleshooting.zh.md

## 当前 Alpha 说明

- 当前兼容基线为 DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`，插件和 DSH 包应保持在同一版本线。
- 任务详情目前以查看为主，不会通过画布修改正在运行的 Agent。
- 节点拖动位置只用于当前页面布局，刷新后会重新排列。

安装包附带 SHA-256 校验文件和 GitHub 构建 provenance；Ubuntu Node 22.19 与 Windows Node 24 CI 已通过。

欢迎试用并反馈：请尽量附上 DSH 版本、Provider、复现步骤，以及 Trajectory 或 Provider 日志中的相关错误。问题和功能建议可以提交到：

https://github.com/Jokasa7/dsh-product-subagent-console/issues

discussions.title: TeachReplay — teach-by-demonstration plugin for DSH (verified on dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2)
discussions.body:
**TeachReplay** ([github.com/Ottohere-Mourn/TeachReplay](https://github.com/Ottohere-Mourn/TeachReplay)) is a harness-agnostic Teach-by-Demonstration engine — and [`@teachreplay/adapter-dsh`](https://github.com/Ottohere-Mourn/TeachReplay/tree/main/packages/adapter-dsh) integrates it with DeepSeek Harness as a plugin.

**What it adds — five tools, one engine:**

| Tool | Purpose |
| --- | --- |
| `teach_start` | start recording a human demonstration on the configured computer |
| `teach_stop` | stop and persist the versioned trajectory |
| `teach_compile` | compile the trajectory into a reusable, parameterized skill |
| `teach_replay` | replay the skill with new inputs — deterministic per-step verification, explicit success/failure |
| `teach_shell` | record a shell command during the demonstration (GUI+CLI workflows) |

**Verified against `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2`**: the plugin builds inside a real DSH workspace, registers successfully, and all five tools run through the real DSH tool runtime (`ctx.tools.execute`) — the integration spec drives the full Teach → Compile → Replay → Verify flow (3/3 passing), and the full DSH host typecheck stays green.

**Demo**: a [26-second walkthrough](https://github.com/Ottohere-Mourn/TeachReplay/blob/main/assets/teachreplay-demo.mp4), plus a runnable `examples/dsh-demo` in the repository.

**Installation**: DSH's sub-packages resolve only inside the workspace, so the supported path today is the documented source/workspace install — see the [adapter README](https://github.com/Ottohere-Mourn/TeachReplay/tree/main/packages/adapter-dsh).

**Compatibility note**: DSH is in developer preview with compatibility-breaking changes — the adapter targets `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2` and should be re-verified against every release you adopt.

Maintained in the TeachReplay monorepo (Apache-2.0).

discussions.title: RFC: Runtime-open root page, details, inbox, and plugin-event seams for external UI plugins
discussions.body:
### Motivation

External DSH plugins can contribute Host behavior and Client bundles, but an external plugin that needs a persistent root-level UI currently has no generic way to:

- add a navigation action without replacing the workspace browser;
- show a main page instead of the current conversation;
- reuse the root details column for plugin-owned details;
- present a global decision inbox above the shell;
- publish a schema-validated Host-to-Client event without extending the built-in static event allowlist;
- mount a plugin-owned Web read route behind the same DNS-rebinding and same-origin checks as `/api`.

Without public seams, plugins must either stay Host-only or depend on DOM takeover, private Desktop APIs, Session-event misuse, or a second shell owner. Those alternatives are difficult to compose and lifecycle-test.

### Proposed generic ownership

This proposal is intentionally product-agnostic:

1. `ui-layout` owns keyed root surfaces and transient active keys:
   - `shell.page`
   - `shell.details`
   - `shell.inbox`
   - `ctx.layout.openPage/closePage`
   - `ctx.layout.openDetails/closeDetails`
   - `ctx.layout.openInbox/closeInbox`
2. `ui-sidebar` owns two additive list seats:
   - `sidebar.navigation`
   - `sidebar.inbox`
3. `api-remotes` owns a runtime-open, schema-validated event registry. A publisher is bound to the caller fiber, cannot shadow built-in events, and carries only JSON-safe tuple arguments.
4. `client-connection` exposes its already-resolved browser request trust fence as a public Host service so plugin-owned routes do not duplicate `trustedHosts` parsing or default open.

The shell stores only active registration keys. Business state and callbacks remain in the contributing plugin. Unknown, unloaded, or abdicated keys close through the shell owner.

### Accessibility and lifecycle expectations

- A narrow root-details surface becomes a full-height drawer.
- Only the topmost overlay has `aria-modal`, keyboard trapping, Escape handling, and focus restoration.
- Background columns become `inert` while the drawer or global inbox is modal.
- Slot withdrawal reconciles and closes the selected surface.
- Empty sidebar list seats collapse without reserving visual space.

### Security boundary

- The event registry validates names and argument tuples before publication; API Proxy retains the final lossless JSON gate.
- A plugin Web route mounts only when both `webServer` and the shared request-trust owner are present.
- The proposal does not expose private Host records, executable catalog data, credentials, install commands, or Desktop-private APIs.

### Prototype evidence

A local external-plugin prototype over `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.1` exercised these generic seams without modifying Desktop APIs:

- complete GUI suite: 4,010 passed / 1 skipped;
- CI-style Web replay: 281 passed / 15 skipped;
- real Loader composition for page → details → inbox;
- temporary Web profile with three external packages: Host read routes and browser navigation passed three consecutive runs;
- unknown-key, contribution withdrawal, stacked-modal, focus-trap, event lifecycle, trust-fence, and JSON-boundary tests.

The current upstream `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2` does not yet expose equivalent seams. The rc.2 image-pipeline changes overlap only with the Connection and API Proxy integration points; the ownership model remains compatible.

### Questions for maintainers

1. Are root page/details/inbox surfaces aligned with the intended slot-system direction?
2. Should runtime-open plugin events remain in `api-remotes`, or is another public carrier planned?
3. Is exposing the connection-owned request-trust service acceptable, or should plugin Web routes use a different shared authorization API?
4. If these seams are directionally useful, what smaller contract slice would be most helpful to discuss first?

I can provide the tested patch and focused contract examples if maintainers want to review the implementation direction. I understand that the repository is not accepting external pull requests at this time; this Discussion is intended to validate the public extension model, not to bypass that policy.

discussions.title: Bug: PTC (Code) mode crashes when an MCP tool description contains literal {{...}} text
discussions.body:
## Bug Description

When PTC (Code) mode is active, any MCP tool whose `description` field contains a literal `{{...}}` string (e.g. `{{variables}}`) causes the entire model request to fail with:

```
unknown prompt variable "{{variables}}" in section "tools:sdk"; registered variables: provider, model, cwd
```

This is because `dsh-system-prompt`'s `interpolate()` function treats ALL `{{...}}` occurrences in tool descriptions as prompt variable references, with no escape mechanism for external text.

## Reproduction

1. Add any MCP server whose tool description contains `{{...}}` literal text (e.g. Netcatty — its `snippets_run` tool description includes `{{variables}}`)
2. Configure PTC/Code mode (e.g. via an agent preset with `promotedPresentation: code`)
3. Send any message → request fails immediately

### Example MCP tool description that triggers the bug

> Run a vault snippet or automation script in a terminal session. Text snippets paste shell commands with optional {{variables}}. Scripts (kind=script) run via nct JavaScript runtime.

The `{{variables}}` here refers to Netcatty's own snippet variable syntax — it has nothing to do with DSH prompt variables.

## Root Cause

In `@deepseek-ai/dsh-system-prompt` (`lib/index.js`, the `interpolate()` function around line 105):

```javascript
function interpolate(input, variables, kind) {
    const text = input.text;
    // ...
    for (let open = text.indexOf("{{"); open >= 0; open = text.indexOf("{{", last)) {
        // ...
        if (!Object.hasOwn(variables, name)) {
            const known = Object.keys(variables);
            throw new Error(`unknown prompt variable "{{${name}}}" in ${kind} "${input.name}"; registered variables: ${known.length > 0 ? known.join(", ") : "(none)"}`);
        }
    }
}
```

When PTC mode renders the `tools:sdk` section (order 150), it calls `sdkSchemas()` which collects all tool descriptions into the section text. That text then passes through `interpolate()`, which throws on any `{{name}}` that is not a registered prompt variable.

### Why this only affects PTC mode

- **Standard mode**: Tool descriptions are sent as JSON Schema to the model API — `{{...}}` is plain text, no interpolation.
- **PTC (Code) mode**: Tool descriptions are rendered into the `tools:sdk` prompt **text section** — `interpolate()` scans the entire text for `{{...}}` and throws on unknown variables.

## Impact

- Any MCP server with `{{...}}` in tool descriptions is incompatible with PTC/Code mode
- This is not an edge case — `{{variable}}` / `{{name}}` / `{{placeholder}}` are common in tool descriptions for tools that support templating
- The error is hard to diagnose: it does not mention which tool or which description caused it

## Suggested Fix

Tool descriptions (and any other external/sourced text) should be **exempt from `{{...}}` interpolation** when assembled into prompt sections. Two approaches:

1. **Escape on assembly**: When `dsh-tools` collects tool descriptions into the `tools:sdk` section text, escape `{{` to a sentinel and have `interpolate()` restore it after scanning.
2. **Skip interpolation for tool text**: Mark the `tools:sdk` section (or any section containing external text) as `raw: true`, so `interpolate()` passes it through without scanning for `{{...}}`.

At minimum, the error should be a **warning with the tool name**, not a request-killing throw.

## Environment

- DSH version: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`
- `dsh-system-prompt` version: bundled
- OS: Windows 11
- MCP server: netcatty-external (any MCP server with `{{...}}` in tool descriptions triggers this)
- Mode: PTC / Code mode (`promotedPresentation: code`)

discussions.title: [Bug] Terminal background-job records are never reclaimed in a live session: unbounded store growth, O(n) list/start scans, and a silent memory footprint that grows with session age
discussions.body:
## EN / English

### Observed behavior

In the local background-job registry (`dsh-jobs-local`), a job record is **written once on `start()` and never removed while its owning agent is alive**. When a job reaches a terminal state (`completed` / `failed` / `cancelled` / `stopped`), `settle()` updates its status, detail, output, and `finishedAt` — but the record stays in the store indefinitely, **including the full `output` string**, until the owning agent is disposed or the jobs service is torn down.

In a long-lived session that repeatedly starts background jobs (test suites, batch processing, deployments), the store therefore grows without bound:

- every terminal job (with its output payload) is retained for the whole session lifetime,
- `job_list` and `start()` scan the entire store (`[...store.values()]`), so their cost grows linearly with session age,
- the memory footprint grows monotonically and silently — no warning, no retention, no LRU.

### Root-cause (store lifecycle, with source references)

Verified on `@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local@0.1.1-rc.2` (`lib/index.js`):

- `:165` — `this.store.set(id, job)` on `start()`: the record enters the store.
- `:365-387` — `settle()`: only sets `status` / `detail` / `output` / `finishedAt`; **never deletes the record**. The terminal `output` string stays resident.
- `:411` — `this.store.delete(job.id)` appears only inside `disposeOwned(owner)` (the **owning agent's** lifecycle end).
- `:424` — `this.store.clear()` appears only inside `disposeAll()` (the **jobs service's** teardown).
- `:394-405` — `ensureOwnerCleanup()` (added in this release): registers an owner-scoped effect that calls `disposeOwned` when the agent is disposed — i.e. cleanup is keyed to the **owner's lifecycle boundary**, not to the job's **state boundary** (terminal).
- `:137` — every `start()` calls `activeTaskCount()` which scans the store (`O(store.size)`).
- `:180` — `list()` scans the full store: `[...this.store.values()]`.
- `:102` — `maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner` (default 10) is checked only against **active** jobs (`:137`), so it bounds concurrency, not accumulation — a false sense of "bounded".

The cleanup trigger is misaligned: **reclamation depends on a lifecycle boundary (owner disposed / service teardown) instead of a state boundary (job terminal + reported)**, so within a live session the store only ever grows.

### Impact scope (production / progress / scheduling)

- **Session layer:** the job store is per-process state owned by the session's agents; a long-running automation session (batch background jobs, CI-style runs, deployments) accumulates terminal records — each carrying its output payload — for the entire session lifetime. Memory grows monotonically and silently.
- **Progress layer:** the accumulated terminal records are the *audit trail* of the session's background work — but they are never pruned, so the cost of reading them (`job_list`) and of starting new jobs (`activeTaskCount`) grows linearly with how much work the session has done. The longer and more productive the session, the slower it becomes.
- **Scheduling layer:** this is exactly the scenario for scheduled/queued workloads: a session that starts jobs on a schedule or in a loop accumulates records with no upper bound; nothing signals the operator until memory pressure or visible latency.
- **Contrast with the design intent:** `maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner` and the new `ensureOwnerCleanup` show the engine *does* manage job lifecycle — but only at the concurrency and owner boundaries. The terminal state, which is the earliest safe point for reclamation, is not used as a trigger.

### Expected behavior

- **Terminal + reported** jobs should be reclaimed (or moved to a bounded, evictable history) — a retention bound on terminal records, independent of session lifetime.
- `job_list` / `start()` should not pay `O(store.size)` — an index by owner (or a bounded terminal-history list) keeps them constant-time.
- The store's growth should be observable: a count/bytes metric and a warning threshold, so silent monotonic growth becomes visible.

### Repro

1. In one session, start a background job (e.g. via `run_in_background` / the jobs tool) and let it finish.
2. Repeat in a loop — the `job_list` result and the store grow on every iteration.
3. Observe: terminal jobs (with their `output`) remain in memory for the whole session; `job_list` and each new `start()` get slower as the count grows; no retention or warning exists.

### Environment

- Engine: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` (also reproduced in `0.1.0-rc.7`)
- Module: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local` (`lib/index.js`)

### Evidence (source)

```
:165   this.store.set(id, job)                     // written once, at start
:365   settle(job, outcome) {                     // terminal transition…
:369     job.output = outcome.output;             // …keeps the full output resident
:366     if (isTerminal(job.status)) return;      // idempotent, still no delete
:411   for (const job of owned) this.store.delete(job.id);   // only on owner disposal
:424   this.store.clear();                        // only on service teardown
:394   ensureOwnerCleanup(owner)                  // cleanup keyed to owner lifecycle
:137   if (this.activeTaskCount(spec.owner) >= …) // O(store.size) on every start()
:180   return [...this.store.values()].filter(…)  // O(store.size) on every list()
```

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 现象

本地后台任务注册表（`dsh-jobs-local`）中，job 记录在 `start()` 时**写入一次，在其 owner agent 存活期间从不移除**。当 job 进入终态（`completed` / `failed` / `cancelled` / `stopped`）时，`settle()` 只更新 status、detail、output、finishedAt——记录（**连同完整 `output` 字符串**）会一直留在 store 里，直到 owner agent 被销毁或 jobs 服务被整体拆除。

因此，在一个反复启动后台任务的长会话中（测试套件、批量处理、部署），store 无界增长：

- 每个终态 job（连同其 output 载荷）在整个会话生命周期内驻留；
- `job_list` 与 `start()` 全表扫描（`[...store.values()]`），成本随会话时长线性上升；
- 内存占用单调、静默增长——无警告、无 retention、无 LRU。

### 根因（store 生命周期，附源码引用）

在 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local@0.1.1-rc.2`（`lib/index.js`）上验证：

- `:165` —— `start()` 时 `this.store.set(id, job)`：记录进入 store。
- `:365-387` —— `settle()`：只设置 `status` / `detail` / `output` / `finishedAt`；**从不删除记录**。终态 `output` 字符串持续驻留。
- `:411` —— `this.store.delete(job.id)` 只出现在 `disposeOwned(owner)`（**owner agent** 生命周期结束）内。
- `:424` —— `this.store.clear()` 只出现在 `disposeAll()`（**jobs 服务** teardown）内。
- `:394-405` —— `ensureOwnerCleanup()`（本版本新增）：注册 owner 作用域 effect，在 agent 被销毁时调用 `disposeOwned`——即清理绑定在 **owner 的生命周期边界**，而非 job 的**状态边界**（终态）。
- `:137` —— 每次 `start()` 调用 `activeTaskCount()`，全表扫描（`O(store.size)`）。
- `:180` —— `list()` 全表扫描：`[...this.store.values()]`。
- `:102` —— `maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner`（默认 10）只对**活跃** job 校验（`:137`）——它约束并发，不约束累积，造成"有界"的错觉。

清理触发条件错位：**回收依赖生命周期边界（owner 销毁 / 服务 teardown），而非状态边界（job 终态 + 已读）**，因此在存活的会话内 store 只会增长。

### 影响范围（生产 / 进度 / 调度）

- **会话层：** job store 是会话的 agent 持有的进程内状态；长跑自动化会话（批量后台任务、类 CI 运行、部署）在整个会话生命周期内累积终态记录——每条都携带 output 载荷。内存单调、静默增长。
- **进度层：** 累积的终态记录本是会话后台工作的**审计轨迹**——但从不被裁剪，于是读取它们（`job_list`）与启动新任务（`activeTaskCount`）的成本随会话完成的工作量线性上升。会话越长寿、越高效，就越慢。
- **调度层：** 这正是调度/排队负载的场景：会话按计划或在循环中启动任务，记录无上限累积；在内存压力或可见延迟出现之前，没有任何信号。
- **与设计意图对照：** `maxConcurrentJobsPerOwner` 与本版新增的 `ensureOwnerCleanup` 表明引擎*确实*在管理 job 生命周期——但只覆盖并发边界与 owner 边界。**终态**这个最早的、最安全的回收时机，没有被用作触发条件。

### 期望行为

- **终态 + 已读（reported）** 的 job 应被回收（或移入有界、可驱逐的历史）——对终态记录设 retention 上限，与会话生命周期解耦。
- `job_list` / `start()` 不应付出 `O(store.size)`——按 owner 建索引（或有界终态历史列表）让它们保持常数时间。
- store 增长应可观测：暴露计数/字节指标与告警阈值，让静默的单调增长变得可见。

### 复现步骤

1. 在单个会话中启动一个后台任务（如通过 `run_in_background` / jobs 工具）并等它完成。
2. 循环重复——每次迭代 `job_list` 结果与 store 都在增长。
3. 观察：终态 job（连同 `output`）在整个会话期间留在内存；`job_list` 与每次新 `start()` 随数量增长而变慢；无 retention、无警告。

### 环境

- 引擎：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`（`0.1.0-rc.7` 亦可复现）
- 模块：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-jobs-local`（`lib/index.js`）

### 证据（源码）

```
:165   this.store.set(id, job)                     // start 时写入一次
:365   settle(job, outcome) {                     // 终态迁移…
:369     job.output = outcome.output;             // …完整 output 持续驻留
:366     if (isTerminal(job.status)) return;      // 幂等，仍不删除
:411   for (const job of owned) this.store.delete(job.id);   // 仅在 owner 销毁时
:424   this.store.clear();                        // 仅在服务 teardown 时
:394   ensureOwnerCleanup(owner)                  // 清理绑定 owner 生命周期
:137   if (this.activeTaskCount(spec.owner) >= …) // 每次 start() 都 O(store.size)

discussions.title: mcp-client 支持 OAuth 令牌自动刷新：透传 SDK 的 authProvider 而非仅静态 headers
discussions.body:
## 背景

DSH 通过 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 桥接外部 MCP 服务器。对于 Streamable HTTP，认证信息目前只能走 `StreamableHttpConfig.headers`——一个静态的 `Record<string, string>`。

这对 OAuth 2.1 保护的 MCP 端点不成立：**这类 token 会过期**。`headers` 的值在 loader 解析该 entry 配置时求值一次，之后不再重新读取，所以外部续期出的新 token 无法到达服务器，除非重载插件或重启 Host。

## MCP SDK 本身已经解决了这件事

`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk`（当前 1.29.0）的 `StreamableHTTPClientTransport` 接受一个 `authProvider`，并且：

- `_commonHeaders()` 每次请求都调用 `await this._authProvider.tokens()`，因此 token 是每请求解析的
- `refreshAuthorization()` 是现成的刷新实现，且在响应未返回新 refresh token 时保留原有的
- 收到 401 时会读 `WWW-Authenticate` 并触发重新授权

但 `createTransport` 只传了 `requestInit`，没有透传 `authProvider`：

```ts
// packages/mcp/mcp-client/src/transport.ts
case 'streamable-http':
  return new StreamableHTTPClientTransport(
    new URL(config.url),
    { requestInit: { headers: config.headers } },
  ) as Transport
```

于是 SDK 里这条完整的能力从 DSH 侧无法触及。

## DSH 的凭据基础设施也已经就位

`llm-pi-ai` 已经把「凭据会过期」这件事完整实现过一遍，用的正是通用 seam：

- `GrantRecord` 存 OAuth 授权产物，`payload` 对 seam 不透明——按 `credentials/src/types.ts` 的注释，「a library that owns a token format keeps owning it, refresh fields and all」
- `ctx.credentials.modifyRecord(key, mutate)` 是串行化的 read-modify-write，文档明确说这就是为 token 刷新设计的，且跨进程互斥：「two processes rotating one refresh token concurrently would otherwise lose whichever wrote first」
- `llm-pi-ai/src/auth.ts` 的注释还补了一句：pi-ai 在 `modify()` **内部**跑 OAuth 刷新，所以这个锁覆盖的是一次网络往返
- `ctx.authorization.registerFlow` 负责「打开这个页面、粘贴这个码」的人机对话

也就是说，需要的东西 DSH 都有，只是 mcp-client 还没接上——它的 `inject` 只有 `['tools']`，源码中没有一处引用 `credentials` 或 `authorization`。

## 建议

让 `createTransport` 支持透传一个 SDK 的 `OAuthClientProvider`，其 `tokens()` / `saveTokens()` 落到 `ctx.credentials` 的 `GrantRecord` 上（刷新在 `modifyRecord` 内完成，白拿跨进程互斥），并通过 `ctx.authorization` 注册首次授权与链条失效后的重新授权。

这比在配置里加一个「令牌凭据名」字段更贴合 SDK 合同：刷新时机、401 重授权、refresh token 轮转都由 SDK 既有实现负责，DSH 侧只提供存储与人机交互。

<details>
<summary>已验证的细节，以及为什么纯配置/自定义插件绕不过去</summary>

在 `0.1.1-rc.2` 上实测过一条不改官方源码的路径，结论是能跑但不该用：

**为什么理论上可行** — `normalizeHeaders()` 对普通对象做的是 `{ ...headers }` 展开，展开会触发 getter；而 `_commonHeaders()` 每次请求都重新调用它。所以在 `config.headers` 上装一个 `authorization` getter，确实能做到每请求解析。实测连续两次请求分别拿到不同的 token 值，静态 header 保留。

**为什么不能写在配置里** — loader 支持 `!js` 表达式，但 schemastery 校验会原地写入参对象（`data[rKey] = data[key]`），遇到只读 getter 直接抛：

```
TypeError: Cannot set property authorization of #<Object> which has only a getter
```

**为什么自定义插件注入也不该用** — 校验之后再 `defineProperty` 可行（schemastery 是原地改写而非重建，`entry.fiber.config` 就是传给 `apply` 的那个对象），但有两个问题：一是配置变更时 `_patchContext` 会调 `fiber.update(config, true)` 重新校验，对已注入 getter 的对象再校验会抛上面同一个错，可能让整棵插件树启动失败；二是它依赖「mcp-client 把 headers 原样交给 SDK」这一实现细节，上游哪天改成构造时 `new Headers(...)` 快照，方案就静默失效——token 不再刷新，直到过期才报错。

**顺带一个真实隐患** — 用外部定时任务（如 systemd timer）续期是绕开这个限制的常见做法，但它与 Host 进程各自读写同一份 refresh token。对滚动式 refresh token（用一次换一个新的），两边并发刷新会有一方的新 token 被覆盖丢弃，整条链随之断掉。`modifyRecord` 的跨进程互斥正是为这个场景准备的，而当前 mcp-client 用不到它。

**环境** — DSH 0.1.1-rc.2，web profile；`@modelcontextprotocol/sdk` 1.29.0；实测端点为 OAuth 2.1 保护的企业内网 MCP 服务（access token 24h，refresh token 7 天滚动）。

</details>

discussions.title: MCP 结果的图片与 ui_url 进入 tool/result.meta，通用工具卡渲染缩略图与页面链接（附可 cherry-pick 分支）
discussions.body:
**一句话**：让 MCP 工具返回的图片块与 `structuredContent.ui_url` 进入 `tool/result.meta`，通用工具卡渲染缩略图与页面链接；模型侧投影不变。已按仓库规范做完（含 keyless 快照与 Agent Note），放在一个可直接 cherry-pick 的分支：
https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...yuanweima:deepseek-harness:upstream-pr/mcp-presentation-meta （基于 `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2`，1 提交 / 32 文件）

## 问题

一个产出"需要人看一眼的东西"的 MCP server——渲染图、另一个应用里的页面——今天没法在 Web GUI 里显示出来：

- image 内容块只有在模型路由接受图片输入时才到达模型；否则 `dsh-mcp-client` 换成占位文本块，字节从所有界面（包括工具卡）消失。
- server 用 `structuredContent.ui_url` 说明"这个结果有个页面"（MCP 生态常见约定）时根本没有通道：URL 躺在 JSON 文本里，无人识别，且常是相对于 server 不知道的主机的相对路径。

core 本就有正确的接缝——`tool/result.meta` 是 `output.presentationMeta` 派生的工具私有、可回放、仅供 UI 的载荷（规范工具输出契约）——但 MCP 桥接层没有填它，通用卡也没东西可渲染。

## 提议（分支里就是这样实现的）

1. `dsh-mcp-client`：`output.presentationMeta` 作为规范 MCP 值的纯投影——每个格式正确的 image 块 → `meta.images[{index, mediaType, data}]`（不论模型路由是否接受；模型侧投影不变），`ui_url`（顶层或 `value` 之下）→ `meta.links[{href}]`，相对路径按新增行配置 `uiRoot` 解析（缺省空 = 透传）。
2. `dsh-client-ui-tool`：通用卡渲染 `meta.images`（缩略图带，单击占满行宽）与 `meta.links`（「↗ 路径」芯片）；折叠行显示图片数 / 页面徽标；芯片派发可取消的 `dsh:presentation-link` window 事件，部署方一个监听器即可接管链接处理，无人接管则 `window.open`。
3. `dsh-client-ui-conversation`：`IConversation.selectView(viewId)`（与 `send` 同样作用域寻址），插件有东西可展示后把自己注册的 `conversation.view` 拉到前台。

## 证据

- `examples/headless-agent` 新 keyless 快照 `mcp-presentation-meta`：真实 headless profile 调用 stdio fixture server 新加的 `render` 工具（PNG + `ui_url`），钉住 `tool/result.meta.images/links` 与"模型侧只有文本块"，两次运行逐字节一致。
- `mcp-client` / `ui-tool` / `ui-conversation` 单测覆盖投影、渲染、事件接管、`selectView`；在 rc.2 基线上 `typecheck` / `lint` / `doc-sync` / `knip` / `verify-client-packages` 全绿。
- Agent Note：`.agents/notes/implemented/feature/2026-08-22-mcp-presentation-meta-images-and-links.md`（含 Alternatives：为什么不把图片塞进模型消息、为什么先用 base64 而非内容寻址引用）。

## 背景与取舍

来自一个私有部署（MCP server 的结果是渲染图与控制台页面），改动本身与领域无关。有意没做：`meta` 里存内容寻址引用（需要桥接层目前没有的异步 meta 钩子，base64 只是日志体积代价）；把渲染放到独立 UI 包（通用卡就是未注册 MCP 工具本来渲染的地方，`tool.call.toolview` 所有者仍保有完全控制权）。

知道目前不收外部 PR，所以以 Idea + 分支的形式放在这里；若方向合适，随时可以按你们的节奏吸收或改写。

discussions.title: Draft Keeper — auto-save and restore composer drafts per session (`dsh-client-draft-keeper`)
discussions.body:
Your half-written prompt now survives a page reload, a browser crash, or an accidental tab close.

**Why:** Composer drafts were browser-local state only — anything not yet sent was lost on reload. I checked the ecosystem (awesome list + this thread) and found history-recall plugins that restore drafts when navigating history, but nothing doing automatic persistence & recovery — so this fills the gap.

**What it does:**
- Persists the composer draft per session into localStorage (single versioned record, best-effort semantics — corrupt or foreign data is discarded, never migrated)
- 300ms debounced writes; forced flush on session switch, `pagehide`, and `beforeunload`
- Restores only when it's safe: empty live draft, plain phase, composer locks open, no pending steering rows — one shot per session per plugin lifetime, with an info notice
- Clearing a draft is final: a manually cleared draft never comes back after reload
- Prunes entries for sessions that have left the live list
- Zero UI, zero slots, zero upstream file changes — talks to the composer only via public client services (`conversation.input`), reuses composer-guards' editable-input resolution

**Known limits (MVP):** plain text only — slash-command claims and @-mention chips aren't restored; multi-tab windows are last-write-wins for now.

**Where:** part of my fork-maintained plugin set → https://github.com/a137460387/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/extensions/draft-keeper. Feedback welcome, especially on edge cases.

discussions.title: Show Your Plugins!: MedSeek — clinical documentation bundle (drafts, de-ID, cited lookups)
discussions.body:
**MedSeek** is a clinical documentation bundle for DSH, built for the daily work of physicians, APPs, nurses, and residents. Free, Apache-2.0, zero telemetry, not a medical device.

**11 tools**

- Drafts from pasted text: SBAR / I-PASS handover, SOAP / APSO progress note, admission H&P, discharge summary
- Hard checklist enforcement: discharge refuses to pass while pending results are unowned; allergies explicit on admission; error-prone abbreviations flagged (ISMP / JC lists)
- Patient instructions scored against a 6th-to-8th grade reading target
- Safe Harbor de-identification of pasted text before anything else runs
- Cited lookups: FDA labels (DailyMed), MedlinePlus handouts (EN/ES), PubMed with reproducible queries, ClinicalTrials.gov records; every result carries source, identifier, link, retrieval date

**Safety architecture**

- PHI guard screens every network-tool call for identifier patterns before it runs (block / ask / off)
- Destination allowlist is exactly five hosts, enforced in code
- Local tools make zero network calls; drafts are banner-marked and never prescriptive
- Web GUI integration through sanctioned surfaces only: warm-paper/espresso themes, settings card, native result cards

Tested against @deepseek-ai/dsh 0.1.0-rc.8 (111 tests + clean-room mount test in CI).

**Install**

```
dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-medseek@0.1.0
```

Repo: https://github.com/Mr-Neutr0n/dsh-medseek (README also in 中文)

Feedback wanted, especially: does the draft structure match what your service expects, and what would make you delete it? Synthetic data only, please.

discussions.title: DSH | subagent-claude-code-wrapper | Delegate subagent work to any Claude-compatible CLI
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project**, independently developed and maintained by a community member. It is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek.

**Project URL:** https://github.com/yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper

**Documentation:** [English README](https://github.com/yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper/blob/main/README.md) · [简体中文 README](https://github.com/yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper/blob/main/README_ZH.md)

## Introduction

subagent-claude-code-wrapper lets DeepSeek Harness delegate subagent work to **any Claude-compatible CLI binary** — not just the SDK-bundled official one.

Forked from DSH's built-in `dsh-subagent-claude-code` with one added config field: `executablePath`. Point it at your CLI and delegation runs through it; leave it unset and it behaves exactly like the built-in provider (uses the SDK's bundled `claude` binary).

Useful for: enterprise internal forks, pinned versions, self-built binaries, or a wrapper script that injects extra flags.

## How it integrates with DSH

- Ships as a standard Harness bundle — `dsh plugin add` mounts it automatically.
- Registers a `claude-code-wrapper` provider on `ctx.subagents` (distinct from the built-in `claude-code`, so both can coexist).
- Passes through the SDK's existing `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable` option — no monkey-patching, no SDK behavior changes.
- On the preset side, reuses DSH's built-in `standard` preset copy flow: duplicate it, change the `tool-subagent-claude-code` row's provider to `claude-code-wrapper`, remove the `disabled` line — delegation is now enabled.

## Install

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add @yaways/dsh-subagent-claude-code-wrapper
dsh web
```

Also available from GitHub or a local directory — see the README for details.

Then follow the three-step onboarding: set `executablePath` → duplicate the preset to enable delegation → switch the default preset.

## Why a fork instead of a PR

The built-in `subagent-claude-code` provider's `Config` exposes `providerName`, `env`, and `permissionMode`, but not the SDK's `pathToClaudeCodeExecutable`. That field maps directly to the VS Code extension's `claudeCode.claudeProcessWrapper` — the built-in provider already covers the other launch-contract settings, this is the only one missing.

If upstream adds `executablePath` to the built-in `Config` and passes it through to the SDK, this plugin can be retired — the field name matches, so user config carries over with zero migration. Until then, this plugin is the "use it now" bridge.

## Verification

- End-to-end verified on DeepSeek Harness: main agent delegates → subagent launches a Claude-compatible CLI via the `claude-code-wrapper` provider → subagent executes a real investigation task and returns results.
- All three install methods verified (npm, GitHub, local directory) — zero extra steps, `lib/` is committed to the repo, no build or `allowBuilds` prompt needed.
- Bilingual README (zh/en) covers the full three-step onboarding including `preset.yml` display names, `settings.yaml` default-preset switching, and other gotchas.

discussions.title: [BUG] 「新建会话」按钮在某些工作区点击无反应（New Session silent no-op）
discussions.body:
> 中英双语。English version below.

## 现象

在侧边栏点击「新建会话」（顶部的全局按钮 / 字标，或某个工作区分组行上的 `+`）时，**有的工作区正常，有的工作区完全没反应**——不创建新会话、页面不切换、也没有任何报错。

## 为什么"时好时坏"

这是**状态相关**的，取决于"当前会话"是不是该工作区的空白（blank）会话：

| 当前状态 | 点击「新建会话」 |
|---|---|
| 当前会话 = 该工作区的空白会话（刚打开应用时自动选中的最近工作区空白会话；或刚点过一次新建会话之后） | ❌ 无反应 |
| 当前会话是普通（非空白）会话 | ✅ 正常（复用工作区已有的空白会话，或新建一个） |

所以同一个工作区：先在空白会话里发一条消息，按钮就"恢复"了；停在空白会话上再点，又"失效"。跨工作区看就是"某些可以、某些不行"。

## 根因

`WorkspaceRuntime.connectWorkspace` 的**空白会话复用扫描**会在工作区的成员空白会话中挑一个复用（设计意图：反复点击「新建会话」不要堆积一堆隐藏的空白会话）。但扫描没有排除**当前会话本身**：

- 当当前会话恰好就是该工作区的空白会话时，复用返回的就是当前会话的 id；
- 随后 `sessions.open(同一个 id)` 是幂等的，选中状态不变；
- 于是界面什么都不变——表现就是"点了没反应"。

修复前相关代码（`packages/client/runtime/src/client/workspaces/service.ts`）：

```ts
for (const id of sessions.ids) {
  const summary = sessions.byId[id]
  if (summary !== undefined && summary.blank && summary.cwd === workspace.path
    && workspace.sessionIds.includes(summary.id)
    && !archived.includes(summary.id)) return summary.id
}
```

## 修复

复用扫描增加 `id !== current` 条件：用户**正在查看**的空白会话不参与复用，落到新建分支（`session.create({ workspaceId })`）。点击「新建会话」现在总是会创建并打开一个全新的空白会话。

```ts
const current = sessions.current
for (const id of sessions.ids) {
  const summary = sessions.byId[id]
  if (summary !== undefined && summary.blank && id !== current
    && summary.cwd === workspace.path
    && workspace.sessionIds.includes(summary.id)
    && !archived.includes(summary.id)) return summary.id
}
```

行为不变的部分：当前会话是普通会话时，仍然先复用工作区里已有的空白会话（不会堆积隐藏空白会话）；`startInitialSelection` 启动选择不受影响（此时尚无当前会话）。

## 测试

`packages/client/runtime/tests/workspaces-service.client.spec.ts` 新增回归用例：当工作区空白会话恰为当前会话时，`startSession` 会创建全新会话并打开它（修复前该用例失败：`session.create` 未被调用，即静默空操作）。

---

## English

### Bug: clicking "New Session" does nothing in some workspaces (now fixed)

**Symptom:** Clicking New Session (the sidebar's global button / wordmark, or the `+` on a workspace group row) silently does nothing in *some* workspaces, while working fine in others — no new session, no navigation, no error.

**Why it looks intermittent:** the failure depends on whether the **current session is the workspace's blank session**:

- Current session == the workspace's blank (e.g. the recent-workspace blank auto-selected at boot, or right after one New Session click) → nothing happens.
- Current session is a normal (non-blank) session → works (reuses the workspace's parked blank, or mints a fresh one).

**Root cause:** `WorkspaceRuntime.connectWorkspace`'s blank-session reuse scan (which exists to avoid piling up hidden blanks on repeated clicks) never excluded the *current* session. When the current session is exactly that workspace's blank, reuse returns the current id, `sessions.open(same id)` is a no-op, and the click appears dead.

**Fix:** the reuse scan now skips the current session (`id !== current`), so the currently-viewed blank falls through to `session.create({ workspaceId })` and the click always creates and opens a fresh blank. Changed in `packages/client/runtime/src/client/workspaces/service.ts`; regression test added to `packages/client/runtime/tests/workspaces-service.client.spec.ts`.

discussions.title: pwsh/tool execution fails on Windows from a non-repo working directory
discussions.body:
# pwsh/tool execution fails on Windows from a non-repo working directory: `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'tsx'`

## Environment
- Platform: Windows (win32)
- Run as: source/dev mode (`cd <repo>; pnpm dsh web`) — package `lib/` outputs NOT built
- Node: v26.5.1 (reproduced; version-independent)

## Symptom
Every sandboxed tool command (e.g. the `pwsh` tool) aborts before any logic runs, on **every** invocation, with:

```
node:internal/modules/package_json_reader:301
  throw new ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND(packageName, fileURLToPath(base), null);
        ^

Error [ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND]: Cannot find package 'tsx' imported from D:\Projects\tricorder\
    at Object.getPackageJSONURL (node:internal/modules/package_json_reader:301:9)
    at packageResolve (node:internal/modules/esm/resolve:784:25)
    ...
    code: 'ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND'
```

Note the import origin: `imported from D:\Projects\tricorder\` is the **session workspace**, not the repo. The machine's real PowerShell works fine—it's not pwsh, it's a node process failing to boot.

## Why it works from the repo but not a workspace
The DSH CLI boots with `node --import tsx/esm apps/cli/src/bin.ts` (root `package.json`). `--import <name>` resolves the package **relative to `process.cwd()`**. Launching from inside the repo finds `node_modules/.pnpm/tsx@4.x`, so the harness itself boots. But the **windows-acl sandbox runner** is spawned on each tool call as:

```js
// packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts — windowsAclRunnerInvocation()
return [process.execPath, '--import', 'tsx/esm', sourceEntry]
```

with `cwd` = the session workspace (`policy.workspaceRoot`). That spawned node resolves `tsx` relative to the workspace, which has no `tsx` and cannot reach the repo's `.pnpm` store (it's a sibling, not an ancestor) → `ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND`.

## Reproduction (minimal)
```bash
cd /d/Projects/deepseek-harness   # repo where tsx IS installed
node --input-type=module -e "console.log(import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm'))"   # resolves fine (in-repo)
cd /d/Projects/tricorder          # any non-repo workspace
node --import tsx/esm --input-type=module -e "console.log('ok')"
# ERR_MODULE_NOT_FOUND: Cannot find package 'tsx' imported from D:\Projects\tricorder\
```

## Root cause
`sandbox-local` is the **only** `--import tsx` user in the repo that passes the bare package name. Every other user already resolves an absolute, cwd-independent `file://` URL:

- `packages/host/directory-picker-native/src/win32-dialog-host.ts:30`
  ```js
  spawn(process.execPath, ['--import', import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm'), ...])
  ```
- `packages/workflow/workflow-worker-thread/src/host.ts:74`
  ```js
  const tsxEsmApiEntry = import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm/api')
  ```

`import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm')` resolves against the **harness install** (where tsx is present), returning a `file://` URL that `node --import` accepts and that does not depend on the spawned child's cwd. The `sandbox-local` string form broke that invariant.

## Proposed fix (one line)
`packages/sandbox/sandbox-local/src/index.ts`, `windowsAclRunnerInvocation()`:

```js
// before
return [process.execPath, '--import', 'tsx/esm', sourceEntry]
// after — match win32-dialog-host.ts / workflow-worker-thread
return [process.execPath, '--import', import.meta.resolve('tsx/esm'), sourceEntry]
```

Verified: the `file://` URL form loads tsx from a non-repo cwd (exit 0); the bare form fails with the reported stack.

## Scope / note
- Only bites source/dev runs where `lib/runner.js` is unbuilt (`existsSync(builtEntry)` false). A built install (or the `dsh` launch-from-repo path) is unaffected.
- The same cwd-sensitivity affects the root `dsh` script itself if ever launched from outside the repo; that's arguably also worth a defensive note, but the sandbox runner is the one that fails on every tool call.

discussions.title: Two defects in llm-pi-ai on 0.1.1-rc.2: a rotated OAuth grant cannot be stored, and a provider availability policy never reaches a listing
discussions.body:
# Two defects in `llm-pi-ai` on 0.1.1-rc.2: a rotated OAuth grant cannot be stored, and a provider's availability policy never reaches a listing

Both reproduce on `master` at `b150a551b8` (0.1.1-rc.2). They are independent, but a deployment using an OAuth-authenticated catalog route hits both, and the second one hides itself.

---

## 1. `toRecord` cannot store a grant that the credential store will accept

**Where:** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/auth.ts`, `toRecord`

```ts
return { kind: 'grant', payload: credential }
```

**What happens:** the seam keeps a grant's payload opaque so the library owning the token format keeps owning it. But `credentials-local` validates that payload at the durable boundary with a rule stricter than `JSON.stringify`: `assertJsonValue` rejects `undefined` outright, where JSON would simply drop the key.

pi-ai's GitHub Copilot refresh returns `enterpriseUrl: enterpriseDomain`, and `enterpriseDomain` is `undefined` for an account with no Enterprise domain. Storing that verbatim throws from inside `modifyRecord`:

```
credentials-local: record "llm-pi-ai/github-copilot" payload holds a value JSON cannot represent
```

**Why the symptom is misleading:** `modifyRecord` here is the write that commits a *freshly exchanged* short-lived token. The route resolved, the credential resolved, and the token exchange with GitHub succeeded — then the turn fails with `PI_AI_ERROR`. The error names the credential store rather than the optional field that carries no value, so it reads as "my credentials are broken" rather than "a field is absent".

**Timing makes it worse:** the failure only appears once the stored access token expires (roughly hourly for Copilot). A deployment can look healthy for a long stretch and then start failing on a boundary unrelated to anything the operator changed.

**Note the asymmetry that gave it away:** `toRecord`'s api-key branch already omits absent fields (`...credential.key === undefined ? {} : { key: credential.key }`), while the grant branch passed the object through untouched. The two branches disagreed about a value neither format can carry.

**Suggested fix:** round-trip the grant through JSON before committing it. The stored payload is then exactly what the seam's opacity promise already covers — what JSON preserves — while a payload JSON genuinely cannot carry (a cyclic object, a `BigInt`) still reaches the store's own loud rejection instead of being silently repaired.

**Alternatives I considered and rejected:**

- *Accept `undefined` in `assertJsonValue`.* That check guards a durable boundary for every provider; silently dropping a value there would hide a real serialization mistake in a record the harness cannot re-derive.
- *Delete the key in a provider-specific branch.* The adapter deliberately names no pi-ai provider on this path. Any provider may fill an optional field with `undefined`, and a per-provider list would drift with the library.
- *Pin an older pi-ai.* The field is not a regression to avoid but a shape the adapter must tolerate.

---

## 2. `reuseCatalogProvider` drops `filterModels`, so a listing ignores the provider's availability policy

**Where:** `packages/llm/llm-pi-ai/src/provider.ts`, `reuseCatalogProvider`

The rebuilt provider forwards dispatch:

```ts
stream: (model, context, options) => base.stream(model, context, options),
streamSimple: (model, context, options) => base.streamSimple(model, context, options),
```

…but not `filterModels`. A pi-ai provider may publish that as an availability policy over the credential in hand; GitHub Copilot uses it to intersect its catalog with the entitlements the stored OAuth credential carries.

Because a listing reads the rebuilt object and never the catalog provider behind it, the policy is silently absent for **every** catalog route — the wrapper reports that it publishes no policy at all.

**What the operator sees:** a model selector offering entries that cannot be called. Choosing one fails at request time with `403 Access to this endpoint is forbidden` instead of the model simply not being listed. On the account I reproduced against, the served list was noticeably wider than the entitled set, and every extra entry was unusable.

**Why it is easy to miss:** `llm.models` answers `ok: true` with `failures: []`. Nothing is failing — the list is simply wrong. Any health check that watches the failure array passes.

**A trap worth documenting:** `Models.getAvailable()` looks like the method that fixes this and is not. It gates on `checkProviderAuth` first, and that consults pi-ai's *own* credential store. Every `apiKeyEnv` route resolves its key through the harness at request time instead, so the store holds nothing for it, the gate reports the route unconfigured, and the entire catalog disappears. I tried that first; it emptied the model list for ordinary api-key routes and turned five existing tests red. Applying the policy alone — `getModels()` then the provider's `filterModels` — leaves the credential question where the request path already answers it.

**Suggested fix:** forward `filterModels` in `reuseCatalogProvider` (delegated, not lifted off `base`, for the same reason `stream` is delegated — lifting the method detaches it from its receiver), and apply it in `PiAiAdapter.listModels`. Keep the forwarding conditional: the key's presence is the signal pi-ai reads, and an unconditional wrapper would make every route look like it publishes a policy, so a caller could not distinguish "no policy" from "a policy that kept everything".

Two properties worth preserving:

- **It narrows only.** A model the account holds but the catalog lacks stays invisible, because both sides are intersections and neither can add. Catalog freshness is a separate question.
- **A credential read that fails should keep the unfiltered catalog, not empty it.** An unfiltered listing is otherwise indistinguishable from a correctly filtered one, and an empty one looks like a route that serves no models. A diagnostic hook on that path makes the degradation visible.

---

## How these two interact

Defect 2 masks part of defect 1's blast radius. An operator investigating "some models 403" naturally suspects the account or the credential, which is also where defect 1 points its error message. The two together make a working credential look broken from two directions at once.

---

## Reproduction notes

**Defect 2** needs only a catalog route whose provider publishes `filterModels` and a stored credential carrying entitlements: compare `models.getModels(provider)` against `provider.filterModels(models, credential)` and observe that a listing returns the former.

**Defect 1** is harder to observe on demand, because it only fires when a stored token has expired. Waiting for that is impractical, so I forced it: copy the credential document, age the stored `expires` into the past so pi-ai's optimistic check fails, then call `getAuth` through a real `credentials-local` provider. That runs a genuine refresh and drives the rotated token through the same `modify` → `toRecord` → `assertJsonValue` path a production turn takes, with every write landing on the copy.

Measured with the normalization in place, the token rotates and the write commits. Measured with it removed, the original failure reproduces verbatim. That difference is what separates "the fix works" from "this path was never broken" — worth stating because the unfixed path passes any test that never reaches an actual refresh.

For coverage of defect 2, asserting both directions matters: that entitled models survive *and* that unentitled ones are dropped. Either assertion alone passes for the wrong reason — an unfiltered list satisfies the first, an empty list satisfies the second.

---

## Environment

- `master` at `b150a551b8`, version 0.1.1-rc.2
- `@earendil-works/pi-ai` 0.82.1
- Windows, Node 26
- A GitHub Copilot account with no Enterprise domain (which is what makes `enterpriseUrl` `undefined`)

I have both fixes working locally with tests, and I'm happy to open PRs if that's useful — I saw in `CONTRIBUTING.md` that external pull requests aren't being accepted right now, so I'm reporting here instead and can share patches in whatever form suits you.

discussions.title: A股行情/K线数据源聚合封装 — 五源自动降级 + DNS容灾 + 重试机制
discussions.body:
# A股行情/K线数据源聚合封装 — 五源自动降级 + DNS容灾 + 重试机制

分享一个我做的 A 股免费数据源聚合库：[cn-data-failover](https://github.com/luoma24/cn-data-failover)

**为什么做**：A股数据源（腾讯/新浪/通达信/FTShare/Tushare）任何单一源都不稳定——新浪行情会间歇性超时、DNS 解析会批量失败（实测一天 389 次 `Temporary failure in name resolution`）。单源可用性约 99.5%，永远到不了 99.99%。

**核心能力**：
- `get_quotes()` / `get_kline()` 单入口，K线五源自动降级（腾讯→新浪→easy-tdx→FTShare MCP→Tushare）
- DNS 缓存 + IP 直连兜底（DNS 挂了用缓存 IP + Host 头绕过）
- 每次请求自动重试 2 次 + 指数退避
- 每条数据带 `source` 字段可追溯
- 纯 `requests` 实现，Tushare token 走环境变量，可选

**踩坑记录**（都是实测踩过才写下来的）：
1. easy-tdx 不要用 `from_best_host()` — 会选到坏服务器，必须固定 `180.153.18.170`
2. 腾讯 K 线成交量字段是字符串 `"411856.000"`，直接 `int()` 会崩，需 `int(float(x))`
3. 新浪行情必须带 `Referer: https://finance.sina.com.cn`
4. FTShare MCP 不能用 GET 探测，必须 POST `initialize` 握手拿 `mcp-session-id`
5. **DNS 是所有域名源的单点故障** — 解法是缓存 IP 直连
6. 装 easy-tdx 会把 pandas 3.x 降到 2.x

实测数据（A股交易时段）：腾讯 319ms / 新浪 174ms / easy-tdx 261ms，多源叠加接近 99.99% 可用。

MIT 协议，欢迎 star / issue / PR！

discussions.title: 工具调用在会话结束后才返回错误，导致任务完成状态与实际执行状态不一致
discussions.body: ## 问题描述 当执行 Edit、Write 或 Pwsh 等有副作用的工具时，工具调用可能显示： tool call was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded 但助手轮次已经显示完成。随后工具错误才出现在已结束的会话中。 这导致用户无法判断： 1. 工具动作是否已经执行； 2. 文件或进程是否已经改变； 3. 当前任务是否真的完成。 ## 复现步骤 1. 在 Web GUI 中执行一个需要用户目录写入或长驻进程操作的任务。 2. 触发权限确认、工具中断或 PowerShell 子进程中止。 3. 观察助手先生成最终回复并结束轮次。 4. 几秒后观察工具错误才显示在已完成会话中。 ## 实际结果 助手轮次已经结束，但工具调用仍可能处于： - failed - aborted - result unknown ## 期望结果 对于有副作用的工具： - 工具返回明确成功前，不应结束当前任务； - `aborted` 或没有持久化结果时，应将任务标记为“结果未知”； - 应自动执行验证，或保持任务未完成； - 延迟到达的工具错误不应追加到已经标记完成的轮次中。 ## 影响 用户可能误以为文件修改、进程启动或配置更新已经完成，也可能在工具实际成功后重复执行，造成重复副作用。 ## 相关错误 tool call was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded ## 已观察到的现象 本次配置修改中，工具调用显示 aborted，但后续重新读取文件发现文件实际上已经写入。 这说明工具最终副作用和前端/会话状态之间存在不同步。

Currently, when typing or reading text in languages like Hebrew, Arabic, Persian, Urdu, and other RTL scripts, the text alignment and word order get broken (especially when mixing RTL text with English code or terminology). Using the Qwen 3.8 27B model running directly inside DeepSeek Harness, I developed a clean, lightweight, and robust solution that adds dynamic `dir="auto"` language detection across the entire interface (chat composer, user bubbles, and assistant markdown responses). To make it super easy for the community to use—and to survive future updates—I have packaged this fix into a ready-to-use Patch file and an automated Windows Batch installer. --- ### 📸 Visual Preview: **1. Input Box (RTL Auto-Direction):** **2. Chat Bubbles & Assistant Response:** --- ### 📦 What is included? 1. **`rtl-support.patch`**: A clean git patch containing all the necessary `dir="auto"` attributes across the client source files (using relative paths). 2. **`apply-rtl.bat`**: A smart interactive script for Windows that validates paths, checks for conflicts (dry-run), applies the patch, and automatically rebuilds the web interface. --- ### 🛠️ How to use (For Users): 1. Download the ZIP file below and extract its contents `Apply-RTL.bat` into your DeepSeek Harness root folder (where `package.json` lives). 2. Double-click `Apply-RTL.bat` and press **Enter**. 3. Refresh your browser page once the build completes! --- ### 📥 Download Package: 📁 **[Download Apply-RTL.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31332523/Apply-RTL.zip)** --- ### 🙏 Request for Main Maintainers & Developers: Please consider officially integrating `dir="auto"` into the core UI components in the next release. Hope this helps the community!

discussions.title: dsh-memory-plus：DeepSeek Harness 记忆优化的「地基修复」方案
discussions.body:
为什么会有这个项目？

DSH 记忆插件半年内涌现了 20 多个（dsh-memory-evolve 205⭐ / dsh-mnemon 136⭐ / dsh-noema 116⭐ 等），但绝大多数是单点功能插件，而且几乎都建立在官方 sessionQuery 之上。

问题在于：官方的 unicode61 存在中文缺陷，意味着整个生态的中文召回都是坏的。

dsh-memory-plus 的定位就是 「记忆全家桶 + 修地基」 ——不是第 16 个记忆插件，而是让所有记忆插件都能正常工作的底层修复。

核心解决了什么？

1. CJK 检索修复（生态唯一）

通过 trigram 双表 + 1–2 字 LIKE 回退，修复了官方 unicode61 的中文召回缺陷。实测效果：unicode61 0 命中 → 本仓库全命中（含 1–2 字查询），12 个单测全部通过。

这意味着什么？20 多个记忆插件共同受益。

2. 工具结果去重

dsh-tool-result-dedup：对重复的工具结果（如多次 git status、ls、重复读取文件）进行哈希去重，替换为指针。纯省输入 Token，与记忆检索正交，生态少见。

3. 混合记忆检索

dsh-memory-index：sqlite-vec 向量臂 + FTS5 词法臂 → RRF 融合；事件级增量嵌入 + file 词条过滤。dsh-memory-tool 则提供模型可调用的 memory_search 工具，输出严格有界。

4. 近无损压缩 + 来源定位

dsh-compaction-locator：每个 `` 追加 Exact Sources 定位符（spill 路径 / 文件路径 / seq 区间）。压缩不丢信息，每条摘要可溯源。

5. 技能自我进化（Phase 3）

dsh-memory-skills：skill_write/delete/list + 后台反思蒸馏（Hermes 式学习循环），请求路径零开销。

验证情况

  • 65 个单测（7 个包，node 环境全部通过）

  • Phase 0–3 全部落地，并在真实 harness（headless profile）中集成验证

  • 详细生态盘点（20+ 项目对照表 + license 自查）：docs/DSH-MEMORY-ECOSYSTEM.md

插件一览

包 | 作用 | 阶段 -- | -- | -- dsh-session-query-sqlite-cjk | 中文可用的会话全文检索：FTS5 双 tokenizer 双表（unicode61 + trigram），按查询是否含 CJK 自动路由 | Phase 0 dsh-tool-result-dedup | 工具结果哈希去重：重复结果替换为指针，节省输入 Token | Phase 0 dsh-memory-index | 混合记忆检索：sqlite-vec 向量臂 + FTS5 词法臂 → RRF 融合 | Phase 1 dsh-memory-tool | 模型可调用的 memory_search 工具，输出有界 | Phase 1 dsh-compaction-locator | 近无损压缩 + Exact Sources 定位符 | Phase 2 dsh-memory-skills | 技能管理器 + 后台自我进化 | Phase 3 dsh-memory-core | 跨会话核心记忆 + KV-safe 稳定注入 | Phase 2 dsh-memory-bundle | 一键安装全家桶 | —

安装方式

bash
dsh plugin --profile default add https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus

或通过 dsh-memory-bundle 一键安装全家桶。

欢迎讨论

  • 使用中遇到问题？欢迎提 Issue

  • 有改进想法？欢迎 PR

  • 想了解生态对比？可以看 生态盘点文档

项目地址：https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus

如果觉得太长，可以只保留「为什么会有这个项目」「核心解决了什么」「安装方式」三部分发出来，其他的留作补充回复。

为什么会有这个项目？ DSH 记忆插件半年内涌现了 20 多个（dsh-memory-evolve 205⭐ / dsh-mnemon 136⭐ / dsh-noema 116⭐ 等），但绝大多数是单点功能插件，而且几乎都建立在官方 sessionQuery 之上。 问题在于：官方的 unicode61 存在中文缺陷，意味着整个生态的中文召回都是坏的。 dsh-memory-plus 的定位就是 「记忆全家桶 + 修地基」 ——不是第 16 个记忆插件，而是让所有记忆插件都能正常工作的底层修复。 核心解决了什么？ 1. CJK 检索修复（生态唯一） 通过 trigram 双表 + 1–2 字 LIKE 回退，修复了官方 unicode61 的中文召回缺陷。实测效果：unicode61 0 命中 → 本仓库全命中（含 1–2 字查询），12 个单测全部通过。 这意味着什么？20 多个记忆插件共同受益。 2. 工具结果去重 dsh-tool-result-dedup：对重复的工具结果（如多次 git status、ls、重复读取文件）进行哈希去重，替换为指针。纯省输入 Token，与记忆检索正交，生态少见。 3. 混合记忆检索 dsh-memory-index：sqlite-vec 向量臂 + FTS5 词法臂 → RRF 融合；事件级增量嵌入 + file 词条过滤。dsh-memory-tool 则提供模型可调用的 memory_search 工具，输出严格有界。 4. 近无损压缩 + 来源定位 dsh-compaction-locator：每个 `` 追加 Exact Sources 定位符（spill 路径 / 文件路径 / seq 区间）。压缩不丢信息，每条摘要可溯源。 5. 技能自我进化（Phase 3） dsh-memory-skills：skill_write/delete/list + 后台反思蒸馏（Hermes 式学习循环），请求路径零开销。 验证情况 65 个单测（7 个包，node 环境全部通过） Phase 0–3 全部落地，并在真实 harness（headless profile）中集成验证 详细生态盘点（20+ 项目对照表 + license 自查）：[docs/DSH-MEMORY-ECOSYSTEM.md](https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus/blob/main/docs/DSH-MEMORY-ECOSYSTEM.md) 插件一览 包 作用 阶段 dsh-session-query-sqlite-cjk 中文可用的会话全文检索：FTS5 双 tokenizer 双表（unicode61 + trigram），按查询是否含 CJK 自动路由 Phase 0 dsh-tool-result-dedup 工具结果哈希去重：重复结果替换为指针，节省输入 Token Phase 0 dsh-memory-index 混合记忆检索：sqlite-vec 向量臂 + FTS5 词法臂 → RRF 融合 Phase 1 dsh-memory-tool 模型可调用的 memory_search 工具，输出有界 Phase 1 dsh-compaction-locator 近无损压缩 + Exact Sources 定位符 Phase 2 dsh-memory-skills 技能管理器 + 后台自我进化 Phase 3 dsh-memory-core 跨会话核心记忆 + KV-safe 稳定注入 Phase 2 dsh-memory-bundle 一键安装全家桶 — 安装方式 bash dsh plugin --profile default add https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus 或通过 dsh-memory-bundle 一键安装全家桶。 欢迎讨论 使用中遇到问题？欢迎提 Issue 有改进想法？欢迎 PR 想了解生态对比？可以看 [生态盘点文档](https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus/blob/main/docs/DSH-MEMORY-ECOSYSTEM.md) 项目地址：https://github.com/QIANLING-0831/dsh-memory-plus

discussions.title: DSH-Portable — take your Harness workspace with you
discussions.body:
I built DSH-Portable for people who want a real desktop window without tying their DSH setup to one machine.

![DSH-Portable on Windows](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/main/assets/dsh-interface-en.png)

It packages the official DeepSeek Harness preview with:

- a portable Windows folder and installer, macOS app/DMG, and Linux AppImage/portable folder
- sessions, settings, plugins, and workspace that move together
- a native window and tray with recent sessions and task notifications
- a built-in plugin market and portable plugin CLI
- tested in-place updates and upstream compatibility gates

The portable workflow is the main difference: exit from the tray, copy one folder to another drive or PC, and continue from there.

Repo: https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable  
Website: https://wsl043.github.io/DSH-Portable/  
Downloads: https://github.com/WSL043/DSH-Portable/releases/latest

This is an independent community distribution, not an official DeepSeek desktop app. Feedback from people using it on different machines is very welcome.

discussions.title: [Bug] Agent 杀死自身宿主后，用户无法得知任务完成状态：崩溃恢复不指名被中断的工具、无恢复通知
discussions.body:
## 现象（用户视角）

当 agent 终止了自己的宿主进程（例如通过 bash 工具 `kill <pid>` 杀掉 `dsh web` 服务器进程）时，会话在工具调用中途崩溃。崩溃恢复后：

- 用户看到一条含糊的 "The tool call was interrupted … Its outcome is unknown"，**没有任何提示说明服务重启了、会话已从日志恢复**；
- 用户无法判断 agent 后续任务是否完成，只能追问 agent；
- agent 恢复后拿到的是通用文案，**没有工具名、没有 callId、没有恢复上下文**，只能靠猜。

实际事故（本机 dsh-sandbox 环境）：agent 执行 `kill 86530`（即托管自己的 web 服务器）→ 会话日志留下 `tool/call`（seq 80584）无对应 `tool/result` → 恢复器合成 `interrupted-tool-result`（seq 80585，`TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`）→ 用户侧只看到通用提示，状态完全不可见。

## 复现

仓库内已有现成的端到端设施：`packages/session/session-checkpoint-policy/tests/crash-recovery.e2e.ts`（SIGKILL 子进程 + 恢复加载）。真实事故的会话日志尾部也完整保留了同样的结构（`tool/call` 无结果 → 合成 `TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN`）。

## 根因

`packages/core/session/src/repair.ts` 的 `interruptedTurnClosers` 合成的结果：

1. 不包含被中断工具的名称与 callId（`pendingCalls` 只记录 `step`/`callSeq`）；
2. 不告知模型"会话日志在中断后被恢复"——模型无法向用户解释发生了什么；
3. （相邻问题，非本修复范围）bash 工具没有"禁止终止自身宿主"的护栏；`dsh web` 也没有优雅重启命令（见 #2933）。

## 建议修复（已实现，见下方分支）

在合成结果文本中加入工具身份与恢复上下文：

> `The <tool> tool call <callId> was interrupted after it was recorded, but no result was durably recorded. The session log was recovered after an interruption, so its outcome is unknown. …`

保守指引（只读/幂等可重试；否则先核对外部状态或询问用户；不要盲目重试）、恢复码、seq 分配与事件词汇表均不变。

- 实现分支：https://github.com/yi-yang/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/crash-recovery-names-interrupted-tool （commit fd4eed4，含单元测试、e2e 断言、README 与 Agent Note）
- 已通过：`repair.spec.ts` 11 项、`crash-recovery.e2e.ts` 2 项、session 包 282 项、`repair.ts` 覆盖率 100%、`tsc -b tsconfig.host.json`、`verify-agent-note-format`、`verify-translation-pairing`、`verify-md-links`

## 关联

- #1574：为 TOOL_OUTCOME_UNKNOWN 补充结构化信息（方向一致，本报告是其模型可见信息缺口的最小实现）
- #2933：`dsh web --stop/--restart`（优雅重启缺失是"只能杀进程"的根源）
- CONTRIBUTING.md 说明当前不接受外部 PR；如团队愿意，可直接从上述分支拉取该提交。

discussions.title: dsh 0.1.1 upgrade breaks third-party plugins with no compat check: registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function
discussions.body:
### Summary
Upgrading `@deepseek-ai/dsh` from `0.1.0-rc.6` to `0.1.1-rc.2` silently breaks third-party plugins that were written against the rc.6/rc.7 adapter contract. In our case, the community plugin `dsh-vision-router` v1.6.2 crashed the web UI on the first message with:

```
registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function (UNKNOWN)
```

This is a **breaking API change in dsh 0.1.1** (`prepareCall` was added to the adapter contract) with **no detection, warning, or migration path** for installed plugins.

### Environment
- OS: Windows 10
- dsh: `0.1.0-rc.6` → `0.1.1-rc.2` (via `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh`)
- Plugin: `dsh-vision-router` v1.6.2 (community, at `~/.dsh/profiles/*/node_modules`, pnpm-managed)

### Steps to reproduce
1. Install dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 with a plugin (e.g. dsh-vision-router v1.6.2) that predates the `prepareCall` contract.
2. Start `dsh web`, send any message (or trigger context injection / memory recall that reaches the adapter).
3. Observe crash: `registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function`.

### Root cause
- dsh 0.1.1 introduced a required `prepareCall` method on registered adapters.
- The plugin's adapter, written for rc.6/rc.7, does not implement it.
- No startup-time validation or upgrade-time compatibility check exists, so the failure only surfaces at runtime on first use.

### Workaround (verified)
Upgrading the plugin to v1.7.6 (commit `dae05e10`, "support DSH 0.1.1 prepareCall adapter contract") fixes the crash.

### Feature request: plugin compatibility self-check after upgrade
Since DSH's design philosophy is "Everything is a Plugin", upgrade-time plugin compatibility is a first-class UX concern. Proposals:

1. **Runtime contract probe (recommended, minimal)**: at boot, verify required adapter methods (e.g. `prepareCall`) exist on every registered plugin adapter; on failure, emit an actionable error naming the plugin, its version, and the required dsh version — instead of a bare `is not a function`.
2. **Upgrade-time check / notice**: after upgrading dsh, scan `profiles/*/node_modules` for plugins and report which ones may need a companion upgrade (like a `dsh doctor` command).
3. **Docs**: change the "command not recognized → reopen window" guidance to "run `npm install -g @deepseek-ai/dsh` to repair" where applicable.

### Bonus (minor)
`dsh web` spawns a `markitdown-mcp` child process; when the process is interrupted, it prints a large misleading `KeyboardInterrupt` traceback. Clean child-process exit handling would help.

discussions.title: [Windows] 关掉界面，后台其实还在跑 —— 做了个托盘工具，让 dsh web 变成真正的桌面软件
discussions.body:
> ### 📦 [ChenSiyun1234 / **dsh-tray-windows**](https://github.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows)
> 让 `dsh web` 在 Windows 上像个正常桌面软件：托盘常驻、独立窗口、**关掉就是真的关掉**。MIT，非官方。

我每天都用 `dsh web`，用久了发现几个挺膈应人的问题，最后写了个 Windows 托盘工具解决掉了。先说问题，因为它们才是这东西存在的理由。

### 一、你以为关掉了，其实它还在跑

这个最要命。

DeepSeek Harness 的界面其实就是个网页。**你随手把窗口一关，看着像是关掉了 —— 但真正干活的那个程序还在后台跑着**，你在屏幕上完全看不见它。

它会一直占着你的内存（实测：什么都不干、刚打开的状态就占 **177 MB**，聊久了只会更多），一直到你下次重启电脑为止。

更麻烦的是：它干活的时候还会开出一堆小程序（帮你跑命令的终端、插件开的浏览器……）。**就算你去任务管理器里把主程序结束掉，这些小程序也不会跟着消失**，它们会变成"孤儿"留在系统里 —— 而你根本认不出那是它留下的。

![关掉之后还剩什么](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows/main/docs/residue-compare.png)

### 二、手滑点两下，就跑起来两份

桌面图标多点两下，或者你在命令行里又敲了一次 `dsh web` —— 于是就有好几份在同时跑，内存成倍占用，你还分不清哪个是哪个。

![开好几个 vs 只有一个](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows/main/docs/instances-compare.png)

### 三、每次都往浏览器里塞一个标签页

`dsh web` 默认会打开你的浏览器多加一个标签页。你的浏览器本来就开着几十个标签，找它跟大海捞针一样，而且它还和你的浏览记录、插件、翻译弹窗混在一起。

![窗口对比](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows/main/docs/window-compare.png)

---

## 这个工具做了什么

### 👉 仓库：[github.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows](https://github.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows)

桌面上一个图标，点开就用，关掉就是真的关掉。

![托盘菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows/main/docs/tray-menu.png)

**关掉就是真的关掉。** 后台程序一启动就被"拴"在托盘上（用的是 Windows 内核提供的进程绑定机制）。你点「退出」，后台程序连同它开出来的所有小程序，会被系统一起收走。

关键在于：**这个保证不依赖任何清理代码写得对不对**。哪怕你直接用任务管理器把托盘强行结束掉，系统照样会把它们全部收干净。实测强杀托盘之后：后台程序、端口、应用窗口全部消失，而你自己的浏览器 14 个进程一个没动。

**全局只有一份。** 再点桌面图标不会启动任何新东西，只会把已经开着的窗口调到最前面（最小化了也会帮你恢复）；启动时会先把多余的收掉；之后每分钟检查一次，万一又冒出第二个就自动关掉并提示你。只管 `dsh web`，你手动跑的 `--profile headless` 之类不会被碰。

**一个正常的桌面窗口。** 没有标签栏、没有地址栏，用的是独立的浏览器身份，关它不会误关你自己的网页。**任务栏上也是它自己的图标** —— 这一点单靠 `--app` 是做不到的，系统仍然当它是浏览器窗口、显示 Edge 的图标，得主动接管任务栏身份才行。

**托盘图标不糊、还能看状态。** 16/20/24/32/40/48/64 每个尺寸单独画，高分屏上不会被拉伸；后台挂了图标自己变灰。

菜单里还有：重启后台服务（改完 `cordis.patch.yml` 重载插件用）、开机自启、一键打开配置文件 / 数据目录 / 运行日志。后台程序的输出都被接管写进日志文件，出问题能查。

---

## 怎么装

需要 Windows 10/11、Node.js、`@deepseek-ai/dsh`、Edge 或 Chrome。
编译用 Windows 自带的编译器，**不用装 Visual Studio，也不用装 .NET SDK**。

```powershell
git clone https://github.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows.git
cd dsh-tray-windows
powershell -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts\install.ps1
```

MIT 协议。**非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无关**；仓库自带的是原创图标，不含任何 DeepSeek 商标资产（想用官方鲸鱼图标的话，仓库里有脚本可以从你本机已装的 dsh 里现取生成 —— 上面那张截图就是这个模式）。

在 Windows 11 + dsh `0.1.1-rc.2` 上开发测试。Windows 10 理论上能用但没实测过，欢迎反馈踩坑。

---

⭐ 仓库在这儿：**https://github.com/ChenSiyun1234/dsh-tray-windows** —— 有问题欢迎开 issue。
