discussions.title: 工具调用失败留下悬挂 tool_calls,会话被 400 INVALID_REQUEST 永久卡死
discussions.body:
工具调用失败(调度器缺失)会在会话历史留下悬挂的 tool_calls,之后该会话**永久卡死**,每个请求都被模型 API 以 400 拒绝,且没有任何自动恢复手段。

<details>
<summary>复现、预期与验收</summary>

- 复现步骤：
  1. 在 web profile 里安装一个把 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 带进 profile 依赖图的插件(如 `@snow-the/dsh-busyloop@0.1.6` 曾把 dsh-tools 声明为运行时依赖),或任何导致 profile node_modules 重链后立即重启的操作。
  2. 重启 dsh web,在旧会话(或新会话)里让 agent 发起第一次工具调用。
  3. 观察：`tool/call` 事件落盘后,工具执行抛 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`,**没有 `tool/result` 事件**;turn 以 error 结束。
  4. 之后该会话的每一个请求都被 API 拒绝：`An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages responding to each 'tool_call_id'. (insufficient tool messages following tool_calls message)`(`INVALID_REQUEST`,400)——会话永久卡死,无法继续。
- 实际结果：一次调度器层的工具执行失败,把整个会话历史永久污染;用户被迫放弃该会话。
- 预期结果：工具执行失败时,agent-loop 应合成一条错误 `tool/result`(如 isError 消息)落盘,保证"assistant 的 tool_calls 后面必有 tool messages"这一 API 不变量;会话应能继续。
- 环境：Windows 11, dsh `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`(npm 全局),web profile。
- 验收条件：模拟调度器缺失(或任何 startCall 阶段的异常)后,会话历史中每个 assistant tool_calls 消息都有对应的 tool messages;会话不因一次工具执行失败而卡死。

</details>

**根因定位(附带证据)**

崩溃发生在 `dsh-agent-loop` 的工具调度路径：

```js
// dsh-agent-loop/lib/index.js:193 (startCall)
const prepared = await ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER].prepare(call.exec);
```

`TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER` 是 `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 导出的 `Symbol`。当 `ctx.tools` 实例来自另一个 dsh-tools 模块实例(例如 profile 安装重链窗口期产生的第二个模块实例)时,`ctx.tools[symbol]` 为 `undefined`,此处直接抛 `Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')`,而 `appendToolCall` 已经先一步把 assistant 的 tool_calls 写进了会话事件流(`tool/call` 事件已落盘),错误路径没有补写 `tool/result`。

会话文件中的事件序列(实测)：

```
assistant/message  (含 tool-call)
tool/call          (appendToolCall 成功落盘)
step/end           ← error: Cannot read properties of undefined (reading 'prepare')
turn/end           ← kind: error
… 之后每个 turn：
request/header → assistant/chunk(finish error)
  "An assistant message with 'tool_calls' must be followed by tool messages …" (INVALID_REQUEST 400)
```

**建议修复**

在 `startCall`/调度路径上对 `ctx.tools[TOOL_RUNTIME_SCHEDULER]` 缺失或 prepare 抛错的情况兜底：为每个已落盘 `tool/call` 的调用补写一条错误 `tool/result`(isError=true),再让 step 失败——保证历史满足"tool_calls 必须紧跟 tool messages"的 API 不变量,避免单次工具执行失败毒化整个会话。

（附带发现:profile 安装插件后立即重启存在 dsh-tools 模块实例分裂的窗口期,建议 boot 时校验工具调度器完整性并给出明确报错,而不是让首个工具调用裸崩。触发本次问题的插件侧已修复为不把宿主包声明为运行时依赖,但宿主对"工具执行失败 → 会话永久卡死"的脆弱性仍然存在。）

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-crypto-portfolio | Unify your on-chain & CEX assets in one self-hosted dashboard · 把链上与 CEX 资产拼到一张图上
discussions.body:
> **_Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members. / 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**
>
> **Project URL / 项目地址:** https://github.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio

---

### Why I built it / 为什么写它

I'll start with the pain points — they're the whole reason this exists. / 先说说我为什么要写它——因为痛点是真的疼。

#### 1 · My money lives in seven places, and checking the total means opening six pages / 我的钱散在七个地方，想看个总数要开六个页面

EN: EVM assets in DeBank, SOL and staking on-chain, BTC in a block explorer, plus three exchanges (Binance / Bybit / Backpack), each with its own app. Checking "how much do I actually have" meant hopping between six pages — and it was easy to miss a wallet along the way. **One plugin puts all of it on a single screen.**

ZH: EVM 资产在 DeBank、SOL 和质押在 Solana 链上、BTC 在区块浏览器、还有 Binance / Bybit / Backpack 三个交易所各一套 App。每次想看"我到底有多少钱"，都得打开 DeBank 翻几个链、再去查质押、最后挨个登录三个交易所——手一抖还容易看漏钱包。**一个插件，把这些全拼到一张图上。**

#### 2 · Assets that block explorers can't see / 链上浏览器看不到的"隐形资产"

EN: Some money is genuinely invisible: native Solana stake accounts (`getParsedStakeAccounts` misses them), Hyperliquid L1 staked HYPE and spot balances, exchange earn/funding accounts — none of these are plain SPL/ERC-20 tokens, so ordinary tools never read them. This plugin digs them out and prices them into your total.

ZH: 有些钱是真的看不见：Solana 的原生质押账户（`getParsedStakeAccounts` 会漏）、Hyperliquid L1 的质押 HYPE 和现货、交易所的理财/资金账户——这些都不是普通 SPL/ERC20 代币，普通工具根本读不到。这个插件专门把它们挖出来，全部计价进总资产。

#### 3 · Dust coins and phishing tokens inflate the numbers / 空气币和钓鱼代币把数字搞得虚高

EN: DeBank lists plenty of fake tokens — ETHG, for example, is a **phishing token with a manipulated price** that once inflated one account by $570K. The plugin has one-click blacklisting: every token you blacklist is removed from totals, trends and historical snapshots instantly.

ZH: DeBank 会把一堆假代币也列出来，比如 ETHG 这种**价格被操纵的钓鱼币**，一个账户能虚报出 57 万美元。插件内置一键拉黑——你点的每一笔都会从总额、趋势、历史快照里同步剔除。

#### 4 · "How much did I have last week?" / 我想知道"上周这时候我到底有多少钱"

EN: Without history there's no peace of mind. Every refresh saves the **last snapshot of the day** (SQLite, deduplicated by day); over time it draws a trend line that is uniquely yours:

ZH: 没有历史就没有安全感。插件**每次刷新自动保存当天最后一次快照**（SQLite，按天去重），日子久了，就长出一条属于你自己的资产趋势线：

![Daily snapshots become trend charts / 每日快照如何变成趋势图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio/main/assets/flow.svg)

---

### What the plugin does / 这个插件做了什么

**A zero-dependency web dashboard, launched from a real DSH plugin.** No framework, no CDN — Python stdlib + vanilla JS. / **一个 DSH 插件，拉起一个零依赖的 Web 仪表盘。** 没有框架、没有 CDN，Python 标准库 + 原生 JS。

**Covers BTC / EVM / Solana / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX.** / **覆盖 BTC / EVM / Solana / Hyperliquid L1 / CEX。** DeBank's 73 chains, BTC P2SH+P2TR, native Solana staking, Hyperliquid's official API (staked HYPE + spot), and read-only CEX keys (named `<exchange>_read`).

**Global filters.** Category (BTC / EVM / Solana / CEX), wallet and chain dropdowns drive every panel — total, pie chart, trend, token table. / **全局筛选。** 按分类、钱包、网络过滤，所有面板一起联动。

**Automatic API failover.** Each source has several providers (prices: CoinGecko → Coinbase → OKX; BTC: blockchain.info → mempool.space; multiple Solana RPCs…); a dead one is skipped and the last working one is remembered. / **多 API 源自动切换。** 每个数据源配了多个 provider，挂了自动切下一个。

**Multi-profile privacy.** Public template (vitalik.eth, genesis BTC) works out of the box; your private wallets and keys live in a separately named profile. / **多 Profile 配置隔离。** 公开模板开箱即用，私人钱包和 key 独立存放。

![Dashboard / 仪表盘截图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio/main/assets/screenshot.png)

Every box in the diagram is a real data pipeline: / 架构长这样——每个方框都是一条真实的数据管线：

![Architecture / 架构图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio/main/assets/arch.svg)

### How it integrates with DSH / 与 DSH 的集成方式

EN: Not a wrapper — a real plugin. It declares a `dsh.bundle` manifest (`cordis.patch.yml`) and installs with `dsh plugin add`. `apply(ctx)` hooks into the Cordis lifecycle: seeds user-local `profiles/default` from public templates on first run, spawns the dashboard as a child process (exposing JSON APIs like `GET /api/refresh` and `/api/history` that an agent can call directly), and stops it cleanly on `ctx.on('dispose')`.

ZH: 不是套壳，是真插件：声明了 `dsh.bundle` manifest（`cordis.patch.yml`），`dsh plugin add` 直接装。`apply(ctx)` 接入 Cordis 生命周期——首次运行用公开模板生成 `profiles/default`，子进程拉起仪表盘（暴露 `GET /api/refresh`、`/api/history` 等 JSON 接口，agent 也能直接调），`ctx.on('dispose')` 时优雅停掉。

### Privacy (important) / 隐私声明（重要）

EN: The repo contains **no private keys, no private wallets, no balances** — `config.py` ships with `WALLETS = []` and empty keys; all private configs live in git-ignored local `profiles/`. Clone it, review it, run it with confidence.

ZH: 仓库里**没有任何私钥、私人钱包或余额**——`config.py` 只有 `WALLETS = []` 和空 key，私人配置全部在本地 git-ignored 的 `profiles/` 里。你可以放心 clone、放心 review、放心跑。

### Install / 怎么装

Requires Python 3.9+ (`requests`; `pynacl` is bundled in `vendor/`). / 需要 Python 3.9+（`requests`，`pynacl` 已随 `vendor/` 打包）。

```sh
git clone https://github.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio
cd dsh-crypto-portfolio
dsh plugin --profile demo add .        # register as a DSH plugin / 注册为 DSH 插件
dsh --profile demo                     # dashboard at http://127.0.0.1:8080
# or standalone / 或独立运行：python3 run.py --init-template --port 8080
```

MIT license. Unofficial, not affiliated with DeepSeek. / MIT 协议。非官方项目，与 DeepSeek 官方无关。

⭐ Repo / 仓库: https://github.com/0xRabit/dsh-crypto-portfolio — issues and feedback welcome, or just reply here. / 有问题欢迎开 issue，或者直接在这里讨论。

discussions.title: Different cordis-family agent presets cannot coexist: second session fails with Host Cordis inspect provider Service is already registered
discussions.body:
## Summary

Creating a session on one cordis-family agent preset fails while a session on a **different** cordis-family preset is already running. The new session aborts with `agent-preset-invalid`:

```
agent-presets: preset "cordis-comfyui" failed to mount: failed to apply loader entry
tool-cordis (@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-cordis): Host Cordis inspect provider "Service" is
already registered (C:\Users\<user>\.dsh\.agent-presets\cordis-comfyui\agent.cordis.yml)
```

Multiple sessions on the **same** cordis-family preset coexist fine. The failure only occurs when the running session and the new session use **different** preset ids that both mount `tool-cordis` (e.g. shipped `cordis` + a user-authored `cordis`-derived preset like `cordis-comfyui`).

## Repro

1. Set the default agent preset to a cordis-family preset that includes `tool-cordis` (e.g. a user preset copied from `cordis` with extra tools, via `~/.dsh/settings.yaml` → `agent-presets.default`).
2. Start a session on the shipped `cordis` preset (it mounts `tool-cordis`).
3. Create a new session (which picks up the default preset from step 1).
4. New-session creation fails with the error above.

I verified via the `session.create` API:
- `cordis` (second session, same preset as the running one) → succeeds
- `cordis-comfyui` (different preset from the running `cordis` session, both mount `tool-cordis`) → fails with `agent-preset-invalid`
- `standard` (no `tool-cordis`) → succeeds

## Root cause

`tool-cordis` registers Host inspect providers into `ctx.cordisInspect`, which is a **process-global, single-instance registry** that throws on a duplicate id:

- `packages/extensions/cordis-host-runner/src/inspect-registry.ts:52` — "Register the process-global Host registry."
- `packages/extensions/cordis-host-runner/src/inspect-registry.ts:64` — `if (this.providers.has(manifest.id)) throw new Error(...already registered...)`
- `packages/extensions/tool-cordis/src/index.ts:38` — every mount runs `ctx.cordisInspect.register(provider)` for the same four ids (`Service`, `Event`, `Builtin`, `Tool`).

Agent presets are mounted **once per preset id** as a standing composition (`packages/preset/agent-presets/src/index.ts` `ensureStanding`, keyed by `preset.id`), and all sessions on that preset share the single standing mount. So:

- same preset, N sessions → one mount → `tool-cordis` registers once → coexists fine
- different presets, both containing `tool-cordis` → two standing mounts → each registers the same four ids → the second `register` throws → the whole preset mount fails → session creation fails

## Expected behavior

Sessions on different cordis-family presets should coexist, the same way sessions on the same preset do. Options:

1. Make `CordisInspectRegistryService.register` idempotent (no-op or shared registration for the same id), or scope the registration per preset standing mount.
2. Move the inspect-provider registration out of per-preset mounting into the host plane, registered exactly once (the provider query is agent-scoped at call time, so one registration can serve every agent).

## Environment

- DSH version: 0.1.0-rc.6 (npx-installed `@deepseek-ai/dsh`, web profile)
- Windows 10, Node v24.14.0
- The user preset `cordis-comfyui` is a copy of the shipped `cordis` preset with an extra MCP-bridge plugin appended; the `tool-cordis` row is unchanged from shipped.

discussions.title: [Bug] Same-mode sandbox_permissions hard-errors instead of running — loops GPT-family models
discussions.body:
On a `workspace-write` (or `danger-full-access`) session, a tool call whose `sandbox_permissions` requests a mode the session **already has** (same or narrower) fails instead of just running. GPT-family models (e.g. `gpt-5.6-sol`) speculatively attach this field on ordinary calls and then loop on the two errors below for the whole turn — on `danger-full-access` they never recover.

```
Error: sandbox escalation to "workspace-write" is not strictly wider than this call's current "workspace-write" mode
Error: invalid justification: expected a non-empty sentence   (when the reason is emptied)
```

No argument set passes both. The operation needed no escalation — writing in the workspace is already permitted.

**Expected:** same-mode → run normally; narrower → reject as a downgrade (not "missing justification"); wider → approval unchanged.

**Env:** DSH `0.1.1-rc.2`, `gpt-5.6-sol` via `azure-openai-responses`.

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: dsh-subprocess-local 的 spawn()/taskkill 未设置 windowsHide，重启 Harness 时弹出空白 CMD 窗口
discussions.body:
## 环境

- 平台：Windows（win32 x64）
- 复现载体：DSH Desktop（Electron 壳，`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7，`dsh-subprocess-local` 0.1.0-rc.7）

## 现象

Electron 主进程以 `windowsHide: true` 隐藏启动 harness 的 node 进程（进程本身没有可见控制台）。随后 harness 内通过 `ctx.subprocess.spawn()` / `spawnSync("taskkill", ...)` 生成的控制台程序（`pwsh`、`bash`、`taskkill`、`node` 等）如果没带 `windowsHide`，Windows 会给它们新建一个可见的控制台窗口。表现最明显的是：每次重启/停止 Harness 时，清理进程树的 `taskkill /T /F`（`spawnSync`，同步执行）会弹出一个短暂停留的空白 CMD 窗口；工具子进程调用也会闪窗。

## 定位

`packages/subprocess/subprocess-local/src/lib/spawn.ts`（打包产物 `lib/index.js`）：

1. `spawnSubprocess()` 中：

```js
const child = spawn(program, args, {
  cwd: spec.cwd,
  env,
  stdio: [ ... ],
  detached: platform !== "win32"
});
```

缺少 `windowsHide: true`（`detached` 仅对 POSIX 生效，Windows 分支没有任何隐藏控制台的设置）。

2. `taskkillProcessTree()` 中：

```js
spawnSync("taskkill", ["/PID", String(pid), "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "ignore" });
```

缺少 `windowsHide: true` —— 这是重启/停止时弹空白窗口的直接来源。

> 仓库内其他位置（桌面壳 main、`dsh-native-command`、`dsh-host-directory-picker-native`）都正确设置了 `windowsHide: true`，说明这是本包遗漏，非有意为之。

## 修复建议

两处 spawn 选项各加一行 `windowsHide: true`（POSIX 上该选项被 Node 忽略，无副作用）：

```js
const child = spawn(program, args, {
  cwd: spec.cwd,
  env,
  stdio: [ ... ],
  detached: platform !== "win32",
  windowsHide: true
});
```

```js
spawnSync("taskkill", ["/PID", String(pid), "/T", "/F"], { stdio: "ignore", windowsHide: true });
```

## 影响面

所有走 `ctx.subprocess.spawn()` 的执行器：`dsh-bash-local`、`dsh-pwsh-local`、`dsh-tool-fs-search`（ripgrep）等；以及任何进程树清理（`taskkill`）路径。

## 备注

已在本机安装副本上验证修复有效（重启后不再弹窗）。本反馈仅为上游跟踪，补丁会被应用更新覆盖。

discussions.title: [Bug] Windows: dsh CLI 插件管理 spawnSync("pnpm", ..., { shell: true }) 未设置 windowsHide，安装插件时弹出 CMD 窗口
discussions.body:
## 环境

- 平台：Windows（win32 x64）
- 版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7

## 现象

在 Windows 上执行 `dsh plugin` 相关命令（或经由 DSH Desktop 安装插件）时，`runPlugin()` 通过 `spawnSync("pnpm", args, { shell: true })` 调用 pnpm。`shell: true` 在 Windows 上会走 `cmd.exe /d /s /c ...`，而 spawn 选项没有 `windowsHide: true` —— 当父进程（隐藏启动的 harness node）没有可见控制台时，会弹出可见的 CMD 窗口。

## 定位

`apps/cli`（打包产物 `lib/plugin-9h8shc4d.js`）中 `runPlugin()`：

```js
const result = spawnSync("pnpm", args.map(...), {
  cwd: dir,
  stdio: "inherit",
  shell: process.platform === "win32"
});
```

## 修复建议

```js
const result = spawnSync("pnpm", args.map(...), {
  cwd: dir,
  stdio: "inherit",
  shell: process.platform === "win32",
  windowsHide: true
});
```

POSIX 上该选项被忽略，无副作用。

## 备注

与 `packages/subprocess/subprocess-local` 中 `spawn()` / `taskkill` 缺 `windowsHide` 是同一类问题（见同仓库另一条反馈 #4023），建议一并修复。

discussions.title: [Analysis] mcp-client activeServerNames: root cause is a scope mismatch, not a missed cleanup — and the proposed "defensive cleanup" is unsafe (#3984 follow-up)
discussions.body:
### Related bug report

This analysis is a follow-up to: 
**[Bug] mcp-client: activeServerNames 生命周期泄漏导致无法创建新会话** — <https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984>

---

## EN / English

### Purpose

This is a **follow-up analysis** to [[#3984](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984)](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984) — not a duplicate bug report. We verified the reported behavior against the engine source, and our reading diverges from the reporter's root-cause guess on two points, plus finds a design-level issue the report did not mention. We are sharing it openly because we believe the current proposed fix would turn a deterministic error into a silent failure.

### The problem — recap

From #3984: `@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` registers every configured `serverName` in a module-level `WeakMap` keyed by `ctx.root`. After a session using a given MCP server is closed, creating a new session that uses the **same** `serverName` fails with:

> `mcp-client: serverName "context7" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml`

The reporter attributes this to the effect cleanup `() => void names.delete(config.serverName)` "not being called" when the session closes, and proposes a defensive "delete-then-check" in the registration effect.

### Correction 1 — "cleanup never runs" is contradicted by the reporter's own repro

The reporter states the cleanup is never invoked, yet also notes: *"waiting about 30 seconds before creating a new session succeeds (unstable)"*. If the cleanup **never** ran, the `Set` entry would persist forever and 30 seconds would not help. The only consistent reading is that the cleanup **eventually runs, but late and unreliably** — the failure is a **delayed teardown**, not a missing one.

This distinction matters: it moves the defect out of `dsh-mcp-client` internals (where the cleanup exists and is synchronous) and points upstream — to **when the preset plugin instance's fiber is disposed** after session close.

### Correction 2 — mcp-client's own lifecycle is sound

In the version we verified (`0.1.1-rc.2`, source matches the master snapshot cited in #3984):

- Registration effect: `dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:768-775` — reads `ctx.root`, rejects duplicates (`:773`), registers the name, and returns a synchronous cleanup `() => void names.delete(config.serverName)` (`:775`).
- The effect also returns `() => connection.dispose()` (`:779`), and `connection.dispose()` (`:678-696`) is a complete async chain: flush disposers → close the client → await the close signal → settle the connection → flush the sync chain.

Nothing in mcp-client leaks by itself. The cleanup is synchronous and correctly paired; the open question is whether the **upstream fiber** that owns this effect is disposed promptly — and the ~30 s delay suggests a teardown timer (reconnect backoff / idle teardown) somewhere in that chain. We could not pin that exact timer by static reading; it needs a runtime timing repro (close a session, record when `serverName` is actually released).

### Design-level finding — the scope mismatch (the part the report missed)

The deeper issue is that the uniqueness constraint's **semantic scope** does not match its **implementation scope**:

- `activeServerNames` is keyed on `ctx.root` (`:731` + `:768`) — and in Cordis, `ctx.root` is the **application-level context** (`cordis/lib/index.js:1681`, `this.root = self`; fiber 0 is the root). The constraint is therefore **process-global**.
- The tool registry these MCP clients feed into is **per-agent scoped** — `dsh-tools` is built on `ScopedLayers` / `scopeOf` / `scopeTarget` from `dsh-scope`, and tool visibility is scoped to the agent context.

So: two **parallel** sessions (or any two agents in the same process) that legitimately want to attach the same MCP server are rejected on the `serverName` uniqueness check **even if teardown were instantaneous and perfect**. The comment intent — "multiple apps in one process must not see each other's names" — is implemented as "unique per process", which is wider than the semantics the tool layer actually needs. The reporter's scenario (sequential sessions) is the symptom; the concurrent case is the structural restriction. Whether the per-process width is intentional (e.g. to prevent double-spawning the same stdio server) is a question only the maintainers can answer — but the mismatch between the uniqueness scope (`ctx.root`) and the visibility scope (per-agent) is a fact worth aligning or documenting.

### Critique of the proposed fixes

**Fix 1 ("defensive delete-then-check") is unsafe and should not be adopted.** In the sequential case it papers over the symptom; in the parallel case it actively creates corruption:

- Two live instances both want `serverName "context7"` (a legitimate concurrent topology today, since tool registration is per-agent).
- Under Fix 1, the second instance first does `names.delete("context7")` — the check then passes, and both instances register the same name.
- Result: **silent dual-live** — two clients claim one `serverName`, and their dispose/reconnect/teardown chains interfere with each other. A deterministic configuration error becomes a silent, harder-to-diagnose failure.

Deleting another live instance's registration before checking is exactly the kind of "fix" that trades a loud bug for a quiet one.

**Fix 2 ("make sure the disposal fires") is the right direction but underspecified.** The delay has to be located first (which fiber owns the preset instance, and which timer delays its dispose) before it can be fixed. Without a runtime timing repro, "ensure disposal" has nothing concrete to attach to.

### Suggested direction

1. **Narrow the uniqueness scope** from `ctx.root` to the agent scope where tools actually live — or, if per-process uniqueness is intentional (double-spawn protection), document it and make the error message say so, so the concurrent case is a *stated* constraint, not an accident.
2. **Fix the upstream disposal delay** — own the fiber: when a session closes, the preset instance's effect chain (including this cleanup) must run promptly and deterministically; find and remove the ~30 s teardown timer.
3. **Observability** — log `serverName` register/release events, so teardown timing (and any future leak) is visible instead of discovered via "session create failed".

### Questions for maintainers

1. Is per-process uniqueness of `serverName` **intentional** (e.g. to avoid double-spawning the same stdio/streamable server), or should the scope be per-agent, matching the tool registry?
2. Where is the preset plugin instance's fiber created and disposed (agent loop? agent scope?), and does anything in that path carry a teardown delay consistent with the reported ~30 s?
3. Would you accept a scope change from `ctx.root` to the agent scope, or a documented + reworded error for the concurrent case, as the first step?

### Environment

- Verified on: `@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2` (source matches the master snapshot cited in [#3984](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984); line numbers above are from the rc.2 build).
- Reporter's environment (from #3984): Windows 11 / Node.js v24.18.0 / master branch / context7 (stdio) + idea (streamable-http).

---

## 中文版 / ZH

### 目的

这是对 [#3984](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/3984) 的**后续分析帖**——不是重复报 bug。我们对照引擎源码核验了报告行为，与举报者的根因猜测在两点上不一致，并发现报告未提及的一个设计层问题。公开分享，因为我们判断：现有建议方案会把"确定性报错"变成"静默故障"。

### 问题回顾

按 #3984：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-mcp-client` 把每个配置的 `serverName` 注册进一个以 `ctx.root` 为 key 的模块级 `WeakMap`。使用某 MCP server 的会话关闭后，新建使用**相同** `serverName` 的会话即失败：

> `mcp-client: serverName "context7" is already in use by another mcp-client instance — pick a unique serverName in cordis.yml`

举报者将根因归于 effect 清理函数 `() => void names.delete(config.serverName)` 在会话关闭时"未被调用"，并建议在注册 effect 里做防御性"先删后查"。

### 修正一——"清理从未执行"与举报者自己的复现数据矛盾

举报者称清理函数从未被调用，但他同时写道：*"等待约 30 秒再创建新会话能成功（不稳定）"*。如果清理**从未**运行，`Set` 里的条目会永久残留，等 30 秒不会有任何帮助。唯一自洽的解释是：**清理最终执行了，但延迟、不稳定**——这是**延迟销毁**，不是"从未销毁"。

这个区分很关键：它把缺陷从 `dsh-mcp-client` 内部（清理存在且是同步的）指向**上游——会话关闭后，preset 插件实例所在的 fiber 何时被 dispose**。

### 修正二——mcp-client 自身的生命周期是健全的

在我们验证的版本（`0.1.1-rc.2`，源码与 #3984 引用的 master 快照一致）中：

- 注册 effect：`dsh-mcp-client/lib/index.js:768-775`——读取 `ctx.root`、拒绝重复（`:773`）、注册名称、返回同步清理 `() => void names.delete(config.serverName)`（`:775`）。
- effect 同时返回 `() => connection.dispose()`（`:779`），而 `connection.dispose()`（`:678-696`）是完整的异步链：flush disposers → 关闭 client → 等待 close 信号 → settle 连接 → flush 同步链。

mcp-client 自身没有泄漏点。清理是同步且正确配对的；真正的开放问题是**持有该 effect 的上游 fiber 是否被及时 dispose**——约 30 秒的延迟暗示销毁链某处有一个 teardown 定时器（reconnect backoff / idle teardown）。静态阅读无法定位该定时器的确切位置，需要运行时计时复现（关闭会话，记录 `serverName` 实际释放的时刻）。

### 设计层发现——作用域不匹配（报告遗漏的部分）

更深的问题是唯一性约束的**语义范围**与**实现范围**不一致：

- `activeServerNames` 以 `ctx.root` 为 key（`:731` + `:768`）——在 Cordis 中 `ctx.root` 是**应用级 context**（`cordis/lib/index.js:1681`，`this.root = self`；fiber 0 即 root）。因此约束是**进程级全局**的。
- 这些 MCP client 所供应的工具注册表是 **per-agent 作用域**的——`dsh-tools` 基于 `dsh-scope` 的 `ScopedLayers` / `scopeOf` / `scopeTarget` 构建，工具可见性限定在 agent context 内。

于是：**并行**的两个会话（或同进程任意两个 agent）想挂同一个 MCP server 时，即使销毁即时且完美，也会在 `serverName` 唯一性检查处被拒绝。注释意图——"同一进程内多个 app 互不可见"——被实现成"每进程唯一"，宽于工具层实际需要的语义。举报者的场景（串行会话）只是症状；并发场景才是结构性限制。per-process 宽度是否刻意（例如防止重复 spawn 同一 stdio server）只有维护者能回答——但"唯一性作用域（`ctx.root`）与可见性作用域（per-agent）不一致"是事实，值得对齐或至少文档化。

### 对建议方案的批判

**方案 1（"防御性先删后查"）不安全，不应采纳。** 串行场景下它只是掩盖症状；并行场景下它会主动制造损坏：

- 两个存活的实例都想注册 `serverName "context7"`（今天这是合法并发拓扑——工具注册本就是 per-agent）。
- 方案 1 下，第二个实例先 `names.delete("context7")`——检查随即通过，两个实例注册了同一个名字。
- 结果：**静默双活**——两个 client 认领同一 `serverName`，其 dispose/reconnect/teardown 链互相干扰。一个确定性的配置错误变成静默、更难诊断的故障。

在检查前删除另一个存活实例的注册，正是那种"把响亮的 bug 换成安静 bug"的修复。

**方案 2（"确保销毁被触发"）方向正确但太泛。** 必须先定位延迟点（preset 实例挂在哪条 fiber、哪个定时器延迟了它的 dispose），否则"确保销毁"没有可落地的抓手。没有运行时计时复现，"确保销毁"无从谈起。

### 建议方向

1. **收窄唯一性作用域**：从 `ctx.root` 收窄到工具真正所在的 agent 作用域；若每进程唯一是有意设计（防双 spawn），则文档化并让错误消息说明这一点——让并发场景成为*声明的约束*，而非意外。
2. **修复上游销毁延迟**——接管 fiber：会话关闭时，preset 实例的 effect 链（含本清理）必须及时、确定地执行；找到并移除约 30 秒的 teardown 定时器。
3. **可观测性**——记录 `serverName` 注册/释放事件，让销毁时序（及未来任何泄漏）可见，而不是靠"session create failed"才发现。

### 向维护者提出的问题

1. `serverName` 的**每进程唯一**是否**有意为之**（例如避免重复 spawn 同一 stdio/streamable server）？还是应改为与工具注册表一致的 per-agent 作用域？
2. preset 插件实例的 fiber 在何处创建/销毁（agent loop？agent scope？），该路径上是否有与约 30 秒延迟相符的 teardown 定时器？
3. 作为第一步，是否接受把作用域从 `ctx.root` 改为 agent 作用域，或对并发场景做文档化 + 措辞更明确的报错？

### 环境

- 验证版本：`@deepseek-ai/dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`（源码与 #3984 引用的 master 快照一致；上文行号出自 rc.2 构建）。
- 举报者环境（来自 #3984）：Windows 11 / Node.js v24.18.0 / master 分支 / context7（stdio）+ idea（streamable-http）。

---

## 署名 / About this report

**EN:** Reported by the **OfferKuai (Offer快) Team** — an AI startup building full-lifecycle job-application services, guided by the belief that *"users need results, not repeated conversations."* Founder: **Zhaofeng (Yaming)**. We use DeepSeek Harness as part of our daily development workflow; this report is our way of contributing back to the ecosystem. Website: <https://www.offerkuai.com/> | Contact: <[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

**ZH:** 本报告由 **OfferKuai（Offer快）团队**提交 —— 一家专注 AI 全流程求职托管的创业团队，核心理念是「用户要的是结果，不是重复对话」。创始人：**Zhaofeng（Yaming）**。我们将 DeepSeek Harness 用于日常开发工作流，这份报告是我们对社区的回馈。官网：<https://www.offerkuai.com/> | 联系：<[contact@offerkuai.com](mailto:contact@offerkuai.com)>

discussions.title: Show & Tell: dsh-labnana — image generation for DeepSeek Harness (NanoBanana Pro, GPT-Image-2, Wan2.7, Seedream)
discussions.body:
Hi all, sharing a plugin I built: **dsh-labnana** — image generation for DeepSeek Harness via the Labnana OpenAPI.

**What it does**
- Text-to-image, image-to-image (reference images: remote URL / local file / base64), and Seedream precise editing with pixel coordinates.
- 4 tools: `labnana_generate_image`, `labnana_estimate_credits`, `labnana_get_subscription`, `labnana_get_task`.
- Results render directly in the conversation as image cards (grid + zoom + save-to-project); no disk writes by default.
- API key lives in the credentials domain; web settings UI under Settings → Plugins → Labnana; i18n follows system language.

**Models** (credits: 1K/2K/4K)
| model | provider |
|---|---|
| gemini-3-pro-image (NanoBanana Pro) | google |
| gemini-3.1-flash-image | google |
| gpt-image-2 | openai |
| wan2.7-image-pro / wan2.7-image | alibaba |
| seedream-5-0-pro | bytedance |

**Install**
```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add github:exoticknight/dsh-labnana
```
Get an API key at https://labnana.com/api-keys (free usage tiers available for gemini-3-pro-image 1K/2K).

Repo: https://github.com/exoticknight/dsh-labnana — Apache-2.0, TypeScript strict. Feedback and PRs welcome!

discussions.title: 【开源】dsh-edge：把 DSH 送上云 — 一个网址随时用，手机也行 🌐
discussions.body: 不用开电脑，不用装桌面端，手机浏览器打开一个网址就能用 DeepSeek Harness。 dsh-edge 把完整的 DSH runtime 跑在 Cloudflare Workers 上。部署完成后你得到一个网址，电脑、手机、平板，随时打开就能用。关掉浏览器下次回来对话还在。 **安装：** ```sh npx dsh-edge install ``` 安装器全程引导，不需要 checkout 源码，不需要配 wrangler。 保留的能力： - 上游完整 UI + Agent Loop - 模型选择（V4 Flash / V4 Pro / Vision Exp） - 图片输入 + DeepSeek Web Search - 持久 /workspace + bash 工具 - Cloudflare 免费额度个人日常够用，只需要一个 DeepSeek API Key 一些技术细节（给感兴趣的人）： - 整个 agent runtime 跑在单个 Durable Object 里，会话和文件系统用 DO 内置 SQLite 持久化 - 只有 LLM 调用是出站 HTTP，其余全在 DO 内完成 - SSE + WebSocket 双通道事件推送 限制： - 单用户设计，不是多人 SaaS - Shell 是 just-bash 沙箱，不是 Linux 容器 - 上游还在 developer preview，可能有 breaking changes Repo: https://github.com/pawaca/dsh-edge

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-llm-verifier | Validate and rank 3/5 coding-agent patches
discussions.body: > **Unofficial community project.** This project is independently developed and maintained and is not affiliated with or endorsed by DeepSeek. [`dsh-llm-verifier`](https://github.com/Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier?utm_source=deepseek_harness&utm_medium=discussion&utm_campaign=developer_preview) is a developer-preview DeepSeek Harness plugin for validation-first Best-of-3/5 coding workflows. It gives the same coding task to 3 or 5 independent candidates in detached Git worktrees, runs the target project's validation commands, excludes every failing patch, and ranks only the passing candidates with an LLM verifier. The original checkout stays unchanged until a separate approval applies the selected patch and reruns validation. ## How it integrates with DSH - Declares a DSH plugin bundle through `package.json` and `cordis.patch.yml`. - Exposes `verified_best_of` for candidate generation, validation, ranking, and local report creation. - Exposes `apply_verified_winner` as a separate approval-gated apply step. - Uses DSH `workspace-write` mode for candidate runs while keeping each candidate in a separate detached worktree. - Currently targets DeepSeek Harness `0.1.0-rc.7`. ## Real DSH run The first screenshot shows a real five-agent DSH review session starting five independent review angles. The second shows the consolidated result. This run was used to audit the verifier's evaluation rules and operational boundaries; it is not presented as a complete `verified_best_of` patch-apply trace. **1. Five-agent review launch** **2. Consolidated audit result** ## Try the developer preview ```bash git clone https://github.com/Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier.git cd dsh-llm-verifier pnpm install --frozen-lockfile uv sync --frozen --project python pnpm run check dsh plugin --profile web add "$(pwd)" ``` Then, in a clean and trusted target repository: ```text Use verified_best_of with 3 candidates to fix the retry bug and add regression tests. Run pnpm test for validation. Do not apply the winner yet. ``` Release: [v0.1.0-preview](https://github.com/Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier/releases/tag/v0.1.0-preview) ## Current boundaries - Source installation only; no npm package or prebuilt binary yet. - macOS and Linux; Node.js 24. - Validation commands execute target-repository code on the host, so the current version is for trusted repositories only. - Detached worktrees provide change isolation, not a security sandbox. - Live candidate and verifier runs consume paid model requests. I would especially value two kinds of feedback: 1. installation or first-run failures with sanitized version/error information; 2. cases where several candidates pass deterministic tests but the verifier selects a clearly weaker patch. Sanitized run feedback template: https://github.com/Web0926/dsh-llm-verifier/issues/3

discussions.title: Find in Chat — Ctrl+F search inside the current conversation (`dsh-client-find-in-chat`)
discussions.body:
Ctrl+F now works inside your conversation. Jump straight back to that error code, file path, or half-remembered parameter buried 40 messages up — no more scrolling and squinting.

**Why:** The app has no in-conversation find (the sidebar search is cross-session retrieval, a different tool), and I found no community plugin covering it — so this fills the gap. Browser-native Ctrl+F sort of works, but it searches the whole page DOM: sidebar session titles, your draft, settings text — all noise, and zero session awareness.

**What it does:**
- Ctrl/Cmd+F opens a floating find bar (top-center, browser convention) scoped to the current conversation's chat view
- Instant as-you-type matching, case-insensitive literal substring; Enter / Shift+Enter cycles with wrap-around; live `n/m` counter
- Current match scrolls to viewport center; all matches get a dim highlight, the active one a bright one — via the CSS Custom Highlight API, zero DOM mutation, the React tree stays untouched
- Session-aware: switching sessions or leaving the chat view closes it; open modals keep native behavior; the composer is never blocked
- Honest about coverage: searches the loaded message window and says so ("searched N messages · earlier not loaded") — same ceiling as native Ctrl+F, which can only see the DOM anyway

**Known limits (MVP):** loaded messages only (no auto-load-older — deliberate, to avoid unbounded DOM growth in a non-virtualized list); literal case-insensitive matching, no regex; matches within a single text node; chat view only — trajectory view and modals keep the native shortcut.

**Where:** part of my fork-maintained plugin set → https://github.com/a137460387/deepseek-harness/tree/master/packages/extensions/find-in-chat. Feedback welcome — especially on the coverage trade-off and anything you'd want from regex or case-sensitive modes.

discussions.body:
> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**  
> **Unofficial community project, independently developed and maintained.**

## 项目地址 / Project URL

https://github.com/Hades03/dsh-model-quota-usage

## 项目介绍 / Introduction

`dsh-model-quota-usage` 是一个 DeepSeek Harness Web 插件，在可拖动、可折叠的右下角悬浮面板中：

- 只显示 DeepSeek 官方账户余额；
- 汇总今日全部 Provider、全部模型的 Token；
- 按 Provider/模型列出输入、缓存、输出和合计 Token；
- 支持全部/DeepSeek 筛选、手动刷新、位置记忆与双击恢复右下角；
- 展开与收起使用屏幕边缘锚定，避免位置漂移。

`dsh-model-quota-usage` is a draggable and collapsible DSH Web overlay. It shows only the official DeepSeek account balance while aggregating today's token usage across every configured provider and model, with per-model input, cache, and output details.

## 截图 / Screenshot

![Model quota and token usage overlay](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Hades03/dsh-model-quota-usage/main/docs/showcase.png)

## 安装 / Install

```powershell
dsh plugin --profile web add "github:Hades03/dsh-model-quota-usage"
```

安装或更新后重启 DeepSeek Harness Desktop。

## 与 DSH 的集成 / DSH Integration

- 使用标准 `dsh.bundle` + `cordis.patch.yml` 安装清单；
- Web client 通过 DSH client 插件入口挂载悬浮面板；
- DeepSeek API Key 由 Harness 凭据服务在 Host 侧读取，不发送到浏览器；
- Token 账本保存在本机，不上传会话标题或 Token 历史；
- 公开运行版仅访问 `https://api.deepseek.com` 的余额接口；
- 支持 DeepSeek Harness `>= 0.1.1-rc.2`、Node.js `>= 20`。

## 验证 / Verification

仓库 CI 已通过发布清单检查、JavaScript 语法检查、定位回归测试及 npm 打包预检。版本保持为 `1.1.0`。

The repository CI covers release metadata, JavaScript syntax, edge-anchor positioning regressions, and package dry-run checks. Current version: `1.1.0`.

discussions.title: DSH | OS Agent Plugin | Volcengine Mobile Use Agent for cloud phone control
discussions.body:
> **Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by community members.**

**Project URL:** https://github.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin

## Introduction

Give your DeepSeek Harness agent a real phone. OS Agent Plugin is a self-contained Harness plugin for [Volcengine Mobile Use Agent](https://www.volcengine.com/product/MobileUseAgent). One installed package contributes both the Cordis runtime and its browser configuration surface, so your model can drive a cloud phone in natural language — no device lab, no USB cable, no Appium grid.

```
You:    Open the shopping app, search for wireless earbuds, and report the top 3 prices.
Agent:  mobile_use_start_task  → RunId: run-8f2c...
        mobile_use_get_status  → step 7/100, tapping search result
        mobile_use_get_result  → "1. ¥299  2. ¥349  3. ¥429"
```

### Features

| Tool | Purpose |
|---|---|
| `mobile_use_start_task` | Start one Mobile Use run, return its `RunId` |
| `mobile_use_get_status` | Read the run current step |
| `mobile_use_get_result` | Fetch the completed result |

- **Settings → Plugins → OS Agent** configures AccessKey, Secret Key, Product Id, PodId, and TOS output.
- AccessKey and Secret Key are write-only in the browser and remain in the Harness credential store.

### Architecture

![Architecture](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin/main/docs/assets/architecture.svg)

### Quick Start

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin.git
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
pnpm dsh --profile web
```

Then go to **Settings → Plugins → OS Agent** and fill in your Volcengine credentials.

---

> **非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。**

**项目地址：** https://github.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin

## 项目介绍

给你的 DeepSeek Harness 智能体配一台真手机。OS Agent Plugin 是一个完整、自包含的 [火山引擎 Mobile Use Agent](https://www.volcengine.com/product/MobileUseAgent) Harness 插件。安装一个包即可同时提供 Cordis 运行时与浏览器配置界面，让模型用自然语言驱动云手机——不需要设备实验室、不需要数据线、不需要 Appium 集群。

```
你：     打开购物 App，搜索无线耳机，告诉我前三名的价格。
智能体： mobile_use_start_task  → RunId: run-8f2c...
         mobile_use_get_status  → 第 7/100 步，正在点击搜索结果
         mobile_use_get_result  → "1. ¥299  2. ¥349  3. ¥429"
```

### 功能

| 工具 | 用途 |
|---|---|
| `mobile_use_start_task` | 启动一次 Mobile Use 运行，返回 `RunId` |
| `mobile_use_get_status` | 读取运行的当前步骤 |
| `mobile_use_get_result` | 获取已完成运行的结果 |

- 在**设置 → 插件 → OS Agent** 中配置 AccessKey、Secret Key、Product Id、PodId 与 TOS 输出。
- 浏览器只能写入 AccessKey 与 Secret Key；密钥保存在 Harness credential store 中。

### 架构

![架构图](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin/main/docs/assets/architecture.svg)

### 快速开始

```sh
pnpm dsh plugin --profile web add git+https://github.com/chenjie1129/deepseek-harness-os-agent-plugin.git
pnpm dsh --profile web --dump-config
pnpm dsh --profile web
```

discussions.title: Security fix: DNS rebinding can bypass the local API's cross-site fence (Host-header validation patch included)
discussions.body:
## Summary

During a full audit of `deepseek-harness` I found a high-severity gap in the local web server: **no layer validates the `Host` header**, which lets a DNS-rebinding page reach the entire local RPC surface as same-origin — no CORS preflight, JSON content-type accepted.

A working, tested fix (with REAL-composition tests + bilingual Agent Note) is ready on my fork:

**PR with full implementation:** https://github.com/Sravanjangam/deepseek-harness/pull/1

## The bug

The apiproxy's cross-site fence accepts only `application/json` POSTs so that blind cross-site writes force a CORS preflight the server never answers (`packages/host/apiproxy/src/fetch/handler.ts`). That fence assumes attacker requests stay *cross-origin*.

DNS rebinding breaks the assumption:

1. Attacker page at `evil.com` rebinds its own DNS record to `127.0.0.1`.
2. Browser considers `http://evil.com:<port>/api/…` *same-origin* (same host string) → **no preflight**, JSON accepted.
3. Full API executes as the local user: sessions, prompts, file tools, shell.

Loopback binding does not prevent this — the connection arrives on loopback. WebSocket upgrades are strictly worse: they carry no CORS at all, and nothing checked `Host` there either.

## The fix

With `host: '127.0.0.1'`, `dsh-host-webserver` validates `Host` at the socket edge before routing and before upgrade dispatch:

- Accepted: loopback names (`127.0.0.1`, `localhost`, `::1`; case-insensitive; explicit port equal to the listening port).
- Rejected: foreign names or missing header → HTTP **421 Misdirected Request** on HTTP; upgrade sockets destroyed with a logged warning.
- `0.0.0.0` bindings skip the check (served names cannot be enumerated — documented limitation).

The check lives in the carrier rather than the apiproxy because upgrades and static routes reach it too. It composes cleanly with the existing content-type fence (rebinding → Host fence; genuine cross-origin → preflight fence).

## Validation

- New REAL-composition tests in `packages/host/webserver/tests/webserver.spec.ts`: all loopback spellings route; foreign/suffixed/missing Host answer 421 or destroyed upgrade; server keeps serving.
- Unit tests for exported `isAllowedLoopbackHost` (IPv6 brackets, wrong ports, malformed values).
- `pnpm run typecheck` green; webserver suite 5/5 green.
- Rationale + alternatives in `.agents/notes/implemented/bug-fix/2026-08-22-loopback-host-fence.md` (+ 中文).

Happy to rebase/rework to whatever shape maintainers prefer — since this repo doesn't accept pull requests directly, the branch `fix/critical-bugs` on my fork carries the commit (`da109b6bc2`) against `master@b150a551b8`.

discussions.title: Idea: allow switching to a non-vision model while old images remain in context (mask images in the request projection instead of blocking)
discussions.body:
## Context

`session.selectModel` rejects switching to an image-incapable model with `model-unavailable` when the model-visible surface (or queued inbox) contains images. The guard makes sense: every agent step resends the effective surface, so an image block would fail the API call mid-turn.

## Pain point

For coding-first workflows this guard over-stays its welcome:

1. Long coding session on a text model.
2. Occasional UI debugging — paste screenshots, switch to a vision model; the visual analysis is then already textualized in the transcript.
3. Switch back to a cheaper/faster text model — blocked, because those screenshots are still in the surface.

The escape hatch today is `/compact`, but compaction retains a recent tail verbatim (default ~16% of the context window), so recent images can survive a manual compact; `/compact` takes no arguments, so there is no way to force a full compaction — and compacting just to unlock a model switch throws away recent context detail the user may still want.

## Proposal

Since the durable log and the derived request surface are separate layers, the cleanest fix may be at request-build time:

- When the routed target lacks image input modality, replace image blocks **in the request projection only** with a short placeholder (e.g. `[image omitted — non-vision model]`). The durable session log stays untouched, so switching back to a vision model restores the images with zero loss.
- Show a clear notice at switch time listing how many image blocks will be masked, so "the model can no longer see the screenshot" is never a silent state.
- The existing guard could then downgrade from a hard block to that warning (keeping the hard block only for images queued in the inbox that are about to be sent).

Lighter alternatives if this is too invasive: add an escape-hatch flag to `/compact` (e.g. `--retain 0`), or allow the switch with an explicit "images will be masked" acknowledgement.

---

## 背景（中文）

`session.selectModel` 在会话的模型可见上下文（或待发送队列）中含图片时，会以 `model-unavailable` 拒绝切换到不支持图像输入的模型。这个拦截本身合理：agent 每一步都会重发整个有效上下文，带着图片块调用纯文本模型会在回合中途直接报错。

## 痛点

对以 coding 为主的工作流来说，这个拦截的"有效期"偏长：

1. 长时间用文本模型做编码；
2. 偶尔调试 UI —— 贴几张截图、切到视觉模型，视觉分析的结果此时已经以文字形式落在对话里；
3. 想切回更快/更便宜的文本模型 —— 被拦截，因为截图仍在有效上下文里。

目前的出路是 `/compact`，但压缩会原样保留一段近期尾部（默认约上下文窗口的 16%），较新的图片可能压不掉；`/compact` 也不接受参数，无法强制全量压缩 —— 而且仅为解锁切换去压缩，会连带丢掉本想保留的近期细节。

## 建议

由于持久日志与派生请求面是分层的，最干净的做法可能是在构建请求时处理：

- 当路由目标不支持图像输入时，仅在**请求投影**里把图片块替换为短占位符（如 `[image omitted — non-vision model]`）；持久会话日志不动，切回视觉模型时图片零损失恢复。
- 切换时给出明确提示，列出将被遮蔽的图片块数量，让"模型看不到截图了"永远不是静默状态。
- 现有拦截可随之降级为警告（仅对即将发送的队列内图片保留硬拦截）。

如果改动太重，轻量替代方案：给 `/compact` 增加转义参数（如 `--retain 0`）；或在用户明确确认"图片将被遮蔽"后放行切换。

discussions.title: 会话标题功能的设计问题与改进建议（含本地模型场景的 bug）
discussions.body:
## 背景

在使用 DSH (0.1.0-rc.8, macOS, 本地模型) 时发现会话标题变成了一段英文思维链：
`Here's a thinking process: 1. **Analyze User Input:** - Input: JSON array of hum...`

排查后确认了完整的因果链，并总结了两点设计层面的建议。

## Bug：本地 OpenAI 兼容端点下，thinking 模型的思维链污染标题

### 环境与复现

- provider: `api: openai-completions`（LM Studio / llama.cpp server 等），模型为 Qwen3 系列 thinking 模型
- 用户消息为中文，如「知道历史会话放在那里了吗」
- 新建会话后，标题被替换为模型思维链的开头（英文）

实际会话日志证据：

```json
{"type": "session/title", "data": {"title": "知道历史会话放在那里了吗", "source": {"kind": "fallback"}}}
{"type": "session/title-llm-request", "data": {"route": {"provider": "l777", "model": "Qwen3.6-35B-A3B-MLX-8bit"}, "maxTokens": 64}}
{"type": "session/title", "data": {"title": "Here's a thinking process: 1. **Analyze User Input:** ...", "source": {"kind": "provider", "provider": "session-title-first-prompt-llm"}}}
```

### 根因（按代码路径）

1. `session-title-first-prompt-llm` 未配置 `provider`/`model` 时，`resolveRoute()`
   回退为复用**当前会话的模型** —— thinking 模型因此被用于起标题。
2. 对 DeepSeek 官方 API，`dsh-llm-deepseek` 有
   `if (options.purpose === "session-title") return { thinking: "disabled" };`
   但 **openai-completions 路径没有等效机制**，请求原样发给本地推理服务。
3. Qwen3 通过部分本地端点时，思维链**内联在 content 正文**返回（而非
   `reasoning_content` 字段），而 `normalizeSessionTitle()` 只清理控制字符，
   不剥离 `<think>` 或推理文本。
4. `maxOutputTokens: 64` 在思维链中途截断 → 思考过程开头直接成为标题。

### 建议修复方向（任一即可解决）

- 为 openai-completions 路径提供 session-title 的禁思考手段
  （如透传 `chat_template_kwargs: {enable_thinking: false}` 或 `reasoning_effort`）；
- 或在 `normalizeSessionTitle()` 中剥离 `<think>...</think>` 及明显的推理前缀；
- 或允许配置声明"此 provider 的模型均为 thinking 模型"，起标题时自动规避。

## 设计建议：fallback 标题本身就很好，LLM 标题可否做成可选？

实测发现 `fallback`（取第一条用户消息前缀）生成的标题已经完全够用：
中文、准确、零成本、零延迟、永不失败。而 LLM 标题引入了一整套新的故障面
（模型行为不可控、额外显存/内存、截断、污染）。

目前 LLM 标题默认开启且覆盖 fallback。建议：
- 将 LLM 标题改为 opt-in（默认 fallback）；
- 或至少在设置中提供「直接使用首条消息作为标题」的开关。

（本次我通过用户层补丁 `~/.dsh/cordis.patch.yml` 中
`- id: session-title-llm ... disabled: true` 达成了该效果，供其他用户参考。）

---

环境补充：macOS 15 (Apple Silicon), Node v22.22.3,
端点为 LM Studio 0.3.x 与自建 MLX 服务，模型 Qwen3.6-35B-A3B / Ornith-1.0。

discussions.title: [Community Plugin] GraphGPT workflows as native Harness tools
discussions.body:
I built **dsh-plugin-graphgpt**, an independent community plugin that exposes reviewed [GraphGPT](https://github.com/BrucePayton/GraphGPT) YAML workflows as a native DeepSeek Harness model-facing tool.

Repository: https://github.com/BrucePayton/dsh-plugin-graphgpt
Release: https://github.com/BrucePayton/dsh-plugin-graphgpt/releases/tag/v0.1.0

### What it provides

The plugin registers `graphgpt_workflow` with three declarative actions:

- `validate` — GraphGPT JSON diagnostics
- `inspect` — normalized graph structure
- `run` — workflow execution with JSON state input

This creates a bridge from the Harness agent/tool runtime to GraphGPT generated LangGraph workflows and the broader LangChain ecosystem.

### Safety boundary

The model cannot provide a command, CLI flags, environment, or working directory. Deployment owners configure the executable and workflow root. Requested workflows must remain beneath that root after realpath/symlink resolution and must be regular YAML files. Execution uses `shell: false`, propagates cancellation, and enforces timeout plus combined output bounds. GraphGPT module allowlists remain in effect.

### Verification

The v0.1.0 CI and local clean-install suite cover native DSH tool registration, argv behavior, traversal/symlink escape rejection, and a real GraphGPT 0.8.0 workflow with a Python node. Documentation is available in English and Chinese.

The repository carries the `dsh-plugin` topic requested by the contribution guide. Feedback on compatibility and the tool contract is welcome. This is a community project and is not an official DeepSeek product.

discussions.title: DSH | dsh-web-search-free | 零模型 token 的多引擎免费 Web 搜索/抓取通道
discussions.body: > 非官方项目，由社区成员独立开发和维护。 > Unofficial project, independently developed and maintained by a community member. **项目地址 / Project URL** - GitHub: https://github.com/MochiNek0/dsh-web-search-free - npm: https://www.npmjs.com/package/dsh-web-search-free --- **项目介绍 / Introduction** 一个 dsh 的 `web` 能力通道插件，把默认的 `deepseek-official` 搜索/抓取通道替换成**多引擎 + 自动 fallback** 的通道：你填哪些引擎的 API Key，它就按你排的顺序依次尝试，前一个失败或额度耗尽会自动落到下一个；同一引擎也能填多个 Key（每行一个）按顺序轮换。所有检索由 dsh 宿主进程（Node）直接发往各引擎，不经过官方搜索后端、也不经过任何 LLM；浏览器侧只有一张设置卡片，不发任何网络请求。装上即接管 web 搜索/抓取，卸载（并重启 dsh）后回落到默认通道，无需手改 profile。`web_fetch` 工具可在卡片里开关——开关即挂载/卸载该工具，不是留着它报错。 A `web` capability channel plugin for dsh that replaces the default `deepseek-official` search/fetch channel with a **multi-engine + automatic fallback** one: provide API keys for whichever engines you choose, and it tries them in the order you arrange; if one fails (or runs out of quota) it falls through to the next. A single engine may carry multiple keys (one per line), rotated in order. All retrieval is issued by dsh's host process (Node) straight to each engine — never through the official search backend, never through an LLM; the browser side holds only the settings card and issues no network requests. Installing takes over web search/fetch; uninstalling (plus a dsh restart) reverts to the default channel, no manual profile edits. The model-facing `web_fetch` tool can be toggled from the card — the switch mounts/unmounts the tool rather than leaving it to fail. --- **为什么叫 "free" —— 和官方通道的计费差异 / Why "free": the billing difference** dsh 默认的官方通道 `deepseek-official` **不是专用搜索端点**：每次搜索都发起一次**完整的 Messages 模型调用**（带原生 `web_search` 服务端工具），由 DeepSeek 在服务端执行搜索。所以每次搜索烧两份 token：① 辅助搜索请求本身（一次完整模型轮次，input + output，`maxTokens` 默认 4096）；② 解析出的 sources 回灌进对话上下文，作为对话 token 一直重发到压缩。两份都从 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` 余额扣。 The default official channel `deepseek-official` is **not a dedicated search endpoint**: every search issues a **full Messages model call** (with the native `web_search` server tool), and DeepSeek runs the search server-side. So each search burns two sets of tokens — (1) the auxiliary search request itself (a complete model turn, input + output, `maxTokens` defaults to 4096), and (2) the parsed sources injected back into the conversation context and resent as conversation tokens until compaction. Both are charged against your `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` balance. 本插件走各引擎的**专用检索端点**（Tavily `/search`、Exa `/search`、Jina `s.jina.ai` 等），纯检索，不碰任何 LLM： | | 官方 `deepseek-official` | 本插件 `web-search-free` | |--|--|--| | 检索方式 | 一次完整 LLM 调用 + 服务端搜索工具 | 直接调各引擎专用检索端点 | | 模型 token | 每次搜索都烧（input + output） | **0**（纯检索，不碰任何 LLM） | | 计费来源 | DeepSeek API 余额 | 各搜索 API 自身额度（多数有免费层） | | 凭据 | **必须** `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY` | 各引擎各自的 API Key | > 还有个容易踩的坑：官方通道**强制依赖 `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`**。如果你对话模型走第三方渠道（自建 provider、中转站等），很可能根本没配这个 key，而官方 provider 的 `available()` 只检查"有没有 key 解析器"（永远有），所以 dsh 照常选中它，**直到模型真调用 `web_search` 才抛 `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING`**，UI 上看不出问题。本插件不依赖任何 LLM 凭据。 > > One more trap: the official channel **hard-requires `DEEPSEEK_API_KEY`**. If your conversation model runs through a third-party route, you likely never configured that key — and the official provider's `available()` only checks whether _a key resolver exists_ (one always does), so dsh selects it as usual and **only throws `WEB_PROVIDER_CREDENTIAL_MISSING` once the model actually calls `web_search`**. Nothing in the UI hints at it. This plugin needs no LLM credential at all. --- **支持的引擎 / Supported engines** | 引擎 | 搜索 | 抓取 | 获取 API Key | |--|:--:|:--:|--| | Jina AI | ✓ | ✓ | https://jina.ai/api-key | | Exa (Metaphor) | ✓ | ✓ | https://dashboard.exa.ai/ | | Tavily | ✓ | ✓ | https://app.tavily.com/ | | Firecrawl | ✓ | ✓ | https://www.firecrawl.dev/ | | Brave Search | ✓ | ✗ | https://api-dashboard.search.brave.com/register | > Brave 没有 URL 抓取端点，只在搜索链里；若只配了 Brave，抓取链为空会报错，请再配一个支持抓取的引擎。 --- **与 DSH 的集成方式 / How it integrates with DSH** - 注册为 dsh 的 `web` 能力通道（同时提供 `searchProvider` 与 `fetchProvider`，id 均为 `web-search-free`），盖过 `dsh-base` 里钉死的 `deepseek-official`。 - 作为 dsh **bundle 层**安装（声明 `dsh.bundle.patch`）：`dsh plugin` 装上即自动对账 bundle 栈、接管 web 搜索/抓取，无需手改 profile。 - 自带 Web 设置卡片（设置 → 插件 → **Web Search Free**）：可拖动排序、逐个填 Key、开关 `web_fetch`，配置存进 dsh 设置命名空间 `web-search-free`，保存即生效无需重启。 Registers as a dsh `web` capability channel (providing both `searchProvider` and `fetchProvider`, id `web-search-free`), overriding the `deepseek-official` pinned in `dsh-base`. Installs as a dsh **bundle layer** (declares `dsh.bundle.patch`): `dsh plugin` auto-reconciles the bundle stack on install, taking over web search/fetch with no manual profile edits. Ships a Web settings card (Settings → Plugins → **Web Search Free**) with drag-to-reorder, per-engine key entry, and a `web_fetch` toggle; config persists in the `web-search-free` settings namespace and applies on save without a restart. --- **安装 / Install** ```sh dsh plugin --profile web add dsh-web-search-free dsh web ``` 打开 **设置 → 插件 → Web Search Free**，逐个填 API Key、拖动调整调用顺序、保存即可。至少配一个引擎的 Key，否则会报 `No web search providers configured.` Open **Settings → Plugins → Web Search Free**, paste each engine's API key, drag to reorder the call order, and save. Configure at least one engine's key, otherwise it errors with `No web search providers configured.` --- **截图 / Screenshots** --- > 项目排序完全依据社区 Upvote。Upvote 不代表 DeepSeek 官方审核或推荐，使用第三方项目前请自行甄别。 > Projects are ranked solely by community upvotes. Upvotes do not represent an official DeepSeek review or endorsement. Please evaluate third-party projects carefully before using them.

discussions.title: [bug] `skill-filesystem` silently drops skills whose frontmatter `description` contains a colon+space ("Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings")
discussions.body:
# Title: `skill-filesystem` silently drops skills whose frontmatter `description` contains a colon+space ("Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings")

## Environment

- dsh: `0.1.1-rc.2` (`@deepseek-ai/dsh`)
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem`: `0.1.1-rc.2`
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill`: `0.1.1-rc.2`
- `yaml` (parsing dependency): `2.9.0`
- Profile: `web`, on Windows 11

## Symptom

A directory-bundle skill placed at `~/.agents/skills/<name>/SKILL.md` never appears in the session skill catalog. Calling the `skill` tool with its name returns `skill "<name>" is unknown or no longer available`. The catalog keeps working for every other skill; only this one is missing, with no error surfaced anywhere in the UI/logs.

## Precise location

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-skill-filesystem/lib/index.js`, `parseSkillFile()` (around line 664):
  - Line 670: `parsed = parseFrontmatter(raw)` — uses the `yaml` package's `parse()`.
  - Lines 669–674: the `catch` block logs `ctx.logger.warn('skill file ${path} ignored: invalid YAML frontmatter: ...')` and **returns** — the skill is silently discarded.
- The upstream failure is a `yaml@2.9.0` parse error:
  `Nested mappings are not allowed in compact mappings at line 2, column 14`
- Same as below: https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/discussions/1450

## Root cause

In a plain (unquoted) YAML scalar, the sequence `: ` (colon + space) is interpreted as a mapping key separator. Any `description:` value containing such a sequence — e.g. `description: ... Two input modes: text-to-prompt ...` — fails to parse, so the whole frontmatter is rejected via the catch block above.

Minimal repro `~/.agents/skills/repro/SKILL.md`:

```markdown
---
name: repro
description: Two modes: text-to-prompt or image-to-prompt.
---
body
```

Expected: skill `repro` appears in the catalog (it is valid YAML from the author's perspective — a quoted string would contain the same text).

Actual: the skill is ignored; the only trace is a `logger.warn` written to the host's stderr, which a normal user never sees. The session catalog (`@deepseek-ai/dsh-tool-skill/lib/index.js`, `agent/pre-step` → `ctx.skills.snapshot()`) simply has no entry for it.

## Why this is easy to trip over

Real-world `description` fields are frequently long prose (many shipped skills use 500–900 chars) and colons are common English punctuation ("Modes:", "Note:", "e.g.:"). Other consumers of the same skill directory (Claude Code, Codex, cc-switch) accepted the file fine; only dsh's YAML parse rejected it. Since the failure is silent, a user reasonably first suspects the file watcher (`git mv` rename not refreshing the catalog), platform symlinks, or the skill name grammar — all of which I checked before finding the YAML cause. The name grammar (`^[a-z0-9]+(?:-[a-z0-9]+)*$`) and `name`/`description` presence are validated with explicit warnings (see `isSkillName` and lines 679–688), but YAML parse errors are not given the same visibility.

## Suggested improvements (any subset would help)

1. **Surface ignored skills to the user.** Publish a diagnostics list (e.g. "N skills were ignored: file → reason") into the `skill-catalog` pre-step message, or at minimum include the underlying YAML message in the `skill` tool's "unknown" error.
2. **Quote on ingest, not on write.** Either have `parseSkillFile` fall back to a quoted-string coercion for the frontmatter fields, or keep the current strict parse but make the error path emit a user-visible warning with the exact reason and file path.
3. **Document it.** Add a note in the skill-format docs that frontmatter string values containing `: ` must be wrapped in quotes, since long descriptions will inevitably contain colons.

Thanks for the great tooling — happy to provide more details or a test fixture if useful.
