discussions.title: Feature request: a turn-level slot (conversation.chat.turn) for grouping a conversation turn
discussions.body:
## What I'm trying to build

I wrote an out-of-tree web UI plugin (`dsh-chat-bubbles`, tagged `dsh-plugin`) that
renders the conversation as IM-style bubbles: one user message on the right, and
the agent's whole response — assistant text + tool results + turn tail — as a single
collapsible bubble on the left. (Of course, by vibe coding.)

The motivation is a transcript problem. A long LLM reply — many tool calls, file
reads, and output — stretches a single turn very tall, and the transcript has no
way to collapse a whole turn. Finding an earlier message therefore means scrolling
a long way. Collapsing each turn as one unit keeps the transcript short and
scannable, so you can jump back to a previous message quickly instead of scrolling
through verbose tool output.

## The gap

The chat view renders a flat ordered list of business nodes (`order.map` →
`ChatNodeSeat`), each dispatched through the keyed `conversation.chat.node` slot by
`kind`. That slot is per-node (one occupant per kind), so a plugin can replace a
renderer but cannot group several nodes or wrap them in shared chrome.

There is no slot above the node level, so an out-of-tree plugin cannot express
"one turn = one collapsible unit" without re-implementing the shipped markdown /
tool / turn-tail renderers.

## Proposed: a `conversation.chat.turn` slot

Add a session-scoped single slot declared by the chat view entry:

- Slot: `conversation.chat.turn` (`single`, `scope: 'session'`)
- `ChatView` groups the flat `order` into turns (one `user`/`steering` message
  plus the following agent nodes, up to the next `user`/`steering` message)
- Owner currency:

```ts
interface ChatTurnOwnerProps {
  /** User-message node keys opening this turn, in order. */
  userKeys: readonly string[]
  /** Agent-response node keys of this turn, in order. */
  agentKeys: readonly string[]
  /** Render one node's seat. */
  renderNode: (nodeKey: string) => ReactNode
}
```

* `renderNode` is a render-prop over `ChatNodeSeat` (same precedent as `renderMessageImages` / `wrapActiveBody`), so the occupant composes the existing keyed renderers instead of re-implementing them.
*  The dispatch site passes a flat fallback, so an unoccupied slot renders exactly as today — behavior-preserving until a plugin registers it.

## Reference implementation
[https://github.com/MoonChasing/deepseek-harness/commit/50f4bcdbd04533cffa70ecb9bc418268bcf63b44](https://github.com/MoonChasing/deepseek-harness/commit/50f4bcdbd04533cffa70ecb9bc418268bcf63b44)

## Why it matters
The slot system is the sanctioned composition surface for the web UI. A turn-level seat is a natural, generic extension point: it lets any plugin (IM-style chat, thread grouping, per-turn summaries, …) treat one conversation round as a collapsible unit without forking the conversation renderer.

Happy to adjust the shape or naming if the team prefers a different contract.

discussions.title: dsh-tools: value schema DSL rejects object-level required with an unhelpful error
discussions.body:
## Summary

The value-schema DSL in `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` rejects object-level `required: [...]` in tool output/parameter schemas, and the resulting error message is not actionable for plugin authors. This caused a real third-party plugin (`dsh-memory`) to crash the whole plugin tree at boot.

## Problem

When a plugin author writes a natural JSON-Schema-style object:

```js
const OUTPUT = {
  schema: {
    type: "object",
    properties: {
      path: { type: "string" },
      content: { type: "string" }
    },
    required: ["path", "content"]   // object-level required
  }
};
```

`defineTool` throws:

```
unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL
```

The DSL only accepts requiredness declared per-property (`required: true` on each property). The error message does not tell the author what the correct form is, so they are left guessing.

## Expected behavior

Either:

1. **Accept object-level `required: [...]`** in object schemas and compile it to the per-property form (or keep it as the raw `required` array). This matches standard JSON Schema and is the most intuitive form for plugin authors.
2. **At minimum, improve the error message** to point at the supported form, e.g.:
   ```
   schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL; declare requiredness per-property with "required: true" inside "properties"
   ```

## Additional related gap

Object schemas also require `additionalProperties` to be explicitly `true` or `false`. When a plugin omits it, the error only surfaces *after* the `required` issue is fixed, which is confusing. Consider defaulting `additionalProperties` to `false` for object schemas (or documenting it clearly).

## Impact

A real plugin (`dsh-memory`, per-workspace memory tools) shipped with object-level `required` and crashed the entire plugin tree at boot:

```
Error: dsh: plugin tree failed to load:
  failed to apply loader entry include (cordis:include):
  failed to apply loader entry memory (dsh-memory):
  unsupported JSON schema: schema.required is not supported by the value schema DSL
```

The fix in the plugin was to move `required` onto each property and add `additionalProperties: false`. But the DSL's strictness and unhelpful error made this non-obvious.

## Proposed change location

`packages/core/tools` — the schema compiler in `lib/types/schema.js` (`runSchemaCompiler` / `assertAuthorKeys`).

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-tools` 0.1.0-rc.7
- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.0-rc.7
- Node.js v26.4.0

discussions.title: Model catalog lagging behind pi-ai releases: glm-5.3 unavailable on zai-coding-cn
discussions.body:
Environment

dsh 0.1.1-rc.2 (latest as of today), installed globally via npm
Provider route: zai-coding-cn (Zhipu coding plan)
Problem GLM-5.3 (released by Zhipu in mid-August) cannot be selected in the model picker for the zai-coding-cn route. The installed catalog tops out at glm-5.2.

Root cause @deepseek-ai/dsh-llm-pi-ai declares "@earendil-works/pi-ai": "^0.82.1". Under 0.x semver rules this range resolves to 0.82.x only, so even the newest dsh ships pi-ai 0.82.1 — whose zai-coding-cn catalog predates GLM-5.3. pi-ai 0.84.2 (published Aug 14) already includes glm-5.3 and glm-5.2-highspeed for this route in its builtin catalog.

Request Bump the dependency to ^0.84.2 (or track pi-ai releases more closely), so new models reach dsh users without manual config.

Workaround (for anyone hitting this): add the model explicitly under llm-pi-ai.providers.zai-coding-cn.models in ~/.dsh/settings.yaml, e.g. glm-5.3 with contextWindow: 1000000, maxTokens: 131072, compat: { thinkingFormat: zai, supportsReasoningEffort: false } — values taken from the pi-ai 0.84.2 catalog entry.

discussions.title: 【优化建议】支持沙箱提权的幂等放行（当 requestedMode 等于当前生效权限时静默通过）
discussions.body:
### 📌 问题背景与现象

在 DSH 会话处于 `danger-full-access` 全权限模式（或当前有效权限已满足模型请求的目标权限）时，部分第三方通用大模型（如 GPT 系列、Claude 系列或通过中转接入的模型），由于对工具 Schema 的过度防守习惯，在调用 `write` 或 `bash` 工具时，仍会机械地附带 `sandbox_permissions: "danger-full-access"` 与 `justification` 参数。

此时，`@deepseek-ai/dsh-sandbox` 中的 `approveEscalation` 会触发严格的 `WIDER_MODES` 校验，直接抛出异常：
``
Error: sandbox escalation to "danger-full-access" is not strictly wider than this call's current "danger-full-access" mode
``
导致正常的写文件与命令执行等操作被直接中断，破坏了 Agent 的自主执行流程。

---

### 🔍 根本原因分析

1. **缺乏权限幂等性（Idempotency）**：
   在成熟的权限系统（如 Linux `sudo`、Kubernetes RBAC）中，以已拥有的权限再次发起同等权限操作应当是**静默成功的幂等操作**。
2. **同等权限请求不应视为致命错误**：
   当 `effectiveMode === mode` 时，当前环境已经授权了该权限，无需弹出用户审批（不会造成审批疲劳），也无需抛出异常拦截。

---

### 🛠️ 建议的修复方案

在 `packages/sandbox/sandbox/src/escalation.ts` 的 `approveEscalation` 函数开头增加幂等放行判断：

``typescript
export async function approveEscalation<A, C>(request: EscalationRequest, approval: EscalationApproval<A, C>): Promise<SandboxMode> {
  const { requestedMode: mode, effectiveMode, justification, subject } = request
  // 如果请求的目标权限已由当前会话满足（例如已处于 danger-full-access），直接幂等放行，无需弹窗审批或抛错
  if (effectiveMode === mode) {
    return mode as SandboxMode
  }
  // 严格提权阶梯校验...
  if (!(WIDER_MODES[effectiveMode] ?? []).includes(mode as SandboxMode)) {
    throw new Error(sandbox escalation to "" is not strictly wider than this call's current "" mode)
  }
  // ...
}
``

---

### 🌿 已完成的代码分支与单元测试

已在 Fork 仓库中完成了代码修改与针对该场景的单元测试：
* **分支地址**：https://github.com/duyiliu/deepseek-harness/tree/fix/sandbox-escalation-idempotency
* **PR 对比视图**：https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/compare/master...duyiliu:deepseek-harness:fix/sandbox-escalation-idempotency
* **测试用例**：在 `escalation.spec.ts` 中新增了 `grants idempotently when requested mode equals effective mode without asking` 校验。

期待官方维护者的审阅与反馈！

discussions.title: BUG？:设置页无法声明模型的输入模态（图片）,并导致图片无法正常输入
discussions.body: # 设置页无法声明模型的输入模态（图片） > 记录日期：2026-08-23 > 复现环境：dsh `0.1.0-rc.8`（全局 npm 安装）+ Web GUI；核对对象：GitHub `master` 与 tag `dsh-v0.1.1-rc.2` > 触发场景：给 [screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp](https://github.com/lkh081231/screenshot-feedback-hook-mcp) 插件配一个能收图的模型，手动添加deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp并尝试发送图片 ## 问题 在 dsh 的「设置 → 模型」里**没有任何字段可以声明一个模型接受图片输入**。这个字段在`settings.yaml`里都存在（`llm-deepseek` 叫 `inputModalities`，`llm-pi-ai` 叫 `input`），但两种 provider UI界面都只能写 `id` / `name` / `contextWindow` / `maxTokens` 四个字段。 ## 后果 **一个刚发布、还没进 dsh 内置目录的多模态模型，用户在 UI 里无论怎么点都是纯文本模型**，所有图片能力（`read_image`、MCP 图片结果、把图片paste到聊天框）都会被闸门拒掉，而 UI 上只提示"当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型"。唯一出路是设置界面右上角「打开配置文件」手动修改`settings.yaml` 。 上游把「卡片只覆盖精选字段」当作**已知的、有意的取舍**写进了 README；本文记录的是这个取舍在「新模型 + 多模态」这个组合下产生的实际缺陷。 --- ## 复现 1. dsh `0.1.0-rc.8`，「设置 → 模型」新建一个自定义 provider（`api: openai-completions`，`baseURL: https://api.deepseek.com`）。 2. 在它的模型目录里「添加模型」，填 `deepseek-v4-flash-vision-exp`。 3. 展开该行的折叠区 —— 只有「上下文窗口」和「最大输出 token」两个输入框。 4. 把默认模型切到它，让 agent 截图或把图片paste到聊天框。 **期望**：模型是视觉模型，图片进上下文。 **实际**：被拒，返回一段「当前模型不支持图片，请切换支持图片的模型」的说明。UI 上没有任何地方能改变这一点。

discussions.title: 插件会话反复从侧边栏消失：detach 被当成删除广播（host/session-removed）+ 工作区记账缺口
discussions.body:
> **更新（重要）**：重新取证后确认，侧边栏反复消失的**主因**不是工作区记账，而是「闲置回收 → `session/disposed`（detach）→ 客户端把会话从列表移除」这条帧链路。工作区记账缺口是次要问题（影响分组归属）。原文的工作区分析保留在后半节。

## 问题

插件创建的会话（如 dsh-qqbot）会**反复从 Web 侧边栏消失**：刷新页面后回来，闲置一段时间后再次消失，如此循环。会话文件完好、`session.list` 始终返回它、工作区成员列表也正常——但侧边栏就是没有它。

## 主因：detach 被当成删除广播给客户端

完整链路（均可在源码中定位）：

1. 插件回收闲置会话。dsh-qqbot 的 `IdleEvictor`（默认 30 分钟）调用 `handle.dispose()`。
2. 会话注册表发出 `session/disposed`。其语义是**从实时注册表脱离（detach），不是持久删除**——磁盘日志完好（dsh-message-feedback README 亦明确："session/disposed / host/session-removed mean detach rather than durable deletion"）。
3. `dsh-host-apiproxy` 的 host 流把**每一个** `session/disposed` 翻译成 `host/session-removed` 帧推给所有客户端（`lib/index.js` 的 `host()` 流：`ctx.on("session/disposed", ...) → queue.push({ type: "host/session-removed", sessionId })`）。
4. `dsh-client-runtime` 收到该帧后，对非 subagent、且当前未被打开的会话执行 `kind:"remove"` mutation，**把会话从侧边栏列表中删除**（`handleHostEnvelope` 的 `host/session-removed` 分支）。
5. 该行只在**下一次 `refreshList()`**（重连/刷新）才回来——因为 `session.list`（磁盘扫描权威）仍然包含它。

Web 端自己创建的会话从不被闲置回收（宿主没有对它们的 evictor），所以永远不会消失；**凡自带回收循环的插件会话必然反复消失**。实测时序完全吻合：QQ 会话闲置 105 分钟（远超 30 分钟阈值）→ 侧边栏行恰好在此期间消失。

客户端对 subagent 与"当前打开中"的会话有豁免（降级为 `running:false` 保留行），但普通插件会话没有——而它们在 `session.list` 里明明是持久存在的。

## 次要问题：插件会话的工作区记账缺口（原分析，仍然成立）

即便刷新后回来，插件会话的**归属分组**也有问题：

- 宿主只在客户端 `session.create` RPC 路径调用 `workspace.attachSession`（dsh-host-apiproxy）；插件通过 `agents` 注册表创建会话，不走该路径。
- `dsh-workspace` 的认领 `bootstrap()` **仅在首次初始化**（`initialized === false`）执行，此后创建的会话永不被认领。
- 结果：插件会话只能落在侧边栏的 Ungrouped 区，而不是其 `cwd` 对应的工作区分组。

## 建议

**主因（detach 帧链路）**，任选其一：

- **A. 宿主区分 detach 与删除**：`host/session-removed` 只用于真正的删除；对已持久化会话的 detach，改发 `host/session-status(running:false)`（行保留、置灰）——与客户端对 subagent 的现有豁免行为对齐。
- **B. 帧上携带 `durable` 标志**：由宿主在发送时查询持久层，客户端对 `durable` 会话降级而非删除。
- **C. 客户端兜底**：收到 `session-removed` 时对非 subagent 会话触发一次 `session.list` 校验，仍持久存在则保留行。

**插件侧现行缓解**（无需等宿主修复）：关闭插件的闲置回收（dsh-qqbot：`sessionIdleTimeout: 0`），会话在宿主生命周期内保持存活，`session/disposed` 不再发生，侧边栏行稳定。代价是会话常驻内存，对单会话/少会话渠道可接受。

**次要问题（记账缺口）**：插件侧在创建/恢复会话后 fail-soft 地 `workspaceRegistry.create(cwd) → workspace.attachSession(sessionId)` 兜底——dsh-qqbot 已在 tencent-connect/dsh-qqbot#21 实现。

## 影响面

任何自带会话生命周期管理（闲置回收）的插件渠道（IM 桥、自动化入口等）都会撞上主因；这是平台级语义缺口，不限于 dsh-qqbot。

discussions.title: plugin --profile <name> install cannot repair a bundle entry missing from "dependencies" — the suggested fix loops forever
discussions.body:
## Summary

`dsh web` fails at boot with:

```
dsh: cannot resolve profile bundle "<pkg>" from the dsh installation or <profileDir>; run 'dsh plugin --profile <name> install' if its dependency is not installed
```

Running the exact command the error message suggests — `dsh plugin --profile <name> install` — only prints **`Already up to date`** and never repairs anything. The user is locked in a loop: boot error → suggested install (no-op) → boot error. The only practical escapes are hand-editing the manifest or deleting `~/.dsh` (which also wipes all sessions and memory).

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh` 0.1.1-rc.2 (run via npx), `@deepseek-ai/dsh-app-boot` (shipped)
- Windows 11, pnpm 11.22.0, Node 24.15.0

## Steps to reproduce

1. Profile manifest `~/.dsh/profiles/<name>/package.json` ends up in this state — a bundle entry that is **not** a dependency (e.g. removed from `dependencies` by hand, or listed directly in `dsh.profile.bundles`):

   ```json
   {
     "dependencies": { "some-plugin": "^1.0.0" },
     "dsh": { "profile": { "bundles": [
       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-base",
       "@deepseek-ai/dsh-web-app",
       "some-plugin",
       "@third-party/web-ui-all"
     ] } }
   }
   ```

2. Run `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh web` → fatal error "cannot resolve profile bundle ...".
3. Run the suggested `npx @deepseek-ai/dsh plugin --profile web install` → pnpm prints "Already up to date" (exit 0), nothing is installed, manifest unchanged.
4. Run `dsh web` again → identical error.

## Root cause

- `dsh plugin <args>` is a thin pnpm forwarder: it runs `pnpm <args>` in the profile dir, then `reconcilePlugins()` only reconciles **dependencies → bundles** (a dependency that declares `dsh.bundle` joins the layer stack; a dependency-listed name that lost the declaration leaves it). A bundle entry whose package is **not** in `dependencies` is never installed by any command — `install` is `pnpm install`, which correctly reports "Already up to date" because there is nothing to do.
- `resolveBundleDir()` resolves a bundle only from (1) the dsh installation itself (in-box packages like `@deepseek-ai/*`) or (2) `<profileDir>/node_modules` — so a third-party bundle entry that was never installed (or was pruned after its dependency was dropped) is un-resolvable, with no command to bring it back.
- The fatal error then recommends a command that, by design, cannot fix this state. This is the trap: the suggestion guarantees failure.
- Bonus: `exportsPatch()` swallows resolution failures (`catch → return false`), so `reconcilePlugins` silently treats the orphaned entry as "not a bundle" instead of surfacing the missing package.

## Suggested fix

1. **Error message**: in `resolveBundleDir`'s failure, suggest the actual repair:
   `dsh plugin --profile <name> add <package>` (installs it as a dependency and reconciles it into `bundles`) — or "remove the entry from `dsh.profile.bundles` in <profileDir>/package.json".
2. **Better**: after a successful `pnpm install`, have `reconcilePlugins`/install also validate every `dsh.profile.bundles` entry is resolvable from the installation **or** the profile node_modules, and print one actionable warning (with the exact command) for missing ones — never a silent no-op.
3. **Even better**: `dsh plugin --profile <name> install` could offer to install bundle-listed-but-not-depended packages automatically (they are declared as wanted layers after all).

## Impact

First-run / advanced-user experience on the official web profile path; the current suggested workaround (delete `~/.dsh`) destroys session history, memory and settings, which is disproportionate for a recoverable manifest state.

discussions.title: [Bug] pnpm run build 静默退出，5 个 CLI 脚本入口不执行（Node 24.0.x import.meta.main 兼容问题）
discussions.body:
## 现象

- 环境：Windows，Node v24.0.0，tsx 4.23.12
- 执行 `pnpm run build`，瞬间结束，无任何输出。不报错，退出码 0。但没有任何构建产物，`.dsh-build/client-build-environment.json` 也不存在。
- 同样症状影响 `pnpm run check:all`、`pnpm run verify-cordis-config`、`pnpm run verify-doc-site-fragments`、`pnpm run verify-runtime-closure` 等脚本。全部都是**静默退出 exit 0**。

## 根因

Node.js bug [#58660](https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/58660) ：**`import.meta.main` 在 TypeScript 入口文件下返回 `undefined`**。Node 24.2.0 才修复，但本仓库 [package.json](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness/blob/master/package.json) 声明的 `engines.node: "^22.19.0 || >=24.0.0"` 允许使用 24.0.x。

本项目 5 个脚本用 `if (import.meta.main)` 作为 CLI 入口 guard：

| 脚本 | 作用 | 调用位置 |
|---|---|---|
| `scripts/build.ts` | 根 build 入口 | `pnpm run build` |
| `scripts/run-gates.ts` | 所有 check:* 聚合脚本 | `pnpm run check:all`、`pnpm run check:ci` |
| `scripts/verify-cordis-config.ts` | Cordis 配置校验 | `pnpm run verify-cordis-config` |
| `scripts/verify-doc-site-fragments.ts` | 文档站点片段校验 | `pnpm run docs:build` 内部调用 |
| `scripts/verify-runtime-closure.ts` | runtime 闭包校验 | `pnpm run verify-runtime-closure` |

在 Node 24.0.x 上，guard 条件永远是 `false`，`main()` 没被调用，脚本直接跑完模块求值、退出 0，**看上去什么都没执行**。

`engines.node` 已经声明支持这一范围，所以用户按声明使用 Node 24.0.x 是合理的，属于仓库真实 bug。

## 复现步骤

```bash
node --version           # v24.0.0（< 24.2 即可复现）
pnpm run build           # 瞬间返回，终端只剩 PS 提示符
echo $LASTEXITCODE       # 0
Test-Path apps/web/dist/index.html   # False（没产物）
```

再单独执行其中一个脚本观察：

```bash
node --import tsx scripts/verify-cordis-config.ts
# （无任何输出，exit 0）
```

## 修复方案

把 `if (import.meta.main)` 替换为跨版本兼容的入口检测：

```ts
import { pathToFileURL } from 'node:url'

const entryUrl = process.argv[1] === undefined ? '' : pathToFileURL(process.argv[1]).href
if (import.meta.url === entryUrl) main()
```

- 兼容 Node 22 / 24.0.x / 24.2+ 全范围
- `pathToFileURL()` 而非模板字符串，避免安装路径含空格、`#`、`?`、`%` 时百分号编码不匹配（参考 [cyberuni/cyberplace#272](https://github.com/cyberuni/cyberplace/issues/272) ）

## 本地修复验证

修复后再次运行其中最轻量的脚本：

```bash
node --import tsx scripts/verify-cordis-config.ts
# verify-cordis-config: 130 config files passed. ✅
```

5 个脚本全部正常执行。commit + pre-push hook（完整 typecheck + build）通过。

## 补丁文件

附带修复补丁（5 files changed, +15 insertions, -5 deletions）：
```diff
(附件：0001-fix-scripts-replace-import.meta.main-guard-with-path.patch)
```

## 相关链接

- Node 上游 bug：[nodejs/node#58660](https://github.com/nodejs/node/issues/58660) — `import.meta.main` 在 TS 入口下失效
- 类似静默 exit 0 模式的详细分析：[cyberuni/cyberplace#272](https://github.com/cyberuni/cyberplace/issues/272) （含 `file://` 模板字面量百分号编码陷阱的踩坑记录）

[0001-fix-scripts-replace-import.meta.main-guard-with-path.patch](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/31336858/0001-fix-scripts-replace-import.meta.main-guard-with-path.patch)

discussions.title: Bug: Failed tool call causing session dead lock
discussions.body:
# Bug: failed tool image result hard-aborts the turn and is replayed on every "continue", so the session can never recover

## Summary

When a `read_image` tool result carries an image that the LLM provider rejects
(in this case LM Studio returns `400 "'url' field must be a base64 encoded image."`
for a WebP data URI), DSH:

1. Converts the provider error into a **hard turn-level error** (`turn/end reason:
   "error"`) instead of returning it to the model as a **failed tool result**
   (`is_error: true`), so the model never gets a chance to recover (e.g. re-encode
   to PNG and retry).
2. On a subsequent "继续" (continue), **replays the interrupted state verbatim** —
   including the rejected image still sitting in the tool-result context — so the
   very first model call of the resumed turn fails with the **identical** error
   again. DSH does not even issue a fresh LLM request; it errors before producing
   any tokens. This repeats forever; the conversation is effectively dead.

## Environment

- DSH v0.1.1-rc.2, Windows.
- Provider: local LM Studio, model `ornith1.5-9b` (a VLM).
- Trigger: `read_image` on an image DSH re-encodes to WebP (e.g. a PNG carrying a
  text comment chunk). LM Studio's OpenAI-compat endpoint rejects `image/webp`.

## Reproduced

Session `session-c62bdc04-464e-46f2-967e-f78d47076aa4` (user title
"上个会话本来是要画个……").

### Turn 2 — the failure (session event `seq`s)

```
seq 3601  step 4  finish kind="tool-calls"   # model calls read_image
seq 3603  tool/call                           # read_image issued
seq 3604  tool/result                          # returns an image (WebP) into context
seq 3607  step 5  usage inputTokens=0 outputTokens=0
seq 3608  step 5  finish kind="error" failure={
             "message": "400 \"'url' field must be a base64 encoded image.\"",
             "code": "INVALID_REQUEST" }
seq 3610  turn/end reason="error"             # HARD turn abort, error NOT returned to model
```

The provider rejected the image the moment the model's next step tried to send it.
Instead of feeding this back as a failed `tool_result`, DSH aborts the whole turn.

### Turns 3/4/5 — "继续" replays the dead state (each ~87 minutes apart)

```
seq 3612  turn/start (turn 3)
seq 3616  step 1 usage inputTokens=0 outputTokens=0
seq 3617  step 1 finish kind="error"  failure={ same 400 INVALID_REQUEST }
seq 3619  turn/end reason="error"

seq 3621  turn/start (turn 4)  -> seq 3626 error (same 400) -> seq 3628 turn/end error
seq 3630  turn/start (turn 5)  -> seq 3635 error (same 400) -> seq 3637 turn/end error
```

User messages between turns: `继续，去读_im2.png` (turn 3), `继续` (turn 4),
`继续` (turn 5). Note that **none of turns 3-5 produced a `request/header` event**:
DSH never makes a fresh model call. It reconstructs the conversation (which still
contains the rejected WebP image in the tool-result context), attempts the first
model step, and fails with the exact same provider error before generating any
tokens.

## Root cause

Two coupled problems:

1. **Provider/tool errors are escalated to a hard turn abort instead of a failed
   tool result.** The model never sees "read_image/that image failed with
   <error>", so it cannot adapt (e.g. strip metadata, re-save as PNG, or skip the
   image and proceed).
2. **"继续" replays the failed turn's full message history unchanged.** The
   rejected image stays in context, so every resumed first step reproduces the
   exact same provider 400. Because the error is a turn-level abort (not a
   recorded tool error), there is no "recover from the failure" path — the state
   is re-sent as-is and dies at the same point.

## Expected behaviour

- A failed tool call (provider rejection of tool output) should be returned to the
  model as a **`tool_result` with `is_error: true`** containing the error message,
  so the model can decide how to recover. Only genuinely unrecoverable conditions
  should abort the turn.
- On "继续"/resume after an interrupted failed tool call, DSH should **not blindly
  re-send the failed tool output** that the provider already rejected. It should
  either drop/neutralize the failed tool result, surface the previous error to the
  model, or otherwise allow the resumed turn to make a fresh decision instead of
  looping on the identical provider rejection.

## Impact

- Any provider rejection of a tool result (image format, oversized content, tool
  schema) turns into a permanent session hang: the model can never recover, and
  "继续" is useless because the failing input is replayed forever.
- In this case the underlying WebP rejection is an LM Studio limitation, but the
  session-death behaviour above is provider-agnostic and is the real bug worth
  fixing independently of the WebP issue.

## Suggested area

- Tool-result error propagation (feed provider/tool errors back to the model).
- Resume/replay logic for interrupted turns (drop or neutralize failed tool
  results instead of re-sending them).

discussions.title: Crash selecting OpenCodex combo models: registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function
discussions.body:
### Summary

When DeepSeek Harness (`dsh` `0.1.1-rc.2`) is pointed at an OpenCodex gateway that exposes **combo (failover-group) models**, selecting any combo model crashes the run with:

```
本轮运行失败 registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function
```

### Environment

- DeepSeek Harness: `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`
- Gateway: OpenCodex (`lidge-jun/opencodex`, GUI bundle) running locally at `127.0.0.1:10100`
- Backend route configured in dsh to point at `http://127.0.0.1:10100/v1`
- Models: OpenCodex "combos" such as `combo/fallback-free`, `combo/fallback-think`, `combo/image`

### Root cause (from harness source)

In `node_modules/@deepseek-ai/dsh-llm/lib/index.js`, `prepareCall(config, signal)` does:

```js
const registration = this.registration(config.provider);
const adapterCall = await registration.adapter.prepareCall(config.provider, config.model, signal); // line 1498
```

`config.provider` is derived from the model's `owned_by` field reported by the gateway's `GET /v1/models`. OpenCodex returns combo models with `"owned_by": "combo"`. Since `"combo"` is not a provider that dsh has registered, the auto-grouped registration's adapter lacks a `prepareCall` method, so the call throws `TypeError: registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function`.

### Why this is harness-side (not gateway)

- The same combo model works fine when called **directly** (`POST /v1/chat/completions` with `model: combo/fallback-free`) against the gateway.
- The same combo model works inside the OpenAI Codex desktop client.
- The crash only happens in dsh because it routes the dispatch adapter by the `owned_by` metadata rather than by the connection/route the user actually configured.

The transport in `dsh-llm-deepseek` (`fetch(`${connection.baseURL}/chat/completions`)`) and `resolveModel` (passes `id` through unchanged) are correct — the model id `combo/...` reaches the gateway untouched and the gateway performs failover. Only the adapter *selection* by `owned_by` is wrong.

### Suggested fix

When a model's `owned_by` does not match a registered provider, dsh should fall back to the **provider of the configured connection/route** for that model (the one the user set up to talk to the gateway), instead of crashing. In other words, `owned_by` should be advisory metadata, not an authoritative provider lookup key.

### Reproduction

1. Run OpenCodex gateway locally (`127.0.0.1:10100`) with at least one combo model configured.
2. In dsh, add a backend route pointing at `http://127.0.0.1:10100/v1`.
3. List models — combo models appear with `owned_by: "combo"`.
4. Select a combo model and send a message → `registration.adapter.prepareCall is not a function`.

### Workaround (for maintainers / users)

Until fixed, a reverse-proxy that rewrites only `owned_by` of `combo/*` models to a registered owner (e.g. `openai`) in `GET /v1/models`, while leaving the `id`/`model` unchanged, makes dsh pick a valid adapter and the gateway still performs failover.

Hello! I'd like to share **shidi** (师弟 — *"junior lab mate"* in Chinese), a scientific research workflow skill for agent IDEs (Claude Code / Codex / DSH).

Hand it a research idea, and it returns **real deliverable files** — not chat text:

- 📚 **Literature research** — multi-angle parallel reviews (one intermediate file per angle, main context never overflows), batch PDF download with honest failure reports (sans-serif: never silently skipped)
- 🧪 **Experiment design** — literature-anchored, with an explicit ✚ "flaw list" section that admits what is uncertain
- 📊 **Scientific figures & paper reading** — publication-grade guidance, 16-slot paper cards
- ✅ **Cross-verification briefs** — the raw question (verbatim) + its full output are handed to *another LLM* as a verification task, so claims get independently re-checked

- Zero dependencies · MIT · data stays local · no platform or model lock-in
- CN/EN README, demo screenshots of the deliverable structures (content redacted)

Made for the research workflows many of us actually run daily. Feedback, issues and PRs welcome!

discussions.title: dsh-zai-coding-models: use new provider models the day they ship (glm-5.3 today) + two ready branches
discussions.body:
When Zhipu ships a new model, DSH users on coding plans can use it the same day — the provider-profile escape hatch is doing exactly what it was designed for. Sharing the plugin that packages this, plus two ready-to-cherry-pick branches from the same journey.

## The story

GLM-5.3 landed on the Zhipu coding endpoints in August. The bundled pi-ai catalog (0.82.1 in current DSH) doesn't know it yet, so the model picker can't offer it. No fork, no waiting: declaring the model on the `zai-coding-cn` route's own profile — `models` list plus two compat switches — made it work immediately. That path is first-class DSH config, and it deserved to be one command for everyone:

**[dsh-zai-coding-models](https://github.com/auuduu/dsh-zai-coding-models)** ([v0.1.0](https://github.com/auuduu/dsh-zai-coding-models/releases/tag/v0.1.0)) — a single-bundle patch plugin:

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:auuduu/dsh-zai-coding-models
```

It keeps the six built-in `zai-coding-cn` models and adds `glm-5.3` (1M context / 128K output / thinking low–max). One nuance worth knowing: pi-ai's auto-detect marks Z.AI routes `supportsReasoningEffort: false`, but the coding endpoints accept `reasoning_effort` fine — the plugin sets `thinkingFormat: zai` + `supportsReasoningEffort: true`, and effort dispatch verifiably works (this GLM-5.3 bridge has been in daily use since the model shipped).

## Two branches, free to cherry-pick

Since external PRs are closed, the work sits on my fork with tests green — if any of it is useful, take it as-is:

**1. [feat/pi-ai-0.84](https://github.com/auuduu/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/pi-ai-0.84)** — bumps pi-ai 0.82.1 → 0.84.2 so glm-5.3 (and glm-5.2-highspeed) land in the bundled catalog. The compat drift gates forced a decision on every new 0.83/0.84 field, all absorbed: `baseten` thinking format, `chatTemplateArgs`, `supportsFinishReason`, `supportsThinkingTokenBudget` (offered), `supportsAdditionalTools` (withheld), `StopReason: deferred → tool-calls`, plus two behavior updates — DeepSeek routes now send `max_tokens`, and a pre-aborted caller signal arrives as an `error` event that the adapter reclassifies as `aborted`. `vitest` and `tsc -b` clean, lockfile diff is 93 lines.

**2. [feat/timem-memory](https://github.com/auuduu/deepseek-harness/tree/feat/timem-memory)** — TiMEM long-term-memory MCP integration (`packages/mcp/timem-memory`), rebased onto current master: follows the `credentials/reference-updated` event split, fixes a zh link locale, re-records bilingual pairing hashes (1005 pairs consistent). 25 tests green.

## The takeaway

The escape hatch isn't a workaround — it's the architecture carrying its weight. New provider model drops → profile declares it → plugin packages the declaration for everyone → catalog catches up whenever it catches up. Thanks for building that seam; this is what it looks like from the ecosystem side.

中文一句话：智谱新模型发布当天就能在 DSH 里用上——插件 [dsh-zai-coding-models](https://github.com/auuduu/dsh-zai-coding-models) 把 provider-profile 逃生口打包成一条命令，另附 pi-ai 0.84.2 升级与 timem-memory 集成两个测试全绿的可自取分支。

discussions.title: 【Pin & Color Plugin】dsh-pin-color：给会话侧边栏加置顶、标签页颜色和 emoji
discussions.body:
给大家分享一个自己在用的小插件：**dsh-pin-color** —— 给 DSH Web 的侧边栏会话加**置顶**、**标签页颜色**和 **emoji**。
![置顶与颜色效果:置顶的会话带 📌 前缀钉在顶部,"…" 菜单追加颜色/置顶项并展开二级置顶菜单](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/LuckVd/dsh-pin-color/main/docs/screenshot.png)


**为什么做它**：会话一多，常用的几个老是沉底，每天都要往下翻；不同项目/用途的会话混在一起也分不清。这个插件把重要的会话钉在顶部，再用颜色和 emoji 一眼区分。

**功能**（入口都在会话行右侧的官方 "…" 菜单里，新增项克隆自官方菜单模板，视觉一致）：

- 📌 **两级置顶**
  - 置顶（本组顶部）：钉在所在分组的会话列表最顶
  - 置顶（工作区全局顶部）：钉到整个工作区树最顶部（所有分组之前）
  - 多个置顶按置顶时间先后排列；已置顶的会话 "…" 菜单直接是一级「取消置顶」项（标注当前级别），一步还原到原位置
- 🎨 **会话颜色**：10 个预设色卡，作用在对话区顶部标签页（文字+下划线）和侧边栏行（左侧色条+淡色底）
- 😀 **emoji**：24 个常用表情，显示在会话名前（侧边栏行和标签页都有）；颜色/emoji 都可一键清除

**持久化**：状态由 host 半区原子写进 `$DSH_HOME/pin-color/state.json`，重启 dsh web 后置顶/颜色都还在。

**安装**（v0.1.0 预构建 tarball，无需本地构建）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile web add https://github.com/LuckVd/dsh-pin-color/releases/latest/download/dsh-pin-color.tgz
# 重启 dsh web，浏览器强刷一次（Ctrl+Shift+R）
```

也可源码安装，见 README。

**实现**：双面插件（host + browser）。浏览器半区纯 DOM 增强、不改 DSH 源码——向官方 "…" 菜单注入条目、像多级子菜单一样在菜单旁展开选择面板（带指针走廊桥接，官方菜单不收起）、置顶位移与官方重渲染对账自愈。host 半区提供同源读写路由，带原型键防护和字段校验。仓库带 host 单测 + jsdom 冒烟测试 + GitHub Actions CI，Apache-2.0 开源：

👉 https://github.com/LuckVd/dsh-pin-color

**已知限制**（README 有完整说明）：会话身份按标题文本匹配，同名会话可能错配；置顶靠 DOM 位移实现，官方侧边栏结构大改时需要同步适配。

用过的同学有任何问题/建议欢迎回帖，也可以直接去仓库提 issue 🙌

discussions.title: [Bug] Late ECONNRESET after an upgraded socket closes can terminate dsh web
discussions.body:
## Summary

`@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver@0.1.1-rc.2` removes its upgraded socket `error` listener in the socket's `close` callback. A transport error delivered after that callback, such as a late `ECONNRESET` during a browser reload or tunnel disconnect, then has no listener and is thrown as an unhandled EventEmitter error. This can terminate the entire `dsh web` process.

I found this while testing an **unofficial community plugin**, but the reproduction below uses only the official published `dsh-host-webserver` package and `@deepseek-ai/cordis`.

This appears to conflict with the package README contract: an upgraded-socket transport error should be logged and its socket destroyed, and should never exit the process.

## Environment

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver`: `0.1.1-rc.2` (current npm release)
- Also source-compared with `0.1.0-rc.8`; the relevant lifecycle is unchanged
- `@deepseek-ai/cordis`: `4.0.1`
- Node.js: `v25.4.0`
- macOS arm64

## Relevant lifecycle

The upgrade handler installs `onError`, then removes it on `close`:

```ts
socket.on('error', onError)
socket.once('close', () => {
  socket.off('error', onError)
  this.upgradedSockets.delete(socket)
})
```

Node may still deliver a queued transport error after the close callback has run.

## Minimal reproduction

Install the two published packages in an empty directory, then run:

```js
import { createConnection } from 'node:net'
import { Context, Service } from '@deepseek-ai/cordis'
import WebServer from '@deepseek-ai/dsh-host-webserver'

const ctx = new Context()
const webServer = new WebServer(ctx, { host: '127.0.0.1', port: 0 })
let upgraded

webServer.registerUpgrade({
  path: '/probe',
  handler: (_request, socket) => { upgraded = socket },
})

await webServer[Service.init]()
const client = createConnection({ host: '127.0.0.1', port: webServer.port })
await new Promise((resolve, reject) => {
  client.once('connect', resolve)
  client.once('error', reject)
})

client.write(
  'GET /probe HTTP/1.1\r\n' +
  'Host: localhost\r\n' +
  'Connection: Upgrade\r\n' +
  'Upgrade: websocket\r\n\r\n',
)

while (upgraded === undefined) {
  await new Promise(resolve => setTimeout(resolve, 5))
}

const closed = new Promise(resolve => upgraded.once('close', resolve))
upgraded.destroy()
await closed

console.log('late error listeners:', upgraded.listenerCount('error'))
upgraded.emit(
  'error',
  Object.assign(new Error('read ECONNRESET'), { code: 'ECONNRESET' }),
)
```

Observed:

```text
late error listeners: 0
Error: read ECONNRESET
Emitted 'error' event on Socket instance
```

The same probe leaves one listener and does not throw when a connection-lifetime compatibility listener is added before the upgrade.

## Expected behavior

A late transport error on a closed upgraded socket must not become an uncaught exception or terminate the Harness process. The server should remain available for subsequent HTTP and WebSocket connections.

## Suggested acceptance criteria

- Closing an upgraded socket and then delivering a late `ECONNRESET` does not throw.
- The Harness process remains alive and the web server continues serving requests.
- Existing logging and socket-destruction behavior for errors delivered before close remains intact.
- Add a focused regression test under `packages/host/webserver/tests/webserver.spec.ts`.

A possible implementation is to retain an `error` listener for the socket's full object lifetime, or replace the logging handler with a no-op listener after close. The exact ownership choice is best made by the package maintainers.

Related failure class: #3251 reports another process-fatal transport gap, but it concerns SDK stdout `EPIPE`; this report is specifically the WebServer upgraded-socket close race.

discussions.title: I built an open-source Polymarket plugin for coding-agent harnesses: 31 verified tools, embedded docs skill, live WS stream — read-only by default
discussions.body:
I kept running into the same problem: LLM agents "know" Polymarket's API from training data, and that knowledge is stale — sort fields return 422s, batch endpoints silently return empty arrays, contract addresses moved. So I built a plugin that fixes this properly instead of prompt-hacking around it.

**What it is:** `dsh-polymarket-knowhow`, a plugin bundle for DeepSeek Harness (works like MCP servers, but as native Cordis plugins — tools/skills/events mounted straight into the agent runtime).

**What you get:**
- 22 always-on market-data tools: search, events/markets discovery (offset + keyset pagination), orderbooks (single/batch), prices, composite quotes, price history, positions, holders, leaderboard, open interest, live volume, geoblock check…
- 7 opt-in trading tools (orders, cancels, balances, heartbeat, place_order) — registered only after explicit opt-in + L2 credentials; order signing delegates to the official @polymarket/clob-client SDK
- 2 Perps tools for the perpetual futures API
- An embedded "knowhow" skill: 16 markdown modules distilled from official docs + my own live verification, so the agent stops hallucinating endpoints
- Optional WebSocket bridge streaming book/price_change/trade events into the agent's event bus

**How I verified it** (the part I actually care about):
- Cross-checked ~140 operations against official OpenAPI snapshots
- Probed production APIs live — which caught real drift: camelCase sort fields (`volume_24hr` → HTTP 422), CLOB batch endpoints requiring FLAT arrays (`{params:[...]}` silently returns `[]`), `/live-volume?id=` vs `?event=`, geoblock living on polymarket.com, moved exchange contracts
- Ran 3 independent review agents (packaging, endpoint-vs-spec audit over ~40 ops, adversarial test review); fixed everything; suite is now 28 unit + 11 live tests, all green
- Boot-verified end-to-end in a real profile: tools executed against production through the registry (search returned live markets, perps tickers/BBO worked, 17 WS events flowed in 45s)

Read-only by default. MIT. Install one line:
`dsh plugin --profile my-profile add github:fashionmascherine-svg/dsh-polymarket-knowhow`

Repo: https://github.com/fashionmascherine-svg/dsh-polymarket-knowhow

Feedback welcome — especially endpoint drift reports if something changed again (Polymarket moves fast).

discussions.title: [Bug] SSE tool_calls delta 解析未防御空字符串 id/name，导致第三方供应商流式响应解析失败
discussions.body:
## 问题描述

`dsh-llm-deepseek` 的 SSE 流式解析器在解析 `tool_calls` delta 时，遇到空字符串 `id` 和 `name` 字段会覆盖已经收到的正确值，导致工具调用链断裂。

## 根因分析

在 `packages/llm/deepseek-adapter/src/index.ts`（编译后 `lib/index.js`）的 SSE 解析逻辑中，`tool_calls` delta 处理代码仅检查 `!== void 0`：

```typescript
if (call.id !== void 0) block.callId = call.id;
if (call.function?.name !== void 0) block.name = call.function.name;
```

当第三方供应商（如 SenseNova/商汤日日新）在流式响应后续 chunk 中返回 `id:""` 和 `name:""` 时，这些空字符串通过了 `!== void 0` 检查，覆盖了第一个 chunk 中已经解析到的正确值（`callId: "call_xxx"`, `name: "read_file"`）。导致后续第二轮请求（回传 tool result）发送空字段，服务端返回 400 错误。

## 影响范围

- 使用非标准 OpenAI 兼容供应商（流式返回空字符串 id/name）的用户
- 工具调用完整链路中断，Agent 无法继续执行
- 报错信息：`"invalid tool_call function, function/name/arguments cannot be empty"`

## 复现步骤

1. 配置一个 OpenAI 兼容的第三方供应商（如 SenseNova token.sensenova.cn）作为 deepseek-official provider 的后端
2. 发送带 `tools` 参数的流式请求
3. 触发工具调用，观察 SSE 后续 chunk 包含 `id:""` 和 `function.name:""`
4. Agent 在第二轮请求时报 400 错误

## 修复建议

在 `call.id` 和 `call.function?.name` 的条件判断中增加空字符串排除：

```typescript
if (call.id !== void 0 && call.id !== "") block.callId = call.id;
if (call.function?.name !== void 0 && call.function.name !== "") block.name = call.function.name;
```

## 环境

- `@deepseek-ai/dsh@0.1.1-rc.2`
- 上游供应商：SenseNova (token.sensenova.cn) / 任何流式返回 `id:""` 和 `name:""` 的 OpenAI 兼容 API
- Node.js v25.6.0

discussions.title: A reproducible issue with persisted named SDK sessions after a full runtime restart
discussions.body:
I found a reproducible issue with persisted named SDK sessions after a full runtime restart. A fresh JSON-RPC runtime recreates the existing session instead of resuming its durable history, which later causes persistence/checkpoint synchronization to fail.

I prepared a minimal fix that reuses DSH's existing `agents.resume()` and persistence semantics, together with package-level and real two-process keyless regression coverage. The regression fails on the current upstream revision and passes with the patch.
